rgyud/ a (9༷)2689 'jam dbyangs smra ba'i seṅge'i sgrub thabs/ 3rje btsun dam pa rgya gar gyis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(7) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(7)2690 'jam dpal ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/ 8rdo rje rnal 'byor mas gsungs/bsdur mchan/(13) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(13)2691 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i spyan dbye ba'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ ༷ 14sta gon gnas pa'i cho ga 14rab gnas dngos gzhi/ 241

rjes kyi chos/ 35slob dpon ra po smri ti dzha na ghir tis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(38) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(39)2692 'jam pa'i dbyangs dpa' bo gcig grub pa'i bstod pa gser gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba/ 40slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad/bsdur mchan/(go) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(dzi)2693 a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs/ 46slob dpon r+sā po mi pham bshes gnyen gyis mdzad/lhag pa'i lha 'di nyid kyis mngon sum du byin gyis brlab pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta r+sā po 1ba na rat+na'i zhal snga nas kyi bka' drin las/legs par sbyar ba'i skad kyi cha shas rig pa dge slong rgya mad+ku sdes 'gyur rnying las cung zad bcos shing /rgya dpe'i rkang pa dang mthun par bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(go) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(go)2694 'phags pa yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs/ 50slob dpon ra po dpal mar me mdzad kyis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(52) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(52)

2695 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i sgrub thabs/ 53kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya ṭībha tras mdzad/rgya gar shar phyogs na dza kata ta li'i paṇ+ḍi ta dpal rnyi bu ta tsan+d+ra dang / blo bo lots+tsha ba dge slong shes rab rin chen gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(59) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(59)2696 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i sgrub thabs/ 60rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal nyi bu ti tsan+d+ra'i zhal snga nas gsungs/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i byin gyis brlabs pa dpal rnyi bu ti ci 'i zhal snga nas blo bo lots+tsha ba dge slong shes rab rin chen gyis zhus te legs par gnang /bsdur mchan/(62) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(62)2697 don yod zhags pa'i sgrub thabs mdo las bsdus pa/ 63slob dpon lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po don yod rdo rje dang /bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(66) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(66)2698 dpal 'jig rten mgon po mkha' la spyod pa'i sgrub thabs chenas dra/ ba/ 673

grub chen pad+ma 'byung gnas zhabs kyis mdzad/rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po 1ba na rat+na'i zhal snga nas dang /chos 'khor lots+tsha bas bsgyur ba las/ slad kyi btsun pa rgya mtshos dag par bcos shing gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(72) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(72)2699 'jig rten dbang phyug gi bstod pa rin po che'i phreng ba/ 73rgya gar shar phyogs kyi pani ta chen po nags kyi rin po che'i zhal snga nas mdzad/de nyid kyis spyan sngar/ dge slong rgya mtsho'i sdes bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(78) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(78)2700 (sde65thag spyadangs/re /thothag (1 cesathag rngam tshob 79slob dpon chen po bsod snyoms pas bshad/rje btsun shar phyogs pa nithā ṇa ༷'i zhabs dang / kun dga' snying po 7 ra tsā thas bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(92) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(92)2701 6ba ma/ ba6de pa/:re skyabazug ngab/ ba(1ba/sa (〈/ / 93slob dpon dwa rka ra pos gsung bar mdzad/༅ dga' snying pos bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(95) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(95)

2702 phyag na rdo rje gtum po chen po khros pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ 96slob dpon klu sa kyis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(101) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(101)2703 gnod sbyin sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi bsgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 102bsten pa'i rim pa/ 102bdag bar+sā pa'i rim pa 102mchod rten bskyed pa'i rim pa 105bzlas pa'i rim pa 105bsgrubapa'irim pa/ 106dkyil 'khor bri ba'i rim pa 106bsgrub pa'i rim pa dngos/ 107las la srur ba'i rim pa/ 108rjes kyi rim pa/ 110slob dpon ra po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po snyi paṃ ka ra 1tshwa na dang / zhu ra gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong rin ra bzang pos bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(111) bsdur r+ṣas re'u mig(112)2704 rdo rje 'dzin pa phyag na rdo rje'i las bsgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba 113'khor lo'i rim pa/ 11na5

bzugang ba/re parashesazab /tha 113ba11ga pa:re par/bozang /tha 115:sngathabatham /kye 1 sgyu / /pa 115ting nge 'dzin gyi rim pa/ 116bsrung ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ 116bsad pa'i nying nge 'dzin/ 116rnal yor pa nyir ya shris mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta rnyi paṃ ka ra dzi1 na dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong rin ra bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus/bsdur mchan/(118) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(118)2705 rdo rje gtum po'i sgo nas phyir bzlog pa'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba/119slob dpon las kyi rdo rjes mdzad/bsdur mchan/(12na) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(12 )2706 spru ṇi sha sngags kyi man ngag gi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 124sbyi don dang po/ rtogs pa lta bas bsrung ba/ 124sbyi don gnyis pa/ rten 'azel jas kyi bsrung ba/ 125phyi ri rab bca' lugs/ 125nang 'khor lo bca' lugs/ 127sbyi don gsum pa/ drag sngags nus pas bsrung ba/ 129'khor lo phur dgod sngags/ 129ba/bas pa 15sa kyi sngags/ 131slob dpon dzising ngas mdzad/rgya gar gyi pan gyi ta de nyid dang /bod

kyi lo tsa ba bai ro tsa nas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(133) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(12na)27༷7 rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ 134rgya gar gyi mkhan po rdo rje go chas mdzad/lots+tsha ba rin r+sā bzang pos bsgyur cing gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(1go) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1go)27༷8 11'ab zug cesazab ——na skyab:re (1ba thabs/ 150paṇ+ḍi ta r+sā po sa ha dza shrīs mdzad/kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ku mā ra 1bha tra dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba nam mkha' bzang pos bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(157) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(157)2709 sgol ma u gra'i mchod pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ 158rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan po shri sha ri pu tra ma hā ga mi'i zhal mnga' nas mdzad de/rang 'a⑫ du bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(16༷) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(160)2710 sgol ma dmar mos 'gro ba dbang du bsdu ba'i 'khor /yo/re /cho can /zhe/ma /rgya /ba 161rdo rje gdan pa bsod snyoms pas mdzad/bsdur mchan/(16na) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(163)7

2711 sngags kyi don 'jug pa/ 164slob dpon di paṃ ka ra 11 nas mdzad/bsdur mchan/(168) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(168)2712 dbang gi man ngag 169ti paṃ ka ra 1dzha nas mdzad/bsdur mchan/(172) bsdur r+ṣas re'u mig(172)2713 dmatshig sbas pa/ 17 te paṃ ka ras mdzad/bsdur mchan/(176) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(176)2714 gzhal yas khang sbyin pa/ 177bsdur mchan/(18 ) bsdurar+ṣas re'u mig(180)2715 chu gtor gyi cho ga 181bsdur mchan/(18 ) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(182)2716 sbyin sreg gi cho ga 184bsdur mchan/(187) bsdur r+ṣas re'u mig(197)2717 lha mchod pa'i rim pa 188bsdur mchan/(191) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(191)

2718 tshe bsgrub pa'i thabs 192bsdur mchan/(194) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(194)2719 'chib slu ba/ 195bsdur mchan/(197) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(197)2720 'chi ka ma'i bstan chos/ 198bsdur mchan/(201) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(201)2721 ro bsreg pa'i cho ga 202bsdur mchan/(205) bsduralngos re'u mig(205)2722 bdun tshigs kyi cho ga 2 6bsdur mchan/(209) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(2༷9)2723 tshawaṃcho ga 210slob dpon r+sā po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po ) paṃ ka ra 1dzha na dang / bod kyi lo tsha ba gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis sgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(213) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(213)

2724 'phags ma lha mo sgrol ma la bstod pa mu tig 'phreng ba zhes bya ba/ 214slob dpon ra po tsan tra go mi 'am 'chi med zla bas 'dzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po te paṃ ka ra 1dzha na'i zhal snga nas bod kyi ban dhe sgra bsgyur gyi lots+tsha ba nag tso rdzo khrims rgyal bas bsgyur zhing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(219) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(219)2725 'phags ma lha mo sgrol ma'i bstod pa/ 220slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(222) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(222)2726 'phags ma sgrol ma la bstod pa smon lam grub pa zhes bya ba/ 223slob dpon r+ṣa po tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(225) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(225)2727 bcom ldan 'das 'phags ma sgrol ma la bstod pa zhes bya ba 226shākye dge slong dad byed go cha rin ra zhes bya bas mdzad/lots+tsha ba rig pa'i khu byug gis bsgyur zhing legs par gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(229) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(229)2728 'phags ma sgrol ma 'jigs pa chen po brgyad las sgrol 10

ba'i bstod pa/ 230slob dpon dpal btsun zla ba'i zhal snga nas mdzad/bsdur mchan/(232) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(232)2729 'phags ma sgol ma la bstod pa/ 233slob dpon mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad/kha 7 mkhan po byud ta ka ra bar ma dang / lo tsa ba dge slong chos kyi ye shes kyis bsgyur zhing zhus/bsdur mchan/(235) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(235)27na0 'phags ma sgrol ma la bstod pa/ 236slob dpon a sgo skya badz+ras mdzad/bsdur mchan/(239) bsdur lngos re'u mig(239)27 1 dam tshig sgrol ma la bstod pa/ 240slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin thob pa des mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po mar me mdzad grags pa dang / lots+tsha ba tshur pra ba ka ras bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(2spre) bsdura'abras re'u mig(24)2732 bde ba'i 'byung gnas dpal ldan rje btsun ma la bstod pa bzhugs so/ / 2dzi'adi mar yongs su grags pa rin po ྾ gsungs/11

bod kyi sgra bsgyur gyi lots+tsha ba gnyan dge slong dharma sa rang 'a⑫ du gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(251) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(252)2733 thams cad grub pa dpal 'phel lha mo la slob dpon klu (1ba spyi)sa ba/sted pa ba(1ba/sa 〈〈// 253bsdur mchan/(255) bsdura'abras re'u mig(255)2734 rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la kha che nyi ma sbas pas tshob/stotshod 25 /ba(nuthab/25 res/ / 256kha che nyi ma sbas pas mdzad/bsdur mchan/(259) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(259)2735 'phags ma sgro'ab ma6) bkra shis pa/ 260paṇ+ḍi ta sur+ya sri dang / lots+tsha ba longs sa dge slong tshul khrims rtsags kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(263) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(263)2736 seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma la bstod pa/ 264slob dpon 'phags pa klu grub kyis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(267) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(267)2737 'phags ma sgrol ma'i mtshan nges pa zhes bya ba/ 26812

mtshan nges par zhes bya ba shan sbyar tshigs lhug tu byas pa/ 268mtshan rnams sdebs nas tshigs bcad du byas pa/ 269bsdur mchan/(271) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(271)2728 tshe dpag tu med pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ 272ye shes kyi mkha' 〈 ma grub pa'i rgyal mos mdzad/bsdur mchan/(280) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(280)2739 tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ces bya ba/ 281rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta zla ba bzang po dang /bod kyi lots+tsha ba glan dar ma rdzo khrims kyis bsgyur zhing zhus te dag par byas/bsdur mchan/(296) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(296)2740 bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ 297bsnyen pa/ 297sa'i cho ga bsnyan pa/ 298sa brtag pa/ 298sa blang ba/ 298sa sbyang ba/ 3༷0sa byin gyis brlab pa/ 300snya gon gyi cho ga bsnyan pa/ 30013

lha lhag par gnas pa/ 00bum pa lhag par gnas pa/ 30 sbyin sreg lhag par gnas pa/ 304sa'i lha mo lhag par gnas pa/ 304slob ma lhag par gnas pa/ na05dkyil 'khor chen po'i cho ga bsnyan pa/ 3091—ba/ ngesazug (1 2ba/ 209slob dpon bdag nyid sgrub cing dbang blang ba/ na10slob ma dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa/ 310slob ma dbang bskur ba/ 317(1zug tshogabang / 317dig gzhi dadad spru ga na ba/ 317sgad ban du 2chi ne+ed zhe she gdun ma ju nad ga da ga de ṣe haid spyi dbad ba ra ba gshad ga/ na19de gnad gshad ga/ 325rngonathabapa tshodatshobapa / 32tsa/shes rab ye shes kyi dbang / 28tshodatshobapa tshob:de ngas/ 328ye shes kyi mkha' 〈 ma grub pa'i rgyal mos mdzad/bsdur mchan/(230) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(na21)2741 khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba'i bsgrub pa'i thabs 2slob dpon dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(339) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(340)14

27tso mi g.yoba'i 'khor lo/ 41paṇ+ḍi ta chos kyi rdo rje dang / lo tsā ba dge tso nam mkha' rdo rjes bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(lda43) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(343)2743 rtumapo'i sgrub thabs/ 34rdo je gdan pas mdzad/bsdur mchan/(3dzi) bsdura'abras re'u mig(3dzi)274 khro bo mi g.yo mgon gyi sgrub thabs/ 346paṇ+ḍi ta r+ṣa po rad na shri dzha nas phyung /bsdur mchan/(ldago) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(3go) 27ga gtum po khro bo chen po'i sgrub pa don dam pa zhes bya ba/ 350slob dpon ra po bhaṅga la'i mkhas pa/rī paṅka ra shrī 1 nas mdzad/rgya gar gyi pani ta nithā ṇa 7 zhal snga dang / ta ra nā thas bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(354) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(na54)2746 gur mgon lha bcu bdun gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so// 355sgrub thabs/ 355lha bcu gnyis ma'i khyad par dang brgyud pa/ ༷ 361slob dpon bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad/a tsa ra ra gyu la dmar po dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba gyi lngang gis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(362) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(362)15

27gye nag po chen po'i 'phrin las gsang ba'i sgrub thabs/ 6na/batshad 1 cad/ 6rdogazhung gi don/ 6 sgrub po rten gyi gang zag na6 bsgral ba'i zhing / 64ji ltar bsgrub pa'i thabs 64nad lha gaskyed ga/ 64chos skyod kasgon go gaskyed ga/ 64rten gzhal yas khang bskyed ba/ 364rten pa lha bskyed pa/ 64dam tshig mgon po bskyed pa/ 364gtso bo bskyes pa/ 64'khor bache'i pa/ 65da sdeṅged sde/ ( kyi gasnyed ga/ 365ye shes kyi mgon po dgug gzhug bya ba/ 265dbang bskur zhing gtor ma dbul ba/ na65sngags bzlas pa/ 66grud gzhi tags/ 66/batham /sbyotshad/ 66bshad par dam bca' ba/ 66las sbyor dngos/ 66bsad ga/ 6616

spyor ba/ 366dngos gzhi/ 367gnan ga/ 369rnyin gasnyeg byu da/ 369mjug yongs su rdzogs pa'i bya ba/ 369slob dpon r+sā po bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad/a tsa ra ra zu la dmar po'i gdam ngag bla ma gyi ljang gis thugs la sbas/bsdur mchan/(370) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(370)27ga dpal nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 371slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad/bod kyi lo tsā ba ga rod kyis bsgyur/rgyal tsha lung mang po dang / chos rje bsod nams kyi phyag dpe las/ yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mar gyis zhus dag bgyis pa las bshus/bsdur mchan/(373) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(373)27go zhal bzhi pa'i dam tshig dngos grub bsgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba 374rak+ṣi ta yis mdzad/gnyan po dar ma grags kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(376) bsdur 'bras re'u mig( 76)2750 dpal nag po chen po'i srog gi spu gri'i sgrub thabs/ 37717

bram ze mag sred kyis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(384) bsdura'abras re'u mig(384)2751 cadabaka mtho byebyecad thos:re /byecad rjesabaka na85slob dpon bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad/la li ta badz+ra dang / gyi ljang dbu dkar gyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(387) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(387)2752 nag po byebyen po:re gtor ma6) ཿdza ga 388slob dpon bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad/dpal 'ging ba'i rdo rje dang / gyi ljang dbu dkar gyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(390) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(390)2753 cadatha/ mas byebyecad 11 (ba /ba/stetshod ngas/ 391bram ze blo ldan mchog sred kyis mdzad/paṇ+ḍi ta tha ta ka ra warma dang / gu ru yon tan shi las bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(392) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(392)2754 nag po chen po'i bstod pa'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ 93bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta la li ta badz+ra dang /bod kyi lo tsā ba gyi ljang dbu dkar gyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(395) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(395)2755 cadabaka 11 byebyecad mas (ba ngab/stetshod ngas/ 9618

bsdur mchan/(412) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(412)2761 tshonang 'ab 2lnga ces zugab/ 34 'ab pa//stetshon nga// 413bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad/la li ta badz+ra dang gyi ljang dbu dkar gyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(416) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(416)2762 dpal lha mo nag mo la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ 417lha ma srin gyis mdzad/la li ta badz+ra dang gyi ljang dbu dkar gyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(418) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(418)2763 dpal lha mo nag mo la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ 419drang srong ke'u tri las mdzad/la li ta badz+ra dang / gyi ljang dbu dkar gyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(tso0) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(tso0)2764 dpa'ab lha ces la bstod pa cesas (1 ba/ 421bla ma mi tri pas mdzad/la li ta badz+ra dang / lo tsā ba gyi ljang dbu dkar gyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(tso2) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(tso2)2765 dpal lha ces la bstod pa stunas bya ba/ 423a bha yas mdzad/paṇ+ḍi ta sha ta ka ra wam dang / gu ru ba 20

yon tan shi las bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(tso5) bsdura'abras re'u mig(tso5)2766 dpal ldan lha mo nag mo la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ tso6nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po gser mig can gyis mdzad/paṇ+ḍi ta snying phreng can dang / lo tsā ba gyi ljang dbu dkar gyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(tso8) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(tso8)2767 'babasgyu skyabatabazug (1 ngas/stepa/ nga ngas(1ba/bzhi 〈〈/ / 429slob dpon chen po bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad/paṇ+ḍi ta shata ta ka ra warma dang / lo tsā ba rin r+sā bzang pos bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(433) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(4na3)2768 ba/cesatshon /gcad cadab/ dzes6) ngas/ste2) nga// 434slob dpon mchog sred kyis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(436) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(436)2769 dpal ldan lha mo dud sol ma'i rjes gnang bzhugs so// 437slob dpon ra po zhe sdang rdo rjes mdzad/bsdur mchan/(spre0) bsdura'abras re'u mig(40)2770 dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa'i bstod chen bzhugs so// 441bram ze rin ra rdo rjes mdzad/bsdur mchan/(44) bsdura'abras re'u mig(44)21

2771 byin kyis brlabs pa nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ snyernal yor gyi dbang byug ra po dpal ldan dzo ba ri pas mdzad/rgya gar gyi bla ma ta ya badz+ra dang / lo tsā ba tso khrims mgon gyis bsgyur/bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta de ba purna ma ti dang /lo tsā ba 'gar chos kyi bzang pos kyang bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(ske) bsdura'abras re'u mig(ā+o)2772 byin gyis brlabs pa'i nag po chen po'i gsang ba'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dzi0'phags pa klu byang gis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(dzi2) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(dzi2)2773 mi bskyod pa la brten nas mgon po'i gegs sel bla ma'i gnad sgyur/ dzi3dpal ldan sha wa ri pas mdzad/bsdur mchan/(dzi5) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(go5)2774 mgon po'i bkra shis yon tan rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ dzi6dpal sha wa ri pas mdzad/bsdur mchan/(dzi7) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(dzi7)2775 mgon po dmar po'i tshe sgrub/ dzi8bsdur mchan/(461) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(461)22

slob dpon dpal 'bir ba pas mdzad/bla ma ra po dur khrod e de bas rang 'a0 mdzad/bsdur mchan/(1281) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1281)2864 dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par dbye ba'i rab tu byed pa zhes bya ba 1282ma hā pani ta dziraza rak+ṣi ta gube+e pa ta'i zhal snga nas/ lots+tsha ba shākya'i dge slong zhang grub pa dpal bzang pos bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(1287) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1287)2865 sems rin po che sbyong bar byed pa zhes bya ba/ 1288rgyal po gyu bu tis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po di pang ka ra shi ri gnya' na dang / bod kyi lo tsa ba khu ston dngos grub kyi bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(1301) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1301)2866 rgyal ba skyed ma'i rnam par dbye ba nges par bstan pa bzhugs/ 1302slob dpon nag po'i zhabs kyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po krisna pan 'di ta dang zhu ra gyi lo tsha ba dge slong tso khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(1na71) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1 71)53

2867 mkha' 'gro ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs kyi rim pa zhes bya ba 1372sa'i cho ga'i rim pa 1372sgrub pa'i rim pa 1374sgrub pa chen po'i rim pa 1378bsnyen pa'i rim pa 1380man ngag kha bskang gi rim pa/ 1393slob dpon shan ting gar pas mdzad/u rgyan mkhan po pad+ma sam snya ba dang /bod kyi lo tsha ba be+e ro tsa nas bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(1384) bsdura'abras re'u mig(1384): dkar chag gi zur ma na/ chos sa (2710)nas (2722)bar gyi chos ga bcu gsum mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i sngags lugs bcu gsum du grags pa 'dir 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rakar chag ltar so sor byes nas bsgrigs yod/chos — (2738)'dir 〈〈sde 〉༅ dum par dpe bsdur byas zin kyang mas yod med kyi khyad yod/chos r+sā (2798)'dir 'gyur byang gnyis 'dug /chos — (2795)nag po r+sā po'i las tshogs 〈〈pe 〉〉dkar chag tu so sor byes 'dug kyang 〈〈snar 〉thastan la gzhir bzung nas gcig tu bsgrigs/chos wo (2817)dang (2829)gnyis bskyar zlos su 'khod yod/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉d+kud lhag ma'i zur ma na/ 〈〈pe 〉skosnar 〉snyo na la rgyud dgyes pa rdo rje'i chos skor kyi lapod dang / rgyud phagasar bcug dbang dang grol byed rim gnyis cha lag nyer mkho sna tshogs kyi skor gyi rgyud 'a nas labar pod bcu bzhi ste bsdoms pod bco lnga bzhugs pa las/ 〈chu 〉sko〈co 〉rang dpe sdur byed chog pa phud pa'i chos ྾ rnams/ 〈snar bstan 〉thas bsdur gzhi dang 〈〈pe bstan 〉8sa zur blta'i par ma byas te/ dpe bsdur zhus nas dpar du bskrun pa yin/ spyir 〈zhape bsdur ma 〉thadi nyid 〈she bstan 〉phro gzhir bzung nas bsgrigs shing / pod rtags dang thod yig rnams kyang 〈she bstan 〉ltar song yod pas gong gi 〈〈pe 〉snga'ar 〉tsā rgyud lhag ma rnams 〈she 〉sko〈co 〉thastan 'gyur gyi rgyud 'anas mjug rdzogs pa'i 'phror mthud nas pod rtags dang thod yig rnams kyang rim par rgyud nas r+ṣabar byas te bsgrigs pa dang / 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉tha sde sa dang pod rtags — chos — so so'i bsdur lngos re'u mig tu sor bzhag byas te bkod yod/54

gsar bcug 'di dag gi gzhung rtsa ba dang mchan bu sogs gang ci'i thad nas phrad rnam dbye'i spyor tshul dang tha snyad skor la deng rabs su spyod pa'i sum rtags dag gsum dang mi mthun pa mang po mchis pa de dag dus skabs der skad gsar bcad kyis zhus ma thub pa'am lo tsā ba rnams kyi dgongs gzhi dgos pa nges can zhig yod snyam ste zhib 'jug gi gnas su ma bcos par sor bzhag byas yod/gzhan yang / pe snar rgyud lhag ma rnams kyi dbu lha phal che ba snar bstan du tshe dpag med bkod 'dug kyang / de gong du sde bstan la bzhugs zin pas/ 'dir tshe dpag med phud pa'i rgyud lhag ma'i dbu lha gzhan rnams snar bstan pod rang gi dku lha ltar dang / tshe dpag med kyi tshab tu snar bstan du bzhugs pa'i dbu lha gzhan rnams dang bdud 'joms 'jigs bral ye shes rdo rjes phyogs bsgrigs byas pa'i snga 'gyur bka' ma'i glegs bam da pa'i 〈〈rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po dpal sgyu 'phrul rtsa ba'i rgyud gsang ba snying po 〉phro bzhugs pa'i dbu lha rnams las gzhung ngam chos tshan rnams kyi nang don la gzhigs pa dang / yang na mdzad pa po dang / 'gyur ba po sogs la ci 'byor byas te bkod pa dang / mthar bstan pa 'di nyid mi nub yun gnas dang / mthun rkyen 'bad med 'byung ba'i phyir chos skyong dang nor lha'i sku brnyan re bcas bkod pa ste/ deb 'di'i rgyud hu dum pa'i dbu lha rje btsun sgol ma sngon mo snar bstan rgyud la pa dang zhus chen tshul khrims rin chen 〈 zhus chen bka' 'bum//nya pa ltar dang de bzhin rgyud u dum pa'i dbu lha tshogs bdag dmar chen/ grub thob pad+ma badz+ra snar bstan rgyud mi dum pa'i dbu lha ltar dang / rgyud ke dum pa'i dbu lha snar bstan rgyud yu dum pa'i dbu lha sogs la gzhir bzung ste bkod/

༄ga /'jam dbyangs smra ba'i seṅge'i sgrub thabs/①ga 'jam dbyangs smra ba'i seṅge'i sgrub thabs dam pa rgya gar gyis mdzad pa zha ma seng rgyal gyi 'gyur bzhugs so// ༄4/ /bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes rab 'phel bar 'dod pa yis/ /spang rgyan/ gla ba/ mtshal dkar/gsum—/ yung ba tsan dan a ka ru/ spang rgyan spos/ dbang lag /shu dag gsum / gser mdog rgya skyegs/ shing mngar thugasum/ dpa' bo bcu gnyis bsdus nas ni/ /zhib par brtags te sbrang rtsi dang / /ba dmar 'o mas ri lu bya/ /brgya dang rtsa brgyad byas nas ni/ /ri lu rnams la hri dang dhi/ /bri ba'i gnag tsha gur gum dang / /rgya skyegs ghing ba sres pas bri/ /rin chen snod du blugs byas nas/ /pad+ma ser po 'dab brgyad dbus/ /gong gi ri lu bzhag byas nas—/ /dmar ser dar gyi chur yang dbub/ /shar du kha ltas stong nyid bsgom/ /stong pa'i ngang las seng ge'i gdan/ /de stengs pad+ma zla ba'i dbus/ /yi ge dhīḥ47—3

dmar tsheg drag ① can/ /'od zer dmar po 'phro ba yi/ /de las bdag nyid 'jam dpal ni/ /sku mdog dmar po rgyan dang ldan/ /'od zer dmar po 'phro ba can / /g.yas pa ral gri g.yon pa na/ /spu ti rnams shes rgyan dang ldan/ /ral pa'i thor ④tshugs gyen du 'greng / /de ltar bdag nyid bsams nas ni/ /thugs kar rgyu las 'khor lo bsam/ /lte bar ral gri sor bzhi pa/ /rtsa ba'i sngags kyi bskor bar bsam/ /'od zer dmar pos 'phros nas ni/ /ye shes sems dpa' spyan drang bzhug /bdun gyi lhung bzed dbus su ni/ /yi ge hriḥlas dbyangs can ma/ /sku mdog sngon mo gzi brjid can/ /g.yas na ral gri g.yon spu ti/ /bsnams shing rgyan dang yang dag ldan/ /thugs kar ral gri sngags kyis bskor/ /'od kyis ye shes srun drang gzhug④ /mdun du sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang bsam/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi/ /blo yi mun pa bsal bar bsam/ /de ltar bsams nas dang po ni/ /bdag ni thugs kar ral gri dang / /sa bon byeḥdang bcas pa las/ /'od zer dmar po 'phros pa yis/ /bdag gi sna bug g.yas nas byung / /dbyangs can ma yi g.yon du bzhugs/ /thugs ka'i sngags dang hriḥl thim/ /thugs ka'i gnas nas tshur la byung / /bdag gi thugs kar zhugs pa las/ /ā li kā li'i sngags su gyur/ /khong pa'i nang dang ba sru'i gseb/ /dpag tu med pas khengs par bsam/ /bar gyi sngags kyi phreng ba las—/ /'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /dus gsum bla ma yi dam dang / /dpa' bo dpa' mo la sogs pa'i/ /sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs bsdus/ /bdag dang lha mo'i spyi bor bstem/ /47—4

bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi/ /blo yi mun pa bsal bar bsam/ /yang cig 'phros pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi/ /dge bshes rnams kyi nus mthu dang / /mtha' yi nor bu'i 'od zer dang / /rtsi shing nags tshal bcud rnams bsdus/ /bdag dang lha mo'i spyi bor bstem/ /lus la ye shes bdud rtsis gang / /des ni shes rab 'phel bar bsam/ /bzlas pa byed pa'i dus dag tu/ /mdun du ri lu la dmigs shing / /sngags ni stong phrag bzhi ru bzlas/ /oṃ tri ḍi ma me ḍi pa mañdzu shrī sum̐/ pradzñā dhā tuḥhriḥswā hā—/ brgya rtsas mi brjed gzungs thob 'gyur/ /stong gis smra skad kun la mkhas—/ /khri phrag gcig ni bzlas gyur pa/ /nyi ma re re dag la yang sh+lau ka ni lnga stong re/ /'dzin 'gyur 'di la je tshom med/ /mngon par shes pa 'char ba dang / /gzhan gyi sems ni shes pa dang / /yi ge'i rigs ni thams cad kyang / /thogs pa med par shes par 'gyur/ /smra dang bstan bcos thams cad kyang / /bka' bzhin rtsom par nus pa yin/ /phyis ni sa'i dbang phyug ①'thob/ /ri lu rgyal chen bzhir mthong na/ /shes rab 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang / /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /ri lu dbyangs can mar mthong na/ /sangs rgyas zhing du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /ri lu nyi zlar mthong gyur na//sngon kyi skye ba dran par 'gyur/ /ri lu 'od du mthong gyur na/ /smra bzhi dag la mkhas pa dang / /'od dang dung dang rnga smra dang / /rlung dang nyi ma me tog dang / /yi ge 'dri klog mthong ba dang / /gnag tsha 'thungs dang nyams dga' dang / /me tog 'dzugs dang zhing rmo ba/ /shes rab 'phel ba'i rtags su 'dod/ /de nas mdun gyi sangs rgyas dang / /dbyangs can ma dang bcas 47—5

pa rnams/ /'od du zhu nas ril bur thim/ /na ma nyi shu rtsa gcig la/ /ril bu re re zos gyur na/ /shes rab 'phel bar the tshom med/ /dang por rjes gnang thob nas ni/ /skar ma rgyal la bsgrub par bya/ /gcig dang brgyad dang bco lnga la/ /bsgrubs na shes rab 'phel bar 'gyur/ /brdzun dang sha chang sgog pa dang / /rdo ngad la sogs sgog pa dang / /'khon dang zhe sdang drag po dang / /grogs ngan mya ngan smre sngags dang / /sems la gnod pa'i las rnams spang / /bza' ba bdog pa thams cad kyi/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje mchod nas ni/ /rtag tu lha la gsol ba gdab/ /sems can rnams la snying rje bsgom/ /gal te las 'phro yod gyur na/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba thams cad kun/ /nyi ma gcig gis grol bar 'gyur//'bring gis gnyis kyis rtogs pa ste/ /nyi ma gsum du bsgrubs gyur na/ /las 'phro med kyang 'grub par 'gyur/ /gzhan gyi brtsod pa bzlog pa ni/ /dpral bar dhīḥyig dmar po bsam/ /dhīḥlas 'od zer 'phros nas ni/ /kho yi shes pa bkug nas kyang / /srin lag bzhi la bstem nas ni/ /oṃ hriḥḍi che ge mo nan hūṃ phaṭa / brtsod pa kun las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /gcan zan rgyal po seng ge'i sgra sgrags pas/ /dur khrod wa tshogs thams cad brgyal bar 'gyur/ /nyon mongs dug rnams 'joms pa'i shes rab mchog /bdag gis 'jam pa'i dpal la rab zhus pas/ /'gro rnams shes rab gru yis 'don par shog /rje btsun dam pa rgya gar gyi gdams pa sdogs so// //47—6

bsdur mchan/3 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i dbu'i mtshan smos pa las blangs te bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉dngar/4 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bug ②〈〈pe 〉〉thur/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉bzhugs/5 ①〈〈pe 〉〉thub/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2616)47—7

po'i sgrub thabs/rkya ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ bā bye rā dzā mdzi sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/rdo rje rnal 'byor mas gsungs pa'o/ /'jam dpal ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub ②thabs—/ 'jam pa'i mgon po la phyag 'tshal/ /gur kum bzang po ltar dmar gzhon nu'i sgu la dpal gyis mtshan/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od kyis rmongs pa'i dra ba bcom pa bzhin/ /dbang phyug yongs bcings phyag gis chos 'chad pa yi tshul mdzad pa/ /rol pa'i stabs bzhugs 'dod sbyin ngag gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snga bar langs nas dang por ni/ /paṃ yig snying gar sna tshogs pa/ /a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng / /triḥyig gur gum lta bur dmar/ /bltas nas zhal bsang la sogs bya/ /bsam gtan khang pa gtsang ma ru/ /bde ba'i stan la yang dag gnas/ /sngags dang sangs rgyas yon tan gnas/ /byams pas 'gro la bu sdug bzhin/ /dga' bas yon tan stong ldan ltar/ /sdug bsngal rgyur gyur 47—8

sdug bsngal las/ /'don par 'dod pas snying rje yi/ /rtag tu rab dga' de bzhin du/ /yon tan dam par rab sbyor 'dod/ /rang gi don la mi lta bar/ /btang snyoms gzhan gyi don byed pa/ /sngags pas sgom bya 'od zer tshogs/ /spros nas rgyal rnams gdan drangs te/ /de yis nam mkha' gang bar blta/ /yid kyis rang bzhin las byung mchod/ /byug pa dril phyi khrus rnams dang / /sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan par bya/ /mchod pa'i sprin tshogs 'phro ba yis /khams gsum yang dag lnga ru spro/ /so so so sor grangs med pa'i/ /lus sprul nas ni phyag bya'o/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang / /rnam gsum lus ngag yid dbang gis/ /byas pa'i sdig dang byas pa la/ /rjes su yi rang de rnams bshags/ /sems can don byed dang bcas pa'i/ /sdom pa yang nas yang du bzung / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jam dbyangs sogs/ /sbyin pa la sogs dge las skyes/ /yang dag tshogs la gsol 'debs shing / /yun ring dam chos gsung bar bskul/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro zhing / /byang chub sems kyi lam mchog bsten/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bha ba a ko haṃ/de nas sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas/ /e yig las skyes zla steng gnas/ /yi ge'i tshogs 'phros lta byas nas/ /'gro ba rnams la 'jam dbyangs mchog /dgug gzhug byas nas sngags pa yis/ /ngag gi rgyal po sgom par bya/ /gur gum lta bur mdzes pa'i sku/ /sgyu ma 'dod lha las rgyal ba/ /ha ri seng ge'i gdan la bzhugs—/ /'khrul pa med par rol pa'i stabs/ /phyag g.yon sdong bu dang bcas pa'i/ /ut+pal sngon po yongs bsnams pa/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yon tan tshogs/ /rin chen kyis rgyan rab mdzes pa/ /'od zer 'phro zhing 47—9

thon gyur nas/ /sangs rgyas tshogs kyi phreng ba blta/ /chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya che/ /phyag gi pad+ma nges par sbyar/ /de bzhin a la dang 'dra ba'i/ /hri yig 'od zer sna tshogs kyis/ /gzhan gyi mgon byed gdan drangs te/ /gzhal yas khang pa dang mtshungs par/ /de dang mtshungs nyid gdan drangs te/ /dam tshig rnam gsum snyam par bya/ /de nas yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /dgug gzhug dbang du bya ba rnams/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya tre sh+ya hoḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ sa ma yo haṃ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ a ti ①dza hūṃ baṃ hoḥ.oṃ gyis sku byin gyis brlab/ ā yis gsung byin gyis brlab/ hūṃ gis thugs byin kyis brlabs nas/ ut+pa la'i phyag rgya dang yi ge'i tshogs kyis ye shes byin gyis brlabs pa yang dag par bskul nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku las thon te lha'i rnam par bkug nas bum pa'i ye shes kyi chu dang rdo rje spyi bor sbyin par bya'o/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis mchod/ /sangs rgyas mchod pa'i dpung gnyen kyis/ /be+er yang srid par 'gyur ba yi/ /srid pa 'grub cing dag par 'gyur/ /slar yang bsgom bya las thob pas/ /lus dang sems ni shin tu sbyangs/ /do shal phreng ba'i rim pa yis/ /de nas sngags bzlas yang dag brtsam/ /khams gsum ma lus yon tan gyi rgya mtshor byas nas gzhug pa la sogs pa bya ste rnam par bsgoms nas/oṃ ā hūṃ zhes pas bkug nas bzod par gsol ba bya ba la sogs pa bya'o/ /bdag nyid 'jam dpal mchog tu gyur/ /'gro rnams de yis rang bzhin blta/ /gang dang yang dag sbyor rnams la/ /sems can don la de bzhin dgod/ /dkon mchog gsum la rab dang ba'i/ /slob ma rnams kyis shes byas la/ /'jig rten dngos grub nges pa ni/ /ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs yin/ /bla 47—10

ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang yi dam gyi lha thams cad nang du bsgoms nas de'i maṇ+ḍal mdor bsdus pa brtsam par bya'o/ /oṃ z-i①ཿswā hā zhes pa ni lag pa bkru ba dang / zhal gsang ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ hūṃ stan byen gyis brlab pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra zu mi hūṃ sa ②yongs su bzung ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ sarba bi ghā nu ta pa ra ya hūṃ swā hā/ ba'i lci ba la sogs pa len pa'i sngags so//de nas legs par byugs nas/ oṃ badz+ra re khe hūṃ/ zhes pa ni re kha byin gyis brlab pa'i sngags so/ /yang me tog gcig ①maṇ+ḍal la phul nas/ oṃ su re khe sarba ta thā ga ta dhi tiṣ+ṭha na tu swā hā/ zhes brjod nas lag pa bkru bar bya'o/ /de'i rjes su me tog cig bzung nas/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ra ṇi ma hā pra ti sā re rak+ṣa rak+ṣa saṃ hūṃ swā hā/ zhes pa rang gi spyi bor me tog bzhag nas bdag nyid bsrung bar bya'o/ /yang oṃ snya④hūṃ zhes pa ni bdag nyid bsrung ba'i sngags so/ /maṇ+ḍal de la sna tshogs pad+ma'i ⑤gzugs su dmigs nas/ de'i steng du zla ba de'i steng du gur gum ltar dmar ba'i bcom ldan 'das kyi sa bon gyi 'od zer kyis thog ma med pa nas yang dag par grub pa'i bcom ldan 'das rab tu 'bar ba gdan drangs te/ rim pa bzhin du byon nas/ de la de bzhin du rab tu zhugs shing bcom ldan 'das bskyed nas/ oṃ mañdzu gho shā ya badz+ra puste hūṃ oṃ agh+ra tshe bh+ya badz+ra puste hūṃ oṃ bai ro tsa nā ya badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ/ rat+na saṃ bha ba dang / a mi tā bha ba dang / a mo gha sibye dang / lo tsa na dang / mā ma tī dang / pāṇ+ḍa ra tā ra rnams sngon ma bzhin du me tog dang / spos dang mar me dang zhal zas dang /dri bzang dang / gos 'phyang ba la sogs pa byin gyis brlabs nas dbul bar bya'o—/ /phyag 'tshal ba dang sdig pa bshags pa dang bsod nams la rjes su yi 47—11

rang ba rnams byas nas/ sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas gshegs pa ni/oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes so/ /oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma shā abyā nut+pa tāta/ oṃ ā hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa ni 'byung po thams cad kyi gtor ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ ha rī h+ye ma hā yak+ṣi byi ha ra ha ra sarba pā pa ni mekhye sarba yakhye ṇi pra be+e shā ni swā hā/ 'phrog ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ a gra piṇa ḍā sha ni bh+ya swā hā/ phud kyi chang bu'i sngags so/ /oṃ usbyiṣ+ṭa ①piṇa ḍa sha ne+e bh+yaḥswā hā/ lhag ma'i chang bu'i sngags so/ /oṃ usarba ta thā ga tā a bhi ṣe ka sa ma ya shi ye hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes pa ni sku gzugs la sogs pa sku khrus gsol ba'i sngags so/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor mas gsungs pa'i 'jam dpal ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //

bsdur mchan/8 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉kho rdo rje rnal 'byor mas gsungs pa'i sgrubu thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉〉sgrubs/1༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉ta/11 ①〈〈pe 〉〉tro/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉mi/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉cig rjo〈〈pe 〉〉waḥ/ ⑤〈〈pe〉〉sga'i/ du〈〈pe 〉snamak+ṣu/12 ①〈〈pe 〉rosku:/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2617)47—13

2691༄ga /'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i spyan dbye ba'i cho ga zhes bya ba/①to rab gnas bzhugs so// ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ mañdzu shri na ma si 5 ghi ti tsak+ṣu man ti bi ti/ bod skad du/ 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i spyan dbye ba'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid can/ /khyab bdag ye shes lnga yi bdag /sangs rgyas mnga' bdag cod 7 —pan can/ /'jam dbyangs de la gus btud nas/ /lha khang sgu gzugs mchod rten dang / /glegs bam la sogs rten rnams la/ /rab gnas bya ba'i cho ga ni/ /bzang zhing dge ba bshad par bya/ /rab tu gnas pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /blo yi rim pas rab phye bas/ /cho ga dgos dang mi dgos pa/ /rim pa gnyis su yang dag bshad/ /don la mkhas pa'i slob dpon gyis/ /yang dag don la spyad gyur pas/ /gang gis gang la rab gnas bya / /gdod nas zhi zhing ma skyes pa'i/ /chos dbyengs mnyam nyid dgag 47—14

sgrub bral/ /de rtogs rab gnas bya mi dgos/ /rab tu gnas pa'i rgyud las/ sangs rgyas kun la rab tu bzhugs/ /rab tu gnas pa gang yang med/ /'jig rten kun rdzob la brten nas/ /rab tu gnas pa rab tu brtags/ /dang po'i las can sems can rnams/ /rtog pa'i rgyu ru mdzad par bshad/ /ces gsungs/ yang na sku gzugs mchod rten la sogs/ /sangs rgyas sprul par nges shes skyes/ /dag snang dad pa brtan pa thob/ /de la rab gnas mi dgos so/ /da ni rab gnas dgos pa yi/ /mtshan nyid bshad kyis nyan par byos/ /dang po'i las can dad pa ⑨can/ /'jig rten tha snyad la gnas pa/ /dgag sgrub lam la zhugs gyur pa'i/ /don du rgyas bsdus gsum du bshad/ /dang po rab gnas zhu ba des/ /gsol gsum btab la bsnyen pa tsam/ /gza' skar tshes grangs 'dzom gyur pas/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs bshams pa ni/ /lha khang rnying pa rdo leb dang / /yang thog dang ni sngar sbyangs par/ /sa yi cho ga mi dgos so/ /so ma'i gnas su cho ga ni/ /gzhung nas gsung bzhin rgyas par bya//sngar sbyangs pa la nub gnyis te/ /de la legs bsham thig btab nas/ /rigs bsdus kyi lha grangs mthun pa'i me tog gitshomabu dgod/ /denasamachod ⑤padang dang gtor ma rgyas bshams nas/ /bdag bskyed byas la bzlas pa bya/ /sa yi lha mo lha dang ni/ /bum pa slob ma sta gon bya/ /dgongs mo rten rnams spyan drangs la/ /de ni rten gyi sta gon no/ /de nas nang par rigs bsdus kyi/ /de la legs par bris nas su/ /mchod gtor la sogs rgyas par bsham/ /de nas nyi ma phyed kyi dus/ /bdag bskyed mdun bskyed sgrub mchod dang / /bdag 'jug byas la slobamayod na dbang rnams skur/ /denas rten gyi sta gon legs par bya/ /de nas bum pa mtshan nyid ldan/ /lha yi grangs dang rigasalngamanyam pa 47—15

'am—/ /yang na drug gam rnam rgyal dang las bum gnyis la bya/ /rang rang rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan bri/ /las bum la ni rgya gram mo/ /gu gul bdug cing bsngags sumabha ni bzlas nas/ /lnga phrag lnga dang chu snas dgang / /mgul chings kha rgyan ldan par bya/ /khrus kyi bum pa bcu gsum mam/ /yang na bum pa gcig la bya/ /'dag chal lnga dang ①ba'irnam lnga dang / /spos lnga dri lnga chu lnga pa nga / /yung ba/ sug pa/ nye shing pa①/ bul tog bag phye dang / shug pa spang spos/ phye spos/ brag spos/spos dkar dang / dridang sna tshogs bu ram kar sbrang / mngar gsum zho dang ni/ /'bras bu sna tshogs 'bru sna tshogs/ /'bras yos sman snatshogs dang rin chen dang / /chu sna ④sna tshogs blug par bya/ /phyag mtshan bri bar mi bya'o/ /da la'i bum dgod gzhung bzhin no/ /de nas khrus khang bsham pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor lho byang gang bder bya/ /rnam lnga byugs la pad 'dab bzhi/ /de la phyag mtshan lnga po dgod//de yi phyi rims pad 'dab brgyad/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad bri bar bya/ /de steng bum pa rgyasapar byed na bcu gsum dgod/ /yang na lte bar ras kyi steng / /bsdu na bum cig me long tshom bu lnga/ /rigs lngar bskyed dang ring srel gyi/ /brgyan pa'i rten dang rten 'byel kyi/ /snying po gser gyis bris la bzhugs/ /de nas nyi ma phyed kyi dus/ /slob dpon khrus byas gos bzang dang / /dbu rgyan la sogs rgyan ldan pas/ /rdo rje dril bu bzung byas nas/ /stan la 'dug nas sngags zlos shing / /spos dang rol mos gnas byin dbab/ /de rnams bshams pa'i rim pa'o/ /de nas bum pa sta gon ni/ /rang nyid dkyil 'khor rgyas dang bsdus/ /rdzogs par bsgom bul mchod pa dang / /bzlas pa byas la da la bsdu/ /dang po'i nga rgyal gnas par bya/ /de nas lha'i bum par ni/ /47—16

bdag babyed bzhin bsam mchod pa dbul/ /rang rang sngags rgo bzlas par bya//las bum rdo rje gnod sbyin bskyed/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa/ de nyid bsam zhing bzlas par bya/ /dri ma khrus kyi bum par ni/ /dbus kyi lnga ru sngags lnga dang / /brgyad du rang rang brgyad bsams nas/ /mchod bstod lha rnams zhu bar bsam//de nas bgegs bskrad sgrib sbyang bshad/ /phyi rol gtor ma rgya chen btang / /nang du gtor ma ci 'byor bsham/ /rten la lan gsum bskor byas nas/ /ā+oṃ big nan/ na ma sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo/ bi sha mu khe bh+ya/ sarba tad khaṃ ud khaṃ te/pa ra na hi oṃ gha gha na khaṃ/ byut+na i rda bha li te swā hā/ ces pas bgegs la sbyin par bya/ /tingalodang 'bras kyi chang bus phyi skor gsum/ /byas sum bha ni ①la sngags bzlas phyir dor ro/ /gu gul bdug cing nyung dkar brab/ /rang nyid me ltar 'bar bar bskyed/ /mdun du babyed cing spyan drangs te/ /hūṃ ye shes bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ /ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khang thams cad sreg /zhe sdang gshin rje 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms/ /dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag lpags can/ /log 'dren srin po mtha' yi dgra 'dul ba/ /rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo bzhugs so 'tshal/ /log 'dren ②'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ /de brjod khro bo dpag med pa/ /bgegs rnams bsrung zhing bzhugs par bsam/ /de la mchod stod bya ba ni/ /dri chab me tog bdug spos mar me dang / /zhal zas mchod sprin bsam kyis mi khyab pa/ /bgegs rnams 'dul phyir 'di dag bzhes nas kyang / /phrin las sgrub phyir brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /de rjes bstod pa'i tshogs kyis bstod/ /de nas rang dang yon bdag gi/ /don du 47—17

sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ /g.yas g.yon me chu mdun du til/ /bzhag la snying ga'i hūṃ las ni/ /sdig sgrib sdig pa'i gzugs don nas/ /til la thim pas gnyis med bsam/ /ā+oṃ ①badz+ra dha ka la kha kha khā hi khā nyi/ sarba pa paṃ da ha na bhasmi ④ku ru swā hā/ zhes pas me la bsregs byas nas/ /rgya mtsho chen por dor bar bsamaske/ /yang na lcags sam rdo leb steng / /me chu zho zan bzhag byas nas/ /nyungs kar dag la sngags bzlas gdab/ /mer bsreg chur blug zho zan bsil/ /mi gtsang de dag bzhi mdor dor ro/ /de nas khrus kyi las byas te/ /lha bzo yon tan la sogs kyi/ /mi gtsang dri ma sbyangs pa'i phyir/ /dngos su ku sha'i sbir gyis bskru/ /yang na me long ngos la bya/ /dri zhim sran dkar yichunapodur ba ni/ /khrus rnams kun gyi sngon du 'gro/ /dri yi bum pa thogs nas ni/ /hūṃ ji ltar dam pa tog dkar dga' ldan nas/ /lha mdzes lhums ①zhugs ltam pas khrus gsol ltar/ /sku gdung ring srel dri ma med par bcas/ /sprul sku yid 'ong rnams la sku khrus gsol/ /phyogs bcur bdud rtsi dam pa'i char 'be+ebs pa'i—/ /rgyal ba'i dam chos rnams la sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nir ma ka ya a bi she ka ta sa ma ye hūṃ/ de rjes ras dkar dri zhim chus/ /ā+oṃ hūṃ tram̐ hri aḥ ces brjod thig le lnga byas la/ /chu'i rdul rnams bsal ba'i phyir//hūṃ rgyal ba'i sku la dpe dang tshad med kyang / /'gro ba'i don du gzugs sku cir yang sprul/ /gser kyi dbyings ltar nyes pa'i skyon bral kyang / /'akro ba'i bag chags ma lus bsal ba'i phyir/ /sdig med rgyal po rnams kyis rab mngags pa'i//kha tshar ma nyams ras kyis sku phyis pas/ /nyon mongs dug gsum dri ma kun bral nas—/ /'bras bu sku gsum myur du thob par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nir 47—18

ma ka ya shud dho haṃ/ zhes pas sku ni phyi bar bya/ /sngon 'gro gsum dang sku phyi ba//khrus rnams kun la shes par bya/ /mngar gsum bum pa thogs nas ni/ /ji ltar ltam pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nir ma ka ya a ste she ka sa ma ye hūṃ/ zho'i bum pas khrus bya ba/ /'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /ser sna'i dri ma sbyong bar byed/ /sbyin pa'i chu yi legs bkrus pas/ /khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus gsol lo/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta na ma a bi she ka sa ma ya hūṃ/ 'bras bu sna tshogs bum pa yis/ /'di ni tshul khrims rang bzhin chu/ /'chal pa'i dri ma sbyong bar byed/ /tshul khrims chu yis legs bkrus pas/ /khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus gsol lo/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pha la sna a be+e ①she ka sa ma ye hūṃ/ 'bru sna'i bum pa thogs nas ni/ /'di ni bzod pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /khong khro'i dri ma spyong bar byed/ /bzod pa'i chu yi legs bkrus pas/ /khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus gsol lo/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta byu hi na a bi she ka sa ma ye hūṃ/ 'bras yos bum pa thogs nas ni/ /'dir ni brtson 'grus rang bzhin chu/ /le lo'i dri ma sbyong bar byed/ /brtson 'grus chu yi legs bkrus pas/ /khrus legs mdzad kyi sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sho dha na a bi she ka sa ma ye hūṃ/ sman sna dag gi bum pa 'dzin/ /'di ni bsam gtan rang bzhin chu/ /g.yeng ba'i dri ma sbyong bar byed/ /bsam gtan chu yis legs bkrus pas/ /khrus legs mdzad kyis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ardza ṇa a bi she ka sa ma ye hūṃ/ rin chen sna tshogs bum thogs nas/ /'di ni shes rab rang bzhin chu/ /rmongs pa'i dri ma sbyong bar 47—19

byedarka/ /shes rab chu yis legs bkrus pas/ /khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus gsol lo/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma ṇi a bi she ka sa ma ye hūṃ/ rdzas gsum bum chu sku phyi ba/ /brgyad brgyad dag tu shes par bya/ /de nas rigs lnga'i khrus byas te/ /sngon 'gro gong bzhin sngon song bas/ /'dag chal ①lnga yi bum thogs nas/ /gzugs kyi phung po rnam par dag /gti mug ma lus sbyong mdzad pa/ /chos kyi dbyings kyis ye shes kyis/ /dpal ldan sku yi khrus gsol lo—/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bud dha a bi she ka sa ma ye hūṃ/ ba yi rnam lnga'i bum thogs nas/ /tshor ba'i phung po rnam par dag /nga rgyal dri ma sbyong mdzad pa'i/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyis/ /dpal ldan yon tan sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na a bi she ka sa ma ye hūṃ/ spos lnga'i bum pa thogs nas ni/ /'du shes phung po rnam par dag /'dod chags dri ma spyong mdzad pa'i/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyis/ /dpal ldan gsung gi khrus gsol lo/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pad ma a bi she ka sa ma ye hūṃ/ dri lnga dag gi bum pa yis/ /'du byed phung po rnam par dag /phrag dog dri ma sbyong mdzad pa'i/ /bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyis/ /dpal ldan 'phrin las sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta karma a bi she ka sa ma ye hūṃ/ chu sna dag gi bum thogs nas/ /rnam shes phung po rnam par dag /zhe sdang dri ma sbyong mdzad pa'i/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes kyis—/ /dpal ldan thugs kyi sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra a bi she ka sa ma ye hūṃ/ khrus kyi rjes la sku phyi ba/ /gong bzhin du ni shes par bya/ /de nas rten rnams bskyed pa ni/ /sngags kyi dag pas mi dmigs bya/ /de yi ngang las seng ge dang / /glang chen rta mchog 'dab chags kyi/ /steng du 47—20

rab na pad+ma nyi zla dang gdan lnga bsam par bya/ /de yi steng du sa bon las/ /rang rang sku ru bskyed par bya/ /yang na byang sems rdo rje 'am/ /rigs bsdus da lar bskyed par bya/ /lha khang mchod rten snang mdzad bskyed/ /de yang sngags kyis sbyangs pa las/ /lha la mchod rten ji bzhin bsam/ /yang na de nang gdan stengs su/ /ā+oṃ hūṃ tram̐ tri aḥ /de las rigs lnga bskyed par bya/ /po ti dril bu gsung gi rigs/ /yum chen dang ni 'od dpag med/ /rdo rje la sogs mi bskyod pa/ /khang bzangs ljon shing rdo rje chu mig khron pa skyed mos tshal la sogs//snang mdzad chen por bskyed par bya①/ /de dag dpral ba mgrin pa snying kha sogs gnas gsum du/ /ye ge gsum ni dgod par bya/ /de la dgug gzhug bya ba ni—/ /dang po'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ /sangs rgyas dpag med spyan drangs pa/ /lag pa bsdod te dpung pa'i thad kar se gol gdab cing rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'i sngags pas dbyangs dang bcas pas ji ltar chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ /rnam dag gtso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra ba/ /nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid ldan pa po/ /dad pas sems can don phyir spyan 'dren na/ /rab tu zhi zhing thugs rje che ldan pas/ /ting 'dzin zhi ba mchog la rab tu zhugs/ /ye shes rab zab chags bral ldan pa po / /kun tu mi zad yon tan tshogs mnga' ba/ /tshur spyon tshur spyon zhi ba mchog gi lha/ /rgyal ba skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen nyid dpal/ /shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan mchog 'di dag /mchod phyir 'di nyid du ni ②gshegs su gsol/ /gzugs mchog 'di dang lhan cig nyid du ni/ /'khor ba gnas srid bar du bzhugs nas kyang / /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dpal dang grags/ /mchog rnams ma lus sbyin par mdzad du gsol/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra sa ma 47—21

ya dza/ dza hūṃ baṃ hos spyan drangs la/ /mchod dhil sogs dbul bar bya/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra a ghu sha ya dza lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas dgug /ā+oṃbadz+ra pa sha hūṃ rdo rje zhags pa'i phyag rgyas bzhug⑧/ā+oṃ badz+ra pho ①ta baṃ rdo rje lcags sgrog gi phyag rgyas bsre/ ā+oṃ badz+ra nan ta ho rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgyas mnyes par bsam/ /dgug gzhug bsres la dgyes par bsam/ /de nas yang ni spyan drangs la/ /spus btsugs thal sbyar spos thogs la/ /hūṃ ji ltar dga' ldan gnas mchog gnas④/ /bde bar gshegs pa bzhugs pa de/ /sgyu 'phrul lha mo'i lhums zhugs ltar/ /de ring bde gshegs thams cad ni/ /de bzhin gzugs brnyan 'di nyid la/ /'jug pa nyid du mdzad du gsol/ /'di la rtag tu sangs rgyas bzhugs/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa dang / /yon bdag rnams kyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sbyor ba 'di nyid kyis/ /ci 'byor pa yi mchod pa rnams/ /me tog la sogs bzhes su gsol/ /bdag dang yon bdag bcas pa la/ /thugs brtse bar ni dgongs nas kyang / /kun kyi 'di la byin brlabs ⑪shing / /'di nyid du ni bzhugs par rigs/ /sangs rgyas dpag med bzhugs par bsam/ /rten de'i ye shes ldan bya'i phyir/ /phyag ma྾ 'dzin tshul las kyi phyag rgya legs pa dpral ba thugs ka mgrin pa phyag rgya bzhi yis rgyas gdab bya/ /yang na oṃ.āhūṃgasum gyi yi ge gsum/ /yongs su gyur pa las 'khor lo pad ma rdo rjer gyur—/ /yi ges mtshan pas rgyas gdab nas/ /oṃ sa ma ya stista lhan/ zhes brjod mchod pa mnyamanyid mi g.yo bstod pa bya/ /yi dam chos skyong la cha gsum la gtor ma rgyas pa gtang ⑥bar bya/ /de nas snyan gsan dbab pa ni/ /lha rnams lhag par gnas pa de/ /nang par dngos gzhi'i dus su ni/ /rten rnams byin gyis rlob pa'i phyir/ /byon par zhu zhes snyan gsan dbab/ /rnam par snang mdzad 47—22

bcom ldan 'das/ /rigs 1sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid spyan dbye ba'i/ /kun kyis byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /ci 'byor pa la ⑤yo byad kyis/ /rab gnas nang par bgyid par 'tshal/ /tshogs pa thams cad rab gnas pa/ /kun gyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /spos thogs lan gsum brjod par bya/ /de nas mchod bstod bsdus pa bya/ /de rjes se gol gdab bya zhing / /badz+ra muḥzhes brjod pa yis/ /rten gyi ye shes sems pa ni/ /nam mkhar bzhugs su gsol ba la/ /mchod dang bstod pa ci rigs bya/ /de nas na bza' gsol ba ni/ /sprul sku la ni ser po ste/ /longs spyod rdzogs la gos sna tshogs/ /khro bo rnams la sngo dmar te/ /glegs bam la ni na bza' dmar/ /de rnams phul la 'di skad brjod/ /'gro ba sems can ma lus bskyab pa'i phyir/ /lha yi na bza' pan tsa li ka 'di/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la gus 'bul na/ /bzhes nas bla med grub mchog bdag la gsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nir ma ka ya dhi pa ta na ye swā hā/ longs sku rnams la rgyan dbul ste/ /byang chub yan lag mchog gi rgyan gyur cing / /'gro kun ma lus bsod nams thob bya'i phyir/ /bde gshegs sras bcas rnams la brgyan mchog 'bul/ /ci bder bzhes nas dngos grub rtsal du gsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a ka ra ni rnyi sha ya swā hā/ de nas rten de gdan la rgyalaporgyal sar ma thon pa rgyal srid la mi dbang ltar/ rab gnas ma zin pa de/mchod 'os ma yin pas so/ /bzhugs/ /nab bza' bkab la ā+oṃ hūṃ tram̐ hri aḥ de dag rten gyi gnas lngar dgod/ /gshin rje gshed kyis bsrung bar bya/ /de nas bdag 47—23

nyid bsrung ba ni/ /phyag rgya bkrol la ye shes gshegs/ /bzod par gsol zhing dngos grub blang / /gnas gsum yi ge gsum bkod la/ /steng 'og phyogs mar+ṣas thams cad sa phyogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin bsam/ /da la'i shar phyogs ku sha'i steng / /mi 'jigs seng ge lta bu yis/ /chos kyi dbyings su nyal ①nas ni/ /bde ba'i gnyid ni log par bya/ /sta gon gnas pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas rab gnas dngos gzhi ni/ /nang par skya rengs shar dus su/ /khrus bya brgyan gdags stan la 'dug /mchod gtor rgya chen bshams byas nas/ /bdag bskyed lha ni gsol gtab nas/ /rten sbyang bkru dang phyi ba dang / /rten bskyed srun drangs mchod pa dang / /dgug gzhug dang ni rgyas gdab bgegs bskrad rnams—/ /rgyas par gong bzhin shes par bya/ /de nas rig pa'i dbang lnga dang / /rdo rje slob dpon dbang bskur nas/ /rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab bya/ /de lagang 'dir bcom ldan 'das la sogs pas gsol ba gdab mchod stod ⑤bzlas pa dang / /rten 'brel snying po brjod nas kyang / /brtan phyir yi ge brgya pa bzlas/ /de nas shag thub rnam snang dang / /sgol ma la sogs rten rnams la/ /gong du dkyil 'khor lhar bskyed pa'i/ /gzugs brnyan gang yin de dag kyang / /rang rang sngags dang phyag rgya dang / /se gol gsum gyis gdul bya'i ngor/ /ngo mtshar ra po zhes so ces pa nas mdzad du gsol zhes pa'i bar brjod la gang yin sku der bsgyur bar bya/ /oṃ na mo bha ga wa te shākya mu ne ye/ ta thā ga ta yā/ arta te bh+ya/ tad ya thā/ oṃ mu ne+e mu ne ma hā mu ne+e ye swā hā/ zhes pas shākya thub par bsgyur/ /de ltar bsgyur ba'i lha de la/ /dngos su bshams dang yid sprul ba'i/ /bkra shis mchod pa'i lha 47—24

mo lnga/ /nam mkha' khengs pa bsam byas nas/ /me tog thogs la 'di skad brjod—/ /hūṃ lta bas mi ngoms bkra shis lha mo ni/ /mkha' la me tog char 'be+ebs glu dbyangs len/ /rgyal ba'i tshogs rnams mchod pas mnyes gyur nas/ /phyogs bcur bsod nams rgya mtshos khyab par shog /lta bas legs 'dre/ mkha' la bdug spos sprin stebs glu dbyangs len/ /snang gsal 'od 'bar glu dbyangs len—/ /zhal zas char 'be+ebs mkha' la sil snyan sgra sgogs glu dbyangs len/ /rgyal ba/ phyogs bcur/ de nas nyi ma 'char ka'i tshe/ /rnam snang chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /spyan la sogs pa dbye ba ni/ /gser thur thogs la 'di skad brjod/ /hūṃ rgyal ba mkha' la byon pa'i thugs rje can/ /sangs rgyas can la sgrib pa mi mnga' yang / /sems can rnams kyi bag chags sbyang slad du/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi spyan ni dbye bar bgyi/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nir ma ka ya tsak+ṣu bhi sho dha na ye swā hā/ gser gyi thur mas dal gyi dbus nas rdul tshon phra mo blangs na/ spyan gyi thad du thogs nas dbye ba ltar byed cing / gser gyi rna 'bru thogs nas ni/ /rgyal ba'i snyan la 'gag pa mi mnga' yang / /sems can chos kyis 'phong ba ①la/ /rgyal bas chos kye rnga brdungs ltar/ /bde gshegs snyan ni dbye bar bgyi/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nir ma ka ya lo bh+ya pa na ye swā hā/ gser gyi tsher gzung shangs phyi la/ /rgyal ba'i shangs la 'gag pa mi mnga' yang / /dri 'dzin rnam dag tshul khrims las 'khrungs pa/ /mos pas 'dzin spyad mchog 'di phul ba yis/ /'gro kun zag med ye shes thob par shog /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nir ma ka ya i rda gha te ye swā hā/dngul gyi tshems shing thogs nas ni/ /tshems dkar thags bzang ⑤bzhi bcu ldan pa la/ /bskur ste dngul gyi tshems shing phul ba yis/ /bde gshegs 47—25

gsung gis dngos grub thob gyur nas/ /'gro ba rnams kyi chos kyi don rtogs shog /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nir ma ka ya ki sha bha dha ni swā hā/ rin chen thur mas zhal phye ste/ /zab zhi spros bral dam chos sgra dbyangs kyis/ /skye 'gro thams cad tshim par bya ba'i phyir/ /ro mchog brgya ldan zhal zas dam pa 'di/ /'bul phyir rgyal ba'i zhal ni dbye bar bgyi/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nir ma ka ya id ni mu kha ta ya swā hā/ gser gyi spu gri thogs nas ni/ /rgyal ba'i gtsug phud lta bas mi ngoms kyang / /gzhan don sgrub cing khyem pa'i rtags spang phyir/ /dad pas gser gyi spu gri phul ba yis/ /'gro kun sdug bsngal kun las grol bar shog /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ①tā sho dha bha ri ka ya swā hā/ sen mo 'breg pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /zangs mdog ltar mdzes yid 'ong skyon bral yang / /bdag cag dad pas phyag dang zhabs sor gyi/ /sen mo 'breg spyad phul bas 'gro kun gyis//sangs rgyas dpe byad bzang bo thob par shog /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra na ga tshe da ya swā hā/ longs sku byang chub sems rnams la/ /dung gi so mangs skra bshad de/ /dbu skra mthon mthing g.yas 'khyel rin chen brgyan/ /lha mi kun kyis lta bas mi ngoms pa'i/ /dbu skra dung gi so mangs legs bshad pas/ /bdag dang yon bdag sgrib pa byang gyur cig /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bho dhi nir ma ka ya karma li da ra ni hūṃ/ sprul sku rab byung cha lugs la/ /na bza' rnams gsum dbul ba ni/ /dri med mtshan la sgrib bsal mi mnga' yang / /dad pas ngur smrig rgyal mtshan phul ba yis/ /nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /sangs rgyas brtul zhugs mchog la spyod par shog /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nir ma ka ya badz+ra wa tra ye swā hā/ longs sku dang ni khro bo la/ /sna tshogs na 47—26

bza' dbul ba ni/ /hūṃ ji ltar sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed kyis/ /rgyal ba'i sku la na bza' gsol ba ltar/ /de bzhin sems can rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /sna tshogs mdzes pa'i na bza' gsol bar bkyi/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nir ma ka ya bra na dhe ya swā hā/ rin chen rgyan rnams dbul ba ni/ /bde gshegs sku la mtshan dang dpe byad ldan/ /rin chen 'od chags 'bar bas sku brgyan cing / /byang chub mchog gis rgyan kyis rab mdzes kyang / /srid zhu bkur ste rim gro phun sum tshul gyis ni/ /rin chen do shal se mo do la sogs/ /rgyan gyi dam pa khyad 'phags mchog phul bas//byang chub sems dpa'i brgyan dang ldan gyur nas/ /bla na ①med thar lam mchog la gnas par shog /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ni ma ka ya rat+na a na ka la hūṃ/thugs kar rdo rjes thig le bya/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan bsams nas/ /t+t+waṃ mtshan bzang dpe byad rnams dang ldan pa'i phyir/ /dung dang dpal be+e'u g.yung drung 'khyil pa dang / /bkra shis rtags brgyad dag gis rab brgyan pas/ /rgyal ba'i thugs la rnam par brgyan gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nir ma ka ya tri shudha a nud rdza ye swā hā/ spyan sogs rab phye rgyan ldan zhing / /na bza' la sogs rab mdzes pa'i/ /rten de gzi brjid ldan bsams nas/ /de dag brtan par bzhugs pa ni/ /phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha' dang mnyam pa khyesems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i skya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs su gsol lo/ /bye brag tu sku gzugs 'di la 'byung gzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa mdzad cing bzhugs su gsol/ hūṃ ji srid mkha' mnyam sems can rnams/ /byang chub sa la mi gnas par/ /'gro ba rnams kyi 47—27

don gyi phyir/ /mya ngan mi 'da' brtan par bzhugs/ /khyad par sku gzugs 'di nyid la/ /'byung bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig bar/ /sems can dpag med don mdzad phyir/ /brtan pa nyid du bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sgo te sa ma tista hūṃ/ brtan par bzhugs pa'i rten rnams la/ /mkho ba'i yo byad dbul ba ni/ /gling bzhi legs par rgyan phul te/ /sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog mdzes/ /ri rab gling bzhi legs par brgyan gyur te/ /zhing khams dag par dmigs te phul ba yis/ /'go kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra re khye a t+t+waṃ/ dri zhim chu yis bkru zhing gtor/ /stong gsum kun tu dri mchog 'byung 'gyur ba'i/ /tshim byed spos mchog thub dbang rnams kyi sku / /gser bzang btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar/ /'od chags 'bar ba'i sku la byug par bya/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nir ma ka ya gha dhe a hūṃ/ 'dod yon dbul ba 'og mchan bris 'di blang 'dir ma zin kyang 'dod yon lnga dbul ba ni/ hūṃ 'di ni 'dod yon khyad par can/ /gzugs kyi lha mo me long lta/ /rgyal ba'i spyan la 'di bstem pas/ /phyogs bcur bsod nams khyab gyur cig /rus pa pu tsa me ka sa mud nyutra pa ra na sa ma ye hūṃ la sogs pa sngags rnams 'dres shes par bya'o/ /gser gdugs bla re chun 'phyang dang / /ba dan rgyal mtshan dbul ba ni/ /theg mchog gdugs dang bla re ba dan dang / /bdud bcom rgyal mtshan lhab lhub ting 'dzin 'phan/ /lha dang lha mo mchod pa'i sgra dbyangs kyi/ /bla re rgyal mtshan rol mos mchod byas pas//bdag dang 'gro ba'i dbang po rab tshim te/ /gnod pa'i dgra bcom bla med go 'phang dang / /theg pa mchog la nges par 'god par shog /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma ha rat+na pu tsa a hūṃ/ sprul sku chu tshags lhung bzed dang / /longs sku ral gri lab dbul ba/ /'gro ba sems can rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /rig pa'i 47—28

gnas lnga dag la slab bya ces/ /maṇ+ḍal las rin chen bdun dang tsa ka li bsdus la ji ltar thugs kyang rgya chen bzhes pa bzhin/ /mkho ba'i yo byad rnams kyang dbul bar bgyi/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta o ba su ka sa pa ri ye swā hā/ rin chen sna bdun dbul ba ni/ /ji ltar sngon kyi 'khor lo sgyur ba yis/ /rin chen sna bdun dag gis mchod pa ltar—/ /rgyal ba rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' la/ /rin chen sna bdun tshogs rnams dbul bar bgyi/ /yī sarba ta thā ga ta sa ta ma ha rat+na pu tsa me ka a hūṃ/ snod bzang rdzas brgyad dbul ba ni/ /lha yi rgyal po lha min g.yul rgyal nas/ /bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa ltar/ /rgyal ba rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' la/ /bkra shis rdzas brgyad dag gis mchod par bkyi/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa ta ma ha pu tsa a hūṃ/ bil ba ltar dkar bum bzang mchod pa ni/ /'jig rten khyim bdag dag gis dpal brten nas/ /bil ba ltar dkar bum pa bzang dang bcas/ /mdun du bdar nas bkra shis byed pa ltar/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rnams la dbul bar bgyi/ /yī sarba ta thā ga ta ar tha bha ba rat+na pu tsa mo ka a hūṃ/ bcud 'bul na/ sman lnga 'bru lnga rad na lnga/ dri lnga snying po lnga/ rin po che'i sgod du blugs la btegs nas/ hūṃ rgyal ba mgon po dpal gyi lha mer bzhugs/ /bsod nams ye shes sku mnga' bsnyems pa la/ /lnga phrag lnga ldan snying po dam pa 'bul/ /'gro bas bde gshegs snying po rtogs par shog /oṃ badz+ra pan tsa pan tsa nyi ma la pu tsa me ga a hūṃ swā hā ces so/ /de nas bkra shis rdzas brgyad dang / /rtags brgyad bkra shis bya ba ni/ /rin chen gter dang dar zab steng / /rin chen 'bar ba legs byas bzhag /de yi mtha' skor bkrashis pa'i rdzas brgyad ni/ /me long gi haṃ zho dang ni/ /dur ba bil ba dung ras dmar/ /nyungs ①dkar rnams kyis khengs par bya/ /de rnams dbul zhing shis pa brjod/ /las thams cad 47—29

pa'i bum pas yon bdag bkrus la/ lhar bsgoms me tog gi phreng ba thogs/ slob dpon la phyag byed du bcug la/slob dpon gyi bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags sam/ sum bha nis bgegs gsal la me long ye shes rgya mtsho chen po yis/ /ye shes rgya mtsho shin tu dag gyur te/ /rnam dag chos la thogs med longs spyod pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang sgrib pa dag par shog /gi waṃ dug gsum 'joms pa nad kyi sman/ /sman mchog chos nyid rab tu rtogs gyur nas/ /nyon mongs zug ngu med par gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang sdug bsngal zhi bar shog /zho ni kun gyi snying por gyur pa ste/ /snying po rnams dang ye shes kun rtogs nas/ /yon tan kun ldan dbyings su gyur pa yis/ /bkra shis des kyang dug gsum zhi bar shog /dur ba tshe ni 'phel bar byed pa ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe ni rab bsgrubs ①nas/ /nyon mongs skye shi rgyun chad gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des ni tshe yang 'phel bar shog /bil ba rgyu rkyen 'bras bur bcas pa'i chos/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod pa kun/ /byang chub snying po mchog tu gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang don rnams 'grub par shog /dung ni chos kyi sgra rnams sgogs pa'i tshul/ /ye shes rgya mtsho nyid du dag gyur pa'i/ /chos rnams ma nor yongs su ston par byed/ /bkra shis des kyang tshig dbang thob par shog /li khri dmar po dbang gi rang bzhin te/ /chos rnams ma nor dbang du bsdus nas kyang / /chos kyi rgyal srid rab tu brtan gyur pas/ /bkra shis des kyang byed srid brtan gyur shog /nyung dkar rdo rje'i rigs ste thams cad du/ /bgegs rnams ma lus rab tu 'joms byed cing / /mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang bgegs rnams zhi bar shog /yang na rdzas dang bkra shis tshig /re re spel zhing brjod par bya/ /47—30

lha bshos bzang zhing brgyan pa la/ /rtags brgyad bkod la shis pa brjod/ /de nas bza' ba dang btung ba'i tshogs kyis bskor la nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs la/ hūṃ zhal zas ro brgya ldan pa yid 'phrog pa/ /legs sbyar ①'di ni rgyal ba sras bcas la/ /dad pas legs 'bul 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog /oṃ 'di byu a rgo sa ④la dhe bya na pra na de swā hā zhes dbul lo/ /bkra shis brjod pa nam mkha'i mthar thug thugs rje'i skyabs/ /dbu yi gtsug tor dkyil du gsal/ /gdugs kyi bkra shis 'di brjod pas/ /yon bdag bkra shis thob gyur cig /sku mdog nya ltar dngas pa'i tshul/ /phyag zhabs sor mo nya ltar gsal/ /gser mig bkra shis 'di brjod pas/ /yon bdag bkra shis thob gyur cig /dbyangs rab dung chen sgra sgrogs pa/ /tshigs dang rus pa'i sbugs 1su gsal/ /dung gi bkra shis 'di brjod pas/ /yon bdag bkra shis thob gyur cig /ma chags shes rab pad+ma'i dbyings/ /zhal gyi dkyil 'khor sgos su gsal/ /pad+ma'i bkra shis 'di brjod pas/ /yon bdag bkra shis thob gyur cig /shes rab bdud rtsi'i bum pa dang / /dbu skra 'gur dang bum par gsal/ /bum pa'i bkra shis 'di brjod pas/ /yon bdag bkra shis thob gyur cig /'jam dpal dung mdog dpal be+e'u/ /thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod du gsal/ /dpal be'i bkra shis 'di brjod pas/ /yon bdag bkra shis thob gyur cig /mkhyen rab dkar po rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /mnyen lcug 'khril ldem sku la gsal/ /rgyal mtshan bkra shis 'di brjod pas/ /yon bdag bkra shis thob gyur cig /rang bzhin dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bskor//phyag dang zhabs kyi mthil du gsal/ /'khor lo'i bkra shis 'di brjod pas/ /yon bdag bkra shis thob gyur cig /bsod nams stobs las legs grub pa'i//47—31

rtags brgyad bkra shis 'di brjod pas/ /bdag dang yon bdag 'khor bcas rnams—/ /deng 'dir bkra shis phun tshogs shog /de nas mchod rten rab gnas la/ /bgegs bskrad khrus gsol gong bzhin no/ /mdun du da la bzhengs nas ni/ /mchod rten lha tshogs de ru bskyed/ /yang na snang mdzad chen por bsam/ /ye shes bcug la dbang yang bskur/ /rgyas gdab spyan dbye la sogs bya/ /oṃ da du sarba ma ha bho te swā hā/ ces pa'i sngags kyis lha bzhu nas/ /gdul bya'i ngo la rang byung gi/ /mchod rten chen por gyur par bsam—/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra a yu she swā hā/ sems can thams cad shes pa bcu dang ldan par gyur cig /bde bar gshegs pa dang dam pa'i chos yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /sems can thams cad lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pas kun tu bzang po'i smon lam la 'jug par gyur cig /srog shing 'bul bar bsams nas ni/ /dam pa'i chos kyi srog shing 'di/ /'gro kun shes bcur rab ldan nas—/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan pa yun rings gnas par shog /bye ni dbul bar bsams ①nas su/ /tshad med bzhi las grub pa yisan / /bsod nams tshogs kyi bye khengs nas/ /bdag dang 'gro ba thams cad kun/ /ye shes tshogs kyis brgyan par shog /yī ar bya ye swā hā/ de nas 'khor lo gzugs pa ni/ /ā+oṃ tsakra bar ta na ye swā hā/ sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag spyopa gsum thob par gyur cig /rnam par thar pa brgyad dang ye shes lnga dang ldan par gyur cig /bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / /mi 'jigs bubazhi dang ma 'dres chos/ /ye shes lhun grub thob par shog /dri med gser gdugs dbul ba ni/ /ā+oṃ tsa na dha ye swā hā/ sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i skyabs chen po dang ldan te chos kyi rgyal po chen por gyur cig /47—32

mkha' khyab chos sku dag pa las/ /tshogs gnyis gzugs kyi skur shar nas/ /'gro kun bla med skyabs ldan te/ /chos kyi rgyal po thob par shog /dar sogs cod pan dbul ba ni/ /oṃ sa dha ga lo ba swā hā/ sems can thams cad dus gsum du dar gyi cod pan dang lhab lhub la sogs pa'i mchod pa dang / mchod pa rnam pa mang pos de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa dang / de dag gi sku gzugs dang mchod rten dang gzugs sku dang gsung rab la sogs pa la mchod pa rgyun mi chad par byed par gyur cig ces pon lam gdab bo/ /ā+oṃ sa dha ga lo bha swā hā/ hūṃ sna tshogs yid 'ong rab mdzes pa'i/ /byang chub rgyan 'gyur cod pan 'di/ /bdag dang 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /yang dag mchod pa'i gnas thob shog /me tog phreng ba gdags pa ni—/ /ā+oṃ pus pa ma le ye swā hā/ sems can thams cad mtshan dang dpe byad dang ldan te sku lta bas chog mi shes pa thob par gyur cig /yid 'ong skyon bral ku mud ta/ /'od kyi tshogs 'khrugs gsal zhing dag /'gro kun dbang po rab tshim pa'i/ /yang dag go 'phang thob ①par shog /g.yer ka'i dra ba dbul ba ni/ /gser gyi dril bu g.yer kha las/ /theg chen chos kyi sgra sgrogs pa/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis/ /chos rnams kun gyi don rtogs shog /chu srin rgyal mtshan gzugs pa ni/ /ā+oṃ ku be+e ra ha dza ye swā hā/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba mi 'dzin mi gdong ba/ bdud bzhi las rgyal zhing chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan du gyur cig /yid kyi stobs las legs grub pa'i/ /mi 'jigs rgyal mtshan phul ba yis/ /'gro kun bdud las rgyal gyur nas/ /mi nub rgyal mtshan thob par shog /phun sum tshogs pa'i gdan dbul ba/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra ni ha ri dza ye swā hā/ sems can thams cad kyis gdan gyi khyad par stobs bcu glang po che'i gdan dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi seṅge'i khri dar / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rta'i stan dang /dbang bcu dang ldan pa rma bya'i gdan dang / thams cad du thogs pa med pa stobs kyi shugs dang ldan pa nam mkha' lding 47—33

gi gdan dang / 'gro ba'i re 'dod skong ba rat+na'i gdan dang / chags pa'i don spang ①pad+ma'i gdan dang / rang bzhin kyis 'od gsal ba nyi ma zla ba'i gdan thob par gyur cig /bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis/ /stobs dang mi 'jigs ④la sogs dang / /re skong skyon bral gdan phul bas/ /mi 'gyur gdan mchog thob par shog /de nas glegs bam rab gnas ni/ /stegs la legs par bzhugs par bya/ /de nas bgegs bskrad khrus la sogs gong bzhin du rgyas par bya/ mchod stod byas la sngags 'di brjod/ /ā+oṃ prad nye prad nye ma hā prad nye ye swā hā/ de yis glegs bam a las ni/ /rdo rje chos su bskyed par bya/ /de yang pha rol phyin yin na④/ /yum chen zhal gcig phyag bzhir bskyed/ /ye shes gzhug cing dbang yang bskur/ /yang na bden pa gnyis ldan pa'i/ /yi ge'i tshogs su bsgyur bar bya/ /lha dang sngags ni dbyer med bsam/ /glegs bam gzhan yang so so yi/ /sngags kyis yi ger bsgyur byas te/ /lha tshogs de nyid gdul bya la/ /gsung gi yi ger gyur par bsam /ā+oṃ prad nye prad nye shu de rmi de ma de swā hā/ zhes pas rab tu gnas par bya/ /spyan dbye la sogs gong bzhin no/ /de nas glegs bam de nyid la/ /rin po che'i khri dbul ba/ /rin chen las grub seng ge'i khri/ /yid 'ong sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras/ /spros bral gsung rab mchog la phul ba yis/ /'gro kun rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs par shog /ā+oṃ a ba na ye rjoswā hā/ de nas na bza' dbul ba ni/ /sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu bzhin rab bkra ba/ /gang la reg pas bde bar 'gyur ba yi/ /gos bzang rin chen bdag gis 'bul lags na//bzod pa mchog gis ⑤gos kyis brgyan par shog /ā+oṃ dhi dhi bya ba pu ye swā hā/de rjes glegs shing dbul ba ni/ /zung 'jug dam chos 'dzin pa kun bral la/ /47—34

thabs dang shes rab zung 'byel gyur pa yi/ /nyi zla lta bu'i rten 'brel legs bkab pas/ /'gro kun ma lus zung 'jug thob par shog /ā+oṃ badz+ra prad nya u bha ya dhe ga swā hā/ glegs thag rdo rje'i thig gus gdam①/ /spros pa du ma rab tu rgyas gyur kyang / /ye shes chen pos ro gcig gyur pa ltar/ /glegs bam cig gyur yo byad mchog phul bas/ /'gro kun ye shes chen po rtogs par shog /oṃ mu tra bha dha ya i rnyiṣ+ṭha thā swā hā/ mchod stod bkra shis gong bzhin bya/ /de nas rgyas pa'i sbyin bsreg dang / /tsa ru'i ston mo rgyas par bya/ /bza' btung mang po bshams pa de/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyis spel byas te/ /zhal zas brgya ldan bde ba mchog ster ba/ /legs sbyar 'di ni rgyal ba sras bcas ⑤la—/ /bdag gis gus phul 'gro ba ma lus kun/ /'byor ldan ting 'dzin mchog la spyod par shog /ā+oṃ sarba di ba bya a pra ti na ma pa ta ye swā hā/ rten la dbul zhing longs spyad nas/ /bdag dang yon bdag thams cad kyis/ /lag tu me tog rol mo dang rten la gzungs thag btags la thams cad dam slob dpon gyi bzung 1ba'am/yang na rdo rje reg la thams cad kyis me tog gis char dbabarjo/ rab gnas kyi sngags ni oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra swā hā/oṃ hūṃ tram̐ thru khaṃ badzi bha bha ba tiḍa tiṣ+ṭha byu khaṃ swā hā zhes brjod do/ /spos bzang thogs la bkra shis brjod—/ /mchod bstod la sogs ci rigs bya/ /de nas rjes kyi chos rnams ni/ /bla ma yi dam chos skyong dang / /gzhi bdag gtor mas tshim byas nas/ /chos skyong la ni bka' sgo ba/ /nag po chen pos rten 'di bsrungs/ /zhes brjod rdo rje'i go bkon nas/ /spyi bor haṃ dang kai bsams nas/ /haṃ dang ke las haṃ dang ke gi sgra byung rjob rdo rje'i khrab haṃ rak+ṣa haṃ shaṃ ka pa 47—35

tsi paṃ/ rdo rje'i khrab dang rgyun gyur nas/ /gzhan kyis mi thub drag shul che/ /nus mthu phun sum tshogs par bsam/ /de nas dam la gdags pa ni/ /rdo rje rtse lnga spyi bor bzhag /rdo rje 'di ni dam tshig te/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin kyis brlabs/ /gal te dam las 'das gyur na/ /'gems par 'gyur ba gdon mi za/ /yī badz+ra ma ha ka la ha na badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa/ bdag dang yon bdag 'khor bcas rnams/ /bsrung zhing skyab pa'i las mdzad nas/ /ci bsam thams cad 'grub pa dang / /'khor dang longs spyod rgyas par mdzod//'gro ba sems can don slad du/ /bde gshegs rnams ni bzhugs kyi bar/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi don gyi phyir/ /sprul sku'i gzugs brnyan srung bar mdzod/ /bstod bskul la sogs rgyas par bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs la bdag ji ltar 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab dngos grub blang ngo / /bzod par gsol yi ge brgya pa gsum brngod la de nas gshegs par bya ba ni/ /rab gnas lha ni mi gshegs par/ /dkyil 'khor lha rnams gshegs bya ste / /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras/ /rigs sdus dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bcas—/ /tshangs pa la sogs lha rnams dang / /yang dag cho ga'i bya ba la/ /nongs gyur de dag bzod par rigs/ /zhi dang rgyas pa phun tshogs par/ /yon bdag rnams la rab mdzad nas/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon pa mdzad du gsol/ /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /bskal pa brgya ru bsrung ba dang / /sangs rgyas kyi ni sgu gzugs la/ /mchod pa chen po mdzad du gsol—/ /dgyes shing thugs bzang gyur pa yis brtan par bzhugs nas ni/ /slob dpon yon bdag bcas pa yis/ /bu dang tsha bo srung mdzad nas/ /rang gnas dge bar gshegs su gsol/ /de nas rab gnas ye shes pa/ /brtan par bzhugs su 47—36

gsol ba ni/ /slob dpon dang ni yon bdag gis/ /sku yi gdan khri nas bzung nas—/ /ji srid sa chu me dang ni/ /rlung gi bskal par 'jig par du/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bcom ldan khyod ni bzhugs par mdzod/ /de nas bkra shis glu dang gar/ /rol mo sgra dang bcas pa yis/ /bskor ba bya zhing brtan par bzhugs/ /yon bdag rnams la 'di skad sgo/ /snyigs ma'i dus kyi sprul pa'i sku/ /'di nyid yin gyis gus par gyis/ /mchod bstod phyag bskor rgyun du 'badaske/ /'di ni mthong ba tsam gyis kyang / /sdig pa'i tshogs rnams thams cad mdzad/ /don rnams grub cing tshogs gnyis sdogs/ /de ltar bsgo zhing zhal zas kyi/ /lhag ma thams cad longs spyad nas/ /lha la mchod bstod bshags pa dang / /bkra shis brjod cing bsngo ba bya/ /de nas yon bdag slob dpon la/ /rta dang glang po ma he dang / /gser dngul zangs sogs dpag med kyis/ /mnyes par bya ba shin tu gces/ /rab gnas rgyas pa'i cho ga'o—/ /rab gnas bsdus pa bya ba ni/ /bsnyen pa sa chog sta gon dang / /bgegs bskrad khrus dang rten bskyed dang / /dgug gzhug rgyas gdab dbang bskur dang / /spyan dbye la sogs thams cad kun/ /zhag cig 1 sdogs pas bsdus par 'dod/ /shin tu bsdus pa'i rab gnas ni/ /rdul tshon la yang mi rten te/ /maṇ+ḍal steng du bum cig dgod/ /de la bsnyen sngags brgya rtsa brgyad/ /bzlas nas bgegs bskrad khrus sogs bya/ /skad cig dam tshig sems dpar bskyed par bskyed/ /ye shes stem dang rgyas gdab dang / /dbang lnga la sogs bsgur bar bya/ /de nas rten 'byel snying po yis/ /rang rang sngags kyi sgu der bsgyur/ /spyan dbye la sogs dngos su bya/ /ma grub ting nge 'dzin gyis so//47—37

mchod bstod rtsa ru'i ston mo dang / /bkra shis mang du brjod par bya/ /kun tu dge zhing mchog thob phyir/ /rgyas pa'am shin tu bsdus pa ⑨rim gsum rgyud la gsungs pa yi/ /rab gnas bzang po 'di byas pas/ /'gro kun 'jam dbyangs thob par shog /'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i spyan dbye ba'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ slob dpon chen po smri ti ②rnye na ghir tis mdzad pa jo gas so// //bsdur mchan/14 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉'a/ ske〈〈pe 〉sngacod/15 ①〈〈pe 〉rgapa 3 〈〈pe 〉7pa/16 nyu〈〈pe 〉ridang / /zhu〈〈pe 〉8ngas/ zu 〈〈pe 〉7tshogs/ rjo〈〈pe 〉risgoms/17 ①〈〈pe 〉ja'i/ khru〈〈pe 〉sngaradrer/18 nyu〈〈pe 〉mgo bhu 〈〈pe 〉〉stosmis/ rngu〈〈pe 〉〉 su/19 kye〈〈pe 〉rab/2༷ ⑫〈〈pe 〉skorachal/21 sti〈〈pe 〉'ang / ②〈〈pe 〉7ni/22 yi〈〈pe 〉7yon/ bye 〈〈pe 〉thazhugs/ 〈〈pe 〉ya/ ④〈〈pe 〉ras/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉thobs/ ⑥ 〈〈pe 〉thatang /23 khye〈〈pe 〉'ag ⑤〈〈pe 〉tha/24 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〉mas/ ②〈〈pe 〉snga stod/25 ①〈〈pe 〉skoraphongs pa (2sna〈〈pe 〉thazangs/26 bla〈〈pe 〉〉lnga/27 khye〈〈pe 〉7na/ 1〈〈pe 〉mi'i/28 nyu〈〈pe 〉7 mur/29 nyu〈〈pe 〉7nga /3༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉sgrubs/47—38

31 ①〈〈pe 〉〉spyor/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉pa/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉sbubs/32 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bsam/ ②〈〈pe 〉stan/ ①〈〈pe〉〉bzhag du〈〈pe〉〉khopa/33 ①〈〈pe 〉torathob/34 ①〈〈pe 〉〉spangs/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉 pa/ ⑧〈〈pe〉〉de/ du〈〈pe〉〉mo/ du〈〈pe 〉stan/35 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bdam/ ②〈〈pe 〉tshosas/ ①〈〈pe 〉sngagazung / du〈〈pe 〉〉 bo// ⑤〈〈pe 〉torabyung /37 hu)〈〈pe 〉sngagacig38 ①〈〈pe 〉〉sdus pa'i/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉ta/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2618)47—39

༄/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs dpa' bo gcig grub pa'i bstod pa gser gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba/kyesngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ sed+dhi e ka bi ra mañdzu gho ṣa su baṇ+ḍi mā la stod tra 3 nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dpa' bo gcig grub pa'i bstod pa gser gye phreng ba zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dbyangs sgrib med spyan gyis gzigs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad khyod kyis sems bskyed la bkod 'bras la sbyar/ /'gro ba ma lus thugs rjes legs bzung 'gron du bos nas sdug bsngal bsal zhing bde la 'god par bzhed/ /brjod kyis mi lang yon tan ldan khyod bskul mi 'tshal bar mkhyen brtses brtag du par gzhan don mdzad mod kyi/ /dad pas skra rtse gang tsum ④bstod bkyi brtse chobs gzhan gyi sdug bsngal spang slad rang bsam dbang gis bskul/ /dri za mi ci lha min mi dang lha dbang gtsor gyur zur phud lnga ldan ljon pa thags bzang ris/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal khyab 'jug dbang phyug che dang 47—40

dga' rab dbang phyug bdud kyi sde dpon 'jig rten skyong / /nor lha nye dbang brgya byin tshangs pa gnas gtsang lha bu gzhon nu rgyal sras mchog tu gyur rnams kyi//rin chen du mas nyer mdzes gtsug rgyan 'od 'phros zhabs rdul pad+mo'i ze'u 'bru blangs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /mgon po khyod sku gangs ri dngul dang dung gi bcag 'phro 'o ma'i rgya mtsho stong phrag skar ma'i gzi/ /ston ka'i zla 'od mu tig dri med rgya spos me tog puṇa ḍa ri ka kun dha 'bar ba'i mdog /zhi ba'i cha lugs gzhon nu'i gzugs 'chang 1brgyad gnyis na tshod shin tu mdzes pa sgeg cing 'gying ba'i tshul/ /pad rtsa ltar 'jam sha rgyas lang tsho ldan pa na chung bzhin du reg bde ka tsa lin di ltar/ /g.yas g.yon mchog sbyin ut+pal 'dzin sku'i rked pa'i skabs phyin mchog tu yid 'phrog rdo rje skyil krung can/ /gtsug tor mi mngon zur phud lnga ldan 'jam mdzes dri zhim mthon mthing ma 'dzings dbu skra'i mtshams mthug pa/ /dpral ba'i dbyes che smin mtshams ma chad pad ma rgyas 'dra dkar nag rab tu phyed pa'i mig dkyus ring / /shangs kyi dbyebs legs sprin med sgra gcan las thar zla ba 'dzum zhal dkyil 'khor blta na sdug /bim pa byi ru pad ma ra ga leb rgan rtsi ltar 'bar 2ba'i mchu sgros mdzes ldan yid du 'ong / /mchog tu 'od gsal pad ma'i rtsa lag stong gi gzi mdangs gang la reg pa'i dbang po tshim par mdzad/ /btso ma'i gser sbyangs las byas rin chen sna tshogs 'bur du btod pa'i 'phra bkod dpung rgyan rtse phran dang / /snyan cha gdub kor 'od 'phros mkhur tshogs 4gsal ldan nor bu spel ma mgul rgyan se mo do 'grig dang / /rin chen do shal ska rags yid 'phrog phyag zhabs gdu bu sil sel khrol khrol sgra snyan rab tu sgrogs/ /khyod ni gdul bya'i dbang gis lug ru 17—4/

dong ka'i me tog nyi 'od gur gum 'dzam+bu'i chu gser mdog /la las mtshal dang byi ru'i chun po li khri ba la sha dang pad ma ra ga'i dpung bzhin mthong / /'ga' 'gas ku sha sman dang dur ba bsnol ba rin chen mar gad 'tsher zhing 'bar ba'i ri ltar khums/ /gzhan kyis nam mkha' bai ḍūr+ya dang in+d+ra byā la ral gri ut+pal spang rgyan bzhin du rtogs/ /mos pa ji bzhin mdog zhal phyag zhabs spyan rnams sna tshogs gcig nas bye ba 'bum gyi bar du snang / /'gro ba'i bla ma khyod kyi gsung mchog rna bar snyan 'jebs yid 'ong ka la ping ka tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ / /bung ba myos pa ngang pa'i sde dpon rab mdzes rma bya rnga sgra sgril ma khyu mchog ngar rtaba'i skad/ /dgu po rgyud mangs rgyud stong ldan dang 2dri za'i rgyal po'i gre 'gyur spel 'dra sgyur mkhas gling bu'i sgra/ /'dod pas myos pa'i na chung gzhon nu'i glu yi dbyangs ltar mnyen 'jam yid 'phrog gsal zhing zur phyin pa/ /lha 'am dri za'i bu mos rol mo sil snyan sna tshogs sgrags pa lta bur gdangs snyan phul du byung / /zab cing rab brjid ring bar rgyun chags ngar ngar chem chem drag po 'brug gi nga ro brgyud ma bzhin/ /yan lag bcu phrag drug ldan mos pa ji bzhin sgra 'byung gang gis thos pa'i dbang po rab tshim mdzad/ /phyogs dus 'gro kun nang na khyod kyi gsung dang mtshungs pa'ang med na lhag pa lta smos ci zhig 'tshal / /lha mchog khyod thugs pad mo ut+pal ku mu ta la chu dang 'dam gyis ji bzhin skyon ma bos/ /dus gsum chos rnams thogs chags rnged par lag mthil dbang po ro ldan 'bras bu lta bur rtogs par 'gyur/ /thugs rje'i sdong chen lhun s+t+rag stobs sogs yon tan rab rgyas byang chub yan lag me tog 'bar/ /ro brgya ldan pa legs smin 'bras bus 'khor ba ji srid khyab rtag gzhan don 77 — /2
