mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun mkhyen ldan pa khyod la kho bo skrag pas zhu ba gsol bgyid re ba'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /bsten pas don grub zab lam rjes 'dzin rigs kyi lha dang sgrub gnas ting 'dzin gzungs dang mngon shes dang / /dpag med thabs mkhas sems can kun gyi don byed yid bzhin nor ltar bsam pa sgrub byed gang zhig lags/ /byang chub bar du lus grib gser gyi ser po ma yis bu ltar rjes 'brang mi 'dor bskyang du gsol/ /mtha' gting rnged pa'i 'khor ba'i mtshor lhung las ngan dud 'gro'i tshogs kyis zos shing sdug bsngal rlabs kyis g.yengs/ /thogs med dus nas lus ngag yid kyis bsags pa'i sdig ltung sprin gyi sgrib pa mun stugs 'khrigs gyur pas/ /lha mchog 'od 'bar nyi ma ma mthong 'phrin las klung gzings myur spyor thams cad mkhyen pa'i ring bskyal gsol/ /slar yang rtag tu snyug bsngal mi ngoms zab yangs rgya mtshor lcung gyur myur skyobs myur skyobs 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /sems can gcig phyir phyi ma'i mu mthar spyod par ma bcos zhal bzhes thabs mkhas thugs rje mkhyen ldan yang / /srid pa'i btson rar dam bcings 'dod yon dug zos nyam thag nga ros 'bod pa ci phyir yal bar 'dor/ /dran pas don gnyer rnams kyi re ba dpag bsam ljon shing bum pa bzang ltar ngas kyang bya'o zhes/ /dam bcas bsnyel tam rgyun du khrod bsam gyis kyang ma rtogs je tshoms sbug bsngal mtsho las thar ma gyur/ /thang la nya bsgyur 'dre ldog chus khyer skyes bu yan lag g.yob bgyid rta glang bcing ba kun tu phra/ /dgras bzung bros tshol khyo shi brang rdung lhang lhang ngu zhing bu gabyug chus khyer smre sngags chen po 'don/ /bkres skom bza' btung don gnyer gzer nad btab pa 'khun bu'i sgra 'byin tsha grang 77— 3

nyen pas bsel drod mdzod/ /gzhan sdug dran dang yon tan tshol phyir lhag par rtag gdungs kye ma myur skyobs 'jam dbyangs lha yi lha/ /de ltar phyogs 'gas bstod dang 'bras bu gsol bgyis dge ba ston ka'i zla ba'i 'od 'dra gang thob des/ /'gro ba kun gyis sangs rgyas rtag mthong mnyes byed theg pa mchog thob byang chub sems bskyed mi 'dral 1zhing / /sdug bsngal kun spangs nag po'i phyogs bcom pha rol phyin rdzogs stobs sogs yon tan mtshungs med legs thob ste/ /'jam dbyangs ji bzhin sangs rgyas zhing spyong sems can smin byed 'gro mgon chos rgyal thams cad mkhyen thob shog /'jam dbyangs bstod pa 'jam dbyangs byin rlabs kyis/ /'jam dbyangs dran pas 'jam dbyangs bsgul ba dang / /'gro kun 'jam dbyangs dpal la dgod pa'i phyir/ /'jam dbyangs spyis len 'jam dbyangs grags pas sbyar/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs dpa' bo gcig grub pa'i bstod pa gser gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba/ slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //

2693ra༅/ /a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs/she ༄/ mi pham bshes gnyen gyi a ra pa tsa na lha lnga'i sgrubs thabs bzhugs so/ /sngal / /rgya gar skad du/ a ra pa tsa na sā dha ṭaṃ/ bod skad du/ a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkar po ri bong 'dzin pa dang 'dra glegs bam ral gris phyag mtshan zhing / /legs par mdzes pa'i gzhon nu zur phud lnga pa shin tu zhi ba can/ /dga' ba rab rgyas thar pa'i mchog ste pad+ma'i 'dab ma yangs pa'i spyan/ /ngan pa'i blo gros sreg pa la mkhas 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skye bo gang dag rnams kyis a ra pa tsa na yi dngos grub phyir/ /lo phyed bar du rgyun mi 'chad par spyor ba bsgom pa gang yin pa/ /mchog gi blo dang khyad par byang chub go 'phang nges par 'thob ldan pa'i/ /'khor lo rin po che yi man ngag shin tu basbus pa bgyi ba lags/ /dri zhim me tog bcal du bkram zhing dri yi chu yis (7— /6

chag chag btab/ /mnyam zhing gtsang ma sngags rig yid du 'ong ba'i sa yi cha dag tu/ /yid 'ong 'jam pa'i stan ni ci yang rung ba dag la nyer 'dug nas/ /bde bar shin tu mtshan ma med pa'i byang chub sems ni bsgom par bya/ /dngos don don dang bcas pa ma lus kun nas ni/ /stong par rnam par bsgom bya slar yang bdag gi lus/ /de dang de ni 'od gsal nyid du bltas byas la/ /swa bhā wa shudhe'i gsang sngags yang dag brjod par bya/ /de nas rang snying dang po'i dbyangs las bar snang du/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'od bzangs ldan pa bsgom par bya/ /de nas 'dir ni dhī yig tu brjod dkar po ste/ /de ni lhag par dri med 'jam pa'i dbyangs su bsam/ /zla ba bye ba dag dang mtshungs pa'i mdangs 'dzin cing / /kun nas 'bar ba'i rgyan rnams kyis ni spras pa ste/ /chags dang bcas par cung zad 'dzum zhing yid 'phrog pa/ /pad+ma'i steng na gcig tu bsam gtan nges pas bzhugs/ /rang gi snying gar a yig mchog las 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa yi gzugs/ /rnam par 'phro ba'i mnyam med 'od zer dra ba can ni yang dag bsam/ /de yi steng du zla ba'i gzugs brnyan dag la sngags pas bsgom par bya ste/ /de ni ri bong 'dzin pa lta bu'i bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid do/ /g.yas su mdzes pa'i gzugs ldan skra can ma ni rnam par 'dzum pa dang / /shin tu rgyas pa'i nu ma zung ldan zur gyis de la blta ba ste/ /shin tu mdzes shing sgeg pa'i lus ma nye ba'i skra can g.yon logs su/ /mtha' dag yon tan gter du gyur pa tsa na dag las bsgom par bya/ /dri med legs par dkar ba dra ba can kyi 'od/ /re pha las byung mdun du nges par bsam pa nyid/ /'od kyi rang bzhin yid 'phrog zla ba'i 'od can ni/ /ba yi 47—/7

yi ge las skyes rgyab tu bzhag par bya/ /yang na yi ge bkod pa'i 'od zer 'bar ba yis/ /rgya cher rab tu snang ba nges par rnam bsgom bya/ /des ni mi shes ri bong 'joms par 'gyur ba dang / /yid ni rnyog pa med pa'i ye shes dam par byed/ /'og gi 'khor lo myur du 'khor bar bsam bya zhing / /gti mug mun nag kun nas rnam par 'joms pa yi/ /zla ba'i gzugs brnyan dang 'dra 'od zer dra ba can/ /lha rnams ni g.yo ba med pa nyid du blta/ /ri bong can lha'i 'od zer sprin ni rgya chen po/ /phyung nas phyogs bcu bo rnams gsal bar gyur pa yis/ /rang lus bzhin du sems can rnams ni brgyan byas te/ /slar yang 'ong ba snying ga'i zla ba la gzhug bya/ /sngags pas gsang sngags dam pa a ra pa tsa na ni legs bzlos shing / /brtan pa'i blo yis man ngag bsgoms las blo ngan sdug bsngal rab bcom ste/ /yid kyi shes pa dri med dag dang pha rol phyin pa rnams dang yang / /mchog tu gyur pa'i sa rnams dang ni gang des rgyal ba thob par 'gyur/ /dam pa'i chos kyi mdzod gyur bla ma dam pa dga' mchog rdo rje yis/ /bde gshegs tshogs kyi spyan sngar cho gas 1gang zhig mngon par dbang bskur ba/ /blo bzang mi pham bshes gnyen des ni skye bos blo mchog grub bya'i phyir/ /a ra pa tsa na yi 'khor lo gzhung du yang dag sbyar ba yin/ /'khor lo'i cho ga bzang po gzhung mchog tu sbyar bas/ /bsod nams rgya chen kun nas bdag gis thob gyur pa/ /gang yin des ni 'jig rten nyon mongs las rgyal zhing / /nges nga/'i bde ba gcig pu 'jam pa'i dbyangs gyur cig/ //a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po mi pham bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //17— /8

2694༄༅/ /'phags pa yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs/1 ༄/ jo bo'i gzhung 2/ sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ṣa ṭa k+ṣa ra sā dha rna/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po re zhig sngags pas gdong bkrus nas stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ sangs rgyas la sogs pa bsams la skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa bya'o/ /bdag ni dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song ba yin no/ /zhes mos par byas la/ sems can ji snyed bsdu bas yang dag par bsdus pa sgo nga las skyes pa'am/ mngal las skyes pa 'am/ drod bsher las skyes pa 'am/brdzus te skyes pa 'am/ gzugs can nam/ gzugs can ma yin pa 'am/'du shes can nam/ 'du shes med pa 'am/ 'du shes yod min med min te/ji srid du sems can rnams kyi khams su rtogs pa de dag thams cad/ bdag gis phung po lhag ma med pa'i dbyings su dgod par bya'o/ /zhes bsams la de 17—50

nas oṃ swa bhā wa shudha sarba dharmā kyiswa bhā wa shusgolhahaṃ/ de ltar stong pa nyid du basbus tsam gyis bsgoms la/ de'i 'og tu rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/de'i steng du yi ge tweḥlas 'od zer brgya stong du ma bsgoms te/ yang de nyid kyis thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i 'dod chags la sogs pa nyon mongs pa ma lus pa thams cad rnam par dag par byas nas bdag nyid kyi 2snying gar zhugs pa las/ bdag nyid 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sku rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas na phreng ba/ g.yon pa na pad+ma bsnams pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /g.yas su nor bu 'dzin pa sku mdog phyag mtshan la sogs pa de dang 'dra/g.yon du 'bru drug ma rig sngags chen mo phyag bzhi ma ston ka'i sprin lta bu'o/ /oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa a la la hoḥ aḥ aḥ aḥ aḥ zhes bya bas byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags kyi rgyal po 'di brjod par bya'o/ /de ltar bsgoms nas de'i 'og tu 'jig rten dbang phyug gi thugs ka'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor las phreng ba 'dra ba skor/ zhal nas phyung zhing lte bar zhugs te 'khor lo'i tshul kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thabs yid bzhin kyi nor bu lta bur rtogs pa sngags kyi rgyal po 'di mtshan ma med pa'i tshul gyis zla bar bya'o/ /de nas lus g.yo ba dang bcas par gyur pa la sogs par 'gyur ba'i rnal 'byor pa dad pa dang /snying rje dang / bla ma la gus pa dang ldan pas ni ring por mi thogs par 'gyur ro / /nor bu 'dzin pa/'i snying ngo/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ zhes de ltar bzlas so/ /de nas ldang ba'i dus su yang sngags brjod par bya'o/ /yi ge brgya pa brjod par bya'o/ /de ltar bzlas nas ci bder gnas par bya'o/ /yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs slob 17—51

ra༅/ /'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i sgrub thabs/ 1ga paṇa chen lugs/ ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya a mo gha pa sha sā dha ṭ+wāṃ/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshanabarjod mgon po hriḥyig las byung ba/ /sems can kun la thugs brtse ba/ /don yod zhags pa sgrubs 2pa'i thabs/ /dam bca' ba gsal por dbye phyir gus phyag 'tshal/ /dang po re shig gnas dbe+en par phun sum tshogs par snga bar langs te gdong bkru ba dang maṇ+ḍal dang mchod pa sngon du 'gro bas lha 'am/ bla ma'i drung du gso spyong blangs pa ma grub na sdom nga/ gnyis la brten nas bya gsung ngo / /te slab pa la gnas la/ sems can thams cad la mi bzod pa'i brtse bas sems bskyed la/ rang gi snying gar paṃlasapad ma dang alasazla ba'i steng du / hriḥdakar po 'od zer 'phro ba bsams te/ de'i 'od kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa dang dri ma sbyangs te/ yang bla ma dang sangs rgyas 47—pya3

la sogs pa spyan drangs la/ phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod pa la sogs pa sangs rgyas dam chos dge 'dun dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'a 'ang / /rnam kun btud te skyabs mchis nas/ /mchod 'os gzhan la phyag 'tshal 'o / /sdig pa/ las ni ldog bgyid cing / /bsod nams thams cad yongs su bzung / /lus rnams kun gyi bsod nams gang / /kun la rjes su yi rang ngo / /bdag gi spyi gtsug thal sbyar ro/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor sla da du/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la gsol/ /de ltar bgyis pa'i bsod nams dang / /bdag jis bgyis dang ma bgyid dang / /des ni sems can thams cad kun/ /bla med byang chub sems ldan shog /ces yan lag bdun pa bya'o/ /bdun rnam dag bya'o/ /de nas tshad med pa bzhi bsgom 1 ste/o swa bha wa bi shudha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shurjo haṃ/ zhes pas dngos po ma lus pa stong pa nyid mos pa nyid dang / oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma ko haṃ/ zhes pas byin gyis rlob 2 po/ /de nas rnam par sad nas stong pa'i ngang las gtso bo'i dasar ngo/ paṃ las sna tshogs phyogs kyi pad ma sdong po lnga pa dbul gyes nga 'o 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus kyi sdong po'i pad+ma'i lte ba la rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo a dkar po las zla ba'i steng du / hriḥdakar po las 'od zer 'phros shing 'dus pa las pad ma dkar po'i lte ba la hriḥyis mtshan pa'o/ /de las 'od 'phros te sems can gyi don bsgrubs te thim pa de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i lha lnga'i bdag nyid du bsams te/ dbus kyi pad+ma'i sdong bu'i lte bar zla ba'i gdan la bcom ldan 'das don yod zhags pa ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhabs gnyis mnyam par bzhengs pa'i sgu/ zhal gcig phyag brgyad pa/ g.yas kyi phyag bzhi na phreng ba dang zhags pa dang / bla ma shri'i thugs dam gyi thang sgu la gtso bo'i pa/d+ma ni dalar po/'od rab mchog dpa la kyi dpe la sna tshogs pa/da ma'o/ /mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa dang / mchog sbyin pa'o/ /g.yon gyi bla ma bhi bhu ta'i phyab dpe 'a g.yon dang po na glegs bam/ gnyis pa na pad+ma dkar po'i yu 77—bye4

ba thugs kar 'dzin pa snang ngo / /rab mchog dpal gyi dpe la g.yas dang po nas rim pa bzhin mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa dang /zhags pa dang 'phreng ba bsnams pa zhes pa 'dug go/ /phyag bzhi na/ yal ga gsum pa'i dbyug pa dang po ti dang pad+ma'i sdong bu dang / ril pa spyi blugs bsnams 'dug go/ /pad ma dkar po'i sdong bu dang / po ti dang / yal ga gsum pa'i dbyug pa dang / spyi blugs 'dzin pa'o/ /spyan gnyis pa/ na bza' dkar po zung gis spras pa'i stag gi lpags pas smad bkris pa / ri dwags kyi lpags pa se ral khar g.yon nas 'phyang ba/ ral pa'i thor tshugs la 'od dpag tu med pas skurten te brgyan pa zhal 'dzum pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis nye bar mdzes pa 'od zer 1 dkar po'i phreng bas 'khrigs pa'i sku las de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i sgu 'phro ba/ sems can gyi don byed pa sems can la thugs rje'i spyan kyis gzigs pa'o/ /de ltar mdun gyi pad+ma la gzhon nu nor bzang ser po/ ralapaser po rin po che'i cod pan can/ rgyan dang na bza' sna tshogs pas nye bar mdzes pa/ g.yas pa dang mchan khung g.yon par ka pa li bcug ste g.yon pas shesarab kyi po ti ka pā li dang / lagapaganyis ngo/ thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /'di zhabs g.yon pa'i sor mos g.yas pa'i sdog pa reg mdzad pa'o/ /g.yas kyi pad ma'i sdong bu la khro gnyer can / zhal gabyug phyag bzhi ma sku mdog dmar ser/ ral pa'i cod pan la steng na mchod rten 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum nu ma dbal can/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pa dang / na bza' brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas gnyis na mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa dang / bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ g.yon gnyis na sipal nyi sa yal ga gsum pa'i dbyug pa dang / spyi blugs bsnams pa'o/ /brgyab kyi pad+ma'i sdong bu la rta mgrin zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sgu mdog dmar po mi'u thung gi rnam pa can/gsus pa che ba dbu skra dang smra ra dmar ser gyen du 'greng ba/ spyan gsum pa 777—55

mche ba brtsigs pa khro gnyer can steng na rta mgo ljang gu bteg pa/ stag gi lpags pas smad bkris snapa/ na bza' stodagayogs dmar po 'phyang ba can/ steng sga cha la rdo rje phyed pa/sa mtshan pa'i/ phyag g.yon dbyug pa dkar po la la oṃtshugs su rten pa/ g.yas dpral bar phyag byed pa babyu/na zhabs g.yas pa'i sor mos g.yon pa'i rting pa la reg bzhin pa/'o/ /de g.yon brkyang 2mtshon pa'o/ /g.yon kyi sdong bu la sgrol ma zhal cig phyag gnyis ma sku mdog ljang gu phyag g.yon na ut+pal la thugs lar bzung nas rna ba la reg bzhin pa'o/ /bsnams shing / g.yas pas mchog sbyin pa'o/ /rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pa dang /na bza' dmar pos g.yogs pa/ nu ma rgyas shing lang tsho dang ldan pa'o/ /de ltar lha thams cad zla ba'i gdan can no/ /gtso bo'i pad ma dkar po/ gtsobo'i khro gnyer can sgol ma/ gsum ni zhabs mnyam nga/ra ga'engs pa'i stangs yin la/ rta mgrin dang nor bzangs zhabs g.yas pa/ dang g.yon sbas pa/'i stangs kyi sgum pa/'i/ 'khor bzhi po sna tshogs pad ma'o/ /de ltar bzhi po de rnams ni rab mchog dpe la g.yon gyi u t+pal de g.yas pa sa kha 'byed pa bzhin sems can gyi don la brtson pas bzhengs nas bcom ldan 'das la mngon par phyogs par bsam mo /de ltar brtan par bsgoms te/ rang gi snying khar paṃ las pad ma dang zla ba'i steng du hriḥdakar por gyur pa las ye shes sems dpa' rang dang zhal ni phyag pa/da ma dang mchog spyin no/ /mtshungs pa'o/ /de'i thugs kar pad ma dang zla ba'i steng du hriḥdakar po gsal bar lta'o/ /mgo bo dang / mgrin pa dang / snying ga rnams su dkar po dang / dmar po dang / nag po'i mdog can gyi oṃ āḥ4hūṃ rnams pad+ma dang zla ba la rim pa bzhin bsam mo/ /de nas sa bon gyi 'od zer gyi ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la/ dza hūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes pas dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang /dges pa dang / dbyer med pa dang / dbang du bya'o/ /rigs lnga spyan drangs/ des 17——56

sngar bzhin mchod de dbang bskur bar gsol ba btab pas yang lha mo bzhis dbang bskur te/ de nas sa bon las 'od 'phros pas 'gro ba thams cad la phog pas/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i skur gyur slar sa bon de nyid la 'dus par yang dang yang du bsam mo/ /de nas man ngag bzhin du spro bsdu byed cing gtso bo'i phyed sgol ma bzhi ngo/ ma bcu cha bzlas gsungs sngags bzlas te/ oṃ a mo gha pa sha triḥswā hā/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ triḥtre+e lokya bi dza ya a mo gha pra sha a pra ti ha ta hriḥhaḥ2hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ snying po'o//de ltar gzungs kyang bzlas so/ /oṃ su bha dha na ku mā ra ye swā hā/ oṃ bh+ri bh+ri ku ṭa ye swā hā/ oṃ dha ha ya gri pa yā hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ tai tā re tud tā re tu re swā hā / zhes so/ /ldang bar 'dod na mchod pa dang gtor ma dang maṇ+ḍal phul te gsol ba btab la/ bsod nams yongs su bsngo te/ ye shes sems dpa' gshegs pa dang / rang nyid la basbus te spyod lam bya'o/ /de ltar nyin re bzhin du thun re bzhi la sogs pa'i nges pas/ nye ba'i snying po 'bum phrag sum cu rtsa drug gam/ snying po'i 'bum phrag bcu drug ma / gzungs kyi sngags 'bum phrag gcig bzlas par bya'o/ /des ni sngon du bsnyen pa byas par 'gyur ro / /de nas sgrub pa/ gnyis las dang ngo/ nye bar bsgrub pa ni/ dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes bdun dang / brgyad dang / dgu'i zhag la spyor ba dang / dngos gzhi dang / rjes kyi tshogs 4brgyad kyi zhag la za gcig pa'am snyung bar gnas par sgrub par bya'o/ /sgrub pa chen po'i sgo nas bcom ldan 'das mnyes par 'dod na yang / dkyil 'khor nye bar bsgrub pa dang / bum pa lnga nye bar bsgrubs te/mchod pa dang gtor ma sngon du 'gro bas dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes brgyad nas brtsams te/ rig pa stong phrag brgyad bar ma chad par gdon par bya'o/ /17—t+ya7

las kyi gsum las sbya ra ro/ /1cho ga thams cad bsgrub thabs bzhin/ gzhung nas gsungs pa man ngag bzhin du bsgrub bo/ /de ltar tshogs pa tshang bas bsgrubs na mtshams med pa lnga byas pas kyang tshe 'di la mngon du 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i sgrub thabs kha che'i paṇa ṭi ta chen po sa'i steng na 'gran zla dang bral ba/ shākya shrī bha tras mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar shar phyogs na dza kata ta li'i paṇa tri ta dpal bhi bu ta tsan+t+ra dang /blo bo lots+tsha ba dge slong shes rab rin chen kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o/ /sa steng na 'gran zla dang bral ba'i paṇa tri ta chen po kha che'i shākya shrī bha tra ces pa de/ rdo rje gdan na bzhugs pa'i tshe sku khams bag tsam ma bde nas dpyid zla 'bring po'i tshes brgyad la gso sbyong la gnas pa dang / nam gyi brgyad cha tsam lus pa na gzims nas bzhugs pa'i tshe/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa 'khor dang bcas pa gzims nas bzhugs pa zhal mngon sum du gzigs nas/bzhengs pa dang de bzhengs par zhal bstan te/ sgu khams kyang dngas nas sgrub thabs 'di mdzad do/ /des bhi bu ti tsan+ta la/ des blo bo lots+tsha ba/ des sras blo gros bzang po/ des slob dpon a mo gha la/ dge'o// //47—58

bsdur mchan/53 skumatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄tsho/ /'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// 5 〈〈pe 〉〉sgrub/ 〈〈pe 〉〉wadang /54 1 〈〈pe 〉〉sgom/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉dub/55 ) 〈〈pe 〉〉pa'i 'od/ ste〈〈pe 〉〉bzangs/56 1 〈〈pe 〉stanakris/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉rkyang / 〈〈pe 〉〉wade/ 4 〈〈pe 〉to/ཿ/57 1 〈〈pe 〉〉gsung / 2 〈〈pe 〉〉waḥ/ 〈〈pe 〉〉kam/ 4 〈〈pe 〉〉cho gas/58 1 〈〈pe 〉〉waro/ / 2 〈〈pe 〉〉sgrub/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2622)47wa 59

2696ra༅/ /'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i sgrub thabs/ 1༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya a mo gha pa sha swa dha rgo/ bod skad du/'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa 'jig rten mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por re shig tho rangs langs te/ khrus byas nas gso spyong blangs te/ khang pa byug pa dang tsan dan gyi chus gtor zhing / gos gtsang ma bgos te rten bshams pa dang kha shar du ltas te stan bde ba la 'dug go/ /de nas sems can thams cad la brtse bas bskyed de/ rang gi snying gar paṃ las pad ma dang / a las zla ba'i steng du hriḥyig dkar po las 'od 'phros pas/bla ma dang 'phags pa don yod zhags pa dang / sangs rgyas la sogs pa spyan drangs la/ phyag 'tshal ba dang bdun po rnam par dag pa bya'o/ /de nas tshad med pa bzhi sgom ste/ snying kha'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis snod bcud thams cad bsnyus te stong pa nyid du dmigs la/ oṃ swa bha wa shudhe sarba dharma swa bha wa shusgo2phohaṃ/77——60

zhes bya bas byin gyis brlab bo/ /de'i rjes la paṃ ljang khu las sna tshogs pad ma'o/ /de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de'i steng du sa bon hriḥyig go/ /de las 'od 'phros bsdus pa las/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa bsgom 1ste/zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag brgyad pa/ zhabs gnyis mnyam po'i stangs kyis sku bzhengs pa/ spyan gnyis pa/ dar dkar po'i na bza' 'chang ba / ri dwags kyi lpags pa sku'i g.yon du se ral khar 'chang ba/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs bkris 2pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ dbu la me tog gi phreng ba can/ zhal 'dzum pa/ rgyan rnged pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na phreng ba/ gnyis pa na zhags pa/ gsum pa na mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa/ bzhi pa na mchog sbyin pa'o/ /g.yon gye dang po na shes rab kyi po ti/ gnyis pa na rna ba la reg pa'i pad+ma dkar po'i sdong bu thugs kar bzung ba/ gsum pa na yal ga gsum pa'i dbyug pa/ bzhi pa na ril ba spyi drugs bsnams pa'o/ /snying gar pad ma dang zla ba'i steng du sa bon hriḥdakar po lta'o/ /de'i 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa lta bus ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te/ dzaḥt+t+waṃ baṃ hoḥzhes pa la sogs pas dgug pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /spyan ma la sogs pas dbang bskur te/ ral pa'i thor tshugs la brten par 'od dpag tu med par cod pan du bsam mo/ /mgo bo dang / mgrin pa dang / snying gar pad+ma dang zla ba la/oṃ āḥhūṃ gi yi ge dkar po dang / dmar po dang / sngon po dgod do/ /de la spro ba dang bsdu ba'i tshul gyis mi skyo'i bar du sgom mo/ /oṃ a mo gha pā sha hriḥswā hā/zhes man ngag bzhin du bzlas so/ /bzlas pa zin nas/ oṃ a ka ro mu khaṃ zhes pa la sogs pas gtor ma bya'o/ /maṇ+ḍal dbul/ mchod pa bya/ gsol ba gdab/47—61

༄khya/ /don yod zhags pa'i sgrub thabs mdo las bsdus pa/1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya a mo gha pā sha sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ sems can thams cad kyi don du blo skyed la/ rang gi snying gar paṃ las pad ma/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du yi ge hri dkar po/ de'i 'od kyis lha'i 'khor lo dang / bla ma spyan drangs te/mdun du bzhugs su gsol la/ mchod de sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa dang /byams pa la sogs pa bsgom 2par bya'o/ /de nas swa bha wa'i sngags kyis stong pa nyid du bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas nam mkha'i dbus su bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom ste/ de'i nang du gzhal yas khang gi dbus su paṃ yongs su gyur pa las pad ma a yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du hriḥdakar po 47—63

yongs su gyur pa las spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis pa/g.yon pa dang g.yas pa na pad+ma dang mchog sbyin no/ /mdog ni gser gyi mdog lta bu'o/ /shar phyogs su paṃ dmar po las pad ma'i steng du zla ba la/ haḥyongs su gyur pa las don yod zhags pa dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/g.yas kyi dang po na zhags pa gnyis pa na rdo rje/ g.yon gyi dang po na lcags kyu gnyis pa na bgrang 'phreng ngo / /lho phyogs su paṃ dmar po las pad ma'i steng du nyi ma la hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las rta mgrin zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas na dbyug pa dang sdigs mdzub bsnams pa/ g.yon na 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'chang ba'o / /nub phyogs su paṃ nag po las pad+ma'i steng du nyi ma las pha nag po yongs su gyur pa las ral gcig ma/ nag po stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/khro mo'i zhal mche ba brtsigs pa'i gdong can/ phyag brgyad pa/ g.yas na ral gri dang / zhags pa dang / pad+ma dang / mda' bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon pa na 'khor lo dang / dbyug pa dang / rtse gsum pa dang / gzhu bsnams pa'o/ /byang phyogs su paṃ dkar po yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma'i steng du zla ba la ṭa skya bo las khro gnyer can zhal gcig pa/ phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas kyi phyag na dbyug pa dang / pad ma bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon pa na phreng ba dang spyi blugs bsnams pa'o/ /mdog skya bo'o/ /rten dang sa bon dang mtshan ma dang /phyag dang zhal la sogs pa lha lnga'i bdag nyid kyis bcom ldan 'das skad cig gis blta bar bya'o/ /de nas snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo bkug cing gzhug pa la sogs pa dang / de nas sa bon gyi 'od kyis 'khor lo bkug ste/ dbang bskur cing rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan par bya'o/ /17—6

phyis ni spro ba dang bsdu ba byas te/ ro gcig tu gyur pas bcom ldan 'das don dam par bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar mi nus na de'i rjes la ngag gis zlas pa'i sngags ni/ na maḥs man ta byu dh+wa māṃ/ sarba tā thā ga tā a wa lo ki te/ kā ru ṇa ma ya mur ta ya1/ hūṃ dzaḥswā hā/ dbus kyi bcom ldan 'das kyi snying po'o/ /ā+oṃ tweḥtre+e lokya bi dza ya a mo gha pā shā a pra ti ha ḍa hriḥhaḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ de bzhin du don yod zhags pa'i snying po'o/ /na maḥs man ta bud dha rgo haṃ khā da bhun dza satwa ya swā hā/ rta mgrin kyi snying po'o/ /oṃ e ka dza ṭi ma hā ro ṣa ṇi tra sa ya sa ma sa ma bra sa ma na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ ral gcig ma'i snying po'o/ /na maḥs man ta budha rgo/ sarba bha wa saṇa ḍa ra ṇi hūṃ phaṭa pā ta ya swā hā/ khro gnyer can gyi snying po zhes bya'o/ /de nas lha'i sgu la dmigs la bzlas pa bya'o/ /ye shes kyi 'khor lo gshegs su gsol te/ ji lta bde bar gnas so/ /mkhas pa gnyis med kyi rnal 'byor gyis las thams cad byas na myur du dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /bsgrub thabs yang dag bsdus pa las/ /bdag gis bsod nams gang thob pa/ /de yis sems can thams cad kun/ /don yod zhags pa thob par shog /don yod zhags pa'i sgrub thabs/ don yod zhags pa'i mdo las bsdus pa/ slob dpon lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po don yod rdo rje dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //47—65

2698༄༅/ /dpal 'dze+eg rten mgon po mkha' la spyod pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/1ga kha sarba ṇi lha lnga'i sgrub thabs pad+ma ka ras mdzad pa bzhugs so/ /༄4 / /rgya gar skad du/ shrī kha 2sarba ṇa lo ka nā tha sā dha na nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal 'jig rten mgon po mkha' la spyod pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 'jig rten mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan mngon 'dod 'bras bu ster ba'i gzi ldang dpag bsam rkang 'thung ni/ /bde bar gshegs rnams bzhed pa'i don chen bzod mdzad ded dpon chen po ste/ /srid dang zhi ba mnyam pa'i dngos gyur dngos po kun kyi ngo bo nyid/ /phyag na pad+ma de yis 'gro ba'i sdig pa zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /skye bos dbe+en pa'i gnas dag tu/ /sngar langs kha sogs dag byas nas/ /'jam pa'i stan la yang dag gnas/ /snying gar zla rgyas 'od gsal ba'i/ /steng du rang gi sa bon bsam/ /snying ga'i zla 'od kyis sa bon/ /yongs bskul de yi 'od zer gyis/ /khar sa pa ṇa 47—67

mgon dpal ldan/ /bla ma sangs rgyas de sras tshogs/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ /sa bon de dag las byung ba'i/ /sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin gyis mchod/ /de nas mngon par phyag byas nas/ /spyig pa bshags pa la sogs bya/ /thog med 'khor bar gang zhig rnal 'byor tshe/ /bdag gis mi dge bgyis dang bgyid stsal ba'i/ /gzhan gyis bgyis la rjes su yi rang ba/ /thams cad bcom ldan rnams kyi spyan sngar bshags/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang rgyal sras 'phags rnams dang / /gzhan dag gis kyang dge ba gang bgyis la/ /rjes/ su/ yi rang de dag ma lus pa/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu ni yongs su bsngo/ /snying rje dam pa las 'khrungs pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /chos kun ro gabyug rang bzhin can/ /gos pa med pa'i gos dag dang / /rab dga' la sogs par bzhugs pa'i/ /byang sems rnams la'ang de bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas mya ngan 'da' bzhed gyur pa rnams/ /gzhan la phan phyir yun du bzhugs par gsol/ /sgrib pa thams cad dpyis 'byin gyur pa yi/ /rgyur gyur byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing / /bde gshegs rnam dag lam gyi dgongs pa rnams/ /rtag par yang dag kun nas bsten par bgyi/ /de nas rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /gcig dang du ma rnam bral stong pa nyid du rnam bsam bya/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dzña 1na badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma kophohaṃ/ zhes bya bas stong pa nyid lhag par gnas par bya'o/ /chos 'di dag thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis yongs su dag pa'o/ /zhes lhag par gnas pa de ltar bdag nyid la'ang kun tu bltas nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shudhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shusgolhahaṃ/zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas sgom pa pos sngon gyi smon lam gyis yang dag par 77—68

bskul ba'i rnam par shes pa tsam gyi baṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las kha dog sna tshogs pa'i pad mar/ oṃ yig las skyes pa'i dri ma med pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa/ de'i steng du dīḥyig 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis nam mkha'i khyon yang dag par gsal ba bsam par bya zhing / de yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma'i snying por rang gi sa bon 'od zer gyi phreng bas brgyan pa blta bar bya'o//de nas 'di dag yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das su bsam par bya ste/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'od ltar dkar ba'i sku can/ ral pa bcings pa las dbu rgyan dang / spyi gtsug tu 'od dpag med bkod pa/ sna tshogs pad ma dang zla ba la skyil krungs 1phyed pas bzhugs pa/ sku la mchog gi brgyan dang ldan zhing zhal 'dzum pa/ brgyad gnyis lon pa'i lang tsho can/ /phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang / g.yon pa sdong bu dang bcas pa'i pad ma 'dzin pa / de'i 'og tu mdog lhag par nag pa'i ri ༄dwags gdong pa gyen du phyogs shing kha gdangs pa/ gre ba khab kyi mig can bsus pa che ba/ shin tu rid pa rnams / phyag nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun sem nga/ra 'bab par mthong bas tshim nga/ra mdzad pa/ snying rjes brlan pa'i dpal dang ldan zhing gru 'dzin gyi ri bo'i spo la bzhugs pa/ lhag par zhi bas rnam par gzigs pa can/ sgegs pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ sna tshogs pa'i mtshan rnams kyis brgyan pa'o/ /de'i mdun du sgrol ma dang / g.yas logs su gzhon nu nor bzangs po/ de la sgrol ma ljang khu phyag g.yon pas sdong bu dang bcas pa'i ut+pal 'dzin cing / g.yas pas kha 'byed pa'i tshul can/ sna tshogs pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ lang tsho gzhon zhing nu 'bur rgyas pa'o/ /gzhon nu nor bzang gser gyi mdog can/ thal mo 17—69

sbyar ba/ gzhon nu'i gzugs 'chang zhing mchan khung g.yon du glegs bam bcug pa/ rgyan thams cad dang ldan pa'o/ /rgyab tu khro gnyer can dang /g.yon du rta mgrin te/ de la khro gnyer can ser mo/ phyag bzhi ma/ ral pa'i cha shas rdzogs pa/ g.yon pas dbyug gu gsum pa dang spyi blugs/g.yas pas phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang / bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa'o/ /rta mgrin mdog dmar po thung zhing bsus pa 'phyang ba/ skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ sbrul gyi mchod phyir thogs dang ldan pa/bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor la sma ra dmar ser gyis spras pa/ spyan gsum dmar zhing zlum pa/ khro gnyer dang smin ma 'khyogs pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs 'chang ba/ g.yon pas dbyug pa'i mtshon cha dang / g.yas pas phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul can te/ 'di dag thams cad rang gi gtso bo la ji ltar mdzes pa'i mig dag gis blta zhing 'dug pa/ rnam par bsam par bya'o/ /de nas rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng dhīḥyig bsams la/ de las rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas/ khams gsum po yongs su gang zhing sems can thams cad 'jig rten dbang phyug gi go 'phang la rab tu bkod nas/slar yang 'od zer de/ sa bon gyi yi ge de la gzhug par bya'o/ /phyi nas 'od zer de nyid kyis ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te/ dam tshig sems dpa' dang chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa ltar gcig tu gyur pa'i skur bsam par bya'o/ /de nas lus ngag yid gsum rnam par dag par bya ste/ rim pa ji lta bar spyi bor oṃ yig dkar po dang / mgrin par āḥ1yig dmar po dang / thugs kar hūṃ yig sngon po rnams bsams la/ 'di rnams las mtha' yas pa'i 'od zer kyi (7—70

dra ba rtag tu 'phros pas/ sems can gyi phung po thams cad kyi sdig pa'i tshogs gzhom par bya'o/ /zhes nus pa ji lta bas gsal bar bsgoms 1par bya'o/ /rnal 'byor brtson ldan sgom pa pos/ /sgrib pa rab spongs shes rab dang / /skal bzang nad med phun sum tshogs/ /mngon du byed nga/ 'thob par 'gyur/ /bsgom pas dub na sems rtse gcig pas bzlas pa bya ste/ de la sngags ni 'di'o/ /oṃ dhīḥswā hā/ 'di rnams ston ka'i rgyu skar dri ma med pa'i phreng ba lta bu'i kha dog dang 'od kyi snang ba can las/ 'od zer du ma 'phro bas bzlas par bya'o/ /dub par gyur na bsod nams yongs su bsngo zhing / langs la ji ltar bde bar lha'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o/ /dpal ldan 'jig rten dbang phyug gi/ /yid 'ong bsgrub thabs bgyis pa yis/ /bdag gis bsod nams gang thob des/ /'gro kun de yi go 'phang gyur/ /dpal 'jig rten mgon po kha sarba ṇa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba grub chen pad ma 'byung gnas zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shrī ba na rat+na'i zhal snga nas dang /chos 'khor lo ts+tsha bas bsgyur ba las/ slad kyi btsun pa rgya mtshos dag par bcos shing gtan la phab pa'o// //

༄khya/ /'dze+eg rten dbang phyug gi bstod pa rin po che'i phreng ba/ 1༄/ /'jig rten dbang phyug gi bstod pa rin po che'i phreng ba bzhugs so/ /༄4 / /rgya gar skad du/ lo ki shwa ra sto tra rat+na mā lā/ bod skad du/'jig rten dbang phyug gi bstod pa rin po che'i phreng ba/ dpal ldan 'jig rten mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten dbang phyug dri med thugs be+e stong dang snying rjes brlan/ /lam mkhyen nyid dang thams cad mkhyen nyid la sogs don dang tshig /gsal bar 'doms pas yongs su rdzogs shing rnam par dag pa'i sgu/ /ye shes lhag pa'i bdag pos rol par mgo bos phyag bgyi'o/ /gdul bya'i dbye ba'i dbang las rnam pa mang por snang ba yis/ /gcig kyang chu snod rnams su gnas pa'i ri bong can mtshungs las/ /khyod ni gsal bar gzhan la phan pa'i rjes su song nyid phyir/ /e ma'o rdzu 'phrul shin tu rmad du byung ba'i sku ni rigs pa lags/ /mu stegs skye bo sa/dul zhing rab tu rtogs par 17—73

bya don du/ /yongs rdzogs zla ba'i zhal gyi rnam par sgeg pa'i dpral ba yi/ /gnas las dbang phyug chen po lha yi bu ni nges phyung bas/ /lha dang chen po'i mi yi shin tu lha dang dbang phyug khyod/ /pad ma'i skye ba pa rnams gdul zhing khong du chud don du/ /khyod kyi phrag pa legs rgyas chen po'i dge ba'i mtshan nyid las//mes po lha yis sras po nges par phyung ba nyid kyis ni/ /'jig rten dbang phyug dbang phyug mchog la mgo bos phyag bgye'o/ /skye bo khyab 'jug pa rnams gdul dang rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /mi bu yang 1phyag na pad+ma 'dzin pa'i thugs ka las / /nges phyung 'di ni srid nga/'i dbang phyug nyid de de'i be+ed du/ /khyod ni skyes bu rnams/ kyi mchog las mchod nyid gzhan yod min/ /nyi zlar gus bcas rim gro bsnyen bkur stobs stob ༄ rnams la ni/ /yad dag bstan phyir mthon mthing mdzes nga/'i spyan ni gang dag las/ /ri bong spyan dang bla ma nges phyung sa la mig rnams kyi/ /nang gi mun nag 'joms pa de la bdag ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal mor rim gro bsnyen bskur 3 spyor ba po rnams gdul ba dang / /rtogs phyir 'dir ni nges par bcom ldan ma ste dbyangs can 'di/ /rgyal ba'i sras po khyod kyi mche ba'i rtse las rab phyung bas/ /mngon 'dod shes rab 'bras bu ster ba la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rlung gi skye ba pa 4rnams gdul dang mi bzad lam grub phyir / /de nas 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal gang zhig las nges phyung 'di/ /rlung lha mchog gi bla ma sa la skye ba pa rnams kyi/ /spyod lam rnam bzhi'i 'bras bu ster ba de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /chu lha pa rnams gdul dang zhi ba'i lam 'dod ldan rnams kyi/ /yang dag khong du chud phyir bde gshegs sras po'i lte ba las/ /yang dag phyung ba chu lha'i gtso bo yang ste myur ba ru/ /'dod dga'i dbang phyug 17——7 /

nyid kyi 'bras bu ster la rtag phyag 'tshal/ /mthun pa'i 'bras bu la sogs mngon par 'dod rnams nges gdul zhing / /yang dag grub phyir rab mchog mtshan ldan zhabs kyi pad+ma las/ gang zhig nges par phyung ba bcom ldan nor 'dzin mar grags pa/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po mnyam med de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /khyod ni srid las grol kyang de la yang dag gnas pa ni/ /sems can tshogs la snying brtse nyid las srid pa'i spyod tshul gyis/ /srid mtha'i bar du brtan pa bdag ni rtag gnas gyur snyam du/ /dam pa'i bsam pa chen po'i mchog gyur khyod la phyag bgyi'o/ /nam mkha'i bar du snang ba'i 'jig rten khams rnams khyod nyid kyis/ /rang gi zhabs gcig mthil gyis kyang ni rnam par gnon pa ste/ /bskal pa'i mtha' ru sred pas rten par 'bar ba drag po'i me—/ /khyod kyis dbugs kyi rlung gi stobs kyis nges par bcil bar gyur/ /rang gi 'dzub mo gyen du gtod de 'dzin pa'i sdigs 'dzub kyis/ /thon po'i tshogs rnams du ma g.yo bar gyur cing sen mo yi/ /sbubs kyis gyen du 'dzin pas rgya mtsho'i chu yang lus ma gyur/ /e ma'o 'di lta'i nus pa khyod las gzhan du ci zhig mthong / /mchog tu mnyen zhing zla ba gzhon nu'i mdzes pa yang dag par / /ston pa'i sku mchog 'di yang lang tsho ma yi yin nam ci/ /'jigs byed drag po gnon las mi lhongs ci yang dub pa dang / /gdul bar dka' ba'i bdud 'joms pa ni khyod kyi spyod tshul lags/ kye lags 'di ltar chen po'i skye bo'i ral phreng dang mtshungs par/ /rang gi dbu skyes mdzes pa'i lan bu 'khyog po de/ /de nyid me yis nyon mongs bdud dzosnashing sbar bar byas pa yi/ /du ba'i phreng ba lta bu dri med spyod la snang bar gyur/ /zla zer cung zad 'phros pa yis ni 47—75

phyogs bcur khyab khyod kyis/ /nag po'i phyogs zad chung ngu'i cha bcas 'od kyis mdzes pa ni/ /srid pa rnams su 'dod pa dang myur ri bong can gang de/ /cung zad las ni ma lus bsam pa rnam par mdzes/ /mthun par sgros pa'i ngan pa'i lam can lugs 'joms shing / /mi dang mi min bsam pa rton la lam dang lam / /yang dag thob byed gzhan don spyod tshul mchog gis ni/ /mdzes ldan rgyal ba sa yi dbang phyug la phyag bgyi'o/ /mya ngan 'das dang srid mi gnas kyang khyod gnas pa/ /'od gsal rang byin rlab ste spyor dang phan pa po/ /ma lus skye bo'i mi dge mi mdzad dge ba yis/ /mdzes ldan rgyal ba sa yi dbang phyug la phyag bgyi'o/ /rigs par dpag med 'od zer phreng bas yang dag bskor/ /de las bde skyed mtsho skyes rang gi phyag gis 'dzin/ /rjes mthun dga' ba thob pa yang dag dga' bde yis/ /mdzes ldan rgyal ba sa yi dbang phyug la phyag bgyi'o / /chos kyi dbyings las kun mchog snying rje rang nyid gtso/ /gang zhig dge ba la sogs tshogs rnams yang dag rdzogs/ /rnam par rtog spangs mthu las sgra yis ston pa po/ /mdzes ldan rgyal ba sa yi dbang phyug la phyag bgyi'o/ /de bzhin nyid dang nyid min gnyis med kun dga' brgyas/ /yongs su gang bar mdzad pa brgya phrag chos kyi gtam/ /'thad ldan mchog tu bde na zhing rigs par gsungs pa yi/ /'dzin ma'i dbang phyug rgyal po mchog la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /mi mchog de yi rang gi sku ni 'gro la rab 'phro ba/ /mtsho skyes spyan gyis shin tu mdzes par gyur pa yi/ /ma lus sems can rnams kyi myur ba'i thar mchog gi/ /'dzin ma'i dbang phyug rgyal po dam par bdag phyag 'tshal/ /mchog tu sprul dang longs spyod rdzogs pa gzhan don dgyes/ /stong nyid gos 77—76

med chos 'dzin pa la dgyes pa can/ /grub pa dam pa rnam sad 'dzin ma'i dbang po ste/ /nor 'dzin dbang phyug rgyal po mchog la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /mchog tu lhan skyes dam pa'i rgya mtshor zla zhal gyi/ /sgo las thams cad gsung ba ma lus ngag tshig ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i mtshan nyid rjes mthun rgyan gyis phul//dbang phyug 'dzin ma'i rgyal po dam par phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten dbang phyug bstod pa rin chen phreng ba ni/ /dpal ldan nags kyi rin chen zhabs kyis bgyes pa las/ /de yi gtsang ma'i dge ba gang zhig thob gyur pa/ /de nyid kyis ni 'jig rten kun du bzang por gyur/ /bstod pa rin po che'i phreng ba 'di ni rdzogs so// //rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po nags kyi rin po che'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'o/ /mkhas pa chen po de nyid kyis spyan sngar/ dge slong rgya mtsho'i sde zhes bya bas bal yul ye rang gi grong khyer chen po'i 'dabs dpal go pi tsan+d+ra'i gtsug lag khang chen por bsgyur ba'o// //

༄/ /sems dpa'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba/1༄/ sems kyi phyag rgya zhes bya ba dri ma med pa'i lung chen po bzhugs so/ /༄4 / /rgya gar skad du/ satwa mu dra nā ma/ bod skad du/ sems dpa'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dang slob dpon kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ rdo rje 'chang la phyag btsal nas/ /man ngag mdo tsam bshad par bya/ /dpa' bo 'jig rten dbang phyug gis/ /nam zhig tshe na bdag la gsungs/ /'du byed ston ka'i sprin dang mtshungs/ /dam pa'i skye bo 'byung ba'ang med/ /'gro 'di sdug bsngal rnam par 'khor/ /de bas sgrub la gzhol bar bya/ /bag chags srid dang sgrib pa dang / /shes pa 'bras bu gnyis dbye bas/ /rim pa gnyis ka'ang ma bslabs 'di/ /thams cad du ni thams cad 'khrul/ /sdig pa bkrus shing byin rlabs pa/ /dad dang snying rje dam tshig ldan/ /zab mo lhag par dga' ba yis/ /nags 'dab ri bo chu 47—79

gling du/ /'dod dang bsam gtan rkun po dang / /ca co kun tu rtog bral bas//tshangs dang rdo rje'i gdan la 'dug /'chi ba stong pa nyid du brtag /sgra dang khang pa yid 'ong bar/ /zla ba rdo rje sogs sbyor bas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa khu bar gyur / /yi ge rdo rje'i rnam pa las/ /mi bskyod 'jig rten dbang phyug 'es pa/'ang yod mod dkyis dag gsungs dbang phyug skye ba'i gzugs/ /skye mched rdo rje gsum dbu rgyan/ /'di la lha mo 'dod ma sgrub/ /de nas yang ni spro bya ste/ /rdo rje sogs la sbyar bar bya/ /'di ni rim pa dang po'o/ /khu khrag rlung ni skye dang gnas/ /'gag pa kun yang byed pa ste/ /lus kyi bde sdug kyang 'di yin/ /rtag tu snying gi dbus na gnas/ /lus dang sems las ngag 'byung ba/ /'di ni tshangs pa'i sgo nga yin/ /sems bcas lus kyi thig le ni/ /rdul dang rlung gis rab tu g.yo/ /rlung rnams 2gang nas g.yo ba ni/ /'dod chags 'phro byed lte ba na/ /mi brtan gzhan yang stong pa la/ /'od zer lnga ni rab tu gnas / /shin tu phra zhing ches g.yo ba/ /brtan dang g.yo ba las grol zhing / /bde ba ma yin snyug bsngal min/ /nam mkha'i thig le sems tsam mo rab tu phra ba'i khams gsum po/ /rang rig tha mal dbang po med/ /yod pa med cing med pa med/ /bde ba'i ye shes bzhi pa yin/ /rdul dag 'gags pa lha yi sku/ /lus yin 'di ni lus ma yin/ /'gro dang 'ong ba 'gro 'ong med/ /sangs rgyas gsung de gsung ma yin/ /rags dang phra ba 'di dag ni/ /thig le bzhi zhes brjod par bya/ /ngag sems 'go dang 'ong ba can/ /de la sngags kyi de nyid ldan/ thim pa rdo rje gsum sngags te/ /gzhan du nam yang yod ma yin/ /lus ni rnam par 'gags gyur pa'i/ /ngag ni yongs su dag pa na/ / 17—80

rlung dag thim pa rim bzhin gyis/ /sems ni stong pa nyid la 'jug /rags pa med cing phra ba'ang med/ /shin tu phra ba'i lus la sogs/ /bud med sgyu mas rab bsgrub bya/ /de ru lus ngag yid kyi sems/ /rdo rje bu mo'i sbyor bas shes//de nas phyag rgya chen por 'gyur/ /'di yi sgrub pa rab bsgrub pa/ /da ni de nas shes par bya/ /rme sha can gyi bdag nyid che'i/ /bu mo a la mthing ga'i mdog /la lar glu gar mkhan kyi bdag nyid che/ /bu mo/ bye dal dmar ba'i mdog /ces 'ang 'byung gsung 'on kyang dkyus dag pa/ 'dra'o/ /lo grangs bcu gnyis lon pa'am/ /yang na nyi shu lnga lon rnyed / /bzhin sbug mig ni dkyus ring ba/ /rab tu bzang la legs par sbyangs / /cho ga bzhin du byin rlabs nas/ /pang par bzhag ste rab tu bsgom//'khyud dang tsum pa rjes chags pas/ /'dod pa lnga dag spyad par bya/ /dga' dang bde ba'i sbyor ba 'dis/ /lus thigalengag rlungayid sems ni snying gar brtag /reg pa bsnyen pa zhes su brjod/ /nye bar bsgrub pa mnyam spyor ba/ /nor bur rdul ni rgyas pa las/ /'dod chags chen po ye shes mthong / /lus ni ngag la thim par 'gyur/ /bsgrub pa'i dam tshig bsrubs pa yis/ /ngag ni sems la rab tu 'jug /thig le rlung gi spyor bcas pa/ /yi ge gsum gyi tshul gyis 'bab/ /rmongs pas lhung ba nyid gyur na/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'am chos kyang rung / /tshal par 'gas par gdon mi za/ /ske long la ni dbugs kyi tshogs/ /thim pa'i sbyor ba ji lta ba/ /yang na srog dang rtsol ba yis/ /bde ba mchog gi go 'phang bsgrub/ /dang po la ni bsgrod pa dang / /gzhan du dbang dang bdag por 'gyur/ /lha dang yi dwags nor sbyin dang / /rig 'dzin lha min bu mo 'am/ /ma sogs cho ga'i sbyor yang rung / /byol song las 47—81

kyang rab tu brtag /thig le mnyam par sbyor ba ni/ sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag ste/ /'khor lo gsang gsum ye shes mthong / /de nas lhan cig skyes par 'gyur/ /gang la lus gnas zla tshes gzhilus dbyangs yig dang / /'gro ba sems can rgyalamadzad thig le sangs rgyas dang / /don dam ye shes rilagazhig bsgom pa ste/ /sgyu ma sgrub byed 'di ni rig par byos/ /thig le spro dang bsdu ba ni/ /sems kyi rgyud ni dri rnged byed/ /steng gi sbyor ba rnam lnga po/ /rlung dang thig le bsam gtan dang / /bde ba'i ye shes lha ru 'gyur/ /dga' ba'i ye shes rdo rje gsum / /sgu gsum rdo rje rab tu sgrub/ /de dag yan lag rnam pa bzhi/ /bsnyen pa'i ye shes chen po'o/ /yan lag drug gi sbyor ba yis/ /mchog gi sgrub pa brtsam par bya/ /rnam pa gzhan du bsgrubs na ni/ /bskal pa gsum gyi yun du'ang min/ /so sor bsdud dang bsam gtan dang / /srog rtsol 'dzin pa rjes su dran/ /ting 'dzin yan lag drug tu brjod/ /dbang po bcu po rang gnas dang / /thig le la yang rnam par sdud/ /'dod yon lnga po lhar spyor bas/ /bde ba'i ye shes bsam gtan yin/ /ye shes yan lag dang po ste//longs spyod gnyis pa yin par brjod/ /rang bzhin shes dang bde ba dang / /gzung dang 'dzin dang gnyis med pa/ /lnga dang ldan pa'o srog stsol ni/ /dbang po ye shes rnam zhi ba/ /bde ba yi yang rlung dag pa/ /dngas ma lnga yi gong bu ni/ /lte ba'i sna rtse rnams su bsgom/ /rin chen rlung du rab tu brjod//rang sngags kha spyor lte ba la/ /phra mo srog gi thig le bzhag /rnam gsum rin chen rab zhugs pas/ /bde ba'i ye shes 'dzin par brjod/ /byang chub rdo rje 'di nyid la/ /mtshan ma mkha' snang lnga ru 'gyur/ /'od zer du ba mkha' 17—82

snang dang / /sgon ma dri med mkha' rnam lnga/ /pig le spro dang bsdu ba yis/ /bde ba bla med gzugs su 'gyur/ /rnam par snang mdzad rdo rje chos/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rigs khro bo/ /thigs pas mchod dang dkyil 'khor dang / /sku gsung thugs dang sems can dang / /rdo rje gsum dang dam tshig dang / /shes rab dam tshig ma skyes pa/ /zhe sdang rigs rnams rjes su dran/ /'di las so sor snang ba skye/ /snyoms 'jug sbyor bas dngos rnams kun/ /gong bu'i dbus su gzugs rnams brtag /yud kyis ye shes sdogs byed pa/ /ting nge 'dzin zhes bya bar brjod/ /de ltar yan lag drug gis ni/ /dngos grub mchog la sbyar bar bya/ /rnal 'byor drug po 'di dag ni/ /byang chub rdo rjes bshad pa yin/ /thig le rnam bzhi g.yo ba las/ /'di ltar ye shes rnam pa bzhi/ /rlung rnams gang la thim pa ni/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi dbye ba'o/ /snang ba la ni spro ba dang / /mi snang bsdu ba zhes su brjod/ /rang dang gzhan gyi dngos po la/ /de bzhin spro dang basbu ba'o/ /bde dang gdung ba stong pa dang / /rnam shes ye shes rnam bzhi'o/ /'dod dang dga' ba g.yo dang g.yo/ /gang ba dga' ba 'char ba dang / /nub pa med dang yang chags bral/ /sems med thig le oṣ+ṭa dang / /rang byung gnyid spur sgra zhes pa/ /snang ba lhag par snang ba dang / /mi snang thog ma lhan skyes te/ /skad cig nyi shu zhes bya'o / /skad cig thams cad las 'das pa'i/ /dga' ba don dam mngon byang chub/ /gang dag rang bzhin lhan cig skyes/ /kun tu 'gro zhing kun tu zhi//rang las rtag tu 'ongs pa ste/ /'di ni zab cing rgya che bas/ /'jig rten rmongs pas mi shes shing / /'phags pa yis kyang de ma gtogs/ /sangs rgyas 47—83

rnams kyis spyod yul 'di/ /byis pa'i sems dpa' rnam mi shes/ /gtso bo bdag dang dbang phyug dang / /gang zag sems tsam rnam par brtags/ /yid kyi dmigs pa yang ji snyed/ /de dag lhan cig skyes pa min/ /yid bzang ma dang snying dbus dang / /dbugs dgag sems med sbyor ba dang / /gsang sngags bzlas byed 'dod pa yi/ /cho ga'i ye shes de dag ni/ /rang bzhin lhan skyes zhes mi brjod/ /sangs rgyas lhan cig skyes pa ni/ /bla ma'i drin gyes gsal 'gyur te/ /thabs kyi rang nyid mtshon par bya/ /chos kun ring dang nye ba med/ /rang bzhin gnyis med lhan cig skyes/ /sangs rgyas bye brag med pa ste/ /'gro ba kun las rab tu 'byung / /de ltar sngon mtha' med pa dang / /sems can dbye ba med yin te/ /'di ste ye shes ldan yin na/ /sa la sogs pa'ang thar min ci/ /rnam snang rdo rje nyi ma dang / /gar dbang rdo rje rta rgyal po/ /rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka /gti mug rdo rje la sogs dang / /de bzhin ltung byed ma la sogs/ /'byung ba la sogs phung po la/ /gnyis med tshul gyis grub pa'o/ /phung po sangs rgyas rnam lnga dang / /'byung ba lha mo byang chub sems/ /mig sogs de bzhin gzugs la sogs/ /'dir ni gzungs ma rnam par brtag /tshigs rnams khro bo'i tshogs yin no/ /srid pa sku gsum rang bzhin dang / /'pho ba sa ru shes par bya/ /lam gnyis zung du spyor ba nyid/ /ji ltar nam mkha'i khams nyid la/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor snang ba ltar/ /sems ni zab dang rgya che ba/ /gnyis med tshul gyis rtag tu gnas/ /gang gi dngos po ma gyes pa/ /stong pa shin tu rang bzhin med/ /snang ba med cing brjod pa med/ /yul dang yul can med pa yi/ /zab mo bde ba dam pa (7—84

yin / /dngos po thams cad tha dad dang / /gcig min mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs/ /rdul dang dus ni yongs bral ba/ /zab mo rdo rje gsum 'dzin pa'i//dkyil 'khor rgya che zhes su brjod/ /de nyid mi phyed rdo rje ste/ /brjod du med cing bsam du med/ /bsam du med pas bsgom bya zhes/ /thub pa chen pos bka' pal to/ /gsang ba dbang po yul phrad pas/ /rnam shes dri ma med mthong ba/ /lhan skyes spros spang shes rab mthong / /thams cad mnyam par shes pa na/ /zab mo lhag par mos pa 'thob/ /lhan skyes yongs su gyur pa na//bag chags rten dang bral bar 'gyur/ /bde ba'i ye shes dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /'di skad rgyal ba bcom ldan 'das/ /lang kar gshegs mdo las gsungs te/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin dang / /'du shes rnam par spangs pa yi/ /sems kyi rgyal po blta bar bya/ /nam zhig sems ni gyur pa na/ /pad mo 'dra ba'i gzhal med khang / /sgyu ma'i spyod yul 'byung ba na/ /de yi tshe na jer zug gnas / /gsungs pa 'di las spyod pa rnams/ /stong pa chen po la 'jug pa'o / /'dod ma'i 'dod pa rnam lnga pos/ /chos kun yongs su mtshon byas nas—/ /yul dang dbang po rjes chags pas/ /lhan byug skyes pa gsal bar rtogs / /rnam pa gzhan du ma 'khrul bar/ /rdo rje rig ma'i spyor ba las/ /nam zhig yan lag 'gags pa na/ /de tshe lhan skyes gcig pur gnas/ /rnam bcu thig ler rang gi sems/ /rab gnas sa bcu dag tu shes/ /rnam bcu rnam par dbye ba dang / /rlung dang thig le 'pho ba rnams/ /dag pa yi yang sa ru brtag /brda dang tshogs kyi rim pa rnams/ /'dir ni de nyid rig pas sgrub / /dbe+en pa 'am yang na dur khrod du/ /paṣ+ṭa la sogs brgyan pa 'am/ /717—85

yang na bsam gtan kho nas kyang / /dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis spyod/ /zab dang rgya che'i spyod pa 'di/ /rim pa dang pos rab sgrub la/ /rdo rje sems dpa' gzigs 'gyur zhing / /mig sman la sogs rig 'dzin 'gyur/ /rang dang gzhan gyi grub mtha' la/ /sngags rgyud brten pa bde bar 'grub/ /bskal pa gsum du dal bas kyang / /byang chub sgrub par mi nus pa/ /lus gcig la yang 'gyur ba ni/ /sngags shes rnams kyis byas pa yin/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa ma grub la/ /stong pa nyid ni yun rings bsgom/ /legs bris gzugs brnyan shar ba la/ /rtse gcig tu ni rab bltas nas/ /yang dang yang du bsgom par bya/ /lha yi de nyid grub par 'gyur/ /sngags rnams thams cad nyid la yang / /yi ge gsum gyis bsgul ba shis/ /spyod pa'i dngos grub g.yel ba la'ang / /'dis ni sngags kyi de nyid 'grub/ /dpal ldan rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /sngags kyi de nyid 'di rab bzhed/ /a umra/ a hra/ hra umra/srog ni gtsug tor dag tu yang / /gyen rgyu thig ler bcas sdud byed/ /rdo rje'i sku ni bsgom par bya/ /steng 'og mgrin pa'i tshogs 'ching ba/ /gtso bo gzi brjid pad+ma la/ /rdo rje'i gsung ni rab tu bsgom/ /smin mar srog ni yi ge ma/ /mgrin pa gsang ba'i yi ge ni/ /rnam gsum thung ngu'i ngag tu 'gyur a thung thim/ /thugs kyi rdo rje rab tu 'grub/ /sgu gsum rnal 'byor pa yi bsgom/ /rdo rje sngags rnams kun gyi ma/ /ā li kā li zhes bya ba/ /skyes pa kāle.oṃbud med āli t+pam ning hūṃ ṛlonyid/ /phomo mning lha rnams kun gyi gsang sngags ni/ /dngos grub thams cad byed pa ste/ /rlung 'ching ba ni phyag rgya 'ching / /lha rnams kun gyi rdo rje gsum/ /'di yis bskul zhing byin gyis rlob/ /dpag 47—86

—med rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe/ /mchog ring ba dang 'od gsal 'thob/ /rnam gsum lus ni ldanga'ajug gi gnas pa byedadang / /'og tu song nas bubumo'i lus bskyed la/ /steng du dbangapo'i 1sgo nas yul rnams kun tu 'gro/ /lha rnams sna tshogs bskyed pa usartidang / /nis n+d+ra'i las rnams sgrub par byed pa'ang yin/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ bza' ba'i dam tshig byed pa ste/ /sgrib pa 'joms shing yeshesakyisku yang sdogs / /sbrul dang gnyisamed btus pa la sogs pa/ /gsang sngags thams cad 'di yin no/ /nyin dang mtshan du skye bo kun/ /'di ni yongs su bzla byed kyang / /bla ma'i man ngag dang bral bas/ /byis pa rnams ni 'khor bar gyur / /spyan drangs bzhugs dang gshegs su gsol/ /ye shes rdo rje gsum bod byed/ /rlunga'agro 'ong bskyed dang skye'achisdud pa la/ /thung ngu ma lus dag tu 'gyur / /yo'ong dang ya'agro ba yogayo dang yabartan/ /hūṃganas pas brtan g.yo ye shes byed/ /āḥyis yongs su spro bar bya/ /oṃ gyis spyan drangs bya ba ste//hūṃ gis gsang sngags gnas pa'o/ /rlung gis de nyid rab grub la/ /sngags kyi rgyal po rtag tu bzla/ /gang zhig tha dad gsang sngags can/ /de ni nam yang grub pa med/ /de nas las rnams bsgrub par bya/ /ci ste grub par ma gyur na//dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /lha rnams rdo rjes bshig nas kyang / /ye shes thig le ting 'dzin gyis/ /sems dpa' de ni don dam sgrub/ /rnal 'byor 'di ni bsgom gyur na/ /nyi ma bdun gyis gdon mi za/ /ye shes rnam par g.yengs pa na/ /rlung gis rab tu bcings pa dang / /'khor lo lnga po yongs bsregs pas/ /snying gi thig le zhu ba na/ /rnam gsum yon tan thim par 'gyur/ /bcing dang bcing ba'i sbyor ba dang / /rab tu bsdam dang 47—87

dgag pa yis/ /rlung rnams 'phral du bcug nas kyang / /tsaṇ+ḍa lī ni sbar bar bya/ /bde ba'i de nyid nye bar dmigs/ /srog ni dbu mar bkag pa dang / /pa tā la yi rlung yang bcing / /gal te zug rngus 'jigs pa na/ /mgo bo rgya mtsho bskyod par bya/ /lus kyi sdug bsngal rab spangs nas/ /mkhas pas rā sā ya ṇa bsgrub1/ /sha chen bdud rtsi'i spyor ba ni/ /rnal 'byor ldan pa rnams kyis bza'/ /thig le gnas ni rnam bcu drug /a i u ṛ t+pa e e e aḥdabyangs kyi yi ge bcu drug las/ /thig le 'pho ba bcu drug dgug /yi ge'i sbyor ba rab sbyar bas/ /'dod can ma la spyad par bya/ /mtshan min thams cad rab spangs nas/ /ka ra ṇa yi rnal 'byor bcing / /dga' ba nye bar dmigs bya ste/ /bltas nas tsum+bha rab spyor dang / /ma mchu'i sbrang rtsi 'thung ba dang / /zla ris bri dang ro 'dzin skyod/ /yan lag bzhi yis sgrub pa las / /lhan cig skyes pa mthong bar 'gyur/ /sbyor ba rnam pa drug gis ni/ /gyen du drangs pa'i rnal 'byor bya/ /bskor ba la sogs lnga sbyor bas/ /'pho ba med la 'bad par byos/ /brgyal dang gnyid dang 'khrig pa dang / /shi dang glal dus gsal 'gyur ba/ /dus kun du ni mtshon par bya/ /las kyi mtha' la chags pa yis/ /de dag gis kyang ma grub na/ /gang du 'pho bas rab 'grub 'gyur/ /rdo rje ye shes yi ge dang / /sum̐ hūṃ dag gis rab tu dgag /yi ge gsum gyi ye shes ni/ /thugs kyi yi ger bsdus pa gang / /tshangs pa'i ting 'dzin thig ler thim/ /de yang 'od gsal bsgom par bya/ /de nyid nyi shu lnga thim nas/ /ye shes skad cig rnam pa gsum/ /'od gsal ba la rab zhugs pa/ /de tshe ye shes dam pa 'grub/ /gal te grub par ma gyur na/ /17—88

rig pa 'dzin pa'i gtso bor 'gyur/ /'dod pa'i lam la zhugs pa rnams/ /rig ma'i dbang phyug rnams bsgoms nas/ /rdo rje sbyor bas rab bsgrub par/ /rigs kyi bdag pos legs par gsungs/ /spros pa'i mtshan mar gyur pa na/ /mtshan med nye bar bsten par bya/ /spyos pa spros med nyid shes pas/ /rnam pa kun tu thams cad spyad/ /'di yi mthong ba rnam mang po/ /rnam pa lnga yi mtshan ma dang / /sngags dang mngon par shes pa lnga/ /skye mched ye shes thob pa dang / /rlung rnams rdo rje sems dpar gyur/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor dri med dang / /rmi lam mthong bar 'gyur ba ni/ /khye'u dang bu mo yid 'ong dang / /lha dang rig 'dzin sgog pa dang / /yul rnams sna tshogs rdo rje sems/ /'dod yon lnga la rol pa dang / /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yang mthong /bde ba mthong ba thim pa dang / /sems dang sgyu ma ye shes sku/ /chos dang gzugs shes bya ba'o/ /rnal 'byor rgyud du gang bshad pa/ /de bzhin nyid sogs byang chub dang / /de nyid rnal 'byor ma rgyud du/ /zla ba la sogs rnam pa lnga/ /de dag 'di la rnam par rig /rdo rje nyi ma nub nas ni/ /sgrub pa kun du brtsam par bya/ /skya reng 'char ba'i dus su ni/ /sgom pa mchog gis 'grub par 'gyur/ /sbyor ba bdun ldan ji srid du/ /ye shes dbang phyug brgyad rgyal po/ /dzñānabade chen dharmartag pa sdug kun gyi gdung med sasto ga pa/ /nirma rdo rje snying rjes gta'idon sgrub pa/ /chos dang longs spyod sprul pa dang / /ngo bo nyid kyi sku zhes pa/ /mnyam pa nyid dang yid kyi gzugs/ /gnyis spangs rang bzhin mtshan nyid dang / /spros pa'i rnam par mi rtog pa/ /de bzhin bag chags spangs pa ste/ /mi phyed rdo rje rnam bzhi'o/ /'gyur dang chags pa ma 47—89

rig pa/ /'di las yan lag bcu gnyis 'byung / /'di dag 'gags pas sa bcu gnyis/ /rab tu gnon pa thams cad mkhyen/ /thub pa chen pos chags bral gyis/ /rigs rnams gdul bar bya ba'i phyir/ /mdo sde stong phrag brgyad cu ga/su ngas/ /'khor lo bsgyur ba'i gzugs kyis ni/ /dam pa'i chags cam rjes bzung phyir/ /dkyil 'khor sprul zhing bshad pa mdzad/ /dman mos chags can rigs rnams la/ /bya ba'i rgyud rnam gsum bshad cing / /zab mo lhag par mos pa la/ /rnal 'byor rnam pa gsum rnams gsungs/ /rnal 'byor rgyud rnams thams cad du/ /rlung gi bde ba rab sgrub byed/ /de nyid rnal 'byor ma rgyud du/ /thig le'i ye shes gsal bar bstan/ /sngags rgyud rnam pa gnyis dag la/ /'dod ma las ni ye shes dang / /sngags kyi rgyud nas 'thob pa yin/ /rim pa gnyis kyi ye shes mchog /gang la rtags dang mngon gyur lha/ /gsang sngags rags dang phra ba yin/ /zhi la sogs pa'i khyad par dang / /rig pa 'dzin dang dngos grub dang / /sku rnam gnyis kyi dbye ba'o/ /gang gang sdom pa ma thob pa/ /de de theg pa la ma zhugs/ /gang dag gsang sngags sgrub byed pa/ /dbang bskur med na grub pa med/ /de 'dir rdo rje'i lam zhugs rnams/ /rim pa gnyis la brtson pa yang / /dbang gi rim ①pas gsal ba yi/ /ye shes 'bad pas bsgom par kyis/ /mkhas pas rang nyid mi smad ye shes 'di/ /ngo mtshar ngo tshas mi g.yo bdebartan pa'i phyir/ /sna tshogs yul dang spyod pas sgom byed pa'i/ /lhan skyes spyod 'di 'gro la sangs rgyas nyid//de bas rang bzhin lhan cig skyes/ /shin tu gsang zhing gsang ba che/ /gzhan du yongs su ma rnyed pa/ /'di ni nga yis spyod la brtan/ /rmongs pa las ni 47—90

bzang por 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya 'di/ /'ga' zhig don du khyod kyis shod/ /rje btsun de skad gsungs ma thag /the tshom thams cad yongs su chad/ /rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor gang / /rnal 'byor rgyud bzhin bdag gis rig /lhan cig skyes pa rab rtogs pas/ /de nas 'gro ba'i bla mar gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa' slob dpon te/ /dpa' bo spyan ras gzigs kyis mkhyen/ /dal 'byor shin tu rnyed par dka' ba dang / /tshe 'di glog ltar mi brtan pa shes nas/ /'khor ba chu klung shugs drag bzlog pa'i phyir//rim gnyis lam la ci ste 'bad mi byed/ /'khor bar dga' dag 'grub par mi 'gyur bas/ /'dod pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par spangs/ /dang po'i lam la brtson par bya ba dang / /gang zhig bsgom par bya ba nan tan sgrub/ /rgyal sras chen po rnams kyang thogs 'gyur na/ /lam mchog 'di yis bcu gnyis lo dag gis/ /mtshams med spyod pa'ang byang chub nges 'grub pa/ /bla ma'i drin las thob 'di cis mi bsgom/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i lam mchog 'di/ /'dir bshad 'gro ba sgol phyir yin/ /bsod nams cung zad gang bsags pa/ /de yis rdo rje 'dzin par shog /skye bo dam pa phrad dka' zhing / /lam bzang 'bras bu che ba'i phyir/ /sgrub par mdzod ces dra ①karnyi/ /thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs/ /sems kyi phyag rgya zhes bya ba rim pa gnyis rgya cher gsal ba/slob dpon chen po grub pa'i sa la 'gro ba 'god pa'i thugs rje can 'jig rten dbang phyug gi zhabs kyi ze'u 'bru la spyi bos reg pa/ bsod snyoms pas bshad pa rdzogs so// //rje btsun shar phyogs pa niṭ+wā ṇa shrī'i zhabs dang / rmongs pa kun dga' ②47—91

snying po tā ra nā thas bsgyur ba'o/ /sngon chad gangs ri'i khrod du ma byon pa'i/ /gzhung bzang 'di ni bla ma'i zhal las thob/ /shar phyogs mkhas pa'i gsung bzhin 'di bsgyur te/ /rmongs nga/ bdag gis cha tsam 'tshal bas so// //bsdur mchan/79 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod//rkya ①〈〈pe 〉stanakyus/ ②〈〈pe 〉gnom/87 zhu/〈〈pe 〉stapo/88 ①〈〈pe 〉〉sgrub/ ②〈〈pe 〉stab a/ ①〈〈pe 〉ngokub/9༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉rims/91 ①〈〈pe 〉〉dwa/ ②〈〈pe 〉stanaga'i/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2627)47—92

༄7/ /ha sā ta/ ha zhes lus can dga' 'gyur la/ /gnyid ⑤kyis myos pa'ang ha zhes smra/ /'dod ldan hā hā ngal 'gyur te/ /de bzhin 'jig pa ①dang khro ba la'o/ /ha zhes lus can srog 'dor te/ /zla ba nyi ma lnga bdag rlung / /snying nang pra ba'i tā li ka /yid ni rab tu g.yo bas ha/ /has ni lus skyes 'gag 'gyur la/ /dbus ma la ni mi shigs pa'o/ /snying nas sgog ma nam mkha' la/ /ha zhes yongs su rgyu bar byed/ /yid 'ongs glog dang thun mtshams kyi/ /mdog dmar de yi sgra ni sa/ /mnyam 'gyur shin tu gnyid yur dang / /'dod la rna bar sa zhes grag /'brug sgra pi waṃ ljon pa ltar/ /gzhan dag sems dpar byed pa 'das/ /gang 'di lte ba'i dbus gnas rdul/ /'dod chags rang bzhin bsgom bya ste/ /rlung gi thigs pa nyams na'o/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin rlabs na/ /zla ba gcig gis lha dang mnyam/ /47—93

ljon pa'i 'dab ma lta byed pas/ /rtsa ba mthong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /ngag gi brjod pa rnam mang gis/ /ci ltar a yig smra bar nus/ /lus ni mi snang shes pa'ang rnged/ /'di ni a zhes brjod par ①'dod/ /gnyid stug log dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /khu ba lhung ba'i skad cig la/ /de bzhin tshim dang 'jigs pa la/ /a ā thos par 'gyur ba'o/ /chu thong me ni gyen 'gro dang / /rmi lam de bzhin gnyid sad dang / /'od gsal ba las sems ldang dang / /yid ni nang du 'gyur ba ⑤na/ /ta yig mngon brjod 'dod pa'o/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten bde ba dang / /gdengs can yul la zla ba shar/ /bya gdong nas ni shaṃ ma'i ①bar/ /nor bu 'od lnga ldan pa gnas/ /'di ni 'khor dang zhi ba'ang yin/ /sangs rgyas sgyu sdem rnams kyang 'di/ /gang la rgod dang gang gis rgod/ /ci yi phyir na rgod pa yin/ /ci ltar de dang ldan par gyur/ /de la 'di ltar brjod bya ste/ /rlung ni lus ngag rdul bcas pa/ /de la'o rgod pa 'di ni bde/ /stong pa la ni lus ngag yid/ /bde ba mchog dang ldan pa'o/ /ha ra lus 'phrog yid 'phrog bde/ /satwa ra sā ya ṇa bde/ /skyed par byed pa ⑤de yin no/ /a pa ra dzi ta nam mkha'/ /dngos po kun las rgyal bar gyur/ /ta thā'i tshul ni rnam med pa/ /dngos po kun yang song ba'o/ /rdo rje bla mas de ltar bshad/ /satwa mu dra'o/ /yi ge bzhi pa'i don ston pa/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang bdag phyag 'tshal/ /slob dpon dwa karnyi chen po/ /sems kyi phyag rgya gsung bar mdzad/ /khaṅga pa yi man ngag go// //sngon chad gangs ri'i khrod du ma byon pa'i/ /gzhung bzang 'di yang bla ma'i drin las thob/ /sangs rgyas sbas pa'i ba/sung bzhin 'di bsgyur te/ /47—94

rmongs pa kun dga' snying pos g.yar khral du'o// //bsdur mchan/93 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉rtor bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉sngaganyis/ ①〈〈pe 〉torajigs/94 ①〈〈pe 〉〉pa/ ②〈〈pe 〉skrunar pa/ ①〈〈pe 〉staba'i/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉spyor/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉4sa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2628)47wa 95

༄ga /phrag na rdo rje gtum po chen po khros pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra pā ṇi tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa sad ta na ba la/bod skad du/ phyag na rdo rje gtum po chen po khros pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma rgyud pa'i rim pa yi/ /man ngag rin chen bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /gsang bdag mngon rtogs rim pa 'di/ /sgro skur med par bri bar bya/ /rdo rje 'chang nas da lta'i bar/ /tshig don rgyud pa bar ma chad/ /dbang gi rgyal po lta bu yi/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma la/ /snying rje ldan zhing shes rab che/ /bzod ldan brtson 'grus dad pas brgyan/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dbang thob cing / /dam tshig sdom pa ldan pa yi/ /dben zhing nyams dga' yid bde dang / /bkra shis dpal 'phel dbang dbang 'dzin / /dur khrod chen po 'jigs pa'i gnas/ /ri gsum rtse 'am brag gi 'og /khro bo'i cha byad 'dra ba'i gnas/ /der ni gsang bdag sgrub par bya/ /47—96

sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen bsags byas nas/ /der ni bkod pa bsham byas nas/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas ni/ /skyabs 'gro dang ni sems bskyed bya/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgom nas ni/ /oṃ swa bha wa shud+dhā sarba dharma swa bha wa shurjo3haṃ/sngags 'di lan gsum brjod pa yis/ /gzung 'dzin snod bcud chos rnams kun / /bar snang gang ba'i dkyil lta sgom/ /de nas hūṃ zhes brjod pa yis/ /sems nyid yi ge hūṃ mthing nag /badz+ra brjod pas rdo rjer gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ /de skad lan gsum brjod pa yis/ /mthu stobs phyag na rdo rje ni/ /mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /g.yas pa gnam lcags rdo rje bsnams/ /g.yon pa sdigs 'dzub zhags pa bsnams/ /srid gsum sku yi khyon du rdzogs/ /klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong / /nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan stengs na/ /g.yas skum g.yon brkyang gar gyis bzhugs/ /dug lnga 'joms pa'i ye shes kyis/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ /ye shes sgu mchog rngam pa'i tshul/ /ral pa kham nag gyen du 'khyil/ /rma ra smin ma me ltar 'bar/ /thugs rjes spyan gsum phyogs bcur gzigs/ /mche rtsigs sngags kyi 'brug sgra sgrogs/ /khro rgyal sna tshogs sku la 'phro/ /khyung chen rigs lnga pho nyar 'gyed/ /gdug pa ma lus 'dul bar byed/ /thod pa rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan/ /dbu la nor rgyas dung skyong ser/ /snyan la dga' bo nyer dga' dmar/ /dpung pa nga/da ma chu lha dkar/ /se ral 'dab bzangs rigs ldan gnag /sku gsung thugs ni byin gyis brlab/ /thugs kha'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis/ /ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te/ /dbang ni bsgur la mi bskyod bsam/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥgasang sngags kyis/ /dgug gzhug dbyer med mnyes par bya/ /thugs kar nyi zla'i 47—97

dbus su hūṃ/ /hūṃ las 'od 'phros sems can rnams/ /grol bar byas nas bdag la bsdu/ /rdo rje srin po'i khu tshur bstam/ /ram̐ ram̐ gnyis kyis me sbar nas—/ /dgra bgegs nad dang sgrib pa rnams/ /thams cad ma lus bsreg par bsam/ /ma hā ro ṣa na e ram̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ /khro rgyal sna tshob/sa mtshon cha thogs—/ /ye shes me dpung phyogs bcur 'phro/ /lha yi sku ni sgom pa yis/ /bsod nams tshogs ni rdzogs par 'gyur/ /de nyid chu ltar shes pa yis ye shes tshogs kyang rdzogs par 'gyur/ /de nas lha sku sgyu ma ltar/ /snang la rang bzhin med par sgom/ /mdun du khyung chen rgyal po sgom/ /g.yas su mgon po nag po sgom/ /g.yon du lha mo bong zhon ma/ /nang gi bka' stod rnam gsum yin—/ /phyogs skyong bcu la sogs pa yi/ /dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa gnyis po—/ /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje yis/ /bka' nyan 'phrin las byed par bsamaske/ /de nas gsang sngags bzlas pa'i tshul/ /u tsa tsar+ya nas li li ka dha dha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa kyi bar bzlas/ gsang sngags phreng ba de dag kyang / /zhi ba dkar la rgyas la ser/ /dbang la dmar la drag la gnag /rdo rje'i lce'i 'od zer ni/ /gnam lcags thog rgod 'bar ba 'phro/ /gdug pa can rnams tshar gcod cing / /de bzhin 'phrin las gang byed sgrub/ /ru rag sha dang lung thang dang / /dung chen 'phreng ba rab tu shis/ /u tsa tsar+ya yak+ṣa se na/ saṃ n+d+ra sha dza dza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ gsang sngags yig 'bru bcu bdun la/ /'bum phrag gsum du snyen pa bya/ /sde brgyad 'dul ba'i drag sngags la/ /'bum phrag gcig gis grangs snyen rdzogs/ /dus snyen rab ni zla ba gsum/ /'bring ni zla gnyis tha ma zla ba gcig /rtags snyen rgyud las bshad pa yin/ /sgrub pa po 47—98

yi snyen pa bya/ /thun mtshams dag tu gtor ma ni/ /thod pa la sogs snod nang du/ /mar kyis brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'am/ /rin chen la sogs snod du ni//mngar gsum dkar gsum ldan pa bsham/ /de nas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ /yi las rlung ste re las me/ /shaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu las/ /a las dung chen nang du ni/ /hūṃ rgyu saṃ dzi saṃ/ dbus nas shar nas g.yas bskor ①du/ /sngo dang dkar ser dmar lngang dang / /de las 'od zer 'phros pa yi /bar du bcod ②pa'i gdon bgegs rnams/ /bkug nas ye shes lnga la stem/ /lus ni sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ /sems kyi dug lnga ye shes lnga/ /gyur pas gsang bdag zhal du stab/ /gti mug sha yi mchod pa bzhes/ /zhe sdang rus pa'i mchod pa bzhes—/ /bdag 'dzin la sogs dgra bgegs rnams/ /bdag med dbyings su sgral du gsol/ /zhes brjod rtsa sngags la ni/ sarba dus tran sarba shag hūṃ thums ma ra ya ma ra ya kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum dag tu bzlas pa yis/ /ljags las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /drangs nas gsol bas mnyes par bsam//de ltar skul ba'i dgra bgegs de'i/ /gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang / /gnyis med ye shes rtogs par shog /khyung chen la sogs bka' bstod snel/ /dkar gyis rgyan pa'i gtor ma la/ /oṃ a ka ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā r+ṇa ā de ba nud pan na twata/ oṃ snyahūṃ phaṭa/ bha ṣ+ṭi ta kha kha khā hi khā hi gsum gyis thams cad mnyes par bsam/ /yi ge brgya pas lhag chad skang / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lha rnams dang / /de sras rnams dang tshangs la sogs/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i cho ga 'di/ /ma tshang ba ni bzod par gsol/ /gtso bos nus pa ci mchis pa/ /ma tshang ba dang ma snyes dhidang / /nyes pa'i dri mar gyur pa kun/ /de dag khyed 47—99

kyis bzod par gsol/ /'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ /dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo/ /srod dang nyal bar gyur pa'i tshe/ /bsrung 'khor gsal bar bsgoms nas ni/ /'od gsal chos sku'i ngang la nyal/ /rmi lam longs skur gsal btab ste/ /nam gyi brgyad cha lus pa na/ /rtsa sngags lan 'bum brjod pa yis/ /nang stong zung 'jug lha yi sku/ /snang la rang bzhin med par bsgom/ /de nas rim bzhin sngar ltar bsgoms/ /de ltar rgyun du sgom pa las / /grub rtags rnams ni rims bzhin 'byung / /bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / /tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas sgrib gnyis dag /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i tshul/ /rang gi lus ngag yid gsum po/ /dag pa gnyis dang ldan pa yis/ /sku gsung thugs su 'char bar 'gyur/ /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje'i sku/ /bsgrub thabs yid bzhin nor bu 'di/ /rtsa ba klu sgrub snying po yis / /sgro bkur med par gsal bar bris/ /gal te 'khrul pa mchis gyur na/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang / /chos skyong rnams kyi bzod par gsol/ /dge bas mkha' mnyam sems can rnams/ /sdug bsngal kun bral bde ldan nas/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog /dpal phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub thabs yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //47—100

96 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄7/ /dpal phyag na rdo rje gtum po chen po khros pa zhes bya ba'i /kha thabs bzhugs so//97 ①〈〈pe 〉snosgor/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉gcod/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉snostod/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉rtos/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2629)47wa 101

rdo rje gos sngon can gyi bgrub thabs zhes dra/ ba/①ragyi/ /rgya gar skad du/ dam pa'i dharma khungs btsun pa dang skad gnyis pa drin che ba sgra don du cung zad rig pa'o/ /ma hā yak+ka se na pa ti/ ni lo ba ra dha ra badz+ra pa ṇi sa dha na na ma—/ bod skad du/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi bsgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dkon mchog gsum ni sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun gsum mo/ /'ab byu/ga 'a'abye'ab mtho/ /klad kyi don la gnyis las/ dang po mchod par brjod pa nas sku 'gying bag dang bcas pa'i zla ba'i gdan la g.yon brkyang gar gyis bzhugs④/ /chos sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa byed pa'i bgegs 'dul gnod sbyin gyi ded dpon yin pas yak+ṣa la dbang ma rungs pa rnams kyis mthong na 'jigs pa'i gzugs su snang ba'i khro bo chen po de ni/ /ye shes lnga ldan rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /g.yas pa'i phyag na 'dzin la phyag byas te/ /gnyis pa bshad par dam bca' ba/ dgos pa dang bcas pa 'jig rten phyi mar rang ni don klu la sogs pa'i gnod zhi ba zhi bar byed pa 'jig rten 'dir phan pa'i dngos grub dang rdo rje 'dzin pa yi/ /go 'phang ①thob byed pa'i thabs kyi 47—102

brjod bya bdag gis tshig dang yi ge'i tshogs kyi brjod byed kyis bshad par bya/ /sems can thams cad kyi don du sems bskyed ①byas shing dbang bskur thob/ /'dir dbang bskur ba'i don byin rlabs kyi gdams pa 'chad bla ma/ ma/nyes byu/sa rang nyid kyi chos gang gi sgor zhugs pa dang bla ma des ji skad gsungs pa'i mi dge ba bcu la sogs pa spangs cing lus ngag yid gsum gyi dam/ cigag 'azigan/ /gatha nga sbra 'a/ casab/ba/ lus gtsang sbrar gnas pas srog gcod pa la sogs pa mi byed/ sha chang sgog btsong mi za/ gos gsum brje/zas gsum za/ ngag gtsang sbra gnas pas brdzun sogs spangs/ bzlas brjod dang kha don la brtson pa/ sems gtsang sbra gnas pas brnab sems la sogs pa spangs pa'i dga' ba'i sems pa dang ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jog pa'o/ /rnal 'byor ldan/ /'dir sngags kyi lung gnod gsang sngags rjes su gnang ba thob/ /zhi ba la sogs pa'i las kyi lung gnod las rnams bya bar gnang ba blangs/ /snying rjes dmigs pa 'jig rten 'dir kyang sems can rnams la klu'i gnod pa bsal ba dang phyi mar rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang thob par byas la sems can sdug bsngal ba 'di rnams snying re rje bas 'khor ba nas gdon snyam du ba(1ba pa pos /yid du 'ong ba'i sa phyogs su/ /dkyil 'khor 'dom gang sa rtsa gtsang ma las byas pa ba'i lci bas byug /de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor de'i dbus su mchod rten tshad ldan brtsig /snying pogazungs sngags sku gzugs bris sku byu/ga ma' na rdorjertselnga pa rnams/ /sngags pas mchod rten de'inang du gzhug du gsol/ /denas rang nyid bde ba'i stan la 'dug /sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gi dpal phyag na rdo rje'i go 'phang thob pa/ra byas la go 'phang de thob nas kyang sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar byas la go 'phang de la dgod par bya'o snyam du sems baspre)da sngon du song ba yis/ /lus dag pa ngag dag pa khrus bya yi ge brgya pa brjod/ /rang nyid kyi snying gar zla bar gnas pa'i/ /hūṃ gi sngonapolas spros pa'i'od zer bla ma sogs rang sangs rgyas byang sems phyag rdor/ /spyan drangs mdun du bzhugs pa la mchod pa rnam pa lnga dang 'dod yon lnga dbul bar bya/ /sngon 'gro lha bskyed pa'i jo bo'i bla ma bir+ya thi tshad med bzhir bsgom par bzhed pas 47byed103

'dis kyang de'i bzhed pa gtso bor mdzad nas tshad med bzhir bsgom par gsungs pa las jo bo rang gi bzhed pa byams snying rje gnyis bsgom pa rang du rnag 'du bar bzhed pa'o/ /'on kyang 'dir rnag bsgom pa'o/ /bajo/nga nam/sa rim pa bya/ /tshad med bzhi byams pa snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms ①yang dran par bya/ /de nas spro bsdu sngon 'gro bas/ /stong pa ye shes tshogs bsgom bya/ /sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag na rdo rje'i go 'phang thob par 'dod pa'i tshad med 'phen pas sems de ni/ /stong pa'i ngang du yi ger blta/ /de nas 'od zer gsum byung bas/ /pad ma zla ba rdo rjer gyur/ /lte bar rdo rjesngon po rtse lnga pa'i hūṃ mtshan de 'od kyis/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas phyag rdor mdun gyi nam mkhar dus gsum sangs rgyas dang phyag na rdo rje mdun du spyan drangs la de rnams 'od kyi rang bzhin du byas nas bsdus/ /'od zer las byung ba'i mchod pa bcus mchod de rdo rje'i lte bar zhugs/ /de dag zhu las de las 'od kyi reg byas rdo rje nyid kyang zhu ba dang de rnams yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje 'ji na/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum spyan 'bras ma gtogs pa dmar—/ /rab bsgeg mche ba rab tu gcigs/ /skra ser mtha' yas sgrul sngon pos dgu skra bcings / 'jog po dmar pos rna cha byas/ rigs ldan khra bos dpung rgyan/ dur skyes ser pos lag gdub/ stobs kyi rgyu ljang gus ga zha/ pad+ma dkar pos rkang gdub byas pa'o/ /rjo/'ab bye/sa pa/na 'bag brgya/na/ /ma ro/ga gnag rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /g.yon brkyang gar gyis zla bar gnas/ /ljags 'dril stag gi sham thabs 'chang / /a la la zhes gad rgyangs sgogs pas/ /bar du gcod par byed pa'i bgegs tshogs rnam par skrag byed par/ /bdag nyid bsgom bya de nas ni/ /gnas gas/ma du zla ba dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i yi ge gsum las phyag mtshan gsum la yi ge gsum gyi mtshan pa'am yang na yi ge gsum nyid do/ /de nyid rang dbang bskur gyi gting la rigs bdag du bzhugs zer ba dang byin gyis brlab pa dang / /zla ba rdo rje'i 'od zer gyis/ /rigs bdag 'og min gyi gnas nas rigs lnga'am mi bskyod pa nyid spyan drangs dbang bskur dang / /47byed104

des rgyas gdab dang ye shes yang de'i thugs ka nas de 'dra ba spros nas rigs bdag du bzhugs pa dang yang des dbang bskur ba'i chu'i lhag ma las grub pa'i rigs bdag gsum bzhugs pa'i ra lug gsum yin te/ rang gang mos bya zhes rtsangs gsung zhes bdag gi slob dpon gsung ngo / /gasdo/ga /ཿdza ga tham/sa ca2) jordob/sa par bya/ /bdag bskyed pa'i rim pa'o// //de nas mchod rten stong par bsgom/ /de las phyag na rdo rjer bskyed/ /de la ye shes ga(1ga rigs bdag spyan drangs pa dang dbang bskur ba la sogs/ /cho ga snga ma bdag baspyod pa'i skabs su bstan pa bzhin du bya/ /mdun gyi phyag na rdo rje de'i thugs kar mchod rten sngon po bsam/ /de'i bum par hūṃ bsams te/ /hūṃlasa'od 'phros bder bar gshegs pa thams cad dang rdor 'dzin bsdus/ /mchod rten nyid la zhugs pa dang / /mchod rten/ mchod rten nyid bsam zer bar gsal kyang man ngag gis rdo rje nyer lnga la gcig dbus na gnas par lta ba yin no/ /gsung la la ni bsnyen pa'i dus su rdo rje nyer bzhi'i dbus su mchod rten sems pa yang yod do/ /rdo rje'i lugs ltar na mchod rten rang sems par gsal gsung / zhu ba'i sbyor bas slar yang bsam /mchod rten bskyed pa'i rim pa'o ①de nas bzlas pa'i rim pa ni/ /rang snying zla ba rdo rje la/ /gsang sngags rgyal pos bskor bar bsam/ /ngag tu bzlas pa sna bug g.yas nas 'thon pa dang / /mdun na gnas pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa'i nang du gzhug /snying ga'i rdo rje nyer lnga dbus na gcig gnas pa la mchod rten 'dir lugs gcig la rdo rje nyer bzhi'i dbus kyi mchod rten la bskor ba byas nas tshur sdud pa la 'dir man ngag la brten nas mchod rten zer kyang don rdo rje rang yin te rdo rje nyer lnga pa'i dbus ma bskor ba byas nas sna bug g.yas sam kha nas 'thon te rang gi g.yon nam kha nas 'jug pa 'di gsum 'dul du gsungs pa'i 'gal me 47byed105

'khor lo bzlas par bya ba de yin no/ /la bskor g.yas nas samakha nas 'thon/ /rang gi lam nas sna bug g.yon nas rang gi kha nas zhu/gas pa dang / /dngos grub mdun na mi'i thugs ka nas blangs nas ranganyid kyi snying gar 'khor/ /'gal me lta bur 'khor ba la/ /dmigs pa gtad de bzlas pa bya/ /bzlas pa'i rim pa'o ①gong du bstan pa'i rim pa de ltar bsnyen pa byas pa na/ /ye shes lhas su khrus kyi bum pa thogs nas dbang bskur dang / /nusapalo brgyad lon pa'i gzugs 'dzin dang / /me tog sngon po'igling du phyin nas 'thub dang / /shin tu nyams dga' ba'i ri rtse mthon por phyin la nas der gnas la sogs/ /rtags rnams tho rangs ltas bstan pa'i mi lam gyi dus su nye bar 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de nas bsgrub pa brtsam par bya/ da ltar rtags de rnams thams cad dam gcig gnyis la sogs pa byung gi gtam brjesten palnga/ lnga/ma pa jordob/sa rus // //⑧bsnyen pa sngon du song bas/ rmi lam la gsum ste/ srod la bag chags kyi snang ba 'byung / nam phyed kyi dus su gnyid stug pa'i snang ba 'byung la/ tho rangs ltas bstan pa'i snang ba ste/ shin tu gsal pa'o gsung / gong du bstan pa'i rtags de rnams byung gi gting de nas bgegs med sa phyogs su/ /bsgrub pa mngon par brtsam byas te/ /yid 'ongs sa ma nyams cing srog chags med pa'i zhib par brdungs nas chu gtsang dang bsres te sa nas sa blangs te/ /dkyil 'khor 'dom gang ba'ilcib sar bas byug /phyogs rnams shar nas dkar ser dmar lngang 'tshams kyang shar lho nas de bzhin no/ /dbus su mtsho skyes 'dab brgyad bri/ /de la klu yi gzugs brgyad byis pa lo brgyad pa 'dra ba stod spu dze+emi thal mo sbyar ba 'dra ba smad sgrul du snang ba'i kha dog ser po bri/ /'jug rjom pang lter 'khyil pa yi/ /steng du rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sku gzugs bris pa'am lugs la dgod/ /'dab brgyad mu khyud dkar po la/ /47byed106

ral gri sngon po rtse mo g.yas su bstan pas phreng bas bskor bar ①bri/ /padama'i mu khyud de yiphyi rol dag tu ni/ /gru chad bzhi'i gzhag lha snam bri/ /rdo rje'i phreng bas tsan tsa re g.yongs ra rnam par brgyan/ /me ris de'i mtha' ma dril bu ser po kha chos skor du dril bu'i phreng bas bskor/ /sgo bzhi'i dag dang yang dag ldan/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po legs bris la/ /mchod pa'i tshogs kyang metogal sogs pa dgram par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor bri ba'i rim pa'o/ /de nas nub kyi phyogs su gnas pas nub sgor mos pa byas la sgor 'dug ste/ /khrus bya sangs dang lag pa gnyis na rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pasarang nyid/ /rdo rje 'dzin par bskyed byas la—/ /ye shes sems dpa' gzhug pa sogs/ /cho ga thams cad rdzogs par bya—/ /rang snying pad+ma'i steng du zlaba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /rdo rje nyi shu rtsa lnga bsgom/ /de nas dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i/ /phyag na rdo rje 'khor bcas la ye shes sems dpa' gzhug las sogs/ /cho ga thams cad rdzogs par bya/ /mdun gyi rdo rje 'dzin pa'i yang / /thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /rdo rje nyi shu rtsa lnga pas④/ /de las 'od byung sangs rgyas dang / /bla ma la sogs mkha' la bkug /mchod pa bshags pa la sogs bya/ /de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni—/ /rang snying rtsa ba rang gi bzhed pas bsgrub pa'i dus su lha'i sku la dmigs par 'dod pas jo bo'i bzhed pas dmigs pa rgya chen ltar lha chung na 'dir bstan pa 'di ltar rnam pa rdo rje rang bzhin lha'i bdag nyid du lta'o gsung skad/de 'dir dmigs pa rgya chung ba'i dbang du byas pa las dmigs pas nus na sgrub pa'i dus su phyag rdor nyi shu rtsa lnga re la dmigs pa gtod pa'o/ /gsung rdo rje'i phreng ba'i mthar/ /gsang sngags 'khor bas sna nas 'thon/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i thugs kar zhugs/ /de nas yar 'thon rang 47—107
