༄sa /dbang gi man ngag①sngan / /rgya gar skad du/ she ka u pa dhe sha /bod skad du/ dbang gi man ngag /rje btsun sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor pa'i lam 'gyur ba/ /dbang gi rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /chu dang rdo rje nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang yan chod ②bum pa la rten dbang dang ni/ /gsang ba nas shes rab ye shes snang ba yan chad de bzhin shes rab ma bsten pa'o/ /rgyasapar bshad pas bumapa'i dbang la chu nas phyir mi ldog pa'i bar ro rnam pa gnyis/ /sgrub pa'i dbang dang slob dpon gyi lha'i de nyid nas nges shes spyod pa'i bar ro/ /dbang ni gnyis su nges pa yin/ /nyon mongs sgrib pa ma lus pa/ /bum pa de yis khrus byed cing / /chu dang micod pan rin rdo rje dril dang dkyil 'khor gyi sgor zhugs nas bum pa'i dbang shin tu sbas ①pa bshad pa/ /ming dang bdag po dbang du ④bcas/ /rigs las phyir mi ldog pa ste/ /sgrub pa po yi dbang du nges/ /slob dpon gyi dbang dkyil 'khor lha yi de nyid dang / /slob dpon gyidabang las la slab pa dang / /47—169

gsang ba'i rgyu sathebs dang nges pa che/ /slob dpon gyidabang du shes par bya/ /thun mongs pa'i dbang gzeng bstod pa dang lha mchod dang / /slobamaladam tshig sgrag pa thun mong ste/ /lung bstan pa dang rjes gnang mchog /bum pa'i dbang dang rdo rje slob dpon man chad so so nyid du nges pa yin/ /de yang bris pa'i rdulatshonadakyil 'khor la 'di la rten pa'o / /rten pa nyid du shes par bya/ /phyag rgya gsang ①ba'i bshad pas lus kyi dkyil 'khor la dzurten pa'o 'ching ba'i dbang la yang / /phyi dang nang du shes par bya/ /phyi dge slong lta bu la ni lce la byang chub sems/ /dbang bskur ba na dkar dmar thig le sbyin byed cing / /ngag gi sgrib sgribapanapa spyong ba can/ /de yang bdangabe+e'u'i tshul pha las thos pa dang / /ma las thos pa'i bye brag gis me long gi slab bya dang bye'u'i tshul du'o/ /dbye ba rnams pa gnyis su nges gang zhumos par bya'o/ /de la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bshad pas ba ga'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /'khor lo nang gi dbang bshad pa/ /de yang gnyis su shes par bya/ /shes rab de nyid yin tshig dbang rin po che yin sems kyi dkyil 'khor dbang rjodang ye shes kyi/ /dbang mchog gnyis su shes bya ste/ /de la shes rab dbang bstan pa/ /gsang dbang gi dus kyi bu mo yang 'di 'dra dbang gnyis kyi dus su 'dra bas so/ /bu mo rigs lnga gang rnyed kyang / /lha mo nyid du byin rlab cing / /cha lugs nyid kyang de 'dra la/ /yi ge a las pad+ma spyor ba'i phyag rgya rdo rje oṃ mkha' gsang byin gyi rlabs so/ /nges par srung byams nas/ /blosab ma'i lag tu gtad pa dang / /dngosagazhi rdo rje pad+ma snyoms 'jug pas/ rang lus rang lus thabs dang ldan pa la gnas pa'i bde ba ni/ /tshangs pa'i phyag rgya gnyis las mcha na nyid 'khrul pa 3/sabade bde sa med pas/ /shes rab kyis skyen byas so stobs las skye/sa pas na/ /dbang de'i ming yang shes rab dbang du brjod pa yin/ /bzhi pa'i dbang bshad pa de nas de rjes nyid la ni/ /semasakyi dkyil de yi mcha na nyid ci 'khor la bsten nas rjo'adra ba/ /sngon 47—170

chad shes par ma gyur pa/ /lkug mas bde ba myong ba'i tshul/ /da lta nyams su myong yang smrar med do/ /dri med dran pa'i brngod du ṇa bas ①nyams su myong ba'i rgyu mche na gyis/ /ye shes dbang du brjod pa yin dpe'i ye shes la rten nas don gyi ye shes skye ba'i gdams pa bshad pa'o/ /de 'ib dbang rnams rdzogs pa dang / /gling bzhi la dbang ba'i ra tsa rgyal rigs sa la bkod pa dag /dbang bskur nas khrims 'dzin pa bzhin spyi bo nas ni dbang bskur bzhin/ /dus de man chad skal ldan dbang thob nas rigs kyi bu/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i burtse de'i sras su dbang bskur ste sangs rgyas sras/ /yon tan rgyal po'i gdung la rigs la stobs rnams chubs longs spyod pa bzhin du burtse'i chos la longs spyod pa'o/ /pa yin/ /ti paṃ ka ra shri dzha 1nas mdzad pa'i dbang gi man ngag rdzogs so①// //

ras /dam byu ga sbas pa/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ sa ma gha pa ta/ bod skad du/ dbang bskur nas dam tshig srungs ②dgos pas dam tshig bstan/ dam tshig sbas pa/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma la phyag 'a' la 'o / /dam tshig mdor bstan ①pa sgrub thabs bcu gsum gyi sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa rang gi chos nyid dam tshig nyams pas dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang bskur gyidamatshig srungs na dngos grub thob par mi 'gyur/ /de bas shes rab dang ldan pa yin rnal 'byor blo ldan pas/ /dam tshig skyon yon shes par byas pa'o/ /rtag tu skyang bar bya/ /byang chub yi dam lha dang sems kyi rdo rje dang / /bla ma rdo rje spyan ras gzigs snying skur gcig pa'i rgyud bzhin no/ /'dzin pa yang / /tha dad par ni mthong na nyams par 'gyur ma mthong ba/ /de ni lte bar ster ma 'dra ba'o/ /dam tshig bgrang rjoba'idang po yin/ /thos pa'i rtsa bzang rtsa lung nas skad 'don pa byas pa'i srun dang dbang gi lhan gcig tu bkur ba'i spun/ /rtsa bza' ba rdo rje'i bum pa man ngag lusapa'ispun dang mimadzadapa'o sgrub pa'i spun lhan gcig du byas pa'i/ /lhan gcig du thob pa'i dam tshig spun dang 47—173

lnga po la/ /ngag tu khro bo btson par byed pa lus brtegs pa ni/ /lung zab mo'i don ston par byed dam tshig gnyis par brjod pa yin/ /tshig 'bru dang ni gang zag dang / /drang don dang rnam par shes lnga mngon dang ldan pa/ /del mi bden rdzun zer ba yid bstan mi byed pa / /de ni bde gshegs bka' las 'da' ba'idam zirdog gsum pa yin/ /ri mo can dang dung can ma/ /dpral ba na pad+ma'i ru ba yod pa pad ma can dang glang po can/ /phur bu can kyi 'di rnams rten stogs ①par bshar bas bud med bstan/ /de ni dam tshig bzhi pa'o//bza' btung gi dam tshig rnam pa burtse cung zad kyis thob par bshad pa ci mthong ba/ /gos las casags pa mi'i la sogs pa sha yi/ rnam/ pa dag /ci gathosa' rtog pa med pa la dngos grub tu shes pa'o//bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin rnam par shes/ /dkonamachog la mi mos 'di ni dam tshogag lnga pa'o/ /snod bcud gzhalayas khang bsdus pa'i chos rnams kun/ /'dod lha'i ②rang gang bsgom pa'i lhar dkyil 'khor rnam pa ru/ /srungs dam tshig dran pa cig la gang yin pa/ /de ni ma srungs na nyams pa'o dam tshig drug pa'o/ /stod smad dga'ami dga' ba bskur ①dang ma bkur dang / /grags dang ma grags rnyed pa dang / /ma rnyed pa la mnyam sems ldan chosamago mnyam pa'o/ /de ni dam 21ga bdun mgo ma mnyam na nyams pa'o/ /ma ni drang srong dge slong spyod pa dregs pa mtshan ma nyams pa don mi mthong dka' thub dang / /④rang gi bud med rgyal po ⑤dang / /mu stegs bram ze gtsang sbra che ⑥dbang mi skur/ /de ni dam chicog brgyad pa'o// /mos pas thegapa'og ma la smad dang le 'o/ can/ /rgyus chos tshol ba g.yo ldan snying stobs med pa la/ /bstan pa'i gsang ba sgrog mi byed/ / rtags mthong ba'i mngon shes blo sgyur te/④ rtsa rlung gdam ngag logs pa zlas rjod dang ⑧mchod sbyin tsam la chags na 'di ni dam tshig dgu pa'o/ /snying rje ngargyal che byams sems gzhan la med/ /shes pa sa srid zab pa'i snod yin chags dngosapo'i chos rnams la/ /dngos por mngon par zhen 47—174

par bya mibyed zhen na nyams ma zhen na srungs pa'o/ /'di ni dam chirdog bcu pa'o/ /dam tshig las dang chos kyi rgya/ /phyag rgya chen po dngos paramartogs par gcig las/ /don gzhan lalog par sems mi byed pa/ /srungasan dam tshig de ni dam tshig/ bcu gcig pa'o/ /dus rtag tu chos sa dwa rtag dang mi rtag sdug bsngal dang / //stong 'khorab pa dang ni bdag donadam par na med dang / /byang chub byamasapa snying rje sems ni dran byed pa—/ /de ni dam tshig bcu gnyis pa'o/ /chos la ming brngodapalas 'das pa ni yod min cing / /phar byed na nyams 'phags donadam du pa la ni gzugs med pa/ /gang zag don dam par na ngo bo nyid med shes/ /de ni dam tshig bcu gsum pa'o/ /rdo rje'i dam tshig bcu gsum pa/ /gang gis bsrungs na thar pas ste/ /gal te nyams par gyur pa na/ /rdo rje dmyal bar 'ched pa yin/ /des na gsang sngags pa las chos nyid mi byed par ston pas de ltar shes na srungs pa burtse dang chos dang gang zag dang bcas par bzung na nyams ni/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba las bud snya pa dang po rdo rje dmyal ba skye ba gnyis yin bde gshegs gsung / /dperan ji ltar sgyug ldom sbrul zhugs bzhin/ /'gyur bar 'di la the tshom med/ /dam tshig sbas pa/ ti paṃ ka ras mdzad pa rdzogs so// //47—175

rag /gzhal yas khang sprun pa/① ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ sra da ta ta/ bod skad du/ dam tshig dang ldan pa des lha mnyes par byed dgos pas lha dang bla ma la gzhal yas khang sbyin pa ston/ ga6/la pa/sa khang spyosan pa/rje btsun ma sgol ma la skephyag 'tshal lo/ /stong nyid bsgom pa'i dang po kho nar 'dod lha spyod pa'o rnal 'byor pas/ /don dam par na 'di ltar yin pa la de ltar 'dri bas/ ma rtogs pas/'khor ba'i du kha gsung yig 'bru la sogs pa las snying rje chen pos 'gro ba ma lus 3pa yul du byas la—/ cho ga gsum las nges par 'byung ba'i/ yi dmagang byed skyed la 'dod pa'i lha rjes su dran pa dang / 'dodalha'iganas gsum du a las zla ba'i dal ④gsum la gnas pa'i yi ge'i rgyal po oṃt+pahūṃ'abru gsum gyis/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyir/ spyi bor 'khor lo mgrinapar pad+ma snying gar rdo rje'i nang du tshud pa'i sku rdo rjesku gsung thugs la sogs pa'i skudakar po dang / gsungadamarapo dang / thugs sngon po'i rnam pa la/ phyag mtshan rtags kyi mtshan ma 'dzin pa de dang de'i mtshan ma 'dzin pa 47—177

bsgoms pa ni/ dper na me long gi gzugs lta bur rig ji ltar me long gi bzhin gyis gang ba'i rnam pa lta bu'o/ /sngon du 'dod lha skyed la dang por tshogs bsags pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /de nas snying ga'i zla ba la gnas pa'i sa bon las 'oda'aphros/ blam mchod 'dod lha'i ma da' la mdun du spyan drangs la/ bdun po rnam par dag pa dang / tshad med pa bzhi sems bskyed pa'i rang ngo stidang ldan pa'i blos/ byang chub mchog tu bskyed la/ oṃ sarba dharma a ka sha bi sa ma sa dhu sarba hūṃ/ zhes pa'i don gyis/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa stong pa nyid kyi ngang las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sbyor bas gnas pa dang / rlung dgu pa ri rab ba dan bum badz+ra bye bas mtshan pa yo baṃ lo paṃ gi sa bon las ṅgang ba'i dkyil 'khor rtsegs pa dang / sum̐ las gzhal yas khang bskyed pa'i lte ba la paṃ las pad+ma'i mchod sdong bzang po la pad ma stong gis brgyan pa gcig kha dog sna tshogs pa lasabasams la/ yang bdag ⑤nyid kyi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas tshogs bsags spyanadrangs nas pa'i yul rnams thob nas/ bla ma dang 'dod lha pad ma'i mchod sdong bzhugs bla ma dang bud dha rnams kyang pa/ gzugs dang / dri dang /'od dang / gzi brjid kyi rnam pa can/ sngon gsum lta bur dmigs la/srog chags spangs pa'i chu la/ dri zhim pos ④bgos pa'i ma 'dal/ me tog la sogs gtor byas la/ mar dang 'o ma dang zho dang chu dang phyi ba'o ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi lngas/ byugs la/ bdud rtsi chen po'i chag chag tsan dan la sogs pas gtab la/me tog sna tshogs pa lha'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i dgram pa dang / sngags 'dis byin gyis brlabs par bya'o/ /me tog dbul ba dang dgram pa dang gnyis ka sngags 'dis bya oṃ a ka ne+e ni ka ne+e—/ a byi la ma dha la swā hā/ ma 'dal byi dor byed pa'i sngags oṃ badz+ra re khe hūṃ/ zhes pas bla ma la 'bul me tog sil ma gtor ba'i na rin po che'i phye ma brdal bar bsam pa 47—178

'am—/ 'phags pa la 'bul na rin po che'i gzhal med khang du bsam la dbul te—/ de rin po che'i ma 'dal byed na yang sil ma dang / 'dod lha'i gzhal yas khang du skye ba ①na tshom bu'i rnam par dbye bas dbye bar shes par bya'o/ /'di bla ma gtso bor mchod pa'i ma 'dal du bzung bar bya'o/ /lung las/ spyan ras gzigs rtogs pa bcu gcig pa'i tan tra las/ de yang bla ma sangs rgyas mchod pa yi/ /ma 'dal rtag tu bya ba'i phan yon dang / /sdig pa thams cad med byed pa ste/ /ganga'adi ni susade bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas gang du sngags gsung ba de bzlos kyang ma 'dal byas nas phul na de ni burtse'i zhing stong la dbang bsgyur ②bar 'gyur ro/ /zhing khams rab 'byam du/ /rnal 'byor phun sum tshogs par 'gyur/ /ces gsungs so/ /ma 'dal 'bul ba ba ④rdzogs so// //

༄7/ /lha dang bla ma mnyes pa des thun mong du tshogs bsags cing bar chad zhi bar bya ba'i phyir chab gtor bstan te/ rgya gar skad du/ pa yo k+ṣi pa ti bi dhi/ bod skad du/ chu gtor gyi cho ga /rje btsun ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chu gtor byed par 'dod pas—/ sngon du 〈 ba ni dang por donadam par na thams cad bdag med par dran par byas la/ de ltar ma rtogs shing 'khrul pa'i 'gro ba rnams la snying rje'i dbang gis 'gro ba la bltas ste/ sdug bsngal gyi yuladamyal ba la sogs pa rnams la rjes su mthong ba dang de'i don du—/ dang por gtor ma bshams pa gtor ma'i snod ci 'byor pa'i nang du/ phye dang rin po che dang / me tog la sogs pa ci 'byor pa blugs ⑧la/ gnyis pa te sbyang ba stan pa gtor ma'i nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge re gyis sreg rdul bral bar byas la/ de nas gsum pa ste bdud rtsir bsgyur ba 'phro 'dus pa'o/ /yi ge a yis bdud rtsir gyur par bsams la/ sngags 'dis byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /47—181

bdud rtsi stan par byed pa'i sngags oṃ sarba dharma badz+ra si ti hūṃ/ mdun du zhes pa 'di ci rigs par bzlas so/ /de nas sohugar sga ba'o sems can gyi zas dang / bzhi pa ste so sor sngo ba stan pa skom la sogs pa byel med par so so'i tshad med pa ji tsam 'dod pa yid tshim pa ②spyod yul dang tsham par thob par bya ba'i phyir/ sngags 'di zlas ④par bya'o/ /dga' ba dang yid tshim par byed pa'i sngags 'di'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra (1—/ lnga pa mnyam snyoms su sngo ba bstan pa drug pa/ sngon la zang zing gi de nas 'di ltar chos kyis so nges bya/sa sngags 'dis phan tshun zhe 'dras pa nga rgyal 'thab rtsod med par med cing 'byor pa phun sum tshogs par bya'o/ /de'i sngags 'di tshar bdun chi na ma sa man ta bu ta nan gra hi sha dri sra pa te ja ma ha sa ma ④ye swā hā/ de nas mig gis gzugs gdags pa zhes sems can de dag gi mig dang yid mngon par dga' ba'ibaradu'odang / mi skye ba'i chos la bzod par bya ba'i phyir/ sngags 'di brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ ru ru spu ru ste ta dza la la tsa ne+e sarba satwa ar tha ne+e swā hā/ ces pas rtogs pa bla na med par bya'o—/ /de nas sngo gang su brjod pa ni ba ni/ de bzhin bdun pa ste tshig tu sngo ba stan pa gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje'i dam tshig gi mthus—/ zang zing dang / chos kyi sbyin pa bkye bas/ sbyin pa gnyis pa de'i stobs kyis zang zing dang chos kyi sems can mtha' yas pa thams cad kyi lus dang sems tshim pa dang / ngan song gi rgyud 'udang bral nas mthar sdug bsngal ma lus pa zad pa dang /bde ba chen po mi zad pa'i gter gyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig /de nas gzhan yang / dge ba 'di yi skye bo kun/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs bsags pas/ /bsod nams ye shes las byung ba'i/ /dam pa gnyis ni thob par shog /ces klu grub klu grub kyi pon lam 'debs pa kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod par 47—182

bya'o—/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de nas byams pa snying rje mnga' ba de bzhin gshegs pa dang / mthu mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas longayod na dal bar gyur pa na/ sher snying la sogs pa chos kyi gtam rgyud gzhan yang brjod par bya'o de nas ci bde bar ro/ /chu gtor gyi cho ga rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/181 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄7/ /chu gtor gyi cho ga bsdo/gas so// 90〈〈pe 〉〉srugs/182 ①〈〈pe 〉ṅkazosor/ ②〈〈pe 〉zibotshad med pa ji tsam 'dod pa yid tshim pa/ ②〈〈pe 〉thazlas/ ④〈〈pe〉bom ()〈〈pe 〉〉rgyu/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2642)47d+ngha183

༄ga /sbyin sreg gi cho ga①raḥ/ /khyad par du tshogs bsags pa dang / bar chad gsal bar bya ba'i phyir sbyin sreg sdeston te/rgya gar skad du/ ma ho ma bi ti/ bod skad du/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga /rje btsun sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thog mar sbyin bsreg byed pa'i sngags pa dam tshig dam tshig sogs sgrang bya dang ldan pas/ chos thams cad bdag med donadam par par mos pa'i rjes la/ byang chub kyi mchog rmākrika ru ṇa sems bskyed par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la lha'i rnal 'byor yud tsam skad cig mas gyisabyas la/ dang por thab khung bya ba bstan ①padabe+en pa'i gnas su dkyil 'khor khru gang zabatugru bzhi bzhipa la/ thab khung rgyar mtho gang ba/ rlum pa dang zhabs phra ba'i pad ma 'i dbyibs lta bu byas la/ gtingazhabs su sor drug pa dorababya/ kha gyer sor phyed dang gnyis bag④pa/ nang chag kyang de'i tshad do phyi chag gi tshod tsam zer ba yin/ /de nas gnyis pa ste bud shing stan pa tsan dan dang shug pa la sogs pa 'o ma can gyi shing la/ yamasashing sor lnga'i yams shing byas la/ gsum pas ste 47byed184

me sbar dwar ba stan pa srub shing las byung ba'i me sbar la/ yi ge ram̐ dkar po las/skad cig mas bzhi pa ste dam tshig gi me lha bskyed pa me lha drang srong gi rnam pa lta bu la/ bgrang 'phreng gis do shal byas pa/ dbyig pa dang ril pa spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ ra skyes la zhon pa bsgoms la/ lnga pa ste ye shes kyi me lha bskyed pa/ bdag gi thugs spyan drangs na ka nas 'od lcags kyu'i rnam pa spros pas/ rang bzhin kyi me lha bkug pas/las kyi me lha la bcug te oṃ ag ne+e ste zhes pas 'dod lhas rin po che'i dbu rgyan phul bar bsams la dbang bskur bar 'dod pa'o/ /'dres pas yon phul ba mchod yon phul la/ rnam min gyi lus logs su bzhag la drug pa ste sreg rdzas dbul ba lus ngag yid gsum gyi 'gal rkyen gan gang tsam sreg lugs bdun byin te/bdag gi sdig pa'i ming nas phyung la/ 'dod lha'i snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas rnam smin gyi lus kyi bshang lam du zhugs nas snying ga bye nas sdig pa'i gzugs phyung nas rdzas la stem par bsam mo/ /'di tshe yang bdun bdun no snying ga nas nag po phri'i rnam pa lta bu byab cing / me lha'i kha gdangs par bsreg par bya'o/ /sreg rdzas ni/ til dang / tsan dan dang / gur gum rnams la/ sngags 'di bzlas shing sreg go/ /oṃ badz+ra a na a sarba thu du dz+wa shā sa pa sharnyi ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing mar dang sreg rdzas la sreg rdzas byin pa'i rjes la/ dgang lugs lan bdun sbyin no/ /bdun pa ye shes kyi lha tshogs thab tu mchod pa stan pa de nas rdzas rnams la bsang gtor byas la/ me lha'i snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rgyu las gzhal yas khang bsgoms la/ de'i nang du rang gi 'dod lha cho ga gsum kyis bgyis pa'i lha skyed la/ bdag gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis 'og min gyi gnas nas/ de'i yeshesarim pa spyan drangs te/ burtse dgongs pa mdzad pa la sogs kyis dbang bskur ro/ /gnyis su med par ①stem pa dang / logs 'di na lha yod pa labadag kyang mar me chad pa'i tshul du/ me lha bsuchad pa las bskyed 47—185

pa'i lha la bzhugs pa dang / 'od kyi thab 'dod pa'i 'od kyi tu bar ①bsam mo/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis brlab par bsam la/ oṃ ā hūṃ gis byin rlabs stan par bya ba'i phyir sku gsung thugs kyis rgyas gtab pa ste/ bdag gnyis su yod pa'i cha gcig gis so/ /sreg lugs dang dgang lugs sbyin par byas te/ de rang rang gi ming dang / zhi ba'i tshig gi bar du bcug la bzlas so/ /sngags 'di oṃ badz+ra ka ti ad mo sarba pā pa da ha na pra mo k+ṣa yā sha— ku ru swāhā/ zhes rnams kyi lus kyi brjod cing bdag gi snying ga nas sdig palnga/ ji lta byas na sdig pa ci byas pa'i de zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ dang po steng du su rtsi'i ②yul sgrub pa'i phyir gzugs gnas pa byab cing rdzas snga ma bsregs rdzas la stem pa la pas/ de'i byin rlabs kyis bdag gi byang chub kyi sems dri ma med pa/ dperanazla ba rdo rje'i rnam pa lta bur gyur pa de yang rnam par rtog pa med cing / rtogapathams cad zhi nas rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal du grangs nges pa med yi dam du bya'o ba'i bde ba chen po/ chos kyis lhun gri/sa grub pa nyid du dper na bdag nyid ye shes lha'i ye shes gshegs dam tshig sdu'o/ /ye shes lha tshur rang gi lus la bsdu/ chos sku spros bral la sems ldan te gzhag go/ /ba(1ba/sa nga/zang ngasas/ma / :gcad cesab/ gi cho ga rdzogs so// //47byed186

bsdur mchan/184 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄gyi/ /sbyin sreg gi cho ga bzhugs so/ / ②〈〈pe 〉〉bsreg ①〈〈pe 〉〉stan/ dhi〈〈pe 〉〉wazobacig185 ①〈〈pe 〉〉pa/186 ①〈〈pe 〉〉du 'bar/ ②〈〈pe 〉mthu tsa'i/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2643)pyi47—187

sngag /lha mchod pa'i rim pa/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ 'dod pa'i dngos grub dbang du bya ba'i phyir lha mchod pa ston de wa pu tsa kra ma/ bod skad du/ lha mchod pa'i rim pa/ rje btsun sgol ma la phyag sharazu 'ab 41/ /bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags ⑤par 'dod pas dang po ste lha mchod pa'i dgos pa ston 'bas pa/nga po pa'i rnal 'dre/ra pas mngon gsum du lha mnyes nas/ mnyes pa'i stobs kyis mngon par 'dod pa'i dngos grub dbang du bya ba'i phyir lha gang mnyes par byed na 'dod pa'i lha'i thugs dam yongs su bsgul ba ni/ cis mnyes par byed na mchod pa chen po yin te/'di ltar dang por rnal 'byor pas/ gnyis pa ste pu tsa byin gyis brlab cing bsham pa ston te/ lo zla tshes grangs dus byin gyis rlab pa yin gsung mkha' 'gro ma 'pho ba'i dus shes par byas la/rdzas sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin dbyangs dang lnga'o lnga'i mchod pa'i yo byad phyi dang / lnga'inang dang /'dod yon gyi lha mo spros te gsang ba dang / de kho na'i la gnas pa'i pu tsa rim pa rnams byin gyis brlab pa rnams tshul bzhin du byas la te/ gsum pa ste pu tsa'i yul bstan pa don dam pa'i 47—188

bden par rtogs par bskyed pas spro ba med pa'i don la lhag par mos pa'i blo sngon du song bas de yang bdag dang gzhan gnyis gi'i 'o/ /ji ltar na mngon par 'dod pa ltar rang gi 'dod pa'i lha'i cho ga bzhin skyed pa dang / ye shes sems pa sgrub pa dang / ting nge 'dzin sems pa'i gnyis med 'dres pa'i thugs ka nas ting nge 'dzin ①mtshon gang ba'i snying ga nas 'od zer las/ paṃ chad pa las kun tu bzang po yab yum du skyed la/ de nyid rjosnyoms par zhugs pa lasade 'od du (1 ba las/ nyi ma ring ba las thung ba'am thung ba las ring bar 'gro ba'i dus 'ong tshes grangs bzang po'i dus des mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyis ma nges pa'o/ /ཿdzas kyi 'a byu/nga gnas/ kha dog dkar ba/ zhabs phra ba/ kha yel ba/ dbyebs gru gsum gyi rnam par bsgoms la/ de nas ting nge ④'dzin sems pa las/ chosa'abyung nang du hri chad pa las—/ pad+ma'i sdong po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i ze 'bru la/ nyi ma'am zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa skyed la/ de'i steng du ting 'dzin rjosems dpa' lasayi ge.a las rtags pa yab yum rnamasnangadu gyur pa dang / de'i ⑤yang snyoms par zhugs pa las 'od du zhu ba las/ gzhal yas khang rgyu rin po che las grub pa ma gas ma chag 'phan med pa/phyogs su ma rjochad pa/ delasakyang 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba/ mthong ba tsam nyams dga' ba chen po bsgom ⑦la/ slar bsgoms ⑧pa de khang pa'i nang du 'gron gyi bzhin du 'ong rang nyid kyi lus ji ltar mos pa'i tshogs kyi rnam par sprul nas gzhal yas khang de'i nang du 'khod de/ dkyil 'khor chen por gyur pa dang / bzhi pa ste ji ltar mchod pa bstan ⑨no/ /bdag gi rnamasmin gyi rnam pa'i lus 'di grib ma'i tshul du logs suchad pa yang lhar ga pa'o/ /chad pa las/ de'i thugs ka nas mchod pa'i lha mo mang po spros spos dang me tog dang zhal zas la sogs pa spros pas/ mchod pa rgya chen pos mchod pas mchod pa dang / lnga pa ste lhas 'gro don mdzad pa bstan ⑩pa ste dkyil 'khor gyi tshogs bla ma dang 47—189

bcas pa mnyes nas 'od zer 'phros shing khyab sems can gyi tshogs thams cad la mchod pa 'dod yon gyi dga' bas rgyachen po byin pas/ dmyalabayan chad sems can dang / lha de dag kyang 'dod yon gyi pu tsa nyams su stsong ba tsam gyis byang chub kyi sems rin po che bskyed nas/lam ches che ba la zhugs te sdom pa gsum la gnas shing rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod kyi lam phyag rgya bzhi rgyud la skyes nas/nas gong ltar tshogs rgya chen po bsags nas kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes/ bde ba chen po rtogs pa dang bral ba'i ro mchog sku nyams su btar nas/ gong ltar don chen po sgrub pas na rang gi nyams dga' ba dre/ ba'i bstod pa/ mnyam nyid burtse dang sems can mnyam pas na mi g.yo zhes bya ba la sogs pa brjod par bya'o/ /de nas lha'i da la'i tsag rdzas dang dkyil 'khor chen po lha tshogs rang bzhin gyi ye shes 'gro ba rnams ①gnyis sbyong ba'i phyir rdo rje'i tshig brngod pa rang gi tha/sa la dbang bskur ba dang / bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa bkra shis ngo bo dag gyur te/ /sems la dbang ni thob par shog rdo rje'i glu ru gyur pa brjod nas/ a don chen po 'di ltar byed mkhan yin zer nas don 'di ltar gyur par yang bsam phyi snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad kyang gzhal yas khang ②de'i ngo bo nyid du dmigs/ nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad kyang lha'i dkyil 'khor de dag gi ngo bo nyid du dmigs/ de dag thams cad kyang de ltar snang ba de kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam du rang rig pa'i rnam 'phrul tsam du dmigs la/ donadam par na rang rig pa rang bzhin kyis 'od gsal ba'i stong pa nyid kyi ngang la mnyamapar bzhag par bya'o/ /drug pa ste pu tsa'i phan yon stan pa'o/ /bdag gi re ba ji lta ba bzhin du tshe 'dir yang phran tshegs kyi dngos grub dngos grub gnas su bstan pa dang / skyeba'aphos nas zhing khams ji lta ba'i dbang 'byor pa'i bde ba can la sogs par ro/ /lung nges par ston par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar rgyun du tshogs bsags pa de'i lha mchod pa'i rim pa rdzogs so// //47byed190

bsdur mchan/188 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉sa / /lha mchod pa'i rim pa bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉〉bsag189 ①〈〈pe 〉〉nebosems/ ②〈〈pe 〉stananyis/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉wange / du〈〈pe 〉stonge 'dzin ni/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉de/du〈〈pe 〉stanasum/ 9)〈〈pe 〉〉bsgoms/ 9ste〈〈pe 〉〉sgom/ po)tu)〈〈pe 〉〉stan/19༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉rnam/ ②〈〈pe 〉mi pa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2644)47—191

༄ga /tshe bsgrub pa'i thabs ①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ rnal 'byor pa tshe thung na sgrub pa'i long med pas tshe sring ba'i gdam ngag bshad pa a yu sa dha na/ bod skad du/ tshe bsgrub pa'i thabs/ rje btsun sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang pos te tshogs bsags pa stan pa yin dang po kho nar rnal 'byor pas/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i dharma sarba shu n+ya ltar don la mos pa byas la/gzugs skur sngon gyi pon 'jug gi dus su smon lam gyi dbang las sems can gyi don byed pa la sngon du tshe sgrub dgos pas rjes su dran par byas la/ gnyis pa ste lhar ston cho ga lngas rang mos pa'i lhar bsgrub pa dang / a ye shes bzhugs pa yin las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du—/ a nyid 'od zer dang ldan dkar zhing gdang ba pa'i phreng ba dang ldan par bsgoms la/ de'i mthus bla ma dang sangs rgyas rnams snang bar byas la phyag 'tshal ba la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs par bya'o/ /gsum pa ste srungs mtshalas kyi rnam pa stan no/ /de nas oṃ tri no me bha rak+ṣ-i sarba swā hā/ ces 47—192

sngags 'di brjod pa tsam gyis bud snya dang bla ma dang 'dod lha las 'od byung bas khyab pa las palnga/ sngags kyis rwa ba dra ba la sogs pas rdo rje'i khang pa/ rtsig pa dang / gur du byas pa 'byongs pa dang / bzhi pa ye shes kyi tshogs bsgom ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir/ stong pa nyid kyi don la 'jug par bya ste/ oṃ shu khya ta dmigs te tsam pa de yang dzha na badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma kophohaṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis rang gi shes pa mig yor tsam las ma gtogs par/ phyinangasgod bcud dngos po'i rang bzhin med cing / lnga pa stegazhal yas khang skyed pa ston dmigs par byas la de nas sems kyi chos nyid kyi yi ge yi baṃ lam̐ re bzhi'i rnam par chad pas/ rlung dang / chu dang / sa dang / me dang /ri'i rgyal po ri rab tu snang ba'i nga rgyal du bstan pa dang / hūṃlasade'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la/ paṃ las pad ma/ de'i lte ba①/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsams la/ de nas de rnams kun tu 'od du zhu ba las/ rin po che las grub pa'i bum pa/ khyad par du shel tshe'i rnam par shes pa'i mdzod dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / drug pa ste dam tshig sems dpa' sgom pa stan de las 'od zer gsumapa las 'phro 'dus bzhu brtul byas pas/bdag nyid 'phags pa tshe dpag tu med par gyur te/ sku mdog dmar po la/phyag g.yas na che'i bum pa bsnams pa/ mdun du 'dug pa la tshe la bar chod byed pa srung ba'i tshe dpag med kyi khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la bka' bsgo ba gcig bsgom/ bdun pa ste ye shes bzhugs par bstan de nas de'i thugs ka'i zla ba la gnas pa'i yi ge a las 'od byung bas—/ 'og min gyi gnas nas/ tshe dpag tu med pa/ spyan drangs la bdag la bstem pa dang / brgyad pa ste tshe sgrub pa stan pa oṃ a mri ta ba hri ces pas rgyunadu bdag gi bzlas pa la brtson par bya'o/ /skabs skabs su bzlas de nas oṃ sarba saṃ ska ri 47—193

ras /'chi ba slu ba/①༄4/ /rnal 'byor pa tshe thung na sgrub pa'i long med par 'chi bltas ④byung na 'chi ba slu ba bshad pa ni rgya gar skad du/ mi thu ma sha na/ bod skad du/ 'chi ba slu ba/ rje btsun sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyams su myong ba'i thabs la/ mchog tu gzhol ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ snangabami bden par dngos po thams cad rmi lam gyi shes pa lta bur shes par byas pa/ stongapanyidade kho na nyid yid la bya'o/ /gal te bsgom pa'i'achi ba slu ba sngon du 'gro ba'i bsam pa/ long med par 'chi ba'i rtags mthong na/ tshe 'di la bya ba rdzogs par 'dod pas 'chi ba'i mtshan ma dang de nas blu ba'i tshigs bcad gal che bas spyo/ra ba 'dis slu bar bya'o/ /de la 'chi ba'i rtags ni rnam pa gnyis te/ nang gi 'chi rtags dang / phyi'i 'chi rtags bstan pa'o/ /de la phyi'i 'chi rtags la yang gnyis te—/ rmi lam du mthong ba'i rtags dang / dngos su mthong ba'i rtags so/ /rmi lam du mthong ba'i rtags ni/ 'dir lug lungabongabon zhon nas kha lho phyogs 47—195

su bltas te/ lung pa stong pa gcig tu 'gro ba dang / lce ru nam phyed na grogs med par zla ba dang skar ma ma mthong bar 'khyams pa'am/ bdag gis skad rigs mi mthun pa'i yul du phyin pa la/ gzhan gyis mis dbang du byas nas/gos med par bdag gcer bur 'dug pa'am/ bdag ①rang dbang med par sa gting du 'dzul ba 'byung ba'i gtor chung byas kyang stub oṃ ba de na ba de su ba de sru hā/ ces bzlas nas stab kyang rung ngo / /:she ba 'iban ces/ /zla ba nya'i nub mo zla ba dros po che na cer bur lag pa gnyis spyi bor sbyang grib ma la ma yengs par bltas pa la thal mo'i grib ma la gnyis su mthong na snying gas pa yin te 'chi rtags so/ /sos ka'i rmig rgyu byung ba'i dus su dben par rang gos med par long bu sprad ②lag pa snol bas spyi bo mnan te/ lus thar sha bcad de ltas pa las grib ma'i mgo nyams na 'chi/ yan lag nyams na bar chad phra mo 'ong dka' la gzugs tshang na tshe ring bar 'ongadangos su mthong ba'i rtags ni/ bdag rang gi lag pa dpral bar gtad la rangal bltas pas mig m+bid de chad pa dang / grib ma'i gzugs brnyan nam mkha' la snang ba de nyams pa dang / bshad pa dang dz+red pa 'dom pa dang / 'du rten med par rtags pas snying mi dga' ba dang / sngar phrad kyang yang sprad par 'dod bral bar mi 'dod pa'o—/ /nye ba dang grung ④po tshogs pa la glo bur du 'dod pas gdungs pa yin no/ /shes pa ma 'khrul pa de la nang gi 'chi ba'i rtags ni/ bdag nyid kyi nyams byin gyis brlabs pa la/ rnabug g.yas kyi dbugs rgyu ba rgyubargya phrag gcig ma tshang ba dang /g.yon gyi dbugs rgyu ba ma tshang ba dang / skyes pa'i g.yas bud med kyi g.yon bla rtsa 'phar ba rjom tshang ba dang / rnal du mi 'dug pa dang gsus kyi rtsa la dgra dar ba dang / sdod nye ba dang bcas pa'i btsa' yod pa yin no/ /de la slu ba'i cho ga ni/ rmi lam ngan pa mthong ba'i rtags byung na/ gong du bshad pa ltar tshe dpag tu med pa'i cho ga byas te/dngos su byung ba'i rtags ni/ shin tu mi rtag pa dran pa'i spyod yul du gyur pa'o/ /47—196

dge ba stobs chen byas pa'o ma chags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang lhan cig pa'i sbyin pa rgya dngos sam bsam pas chen po btang ngo / /lus kyi sunani 'chi ba'i ltas la ni/ rlungargyu ba spong ba dang / nad srung ba gdam ngag gis thig le 'bar 'dzag dang / shin tu na ya byi ru'i sgo nas so / /na ya ni rang gi snying gi dkyil du bu ga nyungs 'bru tsam pa bsam la de je che je che stong sangs te song bar bsgom pa'o/ /dngos po thams cad rang gi lus la 'dus nas je chung je chung la stong par bsgom pa ni gcig dus so :se dmigs pa yid la bya'o/ /de ltar byas na 'chi ba yang phanayonathe tshom med par slu bar 'gyur ro/ /'chi ba slu ba rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/195 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄7/ /'chi ba slu ba baX/gas so// 9)〈〈pe 〉〉ltas/196 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〉la/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉jide/ ①〈〈pe 〉sta(nga / 0〈〈pe 〉〉wab/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2646)47—197

ragyi/ /dbang bskur ⑪ba'i dal ①dang de nas skyed rdzogs bsgom pa sa ma ta'i dal rjodang gnyis/gong gi man ngag bsgom pas 'dod lhar byin kyis brlabs pa sprul pa'i dal ⑤dang gsum/ de nas 'og min du rnam snang dang 'jal nas byin gyis brlabs pa rang bzhin gyi dal ④dang bzhi/ be ro tsa nas byang chub lnga'i gdams pa bstan pas chos sku thob pa don dam pa'i dal ⑦dang lnga'o/ /burtse rnye na dang kun dga' snying po lam lngar 'dod pa — pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs min gsung ngo / /dus chen po la bab te 'chi ba ma zlog na 'chi ka ma'i gdams pa ston tesbyo/ gar skad du/ a de sha sha na/ bod skad du/ man ngag la mtshan rtags pa byang chub sems dpa' sbyang ba'i man ngag zer 'chi ka ma'i bstan chos/ rje btsun sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo//dam tshig med pa dgos pa med rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa kun/ /'das pa'i dus na chos gsum gces/ /gar skyes kyang spyod pa med par shes pa 'khor ba zhe thag bcad pa dang //thar pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa la spyo grong la 'dun pa dang / /'dir byang ba'i byang chub gongam gnyis kyi bya ba de gang gis byas na sems kyi gnas po bya/ /de ltar shes na 'chi ba yi/ /bde nas 47byed198

bde bar 'gro bas so 'jigs pa yod pa ma yin no/ /de la 'khor ba zhe thag bcad pa'i dang po stan pa ni/ /rang lus bcu po 'di 'khor ba'i sgo dgag ming bzhi'i phung po gzugs dang lnga la/ /snying po med par gsob kyi phung por shes par bya/ /rten lugs 'byung las ①'byung bas na mi dge ba ma skyes pa mi skyeskyes pa yang 'gags rkyen bab/ lnga ba/sa :/ga palnga/ las skyes pa gsal rnam/ pa mthaḥdzab/ /ha la'i dug dang bdagagazhan thams cad la 'dra bar shes/ /tshe 'di snang ba mi bden rmi lam lta bu la/ /longs spyod mirtaga'aja' tshon lta bur nges/ /bu tsha lus kyi shig 'dra la—/ /phyi nas brang thog tu 'ong zlog par dka' 'chi bdag bdud ni grib ④so 'dra/ /rnyed pa thag rgya lta bu la rang gis 'ching bas so/ /rang sems rdza gog bye'u bzhin te rten dang bral bas so/ /bud med sngos dang 'dra ba yin mthar du mi gter bas so/ /yul ni ngal so 'dra ba ste daragacig sdod pa yin/ /'du shes 'di bcu sus shes pa/ /'khor ba'i chos la yid byung yin/ /gzhan yang rjes thar ba'i grong la dpa' bo 'dis thar pa'i sgo 'byud su dran pa bdun/ /gang gis shes par gyur pa de/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen phar shes shing / /nyamasamyongade bzhin nyid ni ma ru shes/ /mya ngan 'das pa yul du dran—/ /rang sems thar pa chen por dran/ /bdag 'dzin las grol na chos kun tshul cig stonganyid du nyid du dran/ /bsam gtan sa 'khar dnga'adra bar chen por dran/ /lus rgyud bye brag gi bag chags dang res zad par 'dod pa'o/ /bag chags zad par dran/ /'di rnams 'phags pa'i gshegs shul yin/ /de ltar 'du shes rjes dran gyis/ /man ngag rjes blama'isu bzung nas ni/ /lam 'di la zhugs ①pa la bsam gyis mi khyab phyag rgya che/ /rnal 'byor pa yi rangasemasadabang du bya/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa ji ltar 'jug nasnying gar re las nyi dkyil 'khor/ /tsha zhing rtsub pa rno ba 'od zer gdug pa bsgom byas la/ /nang grol bcud kyis sa bsregs dang / /nang du rngub pa dang sbyar ro/ /thal 47—199

ba thur sems dbugs kyi brda/ /khong pa nangagrol med nas nam mkha' stong pa la/ /sems nyid a'itshul du byang chub a yi dngos lasazlaba'i dal①/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang ltar khadogadakar/ /de steng yi ge hūṃ las ni/ /rdo rje gdan gyi spo shākya thub pas bdud brtul nas sangs rgyas 'dra bas ni rdo rje gdan gyi spo bo bsgom ste/ /rig pa hūṃ gi rdo rje hūṃ gi 'phro 'du las 'phro bsdu yis/ /rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ /yar bstan snying po tshangs pa'i/ /bu ga dag la gtad pa yin/ mar snying po gsang ba yi/ /nor bu dag la gtad pa yin/ /rang bzhin a thung ngu'i rnam pa gsang ba'i stenga'ogasgo chen bsdams pa las/ /rdo rje rlung rgya gram langs pa las/ /lte ba gru gsum du sam mdo me ni yar bar bya/ /zla ba rdo rje bcas pa zhu/ /thil le rgyal po nyid du rgyur/ /sgo brgyad dmig la sogs pa nas lasani 'phros pa yis/ /rnam par ru pa la sogs pa yum lnga zhen pa'i rtog pa rtog pa'i spyo1gas gsang nas//rang sems skum gong ma shas med pa thig le spro ba ṇazhu/ /phyi nang med par kun tu gsal/ /la la mi rtag 'od dang bcas pa mar me'i tshul dudakar dal la/ /tshangs pa'i bu gar bstan pa yis/ /sangs rgyas sam lha skur dmigs la zhing khams rab 'byam nyid/ /'chi ka ma'i bstan chos so/ /byang chub kyi sems sbyang ba'i man ngag sdogs so// //47—200

bsdur mchan/198 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ga / 'chi ka ma'i bstan chos bzhugs so/ / ②〈〈pe 〉〉skur/ ①durjodu〈〈pe 〉〉dkyil 'khor/199 ①〈〈pe 〉〉wazolas/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉gro/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉nug2༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉dkyil 'khor/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉tshed/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2647)47—201

༄ga /ro bsreg pa'i cho ga①༄—/ ro bsreg gi cho ga bzhugs so// ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ tshe 'phos pas bag chags kyi sgrib pa sbyong ba dang phung po lha tshogs la dbul ba'i ro ston to/ /mu lha ma de la/ bod skad du/ro bsreg pa/ rje btsun sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig tshogs phung po'i rgyun gcad phyir rtsams pa'i dgos byed stan pa/ /ro bsreg cho ga brtsam par bya dgos pa de'i phyir na//dang por ro de'i sa ⑤bzhi stan pa 'gro ba la gur gum gyis khrus rgyan stags pa'o/ /thal ①jugar rolnga( snying ka ru//'dod lha gang yin snying po bri/ /las kyi sgrib pa rgyun gcod pa'i/ /snying po spyi bo gtsug tu gdags/ /gnas gtsang ma'i khri stengs ④la/ /kha ni nub tu bstan la bzhag /gnyis pa ma 'dal bstan pa ma 'dal bcas pa'i de'imadun du steng du ni/ /shing dang shiba'iphyed du'o/ /bcas pa'i mchod pa dgram/ /gnyis pas ste me lha dang ta thā ga ta la sbyin sreg bya ba stan no/ /da phan chad lan chags dmigs pa de ltar byas pa'i gtor ma sngon du ba ga ban shākya thub pa la gtor ma/ gtor ma zhes bgyi bsngo ba'o/ /gtang nas ni/ /gnyis pa ste ro byin gyis rlab dhipa stan 47—202

ngan song spyo/nga ba'i gsang sngags kyis dmigs la sngags bzlas kyin tshe las 'das pa'i sgrib pa sbyong ba'i bsam pas zhag bdun du zlas na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs dam skul/ /nye ba'i tshe 'das gos dkar po gon pa smis na mtshan ma mthong ba dang / /sngon du de ltar byas nas de nas cho ga byas nas ni/ /zhal nas gsungs pa'i gangamos kyi dkyil 'khor bri/ /rtsa ba'i lha gang byed kyang rnams tshang ba dang / /'jig rten phyogs skyong la bha ling sbyin gtso bo bran du skol / /dbus su zhiba'i thab khung spur khang gi bri ba dang / /phyi nang gi bar chod zhi ba dang /tshe 'das kyi tshogs rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir me tog gtor ba'i bsras dang la'i lha rnams thab khung du sbyangs ①pa la bya gsung yam̐ ⑪shing bsreg rdzas 'phreng sngags kyis skye med du'o/ /byin rlabs la/ /shing ni me sbar ba'i me'i nang du gzugs/ /sngon dag la bya ba yin ro la sngags kyis gtab nas ni/ /tsan dan dri yis bgegs bsang ④byugs pa yin gdug pa dang / /drisabyugs nas gos dang rgyan gyis mdzes pa la/ /snying ka og ma spyi bo ru/ /sarba byid kyis byin gyis rlab/ /yi/sargyab dang dpral bar 'phreng sngags dgod a a sarba ta thā ga'i sngags so/ /ga6/zug dag 'a/ chagags gzhan dgod/ /de nas ngan song sbyong ba'i sngags zlas sam gdags ngan song sbyong ba'i phyir/ /dam tshig gi me lha dar ye shes gzhug pa dang dgang lugs ④bdun dang sreg rdzas gzhan dang 'thun pa snyed tshad kyang dbul lo me lha'i snying gar ye shes pa spyan drangs nas dgang lugs lags ⑤pa dbul steng du bcas shing cer pa'i nang du me lha'i thugs kar ye shes spyan drangs pu tsa bya'o/ /te dbus su bzhag /de bzhin gshegs pa ཿ/na drangs rjol/ /me lha ma yebaskyed par thab du dgang lugs bdun blug go/ /sna spyo1gas maḥdzad pa'i sprin gyis mchod/ /mchod lugs ji ltar mchod na lha rnams rang rang sngags kyis su/ /ye shes gshegs pa'i shol du bsreg lugs nyi shu rtsa re bya/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje dang / /phyag na pad+ma zhags pa bsnams/ /zhabs kyi pad+mas sdig pa'i gzugs mnan pa sdig mnan cing / /rgyan rnams kun gyis rab tu rdzogs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu' 47—203

rgyan rnam snang gi dbu rgyan no/ /mthos/ /ting nge 'dzin du ma gsal dmigs pa'i rten dgang lugs nas pu tsa sreg pa yam shing gi bar du ①bsams sam yang na bris kyang rung / /dang po snying po oṃbadz+ra pa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa nge/ babyu/na du/ /basbyo/ dra/ga de nas lha gshegs pa me lha mchod/ des kyang dmyal ba nas ye shes gshegs pa dam tshig 'dud nas so/ /gam ni stong dag gis/ /sbyin bsreg ji tsam nus tshad bya/ /na pa ste yon tan brjod pa ston to/ /sbyin bsreg yon tan nges brjod pa/ /de ltar byas pa'i phan yon tan shi ba'i ming nas phyung nas ni/ /mkhas pas dmigs pa dpag tu 'dod pa dang byas nas esbyin bsreg rab 'bad na/ /mnar med pa la sogs par dmyal ba chen por gyur pa yang / /de nasatshe 'phos nas sdug bsngal las gol the tshom med/ /gang gis dze+erten med kyang yan de ro ni med pa la/ /zlas shing bsgom pa'i tshul bsam gtan pas gyis ni/ /cung zad nges pa yidatshigapar byas nas rnyed pa dang / /dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor zhugs pa dang mtshan ma bris nas ni/ /tshatshwamang po mchod rten phreng ba bya ba 'am/ /yang na sku gzugs byas kyang lugs ma lags pa rung / /sbyin bsreg mngon par dbang bskur ④bas/ /gdon mi za bar grol bar ni nus gsung sus gsungs na rnam par rgyal ba lags pa nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pas nges par gsungs/ /sdig can rigs chad pa le lor gyur pa la/ /ma'ongs par tshe 'dir bde ba mthong mi 'gyur/ /rdo rjer skal med de 'dra yang bla ma stobs ldan gyis/ /sreg lugs gongabashad pa'i rim par thob pa ni/ /bar der rgyu rkyenade la rten nas langs kyang byang chub 'thob/ /ro bsreg pa'i cho ga rdzogs so// //47—204

bsdur mchan/202 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〉mo ①〈〈pe 〉〉btsa'/du〈〈pe 〉〉steng /203 ①〈〈pe 〉cisabs/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉pams/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉rgyan drangs/ du〈〈pe 〉〉bsad/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉zug dhi〈〈pe 〉torag⑦〈〈pe 〉〉warim ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〉pa/204 ①〈〈pe 〉〉du'o// ②〈〈pe 〉〉wabyas nas/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉stan/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉skur/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2648)47wa 205

ras /bdun tshigs kyi cho ga①rak+ṣa/ /rgya gar skad du/ bar do'i du kha zhi zhing 'og min la sogs par skye bar bya ba'i phyir/a ti bi ti/ bod skad du/ bdun tshigs kyi cho ga /rje btsun ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por dgos pa bstan pa rnal 'byor pas gzhan shi ba la phan gdags par 'dod pas dusalabab pa na/ shi ba'i dus tshigs bdun bdun gyis bar chod pa la 'dir byas te la cho ga 'di ltar bya ste/ gnyis pas ste gshed dang dbral ba dang dang por bshed ⑤dang dbral ba dang / gsumapaste rnam shes ltar bzung ba dang / bzhipastekhrus bya ba dang / lngapastelha skyed pa dang / drugapastedabang bskur ba dang / 1lam stan pa'o/ /dang por bshed ④dang dbral ba ni/ slob dpon bdag nyid yang dag pa'i mtha'i stong pa nyid du byas la ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs te/ yi ge yi las hūṃ nag po las gshin rje gshed shin tu 'jigs pa'i cha byad can/ 'od zer kun nas 'bar bar bskyed / ka la bstan /phyepar byed pa'i sngags ru pa ya/ a ra badz+ra kro tra hūṃ phaṭa/47byed206

ces brjod par bya'o/ /de nas yang snying ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas rang gi snying ka'i sa bon las rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' bkug la 'og min nas mdun na khyebastems te/ byin gyis rlab yi ge 'bru gsum la lan gsum brjod pa dang / yang thugs ka'i hūṃgi'od zer las/ sangs rgyas grangs med pa bkug te/ bdag rang gi zhal du zhugs pa las/ zhe sdang 'dul ba'i pu ta de dag khrobor bstan par byed pa gyur nas mdun na phyira'aphros pas ro la 'khor ba'i ro bgegs dang bral bar byas gshin de bsang ②nas/dur khrod kyiganas su du bya/ be+er yang yi ge a las lhar skyed de/ dam la gdags par bya'o/ /de nas rnam par shes pa gtar bzung ba ni/ rus pa'am/ gos sam/ming byang la/ mi rus byas la rten byas la/ nor dang / drung po la sogs pa shes pa gang la chags pa yang byangabulabris la bcang bar bya'o/ /de nas khrus bya ba ni/ bum pa sngon po mgul chings dang ldan pa la/'brus can kyi kha rgyan dang / snying po lngal sogs pa khrus byas ldul/ byen gyis rlabs bum gang mos kyis ④cho ga la/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum 'di gsum 'jig rten dug gsum ste/ bcom ldan sangs rgyas dug mi mnga'/ /sangs rgyas gzi brjid dug bcom mo/ /chos dang dge 'dun yang des 'dra'o/ /la sogs pa gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis brjod cing / me long gi logs la khrus byas te/ ā+oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni bi sho dha ni/ sarba karma a ba ra ni—/ bi sho dha ni swā hā/ de'i stobs kyis bsam pa'i khyad par nyon mongs pa dang / bag chags kyi sgrib pa ma lus pa yang dag par byas nas/ sdig pa dag nas rnam par shes pa mar me lta bur gyur pa yin no/ /de nas kho rang la yi dam yod na lha bskyed pa ni cho ga gsum gyis lha yod na der 47—207

bskyed—/ med na nor bu dri ma med pa'i nga rgyal du mos pa dang /de nas tsamapar bya'o/ /dbang bskur ba ni dzin drangs mchod pa lnga phul la dbang bskur ba'i gsol ba gdab la dbang bskur bar bsam/ thob ①nas dkyil 'khor sne'ajug pa rdzogs par bya'o/ /〉stepar ma/6) sa bon las/ 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas grangs med pa spyan drangs la/ bud dha rnams kyi thugs ka nas phyag na rdo rje'i zhal du phyag na rdo rje'i thugs ka nas phyag na rdo rje'i thugs ka nas bston dze+el/ bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs pa'i lha mo drangs med pa bton la/ ro la gson po'i dus su dbang bskur na mos pas de bzhin du bya/ gson po'i dus su dbang ye ma rdzogs na/ dal bar 'jug rdzogs par bya'o/ /dbang bskur rdzogs par bya'o/ /de nas lam bstan pa ni/ oṃ pad me pad me/ pad me bha ba/ su kha bha ta/ ga tsa hūṃ swā hā/ de nas bde legs dang dkon mchog gnyis dang rig ④lnga'i dang bkra shis kyi tshig gis dus gsum du ni khrus bya'o/ /rang snying sa bon drongs su chu rang slug go/ /bskul ba yis/ /me tog char rnams skadacig bab pa dang / /yid 'ong bar snang lha bran tshogs/ /rol mo'i sgra yis brdungs tshe 'das de rnams bsdus nas song bar bsam te song / /gangasong na 'o/ga min gnas las bsam yang bsam dhil 'gro ba dag par 'gyur gsung ngo / /gzhan du min/ /bdun tshigs kyi 'di 'dra ba lan bdun zhag bdun gyi bar du bya'o/ /cho ga rdzogs so// //47—208

bsdur mchan/2༷6 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉rig /bdun tshigs kyi cho ga bzhugs so/ / ②〈〈pe 〉sngagashed/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〉zabadun pa ste/ ④〈〈pe 〉stanashed/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉bston/2༷7 ①〈〈pe 〉〉watshemadun na/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉bsad/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉skoXbyed du bcug pa/ du〈〈pe 〉nya)/2༷/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉thos/ ②〈〈pe 〉mi tshelas/ zhu〈〈pe 〉〉ston/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉rigs/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉bsams/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2649)47—209

༄ga /tsha tshwa'i cho ga①ra za/ /rgya gar skad du/ rten rus pa la rten nas tshogs khyad par can bsags pa'i phyir tsha tshwa ston te ṭī ta ba ti/ bod skad du/ tsha bo'i cho ga /rje btsun ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por sngags pas dngosapochos thams cad bdag med par stong nyid du bsgom la/ de nas stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can du yid la bya tshad med pa'i rnal 'byor du bya'o/ k+ta/de nas srog chags 'jimapa sbru ba dang mi gtsang ba spangs pa'i 'jim pa'i tshogs la/ dzan dang / gla rtsi dang / a ka ru dang / du ru ka dang /gur gum la sogs pa'i dri zhim pos bran pa dang / k+taskyes bu sbyang babadag nyid 'dod pa'i lha'i gangamos kyi nga rgyal gyis/ gnas te/ sarba ka ri hūṃ zhes pa'i sngags kyis/ skyon gyi rim pa sa mi gtsang ba la sogs pa rnam par dag par bsam zhing /k+ta sarba si byin gyis rlabs pa ti hūṃ zhes bya bas/ 'jim pa'i tshogs de dag kyang /ji ltar gser 'gyur gyi ④rtsi ltar/ rin po che'i rang bzhin gyi/47—210

gser dang / man shel dang / pad+ma ra ga dang / bai ḍūr+ya dang / in tra ni la'i rnam par bsgom mo/ /de nas ṣ+ṭagayon zhi gnas dang / g.yasalhag mthong gi lag pa gnyis kyis/ 'byi 'byi bya zhing brtab pa dang bzhugs su gsol ba 'byi 'byi bya zhing /sngags 'dis byin gyis rlab par bya'o/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dzin ta ma ṇa yī swā hā/ces bzlas shing / rinapocheskol phor yi ge khaṃ gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang du bcug la/ badz+ra mu 'dir ma bzhugs par don mdzod gcig pa'o/ /ces pas rdungs pa'i dus su sems can gyi don la skul zhing / dharma dha tu ga bha a/ ces pas skol phor nas phyung la/ sngags 'dis bzhugs su gsol bar bya ste/ ā+oṃ na mo shrī ①ya dha ⑤dhe—/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ tri da ya/ gar rbe dz+ra ④la/ ya ga ga ra/ rma sa/a yu saṃ sho dha ya oṃ/ sarba pā paṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya/ uk+ṇi ṣa/ bi ma la bi shud dhe/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ saṃ baṃ saṃ rdza swā hā/ zhes pa'i brjod pas sngags la sa 'od byung mchod pa phog pa las sam tis sngags kyi 'od zer gyis mchod rten skul bas/ mchod rten sa 'od zer 'phros pas la sangs rgyas kyi sku nyi zer gyi rdul dang / 'dra ba bcug nas slar de ltar mnyam pa las bzhengs pa'i tshul gyis sku ④/rnams byung nas/ 'od zer kha dog nyi shu rtsa lnga 'phros pas/ 'disus kyang mi 'gal bdag gi phung po la phog pas rnam par rtog pa ma lus pa'i tshogs sregs par bsam mo/ /de nas yang sngags 'dis kyang byar gtub sangs rgyas re res kyang / skal ba chen po'i bar du 'gro ba'i don mdzad par gsol ba btab pas/ rab tu gnas pa bya ste/ ye dharma he tu pra bha bā/ te tun te ṣan ta thā ga to/ h+ya ba dad te ṣanya tsa yo ni ro dha ste baṃ bā dhi ma hā shra ma ṇaḥzhes pa'i don la lhag par mos pas 'gro ba yongs su bdag gzhan gnyis ga'i don smin par mdzad pa yin no/ /bdag gis mchod rten bsdu zhing 'phro 47—211

ba'i budha de rnams la kyang skal pa chen po'i bar du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /tsha tshwa'i cho ga /slob dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis ①mdzad pa rdzogs so// //gsang ngo / /dge bshes sbyang nga bya yul ba'i/ rgya gar kyi mkhan po ti paṃ ka ra shri rnye na dang / bod kyi lo tsha ba gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis sgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o ski //ti paṃ ka ra'i sngags lugs bcu gsum pa'o/ /kun la yod na ngo mtshar che—/ bcu gsum ni/ sngags kyi don la 'jug pa/ dbang bskur ba/ dam tshig sbas pa/ gzhal yas khang sbyin pa/ chu gtor/ sbyin bsreg /lha mchod pa—/ tshe sgrub pa/ 'chi ba slu ba/ 'chi ka ma'i bstan chos/ ro bsreg pa/bdun tshigs/ tsha tshwa gdab pa dang bcu gsum mo/ /a ti sha'i sngags kyi/chos tshan bcu gsum 'di dag la/ /bdag gis mchan gtab pa'i bsod nams kyis—/ /myur du byang chub thob par shog/② sbi //47—212

bsdur mchan/21 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄7/ /tsha tshwa'i cho ga bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉mi gyi/211 ①〈〈pe 〉〉sde/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉da/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉mdza/ dhi〈〈pe 〉〉wasku/212 ①〈〈pe 〉〉kyi/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉 maṅgālo/ bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2650)47—213

༄ga /'phags ma lha mo sgol ma la bstod pa mu rtig phreng ba zhes bya ba/⑪ga lha mo sgrol ma la bstod pa mu tig 'phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya 3tā ra de bi stod tra gu lu ta ma la sa dha nā zhu ma/ bod skad du/'phags ma lha mo sgol ma la bstod pa mu tig 'phreng ba zhes bya ba/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig bdag la de nyid ster mdzad/ /'go mgon zhabs la spyi bos btud de/ /sgrib pa nyon mongs dri ma bsal phyir/ /lha mo mchog la bstod par bya'o/ /yi ge tai /pyalas skyes pa'i sku mchog /thugs rje nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od kyis/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skems par byed pa'i/ /sdug bsngal stongs par mdzad la phyag 'tsha'// /las kyi rnam par smin pa'i bud shing //ye shes me yi dpung gis bsreg nas/ /mchog gi dngos grub grub par mdzad ma//ris drug nyon mongs sel la phyag 'tshal/ /rdzu 'phrul thogs med nam mkha'i lus can/ /thugs rjes srid pa'i mtsho chen bsgral nas/ /'gro rnams thar 47—214

pa'i gling du khrid pa'i/ /ded dpon chen mo khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /bris pa'i sku la gsol ba btab pas/ /des kyang grub chen brgyad po 'thob 'gyur/ /gang la gang 'dod dngos grub ster ma/ /'dod rgu'i 'byung gnas khyod la phyag 'tshal—/ /lha rnams rgyab phyogs rig sngags sdus nas/ /khyod kyi sku gzugs spyi bor blangs nas/ /phrin las rnam bzhi grub pa'i rgyur 'gyur/ /mthu rtsal thog med khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /rna rgyan mgul rgyan longs sku'i cha byad/ /rin chen du mas spras pa'i do shal/ /dpung rgyan se mo do yis brgyan ma/ /dpal gyi 'od can khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /khyod la gus pa'i blo mchog skyes pa'i/ /mi de'i rna bar bla ma'i man ngag /tshig gcig song bar ma gyur kyang ni/ /stong nyid bde ba'i nyams kyi drod snyoms/ /shes rab mchog skyed ma la phyag 'tshal/ /khyod kyi gsung mchog brjod du med las/ /a li ka li rol pa'i sgra 'byung / /tud tā ra yis 'ur sgra chen pos/ /'phags lam bsgod pa khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /dha na ta ra phaṭa kyi yi ges/ /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms ma/ /gzhan gyis mi thub drag rtsal chen mo/ /mthu stobs ldan pa khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /lha dang klu dang dri za gnod sbyin/ /drang srong dang ni mkha' 'gro'i dmod sngags//byad stems la sogs pha rol 'khrul 'khor/ /'joms par mdzad ma khyod la phyag 'tshal—/ /swā hās drod kyi skye gnas bshig nas/ /tū lu snu lus mngal gyi kha 'gogasgo nga'i skye gnas oṃ gyis 'joms ma/ /tā res brdzus skyes sel la phyag 'tshal/ /stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can gyis/ /nang nyams phyi ru shar ba'i gzi mdangs—/ /dpal gyi 'od zer shes rab 'bar ma/ /ma rig mun sel khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i 'od kyis/ /bar chad bdud kyi 47—215

mda' lnga bsreg nas/ /sgrub pa rkyen gyi khar mi gtong ma/ /byang chub lam dgra sel la phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi phrin las bdag mo/ /sku gsung thugs dang rdzu 'phrul kun 'gro/ /stobs bcu ma lus pha rol phyin ma/ /dbang phyug brgyad ldan khrod la phyag 'tshal/ /sku yi rang bzhin shes bya'i dkyil 'khor/ /spros pa dang bral nam mkha'i rang bzhin/ /chos kyi sku la gzugs sku rnam gnyis//sna tshogs du mar sprul la phyag 'tshal/ /a li ka li chos kyi ghan dhe/ /gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs kyis/ /tshogs drug yul la rang bzhin med pa'i / /stong pa'i sgra sgrog khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /'byor pa bral nas gzhan gyi sgo rtsar—/ /rdza chag dum bur zas skom slong ba'i/ /mi des khyod kyi bsngags pa brjod na/ /rgyal srid ster mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /ri mo'i gzugs kyis a li ka lis/ /brgyan pa'i yang dag don gyi glegs bam/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i bdag nyid/ /ar+ya ta ra khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /gti mug sgrol ba'i shes rab ral gris—/ /nyon mongs mi shes 'khor ba'i g.yul bzlog /rmongs pa'i ma rig mun rum 'thug po/ /sel mdzad sgol ma khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /pad+ma dang ni zla ba'i gdan la/ /g.yas brkyang ba la g.yon pa bskum pa'i/ /zhabs kyi mthil la pad+ma'i 'dab ma/ /stong dang ldan pa khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun kyi yum du/ /mtshon pa'i ud pal ①che'u legs ldan/ /phyag na 'khor lo rtsibs ma stong tshang / /mtshan mchog ldan pa khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /khams gsum spong byed bsam gtan rdzogs pas/ /'ching ba'i thag pa mtha' dag gcad de/ /srid gsum 'dam gyis gos pa med ma/ /'khor ba las sgrol khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /'khor los sgyur ba rgyal po'i cha lugs/ /rin chen bye brag 47—216

du mas spras pa'i/ /dbu skra 'thon 'thing lcang lor 'khyil ba'i/ /mi bskyod pas brgyan khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /gang gis sgrol ma'i sku yi gzugs brnyan/ /mthong ba la ni mos gus skyes pa/ /dran pa tsam gyis ngan song sdug bsngal/ /ma lus sel mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /swā hā oṃ gyi phreng ba 'khor bas/ /sngags kyi nus pa nor bu sman ltar/ /rten 'byel sna tshogs 'char bar byed pa'i//phrin las 'byung gnas khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan rdzogs pas/ /smon 'jug mthar phyin 'gro ba'i don la/ /brtson 'grus myur mgyogs glog dang 'dra ma/ /le lo tshar gcod khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /bag chags dang ni las la grol nas/ /skye sgo bzhi chod yangs srid med pas/ /'khrul med yon tan pha rol phyin ma/ /sngon sbyangs mya ngan 'das la phyag 'tshal//bud med sgol ma'i ming can de la/ /mos pa skyes nas gus phyag 'tshal na/ /de yis bsod nams sangs rgyas rgyur 'gyur/ /mthong thos don yod khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /nags tshal e ran ta'i gseb tu/ /tsan dan sa mchog skyes pa bzhin du/ /'gro ba'i don mdzad lha rnams nang na/ /khyad du 'phags pa khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /mi 'jigs rnam pa bzhi po brnyes nas/ /bdag med seṅge'i sgra chen bsgrags pas/ /'jig tshogs lta ba drug cu rtsa gnyis/ /'joms par mdzad ma khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /rgyu skar tshogs nang nyi zla bzhin du/ /che ba rnams kyis nang nas khyad par/ /'phags pa ri rab lhun po lta bu/ /'gran zla med pa khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /bzhin bzang lam du zhugs pa'i dus der/ /khrod la gsol ba btab nas phyin na/ /dgra rkun nyes pa mtha' dag mi 'byung / /skyabs gnas bzang mo khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /yud tsam mos pa byas pa des ni/ /47—217

'bras bu ci bsam 'grub pa'i rgyur 'gyur/ /'dod pa'i re ba skong bar mdzad ma—/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra byed la phyag 'tshal/ /'gro ba pa'i 'du byed gtong ba'i—/ /dus der mtshan mchog ta ra thos pas/ /des ni srid pa hrul por byed 'gyur/ /'khor ba dag par mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /'gro mgon byed la bskyabs pa'i mi de/ /gnyen bshes rnams kyis spang bar ①gyur kyang / /ya rabs gong ma rnams kyis khur 'gyur/ /snang ba khul bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /hu lu hu lu ta ra zhes pa'i/ /tshig de brjod pa tsam gyis kyang ni/ /mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su skye 'gyur/ /ngo mtshar bla na med la phyag 'tshal/ /gang gis mu tig phreng ba'i bstod pa/ /'di brjod yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab/ /sbyar dug la sogs 'khrul 'khor mi tshugs/ /'jigs pa ma lus kun las skyob gyur/ /dud 'gro'i rna bar thos pas kyang ni/ /bsod nams de yis bde 'go'i lus 'thob—/ /'khor lo bsgyur rgyal bran bzhin bka' nyan/ /ci bsam pa ni rtag tu 'grub 'gyur/ /lan grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod na/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams phyir sol/ /'di ni 'du ba 'joms pa'i sman yin/ /rgyal po'i chad pa las ni grol 'gyur/ /rgyud la yon tan sna tshogs 'char zhing / /de yi nyams len rkyen khar mi 'chor/ /byang chub lam nas lam mtha' mi ldog /de yi bsgrub pa mtha' ru phyin 'gyur/ /dri ma med pa'i snying po'i don mchog /bton pas rgyud la skye bar byed de/ /ting nge rjo'adzin stong phrag brgyad cu'i sgo 'byed—/ /srid pa'i dra ba bcom nas 'tshang rgya/ /lha mo khyod la mu tig phreng bas/ /bstod pa'i bsod nams zla ba rgyas 'dra/ /'gro rnams snying gi mun pa sel nas/ /ye shes snang ba shar bar shog cig /mu tig phreng ba'i bstod pa zhes bya ba/47—218

'phags ma lasgrol ma la rig pa'i gnas rnam pa lnga la ma rmongs pa snyan ngag mkhan po rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu lta bu/ slob dpon chen po tsan tra go mi 'am 'chi med zla ba zhes bya bas bstod pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po ti paṃ ka ra shrī dzha na'i zhal snga nas bod kyi ban dhe sgra bsgyur gyi ②lots+tsha ba nag tso tshul khrims rgyal bas bi ka ma la shī la'i gtsug lag khang du bsgyur zhing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //bsdur mchan/214 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉thir+ya/ ①〈〈pe 〉ra/0〈〈pe〉〉neyig216 ①〈〈pe 〉skoskuprel/ ('di'i 'og gi ud pal zhes pa rnams 〈〈pe 〉〉pa ut+pal zhes 'khod kyang bsdur mchan du bkod med/)217 7〈〈pe 〉gsungs par/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉wange /218 ①〈〈pe 〉〉sga ②〈〈pe 〉〉wagyi/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2651)47—219

༄ga /'phags ma lha mo sgol ma'i bstod pa/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ar+ya de bi ta ra stod tra/ bod skad du/'phags ma lha mo sgol ma'i bstod pa/ lha mo sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bzlog dka' srid pa'i mun pa ni/ /'joms mdzad nyi ma'i 'od dang mtshungs/ /thugs rjes brlan pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ /sgol ma la ni rtag tu 'dud/ /shin tu rno ba'i sems can gyi/ /glang po che rnams gsod byed pa'i/ /lha mos seng ge 'khros pa rnams/ /mthong ba la ni 'jigs shing 'bros/ /mche ba mdung rtse rtse mo yis/ /brag 'joms shing drung rtsa ba 'don/ /khyod kyi sngags 'di bzlas pa las/ /'jigs shing glang po 'bros par 'gyur/ /phyogs dang nam mkha' ma lus pa/ /'dul bas khyab cing bzod par dka'/ /'bar ba yis ni khri tshig la/ /khyod bstod char pa me zhi 'gyur/ /ma lus gdengs ka las byung ba/ /phud sgra sgogs shing dug ma can/ /sbrul ni lha mo khyod bstod pas/ /nam 47—220

mkha' lding gi byin du 'jigs/ /ral gris gcod pa grol la rnams/ /khrag gi yan lag bskus pa ste/ /khyod kyi mtshan tsam thos pa yis/ /chom rkun nus pa med par 'gyur/ /rgyal po 'khros pa'i bran rnams kyis/ /skra nas bzung zhing zhags pas bcings/ /btson ra spangs te lha mo kye/ /khyod la bstod byed 'jigs med 'gyur/ /dba' rlabs tshogs kyis phyogs bcu dang / /nam mkha' yang ni khyab byed pa/ /gru log nas ni rgya mtsho nas/ /khyod kyi 'bangs ni pha rol phyin/ /khrag dang glad pa 'dam gyis byugs/ /de dag bza' ba la chags pa/ /lha mo khyod kyi sngags bzlas pas/ /sha za de dag 'jigs par 'gyur—/ /yan lag chad cing dri nga ba'i/ /khrag dang snag ni sna nas 'dzag /khyod la 'dus pa tsam gyis ni/ /mdze bo 'dod khams lha 'drar 'gyur/ /bkres skom gyis gdung gcer bu dang / /slong ba yi dwags dang 'dra ba/ /khyod la btud pa tsam gyis ni/ /'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur/ /'jigs pa chen po 'jigs byed pa/ /de ltar dag pa khyod bstod pas/ /dge ba gang bsags de yis ni/ /'jig rten bde ba thob par shog /lha mo sgrol ma la bstod pa slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //slob dpon gyis sgol ma'i shing sku de la bstod pas phyag 'dzub ke re mdzad skadaske/ de ltar mdzad pa ci lags zhus pas/ khyod kyi bstod pa de snyan gsungs te sgrol ma 'dzub ker du grags so// //47—221

༄sa /'phags ma sgol ma la bstod pa smon lam grub pa zhes bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ta ra stod tra pra ni dha na na ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags ma sgol ma la bstod pa smon lam grub pa zhes bya ba/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yi ge ljang ku ud pal las byung ba'i/ /sku mdog ljang ku zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /phyag gnyis sku la rin chen du mas spras/ /yi dam sgol ma khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /don grub la sogs rigs lngas dbu brgyan cing / /bcu drug na tshod 'dzum pa'i bzhin dang ldan/ /gzi brjid bzod dka' dgra tshogs rtag par 'dul/ /yi dam sgrol ma khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyag g.yas mchod sbyin phyag g.yon ud pal 'dzin/ /sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ /g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum tshul gyis rab tu bzhugs/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la rtag tu gzigs—/ /sku la 'jigs pa brgyad skyob sgol ma 'phro/ /'khor ba'i sdug 47—223

bsngal kun nas ①sgol mdzad pa'i/ /yi dam sgrol ma khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang drag po dang / /sna tshogs las rnams myur du sgrub mdzad cing / /phrin las rgya mtsho myur du bsgrub mdzad pa'i/ /yi dam sgol ma khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /seng ge glang chen me sbrul chom rkun dang / /lcags sgog rgya mtsho sha za'i 'jigs pa brgyad/ /de dag kun las yongs su sgol mdzad pa'i/ /yi dam sgrol ma khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /skye ba sngon bsags las dang nyon mongs dang / /'tshams med lnga dang mi dge bcu la sogs/ /mi bzad sdig pa'i las rnams ci bgyis pa/ /de dag thams cad ma lus byang bar shog /bdag la de lta'i skye ba 'di las kyang / /rmi ngan ltas ngan dus min 'chi dang dgra/ /bkra mi shis pa thams cad byang gyur cig /tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod rgyas par shog /bdag ni ma 'ongs skye ba thams cad du//yi dam sgol ma rjes su dran gyur nas/ /mchog dang thun mong ④dngos grub thams cad dang / /bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin 'grub 'gyur cing / /phrin las ma lus kun la dbang bsgyur shog /yi dam sgrol ma thugs rje ldan pa la/ /bdag ni rab tu brtson pa'i gdung sems kyis/ /bstod pa bgyis pa'i bsod nams gang bsags des/ /rje btsun sgol ma spyod dang mi 'bral shog /rje btsun ma sgol ma la bstod pa smon lam thams cad rab tu grub pa zhes bya ba/ slob dpon chen po tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa'o// //47—224

bsdur mchan/222 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ga /'phags ma sgrol ma la bstod pa smon lam grub pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so//224 ①〈〈pe 〉〉pas ②〈〈pe 〉stabangs/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2653)47—225

༄ga /bcom ldan 'das 'phags ma sgol ma la bstod pa zhes bya ba/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ bha ga wa ti ar+ya ta ra sto tra na ma/ bod skad du/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags ma sgol ma la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi phrin las gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid rje btsun ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i yum gyur sgol ma nyid la/ /rgyal dang mkhas rnams kun kyis bstod mod/ /bdag kyang de rjes 'jug par 'dod pas/ /lha mo khyod la bstod par bgyi'o/ /chos kun gshis lugs stong pa'i ngang las/ /'khor ba'i skyon spangs 'dab brgyad gdan dang / /byang chub sems rgyas ku mud gdan steng / /tai yig las 'khrungs ma la phyag 'tshal/ /sku mdog rab mjes mar gad mdangs ldan/ /bcu drug lo lon gzhon nu'i lus can/ /'gying ldem sgeg pa'i rnam 'gyur dang ldan/ /sku mdog yongs rdzogs ma la phyag 'tshal / /yon tan cha shas ma lus rdzogs phyir/ /zla rgyas zhal la bzhi bcu'i 47—226

chems dang / /bden gnyis gzigs pa'i spyan gnyis dkyus ring / /mtshan bzang mnga' ba ma la phyag 'tshal/ /bung ba ltar gnag ral pa'i thor tshugs/ /lha mo sel bus sku stod mjos byas/ /zhal ras bim pa'i kha dog gis mdzes/ /dpe byad ldan pa ma la phyag 'tshal/ /phyag gnyis g.yas pas 'gro la mchog sbyin//g.yon pas thugs khar ud pal legs bsnams/ /zhabs gnyis g.yas brkyang g.yon skum ①tshul gyis/ /'gro ba'i don bzhugs ma la phyag 'tshal/ /lta bas mi ngom mig gi bdud rtsi/ /khyod sku nyid kyis khyod nyid mdzes na/ /dar dang rin chen rgyan gzhan ci dgos/ /rang bzhin rgyan ldan ma la phyag 'tshal/ /rin chen rtse bran rnams las dbu brgyan/ /do shal phyag gdub zhabs gdub sil khrol/ /lha mi'i dar chen na bza' lhab lhub/ /mdzes byed rgyan ldan ma la phyag 'tshal/ /sngon tshe byang chub spyad pa spyod dus/ /mthong thos dran reg gyur pa kun kyang / /go 'phang mchog thob gyur cig ces pa'i/ /smon lam mthar phyin ma la phyag 'tshal/ /'jig rten 'di na che ba'i che mchog /dga' ba'i bdag po lha chen gtsug gis/ /khyod zhabs cod pan bzhin du gus mnos/ /lha yi lhar gyur ma la phyag 'tshal/ /khyod sku'i cha shas dbang po'i gzhu bzhin/ /gsal la ma 'dres so sor snang yang / /rang bzhin dbe+en pa'i dngos po dang 'brelaske/ /snang stong dbyer med ma la phyag 'tshal/ /dri za'i glu bzhin snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis/ /gang la gang 'dul chos char phab kyang / /'gro 'ong gnas gsum ngo bo dang bral/ /grags stong dbyer med ma la phyag 'tshal/ /ji lta ji snyed gshegs pa'i chos kun/ /ma 'dres ma 'khrug mngon sum mkhyen kyang //shes dang shes bya'i mtshan ma dang bral/ /rig stong dbyer med ma la phyag 'tshal//47—227

mthong na dga' dang 'byor ldan smon bzhin/ /mgon khyod mthong dang thos pa tsam kyis/ /mi mthun rkyen zhi mthun pa'i dpal ster/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra ma la phyag 'tshal/ /sbrul gyi dug la ma ki'i rtsi bzhin/ /dgra dang chom rkun rgyal po'i chad sogs/ /dran pa tsam gyis rab du zhi mdzad/ /'jigs pa brgyad skyobs ma la phyag 'tshal/ /gang gis chos kun chub par 'dod kyang / /gti mug mun pas blo mig mdongs rnams/ /khyod la cung zad gsol ba tsam kyis/ /shes rab mchog rtsol ma la phyag 'tshal/ /sgrib gnyis dgra las rgyal bar 'dod pa'i/ /mi des khyod la dpung gnyen bcas nas/ /mun pa'i tshogs la nyi ma'i 'od bzhin/ /ma rig mun sel ma la phyag 'tshal/ /nam mkha'i khron dang khrod kyi mkhyen pa'i/ /rgyal dang rgyal ba rgya mtshor bcas pas/ /tshad kyang bzung bar ma nus zhes grags/ /mkhyen rabs mtha' yas ma la phyag 'tshal/ /chu yi rgyun kyang dus kyis chad 'gyur//khyod kyi brtse ba'i thugs rje'i chu rgyun/ /'khor ba srid du rgyun mi 'chad pa'i/ /thugs rje'i mnga' bdag ma la phyag 'tshal/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong nyon mongs g.yul ngo / /dpa' mo khyod nyid gcig pus bzlog par/ /nus pa'i mthu dpung bsam mi khyab pa/ /skyob pa'i nus mthu bsam gyis mi khyab/ /rgya mtsho'i rlabs kyang dus la yol srid/ /dpal khyod gdul bya 'dul ba'i dus la/ /skad gcig tsam yang yol ba mi mnga'/ /phrin las myur mgyogs ma la phyag 'tshal/ /rang gzhan don bya'i kun rtog bral yang / /yid bzhin nor dang dpag bsam shing bzhin—/ /so so'i skal dang 'tsham par don rangagazhan gnyis/ /'bad med lhun grub ma la phyag 'tshal/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig phyag 'tshal mchog 'dis/ /thugs rje mnga' ba rje btsun ma la/ /mi phyed dad pas rgyun du bstod na/ /mchog gi dngos 47—228

grub thob par gyur cig /ye shes kyi lha mo sgyu 'phrul chen mo la/ shākya'i dge slong dad byed go cha rin chen zhes bya bas bstod pa rdzogs so// //lots+tsha ba rig pa'i khu byug gis bsgyur zhing legs par gtan la phab pa'o// //bsdur mchan/226 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ga /shākya'i dge slong dad byed go cha rin chen gyis 'phags ma sgrol ma la bstod pa bzhugs so//227 7〈〈pe 〉〉bskum/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2654)47—229

༄khya/ /'phags ma sgol ma 'jogs pa chen po brgyad las sgol ba'i bstod pa/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ar+ya ta ra ma hā aṣ+ṭa bha yod ta re sta ba/bod skad du/ 'phags ma sgrol ma 'jigs pa chen po brgyad las sgol ba'i bstod pa/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod zhabs lha dang lha min ma lus phyag byas shing / /thugs rjes ngan 'gror 'gro ba'i sems can rnams la gzigs/ /mi mthun spangs pa'i sgrol ma khyod la ni/ /zla ba sbas pa zhes bya bdag gis bstod par bgyi/ /glang po bsad pa'i khrag gis rkang lag dmar gyur cing / /lam du zhugs pa mthong nas rnam par gnon byed pa'i//seṅge lam du khrod dran pas ni bgrod dka' ba'i/ /nags tshal shin tu rab tu stug por 'jug par 'gyur/ /bar med myos chus dri ma can gyi khur tshos la/ /bung ba lding ba zar zing tshogs kyi sgras g.yos pa/ /yud tsam mi sdod gsod pa'i lam du ni/ /sgol khyod la btud bcom par byas par 'gyur/ /'jig dus 47—230

rlung stobs che bas sbar ba yi/ /gnam ltar rgya che rab tu 'bar ba'i me/ /grong khyer 'ga' zhig gal te khrod kyi ming / /brjod byed de mod nye bar zhi bar 'gyur—/ /'khrig cing 'dags pa can gyi ri sul ljongs/ /lam zhugs mthong nas lam du rgyug pa yis/ /sbrul stobs che ba sgol ma dran pa yis/ /dreg pa slar bcom phyir yang bzlog par byed/ /chom rkun mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa yis—/ /lam zhugs mthong nas rnam par gnon pa yang / /sgrol ma'i zhabs ni dran pa'i stobs kyis su/ /yun mi ring bar bde bar khyim du 'gro/ /nyin re brnyes nas smon byed la mkhas pa'i/ /sa yi bdag pos btson rar bcings pa yang / /khong sgril mi bzad sgol ma'i zhabs dran pas/ /skad cig gis ni dum bu brgya ru 'gyur/ /gyen du 'khrug pas tshangs gnas tsam 'phags shing / /nya dang chu srin 'jigs skrag byed pa'i lus/ /rgya mapa'i dbus su gzings zhig gyur pa yang / /sgrol ma dran pas mi 'jigs pa nyid 'thob/ /lus ni mig sman dang 'dra skra ser skya/ /skams shing lhogs la lhag par rgyus pas 'byel①/ /mi gsod byed pa la ni dga' ba yi/ /ro langs byed zhabs dran pas bcom par 'gyur—/ /de ltar 'jigs pa brgyad las sgol ba yi/ /bdud las rgyal ma dran pa'i bsod nams ni/ /gang zhig 'di ru bdag gi thob pa des/ /'jig rten mtha' dag ma lus rig par shog /'phags ma sgrol ma 'jigs pa chen po brgyad las sgol ba'i bstod pa/ slob dpon dpal btsun zla ba'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //47—231

bsdur mchan/23༷ lamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ga /'phags ma sgrol ma 'jigs pa chen po brgyad las sgrol ba'i bstod pa bzhugs so//231 ①〈〈pe 〉torabrel/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2655)47—232

ras /'phags ma sgol ma la bstod pa/①kho 'phags ma sgol ma la bstod pa ②bzhugs so// ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ar+ya ta ra stod tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags ma sgrol ma la bstod pa/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten gsum mgon yum gyur spyan yangs ma/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yum/ /gnyis med ye shes ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /thugs rje'i dbang gi 'gro don sna tshogs mdzad/ /byams pa'i yum gyur khyod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sku mdog ljang ku 'phrin las sna tshogs mdzad/ /yon tan rab rgyas bcu drug lon pa'i tshul—/ /'gro la rab dgyes zhal ni 'dzum pa dang / /zhi ba'i spyan gyis 'jig rten gsum la gzigs/ /thugs rje che mnga' khrod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /byang sems rang bzhin zla ba gdan du bting / /nyon mongs mi bskyod rdo rje'i skyil krungs ①bcas/ /sgrib pa kun spangs pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /zag 47—233

med bde rgyas zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ /zag med bde ba che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na bza' mchog dang rin chen du mas spras/ /phyag g.yas mchod sbyin sgrub la dngos grub sbyin/ /g.yon pas ud pal skyon bral dag pa'i rtags①/ /phyag gnyis thabs dang shes rab zung du 'brel/ /mtha' bral zung 'jug sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lus ngag yid kyis khyod la phyag byas pas/ /lta ba dman dang sgrub mchod dman pa dang / /nyon mongs dbang gyur dam tshig nyams pa dag /khyed la bzod gsol thugs rjes gzung du gsol/ /yon tan mtha' yas mtshan kyis brgyan pa'i sku/ /khyed la dga' bas rdul tsam bstod pa'isde/ /khyod kyis ①zhal ni rtag tu mthong ba dang / /yang dag lam mchog gdam ngag bstan pa'ibu/ /mtho ris thar pa'i lam mchog bdag la gsol/ /byams pa'i yum gyur bdag la dgongs nas kyang / /bdag cag 'khor bcas bsrung zhing bskyab pa dang / /tshe 'di'i rkyen rnams spyod kyis bzlog pa dang / /phyi mar ngan song sgo rnams bcad pa dang / /bdag gi dge blo khyed kyis rgyas par mdzod/ /'phags ma sgrol ma la bstod pa slob dpon mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //kha che'i mkhan po bhud ta ka ra bar ma dang / lo tsa ba dge slong chos kyi ye shes kyis bsgyur zhing zhus pa'o// //47—234

bsdur mchan/232 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〉slob dpon mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad pa/ ②〈〈pe 〉stanakyil dkrungs/234 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〉ga ②〈〈pe 〉〉〉mthus/ ③〈〈pe 〉nya)/ du〈〈pe 〉〉 thogabasdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2656)47—235

༄ga /'phags ma sgrol ma la bstod pa/①༄/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la bstod pa bzhugs so/ /༄༅༅—/ /rgya gar skad du/ ar+ya ta ra stod tra/ bod skad du/'phags ma sgol ma la bstod pa/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo—/ /rig pa las skyes dbyings na bzhugs/ /spros med rtog bral bde ba che//rnam dag don dam byang chub sems/ /sgol ma chos sku phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhon nu'i tshul ldan mdzes pa'i sku/ /kha dog mchog ldan brjid pa'i zhal/ /lha mo'i dkyil 'khor dbus na bzhugs/ /sgrol ma longs spyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs kyi gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /yang dag rig pa'i gzugs 'phro ma/ /'gro drug sems can sgol mdzad ma/ /sgol ma sprul sku phyag 'tshal lo log rtog ma rig gnyid spangs nas/ /thugs mchog shes bya kun la khyab/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas mchod brnyes/ /sgrol ma sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal lo/ /47—236

bde chen zhi ba mya ngan 'das/ /dam pa'i chos mchog ye shes bcu/ /pha rol phyin pa bcu ston ma/ /dam chos sgol ma phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum bder gshegs thams cad kyis/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs grub ma/ /'dus pa'i ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /sgrol ma dge 'dun phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal zhi 'dod pas/ /khams gsum po la rjes su chags/ /ma ltar brtse ba'i lha mo'i gzugs/ /'dod chags sgrol ma khyod phyag 'tshal/ /srid pa'i rang bzhin dag par mkhyen/ /khams gsum po la chags mi mnga'/ /rgyal ba bskyed mdzad yum gyi sku/ /chags bral sgol ma khyod phyag 'tshal/ /thabs dang shes rab mnyam sbyor bas/ /srid dang zhi la mi gnas pa/ /'dod chags ma yin chags bral min/ /mi gnas sgol ma khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /gti mug mdongs pa'i sems can gyi/ /ma rig mun pa sel mdzad ma/ /bde gshegs sgrol ma khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas kun kyis yon tan tshogs/ /khengs pa zil gnon sems can gyi/ /nga rgyal ri bo 'joms mdzad ma/ /rin chen sgol ma khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dri med gsungs/ /'dod chags kyis gdungs sems can gyi/ /srid pa'i gdung ba sel mdzad ma/ /pad+ma'i sgol ma khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mdzad pa mchog /phrag dog gis bsnun sems can gyi/ /phrag dog zug rngu 'byin mdzad ma/ /'phrin las sgol ma khrod phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis ①rdo rje'i sku/ /khong khro bcom pa'i sems can gyi/ /zhe sdang mtshon cha gcod mdzad ma/ /rdo rje sgol ma khyod phyag 'tshal/ /gzugs brnyan lta bu'i sku 'dzin ma—/ /phra dang rags pa'i gzugs dang bral/ /mtshan dang dpe byad rnam par 47—237

spras / /rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sgra brnyan lta bu'i gsungs brjod pa①//brjod dang yi ge rnam par spangs/ /tshig dang ngag gi lam las 'das/ /rdo rje'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rmi lam lta bu'i thugs mnga' ma/ /dngos dang dngos med sogs mi mthong / /rtag dang chad pa sogs mi shes/ /rdo rje'i thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdul bral mkha' khyab sgol ma la/ /phyag bya phyag byed mi dmigs par/ /yan lag med cing lus med pa'i/ /gzugs med rdo rje'i lus kyis 'dud/ /rtog med spros bral sgrol ma la/ /bstod bya bstod byed mi dmigs par / /sgra dang brjod pa rnam bral ba'i/ /brjod med rdo rje'i tshig gis bstod//tshor bral dmigs med sgol ma la/ /bsam bya bsam byed mi dmigs par/ /'dzin pa med cing rig bral ba'i/ /rdo rje sems kyis rab tu 'dud/ /slob dpon a khyo bh+ya badz+ras mdzad pa'o// //47—238

bsdur mchan/236 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉rim/ ②〈〈pe 〉skosgob dpon ak+ṣi rgya badz+ras mdzad pa/237 0)〈〈pe 〉4)/238 ①〈〈pe 〉stanasung brjod ma/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2657)47—239

༄ga /dam tshig sgol ma la bstod pa/sti༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ sa ma ya ta ra s+t+waṃ ba/ bod skad du/ dam tshig sgol ma la bstod pa/ srid pa sgol mdzad sgol ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid pa'i yum ni khyod lags sdug bsngal med par mdzod/ /byang chub 'gro bar 'dod pas gtso mo khyod bsten to/ /sdug bsngal ldan pa bdag la thugs rjes bskyab tu gsol/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'bras bu bdag la grub par mdzod/ /byang chub lam mchog khyod la brten nas thob 'gyur ba/ /nyon mongs mi bzad dgra'i me rnams 'bar ba la/ /ye shes char gyis rgyun gyis bsil bar mdzad du gsol—/ /'jig rten gsum na dbyings kyi sems can ma lus pa/ /sgol ma khyod ni rlung lha'i ngo bo'am bdag nyid de/ /yon tan yid bzhin nor bu rin chen sgu 'dra ba/ /sems can 'jigs par lhung nas bying ba bskyab par mdzod/ /khyod kyis dgra rnams ma lus myur du bsal bar mdzod/ /klu'i dug ni khyung gis 47—240

bcom nas zhi ba ltar/ /khyod kyis dpal ldan sku mchog gang gis mthong gyur na//sdig pa kun bcom bsod nams dpag med thob par 'gyur/ /don grub khrod mthong grub pa rnams ni 'grub 'gyur zhing / /thugs rje'i bdag nyid sems can thams cad sgol mdzad pa/ /khrod kyis byin brlabs bka' drin bdag la 'byung 'gyur ba/ /blo ngan bsod nams chung ba bdag ni gzung du gsol/ /rtag tu bdag gi khyod kyi gzugs ni g.yar dam bsgom/ /sa gzhi 'dra bar byams pas 'bras bu smin mdzad ma/ /kye ma'o rtag tu bdag ni sdug bsngal gzhir gyur te/ /ma bzhin phan pas dngos grub 'bras bu cis mi gsol/ /lha mo khyod kyis 'gro ba ma lus bde bar mdzod/ /dman pa'i sems kyis srid pa'i rgya mtshor lhung gyur pa/ /de dag skyab med gyur te shin tu sems gdung la/ /gtso mo khyod kyis 'gro ba yang nas yang du bsgral/ /zhi bar gyur pa'i gzugs can khyod ni thugs rje'i bdag /zhal ni nyi ma'i 'od bas shin tu khyab ①par gsal—/ /sdig pa'i gti mug shin tu mi bzad 'joms mdzad pa/ /sgrol ma dam tshig sgol mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /tshangs pa ru tra la sogs rtag tu phyag 'tshal zhing / /rin chen sna tshogs rnams kyis mdzes par spras gyur pa'i//dbu'i rgyan rnams khyod kyi zhabs ni brgyan gyur te/ /dang ba'i sems kyis rab tu bstod de 'dud par byed/ /mtho ris lha rnams thong bas shin tu 'jigs par skrag /de bas sems ni shin tu dang bas dad pa skyes/ /'phags ma sgrol ma khyod kyis de phyir skyab grol mdzod/ /bskul ba thugs rjes ②skyes nas gsung gi mi 'jigs sbyin/ /lha rnams 'khor bcas yang ni sems ni dad pa skyes/ /man dha ra ba in tra ni la'i 'phreng ba sogs/ /pad ma lta bu'i zhabs la lha 47—241

rnams mchod ①mchog mchod⑤/ /sna tshogs mchod pas mchod de khyod la bstod phyag 'tshal/ /mchod pa mchog gis lha rnams khyod la mchod byed pa/ /bsod nams 'bras bu rang gi thob par bya ba'i phyir/ /mchod pa dgyes dang mi dgyes khyod la mi mnga' yang / /thugs rje'i bdag nyid ldan pas lha rnams gzung bar mdzod—/ /sngon tshe mi zhig mtshan mo don gnyer lam 'gro ba/ /don sar ma phyin lam na dgra dang phrad pa la/ /shin tu 'jigs skrag sngangs te sgol ma rjes su dran/ /byin kyis rlabs ④kyis dgra de bran bzhin dbang du bsdud/ /sngon tshe mi zhig nags dkyil glang chen phrad/ /glang chen 'khros nas mche bas rab tu bzung ba las/ /ha ha zhes smras ngu 'bod sgrol ma sgrol mdzad bosarjo/ /de ma thag tu gtso mos glang chen 'jigs pa rjobaskyab/ /sngon tshe mi zhig dogs med khyem na nyal ba na/ /dgra chen gdug pas de'i khyim la me btang nas/ /skrag cing sngangs te langs nas sgol ma sgrol mdzad bos⑥/ /de ma thag tu char kyi rgyun gyis me 'bar zhi/ /sngon tshe smad 'tshong mdzes ma rol phyir nags tshal phyin/ /langs te a sho ka'i yal ga gzung ba la/ /yal ga'i rtsa na sbrul nag 'khros pas de la bzung / /sgrol ma dran pa tsam gyis sbrul gdug rab tu zhi/ /sngon tshe tshong dpon nor ldan don gnyer lam 'gro ba/ /grong khyer ma slebs lam du mi rgod phrad pa las/ /de'i 'jigs pas yum chen sgrol ma rjes su dran/ /byin gyis brlabs kyis dgra rnams bran bzhin dbang du bsdus/ /sngon tshe mi zhig 'phongs nas rkun mar song ba las/ /mdzod khang nang du phyin nas rgyal po'i nyul mas bzung / /khyer nas btson khang nang du lcags sgog mang pos bcings/ /skrag ste sgol ma dran pas bcings pa'i sdug bsngal bral/ /sngon tshe 'phags pa'i dge 47—242

bsnyen tsan tra go mi des/ /'khor bcas rgya mtshor grur zhugs gru de lam du zhig/sgol ma dran te thal mo sbyar te rjes su bstod/ /byin rlabs mngon du zhal bstan chu las gling du chags/ /rgyal po gcig ni 'chags khang nang du nub mo phyin/ /skabs su bgegs kyis gdug pas de la bzung ba las/ /shin tu 'jigs skrag sngangs pas sgrol ma rjes su dran/ /gtso mo khrod kyis bsrungs pas 'byung po'i 'jigs pa bral/ /'jigs pa chen po brgyad ni de ltar med par mdzad/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid sgol ma khyed kyis yud tsam gyis/ /srid gsum ma lus sems can rnams ni 'jigs med mdzad/ /bdag ni shin tu 'jigs skrag gtso mo khyod la skyabs su mchi/ /'jig rten sems can khyod kyis mtshan tsam sus thos pa/ /thos pa tsam gyis sdig pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms par mdzad/ /bdag gis dad pas nang nub khyod bsngags rjes su dran/ /sdug bsngal bdag ldan gtso mo khyod kyis bsgral bar mdzod/ /kye ma ho bdag ni khrod kyis bsgrub par dka' ba ste/ /nang nub khyod kyi sngags ni bzlas brjod brtson par bgyis/ /bdag ni sdig ldan de phyir khrod ni grub ma gyur/ /'jigs sems ldan pa bdag la lha mos dngos grub gsol/ /ma rungs sems can rmongs pas dge spyod mi dran pa/ /gti mug drag pos bsgrib pas lam mchog ma mthong ste/ /bsod nams chung bas bdag ni sdig pa'i g.yang sar thong / /sdug bsngal 'joms mdzad sgol ma khyod la skyabs su mchi/ /dgra dang glang po che dang me dang sbrul dang ni/ /chom pos bcings pa chu dang 'byung po'i 'jigs pa rnams/ /sgol ma thugs rje ldan pa bdag gis bstod byas pas/ /srid gsum sems can ma lus sdug bsngal kun bral shog /yum chen lha mo dam tshig sgol ma la bstod pa ko 47—243
