༄ga /bde ba'i 'byung gnas dpal ldan rje btsun ma la bstod pa bzhugs so//①༄7/ /oṃ swa ste/ bde ba'i 'byung gnas dpal ldan rjes ②btsun ma/ /nyes tshogs 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa chen po dang / /sdug bsngal kun la skyob par mdzad pa mo/ /bcom ldan sgol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yid 'ong rnam mdzes lha'i gzugs dang ni/ /srid gsum ma lus thams cad zil gyis mnan/ /yon tan mtshan dang dpe byad phun sum 'tshogs/ /tshogs gnyis mthar phyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jigs dang 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang ni/ /dus min 'chi dang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang / /srid pa'i rgya mtsho che las khyod kyis sgol—/ /thugs rje'i spyan mnga' ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun sbyor 'ching bas nga bdag 'dzin pa dang / /phyin ci log gi 'jigs tshogs lta ba la/ /bdag 'dzin nam mkha'i mdud pa grol bar mdzad/ /stong nyid sku mnga' ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab tu sdug cing 'phongs par gyur pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dran pa 47byed245

tsam kyis kyang / /sdug bsngal kun las rab tu thar bar mdzad/ /bkra shis bde sbyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyis ①thugs rje las//khyod ni 'khrungs shing sangs rgyas rnams kyi yum/ /rgyal ba'i sras po rnams kyang khyod las skyes/ /lha'i lha mchog ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyon kyis ma gos pad+ma zla gdan la/ /sna tshogs gzugs can rje btsun ma byed ni/ /ud pa la dang rin chen rgyan gyis phreng / /ltar mdzes kun mdon yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rmi lam ngan dang ltas ngan glo bur ba/ /bdud bzhi'i sde dang dpung rnams ma lus bcom/ /sgrib gsum nyes pa'i rtsa ba drung nas 'byin/ /dpa' mo g.yul las rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ / pha'adod pas gdung ba'i skye bo chags can la/ /rin chen gter mdzod 'phags pa'i nor bdun dang / /zag med yon tan gdul bya'i bsam pa bzhin/ /dgos 'dod re ba skong ba'i nor bu ma/ /snyigs ma'i skal par nad mtshon mu ge'i/ /sems can dus min glo bur 'chi ba la—/ /skye 'chi 'pho 'gyur med par thugs chud nas/ /dus gsum bsgres rgud med pa'i rigs 'dzin ma/ /rang rgyud nyes pa'i dmag ④gis bcom pa la/ /bzod pa'i go kyon shes rab mtshon cha yis/ /nyon mongs log pa'i dpung rnams 'joms ④mdzad cing / /'khor ba'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i dpa' mdzad ma—/ /'gro kun srid pa'i nyes pas skom pa la/ /chags med bdud rtsi'i chu yis 'gro rnams la/ /rgyun chad med par rab tu tshim byed cing / /nad med chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor ma/ /gzi brjid 'od kyis gza' bdud zil gyis gnon—/ /mkhyed pa'i zer kyis blo'i pad mo 'byed/ /thugs rje'i 'od kyis srid pa'i chu klung skems/ /mthon dman kun la gsal ba'i rta bdun ma/ /lha 47—246

bran skar tshogs nang na zla nya'i zhal/ /nyes pa'i gza' bral sgrib pa'i rab rib bsal—/ /nyon mongs gdung ba'i tshul khrims bsil zer can/ /yon tan ri bong 'dzin phyir yid 'ong zla rgyas ma/ /bsam gtan rdzing bur nyams kyi pad sdong 'khrungs/ /drod rtag lo 'dab bde ba'i ge sar rgyas/ /gdangs pa'i dri bsung bung ①ba'i 'khor tshogs tshims/ /bying rgod 'dam gyis ma gos chu skyes ma//rnam dag gangs rir nus pa'i rtsal chen rdzogs/ /rigs pa'i mchu sder mu stegs ri dwags 'joms/ /bdag med sgra'i nyan thos wa tshogs skrags②/ /theg dman zil gyis gnon phyir mi 'jigs ma/ /dga' ba'i tshar ①nas byang chub stobs chen rdzogs/ /ting 'dzin chang gi nus mthus glang chen myos/ /dran pa'i mtshon chas bag med g.yul ngo 'joms/ /mos pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i rab brtan ma/ /'khor ba mya ngan thang la 'khyam pa la/ /theg chen myur makyogs bushugs kyi zhon pa la/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pas theg chen lam bsgod nas/ /smon lam shes rab rdzogs pa'i cang shes ma/ /nyon mongs dug la spyod kyang zhen pa med/ /nyes tshogs skyon kyis ma gos sku mdog mdzes/ /ma yengs chos nyid zab mo'i mdang la gzigs/ /ngo mtshar mdzes pa skyed pa'i rma bya medadu / /stong pa'i mkha' ltar lta ba'i gshogs rlabs gcod/ /ngan song gcong rong g.yang sar nyam nga med/ /brtul zhugs mchu sder rtogs pa'i klu rgyal 'joms/ /tshangs pa'i gsungs rjosnyan ka la ping ka mā/ /bskal pa'i mun nag nyes pa'i rdul khrod du/ /rin chen sems stor btsal ba'i don chen du/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong snum kyis sgron me bskyed/ /ma rig mun pa sel ba'i snang gsal ma/ /bag chags g.ya' bral kun gzhi me long gis/ /rtog med sgrib pa'i dri ma rnam 47—247

bsal nas/ /bsal ba'i thugs la brtan pa'i gzugs brnyan shar/ /gnas lugs rang bzhin gsal ba'i mdzes ston ma/ /lnga phung btson rar yid kyi btson bu de/ /bdag 'dzin nyon mongs lcags kyis bcings pa la/ /stong nyid rnam thar rtogs pa'i lde mig gis/ /sdug bsngal 'ching las sgrol ba'i thar byed ma/ /mtshan ma'i yul ngan sdig pa'i smag rum na/ /snyoms las le lo gnyid kyis non pa la/ /brtson 'grus glog dang chos kyi 'brug sgra yis/ /gsal zhing go bar sgrogs pa'i dbyangs chen ma/ /'jig tshogs phung po mi gtsang dur khrod nas/ /lta ba'i tshe srog rtag chad mthar shi la/ /byang chub rga shi med pa'i bdud rtsi yis/ /skye 'gag med par gso ba'i bdud rtsi ma/ /le lo g.yeng ba'i bsod nams ra ba na/ /nyes spyod dgra kun dge ba'i nor 'phrog la—/ /dran pa'i so pa bslab bya nyams skabs su/ /shes bzhin mas ①rtses bsrung ba'i 'tsho byed ma/ /log lta'i than pas dge ba'i myu gu gdungs/ /byams pa'i sprin 'dus thugs rje'i chu rgyun gyis/ /dad pa'i zhing sbangs byang chub lo tog rnams/ /smin pas 'jig rten gso ba'i 'tsho byed ma/ /nam zhig srog gi dbang po 'gag pa'i tshe/ /bshes gnyen srog dang bral nas gshin rjes khrid—/ /nyams thag nga ros 'o dod 'bod pa la/ /'jigs pa skyob phyir srid gsum gnyen cig ma/ /rtsod dus lnga brgya'i skye bo dug lnga rag /sangs rgyas bka' smod mkhas pa'i sku la bsdo/ /log ltas byang chub bar chad byed pa'i/ /dgra bo myur du gsod pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /shes rab mig bu ma rig ling thog gis—/ /mdongs nas mi khom g.yang sar ltung ba la/ /bsdu ba'i lcags kyus bzung nas yang dag lam/ /ma nor drang por 'jug pa'i lam ston ma/ /47—248

sems bskyed stobs dang 0na lam 'phel stobs kyis/ /dus gsum mi bshol thugs rje phyi shol med/ /sems can don la 'khor ba ma stong bar/ /dam bcas skyo dub med pa'i byams sems ma/ /rtogs pa'i chos nyid mkha' la 'gro gyur kyang / /gdug pa 'dul phyir khro mo'i skur sprul nas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bar chad byed pa yi/ /dgra bo myur du gsod pa'i sgol byed ma/ /de ltar mtshan gyi me tog bcu rtsa gnyis/ /dpe byad brgyad cu 'bras bu'i bstod pa ni/ /don kun grub byed rin chen rgyan 'drar mdzes/ /rgyal ba kun gyi bstod pa'i rgyal po mchog /mtshan thos pas ni skal ba stong gi bar/ /ngan song mi skye las ngan sdig sgrib mdzad①/ /glo bur 'jigs pa kun las thar byed cing / /blo ldan rigs dang skal bar ldan par byed/ /gang zhig gtsang sbra nang par sngar lang khruste/ /spro zhing gus par ma yengs ting 'dzin kyis/ /gsum 'am bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig sogs/ /klog gam kha ton brjod pa rab bsgrags na/ /tshe rabs sngon gyi las ngan bag chags sad/ /nyon mongs mi dge sdig sgrib 'byang bar byed/ /mtshams med lnga dang nye ba lnga la sogs/ /sdig pa stobs chen ma lus dag par byed/ /ngan 'gro sdug bsngal 'ching ba gcod byed cing / /srid pa'i sdug bsngal kun las grol bar 'gyur/ /mchog dang thun mong yon tan sdogs par byed/ /rgyal ba kun gyi sras su dbang bskur zhing / /byams sems mkha' 'gro lha srin sde brgyad kyis/ /grogs dang rje bor bkur ba'i gnas su mthong / /bag la nyal dang shes bya'i sgrib pa rnams/ /dag cing sangs rgyas go 'phang myur du 'thob/ /tshe 'dir 'jigs pa gnod sbyin srin po dang / /'byung po ro langs sha za mang po'i tshogs/ /grib gnon la sogs 47—249

rtsub cing sdang sems kyis/ /gnod pa'i 'jigs pa dran pas sel bar byed/ /pha rol dmag tshogs gcan zan mi rgod dang / /rkun po dug sbrul rgyal po'i chad pa dang / /seng ge glang po stag dang me dang chu/ /'jigs pa brgyad sogs dus min 'chi ba rnams/ /mtshan 'di dran pas mos pas rab brjod na/ /sdug bsngal zhi zhing sdig las thar bar 'gyur/ /mdze dang rims dang dug nad la sogs pa'i/ /gnod pa'i sdug bsngal zhi zhing sel bar byed/ /ma byin rlabs myur zhing rab myur thugs rje can/ /gsol ba gang btab dngos grub thams cad dang / /brtse ba chen pos skad cig nyid la ste/ /mi bsnyel skyob mdzad yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba rin po che'i dgongs pa ltar/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho rnams/ /'dun pa 'thun snezhing byams pa'i sems ldan nas/ /bde ldan zhing ltar byin gyis rlab tu gsol/ /sa steng 'dzam bu gling 'di thams cad kyang / /pha rol gdug pa'i tshogs ni zhi gyur cing //bka' rgyud rin chen dar zhing rgyas pa dang / /'phrin las rgyun chad med par mdzad du gsol/ /thub pa'i bstan pa nyi bzhin gsal gyur cing / /sgrub pa po rnams gang du gnas pa'i sar/ /byin gyis rlob cing mnyam par gzhog pa dang / /sgrub pa'i 'bras bu myur du smin mdzad gsol/ /bdag cag gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs su/ /mngon dga'i zhing dang dga' tshal lta bur ni/ /sems can sdug bsngal thams cad zhi gyur cing / /'gro rnams bde chen sa la 'god par shog /ding nas bzung nas byang chub snying po'i bar bcom ldan 'das ma khyod dang mi 'bral zhing / /thugs rje'i lcags kyus rtag tu bzung nas kyang / /dus rnams thams cad byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /yon tan 47—250

mtha' yas bcom ldan 'das ma la/ /cung zad bstod pa'i bsod nams ci mchis pa/ /'gro drug 'khor ba'i sems can ma lus pa/ /bla med byang chub myur thob shog/ //'di mtshan yongs su grags pa rin po ches gsungs pa rdzogs so// //bod kyi sgra bsgyur gyi lots+tsha ba gnyan dge slong dharma kirtis rang 'gyur du gtan la phab pa'o /bsdur mchan/245 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉rdzar bkod/ ④〈〈pe 〉tsā/246 ①〈〈pe 〉7)/ ②〈〈pe 〉ra mig ga〈〈pe 〉ra jom/247 ①〈〈pe 〉〉gibung / sde〈〈pe 〉sngagags/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉tshal/ bu〈〈pe 〉zabagyog ⑤〈〈pe 〉zab/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉sngagasung /24/ ①〈〈pe 〉rabs/249 sde〈〈pe 〉ra dzad/ ④〈〈pe 〉rabangs/25༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉gi'adod pas gdung ba'i skye bo chags can la/ / — gnod pa'i sdug bsngal zhi zhing sel bar byed/ /(zhes pa'i g.yung drung rtags bar gyi yi ge rnams deb 'di'i ldeb 258pa'i bsdur mchan stipar dpe sdur byas yod / ) ②〈〈pe 〉75thun/47—251
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2659)47go252

slob dpon klu sgrub kyis bstod pa bzhugs so//①༄ga /oṃ thams cad grub pa dpal 'phel lha mo khyod lags kye/ /rnam thar yongs rdzogs dri med shes rab pha rol phyin/ /kun la mnga' mdzad bsdu ba'i tog ltar mdzes/ /zhabs gnyis rol pas gzhan don mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /tshad med bzhi'i bdud bzhi'i dpung rnams bcom pa kye/ /gang gis 'dod don gsol ba de dag grub pa kye/ /sku dang phyag zhabs rin chen du mas rnam ④brgyan kye/ /bsdu ba dngos po bzhi ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod//dpa' mo rab brjid dus gsum sa ler mkhyen pa kye/ /'khor ba'i 'dam nas 'gro ba ma lus 'dren mdzad ma/ /hri dang hūṃ phaṭa rab sgrogs dus gsum dbang phyug ma/ /bgegs kyi tshogs rnams myur sgrol khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam dag spyan gyis yul kun dus kun gzigs pa kye/ /sprul pa'i tshogs kyis srid pa'i 'jigs chen 'joms/ /thugs skyo mi mnga' rin chen nor 'dra ma 47—253

sring tshul/ /thugs rje'i dbang nyid sgol ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhar gnas zla ba nya 'dra bsil ba'i 'od ldan kye/ /rims stsogs nyon mongs gdung ba kun sel cing / /gang gis bsam pa'i don grub thams cad rtsol mdzad ma/ /yid bzhin rin chen sgrol ma khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /thams cad kun la dbang bsgyur ①ye shes 'od 'bar kye/ /srid gsum skye 'gro ma lus smin grol mdzad pa ni/ /yid bzhin 'phrin las bzhi'i yal bar mi 'dor cing / /mkhyen brtse mthu ldan ma cig khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyag bzhi mda' gzhu lcags kyu ud pal 'dzin pa kye/ /bdag gi las sgrib sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzad pa dang / /'dod don gang gsol myur du 'grub cing dpal la sogs/ /'phel bar mdzad cing zhabs la gsol 'debs phyag 'tshal bstod/ /nam mkha' lta bu rgyal yum rig pa 'dzin ma kye/ /'phrin las bzhi mdzad khyed zhabs lha dang lha min gyis/ /tshogs kyis btud cing kun la dbang bsgur mkha' 'gro ma—/ /sa gzhi lta bu'i mthu mnga' khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /slob dpon klu grub kyis bstod pa'o// //47—254
bsdur mchan/252 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉rtor bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉warnam/254 ①〈〈pe〉〉spyor/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2660)47ge255

༄ga /rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgol ma la kha che nyi ma sbas pas bstod pa bzhugs so//①༄4/ /rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang bzhin mtha' bral yid 'ong mngon dga'i zhing / /yon tan lhun grub bde chen rnam dag pa'i/ /chos kyi mtho bas dpal ldan po ta la/ /'dod yon rin chen spras pa'i zhing khams na/ /gnyis med 'od gsal dbyings las ma bskyod kyang / /'od dpag med pa'i thugs rje rin chen ltar/ /'dzam gling chags chen skye bo'i don bsgrub phyir/ /bud med mtshan dpes gzhan la snang mdzad nas//sa bcu'i dbang phyug byams sems rig 'dzin dang / /rta mgrin la sogs khro rgyal khro mo dang / /lha dang lha min gnod sbyin dri za'i tshogs/ /rig pa'i rgyal mo la sogs skal bzang ma/ /bstan pa rgya mtsho nam mkha'i rin chen mdzod/ /zab cing rgya che re skong dpag dka'i bcud/ /brjod pas don che thog mtha' bar dge ba/ /'jigs dang sdug bsngal nyon mongs las grol ba/ /rtogs 47—256

pa'i don la dus gsum 'du 'bral med/ /'gro la mos pa'i skabs dang dus snang zhing / /sdig pa dag byed mtshan mchog sum cu gnyis/ /thos pas grol phyir gzhan la brjod par bya/ /chos nyid spros bral bde chen zab mo'i don/ /gnyis med blang dor med par thugs su chud/ /mtshan ma'i rtog pa skye med dbyings su grol/ /dus gsum gcig tu mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas ma/ /dgongs pa'i don la mnyam nyid mi g.yo yang / /brtse ba'i thugs rjes sems can gzhan don la/ /mdzad pa'i thabs kyis gang la gang 'dul ba'i/ /ma nges cir yang 'char ba'i sprul pa ma/ /shin tu dpag med ya nga'i gnas rnams su—/ /'jigs pa brgyad sogs gdon gyis nyen pa la/ /bsnyems pa med pa 'phrul gyis blo gros kyis/ /'khor gyi 'jigs pa sel ba'i rje blon ma/ /gzhon nu'i lus la tshul khrims dri bsgom nas/ /khrel yod ngo tsha shes pa'i gsang gos baspris—/ /chog shes rnam dag mdzes pa'i rgyan kyis brgyan/ /'chal pa'i skyon gyis ma gos khrims btsun ma/ /rnam shes sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying ba la/ /'dren pa'i thugs rje thabs kyi zhags pa yis/ /'gro drug byang chub skam sar 'don mdzad pa'i/ /srid pa'i skyon gyis ma gos khyad 'phags ma/ /snang ①stong gnyis med mkha' dbyings zung mjug 1cing / /rtogs pa'i rigs ④pas gnas lugs don la spyor/ /ting 'dzin thabs kyis bde ba'i ye shes bskyed/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yum gcig ma/ /skye rgas na 'chi'i chu bo dhirgal dka' ba'i⑤/ /rgyud lnga mi dge rab kar 'khyam pa la/ /snying rje byang chub sems kyis gru gzings kyis/ /sdug bsngal chu bo sgrol ba'i kun sgrol ma/ /'gro ba 'gron dupo srid pa'i lam rgyun rnams/ /zag med bde ba'i nor gyis 47—257

'phongs pa la/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i rin chen gser gling gis/ /thar pa'i grong du 'dren pa'i ded dpon ma/ /khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal khang pa na/ /dug gsum gcong gis zin pa'i nad pa rnams/ /dam chos bdud rtsi sman gyis chu rgyun gyis/ /sdug bsngal zug rngu sel ba'i sman mdzad ma/ /①grags dang bkra shis bsod nams 'phel bar 'gyur/ /dpal dang tshe dang rang bzhin rgyas gyur te/ /nor dang longs spyod bu tsa 'phel bar 'gyur/ /shes rab 'phel zhing bstan chos rig par 'gyur/ /gtsug lag mkhas shing tha snyad rgyal 'gyur te/ /rten 'byel gsal zhing drod rtags yon tan 'byung / /mngon shes 'char zhing skye ba dran par byed/ /gzi brjid ldan zhing yid 'ong mthong dgar ②'gyur/ /gsung dbyangs tshangs pa'i dbyangs bzhin snyan 'gyur cing / /ngag tshig gsal zhing lus sems dpa' bar byed/ /gang dang gang du skye ba thams cad du/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rtag tu mi spang zhing / /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten cing mi 'bral bar/ /'dod pa'i don rnams thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgol ma la mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi bstod pa don thams cad grub par byed pa/ rin chen brgyan 'dra zhes bya ba/kha che nyi ma sbas pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //47—258

bsdur mchan/256 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉ltar bkod/257 7〈〈pe 〉〉nang / ②〈〈pe 〉sngarajug ①〈〈pe 〉stareg du〈〈pe 〉stabo'i/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉pa/ rjo〈〈pe 〉toradron/258 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〉'dod pas gdung ba'i skyebo chags can la/ / sto gnod pa'i sdug bsngal zhi zhing sel bar byed/ /(zhes pa'i yi ge rnams deb 'di'i ldeb 246nga9 250nga6bar dpe bsdur byas yod/) ②〈〈pe 〉stanakur/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2661)47—259

༄ / /'phags ma sgol ma'i bkra shis pa/3 ༄/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i bkra shis bzhugs so// raḥ/ /rgya gar skad du/ ar+ya ta ra mang ga la gi ti/ bod skad du/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i bkra shis pa/ dpal ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis 2yum gyur dge ma che/ /dus gsum rtag par zla rgyas zhal can yid 'ong sgegs/ /gzhon nu'i rol pas 'jig rten khyab par gsal mdzad sgrol/ /'gro ba sgrol mdzad sgrol ma'i bkra shis bde legs shog /phyogs bcu'i dus gsum kun tu byang chub sems dpa' lcam/ /pad+ma rgyas pa'i zhal nas 'od zer 'bum dang bcas/ /yud tsam skad cig blo 'gyu zhing khams du ma khyab/ /'gro ba sgrol mdzad sgrol ma'i bkra shis bde legs shog /phyogs bcu'i gsung dbyangs du mas chos kyi char pa 'be+eb/ /yan lag bcu gnyis gsung dbyangs yi ge bcur basbus nas/ /pha rol phyin bcu'i tshul gyis gdul bya 'dul byed pa//77—260

'gro ba'i sgrol mdzad sgol ma'i bkra shis bde legs shog /phyogs bcur 1'od kyis 'gengs mdzad mgon po bcom ldan 'das/ /tshe dpag med pa dbu la rgyan mdzes khur du khur/ /bla ma skyong mdzad dam tshig mi spang sdom pa can/ /'gro ba sgrol mdzad sgrol ma'i bde legs shog /phyogs bcu'i 'phags lam 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /thugs rjes gzigs nas bde thabs du mas sprul mdzad pa//dgra bcom rang rgyal 2sogs dang bu mo'i gzugs 'dzin rgyal/ /'gro ba sgrol mdzad sgrol ma'i bkra shis bde legs shog /phyogs bcur 'gro ba rnams su rtag par 'jigs pa brgyad sel phyir/ /kha dog dkar dmar sngo ljang ser nag sogs/ /du ma'i gzugs bzang rlung bzhin myur du rgyu bar mdzad/ /'go ba sgrol mdzad sgrol ma'i bkra shis bde legs shog /phyogs bcu kun tu gsal mdzad nyi ma'i 'od zer can/ /lha'i 'khor los gsang ba'i brag phug nang gnas pa/ /thugs rje'i spyan kyis rgyun chad med par gzigs pa'i/ /'gro ba sgrol mdzad sgol ma'i bkra shis shog /phyogs rnams gzugs mdzes khyab pa'i lha'i 'khor lo ni / /nor bzang 'od zer can dang phag mo khro gnyer can/ /rtag par phyi bzhin 'brang mdzad mdzes pa'i 'khor gyis brgyan/ /'gro ba sgrol mdzad sgrol ma'i bkra shis bde legs shog /po ta lar ni 'jig rten dbang phyug mgon po'i mthus/ /rig pa'i lha mo tshogs rnams 'gro don bya'o zhes/ /rtag par zhal gyis bzhes nas nad gdon kun sel ba'i/ /'gro ba sgol mdzad sgrol ma'i bkra shis bde legs shog /phyogs bcu'i dad ldan bsgrub pa rnams kyis dran tsam gyis/ /rgyal po me chu glang chen rkun po gdon sbrul gdug /mu ge mtshon 'khrugs nad yams dran pas zhi byed pa'i/ /'go ba sgrol mdzad sgrol ma'i bkra 47—261

shis bde legs shog /phyogs bcur bud med gzugs mdzes rnams ni bsdus//sgrol ma'i sku'i brgya'i char nye bar lha mi klu mo lha min ma/ /gnod sbyin mo mjes rnams kyis bcu drug char mi phod/ /'gro ba sgol mdzad sgol ma'i bkra shis bde legs shog /phyogs bcu'i lha mo rnams dang rin chen rnams kyi 'od/ /kun bsdus sgrol ma'i 'od kyi brgya'i char ①mi nye/ /'on kyang rin chen tshogs mnga' rab sgegs mdzad rnams brgyan/ /'gro ba sgol mdzad sgrol ma'i bkra shis bde legs shog /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyi mtshan ni yi ge bcu/ /oṃ yig ta re dang bcas khyad par tud ta re/ /ta re swā hās mya ngan 'das mchog zhi ba bsgrub—/ /'gro ba sgrol mdzad sgrol ma'i bkra shis bde legs shog /phyogs bcur spyan dang ma ma gos kar la sogs rigs/ /mi'i tshogs kyis rnga yab dri za can thogs nas/ /sil snyan tshogs dang snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis sgol ma bstod/ /'gro ba sgol mdzad sgrol ma'i bkra shis bde legs shog /phyogs bcur rigs 'dzin tshogs rnams 'gro phan gang spyod kyang / /rje mo khyod dran tsam gyis nyi ma'i 'od zer ltar/ /nyon mongs mun pa sel cing sdug bsngal tshogs las skyobs④/ /'gro ba sgol mdzad sgrol ma'i bkra shis bde legs shog /phyogs bcu'i khro bo chen po gshin rje gshed swo rnams/ /sgol ma dran byed rnam ⑦kun bsrungs la brtson/ /khyab 'jug la sogs lha chen rnams kyis rjes 'brang ba/ /'gro ba sgrol mdzad sgol ma'i bkra shis bde legs shog /'phags ma sgol ma'i bkra shis brjod pa rdzogs so// //paṇa rjoṭi ta sur+ya sri dang / lots+tsha ba longs sa dge slong tshud khrims rtsags kyis bsgyur ba'o// //47—262

skye/ ku ru ku le trī lha/ swa swā hā/ skyes ta re tud ta re tu re swā hā/ bkra shis par shog/ //bsdur mchan/26 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉8/261 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bcu'i/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〉la/262 ①〈〈pe 〉〉zur/ ②〈〈pe 〉sku1ba/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉rnams/ du〈〈pe 〉〉pan/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2662)47—263

༄go/ /rgya gar ska/da du/ kha bye ra dha ra sto tra/ bod skad du/ seng ldeng nags kyi sgol ma la bstod pa/ 'phags/ ma seng sdeng nags kyi sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags ma'i pho brang seng ldeng nags na sgrol ma rtse/ /u dum wa ra seng sdeng rgya shug n+ya gro ta/ /tsan dan 'bras bu gsum stong dza ti li shi'i tshal/ /kha zum kha bye me tog shing lo nyams dga'i gnas/ /ljon shing 'bras bu smin dang ma smin tai po la/ /yan lag brgyad ldan chu ni ldung lhung sgra snyan la/ /rma bya ne+e tso khu byug bzhad rnams sgra snyan sgrogs/ /stag gzig rgyug cing e nas gar byed dom dred mchongs/ /lce spyang glu len spre spre khri snyan be+e'u snun/ /lha'i bu mo gzhon nu nags na na drug ldan len/ /dge slong klu grub seng sdeng nags na grub chen mdzad/ /sgrol ma gshegs bzhud zhing khams gnas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /skye med thugs rje'i mtsho las pad ma mar gad mdog /me 77—264

tog zla mdzes bud med rin chen bcud kyis mdzes/ /ngang pa'i 'gros ltar bgyid zhing gnyis 'thung dreg bzhin gzigs/ /bde gshegs thugs rje'i rlan gyis gang mos skur ston ma/ /gser gyi pad mas snyan rgyan ①ud pal dar dpyangs can/ /rin chen rtse bran dbu la don grub cod pan bzhugs/ /mu tig btso ma byu ru'i chun 'phyangs 'gur chu mdzes/ /phyag zhabs gdu gu dpung rgyan sku reg dar sgeg ma/ /thugs rje 'khor ba las sgol phyag na pad mo yis/ /spyan gyi chab las lha mo sku 'khrungs 'od dpag med/ /smon lam mthu yis brtse chen gzhan gyi don la brtson/ /zhing mchog rnam dag seng ldeng nags kyi gzhon nu ma/ /zhal gyi pad ma yid 'ong bzhin ni zla ltar rgyas/ /chu skyes sbyan mdzes dkyus ring dkar nag mdangs gsal ba/ /mgor skyes khyar bu gser gyis sgra brgyan bung ltar gnag /bi'i rdzi 'dra snum zhing mdzod spu dung 'khyil ma/ /bden gnyis phyag ni ud pal kha 'byed bdag sogs kyi/ /gti mug mun sel snying gi chu skyes kha dbus na/ /ud pal g.yon bsnams ye shes rgyas mdzad g.yas pa yis/ /'gro rnams bung ba'i me tog sngon po kha 'byed ma/ /srid par lhungs ②nas mya ngan smre sngags 'don pa la/ /sems can don mdzad seng ldeng nags nas bzhengs la gshegs/ /lang tso dar bab 'o ma rgyas pa'i nu 'bur can/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis srid zhi g.yo zhing bskyod mdzad ma/ /khyu mchog spyang mo 'gying bag lte ba pad ma can/ /dza ti tsam pa li shi dri ngad bzang por ldan/ /phyag zhabs pad ma ltar dmar 'khor ba'i skyon ma gos/ /pan tsa li ga lha dar stod smad brgyan byas ma/ /nyi che'i sku min khyab pas thugs rje'i 'phrin las sku/ /thub pas rgya mtshor gsungs pa klu grub snying po yis/ /nags 47—265

su gzigs so sems can dal gyis khur chen khyer/ /tshangs tshings srid pa'i nags nas zhi bar sgrol mdzad ma/ /bsgres mo gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin sangs rgyas kun gyi phyi/ /ming tsam dran pa nyid kyis 'jigs las bskyob mdzad ma/ /yun/ ring 'khor bar mi skyo zhi bar mi gnas pa'i/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug rgyal sras rnams kyi thugs rje ma/ /rje btsun yon tan mtha' yas bdag gis brjod mi nus/ /kun tu rtogs spangs ye shes mnga' brnyes chos kyi sku/ /gzhan gyi don phyir sku ni seng ldeng nags na gshegs bzhud mdzad/ /srid las bdag grol nags kyi bu mo phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'od zer ral cig ser sngo g.yas g.yon phyogs char gshegs/ /zhi khro'i phyag gnyis rdo rje a sho gri khug thogs/ /snga phyir bzhud cing dpe med gus ldan bsnyen bkur ①mdzad/ /mdzes ma nye 'khor 'od zer ral cig phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sngon mchod phyi nas gdugs khur rigs rgyal bu mo'i ④tshogs/ /rnga yab ting shag rnga gling pi bang glu gar 'gengs//lha'i bu mo bco lnga rgyan ldan na bza' mdzes/ /sna tshogs sku yis mchod bsnams rol la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /nags tshal lha mo sku mdzes dge ma 'khor bcas la//bdag gis bstod bgyis mi bzad dge ba bzang po des/ /'gro ba kun la thugs rje'i chu'i nyon mongs kun dag nas/ /srid pa'i nags nas zhi ba'i tshal du phyin par shog /④gzhon nu kha ti ta re ma la bstod pa tshigs su bcad pa bcu drug pa/slob dpon 'phags pa klu grub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //du47—266

bsdur mchan/264 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉sngag /slob dpon 'phags pa klu grub kyis seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma la bstod pa bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉〉wan/265 ①〈〈pe 〉〉brgyan/ ②〈〈pe 〉ngo nga /266 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bskur/ ②〈〈pe 〉slob/ ③〈〈pe 〉ska/ // du〈〈pe 〉〉barba maṅga lo// //bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2663)47—267

— —rnga sa pa zhas dra/ ba/①༄༅༅ / / a tha ma hā bha ga bā za dz+ra dha ra sa rba ta thā ga tā gra ma tī༄7//de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi btsun ṣi / sa ma ya tā rā nā ma sa rba ku la ta thā ga ta / ba dz+ra ra t+na pa d+mamo'i ④mchog /dam tshig sgrol ma zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa dang rdo rje dang rin po che dang pad+ma dang ka rmā bye pa ti —/ tsa ra ṇi tsa ra kri tā ཿ sbri re ṇa tsa tsa la swa bha b.las kyi rigs thams cad kyi bdag po/ rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba'i byed po brtan pa dang g.yo ba'i rang bzhin gu h+ya ti gu h+ya ta re ma hā gu bye shwa re ma hā gu bye shwa re a d+mā ṭ+wāṃ ba dz+ra nāgasang ba las ches shin tu gsang ba/ gsang ba chen po'i dbang phyug mas bdag nyid kyi rdo rje'i ming me mi swa kā ya bā ñtsi ta t+ta ba dz+re bh+yo ni sh+tsa rā ya na bha ga wa tī tā rā ba dz+ra ṇa'adi rnams nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /bcom ldan 'das ma/ sgrol ma/ rdo rje ma/sa ma ya tā rā ba dz+ra ma hā yo gi nī pa ñtsa dzñā na byu ṣi tā ④ ba dz+ra pa ñtsa mu ku ṭi ཿ rjodam tshig sgrol ma/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma chen mo/ ye shes lngas brgya na pa ma/ rdo rje cod paṇa lnga dang ldan ma/47—268

sa rba bu d+dhā rnyi ṣe ka ཿ dzñā na ma ṇ+ḍa la su tsa n+d+ra —/ a ho k+ṣe ma kā yasangs rgyas thams cad kyi dbang bskur ma/ ye shes dal①/ zla ba'i bde ma/ ngo mtshar bde ma/ sku dang wa pi t+ta ra ñdza ② bhā ya ska rnya pa tai ā ya ta ne+e shi two pra bhi byu ta ཿgsung dang thugs kyi 'dod ma phung po'i bdag mo/ skye mched kyi bdag por gyur pa/ 'byung ba rnams rab bi de sha swa bhā wā ta rtse shwa rī pa ñtsa dzñā na bo dhatu thob pa/ yul dang bral ba'i rang bzhin/ rgyud kun gyi dbang phyug ma/ ye shes rnam pa lngas byang chub bi ra dzo bi ma lo ma hā mā n+d+ra a ti su sgra bi tsi tri tro la k+ṣa ṇa nupa/ rdul dang bral ba/ dri ma med pa/ gsang sngags chen mo shin tu phra ba mtshan dang dpe byad bya spya rgo shu rnyi ta ཿ ma hā shu rnyi ta ཿ sa rba ka rma si rnya ka ram̐rnams kyis spras pa/ dag byed/ dag byed chen mo/ las thams cad grub par byed pa/ 'dod pa sa rba kā ma pra rda da shā k+ṣa ra ga 4 na ru la rā tī tu ṭ+wā rā tu rethams cad rab tu sbyin pa/ yi ge bcu'i sgra sgrogs ma/ sgra sgrogs dgyes ma/ gdung ma/ myur ma/ rnam bi dzñā na pa ri shu rnya ju dha ① su dzñā ga r+bha ma hā su khe ཿ ta trepar shes pa yongs su dag pa/ sra zhing bde ba ye nga shes snying po/ bde ba chen mo'o/ /de la 'di rda yo gī nī sa ma ya dze+e ta t+ya hā tsa ā r+ya tā rāni rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi dam tshig gi gnas so/ /'di skad kyang bka' stsal to/ /'phags ma sgol nī nā ma dwa sha sa ha sri ke ni sh+tsa ra sa ma p+tama'i mtshan nges pa zhes bya ba stong phrag bcu gnyis pa las phyung ba rdzogs so// //yang mtshan rnams 'di ltar sdebs na legs pa yin te/ bcom ldan sgol ma rdo rje ma dang dam tshig sgol ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dhichen mo/ /ye shes lngas 47—269

brgyan rdo rje cod paṇa lnga dang ldan ma sangs rgyas kun gyi dbang bsgur ma/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor zla bzang ngo mtshar bde ma sku gsung thugs kyi 'dod ma phung po'i bdag /skye mched bdag gyur 'byung rnams rab thob yul dang bral ba'i rang bzhin rgyud kun dbang phyug ma/ /ye shes rnam pa lnga yis byang chub rdul dang bral ba dri ma med/ /gsang sngags chen mo shin tu phra/ /mtshan dang dpe byad rnams kyis spras/ /dag byed dag byed chen mo ste/ /las rnams thams cad grub byed pa/ /'dod pa thams cad rab tu sbyin/ /yi ge bcu yi sgra sgogs ①ma/ /sgra sgrog dgyes ma gdung ba ma/ /myur ba ma ste rnam par shes/ /yongs su dag pa sra zhing bde/ /ye shes snying po bde chen mo/ /zhes pa ste rgya skad tshig lhug pa yin mod kyi/ don la brton pa nyid kyi phyir 'di bzung bde bas legs so/ /'di yi dbang dang rim gnyis cha lag bcas/ /zhib par gsungs pa yid la nges byas nas/ /bla ma'i gsung bzhin phyi rol bstan bcos dang / /mthun par rgyud kyi snying po 'di tsam bsgyur—/ / //47—270

bsdur mchan/268 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉ltar bkod/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉stab/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉ta/ rjo〈〈pe 〉to/ཿ/269 ①〈〈pe 〉stanakyil 'khor/ ②〈〈pe 〉sku / ni〈〈pe 〉gasdi/ du〈〈pe 〉〉wam/27༷ 0)〈〈pe 〉〉sgogabasdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2664)47—271

༄/ /tshe dpag tu med pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/1༄/ tshe dang/ga med kyi rgya gzhung sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ༄7/ /rgya gar be+ed du/ a yu a pa ra mi ta sa dha na ma/ bod skad du/ tshe dpag tu med pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /dad brtson 'gro rnams sgral 'dod pas/ /bsod nams tshogs ni sngon song nas/ /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom par bya/ /rang nyid snying khar tri dmar las/ /ye shes me 'bar rnam smin bsregs/ /de rjes rang sems thig le dang / /hreḥdamar tsheg drag gyur pa las/ /'od 'phros don byas tshur 'dus pas/ /rta mchog spyan gsum zhal bsgrad pa/ /dbyug pa sdigs 'dzub rab 'jigs bsgom/ /de'i thugs khar pad zla'i steng / /hriḥlas bcom ldan tshe dang/ga med/ /mdog dmar rgyan mdzes 'dzum zhing sgeg /bum pa yo/ngas su 'dzin pa'o/ /de'i thugs khar pad nyi'i steng / /hriḥlas 'bye chad 77—272

'khor lo ni/ /rtsibs brgyad yongs su gyur pa las/ /gzha la yas gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ /'dab brgyad khyams dang pad ①rag dang / /'dod yon dra phyed pha gus brgyan/ /rta babs mchod rten la sogs mdzes/ /rdo rje me ri dmar smug 'khrug /dang zhing thogs pa med pa yi/ /'od zer tshogs 'khrugs ②bsgom par bya/ /de yang hri las pho brang gi/ /dbus su saṃ gcig chad pa las/ /mi 'jigs brgyad du gyur par bsgom/ /de stengs ④baṃ a ram̐ las/ /pad zla rta ⑦bdun dag tu gyur/ /de'i steng du triḥlas ni/ /'od 'phros don byas tshur 'dus pas/ /pad ma dmar po 'dab lngar gyur/ /de las bcom ldan tshe dpag med/ /mdog dmar gzhon sgeg brgyan gyis mdzes/ /'gro rnams re bskong dpag bsam shing / /bum pa'i kha brgyan thugs khar 'dzin/ /'akying bcas 'od 'khrug skyil rjokrungs bcas/ /de'i g.yon du paṃ dang a/ /gyur pas pad zla'i gdan stengs su/ /a las yum mchog gos dkar mo/ /mtshal mdog 'gying bcas 'dzum zhing sgeg /thugs khar pad ma ra ga'i/ /bum pa yongs su 'dzin pa'o/ /shar du pad zla nyi ma yi/ /steng du hūṃ las rdo rjer 'gyuraX—/ /de las mi bskyod tshe dpag med/ /bai ḍūr sngon po'i mdog 'dra ba//byas krung dang bcas bum pa 'dzin/ /de'i g.yon du pad zla'i steng / /swa las yum mchog sangs rgyas spyan/ /mdog dkar phyag gnyis bum pa 'dzin/ /gzhon sgeg skyil krung bzhugs pa'o/ /lho ru pad zla nyi stengs su/ /swa las rin chen tshe dpag med/ /btso ma gser mdog skyil krung bzhugs/ /bum 'dzin rin chen ⑦brgyan spras so/ /g.yon du pad zla ra nyid las/ /byung ba'i yum mchog ma ma ki/ /nam mkha'i mdog can 'dzum sgeg mdzes/ /bum pa 47—273

bsnams shing skyil krung bzhugs/ /nub tu pad ma nyi ma yi/ /steng du bye las 'khor lor gyur/ /de las snang mdzad tshe dpag med/ /dkar zhing skyil krung bzhugs pa'o/ /g.yon du pad zla nyi ma las/ /dbyings phyug ma rgo dung gi ①mdog /'arming bcas rin chen brgyan gyis spras/ /zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krungs so/ /byang du pad zla nyi ma yi/ /steng du a las rgya gram pa/ /de las don grub tshe dpag med/ /mdog ljang bum pa skyil krung mdzes/ /g.yon du pad ma zla ba'i steng / /ta las dam tshig sgrol ma ni/ /sngo lngang sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes/ /thugs khar bum pa 'dzin pa'o/ /shar khyams zla ba'i gdan stengs su/ /hūṃ bzhi rdo rje bzhir gyur pas/ /rdo rje rigs kyi sems dpa' bzhi//g.yas pa rang rtags rdo rje 'dzin/ /g.yon pa tshe'i bum pa 'dzin/ /rgyan mdzes rdo rje'i skyil krung mdzes/ /lho phyogs pad ma zla ba'i steng / /swa las rin chen 'bar ba bzhi/ /rin chen rigs kyi sems par ④gyur/ /g.yas pa rin chen g.yon pa na/ /tshe'i bum pa thugs khar 'dzin/ /btso ma gser 'dra skyil krung bzhugs/ /nub du pad zla hri bzhi las/ /pad ma 'dab lngar gyur pa las/ /pad ma'i sems dpa' bzhi ru 'gyur④/ /phyag g.yas rang rtags pad ma bsnams/ /g.yon pa bum 'dzin rgyan spras shing / /skyil krung dag gis bzhugs pa'o/ /byang du gdan stengs a bzhi las/ /rdo rje rgya gram las gyur pa'i—/ /las kyi sems dpa' bzhi ru gyur/ /sngo ljang rgya gram bum pa 'dzin/ /gzhon sgeg mdzes shing skyil krung bzhugs/ /'od zer tshogs kyis bskor ba'o/ /shar sgor dza dang lcags kyu las/ /lcags kyu ma ni mu tig mdog /lho sgor hūṃ las zhags pa ser/ /nub du baṃ las lcags sgrog dmar/ /byang du ho las 47—274

dril bu ljang / /lha mo de dag thams cad kyang / /'khril ldem gzhon sgeg rgyan spras mdzes/ /zhal ni phyir gzigs bzhengs pa'o/ /gru chad bzhi la mchod pa'i—/ /lha mo spyi dang 'thun par bsam/ /de las thugs kha'i 'od zer gyis//rang bzhin gnas nas ye shes pa/ /'di brjod spyan ni drang bar bsam/ hūṃ gdod nas rang bzhin mkha' ltar dag /thugs rjes gzha' tshon skur ston pa/ /bcom ldan gsung mchog 'od dpag med/ /rang bzhin lhun grub gzhal yas nas—/ /ting 'dzin gzugs brnyan dam pa 'dir/ /'gro ba'i don du spyan 'dren na/ /tshe zad tshe nyams bsal mdzad phyir/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang / /las kyi rigs mchog tshe dpag med/ /mchod pa'i lha mo rnams ①bzhi dang / /sems pa ②bcu drug sgo mar bcas/ /rang bzhin dkyil 'khor chen po nas/ /ting 'dzin gzugs brnyan dam pa 'dir/ /tshe dang longs spyod rgyas pa dang / /thugs mchog ye shes thob bya'i phyir/ /gnas 'di nyid du spyan 'dren gyis/ /byin kyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol/ /dza hūṃ baṃ hos dgug cing gzhug /mnyes par gyur la mchod pa dang / /bstod pa rgyas dang bsdus pa bya/ /sku gsung thugs ni byin gyis brlab/ /de nas bying rgod rab spangs la/ /ma yengs lha rnams rab tu bsgom/ /de rjes bzlas pa bya ba ni/ /lha rnams thugs kha'i bum pa'i nang //hri hūṃ swa bye a las ni/ /rang rang sngags kyis bskor bar bsgom/ /oṃ hri bye badz+ra dzha na a yu she swā hā/ oṃ hūṃ bye badz+ra snyo na a yu she swā hā/ oṃ swa bye badz+ra snyo na a yu she swā hā/ oṃ rgyu bye badz+ra dzha na a yu she swā hā/ oṃ a bye badz+ra dzha na a yu she swā hā/ de rnams yab kyi bsnyen pa'o/ /yum gyi bum par a pa ra/ /mi ta 47—275

bsams la sngags 'dis bskor/ /oṃ bye a pa ra mi ta a yu dzña na su be+e ni tsi ta te tso ra tsa ya swā hā/ yum mchog lnga'i snying po brjod/ /phyogs bcu'i sems dpa' bcu drug po/ /gtso bo'i sngags rnams bskor ba bsgom/ /dza hūṃ baṃ ho a pa ra mi ta a yu dzña na su rnyi ni swā hā/ sgo ma bzhi'i snying po'o/ /de ltar bum pa'i sngags rnams la/ /dmigs nas bzlas pa byas pa yis/ /yig 'bru rnams las bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /byung bas bum pa gang bar bsam/ /bum nang ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /rang gi gnas gsum thim pa yis/ /lus ngag yid gsum nad gdon dang / /sdog sgrib dag nas dbang bzhi thob/ /'chi med dngos grub thob par bsam/ /de nas rang gis sngags bzlas pas/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kyang / /rang rang gsang sngags zlos par bsam/ /rang snying sa bon shar phyogs nas/ /lha mo dkar mo lcags kyu thogs/ /dpag med shar du 'phros pa yis/ /nad gdon zhi ba'i las byas nas/ /dri za'i lag nas tshe bkug nas/ /rang dang bum par bstem par bya/ /de bzhin lho'i zhags pa las/ /tshe dang longs spyod rgyas byas nas/ /gshin rje'i lag nas tshe bkug nas/ /gong bzhin du ni bstem par bya/ nub kyi lcags sgog dmar mo yisaske/ /srid gsum ma lus dbang bsdus te/ /chu lha'i lag nas tshe bkug nas—/ /bstim zhing klu gdon dag par bsam/ /byang gi dril bu dges mdzad mas/ /nad gdon log 'dren tshar bcad nas/ /gnod sbyin lag nas tshe bkug nas/ /gong bzhin dmigs pa gsal bas bstem/ /shar phyogs rnam rgyal bum par ni/ /rdzas dang mgul chings kha rgyan bcas/ /phyag mtshan bris la bzhug par bya/ /phyi ni bum pa'i rnam pa la/ /nang ni gzhal 47—276

yas khang du bsam/ /gong bzhin bdud rtsis bum pa gang / /de yis rang gzhan thams cad kyi/ /nad gdon sdig sgrib sangs dag nas/ /'chi med dngos grub thob par bsam/ /las bum rta mgrin bskyed pa yang / /bgegs kyi steng du bzhag par bya/ /de yis rang gzhan bar chad srung / /bdud rtsi dmar pos khrus bya'o/ /de ltar rang don gzhan don la/ /ma yengs bskyed rim gsal po yis/ /zla ba gcig tu sngags bzlas na/ /rtags rdzogs zla drug zhal mthong 'gyur/ /de yang rgyun du nyams len na/ /kha ta'i skad kyis ma non par/ /mdun du gtso bo yab yum bsam/ /gsol ba btab la mchod bstod bya/ /bum pa dag la dmigs nas su/ /gsang sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas—/ /de'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung nas/ /rang gi spyi gtsug thim pa yis /'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob/ /tshe dpag med par gyur par bsam/ /brtan pa'i yan lag sngags bzlas so/ /de yis tshe nyid nyi zlar 'gyu①/ /tshe nyams la sogs smos ci dgos/ /gsangs nas bsgrub pa rab tu bsngags / /②de nas gsang sgrub bshad par bya/ /dkyil 'khor gong dang 'dra ba la/ /yab lnga'i sku mdog dmar zhing 'tsher/ /sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /bum pa thod par bcas 'dzin pa/ /rdo rje skyil krungs bzhugs pa'o/ /yum lnga sku mdog yab dang 'dra/ /gzhon sgeg rgyan mdzes sku sha rgyas/ /'dzum zhing nu ma 'bur ba yi/ /g.yas pa pad+ma rdo rje dang / /rin chen 'khor lo rgya gram ste/ /g.yas pa rang rtags phyag mtshan 'dzin/ /g.yon pa thod pa bdud rtsis bkang //yab la stob cing skyil krungs 'khril/ /yab kyi 'od zer dkar ba'i mdog /yum la phog cing yum gyi ni/ /'od zer yab la phog pa yi/ /yab yum 'od 47—277

zer tshogs 'khrug cing / /snyoms 'jug zag med bde ba rgyas/ /gnyis su med pa'i sbyor mtshams nas/ /byang sems dkar dmar bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /rang gi gnas gsum phog pa yis/ /lus ngag yid gsum sdig sgrib dag /thun mong ma yin dbang bzhi thob/ /rang lus zag med bde bas rgyas/ /ye shes lus la mgon por bskyed/ /shar phyogs khyams la rdo rje'i rigs/ /khro bo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /mdog dmar phyag g.yas rdo rje bsnams/ /g.yon pa ra ga'i bum pa bsnams/ /sbrul dang rin chen sna tshogs brgyan/ /me ri 'bar ba'i rlong ①dkyil gnas/ /g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bzhengs pa'o/ /yum kyang mdog dmar rdo rje dang / /bum pa 'dzin cing yab la 'khyud/ /khro zhing cung zad dgyes par bsam/ /lho phyogs su ni rin chen rigs/ /yab yum g.yas pa rin po che/ /g.yon na che'i bum pa bsnams/ /nub phyogs budha'i khro bo ni/ /yab yum g.yas pa 'khor lo ste/ /g.yon pa che'i bum pa bsnams—/ /byang shar 'phrin las khro bo ni/ /yab yum g.yas pa rgya gram bsnams—/ /g.yon pa che'i bum pa bsnams/ /dbus kyi steng dang 'og tu ni/ /khro bo yab yum g.yas pa ni/ /pad+ma 'dab lnga bsnams pa ste/ /g.yon pa che'i bum pa'o/ /phyogs bzhi khro bo gnyis gnyis bsgom/ /rgyan dang cha lugs sku mdog rnams/ /shar phyogs bzhin du bsam par bya/ /sgo ma bzhi ni mdog dmar zhing / /zhal ni phyir gzigs khro mo'o/ /gtso bo lnga dang khro bcu'i/ /bum pa dag la dmigs nas ni/ /gsang ba'i sngags ni bzlas par bya/ /oṃ hri hūṃ swa bye a/ dza hūṃ baṃ ho/ a pa ra mi ta a yu dzha sken ma ha si ti/ ha sa ni ri swā hā/ de skad ma yengs bzlas pa yis/ /bum pa'i chu rgyun spyi bor phog /47—278

sdig sgrib dag nas dbang bzhi thob/ /de nas rang nyid yab yum du/ /gsal la gsang ba'i sngags bzlas so/ /shar dang byang shar mtshams su ni/ /bum pa lhar gnas gong bzhin bsam/ /rang dang lha rnams sngags zlos bsam/ /'chi med bdud rtsis bum pa khengs/ /rjes su lha rnams zhu ba'i chus/ /rang gzhan thams cad khrus bya'o/ /de yis mchog dang thun mong gi/ /dngos grub thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de nas kho na nyid 'di bsgrub/ /lus gnad gtum mo bzhin du bya/ /rang nyid mgon por gsal ba yis/ /gsang gnas chos 'byung gru gsum du/ /triḥdang ram̐ las me 'bar bas/ /khong pa'i nang rnams thams cad khengs/ /spyi bo haṃ brgyad zhu ba las/ /bde chen bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ /rtsa rnams khengs pas bde ba rgyas/ /drod dang bde ba'i khyad par kun/ /steng 'og rlung gi gnad ces bya/ /rta bdun ri bong rgyas btab nas/ /mthar thug lhun grub rnam gsum thob/ /bcu gsum sa rnams rdzogs par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa'i bsgrub thabs/ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma grub pa'i rgyal mos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //47—279

༄/ /tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ces bya ba/ ba༄/ tshe dpag med kyi dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhugs so// ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ a pa ra mi ta a yu dzha na maṇa ḍal bhe ti na ma/ bod skad du/ tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ces bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang bzhin tshe dpag med pa'i sku//ye shes lnga ldan gsung gi bdag /thugs rje'i thugs kyis rjes 'dzin pa'o/ /bla ma tshe dpag med la 'dud/ /rtsa rgyud bshad rgyud las byung ba'i/ /cho ga bzang pos yongs bzung bshad/ /slob dpon mtshan nyid kun ldan zhing / /gzhan phan bsgrub pa'i blo gros can/ /rang dang gzhan gyi don bsgrub phyir/ /yid 'ong nyams dga'i gnas nyid du/ /lha'i rnal 'byor gsal ba dang / /gtso bo 'bum la 'khor rnams dza/ /rab 'bring mtshan ma thob pa dang / /slob mas me tog dang bcas pas/ /gus pas gsol ba gdab par bya/ /17—281

de nas dkyil 'khor bri ba'i phyir/ /sa gzhi brtag cing sbyang dang bzung //nyes nga/ med nga/'i sa phyogs 'dir/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa gsal byas nas/ /baṃ las/ bskyed nga/'i lha mo ser/ /mdzes pa'i rgyan ldan lus phyed snang / /bum pa 'dzin 'a/ ma/chod cing bstod/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyis/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur / /spyob nga/ shākya seng ge yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ /lag nga/ sa 'a bsnun pa 'a/sa/ /dga' ba'i mdangs ldan lha mo yis/ /khyod ni slob dngo/na mchog yin kyis/ /dkyil 'khor las ni rab tu bsgrubs/ /brjod nas/ sa/ la thim nga/ra lta/ /phyogs skyong gtor ma dbul ba dang / /'thun pa'i grogs dang gsol ba gdab/ /ro bsal nyes pa spangs pa de/ /'thas par bcag cing rnam lnga dang / /bdud rtsi lngas ni khyab par byug /me yis sbyang dang sngags kyis ni/ /byin brlabs lha'i khang par bsam/ /bskyed pa'i yan lag kun rdzogs pas/ /slob dpon dkyil 'khor steng 'dug la/ /slob ma gus pas spos thogs te/ /mchod cing bstod dang gsol ba gdab/ /bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med/ /skyon gyis ma gos li khri ltar/ /mnga' dang mnyam pa'i sgu mnga' ba/ /mnyam nyid sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /yon tan ma lus bskyed mdzad cing / /yid bzhin nor bu mtshungs ldan pa'i/ /'gro ba spyob la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /tshe dpag med pa gsung gi bdag /'chi bdag ma lus 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /tshe'i dngos grub gsol ba'i sku/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /dkyil (7—282

'khor bsdus te rta mchog skur/ /khro zhing brjid pa'i nga rgyal dang / /rkang pa hūṃ las rdo rjer byas/ /mig gnyis nyi zla 'bar ba ste/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yis / /'jigs med byang shar mtshams 1song nas/ /dkyil 'khor sa gzhi la gnas pa'i/ /lha dang lha min bgegs tshogs nyon/ /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /nga yi bka' las ma 'da' bar/ /bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'bro bar gyis/ /gal te mi 'gro 'dug gyur na/ /ye shes rdo rje 'bar ba yis/ /mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas shing / /lus rnams stong du gyur nas ni/ /rnam par 'joms par gdon mi za/ /de bas khyed rnams gzhan du dengs/ /rta mchog sngags dang rdo rje'i 'gros/ /dkyil 'khor lan gsum bsko ra bar bya/ /de nas khro bo'i phur pa rnams/ /ki la ya zhes btab nas kyang / /a ko ta yis brdung bar bya/ /me bye sngags kyis byin gyis brlab// //sa'i lha dang lha tshogs rnams/ /sta gon gnas par bya ba ni/ /lha rnams rdzogs par bskyed pa dang / /mchod cing bstod de spos thogs la/ /bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad dang / /rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can/ /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa dang / /slob ma rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /rdo rje can bdag che ge zhes/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bzhengs su gsol/ /rjes su brtse bar nyer dgongs nas/ /sang nub dgyes par byon par 'tshal/ /de nas phyi nang mchod pas mchod/ /dkyil 'khor lhag par gnas pa'o// //rin chen rgyu las byung ba'i/ /lto che mgrin pa ring ba dang / /mchu 47—283

'phyang nag po ra ri med/ /lha grangs mnyam pa las bum dang / /rang rang phyag mtshan rdzogs par bya/ /ha sa dhe ba gser dngul dang / /mu tig mu men byi ru bzhug/ /nas til gro sran mud ka dang / /ga bur dza ti mud ka mchog /ga bur dza ti gur gum/ dang / /tsan dan gnyis dang a ka ru/ /mar dang bu ram sbrang rtsi dang / /lan tsha rnams kyis lto ba dgang / /kha tshar ma nyams ras gzungs kyis/ /mgrin nga/ rab tu brgyan pa dang / /kha rgyan ku sha 'bras bu can / /sna tshogs pad+ma ras kyi steng / /yang na ku sha gdan la bzhugs/ /bye las/ bskyed pa'i gzha'/ yas khang / /chu skyes nyi zla'i gdan stengs su/ /lha rnams rdzogs par bskyed nga/ dang / /sngags bzlas/ ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /bum pa gang bar bsam/ pa dang / /lha rnams rang rang bstod pa bya/ /las bum rta mgrin babyed nga/ dang / /sngags bzlas bar chad bsrung ba dang / /sha lnga bdud rtsi gtor mas mchod/ /'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab / /2slob ma lhag par gnas pa yang / /snyim pas me tog bcas pa'i skye rga 'chi ba na khra yi/ /chu srin la sogs 'jigs rung ba/ /srid pa'i mtsho las bdag sgrol mdzod/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa po/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen por tshul bstan pa'i/ /mgon po chen bor bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de ni bdag la gsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la gsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum de ni bdag la gsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /'od kyis bur byas sdig pa sbyang / /bu tshur theg pa chen po yis/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga 77—28‘1

ni / /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /sgu gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /sangs rgyas dus gsum 'byung ba rnams/ /rdo rje gsang sngags rab bsgoms pas//ye shes mnyam med yang dag brnyes/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /drag po chen po bdud kyi sde/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di kyis shig /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa/ /sngon du 'gro ba'i cho ga bya/ /tshe dang/ga med pa bdag la dgongs/ /ma lus bzhugs pa'i bde gshegs rnams/ /'di nyid nas bzung sangs rgya bar/ /bla med bdag la gzigs par mdzod// //dam tshig sdom pa bzung ba ni/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bya/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du lan drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos kyang bzung bar bya/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis brtan par bzung bar bgyi/ /gnyis su med pa'i tshangs spyod dang / /rang gis dam tshig bsrung bar bgyi/ /bdag gi dge 47—285

———ba'i las rnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas myur du bsgrub byas te/ /sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /bla med gnas su sgol bar bgyi/ /gus pas lan gsum brjod nga/ra bya/ /dpral ba mgrin pa snying kha ru/ /dri'i thig le gsum byas te/ /rta bdun chu skyes 'khor lo'i steng / /thugs gsung sku'i snying pos brgyan/ /rigs kyi lha las 'od 'phros pas/ /ye shes gnyis su med par bstem/ /chu gnyis mngon du 'gro bas/ mchod/ /deng nas bzung nas bu khyod kyis/ /'khor ba'i nyes par ma gos par / /mchod pa kun dang ldan pa ni/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /a shwad tha dang pa la sha /u dum 'bar ba la sogs pa/ /bcu gnyis sor gyi tshad dag la//rtse mo me tog gis brgyan nas/ /maṇa ḍal 'dab brgyad rnam lngas brgyan/ /shar ltas dbus su dor ba ni/ /pad+ma'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ /steng du mchog gi dngos grub yin/ /phyogs su 'phrin las 'grub pa yin/ /'thur ltas sa 'og 'grub pa yin/ /'tshams su 'jig rten dngos grub po/ /de nas skyor chu sbyin pa ni/ /oṃ triḥbi shudha dharma sarba pa ba tsar+ya bi sho dha ya bi ka la pa a na ya hūṃ/ zhes pas ngag sbyangs nas/ skud pa dmar po gsum sgril la/ /rta mgrin sngags kyis bcing bar bya/ /ku sha gtsang ma sngas dang stan/ /ma nor seng ge'i nyal stangs bzhin/ /thub pas ting 'dzin 'grub pa ltar/ /mtshan ma gang byung brjod par bya/ /bzang na dngos grub spro ba bskyed/ /ngan na sbyin sreg gis bzlog go/ /zab cing rgya che'i chos bshad ni/ /'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag/u dum 'bar ba'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam na ni res dga' zhig /res dga' 'byung ngam mi 'byung srid/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni shin tu dkon/ /17—286

bla ma rdo rje can mchod la/ /nang par langs te dkyil 'khor la/ /nam mkhar btegs te thig gdab te/ /bu mo gtsang ma sdom ldan gyis/ /ras bal gang byung skal ba dang / /ye shes lnga 'am sku gsung thugs/ /oṃ aḥspyo na a nu ga ta sarba dharmā/ brjod nas sgril bar bya ba ni/ /pad+ma'i snod du bzhag nas kyang / /mi 'chi lnga yis sbangs byas la/ /blo ldan ye shes bstim byas nas/ /nam mkhar ye shes dza dza gdab/ /sgo'i bcu gnyis cha dang ldan/ /srid kyang khang pa gnyis 'gyur la/ /tshangs pa'i las thig drangs byas la/ /oṃ badz+ra su kra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma hūṃ/ tshangs dang zur thig la sogs pa/ /bstan bcos mthong zhing blo ldan des/ /cha ni gang yin rnam pa dbye/ /gal te nyes pa'i 'bras bu ni/ /chad na bla ma'i srog g.yo zhing / /dman lhag nad kyis btab par 'gyur/ /phyogs 'khrul slob ma rmongs par 'gyur/ /blo ldan nyes pa med par bya/ /gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bcas/ /dra ba dra ba phyed pas brgyan/ /nyi zla dril bu er khas brgyan/ /pho brang chu skyes rim pa gnyis/ /mu khyud pad+ma'i phreng ba dang / /'khyams dang phyi rol pad ra dang / /rdo rje me ri la sogs pa/ /rnam pa ma lus rdzogs par bri/ /rin chen lnga dang 'bru phye'i/ /pad+ma'i snod du so sor bzhag /sa bon bris la ye shes bstem/ /sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlab/ /sngon po ser po dkar po ljang / /dmar po 'di ni nang du 'dod/ /g.yas bskor rgyun ma chad par bri/ /dbang ldan 'tshams 1su drang bar bya/ /pad+ma'i snod kyi steng nas bkab/ /'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni rab sgol byed/ /bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med/ /tshon gyi las ni yang dag brtsam/ /me tog dor la 47—287

mtshan ma brtag /shar sngo lho ser nub dkar po/ /byang phyogs in tra ni la'i mdog /pad+ma lha rnams dmar po'o/ /de ltar rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /khrus byas dri zhim lus byugs nas/ /gos bzangs brgyan la lan gsum bskor/ /tshe dpag med pa'i nga rgyal gyis/ /shar gyi sgo nas nang du zhugs/ /yid kyis sgo bzhi dbye bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra mud gha ta sa ma ya pra be+e sha ya hūṃ/ rnam rgyal la sogs bum nga/ rnams/ /gnas dang go rim bzhin du dgod/ /sna tshogs gos dang rgyan rnams bre/ /mchod pa'i rdzas kyis legs par brgyan/ /dkyil 'khor lha rnams rdzogs par bskyed/ /ye shes bstems la mchod bstod bya/ /tshogs kyi 'khor los tshim pa dang / /bar chad zhi phyir shar phyogs su/ /zhi ba'i sbyin bsreg bya ba dang //slob ma'i cho ga ji lta bar/ /slob dpon bdag nyid dbang dang ldan/ /shar gyi phyogs nas 'jug pa dang / /de nas slob ma gzhugs pa'i phyir/ /khrus byas bgegs dang sdig pa sbyang / /gdong pa ras kyis bkab nas ni/ /bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ /bdag ni skal bzangs rigs yin no/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sgu/ /slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi/ /gtso bo lha mor bcas pa yi/ /lha rnams kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /de nas slo ba dngo na gyis 1lha la tshig 'dis gsol ba gdab/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /tshe dpag med pa'i grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bya/ /oṃ a khaṃ bhi ra hūṃ/ me tog phreng ba gtad pa dang / /dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal te/ /oṃ na ma te hūṃ/ oṃ na ma mi hūṃ / na mo na ma hūṃ swā hā/ shar nas zhugs dang lho nas dbang / /nub 17—288

nas chos bshad byang nas ni/ /'phrin las bsgrub pa la sogs pa'i/ /don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu dza u pa thā na ya ad ma rgo/nisu ta ya mi sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra satwa asteṣ+ṭha sa saṃ/ o sarba ta thā ga ta pu dza a bhi she ka 1 ta ad ma rgo nir+ya ta ya mi sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra rad na a bhi shiñtsa saṃ/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu dza pra bar dha na ya ad ma rgo nit+yā ta ya mi sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dha ma rgo pra bar dha na mo/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu dza karma rgo ad ma rgo nir+ya ta ya mi sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra karmā ku ru saṃ/ dam tshig sdom pa sbyin pa dang / /rnal 'byor du ni sems bskyed de/ /o sarba yo ga tsi ta u pa ta ya mi/rdo rje snying gar bzhag te/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya sto sidha badz+ra ya tha su khaṃ/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / /tshe dpag med kyi dngos grub thob/ /dngos grub gzhan lta ci zhig smos/ /dkyil 'khor ma zhugs mi smra'o/ /dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ /'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste/ /gal te khrod kyis smras gyur na/ /dam tshig chen po'i rdo rje yis/ /rang gi mgo bo 'gas par 'gyur / /tshe dpag med pa deng khyod kyi/ /snying la de ring yang dag zhugs/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na bsreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub rnams/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /badz+ra uḥka oṃ āḥhūṃ/de nas sreng maṇa ḍal phul nas gsol ba gdab brtsams nas bu khyod kyi/ /tshe dpag med pa nga yin gyis/ /khyod kyis nga la brnyas pa na/ /mi bde ma spangs dus byas nas//dmyal bar ltung bar gyur ta re/ /de nas slob ma'i gtso bo yis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /bdag la byin gyis rlobs mdzod la/ /tshe 47—289

———dang/ga med pa dbab par mdzod/ /rkang mthil rlung gi dkyil 'khor dzño/ /snying kha waṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor/ /mgrin par baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor/ /spyi bor yo las rlung dang haṃ/ /de'i spyi bor tshe dpag med/ /yab yum 'od kyi rang bzhin du/ /gar byed sku las ye shes kyi/ /bdud rtsi bab nas lus la thim / /zag med bde bas gang bar bsgom/ /oṃ hriḥbye badz+ra dzñā na a yu she aḥste tho 1ya ste pa ya ste pa ya rā rā tsa la ya tsa la yā/ hūṃ hā aḥdh+ri/ zhes brjod rol mo'i sgra dang / gu gul zla mtshan thod pa ru/ /dur khrod sol ba'i me yis bsreg /bab gyur zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /a las gsung gi rdo rje bsam/ /'bru hi badz+ra/ dge dang mi dge la sogs pa/ /smyos shig rdo rje can kyi rigs/ /steṣ+ṭa badz+ra brtan par bya'o/ /tshe dpag med pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rig pa'i me tog 'di dor bas/ /sngon tshe ye shes brnyes pa'i lha/ /gang yin de la 'bab par shog /pra ti tsha badz+ra ho/ bye brag dngos grub brtag par bya/ /pra ti byut+na sa mi saṃ swa ta ma hā bha la/ slob ma'i mgo la bcing bar bya/ /tshe dpag rnged pa deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed pa ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /oṃ badz+ra nai tra ya ha ra pa tai lo hriḥ/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la lhos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /khyed ni tshe dpag med du skye/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs / /'gro ba phun sum tshogs pa kun/ /thams cad 'di las mngon du 'gyur/ /dngos grub thob cing dam tshig bsrungs/ /gsang sngags la yang brtson par gyis/ /rims kyis rnam par dag par bstan/ /de nas slob ma dad ldan des/ /bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ /(7—290

yon mchog dam pa 'bul ba dang / /dbang bsgur don du gsol ba gdab/ /bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med/ /yab yum gnyis med bde chen sgu/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun kyis/ /dbang bskur ba ni bdag la gsol/ /lan gsum brjod nas shar phyogs su/ /slobam/pad+ma 'dab brgyad khri la 'dug /rnam rgyal bum pa la sogs nas/ /chu rnams dung chos bum par bsdu/ /rdo rje'i glu dang rol mo'i sgra/ /rigs lnga rig ma'i lha mo dang / /byang chub sems dpas bkra shis brjod/ /khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bsrung ngo / /gsang gsum dam tshig las byung ba'i/ /ye shes bdud rtsi dri ma med/ /lha'i chu ni dag pa yi/ /mi skyod rdo rje'i dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra a bye tiṣ+ṭha dzu na a bhe shiñtsa hūṃ/ gser la sogs pa'i dbu rgyan la/ /rin 'byung bskyed cing ye shes bstem / /dar dpyangs bcings la tshig 'di brjod/ /thor tshugs cod pan gyis brgyan pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab bsngags pa'i/ /rin chen dbu rgyan dam pa dang / /dar dpyangs dbang bsgur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rad na mu gu ta a r+bha shiñtsa me/ rin chen la sogs rdo rje la/ /snang ba mtha' yas bskyed cing bstem/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring khyed la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis bzung / /oṃ badz+ra a ti pa ti lto a bhi shiñtsa mo/ dril bu don grub bskyed byas la/ /ye shes bstims la tshig 'di brjod/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan pa yi/ /'gro don mnyam med byed pa yis/ /mchod pa'i 'phrin las sdogs byed pa'i/ /dril bu las kyi dbang bsgur ro/ /oṃ a bye pa ta ya 1a bhi shiñtsa saṃ/ slob ma oṃ las rnam snang bskyed/ /ye shes spyan drangs gnyis su med/ /47—29/

rdo rje ming gi dbang bsgur bas/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du ni/ /cis kyang gzhom/ par mi nus pas/ /rdo rje ming du rab tu grags/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bye she ka ta saṃ/ chu dang cod pan rdo rje dang / /dril bu dang ni ming gi dbang / /rig pa yi ni dbang lnga'o/ /nyon mongs lnga ni rnam dag pas/ /dbang bsgur lnga ni thob pa yin/ /ma rig pa las 'das nas kyang / /ye shes lnga ni rims kyis thob/ /nangabi dbang de nas spyi bo mgrin pa dang / /snying kha lte ba gsang gnas rnams/ /'khor lo lnga'i gnas nyid du/ /rigs lnga tshe dpag med rnams kyis/ /dbang bsgur lha rnams yab yum de/ /'chi med byang chub sems/ su 'gyur/ /rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga rnams gang / /byang chub sems kyi dbang bsgur ro/ /'chi med rdo rje'i lus/ su gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sku ru bsgom / /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na 'dug /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /rdo rje sems dpa'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sibye badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e shang dha ra ya mi hi hi hūṃ/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che / /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul dag pa'i bdag/dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag1 /ngo bo nyid kyi dngos bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems/ dpa' ni/ /mchog gi srid pa byed par 'gyur/ /mtshan ma med par 'gro ba'i gsolab gdab don/ /gang dag bdag gis byed nus pas/ /phyir mi ldog pa dbang bskur che/ /dpa' bo chen 77—292

pos bdag la gsol/ /shar du seng ge'i khri la 'dug /steng du gdugs dkar phub nas kyang / /rnam rgyal bum pas dbang bskur te/ /dbang bskur rdo rje chen po la/ /khams gsum pa yis phyag byas te/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum kyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra a bhi she ka 1a bhi shiñtsa saṃ/ dril bu glegs bam lag tu gtad/ /'phrin las thogs pa med pa rnams / /bu yis gzhan don bla med byos/ /khyod ni rdo rje slob dpon yin/ /chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur ro/ /lha'i snying po lan gsum brjod/ /me tog phreng ba spyi bor bzhag /bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyis/ /bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol/ /bcom ldan bdag gis sbyin lags kyis/ /bdag la go bar mdzad du gsol/ /'jig rten khams ni ma lus par/ /sems can ma lus drang ba'i phyir/ /chags pa med pa'i bsam pa yis ji ltar gdul bya sna tshogs la/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis/ /de bzhin rigs kyis gang 'dul ba/ /khyod kyi 'phrin las mchog yin no/ /de nas bzung nas bu khyod kyis/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang bsad pa la/ /dgug 4dang bcing dang bsreg pa dang / /bskrad pa dbye ba la sogs pa/ /'phrin las sna tshogs 'grub par gyis/ /ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang / /mchil lham de bzhin ri lu ste/ /mi snang bcud len mkha' la spyod/ /thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa/ /de dag khyed kyis 'grub par bya/ /ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal bo yis / /'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ḍa lo hriḥchos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la dri ma med/ /gzung du 47—293

med cing brjod du med/ /chos rnams de ltar shes par gyis/ /ho yis mda' gzhu phyogs bzhir 'phang / /sas nga ba'i dbang mtshan mo gnas khang dbain pa ru/ /bzhin bzangs mig yangs lang tshor ldan/ /lus la dri yis byug byas te/ /brtse dang rgod pa la sogs pas/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis phab te/ /nor bu byang chub sems ltung bas/ /nya phyis dung chos la sogs su/ /drir bcas slob ma'i kha ru ni/ /the bong srin lag dag gis/ sbyin/ /a ho su kas de btung ngo / /zag med bde chen lus la rgyas/ /rdo rje ro yis nyon mongs 'joms/ /thes rab ye thes kyi dbang mtshan ldan shes rab rang bzhin te/ lha mo 'di ni phyag rgya che/ /mtha' yas bde ba sbyin pa mo/ /rnam pa kun du phyag rgya long / /bu yis bla med mchod par gyis/ /yol bas bar bcad snyoms 'jug gis/ /bsrub dang bsrub pa'i spyor ba yis/ /mi rtog ye shes skye bar 'gyur/ /ba'ipaltos shig ltos shig sems la ltos/ /sems nyid cir yang grub pa med/ /bsal bzhag dgag bsgrub gang yang med/ /'di ni rang rig ye shes yin// //'u nga bstan bla ma sprul pa'i sgur bstan te/ /chos gos bzung la lung bstan bya//rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa'i mtha' ni grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro nyid las bton/ /'di ni ngas khyod lung bstan yin/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid dhi sa ma ya sto bhur bu ba swa/ thugasadabang khams gsum pa ni rgyal srid che/ /rgyal ba'i bdag por bstan pa dang / /des ni bdud las rnam rgyal zhing / /grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin/ /gzengs stod deng bdag skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ /bdag gi gson pa'ang 'bras bur bcas/ /(7—294

de ring sangs rgyas sras su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to/ /rta dang glang po ma he dang / /bu dang chung ma sogs dang dbyig /phyag byas bla ma dam pa la/ /ma zhen sems kyis dbul bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod bya ste/ /tshogs kyis rnal 'byor tshim byas la/ /lhag mas 'byung po tshim pa dang / /bkra shis brjod cing smon lam gdab/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba dang / /rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pa yis/ /rdul tshon chu bo chen por dor / /dri bzangs kyis ni thig 'phyis 1te/ /lhag chad bskang phyir sbyin sreg bya / /cho ga bzang po yongs bzung 'di/ /rtsa rgyud le'u 'bum pa dang / /bshad rgyud 'od zer dra ba las/ /brten nas grub pa'i rgyal mos mdzad/ /de yis dge ba gang yod pas/ /rigs drug sems can ma lus pa/ /tshe dpag med pa'i lam zhugs nas/ /de yis 'bras bu myur thob shog /bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor gye cho ga bzang po yongs su bzung ba zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi paṇa ḍi ta zla ba bzang po dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba glan dar ma tshul khrims kyis bsgyur zhing zhus te dag par byas sto// //47—295

tu med pa'i dkyil 'gor gyi cho ga jes bya ba/stig tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i dkyil chog bzhugs so// ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ a pa ra mi ta bha ga bā ti a yu dzñā na/ maṇ+ḍa la be+e ti na ma/bod skad du/ bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor rmi cho ga zhes bya ba/ mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dad ldan mgon la gus pa yi②/ /nags 'dab chu gling mgon par ni/ /rang dang slob ma'i don gyi phyir/ /bsnyen pa sa chog blusta gon dang / /dkyil 'khor chen po bsgrub par bya/ /de la dang po bsnyen pa ni/ /rab dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dngos su mthong ba'amarka/ 'bring rmi lam du mthong ba/ tha ma yang lung bstan thob pa'o/ /grangs kyi bsnyen pa ni/ rab 'bum tsho bdun/ 'bring gsum/ tha ma khri'am/bla ma'i rjes gnang thob pa'o/ /47—297

sa'i cho ga ni rgyud las/ sa ni brtag dang blang ba dang / /sbyang dang byin brlabs pa'o/ /ces gsungs so/ /dang po sa brtag pa ni/ phyogs kyi sa brtag te/ grong khyer gyi byang shar ram shar du'o/ /sa'i mtshan nyid ni/dkar / dmar/ ser/ ljang / byang shar du 'jol ba/ tsha sgo sa'i nyes pa med pa'o / /lto 'phye ni g.yon gyis nyal te/ lto bar chud par bya'o/ /sa blang ba ni/ 'jig rten dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'o/ /dang po mngon pa la bslang ba ni/ gzhi de'i sa bdag rgyal po la sogs pa la'o/ /mi mngon pa la spyir blang ba ni/ sa gzhan nas bslang ba'am/ ras kyi steng bu tū/dri'i thig le dang / me tog gi tshom bu byas la mchod pa lnga dang / gtor ma gsum gsham ⑤mo/ /de nas stong pa'i ngang las rang skad cig gis tshe dpag tu med par bskyed/ thugs kha'i s+thāḥlas 'od 'phros/ nam mkha' la lha tshogs rnams spyan drangs par bsams la mchod pa dang bstod pa bya/ bar chad med par gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma yang phyogs skyong dang lha srin sde brgyad dang gzhi bdag la sbyin no/ /bye brag tu sa'i lha mo la sa blang ba ni/ maṇ+ḍal ①dbus su dri'i thig le'i steng du me tog gi tshom bu dgod/ de nyid paṃ las sa'i lha mo/ sku mdog gser gyi rang bzhin dbu skra g.yas su 'khyel pa/ lte ba yan chod sa las byung zhing / phyag gnyis bum pa bsnams pa bskyed la/ ye shes kyi lha mo spyan drang ba ni/ hūṃ tshur byon tshur byon lha mo che/ /sa mchog rjolha mo 'jig rten yum/ /47—298

rin chen rgyan gyis rab gang ba'i/ /rgyan mchog ut+pal rab tu mdzes/ /phyag zhabs mgul rgyan gser gyis brgyan/ /sangs rgyas tshogs rnams rab mchod pa'i—/ /gser mdog lha mo chen mo khyod/ /phrin las bsgrub phyir gshegs su gsol—/ /ces brjod la mchod yon dbul ba ni/ lha mo khyod ni byon pa legs—/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ pra ti argo sa ma ya hūṃ / ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis lha'i chu/ /dag pa yis ni sku khrus gsol/ /pra ba sad ka ra tī dza hūṃ/ ces pas khrus gsol/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bkyid na/ /de srid lha mo bzhugs su gsol/ /pad+ma ka ma la hūṃ zhes pas gdan dbul lo/ /de nas dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ①dam tshig pa la ye shes lha mo dgug gzhug cing mnyes par bya/de la mchod pa dbul/ sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs la/ lha mo'i ljags zug par bsams la/ oṃ pra tri bh+ya na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo/ bi sha mu khe bye/ sarba tad khaṃ ud ga te sga ra na hi oṃ ga gha na khaṃ gyi na tai ba ṣ+ṭi ta kha kha khā hi khā hi swā hā/ lnga'am bdun gyis phul la/ mnyes pa la bstod pa bya ba ni/khyod ni sa 'dzin lha mo ste/ /sku phyed 'thon po gser gyi mdog /rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan/ /sa 'og lha mo khyod la 'dud/ /gsol ba gdab pa ni/ sa la rgyu ba'i lha klu dang / /gang yang sa la gnas pa rnams/ /sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /byams pa'i sems kyis gnang bar mdzod/ /ces brjod pas gnang ba byin par bsam/ ye shes pa gshegs la dam tshig pa 47—299

bstem mo/ /de nas sa ①sbyang ba bshad par bya ste/ nad rnams mi 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir—/ sa khru gang la sogs pa rkos la/ rus pa dang gyo ②mo la sogs pa bsal bar bya'o/ /de nas yang bdag nyid 'od dpag med kyis ④nga rgyal gyis/ sangs rgyas rnams nam mkha' la bltas te/ de dag gi bdud rtsi bkug la/ sa phyogs gser kyi sa gzhi g.ya' dag par bsams la/ oṃ puṣ+pe puṣ+pe ma hā puṣ+pe/ a pa ra mi ta a yu dzñā su bi ni tsi ta te dz+wa ra dza ya swā hā/ zhes lnga 'am gsum brjod par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi rgya ni khru bzhi pa byas nas/ spangs ni ci 'byor pa'o—/ /de nas sa gzhi dri bzangs kyi chus me long gi ngos ltar byas la/ bla bres dang yol ba dang / 'od dpag med kyi gzungs rnams bzhugs so/ /de nas rang dang slob mas rgyud dang gzungs rnams klag par bya'o/ /spro na zhi ba'i sbyin bsreg kyang lan gsum bya'o/ /de la rjo'ang slob ma la dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba dang / 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang / 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs rnams brjod la/ thun mong gi skyabs 'gro so so ⑤thar pa'i sdom pa rnams dbog /khyad par gyi skyabs 'gro dang / byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par bya'o/ /de ni sa'i cho ga rnams bstan to/ /de nas sta gon bshad par bya ste/ de yang slob dpon bdag nyid 47—300

dgongs ka'i dus su khrus byas/ ras dmar pos lus kyi stod g.yogs/ smad g.yogs byas la/ dkyil 'khor gyi ①dbus su bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas/rta mchog gi bdag bskyed nas bzung ste/ gsang bsgrub yan chad bzlas pa dang bcas pa rgyud dang bsgrub thabs ltar bsgom②/ de nas shar phyogs kyi yum sems dpa' dang bcas pa dang / lho dang nub dang byang gi yum sems dpa' dang bcas pas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ nyon mongs 'dam gyis ①tshogs nang du//thar med bying bar gyur pa yi/ /'gro kun ma lus don phyir dang / /tshe zad tshe nyams nad kyis gzir/ /skyabs med nyams thag gyur pa yi/ /sems can rnams la phan don du/ /bcom ldan mgon po chen po yis/ /'chi med rnga sgra chen po rnams/ /gsung mchog tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ /de ring bdag la bsgrag tu gsol/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun rnams/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bos bdag la gsol/ /zhes phyogs bzhi nas spos dang dril bu thogs nas gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de nas bsgom pa'i dkyil 'khor rdo rje 'degs ④/pa'i sngags dang phyag rgyas nam mkhar bteg la slob dpon bdag nyid dpal rta mgrin rta mgo ljang nag /dbyug pa dang sdigs 'dzub me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i nga rgyal kyis langs te/ rkang pa gnyis t+t+waṃ las rdo rje rgya gram/ mig gnyis su ma dang ṭa las/ nyi ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor kyi steng du hūṃ re re/ min 'tshams su nyi zla 'dres pa'i steng du hūṃ cig bsamaske/ mig gnyis dang smin 'tshams kyi hūṃ rnams rdo rje re rer gyur te/de'i lte bar s+thāḥdamar po re re bsam/ de las rta mgrin dpag tu med pa mang po spros pas/ bgegs rnams bsreg pa'i bsams rjopas rdo rje dril bu thogs la/47—301

byang shar du dga' ba yongs su gyur pa'i 'gros kyis 'gro zhing / stong gsum thams cad g.yo ba'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas bgegs la bka' bsgo ba ni/ hūṃ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i/ /lha la sogs pa'i bgegs tshogs rnams nyon cig /nga ni gnas 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po 'bri/ /bgegs kyi rigs tshogs gang yin byer bar gyis/ /hūṃ hūṃ tweḥ phaṭa lan gsum bzlas la/ bdag rdo rje slob dpon ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ sa phyogs bzang po dri ma med pa 'dir/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor 'bri yis/ 'di na gnas pa'i lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin la sogs pa gang dag gnas pa de dag thams cad dengs shig /gang dag mi 'gro bar sems pa de dag /nga yi ye shes rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba yis/ mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes lan gsum brjod par bya'o/ /spros pa la dga' na g.yas rkyang ①la sogs pa'i stang stabs gsum pa bya'o/ /yang rta mchog gi nga rgyal gyis/ oṃ badz+ra pad+ma ta kri ta kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes brjod pa dang /kyil 'khor kyi phyogs mtshams su/ stod rta mgrin la/ smad phur par dmigs la/ dngos su btab pas phyogs skyong gi bgegs rigs la btab par bsam mo/ /de nas maṇ+ḍal de'i gas chags la sogs pa bsubs thul/ ba'i rnam lnga dang / bdud rtsi lnga dang / dri lnga yang byug par bya'o/ /de'i rjes su thig brgyad btab la dbus dang phyogs rnams su lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i dri'i thig le byas la/ me tog gi tshom bu bkod la dam tshig pa bskyed/ nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor yang bsres nas/ de la dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥye shes pa dgug gzhug cing mnyes 17—302

par byas la/ dbang bskur mchod pa dang bstod pa rgyas par bya'o/ /de ni lha lhag par gnas pa'o/ /de nas bum pa'i bshad pa bya ste/ de yang snga dro'i dus su rin po che'i bum pa rgyas par byed na lha grangs dang mnyam pa'am/ bsdus par byed na bum pa lnga la byas te/ khrus byas gtso bo'i bum pa la pad+ma 'dab ma lnga pa/ shar la rdo rje/ lho rin chen/ nub tu 'khor lo byang la rgya gram 'bri 'am yang na gdags par bya'o/ /de yang shin du bsdus pa na/ rnam rgyal dang las bum gnyis la bya'o/ /de ltar bum pa gu gul gyis bdug ①cing bgegs skrad/ras dmar po kha tshar ma nyams pas mgul chings byas la/ rin chen lnga/sman lnga/ 'bru lnga/ dri lnga/ snying po lnga blugs la/ ba dmar mo'i 'o ma dang /chu gtsang ma dang / dur ba yang drugs par bya'o/ /de la 'bras bu can gyi shing dang / rma bya'i mdongs kyi steng du bzhag nas mchod pa lnga lngas bkor ro/ /bkod pa'i rim pa ni gtso bo'i bum pa rdo rje me ris kyi nang dang / mda' yab kyi phyi'i shar du'o/ /'khor kyi bzhi po ni phyogs bzhir rdo rje ra ba dang gdugs kyi bar du'o/ /las bum ni bgegs kyi steng du bgod par bya'o/ /de nas skyed pa'i rim pa yang / las bum byang shar me ri'i steng du dri bzangs dang /rdo rje gzungs thag la dmigs pa ni bum pa'i nang du/ paṃ las pad+ma'i sdong po'i steng du/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du tweḥdamar po las 'od 'phros gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcad nas tshur 'dus pa las rdo rje dbyug pa tweḥmatshan par 'gyuraske/ de la rta mgrin zhal gcig phyag gnyis dbyug pa dang 47—303

sdigs 'dzub can/ me ri 'bar bas bgegs thams cad bsreg pa cig bsams la sngags bzlas 'od du mi bzhu bar dkyil 'khor chen po'i las ma grub kyi bar du bar chad bsrung du gsol ces 'phrin las gzhol lo/ /gtso bo'i bum pa bskyed pa yang phyi nang gi yab yum du bskyed/ shar/ lho/ nub/ byang gi bum par phyogs phyogs kyi lha rnams bskyed par bya'o/ /de yang bum pa gnyis la ni rnam rgyal bum par lha tshogs rnams bsgrub thabs bzhin bskyed par bya'o/ /las bum la ni gong bzhin no/ /des ni bum pa lhag nas bstan no/ /de nas spro na tsan dan gyi thab zlum po'am/ zla gam du/ gro dang nas dang yungs kar dang dkar gsum mngar gsum rnams bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs te—/ yab yum gyi zhal du phul bas zag pa ①med kyi bde bas rgyud gang bas mnyes te/ bdag gi sdig sgrib dang nad gdon thams cad zhi ba dang / tshe dang longs spyod thams cad rgyas par bsams la rtsa sngags la zhi rgyas kyi sham bu gdags par bya'o/ /de nas ye shes pa gshegs dam tshig pa mi dmigs par bya'o//sbyin bsreg lhag gnas so/ /de nas sa'i lha mo ni mchod bstod gtor ma rnams gong bzhin byas la mchod pa lngas mchod de/ lag pas spos thogs dpus pus ④mo sa la rtsugs la/ skyob ④pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi④/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par lam/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi sde/ /pham par byas 47—304

te dkyil 'khor bri/ /ces lan gsum brjod pas lha mos dpang por zhal gyis bzhes par bsam mo/ /de'i rjes su dam tshig pa bsdu/ ye shes pa gshegs par byas la yi ge brgya pa brjod par bya'o/ /de ni sa yi lhag gnas bstan to/ /de nas slob ma lhag gnas bshad par bya ste/ de yang slob ma rnams khrus byas—/ gos gtsang ma gyon la gu gul gyis bdug byung bgegs bskrad/ slob ma'i zan blud gtsang ma chang bu dang bcas pa chu gtsang mas bran nas gzi brjid chen mo'i ①sngags kyis bgegs la bka' bsgo bar bya'o/ /de nas yol ba'i phyi rol du slob ma rnams gral la 'khod pa rnams me tog dang bcas pas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i ②tshul bstan pa'i/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid sprul du gsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ste/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la gsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /ces lan gsum gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de nas blo dgug pa ni/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ /khrod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga 'di/ /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang / /da ltar bzhugs pa sdogs sangs rgyas/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa rnams/ /de dag kun kyis gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen pas/ /dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes/ /gsang 47—305

sngags spyod pa mnyam med pas/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces pa'i don yang bshad par bya'o/ /de nas nyan par rna gtad par bskul ba ni/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni/ /shin tu bsam pa bzang po'i yid kyis nyon/ /brjed ①nges blo la tshe dpag med sogs pa'i/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlob / /ces brjod pas 'jig rten gyi rtog pa thams cad spangs nas rtse gcig tu nyon cig pa'o/ /de nas lam yan lag lnga bya ba ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma rnams dang /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi spyan sngar/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa la 'gyod pa bskyed/phyis mi byed par dam bca'/ da lta'i sdig pa rnams rang bzhin med par shes pa'i sgo nas/ sems can thams cad dang thun mong du bdag gi sdig pa sbyang bar bya ste/ slob dpon gyi rjes bzlos bya ba ni/ bdag gi sdig pa bgyis pa dang / /bkyid rtsal rjes su yid rang gang / /sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su/ /de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /ces brjod do/ /de nas rang gzhan thams cad kyi dge ba la rjes su yid rang ba ni/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyi/ /bsgom dang bzlas brjod bsod nams la/ /de la bdag ni yi rang ngo / /de nas sangs rgyas tshe dpag med yab yum/ chos de'i zhal nas gsungs pa'i sngags/ dge 'dun rigs bzhi'i sems dpa' sgo ba dang bcas pa la skyabs 'gro bya ba ni/ 47—306

brjod nas slob ma la blud pas/ sdig sgrib dag nas bar chad kyis mi tshugs par bsam mo/ /de nas rta mchog gi nga rgyal gyis skud pa dmar po la mdud pa lnga byas la rta mgrin lngas bskor bar bsams la/ skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon/ bud med kyi g.yas la 'ching ba'i dus su pad+ma'i yig brgya brjod la gdags par bya'o/ /de nas chos bshad par bya ste/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams/ /u dum 'bar ①ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam yang ni res dga' zhig /'byung 'gyur ram ni mi 'byung srid/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga 'di/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gnyis med zab mo'i spyod yul 'di/ /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas byed/ /bskal pa grangs med mang por 'di/ /sngon du byas pa'i rnam smin rnams/ /zab mo'i dkyil 'khor 'di mthong bas②/ /de dag thams cad zad par 'gyur/ /de'i don yang dag par bshad do/ /de nas rtsa ku sha la oṃ tweḥrgyu badz+ra hūṃ zhes bzlas nas stan tu sbyin no/ /oṃ pubye pubye ma hā pubye/ a pa ra mi ta a yu dzñā na su bi ni swā hā/ ces brjod nas sngas su byin nas/ bla ma dang tshe dpag med la mos pa dang bcas pas nyol cig ces brjod do/ /nang par rmi lam dris la ngan na sbyin bsreg la sogs pas bzlog par bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyis/ dkyil 'khor kyi lha la/ mchod stod byas la spos dang rol mo dang bcas pas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bcom ldan tshe dpag med pa yi—/ /lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /bdag la brtse bas dgongs su gsol—/ /bdag la brtse bas dgongs nas kyang / /slob ma rnams la phan phyir 47—308

dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /sang ni dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la/ /de bas gnang bar mdzad par rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon brtse dang / /rang rgyal byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /gang dag la yi spyan mnga' ba/ /sems can bstan la dga' ba rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /sang ni bcom ldan tshe dpag med/ /mgon po'i dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di/ /cho ga bzhin du bri lags na/ /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kyis/ /byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ /ces lan gsum brjod par bya'o/ /sta gon kyi lha nam mkhar btegs la mchod bstod bya'o/ /de nas rang nyid gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis nyal bar bya'o/ /des ni sta gon gyi cho ga bstan no/ /de nas dkyil 'khor chen po'i cho ga bshad par bya ste/ dang po tshon sna lnga'i thi gu rigs lnga yab yum dang bcas pa bde stong dbyer med du byen gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas mkha' la ye shes kyi thig chen brgyad btab la mchod bstod byas la sta gon gyi dam tshig gi lha dang dbyer med du bsam①/ de ltar ye shes kyi thig gi rjes su/ dam tshig gi thig gdab pa ni/ slob dpon shar du lta/ slob mas nub tu ltas nas/ tshangs thig dang po gdab/ de nas lho/ byang / mtshams rnams su thig chen brgyad gdab/ de la bcu drug tu dgos nas/ gsum pa man chad la 'dab brgyad phyogs tshon dbus dmar po'o/ /bzhi pa khyams la shar dkar po 'am mthing ka'o/ /lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang khu'o/ /rtsig pa lnga 47—309

dang nang nas dmar ljang dkar ser sngo ba ldan pa/ 'dod yon dmar/ pha gu ser/ dra ba dra phyed sngo/ mda' yab dmar ba mchod rten dang ldan pa/ rta babs bzhi cha mchod rten du yod pa/ de la rdo rje me ris su 'bar ba dang bcas pa bri bar bya'o/ /de yang byang shar du slob dpon kyis ban reg sor brgyad bris nas pra brtag par bya'o—/ /de nas sku tsa ka li 'am/ me tog tshom bu bkod pa'am/ phyag mtshan rnams dgod do/ /de ltar sku gsung thugs gang bde bkod pa'i rjes la/ gtso bo'i bum pa shar phyogs rdo rje ra ba'i nang du'o/ /las bum byang shar me ris kyi steng du/ bum pa rgyas par 'god na gong bzhin no/ /de nas mchod pa dang gtor ma 'byor pa'i yo byad ci yod kyis dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' bskor ro/ /mda' dang phur pa dang / ral gri brgyad phyogs mtshams su brtsugs la/ steng 'khor lo ①rtsibs brgyad la phyogs dra mig tu yod par bya'o/ /de nas rang bskyed rdzogs rang ji lta ba bzhin du sgom/ dkyil 'khor dang bum pa'i nang du lha tshogs bskyed la/ sgrub thabs bzhin 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba la rang gis dbang slob ma la ji tsam bskur ba de blang bar bya'o/ /de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas la gos so ma gyon nas yol ba'i phyi rol du 'khod pa la bgegs bskrad/ kro ya dpung pa bzang po ltar gtor ma btang / de nas slob ma rnams phyag byas me tog dang bcas pas gong bzhin/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas/ ces gsol ba lan gsum du gdab par bya'o/ /de nas sdig pa bshags pa dang / rjes su yi rang ba la sogs pa yang gong bzhin du byas 47—310
