la—/ me tog dang bcas pa'i gsol ba gdab pa ni/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /thugs rje nyi ma ma lus pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni dgongs su gsol—/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yi/ /slob dpon ye shes spyan mnga' ba /sangs rgyas rol mo las byung ba'i/ /mi ldog 'khor lo'i 'byor pa ldan/ /thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog /gsang ba chen pos 'jug par bgyi/ /gsang ba mchog tu thams cad du/ /slob dpon kyis ni bdag gzhug 'tshal/ /phyir mi ldog par dbang bskur ba/ /bskal pa chen po bdag la gsol/ /mtshan rnams kun kyis rgyas gdab cing / /dpe byad rnams dang yang dag ldan/ /sangs rgyas sku ni yid 'ong ba/ /slob dpon chen po bdag la gsol/ /dbang bskur ba ni rmad byung che—/ /sems can kun kyi don gyi phyir/ /rtag tu bdag ni slob dpon 'gyur/ /slob dpon chen po bdag la gsol/ /ces lan gsum gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyis slob ma rnams la dri ba ni/ bcom ldan tshe dpag med pa yi/ /gsang ba chen po rigs dag par/ /gsang ba yongs su 'dzin pa ni//bdag nyid chen po khyod 'dod dam/ /slob mas 'tshal lags ces brjod do/ /de nas rigs kyi sdom pa'i dam bsgrag pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ste/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song / /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i/ /sdom pa brtan par gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /blo chen khyod kyis bzung bar bgyi/ /byang chub sems gang rdo rje des①/ /shes rab dril bu zhes bshad do/ /slob dpon nyid kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje rigs dag pa'i/ /sdom pa dam tshig yin par gsungs//rigs ⑤chen rigs mchog chen po la/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /zang 47—311

zing chos dang mi 'jigs byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par bshad/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bkyi/ /de las gzhan pa'i bcu bzhi ni/ /spang zhing dor bar mi bya ste/ /phas pham par ni rab tu bshad/ /rtsa ba'i rtsang ba zhes bshad do/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re bzhin du blang bar bya/ /gang tshe nyams gyur rnal 'byor pas/ /kha na ma tho sgom por 'gyur/ /khyod kyis srog chags gsad mi bya/ /ma byin par yang mi blang ngo / /'dod pa log par mi spyad cing / /brdzun du smra bar mi bya'o/ /phung khrol kun gyi rtsa ba ste/ /chang ni yongs su spang bar bya/ /sems can don phyir ma gtogs pa'i/ /bya ba ma yin thams cad spang / /dam pa nye bar brten bya zhing / /rnal 'byor pa rnams bsnyen bkur bya/ /lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang / /ngag gi las ni rnam bzhi dang / /yid kyi las ni rnam gsum po//ci nus par ni rnam par spongs/ /theg pa dman pa 'dod mi bya/ /sems can don la rgyab phyogs min/ /'khor ba dag kyang yongs mi spang / /rtag tu mya ngan 'da' mi bya/ /lha dang lha min gsang ba la/ /khyod ni brnyas par mi bya zhing / /phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang / /mtshan ma 'goms par mi bya zhing / /'di dag dam tshig yin par gsungs/ /'di la rtag tu mi 'da' bar/ /khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bar gyis/ /ces lan gsum brjod pa'i tshe/ slob mas mnyan par bya'o/ /de nas slob mas khas 'di skad blang ①bar bya ste/ slob dpon deng 'dir bdag la gson/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de ltar bdag gis bkyid 47—312

par 'tshal/ /ces lan gsum brjod par bya'o/ /de nas rigs lnga'i sdom pa khas blang ba ni/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems/ dpa' rnams/ /ji tsam dus nas bzung nas su/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol / /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas su/ /nam zhig byang chub snying po la/ /yongs su gnas kyi bar dag tu/ /bdag gis byang chub mchog gi sems/ /ma lus/ par ni bskyed par bgyi/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed nga/ra bgyi / /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la/ /tshu'/ khrims/ kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni bsdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims/ gsu/ma/ /bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /deng nas btsams 1te bzung bar bgyi/ /nam du yang ni mi spong ngo / /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po yi/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgye//rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen ngo/ las byung ba'i//pad+ma'i rigs mchog dag pa la/ /phyi dang gsang ba jeg pa gsu/ma/ /dam pa'i chos kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgye/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don kyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung / /ma grol ba rnams grol bar bgyi/ /ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi/ /dbugs ma dbyung ba (7—3/3

dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod/ /ces lan gsum brjod/de nas sems bskyed pa ni/ slob ma skad cig gis 1dpag med mgon por bskyed la/ rdo rjes dri'i thig le snying khar byas la/ de'i 2zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du bsams nas/ oṃ dīḥrgyu a yu dzñā na badz+ra yo ga tsit+ta ud pa ta ya mi/ces brjod pa ni kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems so/ /yang snying khar rdo rje bzhag la zla ba'i steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa sgom du gzhug /de nas oṃ badz+ra su ra te sa ma ya two bo bye tsit+ta ya de su khaṃ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ ces don dam byang chub tu sems bskyed par bya'o/ /de ltar slob ma lhar bskyed pa de sgu gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ mchod pa lnga dbul bar bya'o/ /de'i rjes la slob ma rnams/ shar sgo dang / lho sgo/ nub sgo / byang sgo rnams nas yid kyis gzhug par bya'o/ /de nas slob ma rnams la spro ba bskyed pa'i sgo nas dam bsgrag pa ni/ snying khar rdo rje bzhag la/ mi yi srid pa legs par thob/ /dus 'dir sangs rgyas rigs su chud/ /nga yis ye shes dbang byin pas/ /tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas thob/ /gang zhig 'di nyid ma mthong ba'i/ /mdun du smra bar ma byed cig /gal te smras na dam tshig nyams/ /des na mchog tu gsang bar gyis/ /lan cig brjod do/ /de nas ye shes sems dpa'i sgo nas dam bsgrag pa ni/ slob ma'i spyi bor rdo rje bzhag nas/ de tshe dpag tu med par bsams nas lus la bstims la/'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig te/ /gang la smras na glad pa 'gas/ /srog la bab kyang mi smra'o / /gsangs dang dngos grub mchog tu 'gyur ces brjod do/ /77—31‘1

de nas dam tshig gi chu sbyin pa ni/ sbrang gi chu yab yum gnyis su med par bsams la slob ma la byin nas/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg 1par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub thob/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu 'di 'thung / /oṃ dīḥrgyu dzñā na badz+ra sa twa hūṃ zhes brjod do/ /de nas khyad par du rdo rje slob dpon gyi dam bsgrag nga/ ni/ rdo rje dang dril bu mgor bzhag la/ dus 'di nyid nas bu khyod kyi/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nga yin gyi/ /nga yis ji skad bka' sprul pa/ /khyod kyis gus pas nyan par gyis/ /gal te nga la brnyas pa na/ /sangs rgyas thams cad brnyas pa yin/ /mos dang gus pa ma byas na/ /bdud kyis bcom nas dmyal bar 'gro/ /de bas dam tshig gnas par gyis/ /dam tshig dag la mi 'da' ba/ /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur/ /ces brjod do/ /de nas gdong g.yogs bcing ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gsum gyis byen gyis brlabs la bcings nas/ me tog phreng ba gtad la lus kyi bshis ni 'di ltar byas te/rkang pa gnyis bzhibs la langs nas/ thal mo spyi bor sbyar te rlung bzung nas/yid kyis gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med/ /yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa yis/ /bdag la ye shes dbab tu gsol/ /dus 'dir byin gyis brlab par rigs/ /ces lan gsum gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyis slob ma'i spyi bor tshe dpag med yab yum 'od dang 'od zer gyi tshul du gar byed pa la dmigs pa gtad pa dang / sku lus la ye shes kyi bdud rtsi kha dog lnga byung nas lus la thim par bsam/ yab yum gye g.yas su grub pa'i rgyal mo/ g.yas ḍā ma ru/ g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/ sgu mdog smug 17byed315

——nag /rus pas brgyan pa/ gar byed pa la shes pa gtad/ g.yon du brgyud pa rnams bsam/ de nas slob ma la dmigs pa de rnams bstan nas rang dang slob mas mos 1gus byas pa dang / spyi bo'i lha tshogs rnams gar stabs su ling ling spyi bor sib sib thim nga/ra bsam/ rol mo sna tshogs dkrol/ spos dkar nag gi dud pas bdug cing / ngag tu oṃ dīḥ rja badz+ra dzñā na a be sha ya a ā/ ces mang du brjod pas lus ngag yid gsum la phebs nga/ra 'gyur ro/ /de'i rtags ni 'phar ba dang / 'dar ba dang / gar byed pa dang / saṃ kri ta'i skad dang / rdo rje'i glu dang / mi rtog gi ting 'dzin dpag med 'byung ngo / /de nas dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa ni/ las kyi slob dpon cig gis rdo rje thogs la slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su khrid nas/ yang dag pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha rnams kyi ni rigs ji bzhin / /dngos grub bsod nams de bzhin shog ces brjod do/ /de nas me tog thogs la/ sngon nas bsgrubs pa'i yi dam lha/ /gang yin de ring bdag bsnyan gyi/ /rigs dang 'thun pa'i dngos grub dang / /lha dang ma nor mjal bar shog /ces me tog dor la/ me tog gang la phog pa'i rigs kyi ming bde chen 'od dpag med/ mi bskyod tshe dpag med dang / rin chen tshe dpag med la sogs pa'i rigs 'thun pa'i ming gdags par bya'o/ /de nas me tog de mgo la bcings la/ tshe dpag med du bsams nas/phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byin brlabs pa'i/ /me tog 'od dpag med pa 'di/ /stobs chen rjod kyis rab bcings pa'i/ /rigs kyi bdag por dbang bsgur ro/ /ces pas spyi bor gdags so/ /17—316

de nas gser gyi thur mas mig phye la/ tshe dpag med pa ding khyod kyi/ /mig ni yang dag 'byed par mdzad/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /phye bas thams cad mthong bar shog /ces brjod la gdong g.yogs dgrol bar bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la lhos/ /mthong nas dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /khyod ni tshe dpag rigs su skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgya'i byin brlabs kyis/ /'gro don phun sum tshogs kun dang / /dngos grub thams cad mngon du 'gyur/ /dam tshig thams cad bsrung ba dang / /gsang sngags la'ang brtson par gyis/ /ces brjod la dkyil 'khor rnam dag bstan / de nas phung po lnga/ 'byung ba lnga/ tshe dpag med yab yum du ngo sprad par bya'o/ /de nas phyag bya ste/ gling bzhis brgyan pa'i maṇ+ḍal dang / lus longs spyod gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul nas dbang bskur bar gsol ba gdab pa ni/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /ji ltar mchod chen brtsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag gsol/ /gtso bo mgon po tshe dpag med/ /yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ /dbang bskur deng 'dir bdag la gsol/ /ces lan gsum gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de nas dbang bsgur ba ni/ sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs/ khro bo thams cad kyi bar chad bsrung / mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis phyi nang gsang gsum gyis mchod/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad (7—3/7

kyis bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod/ rigs kyi yum lngas rin po che'i bum pa nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsis dbang bskur bar bsams la/ slob ma'i spyi thog tu bum pa bzhag nas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu me/ phyogs dus sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa'i/ /rdo rje'i dbang bsgur chen po sbyin/ /ces pa ni spyir bskur ba'o/ /de nas rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur ba ni/ bum pa mi bskyod par bskyed la/ dgug gzhug bya/ rang dang slob ma gnyis ka mi bskyod par bskyed nas dbang bsgur ba ni/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes/ rnam dag pa/ /me long ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /bcom ldan mi bskyod pa yi ni//bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa tu saṃ/ ces brjod nas chu rgyun spyi bor blugs pas lus bde bas khyab cing / zhe 1sdang thams cad dag nas me long ye shes rgyud la skyes par bsgom/de nas dbu rgyan stong pa'i ngang las rin 'byung du bskyed/ ye shes gzhug/rang dang slob ma gnyis ka rin 'byung du bsam/ dbu rgyan slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ thor tshugs cod pan gyis brgyan pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab sngags 2pa'i/ /rin chen dag gi dbu rgyan dang / /dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa tu saṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ nga rgyal dag nas mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes thob par bsam mo /de nas rdo rje ladagug gzhug bya dang rang dang slob ma snang ba mtha' yas su bskyed la/ rdo rje mgor bzhag nas/ sangs rgyas kun kyis rdo rje'i dbang / /de 17—318

ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis long / /ces lag pa g.yas su byin la/ oṃ pad+ma badz+ra sa ma ya dhī1ཿ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu me/ zhes brjod pas/ 'dod chags dag nas so sor rtog pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par bsgom mo/ /de nas dril bu la dgug gzhug bya rang dang slob ma don yod grub par bskyed nas/dril bu mgor bzhag nas/ sangs rgyas kun gyis dril bu'i dbang / /de ring khyod la bsgur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir/ /dril bu 'di ni khyod kyis long / /oṃ a ti pa ta ya te a bhi 2ṣiñtsa tu rma/ zhes pas g.yon du sbyin no/ /des phrag dog dag nas bya grub ye shes rgyud la skyes par bsgom mo/ /de nas rdo rje dang dril bu rnam par snang mdzad du bskyed nas dgug gzhug bya/rang dang slob ma yang de bzhin du bsams nas/ rdo rje dang dril bu spyi bor bzhag nas / sangs rgyas kun kyi ming gi dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir/ /ming gi dbang 'di khyod kyis long / /oṃ badz+ra satwa ya tram̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu saṃ/ zhes brjod pas gti mug dag nas/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes rgyud la skyes par bsgom mo/ /de dag gis bye brag tu rigs pa'i dbang lnga bskur bar bstan no/ /de nas khyad par du 'chi med ye shes bdud rtsi'i phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi dbang bskur ba bshad par bya ste/ de nas yang slob mas gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bla ma mgon po tshe dpag med/ /lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /bdag la brtse bas dgongs su gsol/ /bdag la brtse 717—319

bas dgongs nas kyang / /'chi med che'i dngos grub gsol/ /ces gsol ba lan gsu/ma gdab po/ /de nas dbang bsgur ba ni/ gong bzhin du dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang /khyad par du mgon ngo/ tshe dpag tu med pas/ bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis bum pa bkang nas dbang bskur bas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa/ khyad par du tshe zad pa dang 'gribs pa 'a/ sogs pa thams cad sangs kyis dag par bsams nas bum pa spyi thog tu bzhag la dbang bskur ba ni/ so sor kun rtog rang bzhin gyis/ /bcom ldan tshe dpag med pa ni/ /sku mdog dmar po 'od zer 'bar / /'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ /bum pa tshe yis bkang nas kyang //tshe dbang thams cad bdag la gsol/ /oṃ dhīḥrgyu badz+ra dzñā na a yu ṣe swā hā/ de nas dmigs pa thams cad gong bzhin rang dang slob ma gnyis kas bsams nas dbang bsgur ba ni/ me long ye shes rang bzhin gyi/ /mi bskyod tshe dpag med pa ni/ /sgu mdog sngon po 'od zer 'bar/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ /bum pa tshe yis bkang nas kyang / /tshe dbang thams cad bdag la gsol/ /o hūṃ rgyu ces sngags 'bru brgyad thams cad la'o/ /mnyam nyid ye shes rang bzhin gyi1/ /rin 'byung tshe dpag med pa ni/ /sku mdog ser po 'od zer 'bar/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ /bum pa tshe yis bkang nas kyang / /tshe dbang thams cad bdag la gsol/ /oṃ swā rgyu/ chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin gyi/ /rnam snang tshe dpag med pa ni/ /sgu mdog dkar po 'od zer 'bar/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ /bum pa tshe yis bkang nas kyang / /dbang bsgur thams cad bdag la gsol / /rgyu rgyu/ bya grub ye shes rang bzhin gyi/ /don grub tshe dpag med pa ni/ /(77—320

sgu mdog ljang khu 'od zer 'bar/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ /bum pa tshe yis bkang nas kyang / /dbang bskur thams cad bdag la gsol 'di rnam sa 'os ma kun la ya/nga 'dre'o/ /āḥrgyu/ de dag ni phyi yab lnga'i dbang bskur ba'o/ /de nas yum gos dkar mo'i sgo nas dbang bsgur bas/ lus ngag yid gsum kyi sdig sgrib dang tshe nyams pa dang 'gribs pa thams cad sangs dag nas/lus khru ma bus pa bzhin gyur/ de nas bdud rtsi rkang mthi'/ na yar skya mer mer byung bas spyi bor sleb pa dang / rang lus ye shes kyi lus/ su gyur nga/ra bsams 'a//bum pa spyi thog bzhag 1nas/ 'od dpag yum mchog gos dkar mo/ /phyag na ra ga'i bum pa bsnams/ /tshe dang bdud rtsis bkang nas kyang / /tshe dbang thams cad deng 'dir gsol/ /oṃ rgyu a pa ra mi ta a yu dzñā na su bi ni ñtsit+ta te dz+wa rā dza ya swā hā/ ces yum thams cad la dmigs pa dang sngags 'dre'o/ /mi skyod yum mchog sangs rgyas spyan/ /phyag na shel kyi bum pa bsnams/ /rin chen yum mchog ma ma ki/ /phyag na be+e dur bum pa bsnams/ /snang mdzad yum mchog dbyings phyug ma/ /phyag na gser gyi bum pa bsnams/ /don grub yum mchog dam tshig sgrol/ /phyag na in+ta'i bum pa bsnams/ /tshe dang bdud rtsis bkang nas kyang / /tshe dbang thams cad 'dir gsol cig /de dag gis ni yum lnga'i dbang bstan to/ /de nas sems dpa' bcu drug gi bshad par bya ste/ shar phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhis dbang bskur bas mchi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsams la/ bum pa spyi thog tu bzhag nas 'di skad brjod par bya ste/ shar phyogs mi bskyod sems dpa' bzhi/ /bai dur sngon po'i mdog 'dra ba/ /phyag 47—321

g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga bsnams/ /g.yon na che'i bum pa 'dzin/ /tshe dang bdud rtsis bkang nas ni/ /tshe dbang thams cad 'dir gsol cig /sngags ni mi baspyod nga/'i 'o/ /lho phyogs rin chen sems dpa' bzhi/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra ba/ /phyag g.yas rin chen 'bar ba bsnams/ /nub phyogs nga/d+ma'i sems dpa' bzhi/ /pad+ma ra ga'i mdog 'dra ba/ /phyag g.yas chu skyes 'dab lnga bsnams/ /byang phyogs 'phrin las sems dpa' bzhi/ /in+t+ra ni la'i mdog 'dra ba/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje rgya gram 'dzin/ /g.yon na che'i bum nga/ bsnams/ /tshe dang bdud rtsis bkang nas kyang / /tshe dbang thams cad 'dir gsol cig /de nas 'chi med che'i dngos grub thob pa yin mnyam pa'i nges shes bskyed do/ /des ni sems dpa' bcu drug gi dbang bstan no/ /de nas de kho na nyid bstan par bya ste/ rang dang slob ma'i snying kha'i s+thāḥdang / dkyil 'khor shar phyogs nas lha mo lcags kyu ma dkar mo cig las bcu/bcu las brgya la sogs pa mang po dpag tu med pa spros la/ rang dang gzhan gnyis ga'i nad gdon zhi ba'i las byas/ khyad par du shar dri za'i lag tu rang gi tshe nyams pa dang / 'gribs pa dang / zad pa kun bkug nas slob ma la bsnyim pas/ nad gdon thams cad zhi nas tshe rgyas par bsams la spyi thog tu bum pa bzhag nas/ shar phyogs dkar mo zhi mdzad lha/ /dri zi'i 1 lag nas tshe khug la/ /nad gdon rnams ni zhi mdzad pa'i/ /dbang bskur deng 'dir bdag la gsol/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ a pa ra mi ta ā yu dzñā na su bi ni swā hā/ de nas rang dang dkyil 'khor gyi lho nas zhags pa mo ser mo spros la tshe dang longs spyod 'khor la sogs pa rgyas par byas te/ gshin rje'i lag nas tshe (7—322

bkug la bstems la/ lho phyogs ser mo rgyas mdzad lha/ /gshin rje'i lag nas tshe bkug la/ /tshe dang longs spyod rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /dbang bskur ding 'dir bdag la gsol/ /yang sa bon dang / nub nas lcags sgrog ma nub tu spros / chu lha'i lag nas tshe bkug nas/ srid gsum dbang du byas par bsams la/ nub phyogs dmar mo dbang gi lha/ /chu lha'i lag nas tshe khug la/ /srid gsum dbang du bsdus byed pa'i/ /dbang bskur ding 'dir bdag la gsol / /yang sa bon dang / byang phyogs nas dril bu ma mang po spros nas/nad gdon tshar gcad gnod sbyin lag nas 1tshe bkug la bstem/ byang phyogs ljang khu drag mo'i lha/ /gnod sbyin lag nas tshe khug la/ /nad gdon thams cad tshar gcod pa'i/ /dbang bskur ding 'dir bdag la gsol/ /de ni yum bzhi pho nya bzhir byas nas dbang bsgur ba'o/ /de ltar dbang bzhi po de rnams bskur bas nyon mongs pa dag /'chi ba med pa che'i dngos grub thob pa de'i ngang las bdag nyid gtso bo yab yum du bsgom/ de nas de nyid brtan par bya zhing dbang rtags su rigs lngas dbu rgyan par bya ste/ de yang bum pa spyi bor bzhag /de gtso bo yab yum du bskyed/ de las 'od zer dmar po lus la thim pas/ 'dod chags dag nas so sor kun rtog rgyud la skyes/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu rgyan par bsams nas/ 'dod chags rnam par dag nas ni / /'od dpag med pas dbu rgyan te/ /so sor kun rtog don rtogs nas//mdzes shing pad+ma'i lus thob shog /oṃ dhīḥrgyu pad+ma ka la a bye ṣiñtsa tu saṃ/ bum pa mi bskyod par bskyed nas dpral bar bzhag 'od 'phros pas/ zhe sdang dag nas me long skyes te/ mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan par bsams nas/ zhe sdang 47—323

rnam par dag nas ni/ /bcom ldan mi bskyod dbu rgyan 1te/ /me long ye shes don rtogs shing / /'gyur med rdo rje'i lus thob shog /oṃ hūṃ rgyu badz+ra ka la a bhe ṣiñtsa tu me/ yang bum pa rna ba g.yas su bzhag nas/ rin 'byung du bsam/de'i 'od kyis nga rgyal dag /mnyam nyid ye shes rgyud la skyes nas rin 'byung gis dbu rgyan par bsam/ nga rgyal rnam par dag nas ni/ /rin chen 'byung ldan dbu rgyan pas/ /mnyam nyid ye shes don rtogs nas/ /bde chen lhun grub don rtogs shog /oṃ swa rgyu rata na ka la sha a bye ṣiñtsa tu saṃ/ yang ltag par bum pa bzhag nas rnam par snang mdzad du bskyed/ de'i 'od kyis gti mug dag /chos dbyings ye shes rgyud la skyes/ des dbu rgyan par bsams nas / gti mug rnam par dag nas ni/ /sangs rgyas rigs kyi dbu brgyan te//chos dbyengs ye shes don rtogs nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /oṃ rja rja bud dha ka la sha a bye ṣiñtsa tu me/ yang rna ba g.yon par bum pa bzhag nas/don yo/da grub par bskyed/ de'i 'od kyis phrag dog dag /bya grub ye shes rgyud la skyes/ des dbu rgyan par bsam la/ /phrag dog rnam par dag nas ni//don grub rigs kyi dbu brgyan te/ /bya grub ye shes don rtogs nas/ /ci bsams ma lus 'grub par shog /oṃ a rja ka ra ma ka la a dze+e shiñtsa tu me/ces rigs lngas dbu brgyan par bsams nas bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod cing me tog 'thor bar bya'o/ /bdag kho na mgon po tshe dpag med tshe dpag med kho na bdag nyid yin mnyam pa'i nga rgyal brtan pos gnas par bya'o/ /de dag gis thun mongs ma yin pa khyad par gyi dbang bstan no/ /77—324

bum/ dbang sga dbang ba'i la/ sdud na 'dir rjes gnang rnam sa mdzod/ stan thob gcig tu dbang bong ma rnams kyang bskur na/ de dag bi rjes su/ sdom/sa 1pa/ rgya ma tsho'i rgyud la sa/ skyob pa/'i dkyil 'khor ma/ngon su ma du/ 'es sogs gsungs pa/'i don lnga'i rtogs pa bskyed do/ /de nas gsang dbang so gas ma dzad do/ /de nas rjes gnang bshad par bya ste/ dang po gtso bo yab yum bstan nas 'di kho na ltar byos shig byas nas/ 'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ /khams gsum na ni sdig med cing / /de bas 'dod la chags bral bar /khyod kyis nam du'ang ma byed cig ces so/ /sngags kyi rjes gnang ni pad+ma'i phreng ba la gtso bo'i sngags kyis bsangs la/bcom ldan 'di la rtsal lags kyi/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /ces gtso bo yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa'i sngags lan lnga rjes bzlos bya'o/ /de nas phyi nang gsang ba gsum dus mchod pa phul cig ces pa'i rjes su gnang ba bya'o/ /de nas dam tshig gsum gyi dbang bskur bar bya ste/ de yang slob ma dang rdo rje hūṃ las rdo rje sems dpar bskyed de/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o / /zhes rdo rje lag pa g.yas su gtad de/ snying khar bzung nas/ thugs gnyis su med par rtogs par gyis byug pa'o/ /de nas dril bu snang ba mtha' yas gsung gi rang bzhin du bskyed nas/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /srid pa mchog ni byed pa bo/ /sgra thams cad chos kyi sgrar rtogs par gyis shig pa'o/ /de nas rang 47—325

gi snying khar gtso bo yab yum bsams nas/ yi dam gzugs ni brtan bya'i phyir/ /dam tshig phyag rgya rab tu brjod/ /dam tshig 'di la brtag gnas pas/ /lha'i sbyor ba rab tu grags/ /ces lha sku snang stong sgyu ma'i sgur rtogs par bya'o/ /de nas spyi dang bye brag gi dbang bshad par bya ste/ dang po slob ma skyil dkrungs su 'dug pa'i rkang pa'i bar du chos kyi 'khor lo lag pa g.yas su dung /g.yon du glegs bam/ steng du gdugs phub la/ dengs 1nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa/ /tsam gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /de ring phan chad 'jig rten la/ /spyob pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /chos kyi dung ni bla na med/ /kun tu ma lus gang bar kyis/ /som nyid 2yid gnyis mi bya zhing / /dgos pa med pa'i sems kyis su//gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul gyi mchog /'jig rten 'di la rab tu bsgrag /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan gdags drin du bzo 4zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang / /kun tu khyed la bsrung bar byed zhes pa'o/ /de nas bye brag tu bsgur ba ni/ rang dang slob ma gnyis ka rnam snang du bskyed la/ rigs lngar bsgoms nas don bya snyam du bsams nas/ 'jig rten kun la thams cad du / /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /ces brjod la/ sangs rgyas rigs kyi gdul bya gti mug can gyi don bya snyam du bsam mo/ /de bzhin du rdo rje dang / nor bu dang / pad+ma dang / rgya gram rnams kyi 'khor lo bskor ba rnams la tshig gong bzhin du spel bar bya'o/ /de nas rjes kyi cho ga bstan par bya ste/ de yang lung bstan pa ni/ khyod kyi phung po lnga khams lnga/ /dpag med yab yum yin par ni/ /deng 'dir ngas khyod 17—326

lung bstan bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa rang bzhin rnam dag pas/ /lha yi 'khor lor gnas pa'o/ /ces brjod do/ /gzengs bstod pa ni/yi dam lha dang mnyam par ni/ /dus 'di nyid du gyur pa ste/ /dga' zhing spro ba chen po yis/ /phyi rol mi bsam na 'du'o1/ /ces brjod do/ /de nas dbugs dbyung ba ni/ bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /be+en chad 'chi ba yod min te/ /mi tshugs pa dang mi sod pas/ /cis kyang mi 'chi dga' bar gyis / /ces brjod do/ /de rnams brtan pa'i yan lag tu/ brtul zhugs kyi dbang sbyin pa ni/ sbrang rtsi dang bdud rtsi bsres la/ 'chi med ye shes bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la/ slob ma la sbyin te/ 'di ni 'chi med ye shes chu/ /gang gis reg dang 'thungs pa yis/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun/ /thams cad da lta mngon du 'gyur/ /bgegs dang log 'dren kun 'joms shing / /gzhan kyis rdzi bar mi nus pa'i/ /mi shigs rdo rje pha lam 'gyur/ /lhun grub bde ba chen po'o/ /zhes lan gsum brjod par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi nub phyogs su/ pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du/ tshe dpag med yab yum zhal spyor du bsam/ de la ye shes gzhug /sgu gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas/ mchod pa dang bstod pa byas nas/gsang bsgrub ltar bzlas pa bya/ rang yang gtso bo yab yum du bsams nas snyoms 'jug byas pas/ byang sems dkar dmar gsang gnas nas 'thon/yab yum rnams kyang snyoms 'jug byas pas/ gsang gnas nas byang sems dkar dmar nar byung bar bsam/ de nas ka pā lar sbrang dang bu ram sbrang rtsi 47—327

bsres la/ der byang sems dkar dmar bstem pa dang / ka pā la 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi byang sems dmar pos mer khengs par bsam mo/ /de nas maṇ+ḍal 1gyi steng du bla ma dang gtso bo yab yum gnyis su med pa'i gsang gnas nas byang sems kyi chu bo'i rgyun byung te/ slob ma'i lce thog tu thim pas/ bde stong gi nyams rgyud la byes pa dang / lus byang sems dmar pos khengs par bsams nas / ka pā li'i bdud rtsi byin la/ phyogs bcu'i rdo rje 'chang rnams kyis/ /gsang ba'i gnas las byung ba yi/ /nga yi byang chub sems kyi rgyun/ /de ring khyod la bsgur bar bya/ /ces brjod par bya'o/ /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni/ dkyil 'khor kyi lho phyogs su/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad phyogs mtshon gyi steng du/ slob ma yab du bskyed/ yum gos dkar mo dang gnyis su med pa'i spyor ba byas pas/ yum gyi byang sems dmar pos/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi rims kyis dmar mer kyis khengs par bsams la/ gzhon nu yid 'ong bde ba'i mchog /je tshom spangs nas bsten par bya/ /brjod bral lhan cig skyes dga' ba/ /dus 'di nyid du mngon du 'gyur zhes brjod/dngos sam yid kyis brten par bya'o/ /de nas dbang bzhi pa/ byang du ras dkar po'i steng du dbang bskur bar bya ste/ rang gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i gnas/ bzhir/ tshe dpag med mgon mtshon gang tsam pa re zhal spyor du bsams te/ dmigs pa rnged pa'i ngang du gnas par bya'o/ /de yang ma bcos pa rang grol du bzhag la/ ltos cig ltos cig 77—328

sems la ltos/ /sems nyid cir yang grub pa med/ /gsal zhag ①dgag sgrub ma grub pa/ /rang grol nyid du gnas pa'o/ /ces phyag rgya chen po'i ngo sprod yang bya'o//dus 'dir rang grol lhun grub tu rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i dbang bzhi bskur ba'i cho ga'i las khrigs—/ 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i bum pa zhes bya ba/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma grub pa'i rgyal mos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //'di rtsa rgyud le'u 'bum pa dang / bshad rgyud 'od zer dra ba las phyung bas so/ /'di'i rgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag med/ grub pa'i rgyal mo/ras chung rdorjegrags pa/ mnga' ris byang chub rdo rje/ grub thob kun dga' shes rab rgyalatsha/bla ma bzang yul pa gnyos ston rin byed ldan/ sangs rgyas ston pa brtson 'grus seng ge/ mkhas grub chos rje gzhon nu grub/ zhang ston chos rje'ang zer/ byang chub shes rab/ de la bla ma pu byudh+wa dza dang bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ mkhas btsun sangs rgyas gzhon nu bsod nams gnyis kas zhus rnabyedas cad// //47—329

༄ga /khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba bsgrub pa'i thabs/①sto khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba'i bsgrub thabs bzhugs so// ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ chos khungs btsun rgya gar na sgra'i don dge slong zhes bya ba la dge slong gi yon tan dam pa dgos pa lta bu ar+ya a tsa la khro tā sa dha ni/ bod skad du/ khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba ④bsgrub pa'i thabs/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mngon pa'i lha 'phags pa 'jam dpal rim pa byas lha bsgom bzlas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por mtho' rigs thar pa'i/bde 'byung dkon mchog gsum btud te lha dang mi'i 'dod pa la ④dkon mchog gsum la ma btud par mi 'ong gsung / /khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo' ba/ /sgom pa'i ma thabasarim pa bri bar byam/ /phyag btsal ba'i sngon du 'gro ba la sngags pa kun la phyag btsal ba sngon du 'gro ba phan can chags med cing / /byang chub tu ni blo brtan zhing / /chos ci byed thams cad ni sems can gyi don du bya byams snying rje bsgoms rnala'abyor ye mi dmar ba tsha tsha la sogs pa cho gas ni phun tshogs pa—/ /dngos grub gong gi de tsho yod pa gcig gis bsgrubs rjo'agrub snod du gyur pa yin/ /47—332

dang por sngags pas rnal 'byor yin pa'i brtsom pa'i spyir rang yid gtad de rang la rgyud ltar yod na ri mo byung ba chu gtsang ba me tog dkar ba la phog pa rnal 'byor dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas su/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ rang gi snying kar paṃ las pad+ma re las nyi ma'i steng du 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba'i yi ge hūṃ nag po bsams la/ de las spros pa'i 'od lnga'isakyis rang gi lus phyi dang nang du bcas pa gsal bar byas la byin gyis rlab/ ā+oṃ①sarbathams cad de bzhin mabyed pa lha mo stod pa ba gar ta thā ga ta pu tsa badz+ra swa bha ba ad ma ko haṃ/ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod de/ yi ge hūṃ las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams bskul ⑤zhing spyan drangs la/ mdun gyi nam mkha' 'di yin pas mi shes med larnam par bzhugasapar bsams te/ de dag de lasasprul lal phyag bya'o/ /de'i rjes la oṃ badz+ra ④pus pa a hūṃ swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas/ yi ge hūṃ de nyid las mngon par byung ba'i 'od zer sna tshogs kyi sgo nas las rjoyang dag par byung ba'i me tog gi mchod pa'i lha mos me tog dri zhim po arur rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i sprin gyis nam mkha' khengs par byas nas mchod par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la oṃ badz+ra du pa a hūṃ swā hā zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas de bzhin du yi ge hūṃ las mngon par byung ba'i 'od zer 'phros pa las yang dag par byung ba'i bdug spos kyi mchod pa'i lha mo'i lag pa bzung ba'i spos khang las dri zhim po rnam pa sna tshogs kyi bdug spos kyi sprin byung bas nam mkha' khengs par mchod par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la oṃ badz+ra dhi pe a hūṃ/ swā hā zhes pa'i sngags brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas phyogs ma lus pa gsal bar byed pa'i rin po che'i sgron ma 'dzin pas brel ba'i mar me'i lag pas mar me'i mchod pa'i lha mos mchod par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la oṃ badz+ra gan dhe aḥ47—333

hūṃ swā hā zhes pa'i sngags brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas rin po che'i snod mdzes pa lha rdzas kyi dri rnam pa sna tshogs kyis bkang ba 'dzin pa lag pa brel ba'i dri'i mchod pa'i lha mo gzugs dang lang tsho dang rgyan dang ldan pa dag gis nam mkha' khengs par byas la mchod par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la oṃ badz+ra no be+e de a hūṃ zhes bya'i sngags brjod pa'i rjes la yi ge hūṃ de nyid las kha dog dang dri dang ro dang reg bya phun sum tshogs pa'i lha rdzas kyi bdud rtsi dpe med pas yongs su bkang ba'i rin po che'i snod mdzes 'dzin pa'i lag pa byel ba'i rdo rje'i lha mo dpag tu med pa spros la mchod par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la oṃ sarba bi sha mu tsa me ka sa mun tra ①a hūṃ swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod pa'i rjes la/ nam mkha' ma lus par khyab pa'i rin po che'i gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang bla re rnam pa sna tshogs dang / glu dang sgra la sogs pa dang / 'khor lo sgyur ba'i rin po che dag gis mchod par bya'o/ /de nas de dag gi mdun du/ pus mo'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas thal mo sbyar te/ thog ma med pa'i 'khor ba nas byas shing bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa dang / phyin chad bsdam par bya ba dang /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang rang sangs rgyas dang gang yang nyan thos dang / so so'i skye bo rnams kyi bsod nams la rig pa'i 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po 'di 'grub—/ sems bskyed pa'i 'bras bu spyan ras gzigs la sogs pa'o/ /so sor ④thar pa'i 'bras bu dgra bcom pa'o so so'i skye bo'i sbyin pa gtong ba dang bsnyen gnas bsrungs pa la sogs pa/ rgyu 'bras bu lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang /'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po la sogs ①rgyu 'bras la rjes su yi rang ba'o/ /rjes su yi rang ba dang /byang chub snying po'i bar du dkon mchog gsum 'khor lo bskor bar gyur la mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab la skyabs su 'go bar bya'o/ /de'i rjes la 'khor ba'i srunazla 47—334

mnyam po rang la yang sdug bsngal rigs mi 'dra ba mang po yod pa lta bu las sdug bsngal rnam pa sna spyodags kyis sdug bsngal bar gyur pa'i sems can rnams la snying rjes dmigs shing de dag mya ngan las 'da' bar bya ba'i phyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub du smon pa'i sems brtan par bskyed par bya'o/ /de ltar bsod nams kyi tshogs bskyed nas/ ye shes kyi tshogs bskyed par bya phyir/ oṃ swa bha ba shud dha sarba dharma swa bha ba shud to haṃ/ zhes bya ba lan gsum gyi bar du brjod/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i ngo bo dang bral ba brdzun pa'i rnam par rtog ①pas goms par byas pa'i nyon mongs pa'i bag chags kyis yongs su bsgoms pa'i rang gi sems kyi snang ba tsam rmi lam dang / mig 'phrul dang / chu zla dang mig yor dang khams gsum po 'di dag khyad par med do zhes nges par brtags la/shu n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra sarba ad ma ko haṃ/ zhes bya ba'i sngags lan gsum gyi bar du brjod la/ brdzun pa'i rnam par rtog pas goms par byas pa'i bag chags kyi dbang du gyur pa'i rang gi sems mig 'phrul mkhan gyis sprul pa'i sems can dang / snod kyi 'jig rten rnam par 'phrul pa'i dri ma sbyang bar bya ba'i phyir/rdul dang khug rna dang du ba dang kha ba dang sprin gyis bsgrib khrupa dang bral ba'i ston gyi nyi ma phyed kyi nam mkha' lta bu/ chos kyi dbyings dang mtha' dang dbus med pa'i rang bzhin du phyi dang nang du bcas pa'i 'jig rten gsum po ma lus par rnam par bltas la/ yud tsam rnam par rtog pa med par chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes zhes kyang bya gsung nam mkha' rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas la/ nam mkha' ma lus pa'i 'od kyis rgyas par byed pa'i yi ge paṃlasapad+ma'i khar ram̐ dmar pos yongs su gyur pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du 'od zer rab tu 'phros pa'i hūṃ nag po 47—335

bsams la/ de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje nag po rtse mo gyes par bsams la/de'i lte ba la yang nyi ma la gnas pa yi ge hūṃ nag po bsgom par bya'o/ /de las byung ba thams cad du khyab pa'i 'od zer dag gis phyogs bcu na gnas pa'i sems can gyi khams thams cad rnam par sbyangs nas rang gi 'dod pa'i lha'i gzugs su rnam par byas la/ yang de dag thams cad 'od zer de dag gis bkug cing bsdus la rdo rje'i lte ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i ye ge hūṃ gi nang du chud par byas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dzha na ka ya badz+ra swa bha ba ad ma ko haṃ/ zhes bya ba'i byin gyis brlabs la/ hūṃ dang rdo rje dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rnams gcig tu gyur cing yongs su gyur pa las khro bo'i rgyal po 'phags pa mi g.yo ba char sprin nag po'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ste/ phyag g.yas g.yon na lha dang lha ma yin dang / bdud dang bgegs kyi tshogs thams cad skrag par byed pa'i ral gri me'i phung po ltar 'bar ba'i gdengs pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/ phyag g.yon na bgegs kyi tshogs ma lus pa skrag par mdzad pa'i sdigs 'dzub dang rdo rje zhags pa bsnams ①pa/ ji ltar mdzes pa'i klu chen po phu sgra dang bcas pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'greng ba/ sna tshogs pad ma'i steng gi nyi ma'i gdan la g.yon brkyang pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ rab tu sdang zhing gtum pa'i bdud dang bgegs kyi tshogs du ma 'og du mnan pa/ spyan dmar zhing zlum pa gnyis kyis dus cig tu steng 'og lta zhing 'khros pa'i tshul can/mche ba cung zhig gcigs pa'i tshangs pa dang dbang po dang lha dang lha ma yin gyi tshogs 'jigs par byed pa/ 'jig pa dus kyi skal ba'i me ltar rang lus 47—336

'bar ba'i sgo nas 'byung ba'i khro bo'i rgyal po ma lus pa phyag mtshan bsnams pa sna tshogs pa thogs pa'i tshogs kyis nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor ma lus rgyas par khengs pa'i bcom ldan 'das su rnam par bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar re kha dog dmar po 'od zer rnam par 'phro ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam par bya'o/ /de'i steng du hūṃ nag po 'od kyi dkyil 'khor kun du 'phro ba rin po che'i sgron ma ltar 'bar ba bsams la de las 'od zer 'phros ye shes sems dpa' spyan drang zhing mdun gyi nam mkha' la bsams la/ snga ma bzhin du yang dag par mchod de/ dza hūṃ baṃ ho zhes bya ba rnam pa bzhi brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas ye shes sems dpa' dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang brtan por bya ba dang / mnyes par bya ba dang / ye shes sems dpa' dang dam tshig sems dpa' tha mi dad par gyur par mos pa bya'o/ /de'i rjes la rang gi snying ka'i yi ge hūṃ gi 'od zer dag gis mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams spyan drangs ste/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la bsams la yang dag par mchod de dbang bskur bar gnyer ba'i don du gnyer ba'i phyir/ oṃ a bhi ṣin ①tsa tu oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes bya ba gsol ba gdab pa'i rjes mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i ④de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sgu las byung ba'i sangs rgyas spyan las ①sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis yongs su bkang ba'i rin po che'i bum pas bdag nyid la dbang bskur bar bsams la/ de nas skra gyen du bgrengs pa'i steng du rang gi rigs kyi gtso bo bsgom zhing / rdo rje gsum byin gyis brlabs pa sngon du 'gro bas gus par rgyun mi gcad par bsgom par bya ste/ji srid ting 'dzin brtan par ma gyur pa de srid bsgom par bya'o/ /bsgoms 47—337

pas dub par gyur na de kho na nyid gsum kyi nang du chud pa 'am rang gi sa bon kyis yi ge 'ba' zhig brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa man ngag ji lta ba bzhin du bzlas brjod byas la/ snying po'i gsang sngags la sogs pa gang mngon par 'dod pa zhig kho na 'bum la sogs pa'i grangs su rang gi 'dod pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor gyis nga rgyal dang ldan pas bzlas par bya'o/ /sngags kyi bzlas brjod kyis kyang dub na cho ga nyams pa bskang ba'i phyir rdo rje sems dpa'i snying po yi ge brgya pa'i sngags ji ltar 'dod pa bzlas la ye shes sems dpa' phyir phyung la snga ma bzhin du yang dag par mchod de bstod pa yang bya'o/ /bsgom ①pa las byung ba'i bsod nams kyang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bya'o/ /sngar yang gshegs su gsol bar bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba btab la/ yī a ②hūṃ mu zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas gshegs su gsol lo/ /de nas langs la lus gnas par bya ba'i phyir zas la sogs pa'i bya ba dang / 'gro ba dang 'ong ba dang 'chag pa la sogs pa'i bya ba la yang lus tha mal pa'i rigs dang rus la sogs pa'i 'khor ba'i tha snyad 'khrul pa ma lus pa'i gnyen po rang gi 'dod pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor nam yang gtang bar mi bya'o/ /brtan pa dang g.yo ba'i khams gsum ma lus pa las rang gi sprul pa'i rang bzhin kyis khyab par byas la ji ltar bde bar gnas par bya'o/ /de ltar gus bcas yun ring du/ /rgyun mi chad par bsgom na ni/ /las dang nyon mongs las bslang ba'i/ /tha mal pa'i rnam rtog ldog /rang gi 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /yid ni shin tu brtan gyur na/ /la sogs dngos grub ma lus pa'i/ /snod du rnal 'byor pa de gyur/ /47—338

de nas spro dang bsdu ba'i/ /rim pa goms par gyur pa las/ /dus ni ji srid 'dong bar du/ /sems gnas par ni nus par gyur/ /dngos med dngos sogs ma lus pa'i/ /rnam rtog rab rib bsal nas ni/ /nyon mongs nad rnams ma lus pa'i/ /bag chags bcas pa des 'joms nus/ /phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub dang / /bla med yon tan ye shes dang / /mthu rnams che bas 'byung ba ni/ /bla ma brnyes las rnyed pa'i/ /de nyid bdud rtsi bcud len gyi/ /gus pas rtag tu nyin mtshan du/ /rgyun mi 'chad par bsgoms byas na/ /myur du phyag rgya chen po'i/ /dngos grub snod du gyur pa yin/ /khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba'i bsgrub thabs/ /slob dpon dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so①// //bsdur mchan/332 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉tha'i ①〈〈pe 〉ṅkapo /rjo〈〈pe〉thasgrub/333 ①〈〈pe 〉7go khru〈〈pe 〉7rkisems can gyi don la/ ①〈〈pe 〉7phalhamo/ du〈〈pe 〉7las/334 ①〈〈pe 〉mas/ ④〈〈pe 〉o ①〈〈pe 〉7phal/335 ①〈〈pe 〉masags/ ④〈〈pe 〉ra sgribs/336 ①〈〈pe 〉pho mas/337 ①〈〈pe 〉ma na/ ④〈〈pe 〉zo ①〈〈pe 〉75/33/ ①〈〈pe 〉rabasgoms/ ④〈〈pe 〉masahā/339 ①〈〈pe 〉rgaso/47—339
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2668)47wa 340

2742༄༅/ /mi g.yo ba'i 'khor lo/1 ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ a tsa la tsag kra/ bod skad du/ mi g.yo ba'i 'khor lo/ gtum po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sor bzhi pa'i 'bar ma'i dbus su ral gri bri bar bya ste/ de'i dbus su oṃ tsan dha ma hā ro ṣa ṇa dha ra ka l+ya rak+shi shan ti pus ti dh+ri ti ku ru hūṃ swā hā/ de'i phyi rol tu na maḥs man ta kā ya bag tsi ta badz+ra rgo saṃ a tsa le tsi ta badz+ra rgo saṃ a tsa le tsi ta kā ṇa/ na ṭa na ṭa pa ṭa pa ṭa ha na ha na da ha da ha mo ha mo ha ha sa ha sa madha ra ta gardza gardza/ha na ha na tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha a be sha ya ma hā man+t+ra sā ma ka dhu na dhu na ti ṇi ti ṇi lā da khā da bhig nan mā ra ya mā ra ya dhuṣ+ṭha na bhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa ya sabam̐ ku ru ki ri ki ri ma ta bi ṣa badz+re spo da ya spo da ya/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ e e e haṃ haṃ haṃ a tsa la tsi ta spo ta ya spo ta ya hūṃ hūṃ a sa madh+ri ka tā ṭa ma hā ba la sha ta ya tsa dha ra ya pa ra man+t+ra na saṃ haṃ e 6/bye tu lo ka dhuṣ+ṭa tu/ badz+re a pra ti bha le bh+yo na mi tu dza la ya tra ta a swā hā/ na 47—341

ma ཿdha ra ka mya rak+ṣ-i shan ti/ pus ti/ dh+ri ti/ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ tsan dha ma ha ro ṣa ṇa dha ra ka su/ i na r+ya bi r+ya la tai tsi ta ya hūṃ phaṭa/ de'i phyi rol du sor phyed pa'i 'phar ma la/ oṃ a tsa le tsi ta spo ta ya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ rak+ṣ-i ①shan ti pus lta dh+ri ti ku ru swā hā/ tre+e lok+ṣa su hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ de'i phyi rol tu sor gsum gyi dbus su re kha gnyis pa'i pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa bri bar byas te de'i phyogs kyi 'dab ma rnams su ral gri/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma rnams kyi nang du rdo rje zhags pa gnyis kyi dbus su hūṃ gnyis phyogs rnams kyi re ka gnyis kyi bar du oṃ tsan dha ma hā ro ṣa ṇa dha ra ka su a nā r+ya bit+yā la t+t+waṃ tshe da ya hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ tsan ḍa ⑤ma hā ro ṣa ṇa dha ka su de ya madz+dza ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsan ḍa ④ma hā ro ṣa ṇa dha ra ka su man sa ra sgo ra ṭa rnyi sa ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsan ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa dha ra ka l+ya tri duḥmekha duḥkha la tram̐ tshe da ya hūṃ phaṭa/ mtshams rnams su oṃ tsan ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa dha ra ka su mesarba duṣ+ṭa na dza la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsan dha ma hā ro ṣa ṇa dha ra ka su sarba dharma nai rā rmya ḍa la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsan ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa dha ra ka su rmā sarba bha mā rgo sha ta ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsan ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa dha ra ka su ma hā ni dz+dza rgo par sha hūṃ phaṭa/ de'i phyi rol du sor phyed pa'i 'phar ma'i dbus su thug par byas la hūṃ gi 'phreng ba bri bar bya'o/ /de'i phyi rol du re kha gnyis par 'brel ba'i sor phyed pa'i 'phar ma'i bar du oṃ a tsa lo tsi ta hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kā ma na ta hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā marnya rjopa la ka hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bhi gha nan ma ra ya hūṃ phaṭa—/ oṃ sa ma ya an dha na pā dha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā bhi sha badz+re spo ta ya hūṃ phaṭa—/ oṃ tri pa lī ta li re nar ta ka hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sa man ti ka tā ṭā hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ ma hā ma la shwa ta ya sarba bigha na bi na yā ka t+yā byu da/ oṃ dha ra ka khru rak+ṣi di shaṃ 47—342

kur bhan tu phaṭa swā hā/ de'i phyi rol du sor phyed pa'i 'phar ma'i dbus su ri mo gsum pa nyi shu rtsa bzhis bskor ba bri bar bya'o/ /de'i phyi rol du 'od zer bri bar bya'o/ /mi g.yo ba'i 'khor lo chen po rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta chos kyi rdo rje dang / lo tsā ①ba dge tshul nam mkha' rdo rjes bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/341 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉snyi/342 ①〈〈pe 〉torak+ṣa/ ②②〈〈pe 〉skos/ 0〈〈pe 〉mi ཿ/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉sna/ ①〈〈pe〉〉pan+t+ra/343 ①〈〈pe 〉〉lots+tsha/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2669)47—343

༄ga /rtum po'i sgrub thabs/①༄spro/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsan dha ma ha ④ro sha na sa dra na/ bod skad du/rtum po'i sgrub thabs spyir bsnyen pa dang / bsgrub pa dang / las la sbyar ba gsum du yod mod kyang / 'di'i lugs kyi bsnyen bsgrub tshig chod kyi bsgrub pa bya ba yin gsung / sgo rje rtum/ nge 'a/ byu/ga 'a 'a 'ab 41/ /dgos pa bstan pa mi min bar chad bzlog pa'i phyir/ /dngapopar stong dmigs stong pa'i ngang las baṃ pad re las nyi steng du de gyur pa las hūṃ las ni/ /rdo rje rtum po sku mdog sngo po/ /phyag g.yas na gri khu/ba/ g.yon na 6/ba/sa pa byu/ba/ zug babya/ma / /klu'i rigs brgyad kyis rgyan ④pa ste spyi bor mtha' yas sngon po rna ba la 'jog po ser po mgrin par pad chen sngo skya se ral khar kar ko ta ljang gu/ dpung par rigs ldan khra bo/ lag dub dung skyong ser po/ sked dhipar nor rgyas ⑤dkar po/ rkang pa la pad+ma sngon po sbrul gyi rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /'od zer skal pa'i me dang mtshungs/ /thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' ni/ /de dang dam tshig sems dpa' ji lta ba bzhin 'drab cho1na gang che da bskyed tsam pa gcig bsam 'di la pad+ma mi dgos gsung nyi ma la/ /de thugs snying 47byed344

dkyil yi ge hūṃ/ /hūṃ ni 'di man chad bsgrub pa'i dus su bsgom pa'o ter gyur de las me/ /mched pas rang gi ye shes sems padang/ /dam tshig sems dpa' gsum par gnas / /thams cad me dpung du 'bar bar bsam de nas me che chung ji tsam du 'bar na ri rab tshad du 'bar ba/ /des byed pa'i las ni phyogs mtshams bgegs dang log 'dren dang rang gi rnam par rtog pa thams cad bya sgro thab du bcug pa bzhin chem ril gyis bsregs/ /dzagrir 'dus rang lus me dkyil nayodapar bsgom/ /bgegs dang log 'dren steg 'gyur ba'o/ /rtum po'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/344 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉wā/ ①〈〈pe 〉thargyan/①〈〈pe 〉〉rted/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉rgyal/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2670)47wa 345

byed/ /khro bo mi g.yo mgon gyi sgrub thabs/①byed/ /khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khro bo mi g.yo mgon gyi sgrub thabs la/ phyis thugs khar gri gug bsam/ de'i chang zung nang du pad nyi steng du hūṃ bsams la/ de las sprul pa'i khro chung lag na mdon cha sna tshogs thogs pa spros la bgegs thams cad tshar bcad nas sgrub pa po re re'i mdun na yang khro chung dpag tu med pa bgegs bsrun par bsams la bzlas pa bya'o gsung ngo / /bdag nyid sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma las byed gabyed mabyedan po rin po byed rgyan ma yin dang snyen ④pa'i dus su sngas su ma 'dal la phur bu btsugs la/ de'i rtsar dkar gsum mngar gsum la byas pa'i gtor ma'i gtor ma bsham/ byedamadog dudapa byung ba lta bu dud kha sngoskyazhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas ral gri g.yon na thod khrag bsnams pa/ rang nyid stong par bsam ①pa'i ngang las hūṃ du gyur pa las byedabyedas de'i snying khar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bskyed de'i steng du hūṃ la sogs pa bsgom par bsam babyedadabaskyed na ji ltar bskyed na gong du ji ltar bstan pa ltar bskyed dud ka la sogs pa de nas bsnyen pa'i dus su/ oṃ tsan dha ma hā ro sha na hūṃ phaṭa—/ zhes dang por yi ge re re la yang 'bum tsho sum bcu sum 'bum gsum 'bum bzlas so//47byed346

de nas las byed pa'i dus su mi rus las byas pa'i phur pa lcags la byas kyang mi sto sor bzhi pa 'am drug pa'am bcu gnyis pa la cig la/ mi gamyos mgon du stong pa las hūṃ de mi g.yo ba rang 'dra bar bskyed la/ ye shes sems dpa' gzhug de'i snying khar nyi ma la hūṃ/ de la sngags kyi bskor bar bsam/bdag gi sngags brjod pas snying kha nas langs/ zhal du byung phur pa'i zhal du thim/ de'i snying kha'i sngags las ye shes kyi bcud blangs nas bdag gi snying khar thim zhing / de ltar 'khor bar bsam mo/ /thung ①stong na phur pa sngags dang bcas pa gtsang thon byas nas btab gin snying khar thim phur pa'i ye shes sems dpa' dam tshig sems dpa' phur par song bar bsam mo/ /bsgoms la/ ling kha la bstan pa'i dus su 6/bas baḥ/ pa la④/dang pos kha/ gnyis pas snying / gsum pas lte ba/ bzhi pas phyir su pus gtsugs ①ltar bskums pa'o/ /gong du bsnyen pa bya'o/ /ling ka'i rgyu bstan pa spra tsho la gyi gser du thal chen dum zhig gtang gsung lam thal chen 'am/ bag zan nam gang yang rung /las ling ka mgo bo shar du bstan la gan rkyal du bya'o/ /byas ste/ skye tshe dang / re'u lcags ④dang 'khor lo'i snag tsha byed par 'dod pas/ nya'i rnga gshog rnams brdungs la/ khrag dang rang gi srin lag gi sbyar te/ gro ga la shogabu'am rdo rje rgya gram bris pa'i dkyil du/ming dang sngags su spel la bris gsod na ma ra ya la sogs pa bri ste/ snying kar gzhug bcug la phur bus btab la ma 'dal dur khrod kyi thal bas mi mngon par phur pa dang bcas pa mi mngon par bkab la nam byed dam nyi byed na me tog sngon po gtor la bzhag go/ /de nas/ oṃ tsan dha ma hā ro ṣa ṇa che ge mo shig rlag ste ba ya hūṃ phaṭa spyi'iming yin gsung / ces snying khar gdab/ don mi'i sems thosang steng du ba6/ga la lus dgug pa rdo rje la sogs pa la sngags bzlas shing dgug /ngag gi che ge mo a kar sha ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa bzlas so/ /yid kyi rlung sems dus gcig la dgug zer te mi gtub gsung / lus dang sems gud gud bya sems yig 'brur dgug zhugs rngub/ dbugs rngubs la drang / de nas gso bar 'dod na ming dang bgegs thub phyis mi gnod na snying rje bas phur bu bton te/47—347

oṃ tsan dha ma hā ro sha na hūṃ che ge mo zhig shan ti ku ru swā hā/ zhes sngags brjod nas btab na srod tho rangs phur pa bton te 'o mas bkrus na zhag bdun pa la sos par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang sngags kyi rgyal po 'di lan gcig ni'abum mo bzlas pas/ska'ab pa stong du bsags pa'i sdeg pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa men sdig pa dngos mdze las sogs pa ne+en ①las byung ba'o/ /gi sdig pa zad par 'gyur ro/ /gong ma ltar byas ste/ tsher ma phyir rgol ba'i pus mo la btsugs na/ 'gro ba dang dza ta dzāta res pa'i sngags so 'ong ba rengs par 'gyur ro/ /lingaka'ilcelabatsugs bha ra nyi bha ra nyi zhes ba na lce rengs par byed do/ /mngon par spel ba dang bcas pa'i sngags u tsa ta ya bsngags ④pa'i dur khrod kyi thal ba sgo'i steng du stor na 'byer bar byed do/ /kham por gsar pa la rdo rgyus kyis bris ste sgo la sbyangs na/ byes pa gsar du bu btsas pa bsrung bar byed do/ /dpa' bo cig du ①bsgrub pa'i rgyud las/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po rad na shri rnye nas phyung ba rdzogs so// //phan 'dogs pa ni/ yi ge rabacu pa che ge mo'i byis pa srungs cig hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ces pa kha sbyar gnyis kyi nang du gnyis bris te sa las hūṃ de las bcom ldan 'das su bskyed la/ ye shes sems dpa' gzhug /skud pa ser po dkris la sgo'i nam rol du ya them la btags so/ /'dogs tsam na rnam pa kham bor du bya gsung /47—348

bsdur mchan/346 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i dbu'i mtshan smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉bsnyen/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉bsams/347 ①〈〈pe 〉〉thu/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉wal/ ②〈〈pe 〉sngags btsugs/ du〈〈pe 〉〉lcag348 ①〈〈pe 〉〉sten/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉sdogs/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉tu/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2671)47wa 349

༄/ /gtum po khro bo chen po'i sgrub pa don dam pa zhes bya ba/①༄/ gtum po khro bo chen po'i sgrub pa don dam pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7 / /oṃ swa ste/ rgya gar skad du/ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa sar mārja sā dha nā ma / bod skad du/ gtum po khro bo chen po'i sgrub pa don dam pa zhes bya ba/sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum rgyal dang de sras dam chos la/ /mar me mdzad dpal bdag gis gus btud nas/ /gtum po khro bo'i rgyud kyi rjes 'brangs pa/ /don dam rab tu sgrub pa'i sgon me brtsams/ /'di ni shin tu gsang ba'i phyir/ /su la'ang bstan par mi bya ste/ /mchog tu gsang ba'i spyod yul la/ /mkhas pa bla mar gus la sbyin/ /gtum po khro bo'i dngos grub ni / /dka' thub sdom pas 'grub ma yin/ /bud med dang bral 'chi 'gyur gyi / /rtag pa'i dngos grub med par gsungs/ /rgyal ba rab tu byung bstan dang / /mdo sde chos mngon thams cad du/ /de nyid rab tu sbas mdzad mod/ /47—350

thams cad zab mo 'di la gzhol/ /rin chen rin thang med gzung nas/ /nor bu'i gling gnas dbul po ltar/ /sgyu ma mchog gi chur nub kyang / /de yi ye shes 'di ma thob/ /bde bas yang dag sdom pa ni/ /tshul khrims pha rol phyin par gsungs/ /shes rab ma la brten gcig pus/ /pha rol phyin drug thob par 'gyur/ /shin tu rnam dag byang chub dang / /bcu gsum pa yi sa thob pa'ang / /shes rab ma las myur 'grub kyi/ /gzhan du bskal pa brgyas kyang min/ /de nyid sbed par mi byed na/ /phyin ci log phyir dngos grub med/ /bsod nams sdig pa kun byed de/ /mi g.yo khro bo'i dam tshig yin/ /a ni lhan cig skyes pa'i tshul/ /tsa yig dga' ba bzhi zhes brjod/ /la yig rkyang ma'i lam du rol/ /a yig shes rab dam par brjod/ /tsa yig gis ni thabs su brjod/ /bde ba'i mtshan nyid la zhes brjod/ /chags bral 'joms pas gtum po'o/ /bdud las rgyal ba khro bo che/ /mi g.yo 'di la mngon byas nas/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs spyad par bya/ /lo ni bcu gcig gsang te spyad/ /de nas rigs kyi dbye ba yi/ /gzhon nu ma zungs chas brgyan te/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs mngon du srud/ /kha dog rnam pa tha dad dang / /mtshan ma tha dad rnam brtags pa/ /de bzhin nyon mongs sems kyi mthu—/ /'di las rigs mthun blang bar gsung / /kun rdzob tu ni rigs tha dad—/ /nges par rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs/ /dam pa'i don du dbyer med pas/ /rnal 'byor can rnams ci dgar spyod/ /dang por mkhas pa'i bdag nyid kyis/ /lus 'di dri med sbyang bar bya/ /a tsa la yi sbyor ba yis/ /zla ba nyi ma'i rgyu ba dag /kun 'dar du ni rab gzhug phyir/ /nyin dang 47—351

mtshan du 'bad par bya/ /bgang ba de bzhin dbyung ba dang / /bum pa can dang rengs pa can/ /sbyor ba 'di dag rnams kyis ni/ /rtsa yi khyim ni dbug par bya/ /bla ma'i man ngag lung gis ni/ /'dug stangs sna tshogs tha dad dang / /thag pa'i 'phrul dang gzhu bdungs shing / /'phrul shing sbyor ba sna tshogs bya/ /gang zhig haṃ dang 'brel pa'i phyir/ /srog gi rlung ni zla bar brjod//nyi ma k+ṣa dang thung ngu'i gzugs/ /'di las thur sel zhes bya'i rlung / /'di gnyis gnyis med bsres ①byas na/ /rtag tu thig le thig le gnas/ /gtum mo 'bar ba mchog tu brtan/ /'bar bas kyang ni gnyis 'gag go/ /khro bo'i mig ni g.yas pa srog /g.yon ni thur sel dbu ma yang / /dbus su brjod do yan lag bzhi/ /ro ma dang ni rkyang mar 'gyur/ /de 'gags i ni mchog tu 'bar/ /des bzhu de las 'bar ba yin/ /dpyid dang thig le kha sbyor bas//a tsa la yi ye shes skye/ /bud med kun gyi bde chen gang / /de ni bha ga zhes brjod de/ /de la sku dang gsung thugs kyi/ /dga' ba bcom ldan bzhugs zhes brjod/ /pad+mar rdo rje rab bzhag ste/ /lhan cig skyes pa mtshon byas nas/ /bha ga'i dbus chung thig le yang / /mi 'gyur rdo rje'i lus gnas bya/ /bdag tu rnam rtog kun du bral/ /spros med g.yo ba med pa ste/ /bud med kun gyi lus la gnas/ /de phyir shes rab ye shes so/ /khyab bdag rgyal ba gcig pu yang / /lnga yi tshul du gnas pa de/ /gcig gyur 'od gsal bar thim pa/ /'di yi ye shes a tsa la/ /gti mug la sogs dkar po sogs/ /phung po'ang de bzhin gshegs ye shes/ /sems ni tshe dpag med rdo rje/ /khro bo yid srub 'joms byed pa/ /sems ni rkyen gyis mi g.yo ba/ /mig mi 'dzum pa'i lta 47—352

stangs kyis/ /rlung dang yid ni a tsa la/ /tsaṇ+ḍa tsaṇ+ḍa lī 'bar byed/ /phung po'i bdud med sku zhes brjod/ /ye shes kyis ni 'chi bdag 'joms/ /rgyal ba tshe dpag med gsung mchog /rnam par rtog pa nyon mongs bdud/ /de bcom thugs kyi rdo rje 'o/ /sems kyi 'gyur byed sna tshogs pa/ /stong pa'i srung bas go bgos nas/ /smyon pa'i spyod pa spyod byed pa/ /de la bdud kyi 'jug pa med/ /sku dang gsung thugs rdo rje yis/ /tshangs dang khyab 'jug dbang phyug che/ /legs ldan gdon rnams gzhom par bya/ /mgo bor zla ba bsams byas nas/ /chu yi sa bon bzung bar bya/ /yi ge'i phyi mo bzlas byas na—/ /'chi ba bslu bar byed pa'i mchog /dngos dang dngos med rnam grol ba'i—/ /dga' ba bzhi yi de gcig mchog /rnam par rtog pa kun spangs pa'i//spros pa med pa'i rang bzhin thob/ /de ltar bla ma'i man ngag mdor bsdus 'di//dam pa dam par brten nas shes byos la/ /mi g.yo rgyud rgyal thos par bya ba ste//mar me lta bur mar me mdzad kyis byas/ /ces pa gtum po khro bo chen po'i sgrub pa don dam pa zhes bya ba/ slob dpon chen po bhaṅga la'i mkhas pa/ dī paṅka ra shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta nir+pā ṇa shrī'i zhal snga dang / rmongs pa ta ra nā thas g.yar khral du bsgyur ba'o// //47—353

༄ga /gur mgon lha bachu bdun gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so//1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ma hā ka la sā dha na nā ma/ bod skad du/dpal nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal te ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo//bla ma la gus bden pa bsrung / /pha rol phyin pa drug dang ldan/ /bsdu dngos bzhi pos gzhan don byed/ /snying rjes brtson 'grus brtsams pa yis/ /slob dpon la dmod bstan pa 'jig /dam tshig spong zhing mtshams med byed/ /de rnams bsgral bar bya ba yin/ /gzhung dang 'gal na dam tshig nyams/ /dang por bdag nyid yi dam lhar/ /rim pa thams cad sdogs bsgom ⑤pas/ /bstan pa gnas par bya ba dang / /byang chub don du nag po sgrub/ /yi ge rja kyis gnas bstan pa/ /dur khrod nag po dang dur khrod chen po'i rgyud la sogs pa'i rgyud du bstan pa shes par bya/ /de dbus hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis/ /bsgrub bya bkug nas gdan du bsam/ /de las zangs grir gyur par bsam/ /de las nag po chen 47—355

po bskyed/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ /dbu skra nag po gyen du brdzes—/ /mdog nag gzugs thung gzi brjid che/ /gri dang ka ①pā lag na bsnamasaske/ /mgo bo'i phreng bas do shal byas/ /mche ba gcigs shing spyan bgrad pa/ /kha nas khrag 'dzag khros tsa na/ /rang gi yan lag sha gcod cing //gcer bu stag lpags smad g.yogs can/ /nag po sbrul gyis yan lag brgyan/ /khrag gi rgyun dang yi ge hūṃ/ /de yi zhal du thim par bsam/ /'khor lo 'dab ma brgyad pa la/ /ma mo gshin rje bcu drug gtso bo grub pa dang thabs gcig tu lus dang grib ma lta bur 'khor bskyed/ /de dag rim bzhin bstan pa ni/ /shar phyogs su ni ya ba ti//lho phyogs chos kyi rgyal po ste/ /nub phyogs su rtel pa/ byang phyogs su glang mgo can/ byang shar mtshams su ral pa tshar dgu/ nub byang du dmigs pa/lho nub tu phya bsangasadu/ shar lhor ①mig dmar/ de dag ni mdog sngo skya g.yas gri dang g.yonathod pa thogs pa'o/ /'di dag ni go rims bzhin te/ sharagashin rje pho nya mo dang / lhogashin rje mche ba mo dang / nubagashin rje be con nag mo dang / byangadus mtshan ma dang / byangasharalcags kyu ma dang / nubabyangazhagasapa ma dang / lhonubalu gu brgyud ma dudang / sharalhogashin rje 'be+ebs ma dang /'di dag kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ dbu skra lhug par 'dug pa/gcer bu lce 'jib pa/ mche ba gdags pa/ gdug pa thams cad 'gugs pa/las thams cad tshul bzhin mdzad pa kha dog nag mo/ phyag gnyis na gri gug dang thod pa thogs pa'o/ /de nas thugs ka'i 'od zer dang / /tshigs bcad dag gis spyan drang ba/ /rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas pa/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas 'di ru/ /drag po'i las la spyan 47—356

drangs bzhugs/ /myur bar 'ongs nas de la thim/ /mon sran gri'u 'dzam bu ti—/ /me tog bdug spos sha lnga dang / /bdud rtsi lnga sbyar gtor ma sbyin/ /de dag dbul ba'i sngags gsungs pa/ /oṃ ma hā kā la ya dzñā na a mri ta oṃ 26hūṃ hūṃ ma/ oṃ ma hā kā la shā sa nā pa ha ri re ṣā ba bye ma kā lo yo/ i rda rad na tra yā ya pa ka ri ṇi/ ya ti pra ti dzñā/ sma ra si ta dā/ i rda duṣ+ṭa/ kha kha—/ khā hi khā nyi/ mā ra mā ra/ grit+na grit+na/ bhan dha bhan dha/ ha na ha na/da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa khyod kyis sngon bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas pa bzhin du/ nga yis las ci bcol ba gyis shig /de ltar ma byas na mgo bo ardza ka'i rdog pa bzhin du 'gas so/ /dam chu blud/ lag tu rdo rje byin/ de nas srog gi snying po brjod do/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la hūṃ phaṭa/de nas bstod pa/ hūṃ srin po'i gzugs kyi gdug pa can/ /tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /grong khyer sum rtsegs 'jig byed pa/ /gtum po khrod la bdag bstod do/ /hūṃ mdog nag gzugs thung gzi brjid che/ /gdug pa tshar gcod gri gug g.yas/ /g.yon na gdug pa'i khrag bkang snod/ /thod phreng can la bdag bstod do/ /hūṃ/ khros pas zhabs brdabs sa gzhi g.yo/ /'jigs pa'i gad mos ri rab bsgyel/ /dam tshig nyam pa'i snying 'byin pa/ /dam tshig can la bdag bstod do/ /de nas bskul ba/ hūṃ/ 'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar gyi/ /bstan pa bsrung bar sems bskyed pa/ /nag po khyod ni yin pa ste/ /gdug pa tshar gcod 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /ral pa nag po gyen du g.yengs/ /steng gi lha tshogs 'jigs par byed/ /spyan bsgrad 47—357

'jags bla'adril bar kyi gdon tshogs sdigs/ /g.yas pa'i gri gug gnod sems can la sdang / /g.yon pa'i thod par gnod sems can khrag gsol/ /zhabs brdabs gnod sems can gyi lus la nyed/ /gang zhig dkon mchog gsum dmod dang / /bla ma brnyas byed sems can 'tshe/ /bdag gi bsgo ba kun khug la/ /ling ka 'di la myur du chug /'di'i sha zo khrag la 'thung / /rus pa klad pa nang rol gsol/ /rigs rgyud rtsad nas chod la shog /'dza' ba kun dang phrol la shog /bdag gi bsgo ba ma nyan na/ /nag po khyod ni nyams par 'gyur/ /zhes bskul lo/ /gong gi sngags sam/ yang na/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la che ge mo hūṃ phaṭa/ stong rtsa brgyad bzlas/ rtags dang mtshan ma mthong ba des/ /las sbyor rim pa brtsam par bya/ /'bru sna tshogs kyi phye ma la//tsha ba gsum la gzugs brnyan bya/ /ling ka sor brgyad tshad du bya/ /dug dang skye tshe lan tshwa dang / /rgya tshwa kha ru rtsal ru tsha/ /srin lag khrag dang smyo byed kyis—/ /ling kha bris nas snying khar gzhug /gdug pa'i tsher mas lus la dgang / /dur khrod me gel phub ma dang / /pad+mar 'dzag pa'i rak+ta dang / /tshil chen gu gul nag po dang / /da du ra yi 'bras bus bsreg /stong rtsa brgyad du byas na ni/ /gdon mi za bar nges par 'gyur/ /mnan pas gsad pa'i cho ga ni/ /rabs chad thod pa g.yon g.yon la/ /'khor lo bris la snga ma yi—/ /ling kha rab tu gzhug par bya/ /de nas nyi ma bdun pa'i bar/ /sbyor ba bzhi yi cho ga brtsam/ /de yang nyi ma dang ngo la/ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya che ge mo pra ma yo ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ nyi ma gnyis pa la/ ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya/che ge mo murtsa pa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ nyi ma gsum pa la ya da yo ni ra yak+ṣe ya che ge mo rak+ta 47—358

tsar pa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ nyi ma bzhi pa la/ yak+ṣe yats+tsha ni rā ma ya che ge mo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa—/ ya ba ti dang / phya sangs dang / gshin rje lu gu rgyud ma dang /gshin rje 'be+ebs ma rnams kyis bsgrub bya mgo 'khor du bcug pa'o/ /gshin rje tel ba dang / chos kyi rgyal po dang / gshin rje lcags kyu ma dang /gshin rje zhags pa ma rnams ni bsgrub bya khrag sgyug pa'o/ /glang mgo can dang /dmigs pa dang / gshin rje pho nya mo dang / gshin rje mche ba mo rnams kyis ni bsgrub bya thru ru bcug pa'o/ /ral pa tshar dgu dang / mig dmar dang /gshin rje mtshan mo nag mo dang / be+e con mo rnams ni gsod pa'i las byed pa'o//nyi ma lnga pa la yi ge bcu pa'o/ /nyi ma drug pa la yi ge bdun pa'o/ /de dag la ni gsad pa'i las la sbyar bar bya'o/ /nyi ma bdun pa la nag mo chen mo'i ①sngags brjod nas dur khrod du sbas na rgyud mi lus par 'gyur ro/ /klu grod pa'i gnas su ②klu'i 'khor lo'i bar du bcug la gong gi sbyor ba brtsam par bya'o/ /dur khrod kyi sa la mchod rten nag po khru gang ba byas la/ de'i nang du gzugs brnyan mgo mjug bzlog la bzhugs①/ phyogs bzhir rtsa ba'i sngags gong ma bzhin bris la gzhug /'phan nag po dang dar nag po'i rgyal mtshan btsugs la—/ de la gtad na yang gang bsgo ba 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /yang na khyi'i thod pa sha med pa la khar ling kha bcug la/ snga ma'i sbyor bas khang pa la sbas na yang gang bsgo ba 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /yang na dur khrod kyi ras blangs la/dgra'i snang mdzad la sogs pas byugs la gong du bstan pa'i rdzas rnams kyis 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa gnyis bris la/ rtsibs rjobargyad la dur khrod kyi ⑤ma mo brgyad dang / las kyi gshin rje brgyad bris la/ dbus su dgra'i ming rus bri/47—359

de'i rgyab tu sbrul nag po mgo bdun yod pas dkri/ de'i khar yi ge khaṃ dug gis bri—/ /'khor lo la mgon po'i sngags bris pa gong dang mthun/ de nas lha rnams bskyed nas ni/ /ling ka bar du gzhug par bya/ /kha sbyar byas la thod par gzhug /dug gis byugs la sngags kyis babyung / /sbrul dang sbal pa ljong mo'i sha /gong du gsungs pa'i rdzas rnams ni/ /dug dang bcas pa dag la gdung / /nag po'i phur bus btab nas su/ /klu yod pa'i gnas dag gam/ /sa bdag drag po'i gnas dag tu/ /sgyed bu gsum gyi bar du gzhug /de yi steng du sbyin sreg bya/ /zhag bdun bar du byas nas ni/ /bsgrub bya tsha ba'i rims kyis 'dzin/ /mdzes 'dzin pa la the tshom med/ /sngon du bsnyen pa song ba yis/ /gnod sbyin chen po'i bsnyen pa ni/ /khri phrag bdun du bzlas brjod bya / /de nas ra ru g.yas pa ru/ /'bum tsho gcig gi yungs kar bsag /kha bcad gang 'dod gnas su sba/ /de yi bsnyen sngags bstan pa ni/ /oṃ kri thu ri/ shag pra ma ya/ oṃ kri li shag /shar ser dh+ril bh+yo/ oṃ bu ting khe/shar ser dh+ril bh+yo/ oṃ dza ti khe shar ser dh+ril bh+yo/ oṃ pra ma ya gar gri phebs bh+yo/de yi sbyor ba bstan pa ni/ /lha rten btsugs pa'i gnas dag tu/ /rnel te shi ba'i thod pa ru/ /dkar thab sngo thab dmar thab bya/ /yi ge dang po spangs nas ni/ /rabs chad thod pas dgab par bya/ /ra gsob brdab cing dug me bud—/ /stong re bzlas shing sbub par bya/ /ra hu la dang sbyar nas ni/ /thal ba gang 'dod gnas su sba/ /yang na bsnyen pa'i tshul du bya/ /yi ge lnga yi rang gnas bsrung / /sbyin sreg byas pa'i thal ba la/ /yungs kar dag la bsngags nas ni/ /gtor bas ser ba 'chad par 'gyur/ /yang na phur bus 47—360

gsad pa dang / /sbyin sreg bya ba mchog tu gsungs/ /dpal nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //a tsa ra ra tū la dmar po dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba kyi ljang gis bsgyur// //'di'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bram ze mchog sred/ bde ba'i rdo rje/shradha kā ra/ dī paṃ ka ra/ rin chen bzang po/ dge tshul pu r+ṇa/ lcags ri gong kha pa / rdzing bu kha pa/ spen mug pa/ zhang ye/ /gze ba don grub/ bar thang sneyab sras / dar shag /bu ston bsod dbang / mchog ldan/ skyi ston pa/ kun mkhyen chen po/ byang chub seng ge/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po/mkhas pa gzhon nu seng ge/ chos rje dmar ston rgyal mtshan 'od zer ba/ mkhan chen rin po che bdag ā nan+das ④zhus/'di'i dkyil chog /sa lugs kyi gri gug lha lngas byed pa phyag len yin/'di lha lnga ma'i brgyud pa yin pa 'dra/ gsan yig na ni 'di ka 'dug /lha bcu gnyis ma la/ gzhal yas khang gi dbus su/ 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa'i lte bar gur—/ mdun du e ka tsa ti'i lto bar lha mo/ rtsibs gnyis par yab rtsibs gsum par yum/ bzhi par ming po che ba/ lnga par ming po chung ba/ drug par ral gcig ma/ shar sgor seng gdong dkar mo lcags kyu dang thod rlon gyi phreng ba/lho sgor gzig gdong ser mo zhags pa dang thod pa/ nub sgor dom gdong dmar mo lcags sgrog dang mar me/ byang sgor dred gdong ljang khu tho ba dang lcags kyu 'khor lo bsnams pa/ 'di'i sgrubs ④thabs rgyas pa rin chen grags kyi lag bris gsar bzhengs khrod na yod/ sgo ba bzhi phud na brgyad kyang yod/ lha bcu 47—361

gnyis ma sogs po ti tshad ma'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa yan rjes gnang dang 'dra la/ de nas/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ dpal ldan seng ge/ snyam med pa/gzungs kyi dpal/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar pa ye rgyal/ kun bzang pa/dmar ston pa/ zhal snga nas/ des bdag go/ /yang na/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yan rjes gnang dang 'dra la/ dpal ldan tshul khrims yan 'dra/ chos kyi rnam grangs / zhal snga nas kyi gsan yig brgya so bdun la yod// //bsdur mchan/355 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉rtor bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉thasgoms/356 ①〈〈pe 〉〉tā/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉bangs/ ②〈〈pe 〉skosto/ ④〈〈pe〉〉sga/358 ①〈〈pe 〉〉snags/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉tshed/359 ①〈〈pe 〉shepo'i/ ②〈〈pe 〉to/su/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉bzhug du〈〈pe 〉〉brtsibs/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉7)sa/361 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〉pa/ ②〈〈pe 〉ran+tas/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉sgrub/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2673)47—362

gsang ba'i sgrub thabs/khye༄ ga /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā ka la ma ra na gh+ra h+ya sa da na/ bod skad du/ slob dpon nag po mchog sred kyis ⑤mdzad pa'i nag po chen po'i 'phrin las gsang ba'i sgrub ④thabs/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di la don gsum ste/ dang po glad don mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bca' ba la gnyis las dang ponam mkha' lta bus sngoskya'ajigs byed khrobo'igazugs khros/ /'od zer 'bar bas nyon mongs pa 'chi bdag phung po lha'i bu'i bdud rnams bsreg /rig bcas he ru ka khyod la/ /phyag 'tshal gnyis pa bshad par dam bca' ba mgon po'i bsgrub thabs bshad/ /gnyis pa gzhung don gsum las rten gyi gang zag blama'ab ṭa/sa sems can la snying rjer ldan/ /tshul khrims la sogs bsdu dngos bzhi/ /gsum la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang / /dbang la sogs pa thob pas ni/ /rim pa 'di ltar bsgrub par bya/ /47—363

gnyis pa bsgral ba'i zhing slob dpon la smod bstan pa 'jig /dam tshig la 'phya 'tshams med byed/ /de rnams bsgral bar bya ba yin/ /gzhan du byas na nyams par 'gyur/ /gsum pa ji ltar bsgrub pa'i thabs la gsum las dang po rang lhar bskyed pa/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i he ru ka'i ting 'dzin gnas/ /de'i rim pas bya ba bsgrub/ /gnyis pa chos skyong mgon po bskyed pa la gnyis las rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa brag stengs dkyil 'khor gru gsum gnas/ /thod pa skam dang rlon pa'i/ /rtsig pa gsum ldan pa la/ /zhing gi skang gdung gral krab dang / /gri gug me ris rab tu mtshan/ /sgo ni zur du yod pa la/ /de dbus gru gsum zla gam ldan/ /de dbus ro gnyis bsnol steng du/ /ma las byung ba'i nyi ma bsam/ /gnyis pa lha bskyed pa la bzhi las dang po dam tshig gi mgon po bskyed pa de la gnyis las gtso bo bskyed pa de steng hūṃ dang de gyur pa las gri gug lte bar hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ /de gyur pa las dpal mgon po nag po chen po bskyed par bya/ /mdog nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /spyan gsum dbu skra gyen du badze+es/ /thung zhing sbom la gzi brjid che/ /gri dang ka pa la phyag na 'dzin—/ /brgya phyed mgo bos do shal byas/ /mche gcigs spyan dgrad ljags 'dril ba/ /kha nas khrag 'dzag khros tsam na/ /rang gi yan lag sha gcod byed/ /gcer bu thal bas lus la byugs/ /stag gi lpags pas sham thabs byas/ /klu 17—364

chen brgyad kyis yan lag brgyan/ /zhabs gnyis gyad kyi dor stabs bzhugs/ /khrag gi rgyun yang yi ge hūṃ/ /de'i zhal du thim par bsam/ /gnyis pa 'khor bskyed pa la gnyis las dang po yab bskyed pa las kyi gshin rje brgyad po ni/ /'phrin las kyi dus su gtso bo nyid la bsam byas te/ /bsgrub bya mgo ni 'khor ba'i phyir//ya ba ti dang phya sangs lu gu brgyud ma 'bebs ma ni/ /nag po'i spyi bor bsam par bya /bsgrub bya khrag tu sgyug pa'i phyir/ /beconam gshin rje tel pa lcagasakyu ma chos kyi rgyal/ /de'i mgrin par bsam par bya/ /de nas bsnyo ru gzhug pa'i phyir/ /glang mgo can phonyamodang mchebamadamigs pa ni/ /de'i snying khar bsgom par bya/ /de nas gsad par bya ba'i phyir/ /ral pa tshar dgu ma—momig dmar dus mtshan mo ni/ /de'i lte bar bsam par bya/ /gnyis pa yum barma pa ma mo brgyad kyang de ltar te/ /nag po'i lus su 'dug pa la—/ /gri gug dang ni thod pa 'dzin/ /cha lugs gtso bo dang pho sngo skya mo sngo nag mtshungs bsgom/ /gnyis pa ye shes kyi mgon po dgug gzhug bya ba de nas spyan drang gzhug par bya/ /he ru ka'i spyan snga ru/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas pa/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas 'di ru/ /drag po'i las la spyan 'dren bzhugs/ /myur bar 'ongs nas thim par bsam/ /47—365

gsum pa dbang bskur zhing gtor ma dbul ba dbang bskur gtor ma dbul bar bya/ /bzhi pa sngags bzlas pa nag po chen po'i bzlas pa'i thabs ni/ /snying po dang rbod rbad bsad gsum gyi sngags oṃ dang ma hā ka la sogs pa'i/ /sngags kyi phreng ba gtso 'khor rnams//'khor lo la gshin rje pho mo bcu drug gi rang rang gi snying po gtso bo la phul la zagang cig lnga gas ni ba'/sa pas 'grub—/ /spyi don gsum pa las grub pa'i rtags/ 'khor gshin rje grub na sa ga'i/ 'a ṭa/'ab dang che/ga pa dang / /nam mkha' 'od kyis rgyas pa dang / /sna tshogs skar mda' 'khrug pa dang / /dmag mi mtshon cha thogs pa dang / /khrab can 'khor ma mo grub na tshogs dang bud med tshogs/ /sbyinasreg drod tshad ri las me ni mched pa dang / /las sbyor phra mo mtshon cha mang po 'khrug pa dang / /gtor ma btab pa dang bskang ba bya ba dka' thub mang po 'byung ba dang / /las sbyor gyi drod tshad phab pa a tsa ra ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gsum pa las sbyor la gsum las dang po bshad par dam bca' ba de nas sbyor ba bshad par bya/ /khyad par du ni gyur pa yin/ /gnyis pa las sbyor dngos la gsum las gsad pa/ de la gsum las dang po sbyor ba de la gnyis las dang po liṅga de la dang po rgyud dang tshad bstan pa gsad pa'i cho ga 'di ltar ro/ /'bru nag la sogs rdzas rnams la/ /ling ga sor brgya tshad du bya/ /dpral bar rus dang snying khar ཿ/nga / /lte bzag bsad pa khrag gis bri/ /gnyis pa 'khor lo bri ba la bzhi las dang po rgyu 47—366

dang tshad bstan pa dug la sogs pa'i rdzas rnams kyis/ /'khrul 'khor bri bar re mig dgu pa bzhi pa dgu bris la nyi ma bzhi pa'i sngags dgos ①byas nas ni/ /sngarabyas pa ling ga de'i nang du gzhug /lus sems phung po bkug nas ni/ /zhagabadun tsam du 'khrul 'khor de la rab tu gzhug /stong rtsa brgyad du bzlas pa bya/ /dur khrod zhing ras blangs nas ni/ /rgyud du gsungs pa'i rdzas rnams kyis/ / gshin rje gshed kyi lte bar ④'khor lo rtsibs brgyad bskang ba ①gnyis bris te/ /de la gshin rje brgyad las kyi gshin rje brgyad po ni/ /pho'akhoragayas skor dag tu bri bar bya/ /nag po chen po'i lho ba'i 'khor lo de ladur khrod gnod sbyin mo brgyad ni/ /mo'akhoragayon skor dag tu bri bar bya/ /nag po'i 'khor lo'i dbus su bsabyalha sbyin la/ /sbrul nag mgo bdun yod pas du'akhor dkri/ /gsum pa khyad par du las myur ba'i don du bri ba kha nas dug gi rlangs pa 'byung / /phyi rol mu khyud 'khor ba la/ /bod sbad bsad gsum bri bar bya/ /bzhi pa de la rab gnas bya ba rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga ni/ /'khor lo gnyis po yongs gyur nas/ /gshin rje ma mo'i tshogs rnams de la ye shes bstem gtor gshin rje bskyed/ /de la mchod bstod gsol ba gdab/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum las dang po spang gzugs pa de la gnyis las dang po spang ngo / /'alnga/ga rten khams kyi sa bdag dang / /lha dang klu'i tshogs rnams la/ /gnyis pa rdzas dbul ba gtor ma chen po bsham pa dang / /lug dang g.yag dang phye mar dang / /chang gi phud kyis mchod nas ni/ /gnyis pa bsgrub pa po rang gi ji ltar bya ba bdag nyid skra spyi bor bcing nag po'i gos gyon cing / /gdong la mchi rjom 'dzag pa des brang yang brdung / /srungs ma'i tshogs rnams kyi spyan snga nas/ /gsum pa bden pa'i tshig bsgrags pa bsgrub bya 47—367

de'i nyes pa bsgrag /dkon mchog dbu 'phang 'di yis smad/ /bstan pa gnyan po 'di yis shig /mtshams med lnga sogs brjod par bya/ /de nas srungs ma'i tshogs kyis su/ /de'i las can bsgral dgos zer/ /gsum pa gzungs la brgyad las dang po 'khor lo la ji ltar bya ba/ /lcags kyi khang par bsam che/ zugs/ 'bo/ ra lo dril nas ni/ /mon dang rabs chad kyi thod pa kha sbyar nang du gzhug /drirashi ba'izhing skra'i thag pas sumasgril gyi rgya gram bcing / /dug khrag sna tshogs rnams kyis byug nad sna tshogs su bsam gnyis pa rdzas sna tshogs kyi bsreg pa de nas dkyil 'khor ram̐ ①dbus su ni/ /rab gnas zin pa'i gri rkang sgyed pu'i kha la bzhag /ga'u de'i zhabs su ni/ /dur khrod me dang phub ma dang / /pad ma 'dzag pa'i rag ta dang / /tshil chen gu gul nag po dang / /da du ra'i 'bras bu sreg /sbrul dang sbal pa lcong mo dang / /nya dang sdig pa rtsangs pa dang / /bzhi pa las kyi byed dus nam byed la dur khrod me la nub mo gdung / /nyin par rdzas kyi bye brag gzhan/ /nyin par gshin rjes gsum pa la rak+ta bzhi pa la tshil chen las rnams byed/ /bsad pa'i sha za zhing khrag 'thung ba mkha' 'gro mas ni nub resa'o// /lnga pa ting 'dzin gang gis sngags bzlas pa thun dang pos mgo 'khor gnyis pas smyo gsum pas lkugs ba'i pa/sa bsad nyi ma snibadun du bya'o/ /de'i bsnyen pa bstan pa ni/ /bdag nyid khrag 'thung dgyesapa rdo rje'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /gshin rje gshed kyi gsad sngags ā+oṃḥṣ+ṭiyi ge bcu pa dang / /gshinarje'iya tshogs sum cu rtsa gnyis ni/ /nyi ma bdun la bzlas pa bya/ /de yang nyi ma bsham du sham bu bsad pa'i sngags dang bcas/ /ya mar ka'i yige bdun pa'i bsad sngags dang / /mgon po'i rmam hā ka la ya ṣa sa ④ṇa bod sbad bsad gsum bzlas pa ni/ /drug pa mtshan ma'i sngags nub mo dril la bzlas par bya/ /bdunapa dang thugator ma btang ba'i dus nyin byed 'ug pa ltogs pa'i dus dang ni/ /mtshanabyed bya rog 47byed368

ltogs pa'i dus su ni/ /drag po'i gtor ma btang bar bya/ /brgyad pa dus ji tsam du sngags bzlas pa skabs su thun drug yungs kar khrag dug mda' phur bu lcags phye'o brdeg pa ni/ /nyin mtshan bye brag bod rbad bsad gsum gyi sngags dang bcas/ /de yang gsad pa'i lnga/gas che ge mo la ma ra ya phaṭa spyi/sa gdags/ /de ltar bsnyen pa rdzogs nas nyi ma bdun pa zhag bdun byas nas ni/ /'khor lo'i bya ba rdzogs pa dang / /gnyisapaganan pa gnan pa'i rim pa bstan pa ni/ /klu'i khyim 'am sa bdag 'gul/ /yang na dur khrod mchog tu gsungs/ /de lta bu'i sbyor bas ni/ /khyab 'jug chen po la sogs pa'i/ /lha chen kun kyang bsgral 'gyur na / /bstan pa 'jig par byed pa'i/ /gzhan la lta yang ci zhig smos/ /gsum pa sbyin bsreg byas pa'i dgos pa las kyi kha ni bskang ba dang / /bar chad nye bar zhi ba dang / /'phrin las myur du 'grub pa'i phyir/ /sbyin sreg bya ba mchog tu gsungs/ /gsum pa mjug yongs su rdzogs pa'i bya ba la gsum las slob dpon gang gis mdzad pa/ dur khrod chen po dngos grub brnyes pa'i/ /slob dpon chen po bram ze mchog sred kyis/ /gnyis pa dgos pa gang gis phyir mdzad pa phyi rabs bstan pa gnas pa'i don du mdzad/ /gsum pa d+ku lam gdab pa de'i las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog /①dpal nag po chen po'i 'phrin las gsang ba'i sgrub rjothabs/ slob dpon chen po bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa'o// //47byed369

a tsa ra ra hūṃ la dmar po'i gdam ngag /bla ma gyi ljang dbu dkar gis thugs la sbas pa'o// //bsdur mchan/363 lamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ga /nag po chen po'i 'phrin las gsang ba'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉〉kyi/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉bsgrub/367 ①〈〈pe 〉stanagod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉warigashin rje gshed kyi lte bar/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉wazobaskangab/ du〈〈pe 〉〉thas/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉pachis/368 ①〈〈pe 〉boraṃ/ ②〈〈pe 〉lken/ ①〈〈pe 〉7/ ④〈〈pe 〉bozodang /369 ①〈〈pe 〉ska/ // ②〈〈pe 〉〉bsgrub/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2674)47—370

—thabs zhas dra/ ba/①go sgrub thabs klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ma hā kā la sa dha na ma/ bod skad du/ dpal nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar sngon gsungs pa'i rim pas stong pa nyid du bsgom pa'i rjes la/ sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ yig nag po'o/ /de nyid kho na yongs su gyur pa las/ rje btsun dpal nag po chen po ni/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ sku mdog nag po spyan gsum pa cher 'bar ba/ g.yas dang g.yon gyi phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ mgo bo'i phreng ba 'phyang bas brgyan pa/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du 'greng ba/ sku lus rags shing mche ba gabyugs pa/ 'jigs su rung ba/lto 'phyes lus la brgyan pa/ yan lag thams cad mi'u thung gi gzugs brnyan can—/ kha nas khrag 'dzag pa/ skad cig gis bdag nyid bskyed la sngags 47—371

bzla bar bya ste/ de la 'dir sngags ni/ oṃ ma hā kā la ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/dug dang / khrag dang sgog pa dang / yungs kar rnams bsres pa'i spos nag po chen po la dbul lo/ /sran ma/ sha chen dang / chang dang / me tog dang /byug pa dang / sgron ma dang / bdud rtsi lngas nag po chen po la gsol mchod byas la gtor ma'i sngags 'dis so/ /oṃ ma hā kā la ya/ shā sa na/ u pa ha ri be+e la/ e ṣa a pazi/ ma lo a yi④/ i rda rat+na tra yā ya/ a pa ka ri ṇi/ya ti pra ti dzhar ①sma ra si tā dā/ i rda duṣ+ṭa kha kha/ khā ti khā hi/ mā ra mā ra/grit+na grit+na/ brnya brnya④/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa dzi dun me ke na mā ra ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ de la 'di'i nye bar srud pa ni/ tsha ba gsum la bsgrub bya'i gzugs so sor byas te/ de'i lus la tsher mas bkang ste/ dug dang ske tshe dag gi cho ga bzhin du byugs la me la bdugs na gang gi ming nas bos na skad cig la mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /yang slob dpon rtag tu smod pa/sems can dpag tu med pa la gnod par byed pa ni/ nag po chen pos gsol bar byed de/ de'i lus kyi sha za zhing de'i khrag kyang 'thung bar byed/ rtag par byas nas spyi bo nas yongs su gzung dunas til tsam du byed do/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa mang du yid la go bar bya'o/ /dpal nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bod kyi lo tsā ba ga rod kyis bsgyur ba'o // //⑦rgyal tsha lung mang po dang / chos rje bsod nams kyi phyag dpe las/yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis klu'i dgon par zhus dag bgyis pa las bshus so// //47—372

bsdur mchan/371 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/372 ①〈〈pe 〉stani/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉mi/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉sto/ du〈〈pe 〉startod+dha bharnya/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉de/ du〈〈pe 〉〉bzung / ⑦〈〈pe 〉ska/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2675)47wa 373
