spre —bsgrub pa' thabs zhas bya ba/①ga ta thā ga ta rak+ṣ-i tas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// rag /rgya gar skad du/ tsa turmu kha sa ma ya sirnyi sā dha nā ma/ bod skad du/ zhal bzhi pa'i dam tshig dngos grub bsgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang ni yi dam lha/ /zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas la 'dud/ /rtsa zhal nag po ro za ba/ /g.yas zhal dkar po khro zhing 'dzum/ /g.yon pa dmar zhing rgya cher bzhad/ /steng zhal nag po khro zhal ni/ /bdud dang srin po lha srin dang / /gshin rje ④la sogs bkrag par mdzad/ /drag rgyas dbang dang zhi ba ni/ /zhal bzhi'i kha dog dag gi ④shes/ /de dag bla ma'i zhal shes ni/ /las bzhi bsgrub par 'dod pa yi/ /phug dang nags dang dur khrod dang / /dmar zhing mtho ba me tog rgyan/ /dbe+en zhing nyams dga' bsgrub pa'i gnas/ /der 'dug spros pa bcad par bya/ /shog bu gro ga dur khrod ras/ /dung dang gur kum sin dhu 47—374

ra—/ /dur khrod sol bas snag tsha'o/ /rtsa ba dang ni sham bu'i sngags/ /bton dang bcug pa man ngag yin/ /bsnyen de bsgrub pa las la sbyar/ /dung dang ra gan zangs dang lcags/ /maṇ+ḍal snod kyi bye brag go/ /lha dang 'khor lo 'od zer yang / /bsgom pa'i rim pa shes par bya/ /snga dro dus dang nyi ma'i zer—/ /zla ba yar ngo mar ngo yi/ /de dag dus kyang shes par bya/ /phreng ba gos dang rgyan rnams shes/ /mar dang sbrang rtsi bu ram dang / /zho dang 'bru dang rin chen lnga/ /dug yungs khrag sogs dbye ba shes/ /ma rungs zhi dang mngon spyod rgyas/ /bsgrub bya dbang sdud tshar gcod pa/ /bsam pa'i bye brag shes par bya/ /rang dang bsgrub bya'i bsod nams brtag /bsgrub pa'i mtshan nyid de yis shes/ /bstan pa'i don spyad the tshom med/ /rgyal khams dang ni grong khyer gcig /dbye ba'i rim pa shes par bya/ /las mtha' sdud pa man ngag yin/ /zhal gyi u pa de sha 'di/ /rak+ṣi ta yis mdzad pa las/ /gnyan lo dar ma grags kyis bsgyur/ /bla ma yi dam chos skyong la/ /nyes pa gang snang bzod par gsol// //47—375
bsdur mchan/374 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/②〈〈pe 〉〉rjes/ ①〈〈pe 〉stonas/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2676)47wa 376

6——1 gra' ba21ba thabab dhir dpal nag po chen po srog gi spu gri'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ /༄7—/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ma hā kā la sa dha na maḥ/ bod skad du/dpal nag po chen po'i bsgrub thabs/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo /slob dpon sku yi dgra bo dang / /dkon mchog gsum la gnod byed dang / /bstan pa'i chos la sdang ba rnams/ /bsgral bar bya ba'i man ngag yin/ /gzhan du byas na dam tshig nyams/ /de bas mang du mi spel lo/ /man ngag 'di la rnam pa gnyis/ /bsgrub pa'i thabs dang gsad pa'i thabs/ /bsgrub pa'i thabs la rnam pa bdun/ /dus dang gnas dang dkyil 'khor dang / /dam rdzas bkod pa'i rim pa'o/ /nag po bskyed cing bsnyen pa'i grangs/ /gnas ni dur khrod la sogs pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gru gsum la 'khor lo/ /rdo rje dbus khrag 'khor lo'i dbus/ /gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba ni/ /dur 47—377

khrod ro yi sol bas byug /shi ba'i khrag gis brtsig par bya/ /gru chad gsum yang mthing nag ste/ /zla gam gsum yang dmar por bya/ /de rgyab mthing nag zlum por bskor/ /rdo rje gcol gzhi bya ba yang / /phyogs dang kha dog rnam par gsal// //dam rdzas bkod pa'i rim pa ni/ /dbus kyi gru gsum mthing nag la/ /nag po'i 'phan dang rgyal mtshan btsugs/ /gri gug thod khrag dag kyang bzhag /mi nag khyi nag glang nag dang / /tri rgod snying yang der ni bzhag /de nang gru gsum mthing nag la/ /bshos bu bsten gtor rgyun gtor bzhag /zla khams ①gsum la la dus byug /tshil chen gu gul drag du bdug /de ni dam rdzas bkod pa'orka/ / //brag steng 'khor lo gru gsum dbus/ /hūṃ skyes 'bar ba nag po che/ /ro yi steng du hūṃ las skyes/ /oṃ shri skem hā kā la ye hūṃ phaṭa/ nag po chen po bskyed pa'o/ /gri gug dang ni ka pa la/ /phyag gnyis thugs kar 'dzin pa'o/ /skam po lnga yis dbu rgyan can/ /rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas/ /spyan gsum dbu skra gyen du 'bar/ /mche gatshigs gzugs thung khros tsa na/ /rang gi yan lag sha gcod byed/ /khrag gi rgyun yang 'jib par byed/ /dur khrod chas kyis brgyan pa'o/ /me ri me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /spyi bor oṃ las mgrin par lta—/ /thugs kar hūṃ yig 'bar ba bsgom/ /ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs pa / /byedalas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng / /hūṃ las gshin rje gshed po bsgom//be+er yang lcags kyur gyur pa las/ /rang bzhin gnas nas spyan drangs pa/ /(7—378

hūṃ rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin/ /byen gyis brlab pa'i gnas 'di ru/ /drag po'i las la spyan 'dren bzhugs/ /oṃ e h+ya hi ma hā kā ①ye/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka /sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ②klog ltar 'ongs nas myur bar thim/ /lcags kyu 'od du zhu ba las①/ /lha mo bum pa thogs par 'gyur④/ /khrus byas dbang bskur bum pa las/ /zla ba'i dkyil du lha mo ni/ /gshin rje gshed du gyur pa las/ /nag po'i dbu la brgyan par bsam/ /hūṃ srin po'i gzugs kyis gdug pa can/ /tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /grong khyer gsum brtsegs 'jigs byed pa/ /gtum po khyod la bdag bstod do/ /mdog nag gzugs thung gzi brjid che/ /gdug pa tshar gcod gri gug g.yas/ /g.yon na bdug dhipa'i khrag bkang snod/ /thod 'phreng can la bdag bstod do/ /'khros pas zhabs brdab sa gzhi g.yos/ /'jigs pa'i gad mos ri rab bsgyel/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i snying 'byin pa/ /dam tshig can la bdag bstod do/ /oṃ ma hā kā la ye hūṃ phaṭa/ mon sran gre'u 'dzam bu ti/ /me tog bdug spos sha lnga dang / /bdud rtsi lnga sbyar gtor ma 'di/ /dam chur dmigs la dbul bar bya/ /hūṃ 'thung shig 'thung shig rdo rje'i chu/ /rdo rje'i chu ni 'thung nas ni/ /bsrungs shig dam tshig chen po'i bka'/ /dam las 'das nas tshig par 'gyur/ /hūṃ zung shig zung shig rdo rje ni/ /he ru ka dpal phyag na gnas/ /nag po khyod kyi rjo'adi zung la/ /bdag gis bsgo ba nyan par gyis/ /bdag gis 47—379

bsgo ba ma nyan na/ /nag po khyod kyang nyams par 'gyur/ /oṃ ma hā kā la ya sha sa na/ u pa ha ri ṇi/ a ①ṣa a paṣ+ṭi/ ma ka lo/ a yi i rda rad na tra ya/ a pa ka ri khaṃ ya ti pra ti rnyi sma ra si/ tā da/ i rda duṣ+ṭan/ dgra bo kha kha khā ti khā hi/ dgra bo mā ra mā ra/ dgra bo byuṇ+ḍi byuṇ+ḍa/ dgra bo ban dha ban dha/ dgra bo ha na ha na/ dgra bo da ha da ha/ dgra bo pa tsa pa tsa/bye na mi ke na/ dgra bo ma ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ thun gyi sngags la 'di nyid bzlas/ /ras sam shing shun dag la ni/ /dgra bo'i gzugs brnyan byas nas ni/ /'brub khung nang du gzhug par bya/ /hūṃ 'das dang ma byon da ltar gyis④/ /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa/ /nag po khyod ni yin pa ste/ /gdug pa tshar gcod 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /ral pa nag po gyen du g.yengs/ /steng gi lha tshogs 'jigs par byed/ /spyan bsgrad ljags 'dril mche ba gcigs/ /bar gyi gdon tshogs brlag par byed/ /g.yas kyi gri gug gnod sems can la sdang / /g.yon pas gdug pa'i snying khrag zhal du gsol/ /zhabs brdabs gnod sems can gyi lus la nyed/ /gang zhig dkon mchog gsum la smod pa dang / /bla ma brnyas byed sems can 'tshe/ /bdag gis bsgo ba kun khug la/ /ling ga 'di la myur du chug /'di yi sha zo khrag la 'thung / /rus pa klad pa don snying zo/ /rigs rgyud rtsad nas chod la shog /mdza' bo kun dang myur du phrol—/ /bdag gis bsgo ba nyan par gyis/ /bdag gis bsgo ba ma nyan na/ /nag po khyod ni nyams par 'gyur/ /de bas las rnams myur du bsgrubs/ /yungs dkar yungs nag zi ra rnams/ /dug dang khrag ni bsres byas la/ /gong gi sngags kyis thun rdzas brab/ /de nas phur bu'i gdab las ni/ /mi bsad 47—380

mtshon nam seng ldeng la/ /nag po 'khros pa'i skur byas te/ /bskyed bstem byas la gnas bcur ni/ /dgra bgegs bkug nas gdab par bya ①hūṃ las byung ba'i nag po che/ /thung la sbom pa'i gsus khyim can/ /'od zer bskal pa'i me dpung bzhin/ /rnam pa kun tu 'bar mdzad pa/ /dug gsum bsreg byed phur pa mchog /ha na ha na ki la ya/ /da ha da ha ki la ya/ /pa tsa pa tsa ki la ya/ /dhi na mi ke na ki la ya/ /dgra bgegs spyi bor ki la ya/ /kha kha khaX hi ki la ya/ /ma ra ma ra ki la ya/ /byut+na gyit+na ki la ya—/ /ban dha ban dha ki la ya/ /ha na ha na ki la ya/ /da ha da ha ki la ya/ /pa tsa pa tsa ki la ya/ dhi na me khruke na ki la ya/ /oṃ ma hā kā la ki la ya/ /dgra bgegs ma ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pas gnas bcur gdab par bya/ /dgra bgegs rdul bzhin brlag par bsam/ /lus ni thal ba'i phung por bsam/ /rnam shes mi bskyod zhing du 'phang / /①nag po chen po'i sbyin sreg ni/ /hom khung gru gsum sgo can la/ /rdo rje'i ra bas bskor ba ni/ /rdo rje'i mda' gzhu ldan par bri/ /nag la rtsubs pa'i shing rnams dang / /dur khrod shing rnams brtsig par bya/ /dbus su nag po chen po bskyed/ /rang gi gnas nas spyan drangs la/ /bstem la mchod pa rnam lnga 'bul/ /ling ga thun dang bsreg rdzas ni/ /dgra bgegs kyi ni dbang po lnga/ /rnam shes tshogs brgyad bsams bunas ni/ /nag po chen po'i zhal du 'bul—/ /zhal gdangs mche ba rab gatshigs pa/ /ljags la me 'bar zhal du bsregs/ /argo byungs la bstod pa bya/ /dgra bgegs rtsad nas brlag 'dod na/ /mi bsad mtshon nam gri gug gis/ /sngags bzlas ling ga drag du 47—381

gtubs—/ /sbyin sreg byas la mnan pa bya/ /mtshan ma brtag pa 'di lta ste/ /rdo rje slob dpon rmi ba dang / /dag pa'i dge slong rmi ba dang / /hor gyi bcas chen rmi ba dang / /yul gyi rgyal po rmi ba dang //mi nag khyi nag rmi ba dang / /grib gnon lta bu byung ba dang / /thog dang ser ba 'bab pa dang / /chom sgra 'ur rtig 'byung ba dang / /de dag nag po chen po'i rtags—/ /bshas rar btsud dang khyu bzung dang / /khra yis bye la ded pa dang / /ri dwags rgyar btsud brda ded ni/ /dgra bo khug pa'i rtags su bshad/ /khras bsad khyis bsad mis bsad dang / /mi sha zos sam gdos chen ni/ /rang gis rtsad nas bton gyur pa/ /de dag rmi lam gsod pa'i rtags/ /gri gug yu ba rdo rje can—/ /thod khrag zhal du gsol rmis na/ /srog rtags yin pas kha sbyor dbye/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i rtags rnams ni/ /slob dpon shi ba rmi ba dang / /phyag mtshan chag gam dkyil 'khor la/ /mi nag pa ①'khros pa rmi ba dang / /nag pos 'gyod lugs byed pa dang / /de rnams dam tshig nyams pa'i rtags/ /a mṛ ta dang chang phud dang / /bsur chen dud pa bshos bu ni/ /brgya rtsa brgyad kyis dam tshig bskang // //mnan pa gang du bya ba ni/ /klu'i yul du mnan pa na/ /mdze yis 'chi bar the tshom med/ /btsan gyi yul du mnan pa na/ /gzer thabs 'chi bar gdon mi za/ /gnyan gyi yul du mnan pa na/ /lhog pas nges par 'chi bar 'gyur—/ /khyi nag thod pa sha med la/ /sngags dang dgra bo'i ming spel bri/ /dgra bo'i khyim du mnan pa na/ /dgra bo phung bar ze tshom med/ /bdag dpal he ru ka'i nga rgyal gyis dgra bo ling ga la bkug cing bstem te/47—382

gu gul nag po la sogs drag po'i rdzas kyis bdug cing / mgon po nag po la gtad par bya ste/ hūṃ/ khyod ni tshe len nag po ste/ /sdang ba'i dgra bo las ngan 'di/ /tshe len nag po khyod la gtad/ /khyod ni shi bdud nag po ste/ /sdang ba'i dgra bo nyams pa 'di/ /shi bdud nag po khyod la gtad/ /khyod ni srog gcod nag po ste/ /sdang ba'i dgra bo dam nyams 'di/ /srog gcod nag po khyod la gtad/ /khyod ni mgon po nag po ste/ /sdang ba'i dgra bo las ngan 'di—/ /mgon po nag po khyod la gtad/ /sdang ba'i dgra bo myur du sgrol/ /sdang dgra srog 'phrog ma gyur na/ /srog snying nga yis gtad ni bzung / /bcol ba'i las 'di grub par mdzod/ /dpal nag po chen po'i srog gi spu gri'i sgrub thabs/ bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bla ma mal gyi khyad chos lags so// spyos //47—383

༄ga /nag po chen po'i sprun sreg①ga dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i sbyin sreg bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa bzhugs so| / ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ma hā kā la sa dha na ma/ bod skad du/dpal nag po chen po'i bsgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal te ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan/ /tshul khrims la sogs bsdu dngos bzhis—/ /sems can don byed brtson 'grus ldan/ /rtag tu sgrub la dga' ba yis/ /slob dpon la smod bstan la sdang / /dam tshig la 'phya mtshams med byed/ /de rnams sgral bar bya ba yin/ /gzhan du dam tshig nyams par 'gyur—/ /dang por bdag gi yi dam lhar/ /rim pa thams cad rdogs bsgoms la/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir nag po mchod/ /brag steng dkyil 'khor gru gsum gnag /hūṃ skyes 'bar ba nag po che/ /gri dang ka pa lag na 'dzin/ /mgo bo'i phreng bas do shal byas/ /mche gcigs gzugs thung gzi brjid che/ /47—385

kha nas khrag 'dzag khros tsam na/ /rang gi yan lag sha gcod byed/ /khrag gi rgyun yang 'jib par phyed/ /dkon mchog gsum khro bla ma brnyas/ /'tshams med la sogs byed rnams kyi/ /de rnams mgor gnas til tsam za/ /de ltar gsal bar bsams ①nas ni/ /rang gi gnas nas spyan drangs bya/ /rdo rje 'chang gi spyan mnga' ②ru/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin/ /byin kyis brlab pa'i gnas 'di ru/ /drag po'i las la spyan 'dren bzhugs/ /myur bar 'ongs nas de la thim/ /mon sran gre'u dang dzam bu ti/ /me tog bdug spos sha lnga dang / /bdud rtsi lnga sbyar gtor ma sbyin/ /oṃ ma hā kā la ya/sha sa ①na sa ha ri ne+e/ e a paṣ+ṭi ma hā ka lo ya/ mi dha ta tra tan+d+ra ya a pa ka ri rgo ya ti pra ti dza sma ra si ta i rda duṣ+ṭa pa tsa pa tsa/ de ni me ke na hūṃ phaṭa/yang na sngar bshad sngags kyis sam/ /yang na bsad pa'i sngags kyis dbul/ /'bum mam bye ba sa ya'o/ /me ni nag la gru gsum pa/ /gzugs can byung na grub pa yin/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir sbyin sreg rim/ /bdag gi 'di brtsams bsod nams kyis/ /'gro rnams sgrib pa byang gyur nas/ /bla med byang chub thob par shog /sbyin sreg cho ga sha thag pa/ /slob dpon bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //la li ta badz+ra dang / gyi ljang dbu dkar gyis bsgyur ba'o// //47—386
385 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈'dir bstan dkar chag 〉〉rtor bkod/386 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bsam/ ②〈〈pe 〉gag ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉pa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2678)47—387

༄ga /nag po chen po'i gtor ma'i cho ga①kho dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i gtor ma'i cho ga bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa bzhugs so// ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā kā la ba ṣ+ṭi bi bye/ bod skad du/ nag po chen po'i gtor ma'i cho ga /dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo//dpal ldan nag po chen po dang / /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal nas/ /sems can rnams la phan bya'i phyir/ /nag po'i gtor ma bshad par bya/ /yo las rlung dang ram̐ las me/ /a las thod pa'i snod nang du/ /go ku da ha na dang ni/ /bi mu shu ra ma rnams bsams/ /steng du a las nyi dkyil 'khor/ /de stengs gri gug hūṃ gis mtshan/ /de las 'od zer 'og du 'phros/ /rlung gi me sbar bdud rtsi skol/ /sngo dang dmar dang dkar por bsgyur/ /gri gug hūṃ gis ⑤'od zer gyis/ /ye shes bdud rtsi gzhug ④par bya/ /yi ge gsum mam yang na ni—/ /rgyud gsungs sngags kyis byin brlabs la/ /rtsa ba'i sngags ni gsum 47—388

mam lnga/ /yang na bdun gyis nag po mchod/ /bstod pa la sogs ci nus bya/ /thun 'tshams dag gam thun zhabs la/ /gtor ma'i mchod pa ci nus bya/ /'dod pa'i don kun gsol btab la/ /yi ge brgya pa ci rigs mdon①/ /las la sbyor tshe dmigs pa dgug /gri gug gtubs la thod par gtab/ /gsol bar bsam zhing bsang sngags brjod/ /smod pa dag kyang ci rigs bya/ /gang zhig mos gus byed rnams la/ /mdo tsam bdag gis bstan pa yin/ /dge ba 'di mos sems can rnams/ /bar du gcod las rgyal gyur gcig⑤ /dpal nag po chen po'i gtor ma'i cho ga slob dpon bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //dpal 'ging ba'i rdo rje dang / gyi ljang dbu dkar gyis bsgyur ba'o// //'dir spyan 'dren bstod pa mchod 'bul bskang gso dang bcas pa gcig dpe rnying pa la yod/47—389

༄sa /nag po chen po la bstod pa/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā kā la stod tra/ bod skad du/ nag po chen po la bstod pa/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūṃ dpal ldan mgon po rdo rje nag po ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gyel brjid pa'i rtags—/ /sku mdog mthing nag chos nyid mi 'gyur rtags/ /stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs dpa' ba'i rtags/ /rus pa'i rgyan drug mdzes par byed pa'i rtags—/ /'od 'bar rin chen dpal 'byor rtsol ba'i rtags/ /rin chen gos chen dar nag sgeg pa'i rtags/ /khrag zhag thal chen dur khrod rol pa'i rtags—/ /dug sbrul rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'jigs byed rtags/ /gri gug dam nyams dbyings su sgol ba'i rtags/ /thod khrag zag med bde la rol pa'i rtags//gaṇ+ḍi khro tshogs spro bsdu byed pa'i rtags/ /bzhad ②pa'i nyams dgu khams gsum dbang bsdud rtags/ /zhi thugs dgra bgegs dbyings su sgol ba'i rtags/ /47—391

bcu gsum rtags ldan bcu gsum sa brnyes rtags/ /sku gsung thugs ldan rdo rje nag po bstod/ /bram ze blo ldan mchog sred kyis dpal nag po chen po la rtags kyi sgo nas bstod pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta shra ta ka ra warma dang / gu ru yon tan shi las gu ge tho ling du bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/391 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉kazhad/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2680)47wa 392

༄ga /nag po chen po'i bstod pa'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ /ma hā kā la stod tra/ bod skad du/ nag po chen po'i bstod pa'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa'i/ /hūṃ las byung ba'i nag po che/ /zhal gdangs mche gcigs gad mo sgrogs/ /'jigs byed khyod la mngon par bstod/ /sangs rgyas kun la bsnyen kur rtags/ /mgul pa thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan/ /bgegs rnams ma lus tshar gcod pa'i/ /mgon po khyod la mngon par bstod/ /sku mdog khro tshul ston pa ni/ /mkhyen gsal dbyings su gcig pa'i rtags/ /thung zhing sbom la brjid pa'i sku/ /thugs rje sdang mig gzigs la bstod/ /dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'bar/ /thugs rje zhi khro phyogs bcur 'phro/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas na gri/ /'gro drug thugs rjes sgol la bstod/ /g.yon pa ban dha khrag dang zhag /sha 47—393

chen lnga dang sman lngas bkang / /dug gsum ma lus zhal du gsol/ /sku gsum srin po'i gzugs 'dra stod1/ /'od dpung dug lnga sreg pa'i me/ khro gnyer smin ma rabs bskyod cing / /ljags 'gril khros pa phrin las mdzad/ /hūṃ sgrogs phad 2spro khyod la bstod/ /mche gcigs lce la me stag 'phro/ /brkyang bskum 'ur med thug chem ni/ /thugs rjes zhing khams ma lus g.yo/ /thugs rjes sna tshogs sprul la bstod/ /gtum chen khro bo mang 'phro ba/ /'gran zla med pas che ba la/ /phrin las rgya mtsho lhun gyis grub/ /khams gsum kun 'dul khyod la bstod/ /phra men tshogs rnams skrag par byed/ /ha ha rngam chen gtum la bzhad / /zhal nas khrag ni 'dzag pa ste/ /dkon mchog gsum skyong khyod la bstod/ /bla ma dang ni theg chen dang / /sems can kun la 'tshe byed pa/ /skad cig yud la brlag 'gyur ba/ /nag po chen po khyod la bstod/ /bstod pa'i phreng ba bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa sdogs so// //rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta la li ta badz+ra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba gyi ljang dbu dkar kyis bsgyur ba'o/ /bram ze mchog sred kyis zhal mthong dus dga' nas bstod pas/ mgon po mnyes nas zhal 'dzum mdzad do/ /de nas phrin las bcol ba'i bstod pa mdzad do / /zhal gzigs kyi bstod pa'o// //47—394

༄khya/ /nag po chen po la bstod pa/1༄/ nag ngo/ chen po la bstod pa bzhugs so// ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ma hā kā la stod tra/ bod skad du/ nag po chen po la bstod pa/ hūṃ las rnams kun byed mgon po nag po'i sgu/ /dmar nag me'i 'od kyis kun nas bskor / /phyag g.yas gri gug 'bar ba bsnams pa ni/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i srog rtsa dmar po gcod/ /g.yon pa thod pa dgra bo'i khrag bkang gsol/ /shangs nas rlung byung 'jig rten rlung nag 'tshub/ /zhal nas khrag 'dzag 'jig rten nad kyis 'gengs/ /spyan rtsa dmar pos 'jig rten sdigs par byed/ /sku gsung thugs kyis stong gsum zil gyis gnon/ /mon pa pho mo thams cad dbang du sdudan/ /'jig rten lha srin thams cad dbang byas nas/ /bstan pa nyams pa'i dus kyi bya ra mdzad/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la//thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /nag po chen po gtor 47—396

༄khya/ /nag po chen po la bstod pa/1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā kā la stod tra/ bod skad du/ nag po chen po la bstod pa/ chos dbyings rnam dag zhi ba'i rang bzhin las/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing / /sgyu ma'i chos la shes rab dbang bsgyur bas/ /'khor ba mi spong zhing khams skyong ba'i bdag /rab 'jigs dur khrod ma mo'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /khro gtum mi zad nag po chen po ni / /hūṃ skyes dus mtha'i sprin phung 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /stag lpags sham thabs thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan/ /spyan gsum dmar zhing ljags 'gril mche ba gtsigs / /rab 'bar dbu skra ser po gyen du badze+es/ /gdug pa'i phyag g.yas gri gug 'bar ba bsnams/ /phyag g.yon dang/'a bo'i thod par bdud snying gcod / /rang gi gsang sngags drag po'i nga ro'i sgras/ /ri dang sa gzhir bcas pa'i rgya mtsho g.yo/ /gdug pa'i klu dbang phung sgra 'byin byed cing / /47—398

lce gnyis mche gcigs brjid pa'i brgyan du byas/ /khrag dang bcas pa'i mi mgo lnga bcu dang / /rgyu ma'i thag pas phreng brgyus mgul na 'chang / /g.yer khas brgyan pa'i zhabs gnyis sem bral mnan/ /dbu skra gyen rdzes sbrul gyis bcings pa ste/ /mi skyod rdo rje'i cod pan mdzes par mdzad/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro byin rlabs mchog gi gtso/ /khrag gi mnga' bdag ma tshogs dbang du bsdud/ /'bar byed dus mtha'i me yis kun nas bskor/ /dbang dang dam tshig la gus sgrub pa pos/ /nag po chen po'i gsang sngags rjes dran na/ /sngon gyi thugs dam dbang gis 'phrin las mdzad/ /mgon po mchog khyod thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /byams pa'i zhal ston bdag la brtse dgongs nas/ /dngos grub rgya mtsho'i rlabs can bdag la stsol/ /bla ma mi tri pas mgon po zhal gzigs dus bstod pa mdzad pa rdzogs so// //la li ta badz+ra dang / lo tsā ba gyi ljang dbu dkar gyis bsgyur ba'o// //47—399

— ——2757༄༅/ /nag po chen po la bstod pa/ 1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā kā la stod tra/ bod skad du/ nag po chen po la bstod pa/ dpal kye rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūṃ/ phyogs —bcu kun nas dus gsum bde gshegs kyi/ /phrin las las grub dri med bstan pa dang / /chos ldan skyes bu skyong bar bka' bsgos pa'i/ /dam bcas ji bzhin bsgrub mdzad mgon po bstod/ /rab 'jigs sku ni dus mtha'i sprin srung ltar / /ngam nag 'jigs rung pho nya glog stong 'phro/ /sa gsum g.yo mdzad sa ga'i stabs kyis bzhugs/ /dpal ldan nag po chen po khyod la bstod/ /spyan gsum rab 'bar srid gsum zil kyis gnon/ /mche ba bzhi gtsigs bdud bzhi rtsad nas gcod/ /dbu skra sma ra dmar ser gzi brjid 'bar/ /ye shes me dpung rab 'bar mgon po bstod/ /phyag gnyis zangs gri thod khrag gan dhe bsnams/ /gdug pa tshar gcod chos sgra rgya chen sgrogs/ /dur khrod 47byed40/

———dbang phyug dur khrod rgyan kun 'chang / /dpal ldan stobs 'chang sku yi dbang phyug bstod/ /gsu/nga dbyangs zab cing chos kyi sgra snyan gyis/ /zhi bas sgrol ba'i sems can smin grol mdzad/ /t+t+waṃ phaṭa ma ra ya sogs 'jigs rung sgras/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad gsung gi dbang phyug bstod/ /mkhyen pa chos sku'i dpal rab mngon bgyes dang / /brtse bas gdul bya srid mtsho las sgral phyir/ /bstan pa'i gru chen spel zhing bsrungs 1ma mdzad/ /don gnyis mthar phyin thugs kyi dbang phyug bstod/ srid zhi'i yon tan tshogs kyis 'byor ldan zhing / /bstan pa yon tan 'byung gnas rgyas par mdzad/ /sgrub po yon tan tshogs kyis/ 'byor mdzad pa/ /rin chen yon tan rgya mtsho khyod la bstod/ /rab zhi chos don bsgrub mdzad 'gro ba rnams/ /nyer zhi'i dpal la 'god mdzad phrin las can/ /bstan pa rgyas mdzad tshe dang dpal 'byor tshogs/ /rab tu rgyas mdzad ma hā kā la bstod/ /'gro rnams dbang gyur dbang bzhi'i 'byung gnas khyod / /bla ma'i dbang mdzad dbang gi phrin las can/ /drag shul mngon spyod las kyis dgra bgegs tshogs/ /drag pos sgol mdzad ma hā kā la bstod//ston mchog bla ma sku khams bzang ba dang / /bstan mchog dam chos dar zhing rgyas pa dang / /sgrub mchog bsgrub gnyis phun sum tshogs pa dang / /don mchog sku bzhi grub pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /ces bstod do/ /slob dpon a bha yas zhal gzigs dus bstod pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta shra ta ka ra warma dang / gu ru yon tan shi las gu ge tho ling du bsgyur ba'o// //47—402

2758༄༅/ /dpal nag po chen po la bstod pa/1༄go/ /hūṃ/ sngon tshe bde gshegs pho brang spyan snga ru/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir nag po chen po la/ /rjes 'thun phrin las khyad par gang bsgo ba/ /dam bcas phrin las mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po'i bka' nyan 'khor gyi tshul mdzes shing / /gdug pa 'dul phyir mi gzad gzugs 'chang ba/ /byams dang snying rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /nag po chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/ /dkon mchog gsum la gnod byed tshar gcod cing / /rnam 'phrul gaṇ+ḍi phyag gi dbus na bsnams / /nag po chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyu ma mi mgo phreng ba'i do shal 'dzin/ /g.yas pa'i phyag gis zangs gri rnon po bsnams/ /g.yon pa'i phyag na thod pa khrag bkang 'dzin/ /nag po chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon tshe bde gshegs spyan sngar khas blangs te/ /bstan pa bsrung 5dang 'gro la 17—404

2759༄༅/ /nag po chen po la bstod pa/ 1༄/ nag ngo/ chen ngo/ la bstod nga/ bzhugs so// ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ma hā kā la stod tra/ bod skad du/ nag po chen po la bstod pa/ hūṃ/bde dga' rgya mtsho kun ster zhing / /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gzhal med khang / /legs skyong nag po chen po ni/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs 'chang khyod la bstod/ /zla ba stong gis spras pa yi/ /mtshan mo 'dzam gling nam mkha' ltar/ /khyod sku mthing nag brjid pa la/ /keng rus phreng bas brgyan mthong nas/ /'jig rten 'jigs par byed pa yi/ /srin po rnams kyi snying rab 'gas/ /bdud dang log 'dren dpa' bo rnams/ /mtshon cha bor nas phyogs bcur bros/ /sbrul gyi chun pos bkris pa'i zhabs/ /drag po'i gom stabs bskyod pa ni/ /stong gsum rlung gis 'tshub pa yi/ /mtsho rlabs bzhin du rab tu g.yo/ /lhun ngo/ 'jigs pas bros pa dag /bskyod par ma nus bzhin du 'dir/ /rgya mtsho 47byed406

gnam du 'bros pa ltar/ /dog pa nyid las ring du 'phags/ /nags tshal me tog bcas pa'i shing / /yib par 'dod pa bzhin du 'gyel/ /'brug stong sgra yang sgra min ltar/ /byed po'i gtum sgra gad mo dag /stong gsum 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /rna bar nyan cing stongs par byed/ /kun nas zhi thugs spros bral yang / /bstan pa bsrung dang bdag gi don/ /bsgrub phyir dam bca' ma bsnyel bar/ /rngam 'khrug gtum pas thugs bskyed la/ /bdud dang bgegs kyi snying khrag sha /chem chem gcod byed srin po yi/ /gzugs 'chang bka' stod pho nya gying / /'dir gshegs drag po'i phrin las bsgrubs/ /zhes pas bstod pa bya/ paṇ+ḍi ta spyan chen pos dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du bstod pa mdzad pa rdzogs so// //gyi ljang dbu dkar gyis bsgyur ba'o// //47—407
bsdur mchan/4༷6 1 mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2686)47wa 408

༄4/ /hūṃ bh+yoḥdapal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /rang don bsgrub phyir rnam thar gsum gzhol yang / /snying rje'i dbang gis gzhan don rjes thob cing / /shes rab sna tshogs dag gis 'gro don mdzad/ /dpal ldan lha mo sku mdog char sprin mdog /mtshan mo nag mo shin tu gtum pa'i gzugs/ /shin tu rid cing keng rus gzugs can ma/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis brjid pa'i sku/ /ral pa gyen 'greng lan bu gcig tu 'khyil/ /skra gseb sbrul dang thod pa'i phreng thogs can/ /rna ltag me tog dar nag cod pan can/ /khrag gi chang gis nga ro spyan rtsa dmar/ /mi ro rengs pa khar bcug mche ba bzhi/ /rnam par gcigs shing khrag la shin tu dgyes/ /snyan g.yas sbrul gyi mgul las dril bu yis//gdug pa btul nas tshangs pa'i sgra sgrogs ma/ /snyan cha g.yon na seng ge ral pa dmar—/ /dpa' po khams gsum seng ge'i sgra sgrogs ma/ /phyag bzhi g.yas kyi 47—409

dang po ral gri 'dzin/ /'og ma dung chen rak+ta dmar 'khyil zhing / /g.yon kyi dang po shag ti mtshon cha 'dzin/ /'og ma tri shul mgul na ba dan 'phyar/ /shag ti ral gri mtshon gyis bcad pa yis/ /lha ma yin gyi mgo sogs do shal byas/ /glang po che yi ko rlon stod g.yogs byas/ /smad ni ba glang ko rlon dras pa la/ /phyed ni re lde ser pa sham bu dkris/ /klu yi dbang po gzhibs pa'i rkyed ①bcings can/ /zhabs gnyis lcags sgrog mdzes pa dag gi rgyan/ /khrag dang zhag gi thig les chos bur bris/ /bong bu gzhon nas mtshan mo dur khrod nyul/ /bong bu'i rmig pa glog gi shugs can ma/ /khams gsum skad cig tsam la bskor bar byed/ /skad cig dung dang 'brug gi sgra lta bu/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za dbang du sdud/ /lho phyogs gshin rje'i ⑪pho brang dag na gnas/ /dam pa'i sa na gzugs sku gnyis 'dzin zhing / /ting 'dzin dbang thob gzugs khams gnas su byon/ /tshangs pa'i rgyal po la sogs phyag byas ma/ /gzhan la dbang bskur 'dod khams phas mthar byon//dbang phyug chen po'i sku la dgyes 'khril ④ma/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gnas su byon pa'i tshe/ /lha rnams dbugs 'byin brgya byin phyag byas ma/ /sku mchog ri rab rtse la 'gran pa'i tshe/ /lte ba'i thad ka'i phyogs su nyi zla 'phyar/ /rgyal chen bzhi sogs lha rnams phyag byas ma/ /rgya mtsho'i gting nas me 'bar mtsho skem nus/ /sa 'og dbang po rnams kyi phyag byas ma/ /lha mo khyod kyi cho 'phrul 'di bstan pas/ /bdud dang gshin rje'i tshogs rnams 'dar zhing 'dud/ /ma mo srin po'i tshogs rnams rngam zhing rgod/ /dam sri'i tshogs rnams 'dar zhing dam la 'dud/ /tsi ta rin chen gur phub gzhal yas khang / /nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor rtsegs pa'i ga'u 'bar—/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten dug gi bcud sdus nas/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 47—410

'khor dag la thim mdzad ma/ /dug gi rlangs pas nag po'i phyogs rnams kyis/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams slong mdzad ma/ /ma cig nad kyi bdag mo'i dam la 'dud—/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sman gyis bcud 'dus nas/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dag la thim par mdzad/ /sman kyis slangs pas dkar po'i phyogs rnams kyis—/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams sel mdzad ma/ /bdud rtsi'i sman gyis rgyal mo'i dam la 'dud/ /gang zhig khyed la dad na ma bas byams/ /de phyir ma cig na dag sman gyi gtso/ /rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i spyan snga ru/ /bdag gis dengs ①nas 'khor ba ji srid bar/ /dkar po'i phyogs rnams nad dang sdug bsngal sogs//zhi bar bya dang tshe dang bsod nams spel/ /nag po'i phyogs rnams 'gugs shing dbang du sdud/ sbyo 'bog bsad la sogs pa'i las rnams kyis/ /bstan pa bsrungs pa'i las 'di myur du bgyid/ /'di las 'das na rgyal ba'i bka' bslus pas/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i rdo rjes mgo 'gems so/ /de ltar rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs nas/ /khas blangs bzhin du dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ /dam tshig bzhin du phrin las myur bsgrubs mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdag dang bdag gi 'khor bcas la/ /khyod kyi zhal nas bdud rtsi'i char phob la/ /nad dang sdug bsngal tshogs rnams zhi bar mdzod/ /tshe dang dbang thang longs spyod rgyas par mdzod—/ /zang zing longs spyod 'bru'i phung po dang / /rin chen rkang 'gro phyugs rnams 'phel bar mdzod/ /bla ma smod cing dkon mchog dbu 'phang smod/ /bdag gi dge la bar gcod byed pa yi/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs/ /khyod kyi khong nas dug gi brlangs phyung la/ /'du ba rnam bzhi'i nad kyis khong nas slongs/ /don snying lnga yi khong khrag skyug du chug /bag gzhi sa la 47—411

lhung nas sdebs su chug /las ngan 'khor bcas brang chen brdung du chug /smre sngags cho nges gnam du 'bod du chug /gcan zan la sogs mkha' lding ltas ngan thong / /khyod kyi sngon gyi dam bcas rjes dgongs nas/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ /bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa'o// //bsdur mchan/409 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈snar bstan dkar chag 〉ltar bkod/41༷ ①〈〈pe 〉mun+t+ran/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉rjes/ ①〈〈pe 〉75gel/411 ①〈〈pe 〉〉deng /bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2687)47—412

༄ga /dpal lha mo nag mo la bstod pa zhes bya ba/①༄/ dpal lha mo nag mo la bstod pa bzhugs so// ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/shrī de wi ka li stod tra nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal lha mo nag mo la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ byoḥbaskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ /rlung nag tshub mar 'khyil pa'i pho brang nas/ /ma cig 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ /bdud kyi yum mchog gshin rje'i lcam gcig ma/ /dpal ldan lha mo nag mo mthu mo che/ /nag mo za byed rngam pa'i mche ba can/ /mthing nag gcer bu khrag gi ral pa can/ /khyod kyi sku mdog nag mor bstan pa ni/ /don dam dbyings las g.yo ba med pa'i rtags/ /ral pa g.yas nas g.yon du 'khyil ba ni/ /mkha' las sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed pa'i rtags/ /dbu skra lan bu gcig tu 'khyil ba ni/ /skye med don dam gcig tu rtogs pa'i rtags/ /ral pa'i seb nas me stag 'phro ba ni/ /thugs kyi sprul pa phyogs bcur 'gyed pa'i rtags/ /47—413

thod pa'i phreng bas dbu la bcings pa ni/ /thugs kyi sprul pas 'go don mdzad pa'i rtags/ /g.yon gyi snyan nas seng ge 'phyo ba ni/ /dman btsun thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i rtags/ /g.yas nas sbrul kyi gdeng ka 'phyo ba ni/ /zhe sdang ma spangs gnas su dag pa'i rtags/ /snyan cha dril bu g.yer kha 'khrol ba ni / /sangs rgyas kun la snyen skur mdzad pa'i rtags/ /spyan rtsa dmar zhing sdang mig bgrad pa ni/ /srid gsum rnal 'byor bya ra mdzad pa'i rtags/ /zhal ni drag po'i hom khung gdangs pa ni/ /bstan pa bshig pa'i ru tra sgol ba'i rtags—/ /rno gdug mche ba zur gsum gcigs pa ni/ /bsgral ba'i zhing bcu'i sha la rol ba'i rtags/ /zhing lpags g.yang gzhi sku la gsol ba ni/ /yang dag chos nyid don dang ldan pa'i rtags/ /glang chen ko rlon rnam par dkris pa ni/ /'jig rten 'di na che btsan che ba'i rtags/ /lte ba'i dkyil nas nyi ma shar ba ni/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho gting nas skems pa'i rtags/ /spyi bo'i gtsug na zla ba rgyas pa ni/ /khams gsum ma rig mun pa sel ba'i rtags//zhabs las dbang gi lcags sgrog 'khrol ba ni/ /thabs dang shes rab zung du 'byel ba'i rtags/ /phyag g.yas ral gri 'bar ba bsnams pa ni/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs srog rtsa gcod pa'i rtags/ /gnyis pa thod rlon dmar chen bsnams pa ni/ /srid gsum sha khrag zhal du rngub pa'i rtags/ /g.yon pas mdung rnon ba dan 'phyar ba ni/ /dam nyams ma lus rtsad nas gcod pa'i rtags—/ /gnyis pas tri shu rtse gsum bsnams pa ni/ /khams gsum nyon mongs rdul du rlog pa'i rtags/ /bong bu gwa dmar phyir phyogs zhon pa ni/ /log par lta ba'i sems can sgrol ba'i rtags/ /srin po'i ya 'gal snga ru byas pa 47—414

ni / /srin yul lang ka spu ri 'joms pa'i rtags/ /srin po'i ma 'gal phyi ru byas pa ni/ /bdud dang srin po zil gyis gnon pa'i rtags/ /sbrul nag chun pos gong smed byas pa ni/ /zhe sdang gdug pa'i bgegs rigs 'joms pa'i rtags—/ /rus sbal nag po'i gdu bus brgyan pa ni/ /klu bdud nag po dam la btags pa'i rtags/ /bdud kyi khram bam snga shar btags pa ni/ /dam tshig nyams pa khram la 'debs pa'i rtags/ /nad kyi rkyal pa phyi sor btags pa ni—/ /bstan bshig rnams la nad kha 'be+ebs pa'i rtags/ /bong bu'i tshang ra mig gis brgyan pa ni/ /khams gsum dgra bgegs rnams las rgyal ba'i rtags—/ /don dam bcud kyi rtags su zhag gi zo ris dang / /thugs rje chags pa'i rtags su khrag gi thig les brgyan/ /'dul byed phrin las rtags su thal chen tshom bus brgyan/ /phrin las kun khyab rtags su ma mo 'bum gyis bskoraske/ /ma bdud ①'bum phrag pho nyar khye mdzod la/ /sgrub mchog bdag gi dgra bgegs khrid la shog /ma cig kha nas me 'bar mtsho skems ma/ /lag na ri rab rdo char 'bebs mdzad ma/ /mthu stobs bdag mo ma cig re ma ti/ /bdag gis bcol ba'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ /bdag gis btsun par lha mo khyod la bstod/ /khyod kyis bdag la dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ /dpal lha mo la bram ze mchog sred kyis rtags kyi sgo nas bstod ②pa'o nam mkha'i lha phran rnams kyis bstod zer ba'ang snang // //la li ta badz+ra dang gyi ljang dbu dkar gyis bsgyur ba'o// //47—415
bsdur mchan/412 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/415 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bdud/②〈〈pe 〉〉skopa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2688)47wa 416

2762dag /dpal lha mo nag mo la bstod pa zhes bya ba/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ shri kā li de wi stod tra nā ma/ bod skad du/dpal lha mo nag mo la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ ma bcos chos sku bde ba chen po ni//srid dang zhi bar mi gnas mnyam nyid ngang / /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las mchog /dpal dang ldan pa'i lha mo khrod la bstod/ /sku'i dkyil 'khor chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam/ /mya ngan mi 'da' 'thun par snang ba nyid/ /mdzes pa'i rgyan cha ma cig re ma ti/ /'gro ba'i gnyen gcig ma la bdag bstod do—/ /chos sku mkha' ltar dag pa'i shes rab ma/ /longs sku bde chen rmad byung thabs tshul gyis/ /ma rungs gdug pa can rnams tshar gcod pa'i/ /mi bsnyel thugs rje can la bdag bstod do/ /dman pa mi 'dor rtags su bong bu phyibs / /lha'i lhar gyur lha min skrag mdzad ma/ /sprul sku'i rdzu 'phrul stong gsum khyab par nyul/ /bstan pa'i gnyer mdzad ma la bdag bstod do/ /47byed417

dpal ldan lha mo mi 'gyur thugs rje can/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi 'dod pa'i don rnams bsgrubs/ /bstan pa'i dgra bgegs ma lus med par mdzod/ /ces lha ma srin gyis bstod pa / la li ta badz+ra dang gyi ljang dbu dkar gyis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/417 nyumatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2689)47wa 418

—pa 6/ba jam 'ab/sti༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī de — kā li stod tra nā ma/ bod skad du/dpal lha mo nag mo la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ srid gsum zil non 'dod khams dbang phyug ma/ /'jig rten gtso la rtag tu gus phyag 'tshal/ /ma rnams nang na khyod nyid mchog yin te/ /'jig rten gsum po thams cad khyod la bstod/ /bzhin mdzes yid 'ong lta bas mi ngoms pa'i/ /yon tan sna tshogs kun gyis lus rab brgyan/ spyan mdzes ut+pal sngon po'i mdab ma mdzes/ /bsod nams ye shes snang ba'i dra bas brgyan/ /nor bu rin chen rin thang med pa bzhin—/ /ding bdag pad mo khyod la bsngags pas kyang / /sems la gsal ba thams cad grub par 'gyur/ /lha mo dgos 'dod 'grub la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag ye shes gya nom bkra shis 'dud/ /pad ma lta bu shin tu rnam par dag /lus mdog rab mdzes kun gyis lta bas mos/ /yon tan rgya mtsho gter la phyag 47—419

'tshal lo/ /dri med ye shes 'od zer rab mdzes pa/ /dran pa rnams kyi nang du mchog tu 'gyur/ /mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul yon tan rtsal mnga' bas/ /bdud rigs glang po'i klad chen 'gems la 'dud/ /'di ltar gcan gzan mchog gyur seng ge ltar/ /bstan pa dri med yul 'khor skyong la 'dud/ /de ltar sngags shing bstod pa'i dge ba 'dis/ /kun mkhyen mchog la kun nas gnas par shog /ces drang srong ke'u tri las bstod pa/ la li ta badz+ra dang /gyi ljang dbu dkar gyis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/419 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2690)47—420

༄ga /dpal lha mo la bstod pa zhes bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī de wi kā li stod tra nā ma/ bod skad du/dpal lha mo la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ na mo badz+ra ḍā ki ni bh+ya/ bh+yoḥbaskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ /rlung nag tshub mar 'khyil ba'i pho brang nas/ /ma cig 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ /sku mdog sngo nag char sprin lta bu la/ /thod skam dbu brgyan ②snyan g.yon seng ge 'phyo/ /snyan cha g.yas pa sbrul gyi gdengs ka can/ /spyan gsum dmar zlum zhal gdangs mche ba gcigs/ /'jig pa'i lha mo khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag g.yas ral gri thod khrag bsnams pa yis/ /dam nyams ma lus sgol zhing rol ba ste/ /g.yon pa mdung dang ru mtshon dgra bgegs sgrol/ /lha mo rab 'jigs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku stod zhing lpags sgrul nag ska rags can/ /sku smad ba glang ko zlon re ldes dkris—/ /stong gsum nyul byed bong bu ga dmar phyibs/ /srin po'i ya 47—421

༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī de — kā li stod tra nā ma/ bod skad du/dpal lha mo la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang / /he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rab tu rgyas mdzad phyir/ /ye shes dbyings las rang byung dpal ldan ma/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gyur dpal ldan ma/ /srid gsum bdag pos phyag byas lha mo bstod/ /gdug pa skrag mdzad shin tu rid pa'i sku/ /nam mkha'i mdog can sprul pa'i gza' skar 'phro—/ /khro gnyer smin ma rab bsdus mche ba gcigs/ /bdud bzhi tshar gcod dpal ldan lha mo bstod/ /dug lnga byang chub lam mdzad bong bu phyibs/ /thabs shes zung 'byel zhabs gnyis lcags sgrog mdzes/ /nyi zla rab rgyas khrag zhag thig les brgyan/ /bde mchog 'byung gnas dpal ldan lha mo bstod/ /sku gsum sgrib med spyan gsum glog ltar myur/ /khams gsum skyabs mdzad dar 47—423

nag ko rlon can/ /re lde'i na bza' ldan pa'i lha mo bstod/ /tshad med phyag bzhi thod khrag mtshon cha'i tshogs/ /rnam thar bzhi'i rang bzhin bsnams par mdzad—/ /bsdu dngos rnam bzhis srid na rgyun mi 'chad/ /pha rol phyin drug rgyan ldan lha mo bstod/ /srid pa'i mtsho skems ye shes me dpung 'bar/ /ma rung 'dul phyir dug sbrul seng ges stibargyan/ /gdug pa bsgral phyir khrag gi rgya mtshor bzhugs/ /mgo rlon do shal 'chang ba'i lha mo bstod/ /gsung dbyangs zhi drag chos sgra 'gro ba 'dul/ /thugs zab mdon brtses srid zhi'i dam la sgol/ /yon tan gzi brjid nyi ma 'bum ltar 'bar/ /phrin las kun 'grub dpal ldan lha mo bstod/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos dpal ldan bla ma yi/ /bstan pa dpal 'byor kun nas rgyas pa yis/ /'gro kun theg mchog lam la 'god pa dang / /bsgrub po don gnyis bsgrub pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /dpal ldan lha mo la a bha yas zhal gzigs dus bstod pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta shra ta ka ra warma dang / gu ru ba yon tan shi las gu ge tho ling du bsgyur ba'o// //47—424
bsdur mchan/422 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/424 ①〈〈pe 〉〉go/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2692)47wa 425

༄༅/ /dpal ldan lha mo nag mo la bstod pa zhes bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī de wi kā li stod tra nā ma/ bod skad du/dpal ldan lha mo nag mo la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ bh+yoḥ dpal ldan lha mo dpag par dka' ba khyod/ /thabs kyi cho 'phrul nam mkha' mtha' la spyod/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa khyod nyid la/ /sgo gsum dang ba'i sems kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni bdag gis mchod par mi 'tshal yang / /kun gyi dngos grub dam pa thob bya'i phyir/ /mkha' la 'dod pa'i yon tan char 'bab pa'i/ /mchod pa'i tshogs 'dis dbang po rgyas gyur cig /lha mo khyod ni dge sdig spang ⑤po ste/ /bdag gi lus ngag sems kyi sdig pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus khyod kyi mdun du bshags par bgyi/ /thugs rje'i shugs kyis sgrib pa sbyang bar mdzod/ /khyod kyi khyad par yongs su 'phags pa ni/ /'gro ba'i don mdzad bdag don phun sum tshogs/ /dka' thub phrag dog med pa'i spros pa 'di/ /rjes su yi 47—426

rang khyod kyi rgyud la 'bul/ /'di ltar yon tan ldan pa'i sku mdog ni/ /nag mo bzang mo 'jigs pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /phyogs bcur dus kun 'gro ba'i don mdzad par/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i tshul du bskul bar mdzod/ /yang dag yon tan khyod kyi sku mchog gis/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ /ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar du ni/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /'di ltar phyag 'tshal mchod cing bshags pa dang / /rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yis/ /dge ba 'di yis ngan song stongs gyur te/ /'gro kun tshogs dze+egs byang chub chen por bsngo/ /dpal ldan lha mo la nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po gser mig can kyis yan lag bdun du bstod pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta snying phreng can dang / lo tsā ba gyi ljang dbu dkar kyis bsgyur ba'oske/ / //47—427
bsdur mchan/426 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉stanapang /bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2693)47wa 428

'ab(1'a/ba zab//①༄4/ /hūṃ dpal ldan bka' nyan nag po gnod sbyin sku/ /zhal gdangs mche gcigs sha dang khrag la dga'/ /spyan bgrad skra badze+es rdo rje'i thod gdengs can/ /sdigs pa'i gri gug 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ha ha'i gad rgyangs dgra snying spar gyis 'debs/ /thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan cing zhing lpags gyon/ /log 'dren 'dul zhing dgra bo'i gshed ma byed/ /sha dang khrag gis mchod kyis dgyes par mdzod/ /dpal ldan 'jigs su rung ba'i phrin las kyis—/ /gdug pa tshar gcod bdud dang mu stegs 'joms/ /bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/ /gsang sngags skyong ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsngags ②shing las la bskul gyis dpung bskyed la/ /nyes legs stangs zung dam tshig rjes kyang chod/ /bka' gsang rmad du byung ba'i chos 'khor la/ /dgra bgegs rdul phran tsam yang med par mdzod// //47—429

hūṃ/ mgon po'i bka' nyan nag mo gnod sbyin mo/ /dpal 'bar brjid pa'i gzugs 'dzin drag gtum ma/ /khro la rngam pa'i zhad bsgrad mche ba gcigs / /rkang tshil za byed nag mo khyod la bstod/ /thod pas brgyan zhing byi ru'i lan tshar can/ /gdug pa tshar gcod g.yas pa spu gri 'dzin/ /dar nag na bza' gsol ba'i dbang mo che/ /sdigs pa'i phyag rgya can khyod mchod cing bstod/ /rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgras/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za dbang du bsdud/ /dur khrod nyul zhing snying khrag dron mo 'thung / /dgra bgegs rdul du rlog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pho nya mang po sprul pa'i 'phro 'du yis/ /gtsug lag khang dang dkyil 'khor skyong mdzad ma/ /bdag dang dge ba'i phyogs la gnas pa rnams/ /bu sdug bzhin du rtag tu bsrung du gsol// //hūṃ/ dpal ldan phrin las kun rdzogs pu tra khyod/ /sku mdog mthing nag me yi 'phro 'du can/ /rngam pa'i stabs kyis 'gying zhing shang lang bsnams/ /kying chen gdug pa 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab 'jigs dpa' la rngam pa'i zhal gdangs shing / /glog ltar 'khyug pa'i ljags 'dril mche ba gcigs/ /klad khrag bsres pa gsol zhing spyan rtsa dmar/ /skra bsdes thod phreng can la phyag 'tshal lo / /mgo bo'i do shal dar nag na bza' gsol/ /yon tan lhun rdzogs khams gsum dgra las rgyal/ /'jigs byed chen po dpal bo'i gar stabs kyis/ /sprul pas 'gro don mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lam la gnas pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams//bden pa'i stobs dang dad pa'i nus mthu yis/ /gsang sngags phyogs 'dzin dgra lha khyod bstod kyis/ /rje btsun bdud las rgyal ba dgyes par mdzod/ /bsad pa'i sha dang sbyar ba'i dza gad dang / /bsgral ba'i khrag dang dam rdzas sna tshogs kyis/ /47—430

dam tshig can khyod mchod kyis chos 'khor skyongs/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i las 'di myur du bsgrubs// //hūṃ/ 'jigs byed dbyengs las bzhengs pa'i sku mchog ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rngam pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs/ /dgra bgegs tshar gcod rno dkar mche ba gcigs/ /ro drug ma chags gsol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyan rtsa bsgyur zhing gzigs mdzad thod phreng can/ /yon tan stobs rdzogs ral pa gyen du badze+es/ /phrin las rnam bzhis gdug pa tshar gcod phyir/ /phyag na dam shing 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mdog nag dus mtha'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar//dur khrod brgyan dang cha lugs ldan pas sgog /dar dang stag gi gos gyon mchog tu dpa'/ /gtum chen bha tra khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mu stegs 'dul mdzad dam nyams gshed ma khyod/ /dgra snying spar bas 'debs shing las la brtson—/ /nyams pa gang yin sgrol la sha khrag zo/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i phrin las brtson par mdzod// //bh+yoḥ sngon tshe gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yi/ /bstan pa bsrung bar dam bcas ral gcig ma/ /nag mo bzang mo dam tshig ldan ma khyod/ /dam tshig rdzas kyis mchod cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /srin po'i cha lugs 'jigs pa'i sku mchog las/ /nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i gzi brjid 'bar/ /bdud kyi lcam mo dung gi mche ba can/ /dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag g.yas gser gyi spu gri 'dzin zhing sdigs/ /g.yon pa rgyu ma zhal du gsol zhing bzhad—/ /khams gsum dbang bsdud spyan gsum so sor gzigs/ /nag mo thod phreng can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /za 'og gos gyon mtshan mo dur khrod nyul/ /47—431

nag mo ral pa g.yengs pa'i sprul pa yis/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za dbang du bsdud/ /dur khrod gtso mo khrod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang sngags rdo rje 'dzin pas khyod bstod kyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrungs cig ral gcig ma/ /dgra bgegs rdul du rlog cig kha 'bar ma/ /dkyil 'khor bsrung ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// //stsoḥ rnam dag tshad med bzhi'i rang bzhin las/ /thabs la mkhas pa sgo skyong khro mo'i sku/ /bran g.yog mngag pa pho nya 'phro 'du yis/ /'gugs 'dren 'ching sdom ①mdzad pa'i 'phrul mo che/ /seng ge'i gdong can so gcig srid gsum za/ /lcags kyu 'dren cing thod rlon phreng ba bgrang / /seng ge stag dang bya nag mang po'i tshogs/ /byams pas log 'dren 'gugs pa khyod la bstod//gzig gi gdong can dur khrod khrag ldag ④ma/ /zhags pa thod pa 'dzin cing las la brtson/ /gzig dang spyang mo mkha' lding bya yi tshogs/ /thugs rje legs par 'dren mdzad khyod la bstod/ /dom kyi gdong can khams gsum sa la gzigs/ /lcags sgrog sgron me bsnams pa'i mthu mo che/ /glang chen dom dang mkha' lding sprul pa'i tshogs/ /dga' bas log 'dren 'ching mdzad khyod la bstod—/ /dred kyi gdong can sde brgyad kha lo bsgyur/ /tho ba dang ni lcags kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /dred mo g.yag dang mkha' lding pho nya'i tshogs/ /btang snyoms chen po don mdzad khyod la bstod/ /kun kyang ma mo mkha' 'gro nyi zla'i spyanarka/ /'jigs tshul che la thabs mkhas thugs rje che/ /khaṃ khaṃ tshig tshig sha dang khrag la dga'/ /'jigs pa'i nga ro can khyod mchod cing bstod/ /ces pa 'khor gyi bstod pa/ slob dpon chen po bram ze mchog sred kyis bstod pa 47—432

mdzad pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta thata ta ka ra warma dang / lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/429 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉snga'adir 〉〉rtor bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉mdzogs/432 ①〈〈pe 〉〉sdoms/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉ldan/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2694)47wa 433

༄ga /gnod sbyin nag po'i bstod pa/①༄7/ /hūṃ/ gnod sbyin nag po 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /dar men ga sha sku la gsol/ /phyag g.yas gser gyi gri gug bsnams/ /chos 'khor bsrung ma khyod la bstod/ /gnod sbyin nag mo chen po khyod/ /phyag gnyis spu gri thod khrag bsnams/ /gser gyi rgyan chas rab sgeg pa'i/ /mkha' 'gro chen mo khyod la bstod/ /sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang dang ni/ /slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub dang / /pad+ma'i rgyal po thod phreng dang / /rnal 'byor dbang phyug sa skya pa//kun dga' snying po la sogs pa'i/ /bla ma rnams kyi bka' bzhin du/ /dam tshig bzang po rjes dgongs la/ /bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa khyed kyis bsrungs/ /gnod pa'i dgra bgegs rdul du zlog /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /ji ltar bsams pa'i don rnams ni/ /chos bzhin bsgrub pepa'i las mdzod cig/ //47—434

hūṃ/ mon bu pu tra gnas nas bzhengs/ /men gyi ga sha sku la gsol/ /sher shing seg shang phyag na bsnams/ /mon bu pu tra khyod la bstod/ /mon bu bha tra stag klag bkra/ /dar gyi ral kha sku la gsol/ /spu gri rnon po phyag na bsnams—/ /mon bu bha tra phyag na bsnams/ /spu gri mo ni chen mo ma/ /nag mo chen mo kha 'bar ma/ /gser gyi sru gri phyag na bsnams/ /nag mo khyod la bstod pa 'bul—/ /bud med nag mo brgya/ gshegs kyi shul yang 'dren/ g.yas kyi ru 'dren pa/ stag chas brgyan pa brgya/ g.yon kyi ru 'dren pa/ nyan thos dgra bcom brgya/ be+ed kyi rjes 'brang ba/ ban dhe nag po brgya/ 'khor bcas kun la bstod pa 'bul/ /slob dpon mchog sred kyis mdzad pa'o// //47—435

gnang bzhugs so//①༄7/ /bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan lha mo'i sgo nas gtor ma'i rjes gnang bya bar 'dod pas/ gnas khang yid dang mthun paraske/ maṇ+ḍal dang mchod gtor tshogs kyi yo byad 'tshogs par bshams la/rang nyid bstan bde ba la 'dug nas dgyes pa rdo rje'am/ gdan bzhi'i mngon rtogs bsgom/ yi dam gyi gtor ma btang ba'i rjes la/ lha mo'i mchod gtor rgyas par btang / tshogs kyis mchod nas/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/lag pa me tog dang bcas pa la/ slob dpon gyi slob ma la/ mdun 'di na dgyes pa rdo rje'am/ rdo rje gdan bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rten gzhal yas khang brten pa lha dang bcas pa bzhugs pa yin pas/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol/ rdo rje rwa ba'i nang rol/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi shar phyogs nag po drag po'i khul na spyod rang 'dug par bsgoms/ mdun gyi nam mkha' 'di 47—437

na phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dang yi dam gyi lha tshogs chos skyong ba'i bsrungs ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams sprin phung stebs pa bzhin du thibs se bzhugs par bsams la/ mos pa dang gus pa bgyis shig byas la/ lha mo'i gtor ma de slob ma'i mgo thog tu bzhag la/ lha mo dud pa'i sol ba ma 'khor nag mo 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis/ slob ma 'di zhes bya ba'i lus ngag yid gsum la sku gsung thugs gsum gyis byin kyis rlobs snyam du bsams la/mos pa dang gus pa'i sgo nas bla ma yi dam chos skyong bsrungs ma dpal lha mo dud pa'i sol ba ma 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi mgrin gcig tu/ bshis pa 'di khyed rang rnams la brjod par bsoms shig byas la/ slob ma shes pa do ①dam smra ba'i seṅge yis/ /nyon mongs srid pa'i nyes pa skye ba'i sa gzhom phyir/ /rnal 'byor cho gas nyon mongs g.yo ba gcod pa'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor don dam rgyal ba nyid du 'grub gyur cig /ces brjod pa'i brjod la/ dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum dbang gis bstod pa tshar gcig brjod/ gtor ma slob ma'i lag tu gtad nas/ dur khrod bdag po tshar gcig brjod la/dpal ldan dud pa'i sol ba ma 'khor nag mo 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la mchod pa dang / bstod pa dang / gtor ma la sogs pa phul nas/bdag gi slob ma ming rus 'di zhes pa gtad kyi/ ji srid gnas kyi bar du/'di'i lus ngag yid gsum la khyed kyi sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis rlobs la/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gnyan po bsrungs/ dkon mchog gi che ba phyung gcig /bla ma dam pa'i 'phrin las sgrubs shig /sems can gyi bde skyid spel gcig /47—438

khyad par du'ang slob ma 'di zhes bya ba la sdong grogs dang / bsrung ba dang /skyabs pa dang / sba ba dang / byin gyis brlabs pa chen po mdzad du gsol/nad dang / gdon dang / rkyen dang / bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang / bsam pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub cing / tshe dang /dpal dang / 'byor pa la sogs pa zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ khyed rnams kyis kyang dus 'di nas bzung nas/sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du/ chos skyong ba'i bsrungs ma yin pas/ mchod bstod bsgom bzlas rgyun ma chad par mdzod cig /ces brjod lha mo dang dam tshig bsre ba'i phyir/ 'theb kyu gcig dang / ma da na hub gcig byin/ bka' bsgos pa bzhin 'grogs nas stong grogs byed par bsam mo/ /gtor ma sa gtsang sar btang / smon lam dang bsngo bas rgyas gdab/ dkon mchog gsum dang yi dam gyi bkra shis brjod/ dpal ldan lha mo'i rjes gnang / slob dpon chen po zhe sdang rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //47—439

bstod chen bzugs so//lku༄7/ /hūṃ/ dpal ldan mgon po nag po che/ /dbang phyug chen po srid gsum bdag /mche ba rtsigs shing mchu 'phyang ba/ /shugs chen byis pa'i lus can la/ /dril bu'i sgra sgrog 'jigs par byed/ /shin tu drag po'i 'phreng bas brgyan/ /dgra bgegs gcod pa'i dpa' bo ste/ /ming gi rnam grangs mang po can/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i sdang mig gis/ /khams gsum skrag mdzad khyod la bstod/ /khro rgyal dor stabs tshul du bzhugs/ /klog stong 'khyug 'dra'i ljags 'dril zhing / /g.yon pa gter gyi bum pa thogs/ /g.yas na mdung dang gri khug 'dzin/ /'jigs su rung ba'i 'gyogs pa can/ /lag pa g.yon pa thod khrag gsol/ /tshangs skud mi mgo'i 'phreng bas brgyan/ /sa bla sa 'og sa stengs nas/ /k+ṣ-i k+ṣiṃ 'jigs pa'i sgra sgog pa/ /srin po'i gzugs brnyan rngam pa'i sku/ /bskal pa'i me ltar 'od zer 'bar/ /ha ṣa 47—441

'gri ba'i sku la bstod/ /spo ṭa la ni chen po na/ /dpal ldan nag po chen po bzhugs—/ /te se gangs kyi zhing skyong mdzad/ /zhal bzhi sngon po nyis brtsegs 1g.yas/ /g.yon gnyis dmar ljang khros pa'i zhal/ /ha ha'i gad rgyangs/ 'brug sgra sgog /hūṃ hūṃ sgog pa'i dpal khyod kyis/ /srid gsum lha srin ma lus pa/ /thams cad 'dar zhing skrag par byed/ /dmag dpon chen po zhal bzhi pa/ /las su sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung / /zas su dgra bgegs sha khrag rus/ /za byed khro bo khyod la bstod/ /dngos grub thams cad rtsol ba'i lha/ /rang bzhin dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs pa'i/ /sngar gyi skad du go bar gyis/ /gang gis go bar byed ces na/ /sha chen zan dang me tog spos/ /chang phud sha khrag gtor ma 'di/ /khyer cig zo zhig ②dam tshig can/ /byang phyogs wa tri can na bzhugs/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten dbang byed cing / /rang gi yum dang gnyis med sgu/ /mthu stobs can la bdag bstod do/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar ni/ /dam bcas zhal gyis bzhes pa yi/ /dpal ldan mgon po khyod kyis ni/ /tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor dang / /bdag la thugs rjes dgongs mdzod la/ /nyid kyi mthu rtsal chen po yis/ /bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs rnams/ /de dag khyod kyis myur du sod/ /bdag gi sems la ci 'dod pa/ /de dag khyod kyis myur du sgrubs④/ /bye rngo/ g.yung mo gtum mo srin mo dang / /sing ga la gnas rnal 'byor ma—/ /dmar dang ljang ser khros pa'i zhal/ /gri gug thod 'dzin yab la 'khyud—/ /phrin thulas rnam bzhi sgrub byed pa'i/ /yum chen bzhi po khyed rnams 47—442

kyang / /dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rgyob spyob sdang ba'i dgra la rgyob/ /sod sod gnod pa'i dgra bgegs sod/ /sreg sreg bar chad thams cad sregs//chod chod rnal 'byor dgra bgegs rnams/ /rigs rgyud rtsad nas chod la shog /hūṃ hūṃ k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ 'jigs pa'i rang bzhin can/ /dpal ldan yab yum 'khor bcas ma lus rnams/ /'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i las rnams myur du grub par mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /byang chub ma thob bar du bsrung ba dang / /rtag tu longs spyod rgya chen ldan pa dang / /'jig rten 'dir yang tshe rings nad med cing / /'khor g.yog rigs rgyud dpal la sogs pa yis/ /dngos grub thams cad bdag la rtsal du gsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag dam pa'i chos sgrub pa'i/ /rtag tu stong grogs gnyan po mdzad du gsol/ /dmag dpon chen po zhal bzhi pa'i bstod pa sho lo ka nyi shu pa zhes bya ba bram ze rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //47—443

—sgrub thabs zhas bya ba/①༄/ phyag drug ye shes mgon po'i chos skor las dzā ba ri pa'i gsang sgrub rgya gzhung gsang sgrub dpa' gcig sā ba ri pa'i lugs/ sha ba ri pa'i lugs bzhugs so//༄7—/ /rgya gar skad du/ a dhiṣ+ṭha na ma hā ka la sa dha na nā ma/ bod skad du—/ byin gyis brlabs pa nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar bde ba rgyas byed pa'i/ /dpal ldan thugs rje'i bdag po mchog /spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs bri/ /dang po dang ba rab brtan nas/ /byang chub mchog tu sems skyed spude/ /rang nyid he ru kar skyed la/ /de rjes stong pa nyid du bsgom/ /bla ma sangs rgyas can kun mchod/ /bstod dang bshags pa la sogs bya/ /bsngo zhing tshad med bzhi po bsgom/ /de rjes stong pa nyid du bsam—/ /stong pa'i ngang las e bsam rjute/ /de rjes hūṃ las rdo rje'i brag /47—445

sna tshogs mdog can ram̐ las ni/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de stengs su/ /gha ni shel gyi mdog 'dra las/ /byi na ya ga brdal ba'i steng / /hūṃ las nag po 'jig par byed/ /zhal gsum phyag drug rngam pa'i sku/ /g.yas dkar g.yon pa dmar bas te/ /dbus mthing stag gi pags pas bsgril/ /rin chen zhabs gdub sprul gyis brgyan/ /phyag g.yas gri gug phreng ba dang / /ḍa ma ru ni drag tu 'khrol/ /g.yon pa thod pa mdung rtse gsum/ /de bzhin zhags pas dgra bo 'dzin/ /drag po'i zhal las mche ba gatshig /spyan gsum dbu skra gyen du 'bar/ /pral / nyub sin+d+ra ra yi g.yu rung 'khyil/ /mi skyod spyi bor bzhugs pas byin kyis brlobs/ /gnas gsum lha bsam ye shes sems dpa' bstem/ /dbang bskur nas ni ri rmyebadag so sor bsam/ /brtan par gyur nas rang gi mdun—/ /dpal ldan khro mo dza li ni/ /g.yas pa gri gug thod khrag g.yon/ /sku mdog nag mo 'jigs byed ma/ /g.yas su k+ṣe tra pa li ma/ /ḍa ma ru g.yas sdig 'dzub g.yon/ /sku mdog du ba'i mdog can no/ /g.yon du ṭa ki rā tsa ser / /g.yas pa rtse gsum sdig 'dzub g.yon/ /rgyab tu ma hā ka li ni/ /dmar nag g.yas pa gri gug 'dzin/ /g.yon pa thod khrag zhal du rngubs/ /rus pa'i rgyan ldan gcer bu mo/ /gar thabs keng rus gdan la bzhugs/ /mche gcigs spyan gsum khros pa'i zhal/ /gtso bo dang ni dus mnyam skyed/ /las kyi lha mo bzhi po ni/ /gdug pa can kun 'gugs byed cing / /bzung nas gtso bo la stob byed/ /sngags kyi bzlas pa de rjes tsam/ /oṃ shrī ma hā ka la si thi tha na ma ma hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ rtsa ba'i sngags su bstan pa ni/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā ka la spyo k+ṣe ṭa big nan/ bi na ya ka hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ gtso 'khor nye 47—446

bsnyen sngags su bstan/ /oṃ ma hā ka li dza li ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā ka li ni k+ṣe tra pa la hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rad ṇi ṭa ki rā tsa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā ka li ni sha hūṃ mā ra ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ 'khor gyi sngags su bstan pa yin/ /lha la mnyes pa'i gtor ma ni/ /sha lnga bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga/ /ka pa lar blug byin brlabs te/ /tsan dan shing las gtso 'khor rnams/ /byon pa rnal 'byor mdun du ni/ /sgra dang bcas pas byon pa la/ /gsang ba'i sngags 'dis 'bul bar bya/ /oṃ shrī badz+ra ma hā ka la ye shas rna/ a pa ka ri rna/ ya ti pra ti snyo sma ra si ta dha i dan duṣ+ṭa/ kha kha/ khā ti khā hi/ mā ra mā ra/ grit+na grit+na/ ban dha ban dha/ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di ni me ke na mā ra ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/gtso 'khor rnams kyis gsol bar bsam/ /de ltar rtags dang rab ldan pas/ /bsgrub ①pa'i las la sbyar ba ni/ /sngags la sham bu gdags par bya/ /de nas bsad pa'i las bya ba/ /sngags la ya dang ya gdags bya/ /sbyin bsreg byas la mnan par bya/ /gtor ma steng nas mnan la bzhag /rtags byung skyes pa'i tsi ta ru/ /nag po chen po'i snying po dang / /'khor dang bdud rtsir bcas la gzhug⑤ /dar nag gis gtums mchan khung gdags/ /skabs su lag pas bzung byas la/ /bsad pa'i sngags kun bzlas par bya/ /bdag gis nag po chen po yi/ /sgrub thabs byin gyis rlob pa 'di/ /brtsams la dge ba gang yod pas/ /dpal ldan nag po'i zhal mthong shog /byin gyis brlabs pa nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ rnal 'byor kyi dbang phyug chen po dpal ldan dzā ba ri pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// spri //ghu ya/ rgya gar kyi bla ma a ta ya badz+ra dang / lo tsā ba tshul khrims mgon 47—447

gyis bsgyur ba'o// //'di'i brgyud pa ni/ dngos grub brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po dpal ldan sha ba ri dbang phyug /mi tri pa/ a dzu ga ta pa/ a ta ya badz+ra/ khyung po rnal 'byor/ rin chen brtson 'grus/ chos kyi seng ge/ chos kyi shes rab/brtson 'grus seng ge/ tshul khrims 'bum/ rgyal mtshan 'bum/ byams pa dpal bzang po/ bsgrub chen chos 'byung rin chen/ gdan sa pa kun dga' dpal bzang po/ des bdag la'o// //bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta de ba purna ma ti dang / lo tsā ba 'gar chos kyi bzang pos kyang bsgyur cing zhus dhite gtan la phab ces byams pa gsung ngo / /'di'i bka' yig 3mchog sgrub kyi bka' chung ba dang 'thun par mdzad// //47—448

bsdur mchan/445 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ② 〈〈pe 〉thaskyed/ ④〈〈pe 〉thasams/446 ①〈〈pe 〉〉dpral/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉rigs/447 ①〈〈pe 〉〉sgrub/ khru〈〈pe 〉〉bzhugs/448 ①〈〈pe 〉〉nugs/ ②〈〈pe 〉stanas/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2698)47wa 449

2772༄ga /byin gyis brlabs pa'i nag po chen po'i gsang ba'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/①ga phyag drug ye shes mgon po'i chos skor las/ nag po chen po'i gsang ba'i sgrub thabs 'phags pa klu byang gis mdzad pa'o// ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ a dhiṣ+ṭha na ma ma hā kā la gu ya sa dha dz+wa na ma/ bod skad du/ byin kyis brlabs pa'i nag po chen po'i gsang ba'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas gsang sgrub byin brlabs can/ /ri bo dben pa dur khrod du/ /dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar nag las/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad chos 'byung brgyad/ /rang byung sen dhu ra yis byug /mtshan ldan thod pa ka pa la/ /me long pad ma chos 'byung dang / /li khri gur gum ghi wang dang / /rang byung sin byu rgya skyegs kyis/ /chos 'byung kha sbyar 'khor lo bri—/ /lam du 'bras can rgun 'brum dang / /ka ra sbrang rtsi chang gis bran/ /nya sha dkar gtor bzang du bsham/ /rang nyid dpal ldan nag po che/ /zhal 47—450

gcig phyag drug 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /zhabs gnyis bgegs mnan gzir ba yi/ /nag po stag gi sham thabs can/ /phyag drug sbrul dang rus pas brgyan//g.yas gsum gri gug phreng ba dang / /ḍa ma ru ni rab tu 'dzin/ /g.yon gsum gsum thod kha ṭī kha/ /zhags pa bsnams shing drag po yi lku/ /zhal can mche ba rab tu brtsigs②/ /dpral ba sin dhu ra yis byugs/ /lha shing tsan dan bseb na 'gying / /'khor du ma mo brgyad kyis bskor/ /kun kyang kha dog nag mo la/ /lag na gri gug thod khrag bsnams/ /ro yi gdan la 'jigs pa'i tshul/ /khro mo'i tshul du bsgom par bya/ /gsang ba'i sngags ni 'bum tsho bzlas/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe ṭa big nan/ bi na ya ka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ ril bu mig sman mkha' spyod dang / /rkang 'gyogs bum pa mchil lham dang / /sa 'og rig 'dzin gang 'dod pa/ /dpal ldan nag po chen pos bster1ske/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i nag po chen po'i gsang ba'i sgrub ④thabs 'phags pa klu byang gis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //'di'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / mkha' 'gro ma seng ge gdong can/'phags pa klu byang / dus 'khor ba ka na ri pa/ rdo rje gdan pa/ khyung po rnal 'byor/ rin chen brtson 'grus/ chos kyi seng ge/ chos kyi shes rab/brtson 'grus seng ge/ tshul khrims 'bum/ rgyal mtshan 'bum/ 'jag chen byams pa dpal/ sgrub chen chos 'byung rin chen/ 'jag pa gdan sa pa kun dga' dpal bzang / 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal po/ des bdag bla ma rin chen la byin kyis brlabs pa lags so/ /u u u/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la k+ṣ-i k+ṣe tra big nan/ bi na ya ka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa 47—451

phaṭa / u ne u ne u ne/ hri hri hri/ dza dza nyuwa shaṃ ku ru e gu sha dza dza/ bya rog gi srog rgyud le'u bco lnga pa'o// //bsdur mchan/45༷ ༅mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/451 ①〈〈pe 〉stasros/ ②〈〈pe 〉sngagacigs/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉ster/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉sgrubs/452 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〉ཿ/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2699)47wa 452

po'i gegs sel bla ma gnad sgyur/① sto phyag drug ye shes mgon po'i chos skor las mi bskyod pa la brten nas bgegs sel thabs bzhugs so/ / ༄7/ /gu ru na mo/ mi bskyod pa'i bgegs sel 'di la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song nas/ rang yi dam gang byed du bsgoms la/ mdun du gzhal yas khang pad+ma 'dab bzhi/ 'khyams phyogs mtshon/phyi rdor ra dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba/ pad+ma'i lte bar rin po che'i khri phun sum tshogs pa/ de'i steng du skad cig gis mi bskyod pa sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje g.yon dril bu bsnams pa/ dbu la rigs lngas mtshan pa/ sku gzi mdangs bkrag dang ldan pa/ thugs byin brlabs dang ldan pa/zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ 'og min stug po bkod pa nas/ rdo rje 'chang dang bla ma rnams spyan drangs/ mi bskyod pa la bstim/mchod pa bzhi rdzogs su phul/ gsol ba gdab/ bshags pa bya/ bla ma'i thugs 47—453

kar pad ma dkar po gcig bsam/ de'i lte bar hri dmar ser gcig bsam/de'i mtha' mar gu ru tri ces pa'i yig 'bru ser pos 'khor ba la dmigs pa gtad la bzlas pa bya/ gsol ba gdab po/ /slob ma gzhug pa ni/ sngon 'gro gzhan dang 'dra/ maṇ+ḍal dbus su bla ma gsal gdab slob ma'i spyi bor byon par bsam—/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du yi ge gsum bsam/ de nas dpral bar oṃ dkar po las/ bdud rtsi dkar po byung / slob ma'i spyi bor babs/ bum dbang thob 'dre/ mgrin pa'i ā ཿ mgrin par gsang dbang / thugs ka'i hūṃ ser po las 'od zer bde ba'i rang bzhin ser po babs/ snying gar shes rab ye shes—/ bla ma'i gnas gsum kyi yi ge dkar dmar mthing gsum las/ bdud rtsi dkar dmar gsum byung / slob ma'i dbu ma'i nang nas mar zhugs/ lte bar sleb dbang bzhi pa thob/ rtsa mig thams cad bde ba'i rang bzhin gyis gang /bde stong du ngo sprad dbang gi rgyal po rang gi spyi bo na mar zhugs/ rang lus skad cig gis mgon por bskyed/ de'i thugs kar/ shes pa 'phyo na bla ma ser por bsgom—/ yid mi dga' zhing 'phyo na bla ma dmar por bsgom/ khams 'dus langs shing / dgongs phyogs bsdod snying mi 'dod pa byung na/ sku mdog sngon por bsgom/ gsol ba gdab/ dmigs pa gsal ba gal che/ lta sgom nyams su blang / rang rgyud 'jam zhing bgegs mi 'jug pa'i gnad yin/ bsnyen pa skyel ba'i dus lha sku mi gsal bar gyur na/ nam phyed kyi dus su thun zhabs thams cad la—/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'gro ba sems can thams cad 'od du zhu bar bsam/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can du nyams su blangs/ rang lus/ lha sku snang stong du nyams su blang / thun mgo thams cad du bla ma la gsol ba 47—454

'debs pa gal che/ rdzogs rim ni mgon po'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge bla mar bsdu/rang lus bla mar gsal bar sgom/ bla ma'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge thugs ku'i hūṃ la bsdu / hūṃ na da la thim/ na da thig le la/ thig le stong pa nyid la thim/ sems ma bcos pa'i ngang la bzhag /gsal stong dang bla ma dbyer mi phyed par sgom/bsngo ba bya/ bkra shis brjod/ mi bskyod pa la brten nas mgon po'i gegs sel bla ma gnad sgyur/ dpal ldan sha wa ri pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //mgon po'i bka' gang byed kyang gser gyi maṇ+ḍal shin tu gal che'o // //bsdur mchan/452 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/454 ①〈〈pe 〉togabasdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (27༷༷)47—455

2774༄ga /mgon po'i bkra shis yon tan rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/1 ༄4/ /na mo gu ru/ mthar thug snying po'i don rtogs nas/ /mkhyen gnyis yon tan rab rgyas pa/ /mchog gsum bla ma'i bkra shis shog /snod bcud dag pa'i bde chen po/ /snang stong zhal sbyor lhan cig skyes/ /phyi nang gsang ba mchog gi lha/ /sku gsum yi dam bkra shis shog /gzhi yi de nyid mngon du gyur/ /lam shes ngo bo nyid med cing / /rnam mkhyen gsang ba bsam mi khyab/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas bkra shis shog /slu med rgyu 'bras slab bya phra/ /lhag bsam dge ba rgya chen po/ /smin grol zung 'jug zab pa'i lam / /theg gsum dam chos bkra shis shog /snyen pos bstan pa ngur sprig 'dzin / /kun la phan sgrub rgyal ba'i sras/ /sgo gsum gsang sngags rnal 'byor 'chang / /rigs gsum dge 'dun bkra shis shog /khro gtum rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs 'chang / /phrin las kun bsgrub bstan pa skyong / /'khor 47—456

bzhi dpa' bo'i bkra shis shog /'jig rten khams na ma lus pa/ /'od gsal chen po'i bkra shis shog /gnas 'dir bde legs 'phel gyur cig /mgon po'i bkra shis yon tan rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ dpal sha wa ri pas mdzad pa rdzogs so / / //bsdur mchan/456 3mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (27༷1)47—457

2775༄7/ /mgon po dmar po'i tshe grub/ 1༄/ phyag drug ye shes mgon po'i chos skor las mgon po dmar po'i tshe bsgrub bzhugs sto / / ༄go/ /na mo gu ru/ mgon po dmar po'i tshe bsgrub kyi zhal gdams ni/bdag bskyed gang mos su bskyed pa'i mdun du chos 'byung dmar po gnyis rtsegs/de'i phyir gzhal yas khang gru bzhi 'khyams phyogs mtshon dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa/ de'i dbus su s+ho dmar po las tshogs bdag dmar po/ de'i steng du hūṃ dmar nag /de las 'od zer 'phros/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcad/ tshur 'dus hūṃ la thim/ hūṃ mer gyis zhu ba las/ yid bzhin nor bu'i mgon po sgu mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag drug pa/ zhabs gnyis gyad kyi dor thabs su bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yon dang po gnyis gri thod bar pa gnyis tshe'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ tha ma gnyis ḍā ma ru dang dril bu bsnams pa/rgyan cha lugs gzhan rnams mthun pa/ gnod sbyin bzhi/ lha mo gtsang ris/tsho17— /58

dam can rgya mtsho rnams bskyed la/ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dam tshig pa la stem / gsol ba gdab/ yig brgya bzlas/ bshags pa bya/ de nas mgon po'i thugs kar hūṃ dmar nag gi mtha' mar/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la k+shi rat+na gu ru hūṃ ces pas bskor ba la dmigs la nyer gcig bzlas/ bsnyen pa gzhan rnams kyang bya/ sgu gsung thugs kyi gsol ba gdab bo/ /slob ma gzhug pa ni/ sngon 'gro rnams tshar ba dang / dngos gzhi ni maṇ+ḍal dbus su mgon po gong bzhin gsal gdab/ mgon po'i spyi bor mi bskyod pa sngo skya/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu bsnams pa bsgom/de'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ rgyud pa'i bla ma spyan drangs bstem/ mi bskyod pa yang mgon po la bstem/ dbyer med du bsam/ de nas mgon po'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā 1dmar po/ thugs kar hūṃ dmar po/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus la bzhengs nas rang gi sngags kyi sgra dang bcas pas slob ma'i spyi bor byon/ lta sgom spyod pa snang stong zung 'jug tu ngo sprad / /de nas mgon po'i dpral ba'i oṃ dkar po las/ 'od dkar po byung /slob ma'i spyi bor thim bum dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag /mgrin pa'i āḥdamar po las/ 'od dmar po byung / gsang dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag /thugs ka'i hūṃ dmar nag /snying gar thim/ yid kyi dri ma dag /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ 'od dkar dmar mthing gsum gabyug tu 'dres—/ dbu ma'i nang du lte bar sleb/ tshig dbang rin po che thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag /rang lus phyi dung dkar phyis pa lta bur bsam/47—459

de nas mgon po rang dbang med par spyi bo na mar zhugs/ snying ga'i hūṃ dang dkrug 'dres pas/ skad cig gi phyag drug par sgrong bskyed/ de nas thugs ka'i hūṃ gi mtha' mar rtsa sngags kyis bskor ba la dmigs pa gtad/ hūṃ las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcad/'od zer tshur 'dus hūṃ la thim/ yang sngags las 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi snying gi dkyil du 'od bde stong du me re gnas/ khams ga/sum skrag sa le mthong bar bsam/ rang gis rang gi spyi bor bum pa gzhag ༄7 /bum pa las bdud rtsi dkar dmar gsum babs/ tshe'i bum dbang thob/ mgrin par sleb/gsang dbang thob/ snying gar sleb shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi bde stong gis khengs/ rig 'dzin kyi sa la gnas par bsgom / de dus lta sgom snang stong zung 'jug tu ngo sprad do / /༄ rdzogs rim ni dpral ba'i oṃ āḥl thim/ a hūṃ la/ hūṃ thig le la/thig le na da la/ na da stong pa nyid la lhan kyi bzhag /sems phyag rgya chen por bzhag go/ /dpal sha wa ri pa'i tshe sgrub rig 'dzin khra /brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / sha wa ri pa/ mi tri pa/ ra hu la/ khyung po rnal 'byor/ la stod dkon mchog mkhar/ slob dpon byams pa/ slob dpon sang blo/ mkhas mchog blo bzang / sgrub po sangs rgyas dar/ byab dang / yes rdor/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal po/ des bdag bla ma rin chen la'o// //47—460
bsdur mchan/458 mematshan byang 'di 〈〈snar bstan dkar chag 〉〉star bkod/459 ) 〈〈pe 〉〉 ཿ/46༷ hu7〈〈pe 〉〉bzhag 37〈〈pe 〉〉// //bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (27༷2)47wa 461

ra༅/ /lha tsho'i srog sgrub/ 1 sngag phyag drug ye shes mgon po'i chos skor las dpal lha mo'i srog sgrub bzhugs so/ /༄go / /rdo rje lha mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma mo tri pa'i lugs kyi lha mo'i srog bsgrub 'di la/ rdzas yung kar/ ske tshe/ khrag sna/ dug sna tshogs bsres nas/ dred mo'i thod par blugs la/ grog po phug rdugs kyi 'jag ma dang dgra bo'i dri chen rnyed na rab/ ma rnyed na rkang rjes kyi sa 'tsho bye bsres la/ ling ga mtho gang pa bya'o/ /de nas nyes pa'i spang gzugs/ lo ga pa'i phud gtor la/ rang nyid khro bo gshin rje gshed dam/ phyag rdor du bsgom la/ thugs ka nas 'od 'phros te/ byang shar nas dpal lha mo sku mdog dmar ba/ mche ba gcigs pa/ g.yas zangs gri dmar pos dgra bo'i srog rtsa gcod pa/ g.yon nad kyi rkyal pa kha phye bas/ dgra bo'i rnam shes drug dang nad kyi myos te 'chi ba/ 'khor nag mo bsam gyis mi khyab pas nad dang 717—462

dug gis dgra bo myur du brlag par bsams la/ ling ga la dgug gzhug byas la / gri lcags la byas pa'i phur pa sor brgyad pa gcig lha mor bskyed nas spyan drangs la/ ling ga'i snying gar gzugs/ rtag par zhe sdang ba'i dug dang mtshon gyi char babs pas/ dgra bo kha rubs su shi bar bsam la/ thun rdeg cing sngags 'di bzlas so / /1hi hi ma ma thun bh+yo/ trag rak+ka dgra bo la bh+yo / ra glo yaglo dgra bo che ge mā ra ya sod/ ces bzlas pas/ zhag bdun nas bud med nag mos bdag la rmi lam du snying ster ba dang / dgra bo'i srog kha/kha 'byed pa sogs 'byung ste/ des 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /'bring bcu bzhi/mtha' ma'ang nyi shu rtsa gabyug la 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /gtor ma dmar gtor de srod tho rangs dus tshod du gtong 2/ dam tshig du dre'u'i sha mi za bla ma la gus par bya/ sgrub kyi bar la yugs sa mo la mi reg /'di dug dang 'dra bas mi la mi sbyin/ las skal can dang 'phrad par shog gabyug /lha mo'i srog sgrub bla ma shā thi pas mdzad pa'o// //rgyud pa ni mgon po'i skor dang 'dra'o// //47—463
bsdur mchan/462 1 mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ (〈〈pe 〉〉tha/463 ) 〈〈pe 〉〉// // 〈 〈〈pe 〉〉btong /bsdur 'bras re'u migathad/ (27༷3)47wa 464

—sgrub thabs zhas bya ba/1ga dpal ldan lha mo'i gsang sgrub rje na ro pas mdzad pa bzhugs so/ /༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ṣ+pe ya de bi ma hā ka li sgo h+ya pā dha na ma/ bod skad du/ dpal ldan lha mo chen po'i —gsang ba'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/dpal lha mo nag mo chen mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha mo'i gsang ba'i bsgrub thabs ni / /bsnyen bsgrub las sbyor gsum gyis bstan/ /de las dang po snyen pa ni/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i sgrub pa pos/ /yid 'ong dbyen pa'i gnas dag tu/ /gza' skar dus tshod bzang po la/ /nang gtor phyi gtor btang nas kyang / /gsol ba gdab cing bden pa bdar/ /phyi nang gsang gsum rten rnams bca'//brten gtor rgyun gtor rten rnams bca'/ /de nas 'tshams bcad maṇ+ḍal bya//bdag nyid sems bskyed lhag lhar be+e/ /mdun du rgyu las gzhal yas khang / /de nang thod mkhar me rlung dbus/ /hūṃ las bskyed pa'i lha mo ni/ /sku mdog 47—465

nag la shin tu bsgeg /zhal gcig ma la phyag bzhi ma/ /zhal gnyis btsan dkyil brjid tshul gnas/ /g.yas gnyis ral gri bhan dha bsnams1/ /g.yon gnyis shags ti rtse gsum thog /mi ro khar bcug mche bzhi gcigs/ /spyan gsum dbu skra gyen du brdzes/ /snyan g.yas sbrul dang g.yon seng ldeng / /dur khrod chas brgyad sku la brgyan/ /klu chen gshib pa'i ske rags 2can/ /zhabs gnyis lcags sgogs dag gi brgyan/ /bong bu dmar gwa'i steng nyid du/ /btsan dkyil brjid pa'i tshul gyi 'gyengs/ /gru gsum bh+yo nag gsum las yangs//nag mo gcer bu ral pa can/ /g.yas pas mi snying g.yon bhan dha/ /dur khrod chas brgyad bong bu bcibs / /de rgyab rigs bzhi'i lha mo ni/ /dkar ser dmar ljang bong bu bcibs/ /g.yas pas rang rtags g.yon bhan dha/ /de rgyab phra men brgyad po yang / /seng stag spyang ki cung ka dang / /phag gdong dur bya bya rog bya rgod gdong / /zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri dang thod pa 'dzin/ /dur khrod chas brgyad drel nag rkang gsum bcib/ /de rgyab las byed pho nya rkang ka'i gdong / /stag dang spyang ki spre'u drel nag zhon/ /phyag mtshan mda' gzhu spu gri bhan dha dang / /sbrul zhags bhan dha rgyu zhags nad rkyal bsnam/ /de rgyab las mkhan bye ba 'bum gyis bskor/ /gtso bo'i sa bon hūṃ nyid 'khor rnams bh+yo//'bru gsum byin rlab ye shes myur du gzhug /sngags kyis phreng bas kha dog so sor gsal/ /'od zer spyo bsdu bla ma dag las dris/ /srog bzung srog bsdu srog gis dkyil nas blang / /gtor mchod stod skul dus bzhir byas nas kyang //gang 'dod gsol gdab rtse gcig dmigs pa bya/ /gtso 'khor 'od du e yi gnas su bstem/ /e nyid chos 'byung de dbus lha mo bye/ /'khor rnams skor 47—466

ba skor ba'i tshul nyid du/ /'od kyi spro bsdu'i dmigs pa dag la 'bad/ /de ltar byas pas bdun nam nges med na/ /lha mo gtso 'khor zhal mthong gsung yang thos/ /'bring gis nyams dang tha ma rmi lam ste/ /lus dang grib ma ltar 'khor ci bsam 'grub/ /de ltar bsnyen bsgrub bya ba ni/ /phung pa rnams la brub khung gru gsum bya/ /ling ga gzugs brnyan dug khrag gis bskus nas/ /brub khang nag po'i nang du gzhug par bya/ /gang 'dod thod par bcug nas su/ /dgug gzhug lha dang dbye ba bya/ /mtshon dang thun rdzas ting 'dzin ldan pas brabs/ /lcags kyis sdig pa phyag mtshan cho ga bya/ /dzaḥlas spyang mo hūṃ las ḍa ki ma/ /spro zhing bsad bcad gtub pa'i las byas bsam/ /de dus lha mo'i chibs pa rtag tu bsgyur / /rang nyid der bye pho nya las la mngag /bsnyen bsgrub sngags ni 'di nyid dag gis shes/ /oṃ hūṃ ṣi ya de bi ka li ka li ma ṇ+ḍi ka li ha ka li hūṃ ma hā tsi ta hring hring dzaḥdzaḥbh+yo e a ra li tri dzaḥs ma ya bh+yo/ oṃ e ma hā ka li de bi ka ra li bhi kan tra rag ti tsan dha ru pi ni hūṃ phaṭa/ bsnyen dus nyin mtshan bye brag shes par bya/ /sbad bsad gcig tu dril ba 'di ltar ro/ /ma mo snying la raka sha /ma raka sha /raka mo snying kha rag /khrag la ma dun dun drag ma raka snying tre kye ma ma ru lu la stso bh+yo/ snying kha rag sa ma ya rda rda dzaḥdzaḥm ma hring tsi ta la thun/ snying khrag la ma thun/ shi to ta snying la ya ya ma bh+yo/ ma ma sha sha ma tri ma ma sa ma ya/ dgra bo zlo ma ra ya sod sod ma tsi ta dza la ram̐/ tsi ta ma ma rol bye ril bh+yo/ ma ma las myur du mdzod/ dgra bo'i klad pa la ya/snying la ya/ dbang po la ya/ ma mo snying la thun bh+yo/ ma kha dhar ma mo bye/ oṃ 47—467

bye tsi sa ti sa ma ya du stan rbad/ a ka ri sems sa lu shing na li rbad/ kha dhas tsa mi la bh+yo rbad 'u rbad khrag ra rbad myos te ba slo bshas ti shaṃ/ bsnyen bsgrub las sbyor thun sngags so/ /de ltar bsgrub pas bsgrub bya ste/ /sod pa'i rtag mtshan thon pa dang / /da ni las la sbyar bar bya/ /sha khrag gtor ma bzang du bsham/ /sha ling khrag ling ling gsar dang / /ling gsum dum bur gtub nas kyang / /tsher ma'i shing brtsegs gshen me sbyar/ /me lha lha mor bskyed pa'i zhal/ /sgrub bya bsreg cing sngags 'di brjod/ /oṃ hūṃ ṣi ya de bi ka li ka li ma hā ka li hūṃ bh+ya bh+yo/ ma ma sha trung a mu shaṃ ma ra ya ud man ti hūṃ phaṭa/ brgya 'am stong ci nus gcig brjod / /mchod bstod mthar ni me lha gshegs/ /de nas thal ba dur sar mnan—/ /de ni las sbyor rim pa'o /de ltar byas pas bstan dgra rnams/ /zhag bdun dag gis 'chi bar 'gyur—/ /'di med gdams pa phyi ma rnams/ /mtshon cha med pa'i dmag dang mtshungs/ /snying med pa'i lus bzhin no/ /de bas gsang bsgrub rab tu gces—/ /srung bzlog zhi rgyas las rnams kun/ /bla ma'i zhal la dri zhing brtags / /dpal ldan lha mo'i gsang sgrub 'di/ /dpal ldan lha mos byer wa pa la gnang / /de nas nag po pa nas tikhror brgyud/ /na ro pas zhus mar pa bdag la gnang / /'di ni gcig rgyud dam pa yin/ /spel ba'i gnas me+ed shin tu gsang / /dpal ldan lha mo'i gsang sgrub rgya gar kyi mkhas pa chen po dpal na ro pas mdzad cing / bod kyi lots+tsha ba mar pa chos kyis blo gos kyis bsgyur zhing zhus pa'o rdzogs so// //47—468
bsdur mchan/465 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ rgya〈〈pe 〉staba'i/466 〉〈〈pe 〉〉bsnam/ ② 〈〈pe 〉〉ngag du〈〈pe 〉〉bcib/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (27༷4)47wa 469

2778༄༅/ /rdo rje mkha' spyod ma sgrub pa'i thabs/1ga lha bzhi'i brgya gzhung sgrub thabs zhal gdams bka' stod pa rnams bzhugs so/ /༄4 / /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra tsar na ra sa ha na/ bod skad du/ rdo rje mkha' spyod ma sgrub pa'i thabs/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rigs dang ldan pa'i gang zag gis/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sgrub bya/ /rang nyid yi dam lhar skyed la/ /byang chub sems ni sngon 'gro ba/ /mdun du e las chos 'byung skyed/ /de nang baṃ las rgya mtshor 'khyil/ /triḥlas pad+ma'i sdong por skyed/ /de steng paṃ las pad+ma bsgom/ /lte bar a las zla ba bsgom/ /de steng hriḥlas mkha' spyod ma/ /mdun du hūṃ las bla ma skyed/ /g.yas su hriḥlas spyan ras gzigs/ /g.yon du tai las sgrol ma bskyed/ /rgyab tu hūṃ las mgon po bskyed/ /mngon byang lnga 'am cho ga gsum/ /skad cig dag gis bskyed par bya / /sa bon gnyis las 'od zer 'phros/ /bskul zhing sbyangs la spyan 47—470
