drangs la/ /phyi nang gsang ba gsum gyis mchod/ /ye shes sems dpa' bzhugs pa dang / /sku gsum dbang bskur byas nas ni/ /gsol ba dag ni gdab par bya/ /na mo 'bud dha ya/ na mo gu ru te badz+ra/ bhe ra bhe re na shrī ye / ḍā ka ḍā ki ni ye/ dzño ka dzño ki ni ye/ sarba bud dha bo te sa te satwa sa ra māṃ/ ga tsa me/ de skad gsol ba lan gsum gdab/ /de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ /snying khar paṃ las pad+ma bsam/ /de steng a las zla ba bsam/ /sa bon hriḥlas bskor ba ni/ /oṃ badz+ra na ra tri tri hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa sa man ta hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ta re tud ta re tu re swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā ka la k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe ṭa big nan bi na yak+ṣa hūṃ dh+ri phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ de rnams gang sgrub snying po bzlas/ /gang sgrub gtso 'khor brje bar bya'o/ /ma yengs zla ba gsum nas 'grub/ /de skad rdo rje mkha' spyod gsung / /sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin brlabs pa'i/ /'gu na pa ka ra dang ni/ /a ta ya na badz+ra yi/ /thugs dam yin ces rje btsun gsung / /'di byas dge ba'i rtsa ba yis/ /sems can thams cad ma lus pa/ /mkha' spyod gnas su 'gro bar shog /lho phyogs bla ma ra hu las mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs thugs kyi gtso bo rdzogs so// //47—471

༄ga /nag po chen po phur par sgrub ripa zhas bya ba/ 1ga phyag drug ye shes mgon po'i chos skor las/ nag po chen po phur par sgrub pa'i thabs bzhugs so// ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā kā la ki la ya sarba na ma/bod skad du/ nag po chen po phur par sgrub pa zhes bya ba/ dpal ho ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bstan pa gnas par bya ba'i phyir/ /nag po chen po phur par bsgrub / /lcags sam nag po'i shing la sogs/ /mkhas pas 'jigs pa'i gzugs byas nas/ /sa bon las bskyed 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /bskyed nas rab gnas cho ga bya/ /rdo rje 'chang gi spyan mnga' ru/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas shing / /byin gyi brlabs pa'i gnas 'di la/ /rab gnas bya phyir spyan 'dren bzhugs/ /oṃ ma hā ka la hūṃ phaṭa/ mchod dang bstod pa zin pa'i mthar/ /he ru ka yi cha lugs su/ /gnas pa'i sngags ba blo ldan pas / /drag po'i dus su mgon 4bstod la/ /rdo rje gsor zhing phur bu rdeg /47—473

hūṃ las byung ba'i nag po che/ /thung la sbom pa'i gsus po che/ /'od zer bskal pa'i ①me dpung 'bar/ /dug gsum sreg byed ki la ya/ /hi ru ka'i spyan mnga' ru/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas pa/ /dkon mchog bla ma bsnyas ⑤byed la/ /'od zer bskal pa'i me dpung 'phro/ /dus la bab po ki la ya—/ /sku bstod zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /gri gug thod khrag las sogs bsnams—/ /sku smad zur gsum phur pa'i dbal/ /dam nyams snying la ki la ya—/ /zur gsum rgya mdud chu srin kha/ /blo ldan rdo rje'i tho ba yis/ /gnas bcu ru ni gdab par bya/ /'od zer 'bar ba ki la ya/ /legs ldan nag po drag shul can/ /gdug pa can gyi dgra bgegs 'di/ /brdul du brlag par ki la ya/ /lha min g.yul rnams bzlog byed pa/ /zhal gdangs che brtsigs khrag 'dzag pas/ /phrin las mdzad par ki la ya/ /dur khrod bdag po srin po'i gzugs/ /kham nag ral pa gyen du dze+es/ /ma mo 'bum gyis 'khor gyis bskul/ /bsod byed las mdzad ki la ya/ /lang ka'i grong khyer 'jom mdzad pa/ /'jig byed dka' thub thod phreng can/ /'od zer mang po 'phro 'du bas/ /gdug pa rlag mdzad ki la ya/ /nyi ma lta bur dmar ba'i can—/ /'od zer sngon po 'khrug cing 'phro/ /smin ma'i khro gnyer gyen du bzlog /bdud tshogs bsreg mdzad ki la ya/ /rngam pa ha ha cher sgrags pa/ /ri rab brdul phran bzhin du gtor/ /stobs chen byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /nyon mongs dgra 'joms ①ki la ya/ /khams gsum dbang du bsdud mdzad pa/ /dug gsum brdul du brlag mdzad cing / /grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jigs byed pa'i—/ /log 'dren bsod byed ki la ya/ /dur khrod mkha' 'gro pho nya'i 47—474

tshogs—/ /dgra bgegs ma lus gsod ①byed pa'i/ /nag po chen po'i zhal du btab—/ /bsgod byed dgra bsod ki la ya/ /oṃ ma hā ka la ki la ya kha hi kha ti/ki la ya/ mā ra mā ra ki la ya/ git+na byut+na ki la ya/ bhan dha bhan dha ki la ya/ha na ha na ki la ya/ da ha da ha ki la ya/ pa tsa pa tsa ki la ya/ de na mi gi na ki la ki la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ che ge'i snying la ki la ya/ /de ltar blo ldan phur pa yis—/ /gdug pa can gyi gnas bcur gdab/ /nag po chen po'i phur pa gdab pa phreng sngags dang bcas pa rdzogs so// //gal te de la rtags med na/ /nag po chen po'i srog phur tsams/ /phur pa bdag pos dbu mnan la/ /'gril zhing zhe sdang khro thabs su/ /gong bzhin byas la 'di yang brjod/ /dam bcas bzhin du ma byas na/ /bdag gi bsgo ba ma nyan na/ /bdag gi khyed la gtor ma ci byin pa/ /khyed kyi lus kyi bdud yin te/ /lus nyag tshal par 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de ma thag tu dmyal bar 'gro/ /de bas las rnams myur du bgyis/ /khā hi khā ti ki la ya/ /dam bcas bzhin du ma byas na/ /bdag gi khyed la bzlas pa ci byas pa/ /khyed kyi ngag gi gnad yin te/ /dzad kyi lce yang dum bur 'gyur/ /de ma/ de bas/ma ra ya ki la ya/ dam bcas bzhin du ma byas na/ /bdag gi ting 'dzin ci bgyis pa/ /khyod kyi snying gi gnas yin te/ /khyod kyi snying yang 'gas par 'gyur—/ /de ma thag tu dmyal bar 'gro/ /de bas las rnams myur du mdzod//git+na gyisna sa ma ya/ oṃ ma hā ka la ya sa ma ya/ duṣ+ṭa kha kha sa ma ya/ khā ti khā hi sa ma ya/ de ni mi ge na sa ma ya/ ces dam sgrag cing / srog phur gyis gdan du bsnun cing brdeg go/ /des las rnams myur du 'grub par 'gyur ro//47—475

dpal nag po chen po phur par sgrub pa slob dpon bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //'di'i brgyud pa ni bram ze mchog sred/ dpal sha wa ri nas sangs rgyas bston pa yan gzhan dang 'dra/ /bsdur mchan/473 lamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉sgrub/ ③〈〈pe 〉skasnga/du〈〈pe 〉〉pago/474 ①〈〈pe 〉gaskol ba'i/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉bsnyed/ ①〈〈pe 〉torajom/475 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bsod/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (27༷6)47wa 476

2780༄ga /dpal nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/sti༄/ phyag drug ye shes mgon po'i chos skor las mgon po dbang gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs dang bka' gnyis bzhugs so/ / ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ shri ma hā kā la sa dha na ma/ bod skad du/ dpal nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/dpal dbang gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang thob dam tshig ldan pa yi/ /yid dang mthun pa'i dbe+en gnas su/ /mthun pa'i rkyen rnams tshogs pa dang / /bde ba'i stan 'dug skyabs 'gro dang / /sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgoms nas—/ /swa bhā wa yi stong par sbyangs/ /e las chos 'byung mthing kha'i nang / /dmar po pad+ma nyi ma dang / /bgegs kyi rgyal po'i gdan la ni/ /rdo rje hūṃ dang gri gug a/ /de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ /tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ /dbang gi rgyal po sku mdog dmar/ /zhal gcig spyan gsum dang po gnyis—/ /gri thod bzung nas yum la khyud/ /bar gnyis lcang te'u rtse gsum 47—477

'dzin—/ /'og gnyis lcags kyu zhags pa bsnams/ /dbu skra sma ra smin ma ser—/ /thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / /rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas/ /pang du gsang yum mkha' 'gro ma/ /chags pa'i nyams can sku mdog dmar/ /phyag gnyis gri thod yab la stob/ /phyag rgya lnga ldan yab la khril/ /yab la sbrul rigs lnga yi rgyan/ /'od dpag med kyi spyod paṇa ①'chang / /mdun du ma hā kā la dmar/ /gri gug dang ni thod pa 'dzin/ /g.yas su k+ṣe ṭa pā la ni/ /du kha lcang te'u sdig 'dzub can/ /rgyab du dzi na mi tra ni/ /nag po gri gug thod pa can/ /g.yon du tra ki ra dza ser/ /rtse gsum dang ni sdig 'dzub 'gying / /thams cad khro bo'i chas kyi rgyan④/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi skoraske/ /ye shes me dpung klong na bzhugs/ /kun gyi gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūṃ/ /'od kyi ye shes spyan drang nas/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hos bgugs zhugs cing / /mnyes ①par bzhugs pa'i sa bon las/ /'od 'phros dbang gi lha tshogs bskul/ /mchod nas gsol gdab dbang bskur bas/ /rang rigs bdag pos dbu la brgyanarjo—/ /yab yum thugs khar nyi mar hūṃ/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā ka la spyo k+ṣe ṭa big nan bi na ya ka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa dhu ma gu ye swā hā/ 'od zer dmar po snod bcud khyab—/ /'gro ba'i nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyangs/ /brtan g.yo thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /bdag nyid lhar gsal drung du lhags/ /dad cing gus pas bdud par bsam/ /de ltar rtse gcig ting 'dzin gyi/ /zhag bdun rgyun chad med par bzlas/ /dngos su zhal ston rmi lam du/ /bltas dang mtshan ma ci rigs 'byung / /thun 'tshams mchod pa bzhi rdzogs dang / /spos sbyor bzhi ldan gtor ma dbul —/ /bumagon po'i nang sgrub rje mi tri pa la bdag 'khyung po rnal 'byor gyi 47—478

༷/sa pa'o// 〈sna //bsdur mchan/477 lamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/478 ①〈〈pe 〉〉cod pan/ ②〈〈pe 〉4)sa brgyan/ ①〈〈pe 〉stananyes/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉rgyan/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉ska/ //bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (27༷7)47—479

༄ga /mgon po'i rgyu dus brtag pa bzhugs so//①༄4/ /bla ma mgon po dbyer med phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di ni mgon po rgyu ba'i dus so/ /dus gnyis las yar ngo'i zla ba dang / mar ngo'i zla ba'o/ /yar ngo'i tshes pa bcu gsum la nam gung rgyu de/ kha shar du ltas la bya'o/ /tshes brgyad la srod dang tho rangs rgyu ste/ kha nub tu lta'o/ /tshes bcu la bsrod la rgyu ste/ kha byang du lta'o/ /bcu dang brtswa lnga la skya rengs shar nas rgyu ste—/ kha nub du ltas la bya'o/ /mar ngo'i nyi shu gnyis la nyi ma nub pa la rgyu ste/kha nub du lta'o/ /nyi shu la srod la rgyu ste/ kha byang du lta'o/ /phur pa gdab pa dang thod pa mnan pa dang / khrag zor 'phangs pa thebs pa'i dus ni/dbang phyug chen po skyed gdong nag po dang / lha mo dbu ma dang gnyis/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa la skye 'gro srang la 'jal zhing nyul bas de'i dus su byas na thebs che/ spyid ②zla ra ba'i tshes bcu la 'khor bstan ma bcu gnyis dang 47—480

bcas nas nyul bas thebs che'o/ /'bring po'i tshes bcu drug la 'khor bdud bzhi dang bcas nyul bas thebs so/ /tha chung gi nyi shu gnyis la ma bdud dang bcas nas nyul bas thebs so/ /dbyar zla ra ba'i tshes brgyad la 'khor gza' chen brgyad dang bcas nas nyul bas thebs so/ /'bring po'i tshes brtswa lnga la 'khor klu drug dang bcas nas nyul bas thebs so/ /tha chungs la rigs lnga yab yum dang ma mo thams cad ltad mo la yangs pas mi bya/ ston zla ra ba'i nya gsum ka 'khor ma mo dang bcas nas nyul bas thebs so/ /'bring po'i bcu bdun nas gnam stong gi bar 'khor rgyu skar gyis byas nas nyul bas thebs so/ /tha chungs kyi tshes brgyad nas stong gi bar du 'khor lha chen po brgyad kyis byas nas nyul bas thebs so/ /rgun zla ra ba'i tshes bcu gsum nas bcu drug gi bar du 'khor gnod sbyin dang bcas nas nyul bas thebs so/ /'bring po'i nyi shu nas stong gi bar du 'khor gshin rje dang bcas nas nyul bas thebs so/ /tha chungs kyi nyi shu dgu la lha srin yongs kyi kha lo bsgyur nas sems can la rtsis 'debs byed cing srog bdud pas thebs so/ /drag po'i las kyi phur bu 'debs pa dang /thod pa gnon pa dang / zor 'phen pa dang / ho sbor ba dang / ser ba 'be+ebs ①pa cho gar song song byar mi rung byas na phur pa btab kyang snang /thod pa gnan kyang rdzas 'drul/ zor 'phangs kyang khrag mdzad/ ngan sngags zlas kyang rlung 'dang ②/ lha mo sgrubs kyang don med/ log nas sngags pa rang phungs ①pas mi bya'o/ /drag po'i las gang byed kyang mi rung / phyir zlog pa'i dus ni/ spyi zla ra ba'i bcu bdun dang bcu dgu la byas na zlog /'bring po'i tshes gcig dang nyi shu brgyad la bzlog /tha chungs kyi gnam stong la logarjo /47—481

dbyar zla ra ba'i tshes gnyis dang lnga la zlog /'bring po'i drug la ldog /tha chung gi tshes bcu gcig la ldog /ston zla ra ba'i nyi shu la ldog /'bring po'i tshes gsum la ldog /tha chungs kyi tshes gnyis la ldog /rgun zla ra ba'i tshes brtswa brgyad la ldog /'bring po'i nyi shu la ldog /tha chungs kyi nyi shu bdun la ldogade rnams su drag po'i las gang byed kyang log 'dren gdug pa can gnod pas rang gi srog la gnod do/ /rang ting nge 'dzin dang ldan yang / bu dang chung ma dang / phyug la log te/ sngags pa tshe thung ba dang / bgab ngan pa dang /dbul bar 'gyur ba'i kyon de lta bu 'ong ba yin no/ /slob dpon 'jam dpal gshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa rdzogs sto// //mthu rtsal thogs pa med par shog/ //47—482
bsdur mchan/48 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉stanapyid/481 ①〈〈pe 〉toradebs/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉ldang / ①〈〈pe 〉〉phung / rjo〈〈pe 〉9sdogabasdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2708)47wa 483

༄/ /byen gyis brlabs pa'i nag po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/1ga phyag drug ye shes mgon po'i chos skor las sha wa ri dbang phyug gi mdzad pa'i byin brlab nag po'i bsgrub thabs gos pa'i las mtha' can bzhugs so// ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ sa thi sgra na ma hā kā la swa da na ma/ bod skad du/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i nag po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ myur mdzad srun ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhabs bdub dang bcas bi na ya ka mnan/ /nag po chen po stag gi sham thabs can/ /phyag drug sbrul gyi rgyan gyi rnam par brgyan/ /g.yas pa 'phreng ba bar pa gri gug 'dzin/ /tha ma ḍa ma ru ni drag tu 'khrol/ /g.yon pa thod pa dang ni mdung rtse gsum/ /de bzhin zhags pas bzung nas 'ching bar byed/ /drag po'i zhal la mche ba rnam par gcigs/ /spyan gsum drag po'i dbu skra gyen du 'bar/ /dpral bar sin+tu ra yi legs par byug /rin chen thod rkam lnga yi dbu la brgyan/ /spyi bo mi bskyod pa yi dbu la brgyan 47byed/84

—pa sa rdo rje rigs kyi lha yin/ /khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ /sna tshogs pad ma nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor steng / /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus nas bzhengs / /shing la byin nas gtor ma len par dmigs/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe tra big nan bi na ya ka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ bsnyen pa/'i snga gas so/ /oṃ shri badz+ra ma hā ka la k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe ṭa yā ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bā k+ṣa bā k+ṣa/ru ti ra saṃ sa ha ra s+t+waṃs/ byu hi da bha smi ku ru hri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ 'phrin las sgrub pa/'i snga gas so/ /oṃ ma hā kā la ma 1sha sa na/ a pa ka ri re/ re sha a pa tsi ma hā ka lo ya/ i dan rad na tra ya ya/ a pa ka ra ā+oṃ/ a ti pra tig snyo sma ra se sarba duṣ+ṭan las sbyo ra dus che ge mo jes 'don bha li kha kha khā hi khā hi mā ra mā ra/ byut+na byut+na/bharnya bhan+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ de na me ke ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā las sbyor gyi snga gas so/ lan bdun brjod la gtor ma sbyin/ /dpal ldan nag po che ba'i mchog /ye shes phyag drug bsgrubs 'dod pa'i/ /rnal 'byor pa yi 'di ltar bya/ /dbe+en zhing nyams dga'i gnas mchog tu/ /dkyil 'khor mda' gang gru bzhi bya/ /'thas par byas la chag chag gdab/ /thig gdab sgo bzhi gru chad ldan/ /pho brang 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi 'god/ /kha dog phyogs dang mthun par bya/ /sgo 'khyam nag po nang khyim dmar/ /gru chad sgrug po mu khyud mthing / /rtsibs 4mchen dkar po zhi bar bya/ /pho brang dbus su gtab gtor bca'/ /shar sgor rdo rje lhor gri gug /nub tu thod pa ltag sprod 5lnga/ /byang sgor rgyun gtor bzhag par bya/ /sha chen gri khrag dag gi brgyan / /mgon po'i spo sregs mar me bltams/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas ni/ /ye shes lha yi rnal 'byor bsgoms/ /dkyil 'khor paṃ las pad ma 47—485

'dab brgyad/ /de steng ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ /de steng zla thogs bgegs kyi rgyal/ /bi la bu gang ne+e le 'dzin na ya ka kha sbub bsgyel/ /de yi steng du hūṃ nag po/ /de las 'od 'phros las bzhi 'grub/ /tshur 'dus gri gug nag po yi//yu ba gser kyi rdo rjes byas/ /rno dbal thur la gtad pa'o/ /rdo rje'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ /de steng hūṃ 'thing nag pos mtshan/ /de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ /tshur 'dus pa las dam tshig pa'i/ /mgon po gzhung bzhin bsgom par bya/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum bgegs chen gzer//rus pa'i zhabs gdub rgyal rigs klu/ /dkar khra'i sbrul gyi brgyan pa'o/ /stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ /lto ba thur la 'phyang ba la/ /bhung zhing rbom hrags gel ba'i gzugs/ /gnag cing gzi brjid che ba la/ /mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ /dril bu g.yer khas brgyan pa'o/ /zhal sgrad mche gcigs ljags 'gril zhing / /ag tshoms ser nag sma ra can/ /shangs rdog che zhing khro gnyer bsdus/ /spyan dmar gru gsum sdang mig gzigs/ /dam la gnas pa'i rtags kyi mchog /dpral bar sin byu ra dag gi/ /thig le 'bar bas mtshan pa'o/ /dbu skra kham ①nag gyen la dze+es/ /sangs rgyas rigs lngas mtshan pa yi/ /thod rkam ②lnga yi dbu la brgyan/ /dmangs ④rigs nag khra'i sbrul gyi bcings/ /mi skyod pa yi rgyas gtab cing / /bram ze dmar khras mgrin pa snyan/ /rje rigs ser khras phyag gdub brgyan/ /g.yas kyi dang po thod 'phreng 'dzin/ /bar pa rdo rje gri gug 'phyar/ /tha ma thod pa ltag sprod lnga//dril bu g.yer khas brgyan pa'o/ /g.yon gyi dang po thod khrag gsol/ /bar pa kha ṭaṃ rtse gsum 'dzin/ /tha ma rdo rje lcags sgog gi/ /zhags pa dgra bgegs 47—486

lus la 'debs/ /de yi thugs kar pad nyi'i steng / /hūṃ nag 'bar bas mtshan par bsams/ /'od 'phros ḍa ①ma ru yi sgras/ /lho phyogs dur khrod bsil tshal gyi/ /tsan dan sdong po'i steng dag nas/ /ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hos gnyis med stem/ /thugs kar sa bon hūṃ nag las—/ /rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor bar lta/ /phub ral can dang gri gug be+eng //dpal ldan lha mo la sogs pa'i/ /bka' sdod las mkhan phyogs bzhir bgod/ /gang bcol 'phrin las sgrub par bsam/ /de nas bdag gi sngags bzlas pas/ /gtso bo'i thugs ka'i gsang ba'i sngags/ /gyen du phud te zhal nas 'thon/ /bdag gi zhal thim dngos grub thob/ /thugs ka nas thon thugs kar thim/ /thugs dam brgyud bskul 'gal me yi/ /'khor lo'i tshul kyi sngags bzlas pas/ /sngags las 'phrin las bzhi yi 'od/ /'phros nas las bzhi byas par lta/ /de nas thun bzhir brjod bya zhing / /thun mtshams dag tu gtor ma sngo/ /yi ge brgya pa nyams chags bskang / /ye shes mi shes snga sor bzhag /sems can don du bsngo ba bya/ /bdag nyid lha yi rnal 'byor gyi/ /za 'chag nyal 'dug spyod lam bzhis/ /dus dang yi ge'i grangs dang ni/ /rtags rnams ma rdzogs bar du bzlas/ /dus kyi snyen pa zla ba drug /yi ge'i dbye ba khrag gnyis te/ /grangs kyi bsnyen pa 'bum tsho gnyis/ /rtags ni sgrub la brtson pa yi/ /lus ngag yid gsum g.yeng ba spangs/ /dmigs pa rtse gcig gsal bar bzlas/ /bya nag lding dang khyi nag 'khor/ /sngags pas chas gos nag po can/ /bran g.yog tshul du 'grogs byed cing / /zas nor ster ba rmi ④ba'o/ /de dag khro zhing rgyags pa dang / /bdag gi lad mo sna tshogs byed/ /mig log mchu med 47—487

byed pa rnams/ /las mgon khros pa'i rtags yin pas/ /gtor ma btang ①zhing bshags pa bya/ /de la gtor ma'i man ngag ni/ /rin chen snod dang ka pa lar/ /nasa'abras gro 'bru sna gsum gyi zan gyi gang / /gri sha gri khrag la sogs pa'i—/ /rgyan gyis brgyan te chang gi bran/ /de nas sems bskyed yi dam bsgoms—/ /swa bha wa yi sngags kyis ni/ /phyi nang snod bcud stong par bsam//skad cig tsam las snod kyi nang / /re las nyi dkyil de stengs su/ /sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga nyid kyang / /sa bon gsal ⑤bar gyur pa la/ /'og tu yi dang ram̐ nyid las/ /yi las rlung byung ram̐ las me/ /'bar te yig 'bru zhu ba las/ /'bru ①oṃ s+dzahūṃ gsum brjod pas ye shes kyi/ /bdud rtsi dpag med 'phel bar bsamadhi—/ /de nas dam tshig mgron skyed de/ /ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs nas/ /bstems te phul bas mnyes par bsam/ /hūṃ bde gshegs bla ma mgon dang bcas/ /ye shes phyag drug gtso 'khor dang / /dam can mkha' 'gro tshogs rnams kun/ /bstan bsrungs 'phrin las sgrub don du/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi gnas 'dir gshegs/ /dungs ⑤pa'i sems kyis spyan 'dren kyi—/ /thugs dam thugs rje'i dbang gi ni/ /da lta nyid du gshegs su gsol//oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la spyo ces pa'i rtsa sngags lan bdun brjod/ skar mda' lam du bzhugs shul gyi/ /gnas nas byon nas thim par bsam/ /hūṃ mnyam med mthu chen me ltar 'bar/ /dgra bgegs ma lus thal bar rlog /thal byed gzhon nu 'jigs pa'i sku/ /'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ces pas sgo gsum gus pas phyag btsal/ rtsa sngags bdun la bha ling gdags/ /gtso bo ye shes pa la dbul/ /las sngags bdun kyi 'khor la dbul/ /bstod pa bya 47—488

zhing 'phrin las bcol/ /de yi dus gsum spos bsregs te/ /btsan dug yungs kar sgo kya gsum/ /gri khrag dang sbyar ril bu bya/ /yang na gu gul nag po dang / /btsan dug yungs kar bu ram rnams/ /gri sha dag dang sbyar byas te—/ /ril bu sran ma tsam byas nas/ /sol ba'i me la sregs par bya/ /lha rnams 'du zhing bgegs rnams bskrad①/ /de las dngos grub thob par 'gyur//'di ni man ngag dam pa'o/ /de nas gso ba'i las stan sdepa/ /'khor lo rtse thag bla phur rnams/ /bsrung bya'i go khrab rdo rje yin/ /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad mu khyud ldan/ /lte bar rtsa sngags bsrung bya'i ming / /mu khyud nang ma sgrub sngags te/ /phyi ma rten 'brel sngags kyi skor/ /rtsibs ①la hūṃ chen 'bar ba brgyad—/ /rtsibs mchan rnams la las sngags 'god/ /mchod pa lnga bshams rab gnas bya/ /de nyid gang srung lus la gdags/ /bgegs kyis me dpung 'bar bar mthong / /tshe yi thag pas bsrungs pa rjoni/ /dar ram g.yang mo lug gi spu/ /legs par bskal te sum sgril bya/ /bsnyen sngags bsgrub pa las sbyor sngags/ /stong rtsa brgyad la sogs pa bzlas/ /sngags de rdo rje lu gu brgyud//gser gyi kha dog 'bar ba la/ /yig 'bru thams cad 'khril bar bsam /gus pa gsum la sku gsung thugs/ /sgoms te rab tu gnas par bya/ /gang bsrungs lus la btags pa yi/ /rdo rje ra ba'i nang zhugs pas/ /log 'dren bgegs kyis mthong mi 'gyur/ /bla yi phur pa bca' thabs ni/ /lcags sam seng ldeng sgrug po la/ /rab tshad khru gang yod pa la/ /rgya 'dud gnyis dang bcung bzhogs brgyad/ /dbal gsum rtse mo rno bar bya/ /sku gsungs thugs kyi yig 'bru 'god/ /las sngags mgul du rtags nas ni/ /nag por mnga' 47—489

gsol la/ /gang bsrung de yi sngas su gzugs/ /bgegs rnams skrag cing 'byer bar 'gyur/ /gal te 'tshe zhing nyong gyur na/ /zab mo du ba 'phro gcod sngags/ /dri bzang sman gyi legs bris te/ /rab gnas tshul bzhin byas la kadags①/ /zla gtor brgya rtsa ma chag gtang / /de yi khrag bcad bzhin du 'gro/ /oṃ na mo ma tri gha na se tse'u dhe'u ta ra rdzo swā hā/ chad lhag med pa rab tu gces/ /tshar nas gtang rag dus su gtang / /ming nyid chos skyong mtha' can gdags/ /gdug pa can gyi gnod byed la/ /dang po klud dang gtor ma sbyin/ /tshad med bzhi yi ting nge 'dzin gyi/ /chos bshad bden pa gdar bar bya/ /las ngan dbang gi spog gyur na/ /drag sngags me yi 'khor lo 'di/ /las sbyor sngags kyi sham bur gdags/ /dus bzhi dag tu gzir bar bya/ /oṃ ra kha/ ma hā ra kha/ d+ma ka tho ki ni/ bha ra ma ra kha swa bre ta pra sa tsa ra ri/ ha ra hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ a bhi ba ga mā ra ya/ ra ka sa phaṭa swā hā/ gdug pa 'jil byed sngags 'god 'di/ /sha ba ri ngas rab tu gsang / /las ngan can gyi sri can la/ /mnan pa'i las kyis 'dul 'dod na//kham pa'i bum pa gsar pa gcig /sa dkar chos kyis legs byug te/ /rgyal gsel ②dkor ba gang gnod pa'i/ /mtshan ma rtags la ling kha bca'/ /de yi snying gar yi ge tri/ /dri rgod yag pa'i khrag gi bri/ /ye shes lha yi nga rgyal dang / /phyag rgya bzhi yi sngags kyi dgug /lcags kyu lta bu'i 'od zer gyi/ /gang na gnas pa'i sa phyogs nas/ /drangs te gnyis med bstems par bya/ /sgrub pa zhag gsum bar mi bya/ /ling ga bum par bcug nas ni/ /de yi steng du dngul chu dang / /dngul thal zangs dang ra gan dang / /'bras dang nas 47—490

dang bra bo dang / /yongs su bsngos te blug par bya/ /kham phor gsar pas kha bcad la/ /kha rgyan shu dag nag pos bya/ /lha khang mgon po'i zhabs 'og gam//mchod rten rnying pa'i 'og tu mnan/ /yang na rgya gram lam du'o/ /de yi gsang sngags bstan pa ni/ /oṃ ka mi ni ra tsa swā hā/ ka ni rak+ka ①ni phaṭa/ tai bha ni phaṭa/ mo ha ni phaṭa/ dang po zhag gcig chos skyong sngags/ /de nas man tra 'di nyid bzlas/ /gang gnod them bu bkag pa bzhin/ /'gro 'gyur the tshom med pa yin/ /bsreg pa'i ling ga dpal 'bar la/ /mchod gtor dpal bshos zor gtor rnams/ /rim pa bzhin du gnas su gtang / /rten gsum bca' ba'i man ngag ni/ /sku rten lugs su blugs pa dang / /'bur du gtod dang ris su bris/ /tshad ldan bla mas rab gnas pa'o/ /gsung rten gsang sngags gser yig la/ /thugs rten bde gshegs gdung la bya/ /las kyi ④bka' yi rten dag ni/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra gcig /g.yul lam pha tshan nang spe yi/ /skad cig tsam gyi srog gcad pa'i/ /dri rgod chu klog ma reg pa'i/ /tsit+ta 'bar ba gcig la bya/ /srog rtsa dbu mar ring bsrel gzhug /g.yas su gsung rten gzhug par bya/ /g.yon du rin chen sna lnga dang //dri bzang sman dang spos kyi gang / /dar sna lnga yi ①dril byas te/ /rgyun par mchan khung g.yon par bcang / /sgrubs pa'i dus su dkyil stengs bzhugasarjo/ /de yi lus dang grib ma bzhin/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par 'gyur/ /gso dang gsad pa rnams ⑤gnyis la/ /mchog tu gso ba'i las la shis/ /bsad pa'i las mtha' gzhan du shes/ /rten gyi man ngag zab mo 'di/ /rmu rgod sems can 'dul dka' rnams/ /chos 'dod slob dpon mi 'dod pas/ /47—491

gdam ngag thob nas bla ma spong / /dam nyams lag tu shor ba srid/ /snod med rnams la gsang bar bya/ /sbyor ba dngos gzhi 'jug gsum du/ /rtags 'di dag la yid rtan bya/ /phyi rtags nang rtags gsang ba'i rtags/ /khros pa'i rtags dang bzhi ru bshad/ /phyi rtags bsnyen sgrub byed pa'i dus/ /dkyil las 'od dang me stag 'phros/ / sgrub khangs ①thog tsheg bya rog lding / /bon pa nag po glu len cing / /dar nag thogs nas 'phyar ba 'ong / /nang rtags slob dpon chos 'chad cing / /gdugs phub seng khrir sdod pa dang / /phebs par smra dang lung ston dang / /ban dhe mtshan ldan zas kyi gnod/ /byed par rmi na lha nye yong / /gsang rtags mgon po rmi ba dang / /dngos su zhal ston gri gug dang / /thod 'phreng cang ①te ka pa lar/ /rtse gsum zhags ①pa gter ba dang / /stag seng mchod pa stong pa dang / /shel ri mchod rten la 'dzeg cing / /de la bskor ba byed pa dang / /chos nor gter ston grub rtags so/ /a tsa ra nag po 'khrugs byed dang / /ral gri'i char pa 'beb rjopa dang / /bya nag lug nag 'thab pa dang / /bud med nag mo khro zhing greg /mi sdug sna tshogs ston pa sogs/ /khros pa'i rtags yin bshags pa bya/ /dam rdzas dpung skyed bsnyen sgrubs la/ /brtson 'grus /drag pos 'bad par bya/ /de ltar byas pas las 'grub ste/ /the tshom yid gnyis spang bar bya/ /chos skyong 'di yi khyad par ni/ /'khor la mi gnod rbad par 'gro/ /dkar po dang nag po klu bdud dang / /btsan dang the'u rang rgyal po sogs/ /dgra bgegs rdul du zlog par byed/ /nag po chen po phyag drug pa'i sgrubs thabs/ dpal sha wa ri dbang phyug gis zhal mngon sum du gzigs nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //47—492

bla ma rgyud pa ni/ dpal sha wa ri dbang phyug /rje mi tri pa/ a nan ta badz+ra/ a bhi 'dzug rta/ bla ma du gu pa/ las stod dkon mchog 'khor / / //bsdur mchan/484 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉ngodub/ ni〈〈pe 〉rdzam 25 yis/485 ①〈〈pe 〉〉pa/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉rgyad/ ③du〈〈pe 〉sta:ba/ du〈〈pe 〉〉spros/486 ①〈〈pe 〉skabams/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉skom/ ③〈〈pe 〉stanamang /487 ①〈〈pe 〉〉ṭa/ ②〈〈pe 〉smug488 ①〈〈pe 〉stanatang / ②〈〈pe 〉stanasol/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉 bye/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉bsams/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sngagadungs/489 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bkrad/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉bstan/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉:ba du〈〈pe 〉〉ba/49༷ ①〈〈pe 〉stanadabs/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉gser/491 ①〈〈pe 〉torak+ṣa/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉kyis/ ②〈〈pe 〉stanas/ du〈〈pe 〉sngagazhugs/ du〈〈pe 〉〉rnam/492 ①〈〈pe 〉〉sgrubs khang / ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉ཿnga / ②〈〈pe 〉stanabs/ du〈〈pe 〉torabebs/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2709)47wa 493

༄ga /nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/①to mgon po zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa bram ze chen pos mdzad pa bzhugs so// ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ athiṣ+ṭha na ma hā ka la sa dha na na maḥ/bod skad du/ nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stongapa'i ngang las paṃlasapad ma ramalas nyi ma'i gdan stengs na/ /bye na ya ka brdal ba'i thag④ /hūṃ las gri gug gi spro bsdu las nag po chen po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /stag lpags dang ni rus pa'i rgyan gyis mdzes/ /sbrul chen rgyan dang ral pa thur du 'phyang / /srin po'i thod phreng rus pa nag po yi—/ /thod pas dbu la rab tu brgyan pa'o/ /g.yas dkar g.yon ni dmar zhing spyan gsum pa/ /khros pa'i so gcigs rab tu gtum pa'i mdog /g.yas pa gri gug bar pa bgrang 1phreng ste/ /tha mas chos sgra ḍa ma ru/ /drag po khrol zhing gar stabs mdzad/ /g.yon pa thod pa dang ni mdung rtse gsum/ /de bzhin zhags pas dgra bo 'dzin par byed/ /brkyang skum rjogar thabs mdzad 47byed494

pa'i zhabs bzhi rol/ /mi bskyod byin kyis brlob cing rgyab tu ma hā ka la ni/ /dmar nag g.yas pas gri gug 'dzin/ /g.yon pa thod khrag zhal du rngub/ /rus pa'i rgyan ldan gcer bu mo/ /gar stabs keng rus gdan la bzhugs/ /mche gcigs spyan gsum khros pa'i zhal/ /gtso bo dang ni dus mnyam bskyed/ /las kyi lha mo bzhi po yis/ /gdug pa can kun kun ①'gugs byed cing / /bzung nas gtso la stobs par byed/ /sngags kyi zlas pa de rjes btsal/ /oṃ shī badz+ra tsan dha ma hā kā la bra thi tha na ma ma hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ rtsa ba'i sngags su bstan pa yin/ /oṃ shri badz+ra tsan dha ma hā ka la dza li khro k+ṣe tra big nan bhi na yak+ṣa hā na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ gtso 'khor nye snying sngags su bstan/ /oṃ ma hā ka li ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā ka li khre ta pa la hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rad ni ta ki ra dza hūṃ phaṭa—/ oṃ ma hā ka li ni sha hūṃ ma ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ 'khor gyi sngags su bstan pa yin—/ /lha mnyes pa yi gtor ma ni/ /sha lnga bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga/ /ka pa la blugs byin brlabs te/ /tsan dan shing la gtso 'khor rnams/ /babs nas rnal 'byor mdun du ni/ /sgra dang bcas pas byon pa la/ /gsang ba'i sngags 'dis dbul bar bya/ /oṃ ma hā ka la sha sa nan/ a pa ka ri sha ri shaṃ/ a pas tsi ma hā ka ṭaṃ paṃ i rte rad na tra ya a pa ka ri ni ya ti pra ti dza sma ra si tad tai/i rda duṭaṃ kha kha kha nyi kha ②hi/ ma ra ma ra/ grit+na grit+na/ bhan dha ban dha/ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na mi ke na/ ma ra ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa—/ gtso 'khor rnams kyi gsol bas sam/ /oṃ ma hā ka la so sbi na tsa la nā ne+e/ pu ra dza ling ni/ p+ta ka ra na bha hūṃ ka na ni ra ba sa wu ra hūṃ ga ka hūṃ ka phem ka ra rnyi bhi sha na/ da pa di pi la dha ma ru e pa la se ka ka la ha hi/ oṃ ya na sa na dzo ki ni na ya/ a ne+e ①de e tse lu la e na sa ni pra rna blu sa wu ra this sba 47—495

na ①ma ma hā ka la hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ sngags des legs par bstod pa'o/ /de ltar rtags dang ldan pa yis/ /sgrub pa'i las la brtson par ni/ /sngags la sham bur gdag par bya/ /de nas gsang ba'i las bya ba/ /gtso 'khor sngags la ma ra ya/ /bla mas bstan pa shes par bya/ /sbyin sreg byas la mnan par bya/ /rab chad thod pa steng 'og la/ /gtso 'khor 'khor lo bris byas la/ /lte bar nag po'i ling ga bri/ /kha sbyar bar du ling ga gzhug /ro ras dril la mnan pa bya/ /yang na be+ed dam 'brub khung du/ /man ngag bzhin du mnan par bya/ /gtor mas steng nas mnan la bzhag /rtags byung skyes pa'i tsit+ta ru—/ /ma hā ka li'i snying po dang / /'khor dang bdud rtsir bcas pa bzhugs//sku yi dril la dar nag gtum/ /rang re mchan khung gdags par bya/ /skabs su lag pas gzung byas la/ /bsad pa'i sngags kun bzlas par bya/ /bdag gi nag po sgrub pa'i thabs/ /rang nyid byin gyis brlobs ②pa 'di/ /rtsams pa'i dge ba gang yod pa/ /dpal ldan mgon po'i zhal mthong shog / //①nag po chen pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i sgrub thabs/ sa ra has mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi bla ma a ta ya badz+ra dang / lots+tsha ba shangs pa tshul khrims mgon kyis bsgyur ba'o// dhimaṅgālo//47—496

bsdur mchan/494 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉thog ①〈〈pe 〉〉bsgrang /④〈〈pe 〉〉kyim/495 ①〈〈pe 〉mi kun/ ②〈〈pe 〉ska'i hi khā/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉stani/496 ①〈〈pe 〉〉ni/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉brlob/ ③〈〈pe 〉ska/ du〈〈pe 〉ringasarba/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2710)47—497
5 spre ——5—— sde——chi

༄/ /dpal nag po chen po byin brlabs can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs jes bya ba/1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā kā la shri a byeṣ+ṭha wa ti sa ta na ma/ bod skad du/ dpal nag po chen po byin brlabs can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/myur mdzad mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dam pa'i chos tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i sgrub pa po chen pos mi dang mi ma yin pa gnod pa rab kyis dge ba'i bar du gcod pa byung na/ dge sbyor nyid kyi bar chad gsal ba'i phyir/dpal mgon po nag po'i sgrub thabs 'di ltar bya ste/ gnas dben pa bzang por mgon po nag po chen po'i rten rdzas dang / mchod rdzas la sogs pa phyi rten nang rten dgos pa'i yo byad bsags la maṇ+ḍal legs par byas te/ me tog tshom bu dang / mchod rdzas dang rten rnam dag bkod nas/ tsan dan ber la dar nag gdags/ rang stan bde ba la shar du phyogs par 'dug ste/ rang yi dam lha'i gzhung bzhin du 'tshams gcad pa dang / byin gyis brlab bya'i rdzas 47—501

rnams byin gyis brlab pa dang / dge sbyor yan lag bdun pa dang / tshad med pa bzhis bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag /chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgoms te/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'i ngang las rang yi dam ye shes lha'i bskyed rim gzhung bzhin bya/ de'i snyen sngags ci rigs par bzlas nas/rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas/ bgegs kyi rgyal po log 'dren bkug pa'i steng du/ paṃ yig las pad ma 'dab brgyad bsam/ de'i lte bar ram̐ ①dmar po las nyi ma'i gdan bsams te/ rang gi snying kha'i 'od zer gyis lho phyogs kyi dur khrod tsan dan kyi shing kha nas dpal ye shes kyi mgon po nag po chen po spyan drangs nas nam mkha' na tshur byon te/ gdan thog tu bzhugs par bsams la/ nges par 'byon zhing bzhugs nas bdag la byin gyis brlob por 'gyur ro/ /de la yid ma ches na rang lhag pa'i lhar bsgoms nas snying kha'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas gdan skyed pa snga ma bzhin byas/ gdan thog tu yi ge hūṃ mthing nag bsam/ de las 'od 'phros 'dus rdo rje gri gug hūṃ gis mtshan pa bsam/ de gyur pa las nag po chen po bskyed de/ khro bo'i gzugs brnyan sku mdog mthing nag 'od 'bar ba rgyud nas gsungs pa bzhin zhal gsum par sgom mo/ /dbus zhal sku mdog dang 'thun pa/ zhal g.yas dmar nag /g.yon pa ljang nag tu'o/ /sngon du mthong ba bzhin zhal gcig mthing nag tu sgom—/ gang ltar du sgom yang phyag drug pa kho na ste/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po mi mgo'i phreng ba 'grang ba/ gnyis pa na gri gug /gsum pa na ḍa ma ru 'khrol ba'o—/ /g.yon gyi dang po thod pa khrag gis bkang ba/ gnyis pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ tha ma na zhags pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra gyen du badze+es sdepa'i 47—502

steng na sangs rgyas mi skyod pa bzhugs pa/ dpral ba sin dhu ras byug dhipa/mche ba brtsigs pa/ dbu dang sku la/ sbrul dang rin po che'i brgyan gyis klubs pa—/ mi mgo khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs kyi steng du/ sbrul dang rin po che'i phreng ba'i ske rags bcings pa/dril bu g.yer khas brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis bgrad pas bgegs kyi rgyal po mgo g.yas su bstan pa mnan pa/ sku che la yan lag rags pa/ gzi brjid 'bar ba/ lha ma yin sde brgyad bran 'khor du 'dus par sgoms la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gsum gyis sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ lha dbang skur ba bya mi dgos te/byas kyang 'gal ba med do/ /rang dang mgon po gnyis ka'i thugs kha nas 'od 'phros pas lho phyogs dur khrod kyi shing tsan dan gyi sdong po gcig gi steng nas rang bzhin gyi dpal nag po chen po spyan drangs te/ nam mkha' la tshur ḍā ma ru dang /dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra dang bcas pa byon nas mdun gyi nam mkha' la bzhugs pa la / na mo ma hā kā la ya/ bo de sad ta ma hā sad ta ya/ zhes phyag btsal la/ shrī ma hā kā la dza/ zhes mdun bskyed nag po'i spyi bor dgug /ma hā kā la ya hūṃ gis dam tshig pa la ye shes pa bzhug /ma hā kā la ya baṃ gyis gnyis su med par 'dres par bsam/ ma hā kā la hoḥ zhes pas mnyes par bya'o—/ /de nas gzhung gzhan bzhin du mchod pa byas te/ khyad par du nag po chen po'i spos ni/ tsan dan dang / nyungs kar dang / sgog skya dang /sha chen dang / gu gul cha mnyam par sbyar ba'i spos dbul/ yang na tsan dan dang / nyungs kar/ bu ram̐/ gu gul/ mi khrag gis sbrus pa'i ril bu dbul lo/ /yang na gu gul mi khrag bsres la dbul lo/ /sngags ni/ tsa 47—503

la na ni pu ra dza li/ dza la ki na ri li ka pa hūṃ shaṃ /na ra wa pa/ ur dha ka hūṃ/ ka be+e ka ra/ bhi bhi na/ sha dha pa dha pi la/ dha ma ru e pa la e ka la/ ha hi lo 'i ya na/ a na dhe/ e pa na tsa lu la e sa na/ si ra ma la/ka hi na ra sa ta pa sha a sa ma thi spri/ ma hā kā la hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes (1'o/ —/ / //①de nas stod pa bya ste/ hūṃ dpal ldan mgon po nag po gzi brjid che/ /ye shes rgyas phyir dbu skra gyen du 'bar/ /dbyings na bzhugs phyir mi bskyod rgya yi btab/ /mkha' 'gro bsdud phyir sin dhu ra yis byugs/ /rigs lnga'i mchog 'dus thod phreng dbu brgyan can/ /khams gsum la gzigs spyan rtsa dmar la zlum/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir rno sdug mche ba brtsigs/ /pha rol phyin drug dag phyir phyag drug ldan/ /bdud bzhi rnams cod ②rdo rje gri gug thogs/ /sngags rnams mi ①brjed gzungs ldan thod phreng bsnams/ /gsang chos sgog phyir cang te'u drag tu 'khrol/ /nyon mongs ma spangs dag phyir thod khrag bsnams/ /dug gsum steng 'bugs mdung rtse gsum ldan 'dzin/ /gdul bya mi 'dor rtag tu zhags pa bsnams/ /'jigs pa bskyob phyir stag lpags sku smad bkris/ /bsod nams tshogs rdzogs sku mdog gzi brjid 'bar/ /'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pad ma'i gdan/ /ma rig mun sel nyi ma'i gdan stengs su/ /nyon mongs tshad sel zla ba'i gdan la gzhugs/ /gdug pa 'dul rtags bgegs rgyal log 'dren mnan—/ /chos sgu mi 'gyur thob phyir sgu mdog mthing nag 'bar/ /dgos 'dod skong phyir tsan dan steng na bzhugs/ /nag po chen po dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon gyi zhal bzhes rjes su dran mdzod la/ /bdag gis bcol ba'i 'phrin las 47—504

grub par mdzod/ /ces bstod do/ /de rjes/ sgu rim gyis gsal bar sgom/ de'i rjes la dpal nag po chen po'i thugs khar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la hūṃ yig la snying po'i sngags kyis bskor bar bsams la sngags bzlas te/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer sngags kyi yi ger 'phros pas mchod par gyur/ mgon po'i thugs kha nas 'od zer sngags kyi 'phreng ba tshur 'dus pas bdag byin kyis brlabs shing / dngos grub thob par bsams la srog gi snying po 'di bzlas/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe tra big nan bi na ya ka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ zhes gtam gyi bar ma chad par bzlas te/ de yang grangs 'bum phrag gsum mam/ bdun nam/ bcu bzlas pa'am/ yang na tsan dan gyi shing gi rtsa ru zla ba drug bzlas pa'am/ yang na mtshan rtags su sngags pa rnams dang /btsun pa dang / chu chen po skyes pa dang / grong khyer me yis tshig pa dang / bud med mang po dang / khyi nag dang / bya nag la sogs 1sogs pa rmi ba dang /gnod byed dang 'thabs nas rgyal ba la sogs pa rmi ba dang / yang dang yang du 'byung ba dang / nyams dga' zhing ting nge 'dzin gsal ba la sogs pa nyams byung byung gi bar du zhag re la thun bzhi ru byas la bsnyen pa bya'o/ /thun re'i mchod pa dang bstod pa dang / nyams pa bshags pa dang / 'dod pa bsgrub par zhu ba byas la/ ye shes kyi mgon po nag po gshegs par bya/ bskyed pa'i nag po chen po rang la bsdu/ spyod lam la sogs pa chos spyi dang 'thun pa/ de dag gis ni bsnyen pa'i bya thabs so /sgrub pa ni/ gnas dur khrod dam/ shing gcig gam/ ma mo'i khyem mam/47—bye05

chu 'gram la sogs par dgos pa'i rdzas bsags la/ dkyil 'khor zla gang gru bzhi pa bya/ thig la sogs pa gzhung bzhin gdab/ tshon bri ba ni dbus gru gsum mthing 1nag gtsang gis skor/ de'i mthar zlum po thod pa'i ra ba bya/de gnyis bar gyi zla gam gsum dmar po/ thod ra'i phyi'i gru chad bzhi ljang khu/sgo la sogs pa gzhung ci dang 'thun pa bri'o/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su dpal mgon po chen po'i gzugs brnyan dgod/ zla gam gsum la phud dang /gtor ma dang khrag gi snod dgod/ sgo bzhi la shar du 'phags ma nam gru ma/lho ru nag mo chen po gri gug thod pa can/ nub tu legs ldan nag po chen po/byang du dpal re ma ti rnams kyi rtsa ka li dgod/ mgon nag 'khor gyi rten rdzas rnams / mchod rdzas dang / las spyor gyi rdzas rnams kyang bshams la/rang stan bde ba la 'dug ste / byang chub mchog tu smon pa'i sems bskyed pas/rang gi lhag pa'i lha gsal bar byas te/ snying po ci rigs bzlas par bya/ de nas dkyil 'khor mi dmigs pa las yi ge bye smug nag tu bsam/ de nas lha'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi dang ldan pa/ rta babs bzhi yis brgyan pa bsam / nang gi dbus rim gyis mtho ba/ dbus gru gsum mthing nag /de'i phyir zla gam gru gsum dmar po/ de'i phyi ma zlum po mi mgo'i rtsig pas gtsang khang rtsigs pa/ de lcags gzer dang 'dra ba dam po lcags kyis byas pa/de rnams 'od 'bar ba'i rnam pa can sgom/ de'i dbus su gru gsum gyi thog tu pad+ma dang / bgegs kyi rgyal po rtsigs pa'i steng du hūṃ las dpal mgon po nag po sngon bzhin sgom/ sgo bzhir legs ldan nag po chen po/ lhor nag po chen po gri gug thod pa can/ de gnyis yi ge hūṃ dmar nag dang / mthing nag 77—bye06

las bskyed de/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'o/ /beng ni tsan dan gyi beng dang thod khrag bsnams pa oṃ ma hā kā la rak+ṣa du be+eri dza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ gri gug ma ni rdo rje gri gug dang /thod khrag thogs pa'o oṃshrimahā kā la hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ /shar du ru smug nag nas 'phags ma nam gru ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma phyag na ral gri dang thod khrag /sku mdog smug nag go bh+yo ma mo nag mo brnya li brnya li ku lu ku lu hūṃ bh+yo yang ro ru dud sol dang 'dra ba gcig kyang gda'/ /byang du nag po chen po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag na ral gri dang phub thogs pa oṃ karma ma hā kā la sernyi yo du dza dza hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ nag po chen po gsum dar nag gi ber gsol ba/ rin po che'i phreng ba'i sku rags dang / lha mo'i sku bstod 1zhing gi lpags pa/ sku smad re lde'i sham bu can no/ /mgon po lcam bral kun gshin gyi gdan la bzhugs pa/ mi mgo'i phreng ba'i do shal dang / sbrul gyis brgyan la sogs pa dang ldan pa/ khro tshul can gzi brjid dang 'od 'bar ba/drag shul che la mthu rtsal che ba/ 'khor nag po chen po'i tshogs dang / ma mo dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i gtso mo la sogs pa/ chos skyong ba'i lha ma yin dpag tu med pas yongs su bskor bar bsgom/ de dag gi sku gsung thugs kyi byin brlabs dang / ye shes kyi mgon po nag po chen po 'khor bcas rnams dur khrod chen po'i gnas nas spyan drangs te/ bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa dang / phyag btsal ba dang / mchod pa dang bstod pa rnams byas la/de'i rjes la bdag gi thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rdul tshon gtso bo'i thugs dam bskul/ de las 'od zer dang / sprul pa'i khro bo khro mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ lo ka'i khams kun gyi chos skyong thams cad dbang du bsdus te las la dkol rnyinas/ de dag gi sngags la 47—507

bdag gi dgra bgegs thams cad drag po mngon spyod kyis bsgral bar bsam/sha 1khrag za zhing 'thung bar bsams 2la/ mgon nag chen po 'khor bcas bod pa'i sngags dang / rbad pa'i sngags dang / dgra bgegs bsad pa'i sngags dang / gsum tshang ba 'di dag gzhan dang ma 'dres par bzlas/ o ma hā kā la ya/ sha sa na/ a pa ka ri ni/ re sham ā pastso/ ma hā ka lo yi/i tan ta rad na tra ya yā/ a pa ka ri nan/ ya ti pra tig rnyi/ sma ra se dhan du shaṃ/ sarba dus tang / sarba ta ka ya/ bha bo/ kha kha khā hi/ khā hi/mā ra ya mā ra ya/ ṣ+ṭṛt+na z-it+na/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke ni mā ra ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes smra ba gzhan kyis bar ma chod par bzlas/ thun mtshams su mchod pa dang bstod pa dang /thugs dam bsgul ba dang / ye shes pa che ste rang la stem/ dam tshig lha la sogs pa chos thams cad stong pa nyid du shes par bya zhing / sems can thams cad kyi sbug bsngal la bltas te/ snying rje dang byams pa bsgom/ de la sgrub pa'i mtshan rtags ma byung bar du bsgrub—/ mtshan rtags ni skyes pa dang bud med la sogs pas tshur phyag byed pa dang / skye 'akro mang po bdag gi 'khor du 'dug pa dang / g.yog byed pa dang / byol song 'khol ba dang / sems can ci yang rung ba bsad pa rmi ba la sogs byung byung sgrub par bya/de yang 'khor lo la rten nas sgrub pa dang / mnan bsreg sbrag 5ma la brten te sgrub pa'o/ /'khor lo la rten nas sgrub pa la gnyis/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang / drag pa'i 6'khor lo la rten pa'o/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ni/(7—bye08

nang 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ phyi gri gug rtsibs brgyad/ de'i phyi me ri 'bar bas skor ba bri/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs re re la snyen sngags dang / bsrungs cig sbrel te/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā ka la k+ṣi k+ṣe tra big nan bi na ya ka hūṃ hūṃ che ge mo la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ oṃ ma hā kā la sha sa 1na a pa hā ri sha ri re/ a pa tsi/ ma hā kā lo yo/ i dan twa/ rad na tra ya ya/ a pa ka ri nan/ ya ti pra ti dzña smra ra si tan duṣ+ṭi che ge mo la ka 2rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ 'di lan cig la ma shong na skyar gyi bri'o/ /bri/ nang gi mu khyud la sngags rings bri/ lte ba la bsrung bya'i gzugs ming rus gnas bcas pa bris la/ gur gum saṃ ghi waṃ gyis rtsa ba mnan no//rab gnas byed na/ bskyed rims la sogs pa bsgoms la/ 'khor lo mi dmigs pa las yi ge bye bsam/ de las 'khor lo bskyed/ de'i steng du paṃ las pad ma dang / ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du sngags kyi yi ge rnams bsams la/de las 'od zer 'phros pas chos skyong bkug ste/ sngags kyi yi ge la thim pas yi ge rnams dpal nag po chen por bsgom de'i thugs khar pad ma'i lte ba la nyi ma gnas par bsam/ de'i steng du sgrub sngags bsams nas/ bdag lhag pa'i lhar gsal ba'i thugs kha nas 'od zer sngags su 'phros pas/ dpal nag po chen po'i thugs khar phog /de'i thugs kha las sngags 'od byung nas zhal nas 'thon te/ bdag gi zhal nas thugs khar thim pas sdig sgrib dag cing /snyug bsngal zhi bar byed pa'i mthu skyed par bsam/ sngags brgya rtsa brgyad dam ci nus bzlas la/ mchod stod bya/ ye shes lha gshegs/ dam tshig lha zhu nas / sngags kyi yi ge'i gzugs su gyur par bsam/ me tog dkar po la rten 'byel sngags te/ gtor bas kyang / sngags nyid mgon po'i rang bzhin 47—509

yin la/ mgon nag nyid sngags kyi gzugs su bzhugs pas/ cis kyang gzhom du med pa rdo rje'i yi ger bsams la bsrung bya'i yul la gdags te/de'i lus rdo rje'i rang bzhin/ yi ge btags pas cis kyang mi tshugs par bsam/cho ga gzhan ci dang 'thun no/ /'khor lo la rten te drag po'i sgrub pa byed na/ 'khor lo gnyis byas te/gnyis ka la phyi'i ri mo zlum po bzhi rim du skor ba'i mu khyud sum rim bya/ ri mo phyi rol ma'i phyi me ris skor/ mu khyud phyi rim ma la snyen sngags la mā ra ya phaṭa btags pa dbu phyi ru bstan pa bri/ bar ma la gri gug rno nang du bstan pa ci mang du bri'o/ /nang ma la sgrub sngags dbu phyi ru bstan pa 'khor bar dgod/ri mo zlum pa nang ma'i ngos su 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad rtse nang du bstan pa bri/rtsibs brgyad la 'khor lo'i sngags brgyad bris la/ kha kha khā nyi khā hi che ge mo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ mā ra ya mā ra ya che ge mo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ 1t+na 1t+na che ge mo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ bhan+dha bhan+ta che ge mo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ha na ha na a mu shaṃ mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ da ha da ha che ge mo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ pa tsa pa tsa che ge mo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ di na me ke ni a mu ka mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa rnams so/ /dbus su sgrub bya'i gzugs ming rus dang sngags su bcas pa bri'o/ /de yang 'khor lo steng ma'i mdun na g.yas ngos na phar la 'khor bar bri'o/ /'og ma'i yi ge g.yon du 'khor bar bri/ rtsibs brgyad kyi dbu nang du bstan pa bri/ de rnams khrag chen dang dug gis byugs la 'khor lo gnyis kha sbyar te/ bar du ling ga bris la bzhug/1 /de thod par btsug la thod pa 'grub khung du bcug 17—510

la / de nas yi dam lhar bskyed/ mdun du dpal nag po chen po bskyed la dgug gzhug la sogs pa bya ste/ bsnyen sngags brgya tsam bzlas/ de'i rjes su 'khor lo stong par bsgoms la der bye la/ gnam lcags mtshon cha'i 'khor bo me 'bar bar bsgoms la/ 'khor lo'i bar gyi ling ga la ṇi 'am/ tre las sgrub bya bsams la/ rang lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcas te/ dpa' nag po chen po las sprul pa'i khro tshogs la lcags kyu dang / tho ba thogs pa mang po 'phros te/bsgral bya rang rgyud kyi gnas nas dgug par bya/ lcags kyus snying nas bzung /tho bas rgyab nas phul/ bkug nas sngar gyi sgrub bya la bzhugs1/ de nas 'khor lo skor te/ 'khor lo drag tu 'khor ba dang / dpal nag po chen po'i sprul pa dang / 'khor du bcas pas/ mtshon cha'i char du phab pas/bsgral bya lus dum bur gtubs par bsam/ sha rus dum bu dang / khrag zags pa thod pas bcus te gsol bar mdzad pa dang / sha rus lhag ma mes bsregs cing tshos pa yang thod par blangs nas gsol bar bsgom/ lhag ma thal bar yang song bar bsam/ bsnyen sngags dang las sngags sbrel la ci nus su rang res skabs su bzlas shing thun kyis brab bo/ /de ltar zhag bdun nam bcu bzhi nyi shu rtsa gcig tu sgrub par bya'o// //mnan sreg sbrag 1ma la rten te sgrub na/ 'khor lo'am/ 'khor lo med pa'i ling ga bris pa yang rung te/ rang gi mal 'og 'brub khung bcas par bcug la/ mdun du mchod rdzas dang me thab la sogs pa bshams te/ me thab tu nyin gung ngam mtshan gung la ling kha bsro zhing / yang mal 'og tu mnan 47—511

par bya/ cho ga gzhan sgrub pa ci dang 'thun no/ /de ltar zhag bdun nam/bcu bzhi'am/ nyi shu rtsa gcig bya'o/ /gtor ma la rten 1te sgrub na/ maṇ+ḍal steng du gtor snod bzhag te bye gang yan chad kyi che la gtor ma bya/ gtor ma de zur gsum pa rtsa ba zlum por byas la/ gtor mda' mde'u ni thog lcags sam/ mi bsad pa'i lcags dum bu gzugs/ ras kha tshar ma nyams pas yol ba bya/ mda' la dar nag btags la gzugs/ maṇ+ḍal steng du mchod rdzas ci 'byor pa yang bsham/ me tog tshom bu lnga dgod/ dpal nag po chen po'i rten yod na steng du gzugs/gtor ma'i nang du 'khor lo'am ling ga bzhug /de nas cho ga gzhung bzhin byas la maṇ+ḍal steng gi rten nam/ me tog tshom bu lha ru bskyed la/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥye shes pa dgug bzhug cing / dgyes par bya/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab byed na yang byas la/ mchod pa dang bstod pa bya/ de nas gtor ma stong par bsam la/ der rka las gtor snod thod pa chen por bsam/ de'i nang du gtor ma'i dngos po dang / ling ga yi ge ṇi'am tri las/ dgra'am bgegs gang 'dod par skyed la/ rang dang dpal nag po chen po'i thugs kha nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa las/ las kyi mgon po thugs kha nas khro bo dang khro mo rnams spros pas/ gnod byed kyi lus sems rang dbang med par bkug pa dang /bskyed pa de la stem pa dang / mtshon chas btubs pa la sogs pa bya zhing /thun rdeg cing sngags rings bzlas so/ /yang skul ba'i ma mo dang / mkha' 'gro lag na thod pa thogs pa mang pos sgral ba'i sha khrag thod pas bcus te/nag po chen po tshogs la rol/ rang re yang rol bar bsam mo/ /thun 'jog 17—512

tsam na mchod pa/ bstod pa/ nyams grib bshags pa dang / las la skul bar bya/ ye shes lha rten gshegs su mi gsol/ rten la bzhugs par bya/rang spyod lam dge ba dang mi 'bral bar bya'o/ /thun gzhan la 'jug rtsa na/dam tshig gi dpal nag po chen po byas la/ ye shes pa spyan drangs nas stem pa la sogs pa snga ma bzhin bya'o/ /dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i rtags byung na gtor ma btang te/ nad pa'i gdon 'dul ba yin na/ gtor ma'i phud tsam zhig bzhag la/ de nas gtor ma gnod byed phyogs su btang te/gtor ma skyel mis gos nag bgo/ med na dar nag gi 'phan lus la gzugs/gtor ma la lam phye sgo phye byas la gtor ma zor du 'phang ngo btang ngo / /de nas 'phangs nas yon tan dpag tu med pa 'byung ba las/ phan yon mdor bsdus pa drug ste/ chos skyong mnyes pa dang / tshogs stsog pa dang / dam tshig nyams pa'i dri ma 'dag pa dang / bar chad mi 'byung ba dang / dngos grub sgrub pa'i grogs su 'gro ba dang / 'phrin las sgrub pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur ba ste/don chen por 'gyur ro/ /nag po'i gtor ma'i cho ga'o/ /byis pa chung ngu'i gdon bsrung ba dang / de las 1sogs pa'i mi smyo 'bog la sogs pa'i nad gso ba dang / ser ba bsrung ba dang / gzhan kyi sbyor ngan zlog pa dang / chang nyes zho nyes bsrung ba dang / gzhan pa'i bsrung ba la sogs pa pa bya bar 'dod na 'di ltar bya ste/ dang po nad pa dang /byis pa'i gdon 'dul na/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo sgrub pa sngar ltar byas la/bsrung ba'i skye gdags/ bsrung dka' na gtor chen ltar bzung la/'brub khung bcas la/ ling kha mang du bris la bzhug /de nas mtshams 47—513

bcas 1pa grub na legs ma grub na bya ba gzhan btus la/ dpal nag po chen bo'i skyed rim bsnyen pa bzhin byas la/ bsnyen sngags dang sngags rings la thun bzhir bzlas pa bya zhing / nyungs dkar la sogs pas brab/ gri dang phur pa la sogs pa brteg /skabs su mchod gtor 2dang bskul bya 'phral gtor btang ngo / /g.yas rno bas dgra bgegs thul lo zer ram/ ma thul zer yang de dag la yid brtan du mi rung bas/ rang ngam bsrung bya'i gza' tsho la sems can bsad pa dang / tshig pa la sogs pa byung gi bar du 'phrin las ma bshol bar bya'o/ /de nas bsreg mnan yang bya'o/ /ser ba bsrung na lo chog gzhan bzhin byas la/ khro bo bcu'i sngags bzlas pa'i rdzas kyis bsrung ba skor la/ thal chen dang nyungs kar la sngags rings bzlas la sprin nag la gtor ro/ /spyor ngan phyir la bzlog la/ rang dpal chen por bsgoms la/'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa phyi ru sgom/ 'khor lo nang du phyogs skyong bcu dgyel ba'i steng du khro bo bcu bsgoms la 'khor lo bskor ro/ /zho chang bsrung na/ sngags bzlas nas nyungs kar blugs pas thub/ zho skams na nu ma la dud pas bdug /sngags bzlas pa'i 'jim pas byug /de dag la sngon du gtor ma btang ba gal che'o/ /mnan pa byed na/ gtor ma chen po bshams la/ mnan pa'i 'khor lo bri ba ni/ phyi'i mu gsum bsad pa'i 'khor lo ltar byas la/ khyad par du las kyis kha sgyur ba ni/ mā ra ya byung sar de'i tshab ma s+t+waṃ bha rgo ku ru paṃ bri/dbus su mu khyud skor la de'i phyi rol du 'khor lo rtsibs la rtse mo phyi ru bstan pa 47—514

byas la rtsibs la khro bo bcu'i sngags re bris nas de nas dgra'am bgegs gang la byas pa de la dgod/ de nas dang po dgug bzhug byas la/ 'brub khung gru gsum rang gi mal 'og tu bru/ kha khyer sor bzhi phyir skyed la/ sor gnyis spangs su rtsig /shog bu la ling ga mang du bris te/ gzugs byas pa'i snying khar bzhug /gzugs brnyan gyi ske la tha gu nag po btags la/ rang gi srin lag gis bzung dang po dang / skabs skabs su dgug bzhug mang du bya/skabs su'am zin zin tha gu shing phur la rtod/ 'brub khung du ling ga bcug la de'i kha g.yam pas bcad/ g.yam pa de'i steng du ri rab gling bzhi dang bcas pa bri/ 'og ngos su rdo rje rgya gram bris la kha bcad 1de nas gtor chen bshams la sha lngar byin gyis brlabs/ de'i steng du dam tshig sems dpa' bskyed la/ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la stem/ sngags rings brgya rtsa bzlas shing /rang gi thugs kha nas 'od byung nas kha nas 'thon/ mgon po'i thugs khar thim/lte ba nas khro bo dang khro mo 'thon/ mnan bya bkug ste ling ga la stem/ khro mo khro bo rang gi snying khar bsdu ba yang dang yang du bsam/ bzlas pa 'phro gcod na sngags rang la bsdu/ chos skyong la gtor ma dang maṇ+ḍal dbul/ 'dod pa'i don zhu ba'i gsol ba gdab/ ye shes lha gshegs/ dam tshig lha de kar bzhag /rim pa de ltar grub rtags ma byung bar du bya/ grub rtags ni/dmag grangs pa dang / chu bo chen po skyes pa dang / gong khyer mes tshig pa dang / bdag gam gzhan gnod byed la sogs pa las rgyal ba dang / sems can bsad pa la sogs pa byung na mnan pa bya ste/ gtor chen steng nas dpal mgon po steg ste/ bar snang la bzhugs pa la yang ye shes lha spyan drangs la 47—pya 15

bzhug /mchod pa bya/ gtor ma la yang byin brlabs byas la bsngo ba bya/rang gi 'og gi 'khor lo ston/ gtor ma'i khar bzhag gnod byed bkug la bstem1 / sngags rings bzlas shing / mgon po'i sprul pa'i 'khor gyis/gnod byed bsad 2de btubs pas gtor ma sha khrag gi dngos por gyur pa chos skyong 'khor bcas la btab par bya'o/ /de nas ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu'o/ /de nas mnan pa'i sa ni dge 'dun gnas pa'i them pa'i 'og gam/ mchod rten rab gnas byas pa'i 'og tu bcug la rdo rje rgya gram byas pa'i g.yam pas kha bcad la kha sas dgab/ rkang pa g.yas pas mnan de'i steng du gtor ma blugs/ des gnod byed mi 'chor ro/ /mnan pa'i las so/ /drag po'i sbyin bsreg gis btub pa'am bsad pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi rgyar khru gang ba byas la de'i steng logs kyi 'tho dang rgya mnyam pa zlum po 'phangs su khru gang pa/ zheng sor bzhi rtsig /steng du sgyed bu gzugs/ phyogs gsum du sgo re bya/ de'i nang du bud shing se ba la sogs pa tsher ma can gyis dgang /de'i steng du bye ma blug la bzhag /de'i rtsa ru yang 'brub khung logs re la khru re yod pa byas la de'i ling ga mang po bzhug /mgon po bskyed/ dgug bzhug bya ba la sogs pa sngar bzhin byas la/ mgon po'i sngags rings kha kha khā hi khā hi/ston pa mang po bzlas/ gnod byed skyed la dgug bzhug lan mang po bya/khugs pa'i yid ches pa byung nas/ phur pa dang mtshon cha bsnun/ dum bu mang du ma song bar du bsad 4par bsam par bya/ de nas ling ga'i ro la lag 17—bye16

pas mi bzung bar 'dzin byed gzhan gyis bzung la slar bzhin bsgyur ste/ phur pa'am mtshon kyis bye ma bkrug /ling ga tshig pa dang / rang gi 'og tu dong gru gsum pa byas la/ de'i nang du bye ma blug la/ g.yam pa la 'og tu rdo rje rgya gram / steng du gling bzhi dang bcas pa'i ri rab bris pa can gyi kha bcad1/de'i steng du rang bsdad la rmi lam ston cig par gsol ba gdab/ rmi lam bzang na drag po'i sbyin bsreg bya/ ngan na bzlas pa mang du byas nas 'og gi bye ma phyug la/ dge 'dun gyi them pa la sogs par mnan/ de nas sbyin sreg bya'o / /drag po'i sbyin sreg bya bar 'dod na/ maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi byas pa'i steng du / rgya dang spangs khru re tsam pa gru gsum pa rtsig /de dag nag por bya/gru gsum gyi mtha' mar me ri dmar po bri/ mdun la nye bar mchod rdzas bsham/gtor chen yang bshams la bzhag /nas bro dang / sha chen la sogs pa'i sreg rdzas yang ci mang ci bzang du bshams/ g.yas su mgon po 'khor bcas kyi gtor ma bsham/ g.yon du bgegs kyi gtor ma bsham par bya/ mgon po'i gtor ma bsham napar bya/ mgon po'i rten yod na dgod/ med na mda' bya rgod ma dang / dar nag po dang / skyes pa grir shi ba'i snying dang gsum—/ dar dang snying mda' la btags pa gzugs/ sreg rdzas mi khrag dang nyungs kar dang / btsan dug dang / thal nur rnams sbyar la/ ling ga dang sbags la sreg go/ /'khrul 'khor bcas pa yang dgug bzhug byas la mtshon kyis btub cing / oṃ ma hā kā la 1t+na rgyut+na/ oṃ ma hā kā la bhan dha bhan dha/oṃ ma hā kā la shri/ ha na ha ha/ oṃ ma hā kā la ya dha ra ya dha ra ya/ oṃ ma hā kā la shri/ rgyu karmā ku ru tsū phaṭa/ zhes sngags rings kyi bsham du btags la 47—5/7

mu khyud la bri'o/ /sngags de bzlas par yang bya'o/ /rang gi 'khrul 'khor bsad pa dang / mthon bskyed pa dang / dgug bzhug sngar ltar bya'o/ /rang lha'i rnal 'byor nas bgegs gtor btang / mtshams gcad/ mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab/ de nas thab khung du ram̐ las me dpung bsam pa'i dbus su/ hūṃ las dam tshig mgon po bskyed/ ye shes mgon po spyan drangs/ mdun kyi nam mkha' la byon pa dang / dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ dgug bzhug cing dgyes par bya/sgu gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ mi bskyod pa dbu la sgom mo/ /de nas 'khor lo dang / ling ga dang / bsreg rdzas bsres la lha la dbul/ bsreg 1 rdzas la lag pa mi reg par dgang gzar gyi 2 blugs/ rab brgya rtsa brgyad/'bring lnga bcu rtsa bzhi/ sngags rings bzlas la dbul/ sngags kyi bsham la/oṃ ag ne+e ye de wa te dz+wa la re/ zhes btags la bzlas so/ /de'i dus su/gsal ba rnams gsum gal che ste/ rang yi dam gsal ba/ bsreg rdzas gnod byed du gsal ba/ me chos skyong du gsal ba'o/ /rdzas ma zad par shing zad na/ shing gzhan gyis gsos la bya/ rdzas zad pa dang / ye shes lha phye la rang la bzhug /dam tshig lha rang la btus la sgyed bu gsum gzugs/de'i steng du gla nga btsugs la mar khu blugs/ de'i 'og tu me sbar la mar khu khol ba dang / ram̐ las me dpung bskyed la/ reg bya tsha ba dus mtha'i me lta bu bsam zhing / sreg rdzas rnams gnod byed du bsams la/ bsreg cing nyungs kar dang / lcags che dang / dug phye gsum gyis brab/ ji srid mar khu ma skams bar du gnod byed bkug cing brabs la/ mar khu zad pa dang gla nga'i nang gi rdzas ma tshig pa dang / sol ba rnams bsdus nas de'i steng du gla nga kha 47—518

sbub pa'i steng du gtor chen bzhag la/ mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa la gtor chen dbul/ 'dod don zhu ba'i gsol ba gdab1/ gtor ma rnga la sogs pa'i sgra dang bcas pas gtang 2 ngo / /mgon po rang bzhin kyi gnas su gshegs / 'khor gyi gtor ma btang ngo / /gtor chen gyi gtor ma btang zin pa dang / gla nga kha sbyar ba dbye/ sol ba de sa yis kha mnan/ nang par chags la chu la gdab/ yang na rlung la phyar btang / sbyin bsreg lag len no// sbi //dpal nag po chen po 'di/ nag po gzhan gang bas kyang byin brlabs myur la che bas/ sgrub pa po bkra shis la bsams pa 'grub/ spyir sngags thams cad nas rdo rje slob dpon la dus rtag tu bsnyen bskur bya ba la sogs pa'i dam tshig bsrung dgos pa rnams/ 'di sgrub pa pos kyang bsrung zhing / sgrub pa byas na/ thun mongs dang mchog gi dngos grub thob bo /dpal nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ dpal bdemachog snying po sha ba ri pa chen pos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta a ta ya mimanyamardo rje badz+ra dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba phur bu shangs pa du gu lung pa 'od kyis bsgyur byung zhus te/ gtan la phab pa'o/ /dpe 'di la shin tu dam pa'i bka' rgyas btab bo/ /dpal 'byor lha mdzes lha'i dbang po dang / /'dra zhing rnam spyod ba gam mtho ba yi/ /phyag dpe dgos 'dod rin chen phreng ba 'di/ /gu ru ra bha ṭa khyung po bzang ngo/ bdag gis bzabs pa lags// //47—519
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2711)

༄༅/ /gsang ba'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/nyu༄/ phyag drug ye shes mgon po'i chos bskor las/ sha ba ri pas mdzad pa'i gsang sgrub bzhugs so// ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ gu h+ya swa dha na ma/ bod skad du/gsang ba'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbe+en par tshogs gnyis sngon 'gro bas/ /bsrung ba rdo rje chos 'byung nang / /rlung me chu sa lhun po'i steng / /rgyu las gzhal yas khang pa'i dbus/ /sna tshogs pad+ma nyi zla'i steng / /tshogs bdag pho mo 'gyel ba'i steng / /dpal ldan grags chen he ru ka /zhal gcig phyag drug 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /gri gug thod pa ḍa 2ma ru/ /thod pa rtse gsum zhags pa can/ /g.yon rkyang gar gyis rol pa'i sku/ /sbrul dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras/ /stag lpags grol ba dpa' bo'i sku/ /gsang ba ye shes ra ga'i 'od/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ /ḍa ma ru dang thod pa can/ /g.yas rkyang stabs kyis yab la 47—522

'khyud—/ /las bzhir sku dang yon tan rigs/ /gsung dang 'phrin las bdud rtsi can/ /'khor lo rin chen pad+ma dang / /sna tshogs rdo rje rab mdzes pa'i—/ /gri gug 'dzin sogs mgon po bzhi/ /rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las/ /yab 'dra'i mdog can gtso mo'i tshul/ /dkar ser dmar dang ljang khu yi/ /tshogs bdag steng du rol par bzhugs/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod 'grub//gra phyogs sgeg bdug sogs brgyad dam/ /bcu drug sna tshogs mchod sprin can/ /sgo bzhir pad nyi ro yi steng / /k+ṣe tra pā la gri thod 'dzin/ /dzi na mi tra be+eng dang thod/ /ṭā tī ra dza lcags kyu thod/ /gtum po trag shad mdung zhags 'dzin / /khyams la phyogs skyong rgyal chen te/ /bcu bzhi nang gi rim pa las /de phyir lha chen 'jigs byed dgu/ /klu dang gza' ste so gsum mo/ /de'i phyir rgyu skar nyi shu brgyad/ /gtsang rigs mgon po bdun bcu lnga/ /sna tshogs mdzes pa'i rgyan 1snakyis spras/ /phyi rol khor yug dur khrod brgyad/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan dang / /'phrin las sprul pa mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /'thing dkar ser dmar ljang ba yi/ /dam can rgya mtsho 'jigs gzugs can/ /lha sku sgrib bral 'od gzugs kyi / /dpral mgrin snying lte gsang ba'i gnas/ /oṃ dkar sku dang a dmar gsung / /hūṃ 'thing thugs sogs yon tan ser/ /ha ljang 'phrin las lnga yig ni/ /mdun rgyab nges pa'i rtags rgya'o — —/ /'phro 'du'i 'od zer mtha' yas kyis/ /ye shes spyan drangs gnyis med pa'i/ /spyi bor mi spyod la sogs lnga/ /thugs kar pad nyi zla hūṃ mthar/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe tra pā la bhig nan bi na ya ka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ k+ṣe tra pā la bheg nan t+t+waṃ phaṭa/ bud dha rad na pad+ma dang / /badz+ra karma rus bstan bzhin/ /thabs sgyur sngags dang shes 47—523

rab sgyur tshotsho/ /zhal shes rig 2'dzin rnal 'byor pa/ /sprul sgyur sngags sham ldan pa yis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar rgyas spel/ /dkon mchog dbu 'phangs bstod pa dang / /sems can phan bde 'god la sogs/ /sngags kyi 'od zer 'phreng ba can/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag sna tshogs las/ /gang dgos yid bzhin myur du 'grub/ /log lta the tshom rab spangs nas/ /dad mos rab gus brtson 'grus ldan / /bsnyen bsgrub dam tshig la gnas shing / /byang chub sems dang ldan pa de//bkra shis bde legs ldan par 'gyur/ /gsang bsgrub rim pa dam pa'o/ /sha ba ris mdzad pa rdzogs sto// //bsdur mchan/522 shestamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ 2 8〈〈pe 〉lī/523 1〈〈pe 〉〉brgyan/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉byes/ — sna〈〈pe 〉〉brgya'o/ gi〈〈pe〉〉skyod/524 )sna〈〈pe 〉thasgyur/ 〈〈〈pe 〉staregs/bsdur 'bras re'u mig— rgyud/ (2712)47wa 524

༄ga /nag po chen po'i stod pa rngam pa sgra sgogs zhes bya ba/1ga ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i bstod pa lags/ ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā ka la akhyo pa stod tra na ma/ bod skad du/ nag po chen po'i stod pa rngam pa sgra sgogs zhes bya ba/ myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ grub par gyur cig /t+t+waṃ dur khrod chen po 'jigs su rung ba'i nang / /tshang tshing 'khrigs pa tsan dan chen po'i tshal/ /skal ba me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ /bgegs chen snol ba'i gdan la rab tu bzhengs//ma hā ka la phyag drug 'jigs pa'i sku/ /sgu'i cha lugs mi zad 'bar ba las /dur khrod chas kyis rab tu brgyan pa po/ /gsung gi nga ro mi zad 'bar ba las/ /hūṃ dang phaṭa kyi sgra'i stong gsum 'gengs/ /rnam dag thugs ni mi zad 'bar ba las—/ /spros dang bral ba'i mtshan ma spyir yang ston/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sgo nas khyod la stod/ phyag drug g.yas kyi dang bo'i gri gug gis/ /nyon mongs 47—525

rtsad nas bcad nas dgra la 'phyar/ /'phreng ba 'dzin pas skye 'gro rtsis la 'debs / /ḍa ma ru'i mkha' 'gro dbang du bsdud/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /g.yon gyi dang pos thod khrag bsnams pa ni/ /dam nyams srog rtsa zhal du gsol ba po/ /mdung rtse gsum pos khams gsum dbang du bsdud/ /zhags pas dam nyams ma lus 'ching bar mdzad/ /byin brlabs dngos grub gter la skyabs su mchi/ /chos kyi sgu la 'gyur ba med brtags su/ /sgu mdog mthing nag rab tu 'bar ba la/ /khrag 'dzag lnga bcu rtsa lngas brgyan pa po/ /stag gi lpags pa sbrul gyis chun pos mdzes/ /ma hā ka la khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byi na yak+ṣa gnol ba'i gdan steng na/ /krig krig zhabs kyi dgra bgegs thal bar klog /zhal gdengs mche ba brtsigs shing rngam pa yis/ /dam nyams khong khrag 'dren cing zhal du gsol/ /spyan gsum me ltar 'bar zhing sgrad pa yis/ /khams gsum dbang du bsdud cing rtsis la 'debs/ /dbu skra 'bar ba dze+es pa'i spyi bo na/ /mi skyod rgyal po rab tu brgyan pa po/ /dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūṃ bzhengs cig bzhengs cig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs/ /bskul lo bskul lo 'gro ba'i don la bskul/ /thugs dam rgyud bskul 'phrin las gnyan po mdzod/ /ma g.yel ma g.yel dpal ldan nag po che/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge'i spyan mnga' ru/ /bstan pa srung 37bar khas blang dam bcas pa'i/ /las 'di rnams kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /skyes bu dam pa blo dang ldan pa yi/ /bstod pa 'di yis lan cig stod byas nas/ /pha ma bu tsha rnams la brtse ba bzhin/ /nag po chen pos brtag 3—tu bsrung bar mdzod/ /nag po chen po'i bstod pa rngam pa sgra sgogs zhes bya ba bram ze mchog sred kyis 47—526

༄gro/ /hūṃ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ /dpal ldan 'jigs byed nag po chen po ni/ /chos nyid mi 'gyur sku mdog mthing nag zhal/ /ye shes rgyas phyir dbu skra gyen du 'bar/ /dbyings na bzhugs phyir mi skyod rgya yi btab / /mkha' 'gro 'dul phyir sin dhu ra'i —/mtshan/ /rigs lnga'i rang bzhin thod pas dbu la brgyan/ /dus gsum mkhyen phyir spyan gsum rnam par gzigs/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir mche ba rnam par rtsigs/ /pha rol phyin drug dag phyir phyag drug pa/ /klu rgyal dbang du bsdud phyir sbrul gyis brgyan/ /nyon mongs ma lus rtsad nas gcod pa'i phyir/ /g.yas pa'i dang po gri gug thugs khar 'dzin/ /sems can thams cad mi brjed 'dren pa'i phyir/ /bar pa thod skam 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'dzin/ /chos rnams thams cad stong par sgrogs pa'i phyir/ /tha ma shes rab ḍa ma ru yi sgra/ /rnam par rtog pa rtsad nas spangs pa'i phyir/ /g.yon gyi dang po thod 47—528

khrag thugs khar 'dzin/ /dug gsum ma lus brtsad nas gcod pa'i phyir/ /bar pa kha ṭī rtse gsum phyag na bsnams/ /srid gsum gdug pa ma lus 'ching ba'i phyir/ /tha ma bdud zhags nag po bsdog cing bsnams/ /'jigs pa ma lus sbyong zhing skyob pa'i phyir/ /sku smad stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ /nyon mongs skem phyir nyi ma'i gzi brjid 'bar/ /skyon gyis ma gos pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir byi na yak+ṣa gnan1/ /dgos 'dod sgrub phyir tsan dan dkyil na bzhugs/ /dpal ldan nag po chen po khyod la bstod / /sngon gyi zhal bzhes rjes su dran mdzod la/ /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /mgon po'i gzhung bstod bla ma rā hu las mdzad pa'o// //47—529

༄ga /nag po chen po'i bstod pa/sna ༄4/ /hūṃ byin brlabs nag po chen po ni/ /zhal gcig phyag drug 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /sku mdog mthing nag 'bar ba la/ /dur khrod phyag rgyas sku la brgyan/ /zhal gcig mthing nag rngam pa ni/ /chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos rtags/ /phyag drug brda' dang ldan pa ni/ /pha rol phyin drug rdzogs pa'i rtags/ /zhabs gnyis bgegs chen gnan pa ni/ /bgegs rnams dran du bskol ba'i rtags/ /phyag g.yas gri gug bsnams pa ni/ /nyon mongs rtsad nas gcod pa'i rtags/ /bar pa 'phreng ba 'dren pa ni/ /sems can mi brjed 'dren pa'i rtags/ /tha ma cang te'u 'khrol ba ni/ /chos kyi sgra chen sgrogs pa'i rtags/ /g.yon pa thod pa bsnams pa ni/ /rnam par rtogs pa gcod pa'i rtags—/ /bar pa kha ṭī bsnams pa ni/ /dug gsum rtsad nas gcod pa'i rtags/ /tha ma zhags pa bsnams pa ni/ /sems can bcings pa bsgrol ba'i rtags/ /zhal 47—531

༄ga /nag po chen po'i bstod pa/sna ༄4/ /hūṃ lho phyogs rnam dag tsan dan shing gi gseb/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor chen po las/ /thugs kyis sprul pa ma hā ka la ni/ /sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag drug pa/ /stobs chen rab 'bar 'gyings pa'i cha byad can/ /khro gnyer rab 'jigs mthing nag brjid pa'i sku/ /dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum me 'od 'phro/ /shangs nas rlung 'byung 'jig rten g.yo bar byed/ /rab tu 'jigs pa'i ljags la hūṃ sgra sgrogs/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i tshems bsgrad mche ba rtsigs/ /bar nas rdo rje'i khrag gis gser chen 'be+ebs/ /rmin ma'i a tshom bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar/ /thod pa lngas brgyan mi skyod dbu brgyan can/ /drag po dbu skra kham ser gyen du 'bar/ /sgegs pa'i nyams ldan dar gyi cod pan mdzes/ /'gur gyi bum par gsang ba'i gshugs glu len/ /hūṃ dang phaṭa kyi glu sgra di ri ri/ /sku stod glang chen ko 47—533

bas brgyan pa yang / /dpal thul chen po'i gyad las khyad par 'phags/ /sku smad stag gi lpags pas dkris pa ni/ /khams gsum g.yul rgyal srid gsum zil gyis gnon/ /bdud bzhi sreg mdzad me dpung klong na 'gying / /rnam rtog spang phyir mi ro'i gdan la bzhugs/ /pha rol phyin drug rdzogs phyir phyag drug pa/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /'khor ba'i rnam rtog spang phyir mgo 'phreng can/ /ma hā ka la khrag mthung rgyal po khyod/ /gri gug rab tu 'bar bas dgra srog gcod/ /thod skam phreng bas dgra bgegs rtsis la 'debs / /ḍa ma ru sa mkha' 'gro ma tshogs bsdud/ /thod rlon rab tu 'bar bas dgra khrag gsol/ /mdung rtse gsum pos srid gsum dbang du bsdud/ /bdud zhags nag pos skye nas 'dzin par byed/ /tsan dan be+e con klad pa'i rgya srubs 'gas/ /khyod kyi sprul pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /gdug pa'i gnod sbyin 'bum gyi 'khor kyis bskor/ /k+ṣe ṭa pa la rmyesogs las la 'gyed/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams bran du 'khol/ /dkar po'i chos skyong nag po'i dpung 'joms pa'i/ /ma hā ka la lha mchog chen po la/ /bdag cag bstod dang gtor ma drag tu 'bul/ /rtse bas dgongs la bu bzhin skyab du gsol/ /bcol ba'i phrin las lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /dpal sha ba ri pas mgon po'i zhal gzigs pa'i dus su don gyi sgo nas bstod pa'o// //47—534
bsdur mchan/532 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈snar bstan dkar chag 〉〉rtor bkod/534 ①〈〈pe 〉〉 la/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2716)47wa 535

༄/ /nag po chen po phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs/ 1 ga phyag bzhi ba gtso rkyang klu sgrub lugs kyi sgrub thabs so// raḥ/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsa tubyu dza ma hā kā la sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/ nag po chen po phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs/ dpal nag po chen po phyag bzhi pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por re zhig sngags pas rang gi 'dod pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor byu bdag nyid rdzogs par byas nas/ de'i rjes su nam mkha'i phyogs su paṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma/ de'i steng du āḥyig yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i dbus su yi ge hūṃ gi sa bon yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ de'i lte bar hūṃ gi yi ge bltas la/ de'i 'od zer gyis gdod ma nas grub pa'i 'chad par 'gyur ba'i sku mdog la sogs pa can gyi nag po chen po spyan drangs la/ hūṃ gi yi ge las spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis yang dag par mchod cing /sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /yang dag par bstod nas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ 47—536

badz+ra maṇ+ḍa la muḥde nas tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom par bya'o/ /de ma thag par tha mal pa'i lus kyi dngos po med par bltas te/ chos thams cad bdag med par lhag par mos nas/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma kolhahaṃ/zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod par bya'o/ /de nas pad+mar a yig yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'o/ /zla ba de la hūṃ yig dkar po bltas nas/ de yongs su gyur pa las ral gri'o/ /de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la hūṃ gi sa bon gyis byin gyis brlab po/ /de thams cad yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ldan nag po chen po sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas na ral gri dang gri gug phyag g.yon na rtse gsum dang thod pa'o/ /thung zhing gsus pa 'phyang pa / klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ /mi'i mgo bo'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ 'jigs par mdzad pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i sbyan gsum pa/ zhal mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i gcod 1pan can/ sems dpa'i dkyil mo krung gis nyi ma la gnas pa nyid kyis rdzogs pa'i nag po chen po bsam nas/ snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig gi 'od zer gyis/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ dam tshig sems dpa' dang lhan cig ro gcig par bsam par bya ste/ yang dag par mchod cing dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes bya bas so/ /slar yang de bzhin gshegs pa spyan drangs/mā ma gī la sogs pa de rnams kyis bdud rtsis dbang bskur bar bsam par bya'o//de'i rjes su rang ye shes sems dpa'i sa bon gyi 'od zer las spros pa'i sbyan ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa dang bstod pa yang bya'o/ /de nas de la bdud rtsi lnga dang / gtor ma dang / mchod pa dbul bar bya'o/ /de la 47—3 37

༄/ /ye shes mgon po gri gug can gyi bdag bskyed bzlas pa bstod pa rjams bzhugs/1 ༄7/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal mgon po sgrub par 'dod pas/ gnas yid dang mthun par stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang la/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mi ro bkan pa cig bsam/ de'i steng du rang nyid skad cig gis dpal mgon po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa/ mche ba gcigs pa/ sbyan gsum pa/dbu skra dmar ser gyen du langs pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan pa/rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas bsgum g.yon brkyang pa/ me'i klong dkyil na bzhugs par bsam mo/ /de'i thugs kar ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ mthing nag bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas shar phyogs nas rgyal ba mi bskyod pa spyan drangs la dbu'i gtsug na 47—540

bzhugs des mgon po 'khu ldog mi 'byung ba yin gsung / yang 'od zer dmar smug 'phros pas/ gdug pa can thams cad kyi sems des bsregs par bsam / hūṃ de'i mthar/ oṃ ma hā kā la ha na ha na badz+ra na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pas g.yas skor du 'khor bar dmigs la/ bsnyen pa 'bum tsho bcu bskyal/'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ bzod par gsol/ dge ba sngo1/'bum tsho bcu gsum bskyal na steng gdon las thar ba yin gsung / dpal mgon po'i bzlas lung la brten pa'i mngon rtogs bla ma'i zhal las byon pa bzhin bris pa'o/ /rtags ni/ phyi dang nang dang mi 'grub dang / /ldog brtags 2lnga ru shes par bya/ /tshu ba shugs drag khang thog 'tsheg /glu len bya nag a tsa ra/ /dar nag thogs dang 'o dod 'bod/ /phyi'i rtags su shes par bya/ /slob dpon 'ongs nas gtam smra dang / /chos 'chad lung ston gdugs 'bul dang / / bhan+ta stan pa nang gi rtags/ /mgon po'i sku ston gri gug dang / /mkha' 'gro tshogs dang ca co 'don/ /dngos grub ster bar rmi ba dang / /stag dang seng ge 'phyong ba dang / /shel gyi mchod rten bskor ba dang / /gtor chen khyer 'phrad 'grub pa'i rtags/ /mtshon cha'i char dang a tsa ra / /'khrug rgol khro du zlog rtags so/ /jo bo rjes mdzad pa lags/yang skabs su 'di ltar byed do/ /oṃ ma hā kā la hā na hā na badz+ra ṇa bdag la srungs shig srungs ④shig hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bdag gi zhal nas mgon po'i zhal du zhugs/ mgon po'i lte ba nas byung nas bdag gi lte bar zhugs te 'khor lo 'khor ba'i tshul du phar la nyon mongs pa dang / rnam rtog 47—541

dang / nad dang / gdon la sogs pa'i gnod pa thams cad mthon zhing /tshur la byin brlabs dang dngos grub 'byung bar bsam shing / brgya'am stong ngam grub tshad bzlas/ gzhan yang / oṃ ma hā kā la ha na ha na badz+ra na bdag la gnod par byed pa'i rgyal 'gong ma ra ya dza dza hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kā la ha na ha na badz+ra na ba su puṣ+ṭi ku ru swā hā/ bdag gi 'byor pa puṣ+ṭi ku ru swā hā/ 'byor pa snga dro/ dgra bgegs 'dul na phyi dro gsung / oṃ ma hā kā la bha bo hūṃ ril rbad bu ni dza/ ma hā kā la trag shad sidhi ya ma du ti dza/ gling byin tshal/snying nal tshal/ dgra bo 'di ma ra ya dza dza/ log rtags byung na brgya rtsa tsam gsungs / sngags kyi phreng ba 'di rnams kyang jo bos mdzad/hūṃ srin po'i gzugs kyi gdug pa can/ /tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jigs byed pa'i/ /gtum po khyod la bdag bstod do/ /hūṃ 'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi/ /bstan pa srung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /nag po khyod ni yin pa ste/ /gdug pa tshar gcod 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /dbu skra kham nag gyen badze+es pas/ /steng gi lha tshogs 'jigs par byed/ /spyan bgrad ljags 'dril mche gcigs pas/ /bar kyi lha tshogs brdegs par byed/ /g.yas na gri gug bsnams pa ni/ /dgra bgegs 'dul zhing bdud mgo gcod/ /g.yon na thod pa bsnams pa ni/ /gnod sems can gyi rkang khrag gsol/ /khros nga sa zhabs gnyis brdabs pa yis//gnod sems can gyi lus la gnyed/ /gang gi dkon mchog gsum gnod dang / /bstan pa la gnod mtshams med byed/ /bdag gis bsgo ba kun khug la/ /liṅga 47—pya42

2792༄7/ /dpal nag po chen po'i bstod pa 'phreng 'dzin chos kyi nyin byed bzhugs so// 1 ༄7༅/ /bi shām+bha dza sgra srur+ya sgra ṭi ta ki ra ṇa hūṃ bī dza bhū badz+ra kā ya/༄gro/ /sna tshogs/ chu skyes nyi ma la gnas 'od zer rab 'phro'i hūṃ gi sa bon las byung rdo rje'i sku/ /rda ṭī bhi rngi dza t+pā ṭaṃ be+e kṛ ta bha ya ka rā spyo gra ro ṣa n+t+ra rā dze+e/drag po'i dbang po rnam par 'gyur zhing mche ba gcigs pa'i sku ni 'jigs pa'i gdong can gtum po'i rgyal//sa byā sa spyu a rī ṇa tra sa ya bha ya ka ram̐ ka dh+ri kā pā la dhā ram̐ /dgra rnams skrag mdzad g.yas dang g.yo na nga/'i phyag gis/ gri gug dang ni thod pa 'dzin cing 'jigs byed pa/ /ba n+de ā lbo bhā pā rda tri bhu ba na ku ma ti ni gra haṃ dha dz+re dā māṃ /g.yas/ brkyang zhabs kyi blo ngan srid gsum nges par 'dzin cing chos sbyin mdzad 'a rtag tu rab btud bgyid//nā gā spyo bhū ṣi tī ṅga tri bhu ba na bi / ṣa dā lo ka dha s+thā ṣ+ṭa dhā ram̐/'jig rten chos brgyad 'a so gas/ sa gsum dug sbyin klu brgyad rnams kyi yan 'a/ga rnams la rgyan char 'dzin/ /as+thā laṅgā ra aṅgi tri bhu ba na a pa rda dzā ti mṛ t+t+waṃ dzi dhā ram̐/ kat+t+waṃ srid pa gsu/ma gyi 'gro ba'i skye dang 'chi ba 'a/sa rgya' rus pa'i rgyan kyis dbu dang phyag zhabs spras/ /sa gsum 47—544

kā pā la na sh+ya tri ju ba na sa pa do ṣā ya su dzñā bhe dhā dze+e/ pisgo skyon gyi tshogs rnams legs par mkhyen nas gcod pa'i gri gug dang ni thod khrag nye bar bsnams/ /dmar zluḥke sha pā shaṃ ku ma ti ga ta na dh+rigyu yā dā tram̐ na mā mi/ kṛṭ+wā dz+re ser skra yi zhags pas blo gros ngan pa 'ching mdzad rgyal ba'i snod la gus pas phyag bgyi'o/ /yon tan tshogs mū ta mūdhi gu ṇa ga ṇa pa ra shaṃ shā sa na sgo pa kā re/ tsaṇ+ḍarka lo ka tā kyi pha rol son zhing bstan pa nye bar gnas mdzad sku ni char sprin lta bur gnag /phyogs bcu'i skye 'gro kun dze+e dza ga ti da sha di sha sa t+tha dha n+d+ra pra kā sh+ya / lalba brtu la ku k+ṣi la chos kyi snang ba rab tu gsal mdzad gtum zhing dmar ba'i nyi 'od can/ /mtho ris rol pa'i nor lha swa dza ga ti ba su de bā su de bā gra be+e shaṃ/ kā lā kā le dza ga rja mchog gi cha byad bzhin du lto ba byum zhing legs par rab 'phyang ba/ /blo gros bral bas dus dang dus min bi ga ma bi ma ti ta mad+ma hā kā la ban+de / hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ gardza rā bai pa ra hi log par 'khyams pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag nag po che la 'dud/ /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ sgra sgogs pas rnam par 'tshe ba'i ta ra hi tā n+d+ra ṣ+ṭa sa t+t+waṃ bha yi kṛ ta / r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ duṣ+ṭa bṛsdo pra ba tsa gdug pa'i sems can 'jigs shing gzhan la phan mdzad pa/ /hūṃ ghi r+ghaṃ zhes mi phan smra zhing sems can rtag na ra hi tā d+ma twa dzī ḍābe+e dra stuḥ/ rtsa cho cho du ṣ+ṭa mā be+e pi ba ru tu 'tshe byed gyur pa'i sdang ba'i tshogs rnams kun/ /chod chod chod cig gdug pa'i sha za khrag 'thung tshil bye ra ba shaṃ rmye.an+t+ra mā khā kṛ tīṅga/ bho bho bho sha tru kā yi dang sgyu byema'i 'phreng bas yan lag rnam brgyan pa/ /zhig zhig zhig cig dgra bo'i tshogs rnams mtha' dag gi la gi la sa ka lo haṃ na mo duṣ+ṭa da bye/ sgyi sgyi s+thā du ṣ+ṭa rā shī med cing ming nas gdug pa 'dul mdzad phyag 'tshal/ lo/ /'jigs 'jigs 'jigs mdzad lus ngag yid ku ma ti ku tu ha lo kā ya bāñtsit+ta dzī ṭaṃ / mo mo oṃ ka lpa la rnam par 'tshe ba'i blo ngan sdang ba'i dpung tshogs 'khrugs pa rnams/ /rmongs rmongs rmongs pa'i kun 47—3 45

bṛ dzñā ku ki ka ha ma na saṃ ni gra haṃ sa rba dṛ ṣ+ṭi / tsā tsā shā kṛṇ+ḍa rtogs tshogs kyi 1 nges par bcings pa/'i yid can lta ba mtha' dag gang rnams dang / /rka rka rka zhes nag ba hūṃ mu dha bi ma ti ma rgo mā ra pa k+ṣ-i bi nā sha / shaṃ shaṃ rka ngo/'i rtsa la ga blun zhing rmongs/ pa'i blo can bdud kyi phyogs rnams nyams byed pa/ /'dar 'dar 'dar byed mā ra bhū ba ma kṛ ba da ha ba tso mā ra nā shaṃ rgo mā mi/ d+mā muṇ+ḍa de bdud kyi yu la rnams tha'/ bar rlog cing 'joms par dam bcas khyod 'a/ rab tu 'dud/ /sa 'og g.yo ba'i gra rji kaṇ+ḍaṃ ju ba na ta la tsa lo u na pa ñtsa sha bā yī/ rgya gh+ra laṅgā 'ching lnga bcur gcig chad mgrin pa dang bcas mi mgo'i 'phreng rlung ba rab tu 'phyang / /srid gsum gnas ra ba s+t+waṃ tri bhu ba na ba se dze+e da rgo rtu sa twa rā shaṃ / paṃ paṃ pa'i sems can phung ngo/ ma 'u sa gzigs phyir spyan gsum kyis brgyan zhal kyi dkyil 'khor can/ /skyong skyong paṃ bhu dha — shā s+t+waṃ di na ni shi sa ta tai k+ṣe tra pā lañtsa kur+yā ta / re ram̐ skyong zhig zhing skyong khyod kyis nyin dang mtshan mo rtag tu sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong bar mdzod/ /bsrung bsrung re dha s+thā kā yo ku sha la gha ṭa dza ga drak+ṣa z-i s+t+waṃ na mā mi/ sum̐ sum̐ sum̐ bsrung zhig dge ba 'a sbyo ra 'gro ba bsru/nga zhing 'dzin mdzad chos kyi sku can khyod phyag 'tshal/ /bde bde bde kṛ byu bhā māṃ swa sha pu si la kṛ tai bhā ba nā r+bha rbi khā shaṃ / mo ga spyo
