mdzad dge ba 'a goms bde rgyas zhi dang grub pa'i dang/la mdzad yangs pa'i mchog stsol ba/ /rigs kyi bla pa sbra yā māṃ ma pi ku la gu ru pā de dza garlu pra kur+yā snye tai/ k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ ma'i 'bas sogs 'gro ba kun kyang legs par rab tu bkra shis nye bar gnas mdzad cing / 'tsho 'tsho 'tsho dh+yā ya mā māṃ su ga ta ba tsa na j-i spru r+bha ā r+ya pi tha 6 /mdzad bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab klog cing 'dzin pa'i yid can 'phags pa'i lam gnas dang / /dz+wa dz+wa dz+wa be+e sha nā māṃ pa ra hi te bi hi tai t+t+waṃ dza ga t+t+waṃ na mā mi/ no phan dang mi phan skye bo skyo nga mdzad 'bar 'bar 'bar ba'i cha lugs can khyod gus pas phyag bgyi'o/ /kye kye 47—546

satā na he ma hā kā la a ra ti bi ma tī to bha yo pa dra be+e bh+yaḥ/ mṛ tru nag po chen po dga' bral log pa'i blo can sems can rnams kyi nyer 'che'i 'jigs pa dang / /nad dang ro go pa sarge byu a ri a hi ta kṛd+mā ra karmo khru ka bh+yaḥ/ de bā yak+ṣa 'chi ba'i gnod pa phan bral dgra bo dang ni bdud kyi las la nye bar sbyor ba rnams/ /lha dang gnod sbyin gra hā byā pra ti gha ma na kṛ teḥ duṣ+ṭa nā gā r+ya ka m+meḥ/ shā rnyi pu ṣ+ṭi gza' dang klu sogs gnod byed rab tu snang ba'i las kyi yid can mtha' dag kyang / /khyod kyis dus dang tsa rashā sha ra da sha di shi nai t+t+waṃ ku rū sa t+tha kā lam̐ / bud+dhā ṭ+wāṃ dhan+d+ra phyogs bcu kun tu zhi zhing rgyas dang bsrung dang skyabs pa nyid du rab mdzod cig /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam pā lo sta ba pa da ra tsi tai bīr+ya ut+pā ha tsi bye / dhā s+thā di t+ya chos skyong la nye bar bstod pa'i tshig gang bkod pa'i spro ba brtson 'grus mchog /sems can thams cad la na tsi tram̐ pa ra hi ta ma lkun sā sarba satwe tu pāñtsa/ ya h+phu bye te na la ni phan pa'i yid can chos kyi nyin byed zhes byas gzhan la phan pa'i blos/ /bsod nams thob pa gang des sna dzhai bi bi dha hi ta su khaṃ dzñā na ta two ma yā tsa/ satā she ṣā tri lo ke hi ta tshogs phan dang bde ba'i rang bzhin bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi/ /smon pa'i gnas gang 'jig su kha ma hi ta two su la d+dhā sa dā sru ཿ / dī ju dza ma hā kā la rten gsum na rtag tu phan bde'i de nyid ye shes legs par thob gyur cig /nag po chen po phyag gnyis pa'i sto tram̐ sa māp+ta mi ti/ kṛ ti ri yo shrī mat+pa dhermā di t+ya sba bi ra pā dā nā mi ti/bstod pa rdzogs so/ /ces pa 'di ni gnas brtan dpal ldan dam pa chos kyi nyin byed zhabs kyi sbyar ba'o/ /de yo dharmo yi pra ba ra ma hā ya na yā yi na ma ma mā ta pi tre pūthruṅga ma sa ka la satwa sbyin par bya ba'i chos 'di rab mchog theg pa chen po'i tshul la gnas pa bdag gi pha mas gtso byas sems rā shi ra nu t+ta rā dze+e sa mya k+shi bo rnyo pha la pā p+ta ye tra /can mtha' dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi 'bras bu thob par gyur cig/ //47—547

dpal sa skya lo tsa ba shākya'i dge slong rigs sngags 'chang 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ me mkha' rgya mtsho lo dag pa'i gzhir bzhag nas lo drug cu bskor brgyad dang nyag ma nyi shu bsre ba kun 'dul ces bya ba me mo phag gi lo nag lkuzla ba'i tshes gcig gi nyin/mkhan chen chos kyi rje bsod nams lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i bkas gnang ba bzhin/ dpal sa skya bzhi thog tu dag par bsgyur ba'o/ /rgya skad ma dag pas da dung cung zad dpyad par bya rgyu yod do// //17—548

2793༄khya/ /srog bdud nag po'i dbang bsdus pa rin po che rgyas pa zhes bya ba/1 to mgon po trak+kad kyi dbang bzhugs so// ༄7/ /dpal khrag 'thung rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nag po chen po'i dbang bsdus pa'i lag len byed par 'dod pas/ khang pa phyag dar legs par byas la mchod pa lnga bsham gtor ma ni/dang po yi dam dang nag po chen po ye shes pa la bsngo/ gnyis pa dpal can srog bdud 'khor bcas la/ gsum pa chos skyong spyi la/ bzhi pa dkar gtor cig /rigs drug na gnas pa rnams la bsngo/ ka pā la gcig tu chang la bdud rtsi/ a mṛ ta sbyar la bzhag /tshil chen gyi mar me/ sha chen gyi spos dud/ gu gul kyi dud pa/ spyan gzigs sna tshogs/ tshogs mchod sna tshogs mdun du bzhag pa ni/rdzas bsham pa'o/ /de nas rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sa bon las 'od 'phros/dpal nag po chen po yab yum lha mo brgyad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs te/ mgon 47—550

po'i shar du pu tra mo/ lhor ka ri ma/ nub du re'u tri ma/ byang du las byed ma/nub byang rtsa u tri/ byang shar pe ta li'o/ /sprul pa mon pho bdun/ mon mo bdun/yang sprul khyi mo drug /lho phyogs gshin rje brgyad/ byang gnod sbyin brgyad/ bdud dang srin po la sogs pa rang rang gi kha dog dang 'thun pa/ gdan pad nyi dang /srin po/ 'byung po/ ro langs la sogs pa'i steng du/ zhabs brkyang bsgum gar gyi tshul du bskyed/ mchod gtor phul la mnyes par bsam/ de nas bdag gi slob ma 'di rnams la mgon pos dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba lan gsum gdab/ de nas rigs drug dang / gnyug mar gnas pa'i gtor ma 'byung gtor bzhin dbul/ yi dam dang ye shes pa la gtor ma dbul/ nag po chen po srog bdud 'khor bcas la/ 'di rang gi byin rlabs rgyas bsdus gang rung gis phul / bstod bskul bya/ 'phrin las gzhol lo/ /mgon po be+e 1gtor ma dbang gi don du bzhag /chos skyong spyi'i gtor ma btang / yig brgya grub tshad gcig bzlas / de nas slob dpon gyis yi dam gyi snying po dang / oṃ ma hā kā la hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ sarba bud dha dha kri ni sha ri hūṃ dzaḥces pa stong phrag gcig bzlas so/ /de nas slob mas bla ma la phyag dang yon dang maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rje btsun rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtso/ /bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi/ /dri ma ma lus dag bya'i phyir/ /ma smin smin pa'i dbang rnams brtsol/ /zhes gsol ba lan gsum gdab bla mas gnang ba bya ste/ nga ni sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo yin/ /nga ni khrag thung 3kun gyi rje/ /nga ni rdo rje 'dzin rgyal gtso/ /khyed la nga'i mthu sbyin zhing / /byin gyis brlab cing dbang bsgur ro/ /ces ngas dbang spyin gyis bsgrubs cig gsung bar bsam mo/ /de nas skyabs 'gro sems 47—551

bskyed dbog ste/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ste/ /bla med dkon mchog gsum po dang / /bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dang / /bde gshegs rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /ces lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub du ni nges mdzad cing / /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa bdag gis sems bskyed do/ /tshad med pa bzhi'i don sgom/ de nas thod pa bdud rtsi dang bcas pa slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/dpon slob gnyis kas mdun gyi nam mkha' la/ srog bdud yab yum la lha mo bdun dang / sprul pa mon mo bdun/ yang sprul khyi mo drug /sbas pa'i 'khor gyis bskor bar bsams la gsol ba gsum gdab/ 'di skad brjod/dus gsum sangs rgyas spyan lam du/ /mos gus dad pas 'dud pa la/ /sku'i rang bzhin byin 1par byed/ /'gyur med nag pos dbang bskur zhing / /ngar 'joms byed pa dug 'dra ba'i/ /zil gnon seng ge lpags pa'i gos/ /mi 'gyur g.yung drung mun pa'i gos/ /gsod byed drag po dbang gi gos/ /mgon po'i gos kyis dbang bskur ro/ /ces mgo thog du bzhag /yang gong gi gsol ba lan gsum gdab/ gsung gi dbang bzhi ngag la bskur ro/ /gzhad pa ha ha gad mo'i dbang / /khros pa dza la phaṭa kyi dbang / /zhi mdzad swā hā spyor ba'i dbang / /basbud pa hūṃ mdzad dze gi dbang / bshugs pa'i bod pa bhan+dha'i dbang / /bod rbad rnam bzhis dbang bskur ro/ /yang lan gsum gdab/ thugs kyi dbang bzhi sems la bskur/ /nyon mongs zil gnon bdag sked dbang / /sdug bsngal gdung 'dren snying rje'i dbang / /sred med sbyor ba gnyis med dbang / /'bras bu rang chas 'gro don dbang / /47—552

'gro don dgongs pa'i dbang bsgur ro/ /yon tan 'phrin las nges pa'i dbang bsgur sbyin/ /rang don longs spyod rdzogs pa'i yon tan gter/ /gzhan don dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i yon tan gter/ /'bras bu 'phrin las nges par dbang bskur ro/ /zhi mdzad zhi ba'i 'phrin las dang / /rgyas mdzad rgyas pa'i 'phrin las dang / /dbang snyud dbang gi 'phrin las dang / /mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las bzhi/ /las bzhi mdzad pa'i dbang bskur ro/ /zhes brjod pas—/ rang yi dam lha dang nag po chen po'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/rang bzhin gyi gnas nas nag po 'khor bcas spyan drangs te/ bar snang gi dam tshig pa la bstem la/ dpal nag po chen po 'khor bcas kyi phyag na/rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te/ slob ma'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur te/ smin mtshams yan gang bas bum pa'i dbang thob/lus kyi dri ma dag par bsam/ mgrin pa yan chad gang bas gsang ba'i dbang thob—/ ngag gi dri ma dag /snying ga yan chad gang bas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag /lte ba nas gsang gnas yan chad gang bas dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i dri ma dag /sku gsum kyi don thob par gnyis kas bsam mo/ /dngos su slob dpon gyis sngar gyi thod pa'i bdud rtsi de mgo thog tu blugs te khrus byas 'thung du bcug pas/lus sems thams cad byang chub kyi sems kyis gang bar bsam zhing / sngags drag tu bzlas te/ sarba ta thā ga ta dzñā na badz+ra sarba badz+ra badz+ra phaṭa/ a bye ṣiñtsa saṃ t+t+waṃ—/ oṃ āḥhūṃ tram̐ tweḥswā hā/ sarba ta thā ga ta dzñā na badz+ra sarba budhe badz+ra phaṭa/a bhi ṣiñtsa saṃ hūṃ/ oṃ s+dzahūṃ tram̐ twe swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dzñā na badz+ra sarba rad+ngha 47—553

badz+ra phaṭa/ a bhi ṣiñtsa rma hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ tram̐ s+thāḥswā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dzñā na badz+ra sarba pad+ma badz+ra phaṭa a bye ṣiñtsa saṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ tram̐ byāḥswā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dzñā na badz+ra sarba karma badz+ra phaṭa/ a bhi ṣiñtsa saṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ tram̐ dīḥswā hā/sarba ta thā ga ta dzñā na badz+ra sarba pa paṃ shak+ṣiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ a bhi ṣiñtsa me hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ tram̐ dīḥswā hā/ sarba ta thā ga ta dzñā na badz+ra sarba puṣ+ṭi ku ru ye swā hā/ a bhi ṣiñtsa saṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ tram̐ dhī swā hā/ sarba ta thā ga ta dzñā na badz+ra sarba ba shaṃ ku ru swā hā/ a bye ṣiñtsa saṃ hūṃ/ o āḥhūṃ tram̐ dīḥswā hā/ sarba ta thā ga ta dzñā na badz+ra sarba mā ra ya hūṃ dzāḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa saṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ tram̐ dīḥswā hā/ sangs rgyas kun gyi 1 dbang yang bsgur/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byen gyis brlabs/ /de tshe las kyi gnyer dag gtad/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar mdzod/ /ces rjes gnang sbyin / las kyi gnyer gtad lung bstan par byas te bkra shis brjod do/ /bla ma rgyud pa'i mtshan brjod/ bden pa brdar/ de nas nag po chen po yab yum 'khor dang bcas pas/ ka pā la sha khrag gis bkang ba bzung nas/ slob ma'i mgo thog tu bzhag te/ bod rbad gsang gsum dang gtor sngags ring po di ri ri bzlos shing / khyod kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung gcig thuzer bar dpon slob gnyis kas bsams la/ dngos su gong gi gtor ma de mgo thog tu bzhag la/ srog thigs la sogs pa'i sngags dang gtor sngags ring po brjod pa tsam gyis/ lha ma srin sde brgyad bran du 'khol/ srid gsum zil gyis gnon cing nag po chen pos gzi brjid mi thub pa'i lha 'jigs byed dam yi dam gang byed cig tu dpon slob gnyis kas bsgom mo/ /'di ni mgon po'i gtor ma la brten nas 'phrin las kyi dbang bskur ba yin no/ /47—55 /

༄7/ /nag po chen po'i las tshogs/2༄/ dpal nag po chen po'i las tshogs paṇ+ḍi ta chen po 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ ༄go/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid lhag pa'i lha/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rdo rje can/ /lha mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa la/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje nag po chen po yi/ /bsnyen pa sngon du song ba yis/ /gdug pa can rnams tshar bcad pa'i/ /drag po'i 2las kyi rim pa bshad/ /gang zhig bstan pa 'jig pa dang / /bla ma la ni rgyab phyogs shing / /sems can du ma 'tshe byed pa/ /de la brtsam gyis gzhan du min/ /de la sngags pas sgrub bya bsad par 'dod na/ de'i rim pa 'di yin te/ /dang po ling ga bya ba ni/ /chu 'gram sa dang shing gcig pa/ /gog mkhar tshwa sgo can gyi sa/ /gang la dmigs pa'i bshang gci dang / /mtshan ngan thod par bsres pa las/ /sgrub bya'i gzugs ni sor brgyad pa'i/ /snying khar dug khrag (7—5kye6

dur sol rnams/ /sbyar bas bris pa'i gzugs brnyan gyi/ /snying khar sngags dang gang dmigs ming / /bskul tshig mtha' rten can bris bzhug /de nas mtshan ngan thod pa yi/ /nang bzhug mi shi'i skra yis bcing / /gru gsum dkyil 'khor steng bzhag ste/ /rang nyid lho phyogs kha bltas nas/ /lha yi rnal 'byor byas pa yis/ /snying kha'i sa bon las 'phros pa'i/ /mgon po'i tshogs ni dpag med pa/ /mdog dmar zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /lcags kyu zhags pa 'dzin pa yis/ /sgrub bya bkug nas mdun gnas par/ /bsams te kha sbyar phye ba dang / /bstem nas gnyis su med par lta/ /de nas bzlas pa brtsam pa ni/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la che ge mo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes bzlas sngags kyi yig 'bru rnams/ /rang gi kha nas 'thon pa dang / /bsam mi khyab pa'i mgon po'i tshogs/ /mdog nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /sna tshogs mtshon cha 'dzin pa yis/ /sgrub bya rnam par 'bigs pa dang / /gcod dang gtub pas phung po ni/ /til 'bru'i tshad tsam phye mar sgom/ /de ltar sgom dang bzlas pa ni/ /bdun gsum bar bya sdogs pa dang / /gzugs brnyan phyung ste gtubs pa dang / /dug gi chu la sbags pa yis/ /tsher ma can gyi shing me la/ /gsang sngags bzlas shing sreg par bya/ /des ni sgrub bya tshangs pa dang / /dbang po yin yang nges par ni/ /tshe yi 'du byed 'jig pa la/ /je tshom yod pa ma yin no/ /rdo rje nag po chen po'i las bsad pa'i man ngag rdzogs so// // ñtshagal te rnal 'byor pas bsgrub bya gnas nas bskrad par 'dod na/ de 17—557

yi rim pa 'di yin te/ /dang po 'khrul 'khor bri ba las/ /gzhi ni rlung gis phab pa yi/ /shing lo bar snang nas blangs te/ /dug khrag dur khrod sol ba rnams//mi shis thod pa'i snod du sbyar/ /rab tu ltogs pa'i sgro rtsa yis/ /'khor lo rtsibs drug lte ba dang / /bcas pa bris te rtsibs rnams la/ /sngags drug dgod bya lte dbus phaṭa/ /de mthar sgrub bya'i ming dang ni/ /uts+tsha ṭa yi spel tshig la/ /phaṭa kyi mthar brten sbyar ba bri/ /de nas mtshan ngan thod pa la/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor bris pa yi/ /nang du bzhag ste rnal 'byor pa/ /lho bltas lha yi rnal 'byor du/ /gnas pa'i mdun du nag po che/ /bskyed la ye shes dgug la sogs/ /byas te mchod pa gtor ma dang / /bstod pas mnyes par byas pa dang / /phrin las sgrub zhes gsol ba ni/ /bstan la sdang ba'i gdug pa can/ /che ge mo zhes bya ba 'di/ /bkug cing dbang du bsdu ba dang / /gnas gzhan rnams su bskrad du gsol / /zhes brjod nas ni sngags bzlas shing / /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la che ge mo dzaḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa ngag tu bzlas pa'i tshe/ /mdun na gnas pa'i mgon po las/ /sprul pa dpag med spros pa ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis mdog dmar ba//lcags kyu zhags pa 'dzin pa yis/ /snying phug mgrin pa bcings pa dang / /bkug nas bstim pa gnyis med lta/ /de nas bskrad pa'i gsang sngags ni/ /oṃ ma hā kā la che ge mo utshwa tra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzlas pa dang ting 'dzin ni/ /mdun gnas mgon po las sprul pa'i/ /khro bo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /lag na sna tshogs mtshon thogs nas/ /bsdigs mo'i phyag rgya byed pa des/ /che ge mo 'di yul gzhan du / /da lta nyid du mi 'gro na/ /rgyob sod rnam par 'bigs pa dang / /dum bur byed ces zer ba yis/ /sgrub bya rnam par brtsas lkunas su/ /rang gi gnas nas 47—558

skyod pa dang / /'og nas rlung gi dkyil 'khor dang / /khro bo'i tshogs kyi lus las kyang / /rlung gi rang bzhin 'od 'phros pas/ /bteg cing rgyab nas 'phul ba dang / /skad cig tsam yang ma thogs par/ /gnas gzhan dag tu khyer bar bsam de ltar sgom dang bzlas pa ni/ /stong phrag bdun bya rdzogs pa dang / /'khor lo rta'am rnga mo yi/ /rnga mas bcings te bya rog gi/ /mgul par bcings nas srur ba na/ /sgrub bya rang gi gnas de nas/ /gzhan du skyod par the tshom med/ /rdo rje nag po chen po'i las bskrad pa'i mngon spyod rdzogs so// //tsho7gal te rnal 'byor pas sgrub bya phan tshun dbye bar 'dod na/ dang po 'khrul 'khor bri ba ni/ /rta dang ma he'i rus pa la/ /bya rog 'ug pa'i khrag gis su / /sgrub bya gnyis kyi gzugs bris pa'i/ /snying khar sngags dang sgrub bya'i ming / /bskul tshig mtha' rten bcas pa bri/ /de nas thod pa mtshan ngan du/ /gzugs gnyis mgo 'jug snol ma ru bye / /brtsegs nas bzhag cing bya rog dang //'ug pa rta dang ma he yi/ /khrag dang 'jug ngogs phan tshun sa/ /sbyar ba'i phye ma bar du bzhug /lho phyogs kha bltas rnal 'byor pas/ /rang nyid lha'i rnal 'byor du/ /gnas pa'i snying kha'i sa bon las/ /spros pa'i sprul pas sgrub bya gnyis—/ /bkug ste rang rang gzugs la bstem/ /de nas dbye ba'i gsang sngags ni/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la che ge mo dang / che ge mo bi dre ṣā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ces bzlas te dus ting 'dzin ni/ sgrub bya phan tshun 'tshang 'dru zhing / /gcig gcig nyes pa sna tshogs brjod/ /gcig la gcig gis brdeg pa dang / /phan tshun rmas par byas pa yis/ /so sor gnas par bsam par bya/ /sgom dang 47—5pya9

bzlas pa'i rim pa des/ /stong phrag bdun du sngags bzlas te/ mthar ni gzugs brnyan gcig la gcig /grud pas phan tshun nyams byas nas/ /phye mar byas te chu bo la/ /dor bas 'byed par gdon mi za/ /rdo rje nag po chen po'i las dbye ba'i mngon spyod rdzogs sto// te //2 gal te rnal 'byor pas sgrub bya'i lus rengs par bya bar 'dod na/dang po 'khrul 'khor bri ba ni/ /dur khrod pa la yung ba dang / /dur khrod sol ba bsres pa yis/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor bris pa yis— / /steng du sgrub bya'i gzugs bris te/ /snying khar sngags ming bskul tshig dang / /mtha' rten bcas pa bri bar bya/ /yan lag bzhi dang mgo bo la/ /lam̐ yig ser po'i steng gnas pa'i/ /sum̐ yig ljang khu bri bar bya/ /lte ba'i dbus su lam ser dang / /de steng gnas pa'i sum̐ yig ljang / /la gnas hūṃ yig nag po bri/ /rang nyid lhor bltas mdun gyi char/ /'khor lo maṇ+ḍal steng bzhag nas/ /sgrub po lha yi rnal 'byor du/ /gnas pa'i snying kha'i sa bon las/ /sprul pa spros pas bsgrub bya ni/ /bkug nas gzugs la bstim pa dang / /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la hūṃ phaṭa/lam̐ che ge mo'i kā ya stam+bha ya lo/ ces pa'i gsang sngags bzlas bya zhing / /rengs byed ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pas/ /bsgrub bya dbang chen steng gnas pa'i//lus gnas lam yig yongs gyur pas/ /sprul pa'i dbang chen dkyil 'khor kyi/ /steng du sum̐ yig yongs gyur pa'i/ /ri bos rnam par mnan pa dang / /lte bar ri bo la gnas pa'i/ /hūṃ gyur pa las rgya gram gyi/ /rdo rjes rnam par mnan pa ru / /bsgoms shing stong phrag bdun bzlas na/ /sgrub bya'i lus ni rengs 47—560

'gyur bar/ /the tshom yod pa ma yin no/ /rdo rje nag po chen po'i las lus rengs par byed pa'i mngon spyod rdzogs so// —1 //rngo gal te rnal 'byor pas ngag rengs par bya bar 'dod na/ dang por 'khrul 'khor bri ba ni/ /dur khrod ras la yung ba dang / /ro sol sbyar ba'i snag tsha yis/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i/ /sgrub bya'i gzugs bris de yi lce/ /phyir la drangs pa'i —lto ba'i steng / /khebs pa'i rnam pa can bris te/ /de'i steng lo yig ser po la/ /gnas pa'i sum̐ yig ljang khu yi/ /steng du hūṃ yig nag po la/ /lo yig ser po la gnas pa'i/ /sum̐ yig ser pos bskor ba bri/ /sgrub po rang nyid lhor bltas pa'i/ /mdun du maṇ+ḍal steng bzhag ste/ /lha yi rnal 'byor la gnas pa'i/ /snying kha'i sa bon las 'phros pa'i / /sprul pa sgrub bya mdun bkug nas/ /gzugs la bstem pas gnyis med lta/ /de nas ngag rengs bya ba'i phyir/ /bzlas pa'i sngags ni 'di yin te/oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la hūṃ phaṭa/ lo che ge mo'i ngag stam+bha ya lam/ zhes bzlas sgom pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /dbang chen la gnas sgrub bya'i gzugs/ /dpag tshad brgya stong tshad tsam la/ /rang lus 'od 'phros las byung ba'i/ /khro bo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /lag na lcags kyu 'dzin pa yis/ /lce ni phyir la drangs pa dang / /dpag tshad brgya yi tshad tsam gyis/ /lto ba'i steng rnams khebs par sgom/ /de stengs lo yig yongs gyur las/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor steng gnas pa'i/ /sum̐ gyur pa las ri bo'i steng / /hūṃ gyur rdo rjes mnan pa la/ /lo gyur pa las dbang chen steng / /gnas pa'i sum̐ yig gyur pa 47—pya61

las / /grub pa'i gser gyi ri bdun gyis/ /bskor bas rnam par mnan par sgom/ /gzhan yang rang lus las sprul pa'i/ /khro bo'i tshogs ni dpag med kyis/ /sgrub bya'i lce yi steng gnas nas/ /mtshon chas dum bur byed pa dang / /de dag 'dus las bskal pa yis3/ /me bzhin tsha ba'i 'od byung nas / /bsregs par bsgoms pas stong phrag bdun/ /bzlas pas gdon mi za bar 'grub/ /rdo rje nag po chen po'i las ngag rengs par byed pa'i mngon spyod rdzogs so// 2// gal te rnal 'byor pas yid rengs par bya bar 'dod na/ dang po 'khrul 'khor bri ba ni/ /sngar bstan gzhi dang snag tsha yis/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i/ /bsgrub zibya'i gzugs ni bris pa yis/ /snying khar lam yig ser po las/ /gnas pa'i sum̐ yig ljang khu yi/ /steng du hūṃ yig mthing kha bri/ /rang nyid lho phyogs kha bltas pa'i/ /mdun du maṇ+ḍal steng bzhag ste/ 'dod pa'i lha yi rnal 'byor la/ /gnas pa'i sa bon las spros pa'i / /sprul pas bkug nas bstem pa dang / /yid rengs byed pa'i gsang sngags ni/ /mnyam par bzhag pas bzlas pa ni/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la hūṃ phaṭa/lam che ge mo tsit+ta ya stam+bha ya lam/ zhes sngags bzlas dang ting 'dzin ni/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor steng gnas pa'i/ /sgrub bya gan rkyal gnas pa yi/ /snying khar lam byung dbang chen dang / /sum byung ri bos mnan pa yis/ /steng du rdo rjes mnan pa yis/ /dran pa rnam par nyams pa dang / /brgyal ba lta bur bsgom bya zhing / /rang lus las spros khro bo'i tshogs/ /47—562

dbyug tho gtun shing tho ba dang / /rdo rje khu tshur gdengs pas kyang / /sgrub bya'i snying khar bsnun pa yis/ /dran pa nyams par byas pa de/ /ro bzhin gnas par bsgoms pa dang / /gsang sngags stong phrag bdun bzlas na/ /yid rengs par ni the tshom med/ /rdo rje nag po chen po'i las yid rengs par byed pa'i mngon spyod rdzogs so// 1 // gal te rnal 'byor pas sgrub bya srid skams par 'dod na/ dang po gzugs brnyan bya ba ni/ /sngar bstan sa sna bzhi po dang / /sgrub bya'i bshang gci bsres pa las/ /gang dmigs gzugs ni sor brgyad pa/ /byas pa'i skye gnas nang du ni/ /gro ga'am ni shing lo la/ /sna tshogs dug dang tsha ba gsum//lcags kyi snod du sbyar ba yis/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i/ /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad lte ba dang / /mu khyud ldan pa bri bya ste/ /rtsibs rnams la ni sngags bri zhing / /lte bar ming dang bskul tshig dang / /mtha' rten ram̐ yig bcas par bri/ /mu khyud la ni ram̐ yig gi/ /phreng bas bskor ba bri ba dang / /gzugs kyi nang du bcug byas nas/ /rang nyid lhor bltas 'dod pa'i lha'i/ /rnal 'byor gnas pa'i snying kha yi/ /sa bon las spros sprul pa yi/ /tshogs kyis sgrub bya bkug la bstem/ /de nas srid skems ting 'dzin dang / /sngags kyi bzlas pa bya ba ni/ /sgrub bya mdun nas 1bltas pa yi/ /skye gnas nang du nyi ma la/ /'khor lo sngags bcas bltas pa dang / /ngag tu gsang sngags bzlas pa yis/ /kha nas 'od zer 'phros pa dang / /'khor lo'i ram̐ yig sbas pa yis/ /'khor lo mgar gyi so mal gyis/ /lcags bzhin bsregs par bsgom 47—mi 63

pa dang / /sngags dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor las/ /byung 'od me bzhin tsha ba yis / /sgrub bya'i mngal skems par sgom zhing / /gsang sngags bzlas pa brtsam pa ni/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la hūṃ phaṭa/ che ge mo'i mngal sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya re / ces sngags stong phrag bdun bzlas pas/ /sgrub bya'i mngal ni skem pa dang / /srid nyams par ni byed pa la/ /the tshom yod pa ma yin no/ /rdo rje nag po chen po'i las srid skem pa'i mngon spyod sdogs so// /sna//2gal te mngon spyod de rnams kyis/ /sgrub bya rnam par skrag gyur nas/ /sdig las yongs su ldog pa dang / /sgrub pa po la gus byed na/ /slar yang zhi bar byed pa yi/ /phrin las sgrub pa pos brtsam pa/ /snga dro yi ni dus kyi char/ /gtsang ma'i ras sam dge ba yi/ /shing gi lo ma gang rung la/ /gur gum yang na gi waṃ ni/ /dngul gyi snod du 'o ma dang / /sbyar te 'o can shing snyug gis/ /rtsibs brgyad 'khor lo lte ba dang / /bcas pa bris te rtsibs la sngags/ /lte bar sgrub ming bsgul tshig dang / /mtha' rten bcas pa bri ba dang / /rang nyid shar du kha bltas pa'i/ /mdun du dngul lam dung las su/ /byas pa'i gnod ri zhe du bzhag pa dang / /rang nyid rnal 'byor zhi ba yi/ /sems dang ldan pas zhi ba'i las/ /sgrub byed gsang sngags bzlas pa ni/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la hūṃ phaṭa swā hā che ge mo shārnyi ku ru swā hā/ zhes bzlas zhi ba'i ting 'dzin ni/ /rang nyid kha nas 'od zer ni/ /kun de ltar dkar 'phros pa yis/ /mdun gnas 'khor lo'i sngags rnams la/ /phog nas de las ④shel gong ltar/ /dkar zhing zla ba ltar bsel ba'i/ /'od 'phros sgrub bya'i lus phog pas/ /zhi 47—pya64

bar byed par sgom pa dang / /gsang sngags stong phrag gsum bzlas te/ /mthar ni 'khor lo dri zhim chus/ /bkrus te sgrub bya'i lus bkrus pas/ /zhi bar byed par gdon mi za/ /rdo rje nag po chen po'i las mngon spyod slar gso bar byed pa zhi ba'i las rdzogs so// rte// nagal te bsad sogs mngon spyod kyis/ /sgrub bya rnam par skrag byas kyang / /sdig las ldog dang sgrub po la/ /slar gus par ni mi byed na/ /sngar bstan mngon spyod de dag rnams/ /mthar phyin bya phyir sbyin sreg ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yis brtsam par bya/ /tshwa sgo can nas sa blangs te/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhir byas pa yi/ /dbus su skye gnas dbyibs can kyi/ /khru gang tshad kyi thab khung bya/ /der ni gdug pa'i shing brtsigs te/ /rngon pa'i khyim nas me blangs la/ /lhor bltas lho yi rnal 'byor du/ /gnas pas thab tu pad+ma dang / /nyi ma'i gdan la ram̐ yig las/ /me lha mdog nag khro bo'i gzugs/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ /phyag na dbyig pa spyi blugs can/ /bsgoms te khrag gi yon chab dang / /til dang yungs nag las byung mar/ /dug dang ske tshe smyon pa yi/ /'bras bu mi shis skra dang gos/ /dum bur byas nas khyi phag dang / /bong bu'i rus pa lpags pa rnams/ /lag pa g.yon pas blangs pa dang / /sngags 'di brjod la dbul bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra asne ye ram̐ re che ge mo a mu kai hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa re ram̐/ de nas me+e lha mchod pa lnga/ /drag por sbyar bas mchod pa dang / /'bar chen me yi rang bzhin du/ /bltas pa'i dbus su nag po che/ /sgrub thabs nas 'byung bzhin bskyed la/ /ye shes gzhug dang 47—565

sku gsung thugs/ /byin kyis brlab pa byas pa dang / /de nas mchod pa dbul ba ni/ /dug khrag me tog gu gul nag /yungs dkar sgog skya sbyar ba'i spos / /bong bu'i chu sbyar dri chab khrag /'bru nag dang sbyar sha chen bshos/ /rang rang sngags kyi slad du ni/ /badz+ra ma hā kā la sbyar/ /sngags rnams brjod cing lag g.yon pas/ /thab tu blugs te dbul bar bya/ /de nas khrag gi yon chab sogs/ /sngar bstan pa yi rdzas rnams ni/ /gong du bstan pa'i cho ga yis/ /sngags 'di brjod cing dbul bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la hūṃ phaṭa/ces pa la ni sgrub bya'i ming / /las gang yin pa de yi ni/ /bskul tshig mtha' rten bcas brjod pas/ /thab tu nag po che la dbul/ /de nas sngar bzhin mchod pa dang / /las kyi gsol ba gdab pa ni/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun kyi bstan pa la/ /gdug pa tshar bcad bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /nag po chen po khyod kyis mngon spyod kyi/ /las 'di myur du 'grub par mdzad du gsol / /ces brjod rkang pa brgyad pa yis/ /bstod de yi ge brgya pa la/ /badz+ra mūḥzhes brjod pa yis/ /gshegs pa dang ni mi dmigs lta/ /de las slar yang me lha ni/ /sngar bstan pa de bltas pa dang / /khrag gi yon chab la sogs rnams/ /sngar gyi rim pas dbul ba dang / /mchod pa lnga yis legs mchod de/ /las kyi gsol ba gdab pa ni/ /drang srong chen po gdul dka' ba//ma rungs gdug pa 'dul ba po/ /khyod kyis bdag gi sgrub bya yi/ /las 'di myur du bsgrub tu gsol/ /ces brjod nas ni gshegs gsol la/ /badz+ra asne muḥzhes pa/ /brjod de ye shes lha gshegs la/ /dam tshig lha ni mi dmigs lta//de nas thal ba basbus pa dang / /nam mkha' lding gi gdul bya yi/ /gdon 47—566

gyis bzung ba'i thod pa ru/ /blugs te mnan pa bya ba'am/ /yang na chu bor dor ba dang / /rlung la phyar bas las kun ni/ /grub pa la ni gdon mi za/ /rdo rje nag po chen po'i mngon spyod kyi sbyin sreg rdzogs so/ /rdo rje nag po chen po'i mngon spyod kyi las nyi tshe ba/ slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub 7kyi zhal snga nas brgyud pa'i man ngag /jo bo a bha ya kā ras bkod pa/bod kyi lo tsā ba chen po sin dha ba sangs rgyas grags pas bsgyur ba'o // // kha sbyar dbye ba ni/ de la rang gi snying kha'i hūṃ las 'phros pa las byung ba'i khro bo'i tshogs spros la/ de rnams kyis de la ye shes lha'i kha sbyar yod na gtang bar gsol ba gdab pa ni/ sdig can las ngan sems can 'di/ /mnar med rgyud la gnas pa ni/ /rtse bas bdag gzhan zlog byed pas/ /khyod kyis bsrung ba btang du gsol/ /zhes dngos su rang gi blos de dag gis brjod par bsam ye shes lhas gsan nas de btang de mdun kyi —nam mkha' la byon par bsams la/snying kha nas 'phros pa'i mchod pa lngas mchod la rang gnas su gshegs/ de nas 'jig rten pa rnams khro bo'i tshogs de rnams kyi snying kha nas lcags kyus drangs te/rgyab nas mtshon cha sna tshogs pas 'debs pas dpag tshad du bskrad par bsam/gzugs gu gul gyis bdug go// 4 //47—3 67

bsdur mchan/556 ①mabyed byang 'di pe sko'ar rakar chag ltar bkod/②pe ya/557 ①pe 7byed/rdo rje nag po byed po'i las babyed pa'i mngon spyod zhes bya ba bzhugs so//558 ①pe thatses/559 ①pe 7byed/rdo rje nag po byed po'i las dbye ba'i mngon spyod zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ②pe 7ru/56 ①pe7maṅga lo/ ①pe 7byed/rdo rje nag po byed po'i las lus rengs par byed pa'i mngon spyod zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ①pe byed/561 ①pebyedaṅga lam/ ①pe 7byed/rdo rje nag po byed po'i las ngag rengs par byed pa'i mngon spyod zhes bya ba/ ①pe ra sa/562 ①pe la/②pe7maṅgā lo/ khrupe 7byed/rdo rje nag po byed po'i las yid rengs par byed pa'i mngon spyod zhes bya ba bzhugs so//rjope gis/56 ①pe 7maṅgā lo/ ④pe 7byed /rdo rje nag po byed po'i las srid byed pa'i mngon brjod zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ①pe byedanas/564 ①pe 7masgo lo/②pe sgod/ ④pe 7/ ༷pe 7dag/rdo rje nag po dang po'i las mngon spyod slar gso bar byed pa zhi ba'i las zhes bya ba bzhugs so//565 ①'ar7maṅgā lo/ ④pe 7byed/rdo rje nag po byed po'i mngon spyod kyi sreg zhes bya ba bzhugs so//567 ①pe 〉da sa/ ②pe ska/ ①pe 〉te mdun gyis/ ④pe byedamaṅga lo/47—568

2795༄rgya/ /tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i chig sgrub ces bya ba/1༄/ yum tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i sgrub thabs kyi rgya gzhung dang de'i lag len gyi yi ge zab mo'o/ /༄4/ /he ru ka dpal yab yum dang / /sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo'i tshogs/ /nag po che la phyag 'tshal nas/ /las kyi lha mo'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /thab khung tshad ldan mdog bsgyur bya/ /'thun pa'i dam rdzas tshogs par bsag /rgyu tshogs ling ga 'dzub gang te/ /rims bzhin ma nor steng du bzhag /zur gsum tshil chen me gsum 2 gsum/ /logs gsum gtor ma mchod pa bsham/ /rang nyid bde mchog 'khor lo 'am/ /yang na ye shes mgon por sgom/ /logs gsum du ni lha mo ste/ /sku mdog la sogs zhal las shes/ /de nas bzlas pa tshul bzhin bya/ /oṃ ma hā kā li de wi kṛṇ+ḍi bā oṃ a mu shaṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ sgo ṭa ya sgo ṭa ya/ khaṃ tri hūṃ phaṭa/ gsang sngags de brjod rtags 47—370

rnams 'byung / /des kyang rtags rnams ma byung na/ /drag po'i las la sbyar bya ste/ /shin tu drag po'i las byed na/ /mchod rten nag po tshad ldan dang / /sgrub bya'i ling ga tshul bzhin bya/ /rtags kyi dang ru gnyis kyang gzugs/ /thun rdzas drag por brteg 1par bya/ /oṃ kā li kā li ma hā kā li rak+ta lo dṛ rbad shrī bhak+ṣa swa ra bā lo stam+bha ya stam+bha ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ de nyid drag tu bzlas pa yis sgro las me stag 'byung ba ste/ /de tshe drag po'i las rnams ni/ /bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya/ /des kyang las byed ma 'chun na/ /dpa' bo'i nga rgyal sngags 'di bzlas//sarba sha t+t+waṃ lam thibs thibs swā hā/ sbyin sreg dag gi las la bzhug /'thun pa'i rdzas kyi btang rag btang / /mgon po'i gsang ba'i srog thig /dam nyams kyi snying 'byin/ bstan la sdang ba dgral ba'i las/ tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i chig sgrub ces bya ba sgogs so // // rong glings lo tsā ba rdo rje dbang phyug gis bsgyur ba'o// //47—571

bsdur mchan/570 1 mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang la sa blangs te bkod/ ge 〈〈pe 〉ri r+ṣamo zer raṃ ma/571 1 〈〈pe 〉〉brtegs/ 〈 〈〈pe 〉〉/ / 0 〈〈pe 〉〉〉maṅgalo/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2722)

༄/ /dbang bad+kur gyi tsho ga rin chen phreng 'dra zhes bya ba/1ga nag po chen po'i dbang bzhi bsdus pa/ gtor ma'i byin brlabs dang bcas pa 'di/ grub chen rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad par gcig tu yid ches par dka' yang yi ge rnying ma yin nges so// ༄7/ /dpal khrag 'thung rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nag po chen po'i dbang bsdus pa len par 'dod pas/ gnas khang phyag dar bya mchod pa lnga bsham/ der gtor ma gsum bya ba ni/ dang po gtor ma dbal can cig bya/ yi dam dang nag po chen po ye shes pa la bsngo/ gnyis pa dbal can cig nag po chen po bya rog gdong can la sogs pa'i phyogs skyong rnams la bsngo/ dbal med pa'i dkar gtor cig rigs drug dang gnyug mar gnas pa rnams la bsngo/ ka pā la mtshan dang ldan pa gcig tu chang dang bdud rtsi sbyar la mdun du bzhag pa ni rdzas bsham pa'o// //de nas rang lhan skyes su mos pa'i thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas/47—573

skad cig gis mdun du dpal nag po chen po yab yum lha mo brgyad kyis bskor ba can 1drangs te/ de yang / shar du bya rgod gdong can ma/ byang du khyung gi gdong can ma/ nub tu khwa'i gdong can ma/ lho ru 'ug pa'i gdong can ma/shar lhor phag gdong ma/ lho nub tu khye gdong ma/ nub byang du spyang gdong ma/byang shar du stag gdong ma'o/ /lha mo de thams cad sku mdog dmar mo/ pad nyi'i steng na zhabs brkyang bsgum du bzhugs par bsgom / de dag gi mdun du phyi nang gsang gsum gyis mchod la/ slob ma 'di rnams la dbang bsgur du gsol / ces pa'i gsol ba lan gsum du gdab bo/ /de nas rigs drug dang gnyug mar gnas pa la gtor ma 'byung gtor bzhin byin gyis brlabs la btang / de nas nag po bya rog gdong can la sogs pa'i 'khor rnams la 'di rang gi lugs kyi byin brlabs rgyas bsdus gang rung byas pas phrin las gzhol zhing gtor ma bya gcan zan gyis za bar btang / yi dam dang ye shes pa'i gtor ma de gtor dbang gi rten du bzhag go/ /de nas yi ge brgya pa grub tshad cig bsnyen pa byas pa'i rjes la/ ka pā la'i bdud rtsi la dmigs la/ oṃ tweḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba budha ḍā ki byā shwa ri hūṃ dzaḥces pa sum sbrel du bzlas pa stong phrag gcig bya'o/ /de nas slob ma des bla ma la phyag dang maṇ+ḍal dang yon phul te gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rje btsun rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtso/ /bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi/ /dri ma ma lus dag bya'i phyir/ /ma smin smin pa'i dbang rnams gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab/de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dbog pa ni/ slob dpon kyi rjes zlos byed du bcug ste/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar 17—574

du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis dge ba bgyis pa 'di dag gis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum du baj-id/de nas slob dpon 1gnyis kas mdun gyi nam mkha' la/ nag po chen po yab yum la lha mo brgyad kyis bskor ba gong ltar bsgoms la/ de rnams kyi phyag nas ye shes kyi bum pa'i chus slob ma la dbang bskur bas/ smin mtshams yan chad gang bas bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag par gnyis kas mos pa bya2/mgrin pa yan chad gang bas gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag par mos pa bya/ snying kha yan chad gang bas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/sems kyi dri ma dag par mos pa bya/ lte ba nas gsang gnas yan chad gang bas dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum ka'i dri ma dag par mos pa bya zhing /dngos su slob dpon gyis ka pā la'i bdud rtsi slob ma'i mgo na mar drugs te/khrus byed pa dang 'thung du bcug pas/ lus thams cad byang chub kyi sems kyi chus gang bar bsam zhing gong gi sngags sum sbrel la a bhe ṣiñtsa yā mi zhes brjod mthar bde mchog gi bkra shis brjod pa tsam gyis dbang bzhi rdzogs su thob pa yin / de nas nag po chen po yab yum lha mo brgyad dang bcas pas ka pā la sha khrag gi gtor mas bkang ba bzung nas/ slob ma'i mgo la bzhag ste/ rkang pa brgyad pa dang gtor sngags sgra di ri ri brjod cing / khyod kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrungs cig /ces zer bar dpon slob gnyis kas bsam zhing /dngos su slob dpon gyis/ yi dam dang nag bo chen po'i gtor ma cig tu byas pa de slob ma'i mgo la bzhag ste/ rkang pa brgyad pa dang gtor sngags lan gsum brjod pa tsam gyis snang srid kyi lha ma srin thams cad bran du 'khol ba/47—575

srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i nag po chen po gzi brjid gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i spyi bo'i gtsug na lhan skyes bzhugs pa gcig tu dpon slob gnyis kas sgom pa ni gtor ma la brten pa'i phrin las kyi dbang ngo / /de nas gtor ma bya gcan gyis za sar gtang / he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pas kha bskang / dbang bskur mkhan kyi lha rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs pa'am/ mi dmigs par bsgom1/de nas bla ma la bskor ba lan gsum byed du bzhug /phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul la/bka' drin che zhes zer du bcug la ci bder gnas par bya'o/ /de ltar dbang bzhi phrin las gtor ma'i dbang dang lngas nag po chen po'i dbang bsdus pa bskur ba'o/ /dbang bskur gyi cho ga rin chen phreng 'dra zhes bya ba/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad pa i thi 2 /

༄/ mgon po gsang ba mdzod kyi las byang bzhugs so// ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shri ma hā ka la hi si ta/ bod skad du/ dpal nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ dpal 'jigs byed phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dur khrod dang ni dben pa'i sar/ /drag po'i 2las kyi sgrub pa bya/ /dang po yi dam rdzogs par snyen/ /gtor ma'i sbyin pas rigs drug sdu/ /rgya chen mchod pa'i srid du phul/ /'dri dang klog dang sku gzugs bzhengs/ /grangs sogs khrag sngags sgo phug rtags/ /yar gyi ngo la tsam par bya/ /me dang lcags ni dar ba dang / /mtshams lon gzhan du mi smra'o/ /lho ru ltas te sgrub pa'o/ /tshogs nyid dag pas rgyu nyid sbyangs/ /'dun du tshogs bsags 'khor lo sgom/ /'khor lo gsum gyi rim pa sdu/ /zur gsum las sbyor 'dod lngas brgyan/ /dur khrod ras la khrag gis so/ /spral bar rdo rje mthu chen no/ /thugs dang 47—578

mgrin par sgrub snyen lha/ /dmar smug mdangs kyi de nyid gsol/ /mngon spyod 'grub pas rab tu gnas/ /sdom bzung gtor mar bcas te'o/ /sku dang gtor ma sba bar bya/ /phur pu phyag mtshan nye bar bzung / /mgon po bzhi la snyen pa gsum/ /rim par phye te bshad par bya/ /gang rung gcig gi kun 'grub cing / /drag po la ni gril bar bya/ /chu las skyes pas nyin mtshan sbyar / /dgra dang bgegs nyid dgyel bar bya/ /gri gug nag po hūṃ gis mtshan / /'bar ba 'od kyis sreg par bya/ /de nyid lha ru bya ba yin/ /dur khrod gnas nas de nyid 'bod/ /phur pa me 'bar nam mkhar 'char/ /be+er nag pus mo g.yas su dze+es/ /dur khrod rgyan zhing thod khrag g.yon/ /spyi bo'i gnas su mi skyod rgyan/ /cung zad zil gyis non par bya/ /hūṃ gi rang gi snying po dang / /lha'i sngags kyi de ni 1mthar/ /spro sdu zhal nas thugs su bsdus/'od kyi sprul pas las la bsgul/ /snyen pa'i rtags kyi rim pa yis/ /de nyid bdag la sdu bar bya/ /sgrub pa'i yan lag rang nyid do/ /thugs las sprul te mdun du bsam/ /dmar smug be con 'chang ba can/ /las byed phyi'i mgon po ste/ /snyen dang sgrub pa nang dang gsang / /drag po sgrub pa phyi yi'o/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yin/ /rgyun chags kyis ni phrin las sngags/ /mtshan ma gzhung bzhin byung ba dang / /rang nyid yi dam gsal bar skyed/ /mdun du las kyi mgon po bsam/ /sku gsung thugs su lha nyid dgod/ /gru gsum nang du ling ga bca'/ /sku las sprul pa'i 'khor lngas 'gug zer/ /thod rnga bdung zhing skul bar bya/ /gdug pas lha lnga dbye bar bya/ /e las gru gsum dmar nag 'bar/ /e ram̐: rdzas lnga 'tshogs pa'i ling kha la/ /spra pe sha 47—579

byedabyedaphaṭa: dam nyams dgra bo dgug par bya/ /a pe sha a: bde gshegs sprul nga/ yang sprul bcas/ /lha rnams thams cad spang mdzod cig: nyams pa 'di — bstan la sdang / /mgo ba'i lha rnams da bzur cig /rdzas la zhen na rlag par bya/ /gru gsum nang du mon pa ni/ /'khrid byed nag pos bzung bar bya/ /gnam be+e gas 'bar ba'i rdo rje 'dis/ /dmigs pa'i dam nyams ru tra 'di/ /thar par bya ba'i go me+ed do/ /sprul pa lnga'i lha lnga dbye/ /gru gsum khyud na drag po sgrogs/ /gnas pa'i lha ni gshegs par bya/ /thugs kyi mgon pos tshe mdangs bsdud/ /sgu yis nyos bcing gzir bar bya/ /gsung gis rnam shes dbyings su phang / /thugs kyi sha khrag zan du rol/ /lha mo bzhi 1phung po bzhi/ /rigs bzhi'i sangs rgyas gnas su'o/ /man ngag 'di dang mi ldan na/ /dmyal ba'i gnas dang nye bar 'gyur/ /'di nyid sngags pa ces 'dar bya/ /lho ru gru gsum nag po la/ /nang nyid dbang du khrag gis byug /gdug pa can gyi rdzas cig /dug khrag mtshon nag byug par bya/ /bzhi la thal chen 'bar ba'i snod / /nyer gcig chad kyis sgrub bya la/ /nyer gcig phul ba'i sum gnyis byug /mon nag 'bar ba'i lcags kyu can/ /kha khyer dag la dgod pa yin4/ /cha gsum gtor ma phrin las sngags/ /bdud rtsis bden pa phyogs bcur bdar/ /'bar ba'i lha nyid 'phros pa'i mdog /dmar nag bsgrang phreng tri shul can/ /kha dog rang 5nyid gdan du bya/ /ag tshom drang srong rnam pa'o/ /slob mas 'bar bar byas pa dang / /chos gos nag pos lho ru lta/ /be+egs kyi sgyed bur mi glang sngo/ /stegs bu'i steng du 'dug par bya/ /yi dam sngags dang nyungs dkar gyis/ /'bar ba'i snod 6nyid bskrad cing 17—kye80

gsad / /shan pa'i khyem nas 'bar ba'o/ /mchod lnga tshang bar g.yas g.yon no / /mon nag skyo gsum rdzas nyid 'dun/ /rgang gzar gnyis ni khyud mo la//hūṃ gis sgra yis phyogs su bskul/ /'bar ba'i lha r+ṣazer nyid drang srong che/ /'jig rten las 'das sgu bzhengs cig /mngon spyod phrin las bsgrub slad du/ /gnas 'di spyan drangs byon par 'tshal/ /spyi bo rdo rje sems dpas brgyan/ /sngags dang phyag rgya bcing bar bya/ /g.yas kyi rnam lnga de la 'bul/ /til sran rdzas ni nyer gcig te/ /'bar ba'i lha khyed mthu bo che/ /tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ /phrin las kun gyi bdag pos te/ /rig 'dzin kun gyi bsrungs ma che / /drang srong mgon la bstod par bgyi'o/ /mngon spyod phrin las sgrub slad du/ /'di nyid du ni 'bar bar mdzod/ /ag ni dza la ram̐: 'bar ba'i phyag rgya rab tu gsal / /rgang blugs gsum gyi gso bar bya/ /gzhung ni las kyi lha nyid babyad/ /phrin las bzhin du bzhugs su gsol/ /mchod pa lnga yi gtor ma dbul/ /gong bzhin sreg rdzas brgya rtsa gcig /drug cur dbul bas 'phros pa yis/ /zhal nas khrag zhag 'khyil bar bsam/ /stod pa bya zhing me glang nang / /mar nag blug pas 'bar bar bya/ /bdud rtsi ba la sres pa dang / /dug khrag gis ni ā+oṃ bya zhing / /gro kha la ni khrag gis so/ /dam nyams phung po lnga 'di nyid/ /ye shes lnga yis 'bar ba yis/ /phrin las lnga'i dbyings su sbyang / /dug lnga rtsad nas bcad par bya/ /las mgon nag po'i zhal du sbyang / /drag po'i sngags rjod thod lnga bdung / /smon lam stobs kyis snang ba sbyang / /ling kha'i las ni gong bzhin sbya/ra/ /slar yang mchod cing nyer gcig sdeg /stod bsgul rgyas gdab gshegs par bya//'bar ba'i lha yang de nyid do/ /me glang steng du dgab par bya/ /rgya ram̐ lo 4 47—bye8/

ka rten 'og /rdo rje rgya ram̐ byung ba bzhin/ /lha'i pho brang bsam par bya/ /nga nyid he'i gsung byung tshe/ /rdo rje lag tu gtad pa na/ /de tshe khyod nyid gtang 1bar bya/ /nga'i bka' byung bar du ni/ /skal pa'i bar du gnan par bya/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo sgom par bya/ /'di yis je tshom med par 'grub/ /zlum dang gru bzhi zla kham mo/ /dkar ser dmar ba'i lha dang gnas/ /tsan+dan dkar po shugs 2pa'o/ /'o ma yi ni byug par bya/ /'bras chan dngul phyed 7me tog dkar / /'o mas bsdus pa'i gtor ma'o/ /mar dang til dkar 'bras dkar ni/ /zhi ba la ni rab tu sbyar/ /thams cad khru gang zabs su phyed/ /kha khyer sor bzhi rab tu sbyar/ /'khor lo nor bu pad ma dang / /rdo rje gdengs pas rim bzhin brgyan/ /u rdu 'ba' ra 'o nam 4can/ /me tog ser po gser phye dang / /zho dang sdong ros bro chen no/ /zas kyi bye brag rgyas pa te/ /yam shing dmar po chang la sogs/ /bu ram zangs phye shing thog dmar//rab bu pad ma rag tas sbru/ /pad ma rag tas byug pa bya/ /dbang gi rdzas te kha phye yis/ /rgyas pa la ni byug pa'o/ /dug shing tsher ma can la ni/ /tshil bu yis ni byug par bya/ /dug khrag lcags phye rdo phye'o/ /mi dang ba glang khyi dang ra / /sran ma'i chan ni gsod byed do/ /khrag gis sbags pa'i gtor ma'o/ /bdud rtsi nor bu 'bar ba dang / /lcags kyu tri shul mtshon pa ni/ /phan phyir rab tu bsam pa'o/ /brgya dang brgya rtsa nyer lnga dang / /drug cu yi ni dbul bar bya/ /zhag bdun nyer gcig zla ba gsum/ /zla ba gcig nas nges par 'grub / /mkhas pas dkrugs te gnas pa 'di/ /phyes ste nyams su blang bar gyis/ /gzhan du smra ba mi bya'o/ /bud med bu chung chu la ni/ /sbal sbrul 47—382

bong bu'i khrag du sbyar/ /zhag bdun sngags kyis thod par blugs/ /spyoḥsteng 'og phyogs la mtshams brgyad na/ /dus gsum bde gshegs sprul par bcas/ /bka' bsrung chos skyong mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /dam can thams cad spang mdzod cig /mon pa nag po zor lam phye/ /lha mo bzhi yis zor sgo phye/ /zor lam dgra bo'i snying la grongs/ /sde brgyad bka'i dmag dpung skyed/ /phyogs na bzhugs pa sku zur byug /bdag ni rnal 'byor dam la gnas/ /nyams pa 'di yis snyas rtsugs na/ /mthu stobs bden pas dam du bdar/ /bcol ba'i las 'di grub par mdzod/ /chang phud phyogs bcur gtor bar bya/ /mu stegs 'bar ba'i thod pa la/ /rdzas ngan dug gis mtsho dkyil te/ /drag sngags mtshon gyi me dbal 'phro/ /dmigs pa'i rlung gis bcun pa bya/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs 'khor bcas kyi/ /sa'i lte phur bshig par bya/ /gnam gyi 'ju thag bcad par bya/ /'khor bcas rdul du rlag par gyis/ /drag sngags bzlas cing gos nag gdab/ /ral pa sprug cing thod lnga brdung / /thal chen thun dang bur pa sgril/ /tha ma'am zla ba gcig gis 'grub/ /skul bas mgon po 'khor bcas kyis/ /rdul du rlag nas 'od du 'dus zer sdus/ /yi ge gsum du bdag nyid ni/ /yi dam bsal ba'i gnas su sbu/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo sgom par bya/ /mi ldog nad kyi gdam pa 'di/ /dpe la bzhag par mi bya'o/ /phyag gnyis nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor te/ /sprul pa'i khro bo phyogs mtshams sgo/ /lan gsum du ni bdab par bya/ /phyi ru mi lta nang du lta bsu zer/ /dbyings las sprul pa'i mgon po yi/ /be+e con las sprul pa'o/ /rnal 'byor pa'i srog yin no/ /sku gsung thugs kyi mgon po ni/ /nag po'am yang na las kyi sbyar/ /47—583

rtags nyid la thob las byed pa/ /g.yang la nye ba'i mig med bzhin/ /rang lus ma smin gzhan la sems/ /sgyu ma skyes pa'i byi'u bzhin/ /dam tshig med pa'i sngags pa de/ /shing tshig thal ba'i mtshon bzhin no/ /slob dpon gsod pa'i sngags pa de//ma med dgun gyi khyi'u bzhin/ /dbang ma thob pa'i sngags pa de/ /sgra bu 'bar ba'i 'od bzhin no/ /man ngag med pa'i sngags pa de/ /tshod med chu'o rgal 'dod bzhin / /rdzas ma sogs pa'i sngags pa de/ /rgyud nyid med pa'i gzhu 1bzhin no/ /gtor tshogs med na g.yel bar 'gyur/ /skul dang gdung 2ba'i ngag med na/ /ma sring dam can g.yel bar 'gyur/ /dam tshig rdo rje snying la bzhag /yi ge gsum gyi mna' chu sbyin/ /sngon dang da lta'i dam tshig 'di/ /lha khyod 'da' bar ma byed cig /'das na dam tshig rdo rje 'dis/ /snying gi dkyil nas rlag par byed/ /de bas rnal 'byor dam tshig bsrungs/ /rnal 'byor sdang yang lha 'di bsam/ /za bshos rtag tu dbul bar bya/ /lha nyid gzhan ni rten mi bya/ /slob dpon gzhan la phyag mi bya/ /nyams pa rnams dang sra ba min/ /rtags dang nyams tshod 'das pa na/ /sngags pas 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /spyor ba dam tshig gi le'u ste dang po'o/ / //sngags pas las 'di rtson par bya/ /'byung ba bzhi'i sa bon la/ /nag po'i tshon gyis gso bar bya/ /zhing bcu bsgral ba'i rag ta 'dis/ /saṃ sa bdal ba'i sa bzhi 4'dis/ /drag po'i sgras chag chag btab/ /rin chen sna lnga raka ta dang / /kham pa nag pos bsdu bar bya/ /bang rim bzhi la dur khrod brgyan / /lcags mkhar gnam sgo gcig pa la/ /gru gsum nag pos rgyan 47—584

par bya/ /zor la shan pa'i rgyun la ni/ /bud med gtsang 1mas srad bu bya/ /zur brgyad srad bu'i gur phub la/ /nam mkha' nag pos rgyan par bya/ /bya rog nag po'i phod gtsugs 2te/ /rgyang bu nag po lnga dang ni/ /bzhi dang brgyad brgyad brgyad nyid do/ /bcu gsum rim par bya nag go/ /mda' nag ltong dmar mdung nag dang / /bdud rtsi raka ta bshos nag ni/ /lha'i sgu gsung thugs kyi rten/ /rim pa bzhin du gong bzhin sbyar/ /zur bzhi thod 'khor rgyang bu bzung / /zur bzhi gsal zhing 'bar ba la/ /zhing gi rgyal mtshan re re gzugs/ /stag gzig dom spyang khye nag dang / /mi nag mchod pa tha ma la/ /gling bzhi nyi zla rtsi ta dang / /gtor ma bdud rtsi raka ta dang / /lha dmag phyogs bzhir re re'o/ /go mtshon nyungs dkar la sogs dang / /rin chen lnga dang 'bru sna lnga/ /dar tshon lnga dang mchod lnga dang / /zas kyi bye brag dpag med kyi/ /mtha' bzhi rgyan cing rta lug dang / /ra dang g.yag sogs tshang mar bsham/ /sku 'am phyag mtshan bgod pa ni/ /dbus su gtso bo 'khor lnga dang / /dur khrod sring mo ma mos skor/ /dbang po tshangs pa khyab 'jug dang / /'dod pa'i dbang po bdag po dang / /'bring gi ri ti ka ti ka/dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa/ /dkar ser mthing kha smug po dang / /dmar po ljang khu ser dang dkar/ /zla ba pad ma 'khor lo 'dzin/ /be con phub dang pi wang dang / /shol 'da' nyi ma snam 4pa'o/ /g.yon pa thams cad phur pa 'dzin/ /bang rim dang por dgod par bya/ /lha klu gnod sbyin lto driza zer phye dang / /mi 'am ci yin lha ma yin/ /bdud dang btsan dang dri za'i lto phye zer ro tshogs/ /sku mdog sna tshogs mtshon cha snams/ /bang rim gnyis par 17—58bye

gnas pa'o/ /mtha' yas 'jog po stobs kyi rgyu/ /dung skyong rigs ldan nor rgyas dang / /pad ma chu lha sbrul bzhugs 'khyil/ /rin chen ut+pal sprin dpung dung / /rin chen gser 'phreng pad+ma dmar/ /pad dkar 'dzin cing ro stod mi—/ /g.yon pa thams cad sbrul zhags so/ /sku mdog ser dmar sngo zhing ljang / /dkar ser dmar dang dkar po'o/ /drag po'i dus su rim pa bzhin//dkar dmar nag po phros pa'i mdog /bsam kyis mi khyab 'khor dang bcas/ /phur pa ral gri rkyal pa ni/ /rim pa bzhin ni 'dzin pa yis/ /dmigs pa'i lus ngag yid gsum 'joms/ /dam can rgya mtsho ma lus pa/ /bzhi pa la ni dgod par bya/ /nam mkha' rlung bzhu rgya mtsho dang / /ma sa'i keng rus me 'bar ba/ /dkar ser dmar ljang kha dog go/ /dur khrod lcags mkhar gru gsum nang / /zhing chen nags tshal g.yang gzhi'i gur/ /rim pa bzhin du rdzogs par bya/ /phrin las gzhung srang gnas su sba/ /rgyun du sman rag gtor ma dbul/ /zor du byed na ye shes sdu/ /dang po gnas dang mchod rdzas te/ /tha ma dmag dang mtshon cha'o/ /gong bzhin zor kyi las rnams so/ /drag po la ni 'khor lnga nyid/ /srin po'i gzugs nyid rang gi 'go/ /gri gug thod khrag shin tu khros/ /mgon po stag la zhon pa skyed/ /ma hā ka la 'khor bcas kyis—/ /thugs dam snyan po skang ba ni/ /nam mkha' mthing nag g.yang gzhi'i gur/ /bya rog nag po'i phod rtsugs te/ /zhing gi rgyang bu bcu gsum gyis—/ /sku'i thugs dam skong gyur cig /ma hā ka la 'khor bcas kyis/ /thugs dam snyan po skong ba ni/ /mda' nag ldog dmar bcu gsum gyis/ /mdung nag dbol dmar bcu gsum gyis/ /gsung gi thugs dam skong gyur cig/47—586

ma hā ka la 'khor bcas kyis/ /thugs dam snyan po skang ba ni/ /bdud rtsi raka ta'i rgya mtsho dang / /bshos bu nag po bcu gsum gyis/ /thugs kyi dam tshig skong gyur cig /ma hā ka la 'khor dang bcas/ /phyi'i mdos kyi skang ba ni//nam mkha' 'thing nag phod kyi rgyan/ /rtsibs brgyad nag po'i gur gyis phug 1sgyu /rgyang bu nag po so gnyis kyis/ /sku'i dam tshig snyan po skang / /ma hā ka la 'khor dang bcas/ /nang gi mdos kyi skang ba ni/ /chos nyid mi 'gyur nam mkha' la/ /rnam thar brgyad kyi gur phub te/ /mtshan nyid so gnyis rgyang bus brgyan / /gsung gi dam tshig snyan po skang / /ma hā ka la 'khor dang bcas/ /gsang ba'i mdos kyi skang ba ni/ /nyi zla skar gsum nam mkha' la/ /zhing chen g.yang gzhi'i gur chen phub/ /zhing chen nags tshal rgyang bu yis/ /thugs kyi dam tshig snyan po skang / /mchod dang skang bshags rgyas par bya/ /stod pa dam tshig gzhung bzhin no/ /yi ge lnga'i spro sdu dang / /a li ka li'i phreng ba yis/ /rgyun gyi bshags pa mchog tu sngags/ /sbyor ba thabs kyi le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //gru bzhi zlum po pad 'dab brgyad/ /las kyi lha dang klu chen dgod/ /klu sman dkar gsum gtor ma dbul/ /ting 'dzin 'phro 'dus 'phrin las bcol—/ /zhag gsum la ni nges par 'grub/ /ma grub klu nyid gnas pa'i sar / /klu'i bzung ba'i dbang dang ni/ /skra nag gcod pa'i dbang la sogs//dbang rigs drag po sbyar byas te/ /klu las skyes pa'i nang du blugs/ /kha nyid bsdams dāl sba bar bya/ /gzugs nyid la ni thun gyis brab/ /'dis 47—bye87

'grub 'gyur je tshom med/ /gong gi rdzas nyid ling khar bca'/ /dmod zlas gnas der sbas byas na/ /klu yis 'dzin par the tshom med/ /rgyu lam g.yas su dmigs pa yi/ /khang pa'i rtsa bar sbas byas nas①/ /'gas par 'gyur bar gdon mi za/ /bdag dang mgon po'i 'phro 'du yis/ /khyab 'jug sde brgyad las la sngags/ /zhags bdun bar du sgrub pa bya/ /rgyu ba'i dus su gtor ma dbul/ /gong gi rdzas la dmod pa zlas/ /rgyu ba'i dus su dmigs pa yis/ /yul nyid klu gnyan gnyan pa'i sar/ /yul lha la sogs gzu spang bdar—/ /rdzas nyid de'i phyogs su ④su'o/ /zhag bdun bar du nges par 'grub—/ /bdag dang lha'i sprul pa yis/ /dmigs pa'i yul nyid gar bsam/ /me dang rlung gi 'khor lo bskor/ /bden pa bdar zhing sngags nyid ni/ /lan bdun zlas na chu 'khyags 'joms/ /lha 'di gzhan la bsdu ba dang / /gzhan nyid 'di la sdu bar bya/ /gcig tu mkhas pas sre ba'o/ /gcig tu 'du na spyi gtsugs te/ /gzugs kyi bshang ba'i lam du'o/ /smra ba phyi'i gtsug du'o/ /gnyis kyi snying kha me dang chu/ /rnam nyid spro bsdu'i nus pa dbye/ /rengs bkug las ni phur pa'i gzugs/ /hūṃ gnyis 'thun pa'i rdzas kyis rgyur/ /chags pa'i mdog mtshungs spro bsdus chags/ /rta dang g.yag yang mthun par 'gyur / /g.yas kyi 'og nas blangs byas te/ /sngags nyid dmod pa bdun du bzlas/ /g.yon gyi phyogs su gtor bar bya/ /lus nyid lcags kyi rdo rje te/ /cis kyang mtshungs par mi 'gyur ro/ /mtshon nag la ni lnga nyid dang / /gsum la gsum dang bzhi la bzhi/ /'dud pa'i phyogs su sngags nyid btab/ /gtor ma dbul zhing na ma gtags/ /yar gyi ngo la mchod pa bya/ /mar gyi ngo 47—588

la bzlog pa bya/ /phur pu sor bzhi mgon por skyed/ /mgul du btags na nges par 'grub/ /mtshon nag la ni sngags bzlas zhing / /de yi phyogs su gtor bar bya/ /'gro kyis mtshon la sngags bzlas te/ /khug ma nag por sbu bar bya/ /'dud pa nag pos bcing bar bya/ /lcags kyi khang par tshud par bsam / /'di yi 'ching bar the tshom med/ /ji srid ma krol bar du'o/ /so phag la ni snyen pa'i gzugs/ /khru 'am sor brgyad phyogs su bstan/ /dmigs par bya ba zhabs kyi ste/ /dur khrod sa yi snod du bsam/ /rgyun du dmigs pa'i gtor mar dbul/ /spyor ba ngan pa zlog par 'gyur/ /dbyings las sprul pa'i mgon po yis/ /nyen nyid ral gris bcad par bya/ /rdzas la bcug na sel bzlogs 'gyur/ /dug khrag gis ni byug par bya/ /gang la seng sdeng phur bu de/ /smug cing 'khums par 'gyur ba yin/ /mtshan mo rgyu ba'i gzugs rnams dang / /nags la gnas pa mi dang ni/ /sa la gnas pa 'bul ba yi/ /skyes dang khrag la gong gi gzugs/ /gri khrag gis byug phyogs su rba/ /zla ba phyed nas cho 'phrul 'ong / /gru gsum khrag gis gang ba yis / /skong po'i zor bzhi phyogs bzhir bya/ /sde brgyad byams pas srid du bcad / /yi dam lha yi rtsi ta ru/ /las kyi lha nyid dmar po te/ /kha dog dmar po ber gyon zhing / /bzed lhung dmar po zla bas brgyan/ /a nyid dkar dmar sngags kyis bskor/ /dbyangs yig gi ni dang po gnas/ /mthar gnas bzhi'i dang po la/ /dbyangs yig drug nga/sa brgyan par bya/ /gsal byed sde tshan gnyis pa yis/ /bzhi pa gnas zhing sde tshan bzhi'i/ /lnga pa bzhag pa'i yi ge ste/ /sid bye rgyu gyis mtha' nyid rten/ /sngags kyi sham 47—589

bur gdags par bya/ /phyag rgya bzhi yi bcing bar bya/ /rigs dang mthun pas rgyas btab cing / /bsrung bya dmigs dang snyen po sbyar/ /yi ge bzhi'i nus pa yis/ /da lta nyid du tshe zad yang / /lan gsum gyis ni zlog par 'gyur—/ /dar dmar brgyan pa'i mda' dar g.yab/ /thugs las sprul pa'i lha nyid spro/ /shar kyi phyogs nas skul ba ni/ /shar phyogs lha mo ka tsi ka /'jigs pa'i bud med dkar mo ni/ /sku'i sprul pa 'bum dang bcas/ /lcags kyu zhags pas tshe khug la/ /sa'i phyogs su tshe sdus cig /lha mo gsum la rigs 'dre'o/ /me chu rlung ces 'don pa sgyur/ /sku las sprul pa'i 'khor lnga yang / /sku'i sprul pa 'bum dang bcas/ /lcags kyu zhags pas tshe khug la/ /mkha'i phyogs su tshe sdus cig /gsung las skyes pa'i lha srin yang / /sku'i sprul pa 'bum dang bcas/ /lcags kyu zhags pas tshe khug la/ /rnam shes brgyad la dpal skyed cig /gong gi sngags kyis dgug par bya/ /bdud rtsi dmar po 'od zer 'phro/ /lus nyid gang ba'i mgon po yis/ /bu ga kun tu gang 'dzags sam/ /sprul pa yang ni sdu bar bya/ /mi dmigs pa ni dam pa'o/ /gtor ma dbang nyid las kyi lha/ /snying gar gong bzhin spyi bor bzhag /gong gi las kyi gzhan la'ang bskur/ /gtor ma dkar po zhi ba'i rdzas/ /nad gdon bgegs rnams zhi ba'i rten/ /zhi ba'i gtor ma'i dbang skur bas/ /zhi ba'i rig 'dzin thob par shog /gzhan gsum la rigs 'dre/ /be+e con nor bu sman rag dang / /thun bur yang na gtor mas so/ /mgon po 'chi med gdams pa 'di/ /bla ma'i zhal las blang bar bya/ /ngar mi brgya rtsas nad sel zhing / /mtheb kyu yis ni gdon grol 'gyur/ /chang bu yis ni 47—590

bgegs zhi te/ /zur gsum gtor mas bar chad sel/ /bzungs chu yi ni grib sel 'gyur/ /spral ba mgrin pa snying kha ru/ /sku gsung thugs kyi mgon po bsam/ /'od 'phros lus ngag yid gsum gyi/ /grib sogs 'dun du nag po byung / /rjas nyid la ni rim bzhin stim/ /khru gang ba'i ngar mi la /gtor ma la sogs sbyin par bya/ /sngags nyid rdzas kyi brgya rtsa byab/ /khrus nyid rol mo'ang de bzhin no/ /nad pa'i gos kyi g.yogs byas ste/ /lho 'am rgya ram lam du skyal/ /'byung po sngags kyis 'chi bdag tshim/ /me dang chu yis spyad par bya/ /'dir ni gong gi tshe mchog thusnabya/ /mgon po 'chi slu grib sel 'dir/ /bla ma'i zhal la tso7blang bar bya/ /zhal mthong rtsa ba'i man ngag yin / sbyor ba gnad kyi le'u ste gsum pa'o// //gtor ma chen po las la sbyar/ /mgon po'i phrin las gzhung srang te/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar mgon po bsam/ /maṇ+ḍal 'dom gang gru bzhi la/ /gru gsum nag pos rgyan par bya/ /'bru'i phye dang sna lnga dang / /srid pa'i ma mo khru gang bya/ /mdog nag ral pa nag po la/ /gri'i khrag gi thugs par bya /ngar mi mjeb kyu chang bu dang / /gtor ma la sogs nag po la/ /gri khrag gis byugs sha khrag gam/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du sngags kyis dbul/ /mgon po gtor ma gso zhing dbul/ /sngags pas mgon po'i sngags nyid zla/ /slob ma gnyis kyi btab par bya/ /rol mo rgyun du bya ba yin/ /bar du bdud bzlog lan bdun sbyar/ /dgra'i phyogs su gtor ma 'phang / /bzung chus phyogs su gtor bar bya/ /ma mos las kun sgrub par 'gyur/ /mgon po'i stod bskul 47—591

drag po bya/ /dbang dang gtor ma'i las rnams kun/ /las bzhin ma ni rab tu sbyar/ /las dang mthun pa'i mdo yang sgrags/ /de yis las kun 'grub par 'gyur/ /mtshan byed las kyi mgon po te/ /sprul pa re'i phyogs su'o/ /dar dmar brgyan pa 'di nyid do/ /smra ①nyid hūṃ gis dgug par bya/ /gang nyid bka' dang dran bzhin bsam/ /lha 'dre mi gsum 'du bar 'gyur/ /gong gis mkhas spyod rnam nyid bstan/ /khams gsum kun 'dus lte bar ro/ /las dag 'grub par the tshom med/ /las kyi lha las mgon po spro/ /'bar ba'i ni khams kun sreg /sa la rlung dang chu la sa/ /me la chu dang rlung la ni/ /rdo rje rgya ram̐ gnan par bsam/ /ting 'dzin sngags kyi 'phrul 'khor gyis/ /mi 'grub pa ni gang yang med/ /'phrin las kyis ni las la sbyar/ /gtor ma yis ni las kun 'grub/ /'di la the tshom mi bya'o/ /nyan pas smod byed bden pa brdar/ /rni nyid snyus na the tshom med/ /sbra ba rigs pa ling kha'i gnad—/ /bzlas pas gzhan la smra mi bya/ /gcig las spel bar mi bya'o/ /bla ma'i man ngag sngon du phyung / /'di las lhag par mi bya zhing / /khri ba yang ni mi bya'o/ /gal te 'das na lha 'di yis/ /klad pa'i rgya srubs 'gems par 'gyur/ /de bas tshul bzhin dam tshig bsrungs/ /lha 'di myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /sbyor ba yan lag gi le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //dpal mgon po chen po'i sgrub thabs gsang ba mdzod kyi las byang rdzogs so// //bla ma bram ze bde bas rang 'gyur du mdzad pa rdzogs so // //sdetshul khrims shes rab kyi ①man ngag ltar sgyur ro/ /te rtso'i dpe'o// //47—592

bsdur mchan/578 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉po/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉grar/579 ①〈〈pe 〉stan ②〈〈pe 〉torang /58༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉bzhi'i/ ②〈〈pe 〉stananod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉phur pa'i/ du〈〈pe〉staspri/ dhi〈〈pe 〉tor/ du〈〈pe 〉stananod/582 ①〈〈pe 〉〉btang / ②〈〈pe 〉〉zhug ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉phyi/ rjo〈〈pe〉〉ma/584 ①〈〈pe 〉stanazhung / ②〈〈pe 〉〉bdung / ni〈〈pe 〉〉pa/ ༷〈〈pe 〉〉gzhi/585 ①〈〈pe 〉〉rtsang / ②〈〈pe 〉〉pos phod rtsugs/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉rtso/ du〈〈pe 〉〉rnam/587 ①〈〈pe 〉〉phyab/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉bdams/588 ①〈〈pe 〉〉na/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉wasu/591 0)〈〈pe 〉〉chog 90〈〈pe 〉〉las/592 ①〈〈pe 〉starno/ ②〈〈pe 〉ska/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉kyis/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2724)47wa 593

༄ ga /dpal nag po chen po'i gsang ba'i man ngag ces bya ba/①ga dpal mgon po'i gsang mdzod bzhugs so// ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/shri na ma u pa dhe sha /ma hā ka la sa ma ya/ bod skad du/ dpal nag po chen po'i gsang ba'i man ngag ces bya ba/ dpal mthu chen thob pa phyagan rdo rje de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de'i phyaganardo rje'i sgrub pa'am yi dmagazhan gyi sgrub rdzogs/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung byed dragapo'ilas byed pa/ /de yi sngon gyilorgyus byung 'di ltar ro/ /gleng gzhi'i le'u ste dang po'o// //bdag nyid slobadaponaro langs bde ba yis/ /stan la dbab phyir sgrub pa gtsugs rin chen 'byung khungs kyi brang khang du chos kyi gnas lugs/ /deyimathongalam thob don nyid kho bos mthong / /srog bdag nag po de sngon byung chos skyong bdun/ /oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa ces so srog gi snying po de phul nas/ /spyirabastan pa stan dang sgrub pa rnal 'byor pa spyod sgrub pa spyod kyibargyud pa 47—594

yi—/ /sangs rgyas stong gi stong gi bstan pa'ang kho bos srung / /de yis yid gzhungs zhag bdun bsgrubs/ /nga nyid lharnamasasngon du the tshom med/ /sgrubapa'ilas lasadang sreg gnan sod las kyi rim pa bgyis/ /srog snying phul ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //pha nyid dga' rab dbang phyug go/ /ma nyid dur khrod be+e ta li/ /mdog nag phas byin gri gug masabyin thod pa 'dzin/ /phasabyin sde brgyad masabyin ma mo bran du 'khor—/ /de'im brjod pa tsam brjod pa tsam gyis skrag par byed/ /skul bas dgra rlag par the tshom ci byar yod/ /skye rgyud bstan pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o // //①mgon po sngon byung gi le'u rdzogs sto// ④ //༄ mgon po nag 'di man gis dbang du byas pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgrub pa'i dus gnas nyams ④dga' bsnyenapa'i dus bar chad med pa'i gnas pa dang / /lasasbyoragyi dus dur khrod gnas sogs shin tu shis/ /gtorama'i rgyu sha lnga ra sha ra'ikhrag la sogs/ /'bru'i snying po bdud rtsi shis/ /dkyil 'khor maṇ+ḍal zlum po gru gsum nag /gtorasnod bse' phor gri thod bdud rtsi'i snod rol mo thod rnga shis/ /rten dang be+e con mchog phur dang / /seng ldeng phur pa g.yab dar shis/ /gnas dang sgrub pa'i yo byad bstan pa'i le'u ste dang po'o—/ / //sngon du yi dam gyi bsnyen pa song bas gong gis yan lag sgrubs/ /mgon po cho ga bzhin mdun du skyed la srogasnying ga bcun par bya/ /rgyun tu mchod dang gtor ma bya/ /47byed595

brten pa'i dus dom dang khyi nag bya nag go/ /sapa'idus a tsa ra dang ston pa dang / /ban dhe nag po 'ong bar 'gyur/ /mdog nag ral gri thod pa 'dzin/ /sgrub pa'i dus su bdag nyid sgrub/ /mtshogs mar mthu chen job pa'o/ /yi ge badz+ra satwa lnga'i nus pa sdu/ /snying po gnyis pas bcun par bya/ /nag po phur pa thod pa 'dzin/ /snying po badz+rayak+ṣadang pos bcun par bya/ /snyen pa'i yan lag can du bshad/ /sngags kyis gtor ma dbul bar bya/ /rtags dang snyen sgrub kyi le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //bya nag sogs sku'i 'khor lnga sde brgyad gsung gidang / /thugs las sprul pa'i lha mo bzhi/ /gzhan yang bka' 'og ma 'dus med/ /nag po du ma phyogs bcur 'phro—/ /'khor bstan pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //mdun du dmararlab mgon po be+e con thogs/ /ber nag phod kha 'chang ba can—/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las kyi rim pa de la bcol/ /skul rbad gsang ba'i cho ga bya/ /sreg gnan zor gyi las rnams kyi/ /bstan pa srung bar 'di dgos so//nag po mdos bya nyams pa skang / /dag pa yis ni rgyun bshags bya/ /cig las spel bar mi bya'o/ /bsnyenabartags thon sngon du dang po shin tu ces/ /mon nag spungs pa dmar po 'byung / /las mtha'i rim pa tshul bzhin bya/ /las kyi rim pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //dang po yi dam gzhung srang la/ /las kyi mgon po 'khor bcas bskyed/ /47—596

cho ga rim pa tshul bzhin bya/ /khrus byas maṇ+ḍal phul nas ni/ /slob ma de nyid bzhugs )par bya/ /sngon 'gro skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bshags pa dag las rgyud sbyangs la//gus pa mosapabastan pos mdun na 'dug /sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes dbab/ /sngags nyid byin pas grol bar 'gyur/ /sku gsung thugs kyi stod pa bya/ /phyag na rdo rje de la bstod/ /gtor ma'ang spyi bor bzhag par bya/ /yon phul gsang bar gdams par bya/ /nga la rnag pa'i phyogs su ni/ /ming tsam smra bar mi bya'o/ /rjes su snang ba'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //gong gi las kyi lha de nyid/ /rin chen rgyan can be+e con no/ /bha su dhe ba'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /gtor ma rgyun tu btang bar bya/ /gang 'dod rdzas de rteg la dbul/ /gang 'dod gsol btab sngags nyid gdags/ /mon nag gcig rten gyi rgyal mtshan rgyun tu rten/ /lus dang grib ma ltar du grag /rgyun tu gnas su brten pa'i 'ebya/ /nor sgrub pa dang / rgyun tu rten pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o / / //bstan pa bsrung ba'i dam du bzhag /mig gi 'bras ltar gces par chongs—/ oṃ dkar a dmar t+t+waṃ mthing / sku gsung thugs kyi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa dhe ba ma hā shaṃ la kha tro ta hūṃ/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ dhe ba a su ra pra ti dza/ghu bhi dza ho bha dhu ta ra tsa tin da/ kur bhi dzi dza hūṃ/ trag rag sha sa ma ya rda do dza dza hūṃ hūṃ/ sgrub pa'i snying po'o/ /oṃ dhe ba lha.a su ra a ro mi 'am ci kal dri za sto yak+shi gar+shan rje du na srin po klu ma mo btsan makarigs 'dzin rushaganod sbyin ṣadagra bgegs byebacad 47—597

thams cad kyi hūṃ dgra sod sod ma ra ma ra tshirnya chodacigatshirnya chod cig bhud ta bhud ta hūṃ phaṭa/las sngags bcun pa'o/ /sa ma ya dza dza/ spyan drang ba'i 'o/ /dza hūṃ baṃ ho/stem pa'o/ /oṃ dhe ba a su ra hūṃ/ skyed pa'i sngags so/ /thun ka la rag sha rgo dza rbad/ dgra bo'i snying la thun bh+yo/ thun gyi sngags so/ /oṃ dhe ba a su ra hūṃ pra ti dzaghu nyi dza/ dhu ta ra tsa gyi na hūṃ phaṭa/ bod pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ dhe ba a su ra ni ri mar snying snying / dgra bgegs snying la ltam/ ma ra ya thums/snying khrag thang la phyung / nyos khyer yed khyer/ snying khrag kha ru lhug /gsang ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ dzo haṃ ni/ mo ha ni/ tai pa ni/ bha lin ta kha'i/gtor ma dbul ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ da ma cha da gi ni i a/ 'dro pra pa rne'o 'bras pa ti sa tshe ta so rnyi ba sa dhe'o hūṃ tha tha/ glu blang zhing dgyes par btab pa'oske/ /dra dra ya ba kha dza dza/ ma hā u pa kha nī bā tha na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ zor gyi sngags so/ /oṃ ag ne+e dz+wa la ram̐/ me lha'i sngags so/ /spur ya u gu tsag shani tri snying la tsakra dza la ram̐ yo baṃ rbad/ ling kha sreg pa'i 'o/ /oṃ dhe ba a su ra hūṃ ki la ya hūṃ/ phur pa'i sngags so/ /trag rag sha ru ra ti ba ra ni tro thun rbad phaṭa—/ phur pa gdab pa'i sngags so/ /trag rag sha rad na sidhi ma gu sha hūṃ/srung ba'i sngags so/ /trag rag sha kur bhi tai tai tri ma ra ya rbad/ khams thums rbad/ trag rag sha sa ma ya phrom shar phob/ trag rag sha /a bhi ni rag sha a hril zil phrom shar phob/ dgra bgegs bskrad pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ dhe ba a su ra hūṃ/ bha su pus ting ku ru ye swā hā/ nor sgrub pa'i sngags so/ /ni tri ①s+t+waṃ ba ya nan/ gnan pa'i sngags so/ /las kyi sngags rnams sham bur gdags—/ sngags kyi le'u ste bdun pa'o// //47—598

bdun du sgrubs na so gcig nas/ /dgra de nges par 'chi bar 'gyur/ /sring mo bzhi'i sgrub pa bya/ /mche ba can gsum smra ba can/ /sha dang khrag gi gtor ma bya/ /thun bzhir sgrub cing rbad par bya/ /oṃ a ka la tsa'u dhas a dha ri hūṃ/ oṃ a sa ma hūṃ/ sa ka ma ma ri hūṃ/ oṃ a bha ma hā/ then ka pa la dha re na hūṃ/ oṃ a gha tra ru ru dhi ra pi wa hūṃ/ snying po'o/ /bong thra badz+ra sa ta pa la ti/ ma sa kha'i/ rag ta kha'i/ sarba kha'i/ hūṃ ga la hūṃ/ gang ga la/las kyi sngags so/ /sreg mnan ①gtor ma zor du 'phang / /thod rnga brdung ④zhing skul cing rbad/ /chas gos nag po bgo bar bya/ /sring mo bzhi'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //shin tu ces pas srog ltar bcang / /'di nyid gang la yod pa des/ /bskul ④na dgra de'i srog la rgol/ /khros na dgra bo'i rta phyugs dang / /'khor rnams rlag cing cho 'phrul ston/ /des na 'di nyid lus la bcang / /yod pa tsam gyis dgra kun thub/ /smra na gshags dulas rgyal bar 'gyur/ /ces pas bsngags ⑤pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// //dpal nag po chen po'i gsang ba'i man ngag /slob dpon ro langs bde bas gdams pa rdzogs so// //bram ze chen po la rim par brgyud rjonas/ tshul shes sgyur ⑦ba'i man ngag gi rgyud do/ /mgon po 'di man ngag gi ⑧dbang du byas pa yin pas/ /sgrub thag nye'o 47—599

:rdobakas cas/ /bla ma rin chen 'od pa'i phyag dpe la/ bla ma sang 'od pa'i zhal zhus so/ /de'i dpe la dag par byas te/ rim par ban chung gis kyang zhal zhus so//① //bsdur mchan/594 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/595 ①〈〈pe 〉ska / ②〈〈pe 〉〉paṅga lo/597 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bzhug ②〈〈pe 〉〉par ②〈〈pe 〉〉ka598 ①〈〈pe 〉〉ti/599 ①〈〈pe 〉〉gnan/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉bdung / ①〈〈pe 〉rkosal/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉nags/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉skasngags/ dhi〈〈pe 〉〉rgyud/⑦〈〈pe 〉〉bsgyur/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉stonas/6༷༷ ①〈〈pe〉ri masgolo/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2725)47wa 600

2799༄ga /dam tshig 'dus pa'i dbang /7 ༄/ dam tshig 'dus pa'i dbang bzhugs so// ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/sa ma yā/ a bhi she ka ta/ ke duḥ/ bod skad du/ dam tshig 'dus pa'i dbang / bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdul kyi grangs kyi mgon po bkug /sha khrag rgyan pa'i gtor sogs dbul/ /bstod sogs dam tshig rdo rje gtad/ /snang ba zhus pas snang bar bsam/ /tsā tsāḥsangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dpal mgon po dang lha mo rnams snyan gsan cing thugs gtad du gsol/ khyed rnams kyi spyan sngar/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung / dkon mchog gi dbu phangs bstod/ dam pa'i chos kyi tshul 'dzin/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyong / dam tshig cig la gnas par khas bslangs pa bzhin du/ bdag dang slob ma sangs rgyas ma rgyas kyi bar du/srung skyob pa dngos grub stsal du gsol/ rten cig la 'du ba dang / snying po 47byed601

cig la 'du ba dang / chos nyid cig la 'du ba dang / mchod pa dang /gtor ma cig la 'du ba dang / dam tshig cig la 'du ste/ phan tshun 'khu ma ldog /zhe ma sdang / phrag ma dog /'khon dang sel med par mdzad du gsol / de las 'das na/ khyed rnams rang sha rang gis za ba dang /rang khrag rang gis 'thung ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi bka' yang blus ste/gnar med par gyur ta re/ de bas na bdag dang slob ma la 'go ba dang 'dres pa dang gnas par mdzad du gsol/ mgon po rnams kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa legs so legs so de bzhin du bya'o/ /thabs yin no gsung / legs so brjod/da ni dbang bskur te/ 'di ni mgon bo kun la byin pa'i gtor ma ste/sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i bden stobs kyis/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i mgon po ma lus kun/ /dam tshig cig la 'du ba'i dbang thob shog /'di ni mgon po kun gyis myangs pa'i bdud rtsis te/ /'di ni mgon po kun gyis spyi bor khur ba'i dam chos ste/ /'di ni mgon po kun gyis bltas pa'i mar me ste/ /'di ni mgon po kun gyi snying la gnas pa'i srog yin te/ /'di ni mgon po kun gyi lag tu gtad pa'i rdo rje ste/ /lhag ma sbyar te brjod par bya/ /gang bzhin gsol gdab byin par bsam/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig sgrub pa'i rigs yin te/ /dkon mchog gsum kyi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i mgon po ma lus kun/ /rig 'dzin 'di la 'go zhing 'dres gyur cig /oṃ ma hā ka la sar+pāḥs ma yāḥ'adus gcig pa 'i sngags so/ /sibye hūṃḥ.aḥtris g.yon du bla ma la brgyan dar dmar dbu thod dbul/ /'gro ba 'du ba'i rten 'byel thob / /mgon po 'dus pa yi ge bcu ces byas so/ /rdzogs so/ / 47—602

bla ma bram zes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //tshul shes sgyur ro/ /gtor ma dbus g.yas su bdud rtsi/ mdo rgyud po ti/ g.yon du mar mel/ yi ge bcu pa/ mdun du rdo rje dang mchod pa'o lag len no// //bsdur mchan/601 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2726)47wa 603

280༷sngal/ /dpal mgon po bya rog ma'i bskangs kyi tsho ga'i rim pa/ 1༄/ bskang gso mi mngon ma bzhugs so// ༄7/ /dpal mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal nag po chen po bya rog ma la bskang gso 4bya bar 'dod pas/dang por mgon g.yag dang lug dang bya nag gi rgyal mtshan dang / tshogs dang gtor ma dang mchod pa thams cad tshogs par byas la/ 'di skad du gyer bar bya'o / /hūṃ mi mngon nam mkha'i dbyengs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /bcom ldan dpal chen bde mchog 'khor lo la/ /sgu gsung thugs kyi mkha' 'go'i tshogs kyis bskor ba la/ /phyi nang gsang bar bcas pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad sna tshogs 'bul / /sgu gsung thugs dang 'gal ba ci mchis bzod par gsol/ /bskang ngo bskal par thugs dam bskang / /hūṃ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /ye shes mgon ngo/ bya rog ming chen nag po che/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi 'jigs pa'i gar dang 77—6071

bcas / /sku la dur khrod rgyan dang bcas pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs/ /do nub spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs mchod pa bzhes/ /bskang ngor bskal par thugs dam bskang / /de yi sku gsung thugs las sprul pa'i yum/ /dkar mo glog phreng sku yi yum/ /dmar mo rtsa 'jib gsung gi yum/ /nag mo tsan ti thugs kyi yum/ /bskang ngo / /hūṃ dmar nag gtum drag 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas/ /sprul pa'i mgon po bya rog gdong can bzhi/ /shar nas srog gcod ltas ngan gtong ba'i bya rog gdong / /tshangs ris mgon po 'bum dang bcas/ /bskang ngo bskal par thugs dam bskang / /lho nas za byed smyo 'bog 1—gtong ba'i bya rog gdong / /za byed gshin rje nag po 'bum dang bcas so/ /bskang ngo bskal par thugs dam bskang / /nub nas khrag nad dal yams 'gyed pa'i bya rog gdong / /'phung byed sbas pa ma mo 'bum dang bcas/ /bskang ngo bskal par thugs dam bskang / /byang nas bdun rgyud rtsad nas gcod pa'i bya rog gdong / /snang srid lha srin sha za 'bum dang bcas/ /bskang ngo bskal par thugs dam bskang / /hūṃ keng rus me dpung 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /mkha' 'gro drug dang lha mo brgyad/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang zhi byed ma/ /bsrung byed ma dang chos sku ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /tshor gsang nag mo bya rog mgo/ /'gugs byed sngon mo stag gi mgo/ /gsod byed nag mo seng ge'i mgo/ /'jig rten las grub mkha' 'gro ma/ /bskang ngo bskal par thugs dam bskang / /'jig rten 'dzin pa'i dbang mo che/ /las kyis sprul pa'i lha mo brgyad/ /dbang mo za byed 'gugs byed ma/ /myos byed gsod byed rkos mkhan mo/ /brlag byed ma 47—605

dang mgyogs ma'i tshogs/ /bya rgod la sogs mgo brnyan tshogs su sprul/ /bskang ngo bskal par thugs dam bskang / /hūṃ sprul pa'i mgo brnyan bcu drug ni/ /stag dang gzig dang dom dang dred / /seng ge spyang ki chu srin mgo/ /'phar ba khyung dang 'ug pa'i mgo/ /khra 1dang bya rgod shaṃ ka'i mgo/ /sbrul dang sha wa dag gi mgo/ /phag gi mgo can la sogs pa'i/ /bskang ngo bskal par thugs dam bskang / /gzhan yang mgon po'i 'khor tshogs kyi/ /seng ge gdong can la sogs pa'i/ /pho bdud nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / /mkha' 'gro sgrol byed la sogs pa'i/ /dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / /gang po mdzes pa la sogs pa'i/ /dregs pa sum cu'i thugs dam bskang / /legs ldan nag po la sogs pa'i/ /dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi/ /bskang ngo bskal par thugs dam bskang / /hūṃ sha khrag mtsho ltar gang ba'i dur khrod nas/ /ro langs mang po bsnol ba'i khri stengs nas/ /drag po smyon pa 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /nag po gcer bu sbrul kyis brgyan/ /khye la zhon nas dgra bgegs 'dul/ /rgyal po sha la za ba'i ro langs bcu/ /bram ze dmar po khrag la 'thung ba bcu/ /rje rigs gser mdog tshil la 'jab pa bcu/ /gdol pa nag po rkang gcog rus pa mur pa bcu/ /dmangs rig 2sngo skya pags pa za ba bcu/ /dge slong gtsang ma dbang po za ba bcu/ /sngags pa nag po don snying nang khrol za ba bcu/ /khyi'u gzhon nu dri chu skom du 'thung ba bcu/ /bud med sngon mo ro ras gos su gyon pa bcu / /keng rus 'jigs pa sha med pags med bcu/ /de ltar ro langs nag po brgya yi thugs dam bskang / /bskang ngo bskal par thugs dam bskang / / 17—606

hūṃ nag po stong gi thugs dam bskang ba ni/ /mgyogs byed nag po bya nag zhon pa brgya/ /mon pa nag po phag nag zhon pa brgya/ /ser skya nag po sbrul nag zhon pa brgya/ /bdud po nag po rta nag zhon pa brgya/ /ro zan nag po 'brong nag zhon pa brgya/ /khyab pa nag po lug nag zhon pa brgya/ /bon po nag po dre'u nag zhon pa brgya/ /sgo ba nag po rlung nag zhon pa brgya/ /shan pa nag po khyi nag zhon pa brgya/ /lings pa nag po sha nag zhon pa brgya/ /de ltar nag po stong gi thugs dam bskang / /bskang ngo bskal par thugs dam bskang / /hūṃ gnod sbyin khri yi thugs dam bskang ba ni/ /dgra bo'i bla srog mtha' nas 'gugs pa'i 'byung po gnod sbyin stong / /dgra la mi kha brlang gzhi gtong ba'i 'byung po gnod sbyin stong / /dgra bo'i lo thog 'bru bcud 'jib pa'i 'byung po gnod sbyin stong / /dgra la mi nad phyugs nad gtong ba'i 'byung po gnod sbyin stong / /skye 'gro rtsis la 'debs pa'i 'byung po gnod sbyin stong / /dgra bo'i dbugs len srog la 'jab pa'i snasna'abyung po gnod sbyin stong / /dgra bo'i sha za rkos la 'debs pa'i 'byung po gnod sbyin stong / /dgra bo'i bdun rgyud mtha' nas bsdud pa'i 'byung po gnod sbyin stong / /dgra bo'i rjes gzhi dur nas slong ba'i 'byung po gnod sbyin stong / /dgra bo'i gnam sa skor gyis 'debs pa'i 'byung po gnod sbyin stong / /de ltar 'byung po gnod sbyin khri yi thugs dam bskang / /bskang ngo bskal par thugs dam bskang / /hūṃ ma mo bye ba'i thugs dam bskang ba ni/ /dgra la gar 'phog blu brid byed pa'i ma mo nag mo 'bum/ /dgra bo'i mdangs 'phrog bcud la 'jib pa'i ma mo nag mo 'bum/ /dgra bo sho'u khram la 'debs pa'i ma mo nag mo 'bum/ /47—607

dgra bo'i srog la 'jab pa'i ma mo nag mo 'bum/ /dgra la nad rgyal mtshon 1drub 'phen pa'i ma mo nag mo 'bum/ /gling bzhi stong gsum nyul ba'i ma mo nag mo 'bum/ /dbugs 'phrog srog la brgyug pa'i ma mo nag mo 'bum/ /sha za rkos la 'debs pa'i ma mo nag mo 'bum/ /khrag 'thung rkang la ldag 3snapa'i ma mo nag mo 'bum/ /stong gsum brlag par byed pa'i ma mo nag mo 'bum/ /de ltar ma mo nag mo bye ba'i thugs dam bskang / /bskang ngo bskal par thugs dam bskang / /hūṃ sha za 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang ba ni/ /bar snang ro la lding ba'i bya rgod khri/ /sha za khrag la 'thung ba'i lce spyang khri/ /pags glad rgyu ma 'khyer ba'i wa khye khri/ /ro la khyur mid byed pa'i stag gzig khri/ /ro za ro gos gyon pa'i srin po khri/ /keng rus rjes la snom pa'i gzhad kir khri/ /skad dang dri la brgyug pa'i dri za khri/ /khrag 'thung sha rus 'byed pa'i 'phar ba khri/ /nang khrol don snying za ba'i sbrul gdug khri/ /mdun bsu phyi la 'brang ba'i yi dwags gzugs can khri/ /de ltar sha za 'bum kyi thugs dam bskang / /bskang ngo bskal par thugs dam bskang / /hūṃ thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni/ /thams cad sbyar ba'i bdud rtsi dang / /rak+ta dmar gyi arga dang / /sha khrag dkyil ba'i gtor ma dang / /snang ga'/la 'od kyi zhun mar dang / /sha chen spos kyi dud sprin dang / /tshogs kyi zhal zas mang po dang / /mgon lug nag po spyi dkar dang / /bya mo nag mo gser mig dang / /phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rdzas kyis/ /chos skyong nag po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /bskang ngo bskal par thugs dam bskang / /47—608

hūṃ sku yi dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /bya rgod mda' yis thugs dam bskang //rak+ta rnam gsum gsung gi rten/ /gsung gi rten gyis/ tsit+ta rnam gsum thugs kyi rten/ /thugs kyi rten gyis thugs dam bskang / /g.yag lug nag po phyi yi rten/ /phyi yi rten kyis thugs dam bskang / /bya nag rgyal mtshan nang gi rten / /nang gi rten gyis thugs dam bskang / /gri rgod snying chen gsang ba'i rten—/ /gsang ba'i rten gyis thugs dam bskang / /'bod pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /g.yab dar nag pos thugs dam bskang / /dam tshig gnyan po bsre ba'i phyir/ /bdud rtsi sman kyis thugs dam bskang / /rak+ta zhal du gsol ba'i phyir/ /dmar chen argas thugs dam bskang / /phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /su ra chang gis thugs dam bskang / /rtag tu mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i phyir/ /rtag gtor chen pos thugs dam bskang / /rgyun du phrin las bcol ba'i phyir/ /rgyun gyi gtor mas thugs dam bskang / /rbad pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /khyi nag snying gis thugs dam bskang / /gsang ba'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /gri rgod snying gis thugs dam bskang / /bsgral ba'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /lug nag snying gis thugs dam bskang / /bskang ba'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /lug nag spyi dkar thugs dam bskang / /dgyes pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /mkha' lding nag pos thugs dam bskang / /nal bu'i sha khrag gtor chen 'dis/ /yum chen gsum gyis thugs dam bskang / /bsad pa'i sha khrag snying sna 'dis/ /bya rog gdong can bzhi'i thugs dam bskang / /tshogs phud sha sna 'bru chen 'dis/ /mkha' 'gro drug dang lha mo brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang / /bshos bu dmar nag snying gis brgyan pa'i 47—609

gtor ma 'dis/ /legs ldan seng ge gdong can la sogs pa'i/ /pho bdud nyi shu rtsa gcig thugs dam bskang / /khrag sna sman sna sbyar ba'i gtor ma 'dis/ /mkha' 'gro sgol byed la sogs pa'i/ /dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad thugs dam bskang / /dkar gsum sman kyis sbran pa'i gtor ma 'dis/ /gang po mdzes pa la sogs pa'i/ /dreg 1pa sum bcu'i thugs dam bskang / /'bru bcud bdud rtsis bkang ba'i gtor ma 'dis/ /legs ldan smyon pa la sogs pa'i/ /dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa gnyis thugs dam bskang / /'bru gsum dkar dmar brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'dis/ /ro langs las byed rnams kyi thugs dam bskang / /nag po bdun gyi sha khrag spung ba'i dze+e7gtor ma 'dis/ /nag po stong gi thugs dam bskang / /sha khrag sna tshogs sbyar ba'i gtor ma 'dis/ /gnod sbyin 'byung po khri'i thugs dam bskang / /rak+ta bdud rtsi sman gyis sbran pa'i gtor ma 'dis/ /ma mo nag mo bye ba'i thugs dam bskang / /lhag gtor kha chus sbran pa'i gtor ma 'dis/ /sprul pa sha za 'bum gyis 1thugs dam bskang / /hūṃ de ltar mgon po'i lha tshogs rnams/ /'du ba'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir / /mi rkang gling bus thugs dam bskang / /saṃ sa zas su za ba'i phyir/ /sha chen bdud rtsis thugs dam bskang / /spyan gyi dbang po tshim mdzad pa'i/ /tshil chen mar mes thugs dam bskang / /shangs kyis ④dbang po tshim mdzad pa'i//bsur chen dud pas thugs dam bskang / /ljags kyi dbang po tshim mdzad pa'i/ /bshos bu snying gi gtor mas thugs dam bskang / /snyan gyi dbang po tshim mdzad nga 'i / /rnga dang dril bu cang te'us thugs dam bskang / /mthun pa'i dam 47—610
