dzas yin pa'i phyir/ /gos nag zhwa nag dag gis thugs dam bskang / /mchod pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ /nya sha la phug sgog tsong la sogs thugs dam bskang / /dgyes shing dngos grub blang ba'i phyir/ /tshogs dang gtor mas thugs dam bskang / /g.yag lug nag po mar gyis byugs/ /dar nag ru mtshon rwa la brgyan/ /phrag par dgra bgegs ling ga bskyon/ /gser skyems bdud rtsis bran pa 'dis/ /nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang / /zhes brjod la bshags pa bya ba ni/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po bya rog gi ming can la/sku gsung thugs kyi yum gsum dang / phrin las kyi mgon po bya rog gdong can bzhis bskor ba/ mkha' 'gro ma drug dang / lha mo brgyad dang / mgo brnyan bcu drug dang / phyag brnyan legs ldan seng ge gdong can la sogs pa pho bdud nyi shu rtsa gcig /ḍā ki sgrol byed la sogs pa dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad/klu'i rgyal po gang po mdzes ma la sogs pa dregs pa can sum cu/ legs ldan nag po la sogs pa dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ drag po smyon pa la sogs pa ro langs chen po brgya/ mgyogs byed nag po la sogs pa nag po stong /dgra bo'i bla srog 'gugs par byed pa la sogs pa 'byung po gnod sbyin khri/gar byed nag mo la sogs pa ma mo bye ba/ khyung dang bya rgod sbrul la sogs pa sha za 'bum gyis bskor ba rnams kyi spyan sngar/ bdag gis bka' ltar ma gyur te/gzhung bzhin rngo ma thogs pas/ bsnyen sgrub tshad du ma phyin par las la sbyar ba dang / tshogs dang phud gtor dus su ma grub pa dang / mchod pa'i 'byor tshogs chungs pa dang / ting nge 'dzin ma gsal bar bzlas pa gra chag pa dang /phyi nang gsang ba'i rten rdzas ma tshogs par gsang ba bsgrags pa dang / sgu 47—611

gsung thugs dang phyi nang gsang ba'i dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /dpal nag po chen po ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa/ khrag 'thung gi rgyal po/ bstan pa'i bka' bsrungs/ dam nyams kyi srog gcod/ rig 'dzin gyi srog shing / rnal 'byor gyi dgra lha/ dug gsum gyi sman pa/ gtsug lag khang gi bsrungs ma/ bdag gi rnal 'byor bsrungs shig /tshe dang dbang phyug spel cig /dpal dang grags pa bsgrubs shig /'khor dang gang zag skyongs shig /sdang ba'i dgra dang bar chad kyi rkyen rnams thul cig /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu bzlog cig /nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zhi bar mdzod cig /ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa bzhi bsgyur cig /ye 'brog sum brgya drug cu bzlog byug/lo'i keg dang zla ba'i keg dang zhag gi keg dang za ma'i keg dang bkra mi shis pa thams cad bzlog cig /ces brjod par bya'o/ /yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzlas par bya'o/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams tshogs la longs spyod par bya'o/ /de nas smad las kyi drag po'i las sbyor yang bya'o/ /dpal mgon po bya rog ma'i bskangs kyi cho ga'i rim pa/ bla ma a bha ya kā ras/ dpal nā len+t+ra'i gtsug lag khang du/ rdo sku rang byung gi rtsar mdzad pa'o/ /phyis bla ma chen po dpal rga los rang 'gyur mdzad pa'o//1 //47—612

sbyang khu/ khyi/ phag /seng ge/ stag /dom/ bya/ lug /rnams lnga tshan re re bya/ khyad par du bshos bu khru gang ba zur gsum pa dmar nag khrag gis brgyan pa cig bya/ bzlog pa'i 'khor lo bzhi bri/ bsad pa'i 'khor lo brgyad bri/ gnan pa'i ling ga gsum bri/ de nas gtor ma zangs zhong la sogs par bshams la/ rang kha nub tu blta/ lhor ho lngang / byang bu'i phreng bas bskor/ yi dam chos skyong gi thang sku dgram/ dmar gtor/dkar gtor gnyis bshams/ bzlog pa'i 'khor lo ngar mi'i gnas gsum du sba / gnan pa'i 'khor lo sha khyi'i thod par gzhugasalku/ bsad pa'i 'khor lo ho la bsreg go/ /de ltar rdzas rnams la me rlung gi sbyor ba bya'o/ /bdag mgon por bskyed/ thugs khar he ru ka bsgom/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug bya/mchod pa dang gtor ma 'bul/ rin po che sna tshogs dang / 'bru sna tshogs dang / sman sna chan dang bcas pa 'bul/ de nas bgegs la gtor ma sbyin/mtshams gcad/ de nas stod —pa'i rim pa thams cad bya/ thugs dam bskang / rkang gupa brgyad pas bstod/ de nas gtor mdos de thugs mgon la las mgon bzhis bskor bar bskyed/ 'khor nag po stong / sha za 'bum/ma mo bye ba/ mkha' 'gro ma 'bum/ gnod sbyin khri/ 'khor lha srin sde brgyad dang bcas pa spyan drangs la/ mchod pa 'bul ba la sogs pa bya'o/ /de nas ha sgrogs ma'i chung bsdud dal kha g.yas su sgyur zhes pa yan chad dang /rin chen dpungs pa 'don/ de nas sngags ni/ oṃ ma hā ka la bzlog hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā ka la ya bzlog hūṃ t+t+waṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā ka la gu na tri ta bzlog hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā ka la ga na pa ta bzlog hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/47—615

oṃ ma hā ka la si ti yo 1du dza bzlog hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ ha ha hūṃ hūṃ/ ki li ki li che ge mo bzlog bh+yo/ phe dze phaṭa che ge mo bzlog bh+yo/ kre kre kre che ge mo/ tram̐ k+ṣ-i shaṃ che ge mo/ ka ha ka ha che ge mo/ hro hro kre gnod byed bzlog bh+yo/ pa tsa pa tsa che ge mo/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa che ge mo/ ha ha ha ha che ge mo/ re ram̐ t+t+waṃ che ge mo/k+ṣ-i k+ṣ-i hūṃ che ge mo/ khaṃ khaṃ khaṃ che ge mo/ dhi dhi dhi che ge mo/ k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ che ge mo/shaṃ kai shaṃ che ge mo bzlog bh+yo/ rtsa rtsa rtsa che ge mo/ yo yo yo che ge mo/ saṃ saṃ saṃ che ge mo/ dze phe phe che ge mo/ dzha dzha lha che ge mo/ rgyu rgyu rgyu che ge mo/ k+ṣ-i k+ṣe k+shi che ge mo/ glu glu gluche ge paṃ paṃ paṃ che ge dza dza dza zlog zlog bh+yo bh+yo rbad che ge mo bzlog bh+yo/ thun re la sngags lnga lnga bskul zhing bzlog par bya'o/ /byang bu la ming spel dang bcas pa bris la rtags par bya'o/ /byang bu ni mtshon cha'i rnam par 'bri ba'am / gzugs su byas te/ mda' dang / mdung dang / ral gri dang /dbyug tho dang / rtse gsum dang / tho ba dang / rdo rje rgya gram dang / gri gug du bya'o / /de bzhin du zhag gsum mam/ lnga'am/ bdun nam/ nyi shu rtsa gcig tu bya'o / /yang zhag gcig la yang nyan no/ /thod zor bca'o/ /de dmag dang bcas pas dgra phyogs su btang ngo / /de nas ho bsreg go/ /ngar mi 'khor lo dang bcas pa lam rgya gram du gnan/ gcig kho'i mgul du mnan/ sbyin sreg 2 thal ba zor du 'phang / yang na gnan pa bya'o// //yang gtor ma bsdus pa byed na/ zangs gzhong 1la sogs pa'i nang du ri rab bang rim gsum pa bya/ de'i steng du gtor ma zur gsum pa gcig bzhag/de la bya rog gi dbu mdzugs4/ de la nam mkha' dang / gzugs lnga lngas 47—616

bskor / yang na brgyad kyis bskor/ bshos bu bzhis bskor/ sha khrag sna tshogs dang / sman dang / 'bru sna'i chan dang / dug sna dang / byang bu dang / ling kha dang / dar/ stag gis brgyan no/ /byin brlabs sngags dang 'dra ba la/ bsnyen bsgrub gong du bstan pa bzhin bya'o// //shin tu bsnyus pa ni/ thod pa'i nang du gtor ma dmar nag bzhi bcas la / sha khrag gis brgyan dmigs pa dang bcas pas/ dgra phyogs su 'phang ngo / /de ni zla ba gcig la lan bzhi bya'o/ /bsad par byed na gtor chen byas te/ bcas par ma de bya/ sha sa 1na'i sngags la dgra bo kha kha khā ṭī/brgya rtsa brgyad khrag gis bris/ yang las mgon gyi sngags gsum po la ming thems bcug la brgya rtsa brgyad byas la/ gtor ma re re'i nang du sngags re gzhug /ngar mi dang 'theb kyu dang / sha khrag dang / 'bru sna'i chan la/yungs dkar long thun rdzas btab la brgya rtsa brgyad re byas na dgra bgegs dgug gzhug byas la/ rdzas sha khrag tu byin byus brlabs la/ mdun bskyed thugs mgon la sogs pa thams cad kyis gsol bar bsam/ khyad par du kho'i lha srungs rnams gsol bar byas la/ kho rang gi sha khrag rnams 'bul lo/ /de nas bzlog pa gtang snye/ rdzas dang khyad par sbyor ba rnams shes par bya'o/ /mgon po'i gtor mdos/ gtor bzlog /brgya gtor/ bsad pa'i las/slob dpon nag po pas mdzad pa/dpal rga los/ phag mo grub pa la/ gsungs pa 'di ni shin tu gnyan pas dam tshig med pa la mi bstan/ gang rung rung du mi bya'o// //47—617

bsdur mchan/614 tu mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ khya〈〈pe 〉〉 dang /615 1 〈〈pe 〉togazhug 〈 〈〈pe 〉〉bstod/ — 0 〈〈pe 〉〉bskang /616 7〉〈〈pe 〉〉pa/ tshon 〈〈pe 〉〉bsreg ge 〈〈pe 〉togang / ④ 〈〈pe 〉toradzugs/617 〉〈〈pe 〉〉za/ 4 〈〈pe 〉〉btang /bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2728)47wa 618

༄༅/ /mgon po bya rog gdong gi gtor mdos/1༄7/ /dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtor ma'i phrin las ni/ stong khog rgyas par byas la/ bzlog rkang gnyis btang ba ni/ de nas gos nag po gon/ rnga dang dung dang rol mo'i sgra bsgrags/ dar 'phyar2/gsur chen gyi dud pa btang la 'di skad do/ /hūṃ bdag ni rig 'dzin bsgrub pa po / /bdag ni rnal 'byor dam tshig can/ /bdag ni dpal chen he ru ka /khyod ni nag po chen po ste/ /chos kyi srungs ma thugs dam can/ /bstan pa gnyan po bsrung ba dang / /rnal 'byer dam can bskyang ba'i phyir/ /khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /do nub bzlog pa'i dpung la byon/ /rnal 'byor bdag la dgra byung na/ /ye shes spyan ldan dus la bab/ /do nub bzlog pa'i dpung la byon/ /dpal ldan nag po chen po khyod/ /chos kyi dbyings nas sku bzhengs la/ /bstan srungs legs ldan nag po ni/ /dur khrod gnas nas sku bzhengs la/ /do nub 47—619

bzlog pa'i dpung la byon/ /mgon po srog bdag nag po ni/ /bdud kyi gnas nas sgu bzhengs la/ /do nub bzlog pa'i dpung la byon/ /mgon po 'chi bdag nag po ni/ /gshin rje'i gnas nas sgu bzhengs la/ /do nub bzlog pa'i dpung la byon/ /mgon po tshe bdag nag po ni/ /klu'i gnas nas sgu bzhengs la/ /do nub bzlog pa'i dpung la byon/ /mgon po sgrol ging nag po ni//srin bo'i gnas nas sgu bzhengs la/ /do nub bzlog pa'i dpung la byon/ /mgon po srog zan dmar po ni/ /btsan gyi gnas nas sgu bzhengs la/ /do nub bzlog pa'i dpung la byon/ /mgon po sha zan nag po ni/ /gza' yi gnas nas sgu bzhengs la/ /do nub bzlog pa'i dpung la byon/ /mgon po sgrol ging nag po ni/ /dpe kar gnas nas sku bzhengs la/ /do nub bzlog pa'i dpung la byon/ /mgon po sha zan nag po ni/ /smu'i gnas nas sku bzhengs la/ /do nub bzlog pa'i dpung la byon/ /mgon po dug blangs nag po ni/ /klu'i gnas nas sgu bzhengs la/ /do nub bzlog pa'i dpung la byon/ /mgon po cho 'phrul nag po ni/ /je'u rang gnas nas sku bzhengs la/ do nub bzlog pa'i dpung la byon/ /mgon po nad kyi bdag po ni/ /ma mo'i gnas nas sgu bzhengs la/ /do nub bzlog pa'i dpung la byon // //1 hūṃ nag po stong gi tshogs dang bcas/ /dur khrod gnas nas sku bskyod cig /dpung gi tshogs rnams sgu bskyod cig /go mtshon 'chas pa sku bskyod cig /do nub bzlog pa'i dpung la byon/ /sha za 'bum gyi tshogs bcas rnams / /dur khrod brgyad nas sku bskyod cig /dpung gi tshogs dang sku bskyod cig /go mtshon 'chas pa sgu bskyod cig /do nub ma mo bye ba'i tshogs 47—620

dang bcas/ /rgya mtsho'i gling nas sgu bskyod cig /dpung gi tshogs dang sgu bskyod cig /go mtshon 'chas pa sku bskyod cig /do nub bzlog pa'i dpung la byon/ /bcom ldan dpal chen spyan snga ru/ /ji ltar khas blang kyidam bcas pa'i / /bstan srungs ma lus sku bzhengs la/ /do nub bzlog pa'i dpung la byon / /'di ni bsgrubs 5pa'i gzhal yas khang / /rnal 'byor dam tshig can gyi grogs/ /dam rdzas sha khrag sna tshogs dang / /'bru'i chan dang khur ba dang //la du la phug shing thog dang / /khrag sna dug sna a mri ta/ /dgra bgegs ling khar byas pa 'di/ /mchod par 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa dang / /'dza gad dpa' bo'i mchod pa dang / /khrag gi yon chab dug gi me tog dang / /sha chen spos dang zhun chen mar me dang / /dug gi mthor 'thung khrag gi byug pa dang / /lha bshos dmar bo zur gsum dang / /rkang chen dung dang ban dha'i sgra/ /phyi nang mchod pa rgya chen 'bul/ /ye shes mgon po 'khor dang bcas/ /gnas 'dir sprin ltar stebs mdzod la/ /thugs dam bskang ngo bzhes su gsol/ /thugs dam gnyan po bskongs nas kyang //phrin las gnyan po bcol ba ni/ /drongs cig nyams pa'i snying nas drongs/ /bzlog cig byad kha dgra la bzlog /mgon po'i dmag sna dgra la drongs/ /mgon po'i ru dar dgra la phyor༄ sna/ /mgon po'i mdun drangs dgra la chos4 / /mgon po'i khram kha dgra la spos/ /mgon po'i khram sna dgra la sgyur/ /mgon po'i bshugs pa dgra la long / /bh+yo/ ma ye ma dha nag po che/ /khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab /bdag cag sgyu saspyor 'khor bcas la/ /dgra dang byad kha phur kha byung ba 'di/ /47—62 1

dam can khyed kyis ma tshor ram/ /ye shes spyan dang mi ldan nam/ /sngon gyi dam bcas ma bsnyel lam/ /rig 'dzin rnal 'byor mi skyong ngam/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa mi bsrung ngam/ /dam nyams log 'dren mi 'dul lam/ /khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /bar chad bzlog pa'i dus la bab /hūṃ dpal chen khrag 'thung rngam pa'i sgu/ /dur khrod chas kyis sku la brgyan/ /sprul pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /dus 'dir bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /hūṃ me ri dmar nag 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ /shin tu 'jigs pa'i dur khrod chen po nas/ /thod chen kam rlon baṃ chen gsar rnying dang / /keng rus sngo skya gdug pa sbrul gyis brgyan/ /steng na sprin nag 'khrig cing 'brug sgra sgrogs—/ /khyung dang dur bya la sogs mkha' la lding ༄1sna/ /gcan zan ce spyang tshogs rnams phyi la rol/ /dur khrod chen po'i gnas mchog de nyid na/ /gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dbus/ /sna tshogs pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan/ /bam chen ru tra brtsegs pa'i steng / /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun dang dbyer med pa'i / /khrag 'thung rdo rje nag po chen po ni/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis dor thabs can/ /dgra bgegs bdud bgegs thams cad bzlog tu gsol / /dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'bar ba yi/ /ye shes lha yi gnod pa bzlog tu gsol/ /thod kam lnga yis dbu la brgyan pa ni/ /nyon mongs dug lnga'i tshogs rnams bzlog du gsol/ /rgyal rigs sbrul gyis dbu skra bcings pa yis / /'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i gnod pa bzlog tu gsol/ /rin chen dbu brgyan dar gyi cod pan gyis/ /lha rnams yongs kyi gnod pa bzlog tu gsol/ /spyan gsum dmar zlum phyogs bcur gzigs pa yis/ /dug gsum mi dge bcu (7—622

rnams bzlog tu gsol/ /shangs nas rlung byung khro gnyer bsdus pa ni/ /khro bo pho nya'i gnod pa bzlog tu gsol/ /smin ma glog stong 'khyugs nas gzigs pa yis / /gcan zan la sogs gnod pa bzlog tu gsol/ /zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs pa yis/ /za byed brgyad kyi gnod pa bzlog tu gsol—/ /zhal nas hūṃ phaṭa bh+yo dang bso sgra yis/ /ngan sngags gnod pa'i thun sngags thams cad bzlog /ag tshoms dmar po me ltar 'bar ba yis/ /nyon mongs shes bya'i 3bag chags thams cad bzlog /phyag g.yas gri gug rab tu 'bar ba yis/ /gzhan gyi mtshon cha'i ngan sbyor byed pa bzlog /g.yas kyi 'og ma ral gri 'bar ba yis/ /khams gsum rbad pa'i lha 'dre thams cad bzlog /g.yon na thod khrag dmar po 'cho ba yis/ /ma mo'i khrag rims dal kha thams cad bzlog /g.yon gyi 'og ma kha ṭī lha dmag bskang ba yis/ /ye shes 'jig rten pho nya'i dmag tshogs thams cad bzlog /khrims kyi cha lugs gsum dang ldan pa yis/ /theg pa gsum gyi rbod stong thams cad bzlog /sgu stod glang chen ko rlon gsol nas 'gying ba yis/ gti mug rmongs pa'i bag chags thams cad bzlog /zhing chen g.yang gzhi sgu la gsol ba yis/ /phrin las rnam bzhi'i bag chags thams cad bzlog /stag gi lpags pa'i pa bsnyul 3—chen po yis/ /nga rgyal dregs pa'i bag chags thams cad bzlog /gdug pa sbrul gyis dbu la brgyan pa yis/ /dam nyams zhe sdang gdug pa'i sbyor ba thams cad bzlog /raka ta'i thig les rab tu brgyan pa yis/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro'i rgyu gzer thams cad bzlog /zhag gi zo ris rab tu brgyan pa yis/ /ging dang bdud kyi sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad bzlog /thal chen tshom bus rab tu brgyan 47—623

pa yis/ /dur khrod bdag po'i pho nya thams cad bzlog /zhabs gnyis dpa' bo'i stangs kyis bzhugs pa yis/ /dregs pa lha chen rnams kyi chad pa thams cad bzlog /pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa yis/ /log par blta ba'i dgra bgegs thams cad bzlog /sku la ye shes me dpung rab tu 'bar ba yis / /las ngan 'khor ba'i bud shing thams cad bzlog /dpral ba'i dbyengs nas bya khyung lding rtab yis/ /sa bdag klu'i byad stems thams cad bzlog /sprul pa'i pho nya sgu las 'phro ba yis/ /snang srid lha 'dre'i rbod stong thams cad bzlog /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma dang / /sha chen spos kyi dud sprin dang / /dmar chen rak+ta arga dang / /tsi ta snying chen rgyal mtshan dang / /dgyes pa'i dam rdzas sna tshogs kyis/ /nag po chen po'i thugs dam bskang / /thugs dam bskang ngo byad kha bzlog/ //hūṃ steng gi phyogs kyi pho nya ni/ /lcags kyi bya khyung nag po la/ /spyan ni khrag mdog bse yi spyan/ /rwa ni rdo rje pha lo rwa/ /gnam lcags thog gi bu yug tshub / /thog dang ser ba'i bdag po byed/ /dam nyams yul du thog ser phob / /bshog pa me yi bu yug 'tshub/ /khro bo grangs med me yi tho ba 'dzin/ /sprul pa'i khro bos rbod stong thams cad bzlog /bshog pa g.yon pa rlung gi bu yug gis/ /sprul pa grangs med 'gugs pa'i be+egs kyu can/ /sprul pa'i pho nya rnams kyis rbod stong bzlog /gnam lcags zhun ma'i mchu sder la/ /me yi tsha tsha 'phro ba yis/ /bshog pa sdabs pa'i rlung gis rab ded nas/ /'jig rten khams kyi rmod ngan spyor ba rnams/ /bzlog byug bsgyur cig rang la bh+yo cig /skye rgyud rtsad nas chod cig /gshog pa ral gri 'bar ba yis/ /rlab pas ngan (7—624

sngags chod cing bzlog /the'u yu 'khor lo 'bar ba drag 'khor bas/ /rbod stong ma lus thams cad g.yul du chod cing bzlog /gzhug sgro gnam lcags 'bar ba yis/ /dam nyams lus ngag yid gsum bzlog cing stubs/ /kri kri hri gyi sgra chen rab sgrogs pas/ /sprul pa drag pos dgra bo dbang basbud pho nyar bzlog /sha khrag dmar kyi gtor ma dam rdzas dang / /sha chen dud sprin bdud rtsi a mri ta/ /dmar chen rak+ta rtsi ta snying chen gyis/ /sprul pa khyung chen thugs dam bskongs gyur cig /thugs dam bskangs la byad kha thams cad bzlog /oṃ ma hā ka la/ mang sa la khā hi/ rak+ta la khā hi/ go ro tsa na la khā hi/ ba su ta la khā hi/ srog adzha la khā hi// //hūṃ ma hā ka la bya rog gdong / /thugs dam gnas nas bskul ba ni/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir phrin las mdzod/ /dpal chen khrag 'thung spyan snga ru/ /khyod kyis khas blangs dam bcas pa/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar byas/ /dam chos legs par skyong bar byas/ /dge 'dun bar chad bzlog par byas/ /sgrub mchog rnal 'byor skyong bar byas/ /dus la bab po byad kha bzlog /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dang / /dgra bgegs sgral ba'i sha khrag dang / /dza gad sman dang bdud rtsi 'di/ /bya rog gdong 7gi zhal du bzhes/ /rnal 'byor bdag la dgra byung na/ /mgon po nag pos ram̐ dha logs/ /byad kha bzlog cig bya rog gdong / /khro kha phyis cig bya rog gdong / /dgra bo sgrol cig bya rog gdong // //hūṃ ma hā ka la mthu bo che/ /sku mdog mthing nag 'jigs pa la/ /zhal gdangs ljags 'dril klog ltar 'khyug /gtum rngam rab tu 'jigs pa la/ /ha 47—625

ha hūṃ dang phaṭa sgra sgrogs/ /dam nyams byad kha rang la bzlog /dus la bab po bya rog gdong / /shin tu gtum zhing rab tu drag /khrag 'dzag mgo bo'i do shal can / /stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs can/ /dug sbrul gdug pa'i ske rags can / /phyag na gri gug thod khrag thogs/ /dam nyams bzhes la byad kha bzlog /dus la bab po bya rog gdong / /bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bo 'di/ /dbang du bsdus la byad kha bzlog /rings par khug la byad kha bzlog/ //hūṃ ma hā ka la bya rog gdong / /khros pa'i gad mo sgrogs pa yis lha srin sde brgyad 'dar zhing dngangs/ /rgyal chen bzhi dang phyogs skyong bcu/ /khrag du skyug cing las la 'dud/ /nag po stong dang sha za 'bum/ /ma mo bye ba'i 'khor bcas rnams/ /rang dbang med par las la sgyug /do nub dam nyams dgra bo sgrol/ /'jig rten mi dang mi men gyi/ /rig 1sngags byad kha rbod stong bzlog /dus 'a/ bab po bya rog gdong / /mgon po'i dam las ma 'da' cig /mgon po'i dam las 'das gyur na/ /dam tshig gnyan po'i chad pa 'ong / /khyod kyi dam tshig gnyan po 'dis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba yin/ /dam nyams sdig can dgra bo 'di/ /bstan pa bshig cing dbu 'phang smad/ /rdo rje slob dpon sgu la rdos2/ /rgyal khams phung zhing sems can 'tshe/ /'di la thugs rjes mi gnas kyis/ /da lta nyid la sgrol las thong / /phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og bcu'i/ /rig sngags byad kha rbod stong bzlog /rig 'dzin rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas kyi/ /bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs bzlog /bzlog cig sdang ba'i dgra la bsgyur/ /ye shes lha yi smod pa bzlog /lha srin sde brgyad smod pa bzlog /lo skag zla skag zhag 47—626

skag bzlog /ban bon ngan sngags byad kha bzlog /mu stegs rbod stong thams cad bzlog /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma dang / /sha chen dud sprin a mri ta/ /dmar chen rag ta snying chen gyis/ /ma hā ka la'i thugs dam bskang / /thugs dam bskongs la skyen ngan bzlog /bya rog gdong can dus la bab/ /skye bo'i ya gar ma btang 1cig /mi nag gi 'char kar ma btang cig /mdos dang gtor ma 'di long la/ /byad kha phur kha thams cad bzlog/ //hūṃ steng gi phyogs nas bzlog pa ni/ /bya khyung 'bum ni lding zhing 'phyo/ /gzhad dang dur bya grangs las 'das/ /bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /bzlog bzlog bar chad rkyen ngan bzlog /shar gyi phyogs nas bzlog pa ni/ /nag po stong gis ru dar 'phyar2/ /bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /bzlog bzlog bar chad rkyen ngan bzlog /lho'i phyogs nas bzlog pa ni/ /sha za 'bum gyi dmag dpung 'chas/ /bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /bzlog bzlog bar chad rkyen rnams bzlog /nub kyi phyogs nas bzlog pa ni/ /ma mo bye ba raka ta rlob/ /bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /bzlog bzlog bar chad rkyen ngan bzlog /byang gi phyogs nas bzlog pa ni/ /gnod sbyin mkha' 'akro'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /bzlog bzlog bar chad rkyen rnams bzlog /ma hā mang sa la khā nyi/ ma hā tsi ta la khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta la khā hi/ a mri ta srog adzha la khā hi/ hūṃ shar phyogs mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas/ /bam chen ro dang nyi stengs su/ /srog bdag nag po bya rog gdong / /sku mdog mthing nag char sprin mdog /mi bzad gdug pa'i 'od zer 'phro/ /phyag g.yas 'bar ba'i gri gug 'phyar/ /47—627

phyag g.yon ban dha dmar gyis bkang / /gdug pa'i snying khrag zhal du gsol/ /shar phyogs rdo rje rigs kyi rbod stong thams cad bzlog /dgra bo'i mgo phreng do shal can/ /yan lag rags cing lto ba 'phyang / /dug sbrul gdug pa'i ske rags bcings/ /zhe sdang rigs kyi pho nya thams cad bzlog /ging chen bco brgyad 'khor gyis bskor/ /dam nyams srog la mnga' mdzad pa/ /shar phyogs dregs pa'i dmag dang bcas/ /dam mnyams dgra'i sha khrag dang / /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma bzhes/ /shar phyogs byad kha thams 1 thams cad bzlog / //hūṃ steng gi phyogs nas bzlog pa ni/ /bya nag mang po mchu sder bdar/ /bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /bzlog bzlog byad kha phur kha bzlog /shar gyi phyogs nas/ bzlog pa ni/ /mon pa nag po 'o dod 'bod/ /bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /bzlog bzlog byad kha dgra la bzlog /lho'i phyogs nas bzlog pa ni / /gshin rje khram kha thogs la rngam/ /bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /bzlog bzlog byad kha phur kha bzlog /nub kyi phyogs nas bzlog pa ni/ /mon pa g.yab dor lings se lings/ /bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /bzlog bzlog byad kha dgra la bzlog /byang gi phyogs nas bzlog pa ni/ /gnod sbyin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas/ /seng stag rgyud 'gral rngam par byed/ bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo / /bzlog bzlog byad kha phur kha bzlog /dam nyams dgra bgegs sha khrag dang / /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma dang / /sha chen dud sprin a mṛ ta/ /rak+ta rnams dang dud sprin gyis/ /srog bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /thugs dam skongs la byad kha bzlog /ban bon ngan sngags byad kha bzlog /47—628

lha srin sde brgyad chad pa bzlog/ /ma hā mang sa la khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ma hā tsi ta la khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta la khā hi/ ma hā zhing chen la khā hi/ a mri ta srog ap+ta la khā nyi// //hūṃ byang phyogs ljang nag gru gsum gzhal yas nas/ /ljang nag me dpung pong dkyil nas/ /gnod sbyin nag po bya rog gdong / /sku mdog ljang nag dug chen 'khyil ba 'dra/ /kha rlangs sngo dmar nad kyi na bun 'khrigs/ /mi bzad gdug pa'i tsha tsha bu yug 'tshub/ /khrag gi ral pa dmar po gyen du 'khyil//ral pa'i bseb nas thog dang ser ba 'bebs/ /g.yas kyi gri gug dam nyams srog rtsa gcod/ /g.yon gyi thod khrag dgra bo'i snying khrag 'thung / /sgu smad dpa' bo stag gi sham thabs can/ /dgra bgegs ma lus dbang du bsdud/ /ljang nag sbrul gyi ske rags bcings/ /gnod sbyin nag po'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /dam rdzas dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /las kyi rigs kyi rbod stong thams cad bzlog /sdig can dam nyams dgra bo la/ /nad dang mtshon gyi char pa phob / /byad kha phur kha bzlog cig bya rog gdong / /dus la bab po bya rog gdong // //hūṃ steng gi phyogs nas bzlog pa ni/ /khra dang bya klag bshog ldang 'khrigs//bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /bzlog bzlog byad kha phur kha bzlog /shar gyi phyogs nas bzlog pa ni/ /khro bo mthing nag bya rog gdong / /sha log cod byed sdang mig lta/ /bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /bzlog bzlog gnod pa'i bgegs la bzlog /lho yi phyogs nas bzlog pa ni/ /seng stag dom dred ce sbyang gzig /spyan zan mang bos sa gzhi gang/ /bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /47—629

hūṃ steng gi phyogs nas bzlog pa ni/ /khyung dang khwa 1da shang shang dang / /bzhad dang dur bya bshog pa sdeb/ /bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /bzlog bzlog byad kha sdang ba'i dgra la bzlog /shar gyi phyogs nas bzlog pa ni/ /dung gi mon pa 'bum ni ral gri 'phyar/ /bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /bzlog bzlog ltas ngan dgra la bzlog/ /lho yi phyogs nas bzlog pa ni/ /lcags spyang 2'bum ni ngu zugs byed/ /bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /bzlog bzlog ltas ngan dgra la bzlog /nub kyi phyogs nas bzlog pa ni/ /bal mo 'bum ni g.yab mo sdeb/ /bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /bzlog bzlog ltas ngan dgra la bzlog /byang gi phyogs nas bzlog pa ni/ /stag gzig 'bum ni rgyug 'dral byed / bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /bzlog bzlog ltas ngan dgra la bzlog /dam nyams dgra bo'i sha khrag dang / /dmar gyi gtor ma a mri ta/ /sha chen spos dang zhun chen dud sprin dang / /dmar kyi raka ta tsi ta snying chen gyis/ /bya rog gdong gi thugs dam bskang / /thugs dam gnyan po skongs nas kyang / /'jig rten lha 'dre mi gsum gyi/ /rbod stong bsam sbyor ngan pa rnams/ /bzlog cig sgyur cig dgra bgegs stengs su bh+yo/ /ma hā mang sa la khā hi/ rtsi ta la khā hi/ rak+ta la khā hi/ ba su ta la khā hi/ go ro rtsa na la khā hi/ zhing chen la khā hi/ srog rtsa la kha ram̐ khā hi// //hūṃ bh+yo lho phyogs ser nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas/ /bam chen ro yi gdan stengs su/ /las mdzad ma mo'i klong dkyil nas/ /bdud mo rtsa 'jib khag 'thung rkang ldag ma/ /sgu mdog dmar nag khrag gi mdog /sngo dmar nad kyi tsha tsha 'phro/ /khrag nad rgyu gzer na bun 'thibs/ /dmigs pa'i dgra 47—63/

la dmag 'dren ma/ /sku la khrag zhag thig les brgyan/ /gsod pa'i mtshon cha lag na thogs/ /rtsa chen bzhi nas rak+ta 'jib/ /nag mo grul bum pho nyar 'gyed / /srid pa'i ma mos dmag sna 'dren/ /dgra bo'i sha khrag stob 1cing 'chang / /dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rin chen rigs kyi rbod stong bzlog /las kyi rlung dmar chibs 2su cibs/ /dam la gnas pa'i grogs mdzad ma/ /bdud mo bye ba'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /lho phyogs rbod stong bsam spyor ngan pa bzlog /nad rims dal kha thams cad bzlog /dus 'dir bzlog pa'i dus la bab/ /dus la bab po khrag 'thung ma// //steng gi phyogs nas bzlog pa ni/ /ye shes ma mos nam mkha' gang / /bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /bzlog bzlog byad kha phur kha bzlog /mdun gyi phyogs nas bzlog pa ni/ /ma mo 'bum gyis g.yab mo sdeb/ /bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /bzlog bzlog ltas ngan dgra la bzlog /g.yas kyi phyogs nas bzlog pa ni/ /ming po las kyi gshin rje 'bum/ /bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /bzlog bzlog byad kha phur kha bzlog /rgyab kyi phyogs nas bzlog pa ni/ /dug sbrul gdug pa shigs se shigs/ /bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /bzlog bzlog bsam ngan dgra la bzlog /g.yon gyi phyogs nas bzlog pa ni/ /mon mo bal mos stong khams gang / /bh+yo stso sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /bzlog bzlog byad kha phur kha bzlog /dus la bab po rtsa 'jib ma/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i sha khrag dang / /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma dang / /sha chen spos kyi dud sprin dang / /rak+ta snying chen rgyal mtshan rnams/ /rtsa 'jib ma tshogs thugs dam bskang / /47—632

thugs dam bskongs la byad kha bzlog /ye shes lha yi rbod stong bzlog /'jig rten lha 'dre'i rbod stong bzlog /ban bon bsam sbyor ngan pa bzlog /tshe dang srog gi bar chod bzlog /khar rje za lha'i bar chod bzlog /ma nyes ngan sgrib thams cad bzlog /bsam spyor ngan pa thams cad bzlog /ma hā mang sa la khā hi/ rak+ta la khā nyi/ rtsi ta la khā hi/ go ro rtsa na la khā hi/ ba su ta la khā hi/ zhing chen la khā hi/ srog a dzha la kha re khā hi/ ces pas phud dang rak+ta dz+reng / stab pa bya'o// //de nas mgon po'i gtor ma snying po can brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas par byas la/sngags pa rnams kyis sha za na'i sngags kyi mthar bzlog ces pa re dang / gtor ma re sbrags la man ngag ltar 'bul la/ drag po'i phrin las 'di btang ngo / /1hūṃ ma g.yel ma g.yel chos skyong rnams/ /khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab//nag po stong gi thugs dam dus la bab/ /sha za 'bum gyi thugs dam dus la bab /ma mo bye ba'i thugs dam dus la bab/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyi thugs dam dus la bab / /gtor ma sha chang la phug dang / /'bras chen ling khar bcas pa 'di/ /re re la yang brgya rtsa brgyad/ /mchod gtor 'bul lo mnyes par mdzod/ /dgra bo'i sha la kha ram̐ khā hi/ bzlog cig byad kha phur kha bzlog /bdud dang gshin rje'i rbod stong bzlog /gnod sbyin ma mo'i rbod btong bzlog /klu dang sa bdag khram kha bzlog /gza' dang rgyu skar byad stems bzlog /btsan dang rgyal po'i chad pa bzlog /smug —dang 'gong po'i gnod pa bzlog/ //hūṃ dpal ldan mgon po nag po ni/ /steng gi phyogs su byon pa'i tshe/ /sprin phung 'khrugs pa'i dur khrod du/ /tshangs pa'i tshogs rnams dbang du bsnyud//47—633

lha bdud 'bum ni pho nyar 'gyed/ /de bzhin rigs kyi mgon po ste/ /sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /steng gi phyogs kyi byad kha bzlog/ //hūṃ dpal ldan mgon po nag po ni/ /shar gyi phyogs su byon pa'i tshe/ /rdo rje rigs kyi mgon po ste/ /gtum drag can gyi dur khrod du/ /dri za ma lus dbang du bsdud/ /srog bsdud 'bum ni pho nyar 'gyed/ /sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /shar gyi phyogs kyi byad kha bzlog/ //hūṃ dpal ldan mgon po nag po ni/ /byang gi phyogs su byon pa'i tshe/ /las kyi rigs kyi mgon po ste/ /tshang tshing 'khrigs pa'i dur khrod du/ /gnod sbyin ma lus dbang du bsdud/ /ging shan ma lus pho nyar 'gyed/ /sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /byang gi phyogs kyi byad kha bzlog/ //hūṃ dpal ldan mgon po nag po ni/ /nub kyi phyogs su byon pa'i tshe/ /pad ma rigs kyi mgon po ste/ /'ur 'ur 'bar ba'i dur khrod du/ /klu bdud ma lus dbang du bsdud/ /tshe bdag nag po pho nyar 'gyed/ /sha khrag gtor mdos 'di bzhes la/ /nub kyi phyogs kyi byad kha bzlog/ //hūṃ dpal ldan mgon po nag po ni/ /lho yi phyogs su byon pa'i tshe/ /rin chen rigs kyi mgon po ste/ /dur khrod dpal gyi nags tshal du/ /gshin rje ma lus dbang du bsdud/ /shan pa 'bum ni pho nyar 'gyed/ /sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /lho'i phyogs kyi byad kha bzlog/ //hūṃ dpal ldan mgon po nag po ni/ /shar lho'i mtshams su byon pa'i tshe/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i mgon po ste/ /ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod du/ /me lha ma lus dbang du bsdud/ bdud rigs 'bum ni pho nyar 'gyed/ /sha khrag 77—637/

gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /shar lho mtshams kyi dgra bgegs bzlog/ //hūṃ dpal ldan mgon po nag po ni/ /lho nub mtshams su byon pa'i tshe/ /rnal 'byor skyong ba'i mgon po ste/ /mun pa mi zad dur khrod du/ /srin po ma lus dbang du bsdud/ /sha za 'bum ni pho nyar 'gyed/ /sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /lho nub mtshams kyi dgra bgegs bzlog/ //hūṃ dpal ldan mgon po nag po ni/ /nub byang mtshams su byon pa'i tshe/ /dam nyams sgol ba'i mgon po ste/ /ki li ki la'i dur khrod du/ /rlung lha ma lus dbang du basbud/ /phra men dgu khri pho nyar 'gyed/ /sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /nub byang mtshams kyi dgra bgegs bzlog/ //hūṃ dpal ldan mgon po nag po ni/ /byang shar mtshams su byon pa'i tshe/ /tshang tshing 'khrigs pa'i dur khrod du/ /tshe dpal longs spyod rgyas par byed/ /'jigs su rung ba'i dur khrod du/ /dbang ldan ma lus dbang du bsdud/ /bgegs chen 'bum ni pho nyar 'gyed/ /sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /byang shar mtshams kyi dgra bgegs thams cad bzlog/ //hūṃ dpal ldan mgon po nag po ni/ /'og gi phyogs su byon pa'i tshe/ /rgyud srungs mdzad pa'i mgon po ste/ /bsil ba 'tshal 1gye dur khrod du/ /sa bdag ma lus dbang du bsdud/ /klu bdud 'bum phrag pho nyar 'gyed/ /sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /'og gi phyogs kyi dgra bgegs bzlog/ //hūṃ nag po stong gi dus la bab po mchod par bzhes/ /byad kha phur kha thams cad sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /sha za 'bum gyi dus la bab po mchod par bzhes—/ /ltas ngan thams cad sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /ma mo bye ba'i dus la 47—63bye

bab po mchod par bzhes/ /rbod stong thams cad sdang ba'i dgra la bzlog /mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi dus la bab po mchod par bzhes/ /bsam sbyor ngan pa sdang ba'i dgra la bzlog /gnod sbyin khri'i dus la bab po mchod par bzhes/ /bar chod thams cad sdang ba'i dgra la bzlog/ /lha srin sde brgyad dus la bab po mchod par bzhes/ /byol kha thams cad sdang ba'i dgra la bzlog /byo bh+yo dgra dang bgegs la bh+yo/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /dam nyams las ngan dgra bo yis/ /bsngags cing rbad pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ /'dir byon blud dang gtor ma bzhes/ /dkon mchog bden pa'i bka' dang ni/ /chos skyong mgon po'i bden pa yis/ /bdag la gnod pa ma byed par/ /byad ma rang gi thog du song / /rang nus rang la smin par gyis/ /rang mtshon rang la bzlog par gyis/ /rang srog rang gis gcod par gyis/ /rang sha rang gis za bar gyis/ /rten pa'i lha rnams bdud du phob/ /grogs byed rnams kyang dgra ru slong / /'dis ni bstan pa bshig cing dbu 'phangs smad/ /dam can spyod la do rdos pas/ /'di'i sdong grogs ma mdzad par/ /mthu dang nus pa rtsal thon la/ /rtsad nas chod la drung nas phyung / /snang srid lha 'dre'i chad pa rnams / /dam nyams dgra yi thog du bzlog /snang srid dregs pa'i rbod stong rnams / /dam nyams dgra'i steng du bye/ /ces thams cad kyis byos btab gzhan yang bzlog pa'i phrin las rnams btang ngo / /zor bsgul gzhan rnams kyang btang ngo / /de nas mdos kyi lam bstan pa ni/ bdag ye shes par gsal bar bsgom// //hūṃ rnal 'byor dbang phyug zor 'phen no/ /bla ma dkon mchog gzu dang 17—636

spang / /dus gsum sangs rgyas gzu dang spang / /yi dam lha tshogs gzu dang spang / /chos skyong srungs ma gzu dang spang / /ma mo mkha' 'gro gzu dang spang / /'jig rten lha klu gzu dang spang / /nga yis ma nyes kho yis nyes/ /nga yis ma lan kho yis lan/ /nyes byed 'di la chad pas chod/ /dgra bgegs dran pa nyams su chug /bh+yo drag po las kyi zor mdos 'di/ /steng gi lha la mi 'phen no / /'og gi klu la mi 'phen no/ /drag po'i zor khar ma byon cig /sa bdag klu la mi 'phen no/ /drag po'i zor khar ma byon cig /rgyal chen bzhi la mi 'phen no/ /drag po'i zor khar ma byon cig /phyogs skyong bcu la mi 'phen no/ /drag po'i zor khar ma byon cig /lha srin yongs la mi 'phen no/ /drag po'i zor khar ma byon cig /drag po'i rtsan la mi 'phen no/ /drag po'i zor khar ma byon cig /lha srin sde brgyad sku zur cig /drag po'i zor khar ma byon cig /'jig rten lha tshogs thams cad kyis/ /nyams pa'i mgon skyabs ma mdzad cig /lha srin sde brgyad ma rtogs cig /mchod sbyin gser skyems 'di bzhes la/ /mdos lam phye la zor sna drongs/ /nyams pa'i mgon skyabs ma mdzad cig /gal te mgon skyabs mdzad gyur na/ /gzer nad khrag sgyugs nyam thag chod/ /mtho ba rnams kyang zhabs yar sgums/ /dma' ba rnams kyang dbu mar chums/ /bar na gnas pa sku zur cig /pho brang rnams kyang sgo chod cig /na bza' lhab lhub mtha' bsdus cig /sku zur de ni spyan byol cig /zor dang mdos kyi lam phye cig /sgo ba rnams kyis sgo phye cig /'phrang ba rnams kyis 'phrang sol cig /da ni zor 'phen gang du 'phen/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /sdang bar byed pa'i dgra la 'phen/ /47—637

byad kha phur kha stong la 'phen/ /gnod pa byed pa'i bgegs la 'phen/ /sgo na god kha phye la 'phen/ /phugs na khyim chags che la 'phen/ /nad 'dre cong sri byed la 'phen/ /mo ngan chags kha phyed la 'phen/ /rmi lam ngan pa la sogs pa'i/ /gang la dmigs pa de la 'phen/ /dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du bzlog/ //hūṃ da ni mdos chen bskyod re ran/ /nag po chen po sgu skyod cig /lha'i las mkhan sku skyod cig /lha srin dmag sna sgu skyod cig /phyibs kha dgra bo'i yul du bsgyur/ /dgra bo'i yul khams dmag gis khong / /sdang byed dgra la sgu zur ston/ /bka'i chad pa dgra la chod/ /thun zor sdang ba'i dgra la chos/ /drag byed 'khor bcas dgra la chos/ /dgra bo'i mi nor cham la phob/ /dgra bo'i yul khams rlag par mdzod/ /oṃ ma hā ka la thun bh+yo/ oṃ ku ru rbad bh+yo/ pra mo ha bh+yo/ ma hā ka la 1thun bh+yo/ ke ka la thun bh+yo/ ka la ra tri thun bh+yo/ zhes gtong ba'i dus su zor sngags las so/ /mgon po bya rog gdong gi gtor mdos/slob dpon 'phags pa klu grub nag pos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //77—638

bsdur mchan/61 9 1 mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang la sa blangs te bkod/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉sgrag /dar 'char/62༷ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉/621 1 〈〈pe 〉〉blangs/ 〈〈pe 〉thasgrub/ 〈〈pe 〉〉chor/ 4 〈〈pe 〉〉chod/ 5 〈〈pe 〉〉rgyu/622 1 〈〈pe 〉〉'ding /623 1 〈〈pe 〉〉pa'i/ 〈〈pe 〉〉sdul /624 1 〈〈pe 〉〉'ding / 〈〈pe 〉〉la/625 1 〈〈pe 〉〉sdong /626 1 〈〈pe 〉〉rigs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉brdos/ 〈〈pe 〉〉rigs/627 1 〈〈pe 〉sngagatang / 〈〈pe 〉〉'char/628 1 〈〈pe 〉7thams/63༷ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉rdzi/ 〈〈pe 〉〉bskangs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉// // 4 〈〈pe 〉〉//631 1 〈〈pe 〉skab/ 〈〈pe 〉〉 nga / 〈〈pe 〉〉byu/ — 〈〈pe 〉skoradag632 1 〈〈pe 〉〉stod/ 〈〈pe 〉〉phyibs/633 1 〈〈pe 〉〉// // 〈〈pe 〉〉stong / 〈〈pe 〉〉sgru/635 1 〈〈pe 〉〉tshal/638 1 〈〈pe 〉〉 /47—639

༄ / /gnod sbyin nag po chen po'i grub —thabs zhas dra/ ba/1ga gnod sbyin nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ka la yak+ṣa ma hā sa dha na nā 2ma/ bod skad du/ gnod sbyin nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje gtum po la phyag 'tshal lo//dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa yi/ /thugs kyi sras cig gtum po la/ /gus pas btud de de'i sras/ /gnod sbyin nag po'i sgrub thabs bri/ /nyon mongs gdug pa'i tshogs rnams la/ /ma lus pa las sgrub pa rnams/ /skad cig tsam las grol 'gyur ba/ /rdo rje 'dzin dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /de las dang por sgrub pa pos dbang dang dam tshig thob cing / dad pa phun sum tshogs pas / bla ma la gdams pa yang dag par blangs cing / the tshom rnam par spangs pas sgrub pa la 'jug par bya'o/ /gnas ni dur khrod dang / brag nag po dang / ri rtse dang nags kyi phug dang / mi ma yin 'du ba'i sa lha brten 47byed641

can du bya'o// //der dang ngo/ bkra mi shis pa'i sa la dkyil 'khor bya ste/ lte ba gru gsum pa gre ri dang bcas pa/ rigs kyis 1 mtshon pa'i sgo dang ldan par bri/mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams te/ gnas brgyan par bya'o/ /de nas dur khrod kyi ras la lha bzo mkhas pas gnod sbyin kyi sku bzhengs la/ de'i snying khar dam tshig bsgul ba'i sngags bris te/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa ka la tsan dha sa ma ya ma nu sma ra sid ti t+t+waṃ ces bri'o/ /de nas phyag gnyis dang zhabs gnyis la dam tshig ban+tu la ba'i sngags ni/ yak+ṣa nga/ ta li ces bri/ k+ṣ-i saṃ bha ra ces bri'o/ /de'i rgyab du/ tad tha tad ya tha/ ā+oṃ bho sgo ban yak+ṣa/ a ti pa ta ye/ i dan rgo lo bha ra bha ra sha ri ram̐/ badz+ra pa ni hri ta ya na/ ya sa ma ti kra ma te/ u sa dha rgo/ bha bi shud dhe/ tad ya thā/ ā+oṃ bhudhe bhudha/ bi bhudha bi bhudhe/ ma hi phra ba ta ha ra ha ra yak+ṣa nan/ pra ha ra pra ha ra yak+ṣa nan/ tshin dha tshin dha yak+ṣa hri ta ya ni/ byen dha bhen dha yak+ṣa dha ma ni/ bi se ma ti/ yak+ṣa sha ri ra ni / bi pho ta ya/ yak+ṣa na ya ni/ tad ya thā/ ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa/ yak+ṣa bi da ra na ya hūṃ phaṭa/ yak+ṣa gro ta swā hā na ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ni lam bha ra sa na ya hūṃ phaṭa/a pra ti ha ta pa la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ba ra kra ma ya phaṭa/ kri tan tā ya phaṭa/ kri tan twa ru nga/ ya phaṭa/ ro sha na ya phaṭa/ tra sa na ya phaṭa/ ku sman na bhod sa dha na ya phaṭa/ pre ta bi shartsa/ bi na sha ka ra ya phaṭa/ yak+ṣa a pa sma ra bi na sha ka ra ya phaṭa/ ha sa ha sa/ dha ra dha ra/ ma ra ya ma ra ya/ na sha ya na sha ya/ sarba bhig nan bi na sha ka ra ya phaṭa/ sarba sha bye saṃ gha bi na ka ra ya phaṭa / ni lo bha ra dha ra badz+ra nga/ ni rata dzha ba ya ti swā hā/ ces rdo rje'i lte ba (7—642

la bri'o// //dam tshig 'chags pa sku'i rten no/ /gsung mi 'gyur ba dam tshig gi rten no//gro ga'am ras la 'khor lo bris nas 'chang ba'o/ /thugs gsang ba'i dam tshig gi rten no/ /khye nag po'i snying du bla rten du sku bzhugs pa'o/ /de nas gtor ma la bcugs 1te/ dar nag pos gur phub la bzhag go// //de nas byang chub sems bskyed la/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ting 'dzin bsgom/ /der rjes dkyil 'khor khang pa ru/ /sum las rin chen ri rab steng / /t+t+waṃ ngam k+ṣa 'am yo las ni/ /'phros 'dus gyur pas rdo rjer bsam/ /de dang rten gsum rgyu rkyen las/ /gnod sbyin nag po zhal gsum pa/ /phyag drug 'jigs pa'i zhabs gsum pa/ /g.yas pa 'jigs byed stag gi gdong / /g.yon pa stobs chen seng ge'i gdong / /rtsa zhal khro bos thams cad bsgrol/ /spyan gsum mche ba rnam par gcigs2/ /dmar ser khrag gi ral pa brdzes/ /phyag g.yas dang po rdo rje 'dzin/ /gnyis pa rtse gsum tha mas phur/ /g.yon pa dril bu lcags kyu 'dzin/ /thod chen khrag ldan zhal du rngub/ /g.yas bsgum bdud mo 'ching byed gnan/ /g.yon pa brkyang pas nyi gdong brdzis/ /phur zhabs me 'bar tsha ba yis/ /bsgrub bya gang yin mgor btab nas/ /tshangs pa'i bu gar phug par bya/ /thod rlon ro'i lpags pa gon/ /dur khrod rus pas lus la brgyan/ /sha khrag la dgyes ha har bzhad/ /mthing nag mi bsrun 'jigs pa yi/ /sprul pa gnod sbyin bye bas bskor/ /bka' nyan las la thogs pa med/ /pad ma 'dab ma brgyad pa la/ /shar nas nyi ma'i gdong pa dang / /skar mda' gdong dang lnga rtsen dang / /ku be ra rnams g.yas kyis 47—6/3

bskor / /dbang ldan gtum 'byin yang dag rgyal/ /yang dag shes dang 'bar gdon bris/ /g.yas pa rdo rje g.yon pa ni/ /rtse gsum ba dan 'phyar ba bsam/ /oṃ lnga/hūṃ gis gnas gsum brlab/ /yi ge bzhi yis ye shes bstim/ /thugs kas rdo rje dbang bsgur byas/ /'bru nag la sogs gtor ma yis /gnod sbyin mchod pa gtor mar brjod/ /slar mnyes bya phyir sngags 'di brjod//oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa ka la tsan dha ni lam̐ bha ra dha ra sha ri ram̐ hūṃ phaṭa/ rtsa sngags 'bum las mi nyung bar/ /rtags dang sbyar la bsnyen pa bya/ /nag po'i tshogs dang snyan pa'i sgras/ /bya dang ba dan sngon po mthong / /gnod sbyin gnas dang gos gter dang / /gzhon pa'i mchog tu sku gzugs gton/ /de byung las la sbyar bar bya/ /rjes dang tsha ba'i 'bru dang tsha/ /'gal ba'i rdzas la ling ga bya//gnod sbyin skud pas 'khor lo gdags/ /dmigs pa bkug bstem 'brub khung gzhug1 /nyungs dkar la sogs thun rdzas kyis/ /dus drug sngags kyis steng nas brab/ /oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa ka la tsan dha ni lo dha 2ra dha ra sarba sha bye bi da ra ya phaṭa / ha ra ha ra phaṭa/ pra ha ra pra ha ra phaṭa/ tshin dha tshin dha phaṭa/r+bhan dha bhen dha phaṭa/ be+e spo ta ya bi spo ta ya phaṭa/ sarba sha bye ka ya bag tsi ta bi na sha ka ra ya phaṭa/ sems can bsad dang shi bcad gdang / /dmag 'dren dbang gdon za ba dang / /bya khras sems can bsad pa dang / /rtags byung gnan pa yang na bsreg /drag po'i sngags btub chopar bya/ /des ni nges par bsgrub bya rnams/ /longs spyod dang bcas brlag par 'gyur/ /gal te las rnams gul ba na/ /rten gsum sa ga gtam bcug la/ /steng nas rdo rje 'dzin pa yis/ /rdo rje'i thogs 5chen 'be+ebs par bsam seng 47—644

ldeng me la gso 3bar bya/ /phrin las sngags kyis gzir bar bya/ /de'i mjug la sngags gsum bzlas/ /gnod sbyin srog gi 'khor lo yang / /rdo rje thogs la brdung bar bya/ /nges par las rnams thogs pa med/ /gal te las kyi tshogs bsgrub par 'dod na/ rgyal rigs kyi thod pa la/hor ram bye khra'i khrag gis gnod sbyin gyi gzugs phrin las dang sbyar la bris te/rtsa ba'i sngags la gang 'dod pa'i ming spel byas la/ rgyas pa la ghi haṃ/ dbang la li khri/ zhi ba la mon sran dkar po'i khu ba/ drag po la dur khrod sol ba/bsad pa la bya khra lcags kyi khrag /rengs pa yung ba/ bkrags pa lug gi khrag gis bris la/ ke che'i mar dang / chang dang / spo so 'cha' dang / pri yang ku'i thang chus bris te/ de thang kar byas la rdo rje 'dzin par bsam/ gcer bu skra bshig la/rgyas pa la me tog ser po/ dbang la dmar po/ zhi ba la dkar po/ drag po la nag po/ bsad pa la dud ka /rengs pa ser skya/ lkugs pa dmar nag /sngags la 4gang 'dod pa'i ming dang spel 5la/ nyi ma re la thun gsum du brgya rtsa brgyad du brdeg na/ zhag bdun gyis 'grub par 'gyur ro// //bsrung ba'i 'khor lo byed par 'dod pas/ dar ram ras la lte bar rdo rje gtum po'i sngags la che ge mo la rag k+ṣa rag k+ṣa swā hā/ zhes rtags te bri'o/ /de'i phyir rtsibs brgyad la gnod sbyin rtsa sngags bri/ mu khyud la bsad pa'i sngags bri/ de'i phyi rol re dmig bcu drug la/ gtso bo'i gsung gi sngags dang / rag k+ṣa re re la sku dang spel 6la bri/ de nas mu khyud la phrin las bri/de'i phyir spyan drang ba'i sngags bri/ de'i mthar ka li/ de'i mthar a li bri/de'i mthar chos kyi dbyings kyi sngags bri/ de gur gum gyis bris la/ 'a/ cha'i 47—6/5

sbubs su bcug la btags na/ phan yon brjod kyis mi lang ngo / /bsad par 'dod na skar ma mgo la bab pa dang / shing lo la sha khog par tshud par bris la/ de nas khyi nag po'i glo ba'i shas gtums 1te/ gnod sbyin gyis bsad sngags la u tsa ta ya/ btags te ri lu brgya rtsa brgyad la rtsa brgyad bzlas nas byin nas/ bya rog mthong ba'i bar du yang bzlas te/ ri lu brgya rtsa brgyad sdogs nas gsod par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rams dang me tog sngon po'i khu ba la rtsa ba'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas khwa skad mi 'don pa la/ spral bar thig le byas na kun gyis mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /yid du 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /'bras chang dang ghi haṃ dang / lta gor sha sna rnams la sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas rang gi snying kar k+ṣa bris nas gnod sbyin rnams kyis stobs dang longs spyod sbyin par byed do/ /mthing ril gyi sgo nga dang / khwa ta'i gung sgro dang / khyi nag po'i chu dang / mtsho bya'i mthu rnams la sngags btab la/ mi khyi'i sgra mi grags 2pa'i gnas su spral bar byugs na mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang bcud len nam mkhar 'phur/ /gnod sbyin gter dang longs spyod dang / /phrin las bya ba sna tshogs pa/ /rdo rje gtum po mnyes pa dang / /gnod sbyin rig pa sdogs pas na/ /rgyud dang bla ma'i gdam ngag las//rim pa rgyas par rtogs par bya/ /gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud dang ni/ /bla mas gdams pa'i gdams pa yis/ /gnod sbyin bsgrub pa'i rim pa 'di/ /rang dga' ma yin nyes pa med/ /gal te 'khrul par gyur pas na/ /bla ma dam pa mkhas rnams dang / /rdo rje 'dzin pa las grub nas/ /rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu'i blos/ /bdag gis nyes tshogs bzod par mdzod// //47—646

bdag gis sgrub thabs brtsams pa yis/ /dge ba dri ma med pa rnams/ /'khor ba'i bag chags gzhom slad du/ /byang chub chen por longs spyod shog /gnod sbyin nag po'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon chen po las kyi rdo rjes kong kha na'i 'od ma'i tshal du/ rang gi slob ma rje btsun chen po thang lo pas gsol ba btab nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi paṇa ḍi ta wa la tsan tra dang / bod kyi lots+tsha 1ba glan chung dar ma tshul khrims kyis gus par bsgyur ba'o// //

bsdur mchan/641 41mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ rgya〈〈pe 〉stan/ rnyi〈〈pe 〉〉sgrubs/642 〉〈〈pe 〉〉kyi/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉dha/643 /—mo〈〈pe 〉〉brtsugs/ 37〈〈pe 〉〉brtsigs/644 1〈〈pe 〉〉nung bzhug sa〈〈pe 〉〉rto/ 〈〈pe 〉sngagacad/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉gtub/ 〉〈〈pe 〉〉thog64ga cinye〈〈pe 〉〉bsro/ ge〈〈pe 〉torajug ge〈〈pe 〉〉wali nga〈〈pe〉〉pa/ skye'u〈〈pe 〉stanapel/646 1〈〈pe 〉〉bstums/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉drag647 1〈〈pe〉〉gro tsha/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (273༷)47wa 648

༄ga /dpal nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 1༄/ dpal nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shri ma hā ka la sa dha na nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khro bo gtum po gdug pa 'dul/ /thugs kyi sprul pa nag po la/ /gus pas phyag byas dgra bo rnams/ /bsad par 'dod pas sgrub thabs bri/ /dur khrod la sogs dben pa'i gnas/ /'byung po gnas par dkyil 'khor brtsigs/ /gru gsum khru phyed mthur sbyobakos la/ /sgrub bya'i rdzas rnams tshogs pa dang / /rang nyid rdo rje 'dzin bsams la/ /mdun du e nang ro stengs su/ /hūṃ las nag po chen po bskyed/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis brkyang bskum bzhugs/ /g.yas pa gri gug nam mkhar gdengs/ /g.yon pa thod pa dmar gyis bkang / /gsol ba'i tshul du thugs khar 5bzung / /mgo bo'i phreng bas do shal byas/ /47—649

kha nas t+t+waṃ brjod dgra bo gsod/ /sha lnga bdud rtsi rnam lnga yi/ /gtor mas mchod la bstod bya ste/ /de rjes phrin las bcol bar bya/ /ā+oṃ ma hā ka la bha ling ta pu tsa bho bye kha kha khā hi khā 1hi/ gtor ma dbul ba'i sngags su gsungs/ /oṃ badz+ra gro ta ma hā ka la yi/ sha t+t+waṃ tsi ta kro ting dun dza/ drag pos gsad pa'i 2sngags so/ /ā+oṃ ma hā ka la ghu na hri ta hūṃ phaṭa/ yi ge'i grangs kyi bsnyen pa bya/ /rtags byung las la sbyar bya ste/ /tsha ba gsum la ling ga bya/ /sgrub bya'i ming rus snying gar bcug /'brub gnas bcug la shi skras btags/ /phur bu dag la stod bya la/ /nyin mtshan tsha ba'i thun gyis brab/ /rtags byung nas ni bsreg pa 'am/ /gnan pa byas par gyur na ni/ /gang yin nges par brlag par 'gyur/ /skabs su phrin las 'dis —yis bskul/ /hūṃ dpal ldan nag po chen po ni/ /bskal pa'i me dpung nang nas bzhengs/ /mi ro'i steng nas sgu byung ba/ /mdog nag thung la bsus pa che/ /yon tan rdzogs pa'i lha khyod kyis/ /dgra bgegs gdug pa myur du bsgrol/ /g.yas kyi phyag gi gri gug gis / /bstan la gnod pa'i snying rtsa chod/ /g.yon pa'i phyag gi thod pa yis//dam nyams rnams kyi snying khrag gsol/ /mche ba zla tshes rab gcigs 5pas/ /'jig rten ma lus za tshul ston/ /spyan gsum rnge'i tsha tsha 'phro/ /gdug pa can rnams bsreg par byed/ /rnal 'byor yongs kyi dgra lha yin/ /bdud 'dul rnams kyi dmag dpon yin/ /dam nyams rnams kyi gshed ma mdzad/ /mna' zan rnams kyi srog dbugs len/ /dam pa chos kyi bsrung ma yin/ /nag po gtum po las la gshegs/ /bla ma la 'khu sems can 'tshe/ /ma lus skad cig tsam kyis kyang / /'di nyid du ni rings par khug /sha khrag nang 47—650

khrol 1ma lus la/ /dpa' bo chen pos myur du gsol/ /sha khrag til tsam ma lus par/ /khyod kyi zhal du gsol bar mdzod/ /gal te de ltar ma byas na/ /khyod kyi dam tshig nyams 'gyur te/ /rdo rje 'chang gi bka' 'das te/ /khyod kyi snying khrag thang la 'thig /de bas dam tshig ma 'da' bar/ /gdug pa'i dgra 'di myur du bsgol/ /zhes pas drag tu bskul ba yis/ /gang la dmigs pa myur du bsgrol/ /thod pa mtshan dang mi ldan par/ /ming rus bris te sngags bzlas pa'i/ /nyungs dkar dug dang bcas blugs te/ /dgra'i sgo khar sbas gyur na/ /zla ba drug na rlag par 'gyur/ /ka ka'i thod par ming rus bcug /sngags bzlas zhing la sbas pa na/ /de'i lo thog nyams par 'gyur / /rabs chad thod par 'khor lo bri/ /sngags kyi btab te dur du sbas / /rigs brgyud ma lus 'chad par 'gyur/ /de la sogs pa las kyi rim / /yon tan sngags kyis byed 'gyur bas/ /rtag tu sngags la 'bad par bya/ /gal te las rnams ma grub na/ /lha'i snying khar rdo rje bsam/ /de las me byung bsreg bya zhing / /sngags rnams bzlog la bzlas pa ni/ /las de thogs pa med par 'gyur/ /grub nas bdud rtsi lnga yis mchod/ /de la sogs pa'i las kyi rim/ /bla ma mnyes las blang bar bya/ /nag po chen po'i yon tan kyi/ /bsgrub pa'i rim pa bris pa 'di/ /bla ma'i zhal las gsungs pa 'di//de'i dge bas phrin las rnams/ /'bad pa med par 'grub par shog /dpal nag po chen po yon tan gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ slob dpon las kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po wa la tsan tra dang / lo tsha ba slan chung dar ma tshul 47—6byesde

༄/ /gnod sbyin nag po chen po la rin po ches bstod pa jes bya ba/1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ yag k+ṣa ka la ma hā stud te rad na nā ma/bod skad du/ gnod sbyin nag po chen po la rin po ches bstod pa zhes bya ba/dpal rdo rje gtum po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'chang la gus btud 2nas/ /thugs kyi sras gcig gnod sbyin rgyal/ /nag po g.yung drung chen po la/ /gus pas bstod pa bri bar bya/ /hūṃ dpa' bo chen po gnod sbyin nag po ni/ /ri rab chen po'i lcog bzhi nas/ /khros pa'i sems kyis sku bzhengs la/ /dgra bgegs bsgol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stobs chen mthing nag 'bar ba'i sgu/ /gsod byed g.yas pa stag gi mgo/ /'joms byed g.yon pa seng ge'i gdong / /gdug pa tshar gcod phyag 'tshal lo/ /'bar ba'i phyag drug g.yas pa na/ /ye shes rdo rjes 'byung po 'dul/ /rtse gsum nyon mongs dug las rgyal/ /gsod pa'i phur bu phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yon pas shes rab dril bu 'khrol/ /'gugs 47—653

par byed pa'i lcags kyu 'dzin/ /gdug khrag kha ru 'dren mdzad pa/ /g.yon pa'i phrin las phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhabs gsum g.yas pas shes rab bdud/ /'ching byed 'dod chags rtsad nas gcod/ /g.yon gyis nyi gdong thabs kyi bdud / /zhe sdang rtsad gcod phyag 'tshal lo/ /phur bus dgra bgegs dmigs pa'i mgor/ /gnyis med bde chen rol pa'i zhabs/ /ma rig rtsad nas gcod mdzad pa/ /rtog med ye shes phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jigs pa'i rgyan ldan ha har bzhad/ /log par blta ba rtsad nas 'byin/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' nyan la/ /'jigs byed khro bo phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig bla ma la smod dang / /sangs rgyas bstan la smad 'byin pa/ /las ngan sems can sdig can 'tshe / /bsgrub pa po la gdung ba rnams/ /skad cig tsam gyis gnod sbyin gyis / /'dir basbus ling ga 'di la bstims/ /nus pa med par srog dang phrol / /snying la sogs pa'i nang khrol rnams/ /rang gi snyim pa bkang nas kyang / /gtso bo nyid la bsnyims pa dang / /ma lus khrag gi rgyun yang 'thung 1//rus pa rkang mar glad pa zhag /ma lus par ni gsol bar mdzod/ /bdag la gnod pa'i bgegs chen rnams/ /bsod 2cing bcing ba ma byas na/ /gnod sbyin dam tshig nyams 'gyur te/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' ma gcag /sangs rgyas rnams kyis dam ma bsgral/ /khyed kyis dam bcas dam bsgral na/ /mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas te/ /snying yang dum bu stong du 'gyur/ /lus la bskal pa'i me 'bar ste/ /sbug bsngal 'gyur bar nges pas na/ /nga'i phrin las myur du gyis/ /bskal du bsnyen pa'i phrin las 'di/ /da lta nyid du thogs med kyis/ /k+ṣa ma na ti dgra bo ma lus pa bi da ra ya bi da ra ya phaṭa/17—654

hūṃ gnod sbyin chen po las la ya/ /nag po chen po las la ya/ /mkha' 'gro chen po las la ya/ /'jigs byed gtum po las la ya/ /thugs kyi sras cig las la ya/ /yak+ṣa rno dbal las la ya/ /hūṃ k+ṣa yak+ṣa sa ma ya phaṭa/ bdag gis bstod pa 'di byas pas/ /nag po'i phrin las grub nas kyang / /skal dang mi ldan sems can rnams/ /chos dang 'gal ba tshar gcod shog /gnod sbyin nag po la bstod pa rin po che zhes bya ba slob dpon ka na ri pas bstod pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po bla ma wa la tsan tra dang / bod kyi lo tsa 1ba slan chung dar ma tshul khrims kyis bsgyur ba'o// 2//

2806༄༅/ /rang gnas pa nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/1༄/ mgon po phyag drug pa'i gzhung rgyas pa rtsod bral snga 'gyur la 'gyur chad bsabs shing 'gyur bcos pa bzhugs so// rak+ṣa/ /oṃ na mo ma hā kā lā ya/rgya gar skad du/ swas+thā na ma hā kā la sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/ rang gnas pa nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ rje btsun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdul dka' 'dul ba sdang mthar byed/ /de yi sgrub pa rab bshad de/ /lha dang 'byung po 'jigs byed cing / /dgra dang bgegs rnams rnam par nyams/ /ma zhes bya ba ni sgyu ma'i dra ba dang sngags can no/ /ha zhes bya ba ni haṃ yig dang srid pa dang mya ngan las 'das pa 'phrog pa'o/ /a zhes bya ba'i yi ge ni saṃ yig dang skye ba med pa'o/ /kā yig ni rgyu las grol ba bde ba dang snying rje chen po'o/ /la zhes bya ba'i yi ge ni/ des skye ba med pa la rnam par rol pa'o/ /de la dur khrod la sogs par nag po chen po bsgrub par bya'o/ /sgron ma lnga dang myos byed la 47—657

sogs pa dam tshig lhag par gnas pas shrī he ru ko3haṃ zhes nga rgyal bya'o/ /yi ge t+t+waṃ las yang dag par byung ba sna tshogs rdo rje dang rdo rje'i gur dang / phyogs thams cad du rdo rje'i me'i 'khor yug bsam mo/ /oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā / srung ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ ṭak+ki hūṃ dzaḥ'adod pa'i rgyal pos bgegs rnams dgug cing bcing bar bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje bdud rtsi phyung la/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭi phaṭa/ tī la ya shī la ya sarba pa paṃ phaṭa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra shī la badz+ra dha ra a dzha pa ya ti sarba bisnan kā ya wañtsi ta badz+ra tī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/phur bus btab pa'i sngags so/ /o badz+ra muṅga ra badz+ra tī la a ko ṭa ya hūṃ t+t+waṃ hūṃ phaṭa / brdung ba'i sngags so/ /de nas ji skad bshad pa'i mchod pa rnam pa bdun dang / /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom par bya'o/ /oṃ shu n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba at+ma kophohaṃ/ stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa las slar yang / 'jig rten mgon po 'o sa bon hriḥzhes nam mkhar bzhag go/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i dbus gnas par/ /dkyil 'khor rdo rje kun skyes bsam/ /rdo rje sprin ni 'phro skyes pa/ /de ru yi ge rgyu bsam mo phyi rol du ni dur khrod chen po'o/ /ngos bzhi dang ni gra bzhir ldan/ /sgo bzhi par ni rnam par brtag /de yi dbus su 'khor lo ni/ /rab tu zlum po bri bar bya/ /nyi ma dang hriḥyig 'ongs pa hūṃ du gyur pa las rdo rje gri gug go/ /de la nag po chen po/ mun pa'i zhal can spyan gsum pa/ gri gug dang phreng ba pa 1dang cang te'u ni g.yas pa'i phyag gsum gyis 'dzin pa/ de bzhin du thod pa dang / mdung rtse gsum pa dang / zhags pa ni g.yon pa'i 'o/ /mnyam pa'i stabs kyi go yig las byung ba'i log 'dren mnan pa sbrul ni mi rus dang dril 47—658

bu'i phreng ba dang / mgo bo'i do shal can/ stag gi lpags pa grol ba/ cher 'khrugs pa/ 'bar ba chen po'i sku/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa pha rol 'joms pa'o / /dpral bar sin+tu ra'i thig le'o/ /nag mo chen mo hriḥlas byung ba/kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang / thod pa 'dzin pas phrag pa nas 'khyud pa/ des byin pa gnyis kyis mkhyud pa'o/ /g.yas su ni gshin rje chos be con dang / zhags pa 'dzin pa g.yon du ni dus mtshan ma'o/ /mdun du ni tri shu la dang ka pā la 'dzin pa dz+wa li nā'o/ /cang te dang thod pa bsnams pa/ zhing spyong ma ni rgyab tu'o / /khu ba dang / khrag dang / bdud rtsi lnga dang / sgron ma lnga ni mtshams su'o/ /sgo rnams su ni lcags kyu mo dang / zhags pa mo dang / lu gu rgyud 1mo dang / 'be+ebs ma'o/ /mtshams rnams su ni/ gshin rje sreg ma dang / pho nya mo dang / mche ba mo dang / be+e con ma'o/ /ma mo dgu ni/gcer mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sku dang gsung dang thugs byin kyis brlab pa'i sngags so/ /k+ṣe dzi khaṃ shaṃ ske/ paṃ yig la sogs pa'i sngags so/ /ye shes sems dpa' dgug par bya'o/ /byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar rtsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang rab tu sgral ba'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje ding bdag sprul/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum rdo rje las byung ba/ /khams gsum dag gis phyag byas pa / /rdo rje dbang bsgur chen po sbyin/ /gsol ba bya ba dang dbang bsgur ba rdo rje'i tshig go/ /mi bskyod dam tshig dbu rgyan la/ /sgom na rab tu mnyes par 'gyur/ /'di ni khro bo thams cad kyi/ /'da' bar dka' ba'i dam tshig go / /oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥsbyang ba'i sngags so/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ byin gyis 47—6pya9

brlabs pa ste phyag rgya'o/ /de la sngags 'di dag ni las thams cad sgrub pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā ka la k+ṣi k+ṣe tra bisnan bi nā ya ka rtsa sngags 'di la rgya dpe gsar pa na 'dra min du 'dug kyang snga ra gyi bod na yod pa/ nyid dbang btsan par byas so/ /hūṃ phaṭa/ rtsa ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ shrī ma hā ka la shwa sa no pa ha ri ṇi e sngo pa sh+yi ma kālhalo ya mi rda rat+na tra ya a pa ka ri r+ṇa ya di pra ta dzñā sma ra se/ ta dā/ i rda duṣ+ṭi/ kha kha khā hi khā nyi/ ma ra ma ra / kṛt+na kṛt+na/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/dī na me ki na mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ phreng ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra nā ra kri kri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa snga gas 'di yang snga 'gyur bod dpe dbang btsan par byas so/ /swā hā/ mkha' 'gro mas dbang du byed pa'o/ /oṃ hūṃ shrī ya/ de bi kā lī kā lī ma hā kā li hūṃ bh+yo/ nag mo chen mo'i 'o/ /oṃ āḥm hā kā lī de bi kā la bikrān+ta kā rā tri tsaṇ+ḍa rū pi rji hūṃ phaṭa/dus mtshan ma'o/ /oṃ dīḥkā la rū pa hūṃ khaṃ/ nyi ma'i bu'o/ /oṃ āḥkro bye ka ya mān+ta ka ha na ma tha bhaljo hūṃ phaṭa/ gshin rje gshed kyis byin kyis brlabs pa'i sngags so/ /thal mo sbyar ba ni nag po chen po'i dam tshig go/ /rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa ni nag mo'i phyag rgya'o/ /bha ga ltar byas pa ni dus mtshan ma'idzo/ /'dzub mo brkyang ba ni chos kyi rgyal po'i 'o/ /phyag rgya 'di dag gis spyan drangs shing /mdun du dam tshig sbyin pa ste/ oṃ badz+ra ha na ha na badz+ra sa ma ya mā ti kra ma hūṃ phaṭa / zhes pa ni sngags so/ /lte bar bha ga la gnas pa'i/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsam par byas na/ bde ba chen por 'gyur te/ 'jigs byed chen po dang / dus mtshan ma mnan pa/ gri gug dang thod pa kha ṭī ga 'chang ma / steng du lta zhing dmar mo 'bar ba'i lus can ma'o/ /'di la ni bzlas pa med de/ gzhan du 'di nyid sngags so/ /gshin rje gshed ni nag po nag 47byed660

dkar dmar ba'i zhal/ 'khor lo dang ral gri dang be+e con dang / mdung dang / sta re dang / thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /dur khrod kyi rgyan dang ldan pa ma te snasnal zhon pa'o/ /gal te dam tshig nyams pa la/ slob dpon rdo rje sems dpas bdag nyid la sogs pa bkru bar bya'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dam tshig dran pa bzlas pas gsol ba bya'o/ /cod pan gyis/ bdag la sogs pa la dbang bskur ba bsgom na/ las dang dngos grub rnams 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang sgrub pa bshad pa/ dbugs dbyung ba dang / dgang ba dang /rengs pa dang / bum pa can gyi las kyis lus dag par bya'o/ /de nas gdol pa mo'am/ gzhan pa'i rigs kyi'o/ /pad+ma can nam/ ji ltar rnyed pa'i mi mo/ bha ga bzang ba/ rtsa mchog dang ldan pa/ lo bcu gnyis ma la sogs pa blangs nas dag par byas te rim pa ni 'di yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i btsun mo'i mchog /spyan la sogs par bsgom par bya/ /yi ge hūṃ dang oṃ dag dang / /s+dzadang phaṭa ni rab brtag bya/ /'od zer sna lngas khyab pa yi/ /pad+ma rdo rje rab bsgom bya/ /mthong ba dang ni reg pa dang / /tsum pa na dang rtag par mkhyud/ /ye shes pad+ma kha bye ba/ /rdo rje sor mo nges par bzhag /'dod chags rdo rje'i tshul gnas te/ /rdo rje'i phur bu nges par gdab / /dbang po gnyis ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /sangs rgyas dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /de nas dpa' bos me tog chu/ /'thungs nas sngags ni rjes dran bya/ /dbugs 'byen brgyal dang rgod pa dang / /sgeg pa'i gar ni ngo mtshar bas/ /phyag rgya lhan cig sgrub pa pos/ /myur du bde ba thob par 'gyur//bu mo yang gsungs pa/ lce sbom mig ni dmar ser la/ /rtsub cing sru ni 47—661

dmar ser yin/ /des kyang grub par 'gyur ba ste/ /rig ma chen mo spyan la sogs / /rtag tu 'dod pa'i don brtson pa/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod dag gis ni/ /ji ltar 'dod pa bsten na 'grub/ /ces gsungs so/ /las kyi phyag rgya'o/ /ba lang sha dang rta sha dang / /khyi sha dag dang sna tshogs pas/ /dkyil 'khor gru gsum byas nas ni/ /gtum mo rang gi lus las byung bas dbyer med pa'i sems bsgom par bya'o/ /chos kyi phyag rgya'o/ /dngos po med la sgom pa rnged/ /bsgom par bya ba bsgom pa min/ /de ltar dngos po dngos med pas/ /sgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ /chos rnams dngos po med pa la/ /chos kyi de nyid kun bshad pa/ /e ma ngo mtshar las byung ba/ /nam mkha' la ni nam mkha' bsgom/ /phyag rgya chen po'o/ /lus dang ngag sems rdo rje la/ /rdo rje 'jam pa rab tu bsgom/ /lus dang ngag sems la spros pas/ /rdo rje 'jam pa 'dra bar 'gyur/ /dpag tshad brgya yi khyen tsam du/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i 'od dag gis/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa yis/ /dag pa'i bdag nyid snang bar 'gyur/ /'di nye bar mtshon pa ni kun brtags te/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /de dag ni bsnyen pa'o/ /de ltar rtag tu goms pa na rig pa'i brtul zhugs spyad pas bdag nyid nag po chen por 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang rje btsun gyi sgu gzugs zla mtshan kyi ras sam/ g.yul gyi ro ras la gsang bas dz+res te byin gyis brlabs nas/nag po chen po gang yin pa de rdo rje slob dpon du bsam pas/ ri mo'i mdun du mchod pa dang / dug dang sha chen po dang gu gul gyi gdug 2pa phul nas 17—662

gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe tra bisnan bi na ya ka ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ nag po chen po nyid 'ongs nas ci 'dod ces smra'o/ /des kyang nag po chen por mdzod cig ces byas na/ bdag nyid nag po chen por 'gyur ro/ /ril bu dang / mig sman dang / ro dang /ral gri la sogs dang / las thams cad ster ro/ /cho ga 'di kho nas nag mo chen mo la sogs pa 'grub par bya'o/ /yang lang tsho dang ldan pa'i bu mo'i mgul nas 'khyud nas nag mo'am/ dus kyi mtshan ma'i gsang sngags dang bcas/ dzā la ya dzā la ya zhes brjod na 'bar bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzung ste spyod pa spyad pas bdag nyid nag po chen po dang mtshungs par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du phyag mtshan rnams dang / lha dang 'byung po thams cad nag po chen po'i bkas mngag gzhug tu bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la k+ṣ-i k+ṣe tra bisnan bi nā ya ka badz+ra a mu kai sā dha ya sā dha ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ mtshon cha sgrub pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe tra bisnan bi nā ya ka ā dzñā ya a mu shaṃ/ ā kar+ṣa ya ā kar+ṣa ya a mu shaṃ sā dha ya sā dha ya phaṭa swā hā/ 'byung po thams cad sgrub pa'o/ /yang na rdul tshon la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor bris nas kyang sgrub ste/ mtshan ma mthong zhing 'jigs pa med pa'i rnal 'byor pas thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro//ci ste ma grub na drag shul sbyor ba bya'o/ /de dag ni sgrub pa chen po'o/ /gzhan yang las kyi sbyor ba phra mo dag kyang sgrub ste/ rtse gabyug tu ma gyur pas kyang ngo / /gshin rje'i 'khor lo dur khrod kyi ras la dug dang khrag dang ke tshe dang / lan tsha dang / dha du ras bri'o/ /lte ba dang khang pa sum cu rtsa 47—663

gnyis la yi ge bcu bdun dang / nag po chen po dang 1gshin rje gshed kyi sngags kyi bskul ba dang bcas pa bri'o/ /yak+ṣe ma me da dza sa do ru yats+tsha ni rā ṇa yo ni ra/ de nyid nya phyis gnyis kyi dbus su bzhag nas bskul bar byas na nyi ma bdun gyis gsod par byed do/ /de bzhin du de dang de'i cho ga las thams cad sgrub pa ste/ 'khor lo 'di ni chen po'o/ /gzhan yang 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ lte bar rtsa ba'i sngags dang / phaṭa a mu ke mā ra ya phaṭa ces bris/kha kha khā hi khā hi a mu kai mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces bya ba la sogs pa yang rab tu bris/phreng ba'i sngags kyis phyi rol nas bskor ba'i 'khor lo 'dis kyang drag shul thams cad sgrub par byed cing / sngags dang 'khrul 'khor 'ching ba dang gcod pa dang / byis pa'i gdon rnams kyi gnod pa thams cad dang / nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad dang / mi mthun pa thams cad bsrung bar bya'o/ /nag po'i bkas ma mo rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / gshin rje rnams dang /srin po rnams dang / lha min rnams dang / 'byung po rnams dang / grong khyer skyong ba rnams bskul nas kyang las sgrub po/ /nag po chen po la gtor ma sbyin te las rnams bsgrubs par bya/ sreg blugs dag kyang dbul lo/ /mi rus las byung phur bu 'am/ /yang na seng ldeng rtse las skyes/ /be+egs las byas pa'i phur bu dag /snying ga nas ni rkang pa'i bar/ /phur bu btab na myur du 'chi/ /dgra bo'i bshang gci las gzugs brnyan byas te/ ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥs 1bkug nas/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe tra bisnan bi nā ya ka badz+ra ki li shī la ya sarba sha trun brnya hūṃ phaṭa/ 'dis gdab po/ /da ni drag shul gyi spyor ba thams cad pa bshad pa nam mkha' rdo rje'i srin 47—664

———po ni/ drag cing khro bo rab gtum dang / /wa dang bya rog sna tshogs dang / /bya rgod khye yis gang bar bsgom/ /me yi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /dgra bo rnams ni skrag par bsgom/ /khams gsum gnas pa'i sems can rnam/sa//sangs rgyas sgur ni rnam bsgoms la/ /dgra bo bsad par bsam nas su// /de nas las rnams brtsams par bya/ /de la dkyil 'khor nga/ de rnams kyis de'i lus btang zhing / de'i bsrung 1ba'i lha rnams kyang bkug nas rang nyid la thim par bya'o/ /phur bus btab cing mtshon chas bcad par bya'o/ /bso/da nams gang gis tshe 'dir srung ba rnams/ kyang sngags/ pas blang bar byas 'a//'byung po gang dag srung ba byed pa rnams la gtor ma sbyin pa dang / phur bus gdab po/ /a mu ka k+ṣa 2 samyu ṭā di rak+ṣa man+t+ra de ba māṃ/ tī la ya tī 'a/ ya hūṃ phaṭa / phur bu bskul ba'i sngags dang / phreng ba'i sngags dang bcas nga/ ni gdab pa'i sngags so/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis de'i lte ba bcad cing /snying ga'i thig le dbye bar bsam mo/ /rgyu ma rkang dang khrag la sogs/ /thams cad drangs par rnam bsgoms te/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs nga/sa mnan//bsgoms na dgra rnams 'chi bar 'gyur/ /bla ma'i zhal gyi man ngag gis mtshon cha drug po dag gis sprin gyis char dbab pa'o/ /gzhan yang mnan pa dang / sdang ba dang / srin ngo/sa 'dzin nga/ dang /rims dang / bskrad pa dang / rmugs pa dang / dbang du byed nga/ dang /bu mo 'gugs pa dang / zhi ba dang / rgyas pa la sogs pa/ de de'i cho gas bya ste skad cig gcig gis 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /dbang bskur ba la 'di sbyin bya / /gzhan du khro bo gtum pos gsod/ /dngos grub kun gyi spyor sgrub nga// /47—663

slob dpon bka' las don yod yin/ /zhes pa 'jig rten dbang phyug ma hā kā la'i sgrub thabs rang gnas pa zhes bya ba de bā a ka ras mdzad pa'o/ /'di'i 'gyur rnying grub chen tshul mgon nyid kyis mdzad pa las/ sngags rnams phal cher zhal bzhes kyi dbang du mdzad pa 'dra bas dkyus na med/mdzad byang bram ze rat+na pha las mdzad ces 'byung ba la bar skabs su mchan bu dkyus su shor ba sogs lhag chad nor skyon shin tu mang po snang ba/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta puṇ+ḍi badz+ra pa'i zhabs kyi rgya dpe dang bstun nas/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas 'gyur chad mang du bsabs shing / g.yar khral du zhus thug byas pa'o / / //

bsdur mchan/657 1 mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/658 1 〈〈pe 〉〉wapa/659 7〈〈pe 〉〉brgyud/66༷ / 〈〈pe 〉mi 'o/661 2skre 〈〈pe 〉〉 gshin rje/ 37〈〈pe 〉sngagazhag662 37〈〈pe 〉〉bdug664 2nye 〈〈pe 〉to/dang / skye〈〈pe 〉〉bsgrub/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉dzaḥ/665 41 〈〈pe 〉〉sung / ge〈〈pe 〉〉tā/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉smugs/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2733)47wa 667

༄/ /rje btsun dpal nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs man ngag mdor bsngus pa/ 1༄/ rje btsun nag ngo chen ngo phyag bzhi nga 'i sgrub thabs man ngag mdor basbus nga/ jes/ bya ba grub nga/'i slo ba dngo na chen ngo/ zhi ba sbas nga/sa mdzad nga/'o// ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ bhaṣ+ṭa raka shrī ma hā kā la sa/ dhī na nga/ de sha sad+dhibe+e/ bod skad du/rje btsun dpa'/ nag ngo/ chen ngo/'i sgrub thabs man ngag mdor basbus pa/ dpal te ru ka la phyag 'tsha'/ 'o// /bskal nga/'i me yi 'phreng bas rab bskor sdang dang lha min gsod byed gtum ngo/ ste/ /char sprin mtshungs sku glog dmar rje 2 'gro ro 'dzin ral gri skyod nga/sa phyugs/ rnams gsol/ /mi bzad mtshon chas bdud tshogs bcom nas thod nga/ra khrag 'thung mchog tu brgyan mdzad pa/ /grub pa kun gyi ma/chog stsol 'jigs/ byed nag po chen pos 'gro 'di skyong bar mdzod/ /sgrub pa ngo/ dang/'a bo'i gnas/ su/ gnas te/ dkyil 'khor gru bzhi la gnas pa'i zlum po bya'o/ /der zur drug pa bha ga'i rnam pa dgod par byas nas/ mchod 77byed668

—pa dang gtor ma bsham mo/ /der yang nag po chen ngo/ 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs te/ khrag gi yon chab dang me tog la sogs pa dbul ba dang / mdun rnam par dag pa dang / gtor ma dang bstod pa byas la/ oṃ muḥzhes gshegs/ su gsol/ de nas byams pa dang snying rje dang dga' ba dang btang snyoms la gnas par byas la/ slar yang bdag med pa'i don la gnas pas stong par bsam mo/ /oṃ shu t+yā ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma kophohaṃ/ de nas mdun du gsang ba'i bris sgu dgram pa dang / bsgom zhing bzlas pa bya'o/ /de'i rim pa ni thogs 2mar dur khrod kyi gzhir mos pa bya'o/ /phyi nas chu skyes dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i mi ro'i gdan no/ /der zla ba dang nyi ma la hūṃ dang gre gug las skyes pa'i nag po chen po rab tu 'bar ba can/ sprin nag dang mtshungs pa/ bya rog dang khyi dang ce spyang gi tshogs spro ba/ spyan gsum pa/ sma ra dang smin ma 'bar ba/ skra ser po brdzes pa/ srin po'i lus can phyag g.yas dag gis gri gug dang / ral gri'o/ /g.yon dag gis tri shu la sbrul dang bcas pa dang thod pa khrag can no/ /stag gi lpags pas smad dkris pa/ sbrul dang / ni rang spu brgyan pa/ rdo rje dang thod pas cod pan bcings pa/ mgo bo'i do shal can/ drag po'i gad rgyangs sgrog pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krungs sam yang na mnyam pa'i stabs su'o/ /de la yi ge gsum dgod pa dang / go cha bcing bar bya'o/ /de nas ye shes pa bkug cing dbang bsgur te/ mi bskyod pas rigs kyi bdag por 'gyur ro/ /yang mchod cing bstod nas sngags bzla ste/so sor bzhi 'bum du bzla'o/ /thun mtshams su yang bris sku la mchod nga/ dang bstod pa bya'o/ /de dag ni bsnyen pa chung ngu'o/ /717—669

de'i rjes su nag 1chen po'i 'khor bkod de/ dam tshig dbang mos mgul nas mkhyud pa/ de ni cang te'u dang thod pa can gcer mo mchog tu sgeg pa mgo bo skam po'i thod pa dang 'phreng ba can/ seng ge dang / na chung dang /gdol pa dang / 'dab chags spro ba nag mo chen mo'o/ /mdun du tsa muṇ+ḍi bung ba'i mdog can/ tri shu la dang / dung chen po thogs pa/ g.yas su dka' bzlog ma 'od dmar 'khrug pa mo/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon du phag mo sngo skya kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang mi'i mgo bo bsnams pa'o/ /nag mo chen po'i mdun du gshin rje nag po ral gri dang zhags pa thogs pa'o/ /g.yas su srin po dmar nag lag na gri gug dang thod pa'o/ /g.yon du 'byung po'i dbang po thal mdog cang te'u dang rtse gsum 'dzin pa'o/ /de dag ni tweḥtsa haḥhe ya ra bye zhes pa'i ye shes las byung ba'o/ /da ni sngags rnams bshad par bya ste/oṃ ma hā kā la hūṃ phaṭa/ dang po'o/ /oṃ ma hā kā la ya na mo hūṃ phaṭa/ gnyis pa'o / /oṃ āḥsaṃ haṃ ram̐ t+t+waṃ phaṭa swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po ste gsum pa'o/ /na maḥsma shan bā se ni/ ma hā kā la a ru tsa rā ya/ tar+ya thā/ tsa le pra tsa le la la khā ya/ de ba liṅga swā hā/ snying po ste bzhi pa'o/ /oṃ ma hā bye ra ba sarba sid bye dā ya ka ḍi hūṃ bye ṭaḥ dngos grub dang rdzu 'phrul bskul ba ste lnga pa'o/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ shas no pa ha ri ṇi/ e ṣelhapabye ka lo3yo i rda/ rat+na tra yā pa ka ri ṇi/ ya ti pra ti dzha/ sma ra se ti dā/ i rda duṣ+ṭi/ kha kha/ khā nyi khā hi/ mā ra mā ra/ kṛt+na kṛt+na/ ban+dha brnya/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/pa tsa pa tsa/ dī na me ke na mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ nag po chen po thams cad kyi 'phreng ba'i sngags te las thams cad byed pa'o/ /oṃ su ra tā sa ma ya shā rī hūṃ hūṃ 47—670

phaṭa swā hā/ nag mo chen po sbyangs shing bod pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ kri/ ṅgi dzi phaṭa swā hā/ nag mo chen mo'i snying po'o/ /oṃ tsa muṇ+ḍi/ dhu ma ke shī bidhudz+dza he/ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ de bdat+ta ā na ya swā hā/ tsa muṇ+ḍi'i 'o/ /oṃ dīḥha hūṃ shrī phaṭa swā hā/ u ma'i 'o/ /hriḥha ha ma tha ma tha ha swā hā/ phag mo'i 'o/ /oṃ hriḥkā la rū pa hūṃ khaṃ/ gshin rje'i 'o/ /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣas kru rang ha pa tsa sum̐ sum̐ swā hā/ srin po'i 'o/ /oṃ ru tra ya ma he shwa rā ya ma ma hu ti hūṃ phaṭa/ drag po'i 'o/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ byin gyis rlob pa'i 'o/ /o ha/namaḥhi / swā hā hūṃ/ bo ṣaṭā he/ hūṃ hūṃ ho/ phaṭā haṃ/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ oṃ/ tri/ mo/hre hri/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭu phaṭu/ ces pa go cha'o/ /oṃ ka la sha a bhi na ya na rgo1/ s+thā rgo oṃ shun+ya tā abyeṣ+ṭhate swā hā/ lha dbang bskur ba'i sngags so/ /hūṃ dhīḥṭ+wāṃ bye/zhes pa ni rdo rje dang pad+ma byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /nye ba'i bsnyen pa'o/ /'dir nag po chen po shes rab ma dang bcas pa bsgom pa ni/ bsnyen pa chen po'o // // bye —de bzhin du 'khor lo bsgom pa ni/ nye ba'i bsnyen pa chen po'o/ /de dag tu sngags gcig ni bye ba'o/ /gzhan dag ni 'bum phrag bzhi la sogs pa'o/ /nag mo chen mo la sogs pa'i ni 'bum du'o/ /de nas ni sgrub pa brtsam par bya ste/ dur khrod la sogs par dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi par dbus su zur drug pa'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de dag tu dbus dang nang gi zur gsum la yi dwags kyi gdan no/ /gzhan ngos kyi grwa la/ma te dang / khyi dang / stag gi gdan no/ /de dag tu mtshan ma bkod la/tho ba dang / dbyug pa dang / pad+ma dang / ral gri ni sgo bzhir ro/ /thod 47—671

pa ni grwa bzhir ro/ /bum pa dang ka pā la dang sin+d+ra ra'i dkyil 'khor dang /gtor ma yang dgod nga/ra bya'o/ /'dir ni mut+pa rabye rab la sogs pa dang /kul+le dang / ku ru rtakul+le dang / ṅka lī yo dang / ha ri yo rnams/ be+egs kyu dang / mda' dang / phur bu dang / shat+ta'i lag can no/ /zhes pa man ngag go/ /bdag nyid de'i dbus su 'dug la/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na / nag po chen po'i drung du/ bdag nyid kyang der bsam ste/ zla ba drug tu bzlas pas ni/ sgrub pa'o/ /de dang bdag nyid gcig tu bya bas/ zhag bdun du rgyun mi 'chad par bsgul ba ni/ sgrub pa chen po'o/ /de'i rjes su dngos grub blangs la dkyil 'khor gshegs nas ci bder 'dug par bya'o/ /gang zhig sgrub pa la gnas pas gtor ma dang mchod pa dang /sbyin sreg rgyun mi 'chad nga/ra bya ste/ de la gtor ma sbyin pa'i sngags ni 'di'o/ /gang byin kyis brlab nga/ dang / bsrung ba dang sbyin pa'i tshe/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i 'phreng ba'i sngags bzlas la/ na maḥs man+ta kā ya wāñtsit+ta badz+ra ṇ+ḍaṃ/ oṃ āḥt+t+waṃ oṃ saṃ ram̐/ haṃ haṃ shaṃ kai ram̐ ram̐ ra ra ma hā ma hā kā la da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa gardza gardza ke sha warta ma ne+e/ i saṃ bā lidṛt+na kṛt+na kṛt+na pā ya oṃ a hūṃ sarba bisnadz+re nā ya ka /oṃ ā kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmya r+ṇa ar+ya nu t+parja twata/ oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ 'byung po'i tshogs pa rnams la ni/ oṃ sarba k+ṣe tra pā la sa ha ga ṇa dru tī bā ling kṛt+na kṛt+na kha kha hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ gang gtor ma sbyin pa dang bzlas pa dang / mchod pa la 'jug pa na dam tshig bsgul bar bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la/ dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥthal mo mnyam par bcing ba dang / rdo rje 77—672

thal mo ni nag po chen po bud med dang bcas pa'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /de nas las kyi rim pa ste las kyi don du mchod pa'i nyin mo bdun no/ /de nas dug dang khrag dang lan tshwa dang nilba dang / ske tshe btags pas/ ro ras la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa gnyis bri'o/ /lte bar snying po bsgul tshig dang bcas pa bri'o/ /'og ma la g.yon skor du/ kha kha de ba dat+ta rmā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ces pa la sogs pa'o/ /rtsibs chan dag la/ dī na me ke na de ba dat+ta mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol du mu khyud la yang de dang 'dra ba be+er yang mu khyud gnyis pa la/ phaṭa de ba dat+ta mā ra ya phaṭa ces pa'o mtshon cha nang du ltas pas kyang ra ba'o/ /de'i bar du gzugs brnyan sngags kyis bskor ba'o/ /bdag dang bris sku lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas pas 'khor lo byin gyis brlab par bya'o / /de nyid thod par bcug la sgrub bya dgug pa dang / snying po dang 'phreng ba'i sngags drag tu bzla'o/ /dug khrag dang / yungs kar dang / ske tshe dang / lcags dang / dur khrod kyi thal ba dang / ro bsregs pa'i rdo dang / gtum po'i thal ba dang / bra bo dag la bzlas pas kyang gtor ro/ /gal te bsrung ba dang bcas par gyur na/ kha spyor dbye'o/ /de nyid bshad par bya ste/ ji ltar lha sbyin dang mchod sbyin sdang bar byed pa de ster te/ khwa dang 'ug pa la gnas pa bri/ 'khor lo rta dang ma he dang / khwa dang 'ug pa'i khrag gis bri'o/ /lha dang sgrub bya'i rdzas kyis kyang byug go/ /kla 1 rnams kyi dur gyi khang pa'i rdzas dang / rus pa dang / ma ṣi ta kyi khrag dang bcas pa nyid lha min gyi rdzas so/ /de nyid gu gul dang / rang byung dang / bshang ba dang / khyi dang / phag gi rus pa dang / ka ping dza' rwa sregs pas/ bdug 47—673

go / /de yang / dong bur sgrub pa na bzang po zhes pa man ngag go/ /yang logs shig tu/ gzugs brnyan dang 'khor lo bri'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa la snyan gsan phab ste mchod nas sngags kyis bskul lo/ /srung ba rnam dag ni/ de ba dat+ta k+ṣa sam+bu ṭi rak+ṣa man+t+ra de ba tañtsa ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes bkug la 'khor lo dang sngags phur bus gdab po/ /de'i dge ba de dag /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lhas skye ba gzhan du 'phang ba'i don du 'chad cing / bdag la rab tu dgug ste/ de ba dat+ta'i srung ba po lha dang lha min ston mos mi 'gu ba de dag dgug cing gzugs brnyan phur bus gdab po/ /de nas rab tu bskul na/ 'grub par mi 'gyur ba dag kyang nyi ma nyi shu rtsa gcig na 'chi bar the tshom med/ yang na 'khor lo de dung chen kha spyor du bcug la dur khrod du sba ba'am sreg blugs su bya'o/ /'khor lo 'di ni drag shul kun byed pa ste/ skrad pa dang / dbye ba dang / gnan pa dang / lkugs pa dang / ma ning du byed pa dang / rims kyis gdab pa dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang srin pos 'dzin par byed pa rnams so/ /smras pa/ dang po dang ni gnyis pa gnyis ni 'bum dang gsum pa de nas bzhi pa bye bar bzlas/ /lhag ma yang ni 'bum phrag mda' dang 'khor ni 'bum gyi bzlas pas bcu gnyis lo grangs kyis/ /dngos grub dang ni las kyi sngags rnams 'bum bcas bye bas phra mo thams cad rab tu 'grub/ /zla drug brtson pas bgegs nyams nyes pa'i zla bas 'byung po thams cad mngag gzhug 'gyur ba 'di ko/ /gzhan ni gang la 'grur shā'agyur ba de de'o rnga mo byedang zung rus sdesbal dang ni lug /ma ning de dang ro langs sngags can ma sogs lus gnas 77—67 /

mkhar gnas mgrin rings khrag dang gzhan/ /lag dang yung ba sbal pa'i khrag bsres tshim gi'i rtsa ba gzhan ni sngar mtshungs snag tsha ste/ /de yi srad bus bcings dang so sor mtshon cha bskul tshig bcas pas las kun rab 'grub 'gyur//ro 'dzin ral gri tram̐ yig ljang khus mtshan pa'i snang bas dngos grub kun bsdus te//oṃ dang tram̐ hri de nas ka pa la dang ra tra de rjes swā hā'i rab sngags ni/ /bzlas pas rigs sngags mnan dang bcas pa tshig par bsams na de yi las rnams thal bar 'gyur/ /bgegs dang sdig pa yang yang sbyangs shing / bdud rtsi'i bum pas sku gzugs rab bkrus sman mchog gis/ /dbang bskur mchod dang gang gang 'khor lo de ltar mchod nas bsrung dang zlog pas gzi nyams 'joms/ /oṃ badz+ra karnyi ka ha na ha na sha bye mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kharge mā ra mā ra mā rā ya mā rā ya sarba bispyon+da hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tri shul dzhan+da bhin+da ma na ma tha phaṭa ho/oṃ/ pad+ma ka pā la sarba dhā na puṣ+ṭi kurban+tu oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ma ru ke ṇa sarba ḍā ki byā ba hā ya ba hā ya hriḥdzaḥ'adi dag ni mtshon cha ste sprin 'thug po spro bas las thams cad 'grub pa'o/ /oṃ pra wa ra haḥdagug pa'i sngags so/ oṃ pa su ga ya li hūṃ/skyod par byed pa'o/ /oṃ kha ṭa pa tsa tra hraḥgasod par byed pa'o/ /oṃ ru a swā bi du paḥrmugs par byed pa'o/ /oṃ saṃ ram̐ shesnaha/ 'byung po 'dul ba'o/ /oṃ dze+e re/ me rengs par byed pa'o/ /oṃ dze+e dze+e dze+e chu rengs pa'o/ /oṃ haṃ dze+e yo swā hā/ ral gri rengs pa'o/ /o he tidz+re he wa hūṃ/ mkha' 'gro ma 'dul ba'i sngags so/ /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa rang rang gi sngags bskul ba dang bcas pa dang / lte bar snying po gsum bskul ba dang bcas pa'o/ /cho ga thams cad ni sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes pas brtag go/ /chu dang me rengs pa ni 47—67pya
