khyem dang lus sam gnas la gdags so/ /ral gri rengs pa ni lus la gdags so / /mkha' 'gro ma dang 'byung po gzir ba ni rtag tu bsgul zhing mnan pa'am bsregs lugs bya'o/ /sngags kyi 'khor lo klu rigs brgyad kyi snying gar bri/rab tu bkug la/ nag po chen po'i gzugs brnyan gyi 'og tu bcug /ri dwags lte ba dang rma bya'i khrag dang / phag gi mche ba btags pa'i chus thal ba dang yungs kar la bran te/ oṃ ma hā rgo ta hūṃ ha/ sarba ban+dha ban+dha a dzñā pa ya tī swā hā/ ces 'bum bzlas so/ /'khor lo bcangs shing yungs kar dang thal ba gang la bsnun pa'i sbrul 'bros pa'am 'ching bar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ mu khaṃ ste bhā ya a mu r+yā baṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ 'khor lo'i dbus su lce bcings pa sbu ti la'i snying gar bcug ste lce la phur bus btab ste/ sngags 'dis bskul ba na lkugs pa las gzhan ma yin no/ /oṃ hri saṃ tsa muṇ+ḍa haḥshrī hūṃ phaṭa/ 'bum du bzlas nas bsgul tshig dang bcas khri bzlas la/ sngon dang 'dra ba'i 'khor lo bcing ba dang / gnam lcags kyi rdo rje la lan stong du bzlas te bcangs na mtshon cha bcings par 'gyur ro/ /snying po'i mthar/ oṃ dza la ya wa hūṃ/ ces bzlas shing / mchod rten gyi drung du gtsang sbrar bcas pas shes pa skye bar 'gyur ro/ /snying gar rdo rje rnon po sgoms la/ snying po'i mthar/ oṃ ba ra ba ra pra ba ra pra ba ra hūṃ/ zhes bzlas pas blo gros mi zad par 'gyur ro/ /sbyin sreg gi bya ba ni gzhan du bstan pa'o/ /gtor ma nye bar spyod pa dang bcas pa khrag dang chang dang sha dang 'bras bu dang dzam+bu lis brgyan pa brgya dang / bkra shis kyi grangs dang / drug cu dang / nyer lnga sbyin pa/ 'byung po'i pā la ta dang bcas pa sbyin na las tha dad pa thogs pa med par 'grub po/ /gang zhig lcags dang seng 47—676

sdeng dang mi rus kyi phur bu mang po dag byas la/ tī li yo bsgrub par bya'o/ /oṃ tshin+da tshin+da/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ dīp+ta tsakra hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pas bsnyen nas/ phur bu rnams la so sor bzlas pa stong dang / thams cad du khri bzlas pa'am 'bum du bzla'o/ /phyis mu stegs byed la sogs pa'i lha'i gzugs brnyan byas la zhag bdun du dgug par bya'o/ /phur bu'i gtso bo la mchod pa dang gtor ma dang sregs blugs dbul bzhin du gzugs brnyan gyi gnas gsum dang / dbang po rnams la phur bu rnams kyi phur bus gdab po/ /dug dang khrag gi dbus su spyings la mchod rten dang ri bos mnan par bya'o/ /'dis ni dgra bo'ang phur bus gdab pa rig par bya'o/ /phur bus bcings pas ser ba'ang srung bar byed do/ /yang k+ṣa yig las langs ka'i bdag po be+e con dang zhags pa dang ral gri dang thod pa thogs pa bsgom 1shing yang dgug ste/ oṃ krang ke ri phaṭa da sha khri ba a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes bzlas la/ bshang ba'i dkyil 'khor dang sha dang khrag dang myos byed/ thod rus kyi bdug pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ badz+ra kar lī rak+ta sī hi ri mi ri swā hā ru lu ru lu bh+yoḥ srin mo rnams kyi sngags so//'dis ni rbod gtong grub par byed do/ /oṃ hwa ri h+ye ma hā yak+ṣi ṭī ye ha ra ha ra pra be+e sha ni swā hā/ lcags kyu dang 'brus dang ne+e'u le 'dzin pa'i 'phrog ma dmar mo gnod sbyin mo brgyad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs te chang bu dang shing thogs la sogs pas mchod par bya'o/ /'dis ni gter chen po dag rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang / 'byung po la sogs pa mngag gzhug gi rtogs pa ji ltar 'byung ba ltar sgrubs na thams cad 'grub par byed do/ /yang nag po chen po mkha' lding gi lus can du byas la/ badz+ra bita ta t+t+waṃ ka ra haṃ ha swā hā/ zhes 'bum bzlas 47—677

shing / phyis klu brgyad kyis rjed par byas pa/ nges par sgrubs te/ bka' tsam gyis char 'be+ebs pa dang gcod par byed do/ /gal te 'khor lo bri bar 'dod na/ dbus su snying po bskul tshig bcas pa bya/ rtsibs brgyad la yang snying po bsgul ba 1dang bcas pa bris la mu khyud gsum du byas la gsum pa'i rab sngags la sogs pas bskor te/ phyi rol 'dab ma brgyad la phuḥ brgyad bkod/re re'ang ming bskul ba dang bcas pas bskor/ phyi rol du sbrul gyi phreng ba dang nag po'i gzungs kyis dkris pa bā ru ṇa'i snying gar bcug la klu gnas su mchod pa dang drag tu gzir na nges par 'grub pa'o/ /oṃ a mṛ ta prabhe a mṛ ta hūṃ/oṃ badz+ra kau wa ma hā kā lā ya hūṃ tsi rā rnyi ba ku ru ku ru hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ ces 'bum bzlas pas dus kyi mun pa bzlog cing ring du 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ go rī ho bhad+dhā mu tram̐ 2sarba go ri ta dzñā rgo dad maṇ+ḍa le s+thā ṭa ye hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/bud med byen gyis brlab pa ste bzlas pas ji srid 'bar bar gyur gyi bar du'o/ /de nas ni nag mo chen mor 'gyur te grub pa'o/ /de bzhin du phyag mtshan dang gzhon pa la sogs pa bsgrub ste/ a mu shaṃ sā dha ya sā dha ya a dzñā pa ya t+t+waṃ ye swā hā / zhes pa'i sngags kyis so/ /bdag nyid ha ri yo gis/ 'khyud pa klu brgyad dang bcas pa'i rnal 'byor las/ sngags kyi mthar nā ga rā dzaḥ phuḥphuḥphuḥphuḥphuḥphuḥphuḥphuḥrdzu dz+rī rdzu spyor mtshams las rdo rje dang pad+ma so so'i 'od kyis rab tu bkug na pho dang mo so so'i mdangs 'phrog par 'gyur te/ the tshom med do/ /thod par ma mo dang bcas pa nag po chen po'i sgu rdo las grub pa bzhag ste/nor dang 'bru dag dang nyi shu lnga pa'i thum por bya'o/ /khrag chen po dang bcas ar+gha brgya dang brgyad gtor mar bcas pas mchod pa dang / lcags sbyangs pa'i 47—678

gri gug /ha na ha na badz+re ṇa'i sngags kyis bsngags pas kha zas dgra bo'i lus su byas pa bcad de zos pa dang / arka'am/ ko bi dā ra'i shing gi ral gri 'bar ba'i sngags kyis bsngags pa dang / kha dī ra'i shing la tri shul byas la dgug pa dang / dbang du byed pa'i sngags kyis bsngags na go rim bzhin du/rgyas pa dang / gsad 1pa dang / gdon rnams 'jig pa dang dbang du byed do / /mi'i thod pa las cang te'u byas la/ ce spyang gi klad rgya dang ri bong gi pags pas g.yogs te/ g.yul du bsad pa'i rgyus pa dang / rā ḍi skras tra 7 ba byas la yang dag par mchod nas/ marka ṭa'i dbang po lnga der blugs na/sngags pas mkha' 'gro ma dbang du bsdu ba dang / 'byung po 'bros pa dang /nag po chen po 'bebs par byed do/ /da ni bris sku'i cho ga 'di yin te/ g.yul gyi ras chen nam/ dpa' bos rin gyis nyos pa me tog dang khrag chen kyis byugs la/ ar+gha'i mchod pa dang / bā la ta lan gsum byas la gsol ba gdab po/ /ji ltar te ru ka'i bris sgu'i cho ga ltar byas la mchod pa dang gtor mar bcas te bzlas pa 'bum kyis 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /sgrub pa po dag gis rab tu 'bar ba de srid du bzlas pas/ nag po bka' mngon du thob ste dngos grub chen por 'gyur ro/ /rab sngags a ki da badz+ra dza ya dza ya hā hā swā hā zhes pa dang bcas pa bzla zhing bdag nyid gser gyi kha dog /bum pa dang thod pa dang / lcags kyu 'dzin par bsgoms nas bdag dang gzhan la dbang bsgur na tshe mchog tu ring bar 'gyur ro/ /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad nag po'i sngags lnga pa bskul ba dang bcas pa lte bar oṃ twe k+ṣiṃ/ de ba daja bā shaṃ ku ru oṃ twe smyu ces pa bri'o/ /de'i phyi rol 47—679

——ke.ut+pa la'i 'dab ma brgyad la ku ru kul+le'i yi ge brgyad do/ /de nas phyi rol du 'dab ma brgyad pa'i pad+ma la oṃ hri m+bi brtsegs mar bris te gro ga la go ro tsa na dang /tsan dan kyis so/ /'khor lo 'di bsgul ba 1dbang du byed do/ /gzhan yang lha mo kupre gur gum gyi mdog can ro langs ma skra 'phyang ba mo/ khrag dang /gur gum dang / pu tro dzi ba'i maṇ+ḍal du dgug go/ /oṃ be+e tā li pu tra sidhi swā hā / 'bum bzlas so/ /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa dbus su liṅga nag po'i sngags bsgul tshig can gyis bskor/ rtsibs la ni rigs can ma'i sngags so/ /bar bar du ni bsgul tshig go/ /phyi rol du a sogs dang / ka sogs dang /rten cing 'bre'/ par 'byung ba'i sngags kyis bskor ba bris la/ bud med sbyang ba dang bkru ba byas la/ de lha mor bsam pas mngal du 'jam dpal bsam zhing / dgug pa dang dbang bskur te mchod nas 'khor lo btags na srid 'phel lo/ /phag mo dang tsa mud+dhā sngags bcas kyi bha ga'i rnam par nag po dang gshin rje'i sngags kyis liṅga gru gsum byas la mchod na/ nor dang dbang phyug dang bsad nga/'i las 'grub po/ /sa hi ka la hriḥ.u ma'i lte bar yi ge lnga bsgoms te 'bum phrag bcu gnyis bzlas la/ 'khor lo pad+ma'i 'dab ma bzhi la yi ge bzhi dang bcas pa dbus su bha ga dang liṅga'o/ /de la hriḥyi phreng bas bskor/liṅga la dhīḥche ge mo ā kar+ṣa ya hriḥ ces pa bris la rab tu bskul na dbang dang dgug pa mtha' dag 'grub cing nges par bud med 'gugs par the tshom med do/ /'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa bsgoms pa'i dbus su zur drug pa la gnas pa'i nag po chen po gdugs dkar po dang 'khor lo thogs pa/ snying gar rdo rje gtsug tor ma la rdo rje gtsug tor kyis yang dag par 'khyud pa steng dang 'og tu nag po chen (7—680

po dang phyogs brgyad du dbang po 'jigs byed la sogs pa rnams ro langs chen po'i rnam par gnas pa rang rang gi chung ma can no/ /dang por gtsug tor chen po dang / rdo rje gtsug tor chen po'i rigs sngags bzlas la nag po'i gzungs kyis byad ma bsad par bya ste/ ma hā kā la bye ra ba bāsba sha /bha dha bhu z-i z-i bhe sgo lha bhaḥbho bho/ byad ma a mu shaṃ mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pas kyang ngo / /phyir zlog chen po'o/ /da ni man ngag cung zad brjod par bya ste/ de la kha cig dpal sdom pa'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom mo/ /gzhan dag ni sems dpa' gsum gyi tshul smra'o//lhag ma ni phra mo dang thig le bsgom par bya'o/ /'ga' 'ga' dag ni/ 'di ni las tsam gyi don te/ de'i phyir gsang ba chen po'i rim pa mi 'dod do/ /zhes smra ba ni yang dag pa ma yin no/ /ci phyir zhe na nag po chen po'i rgyud la mi 'jug go/ /slob dpon dag gis kyang dngos grub dag gi sgrub pa'i thabs byas shing / 'grub par mthong bas 'di ni phra mo kho na ma yin no/ /'dir smras pa/lte bar rdo rje dbang mo rnam par gnas pa me ma dang / gnyid ma dag gnon pa bha gar ni nag po chen po'o/ /spyi bo la yang he ru ka gdan rnam par gnon pa'o//zhal nas zhal dang / rdo rje dang pad+mar 'bar ba dang 'dzag pa'o/ /ma rlung gis lus ni dri med byed/ hā/ rdo rje'i lam nas gad rgyangs sgrog /kā/rkyen dang bral ba dmigs su med/ /la/ rol pa phyag rgya'i bde mchog can/ /lus dri ma med par byed pa ni bum pa can la sogs pa'o/ /thur sel byed pa rnam pa gnyis babyung ngo / /gad rgyangs brgyad ni/ h+la h+la/ ṭīng dīng / t+t+waṃ hūṃ yīḥ.iḥzhes pa'o/ /'di dag phyag mtshan brgyad kyi rim pa yang ngo / /rkyen 47—681

dang bral ba ni rang gzhan gyi de kho na nyid do/ /rol pa ni phyag rgya gsum la sems ma log par mtshon pa'o/ /gzhan yang zhing skyong gi sa bon dag kyang gsang ba'o/ /ces pa be+e rje btsun nag po nyid kyi nges pa'o/ /bzhi pa lnga pa de'i rjes su/ yan lag drug ldan slob dpon 'dod/ /bla ma'i zhal snga'i rim pa las/ /byung gang bde chen rdo rje smras/ /mi bzad srin po gdon dang bgegs kyi mthar byed nyid/ /'jigs byed nag po gzhan gyis mi thub sgrub thabs gtso/ /bshad pa des kyang sgrub po rnams la grub rtsol zhing / /myur du gter dang rdzu 'phrul grol ba'i 'bras thob shog /ces pa rje btsun nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs man ngag mdor bsdus pa zhes bya ba grub pa'i slob dpon shārnyi gup+ta'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //shar phyogs go ra'i paṇ+ḍi ta nir+pā ṇa shrī dang / slob dpon pūṇ+ḍi badz+ra'i zhabs dang / rmongs pa kun dga' snying pos bsgyur nas/ slar yang rgya dpe dang gtugs te 'bru zhus yang yang byas pa'o// maṅga lo//47—682

bsdur mchan/668 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉tsās/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉)sa/669 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bdun/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉thog67༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉 po/671 ①〈〈pe 〉mi rna/ ②〈〈pe〉po/672 ①〈〈pe 〉〉re/672 ①〈〈pe 〉〉ltar/674 ①〈〈pe 〉sta grur/ ②〈〈pe 〉nyapo/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉du/675 ①〈〈pe 〉〉pa ra/677 ①〈〈pe 〉〉sgoms/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉thog678 ①〈〈pe 〉mi ba/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉tra/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉bzhon/679 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bsad/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉dra/68༷ ①〈〈pe 〉〉bas/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2734)47wa 683

༄ga /dpal nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/①ga slob dpon sgra gcan 'dzin bzang pos mdzad pa bzhugs so// ༄ga /na mo badz+ra ḍā kā ya/ rgya gar skad du/ shrī ma hā kā la sā dha na/ bod skad du/dpal nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ rje btsun sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jigs byed dgra rnams nyams byed pa/ /lha min mthar byed nag mo'i bu/ /de la btud nas sgrub pa'i thabs/ /mdor bsdus bdag gis bshad par bya/ /de la dam tshig dang ldan pas/ /dur khrod dang ma mo'i khyim dang / ling ga gcig pa'am/ yang na khyem du sgrub po/ /thog mar dkyil 'khor du myos byed dang sha dang gtor ma dang / me tog la sogs pas yang dag par mchod nas/bdun rnam par dag pa bya'o/ /de nas oṃ muḥzhes gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /oṃ shu n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod de thams cad dmigs su med pa'o/ /de nas byams pa la sogs pas yang dag par bskul te/ chu 47byed684

skyes dang nyin mor byed pa la gnas pa'i/ mchog gi dbang phyug bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor la'o/ /de las bdag nyid nag po chen po/ sprin dang mtshungs pa—/ spyan gsum pa/ skra ser po/ lag pa g.yas dag gis gri gug dang ral gri'o/ /g.yon dag na tro shu la dang thod pa khrag can no/ /stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs dkris pa/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje dang mi'i thod pas thod byas pa/ mgo bo bcad ①pa'i phreng ba can/ rab tu 'bar ba 'khrigs pa'oske/ /mgo bo dang lce'i rtsa ba dang / nu ma'i dbus su/ rigs byed kyi dang po dang / rnam par bcad ④pas mtshan pa dang / mchog gi dbang phyug rnams bsam mo/ /de la sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur ba dang nag po chen po dgug par bya'o/ /yang mchod nas bzlas pa bya ste/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūṃ phaṭa—/ lus bskul ba'o/ /'bum bzlas pas bsnyen pa'o/ /de bzhin du oṃ ma hā kā lā ya na mo hūṃ phaṭa/ phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /oṃ āḥ.oṃ haṃ re hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/tshig bskul ba'o/ /na maḥshā sa na bā se ni/ ma hā kā la a nu tsa rā ya/ tar+ya tha3—/ tsa le pra tsa le la la la la ya de ba liṅgā swā hā/ thugs bskul ba'o/ /oṃ ma hā hai ra ba sarba sidhi dā ya ka ḍi hūṃ rku bye ṭaḥdangos grub sprul ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ tsa mun+ḍi dhu ma ka shī bidhu dz+dza he ha ha bun ha na da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa de ba dat+ta ā na ya swā hā/ tsa muṇ+ḍa'i 'o/ /oṃ hriḥha hūṃ shrī phaṭa swā hā/ dka' zlog ma'i 'o/ /hriḥha ha ma tha ma tha swā hā/ phag mo la sogs pa ma mo'i sngags so/ /sha dang til dang zan dang chang dang sran ma dang / dzamyu li khrag dang bcas pa'i gtor ma bya'o/ /de'i sngags ni 'di yin te/ na maḥs man+ta kā ya wā—t+ta badz+ra rde/ oṃ āḥhūṃ oṃ oṃ rma haṃ haṃ shaṃ shaṃ re re ra ra ma hā ma hā kā la da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa gardza 47—685

gardza ke sha warta ma ne+e yi oṃ bā ling kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍi kṛṇ+ḍa pa ya kṛṇ+ḍa pa ya oṃ yasahūṃ/ sarba bisnan bi nā ya ka oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ/ sarba dharma ṭ+wāṃ ar+ya nut+pan+da tād/ oṃ s+dzahūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ 'di la rdo rje bdud rtsi'i sngags kyis bsrung ba dang bcas pas sbyin no—/ /de nas rab tu bskul bar bya ste/ rje btsun nag po chen po'i phreng ba'i sngags bzla'o/ /rkyen gyi gnas rig bla ma ni/ /byed po de yi lung bsdus pa/ /sgra can ①'dzin bzang gus pas te/ /'bad pas 'di ni gsang bar byos/ /man ngag shin tu rnyed dka' ba/ /nam yang brjod pa ma yin te/ /ti ra'i rigs la rgyud bzhin du/ /bstan na 'bras bu chen por 'gyur/ /ces pa nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs dpal ldan klu'i zhal gyi rim pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar kyi mkhas pa nir+pā ṇa shrī'i zhal snga nas dang / rmongs pa kun dga' snying pos g.yar khral du bsgyur ba'o// maṅga lo//47byed686
bsdur mchan/684 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/685 ①②gcad/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉shā/ ④〈〈pe〉〉waha/686 ①〈〈pe 〉stanacan/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2735)47—687

2809༄ / /'jogs byed nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/1 ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ bye ra ba ma hā ka 2la sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/'jigs byed nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ rje btsun nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo bdud bzhi las rgyal ba/ /gdul dka' ma lus 'dul ba po/ /ma mo'i tshogs kyi kun nas bskor/ /'byung po ro langs tshogs btud nas / /de nyid kyi sgrub pa'i thabs bshad par bya'o/ /dpa' bo'i g.yul gyi sa'am / dur khrod kyi gnas su/ ro'i stan la nye bar 'dug nas/ snying kha'i pad+ma la gnas pa'i sa bon kyi 'od kyi nag po chen po bkug nas mchod par byas te/ phyis rang nyid la bsdu'o/ /de nas ni stong pa nyid sgom par bya'o/ /phyis ni rdo rje'i gur gyi dbus su/ bdag nyid nyi ma la hūṃ mig sman ltar gnag pa bsam par bya'o/ /de las nag po chen po dbyar gyi char sprin dang mun pa ltar gnag pa/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi bzad pa'i zhal gdangs 47—688

shing mche ba gtsigs k+ṇipa/ zhal nas khrag 'dzag pa/ gtum zhing rab tu 'khros pa/ byis pa'i lus can/ sbom thung sus pa 'phyang ba/ mi'u thung /phyag rgya lnga dang / mi sdug pa'i rgyan rkyedang ldan pa/ dang po'i phyag gnyis kyi rdo rje gri gug dang / mgo bo'i thod pa khrag dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ lhag ma g.yas pa'i phyag gi ni/ ral gri dang mdung rtse gsum pa bsnams pa/ g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyi rab bong gi gdan la 'dug pa/ khrag 'dzag pa'i mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ stag gi lpags pa'i smad g.yogs can/ bskal pa'i zhe mtha'i me dang mnyam pa'i 'od/ 'byung po'i tshogs kyi mchog tu brjed par byed pa / de nyid kyi dpral bar ni thig le'o/ /mgrin par ni rnam par bcad pa'o / /snying gar ni hūṃ yig go/ /dur khrod kyi gnas thams cad nas 'jigs byed chen po 'khor dang bcas pa bkug ste bdag nyid la stem par bya ste/g.yon dang g.yas kyi dpung pa gnyis dang lag pa gnyis dang / brla gnyis dang / rkang pa gnyis rnams la ni rim pas nag po'i yan lag bsgrogs byed/gtum po khros pa/ yid myos/ thod pa can/ 'jigs rung / spro byed ste/'jigs byed brgyad po ni rol pa'i stabs kyis gnas pa nus ma rnams la yang dag par mkhyud pa gri gug dang thod pa'i phyag can no/ /lte ba dang / snying kha dang / mgrin pa dang / spyi bo dang / smin mtshams dang / gsang ba rnams su/ kā li dang / kā pā lī bhā dang / kupre dang / ku ru kul+le dang / bi ro dhī nī dang / bi pra tsit+tha ④rnams lha mo'i mtshan nyid rdzogs pa/ 'jigs byed chen po rnams dang mtshungs pa'o/ /kha dang / bshang lam dang / lte ba dang / spyi bo rnams su/ phyag na dbyug pa dang / phyag na ral gri dang /47—689

zhing skyong dang / tshogs kyi bdag po rnams ral gri dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /de ltar sems brtan par gyur gyi bar du sgom par bya'o/ /gal te yid skyo bar gyur na/ sngags bzla bar bya ste/ hūṃ ma hā kā lā ya na mo hūṃ phaṭaḥ'abum phrag gcig gis 'byung po thams cad dbang du byed do/ /bye ba bzlas pas ni nag po chen po nyid mngon du 'ong ngo / /der ni 'jigs pa chen po 'byung ngo / /ro langs dang srin po 'bum snyed kyis bskor te ha ha zhes sgog par byed do/ /der 'jigs par mi bya ste/ khrag chen po dang stsos byed kyi arga dbul bar bya'o/ /'jigs byed nyid kyi mngon du/ sgrub pa po ci 'dod ces bri bar byed do/ /sgrub pa pos smras pa/ bdag nag po chen por mdzod cig ces brjod na de nyid dang mnyam par 'gyur ro/ /'dod pa'i don thams cad byed do/ /rma.a si taṅga sgo ra ba ya na maḥbhi ṣa r+ṇa snye ra ba ya na maḥsaṃ ha ra ste ra ba ya na maḥ ()ru ru snye ra ya na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa snye ra ba na maḥkrodha sgo ra na maḥ.un ma da sgo ra ba ya na maḥku pā lī snye ra ba ya na maḥ (0 kā na maḥkā pā lī ju na maḥkul+la be+e na maḥku ru kulbe be na maḥbi ro dhi bye na maḥbi pra — yi na maḥ 〈beḍaṇ+ḍa na maḥni ste na maḥkhage pā ni ste na maḥk+ṣe na maḥganan maḥ 9)man+d+ranyes/swā hā shrī ma hā kā la snye ra tachu ya mi na maḥ (71ma hā kā la snye ra baṃ pu dza yā mi na maḥ sā yu d+ma ya/ sa ba ha na ya—/ sa pa ri bā rā ya/ shrī dak+ṣi ṇa kā li kā sa nyi tā ya 1ma hā kā la ya na maḥlan gsum pa dizab nyin 6/ga so sor mchod pa bya bar 'dod na/ gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /thig bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan/ /dra ba ra ba rta babs mdzes/ /zur bzhir mdung thung brgyad ldan pa/ /dbus su rdo rje'i 'phreng ba can/ /sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad la/ /zur gsum rnam pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /rnam gnyis rtse mo rna bar ldan/ /sha rus la sogs rab ldan pa/ /dkyil 'khor shin tu 'jigs pa yi/ /dbus su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ /mchog gi dbang phyug rab tu bkod/ /de nas sa 47—690

bon gyi 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo thams cad bkug nas rang rang gi stan la gnas par bya'o/ /lha thams cad kyi ming la/ mgo bor oṃ dang / tha mar ni na ma zhes sbyar ro/ /de nas dang por ni mchod yon dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas me tog la sogs pa ci bde bar phul zhing bstod nas/gtor ma dbul bar bya'o/ /'dir myos byed kyi btung ba dang / khrag chen po'i mchod yon dang / sha sna tshogs pa'i gtor ma/ tshil chen po dang gu gul bdug pa rgyun mi chad par mchod par byed na de la ma hā kā lā dgyes so/ /de nas ni sngags bzla bar bya zhing phyis nas mchod nas sirnyi prad ma te shā na kā li kā pra ṇa babe+e bhe/sid+dhi de hi kṛ pā sā ra ma hā kā la na mo stu te/ stod pa'o/ /gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /gal te slob ma kha cig la byin gyis brlab nyepar 'dod na/ lha'i drangs nyid kyi thod par khrag chen po dang myos byed bsres pa'i chu rang gi sngags kyis snyemangon par bsngags pa bzhag par bya'o/ /gsol ba btab par gyur pa'i slob ma nang du 'ongs pa la bdud rtsi lnga'i chus dkrus te gnas rnams su zig le bya'o/ /de nas lha thams cad kyis sngags kyi chus dbang bsgur bar bya'o/ /slob ma nag po chen po lus kyi lha'i tshogs dang bcas par 'dug pa la sngags kyi bsngags pa'i cod pan dang / mtshon cha dang / rgyan dang / stan rnams sbyin nas/ phyis gsang sngags kyang sbyin nas bzlas par bya'o/ /de la slar yang chus dbang bskur nas/gtor ma la sogs pa thams cad kyi mchod par byas nas 'dis ni bya ba thams cad sdogs pa yin no/ /de nas slob mas kyang yon dbul bar bya zhing / slob dpon gyis kyang byang —ba thams cad bya'o/ /ces pa ni byin gyis brlab pa'i cho ga'o / /ma yig gis ni sgyu 'phrul che/ /hā yig 'di la gzhom med pa/ /kā yig rgyu 47—691

dang bral ba ste/ /la yig rnam par 'phyang ba nyid/ /ces pa ni/ 'jigs byed nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs dpa' bo rgyal po'i zhal snga'i rim pas grub pa'i slob dpon ba ga la'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta puṇ+ḍi nan ①dang / dge slong tā ra nā thas g.yar khral du 'tshal ba'o ②//bsdur mchan/688 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉kho'ajigs byed nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ / ②〈〈pe 〉〉yi/689 ①〈〈pe 〉〉brtsigs/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉brgyan/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉skol ba'i/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉cista/691 ①〈〈pe 〉〉brlabs/ ②〈〈pe 〉nya)/ ①〈〈pe 〉tham/692 ①〈〈pe 〉tonan+da/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〉maṅgālo/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2736)47—692

2810༄༅/ /rnam thos sras rjes su 'azang ba'i gtor ma'i cho ga zhes bya ba/1 ༄/ rnam sras kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i gtor ma'i cho ga bzhugs so/ /༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ bye shra pa a nu dzā pa bhi ti bha li na ma/ bod skad du/ rnam thos sras rjes su 'brang ba'i gtor ma'i cho ga zhes bya ba/bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po gos sngon po can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sa gsum mgon po 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad bcom ldan gos sngon can / /nam mkha' mdzod kyi gter 'chang gnod sbyin kun gyi rje/ /gang gis mtshan thos skyob mdzad lha'i rgyal po phyag 'tshal nas/ /de mnyes bya phyir gtor ma'i rjes bzung nas/ /rjes su 'brangs pa'i cho ga bshad par bya/ /khro rgyal gos sngon rnal 'byor pas/ /yi ge bco lnga'i snying po la/ /bye ba lnga 'bum spyon song nas/ /sngon du 'gro dang byin rlabs sogs/ /gtor ma'i cho ga sngar bstan bzhin/ /sgrub pa pos ni 'dir shes bya/ /de nas mdun du bye las ni/ /47—693

gzhal yas khang gi nang nyid dbus/ /paṃ las pad ma 'dab brgyad bsam/ /lte bar bcom ldan gos sngon dang / /bka' sdod rgyal po rnam thos sras/ /sa bon gnyis las yang dag skyed/ /de'i phyi rol 'dab brgyad dang / /nyi shu rtsa brgyad sum cu gnyis/ /sa bon gnas las de rnams dbyung / /'dab brgyad gnod sbyin gong ras klu/ /phyi rol nyi shu rtsa brgyad la/ /sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad bskyed/ /de'i phyi rol 'dab ma la/ /stobs chen sum cu so gnyis skyed/ /gzhan yang klu dang gnod sbyin rnams/ /bye ba 'bum 'phrag 'khor bcas bsam//de nas rang gi snying ga yi/ /sa bon hūṃ gi 'od zer kyis/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gos sngon dang / /rgyal chen 'khor bcas spyan drang bya/ /hūṃ ri rgyal lhun po'i byang phyogs nas/ /lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas/ /pad+ma mdzes pa'i gdan stengs nas/ /klu brgyad lus snol nyi zla'i gdan—/ /khro bo'i rgyal po sku bzhengs cig /sku la ye shes 'od 'phro bas/ /bskal pa'i me dpung chen po 'bar/ /bcom ldan gsang bdag gos sngon can/ /rnal 'byor sprul pa'i gzhal yas 'dir/ /gdug pa snol ba'i gdan stengs su/ /'phrin las mdzad phyir gshegs su gsol/ /ā+oṃ ni lam bha ra dha ra badz+ra pa ni/sa ma ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ dgug gzhug bcing dang dges par bya/ /de rjes dbang bskur byin gyis rlabs①/ /de nas rgyal po spyan drang ste/ /hūṃ ri rgyal lhun po'i byang phyogs nas/ /lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas/ /rin chen spungs pa'i gzhal yas nas/ /khro rgyal gsang bdag spyan snga nas/ /dpal ldan rgyal chen rnam thos sras/ /btsun mo sras dang blon por bcas/ /bye ba 'bum phrag 'khor bcas rnams/ /sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la/ /sangs rgyas 47—694

bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /sems can kun la sman slad du/ /byang phyogs gnas na bzhugs pa rnams/ /yid bzhin sprul pa'i gzhal yas 'dir/ /'phrin las mdzad phyir gshegs su gsol/ /ā+oṃ bye sha rā ma na ye sa pa ri ba rā/badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ brda' rgyud phyag rgya bcas nas ni/ /bye yig sum cu rtsa bdun sring / /snyong snying 'dod dang mgo sprid dang / /rang rang sngags kyis mchod pa dbul/ /dgug gzhug dbang bskur byin rlabs bzlas / /ā+oṃ ni lam bha ra dha ra badz+ra pa ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ ā+oṃ bye shra ma na ye swā hā/ ā+oṃ dze+e ba pa dz+wa dha ya swā hā/ ā+oṃ purna bha kra ye swā hā/ ā+oṃ ma ni bha tra ye swā hā/ ā+oṃ ku be+e ra ye swā hā/ ā+oṃ sam pra dza na ye swā hā/ ā+oṃ gu nyuhasta na ye swā hā / ā+oṃ pan dzi ta ye swā hā/ ā+oṃ pi tsi kun dha li ye swā hā/ sarba yag k+ṣa/na ga /ashaṃ/ du pa/ pus paṃ/ di paṃ/ gan t+t+waṃ/ ni be+e te/ shap+ta/ oṃ saṃ hūṃ/ i rda bha li gh+ri ha na du/ sa ma ya rak+ṣa du/ ma ma sid+dhi/ me pra yad tsa / sarba karma/ swa ta a mo ka swā hā/ rin chen bdun dang bkra shis brgyad / /bza' btung longs spyod ji snyed kun/ /tshogs mchod rgya chen dbul bar bya/ /rta dang glang po khang bzangs dang / /gser dngul la sogs nor gyi dbyeg /phyi nang gsang gsum rten rnams kyang / /mgon po 'khor dang bcas la dbul/ /der bhan dza na sreg pa rlab/ /ling kha bcas pa dgug gzhug bya/ /phur pas gdab cing mtshon gyis bcad/ /de nas bka' sgo'aphrin las bcol// //hūṃ bzhengs cig bzhengs byug sku bzhengs cig /ri rgyal lhun po'i byang phyogs nas/ /gnam lcags 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang / /dregs pa sgol 47—695

ba'i gdan stengs nas/ /bcom ldan khro rgyal gos sngon can/ /mi bzad drag po sku bzhengs cig /khro bo'i rgyal po 'jigs byed kyis/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs/ /dbang sdud rdul ①du brlag pa'i phyir/ /khyed kyi phrin las dus la bab/ /phyogs bcu kun tu khyab byed pa'i/ /sprul pa drag po 'gyed mdzad pa/ /khams gsum za byed rngam pa'i hūṃ sgra can/ /shin tu mi bzad khro chen 'jigs pa'i sku la ye shes 'od 'bar bas/ / bskal pa'i sneme 'bar lam se lams/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs ma lus 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /zhabs brgyad brkyang bskum khro bo'i tshul du bzhugs/ /dregs pa stobs chen ma lus gdan ①du mdzad/ /rigs drug sems can phyogs skyong bcu/ /lha chen brgyad dang klu chen brgyad/ /khro bcu 'bar ba'i gdan stengs na/ /klu chen brgyad kyi lus bsnol nas/ /pad ma nyi zla 'bar ba'i dbus/ /bcom ldan sku'i cha lugs bstan pa ni/ /shin tu mi bzad khro bo 'jigs pa'i sku/ /dgra bgegs 'dul mdzad phyag mtshan sna tshogs bsnams/ /g.yas kyi phyag brgyad 'bar ba na/ /gsod cing sgol ba'i phyag ca ni/ /rdo rje dbyug tho glang chen mche—/ /nyi ma'i 'khor lo lcags kyu dang / /sdom zhing 'dzin pa'i phyag rgya ste/ /zhags pa gsal shing ④gril chen dang / /bya khyung 'phan dang rgyal mtshan bsnams//zhal bzhi shin tu khros dupa ni/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi rdzogs par mdzad/ /rnam thar sgo gsum mtshon pa'i phyir/ /zhal gsum khro rgyal rngam pa'i zhal/ /chos nyid mi 'gyur steng zhal gnag /ral pa dmar ser gyen du 'bar/ /mi bskyod rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs/ /gdug pa 'bar ba thod du bcings/ /sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa'i phyir/ /rtse gsum 'bar bas dbu la brgyan/ /47—696

smin ma dmar ser gyen du 'bar/ /stobs chen ma lus kun 'dul bas/ /sma ra ag tshom dmar ser rtsub/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs 'joms pa'i phyir/ /zhe sdang chen po 'khrugs pa'i rtags/ /spyan rtsa me ltar 'bar ba yis 'gro drug thugs rjes gzigs pa'i rtags/ /spyan gsum sdang dmigs bgrad pa yis//srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i rtags/ /khro gnyer dpral bar bsdus pa ni/ /dregs pa chen pos 'dul ba'i rtags/ /shangs nas rdo rje'i rlung nag 'tshubs pa ni/ /stong gsum log 'dren thams cad 'thor ba'i rtags/ /ljags ni glog dmar 'khyug pa yis/ /zhal nas sngags rgod drag po 'don pa'i rtags/ /dbugs 'gyu me ltar 'bar ba ni/ /'khor ba'i bag chags sreg pa'i rtags/ /'jigs pa'i ya sos ma mchu mnan pa ni/ /khams gsum dregs pa dbang du sdud pa'i rtags/ /a la la yi gad rgyangs sgrog 1pa ni/ /log 'dren bdud sogs rengs par mdzad pa'i rtags/ /mthing nag zhal du sbrul nag gsol ba ni//log 'dren gdon gsum zhal du gsol ba'i rtags/ /shin tu 'jigs pa'i khro mchog sku nyid la/ /klu rigs sbrul brgyad sku la brgyan pa ni/ /rigs bzhi'i klu rnams dbang du sdud pa'i rtags/ /rab 'jigs stag gis sku smad dkris pa ni / /zhe sdang srin po dbang du sdud pa'i rtags/ /dar kha sngon pos stod g.yogs byas pa ni/ /rdo rje rigs kyi khro bor bzhugs pa'i rtags/ /shin tu mi sdug gshin rje'i cha byad can/ / bskal pa'i tsome dpung nang na dregs shing 'gying / /dbang po nyi ma 'phrag par khur ba ni/ /yon tan thams cad sku la sdogs pa'i rtags/ /zhabs brgyad rdo rje'i gzhi la btams 1pa yis/ /sprul pa'i pho nya phyogs bcur 'gyed pa'i rtags/ /bcom ldan sku yi cha stod nas/ /47—697

khyung dang khra 'ug 'ol ba dang / /shang shang dur bya kang ka'i tshogs/ /nam mkha' lding gi tshogs chen 'phro/ /gnam be+egs 'bar ba'i mchu sder gyis/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs snying nas 'dzin/ /khro rgyal thugs dang skyed pa las/ /rdo rje dbyug tho btun ṭ+wāshing thogs/ /'khor lo rtse gsum bsnams mdzad pa'i/ /khro bo khro mo'i tshogs su 'phro/ /dam las 'da' byed dgra bgegs la/ /lnga phung yan lag rdul du rlogakye /khro rgyal sku yi cha smad nas/ /stag dang dom dred glang chen sprul/ /seng ge chu srin 'jigs pa'i tshogs/ /gcan gzan gdug pa'i tshogs su 'phro/ /bstan pa gshigs pa'i dgra bgegs kyi/ /sha khyag rus pa'i lta ba chom/ /de ltar sprul pa 'gyed mdzad pa'i/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gos sngon can/ /dri med skyon bral phyag 'tshal stod// // hūṃ sngon tshe bskal pa dang po la/ /'dzam gling 'go ba'i mi rnams kyi/ /tshe lo brgya pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /shakya seng ge'i spyan snga ru/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen mang —/ /thugs dam zhal bzhes dgongs mdzad pas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /'gro ba kun la phan rtags phyir/ /ri rgyal lhun po'i byang phyogs nas/ /i la ni 'dra'i zhing khams su/ /lcang lo can gyi pho brang der/ /yab cig rnam mang thos pa dang / /lha mo dpal tshul bzang mo yi/ /sras su skye bar smon lam btab/ /smon lam las dang mthu stobs kyis/ /byang phyogs skyong ba yongs kyi rje/ /lha rgyal sras kyi thu bor 'khrungs / /lcang lo can gyi pho brang der/ /gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje yis/ /mthu stobs rtsal bar dbang yang bskur/ /bstan pa bsrung bar dam yang bcas//sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la/ /mgon po nor 'chang stobs po che pho 17—698

brang lcang lo ldan pa'i bdag /dbus ma'i pho brang sum rtseg gi/ /rtse mo rin chen nor bus brgyan/ /zur bzhi rim gsum khang brtsegs dgu/ /rnam pa bco lnga'i mchog gis spras/ /rin chen khang brtsegs sgo bzhi ste/ /ka ba stong phrag bcu gnyis brgyan/ /pho brang phyi rol phyogs mtshams na/ /bum pa bzang po dpag bsam shing / /rin chen rdzing bu 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /spos kyi glang chen thal skya dang / /gh+ri ba ban glang ma he'i tshogs/ /rta dang shing rta skad snyan dang / /de na lha rdzas rol mo 'byor/ /phyi rol dpag tshad nyi shu na/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i ra bas bskor/ /dbus ma'i rin chen pho brang na/ /gter skyong rgyal po gzi brjid can/ /sku la rin chen brgyan gyis spras/ /btso ma gser mdog 'od zer 'bar/ /chibs su seng ge dkar mo chibs na bza' chu dar sngon po gsol/ /phyag g.yas rin chen dbyug to bsnams/ /gnod sbyin 'byung po rdul du rlog /phyag g.yon gser gyi ne le bsnams/ /sgrub pa po yi re ba bskong / /zhal nas rin chen char pa 'be+ebs/ /thugs rjes phongs pa sgrol bar mdzod/ /phrag gong g.yas g.yon nyi zlas brgyan/ /nyi ma 'bum gyis tūgazi mdangs can/ /dbu skra ral pa'i thor rtsugs la/ /sna tshogs rin chen brgyan gyis spras/ /sku la gser khrab ser po gsol/ /zhabs g.yas sems dpa'i dkyil krung bzhugs/ /seng ge kha dngas yal le yal/ /lce ni bar snang glog pas 'khyug /g.yu ral sngon po me stag 'phro/ /lcags kyi sder chen shad de shad/ /seng ge'i 'khyug tshul zhungs se zhungs/ /seng ge'i nga ro cher sgrogs shing / /dar zab stan cha phu ru ru/ /ha dar lcang sngon lhabs se lhabs—/ rgyal chen sku'i g.yas phyogs nas/ /lha mo tshul bsrung zla 'od bzang //47—699

rgyal chen sgu'i g.yon rol nas/ /lha mo mdangs ldan me tog bzang / /btsun mo yang g.yog me tog bcas/ /bu mo stong phrag drug cu ste/ /la la rgyan dang rol mos 'byor/ /la la lhab lhub na bza'i tshogs/ /rgyal chen steng na lding ba ni/ /tshangs pa'i bya rgyal ka ru na/ /gser gyi khyung chen 'dab gshog bzang / /gnam lcags ra dang mchu sder can/ /mkha' lding rgyal po gser gyi spyan / /sder mo gnam be+egs rdo rje yis/ /klu rgyal 'dab bzangs zhal du gsol / /'khor ni tshangs pa'i bya rgyal 'bum/ /lus ngan rgyal po'i sras chen po/ /kun tu rgyal ba mi la zhon/ /sku mdog dmar nag 'bar ba la/ /na bza' mtha' be+er 'khor lo ris/ /phyag na zangs zhags mdung thung bsnams//srin po zangs kyi ral pa can/ /'khor mang gnod sbyin bye ba 'bum/ /btsun mo sras dang blon por bcas/ /nang mi dmag dpung gzhon rmyepar bcas/ /pho nya yang g.yog bran mo rnams/ /bcol ba'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ /dbang phyug chen po lha chen po/ /chibs su seng ge sngon po chibs/ /sku mdog dmar ser 'thing gi ral pa can/ /drang srong stobs chen phyag bzhi pa/ /seng ge dkar po'i stod g.yogs la/ /phyag na rtse gsum 'khor lo bsnams/ /u ma dang yang lhan cig bzhugs/ /'khor dang lha dmag bye ba 'bum/ /khyod ni dmag dpung chen po ste/ /dmag dpung skyed la ru dar phyor/ /glang chen rab tu brtan pa la/ /legs ldan nag po'i dmag dpung zhon/ /lha dang gnod sbyin dmag snyud cing / /grong khyer sum rtseg 'jig par byed/ /lha min g.yul las rgyal mdzad pa/ /phyag na gser gyi be+e con bsnams/ /'khor ni lha dmag bye ba 'bum/ /spyod ni dmag dpon dpung chen ste/ /dmag dpung bskyed la 47—700

ru dar phyor// //hūṃ rgyal chen las la bskyod tsam na/ /chibs su sngon po phur kar chibs/ /bse sga sgrug po wangs se wangs/ /gse mthur smug po khyugs se khyugs/ /mi mgo rta mgo phru lu lu/ /gser gyi blo nan khyugs se khyugs/ /mu men yob chen khra la la/ /na bza' mtha' be+er dmar ljang la/ /sbrul nag sha chings byengs se brengs/ /'dzam bu chu bo'i gser sga la/ /rin chen mang po'i rgyan cha can/ /stag ral g.yas la gzig zhubs g.yon/ /sku la bse khrab smug po gsol/ /stag gi g.yang gzhi phru lu lu/ /phyag na bse mdung smug po rnams/ /bse mdung gnam lcags rdo rje rtse/ /rgyal po chen po'i phyag g.yon na/ /rin chen shel gyi mchod rten bsnams/ /mi'i rgyu zhags sha ra ra/ /rgyal po'i 'phrag gong g.yas g.yon na/ /nyi ma zla ba'i 'od zer 'phro/ /sku mdog mthing nag gzi byen can/ /dbu skra ma thing ral thor tshugs la/ /rin chen bse yi rmog zhu can//zab chen 'phan dar lhabs se lhabs/ /rgyal po'i snyan cha g.yas g.yon nas/ /sbrul nag chun 'phyang phru lu lu/ /khros pa'i spyan gsum sdang dmig gis/ /ltas pa tsam gyis srid gsum 'jig /khro gnyer smin ma dpral bar bsdus/ /khros pa'i shangs ni ngub kyin 'bud/ /sma ra ag tshom me ltar 'bar/ /zhal nas drag sngags ku cho 'byin/ /rgyal po'i bka' lung thang cig gis/ /klu rigs 'bum sde'i dmag dpung sdud/ /rgyal po'i bka' lung thang gnyis kyis/ /lha dmag bye ba 'khor du sdud/ /nyid kyi bka' lung thang gsum gyis/ /gnod sbyin 'bum phrag dbang du sdud/ /rgyal chen bzhugs pa'i sku mkhar ni/ /rin chen bse'i sku mkhar la/ /mi mgo'i kha bad yengs se yengs/ /sku mkhar de 47—701

yi rtse mo na/ /bse mdung dmar po ldems se sdems/ /bse'i mdung bzang rtse mo la/ /mi snying rgyal mtshan ye re re/ /bse'i mdung bzangs skyed pa la/ /dar nag ba dan lhabs se lhabs/ /dar nag ru mtshon phyar tsam na/ /lha min 'bum sde g.yul ngo bzlog /sku mkhar de yi zur bzhi na/ /mi snying rta snying hri li li/ /sku mkhar de yi logs bzhi na/ /mi khrag rta khrag sha la la/ /sku mkhar de yi 'gram bzhi la/ /mi ro rta ro brums su brtsigs/ /sku mkhar de'i nang shed na/ /rta btags skad 'don tse re re/ /mi btags 'bod dang lhang nge lhang / /srog gcod ngu skad stongs se stongs/ /brag cha skad ngan tse re re / /sku mkhar de yi g.yas rol na/ /gnod sbyin zangs kyi ral pa can/ /'khal ma snying gi nang khrol gyis/ /snyim pa dag ni yongs su bkang / /lag na zangs kyi bcu sta thogs/ /yid la gnag pa'i dgra bo la/ /bcu stas rdeg cing zhags pas bzung hūṃ/ /sgu mkhar de yi g.yon logs na/ /gnod sbyin nag po skad rdangs can/ /ral pa spyi bcings lcags kyis so/ /mi lpags g.yang gzhi gos su gon/ /lag na lcags kyi dgra sta bsnamasarngu / /yid la rnag pa'i dgra bo la/ /dgra stas mgo dang yan lag chod/ /sku mkhar de'i rgyab logs na/ /phung byed sbas pa'i ma mo bzhi/ /kun kyang srin mo khrag mig ①ma/ /khrag gi ral pa sa la 'drud/ /kha nas khrag lang gron mo sgyug /lag na zangs kyi sru gri bsnams/ /yid la rnag pa'i dgra bo la/ /spu gris mgo dang snying rnams gshogs/ /sku mkhar lcags kyi sgo mo la/ /zangs kyi tha ram si li li/ /sgu mkhar de yi sgo srungs la/ /srin po zangs kyi mche ba can/ /byu ru'i ral cig gnam du 'greng / /sbrul nag pags pa'i stod g.yogs la/ /lag na 47—702

lcags kyi tho chen thogs/ /yid la rnag pa'i dgra bo la/ /tho bas snying dang yan lag chom/ /sku mkhar de yi g.yas logs na/ /lcags seng g.yal gyin mche ba 'dar/ /sgu mkhar sgo mo'i g.yon ngos na/ /lcags kyi dom nag ngu zhing zugs/ /sku mkhar ya khang rtse mo la/ /lcags kyi khyung chen sngon po cig /mchu sder dgra bo'i snying la 'jums/ /sgu mkhar ba gam logs bzhi na/ /bya nag mang po phur hūṃzhing lding / /sgu mkhar de yi yang stengs nas/ /rgyal pos g.yab mos btab tsa na/ /gnod sbyin gdug pa'i blon po brgyad/ /rgyal po'i mdun na rgyug pa ni/ /gnod sbyin chu dbang bum pa'i lto/ /sku ni gser mdog 'bar ba la/ /mtha' be+er ljang sngon shing lo ris/ /gser gyi ska chen khyugs se khyugs/ /phyag na ban dha spu gri bsnams/ /chibs su dmar nag zhur po chibs/ /klu rigs 'bum sde'i dmag dpon mdzad/ /khyod ni dmag dpon 3chen po ste/ /dmag dpung skyed la ru dar phyor/ /rgyal po'i g.yas nas rgyug pa ni/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon gang ba bzang / /sgu mdog ser nag 'jigs tshul can/ /mtha' be+er sgrug nag glang chen ris/ /bye ru'i ska bzangs khro 1la la/ /mu men chun 'phyang sha ra ra/ /phyag na bum pa bzang po bsnams—/ /dmar ser 'dongs po chibs su chibs/ /'khor dang gnod sbyin 'bum gyis bskor/ /spyod ni dmag dpung chen po ste/ /dmag dpung bskyed la ru dar phyor/ /rgyal po'i rting nas rgyug pa ni/ /sde dpon chen po nor bu bzang / /sku mdog dmar zhing gdangs pa la/ /mtha' be+er sngon po seng ge ris/ /zangs kyi ska bzangs khyugs se khyugs/ /phyag na shel dkar sku gdung bsnams/ /chibs su sngo nag zhur bo chibs/ /'dod khams lha bran 47—703

gtso bo ste/ /'khor du hūṃlha bran 'bum gyis bskor/ /khyod ni dmag dpung chen po ste/ /dmag dpung skyed la ru dar phyor/ /rgyal po'i g.yon nas rgyug pa ni/ /rta bdag chen po ku be+e ra/ /sku mdog sngo nag 'gyed pa la/ /mtha' be+er dkar skya gzha' tshon ris/ /dngul gyi ska bzangs khro la la/ /phyag na bse phub ral gri bsnams/ /dbu la dar smug 'gying zhu gsol/ /chibs su mtshan dmar 'dongs po chibs/ /'khor du gshin rje 'bum kyis bskor/ /khyod ni dmag dpung chen po ste/ /dmag dpung skyed la ru dar phyor/ /sde dpon rgyal ba'i khyu mchog ni/ /sku mdog dmar skya 'jigs tshul can/ seng ge dkar po'i stod g.yogs la/ /stag chen rngam pa'i sham thabs can/ /sbrul nag ska chings khyugs se khyugs/ /lcags kyi rnga mo chibs su chibs/ /gnam be+egs 'khor lo phyag na bsnams/ /g.yon pa zhags 'debs sha ra ra/ /'khor dang gnod sbyin drug 'bum ste/ /khyod ni dmag dpon chen po ste/ /dmag dpung skyed la ru dar phyor/ /sde dpon chen po lngas rtsen ni/ /sku mdog ser skya rab 'jigs byed/ /mtha' be+er kar ljang skar mda' ris/ /dar nag ska bzangs bdun yug 'phyar/ /phyag na rin chen khang bzangs bsnams / /dbu la dung rmog sul mdas gsol/ /leb rgan cod pan lhabs se lhabs/ /chibs su rag pa phud mar chibs/ /'khor ni dri za bdun 'bum ste / /khyod ni dmag dpon chen po yin/ /dmag dpung bskyed la ru dar phyogasasnye / /gnod sbyin dbang po yang dag shes/ /sku mdog ser zhing dngas pa la/ /na bza' mtha' be+er lcags thag can/ /leb rgan dar kyi sku rags can—/ /dbu la rin chen rmog zhu gsol/ /phyag na gnam lcags dgra sta 47—704

bsnams—/ /dkar po rngog dmar chibs su chibs/ /'khor ni ma mo 'bum gyis bskor/ /khyod ni dmag dpung chen po ste/ /dmag dpung skyed la ru dar phyor / /'brog gnas rgyal po ser skya ni/ /sngo zhur 'khyug pa chibs su chibs//sku la dar nag ber chen gsol/ /rin chen gser gyi ska bzangs can/ /phyag na bse mdung smrag po bsnams/ /zab chen ba dan lhabs se lhabs/ /dar sngon cod pan pu ru ru/ /mi zhon rta zhon srin po'i dmag /drug 'bum brgyad khye dag gis bskor/ /khyod ni dmag dpon chen po ste/ /dmag dpung skyed la ru dar phyor/ /dmag dpon pi tsi kun dha li/ /sku mdog dkar gsal gzi brjid ldan/ /na bza' ha dar pho long ris/ /bse' rmog rin chen dngul sga can / /phyag na gcod pa'i ral gri bsnams/ /chibs su ngang pa phung dmar chibs—/ /'khor ni drang srong 'bum gyis bskor/ /khyod ni dmag dpon chen po ste/ /dmag dpung skyed la ru dar phyor/ /gnod sbyin gdug pa'i blon po brgyad—/ /bye ba 'bum phrag bcas 'khor bcas rmyebasnams/ /sngon tshe bde gshegs spyan snga ru/ /bstan pa bsrung bar dam du bcas/ /'dod pa sgrub par zhal gyis bzhes/ /thugs dam skul lo rgyal po nyid/ /gdug pa'i klu dang gnod sbyin tshogs/ /las la skos so sha ra ra/ /rgyal po rta dmag gshegs tsam na/ /khu sgra tho le lhangs se lhangs/ /dga' ba'i gtam sgrogs cha ra ra/ /mi rkun sgyugs pa tshe re re/ /gsod gcod gtam ngan di ri ri/ /brda' sgra drag po chems se chems/ /rta rgyug rmig sgra hrabs se hrabs/ /srin po mi zan rngam pa'i gzugs/ /srin mo mi bzad cho nges 'debs/ /mtshon thogs mang po gnam la 'phyar/ /la la lcags kyu zhags pa thogs/ /gzhu bdungs mang po 47—705

khye li li/ /sprul pa'i brda' sgra 'u ru ru/ /gnam lcags skar mda' hribs se tribs / /srin po gnod sbyin bya gag gzugs/ /gcan gzan gzugs kyi sprul pa rnams/ /mi sdug bzhin ston tshe srog gcod/ /bye ba 'bum gyi dmag dpon rnams/ /las su sangs rgyas bstan pa srung / /zas su sha dang khrag la rol / /snying brtse med par sgol la brtson/ /longs spyod dbugs dang mdangs la rol/ /thugs dam brgyud nas rnal 'byor bdag bskul lo/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las myur du grub par mdzod/ /sdang ba'i dgra bo las ngan 'dis / /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'di yis bshig /dkon mchog dbu 'phang 'di yis smad/ /sdang ba'i dgra bo las ngan 'di/ /ri rab zom dang rgya mtsho'i gting she/ /gang dang gang du gnas pa der/ /mi dang lha ru khyed kyis phyes2 / /lus dang sems su khyed kyis phrol/ /gnam gyi 'ju thag khyed kyis chod / /sa'i rten phur khyed kyis phyung / /dug mda' 'phongs cig dus la bab / /rgyal po las la bskyod pa na/ /rnga chen rdung zhing dril bu bsgrol zhe/ /dung 'bud zangs dung cha lang gdab/ /dar phyar sgyugs pas gdab par bya/ /rgyal po las la bskyod pa'i tshe/ /rta dul dar shing chag pa dang / /dar phyar sgyugs pas gdab par bya/ /blon po yul gyi rgan rabs rnams/ /'khro sprug 'debs shing ngu ba dang / /ltas kyi rim pa byung ba na/ /spogs pa'i cho ga brtsam par bya/ /rang nyid khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis/ /rgyal po'i rten rnams 'og du gzhug /hūṃ bye shar ma na ye/ a nu ra tsa ku ru hūṃ/ gsang ba'i snying po brgya rtsa brgyad/ /sems dpa' dam tshig phyag rgya dang / /dmag dpon las kyi phyag rgya dang / /gnod sbyin gzir ba'i phyag rgya yis/ /khro bo gzir ba'i gzungs sngags kyis/ /47—706

'khu na sngon 'gro'i cho ga bya/ /rgyal po gzi brjid che ba dang / /ltas kyi rim pa bzang ba ni/ /'dod pa'i don rnams 'grub pa'o/ /'phrin las drag tu bcol ba dang / /gang 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ /rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyis rjes su 'brang ba'i gtor ma'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa rdzogs 15// 1 //bsdur mchan/693 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/694 1〈〈pe 〉zasab/695 lha 〈〈pe 〉skaragu/696 1〈〈pe 〉radul/ pya〈〈pe 〉rdzal ba'i/ ge〈〈pe 〉7rtan/ ④〈〈pe 〉lkeng / ⑤ 〈〈pe 〉thakhros/697 lku〈〈pe 〉〉sgogs/ rjo〈〈pe 〉ga la ba'i/ la 〈〈pe 〉sngagatams/698 ① 〈〈pe 〉༄na/ pyi〈〈pe 〉sngadul du rlogs/ 1〈〈pe 〉7/699 1〈〈pe 〉〉gyi/7byeX 1〈〈pe 〉ra zhon/7༷2 ①〈(pe 〉〉rgyang / ⑤〈〈pe 〉rams/ phya 〈〈pe 〉ramig7༷3 ① 〈〈pe 〉ra phur/ rte〈〈pe 〉rapung / 1〈〈pe 〉lta/7༷4 ①〈〈pe 〉rang / 'u 〈〈pe 〉tsār/ zhu 〈〈pe 〉radangs/7༷5 1〈〈pe 〉7bcas/7༷6 1〈〈pe 〉staXng / 3〈〈pe 〉7)/ zu 〈〈pe 〉thagrol/7༷7 lha〈〈pe 〉ra maṅgālo/47—707
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2737)47wa 708

༄ga /glang po rin po che la nor blang ba'i man ngag ces bya ba/lha༄/ yid bzhin nor bsgrub glang chen bcas chog bzhugs so/ /༄4 / /rgya gar skad du/ haste glangapocherd na rin po che dha rgo nor ye ti blangab/u pa dhe sha man ngag na ma ces bya ba/ bod skad du/ pyaglang po rin po che la nor blang ba'i man ngag ces bya ba/ dgos 'dod ma lus 'byung ba'i rin po che/ /rin chen bdun las khyad par 'phags/ /gter mdzod khyod la phyag 'tshal lo /dbul ba'i sdug bsngal sel 'dod cing / /gang zhig nor rdzas sgrub 'dod pas/ /gter mdzod 'di la 'bad par bya/ /glang po gter mdzod ces bya ba'i/ /nor sgrub gang zhig byed 'dod pas/ /bsreg thub rdza sa bzang po la/ /rad na sna lnga bdar byas te/ /rgya gar glang po che'i gzugs/ /nyam bag cho shing lta na mdzes / /yan lag thung shing gsus pa che/ /mgo la yid bzhin nor bus brgyan—/ /mkhas pas nang dang ldan par bya/ /de nyid me yi smin bya ste/ /47—709

de yi nang du gzhug lkupa ni/ /sngags dang rdzas su shes par bya/ /dang po sngags kyi mtshan nyid ni/ /grub na gser gyi bri bar bya/ /ma grub rgya shog dkar po la/ /rgya snag lard na gsal dag gis bri bar bya/ /dri bzang lnga yi tsa nan bya/ /de yi sngags ni 'di lta ste/ /oṃ ma ha ha ste phyard na sarba sibye dzupha la hūṃ / rad na pu ne+e sebye sidhi hūṃ/ rin po che gter gyi dngos grub chen po thob par gyur cig /dha rgo me dhi hi sidhi hūṃ/ nor zas dang longs spyod kyi dngos grub chen po thob par gyur cig /na na khed dhi sidhi sidhi hūṃ/ kha zas kyi mchog chen po thams cad kyi dngos grub thob par gyur cig /dha la sa sbo sidhi sidhi hūṃ dza dza/ 'khor dang longs spyod kyi dngos grub chen po thob par gyur cig/bkra shis par gyur cig /sar+ya dre dan/ bi dza ye bi dza ye ug ge ug ge swa sti tra pa ti a khu me/ pra sa ra dha/ swa dhi/ pra ha khe/ mu de mu ne+e gu ra de gu ra ne+e/ a khe mu khu khe mu ra ge myu ra ge/ swa ste gur na yā/ sarba pa ste bye bye bye/sri snyi sri ste/ mu le mu le/ ke she ke she/ tsur na/ tsur na/ bhi ma le swā hā / oṃ shaṃ ka ra/ shaṃ ka ra/ nir gad tsa ta ni/ nir gad tsa ta swa sti/che ge mo zhes bkyi ba'i khyim 'di ru/ pho brang rin po che'i gter gyi gang bar gyur cig /'bru dang longs spyod kyi 'char ⑤'bab par gyur cig /'khor dang longs spyod sprin ltar 'du bar gyur cig /bu tsha dang rigs rgyud thams cad dar shing rgyas par gyur cig /snyan pa dang grags pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur cig /rkyen dang bar chad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig /tshe ring nad rnged bde skyid phun sum tshogs par gyur cig /tshe srog brag pas sra bar gyur cig /longs spyod 'phrul dga'i lha dang mnyam par gyur cig /47—710

zas nor thams cad rmye 'phel bar gyur cig /zas nor gyi dbyig chen po thob par gyur cig /mi nor zas gsum kyi lud cing gang bar gyur cig /'bru'i bang ba thams cad kyang til kyi ga'u bzhin du gang zhing 'phel bar gyur cig /'thor ba thams cad sdud 1cig /nyams pa thams cad sos cig /zad pa thams cad snon cig /dma' kyeb thams cad khong cig /khengs pa thams cad slud cig /dmu yad kyi zhag chen po phob cig /bde legs phun sum tshogs pa 'byung bar gyur cig /de nas rgya shog dkar po la/ /rin chen sna bdun bris byas la/ /rang rang rgyab du sngags 'di bri/ /oṃ 'khor lo rin ngo/ chetsakra rad na pha la/ sidhi hūṃ/ oṃ norabu rin po che ma hā rad na pha la swa ti hūṃ/oṃbatsun mo rin po che bhi hi rad na pha la sri ti hūṃ/ oṃ blonaporin po che ma hā rad na pha la se ti hūṃ/ oṃ glangaporin po che ha ti rad na/ pha la si ti hūṃ/ oṃ dha na rta mchog rin ngo/ cher ga ma sha rad na si ti pha la hūṃ/ oṃ gha ti rad dmagadapon rin po che na pha la si ti pha la hūṃ/ gzhan yang rgya shog dkar po la/ /bkra shis rdzas brgyad tshang bar bri/ /de nas glang chen khog par gzhug④ /gnyis pa rdzas kyi rim pa ni/ /bre srang phyug po rin po che'i spyi bye spyi srang dang dgu'i breg pa dang / /phyug po dgu'i zhing sa mu ma chen po'i khang sa dang / /'phan midar ba'i po dgu'i zhing sa khang sa dang / /gser dngul zangs lcags dung dang ni/ /man shel byi ru mu tig dang / /'bru gro til dkar nag sna lnga dang dar zab dang / /zas sna mang bzang bapo dag dang ni/ /dkar 'o ma zho dang mar gsum dang ni mngar ⑤karabu ram sbrang gsum dang / /mdzo dang dre'u ma gtogs ⑥pa/ /phyug ma zal phyags dgu yi spu/ /rta dang ra lug bzang po'i sru/ /'bri g.yag gnyis kyi sru dang ni/ /bzang drug sman dang me tog dang / /phyug 47—711

po bdun gyi nas 'bru dang / /bkra shis 'dzom pa'i nor rdzas dang / /ma lus glang chen khog par gzhugatshosna /rten 'byel snying po brgya rtsa brgyad/ /bzlas la gong gi rdzas la gdab/ /de nas zhabs sdom legs par bya/ /sum cu rtsa ting 'dzin gyi spyan drangs pa gsum lha yul nas/ /dgos 'dod ma lus 'byung ba yi/ /glang po rin chen spyan drangs la ha ti rad na sa ma ya hūṃ dza zhes pa 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus/ /de la gnyis su med par bstem/ /bstem pa'i rdza'i glang po de/ /glang po rin chen nyid du 'gyur/ /gyur pa'i bdag gi 'dod pa kun/ /glang po de las 'byung bar bsam/ /dgos 'dod kun 'byung 'byung ba de/ /rang gi mdzod dam phugs su gzhug 3bzhag zer/ /nas tshugs sam ni nas kyi khengs pa'i bang ba bang mdzod gzhugadu/ /bzhag pa'i thabs ni 'di ltar ternyi/ /dar sna lnga'i sna nas gdag /seng sdeng phur pa sor bzhi la/ /glang po rin chen bstod la bzhag /de la rab gnas ye dharma dang ting 'dzin gal che gong ltar bya/ /'brang rgyas byas la bkra shis gsol/ /de tshe de'i nyin par la/ /glang po'i rtsa gzhi dang rab gnas byed tsa na nor rdzas gter ba byung gyur na/ /shin tu rten 'brel bzang bas raban/ /dngos grub chen po 'byung ba'i rtags/ /de nas rdza'i glang po de/ /mi yis mthong bar mi bya zhing / /'gom shing tho yugs mi btang srebar/ /shin tu ces bkras ldan par bya/ /mi lag 'brim par mi bya'o/ /de ltar byas pa'i yon tan ni/ /bdag nyid shin tu dbang phyug cing / /longs spyod 'phrul dga'i lha dang mnyam/ /ci bsam thon gyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /sems can kun gyi smon par 'gyur/ /nor zas sprin ltar 'du bar 'gyur/ /mi rgyud nags tshal bzhin du rgyas/ /nad dang gdon las grol 'gyur te/ /bde legs phun sum tshogs par 'gyur/ / 17—712

mdor na yon tan ma lus kun/ /glang po rin chen nyid dang mtshungs/ /de phyir 'di la 'bad par bya/ /'di las dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung / /glang po rin po che'i nor gyi char 'bebs pa zhes bya ba/ zas nor longs spyod tshe dang bsod nams thams cad sprin ltar bsdud pa'i man ngag /'byor pa smu yad gter dang sprod pa'i gdam ngag /shin tu zab pa'o/ /sngags kyi mchod/oṃ ma hā hā ste rad na sarba sidhi pha la ba shar ku ru hūṃ hūṃ/ ces shog bu la mang du bris la/ glang po che'i nang du gzhug ①go/ /bdag 'chang ba po'i longs spyod dang / 'byor pa thams cad spel cig bya'o/ /'phags pa klu grub kyis mdzad pa'o//ske //

sngag /tshogs kyi bdag po'i sgrub thabs 'khor lo chen po zhes bya ba/①༄/ bla ma gser gling pas mdzad pa'i tshogs bdag gi sgrub thabs lags so/ /༄go—/ /rgya gar skad du/ ga ṇa pa ti pa tra ma hā sā dha nā ma/ bod skad du/tshogs kyi bdag po'i sgrub thabs 'khor lo chen po zhes bya ba/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid tshogs kyi bdag po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag 'tshal dpal ldan tshogs bdag dgyes/ /dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung bas nor bu rin chen lta bu yi/ /gsang balnga/ tshogs bdag bsgrub pa la mang du yod na'ang tha/gas ma ཿdzag 'di dag gser gling pa chos kyi grags pabadag gis bshad/ /mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'igang zag sgrub papos des sems can gyi don du blos slangs la/ /yida'onganyams dga' ba'i gnas su rdzas gong du stan pa'i yo byad la sogs pa'i bsags te/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i dkarala'abol ba'i sa la ni/ /dkyil 'khor gcung ma gru phyar ba bzhikhru bzhi pa bor sngags pas/ /de dag la ba yi rnam lngas byidoralegs par sbyangs pa/ /dbyibs dbusamatho tsan dan la sogs pa'idri yis spras par bya/ /lha yi 47—715

grangs dang kha dog bzhin pame tog dgod lha'i gdan dkar po'o/ /mchod pa bzang podang gtor ma'i tshogs chenapo la sogs pa/ /bshams nas gser sogs dngul lam khro chung bdag gi lha re re la rten dang mchod pa yang re re la sogs pa sbyor ba rdzas bsag pa'o/ /lnga/na bye na 'a/sa/ /byu/sa pa'i rten ni tshogs par ①mtshangab med par bzhugs/ /de nas 'od zer 'phros pa dang bcas pasabadag nyid rnal 'byor pas/ /'jigarten mgon po'i rol pas legs par bstod pas gnas la/ /rang nyid skyon thams cad kyis ma gos par mcho skyes zla ba'i steng / /thugs ka'i sa bon yi ge hriḥdakar las ni 'od lasa'aphros pas/ /'jig rten mgon po burtse thams cad dang ba rdo rje swa ta dpag tu med pa la sogs dang / /tshogs kyi bdag po 'di dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor bcas la/ /ming gi snying po sbyong bar tshogs bdag gi gha na pa ti ye k+ṣa la sogs pa'i 'jug tu 'di dag brtags pas byu1/ /ces la 'di btags pas lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas sdom /ste 6) mtha' ma yis/ /'jig rten mgon po la sogs pa rnams spyan drangs bya lam khams dang ni/ /mdun gyi rten sgramapa la la yang bzhugs par bya/ /de nas byams pa la sogs pa tshad med pa bzhi tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi dang / /nor bsgrubs nas dbul 'phongs kyi sdug bsngal bsal bas byang chub sems/ /cung zhig bsgoms nas rnam dag yanalagabadun pabya'o/ /oṃ chos nyid kyi sngags swa bha ba bi shudhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bha ba bi shurnyo haṃ/ lan gsum brjod pas stong par bsam/ /snang ba'i rang bzhin 'diltar sgyu mar gnas/ /ga sogs dam tshig pa bskyed pa yī k+ṣa dang na ga la sogs pas sa bon 'od 'phros pas sems can 'phongs pa bstan pa'i don byas nas tshur 'dus nam mkha'i mgon po de nyid la mchod/ /tshur 'dus de thod pa phyag mtshan du gyur pa dgra sta la sogs bsam/ /'od 'phros pa'i sa bon stong las khro bo'i dkyila'akhor gyi lha tshogs/ /hūṃ hūṃ sgra las skaghan pa ) cho gas bdag gzugs su gyur nas yang / /de la zhugs pas dedag gi ngo bo de 'od du zhu/ /lha yi bdag po'i chu 47—716

rgyal po bzhi yis bdud rtsi'i 'char phab pa'iyi/sa bkrus/ /de gsos de dag 'od du zhu bas de sogs ngo bor dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs su bsam/ /de nas mdun du bshams pa'imachod pa phul nas ni/ /gtso bo'i sgo nas bsnyen pa la oṃ ba ra da ga hūṃ/ gnod sbyin la sogs 'khor rgyal po bzhi dang klu brgyad rnams la/ /khri dang gtso bo 'bum gyis bsnyen pa de rdzogs/ /de nas 'bulaba'i dus su yang mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam/ /na mo raza tra yā ya/ mchod pa sprin gyi gzungs 'di'i mgor rten gnon dang tshogs bdag la sogs pa'i mtshan brjod la/ na mo bha ga ba ti badz+ra sa ra pra mar da ni/ ta thā ga ta oṃ badz+re badz+re/ ma hā ba bi bha rgya rgya badz+res ma hā bho dhi tsi ta badz+re/ ma hā bho dhi man sgo badz+rer/ sarba karma a ba ra ṇa bhi sho dha ṇa badz+rer/ye swā hā/ oṃ ga na ①pa ti pusnye ②me tog byu pe spos a lo ke ne+emar me gan de drichabanai bi t+yazhal zas shabe+e rol mo yasahūṃ swā hā/ ming gi mjug du chabadz+ra pusnye yasarjohūṃ la sogs brjod| /marapare re la yang de bzhin bya/ /de nas gtor ma'i shin tu r+ṣa po blos byung du ches so/ /tshogs la ni/ /chasahūṃyige gsum gyis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab/ /a kha ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ar+ya nud pan na twad oṃ āḥhūṃ 'byung po thams cad pa'i sngags 'di bdun dang ni/ glang chen phyag rgyas bcas nas ni/ ming gi gha na pa ti la sogs kyi sha sa la bsnyen pa'i tha mar bha li gi na kha khā kha hi kha hi dang ni yag k+ṣa sogs brjod pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams legs par tshim par bsam/ de nas bdag nyid spos thogs te/ /rten la bdug ⑤nas gzungs chu'am lha chu'am yang na chu gtsang ma dag gi rten la sku khrus gsol/ /de nas bsgrubapa pos brtags pa'i sa la ni/ /gong ltar gtso bo yab yum gyi dkyil 'khor gong ltar byas pa la/ /tshangs thig la sogs pa'i thig gdab le'u tshe pad 'dab brgyad pa yis/ /lte bar snatshogasapad ma 'dab brgyad la/ /dgra sta bhan dha'i mtshan ma dang mkha' 'gro bzhi'i phyag rgya yang dgod/ /shar gyi le'u tshe pada'adab zer ser po la/ /47—717

tri ser po yang de la dgod/ /lho'i le'u tshe pada'adab la sngon po la/ /dbyug to sngon po legs par dgod/ /nub kyi le'u tshe padam zer dmar po la/ /chus gang sprin phung dgod par bya/ /byang gi le'u tshe pad 'dab zer ro/ /ljang khu la/ /rin chen ljang khu dgod par bya/ /byang shar le'u tshe dkar po la/ /mdung rtse gsum pa dgod par bya/ /shar lho'i le'u tshe dmar po la/ /dgra sta de la dgod par bya//lho nub le'u tshe nag po la/ /sprin phung glog du bcas pa'o/ /nub byang le'u tshe nag po la/ /rtse gsum po yang dgod par bya/ /sgo bzhi dag du ral gri bzhi/ /'dod yon la ni pad ma'o/ /de'i grub na rgya che bas re re ma grub na gtso bo la gcig gnod sbyin brgyad la gcig klu brgyad la gcig rgyal po bzhi la gcig bya'o/ /chos ①ni gser dngul la sogs pa'i zigan byer dang / /'brang le yang tshonasnebazangs las bya'o/ /tshon sneni sbyar mtshon la sogs pa'i ngan pa de dag spangs pa'o//de'i mtha' mar 'bras bu can gyi shing la sogs pa'i mchod tshogs dang / /gtor ma'i tshogs kyang bsham par bya/ /sku khrus gsol ba'i ta gon ni ral gri la sogs mtshon cha dang //shing bzangs bum pas bskor bar bya/ /dar gyi bla bres la sogs dang / /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan phyogasaphyogs su ni gzugs par bya/ /mgon po'i spyan ras gzigs kyi rol pas gnas nas ni/ /gong ltar sgom zhing phyag mtshan tshun chad thams cad mthun pa la khyad par du ni dam tshig pa'i/ /khyad par nang bsgrub ladakyil 'khor 'khor lo 'di ltar bsgom—/ /sna tshogs pad ma'i steng du ni/ /dgra sta las gyur tshogs bdag mchog /sku mdog sngon po zhal cig pa/ /khyu mchog shangs ldan spyan gsum pa//phyag bzhi dang pos mche ba ste/ /zhags pa g.yas pas rim par 'dzin/ /dgra sta kha t+t+waṃ ④kha g.yon ni/ /rim pas 'dzin cing zhabs bzhi yis/ /klu bzhi mnan pas gsus pa che/ /a bsgyur yumardo rje phag gdong ma/ /sku mdog 47—718

dmar mo gtso la mkhyud①/ /yumagyiphyag mag dgra sta g.yas 'dzin bhan dha g.yon/ /khrag gis bkang ba gtso la stob/ /zla ba'i stan dngabyi la sngon po'i stan la yum dang ni/ /gnyis su med paralhanaskyes su bsgom par bya lhan skyes su/ /'khor bskyed la shar du khams gsum bdag po'i bdud/ /ser po la phug g.yon 'dzin la/ /dri ser g.yas pas gcod byed pa/ /lho'i phyogs su gnod sbyin ni/ /rdo rje mchu can ma he gdong / /tho ba g.yas 'dzin dbyug to g.yon/ /sku mdog sngo la 'jigs gzugs can/ /nub du gnod sbyin sprin gyi bdag /g.yas pa chus gang sprin pa dang / /g.yon pa zhags pa 'dzin pa dkar/ /byang du gnod sbyin nor gnas pa/ /ljang khu kha t+t+waṃ ljang khu g.yas/ /rin chen g.yon pas thogs pa ser po'o—/ /byang shar bgegs rgyal nag po ni/ /byi na ya ka glang chen mgo/ /g.yas pa mdung rtse gsum pa dang / /g.yon pa la phug thogs pa'o/ /shar lho'i yi dwags drag po —ni/ /g.yas pa dgra sta 'dzin byed cing / /g.yon pa mi thod baṃ ril thogs/ /mdog nag khros pa bsgom par bya/ /lho nub phyogs su sprin gyi ni/ /sgron me zhes bya sprin phung g.yas/ /klog gi 'od ni g.yon na thogs—/ /sku mdog sngon po bsgom par bya/ /nub byang mtshams su bgegs rgyal ni/ /log 'dren snang g.yon zhes bya ba/ /rtse gsum g.yas 'dzin thod ke g.yon—/ /sha dang la phug gis bskang 'dzin/ /glang chen sna can bsgom par bya—/ /lha rnams la ni bzhengs pa sems dpa' ltar/ /lhabargyad ni klu brgyad thal mo sbyar gnas pa/ /a ba ra dang ba ru na shi ni/ /shar gyi phyogs su bsgom par bya//dung skyong 'jog po lhor gnas pa/ /rigs ldan mtha' yas nub tu ste/ /pad+ma pad+ma chen po ni/ /byang gi phyogs su bsgom par bya/ /shar sngo ba la sogs pa'i sku mdog 47—719

phyogs dang mthun par bsgom/ /shar sgor yul 'khor skyong zhes bya/ /sku mdog dkar po bsgom par bya/ /lhor ni 'phags skyes po zhes bya/ /mdog sngo 'jigs pa bsgom par bya/ /nub tu spyan mi bzang ba ni/ /mdog dmar 'jigs par bsgom par bya/ /rnam thos sras ljang byang sgor bsgom/ /phyag na ral gri re dang ni/ /nor bu'i rin chen re re yang / /go mtshon dmag gi tshogs dang bcas/ /dbang bsgyur khro bor bsgom par bya/ /sgo bzhi sgo khyud mdzes ldan pa/ /'dod yon sngon po legs par sgom①/ /dam tshig 'khor lo ye shes sems dpa'i spyan drangs de la bzhugs nas del ni/ /sposalasogs dri yi cho1gas kyis rtenal bdug par bya/ /oṃ ye shes sems dpa' ga ṇa pa ti yak+ṣa na ra dza e bye hi/e bye hi/ e bye hi dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ ji ltar dam tshig sems dpa' gnas pa ji bzhin gzhug② /lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas ye shes sems dpa' de spyan drangs nas dam tshig sems dpa' la gzhug /oṃ na mo ga ṇa pa ti dzñā bhan ti yā rad na si ti swā hā/ ya bsapaposhaka pa lā/ ma hā bhe ra bhe/ tri pra tsa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ de ba yak+ṣa na ga yā yā yā/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ—/ rad na sidhi swā hā// //zla ba shasalagasum gyis rdzogs pa yin/ /de nas bsnyenapa dang gong bzhin mchod pa dbul/ /gongaltarade nas gtor ma btang nas ni/ /tsan dan la sogs kyi driyi tshogs kyis de la bdugs/ /de nas 'dod pa'i nor la sogs pa rang gang 'dod kyi gsol ba gdab/ /de nas nyin re layang thun bzhi ru/ /dus rnams mchod pa la brtson par rtag tu bya ba yin/ /dkyil 'khor somamagrub na rnyings dze+epa gso bar bya/ /de ltar byas pas rab snyen bas gnyis pos las thams cad kyi don rnams 'grub/ /mchod padang gtor ma byas shing tshigs bcad kyis bstod pa yis/ /tshogasabadag de dag de dag bdag gis 47—720

mnyes par bya/ /11gas bdag gsang ba'i bsgrub pa'i lugs la mang na 'ang lugs khyad du 'phags pa 'di dag sgrub pamachog /dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud dang bla ma'i man ngag la/ /①brten nas gser gling pa chos kyi grags pas rang bzo spangs nas legs par bdag gis yang dag rgyud dang bla ma'i man ngag ma nor legs par bsko/da/ /zhi rgyas dbang bsad pa la sogs pa rnams 'a/sa 11gas gzhan las legs par rtogs rgyud dang man ngag la sogs pa thams cad mkhyen pas de rnams bkus pa yin/ /bsgrub thabs 'di la 'jug 'gyur bsgrubapa po'i gang zag la/ /bde ba mchog thun mong gi dngos grub myur du 'byung 'gyur shog /tshogs kyi bdag po'i sgrub thabs mthun rkyen thams cad tshang bas na 'khor lo chen po zhes bya ba slob dpon a ba byu ti pa'i gser gling pa'i rnal 'byor gyi mtshan yin zhal snga nas gsungs pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang / lots+tsha nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba'o/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas la gtad pa'o// //47—721

bsdur ma na/715 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/716 ①〈〈pe 〉〉pa'i/717 ①〈〈pe 〉〉ṇa/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉puṣ+pe/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉wa.a lo te/ 0〈〈pe 〉tshog ⑤〈〈pe 〉stanadugs/718 ①②①〈〈pe 〉〉patshon/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〉/719 ①〈〈pe 〉skarmad/72 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bsgom/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉bzhug ②〈〈pe 〉stagangs/721 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〉de dgabasdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2739)47—722

༄ga /bgegs kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ bī na ya kan rā dza sa dha nā ma/ bod skad du/bgegs kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma mo'i khyim dang nyams dga' bar/ /sgom pa bzang po byas pa nyidaske/ /'bad pas bris sku dmigs nas ni/ /sngar mchod blo gros ldan pa yis—/ /gar mkhan cing pa rtag gnas pa/ /dpal tshogs bdag chen po zhabs g.yas brkyang bas gnas pa/ sku mdog dmar po 'od dmar po 'od 'bar ba dmar pos 'khrugs pa/ zhal cig pa/ spyan gsum pa/ glang chen gdong ral pa'i dbu brgyan bcings pa/ mche ba gatshigs ②pa/ bong ge thung la sbom la rags pa/ gsus pa 'khyil zhing che ba/ shin tu 'jigs pa/rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag bcu gnyis pa/ g.yas dang po dgra sta/gnyis pa gtun shing / gsum pa mda' gzhu/ bzhi pa kha ṭī ka /lnga pa 47—723

lcags kyu/ drug pa thod pa khrag gis bkang ba'o/ /g.yon pa dang po rdo rje/gnyis pa ral gri/ gsum pa thod pa chen pos bkang ba/ bzhi pa phub hu chung / lnga pa ba dan rtse gsum pa/ drug pa 'phang mdung bsnams pa'o/ /pad ma dmar po dang / nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa'o/ /oṃ gaḥgaḥdangos grub gnyis sid dhi sid dhi sarba abye me pra sā dha hūṃ hūṃ dzaḥdzaḥswā hā/ dgug pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ byedagaḥhūṃ swā hā/ bzlas pa'i sngags so/ /stong phrag brgya yis 'grub 'gyur bas—/ /don thams cad bdag la rab tu bamados phyi nas las rnams yang dag brtsam/ /lan cig yongs bzlas thig le byas/ /sngags pa skal ②bzang mthong na dga'/ /rgyal po'i sgo ru ches mchod cing / /dgra rnams thams cad 'jigs par byed/ /bgegs rnams nye bar bgrod ①nyid dang / /'dod pa kun gyis dhi'abras gter bar—/ /the tshom med pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de lta'i cho ga sgrub pa nyid/ /ma mo rnams ni 'grub pa'i mchog /dpal bgegs kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/grub pa'i rtul zhugs brnyes pa/ slob dpon nag po spyod pa pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra dang lots+tsha ba gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer kyis bsgyur ba'o//⑤//47—724

bsdur mchan/722 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉kho bgegs kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / ②〈〈pe 〉sta:gas/724 ①〈〈pe 〉〉phug ②〈〈pe 〉〉bskal/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉bskyod/ rjo〈〈pe 〉skom ⑤〈〈pe 〉mi maṅgālo/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (274༷)47—725

༄pha /sna tshogs skor bu bde mchog 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/①ga bde mchog gi sgrub thabs/ ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ karma ma ṇi tsakra saṃ bha sā ④dha nā ma/ bod skad du/ sna tshogs nor bu bde mchog 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro la btud de/ /sna tshogs nor bu'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /gsang ba mchog ni mdor bsdus nas/ /skad cig gis ni bdag bsgoms la/ /he ru ka dpal gzugs su bya/ /sngo zhing drag pa rnam 'gyur ba/ /drag po spyan gsum zhal drug mtshon/ /zla ba phyed pa ral pa 'dzin/ /sna tshogs rdo rje dbu mchog la/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /rdo rje phreng bas rnam par brgyan—/ /sku la mgo bo'i do shal can/ /phyag rgya drug gis rnam par brgyan/ /stag gi lpags pa gos su bsnams/ /phag mo yis ni sku la brgyan/ /zhal gcig pa la bzhengs pa ste/ /g.yas pa ser la dud pa'i mdog /g.yon pa 47—726

dmar la ljang khu'o/ /steng gi zhal ni stag gdong ste/ /dkar zhing sprin mdog drag cing 'jigs/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam par ldan/ /lha mo'i mchu ni 'tshir ba ste/ /rgyal ba'i lpags pa gos su gon/ /ḍā ki ma yi rigs 'dzin zhing / /thod pa dang ni kha ṭī 'dzin/ /rdo rje mtshan gyis brgyan pa ste/ /zhags pa lcags kyu phyag na bsnams/ /cang te'u dang ni mgo bo 'dzin/ /gri gug zhags pa de bzhin te/ /phyag ni bcu gnyis dag tu bshad/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni thams cad kyang / /zhabs gcig tu ni rnam par bsgom/ /glang po be+e'u'i gdong dang ni/ /seng ge'i gdong yang de bzhin te/ /dang po khyi yi gdong yin te/ /gnyis pa 'ug pa'i gdong yang yin/ /gsum pa phag gi gdong yin te/ /bzhi pa khu ta'i gdong can ni/ /gnas kyi dbyibs kyi chos bdag nyid/ /sna tshogs gzugs ni chen po 'dzin/ /mtha' yas rnam rgyal grags pa ste/ /thams cad mkhyen zhing thams cad la/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i sku lus 'chang / /de bzhin bsgom zhing rnam bsgom ste/ /sna tshogs gzugs can rin chen bzhin/ /bdag nyid chen po rnam par rol/ /oṃ shri badz+ra he te ru ru ke hūṃ ①hūṃ phaṭa/ ḍā ki ni dz+wa la saṃ pa ram̐ swā hā/ zhes pa phrin las thams cad ni/ /bsgrub par 'dod pas bzlas par bya'o/ /tshogs dang gtor ma las rnams ni/ /gzhan nas gsung bzhin brtsam par bya/ /sna tshogs nor bu'i sgrub thabs 'di/ /'khor lo sdom pa nyid thob shog /sna tshogs nor bu bde mchog 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ slob dpon nag po pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra dang / lo tsa ④ba gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur ba'o// //47—727
bsdur mchan/726 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉zab/727 ①〈〈pe 〉skus/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉thats+tsha/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2741)47wa 728

༄ga /dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i bsgrub thabs zhes bya ba/7 ༄/ 'byung po 'dul byed kyi bsgrub thabs/ ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/shrī badz+ra ḍā ki ni sā dha nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i bsgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ he ru ka dpal phyag 'tshal nas/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /'di nyid cho gas bsgrubs gyur na/ /ma mo rnams kyang bsgrub pa'i mchog /de dbus khro bo chen po ni/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /zhal gyi mche ba cung zad gabyugs 4/ /khro bcas zhal ni bzhad —pa dang / /sku mdog sngo nag 'jigs chen po/ /thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan pa'o/ /ro dang nyi steng g.yon brkyang zhing / /g.yas skum stag lpags kyis brgyan pa/ /gar ldan sum cu gsum 'jigs mdzad/ /spyan gsum cher bsgrad bgegs kun gnon/ /rdo rje thod khrag thugs khar 'dzin/ /'og mas mda' gzhu rgyab nas 'gengs/ /tshogs bdag stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /a las pad+ma re nyid las/ /nyi stengs hūṃ 47—729

las rdo rje las/ /rang nyid khro rgyal gsal ba'i mdun/ /gaḥlas gyur pa'i bgegs bdag bskyed/ /dgug sngags brgya yis spyan drangs te/ /phyag mchod bstod pas dngos grub blangs/ /gal te 'gor na rang nyid lus/ /hūṃ mdzad skyed rim brtan byas nas/ /gsang sngags 'bum bzlas zhabs 'og bcug /phyag g.yas mje bong mthe chung mnan/ /mdzub 1gsum rdo rje'i phyag rgya yis/ /gzir te thugs ka'i pad steng gi/ /re las me 'bar tshig pa yis/ /skrag ste thal sbyar gus btud nas/ /bka' nyan dngos grub lter bar bsam/ /lha chen gzir ba'i man ngag gzhan/ /mi bri sdig che zhal las shes/ /grub pa brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa nag po spyod pa'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so // //1rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba 'brog mi shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur te gtan la phab pa'o// (d+ngha //47—730

༄khya/ /bgegs kyi rgyal po bsgrub pa'i thabs jes bya ba/teg bgegs rgyal gyi sgrub thabs/ ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ bi na ya ka rā dza sā dha nā ma/ bod skad du/ bgegs kyi rgyal po bsgrub pa'i thabs shes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bgegs kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /lha mo skal ba chen mo nyon/ /ma mo'i khyim dang nyams dga'i gnas/ /blo ldan mchod pa sngon 'gro bas/ /sgom pa bzang po bya ba nyid/ /'bad pas bris sku dmigs nas ni/ /sku mdog dmar po cher 'bar ba/ / skyil krung 2'gying ba'i gar gyis bzhugs/ /zhal gcig d+ngha pa la spyan gsum pa/ /ral pa'i thor tsug dag gis brgyan/ /dmar po 'bar 'khyil 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /mche ba gabyugs pa yang dag bri/ /dgra sta gtun 4shing nyid dang yang / /de bzhin du ni mda' dang gzhu/ /kha ṭī ga dang lcags kyu dang / /thod khrag dmar po 'khyil ba dang / /de bzhin rdo rje 47—732

ral gri dang / /sha chen thod pa 'dzin pa dang / /phub chung ba dan rtse gsum dang / /'phang mdung dag dang bcu gnyis so/ /oṃ gaḥgaḥsidhi sidhi sarba ārja sa dha me pra sa dha ye hūṃ hūṃ dzaḥdzaḥswā hā/ zhes spyan drangs pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ a gaḥhūṃ swā hā/ bzlas pa rtsa ba'i sngags so/ /stong phrag brgya yis 'grub 'gyur bas / /de nas las rnams yang dag brtsam/ /lan gcig yongs bzlas thig le bya/ /sngags pa skal bzang mthong dgar 'gyur/ /rgyal po'i sgo drung ches mchod cing / /dgra rnams 'jigs pas 'dun par 'gyur/ /bgegs rnams skrag cing zhi bar 'gyur/ /'dod pa kun gyi 'bras ster bar/ /'gyur ba 'di la the tshom med/ /oṃ gaḥgaḥsidhi sidhi sarba arba sa dha me pra sa dha ye hūṃ hūṃ dzaḥdzaḥswā hā / 'gugs sngags nyer gnyis pa lcags kyu'i phyag rgya byas la brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la lha yul nas dgug go/ /oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ zhes yi ge bdun pa gsum gyes gdan dbul lo/ /oṃ a gaḥhūṃ swā hā/ rtsa ba'i sngags 'bru drug pa 'bum bzlas so/ /oṃ badz+ra a gu sha /badz+ra ma hā gu h+ya sernyi a kar+ṣa ya hūṃ dzaḥ/zhes pa dngos grub blang ba'i sngags yi ge bco brgyad pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas so/ /oṃ a mu ka dzi wi ma la ya/ mo gha dze+e bha la a bha bha ye/ a mu rka 1ma ra ya hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ /zhes pa nor spel ba'i sngags yi ge nyer gcig pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas so/ /oṃ mu le rgyu zhes pa btsun pa'i sngags yi ge bzhi pa brgya rtsa re bzlas so / /bgegs bdag/ chen po sku mdog dmar po zhabs g.yas brkyang ba/zhal gcig spyan gsum pa/ mche ba gcigs pa/ sbom la thung ba/ gsus khyim che ba/ thor tshugs 'khyil ba/ 'jigs shing rngam pa/ glang po'i gdong can / dar dang rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ phyag bcu gnyis kyi 47—733

g.yas dang po dgra sta/ gnyis pa gtun shing / gsum pa mda' gzhu/bzhi pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /lnga pa lcags kyu/ drug pa thod pa khrag gis gang ba/g.yon gyi dang po rdo rje/ gnyis pa ral gri/ gsum pa thod pa sha chen gyis gang ba/ bzhi pa phub chung / lnga pas ba dan rtse gsum pa/ drug pas 'phang mdung bsnams pa'o/ /pad ma dmar po dang nyi ma'i dbus na zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /bgegs kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/grub pa brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen po nag po pas rgyud kyi rgyal po rdo rje mkha' 'gro nas phyung tshob rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra dang / lo tsa ba gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur ba'o// 3 //47—734

sngag /'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po la bstod pa/hūṃ༄/ tshogs bdag gi bstod pa/ ༄spro/ /rgya gar skad du/ /ār+ya gaḥn pa ti stu ti/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po la bstod pa/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo lo ka mgon mdzad gnang bar mdzad/ /dpal mdzad de bzhin phan par mdzad/ /mnyam pa med cing dpe med pa/ /tshogs bdag de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang sngags dbang phyug rigs 3sngags rgyal/ /longs spyod 'byung gnas gter gyi mchog/'bras bu mngon par ston pa po/ /tshogs bdag de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo chen po bdud las rgyal/ /stobs chen nyon mongs g.yul 'joms shing / /bgegs 'joms duḥkha 'joms mdzad pa/ /glang chen snar ldan gtso la 'dud/ /rin chen chen po rin chen sgu/ /rin chen chen po rin chen 'byung / /rin chen bstan pa bsrung mdzad pa/ /glang chen snar ldan gtso la 'dud/ /tshogs kyi bdag 47—736

༄/ /bgegs bdag chen po'i d+ku bri ba'i man ngag yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba/ 1༄/ bgegs rgyal gyi bris sku'i man ngag ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ma hā bi na ya ka rū pa u pa de sha rad na nā ma/ bod skad du/ bgegs bdag chen po'i sku bri ba'i man ngag yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor lo sdom pa la btud de/ /dgegs bdag chen po'i bris sku bri/ /ro la g.yogs pa'i ras saṃ ni/ /mtshon kyis bsnun pa'i ras dang yang / /bu btsas shi ba'i ras dang ni/ /ba glang lpags sogs khyad par las/ /nag po'i brgyad dang bcu bzhi la/ /'byung po'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub par bya/ /ri mo mkhan yang dam tshig ldan/ /sgrub po dag gis bri bar bya/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /sgo bsrung dag ni yang dag ldan/ /dngos grub kun gyi yon tan gnas/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lngas gang ba/ /mchod pa lnga yis brgyan pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor nyams dga' bri bar bya/ /47—738

dbus su dkyil 'khor kun du ni/ /re kas bskor zhing shin tu mdzes/ /pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa bri/ /me tog dmar pos legs par mchod/ /dri dang bdug pa'i khyad par dang / /bdud rtsi lngas ni gang ba dang / /nya dang sha dang chang rnams kyis/ /nye bar mchod pa'i gtor mas gang / /de dbus khro bo chen po ni/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /cung zad zhal gyi mche ba gcigs//bro bcas zhal ni bzhad 1pa dang / /sku mchog sngon po 'jigs chen po/ /thod nga/'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /yi dwags zhon zhing nyi mar gnas/ /gar lda na sum cu gsum 'jigs mdzad/ /stag gi lpags pa'i gos 'dzin zhing / /spyan gsum bzang po'i gzugs can te/ /ba dan gsum pa 'bar rdo rje/ /thod pa dang ni mtshan ma 'dzin/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi phyag dag la/ /mda' dang gzhu nyid de bzhin no/ /oṃ badz+ra kro ta ḍa ki hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzlas so/ /de yi mdun du bgegs bdag che/ /gzi brjid chen po 'od 'bar ba/ /bcu gnyis phyag ldan 'jigs chen bri/ /'dab ma brgyad la gnod sbyin brgyad/ /bgegs bdag chen po ji bzhin bri/ /dang po ras chog tshul bzhin bya/ /de nas lha bzo mtshan nyid ldan/ /mnyes par byas te yid 'ong bri/ /rab gnas mkhan po byin rlabs ldan/ /mchod pa'i yo byad ci 'byor kyis/ /rab gnas cho ga tshul bzhin bya/ /byams pa snying rje byang chub sems/ /rgya chen 'dun pa 3drag po bskyed/ /mchod dang bsngo ba rgyas par bya/ /'di ni yid bzhin nor bu ste/ /rtag tu mchod na dgos 'dod 'byung / /'di ni bris sku'i gdams ngag go/ /'byung po'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub bya ba/ /de nas bzlas pa 'bum byas na/ /mdun du mngon sum nyid du 'gyur/ /rten dgram mchod 47—739

༄༅/ /'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po'i gtor ma'i cho ga1 ga gtor ma'i cho ga17 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya gaḥn pa ti ba li bi dhi/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po'i gtor ma'i cho ga /dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la 'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po yang dag par mnyes par bya ba'i phyir/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod pas/dang po rin po che'i snod phun sum tshogs par 'bras chan dang / khur ba dang /dkar gsum dang / dngar gsum dang / la du dang / la phug dang / glang sha dang / rgun 'brum la sogs pa bza' ba dang / btung ba dang / kha dog dri ro phun sum tshogs pas legs par bkang ste mdun du bzhag ste/ stan bde ba la 'dug nas/ tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi rjes su dran pa dang / gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par bya'o/ /de nas chos thams cad bdag med par bsgoms te/ rgyu las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i 47—741

nang du/ khaṃ las zhal zas ro brgya ldan pas byur bur gang bar bsam/ de nyid gsum dang / oṃ a ka ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā māṃ/ ar+ya nut+pan na twad oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa/swā hā/ zhes bya bas byin gyis brlabs la/ de nas rang gi snying khar sa bon gyi yi ge bltas la/ de'i 'od kyis ye shes kyi 'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po spyan drangs la / mdun du dmigs nas/ phyag rgya bstan te/ oṃ na mo tu te/ na maḥgaḥn sa ta ye/ i rda ba li kha kha khā hi khā hi swā hā/ zhes bya bas dbul zhing des kyang tshim par longs spyad nas dges par bsam mo/ /de nas 'di skad ces/ 'bras bu sman dang rin chen pos/ /la du la phug glang sha dang / /rgun 'brum rgun chang dkar gsum dang / /mngar gsum 'bras chan khur ba sogs/ /phyogs bcu lha mi'i yid 'ong sogs/ /yongs su bzung ba med pa 'bul/ /mgon khrod bdag la rab tu brtse ba yis/ /'di dag bzhes te dges par gsol nas kyang //bdag gi las rnams 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /bar chad rab tu zhi bar mdzod / /de nas bstod pa'i tshig gis yang dag par bstod de/ rtsa sngags saṃ gzungs kyi phreng ba ci nus su bzlas te/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de nas ye shes pa gshegs su gsol la/ bsags pa'i dge rtsa yongs su bsngo zhing / yi ge brgya pa bzlas so/ /'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po'i gtor ma'i cho ga /slob dpon chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa/ nag po zhabs kyis mdzad pa sdogs sto// //paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra dang / lo tsa ba gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur ba'o// // 47—712

282༷༄dzo /bgegs bdag gi sprun sreg gi cho ga rab tu bshad pa/lku༄/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ho mal+lī bi di nā ma/bod skad du/ bgegs bdag gi sbyin sreg gi cho ga rab tu bshad pa/ dang por sngon du 'gro ba brtsam/ /rgyas par ser po'i sa las ni/ /rin chen rnam pa'i thab khung ngam/ /yang na gru bzhi mnyam par bya/ /rgya ru khru do dpangs su gang / /de'i nang du sor mo brgyad/ /dor ba der ni kha khyer gnas/ /kun nas sor mo bzhi pa ni/ /rin chen phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /thab khung dbus ni ser po ru/ /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad lte ba la/ /rdo rje rin chen ser po drug /ser po'i sa dang dri yis ni/ /thab khung kun tu byug par bya/ /bud shing thab khung bas thung tshad/ /dgon pa yi ni gci ba nyid/ /'bu srin yongs su spangs pa'o/ /yo shing 'bru dang bsreg pa'o/ /shing ni bshis pa'icho ga'o—/ /yam thi/nga zhi ba bzhin du bzung / /mdzes pa dbus kyi cha las skyes/ /47—744

khu tshur bcangs pa'i khru tshad tsam/ /zho dang 'o ma mar la brtag /zas kyi mchog dang zho'i zas/ /mar la sogs pa'i ro mchog dang / /mar dang ldan pa'i sbrang rtsi dang / /sa le chu blugs pad+ma dang / /byu ha ya na ge 1sar dang / /bil ba'i 'bras bu dur ba rnams/ /'bras bur bcas pa'i shing sngon bzhin/ /rgyas pa'i las la sbyin sreg bya/ /tsam pa ka dang a sho ka /na ga ge sar ze 'bru can/ /ji ltar me tog la sogs pa/ /dri med rab snyedangs 'bras bur bcas—/ /ljon shing dri ma med pa yis/ /shing gi me tog rab ldan pa/ /sor mo lnga pa rab tu ldan/ /ser po'i brgyan bcas snga dro ste/ /nor gyis phongs nas rgyas par bya/ /bzang po'i 'dug stangs kyis 'dug ste/ /yang na rgyal po rol pas so/ /'bum phrag gcig tu sbyin sreg bya/ /gling kun dbang bsgyur rgyal po yis/ /dpal chen po la spyod par 'gyur/ /brtul shugs can sems mgu sems dang / /byang du kha bltas dga' ldan pas/ /rigs bdag rin chen 'byung ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /gzhanadu bshad pa'i rgyas pa yi ni cho ga bzhin/ /oṃ gyi mtha' can sngags bzlas so/ /thab tu me lha ser po bskyed/ /bsangs 4 sbyangs mchod pas mnyes par bya/ /de rjes bgegs bdag rgyas par bskyed/ /dgang thublugs rgyas par 'bul bar bya/ /dngos grub kun dang las rnams ni/ /sngags pas sbyin sreg med mi 'grub/ /de phyir sngags dang sbyin sreg bya/ /'bad de brtsam par bya ba yin/ /rgyas pa'i las so/ /dbang gi las ni/ dbang la dmar ba'i sa dag la/ /zla gam dang ni mtsho skyes 'dra/ /rgya la khru do dpangs su gang / /byug pa khadogadamar po kha khyer ni—/ /lcags kyu 'bar bas rab tu brgyan/ /dbus su pad+ma mtsho skyes dmar/ /47—745
