dbang la shis pa'i shing brtsig go/ /'o ma can dang dmar po'i shing / /ljon shing dri ma med pa ni/ /shing gi me tog dmar po can/ /dbang la bshis pa'i shing gis brtsig /mchod rdzas me tog dmar po sogs/ /zhal zas la sogs ci 'byor bsham//sreg rdzas ming gzugs me tog dmar/ /ba glang sha dang gi haṃ sogs/ /sngags pa'i cha lugs dmar zhing mdzes/ /dus ni nyi ma nub kha ste/ /chags shing gos ni dmar po gyon/ /sems dpa'i dkyil dkrung dag gis gnas/ /chags pa rdo rje spyor ldan pas/ /nub tu kha bltas thun dang por/ /sngags pa bgegs bdag nga rgyal kyis/ /yo las rlung gi dkyil 'khor las/ /btsun mo'i pad+ma 'jam gnas pa'i / /bsgrub bya rjes su chags pas dmigs/ /'od zer bskul ba'i sbyor ba dang / /sngags pas hoḥyig mtha' can bzlas/ /rnam g.yeng mig zur kyis bltas pas / /bud med skye bo rmongs par 'gyur/ /bsang sbyangs me lha dmar mchod de/ /rjes la bgegs bdag dmar po bskyed/ /sreg rdzas dgang blugs legs par dbul / /las rnams thams cad 'grub pa ste/ /las kun kyi ni de kho na/ /bsam pa'i khyad par gyis ni bya/ /sa la las dang rjes 'thun pa'i/ /thab khung las rnams thams cad la/ /sngags pas ji lta bzhin du bya/ /gzhan gyi dpung gzhom sbyin bsreg ni/ /bsgrub po rgyal po'i rgyu ru ni/ /gsang sngags stong phrag bcu ru bzlas / /pho nya'i steng du rab gnas te/ /sbyin sreg stong phrag lnga ru bya/ /sha chen dang ni 'o mar rtags/ /de yi dgang blugs rim bzhin bya/ /dpag tshad 'bum phrag brgya nyid du/ /dmag mis gang ba brnyed par 'gyur/ /dpal chen grub pa rgyal dbang phyug /de bzhin gzhan gyi brdo mi nus/ /mi dang ba glang ba yi sha /de bzhin bsreg blugs gzhan dag la/ /chang dang 'o mar mnyam brtags pa/ /47—716

'bum phrag gcig tu sbyin bsreg bya/ /gling bzhi dbang bsgyur rgyal po yi/ /dpal chen po la spyod par 'gyur/ /de nas dgug pa'i cho ga bshad/ /li khri'i mdog dang bsgrubabya'adra bar bsgom/ /rlung du steng bltas tegan kyal du phyogs gos can/ /bsgrub bya shesarig g.yog pa 1bsam par bya/ /rol mo'i mtshams rngam gdan la gnas / /zhags pa lcags kyu'i sbyor bar ldan/ /dza' mtha' can sngags bzlas te//bsgrub bya'i snying kha chu skyes dbug /'jig rten gsum po nges par dgug /de nas gzhan gyi cho ga bshad/ /dgug sogs ji ltar gsungs pa yi/ /thod pa dum bu gcig pa'ang rung / /mnyam par mdzes shing bzang po la/ /bsgrub pa bya ba'i lus bri zhing / /de bzhin 'dab ma zer yang thing lo la bris pa'i thod pa/ dum bu gcig pa 'a / ling ga snga gas dang ming dang bcas pa bri ba mang po byas pas brlan can brgya'i/ /sngags dang ming ni lhan cig tu/ /gser gyis shing gi snyu gu yis/ /ba glang gi haṃ khrag gis bri/ /khrag gis spags pa yi ni gos/ /bsgrub bya yi ni steng du g.yogs/ /snying po'i sngags ni go bzlog la/ /bzlas pa sbyin sreg bya ba ste/ /sngags dang 'gyeng bar bca' 'digs kyis // //4 'dab ma re re rab blangs shing / /yid la 'dod pa myur du dgug /de nas gzhan yang tsan dan shing / /dmar po'i rang bzhin gzugs brnyan bya//rang gi khrag dang gi haṃ gis/ /bris te de snying khar bzhug 5par bya/ /tsha ba gsum gyis lus la byug /zangs ma'i khab kyis bsgrub bya yi/ /snying kha lte ba gsang ba yi/ /gnas gsum bo ni phug byas te/ /gang 'dod mtshan mo phyed na ni/ /de ni myur du dgug par 'gyur/ /gser gyi tsag gi bha ga ni/ /bris te de stengs lag g.yon gyis/ /mnan te gang gi ming smos te/ /brgya dang rtsa 47—747

brgyad bzlas byas na/ /de ni skad cig de la 'ong / /steng du 'khor lo'i 'dab blangs te/ /bya rog sgro yi snyug gu yis/ /mig gi chu yi ming dang ni/ /spel ba'i 'khor lo bri bar bya/ /'bad de steng gi rlung srur na/ /de ni skyod pa'i cho ga nyid/ /spre'u'i rus pa'i rang bzhin la/ /phur bu sor tshad drug bya ste/ /lan bdun du ni mngon bsngags pas/ /gang gi sgo ru brkos sbas na/ /de yi rigs ni gcod par 'gyur/ /ba glang glang po rta bong dang / /rnga mong ma te'i gnas rnams su/ /brkos te sbas na brlag par 'gyur/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhon nas ni/ /mgrin rings steng du rab gnas pa/ /bsgrub bya phyogs kyi gos can lta/ /skra grol til gyi mar khus byug /lho ru phyogs shing skyabs med pa/ /myos dang bcas shing ngu bzhin pa/ /zhags pa yis ni lag bcings te/ /rgyab nas bsnun bzhin pa ni bsam/ /mkhas pas de tshe me kha lta//khams gsum mnan pa'i bsam pa dang / /gal te 'dod pa bsgrub 'dod na/ /dza' mtha' can sngags bzlas 'grub/ /rta dang ma te rab zhon pas/ /gnyis po dag ni rtag par bsam/ /bsgrub bya mtshon chas rab spras la/ /phan tshun du ni brtsod par ldan/ /bsgrub po 'khrul 'khor bsam gtan phyogs/ /kun du brtse ba med sems par/ /ma te rta la zhon pa yis/ /char bcas 'khor kyi khyad par gyis/ /ming gi yi ge de rnams dang / /re dang re gyis kun nas spel/ /de bzhin spyi bo'i steng du re/ /yan lag las ni shes par bya/ /ri yi rtse mor gnas gyur pa/ /rdo rje dkyil dkrung des bstan par/ /des ni bsgrub bya yang dag mnan/ /lus dang ngag dang sems ni gzir/ /des ni mngon du 47—7/8

༄/ /shin tu myur ba'i lha chen po bgegs kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 1༄/ shin tu myur ba'i lha chen bgegs kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/༄༅༅ / /rgya gar skad du/ pu ṇa de wa ma hā bi gha rā dzā sā —dha nā ma/bod skad du/ shin tu myur ba'i lha chen po bgegs kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gtum bo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyams dga' ba'i sa phyogs su/ yid du 'ong ba'i khang par/ 'dod pa bsgrub pa'i bya ba brtsam pa ni/ dang por thang ka dgram zhing / mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams la/rang stan bde ba la rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis 'dug par bya'o/ /rang yi dam gang yin pa'i nga rgyal bya/ de nas rang gi mdun du lha 'di bsgom/ de'i sku mdog ni/ me 'bar ba ltar shin tu dmar ba gdong bzhi pa/ spyan gsum pa/ral pa'i thor gtsug — —sgril nas dkris shing bcings pa/ 'od zer dmar po 'bar ba/ shin tu 'jigs pa/ mche ba rab tu gcigs pa/ phyag bcu 47—750

gnyis pa/ g.yas pa dang po nas rim pa bzhin du dgra sta/ mda'/lcags kyu/ rdo rje/ ral gri/ 'phang mdung rnams so/ /g.yon dang bo gtun 1shing / gzhu/ kha ṭī ga /thod pa khrag gis gang ba/ sha chen gyis gang ba'i thod pa/ phub chung dang / ba dan bsnams pa'o/ /rdo rje dang thod pa thugs kar 'dzin zhing / gzhan kun 'char thabs su'o/ /oṃ gaḥgaḥsedha sidhe / sarba arja sa dha me/ pra sa dha ya hūṃ dzaḥdzaḥswā hā/ dgug pa'i sngags so//bsnyen pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ a gaḥhūṃ swā hā/ bsnyen pa'i grangs/ sngags brgya 'am stong bzlas nas/ las sbyor brgya brjod par bya'o/ /til nag pos las gang 'dod pa bya'o/ /de ltar bsgrubs pa'i sngags pa de thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba dang / yid du 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal pos mchod pa chen pos mchod byung 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /dgra thams cad 'ching ste/ lan tshwa chur btab pa ltar 'gyur ro/ /bgegs thams cad 'byer zhing drung du 'ong mi nus par 'gyur ro/ /las thams cad 'grub cing nor rnams brnyed par 'gyur ro/ /ji skad smras pa'i tshig la gzhan yid ches par 'gyur ro/ /bgegs sel ba'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon di bhepaṃ ka ras mdzad pa rdzogs sgo// //

༄7/ /shin tu myur ba'i lha bgegs chen po/bgegs kyi rgyal po bsgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/rte༄/ bgegs kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs be+e ro tsa na'i rang 'gyur/༄spro—/ /rgya gar skad du/ su bud dha ma hā bi gha big nan rā dza sā dha niri /bod skad du/ shin tu myur ba'i lha bgegs chen po/ bgegs kyi rgyal po bsgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gtum po la phyag 'tshal lo / /nyams dga' ba'i sa phyogs su/ yid du 'ong ba'i khang par 'dod pa rtsam — pa ni/ dang por tsan dan gyi thang ka dgram/ gzhan yang mchod pa bshams4 / 'dun pa drag po bskyed/ rang stan bde ba la rol pa'i 'dug stangs su 'dug par byas la/ de'i sgu mdog ni/ me chen po ltar dmar ba/gdong gcig pa/ spyan gsum pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs sgril sgrigs shing bcings pa/ 'od zer dmar po 'bar ba/ 'jigs pa'i mche ba gcigs pa/gcig chag pa/ phyag g.yas na dgra sta dang / gtun 5shing dang / mda' 47—753

gzhu dang / kha ṭaṃ ga dang / be+egs kyu dang / thod pa dmar chen kyis bkang ba'o/ /g.yon na rdo rje dang / ral gri dang / sha chen pos bkang ba'i thod pa dang / mun shun ti dang / ba dan rtse gsum dang / shag 1ti dang bcu gnyis so/ /oṃ gaḥgaḥsed dha sarba arja me pra sa dha ya hūṃ hūṃ dzaḥswā hā/bsnyen pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ a gaḥhūṃ swā hā/ bsnyen pa'i sngags brgya 'am stong bzlas nas/ phyis nas las byed pa na gang 'dod pa bya'o/ /til nag po la sngags la las gang 'dod pa bya'o/ /de ltar bsgrub pa'i sngags pa de ni thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba dang / yid du 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal pos rgyal por mchod cing 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /bgegs thams cad byer zhing drung du 'ong mi nus par 'gyur ro/ /las rnams 'grub cing don rnams brnyed par 'gyur ro/ /ji skad smras pa'i tshig la mi gzhan dag yid ches par 'gyur ro/ /bgegs sel ba'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //rgya gar ko sa la'i rnal 'byor pa/ brtul shugs spyod pa bai ro tsa nas rang 'gyur byas pa'o// //47—75 /

2823༄khya/ /dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i 'khor lo'i gsal byed/1༄/ 'khor lo'i gsal byed ḍo t+ta te ru kas mdzad pa/ ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ shri ga ṇa pa ti tsakra srur+ya/ bod skad du/ dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i 'khor lo'i gsal byed/ rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i zhabs kyi chu skyes la/ /btud de de'i man ngag ni/ /bri gzhi rab gnas bsgrub pa dang / /bgegs dbang 'khor lo'i gsal byed bri/ /sngags pa bskal bzang yo byad tshang / /rgyu skar rgyal la las rnams brtsam/ /thog mar bri ba'i cho ga ni/ /sa dang nam mkha' bar dag gi/ /'khor lo gsum kyi dbye ba yis / /bsgrub pa'i srog gi 'khor lo 'bar/ /khor yug rim pa dgu yi dbus / /zhi rgyas zla ba nor bu dang / /dbang drag nyid phyed gru gsum nyid/ /thog ma'i sde tshan tha ma'i mthar/ /oṃ yig 2gis ni rab brgyan pa'i/ /yi she drug pa nor bu'i gzugs/ /oṃ a gaḥhūṃ swā hā/ rims ldan thog ma mtsho skyes 47—7bye6

brgyad / /dang po'i gsum bo re re'i mthar/ /gang 'dod spel bas bskor ba'o / /mig me rig byed mnga' rim bzhin/ /oṃ gaḥgaḥsirnyi sirnyi/ sarba arba sa dha me pra sa dha ye swā hā/ oṃ ba ra 'ibata ka ye swā hā/ oṃ ba ka tre dhaṣ+ṭa rgyas pa ban+dha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ga na pa dbangata ye swā hā/ nye snying / snying po ming gi snying po/ ro ri klu rnams go rim bzhin/ /dbyangs dang gsal byed spel tshig bcas / /a ā la sogs pa dbyangs yig /ka kha ga nga sogs gsal byed/ /ye dharmā sogs rten 'byel snying/ /bu gar las bzhi rim pa ni/ /zla ba yid bzhin zhar la mtshon/ /bgegs bdag rol pa'i lto bar bri/ /phrin las bzhi yi rim pa'o/ /nam mkha' bzlog pa'i rim pa yi/ /rgya mtsho yang ni de bzhin no / /de nyid bar nang tsakra'o/ /nam mkha' rgya mtsho'i tsakra yang / /khor yug rim pa lnga dang ldan/ /lte bar ga la spel tshig bskor/ /dang po 'dab brgyad mtsho skyes te/ /brgya byen gshin rje gnod sbyin chur/ /yi ge bdun pa spel tshig bcas/ /me rlung bden bral bgegs kyi sar/ /nye snying snying po yang snying ngo / /rtsa ba'i sngags rnams rim las bri/ /mig me+e mtsho mthar oṃ dbyangs gsal/ /rten 'brel spel tshig bcas pa bri/ /de lta'i bar mchog 'khor lo yang / /las bzhi'i dbye bas so sor 'gyur/ /ras kyis 1nor bu'i mdog bzhin no/ /yar ngo'i tshes la skal bzang gis/ /n+ya gro ta sogs dkar po la/ /'bras la sogs pa'i snag 1tsha yis/ /dur ba'i snyug sogs 'dzin pas bri/ /shar du phyogs te bris pas ni/ /zhi ba'i cho gas rab tu gnas/ /dngul la 47—757

sogs pa'i ga'ur gzhug /mar dang 'o sbrang dag gis dgang / /maṇ+ḍal steng bzhag rin chen snod/ /'bru bcas dbus su gzhug par bya/ /rang nyid lhag pa'i lhar dmigs te/ /tsakra tshogs bdag rab dkar gzugs/ /thugs kar 'khor los brgyan pa bsam/ /bdag gi bzlas pas de nyid bskul/ /bdag la nad gdon lce 'bab sogs/ /mi 'thun phyogs rnams zhi byed cing / /'dod pa bsgrub par bsgom pa nyid/ /bzlas pa'i sbyor ba dang ldan pas/ /zhag bdun bar du bsgrub par bya/ /de nas ga'ur dar dkar dril/ /mchan khung g.yon bcang snga dro'i dus/ /ga'u mdun bzhag sngar bzhin bsgom/ /de yis nad gdon 'jigs pa dang / /rgyal po chom rkun lce 'bab sogs/ /bsam sbyor ngan rnams zhi bar byed/ /zhi bar byed pa'i cho ga'o/ /n+ya gro ta sogs ser po la/ /lho phyogs 'jam pa'i snyu gu yis/ /'bras bu tshe dang bsod nams ster/ /rgyas par byed pa'i mtha' rten can/ /cho ga bzhin du bris nas ni/ /rgyas pa'i cho gas rab tu gnas/ /gser la sogs pa'i ga'ur gzhug /mar dang 'o ma sbrang rtsis bkang / /maṇ+ḍal rabe+e'i snod mdzes su/ /bzhag la gser ldan tshogs bdag ni/ /bskul bas don kun 'grub par 'gyur/ /slar yang gser mdog can gyis dril/ /bcangs zhing srung la mdun bzhag ste/ /sngags kyis tshogs bdag skul 1ba yis/ /'dod dgu 2'byung zhing rgyas par bsam/ /bsod nams tshe dang 'byor ba sogs/ /grags dang dpal ni rgyas par byed/ /rgyas par byed pa'i cho ga'o/ /47—758

gro ga gur kum gi haṃ chus/ /zangs sogs snyug gus nub byang bri/ /dbang dang dgug pa'i spel tshig bcas/ /de nyid cho gas rab tu gnas/ /zangs sogs ga'ur pra tshil bsdams/ /mar sbrang blugs te bsdam par bya/ /snod bzang maṇ+ḍal steng bzhag la/ /tshogs bdag pad+ma ra ga'i mdog /bdag gi bzlas pas bskul ba dang / /'jig rten gsum sogs 'byor ba bkug /dbang dang dgug pa'i don grub bsam/ /gang zhig dbang dang dgug 'dod pas / /cho ga 'di yis 'grub par byed/ /dur khrod ras sogs nag po la/ /mi rus sgro rkang snyu 1gus bri/ /bsad dang rengs dang dbye ba dang / /bsrung dang bzlog par ro ras nyid/ /snyug mas lho phyogs spel tshig bcas/ /drag po'i cho gas rab tu gnas/ /tshogs bdag nag po'i lus la'o/ /maṇ+ḍal steng bzhag bskul ba yis/ /bdag la gnod pa'i skye bo rnams/ /bsad rengs rmugs dang bzlog pa dang / /mi mthun bsrung zhing don grub bsam/ /slar yang be+egs kyi ga'ur gzhug /srod 'a/ mdun bzhag sngar bzhin bya/ /de lta'i bsrung 'khor cho ga yis/ /lha yang rung ste brlag par byed/ /nad gdon 'jigs pa ma lus bsrung / /byad stems rig sngags ngan rnams bzlog /gsang sngags mgo bo nang du bstan/ /bsrung dang zhi rgyas phyi ru ste/ /de lta'i cho ga bzang po nyid/ /brtsams pa tsam gyis thun mong mchog /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /skal bzang rnams kyi don ldan no/ /dpal ldan gnyis med rol pa'i zhabs/ /bung ba bdud rtsis tshim byas pa'i/ /'khor lo'i cho ga'i dge ba des/ /'gro kun phun 47—759

2824༄༅/ /sngags kyi rgyal po'i dam tshig dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/1༄/ sngags kyi rgyal po'i dam tshig dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs bzhugs so/ /༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ man+t+ra rā dzā sa ma ya sid+dhi sā dha nā ma/ bod skad du / sngags kyi rgyal po'i dam tshig dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/de bzhin gshegs pa gdon mi za bar grub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma dang ni lhag pa'i lha/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag btsal nas/ /thun mong sgrub pa'i rim pa bri/ /phrin las sgrub par 'dod pa yis/ /gnas ni nags tshal dur khrod dam/ /rtse mtho brag dmar me tog ljongs/ /dben zhing nyams dga' sgrub pa'i gnas/ /de ru 'dug la spros pa bcad/ /shog bu gro ga dur khrod ras / /dud dang gur kum sin+d+ra ra/ /dur khrod sol bas snag tsha'o/ /mu khyud gsum pa chu dkyil 'khor/ /dbus kyi ri mo'i mtshan nyid ni/ /sa dang chu dang me dbye yis/ /rdo rje bum pa be+egs kyu yi/ /bsnol dang brtsegs pa go 47—761

bar bya/ /gru bzhi rdo rjes mtshan pa la/ /dang po'i h+ya gsum nang du bri/ /de nas re kha rnam bzhi la/ /mu khyud gsum dang ldan pa la/ /yi ge sum brgya rtsa gnyis kyi/ /h+ya kyi rim pa bri bar bya/ /h+ya rnams thams cad g.yon bskor bri/ /nang du ming yig bri bar bya/ /yi ge sum cu rtsa bzhi la/ /nga nya na ma bzhi spangs nas/ /gzhan rnams 'khor lor dgod par bya/ /ka kha ga gha nga /tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa rte ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ ka kā dha ya gnyis/ kha khā hi khā hi/ ga gādzha ya gāsto ya/ gha ghā ta ya/ ghā ta ya/ tsa tsā la ya gnyis/ tsha tsā ta ya gnyis/ dza dzām+bha ya/dzha dzñā ta ya gnyis/ ṭa ṭā la ya gnyis/ ṭha lbo ka ya gnyis/ ḍa ḍā bha ya gnyis / bhā ṭ+wā ka ya gnyis/ ṇa ṇa sha ya gnyis/ ta tā bha ya gnyis/ tha thā 1bha ya gnyis/ da dā ra ya gnyis/ dha dhā ra ya gnyis/ na nā sha ya gnyis/pa pā ta ya gnyis/ pha pā tā ya gnyis/ ba bārnya ya gnyis/ bha bhe da ya gnyis / ma mā ra ya gnyis/ ya yo ha ya gnyis/ ra ro ha ya gnyis/ la lo ba ya gnyis/ wa wā ha ya gnyis/ sha sho ṣa ya gnyis/ ṣa 6ji ya gnyis/sa sā dha ya gnyis/ ha hā na ya gnyis/ k+ṣa k+ko bha ya gnyis/ che ge mo wa sh+yi kṛt+ta wa sh+ya — ku ru hoḥshādhid+ku ru/ pujid+ku ru/ k+ṣa saṃ rngo ku ru/ khyo baṃ ku ru/ma re ku ru swā hā/ oṃ sidhi sedhi ma hā sidhi pū dza aghi ta bha na ta mā ra ṇi ka ri ṇi rja/oṃ ku su ma mā li bhe hūṃ dzaḥ.oṃ badz+ra ku pa dzi shaṃ bye ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥ.oṃ gro ga ma kriste sarba sha trun nā ma/ rtsa ba'i bye dang sham bu'i h+ya/ /bsgyur dang 'don dang 'jug pa gces / /dang po bsnyen te sgrub pa bya/ /las la sbyar te ma grub na/ /'khor lo ting 'dzin h+ya kyis spogs/ /ḍā ki ma yi rdzas sgrub 'di/ /spog mi 47—762

dgos te gdams pa'i mchog /dung dang ra gan zangs dang lcags/ /snod kyi bye brag bstan pa'o/ /lha dang 'od zer 'khor lo las/ /sgom pa'i rim pa de yis shes/ /thun mong lha dang khyad par lha/ /mchog tu shis pa'i lha zhes bya//brgyad dang nyer lnga'i dus su ni/ /rab tu gnas dang sgrub pa dang / /spogs pa'i dbye ba shes par bya/ /snga dro gung dang nyi ma'i zer/ /de bzhin dus kyang shes par bya/ /chu sa me yi dbye ba yis/ /bgrang phreng gos dang rang mdog shes / /mar dang sbrang rtsi bu ram dang / /zho dang 'bru dang rin chen lnga/ /dug yungs khrag sogs dbye ba shes/ /ma rungs zhi dang longs spyod rgyas/ /dmigs bya dbang bsdud tshar gcod pa/ /nang re dus kyi dang po la/ /gsang sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas/ /zla ba gcig dang gnyis dang ni/ /gsum dang bzhi na 'grub par 'gyur/ /gtor ma mchod pa sbyin sreg gis/ /thun mong khyad par mchog gi lha/ /mnyes par byas la dngos grub blang / /bar chad bsrung ba'i cho ga la/ /rab tu 'bad pas bsgrub par bya/ /lus ngag yid kyis sba bar bya/ /hor pa mi ro rgyal po bzhin/ /shin tu gsang ste spyad na 'grub / /bla ma dam tshig ldan pa la/ /lung sgrub pas ni 'dod pa 'grub/ /de yis man ngag shes par bya/ /rab 'bring tha ma'i dbye ba yis/ /rang dang bsgrub bya'i bsod nams brtag /bsgrub bya'i mtshan nyid de yis shes/ /grub nas gzhan la lung mi dpog /sgrub pos rab tu gnas pa dang / /'khor lo'i rab gnas gso bar bya/ /chos dang ldan pa'i gang zag gis/ /chos kyi don dang sems can don/ /bstan pa'i don du spyad pa na/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /de las gzhan pas mi 'grub ste/ /lus ngag nyon mongs kho 47—763

—dbang du bya ba zhas bya ba/ 1rak+ṣa/ /rgya gar skad du/ ka li tsakra srur+ya wa shaṃ nā ma/ bod skad du/gsal byed nyi ma'i 'khor los dbang du bya ba zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgrub pa pos snod bcud dbang du bya bar 'dod pas/ rang nyid khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa / sku mdog li khri'i phung po ltar dmar ba/ yum bde ba rgyas byed ma dang gnyis su med par bltas te/ h+ya 'di bya khwa ta'i skad mi grag pa'i dus la pad+ma'i phreng ba 'dzin pas bzla bar bya/ oṃ shāk+ṣiṃ ka ri ṇi rgyu/ oṃ ku su ma mā li bhe hūṃ dzāḥ.oṃ badz+ra ku pi dza kaste ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥgro ge ma kṛt+t+waṃ sarba sha t+t+waṃ 2nan/ ka kā dha ya nas / mā ra ṇi yan sngags rgyal dam tshig gi sngags dang 'dra'o/ /'di'i cho ga ni/ shing shun la dang po'i sngags gsum nang du bri/ gru bzhi pa la rdo rjes mtshan pa phyi rol du bri/ de nas mu khyud bzhi pa'i ye ge sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi bye 47—765

rim pas bri/ thams cad g.yon skor du'o/ /mā ra ya btags nas gtor ma dmar po byin na drag por 'gyur ro/ /nga nya gnyis dang bral ba'i na ma gang rung spangs pa'i tsakra zangs sam/ kham sa'i ga'u sor drug par sbrang rtsi dang mar du sbyar ba bcug la/ rkang pas mnan te bzlas na snod bcud kyis bsdus pa la dbang byed par the tshom med do/ /gal te grub par ma gyur na nyi ma dang zla ba'i 'khor los gnad du 'be+ebs par byed do/ /sbyin sreg dang 'khor lo kha spyor gyi man ngag bzhin du spogs pas de ma thag tu 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /'khor lo'i spyor ba rigs gsum gyi sbyor bas byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /mar ngo'i tshes bcu la rab tu gnas par bya'o/ /man ngag bzhin/ nyin mo dang mtshan mo sngags kyis bsrung bar bya ste/ chu la yongs su bzlas nas btung bar bya'o/ /'di ni lhag pa'i lha yis kyang bsgrubs tshon 'grub ste snga ma bzhin no/ /khyad par du sa sna gsum gyi mdag pa la bde ba rgyas byed ma'i sku legs par bya ste/ 'khor lo dang ril bu la man ngag bzhin du bsgrub 3snanas bsgrub bya gang la byin pa dbang du 'gyur ba la the tshom med do/ /gsal byed nyi ma'i mkhor los snod bcud dbang du bya ba/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa rdzogs so // //1paṇ+ḍi ta sru bi ra'i zhal snga nas dang bye/ shākya'i dge slong ba ri lo tsa bas bsgyur ba'o// shudzhatre //47—766

bsdur mchan/765 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉rab gsal byed nyi ma'i 'khor los dbang du bya ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / tsho(〈〈pe 〉〉kun/766 spyi 〈〈pe 〉thasgrub/ 0〈〈pe 〉stabasgrubs/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉ska / ④〈〈pe 〉bodang / ⑧〈〈pe 〉tshogaṅgā lo/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2752)47wa 767

༄7/ /dpal tshogs kyi bdag po zhi ba'i sgrub thabs/khyeg tshogs bdag dkar po'i sgrub thabs man ngag cha lag dang bcas pa bzhugs so//༄4 / /rgya gar skad du/ shri ga na pa ti shan ta na sa dha na ma/ bod skad du / dpal tshogs kyi bdag po zhi ba'i sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por gnas dbe+en zhing yid du 'ong bar / maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa ba yi rnam lngas byug go/ /sman dang dri zhim po'i chus chag chag gdab/ tsan+dan dkar po'i dri'i thig le gcig bya/ me tog dkar po'i tshom bu gcig dgod/ mar me dang dri dang spos dang lha bshos dgram/gtor ma chan nam bag bye la sbrus pa'i zan dkar gsum mngar gsum/ la phug re re/ la du'i ri lu re re gzhugabye /lugs sgu'am bris sku yod na bzhugs su gsol/ de ltar bsham de nas dang po dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa phul la/ bdag nyid yi dam lhar bskyed/ de nas mdun du a las zla ba'i 47—768

steng du yi ge hūṃ dkar po gcig bsam/ de las dpal tshogs kyi bdag po sku mdog dkar po glang po che'i mgo can phyag g.yas gnyis na/ la phug dang dgra sta bsnams pa/ g.yon gnyis na thod pa nor bus bkang ba dang / kha tram̐ kha snams pa/ rin po che dang lha'i me tog gis brgyan pa/ byi ba sngon po'i khri la bzhugs pa gcig gsal bar sgom/ de nas bdag nyid kyi thugs kha nas/'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal tshogs bdag spyan drangs la/ mdun gyi de la bstems 1la/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya bstan/ sku khrus gsol/ mchod pa sngags kyis dbul/de nas zlas pa bya ba ni/ oṃ ba ra ta ka swā hā zhib/ oṃ ba ga ba te e ka doṣ+ṭa bin dha sidhi hūṃ rgyasapa/ oṃ bye ga na pa ti ye swā hā dbang/ zhi ba'i yi ge 'bru bdun pa/ 'bum phrag gcig zlas pa byas na ji ltar 'dod pa'i dngos grub kyang gter/ bsams pa yang 'grub longs spyod che/ yo byad kyang 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /khams gsum gyi nor thams cad 'ong ste phyug por 'gyur ro/ /nye ba'i snying po bhagabate zla ba drug mchod pa dang zlas pa byas na mi tha mal pa yang stong 'khor lo bsgyur ḍa ba'i rgyal po dang bsod nams mnyam par 'gyur ro/ /ming gi snying po gnapa ti zla ba drug tu zlas pa dang mchod pa byas na/ rgyal po dang blon po dang / skyes pa dang / bud med la sogs pa thams cad bdag gi dbang du 'gyur ro/ /zlas pa thon nas/ dkar gtor la sngags btab ste dbul bar bya'o/ /dam tshig ni chos la gnas par bya dgos so/ /gtor ma ni khams zhe las kha zas ro brgya pa/ nam mkha' khengs par sgom mo/ /de la gsol bar bsam mo/ /47—769

phyag 'tshal dpal ldan tshogs bdag dgyes/ /phyag 'tshal dpal ldan zhi ba che/ /phyag 'tshal dpal ldan khro bo che/ /tshe 'di nyid la dngos grub ni/ /ci 'dod pa ni bstsol bar mdzod/ /lha yi rgyal po'i mnga' thang ni/ /bsgrub pa po la bstsol bar mdzod/ /shin tu thugs rje'i bdag nyid las/ /tshogs bdag chen po thugs rje che/ /thugs rje chen pos dbul ba bskyob/ /nor lha chen po khyod nyid la/ /bdag nyid dang bas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dpal ldan tshogs bdag chen po ni/ /sku mdog dkar po glang chen dbu/ /g.yas kyi phyag na la phug bsnams/ /g.yon na yid bzhin nor bu bsnams/ /'og ma dgra sta kha tram̐ ka /gsus chen rgyan rnams kun kyi 7brgyan/ /zla ba byi ba'i khri la bzhugs / /phyag 'tshal dpal ldan tshogs bdag la'o/ /la phug gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /tshe dang longs spyod 'phel ba dang / /nad dang 'byung po zhi bar mdzod/ /mi dang lha klu gnod sbyin rnams/ /bdag gi bran du 'gyur bar shog /lha'i longs spyod mang po las/ /'dod pa'i yon tan 'byung bar shog /dngos grub sgrub pa'i dbang phyug can/ /gdul bya'i dbang gi sku sprul pa/ /lha chen tshogs bdag chen po yis/ /'jig rten 'dir yang bsrung zhing dngos grub stsol / /phyi ma byang chub thob pa'i grogs mdzod cig /zlas pa thon khar gtor ma sngags kyis btab te dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas ye shes sems dpa' gshegs/ dam tshig pa sdus la spyod lam bya'o/ /bsdus pa la dga' ba'i gang zag la bstan pa'o/ /'di jo bos dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud la rten bye nas mdzad pa'o/ /des 'brom/ des spyan snga ba la gnang ba'o// //47—770

bsdur mchan/768 9①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ tsho(〈〈pe 〉〉bzhug769 ①〈〈pe 〉stagams/ du〈〈pe 〉〉sgyur/ dzodu〈〈pe 〉skabam/77༷ 〉〈〈pe 〉nya)sa/ rgya〈〈pe 〉stabarten/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〉maṅgālo/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2753)47wa 771

༄7/ /'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs/1 ༄/ nag po nga 'i gdams ngag tshogs bdag gi sgrub thabs jo bo rje nas rgyud nga /༄go / /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ga na pa ti tsin+ta rad na/ bod skad du/'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshogs kyi bdag po sgrub pa 'a//zhi ba dang / khro bo gnyis las 'di zhi bar sgrub pa'o/ /gnas dbe+en par 'dug te/ maṇ+ḍal khru gang gru bzhir byas la/ ba'i rnam lngas chag chag byas/dbus su me tog dkar po'i tshom bu dgod/ tshogs kyi bdag po'i bris sku'am/lugs sgu gang rung byug bzhugs su gsol/ la phug dang la du las byas pa'i gtor ma bzang du bshams la/ gtor gzhong dang / gtor mas nam mkha' khengs pa/ ro mchog brgya dang ldan pa'i zhal zas su byin gyis brlabs la bzhag/de nas rang yi dam gyi lhar bsams pa'i mdun du/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/ 47—772

yi ge ga dkar po shel gong ltar dkar ba bsams te/ de 'od du zhu ba las lha tshogs kyi bdag po/ sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ glang po che'i mgo can/ mche ba ya cig chag pa/ phyag g.yas dang po na dgra sta/'og ma na la phug g.yon dang po na kha ṭī rtse gsum/ 'og ma thod pa rin po ches gang ba bsnams pa/ lhu tshigs thams cad rin po ches brgyan pa/ byi la'i khri la g.yasabarkyang bzhugs pa gcig bskyed do/ /de nas lag pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur bcangs te/ gung mo'i rgyab du mdzub 1mo btsugs la/ g.yas pa'i ma/thil du gru mo gtsugs nas/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ ri rab kyi rtse mo nas/ lha chen po tshogs bdag spyan drangs par bsams la/ mdun skyed la stem mo/ /de nas bzlas pa byas te/ oṃ pa ra ta ka swā hā/ zhes pa nye ba'i snying po de 'bum phrag gcig bzlas na/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi nor thams cad 'ongs te phyug por 'gyur ro/ /oṃ bha ga wa te/ e ka rdaṣ+ṭa bin+dha hūṃ phaṭa/ rgyas nga 'i thugs sam snying gi snying po'o/ /de bzlas nas zla ba drug mchod pa byas na/mi'i mtha' yang 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /oṃ bye ga na pa ti ye swā hā/ zhes pa ming gi snying po'o/ /de zla ba gcig bzlas na/ skyes pa dang bud med dang rgyal po dang btsun mo la sogs pa thams cad bdag gi dbang du 'gyur ro/ /dam tshig tu chos la gnas par bya'o/ /'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po yid bzhin nor bu'i bsgrub thabs/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug brtul zhugs spyod pa nag po pas mdzad pa dze+egs so// // shin tu zab par 'dug ste/ spyan snga 4rnal 'byor gye zhal nas/ nga la mgon po dang nor lha mang po yod de/ 'di las myur ba mi 'dug gsung ngo / /47—773
bsdur mchan/772 tsho mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/773 97〈〈pe 〉〉tu 'dzub/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉ga (〈〈pe 〉〉btul/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉panga'/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2754)47wa 774

༄sa /'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po'i sprun sreg gi tsho gatsho ga sbyin sreg gal thab khung la rten nas bsgrub pa bye / ༄spro/ /rgya gar skad du/ ar+ya ga na pa ti/ ho ma bi dhi/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga /tshogs kyi bdag po la phyag 'tshal lo /dang po bangamadzod du maṇ+ḍal kyi stegs bu gru bzhi pa nang stong par byas pa rtsig pa'am thab ma'i dkyil du brus la rnam lnga sa ser byug dri bzang chag chag bya/ de nas sa ser pos sgo nub tu bstan pa cig bri'o me togatshom bu dgram/ /der 'khor lo bzhag la/ rdzas ni glang sha /snum khur/ 'bras yos/ bu ram dang bzhi sbyar ba'i ril bu/ sran ma btsos pa tsam byas la rang gi g.yas su bzhag /mchod pa dang gtor ma g.yon du bsham/ de nas kha byang du ltas la/ tshad med pa bzhi sgom/ rang yi dam du bskyed snye/ thab tu tshogs bdag rtsa sngags kyis bskyed la/ rang gi sa bon gye 'od kyis/ tshogs bdag ye shes pa spyan drangs la yi ge bzhis dgug gzhug 47—775

bya'o / /gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ gtor ma byin brlabs byas la mi btang bar bzhag /mchod pa tshar gcig 'bul/ bstod snapa bya de nas me sbar la ril bu brgya rtsa brgyad po re re dang / rtsa sngags spel tshig can re re dang bcas pa tshar bsreg /yang na rtsa sngags kyis nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags re brjod la bsreg /ril bu brgyad dngos grub kyi sngags kyis bsreg pa bzhin bya/ de yang ma 'byor na rtsa sngags kyis ril bu bdun bsreg /dngos grub kyi rgyal po sngar bzhin te/ 'di la rgyas basbus med la/ rtsa sngags kyi rgyas bsdus de ltar shes par bya'o/ /de nas sbyin sreg rdzogs pa dang / me lha mdun gyi nam mkhar gshegs la thal ba phyir gsal 2 la/ ril bu bdun la rtsa sngags re bzlas la 'khor lo'i lte bar bzhag ril bu brgyad la dngos grub kyi snga gas brgya rtsa bzlas la 'khor lo'i rtsibs la bzhag /de thams cad thal bas bkab la/ g.yam pas ma reg par kha bcad la 'dag zhal legs par byas te/ maṇ+ḍalabyas te der me tog ser po'i tshom bu dgram / mchod stod bya/ dang po byin rlabs byas pa'i gtor ma de 'bul/bkra shis brjod de nas sbyin sreg bya ba ni/ me gtong dus su rdza'i 'khor lo bzhug /'khor lo'i yi she tshogs bdag me lhar bskyed/ oṃ grum bye ga na nga/ ti ye swā hā/ tshogs bdag bang mdzod dam thab kyi phyogs su yon bdag gi tshul du bzhugs su bcug go/ /tshogs kyi bdag po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rdzogs sto// //47—776
①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉7'i sgrub pa'o// ①〈〈pe 〉〉skyed/①〈〈pe 〉snostod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉bsal/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉thas/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2755)47—777

༄༅/ /'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po la bstod pa/hūṃ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ar+ya ga na pa ti stu ste/ bod skad du/'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po la bstod pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten mgon mdzad snang ba mdzad/ /dpal mdzad de bzhin phan pa mdzad/ /mnyam pa med cing dpe med pa/ /tshogs bdag de la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gsang sngags dbang phyug rig sngags rgyal / /longs spyod 'byung gnas gter kyi mchog /'bras bu mngon rtogs ston pa yi/ /tshogs bdag de la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dpa' bo chen po bdud las rgyal/ /stobs chen nyon mongs g.yul 'joms pa'i/ /bgegs 'joms sdug bsngal zhi mdzad pa/ /glang chen sna ldan gtso la 'dud/ /rin chen rgyal po rin chen skus/ /rin chen rin chen chen po 'byung / /rin chen bstan pa bsrung mdzad pa/ /glang chen sna ldan khyod la 'dud/ /tshogs kyi bdag po rdzu 47—778

'phrul che/ /lha dmag dkar po dbugs 'byin zhing / /lha min nag po'i g.yul zlog pa/ /glang chen sna ldan gtso la 'dud/ /sku ni yon tan rin chen stenyul/ /gsung ni yon tan ngo bo nyid/ /thugs ni yon tan bdag nyid can/ /glang chen sna ldan gtso la 'dud/ /tshogs kyi bdag po'i bstod pa slob dpon nag po zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// ② //bsdur mchan/778 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ga 'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po la bstod pa bzhugs so/ /779 ①〈〈pe 〉nyesdo/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〉maṅgālo/ shu /bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2756)47—779

༄7/ /tshogs bdag gsang grub/1 sngag tshogs kyi bdag po'i gsang ba'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ raḥ/ /rgya gar skad du/ gha na pa ti ghu ha sa dha na ma/ bod skad du/ tshogs kyi bdag po'i gsang ba'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'gro don spyodapasbyo nga ba la mdzad/ /bsod nams tshogs tshad med pa sogs 2 dgos pa'i phyir/ /tshogs kyi bdag po bsgrub par bya/ /mi skad khyi skad mi thos pa'i/ /gnas ni gangs ri mtho ba'i rtser/ /lha chen gnas pa'i sa yin te/ /tshogs kyi bdag po sgrub par bya/ /yang na maṇ+ḍal dmar por bya zangs ma'i maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi la/ /dmar ngo/ bri byi'i rig da7ra ngo/ bya bum pa lta bu'i dkyil 'khor bri/ /de stengs rin ngo/ che'i thog tu gzugs ba'ag rin chen lnga dang bum rdzas kun ka ra bum pa/ yin wi ti bzhag /nang du chu dang 'o ma drug /skyes skyed zer pa'i sa bon shel mdog gzhug /ga bur dza ti sdon sogs dri bzang rnams gdab/ /de stengs tshogs kyi bdag po'i rten ni/47—780

lung pa byang shar kha ltas sa dang chu sres pa la/ /skar ma rgyal la tshogs kyi bdag po'i sku bzhengs te/ /spre'uzhal gcig phyag bzhi sgu mdog dmar/ /g.yas pa pho rtags snang srid mes po 'dzin/ /g.yon na ra nu'i momatshan ma bsnams/ /phyag gnyis thal sbyar spos gdong 'dzin/ /zhabs gnyis skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs//khong par spre'u'i snying du ma gcig gzhug par bya/ /snying du gzhug par bya/ gsang sngags 'bru bcu mthing shog la rin po ches bris la snying khar drilalagazhug /sku gzugs legs par tshar ba dang / /bum pa'i steng du bzhugs su gsol/ /mchod pa gtor ma mdun du bshams/ /de nas rang gi yi dam bsgom/ /stong pa'i ngang las mdun du yi ge gha/ /de gyur spre'u phyag bzhi pa/ /yeshesapasum cu rtsa gsum gnas nas ni/ /tshogs kyi bdag po spyan drangs bstem/ /rang bzhin dag pa lha'i yul/ /lha chen yab yum sprul pa'i sras/ /nor bu dri ma med pa ni/ /gzhon nu stobs ldan gcig gis sras/ /phyag bzhis gling bzhi khyab par nyul/ /lha dmag dkar po'i kha lo sgyur/ /gang gis khyod kyi mtshan 'dzin pa/ /de la nor gyi char pa 'be+ebs/ /thugs dam rgyud bskul spyan 'dren na/ /thugs rjes dgongs nas gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ gha na pa ti a kar+ṣa ya dza dza/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin brlabs bya/ /mchod pas mchod cing gsang sngags bzla/ /tshogs kyi bdag po'i thugs kha yi/ /zla bar steng du gha yig dmar ngo/ rtsa ba'i sngags gzungs sngags kyis bskor/ /oṃ rtsagha na ma gha na swā hā/ oṃ gzungs snga gas rad na rad na—/ rod na rod na/ gha na ba ti/ gha gha gha gha gha gha gha gha gha pa ti swā hā/oṃ tsu ru tsu ru ma nu ma tra/ tu ru tu ru gha gha ta ma gha na pa ti ye swā hā/ rtsa sngags lazhag bdun gzungs sngags dang stelabazhag bdun bcas pa/ /zhag bdun smra ba 47—781

bcad la bzlas/ /tshogs bdag thugs dkyil yi ge la/ /'od 'phros khams gsum nor bcud bsdus/ /lha chen zhal nas snying khar zhugs/ /gsang ba nas byung nas nibum pa bdud rtsi'i rnam par 'khyel/ /dngos grub tshul du bumachu debatung bar bya/ /de nas las la sbyar ba ni/ /gang 'dod phomo'irten ni phyar zhing mthongs nas g.yab/ /'khor lo bsam gtan bzhin du las la sbyar bar bya/ /phortagasasridapa'i mes po zangs la bya/ nang du gang 'dod pho mo dbang du bya ba mtshan ma sa de'igazhug /rtsa ba'i sngags la che ge mo bā shaṃ ku ru swā hā/ las sngags bzlas/ /spel chi1ga ming dang dbang ni sham bu bsgyur bar bya/ /zhag bdun las la sbyar byas na/ /srid pa'i rgyal po nyer gcig tshar nas mi lam du 'byung ba dang dar snas brgyan/ /yul mis ma mthong bar 'khor mthong ba'i 'phyar zhing g.yab/ /lha dang mi'i bu mo bdud/ /yang na ra nu mtshan ma la/ /zhag bdun las la sbyar byas nas/ /dar ram 'phan shing rtse la 'phyar yang na mthongs nas g.yab bo/ /lha dang mi'i bu mo 'dud/ /yid 'phrog sngags kyang 'di nyid do/ /rtsasngags oṃ gha na ma gha na dza ya swā hā/ las sbyor sngags oṃ bha bha seng seng / khaṃ khaṃ/ yer yer/ nga rab ghu mi ha sa rma khri/ che ge mo ba shi ku ru ye swā hā/ de nas 'khor lo'i las sbyor ni/ /maṇa dhal steng du mda' bzhi gzugs/ /de steng bzhag pa'i smad 'tshong ma ras la bri 'khor lo bsreg rtsibs drug smad 'tshong ma'i khyim gyi mes/ /'od zer lcags kyu ltar spros pa'i/ /bsgrub bya dbang med dgug par bya/ /dud pa gang du song tha mar btso bya drag pa dang zas bsreg ba'i gnas//'od kyis bkug cing rang la bzhug /rnala'abyor pas zhag grangs bdun gyis 'dod pa byung ba'i mngon du gyur pa'i bar du 'grub/ /de nas mchod dang dkar gsum mngar gsum la du la phugagator ma dang / /bstod pa dang ni bzlas pa dang / /dngos grub bslang 47—782

dang gsol ba gdab/ /ye shes gshegs cing dam tshig bsdu/ /rgyun du mchod cing bsten na ye shes pa gshegs la dben par bzhugs la gang 'dod gsol ba gdab ྅glu gzugs sba hu/nga skya/ཿdzad par bya/ /skar ma rgyal la zla re zhing / /mchod nas gang 'dod gsol ba gdab / /brtson 'grus can gyis sgrub pa brtsam/ /'dod pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /'di sbyar ba las bsod nams gang / /des ni 'gro ba ma lus pa / /'dod dgu'i dpal dang ldan 'gyur te/ /bla med byang chub thob par shog /tshogs kyi bdag po'i sgrub thabs slob dpon di paṃ ka ra dzñā nas mdzad pa'o / /rdzogs so// ① //bsdur mchan/78 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈'dir bstan dkar chag 〉ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉'thog782 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〉maṅgālo/ shu /bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2757)47—783

༄khya/ /tshogs kyi bdag po la bstod pa/shā ༄༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ ga na pa ti stod tram̐/ bod skad du/tshogs kyi bdag po la bstod pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sum cu rtsa gsum dga' ldan lha yul nas/ /lha'i ded dpon tshogs bdag bzhugs pa ni/ /tshogs bsags smon lam stobs kyis lha chen sras su 'khrungs/ /thugs rje chen pos byin rlabs gling bzhi'i bdag po mdzad/ /'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang sprul sku khyed la stod/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi phyag bzhis 'gro don mdzad/ /gzhon nu phyed pa'i dkyil krung phyed pas bzhugs / /yid bzhin nor bu'i brgyan spras 'dod dgu char du 'bebs/ /thugs gtum dpal brtul che bas lha min g.yul ngo bzlog d+ngha /dregs gtum nga rgyal mchog mnga' khyod la stod/ /nyi zla la phug bgrang 'phreng dgra sta phor pa snams thu—/ /lha yi na bza' pan tsa li ka sku la gsol/ /lha mchog khyed 'dra 47—784

'jig rten gzhan na mi bzhugs pas/ /khyad 'phags yon tan mthar phyin rjid pa'i sgu la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dug gsum mun pa mi mnga' sku mdog dung lta bu/ /mdzes pa'i rgyan spras mthong ba tsam gyis lha mo 'du/ /lha dmag dkyil bzhugs bso sgra chen pos stong gsum ldeg /gdug pa'i nga ro 'od zer 'phros pas bgegs rnams 'joms/ /rngam pa'i nga ros rgya mtsho'i klu rnams bsreg par byed//'gran pa'i zla med stobs chen khyod la phyag 'tshal stod/ /rnam shes rags pa skye phyir spre'u'i sgu ru sprul/ /spyan zlog spre'u'i zhal ni cung zad khro bo'i tshul/ /chags pa'i dbang gis byi ru lta bur sku mdog dmar/ /phyag gnyis thal sbyor spos ldong dri yis lha rnams bsdud/ /g.yas pa srid pa'i mes pos mo rgyud dbang du basbud/ /g.yon pa ra nu'i mtshan mas skyes pa las la 'khol/ /thugs las 'od zer bkye bas khams gsum bran du 'khol/ /skyi ser rlung bzhin nam mkha' khyab par rgyu bar byed/ /byed sku'i 'od zer lcags kyus 'jig rten nor rdzas kun/ /gcig char bsdus te sgrub po bdag la'ang nor kyi char/ /'be+ebs zhing dgos 'dod rol pa'i dngos kun bdud rtsir zhu/ /rtsa lam nas rgyud gsang ba'i rdo rje nas ster )ba/ /rgyun rab sbrengs pas ka ra wa ti stams pa las/ /'phongs pa sgrol mdzad bdud rtsi'i rgyun la skyabs su mchi/ /tshogs chen tshogs dpal tshogs dbang tshogs kyi bdag po la/ /btsun mo ha ris mdun nas phyag dang mchod pa 'bul/ /lha mchog byed kyi sgu la bdag gis bstod byed na/ /bdag gi 'dod pa'i don rnams byed kyis sgrub tu gsol/ /dpal gshin rje gshed kyi dngos grub rnyes 2pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta a mo gha badz+ra gyis/ dur khrod shaṃ ka ru srungs su/ tshogs bdag zhal gzigs nas bstod pa'o// //47—785
bsdur mchan/784 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉rtor bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉zlog ②〈〈pe 〉〉brnams/785 ①〈〈pe 〉sngagater/②〈〈pe 〉〉brnyes/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2758)47wa 786

ltarad+kudaphyakrasgomu mkhyud phyi mar pho la ka li mo la li de'i gi.a / nang ma mkhyad la sir+sha ༄gzangs sngags bri/ lte ba'i ma ༄༄mi noramemakhyud la rtsa sngags spel tshig can bri/lte bar gang 'dod dbang du bsdus nga 'icag /rtsabs brgyad la las sngags bha bha sogs bri//47—787

༄ga /tshogs kyi bdag po chen po khams gsum dbang sdud dmar po'i sgrub pa'i thabs ①༄/ tshogs kyi bdag po 'dod pa'i dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/༄spro—/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā ga na pa ti dha tu tri ka ra ta shi ku ru sa dhā māṃ/bod skad du/ tshogs kyi bdag po chen po khams gsum dbang sdud dmar po'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas lha chen dbang phyug dpal/ /tshogs kyi bdag po sgrub par bya/ /nags tshal ri bo dmar po ru/ /nub ltas dbe+en par maṇ+ḍal ni/ /zla khaṃ ra ga lta bu la/ /tsan dan gur gum dag gis byug /me tog dmar po'i tshom bu dgu'am lngadagod/ /sku dang bum pa legs par maṇ+ḍalastedagram/ /rnam lnga la sogs mchod pa ni/ /rig pa 'dzin pas ci nus bsham/ /la du la phug gtor ma yang / /me tog dmar pos brgyan pa dgod/ /pad+ma'i sdong po'i phreng ba dag /legs par g.yas pas bzung la bzlas pa bya/ /de nas bdag nyid mgon po ni/ /'od dpag med 47—788

byedapa'i khro bor rtamagrin du skyed/ /de'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ /maṇ+ḍal steng gi tshom bu 'istengagi sku las/ /lha chen 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ni/ /sku mdog dmar po hri las skyed/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi bgrang phreng g.yas dang po dang/ /g.yon dang po la phug 'dzin pa'i phyag rgya dang / /la du'i phor pa g.yas logs su/ /phreng ba 'dzin pa'i 'og tu bsam/ /dgra sta dmar po g.yon 'ogamayin par/ /glang chen gdong la ral pa can/ /mu tig la sogs brgyan gyis spras/ /sku smad ljang nag dbang sngon dar gyis blubs/ /do shal la sogs phreng bas mdzes/ /zla ba pad dkar steng na ni/ /g.yas rkyang ba yi tshul gyis ni/ /bum pa sngon po'i khri la bzhugs/ /'od zer dmar 'phros lcags kyu can/ /ye shes dgug sogs cho ga ni/ /mkhas pas tshul bzhin byas nas kyang / /spro sdu man ngag can gyis ni—/ /sgrub bya ganga'adod yid ladamigs pa'i ting 'dzin sgom/ /bzlas pas sku gsung thugs rnams bskul/ /sku bskul ba'i snying po oṃ triḥgaḥṇa ba ta ye/ ma hā rak+ṣa sa ma 'bum phrag gcig yahūṃdzaḥgasung bskul ba oṃ ma hā pad+ma gaḥn pa ta ye bye swā hā/ thugs skul ba hriḥtsi ta gu ṇa sid dhi ba ra ta ka swā hā/ nye ba'i snying pos gsum ka skul gsung oṃ ma hā rak+ta ga na pa ta ye/ a kar+ṣa ya dza hūṃ baṃ hoḥswa dha ya 'bum phrag gcig swā hā/ zhes pa'i gsang sngags ma nor bzlas/ /thun 'tshams gtor mas mchod par bya/ /stod pas dngos grub gsol ba gdab/ /dang po theg chen bsam pa las cho ga rdzogs nas dngos grub blang / /rtags bzang mthong nas sbyin sreg ni/ /bla ma'i man ngag bzhin du bya/ /de las dngos grub du ma 'byung / /'di la the tshom yod min te/ /nges pa nyid du 'grub par bshad/ /yang na tshogs bdag chen po de/ /gtsug lag khang chen nang du ni/ /'dod yon du mas bskor ba ni/ /47—789

rab tu bsam bya spro bsdu bya/ /de ltar ting 'dzin 'bad pa na/ /rgyal srid longs spyod dpag med ni/ /'khor lo sgyur ltar lha dang mnyam/ /mgon po nyid kyis ster bar ni/ /lung bstan rgyal ba mchog gis gsungs/ /dpal tshogs kyi bdag po 'dod pa'i dbang phyug sgrub pa zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi bla ma chen po tsan ṭa pas/ dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i rtog pa chen po dbang gi le'u la brten nas mdzad pa/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal bai ro tsa na'i zhal snga ①nas/ bod kyi lots+tsha ba ldi ri chos kyi grags pas sgyur ②ba rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/788 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/79 ①〈〈pe 〉spanga'/ ②〈〈pe 〉thasgyur/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2759)47—790

༄ga /'dod pa'i dbang phyug gi bstod pa/1༄7/ /bstod pa bya ba ni/ hri/ gsung las skyes pa'i mgon po tshogs bdag ni/ /pad+ma ra ga nyi ma gzhon nu'i gdong / /glang chen zhal la lha'i nor bus brgyan/ /spyan gsum rab mdzes ud pal ze 'bru ltar/ /rab rgyas gzigs pas 'gro ba'i dbul ba skyob/ /mche ba dkar po rin chen mdangs dang ldan/ /rin chen phyag rgya g.yas na bgrang phreng dang / /zhal zas du ma la du'i bzed zhal 'chang / /gdug pa kun sgrol dgra sta dmar po 'chang / /'byung po'i kha zas la phug g.yon na 'dzin/ /lha las spags pa'i rgyan dang cha lugs can/ /ral pa'i thor tshugs khro bo sprin ltar 'phro/ /hri yi sgra 'byin gsung gi nga ro yis/ /khams gsum dbang bsdud yid la re ba skong / /dbang sngon nam bzas sku smad mjes par bklubs/ /pad dkar zla ba'i 'od kyi gdan la ni/ /longs spyod bum pa sngon po bai ḍūr mdog /rab tu mnan nas 'dod 47—791

pa'i 'bras bu ster/ /lha chen 'dod pa'i dbang phyug khyod la stod/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa rab tu skyong la stod/ /mu stegs byed sogs dbang du byed la stod/ /longs spyod mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod la stod/ /dam tshig 'dzin la dngos grub ma lus rtsol zhes stod do/ /bla ma chen po tsaṇ+ḍa pas mdzad do// ① //bsdur mchan/791 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈snar bstan dkar chag 〉〉ltar bkod/792 ①〈〈pe 〉〉neshu / maṅgālo/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (276༷)47—792

༄༅/ /tshogs kyi bdag po khro bo'i sgrub thabs/ 1—༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ gaḥṇa pa ti gro dha ya sa dha dze+e/ bod skad du/tshogs kyi bdag po khro bo'i sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig sdom pa la gnas pas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis sgrub byed pa'i/ /tshogs bdag chen po sgrub par bya/ /maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi ser po'i steng / /me tog ser po'i tshom bu dgod/ /spos kyi dri chus chag chag gdab/ /gur gum ghing sa ser gyis/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad legs bris te/ /ma hā gaḥṇa'i ru pa ni/ /tsan dan la sogs khyad par shing / /rin chen gser la sogs pa 'am/ /sa la de dag brdar ba la/ /spre'u gzugs thal sbyar khong stong nang / /spre'u'i tsi ta go ri'i rgyan/ /dar sna lnga dang ldan par bri/ /zhabs su gang 'dod ming spel bya / /rat+na 'bru sna dri sna bzhug /zhabs sdoms rab gnas legs byas la/ /dngos grub ster zhing rang la gzigs/ /'dab brgyad 'khor gyi gnod sbyin 47—793

brgyad / /ser po phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar/ /rin chen thogs pa gtso la 'dud/ /tshad me+ed bzhi po sgom bya zhing / /bdag nyid yi dam lhar sgoms nas / /rang bzhin gnas nas spyan drangs te/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥdagug bzhug bstem / /dgyes gur mchod pa rnam lnga dbul/ /la phug la du gtor ma dang / /tsan dan dkar po dri bgos par/ /ma tsa ra'i hu ga dang / /a ga ru dang gu gul gyi/ /khyad par dri yi dril bus bdug /'dod pa'i don ni gsol bar bya/ /rgyu skar rgyal gyi nyin par gnas / /zhag bdun sgrub cing rigs sngags bzlas/ /oṃ rad na rad na rod ṇa rod ṇa/ gaḥṇa pa ti gaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥṇa pa ti tsu ru tsu ru/ ma ṇi bha tra tu ru tu ru gu 2gha ta ya/ gaḥṇa pa ti ye swā hā/ 'dod pa'i don rnams 'grub pa'i rtags/ /rin chen char 'be+ebs lo legs rtags/ /gter rnams rnyed cing dge rnams 'grub/ /'dzam gling nor rnams lag tu 'ong //de nas grub par gyur pa dang / /sku de mchod pa'i gral du bzhugs/ /za ma tog du dar gyis dril/ /mi la mi bstan sba bar bya/ /oṃ ba ra ta ka swā hā/oṃ bye gaḥṇa pa ti ye swā hā/ oṃ bha ga ba ti oṃ ka rda bye bhernya t+t+waṃ phaṭa/ gal te ma grub na spogs pa'i cho ga ni/ zhag gcig skyar te/ des kyang ma grub na/gzugs mgo bzhug bzlog ste gu gul gyi dud pas bdug cing mal 'og tu nyung dkar gyis brabs pas 'grub par 'gyur ro // //2sbyin bsreg ni/ 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rgyud le'u dgu pa nas/dbang dang dam tshig ldan pa yis/ /bgegs kyi rgyal po mchod pa na/ /ma mo'i gnas dang mkha' 'gro 'du/ /dben par tsan dan du ru ka /si h+la ga 47—794

bur la sogs spos/ /me tog dmar po'i mchod pas mchod/ /sngags bzlas gtor mas 'dod don gsol/ /mkhas pas me la sbyin bsreg bya/ /gsungs pas / dkyil 'khor zla gam dmar po bya/ de'i dbus su pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad bya/ de'i rtsar yang zla kham dmar po gcig bya/ 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su shing 'bras bu can rtsigs la sbyin bsreg bya/ ril bu dmar po brgya rtsa brgyad/ nas nag 'bru gu brgya rtsa brgyad/ la du dum bu brgya rtsa brgyad rnams sngags gnyis sbrel la dbul/ oṃ gaḥgaḥsebye sidhi/ sarba arja me pra sa dha ya hūṃ hūṃ dzaḥdzaḥswā hā/ dgug pa'o/ /oṃ āḥgaḥhūṃ swā hā/ bzlas pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ya ste/ gdan dbul ba'o/ /rang gi yi dam gyi lhas tshogs bdag sngags pas/ tshogs bdag gis lha 'dre thams cad dbang du bsnyus te/ ci bsams pa thams cad sgrubs par bsam mo rgyal ba'i bzhed pa sgrub pa dang / sdug bsngal chu bor gnas pa yi/ /skye bo yun du skyab pa'i phyir//byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed bgyi/ /nyi ma'i 'od bzhin gsal ba'i zhal/ /ma rig sgrib pa sangs pa'i sku/ /'jig rten 'dir ni don mdzad pa'i/ /tshogs bdag nyid la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsum mchod gzungs bzlas pas/ /bgegs sel don kun sgrub byed ces/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis lung bstan gang / /tshogs bdag nyid la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha rnams khyed la mchod par byed/ /tshogs bdag khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /me tog 'phreng sogs rin chen dbyig /la du la phug yid 'ong zas/ /tsan dan ga bur du ru ka /si h+la la sogs spos mchog dang / /mar me rol mo la sogs kyis/ /bgegs rgyal tshogs bdag 'khor bcas mchod/ /bdag la dngos grub rgya chen 47—795

bstsol / /ces gsol ba gdab po/ /dbu rgyan pa'i zhal nas/ 'di lha chen brgyad kyi yab yin pas/ spogs chog byar mi rung gsung / dam tshig mi gtsang ba la 'dzem/ ci za ci mthung gi phud kyis mchod/ bla ma gser gling pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// skye//bla mas tshogs bdag gi rtogs 2pa gsum/ bsgrub thabs bzhi/ bgegs sel ba'i mdo/ de'i las tshogs/'di rnams bsgyur ba yin no/ /dngos grub 'byung ba ni lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba'o/ /gzungs kyi bshad pa ni dz+wa pa/ ti sha las byung ngo / /bsdur mchan/793 1ma/tshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉/ tshogs kyi bdag po khro bo'i sgrub thabs/794 1 〈〈pe 〉ras/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉gha/ 〈〈pe 〉〉//796 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〉maṅgā lo/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉rtogabasdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2761)47rdo796

༄ga /tshogs kyi bdag po dam tshig gsang ba'i bsgrub thabs zhes bya ba/1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ gha na ba ti sa ma ma nu sma ra gha ha sa dha na ma/bod skad du/ tshogs kyi bdag po dam tshig gsang ba'i bsgrub thabs zhes bya ba/dpal tshogs kyi bdag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di ltar 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /thugs rjes gzhan la dus gsum du/ /gzigs par mdzad pa'i lha khyod kyis/ /thugs la sprul pa tshogs bdag gi/ /bsgrub pa'i thabs chen mchog gyur pa/ /bdag gi ji ltar rnyed par bri/ /'byung po kun gyi rgyal po mchog /bsgrub pa po la nyer brtse ba'i/ /tshogs bdag bsgrub par 'dod pa yis/ /dang po gnod sbyin bsgrub la dpal/ /bla ma la gus snying rje che/ /brtson ldan dad pa cher gyur pas/ /bla ma sngon du mnyes par bya/ /lung dang gdams ngag ldan pa yis/ /yid dga' ba'i gnas dag tu/ /maṇ+ḍal chag chag mchod pa bshams/ /tho rang — —7byang chub sems bskyed nas/ /bla ma 47—797

sangs rgyas la sogs mchod/ /de nas skyabs gsol gtor ma sbyin/ /dge ba bsngo ba byas nas ni/ /khams gsum ma lus sems can la/ /byams pa sngon du 'gro ba yis/ /tshad med bzhi yis nyon mongs rnams/ /ma lus par ni zhi bar bya/ /de rjes phyi nang chos rnams kun/ /stong pa nyid du bsam byas te/ /oṃ swa bha wa be+e shud sgo sarba dharma swa bha wa bi shud bho haṃ/ sngags kyis dag pa bsam byas te/ /de yang ye shes chad pa med/ /snying rje'i ngang du bsam byas te/ /oṃ shu dzu na ta bye na badz+ra swa bha wa ad ma kolhahaṃ/ zhes pa'i dag pa bsgom par bya//stong pa'i ngang las rnal 'byor pa/ /yi dam gang yin gsal bar blta'/ /de'i mdun du zla ba dang / /byi ba'i steng du tshogs bdag ni/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi sgu mdog dkar/ /brkyang bskum 'gying ba'i tshul du bzhugs/ /lha yi nam bza' bstod 1g.yog ste/ /rin chen rgyan gyis legs par brgyan/ /phyag g.yas na la phug dang / de bzhin dgra sta bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon pas rtse gsum thod pa 'dzin/ /spyan gsum gsum pa shin tu 'phyang / /dbu yi steng na zla tshes la/ /'od dpag med pa bzhugs pa'o/ /ye shes bkug la yi ge gsum / /rang rang gnas su bsam par bya/ /de la mchod cing gtor ma sbyin / /de nas sku la dmigs pa'am/ /rang gi snying nas gsang sngags ni/ /skyes te kha nas tshogs bdag gis/ /zhal du zhugs pa snying khar bstem/ /bstod cing skul la lte ba nas/ /'thon nas bdag gi lte bar zhugs/ /mchod cing bsnyen bkur byed par bsam/ /de ltar bzlas pa'i sngags bstan pa/ /bla ma'i lam las byung ba dang / /rgyud kyi gdams pa ltar btu' ba/ /oṃ zhes bya ba dang pos ste/ /yid sbyin nor bu bsam 'phel la/ /me yi yi ge gdan la 47—798

bzhugs / /dbyangs yig drug pa 'og tu gdags/ /thig leḥn das brgyan par bya/ /mtshan gyi dang po blangs bya ste/ /bzhi pa'i lnga pa yang sbyar bar bya/ /de nas lnga pa'i dang po bri/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan dang po/ /de yi rjes su bstan par bya/ /rlung gi sa bon de nas sbyin/ /dbyangs yig brgyad pas brgyan par bya/ /dro ba'i mtha' ma gnyis dag la/ /dbyangs yig gnyis pas brten par bya/ /de ni mtshan gyi gsang sngags pa/ /rang 'dod 'bras bu sbyin pa yin/ /oṃ ni dpal ldan bkra shis te/ /dang po bu la bzhugs par bya//yid sbyin bsam grub rin chen gyis/ /yi ge de rjes bsam par bya/ /nyi ma'i sa bon de nas bri/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan dang po/ /de nas blo yis blang bar bya/ /gsal byed dang po de nas brjod/ /rin chen sa bon de nas sbyin / /las kyi yi ge de nas brjod/ /ring par ston pa 'dod pa 'grub/ /oṃ ni dang po tshangs pa ste/ /de nas nor 'dod rin chen bzhag1 /gsal byed dang po de nas bstan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan dang po'o/ /dbyangs yig brgyad pas steng brgyan pa/ /de nas gsal byed dang po yin/ /sde mtshan khyegasum pa'i bzhi pa la/ /dang po lnga pa sbyar bar bya/ /sde mtshan ཿlnga pa'i dang po ni/ /gsum pa'i dang pos ston par bya/ /'dod pa skong ba'i yi ge la/ /dbyangs yig yi ge gsum pas mnan/ /bzhi pa'i lnga pas bsten bya'o/ /de rjes bzhi pa'i gsum pas bzhag /'khros pa'i sa bon chen po bzhin/ /drag po las dang sbyar bas na/ /rang 'dod lha dang phrad par 'gyur/ /de ltar dngos grub mchog 'dod pas/ /lha chen zhal ston bar dag tu/ /sngags la shin tu 'bad par bya/ /'di ni dam pa'i sngags so/ /gal te las la spyor 47—799

'dod na/ /chang dang la phug la du dang / /'o mas 'phags pa mchod par bya//bstod cing las kun gang bsgoms 'grub/ /'di ni lha chen mnyes pa yin/ /yang na zangs sam 'khar ba la/ /gzugs byas maṇ+ḍal gtsang ma'i steng / /bzhugs te mchod pas mnyes byas nasalku/ /des kyang bdag la dngos grub ster/ /yang na gtsang ma'i ras dag la/ /mkhas pas bris te rgyal bab la/ /mchod cing bstod na gang bsgoms grub/ /yang na me tog dmar po la/ /bsngags bzlas steng na gtor byas na/ /bdag gi re ba thams cad skong / /yang na dngul lam shel dag la/ /'phags pa byas te mchod bstod na/ /spyi bor bzhugs la mi sngags bzla/ /grong khyer dbus su 'ongs pa na/ /mi rnams 'du bar 'gyur ba yin/ /yang na glang chen chang dang ni/ /khrag dang myos byed thig le yis/ /mnyam pa'i ras la bri byas na/ /phyag 'tshal mchod bstod gsol ba gdab/ /nye ba'i sngags bzlas bskul byas na/ /'phags pa nyid dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /rten de kun la bstan mi bya/ /la phub — byesngags kyis btab pa dbul/ /tsan dan chu'i sku khrus gsol/ /de ni 'thung bsam byugs pa yin1/ /nad rnams kun las grol bar 'gyur/ /zangs kyi tshogs bdag 'the 'ong tshad/ /byas ste lag g.yon ste bzhugs ste/ /rgyal po'i bud me'i zho 'dzin nas/ /glang po'i sna yis phug byas te/ /bdag la nye bar brtse bar bsam / /mtshan kyi rig pa bzlas byas nas/ /de nyid nges par 'ong bar 'gyur / /gsang sngags 'bras bu nyid du 'dod/ /gzhon nu mas bskal srad bu la/ /mdud pa nyi shu rtsa gcig byas/ /sngags re lha re bsam byas pas/ /dpung pa g.yas la babyungs pa na/ /de nyid myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /ghi 47—800

hang ka ra bu ram dang / /sbrang rtsi rang gi thig le las/ /tshogs bdag bris ste de la dmigs/ /yi ge brgya pa bzlas byas te/ /de nas 'dod pa'i don dmigs nas/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas pas 'grub/ /de nas sku gzugs dar gyis dril/ /rang gi mchan khung g.yon par sba/ /des ni 'dod pa kun 'grub 'gyur/ /'o ma dang ni glang gi sha /bu ram bca' yos bcas pas ni/ /ri lu byas ste tshogs bdag gi/ /'khor lo'i steng du tsan dan shing / /bcer ste me la sreg pas ni/ /ming dang spel bas don kun 'grub/ /zhag bdun bar du byas pas ni/ /dbul po phun sum tshogs par 'gyur/ /glang gi sog pa sha med la/ /gzugs bris de mtha' sngags kyis bskor/ /nam mkhar bstan pas ser ba 'chad/ /mnyam pa'i ras la tshogs bdag gi/ /gzugs bris de mtha' sngags kyis bskor/ /shing rings rtse la phyar byas pas/ /pha rol dmag rnams bzlog pa yin/ /de sogs las rims ma lus kun/ /bla ma mnyes shing lha mnyes pas/ /'grub 'gyur 'di ni mchog tu bsgrub/ /bdag gi tshogs kyi bdag po yi/ /bsgrub thabs rgyas pa gang brtsams las/ /'dod don 'bras bu legs 'grub ste/ /byang chub mchog la sems gzhol shog/ //dpal tshogs kyi bdag po dam tshig mchog du gsang ba zhes bya ba'i bsgrub thabs / grub pa thob pa'i bla ma tsa na kir tis mdzad pa'o/ /dpal tshogs kyi bdag po mnyes par bya ba rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi rnal 'byor pa chen po bhe ro tsa na dang / lots+tsha ba dha ri ban dhe chos kyi grags pas/ nyang smad rma lung gi gnas su bsgyur ba'o/ /lho phyogs kyi rgyal po ghu na so spra ba des pan tri ta nag po dpal 'dzin/47—801

des rnal 'byor pa ka na tsa na ra/ de bla ma tsa na kir ti/ des bla ma ta thā ga ta ra kri ta/ des bla ma dzi na ka shrī la/ des bla ma bho ro tsa na'o/ /dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud 1 dang / rdo rje sems dpa' — bhezhus lan gyi rgyud zudang /bla ma kan tsi ni ra'i gdams pa gsum la brten nas brtsams pa'o/ /bsgrub thabs che ba yin/ gzhan 'di bas chung ba mang po bzhugs so/ /zab mo yin zer/ 'di la yi ge logs pa ni ci yang mi bdog go/ /lung gcig yod na nyams su blangs pas chog pa yin bla mas gsungs so// //bsdur mchan/797 nyematshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ 'u 〈〈pe 〉thangs/798 sna 〈〈pe 〉ra bza' stod/799 1 〈〈pe 〉thazhag 3 /〈〈pe 〉〉tsan/8༷ nya7〈〈pe 〉ra/ — — 〈〈pe 〉ra ga sna〈〈pe 〉skorathungs sam byugs pa yis/8༷2 —1〈〈pe 〉〉〉/ sa 〈〈pe 〉tha/ ༄ —〈〈pe 〉〉rgyu/47—802

2836ra༅/ /rim pa drug pa zhes bya ba/1 ༄/ rim pa drug pa bzhugs so// ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ kra ma ṣa ṭa nā ma/bod skad du/ rim pa drug pa zhes bya ba/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro rnams rtag pa'i dngos grub rtogs gnas te/ /de la rtog cing dge dang mi dge 'dzin/ /dug dgra gseb thar chu srin kha ru ni/ /gru chad bzhin du dga' dang mi dga' skye/ /rtag tu brtse bas 'dzin cing nga ros 'jigs/ /de la dngos po kun gyis 'dud cing 'dud/ /bka' drin thob dang rang nyams rtogs de dran/ /de 'dir 'dod lha mnyes nges 'byung ba dang / /sbyor ba gzhan gyis nges par 'byung ba yin/ /gnod sbyin gyi sgru ba nga la rten nas dang po gnyis yin gnyis pa bzhi ru snang //dang po bzlas pa grub pa dang / /grub pa'i rtags dang mtshan ma ni/ /gsang sngags grub pa'i rtags dang mtshan ma ni/ /gsung grub pa 'i rtags rmi lam du glegs bam du ma 'cher mthong lag gis len/ /rnga dang dung dang cha lang dril bu dang / /rang 47—804

gis sna mchod pa'i sgra sgrogs du ma'i gzugs mthong ba/ /maṇ+ḍal dkyil 'khor las byed chos 'chad nyan/ /glegs bam klog cing kyus lta yi ge 'dri ba smra/ /klu grub pa'i rtags su ras bris la ni lha khang 'der ba lugs sku bde gshegs gzugs brnyan ni/ /du ma mthong zhing rten gyi gzugs mthong ba/ /thugs grub pa'i rtags rol mo'i gzugs byed mchod rten gdung stsogs byed/ /grilabural gri rdo rje la sogs mtshan ma rnyed dam mthong / /yon tan grub pa'i rtags me tog sna tshogs gsal bar mthong ba dang / /nyi zla'i 'od babs gza' skar 'od mthong dang / /me btong du langs nam mkhar yang ni 'khrigs/ /rdzing las chu 'dren khron pa las ni 'dren/ /'bras kyi myu gu bzang dang lo ma bzang / /lce spyang la sogs thul pa gos bzang gyon/ /phrin las grub pa'i rtags zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi rgyan cha bzang zhing mtshon cha sno la 'dzin/ /de rnams byung gyur gsang sngags 'grub pa'i rtags/ /rnal 'byor pas sngags grub pa'i rtags kyi rim pa ste/ rim pa dang po'o// //mig la sogs pa'i dbang pos srid gsum mthong / /thos dang snga phyi'i rkyen dran rdzas kun 'dud/ /ras bris bzhad cing ro stsogs rdzasal 'od 'byung dri/ /mun nag nas klog 'byung ba dang nam mkha' nas me tog char 'babasadanga'aja' tshon snang / /tshogs na mngapol chos 'chad mdun na glegs bam lenapa dang dpyad/ /nam mkha' stong las sna tshogs rol mo'i sgra/ /'brug sgra klog 'gyu thog chen rang gis gzhan du 'be+ebs pa dang / /klu grubapa'i rtags nam mkha' stong zhing sprin sngon mthong ba dang / /de bzhin 'thing nag sprin sngo bsel nar — 'dug pa dang nges 'gyur dang / /nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor 'od ldan sa gzhi brdal/ /ras bris lugs ma la sogs bde 47—805

gshegs gzugs byedapa dang / /mchod cing skor ba byed dam rten la bskor/ /dkyil 'khor bris nas mchod dam gzhanal 'byed dam dbang bskur ba/ /mdzes pa'i snod du yon tan grub pa'i rtags me tog sna tshogs thu bdang/ /rin chen sna tshogs me tog be+e ḍūr snyed padang/ /shin tu skam pa'i sa la chu rdol ba dang / /thugs grub pa'i rtags bdag nyid me dpung ginang 'dug padangasrog chags 'tshigs pa dang / /ting 'dzin mi gsal na yid dga' zer gsal zhing yi dwags gzugs la brtson/ /dben zhing nyams dga'i gnas kyi nang du mthong / /rtse gcig pa'i bsam gtan byed pa dang / /'phrin las grub 1 pa/'i rtags seng ge'i khri la gnas pa rmis/ /lha khang gnas gzhi rtsig mtshungs dang / /chu bo che dang rgya mtsho'i steng nas 'gro/ /bar snang bdanga'aphur zhing sdeg pa'i ltos 'gro sbrulalen/ /'di 'dra'i rmi lam gsang sngags grub pa'i rtags/ /rnal 'byor pas gsang sngags grub rtags kyi rim pa ste gnyis pa'o// //las bzhi yod pa las gnyis pa'i bzhi pa dang po'i bzhipa'idang po mtshan nyid ni/ /spyor ba gzhan 'byung rnal 'byor nyid la'o/ /ri gzar dag la mi thar mthar zad lhung / /ri brag 'dzul 'dod chu dong lhung ba dang / /phyugs lhas 'dam rdzab bshang gci ngan dang ni/ /kha dog dmar dang skya ba'i chu dag la brgal ba dang / /rtsub dang roba'igos gnag dang dmar ba'i gos dang ni/ /shin tu hrul po tsa ti'i lpags pa gyon ra lug dug po gan/ /shing rtsi'i ri las lhung dog rten med 'dug /gcer bur 'dug cing lcag cing chu nang 'gro/ /lha sa bsam yas lta bu'i 'dre 'jog gzung 'dzin yod pa'i rten sa de ru ni/ /nyin dang mtshan du rtag tu 'gro ba rmis/ /glang nag glang dmar ba nag ba dmar zhon/ /rtsub pa'i reba'igos gyon gha dha bong 47byed806

bul zhon pa/ /ma he ba glang khyus 'go sogs rmi ba/ /gnag dang ba glang khyus 'gro stsos mthong dang / /rta dang gha dha bongabudamig zlum khyus 'gro rtsos/ /rape ta tshe lug ta khyus 'gro rtsos mthong ba/ /seng ge spyang dang khyi sogs mche can rmi/ /bse dang byi ba chags rmi 'gyur ba'o/ /sbyor ba gzhan gyi gnod pa 'byung ba rnal 'byor pa la mtshan ma 'ong ba'i rim pa ste/ gsum pa'o// //gnyis pa'i bzhi pa la bdun yod pa las dang po song nas gnyis kyi mtshan nyid ni/ /rnal 'byor klu mi thub pa'i rtags stobs kyis mi thub mtshan nyid ni/ /chubya dngachurabye ba sbrul gdug gnas pa'i mtsho/ /chu srin nya dang chu sogs gnas pa dang / /sdig pa sdom dang rtsang pa rkangs mangs 7dang / /sbrang bu mchu rings srog chags phra mo rnams/ /de rnams rmi 'gyur bran rnams sbyor ba gnod/ /sbrul dang sbal pa sdom dang sdig pa dang / /bya sogs lus 'byar mchu rdebs bshog sbrul dang / /be ta ralugal sogs rdzi med mgo rgod rmi/ /mi thub rtags te bud med snyo ba dang //mi thub kun la rtegs 'gyur mdog rgod ma/ /rgyan bzang mdzes pa'i snod du zas sogs bkang nas/ /rtag tu rgan mor 'ong 'gyur mi thub rtags/ /ltos 'gros lus dkris ldan zhing mi phral zhedang / /sdig padang rtsad sogs 'byar zhing mchu 'dzugs pa/ /sbrang bu mchu rings srog chags phra mo rnams/ /khrag 'jib lus nang zhugs 'gyur mi thub rtags/ /chu srin nya sogs chu chen 'phyo zhing 'khyug /gnag dang dmar sogs chu yis khyer ba rmi/ /de yang brtson 'grus drag pomi thub rtags de brtson pas bzlog /dad ldan brtson pas mi 'grub par zheyang med/ /sbyor ba gzhan nas 'byung ba'i gnod pa la rnal 'byor pa'i stobs 47—807

kyis mi thub pa'i rtags kyi rim pa ste bzhi pa'o// //gnyis pa'i la gsum yod pa/ las bzhi pa gsum pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /gnod sbyin thub pa'i rnal 'byor pa yis thub cing non pa'i rtags/ /ma te gnag sogs rdzud cing rid pa dang / /dud 'gro rnams ni rangagis btags sam gtod gyur pa/ /dud 'gro dgras khyer gtod dam rkun mos khyer/ /dud 'akro mtshod dang 'bras kyi phug 1ma 'chag /dud 'gro 'khol dang rdzi yis skyong ba dang / /dud 'a1 yor dang dgab thebs grub pa'i rtags/ /dud 'gro rangagis bsad dam btsos nas za ba dang / /rang dngagazhan las me 'byung nasadud 'gro tshig 'gyur ba/ /de ni nges pas dbang du 'dus pa'i rtags/ /bud med dgud cing ngo dma' shi ba dang / /ngu zhing rgyan bzang brtags nas phyag byed dang / /rangagiganas nas gzhan 'gro thub pa'i rtags su bstan/ /klu thub cing non pa'i rtags sprul la sogs pa srog chags du ma rnams/ /bsad dam zos sam shi 'am deng gyur dang / /skem dang 'tshig 'gyur thub pa'i rtags yin no/ /chubya dang chubyi ba sbrul gdug gnas pa'imatsho skems/ /bud med zhum zhing du ba thub pa'i rtags/ /sbyor ba gzhan rnal 'byor pa'i rtsal kyis non pa'i rtsal gyi rim pa ste lnga pa'o// //gnyis pa'i laba'iyod pa las bzhi pa bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /bdud grub pa'i rtags sbyor gzhan rab tu rang nyid phyag rdor skur byas nas khros par gyur pa ni/ /rang nyid nam mkha'i dkyil na bdud dga' rab dbang phyug dang nam mkha' la gnas nas sdod pa yin pas/ de grub pa'i rtags su nam dasar po zer mi g.yo gnas na gnas ni/ /sprul pa sna tshogs gzugs ni ston 47—808

cing phyogs/ /'khor dang ①pho nya 'gyed cing 'dug /rigs thub pa'i rtags mtha' dgra rgyalapobag bu chung rab byung gzugs/ /'od 'gyur thad la ②skyes pa'i bka'isnephonya yin/ /de ni sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gsum bya bzlog pa bya ba'i thabs ni gsungs/ /blon po yul kyi rgan rab 'ong 'gyur ④yang / /brod pa bskyed pa gzhon nu bu mo'i gzugs/ /sngags pa'i gzugs su 'ong 'gyur brag skyes yin/ /de bcos bya ba'i thabs ni sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin bstan pa yin/ /dkar dmar gnag cing shin tu mang ba yin/ /ba glang 'tshe zhing phyugs nang 'dug pa dang / /ral pa bzang po bud med sgrug nag mibadang / g.ya' ri gangs ri las gnasapa'i ma mo yin skye pho nya yin/ /de phyir bcos pa'i thabs ni du ma gsungs / /bud med gzhon zhing rgyan bzang rab byung la/ /ma dang srung ⑤mo sring mo ne+e ne+e mo'i gzugs/ /nye du nye 'byel khrom chen bud med dang / bu mo chung ma sogasami ba — mtsho las skyes pa'i mtsho sman yin/ /de ni gnan pa'i thabs ni bya ba dang / /srungaskud kyis de rnams zhi 'gyur 'ga' zhig dbang du 'du'/ /dbang du 'gro ba rtog pa'i nad las thar/ /khyi la sogs pa dud 'gro phal cher ni/ /sbyor ba gzhan kyi pho nya rbadapayin pas bzlog /bdud mi thub pa'i rtags ni rang gi ngo bo gtso bo'i gzugs can te bdud dga' rab dbang phyug tu rmi na/ /brang 'gro'i sprulagazugs rgyan ldan pa de nyid do zhal gsum phyag drug tu'o/ /nam mkha' yi ni mthongs na gnas byas shing / /sprul pa'i gzugs ni brjod kyis mi lang ste 'dimado tsam bstan pa'o/ /de yang dpag tu med pa'i grubamatha'i mtha' mi rtogs//de phyir bde gshegs mthu dang mtshungs pa yin/ /de rnams thams cad sbyor ba gzhan gyi bka' yi pho nya bkye ba'i rim pa ste drug pa'o// //sa ba ris bla ma'i bka' dang yidamalhag lhas gnang ba byin/ /sems can don la 47—809

brtsams 'gro la brtse bas rtog pa cung zhig sbyar/ /sbyarabade yis dge ba ci bsags pa—/ /rtog pas nges shing nges rtogs shog /rim pa drug pa zhes bya ba rtags gsal bar byed pa/ nam gru'i rigs las byung ba/ dngos grub brnyes pa dza ba ris mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bal po dre ba lhagangaba'i blo gros pur+ṇa ma ti dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// dge'o//bsdur mchan/8 4 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/8 5 ①〈〈pe 〉yog/ 〈〈pe 〉ra rang /8༷6 ①〈〈pe 〉skoragrub/8༷7 ①〈〈pe 〉thamadangs/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉ra la/ ④〈〈pe 〉sngagang /8༷8 sti〈〈pe 〉lbāb/ ②〈〈pe 〉mir/ ne+e〈〈pe 〉phod/ du〈〈pe 〉wags//༷9 ①〈〈pe 〉〉 ra ka'i/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉pas/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉gir ka'i/ du〈〈pe 〉ra ra/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉zas/47—810
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2763)47wa 811

༄ga /a pa ra be+e ta rin chen bzang po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/①༄/ gnod sbyin a pa ra tsi ti sgrub thabs zab mo yang dag bzhugs②/༄4—/ /rgya gar skad du/ a pa ra tsit+ta rad na pha la sa ta na ma/ bod skad du/ a pa ra tsi ta rin chen bzang po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnas dben zhing yid du 'ong bar ma 'dal dang mchod pa bshams la/ sems skyed bzhi bsam par bya ste/ dkon mchog la mchod pa dang / bla ma la zhabs rtog bya ba dang / dbul 'phongs rnams la sbyin pa btang ba dang / rang sgrub pa byed pa'i yo byad kyi ched du gnod sbyin gter gyi bdag po sgrub snyam du sems skyed do/ /de nas yan lag bdun pa dang /tshad med pa bzhi dang / stong pa nyid du bsgom ①par bya'o// //gnod sbyin 'di'i sgrub thabs la don gsum ste/ dang po rang la khu mdog 47—812

mi yong ba'i phyir rang chas su bzhug pa dang / sgrub pa bya ba dang / las la sbyar zhing ma grub na spogs chog bya'o/ /gnas dbe+en zhing yid du 'ong bar phyag na rdo rje'i sten delayan lag thangs sku'am/ lugs ma bdun pa byas la gsol ba gdab bzhugs pa la/ mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams la/ gtor mas bar chod sol gcig byas la rtag gtor chosabyed la bya'o// //de nas rang badz+ra pa ni skyed la ye shes sems pa spyan drangs la stem/ de'i thugs khar a las zla ba'i steng hūṃ gi mtha' ma sngags kyis skor bar dmigs la/ā+oṃ tsan dha ma ha ro sha ṇa hūṃ phaṭa ces zlas pa zhag lnga bya ba ni snyen pa'o/ /de nas sgrub pa bya ba ni/ tshes gcig la gnas der ma 'dal pad+ma 'dab ①brgyad pa gcig bri/ 'dab ②ma bzhi ser/ mtshams bzhi mdzes tshon/ de'i dbus su kha dog dkar por skyed na nag por bri/ kha dog nag por skyed na ser por bri/lte ba la hri bri/ sgo gcig shar du lta bar bya/ gtor ma gnyis byas la/gcig rtar bzung / cig 'phral btang ngo / /de dar dmar ser kha dgab/ ri bong gi rkang dang dbang lag der gzhug /nor gang 'dod pa'i tshig zangs medan 'ar+ṣa kyi byang bu la rin po ches bri bri/ de yang 'dod yon lnga la longs spyod dang / ces bsam phun sum tshogs pa'i/ dngos grub chen po bdag la byed zhes bya'o/ /bla rdo bzung /rtag gtor la 'bru sna dang / rin po che dang / shing thog dang dar zab gzugs| mchod pa bsham/ rang phyag rdor snying po brgya tsam zlas pa ni snyen pa'o dnga'adra'o/ /de nas skad cig gis ma dal khar gnod sbyin sku mdog dkar po/zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas na lcags kyu/ g.yon na rin po che'i 47—813

bum pa bsnams pa/ rin po che bum pa'i steng na zhabs g.yas pa skum pas bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ dar sngon po'i sham thabs can/spyan che ba lug la khad pa cig du bsams la/ de nas spyan drang ba ni/lcags pa'i phyag rgya dang thugs kha'i hūṃ gi 'od zer dang / snying po'i zhabs la dza hūṃ baṃ ho rtags la ri rab kyi byang shar mabyedas nas spyan drangs nas gnyis su med par stem/ de nas snying po'i zhabs su/ pus pa pu tsa hūṃ zhes bya ba la sogs pa rtags la mchod pa 'bul/ snying po'i zhabs la bha ling kha kha khā nyi khā nyi rtags pa 'am/ ā ka ro rtags la gtor ma 'bul/ de nas stod pa bya/ kho la dmigs pa gsal bas 'od gzer phar 'phros pas mchod par bsam/ tshur 'dus pas nor ster bar bsams la zlas pa bya/ zlas pa rdzogs nas pu tsa bya/gtor ma 'bul stod pa bya'o/ /de nas gsol ba btab pa ni/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /'dod yon lnga la longs spyod dang / /ci bsams lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub thams cad bdag la byed/ nga yi bka' las ma 'da' cig /nga yi bka' las 'das gyur na/ /phyag na rdo rjes mgo'o khos/ /rang stan mthon po'i phyag rgya mi gshig mi yis sems brgul gcig bya'o/ /de nas snying po'i zhabs su mu zhes bshags pa 'am/ yang na lus dang grib ma bzhin bya ba man ngag yin no/ /de ltar thun drug tu zhag gcig bzhin sgrubs pas/ nya'i nub mo gnod sbyin byon te/ rtags rab 'aming gsum 'byung bas/ 'jigs pa med pa'i sems kyis dngos ①su byon nas mchod pa bya/ sposalasogs gtor ma 'bul gu gul rgyun du sreg /nya'i nub mo thud kyal dang sha khog la sogs pa tser la kho la 'bul/gtor ma 'bul dus thams cad du hri las kho nag po'am dkar por skyed la 47—814

'bul lo/ /rang der sgom pa'i lag len/ phyag rgya rdo rje bsdams pa la gru mo gnyis sbyar te/ bgreng ba la rang gi chil ma rlan/ de bzung la tha tshigs bya ba ni dam sre ba'i/ dngos grub kyi tshig bris pa'i byang bu zung la/ sngar kyi tshig gis gsol ba btab pa'o/ /dngos grub gang 'dod blang ngo / /rtags rab 'bring mtha' ma gsum gang byung yang / mchod stod la sogs de ltar bya'o/ /de ni 'grub pa'o// //de nas las sbyar ni 'di'o/ /skya rengs shar ba'i mtho rengs kha lcags kyus rdzas ci 'dod dgug par bsam nor dreng ba'i snying po zlas so/ /sngar ltar kho ci skad zer yang gtam mi smra'o/ /gsol ba btab bo/ /nam langs pa dang gtor ma thams cad btang ngo / /ma lus gshegs pa'am lus dang grib ma bzhin du bsam mo / /de ltar byas na kho zla ba phyed kyis 'grub po/ /de ma 'grub na spogs pa zla ba phyed bya'o/ /des kyang ma 'grub na yang zla ba byed bya/ de ①mi 'grub mi srid do/ /des kyang ma 'grub na kho bdag mchi'o/ /gtor ma dkar gtor bya/ 'bras chan rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ dkar gtor bkang la gzhag /nya'i nub mo kho 'ong bas/shin tu 'jigs par mi bya'o/ /phyag rgya mi bshig gu gul sreg /kho'i gzugs la nges pa med ji ltar byung yang dngos grub blang / /res dga' byis pa khye'u'i gzugs/ /mig ①ni bag tsam thong la khad/ /byon pa'i dus su dngos grub blang shin tu 'jam shing bkra shis gsol ba gcig thub na sid dhe bya'o/ /'dod pa lnga'i longs spyod dang / ci bsam phun sum tshogs pa lhunagyis grub pa'i dngos grub chen po bdag la stsol/ mi yis sems dgul gcig bya/ 'di mis snying sgul ba'i sngags/ rtsa sngags nyid kyang 'di nyid yin/47—815

yid 'phrogs sngags kyang 'di nyid yin/ ā+oṃ hri dza a pa ra tsid ta dza dza/ srog rtsa byeng byeng thul thul/ lhamoklu mo thams cad 'dus par 'gyur ba yin/ /lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du bsdus/ /de bas bsod nams skyed pa yin/ /gang na 'dug pa'i sa phyogs su/ /rangaladagra yi gnod pa mi 'byung ngo / /khros pas mi rnams 'chi bar 'gyur—/ /'di sgrubs yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /sum cu rtsa gsum lha'i gnas skye //lha min gyishing thog bdag la ster/ /rin chen ster rnams sa'og gi bdag la ster/ /bdag la shin tu chags par 'gyur/ /de bas de mthong ngo mtshar che/ /bsgrub dus gsum la rab zla ba phyed/ 'bring gnyis/ mtha' ma gsum/ sgrub dus gsum la rab dngos ①'bring stug chom/ mtha' ma rmi lam du 'ong / dngos grub gsum ni/rab lung ston/ 'bring lha yul du lha mos khrid de/ mtha' ma 'khor dang nor 'du/de ltar grub pa'i rdzas de cha bzhir byas te/ cha gcig bla ma/ cha gcig dkon mchog /cha gcig 'gro ba rnams la sbyin/ cha gcig rang bshad do/ /de ni nor 'phel ba'i gdam ngag yin no/ /bsgrub dus su dam tshig rtsa ba bzhi srung / sha chang sgog rtsong srung / smra bcad mtshams sdam/ zas dkar gsum mngar gsum la bya'o/ /'di bla rdo bcang ba ni gnyis te/ bse byang la/ gser ram dngul kyi mkhor lo rtsibs brgyad bris la/ rtsibs sngags bri/ dbus su rtsa ka la bris la dar du dril la bzung ngo / /kho bo'i sku de sgrub dus na dril rba ldom du bcug la bsgrub khang du bzhug /byes su 'gro na gar 'gro khyer la 'gro/ yang rdo pha bang long bu la ri bong gi khrag gis skebris te/ snyingapodar du dril te rtag tu bcang ngo /las grub pa'am rtags ma byung na/ pha wang long bu de ri bong gi snying du 47—816

bzhug /de ri bong gi thod par bzhug /de gnyis bra ba g.yag po rlung bur bzhugs—/ bris sku dang bla rdo rnams nyungs dkar kyi dud pa la bdug cing rang phyag na rdo rje'i bsdog ①pas gnan pas yi ge bcu pa la kho bo'i snying por log par rtags la gzer ro/ /de nas sgrub pa kyar na 'grub nges so/ /nya nam byung gi skya rengs shar ba la ka re btang zhing nor drang ba'i snying po zlas/ don gnyer ram nor dgos pa'i tshe/ dus nam yang 'dris te gtor ma sbyin la nor drang ba'i snying po zlas la gsol ba gdab/ zas nam za ba'i tshe dkon mchog gsum la phul ba'i rjes la/ lha bshos kyi gzugs re byas la/ ne+e be te hūṃ zhes brjod la kho la 'bul lo// //hūṃ ri rab ri yi rtse mo nas/ /byang shar mtshams kyi rtse mo nas/ /phyag na rdo rjer rdzu 'phrul stobs/ /gter bdag chen po 'dir gshegs dang / /nor bdag chen po 'dir gshegs dang / /las rnams sgrub byed 'dir gshegs dang //mthun pa'i rdzas la 'dir gshegs dang / /byon nas 'di nyid bzhugs su gsol//dam tshig gnyan po srung ba dang / /sgrub pa po la rtse ba'i phyir/ /'gro ba'i don la bzhugs su gsol/ /gnod sbyin rgyal po rin chen sbyin/ /dgyes pa'i zhal zas sna tshogs dang / /dar sogs spyan gzigs sna tshogs dang / /skyems sogs sna tshogs bzhes su gsol/ /zhes spyan drang ba'o// //tri las mkhan chen khyod nyid la/ /mos pa'i tshul kyis bdag stod do/ /lha rnams kun gyi kha lo sgyur/ /lha yi rgyal po khyod la stod/ /lha min mi rnams dbang du bsdus/ /gnod sbyin rgyal po khyod la bstod/ /gang na 'dug pa'i sa phyogs su/ /rin chen char 'be+ebs byed la stod/ /dgra'i bar chad sel bar 47—817

byed—/ /mthu stobs bdag po khyod la stod/ /khyod la mchod cing bdag bstod ①na/ /dngos grub thams cad bdag la sprul/ /stod pa'o/ /ā+oṃ hri dza ā pa ra sbud ta dza dza rtsa sngags so/ /ā+oṃ bhud ta shri ā pa ra gru'i ta dza dza/ sarba ma de tri sam rba tri swā hā/ nor drang ba'i sngags so/ /dza dza ta tsi ta tsi ra ma pa a dza hri ā+oṃ/ gnad la 'bebs sngags so/ /ā+oṃ shri ri hūṃ/sring mo'i sngags so/ /yang rigs gcig la rdo rje pha wang long spu la srog sngags bris la bra ba'i blud bur bcug ⑤ste/ kha cings la rgun stor nang du bzhug /las ma stub na/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje a pa ra tsi tas de'i las ma stub po/ /byas la langs la btab po/ /de nas kho phyung la zangs ma'i byang bu la—/ 'dod don gsol ba'i tshig bris la kho la stan no/ /des ni bar du mi chod pa yin gsung ngo / /rtags ni tshong pa mang po dang nor dang longs spyod mang po ster ba dang / rang dbang ba las rmi lam du 'byung ngo / /de ltar byung na grub pa yin pas/ gtor ma kho la sngos la star bzung ngo / /spogs chog mi dgos so/ /ma grub na spogs chog bya ba ni bzhi ste/ gnan pa dang / gzir ba dang / sbyin sreg dang bzung ba'o/ /de la gnan pa ni/ 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa byas la dkyil du kho bo'i gzugs bri/ mtha' ma la sngags bri/ phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo gcig gis steng nas bkab po/ /de gnyis kham phor kha sbyar gyi nang du gcug ①la gu gul gyi dud pas bdug /rdo rje pha wang long bu dang /dar zab dang rin po che brdar la der bzhug /rdo rje rgya ram bris la rang gi 47—818

mal 'og du gnan pa bya/ de nas badz+ra pa ni zlas pa byas pas kho ma bzod de 'ong /de nas yang ston la sngos khung du bzhag pa snyen pa zla ba phyed bya'o/ /des kyang ma grub na gzir ba ni/ ling ga de gtor ma'i steng du bzhag la/gu gul dkar po'i dud pa dang mi gtsang ma'i sha chen sregs la/ lag du rdo rje thogs—/ rang phyag rdor kyi sngags bsham la kho rang gi sngags rtags la gzir ro//des kho nyan na gtor ma kho la sngos te sbyin la/ gnod sbyin a pa ra cid ta mi'i snying sgul cig /nga'i grogs kyis bya'o/ /sbyin sreg la shing gang yang rung ba'i me blang ngar stang la 'og ma'i 'khor lo de me lce la sreg zhing / nyungs dkar la sngags la dang po thabs su sreg go/ /de nas kho la sbyin la longs spyod la sogs pa rgyas par gyur cig byas la/star bzung ba de kho la sngos kyin mi stang ngo / /yi dam lha'i zlas pa dang 'don 'dod kyi bzlas zhabs la kho'i zlas pa sum brgya tsam re ma rjod par bya'o/ /des ltar byas na kho de bzhin du byed pa la lan gsung ngo / /gu gul gyi spos sreg la nya la'o—/ /nub rangs pa la zlas pa bya/ mtho rengs sgrub pa bya/ bdag gis ji ltar bya zer nas 'ong ste/ de'i dus su bdag gi khol po kyis byas la/ mi byed na rdo rje'i dmyal bar song byas la gal bzung / dang po maṇ+ḍal mdzes pa'i thog du rgya phor gyi nang du chang phud ma nyams pa dang / gtor ma rgyan dang bcas pa dang /sman dang a mṛ ta dang / spyan gzigs sna tshogs dar dmar ser mdzes pa'i sman dang / rgyan la sogs pa srog gi snying po nas sgreng zhing stod bcol bya'o/ /rtags ni srang ba'i tshogs dang / zhung can gyi tshogs dang / btsun pa dang ban de nag po dang / 'od rnams 'byung ngo / /sman gyi dri bzang po byung na shin tu bzang ngo /47—819

dam tshig nyams na srog la 'ong ngo / /gnod sbyin ā pa ra cid ta'i sgrub thabs rgyal po yin 'dra bhu dhis mdzad pa rdzogs so// ①//bsdur mchan/812 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉skoso/ / ③〈〈pe 〉rkam/813 ①〈〈pe 〉〉padab/814 ①〈〈pe 〉〉sngos/815 ①〈〈pe 〉〉des/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉dmig816 ①〈〈pe 〉〉sngos/ ②〈〈pe 〉stan/817 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bdog818 ①〈〈pe 〉〉stod/ ②〈〈pe 〉stanacug ②〈〈pe 〉〉bcug82 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〉maṅgal/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2764)47wa 820
snar thang ltar/'di ram̐~X rgaba'adi 'og du'o47—821

rag /nor lha gsang ba'i sgrub thabs/①༄ nor lha gsang ba'i bsgrub thabs bzhugs / rag /rgya gar skad du/rad na bde ba sgo h+ya sa dha rgo/ bod skad du/ nor lha gsang ba'i sgrub thabs/sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgosapadakon mchog gsum dang bla ma mchod pa'i phyir/ longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa thob par 'dod pas/maṇ+ḍal lnga pa yul lnga dang pu tsa bshams pa ston dri zhim pos byugs pa'i steng du/ me tog ser po tshom bu dgu bkram par/ bas dang rgyun gyi gtor ma dang mchod pa lngasogasabashams te/phyi stong pas bkrus nangagi khrus las gtor byasal/ stan nang tshangs can bdebal kha byangadu bltas te 'dug nas/ tshad med pa bzhi dang tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom par bya'o—/ /de nas bdun po rnam dag pa bya ste/ ye shes kyi tshogs de nas shurgya tas stong pa nyid kyi ngang las/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du dzam ser po yongs su gyur pa las pi tsa puri de las/ 'phagasapa 'dzam bha la gter ra po'o gdan dang radana'irgyan du bcas pa 47—823
