bdag nyid bsgom par bya'o/ /yum nor 'dzin ma g.yon phyogs stazur du su bsgom mo//maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du ba so'i za ma tog gi nang du/ gser dang / dngul dang /dung dang / man shel dang / zangs dang / be+e ḍūr+ya dang / lcags dang /byi ru mutigamu men la sogs pa dang / lan tshwa snyingapolngadang / rtsi mar dang /sbrang rtsi dang / bu ram dang / 'bru sna lngatshogs rnams blugs so/ /de'i nang du lha rnams bskyed par bya'o/ /rten de la de larangabazhin pa spyan drang ba dang /bzhugs su gsol ba dang / mchod pa dbulabarnams sngar ltar bya ste/ 'phro bdag dang rten 'du bya zhing rig sngags mitshig gis bar ma chad par bzlas so/ /ā+oṃ rdzu bha la dza len dra ye swā hā/ ā+oṃ ba su dha ri ni swā hā/ rad na badz+ra a mo gha sid ti bye ad ma rgo swā hā/ zhes bzlas pas/ grubapa'i rtags bdag nyid kyi lus rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan par mthong ba dang / sa gzhi thams cad 'bru sna tshogs kyis gang bar mthong ba dang / nyi zla gdan du bting ba la sogs pa'i rtags bzang po mthong ba dang / de nas za ma tog spyi bor blangs ste/ rad na bye sidhi ho/ zhes brjod la dngos grub zhalalta'o/ /blang ngo / /snying po rnam pa lngarol cing za ma tog la bskor ba byas na/ gnas skabs kyi phan yon nor gyi longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa myur du thob ste mthar thug gi lngos bu sa brgyad pa non par 'gyur ro/ /nor lha rgyal po yab yum gyi gsang ba'i bsgrub thabs rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po bhi na ya tsan tra dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //47—824
bsdur mchan/ 822 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〉so /bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2765)47—825

༄༅/ /'phags pa 'dzam bha la la bstod pa jes bya ba/ 1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya 'dzam bha la stod tra na ma/ bod skad du / 'phags pa 'dzam bha la la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chu la gzigs zhing chu la dges/ /chu yi tshogs la rtag tu bzhugs/ /chu skyes 'jig rten nor gsol ba/ /gnod bcas khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan gang gis khyab 'jug la/ /dpal gyi lha mo gnang mdzad cing / /lha yi lha yi spyi gtsug du/ /ri bong can gyis brgyan par mdzad/ /don kun byed pa'i dpag bsam shing / /gangs kyis lha gnas su bzhag cing / /lha la 'pho med gnas thob phyir/ /bdud rtsi gang gis byen pa dang / /de ltar gzhan don mdzad nas kyang / /gang gi mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad/ /de yi sbyin pa'i stobs mthong nas/ /sangs rgyas kyang ni ngo mtshar 'gyur/ /thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa'i rgyu/ /sbyin pa gang 47—826

gi stobs las byung / /'phags pa 'dzam bha la de yi/ /zhabs la rtag tu gdud par bgyi/ /gang la dad na 'jig rten 'di'i/ /dge ba'i rtsa bas phongs pa yang / /dge ba can bzhin longs spyod ni/ /bla na med pa thob par 'gyur / /btsun mo dam pas bskor ba yi/ /gzhal yas khang la rnam gnas nas / /gang la dad na skal ldan ni/ /longs spyod kyis gzhan 'byor par byed / /'jig rten sdug bsngal can gzigs nas/ /sdig sogs 'joms par byed pa gang / /sprul pa sna tshogs sprul nas ni/ /dpal gyi 'jig rten rgyas par mdzad/ /sngags rgyud dag gi 'dod don kyang / /bsgrub pa'i thabs la mkhas pa gang / /de la nor rgyun ma dag gis/ /don med spangs nas rgyas par mdzad/ /brgyud pa las byung sngags thob nas/ /phyi nang mchod pa la mkhas pa/ /'dzam ba la'i sgrub byed ni/ /'jig rten pa dang mnyam med 'gyur—/ /zhe sdang can du rigs mthun pa'i/ /bung ba lta bu'i gzugs 'dzin cing / /nor ni rgyas par byed pa dang / /dgra rnams gsod nga/ra byed pa yi/ /mi bzad gter rnams 1ster ba'i ngang / /skal bzang byed dang snyug bsngal spong / /chos ston pa dang ltas ngan sel ba yi/ /dus gsum gzigs mnga' 'dzam bha la la 'dud/ /sbyin bdag chen po gsang ba'i bdag /dpal ldan 'dzam bha la bstod pas/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs nas/ /'gro rnams dbul dang bral bar shog /chos dpal zhu ba'i ngo ru ni/ /lung las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin/ /dpal ldan rin chen rdo rje yis/ /bcom ldan 'dzam bha la bstod do/ /'phags pa nor lha'i bstod pa/ dngos grub brnyes pa'i bram ze rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //47—827

rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇa ḍi ta ma ha 'dza na dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba mal blo gros grags kyis bsgyur cing zhus pa'o// //bsdur mchan/826 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉kho 'phags pa 'dzam bha la bstod pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / ②〈〈pe 〉stan/821 ①〈〈pe 〉〉rnam/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2766)47—828

༄༅/ /nor bdag gtso 'khor lnga'i bstod pa dbyig gi char 'bebs zhes bya ba/1 ga rje btsun lha lnga'i bstod pa bzhugs so// ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ba su pa ti u pa dh+ya pañtsa stot+tha ba su me gha a be+e sha nā ma/ bod skad du/ nor bdag gtso 'khor lnga'i bstod pa dbyig gi char 'be+ebs zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /e ma/ 'jig rten dbang phyug nor bdag sgu sprul 'phags pa ni/ /gti mug rnam dag chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis dbu skra gyen dze+es nor bus brgyan/ /sha rgyas bsus 'chang sna tshogs dar gyi na bza' klubs/ /phyag g.yas be+e con 'dzin pas 'jig rten dbang du sdud/ /g.yon pa ne+e'u le 'dzin pas longs spyod char bzhin 'be+ebs/ /sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags 'brug la chibs / /sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /g.yon gye gru mor rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams pa ni/ /nyid kyi sku la gnyis med 'khril ba'i yum 47—829

mchog mtshon/ /spyan gsum khro gnyer cung zad bsdus pa zhi khro'i tshul/ /yid la re ba'i 'bras bu byin la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /shar du zhe sdang rnam dag me long ye shes sku/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /g.yas pa rdo rje g.yon pa rten 'brel rdzas rnams 'dzin/ /bgegs rigs kun 'joms rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lho ru ser sna rnam dag mnyam nyid ye shes sku/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /g.yas pa nor bu g.yon pa rin chen bum pa bsnams/ /dbyig gi char 'bebs rin chen mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /nub tu 'dod chags rnam dag kun rtog ye shes sku/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /g.yas pa pad+ma g.yon pa 'gugs byed lcags kyu bsnams/ /'gro rnams dbang bsdud pad+ma mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /byang du phrag dog rnam dag bya sgrub ye shes sku/ /las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /g.yas pa rgya gram g.yon pa rgo'u le'i rkyal pa bsnams/ /las kun 'grub byed sna tshogs mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces mar me mdzad ye shes kyis nor bdag gtso 'khor lnga zhal gzigs pa'i dus su bstod pa/rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dang lo tsa ba chen po brtson 'grus seng ges bsgyur ba'o// tshosna//47—830
bsdur mchan/829 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/83 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〉maṅga /bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2767)47wa 831

༄ga /gnod sprun tsho nag mos bsad pa'i sgrub thabs/ k+ṣe༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ yak+ṣi ka li ma ra na sa dha/ bod skad du/gnod sbyin mo nag mos bsad pa'i rdzusgrub thabs/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por bdag nyid rdo rje 'dzin par bsams te/mdun du gnod sbyin nag mo sgu mdog nag mo/ g.yas pa ral gri bsnams pa/g.yon pas nad kyi rkyal pa bsnams pa/ na bza' sngon po gsol ba/ kha nas khrag dang dug gi kha chu can spyan gsum pa/ ral pas tsha ra'i rtsos po khar slebs pa can cig bsams la/ mdun du khrag sna tshogs pa dang / snying sna tshogs pa'i gtor ma byin la sngags 'di bzlas so/ /ru ru shad shad kha khaṃ la rtu rtu/ba sha ma ma kha tam/ tsi ta tsi ta rbad rbad/ ril ril thum ril sod sod/sum 'bum nyi shu rtsa gcig las mi nyung bar bzlas so/ /de nas 'brub khung du dgra'i zag pas chag chag byas la/ gru gsum bsnol ma cig khrag gis bri/ de 47—832

nas khyi mo dkar mo'i grod par khrag sna snyed tshad/ phag khra mo'i khrag /ra rgya mo'i khrag /khyi mo'i khrag /dgra bo'i ming rus ling ga dang bcas pa/ dgra bo'i pha mes kyi sha rus phye ma drugs la/ maṇ+ḍal khar rang la kha bstan la bzhag /de nas re'u 'am bra ba byi ba'i rkyal par nyungs kar la sngags btab la blugs la/dug sna tshogs pa'i phye ma blugs la rngud pa bya ste grod pa'i kha na mar bud par bya'o//bdag nyid rdo rje 'dzin par bsam khros pas gnod sbyin nag mo ni/ ra rkyal nang du bsam bya ste/ /dug gi rkyal pa 'bud par bsam/ /sngags kyi gdug pa 'di yang bzlas/ /du du ma ma shag khug /du sha ma ma mo rol/ du ni ma ma snying phyung / sa ma ya srog chod/ pu sha du ya/ ma ma ti ma du ya/ sha sha ma ma rbad pu ya/ ni na ma bh+yo bh+yo sod sod/ ma du ya ma du ya/ tshal pa rbad rbad yeng yeng / sha thum sha thum rbad/ mar dur ma dur rbad/ sha bye mang sa bh+yo / rtsa thum ma ya bzlog /yak+ṣi ka li dgra bo la nad phob/ ces drangs mang du bzlas/ gtor ma byang shar 'tshams su gtang / /khrag dang grod pa khyim la brdeg /ling ga ming byang gnan pa bya/ /ma mo 'du ba'i dus dag tu/ /rbud pa khyedagra bo'i phyogs su rngud/ /'di nyid lo cig byas pa na/ /dgra bo rbod gri la sogs pa'i/ /nad kyi rigs kun der phab nas/ /ma lus 'chi bar gdon mi za/ /gnod spyin mo nag mo yis dgra bo bsad pa'i thabs/slob dpon las kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa'o // //2 rdzogs so // // 1paṇ+ḍi ta wa la tsan chen po dang / lo tsa ba glan chung dar ma tshul khrims kyis bsgyur ba'o// //47—833

༄ga /khro bo'i rgyal po khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/1༄/ khro bo'i rgyal po rnam par rgyal ba'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ rak+ṣa/ /rgya gar skad du/ gro ta ra tsa tre log kya sa dha na na ma/ bod skad du / khro bo'i rgyal po khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/dpal rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum bde gshegs ma lus pa'i/ /nus pa mchog mnga' khro bo che/ /khams gsum las rgyal lha khyod la/ /phyag byas bsgrub pa'i rim pa bri/ /bsgrub la brtson pa'i sngags pa yis/ /dben zhing bar chad spangs pa'i gnas/ /bde ba'i stan la mnyam bzhag ste/ /bla ma dkon mchog gsum mchod nas/ /sdig pa bshags pa la sogs bya/ /tshad med stong pa'i rang bzhin bsam/ /de rjes pad+ma nyi ma la/ /hūṃ gi yi ge shel ltar gnas/ /'phro gru'adus slar gyur rdo rje ste/ /de las khro bo chen po ni/ /dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ /g.yas pa rdo rje rtse gsum 'dzin/ /g.yon 47—835

pa dril bu chen po ste/ /rin chen rgyan gyis lus la brgyan/ /thod pa'i 'phreng ba stag lpags can/ /stod du glang gi lpags pa mdzes/ /spyan gsum mche bas 'byung po gsol/ /yi ge gsum kyis byin brlabs la/ /ye shes sems dpa' bstem par bya/ /dbang bskur rnam par snang mdzad che/ /hūṃ gis gdug pa ma lus 'joms/ /de nas gsang sngags bzlas pa ni/ /oṃ badz+ra kro ta tre log kya bi dza ya hūṃ phaṭa/ rtags dang sbyar la bsnyen pa bya/ /gal te bsgrub pa byed 'dod na/ /ma dhal gru gsum mthing ka la/ /'khor lo bris la yi ge dgod/ /de steng rgya shog yi ge can/ /rtsang la brgyangs la gsad ①pa bya/ /de yi drag po'i sngags gsungs pa/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra gro ta tre log kya bi dza ya/ che ge mo ma ra na sod sod/ ma ra na bying bying / ma ra na mugs mugs/ ma ra na ha la ha la/ma ra na myos myos/ ma ra na myos bying / thum ril/ che ge mo ma ra ya tsi ta rbad rbad/ steng nas thun brab 'og nas kyang / /gu gul la sogs rdzas kyis bdug /bar du bsgrub bya gsad par bsam/ /gdon dang bral bar ma gyur par—/ /las de btang bar mi bya'o/ /thun par sha chang sgog pa dang / /la phug khur ba'i gtor ma yang / /a kha ro yi byin brlabs nas/ /sngags 'dis gdon gyi sha khrag du/ /bsams la lan lnga brjod par bya/ /ā+oṃ ⑤badz+ra kro ta tre log kya bi dza ya/ i dam bha ling ta kha hi kha hi sa ma yā bhāshrī swā hā/ de ltar byas/ pas rtags byung na/ /'khor lo bsregs te thal ba dang / /gzugs su byas pa mchod rten mnan/ /yang na rlung la bskur ba 'am/ /tsha tsha byas la lam du mnan/ /de ltar lan cig byas pa yis/ /tshangs pa brgya ④byin sred med bu/ /stobs chen rnams kyang thul bar 'gyur/ /rtag tu gsang sngags 47—836

bzlas pas kyang / /gdon rnams 'bros par je tshom med/ /lha la sogs pa'i gdon chen rnams/ /gang gnod sngags la bsngags par bya/ /bum pa gtsang ma chus bkang ste/ /kha brgyan gzungs thag dkar po yis/ /pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i steng bzhag la/ /rigs 1pa'i khro bo bsam byas la/ /sngags bzlas chu des lus bkru tsodang / /khong du btung ba byas gyur na/ /'bras dang shu ba me rbal 'joms/ /nad rnams thams cad zhi bar byed/ /yang na bum par gnod sbyin ni/ /sngon po g.yas pa rdo rje 'chang / /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub me 'bar ba/ /lnga 'am bzhi 'am bcu bsams te/ /ā+oṃ ma ha ni lam̐ bha ra dha ra badz+ra pa ni ma ha yag sha hūṃ/ mu ru ta mu ru ta/ bi ru ta bi ru ta/ spo ta yā spo ta yā/ sarba bi na swā hā/ gzungs thag sngon po dkris te/ zhag bcu bzlas pa'i chu yis ni/ /'dze la sogs pa'i nad chen rnams/ /de yi mod la 'byang bar 'gyur/ /gnod sbyin rnams la nya sha dang / /chang gi gtor ma ci rigs sbyin/ /rtag tu sngon po'i gos 'chang zhing / /rams dang ra'i tshil lu dang / /at+pal ghi hang chang bsres nas/ /rnal 'byor pa yi snying ka ru/ /rdo rje'i lte bar chud pa'i sngags/ /ā+oṃ ni lo bha ra dha ra badz+ra pa ni yak+ṣa zis ma ya ma nu thra ra a a sto hūṃ/ 'di bris nyin re ma chag na/ /gnod sbyin rnams kyis bsgrub pa po/ /skad cig tsam yang mi g.yel bar/ /lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs/ /de stsogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /gnod sbyin kyis ni byed par 'gyur/ /rtag tu bla ma mchod bya zhing / /rdo rje 'dzin pa mnyes par bya/ /lha gzhan brnyas par ma byas na/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu 'byin par 'gyur/ /khro bo khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i sgrubs 5thabs/ slob dpon las kyi rdo 47—837

rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so // //①bla ma wa la tsan tra dang lo tsa ba slan chung dar ma tshul khrims kyis sgyi ḍa na'i dgon par bsgyur ba'o//② //bsdur mchan/835 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉toraphros /836 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bsad/ ②〈〈pe 〉stago ④〈〈pe 〉〉rgya/837 ①〈〈pe 〉〉reg (kye〈〈pe 〉〉dkru/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉bkris/ du〈〈pe 〉〉pag k+ṣa/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉sgrub/838 ①〈〈pe 〉〉/ / e〈〈pe 〉〉〉maṅga /bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2769)47wa 838

༄ga /khro bo chen po bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sgrub thabs/1༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ a mṛ ta kro ta tsu la ma hā sa dha na/ bod skad du/ khro bo chen po bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje 'chang chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdug pa dbang chen 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /nag po'i klu rnams 'dul 'dod pas/ /gtum chen khro bo las kyi lha/ /de'i bsgrub thabs bri bar bya/ /byams pa sngon du 'gro ba yis/ /bla ma rdo rje can mchod la/ /chos rnams stong pa'i ngo bor bsam/ /de yi rang bzhin rnam dag las/ /pad+ma nyi ma klu brgyad steng / /hūṃ gi 'phro 'dus rdo rje 'bar/ /de las khro bo chen po bsam / /in tra ni la'i kha dog can/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhis mdzes pa ni/ /g.yas pa rdo rje las kyi khyung / /rigs lnga rnam par dag par bsam/ /cig shos dbyug tho phur bu 'be+ebs —/ /brkyang bskum zhabs kyis gdug pa badze+es/ /rin chen klu yis sku la mdzes/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i go cha can/ /bskal pa'i 47—839

me'i nang na bzhugs/ /sprul pa'i khyung gis nam mkha' gang / /ye shes bcug la byin gyis brlab/ /dbang bskur khyung gi go dang ldan/ /skad cig tsam gyis gsal ba las/ /sngags kyis rang gi nus pa bsgrub/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra kro ta a z-i ta kun dha li na ga ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ gal te las la sbyor ba ni/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra gro ta a z-i ta che ge mo ra na sod sod/ ma ra na bying bying / ma ra na mugs mugs/ma ra na ha la ha la/ ma ra na myos myos/ ma ra na myos bying / thum ril ka ru na na ga ma ra ya dza dza/ rtags la phebs par gyur pa dang / /gang yin sbyin sreg las kyis bsad/ /yang na mi mthun rdzas kyis brab/ /nad pa'i lus la brab bya ste/ /gzugs la yang dang yang bstems te/ /nges par klu'i nad rnams zhi/ /skabs su gtor mas lha mnyes bya/ /rin chen snod du klu sman blugs / /rang sngags kyis ni byin brlabs dbul/ /zhi ba'i las de sngon 'gro yin/ /bum pa gtsang ma chus bkang la/ /khro bo khyung dang bcas pa bsam//rig pa gong mas gtab pa la/ /chu ni khol ba'am rlangs byung nas/ /nges par bkru ba byas gyur pas/ /'byung po ma lus nad zhi'o/ /gzhan yang gdon chen po rnams/ gzhom par 'dod na rang sngags gzhug /'di ni bsrung ba dam pa yin/ /gro ga ras la bris pa yis/ /bsrung ba de'i ①mgul du gdags//gla rtsi gu gul shu dag dang / /ngur ba khu byug 'dza' ti dang / /tsan dan a ka ru dang bcas/ /byis pa'i chu yis sbrus pa ni/ /ri lu sran tshad gtor ②gtang bya—/ /nang gi gdon rnams zhi bar ④byed/ /rgya tshil phag pa sram gyi brun/ /gu gul rma bya'i sha dang ni/ /ra thug lug thug rmang kha dang / /rta bon rwa'i gzhob dang ni/ /nya'i glad pa me la bsreg /lus gos sna nas bdugs pa yis/ /47—840

bar gyi gdon las mchog tu shis/ /rtsan dug dri chen shing khun dang / /'bras bu gsum dang tsha ba gsum/ /bya rgod spos dang mon spos dang / /gcan zan sru dang khrag rnams dang / /thar nu thang phrom spru nag dang / /dri chus lus la byugs gyur na/ /nges par gdon rnams 'bros par 'gyur/ /gzhan yang bya khyung rus pa sha /khrag dang lpags pa spu rnams kyis/ /phyi nang bar gsum klu nad 'joms/ /de la drag po'i sngags med na/ /go cha med pa'i mtshon thogs 'dra/ /'di ni mi thub go cha mchog /sngags kyi nus pa sngar song bya/ /bag zan las ni sbal pa'i gzugs/ /khro bo kham phor steng bzhag ste//klu chen rnams kyi sngags dag la/ /ā+oṃ bu mi pa ti sarba gdags/ /klu sman 'o mas lus la btig /nyin re zhing yang zhag bdun bar/ /bsgrub pa byas te sbal pa de/ /gnod pa'i phyogs su bzhugs nas kyang / /steng du mthun pa'i rdzas rnams sbyin/ /nges par gnod pa zhi bar 'gyur/ /bdag gis bsgrub thabs 'di byas pas/ /skal ldan klu nad byang nas kyang / /khro bo chen pos lus ston cing / /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog /khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa chen po'i bsgrub thabs/ rje btsun thang lo pas bla ma'i gdams pa dang / bya khyung las rgyud la brten nas mdzad pa rdzogs so // //①lo tsha ba slan chung dar ma tshul khrims kyis/ rje btsun wa la tsan tra la gu lang gser gyi ma dhal phul nas zhus pa'o// ④//47—841

brtsar mchan/839 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉kho khro bo chen po bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so//②〈〈pe 〉〉ta/ ②〈〈pe 〉toradebs/84 ①〈〈pe 〉〉wade'i/ ②〈〈pe 〉tshostor/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〉bar/841 ①〈〈pe〉ska / ②〈〈pe 〉mi maṅga /bsdur 'bras re'u migabyud/ (2770)47wa 842

byed /bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje gnod marjas sde bo'i rgyal po chen po sdang ba thams cad rnam par 'joms pa'i babyedab byedababyed①byed/ /rgya gar skad du/ shri bha gha ban badz+ra su bha ma ha kro dha ra dzā sarba duṣ+ṭa bi dha ra sa dha na/ bod skad du/ bcom ldan 'das ḍa ki'i bzhi gnyis pa las/bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba ni dbang byug la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pas so/ /yang na nyon mongs lnga la sogs pa'i bdud bzhi bcom pas na bcom ldan 'das te dpal byed rje stong pa nyid kyi ye shes de nyid gdug pa can 'dul ba'i don du gsung rung / mnyam sbyor las/ shin tu gdug cing gtum pa la/ zhi bas phan par mi 'gyur te/shes rab thabs kyi ngo bo yis khro bo de bzhin shes bya kun mdzad/ badz+ra ḍaki'i rim pa phye ba bzhi pa las/ mi shes pa'i ri bo 'joms pas na ye shes de nyid ni rdo rje'o/ /gnod mdzes khro bo'i rgyal po chen po de nyid las/khro bo'i byed 'chang byedas pas kyang / /'jig rten gsum dag sreg byed na/ /sangs rgyas thams cad khros pa/ /khams gsum ma lus byed ci dgog /bstan pa la sdang ba thams cad rnam par 'jobyedas pabyed sdug bsngal ba la mi bzod pa sbyor ba byed byed nus pa dang ②/ bsgrub thabs/ thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigasanithugs rje byed dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dharmakaya rnam par mi 47byed843

rtog bde oṃ sgo ka ya chen po/ /niraman ka ya rtag tu sems can don brtson pa/ /mngon mthong nges la 'dren pas margon po he ru ka khrag 'thung mnga' mnyes pa dpal la sku bzhi'i bdag nyid rgyu dang 'bras bu'i tshig don rtsam las mi spyor gsung / /sgo gsum kun nas dang bas phyag 'a' la te/ /dgos pa bstan pa la sdang ba'i dgra yang gdug pa ma tha/sa 'a du'/ ba dang / /dngos grub la bar du gcod pa'i bdud dang lus srog la rnam par 'tshe ba'i bgegs kun rnam par gzhom pa'i phyir/ /rang dga' yangs le'u bcu drug pa yul dngos gsung brngod bya mngon brjod rgyud las gsungs bsgrub thabs—/ /bzlosapa spangs bla ma'i man ngag gis gsal bshad brjod byed kyi dgos pa/ /ngan song gsum la skyob pa'i gsung skyabs gsum la ni mngon dga' zhing nges par sgo bas ste zhe dag pa na skyabs gnas su byed pa/ /rtse mo las/ 'jig rten ni gang zag bzhi/ bskal pa brgyad ni brtson byas shing / /cho ga bzhin du kun spyad kyang / /de dag 'grub par yod mi 'gyur/ /byang chub sems ni ma skyed pa/ /the tshom yod pa nyid dang ni/ /gang zhig bka' bstsol mi byed dang / /ma dad pas ni mi 'grub ces pas byu/nga dzaḥb bzhi spangs pa maḥdzag nyan rang las mchog du gyur pa bhu ta'i gsung / sem sa rtogs pa thugs su chud pa ma nyams pa brtan pa dang phyi dang nang gi 'jug pas zhugs gsung / /dkyil 'khor zhugs shing dbang ——ba nas/ /mngon rtogs 'phel ba'am mi 'dab pas/ snyom pa las kyis yal bar mi 'dor bar/ yang ma dhar ka la pa shang chud pas/ dngos grub dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas gsung / bdag 'dzin gyi rtogs pa che zhing bdag med pa'i rtog pa chung na/ khams bde ba'i yan lag du grub na khrus bya/ ṭa ki'i bzhir pa las rnam shes hūṃ gi gzugs lus ngag yid gsum dag pa bya nyid do/ /dam 21ga spyod pa la brtson pas/ /ri sul ri rtse chu ngogs 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i 'gram/ /shing cig zhi gnas ma mo'i khyer mam dur khrod dam/ /bskyed ched du byas pa'i skye shing gsung tshal lha khang mchod rten lo bdun nam bzung na khang stong bzhi mdo 'am/ /yid deshasachebs ni gang du dga' yid rjes mthun 47byed844

bar bde ba'i stan gnas ste/ /snying kar rang 'byung 'od dro can/ /der gnas rdzu gi 'od zer gyis/ /sngon grub pa bsgrub pa mnyes pa tshangs ma rgya byin mo sogs rnams legs bskul bas/ /nam mkha' gang ba gsal bltas la/ /phyag 'tshal lus dbul nyer spyod lngas mchod cing bshags dang rjes yid rang / /ya sa sngo skyabs 'gro chos 'khor bskul mya ngan mi 'da' gsol/ /sems bskyed ponapagasung dang / lam gnas 'jug pa gsung tshangs pa'i gnas mthar de nyid kyang zhu bzhi rnams bho sa te/ /gzung ba dang 'dzin pas stong pa'ide rig pa 'joms pa dang mi byed pas yeshesarig bya rig byed mi phyed pas rdorje shu n+ya tas mchog sgo bya/ /sngar gyi tshad med pa'i phrin las ma nu'i don du bhudha thob par bya mnyam pa dang nam mkhar re las nyid dkyil 'khor/ /de gyur palas stengs hūṃ las 'od 'phros 'dus gyur pa las byung sna tshogs rdo rje las/ /'od 'phros de las rdo rje'i rang bzhin 'od 'phros ra ba sa gzhi gur/ /bla re dra ba me 'od h+ya dang sgrar byung a brlab sgo/ /der ni paṃ las snatshogasapad+ma'ilte bar rgyu las a li rnam pa zla ba dang rang bzhin me long ye shes ngo bo shes rab gyur pa las 'dab ma brgyad phyag 6) 2)pa/ / /ma/ li las byung rgyu ka li rnam pa nyi ma rang bzhin mnyam nyid ngo bo thabs zla nyi'i dbus son las 'od 'phros sems can don byas tshur 'dus hūṃ gyur pa'i/ /rdo rje lte ba'i khongs chud hūṃ gis 'phro 'du las—/ /sa pas bhud dha sgo dhi 'od zer gyi rnam par tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las yongs su rdzogs pa khro bo'i 'khor lo bho par bya/ /snatshogasachus skyes 'dabalte bar 'dren pa mchog /hūṃ mja da rgyu sa bon rnam pa phyag mtshan rang bzhin so sor rtog pa/ rgyu gdan nyi zla phyag mtshan rnam pa 'od kyi gong bu rang bzhin bya ba grub pa rgyu 'od gong rnam pa sku rang bzhin chos dbyings in tra ni la'i mdog brgyad dang brgyad gnyis zhal phyag gis/ /rnam mdzes 'jig rten gsum rgyal sgo/ /dbang sngon chu shel 'dzasru'i chu gser ①dza ba dang / /su ma tiḥrtsa zhal sngo/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar rgyab ser de'i steng na gsum dbus dkar g.yas sngo g.yon ser de'i steng du ma dmar/ bha tra bo de rtsa zhal g.yon 47—845

gyi gsum kun dang ut+pal gtso ma'i stenalagaser dang pad+ma ra ga /spyan gsum ba dan thugs rjes ma nu'i don la chags pa'i du'i mdog can mche' brtsigs bdud bzhi 'joms pa thod pa'i//'phreng bas thod byas sangs rgyas lnga'i ngo bo yang na steng na sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan can/ /bzhugs tshul g.yas brkyang ba'i gnas pa yis/ /bde byed kyi ni mgo bo dang / /u ma'i nu ma mnan mdzad cing / /khros pa'i spyan gyis rnam par gzigs/ /rdo rjes mtshan pa'i phyag rgya drug gis sku brgyan cing / /mgo bo'i do shal mgo 'a phreng ske rags rus pa'i ske rags dang gnyis yod pas gsung stagawags rlon pa gos/ /phyag dang po gnyis sdigs 'as/ba kyi rtse lcags kyu/ ltar gug ge pa rgyab sprod nas ze chung gnyis g.yas 'a:ngeng ba'i byu/ga gis rdo rje dang / /g.yonadril bus rang snang rig ma rangaji'adra ba la 'khyud ①gnyis med zag med pa bde/ /dngapo'i'og ma gnyis kyis dpral ba'i steng du sngar gyi phyagargya/ /sdogs 'dzub lcags kyu'i 'ching ba de nyidabacas pa 'o/ /gzhanagayon gsum pa rnams thod pa kha ṭī ga /ral gri dang ni lngapalcags kyu dang / /drugapasdigasa'adzub dang bcas pa zhags pa bdunapa'akhoralo dang / /g.yasagasum pa rin po che dang bzhipatho ba mdung bar pa/ /drug pa mgobo bdunapa cang te'u brgyadapa nyid kyi na ra'i/ /lpags pa'i gos mchog steng du mgo g.yas bstan 'dzin/ /phyogs yangasakyi mdab mar lugs las bzlog pa yis/ /shara'adod pa'i rdo rje byangasngon po dang / /nubastobs chen rdo rje lhomi g.yo rdo rje rnams/ /su ma ti zhal thams cad sku mdog dang gcig par bzhed/ bha tra bornyi ngos kyi zhal gnyis de'i khro bo sku mdog dang mthun pas 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i g.yas ljang / g.yon dmar nag sogs su gsungs/sngo ljang dmar dang dud ka ngur sprig dmar nag bsres/ /drug phyed zhal dang gsum gnyis phyag gnyis/ /spyan gsum mche ba rnam brtsigs zhal/ /thod pa'i 'phreng bas rnam par brgyan cing g.yas dang po nas 'dod pa'i rdo rje tho ba rdo rje sngon po'i dbyig pa/47byed846

stobs chen mdung rtse gsum mi g.yo ral gri/ na ra'i rus pa'i brgyan dang ldan pa'o/ /g.yas rim pa bzhin tshangs pa phung po'i bdud brkyangadabang po lha'i zhabasanye dbang kyis drag po nyon mongs 'chi bdag gsung bdud bzhi rnam mnan cing / /'dren pa'i stegatsobophyag rgya 'ching ba'i phyag rgya dag gis/ /rang gi mtshan ma dang ni dril bu 'am/ /rdo rje yang thams cad g.yas rdo rje dril bus rang snang rig mar 'khyud/ /phyag gzhan dag gis bdag po yi/ /phyag rgya dpral bar 'ching ba dang / /thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ kha 'dzin a bi nas rang gi phyag rgya dril bur bcas 'dzin pa'i phyag rgya 'ching ba ste ces pa dang tho ba dbyug to mdung dang ni/ ral gri dril bu de bzhin no/ /yang na thams cad rdo rje dril bu te ces so/ /brla la hre sho/ byin pa la mang rtsa sor mo la hūṃ sge/bol la me ma the bo la ṭ+wāṃ tsam/ pus mo la me kha la ke/ sna la rku gsang bar sho bshang bar sum̐ mig gnyis rna ba gnyis la yang bzhi'o/ /cing / /sdogs 'dzub rdo rje dang bcas pa'o/ /gnas gsum la ni rdo rje gsum bho cing / /lus gnas spyir gsum du yod pa las 'di'i go cha chen pos yang dag bsrung / /h+ya dang phyag rgya'i sbyor bas nyer bkug pa'i/ /ye shes dam tshig gnyis su med ye shes pa dang dus gcig byon pa la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol zhes pa dang gya brngod cing dbang bskur bar bsam mo gsung sprad dbang bskur/ /ā+oṃ sum̐ bha ni sum bha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ gyit+na pa ya gyit+na pa ya/ oṃ a na ba ga ban ba ①badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ra /snying kar pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar / phyogs bzhir ṭ+wāṃ lo khaṃ hūṃ tshogs khar khaṃ shā/ spyi gtsug ke rtsa/ sna ba g.yas me sre ltag par ye/ sna ba g.yon sum tha/ smin dbus waṃ khaṃ/ mig gnyis lo/ phrag pa gnyis saṃ sum̐/ mchan khung gnyis sa sa/ nu ma gnyis me/ sna rtse baṃ sum̐/ kha la snye bye/ 'gul par rgo snying kar me haṃ/ sgangs par me khaṃ/ rtags la lo tsam/ bshang bar re khaṃ brla la 4 sho byin pa la me rtsa/ sor mo la rgyu su/ bol la me/ the bo la ṭ+wāṃ gi pus mo la /kha la rka sna la rku/ gsang bar 7 bshang bar sum/ mig gnyis la yang bzhi'o/ /rgyud nas sum cu 47—847

rtsa bdun rnam dag pas/ /yi ge'i dkyil 'khor sgo par bya/ /ces pa/ snying kar hūṃ dang / phyogs bzhir ḍa lo khaṃ rtu/ gnas nyer bzhir khaṃ sre sogs/ mig sogs rang du kai zu shaṃ sum̐ bzhir/ ye bzhi'o gtso bo la mi skyod pa 'khor lo rnam snang don grub 'od dpag med rin 'byung / rang snying chos kyi yi ge lha'i kha dog dang mthun pa mar me'i 'phreng ba bzhin bskor ba la dmigs la gsungs ste nges par bzhi bsdu ba snying ka'i 'od kyis gtso bo dang 'khor dang bsrung 'khor dang bsrung 'khor la khyab rgya che bar byas/ 'khor gtso bo de las phyag gnyis pas bsngo ba sogs bya thun gnyis sogs la phyag gnyis pa las spro ba semasacan don byas dang tshurabasdu ba la dmigs hūṃ la bsdu hūṃ de las gtso bo 'khor bzhi sgo sa la ye shes bzhug pa yan chad bya gsung te/ chen gcig sem sa kyis mngon bzlas na/ /las kun thogs pa med par 'grub/ /dpal ldan mngon brjod bla ma las/ /gsungs pa'i bsgrub thabs rnams bkod pa'i/ /bsngo ba'i dngos po dge des 'gro rnams sdang ba las ched du bya ba bsngo ba gnas skabs dang mthar thug gnyis gsung / /rnam rgyal dngos grub mchog thob dharma tsakra mchod rten gyi 'khor lta bu skum po badz+ra rad na'i rad na tsa7 gsum pa ste zur gsum gyi logs gsum la dmag gsum pa'o/ /shog /bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje rdo rje ni 'joms pa dang mi byed pa ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / rtag pa gnyis pa las/ mi shes pa'i ri bo chen po 'joms pas na ye shes nyid rdo rje'o/ /ces pa dang / rdo rje mi phyed zhes bya ste/ ces pa'o/ /gnod mngesas khro bo'i rgyal po chen po sdang ba thams cad rnam par 'joms pa'i bsgrub thabs slob dpon prad dzñā rak+ṣ-ir tas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //kha che'i mkhan po bha tra bo dhi dang / a tsar+ya mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug gis bsgyur ba'o// //phan gdags bya ba 'dogs byed bshad/ /'dogs tshul ma tshang kha skong dang / /mi gsal gsal byed cha mthun la/ /nges pa bskyed pa gsum yin no/ /man tra mi 'grub pa'i rgyu bzhi lung ma thob pa/ yid ma ches pa/ngag gi nyes pa bzhi ma spangs pa/ bzlas pa bar ma chad pa'o/ /lung bla ma gcig nas gcig tu rgyud pa'i lung yod 47byed848

pa'am rten byin brlabs can las so/ /bsdur mchan/842 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉kho rdo rje gnod mdzes khro bo'i rgyal po chen po snang ba thams cad rnam par 'joms pa'i bsgrub thabs/ slob dpon pradzñā rak+ṣir tas mdzad pa bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉〉wamasdug bsngal ba la mi bzod pa sbyor ba kun slong nus pa dang /845 yo)〈〈pe 〉stanasel/846 ①〈〈pe 〉stapakhyud/847 7〈〈pe 〉〉wab/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2771)47wa 849

༄ga /khro bo reg tshig gi bsgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/①༄/ khro bo reg tshig gi bsgrub thabs rnams bzhugs/ ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ kabha ya na khakro ta gas tsa na ngan ma/ bod skad du/ kakhro bo khareg tshig gi gabasgrub pa'i thabs ngazhes bya ba/ yigepa'iphyag khro rgyal reg tshig la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyagagi yul gtum chen rab 'bar gdug pa 'joms/ /mustegs ngan sngags sbyor 'joms lus ngag yid gsum gyi phyag 'tshal lo/ /pha rol gcod pas mtshon cha rab tu 'bar ba yis/ /chedadubya ba pha rol sbyor ba bshig phyir bri/ /dgra'am rang bsad bsrung gnad kyi man ngag zabamoni/ /bsrung bzlog gsad mdorabasdus gsum shes par bya/ /dang po bdag la mthu gtad nas sdeg pa bsags pa sdug bsngal rgyu spyod pa'i/ /sems can kun la spyi lasnying rje bsgom/ /byebrag du rang la sdang ba'i sems ldan zhing //ngan sngags sbyor byed pho nya sbod/ /dmod pa'i sbyor ba byed pa la/ /gdengs gsum bla ma'i zhal las shesached du gtang ba'i snying rje bskyed/ /bdag gzhan gnyis ka bde 47—850

ba'i phyir/ /thabs mchog bhar ba'i lha sgom smon/ /snying rje ldan pa'i mi rnams kyi / /lus ni glags mi rnyed pas pha lam gong po 'dra/ /de nas phyi nang 'jig rten gyi—/ /dngos po thams cad gzhom par bya/ /oṃ chos thams cad shin tu dag swa bhab shud dha sarba dharma swa bha ba shud sgo haṃ/ lan gsum snangab tsam 'di brjod de 'jig rten na/ /bdag dang pha rol dgraboyi sbod stong dang / /thun zoramanan pa rdzas dang kho'i ngag sngags kyi sbyor ba rnams/ /thams cad ma lus stong par sngags ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyang ba bsam/ /mkha' ltar thams cad stong pa la/ /gnyis ka stong nyid yin pas gcig la gcig gnod byed par 'gal/ /mkha' la sprin byung ba ltar stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin las—/ /rgyu bskyed semasalas byung ba'i 'khor lo 'bar ba ni/ /me yi 'khor lo 'byung po sde brgyad gcod pa'i rtsibs brgyad pa/ /'dab dgu'i tshadatshad ldan bsam par bya/ /spyor lo steng du cung zad ma reg par/ /ram̐ dmaralas 'bar ba'i me'igazhal byas bskyed—/ /me'i dkyil 'khor gyi dkyil du padanyi'isteng du yi ge hūṃ las ni/ /sngags rtsa sngags brjod lha dgu 'khoradang dus gcig bskyed/ /khrobodagu sku mdog mun ltar gnag pa la / /ba spu kun nas me dpung 'phro/ /sma ra byun ma dbu skra gyenadu'abar/ /nyi ma dus gsum mam brdar bhar ba'i spyan gsum bgrad/ /mche brtsigs ljags sgril gad mos 'debs/ /shangasagong nyegal 'bur rtogacheskal med 'jigs pa'i shangs/ /phyag gnyis g.yas rdegatshul sha sul hrags yanalag sbom/ /ba spu kun nas me dpung 'phro / /gsus pa mazhumapa'aphyangazhingagayonabarkyang g.yasabakum ①bzhugs/ /stag gi sham thabs rlonapa sbrul gyis yanalagabargyan/ /phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje g.yon tri shu la/ /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad rtsibs bzhi bkal/ /'khor zhing loga'adren rnam par gcod pa rnams/ /de ltar lha dgu 'khorabaskyed nas ni/ /phyogs mtshams lha 47—851

brgyad phyir bltas nas/ /sngags 'di kun gyis brjod par bsam/ /oṃ sngags bzlos ma thog sngags kyi tshigs bcad du mi rung gsung bha ya na sa ni/ tra ①sa ni sarba ma ra/ pra kai tai/hi ra/ bhi na sa ni/ yi ge tsi ta/ sarba dush+tsan/ duṣ+ṭan sa ta ki/ sarba na/pra tai ki ra ni/ phaṭa du phaṭa swā hā/ me dang khro bolas byung ba'i 'khor lo thams cad kun//bzlog pa'i dus su g.yas skor du ni 'khor lo bsam/ /rangaladamigs pa'i dgra dang bgegs yod na/ /me dang 'khor lo spros la lusalabasnun/ /sgom bzlas nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum dus drug brtson gyur na/ /kho'isbod gtong ldog cing ngan sngags 'jig /kho'irdzas kyi nus pa 'jig par 'gyur/ /bla ma mthong rgyags bla mas bsrung ba'o/ /drin can bla ma steng du sgom/ /khro bo brgyad kyi skeblama'imatha' bskor la/ /steng du gdug pa bzhin 'khor lo bhar ba bsam/ /'og tu slob 'khor yo byad bsam/ /khro bo brgyad kyis rang gi mtha' ma'i dang 'dra bas mtha'abaskor la/ /'og phan tshan bskor/ ya gcig go gdan bzhin du tu 'khor lo bhar ba bsam/ /de nas khorangal bzlog par 'dod pa yis/ /'khor lo'i gnad dgu man ngag tushes pa bya/ /snang ba rnam rtog gcod pa'i 'dzin pa gcod/ /kho mashitsam bzlog dang gsad dang kho dang ponya gnyis ka blo rdeg dang / /rangagilus bsrung kho'ingag gnan so mi lam brtag pa byed do/ /rlung gi rgya'i'akhor lo'i tshad tsam pa/ /gcod 'ogadupa brtan gyi 'khor lo bsam/ /'ogadu dngos po rnam par gcod cing 'khor ba yis/ /gnas pa snod kyi 'jig rten 'byung bzhi las bams po grub tshad dang / /brten pa sde brgyad 'byung po semasacan ①rnams/ /gcad tsakrabasreg thams cad stong par bsam/ /de rnams rnam shes thams cad kun/ /sprul pa'i tshul du rang la bsdu/ /nam 47—852

mkha' stong pa'i dbyings na ni/ /'khor lo gzhal byas lha rnams kun/ /tshangs pa 'jigs chags dang bral lo bzhin du brtag par rangabasam/ /sngags zlas lha'ing rgyal gyis spyod lam thams cad bya/ /de nas bsgoms pas skyo bar 'gyur gyi bar/ /rang gi snying khar 'khor lo bhar ba 'dzubagangabasam/ /lte bar rdo rje sems nyid kyi nasasngon po tsam la/ /khrobo'iye shes kyi ngo bo yi ge hūṃ gis mtshan pa la/ /hūṃgimatha' mar rtsasngags kyis bskor bar bsam/ /rnam par ranga'akhor dubar gyur pa la/ /yid rtse gcig tu gtad rnam rtog gzhan mi gtang / /ting 'dzin brtan pa'i rtse gcig tu gnas rnal 'byor pa/ /lus sems las su rung bar 'gyur nus stobs thams cad dang ldan par 'gyur /de las skyonaldang bar 'dod pa na/ /rnam smin zhen pa'i las ngan las grub pa'i sha khrag lus brtubs shing / /ye shes me yis phyemarnams bsregs nas ni/ /bdag rang dngos bral bdag med nam mkhar bsam/ /bzlog par 'dod na tsakragayas su bskor/ /gsad par 'dod na g.yon du bskor/ /blo rdeg byed na bsgyur la bskor/ /rten gyi dad pa rgyal ba'i ringasrel rgyu/ /rin chen gseraphye ma dur khrod sha za yod pa nas sa//so thub bsregasa'ajim pa sbrus pa la/ /rangagi mthe'u chung gi khru gang tshad ldan mchod rten bya—/ /bang rim lnga byangs ra por dang ldan pa la/ /dang po hūṃ gis bskor ba mgo nang du yod pa bri/ /oṃ dang ha dang sa dang ha/ /bang rim bzhi la rim bzhin bri/ /gzungs mtshan ①nyi shu rtsa gcig la/ /bdag gi dgra bo che ge mo'i/ /lus ngag yid gsum gyi sbyor ba rnams/ shig cig shig cig /chom cig chom cig /non cig non cig /ces pa btags bris mchodarten gyi nang du bzhug /mi 'jigs brtan pa'i rten spyol snying po gzungs dang gzhug⑤ /brigazhidur khrod ras kyi gzhi ma la/ /gri khrag dug chu sbyar ba yis/ /dgra'ilte ba brtsibs ①brgyad mu 47—853

khyud gnyis/ /lte dgra'i zer dang sngags bya yin bar ming rus gzungs kyis bskor/ /rtsibs la regayas g.yon hūṃ re re gnyis dang / /sngags la 'dogs byas ga'imu khyud la//rdo rje yang de'i phyi ma la tri shul de phyir bri/ /mchod rten lachosabacug la zhabs sdom bya/ /bsgrub bya'i lusatshadaling kha khru gang tshad/ /lce ni thong brangathong du drangs kang tshad du bri/ /rnag rdzas chushulapadug dang dha du ra'i/ /khu bas ling ga byug par bya/ dpral bar ming ①ming ste snying khar rus/ /yan lag bzhi la dza rdo nang du bstan pa dang ram̐/ /lce ④gser gyi rdo rje rgya gram bri/ /de nas rang gi bsgrub khang du/ /ma dhal steng du ling kha gding khru/ /de'i steng du mchod rten bzhag /dusazla ba yar kyi tshes brgyad la/ /bgegs sprad rtsasngags kyis stong pa nyid du k+ṣiṃbhabasabasam/ /yig tsakra'i 'bru rnams ni lha ru bsam/ /rgyu las rin chen mchod rten bskyed/ /sa drangs pa'ilha bzhugs khrus gsol chugatsang gis mchod bstod bya/ /bsgrub bya srangabamanan par gsol ba rdab/ /de nas rang khroborabasam la gi snying kha nas/ /lcags kyu zhags pa rab spros la/ /dgra'i snying phugs mgul mchings rjodagug par bya/ /oṃ bha ya na dgra'i ming che ge mo oṃ a bhu sha dza/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang bcas la/ /lan grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig gis/ /bkug la ling ka de la bstem/ /oṃ bha ya na che ge mo dgrabo'i ming pra be sha stom/ 'khor lo bzhidang bri lugs gong dang 'dra ba la/ /lte bar hūṃ gcig ga sagayon re gnyis mtha'/ /de'i hūṃregyimatha' ma sngags kyis bskor/ /mgo bo'i thad ka hūṃ gi steng du oṃ byas la/ /rtsibs la migaphyir brtan pa hūṃ dang re gnyis bri//rtsa sngags rak+ṣa bcas pa ni/ /mu khyud nang la bri bar bya/ /rdo rje bar mu tshod phyi ma lamatshams med par bri/ /de'i phyi la me ri bri/ /bgegs rtsa sngags bzlas thun brab skrad 'khor lo stong par bsam/ /rgyu las 'khor lo ji bzhin bskyed/ /yig 'bru 47—854

dam tshig khro bo la/ /ye shes khro bo regatshig dgu po bkug la bstem/ /rten 'byel snying pos me tog gtor/ /bum chus bkru zhing bsnyenapabyas pa'i gnyis med bstem/ /rnam lnga mchod bstodapabastod bsrung ba gsol ba gdab/ /'khoralol 'jus la zhag bdun bar du bsnyen pa bya/ /de nas dril la las btum①/ /rangagidapung pa g.yon la gdags par bya/ /dus rnams kun tu bsrung bar 'gyur/ /de nas rang gi snying kha ru/ /pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa sngonapobasam/ /dbus su pad+martsa sngags kyi yig 'bru bsam/ /a mdun nurgyab tagayas ra g.yon 'dab ma la/ /'od zer yi ge rnams la ldan par bsams nas ni/ /oṃ bha ya na a nu ta ra/ a sa le ston/ ces pa brgya dang brgyad bzlas la/ /gos gsar gon la sngas khar gzhug② /lho ru mgo bstan pa ④gzhogs g.yas phab/ /nyal la rmi ltas brtag par bya/ /bong bu dre'u bud med dang / /bya nag lug nag tshong pa rnams/ /srogagacod kyi mo rig rnams kyi cho 'phrul yin/ /mon dang gnag dang bya rog rnams/ /bdud dang 'gong po'i cho 'phrul yin/ /srin po shan pa ri dwags sha /gshin rje yi dwags cho 'phrul yin/ /gcan zan dha dang jag pa rnams/ /gnod sbyin rnams kyi cho 'phrulayin/ /lus dang a me 'bar nyi mas gdungs pa ni/ /sbyin sreg byed pa'i rmi ltas yin/ /ser ba sho rgal ri nyer rmi/ /zor kha gtong rjopa'i ltas su bzung / /dong du lhung dang 'dam du bying / /gdos la brtags dang ri yis mnan—/ /steng du srog chags 'khrab pa rnams/ /mnan pa yod pa'i rmi ltas yin / /bsrung bzlog sbyor ba drag tu bya/ /go gon mtshon thogs 'khar du chud| /las mkhan ga pas na srin pos g.yog byas rmi ba na/ /tharalabazlog shing thub par 'gyur ba yin/ /de nas rang gi lto ba ni/ /rin chen lus 'di byin gyis 47—855

brlab bum par bsam par bya/ /'khoralo'i steng du snying khar lha dgu bskyed nas ni/ /lha ladamigs la bzlas pa byas pa yis/ /lha rnams bdud rtsir zhu bar bsam /tho rangs snga bar langs la ni/ /dgra yi phyogs su kha bltas lharubasams la/ /dri chu'i dngas ma khror gang la/ /oṃ bha ya na a mri ta hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa nyi shu rtsa gcig btab bdudartsir bsams la/ rang gi zhalagadams las shes so/ /khong du btud par bya//de 'og dri chu khyor g.yasapa'igang la/ /oṃ bha ya ma ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces btab g.yon pa'i srin lag gis/ /spyi gtsug smin mtshams lkog ①ma dang / /snying kha lte ba gsang gnas dang / /bcu drug mdo dang ro rgyab dang / /ltag pa'i bdud du thig le tsakra rdo rjes ma— pa re bsam bya/ /grub na mgo lus khyab par byug/de'i lhag pa'i dri chu la/ /oṃ bha ya na che ge mo ma ra ya/ srog thun sa ma ya zlog/thum bh+yo/ nyi shu gcig btab lan gsum gsum tsakra me dang bcas par bsams la 'phang /zor kyi sna la dgra bdas nas/ /gshin rje'i gnas su song bar bsam yang bzlog dkar mo labazlog 'di shes pa'i byedan/ /mi la sbyor ba gzhan mi dgos/ /de nas bsad 3pa'i sbyor byed na/ /'phang sreg gnan gsum shes par bya//sngon du bsnyen pa 'bum tsho lnga nye bsnyen 'bum tsho gsum dang bcas pa rdzogs pa yis/ /ra khyi phag gsum rog po yi/ /srog chags gang rung snying gi khrag dang khrag gzhan la/ /nyung 1dkar skye tshe lan tsha dang / /dug dang tsher ma'i rtse mo gdab/ /lcags sam zangs la bre gsum shor ba gru gsum ga'u'i nang du blugs/ /ga'ul mi rgyus bsgril ma'i skud pa gdags—/ /sngags sābha ba kyi don dran stong par bya/ /hri las chos 'byung dmar nag gru gsum bskyed/ /ra las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho sanag bsam/ /de'i nang du lha 47—856

dgu bskyed/ /ye shes khro bo bkug la bstem/ /lha la ga'uyidamigs te sngags bzlas pas/ /khro bo rnams kyi smin mtshams nas/ /ye shes rgyun 'dzag thim par khrag sga mdog du bsam/ /mchod bstod gtor mas dusadrug du mnyes byas shing / /nyi shu gcig tu thunadrug du bsgrub pa bya/ /rtags khrag lhung ba la sogs pa byung nas ni las sbyor brtsam/ /rtsemom nyams pa'i g.yag rog ra g.yas nang du blugs/ /steng g.yogs med pa'i sa khyer rangalal/ /dgra'i phyogs su kha bltas te/ /rang gi gdong du khrag zor bzhag /bsnyen gtor de yi zoragyigayas su ste/ /yul gyi lha la nas kyis 1gser skyems dbul/ /phyogs kyi lha la rangagis ma nyes nga/'i dpang gzugs bya / /ye shes lha gsalabar bya yi nga rgyal gyis/ /brdzus skyes drag po'i pho nya rang bzhin rang gi mdun du bsam bskul/ /lha chen yabartag pa tshangs pa'i sras/ /lhadabang phyug chen po khros pa'i dmanyams la sku/ /srin po rag sha sprulapa'i mtshan mthu bo che/ /rdzu 'phrul shugs che mi la chibs/ /sku mdog smug nag gcer bu la/ /lcags kyi ral pa sha ra ra/ /dpral na khrag gi dmig dgu la/ /khrag gi mchi ma nyi li li / /g.yas gnyis mi'iro dbyug lcags be+er bsnams/ /dbyug pas byobs la be+er kas bsnun/ /g.yon gnyis lcags kyu rgyu zhags rlonapabasnams/ /lcags kyus snying kha nas khug la zhags pas chings/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i snying mgo chod/ /rag sha bhar ba'i g.yas g.yon na/ /lcags kyi mon pa nag po gnyis/ /gcer bu thal ba'i mdog can la/ /lcags kyi ral pa rtsug na 'khyil brjes/ /lag na lcags kyi tho skam bsnams/ /skam pas bzung la tho bas rdungs/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i gshed ma mdzod/ /dza la rag sha ma ra pra kang / hi ra bhi na sa ni yi ge sbu ta/ sa ma ya che ge mo la ma ra ya bh+yo/ stengadu'akhor lo rtsibs brgyad 'og du 47—837

rtsibs bzhi la/ /ra'i steng dang 'og du bsgom/ /dgra la lusalabasnun par bsams la 'phang / /dgra la rartse'ikha bltas thebs pa ste/ /rang la kha bltas log pa yin/ /gzhan du bltas na 'gyangs par 'gyur/ /zor kha nyi shu gcig 'phangs na / /dgra la byas na nad kyis thebs par 'gyur/ /bgegs la byas na zlog par nges/ /mnan pa'i las ka byed pa na/ /bsgrub pa gong dang 'dra ba la/ /sa bdag phag pa'i lasasbyor dus su thod par bzhug /re ba nag po'i khung du gril/ /tshon sna lnga yi skud pas bcing / /sbyin sreg thal ba dang bcas par/ /dur khrod gnyan po'i gnas su sba/ /gru gsum khru gang dong du gzhugalku /steng nas rgya re bhar bas mnan/ /steng du sbyin sreg lan gsum bya/ /drag po'i las gsum phal che rnams/ /sbyin sreg cho ga'i gzhung nas shes/ /brdzus snyeskyes kyi slob dpon ar+ya dhe bas/ mu stegs pa'i sbyor ba rnams bshig pa'i phyir mdzad nga/ spyodags 65 // //— rgya gar gyi mkhan po rdo rje gdan pa dang / bod kyi lo tsa ba ba ri bas bsgyur ba'o// //47—858

2846༄7/ / reg 'bogs ma'i bsgrub thabs/lku༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ bha ya shu la stam bha sasan tsa nakha/ bod skad du/dgra babegs la reg 'bigs ma'i saphyag che mthar thug du bsgrub thabasakha/ zhal la khro gnyer ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgra baspegs la re ga'abigs mdung can ar+yadhebs sgrol ma khro gnyer mtshan can la 'dud/ /gdug pa bstan pa/ spyi gang zag spyi bla ma'i bdag ras gi thar nga/ la bar du gcod pa 'o/ /thams cad gzhom phyir de sgrub yang dag bri/ /sngonapa thog med mar ma byas gyur kun la phan zhing bde bar bsam/ /sems can kyi nang nas gdug ldan snyingarje med pa/ gnod sems can la mchog tu byams blo bskyed/ /bde la dgod phyir mchog bsngags gnas skabs su khro mo nyid bskyed gsang 'dus nas bya/ /chos rnams stong nyid dngos bdenang 'i bral spyos med mi rtog don dam bsam/ /lha'i snang tsam du kun rdzob bden pa sa bon paṃ las gdan du pad+ma pad+ma'i rtse mo mdung mtshan ste/ /pad ma kun la tsher ldan pad ma la me bhar me stag rab 'phros kyin phyogs kun tu 'gyed rab 'khor g.yasasubasam/ /47—860

steng 'og du nam mkha'i sa bon e las dmar nag 'khrug pa'i chos 'byung gru gsum bskyed/ /chos 'byung gi dkyil du khro mo'is bon lha las rtsa ba'i gzungs brjod khro mo 'khor dgu dus gcig tu bskyed de/ /khro mo rnams kyi gtso mo la bsrung ba'i zhal rnams phyir bltas gzungs 'di kun gyis bzlas par bya/ /oṃ sarba thams cad bha ya na sha reg 'bigs ni/ tra sa phye gcig ni tra sa ya gtoragacig /bhe ra te bh+ri/ ku ta ta ṭi/ ste ta ṭi/ bhe ra ti shwe ta she ta—/ dza ti ni swā hā/ g.yas mdung dang g.yon tri shu la'i steng du tri shul 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad rtsibs bzhi yis/ /dgra bgegs rnams kyi lus la sha khrag gis lus la bsnun te 'khoralospros la myos byas la/ /ne+e mi tri 'dre dha lha sulha ma yin phu k+ṣa'i gnod sbyin 'od zer gyi rnam pas drangs nas ni/ /rangagishangs su rngubs anan te lte bar e'imelanges par srogabasreg par bya'o/ /mibasad pa'i gri lcags shi yanganashing las ni 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad lte bar yu ba yod pa bya/ /sngags kyi sde tshan brgyad ni rtsibs la rab bkod lha 'khor lo la bstems la/ /rdza'igru gsum par ga'ur bzhu/ga ste de mthar dgrabagegs kyi ling kha spyi tshugs bzhug /zhagarel thun drug bskor zhing gongagigazungs sngags 'di brjod bya—/ /ling ga la dgra bgegs dgug bzhug bcings 'odazer gyis te nges skor shelas chag pas sbyar bya/ /nyungs kar skye tse dug khrag sol ba thal chen dang / /gshin rje skra dang dur khrod ras snyigs sdig sha sbrul/ /bsres la sbrulagyigazugs bcas zhal du gzungs kyi rtsibs brgyad la sngags rno phyogs gcig tu byas la 'khor lo bzhug /dgra la sbul gyi zhal bstan gdong du ling kha drababazhag cing brdung / /gsum 'grub de nab/ las la/ dgra'i grong mthong bar sbas la bzhag ro/ /de nas bsnyen bsgrub bya/ 'gul ba'am mi lam du rab byung na 'og tu ling ga gzhug mnan pa'o/ /khyung gi 'dra ba go ba dang rma bya'i sgos brgyan pa dang bla mas byug pa gal che'o—/ /sgrul gyi mnan pa byed dus sba'o/ /sbyar bar bya zhing legs spang bya/ /dge ba 'di 47—861

yis thub pa'i bstan pa ring du gnas gyur cig /slob dpon ar+ya dhe bas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/86༷ humatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉rab reg 'bigs ma'i sgrub thabs ar+ya dhe bas mdzad pa bzhugs so//861 1 〈〈pe 〉〉bskor/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2773)47wa 862

༄༅/ /skal 'jog dbang gi cho ga1 sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ a wi shin tsa tu ma bhi ti/ bod skad du/sku gsum gyi 'bras bu skal 'jog dbang gi cho ga /dpal gyi mchog dbang gi bde mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde chen chosaskuzag med bde mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skal ngan skal 'jog dbang gi cho ga 'di brtsam bya/ /bla ma la bzhi rdzogs su dbang thob thong rtsanyung bzhi pa spangs bsnyen dbang bsnyen sum 'bum rdzogs pa'i/ /dang por sa brtag 'jig rten pa la gtor ma gtang sa bslang dang / /sa sbyangs sa bsrung sngon 'jug bya/ / dal la tshon 5sna lnga yis bri/ /rtsibs brgyad nag po gru chad dmar—/ /nang na phar nag po dkar ser dmar ljang rtsigs/ /'dod yon dmar pha khu seradra ba khrobodang / /dra phyed ba gam dha yab dkaraka ser/ /rta babs la gar mdzes su sogs spyi dang bstun/ /rdorjer ba'i dod du 'khor lo dmar po 'di phyir dur khrod brgyad po bri/ /dkyil du hūṃ ngam yanganardo rje sngon po dgod/ /bsnyen pa'i dbang bsgrub byas 47—863

pa'ibum pa dgod bya ste/ /mtha'aru gtor ma mchod pa rgyan sogs dgod/ /dkyil 'khor rangabi lhar lha rnams rdzogs bsgoms la/ /rang bzhin 'ogamin gyi khro bo chen po'i lha tham sa cad tshogs/ /sngonagyidam tshig chen pos rangagi gnas 'dir gshegs la/ /gnyis su med par bsams pa dang bzhugs gsol te/ /dbang bskur snasnardzogs par dbang bdag 'jug tu lha la zhus nga/'o/ /rtsal gyur cig /dza hūṃ baṃ ho/ de nas 'byung por dbang la bar du gcod nga/ rnams la gtor ma sbyin/ /phyi'islob ma nang gzhug phyi rol tu/ /rlo ba mas maṇ+ḍal phul la blam/sa dam la bzhag /bla mas slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la khro bo'i rgyal po reg tshig gi/ /byen brlabs tshul 'dzin bdag yin gyis/ /khyod kyis brnyas par ma byed cig /brnyas na brnyas mkhan de mnar med dag tu ltung / /bdud rtsi byin la 'thung cig rdo rje'i dam tshig chu/ /bsrung na reg tshig dngos grub ster/ /'das na snying 'byin srog gcod 'gyur/ /badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ/ snying khar rdo rje bzhag la dkyil 'khor 'jigs chen rab 'bar ba/ /dam tshig med la mi bstan te/ /de bzhin smra bar mi bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor yolaba'inang bcug la/ /yon phul gsol ba gdab par bya/ /rjesabarjod bya ma lus phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol / /bdag ni bcom ldan reg tshig gi/ /dam tshig dngos grub 'tshal ba ste/ /sngags dang phyag rgya bstan pa dang / /dkyil 'khor la sogs bya ba dang / /bsgrub pa'i thabs rnams ji lta bar/ /bdag la de bzhin bstan du gsol / /de nas slob ma khorang gi lha ru bsam/ /snying khar bla mas de'i sems la lha rnams 'phro mi rung lha bstems sngags kyis rtsal/ /lhal me tog phul te dam tshig gi rtags su mgo la bcing / /gdong g.yogs bkrol te rdo rje sems dpa' mig bye bas dal thams cad mthong 47—864

ngo/ /dkyil 'khor bstan/ /bkra shis bum pa bum lha rnams spyi thog tu bsam du gzhug go/ /ye shes mchog /skal 'jog khyod kyi mgo la bzhag /dngos grub dam pa spyi bos long / /de nas lha rnams thim par sem du gzhug go/ /bltam pa'i dus bzhin ye shes chus/ /skal rtsol dag byed khrus gsol zhing / /zhe sdang dri ma legs sbyangs te/ /lha dang mi phyed spro bar bya/ /oṃ bha ya snyo na a wi na ka me/ slob ma lha ru yang dag bla mas de lta bu gsal bar bskyed/ /yab yum mkha' gsang las byung ba/ /ye shes byang chub sems chen po/ /bde chen bdud rtsi yang dag sbyin/ /rdo rje lce yis blangs par gyis/ /a ho ma ha su ka ho/ /skrag dang gzi mdangs ldan par bsam / /de nas bla mas slob ma la/ /byin brlabs lha mo yang dag sbyin/ /mkha' gsang byin brlabs spyor bar bya/ /bde chen mkhas spyod rnal 'byor ma'i//dbyings kyi pad+mar yang dag sbyor/ /lhan skyes bde ba rdo rjer 'gyur/ /khyod kyis tshul mchog 'di spyod cig /a nu ra ga badz+ra stom/ /bde stong mi rtog nam mkha'i bzhin/ /lhan skyes ye shes rdo rje bsgom/ /de nas lha rnams bde bar sbyang / /nam mkhar sprin bzhin stong par bsdu/ /de la gang dang mi gnas te/ /yod med kun spangs bsgom par bya/ /dbang bzhi rdzogs par sbyin no/ /oṃ swa bha ba shud dho sarba dharma swa bha ba shud sgo haṃ1/ bzlasalung gi 'di yis byin brlabs dngos bral bya/ /yar ngo'i tshes brgyad nyi ma la/ /yon dang mchod pa legs phul te/ /gong bzhin dbangachog nas gsol ba lan gsum gdab/ /bla mas sngags kyi phreng ba rnams/ /slob ma'i kha ru bstim par bya/ /sngags kyi sgra ni rjes bzlas so/ /bcom ldan khro rgyal reg tshig dang / /bla ma bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bcom ldan reg tshig rgyal po la/ /bdag ming 'di zhes 47—865

bkyi ba ni/ /dus 'di nyid nas bzung nas su/ /byang chub snying po thob kyi bar / /yid dam bgyid par dam 'cha'o/ /bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa rnams / /thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyis/ /bdag la byin kyis brlab tu gsol/ /bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ /bcom ldan 'di la rtsal lags kyis/ /bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /de yi spyi bor me tog bzhag /khro bo rnams ni de la bzhug /khro bo rkyang pa'i rigs stsal lo / /byin brlabs sngon 'gro gong bzhin bya/ /sngags kyi bzlas pa rang gzungs brjod/ /dam bca' ba la khro mo gzugs/ /byin brlabs pa yang khro mos bya/ /yum rkyang dag gi byin brlabs so/ /gzhan phan gzhung nyung 'di sbyar bas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa ring gnas shog /dbang gi cho ga ar+ya dhe bas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //47—866

2848ra༅/ /khro bo reg tshig gi dam tshig gsang ba'i bsgrub thabs/shesnarak+ṣa/ /rgya gar skad du/ khrebha ya khagro ta gaghu ya ngas ma ya casan tsa na/bod skad du/ 7khro bo khareg tshig gi gdam tshig ngagasang ba'i cabasgrub thabs/bcom ldan 'das reg tshig la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngobonyidastong zhing thugs rjes 'jigs pa'i sems can skur sku'i rnam 'gyur snang ba'i/ /de nas rab gtum khro bo khro mo rnams 'a khros pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal te/ /de nyid bsgrub phyir de'i bsgrub thabs sngar ma thob pa/ rnams thob pa/ra byed pa/'i phyir bri/ /dbang skur legs thob sngags pas thog mar ni/ /byams dang snying rje dga' dang btang snyoms sgom/ /dkon mchog gsum la sems can gyi don du skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bshags dang yid rang dang / /bskul zhing gsol gdab bsngo ba rnams brjod la/ /chos rnams dngos bral stong pa nyi tsher bsam dung skyes ma ser mo gzugs can ma dmar mo/ mkha' 'gro ma ljang gu/ 'di rnams zhal gcig phyag bzhi la/g.yas rnams gri gug ḍa ma ru/ g.yon thod pa kha ṭaṃ kha lte ba snying kha dpral ba dkog ma krong bskyed du bsam mo/ /47byed868

'brum gsum las ni steng du gur bar du ra ba 'og tu sa bzhi 'khor lo sum rtsegs bskyed/ /'og gi la tri shul b.rapa rdo rje steng ma 'khor lo rim bzhin mtshan/ /bar ma'i lte bar e bskyed sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa chos 'byung bsam/ /de nas ram̐ gyur me'i rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pagazhal yas khang / /'khor lo pad nyi dgu yis rab mtshan bsam/ /phyi rol phyogs mtshams dur khrod rab 'jigs 'bar/ /yabahūṃ dzha yu ma gyilas gyur hūṃ las rdo rje tri shu la/ /paṃ las 'od 'phros rdorjetri shul las mchod cing sdig sbyangs tshur 'dus te/ /yabayumazhe sdang rdo rje'i sku gnyis dus gcig du mnyam rdzogs bskyed/ /stag sham glang chen stod g.yogs smin ma gyen du 'bar ba/ spyan gsum dmar rlum/ smin mtshams khro gnyer shangs 'bur che ba mche ba brtsigs pa ljags 'dril ba/ phyag 'phyang ba phyal 'phyang ba brkyang bskum mo/ /reg be+e ga reg 'bigs 'jigs ches mi sdug sku/ /'khor lo rgya ram thod skam sbrul gyis brgyan/ /stodagayogs su glang chen ko rlon shamathabs su stag lpags gos su gyon/ /thod zlon lngabacudo shal chun 'phyangs se ral kha/ /yabardo rje tri shul 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa la bzhi pa rab bsnams bskor/ /yum gyi g.yas pas gri gug 1tri shul g.yonapas 'as ra lo dngabazhibasnams cing 'khyud/ /yab kyi g.yas pasa'ajigs byed yumagyigayon pa dus mtshan brdzis shing brkyang bkum bzhugs/ /gzugs hūṃ dkar pos dpral ba dang rnam shes sngon po snying ga tshor e ser ngo/ lte ba dang 'du shes dmar po mgrin pa 'du byed ha ljang gu bol gong dang / /mig kro dkar dang rna ba hūṃ ser sna tram̐ dud kha dang adamaralce/ /kha ljang lus dang yid hūṃmajingal yi ge rim bzhin bkod/ /'od rangal 'phros spyan yabayumadrangs mchod yid kyis bsams te la gnyis med rangalabasnyim/ /ye shes bum pas dbang bskur yang 'od 'phros rigs lnga spyan drangs la sprul pa'i lha mo bzhis dbang bskur la thod pa lnga'i steng du rigs lngas rgyas btab par khrus gsol bas/ /mi bskyod sku yis gtsug gi rgyan du bsam—/ /rdo rje pad+ma byin brlabs snyoms zhugs la/ /rgyuthig le cha re byang chub kyi sems 47—869

dresab/ba/ skya/zu skyabs yum gyi mkha' las thig le dkar po sran ma tsam bcu drug phyogs bzhir g.yas skor mtshalas g.yon bskor du spros pa'o/ /kun tu spro/ /rgyuthig le las byung khro cho1gas dus gcig bskye/da/ /shar du 'jigs 'bar lhorugatum 'bar nubadusgrol 'bar byangadu rngam 'bar phyogs/ /byang shar stobs 'bar nubabyang shugs 'bar sharalhoradabugs 'bar lhonub gzi brjid 'bar shar lhor gzi brjid/ /mtshams g.yon skor tshul kyis mtshams gshin rje bzhir dgod par bya/ /sharadukhyi gdong lhophag gdong nubakhwa gdong byanga'ug gdong phyogs g.yas bskor du/ /pho nya khyu mchog rtogs byang shar sha ba'i gdong nub byang brtan ma ce spyang gdong can lho nub mche ba mthar byed gshin rje ma he'i gdong can shar lho ru 'joms/ /mtshams dgod bdag rnamalnga dang gis bdag mchod bstod pa gtor ma dang bdud rtsi dang bya/ /de nas gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams rang la rang gi mchod bstod bya/ /sngags rtsa ba'ibatus legs par brjod par bya/ /dge ba 'di yis sku gsum myur thob shog /bde mchog reg tshig gis bsgrub thabs/ar+ya dhe bas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rdo rje gdan pa dang / ba ri lo tshas bsgyur ba'o// //47byed870

༄ / /khro bo reg tshig gi sprun sreg gi cho ga zhes bya ba/khye༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ bha ya haṃ me bhe ti na ma/ bod skad du/ khro bo reg tshig gi sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes bya ba/ za byed rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /za byed rngam pa dgra bgegs sgol/ /drang srong mchog la phyag 'tshal te/ /rten pa'idangos grub kun dang nye ba'i phyir/ /gzhanal phan don du sbyin sreg cho ga bshad par bya/ /thab dang shing dang me dang rdzas/ /dus dang cho ga rnams su nges/ /dur khrod sa'i 'jim pa la khragagis sgrus la/ /gru gsum rtse mo lhor bstan pa/ /ngos lagasum ka la 'theb chung khru re ste/ /zab kyi tshad du de phyed yin/ /phyi ru bkyed phyir phyir phyogs su dang dpangs su khyenalabartsig /kha khyer la sogs sor bzhi yin/ /zhabs su rtse gsum kha khyer la/ /rdo rje phreng ba bri bar bya/ /stobs chen shugs ldan gyad gzugs brnyan gsum gyis/ /methab kyi zur gsum nas ni bteg pa bya/ /dug khrag ro sol — thal ba rnams/ /sbyar ba'i thabakhu ba byug par bya'o/ /dug 47—872

rtsa khrag la spags rtsemopa yis/ /thabakyikha khyer la ni gzugs pa'o/ /mdog shingagiganag tsher ma rno ba dang / /dri ngan srin bus zos pa dang / /ro bsregs 'gal rog la sogs shing bu la/ /dngapo'ibud shing tshad ni khru gang la/ /phyis bsnan pa yam shing tshad dang de'i phyed/ /yam shing rtsemoganyis dug dang mar la spags / /de nas shan pa nag po yi/ /khyim nas nyi phyed me blangs la/ /me rdzas nang du blugs la bzhag /chu rtsang me tog mar me spos/ /dri dang lha bshos mchodardzas rol mo rnams/ /thab kyi g.yon du bsham par bya /dug dang khragadanganyung kar skye tshe dang / /dha du ra dang til mar rnams/ /g.yas kyi phyogs su legs par bzhag /sorabacu gnyis tshad ldan gnag pa'i rdzas ling ga la/ /dpral ba mingabakog ma mingamakhan snying kha rusaru/ /ming dang ming mkhan rus rnams te/ /yan lag bzhi la yig 'go kun tu bstan dza dang re/ /ye shes khro bo sngags 'bru rnams/ /spyi bo nas bzung g.yas su bskor/ /dza la rag sha'i drag sngags kyis/ /spyi bo nas btsugs g.yon ru bskor/ /bsgrub bya'i ling kha bri bar bya/ /khorangagi rjes su dri chu dri ma rnams/ khrag la bsres pas ling ka la byug par bya/ /dgra'ishes pa thun gyis dgug bzhug thun gyis brab dang sngon dmar skud pas bcing ba rnams/ /bsgrub pa'i dus su rdzogs par bya/ /che ge mo'i ming ling du tsi te phyung / /ma ra ya srog la thun/ ces pa nyi shu rtsa gcig bri/ /thab khung nang du brub par bya/ /gzung dus tshes brgyad bsgrub pa'i dus/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig grangs nges yin//dgu stong nyi phyed nam phyed la/ /bsreg pa'i dus su bstan pa yin/ /me sbar me pra smon pa dang / /me pra brtag dang me lha bskyed/ /mchod 47—873

pas mchod a bsreg rdzas dbul/ /gnag pa'i rdzas btums bstab par bya/ /bstod dang gsol btab gshegs su gsol/ /sra bkrol gdong pa khrag gis byug /stan spangs pus btsugs gos nag bgo/ /dur khrod ras dang tshil chen la/ /me bskyed lho'i zur nas sbar/ /bha ya na dza la dza la hūṃ/ las 'di myur du 'grub pa na/ /me mdog dmar nag 'tsher ba dang / /me lce rno la 'tsher ba dang / /du ba mda' ltar 'gro bar shog /ji ltar smon pa bzhin byung na/ /me'i ltas ni bzang ba yin/ /de las bzlog na ngan pa yin/ /me'i nang du ka dmar nag las ni/ /srin po mdog phyag mtshan sku ltar bsam mo/ /'bar ba bskyed par bya/ /spyi bor reg tshig lha dgu bskyed/ /ye shes pa la dgug bzhug bya/ /mchod pa'i rdzas ni thams cad kun/ /rim pa bzhin du dbul bar bya/ /bha ya na sa ni tra sa ni/ dza la rag sha ma ra pra ke argo swā hā/pus pe/ du paṃ/ dhi paṃ/ ghan sgo rgo bi te/ mchod pa'i bye brag thams cad nas—/ /lan grangs nyi shu re re dbul/ /bsreg pa'i rdzas rnams thams cad kun—/ /dgra bo'i sha dang khrag du bsam/ /kun nas lan grangs gong bzhin dbul—/ /bha ya na sa ni tra sa ni/ dza la rag sha ma ra pra kai/ che ge mo'i srog la thun ma ra ya phaṭa/ rang gi mdun gyi ling kha ni/ /mtshon gyis nyi shu rtsa gcig gtub/ /ming gi ling kha re re dang / /bcas pa rngam pa'i zhal du bstab—/ /bha ya na sa ni/ tra sa ni/ dza la rag sha ma ra pra rka/ che ge mo ma ra ya rbad srog thun la rbad/ tsi ta/ ma sa/ rag ta/ go ro tsa na/ ba su ta/ ra la kha re kha tī/ dum bu re re gsolabar bsams la lan re dbul/ /bstod pa ①gtor chog nas tshul bzhin bstod par bya/ /'dod pa'i don kun gsol 47—874

ba gtab①/ /rang bzhin gnas su gshegs su gsol/ /lhag chad bskang phyir brgya pa brjod/ /'di las thob pa'i dge ba yis/ /bdag sogs bsgrub zhugs thams cad kun/ /dngos grub dang nye bar shog /khro bo reg tshig sbyin sreg 'di/ /dge slong byang chub seng ges bris/ /gzhan la dbang por 'di mi tshal/ /rang gi shes rab sbyang phyir byas/ /'on kyang mkhas pa'i gzhung rnams dang / /'gal zhing nor ba 'di la med// khrug //ar+ya dhe bas mdzad do// //bsdur mchan/872 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉kho khro bo reg tshig gi sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / ②〈〈pe 〉〉pa/874 ①〈〈pe 〉〉wapa/875 ①〈〈pe 〉sngagadab/ ②〈〈pe 〉staspyibasdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2776)47—875

ra༅/ /khro bo reg tshig gi gtor chog①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ bha li dha dzhai ti na ma/ bod skad du/gtor ma'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ khro bo reg tshig gi gtor ma/ rang na byu ru la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsham dang sbyang dang bsang ba dang / /bskyed dang byin gyis brlabs pa dang / /dgra bgegs bkug bstem srun drang dang / /de bzhin gtor ma dbul ba dang / /bstod cing gsol gdab gshegs gsol lo/ /'bru sna lnga yi zan la ni/ /zur gsum zur rno rtsa ba brtan/ /dkyil mthug dpal byas dkyil du gzugs/ /de yi mtha' ma 'theb sgyus dgang / /ra khyi phag gsum rog po yi/ /sha dang khrag gis brgyan pa ste/ /chus sbyangs bsham snod thod pa'o/ /bar du gcod pa'i bgegs rnams kun/ /lag pa g.yon pas se gol rtog cing sngags bzlas la/ /rang rang gnas su bskrad par bya/ /gtor ma gtor snod bcas pa rnams/ /dag pa'i subhaba'isngags brjod stong par bya/ /47—876

stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin las/ /ni las midang 'dra ba ru gyad gsum sgyed pu ste/ /e ①las rin chen thod pa'i snod phyi dkar la nang dmar ba mdun rang la bstan pa dbus su yo g.yas su resngon du lorgyab tu khaṃ g.yon du saṃlas ni/ /phrag dog mkhris pa 'dodachags khragadang nga rgyal glad pa gtimugasha /zhe sdang rus pa la sogs dug lnga bsam/ /yi ge 'bru 6k+ṣiṃhūṃ gsum steng bsams la/ /zhu nas dngosapo thim pa'i bdud rtsir gyur/ /snying kha nas lcags kyu 'dra ba'i 'od 'phros pas/ /dgra bgegs kyi snying phug a gh+ra shas kug ②ste/ /gtor ma la gnyis su med par bstem par bya/ /'od 'phros lha dgu pho nya dang / /bcas par mdun du spyan drangs la/ /sngags 'di brjod la dbul bar bya/ /oṃ bha ya na sa ni tra sa ni/ badz+ra kro ta bha lin dha kha'i kha hi/ thum bha thum bha kha hi kha nyi ma ha rag ta la kha kha nyi/ ma ha oṃ sa kha kha nyi/ gti mug shi'i mchod pa bzhes/ /zhe sdang rus pa'i mchod pa bzhes/ /'dod chags khrag gi mchod pa bzhes/ /ma ra ya tsi ta srog thun kha kha hi/ bdun nam gsum brjod zhal du dbul/ /khro rgyal reg tshig stobs po che/ /mun nag lta bu'i sku 'dzin cing / /phaṭa kyi sgra 'byin me dpung 'bar/ /mgon du gyur la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ /khro rgyal brgyad po stang stabs tshul du bzhugs/ /zhal du dgra bgegs don snying ma lus gsol—/ /khro rgyal gtum chen las kun grub par mdzod/ /dngos grub ci 'dod gsol ba gdab/ /badz+ra mu brjod gshegs su gsol bar bya/ /dge ba 'di yis thams cad 'byor ldan shog/ sbi //47—877
bsdur mchan/876 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈snar bstan dkar chag 〉rdzar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉khogator ma'i cho ga zhes bya ba/877 0)〈〈pe 〉stag phu)〈〈pe 〉〉bkugabasdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2777)47wa 878

ras /lha chen po gsum gyi bsgrub thabs/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā dhe ba tra sa na tsa na/ bod skad du/lha chen po gsum gyi bsgrub thabs/ de'i sde dpon reg tshig la phyag 'tshal lo/ /reg tshig tshogs la phyag 'tshal te/ /de yi las byed bsgrub thabs bri/ /rten la bsnyen te gzugs la bsgrub/ /gzugs gnyis dag gis las sbyar sbad/ /lha chen dmigs pa waṃng klu mgo mngam za'i snying / /rten byas 'di rnams brjod par bya//lo ki sha ri dha ba bh+ra ma bhad tra bhad tru hri tai dza/ zhag bcu bsnyen pa 'di bya'o/ /de nas lha chen gsum gyi gzungs byas la/ /snying khar 'khor lo dgod par bya/ /bkug byas bkug la sngags brjod te/ /bcu ru bsgrub pa 'di bya'o/ /las mkhan pang par ling kha gtang / /ral nag skud pas legs dkris ②la/ /de la sgol ba'i las bcol te/ /sngags bdag drag po sde gsum po/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed lha'i rje/ /lha bdud gtso bo mi bzad pa/ /dmar ser 'od 47—879

zer nyi stong chas/ /'dod khams kun 'khor 'khor lo zhon/ /'dod yon drug gi 'khor lo dang / /nyon mongs lnga yi mda' 'gyengs byed/ /khyod kyis bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /tshangs pa skye dgu kun gyi rje/ /dkar ser zla ba stong 'od 'gyed/ /pha rol phyin dang mchog phreng can/ /khyod kyis bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /lha chen khyab 'jug rgyal chen gtso/ /nag ser char sprin nag po'i mdog /gza' sbrul nag po chibs su zhon/ /lag na rdo rje tho chen thogs/ /khyod kyis bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /'khros te gsum ka srin po'i gzugs/ /sprul te gsum ka mon pa'i gzugs/ /gzugs ni mi sdug lho yi mon/ /mdog ni mi mjes thal nag mdog /skad ni mi go ldab ma ldib—/ /dmod pa 'dor ba shib se shibs/ /drag sngags zlos pa sha ra ra/ /mon pa mang po bun bun bun/ /mon pa rkang sngon shad de shad/ /mon phrug mang po nyi li li/ /khyod kyis bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /'di yis sngags 'di mchog 'gyur te/ /sngags bdag drag shul stobs ldan shog /las byed kyi bsgrub thabs ar+ya dhe bas mdzad pa// khrus //47—880

bsdur mchan/879 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉kho lha chen po gsum gyi bsgrub thabs so// ②〈〈pe 〉stabakris/88 ①〈〈pe 〉sprosaka sbo / maṅga lo//bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2778)47—881

༄ga /bla ma phyi ltar sgrub pa'i man ngag⑨ga bla ma sgrub pa'i rgya gzhung phyi sgrub ti slo pas mdzad pa bzhugs sto// ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ gu ru na mo lo ka /bod skad du/ bla ma'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'chang chen tshe 'dir thob 'dod pas/ /lam gyi mthar thug bla na med pa'i lam/ /mos gus mthar thug bla ma'i mos gus yin—/ /sgrub pa zab mo bla ma'i sgrub pa ste/ /dam tshig zab mo bla ma'i dam tshig la/ /rten 'brel zab mo bla ma'i rten 'byel mchog /'bras bu mthar phyin bla ma'i 'bras bu'o/ /de phyir bla ma sgrub la mkhas par bya/ /bla ma sa gzhi'i rang bzhin las/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu rten par byed/ /bla ma ye shes me chen las—/ /sgrib gnyis bag chags bsreg par byed/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs rlung gis ni/ /yon tan gong du g.yo bar byed/ /bla ma'i thugs rje chu 'o las/ /'gro ba kun gyi gso byed mdzad/ /bla ma shes rab zab pa yis/ /ma rig mun 47—885

pa sel bar byed/ /bla ma thabs kyis nyi ma yi/ /nyon mongs rlan rnams skems par byed/ /bla ma mkha' ltar dag pa las/ /bdag 'dzin thams cad 'jig par byed/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs sman gyis ni/ /nad rnams thams cad sel bar byed/ /bla ma dpag bsam shing bzhin du/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu ster bar byed/ /bla ma lta ba'i shel bzhin du/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub 'byung / /bla ma yid bzhin nor bu ltar/ /phun sum tshogs kun bskyed par byed/ /de phyir de la dam par byos/ /bla ma phyi ltar sgrub pa'i man ngag rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ti lo pas mdzad pa rdzogs sgo// //rgya gar shar phyogs dz+dza gad li'i paṇ+ḍi ta bi bu ti tsan+t+ras/ dpal khan pa'i dur khrod du sgra rang sgyur du bsgyur ba'o// //47—886
bsdur mchan/885 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2779)47wa 887

sto /phyi sgrub kyi rten 'brel paṇa chen bhi bu ti tsan+t+ras mdzad pa bzugs so//①༄7/ /bla ma mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal sras nā ro pas yi ge bdun pa sgrubs pas/ lus med mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan thob/ shar phyogs su bla ma 'tshol du phyin/ gu ru tislo pa bya ba grub thob thos sam byas pas/ bla ma tiphro pa bya ba ma thos/ sprang po tikhro pa bya ba 'di kun na 'dug zer ro/ /gtsug lag khang dang ④gtsug phud spra bha bya ba'i sgo na/ ras gha 'ja' ra gyon pa'i dzo ki spyan rtsa dmar shig ge byas pa gcig 'dug pas/ nya gson po lnga bzung nas dge 'dun gyi spro khang du bsreg pas/ dge 'dun rnams kyis sdigs pas—/ khyed mi dga' ba mi byed gsung nas/ se gol sdabs te/ nya chu zang du bcug pas ma shi bar 'khyug gin 'dug go/ /der nges par tiphro par 'dug snyam nas/ maṇ+ḍal re phul te/ zab mo'i gdam ngag zhus pas/ thog ma nyid du spyan ce re gzigs nas 'di skad gsung / khyod rdzogs pa'i sangs 47byed888

rgyas tshe 'dir sngon du bya bar 'dod na/ lam mthar thug zab mo bla ma'i lam/mos gus mthar thug bla ma'i mos gus/ sgrub pa zab mo bla ma'i sgrub pa/ dam tshig zab mo bla ma'i dam tshig /rten 'byel zab mo bla ma'i rten 'byel/ 'bras bu mthar thug bla ma'i 'bras bu/ sku gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang bla ma las bsgod par gyis gcig gsung / sgron shing 'tshal bu shing 'gal gsum la me btang nas/ 'dir sdod nus sam gsung / der bla ma'i bka' sgrub pa'i phyir der 'dug pas mes tshig /gu ru'i zhal nas/ khyed kyis gus pa'i bsam pa dang / /nga'i bka'i bden pa yis/ /snga ma kho na bzhin du shog /gsungs pas bsos so/ /der nges shes skyes/ yang dag pa'i gdam ngag zhus pas/ na ro pas/ srid dang 'das pas bsdus pa'i chos rnams la/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa ma yin pa/ /tilko nga'i ci yang bstan du med/ /gsungs so—/ /in+t+ra bho tis tshogs la sbyan drangs pa'i dus na/ mos gus ma bcos pa byung bas/ 'khor ba'i chos la bcos ma dgos pa'i rtogs pa skyes/ der gu ru'i mkhyen bzhin 'di skad gsungs/ bla ma sa gzhi'i rang bzhin las/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu'i rten pa byed/ /bla ma ye shes me chen la/ /sgribs gnyis bag chags bsreg par byed/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs rlung gis ni/ /yon tan gong du g.yo bar byed/ /bla ma thugs rje'i chu'o las/ /'gro ba gnyis kyis bso skyed mdzad| /bla ma shes rab zla ba yis/ /ma rig mun pa sel bar byed/ /bla ma thabs kyis nyi ma yis/ /nyon mongs rlan rnams skem par byed/ /bla ma mkha' ltar dag pa las/ /phyogs 'dzin thams cad 'jig par byed/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs rlan gyis ni/ /nad rnams thams cad sel bar byed/ /bla ma 47—889

dpag bsam shing bzhin du/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu ster bar byed/ /bla ma la ltos shel bzhin du/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thob/ /bla ma yid bzhin nor bu ltar/ /phun sum tshogs pa bskyed par byed/ /de phyir de la dam par byos/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bla ma gus pas brten pa/ dpal 'jigs med grags pa la/ bla ma tislo pas gsungs pa'o// //bsdur mchan/888 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉skosnar 〉ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉dang /bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2780)47wa 890

༄ga /bla ma nang gi sgrub pa/①kho bla ma sgrub pa'i rgya gzhung nang sgrub nā ro pas mdzad pa bzhugs sgo// ༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ gu ru mi ti na ma/ bod skad du/ bla ma sgrubs pa/ rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /e ma ho sangs rgyas sku gsung thugs/ /e ma ho mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i skad/ /gsang ba'i mdzod tol bla ma sgrub pa bri bar bya/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas dang ni yi dam phyi nang lha/ /rgyal sras rnams dang dpa'o rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo/ /'di sgrubs pas ni kun gyi dngos grub thob/ /dur khrod ri khrod gnas dang zhing rnams na/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'du ba'i gnas dag dang / /bkra shis gnas su dam tshig rdzas rnams bsags/ /nang gi khrus byas 'bol ba'i stan dag la/ /byams dang snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms sgom//dzaḥkhruhūṃ baṃ hoḥs dkyil 'khor spyan drangs la/ ma hā gu ru na ma te/ na maḥmi/na mo na maḥ chu gsum sngon du 'gro ba phyi'i mchod pas mchod/ /sha lnga bdud 47byed891

rtsi lnga sogs nang gi mchod pas mchod/ /gsang ba'i mchod pas dgyes par mdzad nas ni/ /yan lag bdun pa rgyas bsdus gang rung bya/ /oṃ swa bha wa zhes—/ chos kyi dag pa rnam dag dran par bya/ /dag pa lus kyis dkyil 'khor sgom bya ste/ /chu skyes dang ni nyi zla'i gdan la ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'akying ba'i sku mnga' zhing / /sgeg cing dpa' la zhi ba'i tshul 'dzin cing //rus pa'i rgyan spras gar gyi nyams dgur ldan/ /rdo rje dril bu 'dzin zhing phag mo la ni 'khyud/ /gar gyis rol pas snyoms par zhugs par bsam/ /rdo rje phag mo'i mtshan nyid ci 'dra bshad pas gsal/ /rdo rje ma ni sngo zhing ḍa ma ru dang rdo rje 'dzin/ /rin chen ma ni ser la rin chen 'dzin/ /pad+ma'i rigs ni dmar zhing ka pā stil yang 'dzin/ /las kyi rigs ni rdo rje rgya gram ljang mdog ma/ /bde chen rigs ni dkar zhing 'khor lo 'dzin/ /sna tshogs rigs ni phyag mtshan sna tshogs can/ /gtso bo skor la mchod pa byed par bsam/ /de dag kun kyang bcu drug lo lon gcer bu sha rgyas shing / /sku mdog ser po'ang snang ladri zhim dbu skra dmar ser gyen du badze+es/ /bsil bu thur du 'phyang zhing hi hi'i sgra sgog cing / /ha ha rgod cing ḍa ma ru'i sgra yang 'byin/ /phyag rgya lnga dang ldan par rab tu sgom/ /yi ge bzhi dang phyag rgya'i sbyor ba yi/ /sangs rgyas sa na rab tu bzhugs pa rnams/ /de rjes lha tshogs rnams la dgug gzhug bya/ /de rjes lha mo rnams la dbang skur zhing / /rigs kyi bdag pos rnam par brgyan byas nas/ /phyi nang gsang gsum rdo rje 'dzin pas mchod/ /de rjes bstod pa dag gi bstod par bya/ /yi ge gsum gyis sbyor bas bdud rtsi myang zhing lha mo stsos par bya/ /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /rdzogs par sgom pa 47—892

gnas bya ste/ /mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i skad ni sgrags par bya/ /oṃ ābyugu ru/sidhi hūṃ/ 6badz+ra bai ro tsa ni ya ①hūṃ phaṭa sru hā/ oṃ uhūṃ/ badz+ra ḍa ki ni/rat+na ḍa ki ni/ pad+ma ḍa ki ni/ karma ḍa ki ni/ budha ḍa ki ni/ bhi sha ḍa ki ni/sidhi shan dhi rna ku ru ye swā hā/ puṭaṃ ku ②ru ye swā hā/ wa shang ku ru ye swā hā/ma ra ya phaṭa/ di ri di ri hri hri phe phe/ i rda bha ling ta kha kha bhi t+ta/ ma ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ yi ge phreng ba dpa' ba'i mig gi bltas nas ni/ /blo dang ldan pas gsang sngags bzlas byas nas/ /sangs rgyas srog 'phrog dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du/ /sa rnams g.yo zhing dngos grub char yang 'bab/ /dus dang bsam pa dmigs par byed pa las/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhi ba'i las rnams 'grub/ /rgyas pa rin chen 'kha' 'gro dbang ni pad+ma'o/ /'jig rten mkha' 'gro drag po'i las byed cing / /mngon spyod las la gshegs cing byang chub thob//ka pā ③la ni dam tshig rdzas kyis bskang / /sbyang zhing yi ge rnams kyis byin gyis zlobs/ /gong gi phreng sngags kyis ni dbul bar bya/ /de rjes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las dang / /khyad par rtsa ba'i dam tshig bsrung bar bya/ /pham pa ldung ba sbomaponyes byas phra mo bsrungs—/ /gsang dbang spyad sgrubs shes par bya ba'i dam tshig bsrungs/ /nyams na tshe 'dir sdug bsngal phyi ma dmyal bar rtsang / /dam nyams de'i rjes phyogs su yang 'gro mi bya/ /dbu mar tshogs 'khor sbyin bsreg 'bum phrag bdun//me tog tshom bu'am gsang sngags bye ba bzlas/ /srog chags bye ba'i tshe skyabs tshe bshags pa'i gdams pa'o/ /lus la khrag phyung maṇ+ḍal brgya rtsa 'bul/ /rtags mthong snang thob bskang ba tshad 'khyol nyes pa dag /dus gsum sangs 47—893

rgyas pas kyang bla ma dam pa lhag /rdo rje 'chang dang gnyis su med par sgoms byas na/ /bzang po'i rgyal ba thams cad sgoms par 'gyur/ /bla ma sgrub cing rig ①pa 'di sgrags ②na/ /rgyal ba kun gyi dngos grub de yis thob/ /de'i sku mthong rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mthong / /gsung thos pas ni rgyud sde thob 'thung shing / /dran pa tsam gyis sgribs sbyang yon tan bskyed/ /sku gsung thugs kyi drag po'i tshul bzung nas/ /lus ngag yid gsum sgribs pa de dag gis/ /spyi gtsug zhabs bzhag bum dbang rab tu thob/ /de bzhin gsang ba shes rab bzhi pa dang / /mchog gi dbang bskur blo ldan gyis ni zhus/ /dam pa 'di mchod bde gshegs ma lus mchod/ /lus ngag yid gsum rtse ba'i zhabs tog bya//sgrib pa sbyong dang tshogs gnyis rdzogs par 'gyur/ /dam tshig mi nyams nyams na bshags pas mchod/ /mkha' 'gro mi 'khu mi bsdod dbang du 'dus/ /dngos grub ma lus 'grub cing grub pa nyams mi 'gyur/ /grub pa brgyad dang phra mo rnams ni mngon du gyur/ /e ma ho/ 'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang 'dra/ /de mnyes na ni sangs rgyas kun mnyes shing / /de bsnyas pas ni sangs rgyas kun bsnyas 'gyur/ /srog pas gces par bzung zhing mig 'bras lta bur brtse/ /gtsug gi nor bu lta bur gsol ba gdab/ /des ni phun sum tshogs pa 'grub par 'gyur/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi zhabs tog du/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sgrubs pa 'di byas pas/ /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /dri ma dang bcas snod min spel byas na/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis dngos grub 'jig byed cing / /log 'dren gsum pos bsad nas sems can dmyal bar ltung / /rin chen lta bu'i gang zag gis ni sgrub par bya/ /bla ma nang gi 47—894

sgrub pa dpal na ro pas mdzad pa rdzogs sto// //parnyi ta bi bu ti tsaṇ+ḍis sgra rang 'gyur du bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/891 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉waḥ/892 ①〈〈pe 〉〉pa/892 ①〈〈pe 〉〉pe/ ②〈〈pe 〉sngag/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉pa/894 ①〈〈pe 〉〉rigs/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉sgrugabasdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2781)47wa 895

༄ga /bla ma gsang bar sgrub pa zhes bya ba/①go bla ma gsang sgrub klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa bzhugs snyo// ra ga /rgya gar skad du—/ gu h+ya sidhi na ma/ bod skad du/ bla ma gsang bar sgrub pa zhes bya ba/ ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang / /de bzhin mar la mar bzhag bzhin/ /bla mas mtshon pa'i sku gsum ni/ /legs mthong gang yin 'dir phyag yin/ /e gsang chos kyi 'byung gnas su/ /waṃ skyed sbyor bas 'byung bzhi grub/ /rkang par rlung la sum mdor me/ /lte chu brang sa rgal tshigs ri/ /dbang chen sa'i dkyil 'khor las/ /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa grub/ /rlung lnga rin chen lnga'i rtsig /'dod yon dbang po lnga'i mdzes/ /lce ni rin chen pha gu sna/ /rtsa rnams dra ba phyed pa ste/ /bye brag so so'i phreng bas brgyan/ /mi mnyam me dang gru bzhi ste/ /dran dang dbang po sgo bzhir lha/ /rnam shes tshogs brgyad dur khrod brgyad/ /gnas kyi dbye ba rab bstan pas/ /mdor bsdus nas ni 47—896

bshad par bya/ /'tshogs ma pu li ra ma la/ /spyi gtsug dza lan dha ra dang / /rna ba g.yas pa o rgyan dang / /spyi bo'i rgyab ni arbu ta/ /go ta wa ri rna ba g.yon—/ /ra mi shwa ra smin ma'i dbus/ /mig gnyis dhe wi ko ṭi dang / /ma la wa ni dpung ba'i rtsa/ /ka ma ru ni mchan khung gnyis/ /ar bu ta ni nu ma gnyis—/ /ko sa la ni lte bar shes/ /tri sha ku ni sna'i rtse/ /kha'i pad+ma ka ling ka /mgrin pa lo pa kar ni brjod/ /snying ni kan cir shes par bya/ /nyi ma la ni gsum mdor shes/ /mtshan ma sgri ha pre ta dang / /pre ta pu ri gshang ba'i lam/ /brla gnyis waṇ+ḍa di ba te/ /— tra ni byin pa gnyis/ /rkang pa'i bol ni sin dhu'i dpun/ /sor mo rnams la na ga ra/ /the bong gnyis ni ma dhur shes/ /ku lu ta ni rkang pa'i 'thil/ /de ltar gnas kyis rnam pa dag /sa bcu par ni dag pa nyid/ /rtsa rnams dpa' mo'i rang bzhin te/ /bde ba dpa' bo'i rnam par rgyu/ /rtsib ma rdo rje'i rwa sogs bsrung / /ba spu mtshon cha'i dra bar gyur/ /sen mo me ri 'bar bas bsrung / /sku'i dkyil 'khor legs par grub/ /thig le zla ba'i rang bzhin las/ /rnam shes a thung gzugs dang 'grogs/ /rmi nyi ma'i rang bzhin las/ /zhu bde spros dang bral bar gyur/ /de tshe rigs kyi phyag mtshan mdzes/ /mgon po sku'i rdo rje bzhengs/ /rdo rje slob dpon lus 'di la/ /rgyal ba'i sku ni rims bzhin bzhugs/ /dang po sku'i rdo rje ni/ /gzugs phung la ni yang dag bzhugs/ /rjes su chags pa'i rdo rje ni/ /tshor ba yi rgo phung por bzhugs/ /bcom ldan gsung gi rdo rje ni—/ /'du shes kyi ni phung por bzhugs/ /mched pa kun gyi rdo rje ni/ /'du byed kyi ni phung por bzhugs/ /bcom ldan thugs kyis rdo rje ni/ /rnam 47—897

shes phung por yang dag bzhugs/ /'di'i sha sogs sa khams la/ /bcom ldan yum chen spyan ma bzhugs/ /dro ba la sogs me khams la/ /bcom ldan yum chen gos dkar mo/ /skyod pa la sogs rlung khams la/ /bcom ldan yum chen sgrol ma bzhugs/ /gsher ba la sogs chu khams la/ /bcom ldan rdo rje ma ma ki/ /de bzhin sku'i khams rnams la/ /bcom ldan rdo rje dbyings phyug ma//yul lnga rnam par dag pa las/ /mchod pa'i lha mo lnga ru gyur/ /de'i mig gi dbang po gnyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sa'i snying / /de'i rna ba'i dbang gnyis la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa phyag rdor bzhugs/ /de'i sna la bzhugs pa ni—/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nam snying po/ /de'i lce la bzhugs pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten dbang / /khams bzhi'i rang bzhin gong bu ni/ /'du shes bya bar rtags pa la/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnam sel ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa de na bzhugs/ /de yi yid kyi dbang po la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jam dbyangs bzhugs/ /lus kyi tshigs rnams thams cad la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu bzang / /lus kyi rtsa rgyus thams cad la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa byams pa bzhugs/ /lag pa g.yas par bzhugs pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gshin rje gshed/ /lag pa g.yon par bzhugs pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzhan mi thub/ /kha'i pad+mar bzhugs pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rta mgrin no/ /gsang ba'i gnas su bzhugs pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rtsi 'khyil/ /dpung pa g.yas par bzhugs pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mi g.yo ba/ /dpung pa g.yon par bzhugs pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'dod pa'i rgyal/ /pus mo g.yas par bzhugs pa ni/ /de bzhin 47—898
