gshegs pa stobs po che/ /rang gi spyi bor bzhugs pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor los sgyur/ /rkang pa'i 'og tu bzhugs pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gnod mjos so/ /lus kun de dag kun la yang / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bzhugs/ /sku'i dkyil 'khor zhes brjod pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyi lus/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dbye ba yis/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ma lus 'di/ /lus pa med pa sangs rgyas sku/ /skye ba 'di la rnal 'byor pa—/ /mya ngan 'das la bzhugs par 'gyur/ /mya ngan 'das pa myur du thob//spyod kyis dge ba yongs su smin/ /de bas rdo rje slob dpon ni/ /mthong na don ni yod pa de/ /phyi ma'i dus kyi sems dpa' che/ /des na sems can thams cad kyis/ /lha la mchod pa'i yo byad kyis/ /rab tu 'bad pas bla ma mchod—/ /de nas mthong ba don yod bcas/ /byang chub sems dpa' grags chen dang / /dga' zhing gus pas phyag byas na/ /bcom ldan 'das ma mchi ma blag /gsung de thugs kyi dkyil 'khor bzhugs/ /legs so byas pa byin pa ni/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad gsungs/ /a u i zhi u spru/ ṛ dzā/ lo khrus/ e i/ o sko i lhadabyangs dang gsal byed rang bzhin te/ /ka tsa ṭa ta pa'i sde tshan dang / /ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa hā k+ṣa/ /gsung gi dkyil 'khor chen po zhes/ /ngag kun rab tu spro ba 'don/ /ji lta ba'i khyad par gyis/ /mar sar gnas par 'gyur ba yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gos dkar sogs/ /sngags kyis rgyal po rab tu gnas/ /klog dang bsam gtan med mod kyang / /'on kyang bzlas par bshad pa yin/ /'gog pa'i bzlas pa rab tu gnas/ /de ring ngag gi rab tu smin/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor bka' 47—899

stsal pa/ /rang byung gsal ba kun mkhyen pa/ /nga ni mi gnas dbyings su dag/gnyis med bde ba'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /nga ni lhan cig skyes pa'o/ /gang shar ba ni nga yi rtsal/ /nga ni spros dang bral ba'o/ /yul drug snang ba nga yi gdangs//gang yang gnyis su med pa'o/ /rgyu 'bras rkyen gyis bdag gi spyan/ /dge ba rdo rje nga yi srog /nga yi rgyan ni ye shes lnga/ /bde bar gshegs pa kun la mdzes—/ /srid dang zhi ba nga yi zhabs/ /mi gnas pa ni rdo rje'i thugs/ /skyed dang rdzogs pa shin tu gsal/ /grol ba'i gtso bo sangs rgyas so/ /nyon mongs lnga dang ye shes lnga/ /dbyer med rdo rje zhes bya ba/ /'chang ba 'dzin pa zhes grags yin/ /rnam shes rdo rje 'chang du 'dod/ /khyed kyis dge ba yongs su smin/ /bdag don gzhan don 'bras bu bcas/ /de ring sangs rgyas sras su gyur/ /gtso bo dbang skur rab tu thob/ /nga yi dgongs pa rab tu rtogs/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen por gyur/ /mya ngan 'das la rab tu bzhugs/ /mi gnas rdo rje khyed la smin/ /de skad ces ni thos pa dang / /rdo rje 'dzin pa rab dga' ba/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa'i rgyal ba mchod/ /rjes su yi rang gus phyag 'tshal/ /'khor lo sgyur ba'i gtso bo yis/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa gsal bar bstan//sdud ①po la sogs bdag gis thos/ /tikhro pa yis ma brjed bzung / /'phags pa lha yi mngon par gyis/ /bla ma gsang ba sgrub pa ni/ /paṣ+ṭa ta na ga dzu nas mdzad pa rdzogs sto// //dpal ding ri glang 'khor gyi ②dgon par/ parnyi ta bi bu ti tsan+t+ras bsgyur ba'o/ /༄ga /'di'i brgyud ①pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ nā ④47—900

ga dzñā na/ tislo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham mthing pa/ shākya ṭī②bha tra/ bi bu ti tsan+t+ra/ rab shrī bha tra/ bla ma zhang / rat+na ⑤sing ha rnams so// //bsdur mchan/896 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/899 ①〈〈pe 〉〉ri rī/ li snyi9 ༷ ①〈〈pe 〉stabasdud/ ②〈〈pe 〉4)sa/ ni〈〈pe 〉〉ཿda/ ④〈〈pe〉stan/9 1 ①〈〈pe 〉〉gi ②〈〈pe 〉torajo/bskur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2782)47wa 901

༄ga /rgyud sde lnga'i sgrub thabs de kho na nyid bsdus pa bzhugs sgo//①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ he ru ka pañtsa sā dha na ma/ bod skad du/bla med rigs lnga'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rten gyi gang zag gnas dang ni/ /grogs dang rdzas dang mchod thabs dngos/ /de la rten gyi gang zag ni/ /dbang gi gnang thob dam tshig ldan/ /bla ma la gus sgrub la brtson/ /shes rab snying rje drug ldan no/ /gnas ni rgyud mthun dur khrod nyer bzhi dang / /ri rtse chu ngogs shing drung ②bas mtha' sogs/ /lha khang khang stong 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' sgeb/ /yid mthad dbe+en zhing byin ④che nyams dga'o—/ /grogs ni bzang shes mthun dang sngags zhing skyes/ /rdzas ni bris sku phyag mtshan la sogs rten/ /mchod pa phyi nang gtor ma tshogs/ /'tsho ba'i yo byad gang dgos bsgrub/ /thabs dngos sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes/ /sbyor ba bsod nams ye shes tshogs/ /bsod nams tshogs la phyi nang gsang / /phyi ni 47—902

tshogs bsag ①sbyin pa btang / /nang ni dbang bskur tshogs gtor btang / /gsang ba bsrung 'khor rgyun gshegs so/ /bsrung 'khor gnas dang rnal 'byor dang / /bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum bsrungs/ /gnas ni sum bhas khro tshogs spro/ /phur bus btab la tho bas brdung / /rdo rje ra gur me 'bar bsgom| /rnal 'byor bsrung ba bsrung 'khor nang / /bla ma yi dam skyabs su 'gro| /bdag bsrung lhar skyed lus bsrung zhing / /bdud rtsi ril bu lce bzhag dag /yid ni tshogs zhing spyan snga ru/ /bcu gsum rnam dag tshad med bsgom| /dngos gzhi bsrung 'khor nang du ni/ /chos 'byung 'byung bzhi gzhal yas bsam/ /dur khrod bcas dbus bdud bzhi'i steng / /bskyed rdzogs bzlas pa'i nyams len ni/ /bskyed rim sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog las rgyal mchog /sbyor ba mngon ②byang lnga yis su/ /mtshon cha yab yum bskyed pa yi/ /mkha' gsang byin brlabs 'khor rnams spro/ /yab yum 'od zhu glus bskul bzhengs/ /gnas lngar dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ /sngon byang lnga'am cho ga gsum/ /skad cig dag las wal kyi bsgom/ /'khor rnams skad cig dag gis so/ /bcom ldan sku'i snang ba las/ /spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo ru/ /re mig dgu dang lha rnams bcas/ /de la gsang 'dus dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /bcom ldan gsung gi snang ba las/ /mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo ru/ /pad+ma 'dab bzhi dag la ni/ /ma hā ma ya'i dkyil 'khor bsgom / /bcom ldan thugs kyi snang ba las/ /snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo ru/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad dag la ni/ /kye rdor sprul pa'i lha dgu bsgom/ /bcom ldan yon tan snang ba las/ /lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo ru/ /'khor lo lnga dang ldan 47—903

pa la/ /bde mchog 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /bcom ldan 'phrin las snang ba las/ /rten 'byel gsang ba'i 'khor lo ru/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad sgo bzhi la/ /rdo rje 'jigs ①byed dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /de rnams dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog go/ /ye shes spyan drangs mchod bstod stem/ /skye mched sku gsung thugs byin brlabs/ /dbang bskur rgyas btab bdud rtsi myang / /mchod bstod chos 'khor bskor ba ni/ /las rgyal mchog tu bshad pa'o/ /rdzogs rim 'od gsal yongs rdzogs dang / /thig le ngo bo nyid rnams so/ /gtso bo 'od kyi snod bcud nas/ /sku sogs thig le'i bar du bsdu/ /yongs rdzogs rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi/ /dga' bzhi snang stong zung 'jug go/ /thig le 'bras bu'i dbang dang bcas/ /ngo bo sna tshogs zung 'jug go/ /bzlas pa bsam gtan rdo rje'i dang / /phreng ba las bzhi'i bzlas pa bya/ /bsngo ba ldang khrus zas gtor ma/ /spyod lam rjes chags nyal ba yi/ /rnal 'byor brgyad kyis nyams su blangs/ /ma yengs lo zla tsam gyis 'grub/ /sa lam rim bgrod rtogs pa 'char/ /dag pa mkha' spyod sngon sangs rgya/ /de skad a ta ya na dang / /dzha na badz+ra zhal nas gsungs/ /rgyud kun snying po byug bsdus nas/ /nyams su len pa'i lam rim ni/ /bkod pa'i dge bas mkha' mnyam kun/ /ye shes lnga ldan sku thob shog /'di la nyes pa'i tshogs mchis na/ /bla ma ḍa kis bzod par gsol/ /dpal rgyud sde bla med rigs lnga'i sgrub thabs de kho na nyid bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ slob dpon chen po ghan+ta badz+ra pas mdzad pa rdzogs so / /②rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta dang / bod kyi lo tsā ①ba glan dar ma blo gros kyis bsgyur ba'o// //47—904

bsdur mchan/9 2 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉〉rtor bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉dung / ③〈〈pe 〉7) dbya/ ④〈〈pe 〉8nga /9 3 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bsags/ ②〈〈pe 〉mthon/9༷4 ①〈〈pe 〉skarajig ⑧〈〈pe 〉ska/ // ③〈〈pe 〉〉5/bsdur 'bras re'u mig da/ (2783)47wa 905

sngag /dpal rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga de kho na nyid bsdus pa gsal ba zhes bya ba/①ga dpal rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzhugs sto// ra /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ma hā tan+t+ra rā dzā phe na tar+ya twa saṃ gra ha maṇ+ḍa la bri bhi swa bha wa nā ma/bod skad du/ dpal rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga de kho na nyid bsdus pa gsal ba zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje 'chang chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan dekho na nyid 'dus pa gsal ba'i gsangabasnying po dri ma med pa'i donalas/ /rgyud mchog chen po gongama'i gong ma bla ma'i bla mar gyur pa nyid/ /de nyid lnga bsdus pa'i bshad rgyud dang bcas pa dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dngos grub gnyis bde ba'i gter/ /gsang ba'i bdebachen po'i mdzod kyi rgyal po gtsobornams la gus btud de/ /de'i yin lam cho ga gsal brgyud ldan bla ma'i dngalhag pa'i lha zhal las legs brnyed pa/ /zhalagyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun rim par 'thungs pa bdagagis 'dir gsal b.rabya'o/ /'dod pa lnga ni yongs spangs shing / /dka' thub kyis ni ma gdungs par/ /rnal 47byed906

'byor nyid kyi rjes 'brangs la/ /bde bas byang chub bsgrub par bya/ /e'i cha byad bzang po gang / /dbus su baṃ gyis rnam par brgyan/ /sangs rgyas rin chen za ma tog /bde ba can du rtag tu bzhugs/ /sdoms pa'i dkyil 'khor gcig nyid las/ /rin chen lnga ru mtshon pa yin/ /rig lnga dag pas byung ba ni—/ /dam pa'i rigs ni brgya dag dang / /de dag las ni 'bum sder 'gyur/ /de las de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs/ /gang gis ji snyed bsam mi khyab/ /grangs med dag tu 'gyur ba'o/ /bdag med don rgyud snying po ni/ /dkyil 'khor bsdus pa nges gsang ba/ /snying po kye rdo rje dang / /dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa dang / /'phags pa sgyu 'phrul chen po dang / /'khor lo sdom pas bsdus pa dang / /rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs chen te/ /mthar thug lnga las cho ga'i rim/ /gang gis slob ma dbang bskur ba/ /gcig tu bsdus te rim pa bzhin/ /bla med rgyud du dri ma med/ /'di ni smin par byed pa'o/ /sangs rgyas mgon po gang nyid kyi/ /dkyil 'khor dbus mar gyur pa yi/ /de nyid kyi ni dkyil 'khor bshad/ /snying po len phyir dkyil 'khor te/ /dkyil 'khor re re bsgom pa 'am/ /yang na bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /rdo rje 'chang chen lha'i gtso/ /sku ni dgyes pa'i rdo rje te/ /gsung ni sgyu 'phrul chen mo nyid/ /thugs ni rdo rje 'dus pa gsang / /yon tan bde mchog 'khor lo sdom / /phrin las rdo rje 'jigs byed de/ /phyogs ni dkyil 'khor nges pa nyid| /dbus su rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid/ /shar du de bzhin gshegs pas te/ /lhor ni rin chen nub dpag med/ /byang du las te bkod pa yis/ /nges pa'i rim pa 'pho bar 'gyur/ /slob dpon gsang ba'i don ston byed/ /rim 47—907

pa bla med thob pa dang / /slob ma skal bzang dad ldan brtson/ /rim par bya ba la 'jug pa/ /snying po bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /dang po 'jug pa'i go rim ni/ /rin chen gser dngul mu tig dang / /me tog gos dang rgyal srid dang / /gtor ma shing rta rkang pa dang / /dpa' bo'i ston mo dga' ston bya—/ /de nas gsol ba btab byas te/ /slob dpon dpa' bo dgongs su gsol—/ /bdag gzhan 'khor bas rab tu 'jigs/ /sdug bsngal 'di dag mi gzod na/ /'jigs pa 'di las nges thar par/ /bsgral ba'i thabs ni khyed la zhu/ /dpa' bo khyod ni grol nas bzhugs/ /'jigs byed khyod ni rig pa 'dzin/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'jigs pa las/ /bdag ni khyod kyis legs skyabs te/ /'khor ba 'di las nges thar zhing / /sdug bsngal rnams la zad thob nas/ /'jigs med ye shes lus thob tshe/ /'gro ba bdag gis bskyab pa'i phyir/ /'khor ba'i gnas su bdag mchis la/ /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bdag gis bsal/ /'jigs pa kun las bsgral bar bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /rgyud sde lnga'i dbang bskur ba/ /'gro ba skyob phyir gzi brjid can/ /yon tan thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /deng bdag bdag la brtsal ba dang / /bdag gzhan ngan 'gro las grol phyir/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /gnas nas 'gro ba sgrol byed pa'i/ /ye shes dbang mchog bdag la rtsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /bdag gis de dag gzhan bsgral phyir/ /slob dpon 'khor lo brnyes byed pa'i/ /rdzas 'ga' bsags pa dang 'tshogs pa'i/ /slob dpon dpa' bos deng ①bdag bsrungs/ /dkyil 'khor lha dang chos skyong la/ /mchod dang gtor mas mnyes pa dang / /47—908

sngags dang phyag rgyas mnyes pa dang / /ting nge 'dzin gyis dgug gzhug mdzod//ces ni gsol ba gdab par bya/ /de nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa'i cho ga yang bya/ de nas slob ma rnams dkyil 'khor pa'i bur skyed pa'i cho ga yang bya/ slob ma de dag rdo rje'i gur du tshud par bsams la zhal bzhi pa'i sngags dang aṣ+ṭa dang / hriji dang / phur bu brdab pa dang / brdung ba dang bcas pa bya/ bgegs bsal ba'i cho ga bya ste/ me phor du yungs dkar gyi brdag ①cing bsreg pa dang / sdig pa byung ba bsreg pa yang bya'o/ /zhes rdo rje gdan pa yang gsung ngo / /rjes su ma ti chen mo ni/ slob ma'i snying khar ka ④dud kha bsam/ lte bar nyi ma la hūṃ bsam/ 'og tu yo rlung gi rang bzhin cig bsams la rlung gi yi gyi rlung bskul bas/ hūṃ de las me'i 'od dang bcas pa byung bas hūṃ gis kai ①ded nas/ slob ma rnams so so'i sna bug g.yas nas 'thon ste/ mdun du nyon mongs pa dang / las dang / shes bya'i sgrib pa'i rang bzhin nam/ ngo bo sha za'i gzugs can du gnas pa de/ hūṃ dang rdo rje gnod sbyin zhes bya ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje 'bar ba can/g.yon sdigs 'dzub me dpung can/ sku mthing nag las kyi gzugs can des zhal du tso tso gsol bar bsam mo/ /yang na rdo rjes brdungs shing mes bsregs pas—/ rnam shes rdo rje la bsdus shing bstem zhes so/ /rje ta ni/ khro bo de rdo rje bdud rtsi 'arnal par bsam pas/ rlung sna bug g.yas nas phyir rgyu ba dang bstun te phyung bas/ zan la sdigs ④pa'i gzugs byas la phur bus btab pas bcom par bsam zhing / oṃ sarba pā ⑤paṃ a kar ṣa ni/ bi shwa dha na badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ 0phaṭa/ ces sdig pa dgug pa rdo rje lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas dgug go/ /de 47—909

nas sdig pa gzhom par bya ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra a thi ta kuṣ+ṭa li ha na badz+ra pa ni ki khā ya baṃ me ta ya/ sarba a pa ya ban dha ni pra mo k+ṣa ya/ sarba pā paṃ ①a pa ga te bh+ya/sarba u ta na/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa ma ya tra phaṭa/ ces lan bdun brjod do / /zhes gsung ngo / /sa brtag blang zhing sbyang ba dang / /byin gyis brlabs shing bsrung ba dang / /tshad ldan shin tu ngos mnyam pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi'i rdzas su bshad/ /bum pa lha'i grangs mnyam pa/ /lto ba che zhing mgrin pa ring / /dbang bcas mi nag rgyan gsum ldan/ /nyi shu lnga bcug byin brlabs rdzas/ /mchod pa ba dang me tog phreng / /mar me byug pa zhal zas mchog /rol mo gdugs dang rgyal mtshan 'phan/ /lda ldi bla re mchod pa'i rdzas/ /rin chen bdun dang nye ba'i bdun/ /bkra shis brgyad dang nye ba'i brgyad/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya che ba/ /de ni mchod pa'i rdzas su bshad/ /swa shing bsrung skud ku sha dang / /gdong g.yogs me tog phreng dang ldan/ /cod pan rdo rje dril bu dang / /bdud rtsi lnga dang ma da na/ /bha la mchog dang phyag rgya lnga/ /dbang gi yan lag ji snyed pa/ /'di ni bsnyen pa'i rdzas su bshad—/ /dngos la bsnyen pa'i yon tan ldan/ /rdo rje slob dpon bdag nyid che/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi bsnyen pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rim pa ni//dang po sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin dang / /dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog nyid dang / /las kyi rgyal po'i ting 'dzin no/ /sngags kyi bsnyen pa bya ba ni/ /'khor lo'i bdag po'i bzlas pa 'bum/ /dkyil 'khor pa'i de bzhin khri/ /yang na rang gi lha yis so/ /de dag grangs yin mtshan ma ni/ /rab 'bring tha ma gsum byung ba/ /lhag pa lha'i zhal mthong dang / /lung bstan thob dang rmi lam du/ /47—910

zhal mthong sgra dang dri bzang 'byung / /gnang ba thob dang rjes gnang byung / /snying po'i lha la lung thob pa/ /bsnyen pa'i cho ga bstan pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor dngos kyi cho ga ni/ /rgyu'i bya ba bstan pa dang / /lhag par gnas par bya ba dang / /dkyil 'khor rim pa'i ngo bo dang / /dbang nyid bskur bar bya ba'o/ /dang po'i rim pa bshad bya ba/ /sa btsal brtag dang blang ba dang / /bzung dang sbyad sbyang rtsig par bya/ /de la dkyil 'khor sa btsal te/ /tshal dang skye bo med gnas dang / /dur khrod dag dang chu yi ngogs—/ /byang chub sems dpa'i khang pa dang / /dkyil 'khor ldan dang lha khang du/ /dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i slob ma rnams/ /legs par nges par smin par bya/ /zhi la shar du bltas la rtsal/ /de bzhin rgyas la lho ru blta/ /dbang la nub ste drag po byang / /nang par snga dro phyi dro phyed/ /srod sogs rim pas btsal bar bya/ /de nas 'dir ni dpa' bo des/ /sngon du dpyad pa byas nas ni/ /de nas sems can bsgral bya zhes/ /dga' ba'i sems ni sngon du bya/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor pas/ /rgyud kyi cho ga lha rnams ni / /mnyes bya dkyil 'khor bri bya zhing / /sa yang yongs su brtag bya zhing / /ri dang nags tshal sman ljongs dang / /rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram dang ni/ /sngon grub pa'i dur khrod dang / /yid dga' ba yi sa phyogs su/ /brtag par byas te brtan pa ni/ /snum zhing mnyam la tsha sgo med/ /ring du brus pas slar khengs pa/ /'phel bar gyur na mtshan nyid ldan/ /phyed dang mnyam dang 'bri dang mtho/ /mtshan ma shes pas lto 'phye yi/ /lto bar bsams te brko bar bya/ /47—911

mi dang mi ma yin pa dang / /sa'i bdag po lha dang klu/ /yul der gnas pa'i 'byung po dang / /sde brgyad sa lha'i lha mo la/ /sa 'di blang ba'i don du yang / /gtor ma sbyin dang mchod sbyin dang / /sa bzung ba ni rnam pa gnyis/ /sa'i lha mo bzung ba ni/ /lha mo spyan drangs mchod bstod bya/ /dgyes nas gnang ba byin byas te/ /thim ste khas blangs don sgrub pa'o/ /slob dpon bdag nyid lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i mdun du maṇ+ḍal byas la me tog bkod dri'i thig le bya/der baṃ ser po las lha mo ser mo bum pa thogs pa bskyed de/ ye shes pa bstem pa mchod yon dang bcas pa①/ mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod nas/bstod la gsol ba btab pa ni/ oṃ rnal 'byor bdag gi dkyil 'khor bri/ /ma ma rin chen sna tshogs 'dzin/ /dpal ldan te ru ka mchod la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang mdzod cig ces brjod pas/ dril bu bkrol la ye shes gshegs/dam tshig pa de de ltar legs so gsung nas sa la thim par bsam mo yang na rang gi lhag pa'i lha'i/ /'khor lo bar snang bzhugs pa la/ /mchod bstod gsol ba btab pa yis/ /bka' gnang lung bstan gnang ba thob rnal wor dang rjes su rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor chen po dang shin tu rnal 'byor la sogs bsgoms skepas/ /rnal 'byor pa larang gi lhag pa'i lhas gsal bar bstan/ /sa bcad pa la lha mo de/ /nam mkha' la ni bzhugs par bsam/ /mchod cing bstod pas dgyes gyur nas/ /bsrung zhing ye shes kyi lha mo des gzigs zer bdag la dgyes par bsam/ /de nas steg bu brtsigs byas te/ /sa'i ro shing gi ro sa ba snod kyi ro rgya dum mi'i rus pa gos kyi ro re ba zas kyi ro dang ya'i ro phub ma rnams so lnga bsal ba yis/ /sbyangs pa sngon du 'gro bar bya/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bzhengs 'dod pa'i/ /sa gzhi der na dze+edabus su yang / /bar 47—912

chad bdud rnams tshar bcad phyir/ /drag po'i sbyin sreg bya ba'am/ /bdag dang slob ma sa bdag sogs/ /bar chad zhi ba'i sbyin bsreg bya/ /de nas mngon par sbyang ba ni/ /sa ni pus mo nub pa'i bar/ /brkos la spos chu la sogs pa/ /dri zhim chu yis sbyangs nas ni/ /shin tu mnyam pa'i steg bu bya/ /'thas shing ltar legs me long bzhin de ni las bya bas ba'o/ /dbus ma na ni yon bdag dang / /bsgrub pa'i gtso bo 'jig pas na/ /rim gyis mtho zhing gzhol bar bya/ /de nas lus ngag yid gsum gyis gis ba ni ga bha was stong par byas la sngags kyis gisas lha'i nga rgyal brtan par bya zhes rdo rje gdan pa bzhed gtso bo'i lag pa yis/ /mnyam par gzhag nas lha yi ni/ /rtsa ba snying po nye snying sogs/ /rim pa sngags kyi phreng ba yang / /lan bdun brjod pas sbyang bar bya/ /sa'i nyes pa dag par 'gyur/ /de nas khro bo'i phur bu bcu/ /sngon du byas te sa bcad pa/ /rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal bas/ /phur bu bcu la khro bo bcu/ /bskyed dang ye shes gzhug pa dang //mchod bstod dbang bskur rgyas btab bya/ /me tog phreng ba gdag par bya/ /gsol ba btab nas bzhugs su gsol/ /de nas dbus su gdan bting der/ /rdo rje slob dpon bzhugs nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bor mos pa yis/ lha tshogs thams cad bsam pa yang / /'khor du yongs su rdzogs par bsgom/ /de la phyogs nas mchod pa dang / /maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba sngon 'gro bas/ /mchog tu gyur pa bzhi dang ni/ /yang na gcig gis las byas la/ /nges par gsol ba gdab pa ni/ /shar phyogs rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun kyis gnas/ /chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /lho phyogs rin ra mtshan rnams thams cad 47—913

yang dag rdzogs/ /mtshan min yang lhamor mos pa bya thams cad yang dag spangs/ /kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor gtso bo bshad du gsol/ /nub phyogs nas zhi ba'i chos ni mchog las byung / /ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyang ba/ /kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /byang phyogs nas sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med/ /kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo bsgyur/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /zhes pas dkyil 'khor phyogs bzhi nas gsol ba slob ma bzhis gdab bo/ /rdo rje chos su brgyan pa rdo rje dril bu bsnams pa la bla ma dkyil 'khor lha/ /nam mkhar yongs su bteg nas ni/ /bgegs la gtor ma gsum byin te/ /zhi bas bka' bsgo bskrad par bya/ /de nas rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' las kyi he ru ka rdo rje drag por bsams te/ rkang pa gnyis la hūṃ re re las sna tshogs rdo rje re re bsams te bskal pa'i me lta ci'i 'od zer rkang pa'i 'og nas byung nas gdug pa can rnams sreg par gyur pas phan tshun byer bar bsam mo/ /mig gnyis su ma las nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ tai las zla ba gnyis las rdo rje hūṃ las rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba rtse lnga pa rer bltas la lag pa g.yon pas dril bu 'dzin g.yas kyi rdo rje gsor la legs par 'a nas sa de la gnas pa dag 'dis bzad par bya'o/ /de las 'od 'phro ba dang bcas pas rab tu myur zhing g.yo ba'i mig gis 'bar ba'i lta ba byams pa'i lta ba blta zhing / bzhengs la/ sa phyogs dri ma med pa 'dir/ sems can thams cad kyi don du/ dpal rgyud sde chen po lnga'i dbang bskur bgyid kyis spyod lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / 'byung po dang / sha za dang srin po la sogs pa gang dag gnas pa de dag thams cad myur du song cig /'di ltar dpal he ru ka'i bka' thos nas myur du dengs shig /gang mi 'gro bar gyur pa 47—914

de dag mgo ardza ka'i dog pa bzhin du tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro zhes lan gsum brjod par bya'o/ /de nas dbang ldan gyi phyogs su song ste/ hūṃ mang po brjod pa dang / zhal bzhi pa'i sngags brjod cing g.yas skor du bskor zhing / rdo rje rgya gram dang / rdo rje rtse gsum pa dang / rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i bar du rkang pa dang lag pas phyag rgya dang bcas pa/ te ru ka dgyes pa'i gar dang / rnal 'byor ma bde ba dang / dpa' bo dang khro bo rol pa'i gar gyis bskor bar bya'o/ /phyi nang phyi'i lta stangs drug cu rtsa bzhi la sogs pas phyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor spyor nang lus kyi dkyil 'khor du rtsa yi ge'i dkyil 'khor sbyor de kho na nyid kyi dkyil 'khor du ye shes kyi rlung gsang ba shes par bya'o/ /de nas mchod pa dang bstod pa bya/ khro bo'i phur pa rnams gnas bcur gdab pa'i dus su/ 'jig rten pa'i phyogs skyong bkug nas phur pa gdab par bya ste/ gsang ba mtshalas kyi 'khor lo bsgoms te/ bgegs rnams la phur pa gdab pa dang / phur bus lus ngag yid gsum la gdab pas de brdungs nas r+shabadz+ra mud ka ra/ phur pa'i lha rnams 'od du 'bar bar bsam mo /'di'i dus su khro bo bcu la gtor ma rapobacudabul/ mchod pa bya'o/ /de rnams ni bgegs bsal ba'i cho ga'o/ /de nas lhag par gnas par bya te/ dang po sa'i lha mo lhag par gnas par bya ste/ sa'i lha mo lhag par gnas pa ni/ sa la reg pa'i phyag rgya dang / /mi bshigs thig ler bcas pa yis/ /sor mo lan gsum bsnun nas ni/ /bkug nas mdun du gnas par bsam/ /yan lag rgyan rnams thams cad dang //kha dog ser po legs par mdzes/ /lag na bum pa thogs nas ni/ /bdag 47—915

ni ci bgyid bka' stsal smros/ /mchod yon zhabs bsil la sogs byen/ /gzi byin can des 'di ltar bya/ /oṃ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par las/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyed ni dpang du gyur/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa /de bzhin bdag gi bdud kyi sde/ /pham par bya zhing rgyal ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor rgya chen bri bar bya/ /de skad lan gsum brjod pa yis/ /der ni thim par bsam par bya/ /de nas bdag nyid kyis mchod pa dbul zhing gsol ba gdab/ dkyil 'khor pa dang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag byas te/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /rdo rje slob dpon brtul zhugs che/ /sems can kun la phan bya'i phyir/ /slob ma rnams ni gzhug par bgyi/ /zhes brjod do/ /lha la spyan drangs bstod pa dang / bar 'dir dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa la chos bshad par bya ste/ slob dpon kun dga' snying po'i tshul dang / rdo rje rtse mo las gsungs pa dang / slob dpon brtul zhugs spyod pa'i nag po pa'i zhal nas kyang gsungs pa ni phan yon dang / bsod nams dang / stobs la sogs pa shes par bya'o/ /rang nyid lhag par gnas par bya/ /dkyil 'khor legs par byugs pa la/ /dri yi thig le dgod pa ni/ /gru bzhi thig le rlum po dag /rim pas sbyang ba lha grangs dgod/ /de nyid dam tshig dkyil 'khor lnga—/ /bskyed la 'od 'phros gnas nas dgug /spyan drangs mchod nas bstod pa bya/ /dgug gzhug bcing dang dgyes pa bskyed/ /de nas gsol ba 47—916

gdab pa ni/ /rdo rje slob dpon blo gros che/ /sems can don rnams bya ba dang / /sangs rgyas thugs dam bskul ba'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bo rig mar bcas/ /gang yang phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang / /rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can/ /byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /slob ma rnams la phan bya dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod bya'i phyir/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa 'di zhes pas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /nang par dkyil 'khor bzhengs par bgyi/ /rjes su brtse bar nyer dgongs te/ /kun la byin gyis brlab du gsol/ /de ltar lan gsum brjod nas kyang / /spos phor gyis ni dbul bar bya/ /mchod pa kun gyi legs mchod de/ /gsol ba gdab par bya ba'o/ /bum pa mchog ni bcu gcig gam/ /yang na bkra shis bum pa bdun/ /lha grangs ldan pas so so yi/ /cho ga'i bum par rab tu bshad/ /bum pa kun kyang de la bum pa lhag par gnas pa bya ba ni/ bum pa rnams la lha so so'i mtshan ma btab la phyogs so sor mngon par bzhugs pa gal che'o/ /mtshan nyid ldan/ /mkhas pas ①legs par bkod pa bya/ /cho ga bzhin du mngon bzlas te/ /rim pa spyi dang bye brag gis/ /bsgrub pa bkra shis pas man ngag bzhin/ rgyud rnams sbyor ba shes par spyad/ /sngar gyi dkyil 'khor gyi tshom bu'i stengs su bya ba'am/ yang na logs su maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du| ras kha tshang ma gtings/ de me tog tshom bu bshams pa'i steng du bum pa rnams bshams te bum pa'i gzungs thag lag pa g.yas pas bzung ste/ dang po gtso bo'i bum pa stong pa'i ngang las rgyu snyeser po las 'od zer 'phros pas 47—917

phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs dam bskul zhing mchod/ 'gro ba sems can gyi don byas nas rgyu la bsdus te gzhal yas khang gdan dang sa bon dang bcas pa bskyed de skad cig gis bsams la/ rnam rgyal gyi bum par gtso bo'i sngags brjod pa tsam gyis lha rnams skad cig gis gsal bar bskyed pa ni rdo rje gdan pa'i lugs so/ /rje rta chen po ni/ oṃ swa bha wa dang shu n+ya tas stong par byas la/ badz+ra rak+ṣas bsrung zhing / bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgoms pa'i nang du/ chos 'byung dang 'byung ba bzhi'i steng du mngon par byang chub pa lngas lha so so'i bskyed la/ mkha' gsang byen gyis brlabs la/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog lha lnga so sor bskyed do/ /sku mdog phyag mtshan so so las byung ba bzhin te/gtso bo gang gis byas pa de grub pa dang / gzhan bzhi po de dus mnyam du bskyed pa'o/ /yang rje byang chub sems dpa' dang rje bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta rnams/rgyu ser po las gzhal yas khang lha rnams cho ga gsum gyis bskyed gsung ngo / /rgyu las lha'i khang pa'i nang du lha so so ba skad cig gis bskyed pa ni/ rjes su ma ti chen mo'i bzhed do/ /rje rta ni bdud rtsi myang ba phan chad tshar bar byas la/mchod pa dbul zhes gsung ngo / /de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ bum nang gi lha'i thugs kar lha so so'i phyag mtshan gyi lte bar nyi ma'i steng du/ hūṃ ①las sngags kyis bskor ba dang / bdag nyid la yang de bzhin du gsal bas bum pa'i lha'i thugs ka nas zhal na tshur byung / bdag gi zhal du zhugs dbu mar brgyud rdo rje'i lam du don/ gtso mo'i gsang gnas thugs kar 'khor bas te/phreng ba'i bzlas pa bsnyen pa'i dus su spro bsdu bya zhing / sngags gzungs thag la 'khril nas 'khor bar bsam zhing / gtso bo la stong / 'khor la brgya/47—918

gtso bo la brgya bzlas na 'khor la nyi shu rtsa gcig go/ /bum pa'i lha zhu ba'i dus ni—/ rdo rje dpang du bzhag la lag pa g.yas pa me tog gzung la/ pad+ma'i 'khor lo'i phyag rgya dang / lag pa g.yon pas chos skor du bskor la/ dri'i dung chos bzung ba la lan re bskor zhing bum pa'i nang du blug la/ oṃ a khaṃ bi ra hūṃ/ zhes lan bdun brjod la/ bum pa'i lha ye shes sems dpa' nam mkha' la bteg /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa bya/ bstod pa yang bya/ dri dung chos kyi dri'i thigs pa gcig bum pa'i nang du blugs pas/ ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka nas bdud rtsi'i ngo bor byung ste bum pa'i lha'i spyi bo na mar babs pasaske/ lha rnams 'od du zhu ste/ bdud rtsi sngags kyi rang bzhin du dkar phung nge yod par bsam/ bum pa'i dbang gi dus su yang de ltar bsgom gsung ngo / /rje rta chen po dang / bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta dang / ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta'i bzhed pas/ ye shes sems dpa' yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas/ bdud rtsi gnyis 'dres nas babs pas/ bum dbang gi lha la gsang dbang ltar zhu ba dang / shes rab ye shes ltar gnyis bzhed do/ /rdo rje gdan pa ni phyag len kyi dus su/ dang por 'bru lnga/ de nas rin po che lnga/ sman lnga/ dri lnga/snying po lnga rim pas gzhug pa'o/ /de yang mi dmigs pa ni/ bum pa'i dbang la snga ma de dag dang 'thun la/ 'on kyang dbang rdzogs par byed na/ bum pa'i ye shes sems dpa' ma gshegs par mchod pa byas pa'i rjes la/ bum pa'i steng gi argo blug la/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rigs lnga la sogs thams cad kyang yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas/ de dag kyang byang chub sems dpa' bde ba'i ngang du zhu nas tshur bsdud pa'am yang na mi bzhu bar mkha' gsang nas 47—919

bdud rtsi'i chu byung nas/ bum nang gi lha'i gtsug na mar babs pas yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas bdud rtsi dkar dmar du zhu nas mer gyi khengs par bsam—/ yang dkyil 'khor gzhan bzhi po'i bum pa yang mdun du rim pa bzhin du bzhag pa'am/ yang na ma bsgul ba yang rung ste lha so so'i bskyed tshul byaske/ sngags bzlas pa byas te gong dang 'thun pa yin no/ /las thams cad pa'i bum par ni/ rgyu las gzhal yas khang dang / pad+ma dang nyi ma dang zla ba'i steng du khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sku mdog ljang nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa bskyed—/ don yod grub pas dbu brgyan par bsam zhing / oṃ a big nan ta krid hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzlas so/ /de yang dam tshig pa bskyed la ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstem/ mchod pa dang bstod pa bya/ yang ye shes sems dpa' nam mkhar bteg nas sngar bzhin bya/ de nas lha zhu bas bdud rtsir gyur/bdud rtsi las chu yi rdul phra rab re re lha re rer gyur pas khengs par bsam/yang na rdo rje'i rdul phra rab re rer bsam pa'o/ /de nas bum pa rnams rol mo dang bcas pas stibaskor ba lan gsum byas la dkyil 'khor la bskor ro/ /slob ma lhag par gnas pa bya ba ni/ spro ba bskyed dang gnang ba sbyin/ /sdom pa dbog cing bsrung ba gdags/ /so shing dor bar bya ba dang / /ku sha sbyin dang gzengs bstod nas/ /0na lam gdab cing nyal du gzhug /de nas slob ma khrus byas te/ /maṇ+ḍal me tog bcas phul te/ /bla ma dang ni lha rnams la/ /mos pas sngon du phyag byas te/ /pus gtsug thal sbyar dul bar 'dug /de la bla mas brjod pa ni/ /sngags kyi dngos grub 'dod pa gang / /47—920

dkyil 'khor 'dir ni gzhug par bya/ /sangs rgyas 'dod pas de las gzhan/ /'jig rten 'di'i bsam pa spang ①/ /dad pa chen pos ldan pa dag /'jig rten pha rol la dmigs nas/ /blo dang ldan pa dkyil 'khor gzhug /bdag don 'di 'bras gnyer mi bya/ /bdag don tshe 'di'i ched byed na/ /gzhan don sangs rgyas ga la 'byung / /gzhan don ma 'ongs par dmigs na/ /'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub/ /de skad ces ni bshad byas nas/ /de don bshad cing gdam par bya/ /de nas slob ma de nyid ni/ /lha'i 'khor lo'i sras su bskyed/ /spro ba bskyed par bya ba yin/ /de dag rim pa ji bzhin no—/ /de rjes gnang ba sbyin pa las/ /dang po gnang ba nod byas te/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa'i/ /slob dpon chen po bdag 'tshal lo /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /sdom pa rnams kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas gnang ba sbyin byas te/ /bu tshur theg pa chen po la/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /de bzhin yang dag ma byon dang / /da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa dag /de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas/ /dpa' bo byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med de/ /ye shes 47—921

mnyam med thob pas na/ /skyob pa dpal ldan he ru ka /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yi bcom/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir—/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces brjod do/ /slob ma byang chub thob bya'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs de gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor dbang lha mo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ /khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ /lhag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung la sogs pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor chen po bzhi rnams sogs/ /lha'i 'khor lo dpag med pa/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung ste/ /ji srid gnyis med la gnas par/ /dpa' bo brten dang mchod pa dang / /thabs dang dus dang yon tan dang / /mi mnyam par ni bya ba dang / /chos ni bdun du shes par bya//yon tan bdag gzhan don sgrub pa/ /mi nyams pa yis rgyas par dbye/ /byams pas zhal mthong chos nyan grogs/ /sdom gsum ldan pas rang nyid 'grub//gzhan la smon pas chos kyang ston/ /'khor dang ldan pas ston par byed/ /lam nye 'bras bu myur ba yis/ /rgyu 'thun 'bras bu da lta nyid/ /slob dpon de nyid rang la gnas/ /des ni skye ba re la bsrung / /sdom gsum dbang dang ldan mthong nas/ /slob ma 'di rnams rgyal bar 'gyur/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas yan lag bdun pa ni/ /don dang bcas pa bsam bya zhing / /rgyud sde so so'i rjes 'brang ngam/ /yang na rang gi rigs kyis brjod/ /sdom pa sbyin par bya ba ni/ /bla mas bstan 'dir rjes su 'jug /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ste/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su gsol/ /'di ni sangs 47—922

rgyas rigs yid 'ong / /sdom pa brtan par gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya ni/ /blo chen khyod kyis bzung bar bya/ /byang chub sems gang rdo rje de/ /shes rab dril bu zhes su sgogs/ /slob dpon khyod kyis bzung bya ste/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par bshad/ /rin chen rigs la rtag tu ni/ /nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ /gzhan yang chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu byin/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa rnams/ /dam pa'i chos kyang ma lus bzung / /'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba yi/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad dang ldan par/ /yang dag nyid du khyod kyis bzung / /ci nus par ni mchod par bgyi—/ /zhes lan gcig brjod do/ /gzhan yang bcu bzhi 'di dag ni/ /phas pham par ni rab tu bshad/ /spang zhing dor bar mi bya ste/ /rtsa ba'i lhung bar shes par bya/ /nyin mo mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re zhing ni bzlas par bya/ /gang tshe nyams na rnal 'byor pa/ /kha na ma tho spom por 'gyur/ /khyod kyis srog chags bsad mi bya/ /ma byin par yang blang mi bya/ /'dod pas log par mi g.yem zhing / /rdzun du smra bar mi bya'o/ /nyes pa kun kyi rtsa bas te/ /chang ni spang ba nyid du bya/ /sems can don phyir ma gtogs par/ /bya ba ma yin thams cad spang / /dam pa nye bar bsten bya zhing / /rnal 'byor pa rnams bsnyen bskur bya/ /lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang / /ngag gi rnam pa bzhi dag dang / /yid kyi las ni rnam pa gsum/ dgeb kun la ci nus par ni rjes su skyongs/ /theg pa dman pa 'dod ①mi bya/ /sems can don la brtson 47—923

par bya/ /'khor ba dag kyang mi spong zhing / /rtag tu mya ngan 'das mi gnas//lha dang lha min gsang ba pa/ /khyod kyis bstan par mi bya zhing / /phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang / /mtshan ma 'gom par mi bya'o/ /'di ni dam tshig yin par bshad/ /khyod kyi rtag tu bsrung bar bya/ /de nas slob mas blang ba ni—/ /des kyang 'di skad brjod bya ste/ /slob dpon chen po bdag la dgongs—/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de ni bdag gi bgyid par 'tshal—/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /yang dag byang chub nges mdzad pa'i—/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis babyed par bgyi//sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni bsdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /deng nas brtsams te bzung bar bgyi/ /nam du yang ni mi spang ngo / /rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po yi/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i—/ /pad+ma'i rigs mchog chen po yi/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum/ /dam chos so sor bzung bar bkyi/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po yi/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gi sdom pa ma 47—924

lus bzung / /ma grol ba rnams grol bar bgyi/ /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /ces lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas slob ma khrus bya ste/ /'byor pas bsrung ba ni zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya ba dang / /slob ma rnams kyi gnas sum brgya gdams pas bsrung ba ni slob ma rnams kyi gnas gsum du/ /'bru gsum gyi ni yi ge dag /rdo rje gsum ni bsam par bya/ /des ni sdom pa brtan par byed/ /de la mchod pa lngas mchod cing / /bsrung skud bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yi/ /bum chus bsang zhing sngags brjod pas/ /bud med rnams kyi dpung pa g.yas/ /skyes pa rnams kyi dpung pa g.yon/ /de ni rim pas gdags pa'o/ /de nas so shing brtag pa yang / /sor ni bcu gnyis 'bus ma zos/ /me tog ldan pas bcings pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni lho ngos su/ /maṇ+ḍal ba'i lci ①bas byug /de la drag por dor bar bya/ /oṃ a khaṃ blu ra hūṃ/ de la dngos grub mtshan ma brtag /rim par brjod par bya ba yin/ /de rjes khyod chu blud pa yis/ /kha ni bkru bar bya bas te/ /oṃ shrī bi shudha sarba dharma pa paṃ tsa paṃ shwa dha ya sarba bid ga la a pa na hūṃ/ zhes pa lan gsum brjod pa'o/ /de nas ku sha'i ④chun po yis—/ /phyed la lha'i gsang sngags dag /lan bdun btab la sbyin pa g.yas//sngas su sbyin par bya ba'o/ /phyed la bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang / /oṃ a khaṃ ④li ra hūṃ zhes brjod pas/ las bum chu yis gnyis ka bsad/ /de nas rjoyi ge brgya pa brjod/ /de rjes mdun du 'dug pa la/ /gzengs ni bstod pa bya ba ste/ /'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams/ /u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ba/ /gsang 47—925

sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gis bskal pa bye ba ru/ /sdig pa'i las kun byas pa yang / /de kun kyis ni dkyil 'khor 'di—/ /mthong bar byas par 'gyur bas na/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags brjod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos/ /gang gis bskal pa bye ba ru/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs bsags kyang / /'di ni mthong ba shin tu dka'/ /bla med 'di la dga' bar gyis/ /shes brjod do/ /de yang nub mo ci smis pa//rmi lam ma gsangs smra bar gyis/ /de nas sa phyogs dbe+en par ni/ /dad pas lha dang bla ma la ma yengs pa'i mos gus kyis byas la phyag byas nas so sor nyal du gzhug par bya'o/ /ci bder nyal du gzhug pa'o/ /so shing brtag ①pa'i rim pa ni/ /rtse mo gyen du 'grengs ②'gyur na/ /de ni dngos grub mchog ces bshad/ /de bzhin shar du bltas na ni—/ /de ni dngos grub 'bring du bshad/ /mtshalas dang byang du kha bltas na//'jig rten pa'i dngos grub thob/ /so shing dor ba gang zhig la/ /gal te thur du bltas na ni/ /des ni sa 'og dngos grub thob/ /nges pa brtan par gyur pa'o/ /rmi lam rnam pa ci byung ba/ /nang par bdag la gsal bar smyos/ /de nas bzang na bshis par bshad/ /ngan na bgegs bzlog sbyor ba bya/ /rmi lam don bshad bar chad bsal/ /de nas dkyil 'khor thig gdab pa dang dkyil 'khor bas pa dang gnas brgyan pa dang tshon dgye ba dang rdul ra la ma— ma dgod pa dang thig gdab phyir/ /mchod pa sngon du 'gro ba yis/ /lha rnams nam mkhar bteg byas te/ /bla mas grogs dang bcas lha la/ /gsol ba gdab phyir me tog dang / /thal mo sbyar te 'di skad brjod/ /47—926

thabs dang shes rab las byung ba'i/ /bcom ldan dkyil 'khor 'khor lo ni/ /te ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ /rig pa'i rgyal po phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /dkyil 'khor thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /mgon khyod bdag nyid bri bar 'tshal/ /rgyal ba khyed rnams mchod pa dang / /slob ma rnams la brtse ba'i phyir/ /de ring mchod pas snyan gsan bcas/ /bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la/ /khyed kyi bka' drin dran pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs/ /'go ba gdul bya rgyud sde bzhi/ /rgyal ba bdag ni gus mchod dang / /slob ma 'gro la brtse ba'i phyir/ /de ring mchod pas snyan gsan 'be+ebs/ /bdag la brtse bas sta gon mdzad/ /'bras gnas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /sngags kyi lha gzhan gang lags la//spyod rnams thams cad mchod pa dang / /'gro dang slob ma bskyab pa'i phyir/ /de ring khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /bka' drin byin rlabs thugs rjes gzigs//gzhan yang 'byung po mthu che ba'i/ /'jig rten skyong ba la sogs pa'i/ /sangs rgyas bstan la bdag dga' zhing / /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mang po yang //rdo rje'i sbyan ldan kun/ /snod ldan 'di dag dbang zhu bas/ /rgyud sde lnga yi lha tshogs mchod/ /dkyil 'khor lnga po bzhengs pas na/ /yo byad ci 'byor pas mchod cing / /nus pa ci yod 'gro don byed/ /de phyir bdag dang slob ma la//nus pa ji ltar yod pa des/ /bdag gi 'dod pa rab rdzogs par/ /khro bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams/ /khyed kyi ma yengs bar chad bzlog /ces lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bteg /spos phor lag tu thogs nas ni/ /ma lus phyogs bcur bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas thams 47—927

cad bdag la dgongs/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yi/ /rdo rje can gyi dkyil 'khor bri/ /deng 'dir sangs rgyas kun gshegs te/ /dngos grub de bzhin btsal du gsol/ /zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon rigs ma dang ldan pa'am/ yang na/ bsgrub pa'i grogs las kyi rdo rje dang bcas pas thig gdab par bya ste/ gsar pa legs par bskal pa dang / /tshad ldan mdzes pa'i srad bu yis/ /rang 'dod lha'i gzugs kyis ni/ /shes rab ldan pas thig gdab bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ste—/ tshon skud sna lngas bsgyur ba'i srad bu dang / yi ge lngas byin gyis brlabs te/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i khu tshur gyis bzung / oṃ a byo — a nu ga ta sarba dharmā a nu pra wiṣ+ṭa sarba dharmā/ ar+yan ta a nu pra waji sarba dharmā zhes pa'i sngags lan bdun gyi bar du brjod pas/ dzā zhes las kyi rdo rje'i lag tu gtad la—/ phyogs thams cad mnyam pa nyid du dmigs pas shar du bltas te gdab par bya/ thig gis sgras ye shes kyi 'od kyi snang ba lnga bkug ste bstem pas/ gdab par bya ba ni/ slob dpon shar lta slob ma nub/ /slob dpon lhor 'dug slob ma byang / /tshangs thig gnyis pa gdab par bya/ /me yi phyogs su gnas pa yisaske/ /byang bltas shar kyi thig bya'o/ /rlung du gnas te lhor bltas pas/ /nub kyi thig ni gdab par bya/ /me'i phyogs su gnas pa yis/ /byang bltas shar gyi thig bya'o/ /rlung du gnas te lhor ltas pas/ /nub kyi thig ni gdab par bya/ /de nyid kyis ni byang ngos gdab/ /bden bral gnas pas dbang ldan bar/ /thig ni mkhas pas gdab par bya/ /de nas ye shes thig gshegs la—/ /de nyid rang ngam gzhan yang rung / /byin rlabs dkar gyi sa btsal te//47—928

oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya su tram̐ ma ti kra ma hūṃ dza dza/ zhes pas g.yon bskor du go rim lta ba'i man ngag dang ldan pas/ le tshe dgu pa'i thig gdab par bya'o/ /gsang ba chen po rgya dbye ba/ /rnam pa du mas mdzes pa nyid/ /de nas de'i mtshan nyid kyang / /gsar pa dag ni bkal nas kyang / /tshad ni 'thun pa nges pa yis—/ /thig ni mkhas pas ci nus gyis/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni rim pa bri/ /gru bzhi bgyi zhing sgo bzhi dang / /rta babs bzhis ni mdzes bgyis pa/ /zig bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan/ /dar dang me long phreng bas brgyan/ /grwa'i phyogs ni thams cad dang / /sgo khyud kyi ni mtshalas rnams su/ /rdo rje rin chen spras pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor phyir rim thig gdab po/ /de'i rim pa'i nang bzhugs pa| /'khor lo pho brang rdo rje yis/ /thig gi phyogs su bskor bya zhing / /ka ba brgyad kyis mdzes bgyis pa/ /phyogs kun mnyam pa nyid dmigs pa/ /shes rab can gyis thig gdab pa/ /shar dang nub dang byang dang lho/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi ste le tse dgu/ /tshon rnams nges par byin brlabs te/ /de nas tshon byin kyis brlab pa ni/ tshon rnams la rgyu hūṃ tram̐ hri khaṃ①/ zhes pa'i yi ge bkod cing mchod la/oṃ badz+ra tshin dha sa ma ya hūṃ ②zhes bya ba 'di phyag rgya dang ldan pas/ tshon rtsi rnams la lan bdun gyi bar du mngon par bzlas nas/ tshon thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen pos gsung ngo / /de la phyag rgya yang 'di yin te/ rdo rje'i phyag rgya gnyis pas ni/ /mdzub mo'i rtse mo mnyam sbyar la/ /byas nas tshon rtsi thams cad 'bar ba'i lta bas dgug par bya/hi zhes bya ba dang / rdo rje nyi ma khro bo'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang / g.yon pa'i rdo 47—929

rje khu tshur kyis mthar sbyar 5ra bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ye hūṃ zhes bzlas shing dbang ldan gyi phyogs nas brtsams te g.yas nas bskor ba'i tshul gyis ①rtsi dgye bar bya'o/ /zhes slob dpon a nan ta gasnya'i bzhed pa'o/ /tshon pra brtags nas dbus su bri/ /de nas slob ma brir gzhug ste/ /'di ni chos dbyings dag pas te//sems can khams ni sgol byed pa/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rgyal po nyid/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun kyi gnas shes so/ /pho brang gnas ni dur khrod bar/ /rim pas bri zhing mdzes par bya/ /de nas dkyil 'khor rgyan bkod de/ /bsgrub pa nyid du bri bar bya/ /de nas dngos bstan pa bum pa bskur ba phyi nas bya nibazhi las—/ lha'i phyag mtshan yi ge 'bru gsum gang rung bkod pa ni/ rgyud so so las byung ba'i bya ste/ 'di med na mi shes par gsang ba spyi rgyud nas gsungs pas gal che bar gsungs te/ bla ma be+e ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta bzhed do / /bum pa dang dkyil 'khor la/ dang por sa pa bya ba ston sgrub pa nus par ldan par bya/ de nas cho ga yongs rdzogs pa/ /dbang ni bskur bar bya ba'o/ /slob ma rnams la phan bya'i phyir/ /slob dpon dkyil 'khor 'jug par bya/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bcas pa rnams/ /stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis/ /so so'i lha rnams gsal ba dang / /yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa yis/ /bsrub pa'i sbyor bas bdud rtsi dbab bum pa bas pa dang / dkyil 'khor lhag pa'i lhar btso pa dang / rnal 'byor rnam pa bzhi bsgoms pa'am/ ting nge 'dzin gsum bsgom ①pas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba yan chod bya'o/ /bar 'dir bum pa'i bzlas pa dang / bskyed rim lhag gnas kyi dus bzhin du 'dir yang bya/ slob dpon bdag nyid slob ma la bskur ba de kho na bzhin bdag nyid kyi blang / tshogs 'khor gcig bya ba 47—930

gal d+ku/ /'khor lo la mchod bum pa dgang / /gtso las 'khor spros las byed pas—/ /rnam rgyal bum dgang spros pa la/ /bum pa gzhan du rim bzhin blug /'gro don gtso bo'i las yin pas/ /slar yang gtso bo'i bum pa dgang / /rnam rgyal steng du bdud rtsi las/ /bsre ba lag len mthong bas bya/ /slob dpon nyid kyi gang dmigs la/ /rim pas gang 'dod blang bar bya/ /de nas slob ma 'jug pa yis/ /cho ga'i rim pa nyi shu ste/ /gsol ba gdab dang gdong g.yogs bcings/ /me tog phreng bzung sems rab bskyed/ /don dri khas blangs nang gzhug① /tshogs bsags mna' dgag dam chu blud/ /dam sgrag bka' sgo ye shes dbab/ /me tog dor rjes mthong ba dri/ /spyi gtsug me tog phreng ba bzhag /gdong g.yogs bkrol la lha ngo bstan/ /lha dang dkyil 'khor don yang bstan/ /'dod lha'i bslab pa bsgrub pa bstan pas te| /'di dag mdor bstan don yin no/ /de nas lha dang bla ma la/ /yol ba yi ni phyi rol du/ /gsol ba gdab cing me tog dbul/ /phyag dang me tog sngon 'gro bya/ /de rjes dri ma med pa yi/ /dar ras dmar pos gdong g.yogs bya/ /de yang las bum chus bsangs la/ /slob ma rnams kyi mig dgab po/ /me tog phreng ba bzung nas ni/ /rdo rje me tog ldan pa dag /snying khar bzhag la 'di skad brjod/ /oṃ badz+ra yo ga tsisto u pa ta ya mi sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bo dhi snecit+ta swa bha wa at+ma ko haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal bcad pa dang / /rdo rje gdan pa ni/ bar 'dir yan lag bdun pa sngon du 'gro bas sems bskyed par bzhed do/ /su ma ri chen mo ni/ snga ma'i 47—931

dus su ni smon pa sems babyed/ 'di'i dus su 'jug pa sems babyed ces so//rje rta chen po'i bzhed pas/ me tog bcas par snying khar bzhag /de nas sems bskyed par bzhed do/ /sangs rgyas byang chub thob bya'i phyir/ /byang chub sems gnyis sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub sems dpa' che rnams kyi/ /bskyed pa de ltar bdag kyang bskyed/ /rgyal bas 'gro ba sgol bar mdzad/ /'gro rnams bdag gis mgon gyur pa/ /bdag ni tshe 'dir sangs rgyas kyi/ /bla med go 'phangs gnas thob pas/ /sangs rgyas gyur pas 'gro ba rnams/ /ma lus srid pa'i mtsho las sgral/ /zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas las kyi rdo rje yis/ /khrid de yol ba'i drung bzhag ste/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis—/ /bu khyod dag pa gang la dga'/ /skal ba bzang la bdag dga'o/ /skal bzang des khyod ci byed pa/ /sangs rgyas mchog 'dod dam tshig yin/ /zhes brjod do/ /bla ma dang dkyil 'khor la maṇ+ḍal dang / me tog 'bul/bdun rnam dag bya ba ni/ tshogs bsogs ①pa'o/ /maṇ+ḍal phyag sogs sngon 'gro ba/ /tshogs bsags pa ni rang gzhan gyi/ /don gnyis rdzogs par byed pa'o—/ /mgon po khyed la gang gsol ba/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 'khor lo che/ /dkyil 'khor chen po dam pa yi/ /cho ga'i mchog ni bshad du gsol/ /rgyal ba mi gnas mya ngan 'das/ /bcom ldan sku de bdag la ston/ /lan gsum brjod la me tog dbul/ /de don bshad la dad pa bskyed/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /bcom ldan dkyil 'khor grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /mkhas pas slob ma dbang skur bya/ /de nas bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pas 'di skad brjod/ de ring rigs kyi bu spyod la/ phyogs 47—932

bcu dus gsum gyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pas/ mchog gi dngos grub thob ste/ de lta bas na thun mong gi dngos grub lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar ma byed cig /gal te smras na nyams pa gyur ta re/ a su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ hoḥsidhi badz+ra ya ta su khaṃ/ zhes brjod la/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad slob ma'i ba spu'i bu ga na phar sib sib zhugs par bsams la/ me tog brteg go/ /de nas slob ma de dag kun/ /shar gyi phyogs su gnas byas la/ /mchod dang bstod pa cher byas te/ /bla mas yang dag brtan par yang / /zhal bzhes slob ma de dag kun/ /mkha' gsang gnas nas bton ①byas te/ /bgegs bsal sdom pa sbyin par bya/ /slob ma cha gsum gyis ni/ lhar bcas dkyil 'khor shar phyogs kyi/ /dur khrod dag na gnas par bsam/ /de nas slob ma'i gnas gsum du/ /nyi ma pad+ma zla ba la—/ /gnas pa'i yi ge hūṃ dang a/ /oṃ gsum nag dmar dkar ba las/ /rdo rje gsum du bskyed byas te/ /gnas pa'i sa bon spro sdu ④yis/ /'gro ba sbyangs te gnas par bsam/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma ko haṃ/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wāk+ka badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa ā ko haṃ/ gsol gsum gdab cing byin brlabs pa/ /dag pa'i sku ru bsam par bya/ /dri'i thig les mchod par bya/ /spyi borardo rje bzhag nas 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste/ /khrod kyi spyi bor bzhag pa yis/ /sangs rgyas sku ru khyod 'grub cing / /rdo rje'i skur 'gyur gsang ba che/ /'di 'dra'i dkyil 'khor ma mthong la—/ /ma smra smras na mgo 'gas bshags/ /snying khar rdo rje bzhag nas rdo rje 'dzin pa 47—933

de khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par 'gyur/ /tshul 'di gzhan la mas gyur na/ /de ma thag tu bral zhing 'pho/ /oṃ ṭīsarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra satwa sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūṃ/ dung chos kyi dri chu yis las bum gyi chu 'di ni gsang ba'i dam tshig chu/ /dam tshig bsrungs na 'grub ste thob①/ /'das na sreg cing 'tshod par 'gyur/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'di 'thungs/ /oṃ badz+ra a mri ta u ka to da ka tha pi li āḥhūṃ/deng nas brtsams te khyod nyid kyi/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nga yin pas/ /nga yis bsgo ba khyod kyi gyis/ /gal te bsgo ba ma byas shing / /brnyas na nyams par gyur nas ni/ /ya nga ba ni ma spangs par/ /bskul nas dmyal bar gyur ta re//zhes brjod do/ /de nas ye shes 'be+ebs pa'i don du gsol ba gdab ste/ hūṃ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i ye shes mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la deng / /slob dpon khyod kyis dbab du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /ye shes lnga 'be+ebs pa rje ra hu la'i bzhed do/ /me tog lan lnga dor/ye shes ngo sprad/ lan lnga phyag len yin no/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyis brjod pa/ /'di ni ye shes rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yin par grags/ /ye shes rdo rje bla na med/ /de dag lan gcig brjod pa yis/ /sngags dang phyag rgya'i sbyor shes pas/ /rkang pa mnan zhing gyen du blta/ /steng du be+e zhes sgra sgogs pas/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams bzhugs pa'i/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs kun/ /nam mkhar bzhugs pa la mchod cing / /thogs ④med byin rlabs rab tu 'bebs—/ /man ngag bzhin du bstan pa la/ /gu gul gyis ni bgegs bskrad cing / /thogs ①med byin rlabs 0rab tu 'be+ebs/ /sha chen dud pas bdug par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa a be sha ya be+e/ /stam bha ya ra rā ra rā/ tsa la 47—934

yā / tsa la yā/ ha le yā/ hūṃ ya haṃ hūṃ rngo ①swā hā/ a tiṣ+ṭha ma ha kro ta a be+e sha ya hūṃ/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ba di ma he bir+ya rā dzā ya bi dhi ma te swā hā/ bsnyen pa ma song brgya rtsa brgyad/ /song na lan bdun bgyis te dbab/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rtags byung nas/ /rdo rje spyi bor bzhag bya zhing / /oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra badz+ras / brtan par 'gyur/ oṃ a tiṣ+ṭha babs pa'i ye shes bdag la brtan par mnos gcig pa'o/ /badz+ra ḍi phyo me bha wa/ sha bdag la brtan par mnos gcig pa'o/ /shwa twa me bha wa/ hri da ya me a dhi tiṣ+ṭha/ bdag la dngos grub gsol gcig pa'o sarba sidhim+me pra yats+tsha hūṃ hūṃ ha dges par brtan par bzhugs gcig pa'o/ /ha ha ha ho/ badz+ra muji 'dis brtan par byed pa'o/ /baṃ/bden pa'i byin rlabs bden par bskul/ /tshig 'di glu yis gsol ba gdab/ /'dod chags chen po las byung ba'i/ /'khor lo'i de nyid gzugs brnyan bzhin//bdag gis mthong na slob ma rnams/ /gzhug phyir bdag ni gsol ba 'debs/ /nam mkha' las byung mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' che rang bzhin/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bdag cag bsgrub/ /dngos grub chen po mchog gi mchog /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag cag bsgrub/ /dkyil 'khor lha ru bdag cag bsgrub/ /shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun tu bzang po kun gyis ①bdag /byang chub sems dpar bdag cag bsgrubs/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /'khor ba bsgyur ba phyag rgya'i mchog /grub pa'i rdo rje cher ston pa/ /dkyil 'khor lha ru bdag cag bsgrubs/ /sems can kun gyi yid la khyab/ /sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /sems can kun gyi gtso bos te/ /'dod chags 47—935

mnyam pa'i dam tshig mchog /shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bden pa'i byin rlabs gang yin pa/ /gtso bo lha mo mgon khyod kyis/ /bdag cag bsam pa yongs rdzogs shog /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bus te/ /dag ①cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /rgyu dang las las skyes pa ni/ /de bzhin nyid las yang dag byung / /bden pa des kyang dkyil 'khor 'di/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ /bar chad bdud med kun mthong shog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bya/ /lha'i rigs kyi rim pa dang / /dngos grub bsod nams de bzhin shog /ces gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de nas las kyi slob dpon gyis/ /rdo rje ②slob ma rnams bzung nas/ /thams cad rol mo'i sgra byas shing / /dgegs sgra'i snying po a khaṃ bzlas/ /dkyil 'khor lan gsum bskor bar bya/ /shar sgo nas ni phyag gsum bya/ /'grengs nas yi dam lhar mos la/ /slob mas de nas de nyid du/ /gang la phog pa lha yi rigs/ /me tog thogs la 'di skad brjod/ /sngon nas bsgrubs pa'i yi dam lha/ /gsang chen mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /rigs kyi dngos grub nges pa yis/ /gang yin de ring bdag bsnyen gyis/ /rigs dang 'thun pa'i dngos grub dang / /lha dang ma nor mjal bar shog /oṃ pra tits+tsha hoḥzhes brjod par bya/ so shing snang ba gsum 'thun pa/ /de la dngos grub nges pa yin/ /de nas me tog dag gi dbang / /slob dpon sa bon spro bsdu yis/ /rnam snang me tog de la bstem/ /spyi bor sbyin par bya ba yin/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin rlabs pa/ /me tog rnam par snang mdzad de/ /stobs chen khyod ni 'di long zhig /khyod kyi spyi bor rtags bstan nas/ /gong 47—936

du me tog lhung gyur pa/ /de'i gnas sogs brtan par bya/ /de nas spyi bor bla mas gdags/ /oṃ pra ti griṇ+ḍa swa mi mo swā hā sa la la zhes pa ni/ stobs dang ldan pa sems can khyod kyis 'di thogs shig pa'o/ /de nas mig ni dbye ba ni—/ /chabadz+ra satwa sa man ta he ru ka dpal deng khyed rdo rje sems dpa' ①kyis/ /tsas ra ga ta rang mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /thams cad mig ni 'byed uta ga ta ma ti sarba khyo badz+ra tsas pu ta ta re ha badz+ra pa sha dza par 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa sa man+ta tsagrur ga ta tang par uta gha ta ya ti sarba sgo badz+ra tsagrur nud ta ra ha badz+ra pa sh+ya/ kye rdo rje che ge mo zhes bya ba 'dis/ gdong g.yogs dgrol bar bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra a ni tra ya ra ha sa tra lo hri a/ badz+ra tsakhyi pa sha sa ma ya hūṃ/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos kyi rdo rje che ge mo stos cig bya'o/ /da ni dad pa rab tu babyed/ /khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes/ /skal ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /'gro ba phun tshogs dngos grub kyang / /thams cad 'di la brten te byung / /dngos grub thob phyir dam tshig skyongs/ /gsang sngags bzlas la brtson par gyis/ /shes brjod do/ /de nas yang na rim pas ston/ /rgyud sde chen po lnga rnams kyi/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo dbang bskur ba/ /'gro ba skyob phyir gzi brjid can/ /thams cad yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bde chen gtor mchog der sprul cig /bdag gzhan ngan 'gro las sgrol phyir//thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /gnas nas 'go ba sgrol byed pa'i/ /ye shes dbang mchog bdag la stsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas dkyil 'khor shar phyogs su/ /slob ma rim pas bzhag bya ste/ /slob dpon lha'i nga rgyal gyis/ /slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi/ /gdon ni bskrad par 47—937

bya bas te/ /me phor nyungs dkar gu gul brdeg /oṃ sarba pa paṃ sarba bid shirnyi ku ru swā hā/ zhes so/ /rdza gsar pa'i nang du me la gu gul bsreg cing /drag sngags sam/ gdong bzhi pa'am bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags bzlas pas gdon thams cad bskrad par bsam zhing / der chu gtsang ma blangs nas mtheb 'dzub kyis blangs te slob ma'i sdig pa thams cad sang sang song bar bsam zhing las byas pa dang / me chu de gnyis phyi rol du dor ro/ /'di na rgyud kyi bar chad kyi/ /bgegs bsal cho ga'i rim pa yin/ /gzhan du 'di nyid bya bar bshis—/ /sbyin sreg mtshan nyid ldan par bya/ /de nas bskul bar bya ba ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo/ /rnal 'byor rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas dbang bskur ba'i sngon 'gro la/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pa ni/mngon rtogs rgyas par bsgoms la slob ma de la mchod bstod yan chad bzhed do/ /rje rta chen po ni/ sku gsung thugs rgyas gdab pa yan chad kyi cho ga gsung ngo / /dha byang chub sems dpa' dang / be+e ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta ①gnyis dam tshig lhar bskyed pa la ye shes dgug gzhug cho ga gsung / rjes su ma ti chen mo ni/ de ltar bsams nas dngos gzhi'i dus su/ bdag gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer byus lhag pa'i lha'i 'khor lo dang / bla ma spyan drangs la de la rang gis sa bon gyi 'od las spros pa'i mchod pas mchod/ de nas bstod pa ni de la so so'i bstod pa bya/ de nas sems can thams cad kyi don du/ nyon mongs pa dang /las dang bag chags kyi sdig sgrib sbyang ba'i don du dbang bskur du gsol zhes brjod pa dang / sangs rgyas de dag gis legs so zhes brjod cing / bla ma 47—938

dang yi dam dang lha'i 'khor lo bskul ba dang / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / rig pa'i lha mo dang / khro bo'i rgyal po bcu la sogs pa rnams kyi phrin las dang / dgongs pa dang / ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs par bsam mo/ /de la sangs rgyas kyis ting nge 'dzin mdzad/ byang chub sems dpas bkra shis brjod/ lha mo gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pas glu len—/ spyan ma la sogs pa bum pas khrus byed do/ /de nas dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa ni/ phyag ni sngon du 'gro bas te/ /bla mas 'jug par gnang ba ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /te ru ka dpal grong khyen mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /sku gsung thugs gnyis su med pa'i sgo nas phyag bya ba ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu na stso pasgra na ya/ at+ma ①rgo nir+ya ta ya mi shri gu ru tsar+ya/ ka ya wāk+ka byusto pra na me na badz+ra sa marnya ka ro mi a rnyi ṣiñtsa mo/ zhes pas dbus kyi dkyil 'khor la phyag bya'o / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu stso pasba na ya ā rna nit+ya ta ya rma/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra satwa hri te ru ka badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sa mo/ zhes shar phyogs rdo rje rigs rnams la phyag bya'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu spyo pasba na ya/ ā rna/ nir+ya ta ya mi sarba ta thā ga ta tsakra saṃ bha ra badz+ra rat+na a bi ṣiñtsa a tiṣ+ṭha ka ro mi/ zhes lho phyogs rin chen rigs la phyag bya'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu sbyo pasba na ya ā rna②/nir+ya ta ya mi/ shri ma hā ma ya sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dharma pra bsnya na ya rna①/zhes nub phyogs pad+ma'i rigs la phyag bya'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu sbyo paspru na ya āt+ma rna④/ nir+ya ta ya mi shrī badz+ra dzhai ra ba sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra karma tu mo⑤/zhes byang phyogs las kyi rigs kyis lha la phyag bya'o/ /zhes phyogs bzhi nas phyag 47—939

bya'o—/ /de nas sdig pa bshags pa dang phyag btsal ba la sogs pa bya ste/ kha byub par rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni/ /shin tu bsam pa bzang po ldan pas dug can spangs nyon/ /rjed ngas blo la rdo rje sems sogs zhabs rdol ba pa'i//bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi byin mi rlob/ /dbang med bdag gis mi dge bgyis pa dang / /rjes su yid rang ①yang na bgyid btsal gang / /de dag thams cad byang chub mchog gi ni/ /spyan sngar da ltar ma lus so sor bshags②//bde gshegs sras kyi tshogs gnyis zab pa dang / /rgya chen 'gro ba ma lus pa yi don—/ /bsgrub par byed dang de las gzhan pa la'ang / /rtag tu bdag ni rjes su yi rang ngo / /thugs rjes khyab pa'i thugs dang ldan gyur cig /blo gros sdig bral gti mug tshogs kun 'joms/ /ma lus rigs kyi pad+ma'i nang bzhugs pa'i/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /blo mchog rnams kyi kun dga' ra ba der/ /srid pa'i 'jig pa nyid kyi rgyal byed tshal/ /srid pa'i 'byor pa zil gyis mnon pa'i mchog /gsung mchog chos la bdag nyid skyabs su mchi/ /'dod chags la sogs sbrul gyi dug bcom zhing / /blo gros rnam rgyal thugs rje che ldan pa'i/ /brtul zhugs bzang po'i tshogs la skyabs mchi zhing / /srid dang bral ba rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rgyu'i ⑦rjes la bdag po'i yul bdag nyid/ /'bras bu'i stobs kyi dgra las rgyal gyur paske/ /snying rje'i rtsa ba zung cig yang dag rtogs/ /mnyam med byang chub rnam par gzung rjobar bgyi/ /sems can rnams ni yongs su smin pa'am/ /yang na yongs su skyab par bya ba dang / /rang gi sems ni dag par bya ba dang / /dngos po thams cad rtsa sogs bzhin du btang / /de bzhin tshul khrims bzod 47—940

dang brtson 'grus dang / /bsam gtan shes rab bla na med pa ni/ /bdag dang gzhan rnams dag par bya ba'i phyir/ /skad cig re re zhing ni bsgom par bgyi—/ /bde bar gshegs pa sngags la mkhas pa yis/ /chos rgyal rtag tu lhun gyis grub pa ni/ /'gro ba 'di yis thob par bya ba'i phyir/ /khyad 'phags gnas la bdag nyid gnas par bkyi/ /zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas rdo rje bla na med pa rgyud sde chen po lnga'i so so'i rjes su 'jug pa'am spyi'i cho ga'i rjes su 'jug pa'i rim pa la brlab pa gnas par bya ste/ de dag gi rigs kyi dbye bas rdo rje dang / pad+ma dang / ral gri dang / 'khor lo dang /rin po che rnams gsal ba lus kyis gnas su mngon par phyogs pas/ so so'i lha dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo snang bar shes shing / 'od zer spro ba dang bsdu ba'i rim pa yongs su rdzogs pa'am/ rim pa can du bya ba ni/ 'dir bla na med pa'i cho ga ston pa'o/ /slar yang so so'i rigs kyi 'khor lo nam mkha' la gsal bar bskyed pa dang / rdul tshon gyi snang ba'i dkyil 'khor dang 'thun pa bla na med pa'i sbyor ba lha'i gtso bo yab yum gnyis su med pa'i bde ba chen po'i dga' ba'i sgyu ma'i sgras sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams sbyangs pa can dran pa'i gnas nas so so'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te/ bar snang la bzhugs pa la phyag dang mchod pa sngon du 'gro bas bstod pa bya ste/ dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang /bstem pa dang / dgyes pa bskyed cing / bzhug ①pa dang dbyer med par gyur pa la rag par byed pa dang / gsal ba'i snang bas khyab pa dang / rtog pa'i dri ma thams cad dang bral ba'i ngo bo yang dag pa'i dbang bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa las brnyed pa ni gsang ba chen po thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang ste/ dri 47—941

ma 'khrus par byed pa dang / ye shes rgyud ①la bskyed par byed pa dang / ye shes brtan pa'i nus pa 'jog pa'i don gyis dbang yin la/ gzhan thams cad ni cho ga tsam du zad de/ phyin ci ma log pa'i rgyud la brten pa dang / sangs rgyas nas bar ma chad pa'i chu bo ma nub pa dang / dngos grub kyi byin brlabs kyis phrin las 'jug pa dang / gsang chen gyi don ma nor bar rtogs pa'i spyod yul gyi khyad par du byas pas te/ yid ches pa'i don dang ldan pas tshad mar gyur pa'o/ /'di ni rnam par dbye ba la mkhas pa dang / mi mkhas pa brtag par bya ste/ bya ba dang / byed pa dang / sgras dben pa dang / snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir ni/ gtso bo rnams go 'pho bas/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo rab tu bsgrub pa ni/ phyag rgya chen po'i gnas thob pa la khyad par byed pa yin no//de nas sems bskyed cing de brtan pa'i cho ga'i don du 'di brjod par bya ba ni/bdag gis 'di ltar bstan pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ bdag gis thams cad yongs su btang bar bgyi'o/ /bdag gis sems can thams cad la mnyam pa'i sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /bdag gis sems can thams cad theg pa thams cad dang thabs kyis bye brag thams cad kyis brtul nas mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings la rab tu bzhag par bgyi'o/ /bdag gis sems can thams cad mya ngan las 'da' bar gyur kyang / sems can 'ga' yang yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa med par shes pa khong du chud pa'i don to/ /zhes sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /bdag gis chos thams cad skye ba med pa nyid du rjes su rtogs par bgyi'o/ /bdag gis ma yengs pa'i sems dang brtson pa dang /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis sems kyi pha rol du phyin pa drug la brlab par 47—942

bgyi'o—/ /bdag gis chos thams cad theg pa gcig gi byed du gnas pa la bslab par bgyi'o/ /bdag gis byang chub kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun la gnas pas so sor rtogs par bya ba'i phyir bslab par bgyi'o/ /bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag pa rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams so sor rtogs par bya ba'i phyir mngon par brtson par bkyi'o/ /de bzhin du bdag gis sangs rgyas chos rgyu dang 'bras bur bcas pa ma lus pa'i bar la mngon par gnas par bya ba'i phyir mngon par bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /'di nyid kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub don por sems bapa'i pa rdo rje lta bu yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yab dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bka' bzhin byed pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thu bor gyur pas te/ 'di nyid ni bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang po'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams kyis ji lta ba bzhin du yang dag par rdzogs par bya ba'i stobs kyis byang chub kyi snying po bdag gis sems bskyed pa 'di la gnas pas/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis sgo mtha' yas pa la gnas pa/ thug mtha' med par rdzogs par byas nas/ gdul bya 'gro ba'i tshogs ma lus pa rnams la spyod pa'i rab tu dbye ba'i sgo mang po bstan pas/ yang dag par mgu bar bya ba dang / yang dag par gzengs bstod par nges par sbyar bar bya'o/ /deng bdag skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ /bdag gi gson pa'ang byedas bur bcas//lha dang dam tshig mnyam par ni/ /'gyur ba 'di ni the byed med/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems gcig la/ /mi ldog par ni bdag 'gyur te/ /de bzhin 47—943

gshegs pa'i rigs su ni/ /deng bdag skye bar the tshom med/ /lha dang skal ba mnyam pas te/ /bdag gis mchod pa bla na med/ /sangs rgyas thams cad spyan 'dren pas/ /de dag 'dus pa'i mchog yin no/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas dkyil 'khor so so'i rang gi phyag rgyas bcings te/ rang rang gi snying po brjod pas/ oṃ a badz+ra dh+rig① /oṃ a hri hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ de ba pi tsu badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ②phaṭa/ oṃ hri ha ha hūṃ hūṃ ①phaṭa/ oṃ hri ṭi —kṛ ④tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ces rdo rje gdan pa bzhed do/ /rje rta ni gsang ba 'dus pa dang / sgyu 'phrul chen mo gnyis ka la/ oṃ yasahūṃ 'ba' zhig ste/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa byed la/gzhan gsum po sngags so so yin zhes gsung ngo / /su ma ti'i bzhed pas/rgyud thams cad kyi sngags kyi rtsa ba ā li kā li yin pas/ oṃ dang hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/swā hā'i bar du brten pa bya de tshe sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha bskyed—/ tshar lngas ma hā ma ya'i bskyed/ tshar bcu gsum gyis te he badz+ra bskyedaske/ tshar drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi 'khor lo sdom pa bskyed/ tshar bcu gsum gyis yang rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sngags yin gsung / de dag bzlas pas/ phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i rten 'byel byed pas de'i nga rgyal byed pa'o/ /lha'i nga rgyal bskyed cing / sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje dang / yon tan bde ba chen po dang / phrin las yongs su dag pa'i rdo rje te/oṃdam tshig ra po'i bdag nyid badz+ra ma hā sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ de nyid kyi snying kha dgyesardor dang /dpral ba sgyumadang / gog ma ramodang / spyi bo gsanga'adus dang / lte ba spyoralo sdom pa dang / gsang gnas rdo rje'ajigs byed te gnas lngar bcing zhing byin gyis brlabs par byas pa de la/ oṃ sa ma ya satwa a dhi tīṣ+ṭha swa mo/ zhes brjod 47—944

par bya'o/ /de nas bdag nyid kyis dkyil 'khor shar sgor 'dug ste/ rgyan dang chas la sogs pa dang ldan pas/ bdud rtsi lnga'am dri'i chus phyogs kun du gtor bas/ sa gsum po rnam par dag pa'i gzhal yas khang du byin gyis brlabs pas brten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo nam mkha' nas phab ste gnyis su med par bya'o/ /phyi'i rig ma dang 'dus byas pa'am 'od kyi rig ma dang ldan pas/ lhan cig tu dkyil 'khor pa'i gtso bor mos pa la mkha' gsang byin kyis brlabs te/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras—/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yang dag par bkug ste/ bdag gi zhal du zhugs/ rtsa dbu ma nas brgyud nor bu nas lha mo'i pad+mar babs pa dang /mkha' gsang stong par gnas pa'i nang du/ thig le gcig la rgyu las gzhal yas khang le tse dgu par bskyed/ der thig le phyi ma'i chas lha rnams gzhal yas khang so so skye bo dang bcas pa bskyed pa ni/ cho ga gsum mam/ mngon par byang chub pa lngas gsal bar bskyed de/ de yang gtso bo dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha sum cu rtsa gnyis pa ste/ dbus su mi bskyod pa zhe sdang rdo rje bsgyur ba dang / de'i yum reg bya rdo rje ma/ phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi/mtshalas kyi grwa bzhi spyan sogs bzhi/ lha khyams la byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/bar gyi gru chad bzhi la gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa bzhi/ de nas khro bo'i rgyal po bcu/ de dag kyang so so'i rang snang gi yum dang bcas pa bskyed par bya'o/ /shar kyi dkyil 'khor la/ dpal kye rdo rje dbus su bdag med ma dang bcas pa dang / pad+mar lha mo brgyad/ sgo bzhir lha mo gdong gnyan dang bcas pa bzhi bskyed pa ni/ pho brang dang bcas pa'o/ /lhor dpal bde mchog gi 'khor 47—945

lo'i dkyil 'khor tshom bu bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi pa'i lha tshogs 'khor lo gsum ldan du bsam mo/ /nub tu sgyu 'phrul chen mo te ru ka la 'khor rigs bzhi'i lha mos bskor ba'o/ /byang du dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum thod pa bzhi dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyis ①'khor lo ste/ mtshalas bzhir rin po che'i bum pa la yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang / dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/yon tan 'byung ba'i gter dang bcas pa la/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo rta babs kyi khyad par dang ldan pa/ dur khrod kyis yongs su bskor ba'i bskod pa tshad med pa dang ldan pa/ dpe med pa'i rin po che du ma'i 'od 'phro ba dang bcas pa'i snang ba ye shes kyi cha las grub pa de pad+ma bha ga nas phyir bton ④te/mdun kyi bar snang la gsal bar gnas par bltas pas/ yi ge hūṃ gis bar chad kyi bgegs bsal ba dang / mchod yon dang / zhabs bsil dang /sku khrus 'bul te mchod pa dang bstod pa rgyas par bya'o/ /de nas dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la gnyis su med par bstem la/ de dag la rim pa ji lta bas/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang /rig ma dang lha mo dang / khro bo'i rgyal po la sogs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ste bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyen du 'khyil pas rang rang gis rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa ni/ gtso bo gang yin la mi bskyod pas so/ /shar du ni gtso bo la rnam par snang mdzad/ lho'i gtso bo la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis so/ /nub kyi gtso bo la 'od dpag med kyis so/ /byang du don yod grub pas rgyas gdab par bya'o—/ /de las kyi rigs dbye ba nyi shu rtsa lngar 'gyur bar shes par bya'o/ /de nas so so'i lha'i nga rgyal brtan ①par bya ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wak+ka 47—946

tsit+ta badz+ra swa bha wa ā ko haṃ zhes so so'i nga ①rgyal brtan par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor pa thams cad la so so'i bye brag gam/ spyi'i thun mtshams su bdud rtsi myang ba lce rdo rje'i sbyor bas drangs shing gsol bas bde ba chen po'i sku nyams brtas ⑤par gyur pa'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta badz+ra swa bha wa ā ko haṃ / zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas mchod pa thams cad kyis yang dag par mchod cing / rang gi sa bon las 'phros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis lha so so'i dkyil 'khor la bstod pa ni/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /gsang ba'i dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /gsang ba'i rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med//rang bzhin dag pas yang dag byung / /rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa thob/ /rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs mdzad/ /rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med/ /rdo rje sems dpar phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha tshogs kyi gtso bo la bstod do/ /khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor/ /nyid kyi thugs kyis khyod kyi dgongs pa bsgrub/ /khyod ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'khor ba kun bsgrub pa/ /snying rje'i shugs kyi sems can byang chub dang / /kun rdzob sgyu mas byang chub sgrub pa'i yid/ /dgyes pa'i rdo rje dpal ldan te ru ka la 'dud/ /ces pas dgyes pa rdo rje'i gtso bo la bstod do/ /47—947

phyag 'tshal bcom ldan mgon po dpa' bo dbang ldan ni/ /bskal pa'i me dpung lta bur rab tu 'bar/ /ral pa'i cod pan dbu'i brgyan du bcings/ /mche ba rab brtsigs ①rab 'jigs chen po'i zhal/ /dgra sta zhags pa kha ṭ+wāṃ mdung bsnams shing / /rab 'jigs stag gis lpags pa gos su bsnams/ /sku la phyag stong gzi brjid 'bar ba can/ /dud kha'i mdog can bgegs mthar mdzad la 'dud/ /ces dpal bde mchog 'khor lo la bstod par bya'o/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'go ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los bsgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsung thugs/ /'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun rtog 'ching ba gcod mdzad cing / /'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug pa/ /de snyed rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /sgyu 'phrul rgyal po he ru ka /yang dag sprul pa der mdzad cing / /sku gsum ye shes ro gcig pa/ /sgyu 'phrul rgyal po phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dpal ldan sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i lha'i gtso bo la bstod pa'o/ /bla ma la gus rdo rje 'dzin pa gshin rje gshed po 'jam pa'i mchog /sgyu ma'i gzugs can yang dag bde ba rgyas pa gzhan gyi don 'jug pa//gri gug la sogs mtshan ma skebasnams shing khro ba dang bcas mtshungs med pa'i/ /zhal dgu yis ni 'jigs pa 'jigs byed rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dpal ldan rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gtso bo la bstod/ de nas rgyas pa dang bsdus pa'i dbye bas bstod pa thams cad kyi yang dag par bstod par bgyi'o/ /de nas slob dpon bdag nyid dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga rdzogs par blang ba'i dus su phyi rol na gnas pa rnams kyis mchod pa dang bstod pa bya/ slob dpon gyis rje ra hu la'i bzhed kyis rdo rje slob dpon gyis phyi 'jug nam mkhar dkyil 'khor bsams la blang /47—948

nang sag lus dkyil nas rang gi dbang blang bar bzhed gsung ngo / /dkyil 'khor du mchod pa dang 'thun par tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya'o/ /lha dang phyogs skyong dang bcas pa dag rol mo dang bcas pas/ gtor ma rgya chen po dbul bar bya ste/ dngos gzhi la bar chad med pa dang bsam pa mthar phyin par gyur cig pa'i gsol ba gdab cing mchod do/ /yang na rang nyid nus med na/ /'khor lo kun gyi lha rnams ni / /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes spyan/ /nam mkha'i khams na bzhugs pa dag /sngon mdzad pa'i shugs kyis ni/ /dgyes pa chen pos legs byon te/ /he ru ka dpal bcom ldan 'das/ /bsgoms nas thams cad dbang bskur ro/ /shar gyi sgo nas bzhugs pa yi/ /sgo ni phyi nas 'jug byed pa/ /sku ni rdul tshon lus gnas dag /dbang gi rim pas dbu la dor/ /der ni rung ba blangs nas ni/ /mgo la bcing ba phreng ba'i dbang / /sngon du 'gro ba bstan pa'o/ /de nas dang po shar phyogs su/ /maṇ+ḍal phul te phyag byas te/ /byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /ji ltar che ba'i byin brlabs pa/ /bdag kyang skyab pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de nas bla mas las bum gyis bkru ba'i sbyor bas khrus bya zhing / sna tshogs rdo rje bstan par bya/ /ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni—/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis lha yi chu/ /dag pa yis ni sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa sa ma ye shri ye hūṃ/zhes pas rang gi lha'i gzugs su bltas pas/ gsang ba bla na med pa'i lha rnams zhal du zhugs pa dang / nang brgyud nas yab yum gyi mkha' nas phyir 47—949

don te phyi rol gyi nam mkha' la gnas nas dbang bskur bar mdzad pa ste/ rdo rje chen po'i dbang bskur ba/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /zhes pas gtso bo rnam par rgyal ba'i bum par bsdus la/ des dbang bskur bas dmigs brtan par bya ste/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas//thams cad bdag nyid rigs kun bdag po'i ye shes mchog /bkra shis sems lus rgyas byed bde chen po/ /bkra shis 'dis ni dge byed bde legs dang po'o//phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser kyi ri bo 'dra/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa'i 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba'i/ /bden pa 'dis ni skye dgu'i zhi byed gnyis pa'o//de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas gsum pa'o—/ /chos kyi dam pa rnams la skye dgu zhi byed pa/ /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /lha dang mi dang lha ma yin kun mchod pa'i gnas—/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis bzhi pa'o/ /zhes brjod de/ chu zhabs gyen du 'khyil pas rigs kyis brgyan pa ni dbang bskur ba'o/ /de nyid lha bstem pas ni bdag la dbang brtan par byed pas te/ gsol ba btab pas maṇ+ḍal me tog dang bcas pa phul ste/ de nas bla mas rang gi lhar mos su bcug ste/rdo rje chen po zhes brjod pa'i mthar/ thor gtsug cod pan gyis brgyan pa'i/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yis/ /rin chen dbu brgyan 'bar ba 'dis/ /dri med cod pan dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na dz+wa la a rnyi ṣiñtsa tiṣ+ṭha 47—950

ṭha ṭha zhes pas/ dbu rgyan cod pan sbyin par bya'o/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lhar gsal bas/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba/ /'gro ba skyob phyir gzi brjid can/ /de ring khrod la dbang bskur te—/ /oṃ shri ①te ru badz+rasatwazer ka.a ti pa ti s+t+waṃ badz+ra—ga zer a rnyi ṣish+tsa mo tiṣ+ṭha bi ra sa ma ya ste/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya—/ /sangs rgyas nyid du rab bsgrub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis long / /rdo rje lag pa g.yas su sbyin par bya'o/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /dril bu dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /byang chub mchog du rgyal bas bzhed/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+d+ra a ti pa ti s+t+waṃ ④a dzhai ṣiñtsa rma tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ①zhes pas dril bu sbyin no/ /de nas mgo bor rdo rje bzhag ste—/ oṃ shrī badz+ra sarba ta thā ga ta a ti pa ti a rnyi ṣiñtsa rma shri he ru ka na ma a rnyi ṣe ka ta/ kye/ dpal gzhad pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa rigs kyi las dang rjes su 'thun pa'i ming de nyid 'dus pa'i rgyud rdo rje gur du gsungs pa bzhin shes par bya'o/ /skyes pa dang bud med la dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i don mngon du byed pa bstan pa'i ming gis/ gsang ba'i mtshan shes par bya'o/ /de nas gzhan don nus pa'i slob ma la/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis dbang bskur bar bya ste/ maṇ+ḍal stegs bu seng ge'i khri dang bcas pa/ gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang bcas pas mchod par bya zhing / rdo rje sems dpar bskyed byas la/ /rdo rje dril bu yang dag 'khyud/ /gnyis med bde chen rnal 'byor bdag /phyag rgya chen por byin gyis brlab/ /lag pa g.yas su zla ba la gnas pa'i/ hūṃ las rdo rje bskyed de/ thog mtha' med pa'i 47—951
