sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /bcom ldan dpal mchog dang po pa'i ①skyes bu la'o/ /zhes brjod do/ /de nas yang g.yon du nyi ma'i steng du a las dril bu bskyed de/a srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag mchog sems dpa' ni/ /srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /chos kyi gsung sgra dag pa'i blos brjod par 'gyur ro zhes brjod do/ /rdo rje che dang dril bu 'bar/ /rdo rje la ni rab tu gnas/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma bsdu ba nyid du kyis/ /shes brjod do/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyi rjes gnang sbyin no/ /de nas brtul zhugs kyi dbang sbyin pa ni/rdo rje'i brtul zhugs ni/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i phyag na gnas/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung / /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ shrī sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha ye shad s+t+waṃ/ dha ra ya mi hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha nyi/ zhes rdo rje'i brtul zhugs so/ /'di ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bshad/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed do/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ghan dha e sha ta ma da ra ya mi a zhes brjod la dkrol bar bya'o/ /de nas rang snang gis rig ma dang zhal sbyar du bsams te/ phyag rgya dang ldan pas—/ yid kyi lus ni brten bya'i phyir/ /dam tshig phyag rgya zhes su bshad/ /dam tshig yid ni brtan pa gang / /de phyir phyag rgyar rab tu grags/ /shes brjod la yid kyi lha dngos su mos pas brten par 'gyur te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wak+ka tsit+ta a nu ra ga na sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra s+t+waṃ/ zhes brjod cing nga rgyal 47—952

du gnas par bya'o/ /de nas spyod pa'i brtul zhugs sbyin pa ni/ pha rgyud du rin po che'i rgyan gyi phyag rgya lnga dang / ma rgyud du rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga la byin gyis brlabs te/ rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya 'di/ /phyi dang nang du yang dag gnasaske/ /'khor lo'i gzugs kyis mi bskyod pa/ /rna cha'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med/ /mgul gyi phreng ba yang dag gnas/ /lag gdub rnam snang nyid du brjod/ /ska rags la ni don yod grub/ /sbyin gyis dpa' bos bzung bar gyis—/ /shes pas so so la sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs te/ rim pa bzhin du/oṃ hūṃ dha ra ya dha ra ya/ mar dha mar dha badz+ra dh+rig phaṭa rma swā hā/ oṃ hri badz+ra dharmā sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hu lu hu lu a ro lika baṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ tra badz+ra sur+ya h+ya mo bi da sa na sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ta ma haṃ rat+na dh+rig mo phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ phroṃ ṣad pa ra ma ṣad ①dza hi dzi na dzig a phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ kham phu phu phu/ ti nyi nyi/ pradzha sgrig tai phaṭa swā hā/de ni rigs lnga'i phyag rgya'i rgyas gdab pa'i don du sbyin pa'o/ /oṃ shrī sarba ta thā ga ta ku la a rnyi ṣiñtsa sa ma ya shrī sa med tsar+ya a rnyi ṣe ka ta/ rigs bsdus pa'i bdag nyid du nga rgyal kyi brtul zhugs sbyin pa'o/ /de na bla na med pa'i lugs su sbyin pa ni/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la/ /phyag 'tshal don du 'khor lo bzung //bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la/ /spyod tshig mi snyan spang ba'i phyir/ /rna ba gnyis la ②rna cha bzang / /srog chags gsod pa spang ba'i phyir/ /lag gdub dpung rgyan gnyis su 'dzin/ /sngags rnams rgyun mi 'chad brjod phyir/ /mgul gyi phreng ba yon tan zung / /bde ba che dang 'bral med phyir/ /ske rags tshar ni bcu drug nyid/ /thod pa'i phreng bar bcas pa rnams/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang ḍa ma ru/ /rdo rje dril bu'i rgyan dang bcas/ /ske rags sil sel sgra sgrogs shing / /47—953

mchod phyir thogs pa rnal 'byor bdag /gri gug dang ni rnal 'byor snod/ /dpa' bo khyod kyis blang bar kyis/ /shes brjod do/ /de ni phrin las zhi ba la sogs pa dang / rgyud rnams kyi thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i las tshogs thams cad 'grub pa dang 'grub par 'gyur ba/ spyod pa'i nus pa bzhag pa yin no/ /de nas rjes su gnang ba'i dbang sbyin pa dag ni/ 'di nas bzung ste byang chub bar/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs la/ /shes rab thabs kyi sbyor ba yis/ /bde ba'i gar gyis rol bar gyis/ /gar ro/ /s+thā/ sgeg dang bcas pas phreng ba dang / /sangs rgyas kun rdzob rnal 'byor ma/ /de ni 'bral bar mi bya ste/ /phreng ba de yi rgyan yin no/ /phreng ba'o/ /gh+ri/ lus can kun la dam tshig gi/ /khyod kyis glu ni blang bar bya/ /de nas rnal 'byor ma rnams dang / /myur du bde bas rgyan par 'gyur/ /glu'o/ /ghā/ 'dir rgyal ba rnams la dri phul bas/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang / /rnal 'byor ye shes mthong ba yis/ /byang chub lus can rnams la bskor/ /dri'o—/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul bas/ /brtul zhugs bzang pos legs tshim gyis/ /lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su/ /ye shes kyis ni chim par 'gyur—/ /spos so/ /hri/ chos kyi sgon me legs sbar ba/ /pad+ma gar dbang rang nyid de/ /sems can ma lus rig mdongs byas/ /ye shes snang bas khyab par gyis/ /mar me'o/ /tsak+ṣu/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra ne+e tra ya a pa ha ra pa ta la hri/47—954

thur ma'o/ /dha/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bus te/ /dag cing gsal la dri ma med/ /rgyu dang rkyen las rab tu 'byung / /ngo bo med cing gnas pa med—/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ /sems can don rgo mnyam med gyis—/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /me long ngo / /kre/ sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /ji ltar thabs kyis 'dul 'gyur ba/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /de bzhin rdo rje pad+ma dang / /nor bu las kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /'khor lo'o/ /khyod kyi the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /chos kyi dung ni bla na med/ /dri med kun tu gang bar bkyi/ /dung ngo / /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sdang bar bya dang gnod sogs pa/ /bsad dang bskrad pa thams cad dang / /las de rnams ni grub par bgyi/ /ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang / /mchil lham ①de bzhin ril bu te/ /rnal 'byor pa yis bsgrub dngos grub/ /de ni ci dgar grub par gyis/ /zhes rjes su gnang ba'o/ /lus dang srog la ltos med par/ /dam tshig dang ni sdom pa bsrungs/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re bzhin du bzlas par bya/ /gang tshe nyams na rnal 'byor pa/ /kha na ma tho sgom por 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams/ /thams cad dpang du gnas pa la/ /dkyil 'khor pa la rab tu mchod/ /theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya/ /sems can la yang rgyab phyogs min②/ /'khor ba dag kyang mi spong zhing / /mya ngan 'das la dgar mi 'gro/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma kun la/ /khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya ste/ /phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang / /mtshan ma 'gong bar mi bya'o/ /47—955

dam tshig rab bsrungs bsod nams kyis/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /tshangs par spyod pa shin tu bsrungs/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub 'gyur/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de ltar bdag ni bgyid par 'tshal/ /zhes dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrungs par ①khas len pa'o/ /'dir dbang bskur ba'i slob ma ni/ /lag nas bzung ste gzi bcas pa//gnyis med ye shes bla med pa/ /ma lus don ni kun brjod bya/ /gnyis med ye shes sems ldan pa/ /mi bya ba ni ci yang med/ /tshangs par spyod pa rtag gyur pas/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la spyod/ /gnyis med la gnas zas sogs la/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs brda/ /gnyis med ye shes thogs ②med pa/ /dam tshig spyod pa spyad par bya/ /sna tshogs dbang phyug legs spyad cing / /tshangs par spyod pa de bzhin no/ /khro ba med par brgyan spyad pa/ /bsgrub pa pos ni yongs su bsrung / /rtag tu bsgrub la gnas nas ni/ /yul kun la ni rnam rol zhing / /gnyis med bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ /mi brtan srog ni ji srid bar/ /bu spyod kyis ni bsgrub par bya/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /ci dga' bar ni longs spyod cing / /shrī te ru ka rnal 'byor cher/ /bsams nas thams cad rab tu brtag /bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /rnal 'byor ma ni kun gyi gnas/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /te ru ka dpal bdag mchod do/ /'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ /khams gsum na ni sdig med pas/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral ba/ /khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o/ /bsrung ba yi ni dam tshig go/ /g.yon pa yi ni chos gos mtha'/ /g.yas kyis mi 'jigs pa sbyin te/ /ho ru 47—956

ka dpal rnal 'byor che/ /'khor lo thams cad rnam par gnas/ /te ru ka dpal lung bstan bzhin/ /mgrin gcig tu ni thams cad kyis/ /'di ltar nga yis lung bstan te/ /dngos po mchog tu 'grub pa'i phyir/ /sred pa ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /oṃ he badz+ra a ku ri shri he ru ka na ma sarba ta thā sidhi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ bhur bhu ba swā hā/ gang la tshigs su bcad pa 'dis/ rdo rjes gdon mi za bar 'grub pa'i phyag rgyas gnas pa la mchog tu gsang ba'i tshogs mgrin gcig tu rgyal ba rnams kyis lung ston par mdzad do/ /lung bstan pa dang sems dga' ba bskyed pas sems dga' bskyed pa'o/ /khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che/ /rgyal ba bdag por bstan pa dang / /der ni bdud las rnam rgyal zhing / /grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yis/ /deng 'dir sangs rgyas nyid thob par/ /khyed rnams the tshom med pa yin/ /dbang mchog bskur ba tsam gyis ni/ /slob ma yon tan rgyal por 'gyur/ /slob dpon nyid kyi bden pa yis| /brtan g.yo kun kyang dam tshig yin/ /des shes pa bde bar gnas pa ni dbugs dbyung ba'o/ /rjes la sems can don phyir sems bskyed pa'o/ /sems can bsgral ba'i don de las/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' 6) pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /zhes khas blang bar bya'o/ /de nas lha'i de kho na nyid dang / dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid bstan par bya ste/ 'di dag gis ni bum pa'i dbang bskur ba'i cho ga bstan pa'o/ /'dir rdul tshon gshegs pa dang / tshogs kyi 'khor lo ji ltar bya ba dang /lha dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ ye shes sems dpa' rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs su gsol ba ni/ man ngag gis bya'o/ /yang bla ma la ji lta ①bsnyen 47—957

bkur ba dang / rjes pa sbyin sreg bya ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ①ba dang /smon lam gdab/ bkra shis brjod nas ci bde bar bya'o/ /'dis ni nye bar bsdu ba'osde/ /de nas slob ma rnams me tog lag tu thogs nas/ bla ma la bskor ba lan gsum mam bdun bya'o gsung ngo / /de nas gsang ba'i dbang mchog gi/ /ngag gi dri ma dag byed cing / /gsung gi rdo rje bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /yang dag ye shes snang ba'o/ /maṇ+ḍal me tog phyag byas nas/ /gsol ba gdab pa slob ma yin—/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje rnams—/ /gcig bsgrub bde ba chen po ni/ /gsang ba'i ye shes bdag la sprul—/ /de ltar lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ /de nas de nyid rjes thogs sam—/ /yang na dus phyis yin yang rung / /me tog ting 'dzin gsang ba pa/ /lus kyi ting 'dzin gtsor gyur pa/ /rig ma lhan cig ldan byas la/ /bla mas byang chub sems bsgrubs la/ /'khor lo bzhi dang gnas lnga las/ /dkyil 'khor rim pa bsam byas la/ /thams cad bde ba'i nyi zla bcas/ /gsal bar zhugs te gnas pa la/ /rdo rje chen pos dbang bskur ba/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis po ni/ /gang zag rim pa'i khyad par gyi/ /bde gshegs zhu ba'i rang bzhin gyi/ /byang chub sems dang slob dpon gyi/ /dri dang bcas pas slob mar sbyin/ /des kyang a ho su kha zhes/ /brjod pas bde ba myang bar bya /47—958

gsang ba chen po bla na med/ /rim bzhin chu la sogs pa nas/ /gsang ba'i dbang gi bar dag gi/ /rim pa thob pa'i shes rab ma/ /bsten pa'i ye shes sbyin bya ste/ /de nas bdag nyid dngos po gang / /yongs su bla ma la phul te/ /gsang chen shes rab ye shes kyis/ /sems kyi dri ma dag byed cing / /thugs kyi ye shes bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bsgrub//de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje las/ /gsang chen mchog gi ye shes nyid/ /bla na med pa bdag la sprul/ /bcu gnyis brgyad gnyis lon pa yi/ /rig ma bde chen brgyad po ni/ /der yang slob ma'i spyod yul nyid/ /ro gcig pa yang bya ba min/ /rang rig las byung ye shes ni/ /bdag gzhan yang dag rig pa spangs/ /mkha' mnyam rdul bral dri ma med/ /dngos dang dngos med bdag nyid mchog /thabs dang shes rab gnyis 'dres shing / /dang po dga' ba tsam nyid de/ /grangs gnyis pa ni rab tu dga'/ /gsum pa dga' bral zhes bya ste/ /bzhi pa lhan cig skyes par brjod/ /de skad thos nas blo ldan par/ /gsang ba dkyil 'khor 'khor lo ni/ /rang lus snang ba sems kyi tshogs/ /ye shes brjod par bya ba yin/ /ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing / /rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ /bde chen lhan cig skyes pa yi/ /brjod du med pa shes par gyis/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs—/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bur 'gyur/ /bla med ston pa'i bla ma ni/ /rang gi srog kyang brten byas la/ /longs spyod g.yo ba smos ci dgos/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /bla ma yongs su mnyes par bya/ /bla ma'i sku 47—959

gsung thugs nyid ni/ /de bzhin gshegs par gnas pa na/ /bla ma'i sku ni rnam snang mdzad/ /khyab par rtag pa'i rdo rje yin/ /bla ma'i gsung ni 'od dpag med/ /grags pa rang byung 'gag pa med/ /bla ma'i thugs ni rdo rje 'dzin—/ /'gyur med dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /de la mos pas mchod gyur na—/ /dbang rnams yongs su rdzogs par thob/ /'di ni rgyud rnams kun gyi don bsdus pa/ /snying po mchog gi dbang gis lam bgrod nas/ /rim pas bde chen rtogs par 'gyur ba'i don/ /'di bkod dge bas 'gro rnams mchog thob shog /rgyud sde lnga'i snying po'i don du gyur pa/ /lhag pa'i lha dang bla ma'i lung thob nas/ /gang bris gnas gsum mkha' 'gro ma mnyes na/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la bzod par gsol/ /rgyud sde chen po lnga'i dkyil 'khor cho ga de kho na nyid bsdus pa gsal byed ces bya ba/ slob dpon chen po mkhas par grub pa can rdo rje gdan snyan dha pa badz+ra zer pasamadzad ra po shri ke bha ba la ba pa yongs su rdzogs sto// //paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang / lo tsā ba glan dar ma blo gros snyarmāmati zer kyis bsgyur ba'orka/ / //yang slad na rje de nyid la khyung po rnal 'byor pas gtugs nas yongs su zhus so/ /'phan yul 'chad kar bzhugs pa'i dus su/ 'brom ston rdo rje snying po la gnang ba'o/ /de yang thang po ston pa yin no// //47—960

'khod kyang bsdur macan du bkod med/) ①〈〈pe 〉〉treji wi ṭi/946 ①〈〈pe 〉〉gyi/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉bston/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉brten/947 ①〈〈pe 〉〉wang / ②〈〈pe 〉〉stas/948 ①〈〈pe 〉sngagacigs/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉pa 951 ①〈〈pe 〉〉gi ②①〈〈pe 〉〉ste/952 ①〈〈pe 〉〉po'i/952 ①〈〈pe 〉〉ṣa/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉wal/955 ①〈〈pe 〉〉mnyam/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉ni/956 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bsrung bar/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉thog957 ①〈〈pe ltar/958 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bar sngo/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉ba'i/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2784)47wa 962

༄ga /rkang grangs rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba/①ga rkang grangs rin chen phreng ba bzhugs so// ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/pa tra rad na ma le na ma/ bod skad du/ rkang grangs rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba②ske/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po slob dpon mtshan nyid bcu ldan pa/ /gnyis pa slob ma'i mtshan nyid nyer bzhi ldan/ /nyan sogs 'dod la gsol gsum gdab par bya/ /bla mas rab 'bring tha ma'i bsnyen pa bya/ /slob mas longs spyod rdzas ni tshang bar bsham/ /lo dang zla ba gza' skar shis pa la/ /sngon 'gro dkon mchog tshogs bsag khrus byas la/ /dang por rlung bcad sa gzhi bzung ba ni/ /skyabs 'gro rnam gnyis sems bskyed sdom pa dang / /gtan khrims lnga dang so sor thar pa dbog /de nas sa'i cho ga rnam lnga bya/ /gnyis pa sta gon gnas par bya ba ni/ /sa gzhi bgegs skrad las rnams bya ba shis/ /sta gon rnam pa lnga dag tshang bar bya/ /47—963

nub gsum pa nas rims kyis 'jug pa ni/ /phyag rdor 'gro bzangs bcu bdun bdag nyid dang / /klu grub mdo lugs lha dgu'i bdag nyid dang / /lcags phub ma ni bcu gsum bdag nyid dang / /'jam dpal gsang ldan nga gsum bdag nyid la/ /tsaṇa ṭa go mi'i bcu bdun bdag nyid lags/ /rta mgrin rgyal po bcu bdun bdag nyid yin/ /thugs rje chen po bcu gsum bdag nyid can/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor bcu gsum bdag nyid can/ /me ltar 'bar ba bcu bdun bdag nyid do/ /rdo rje dbyings ni nga gsum bdag nyid dang / /dpal mchog dang po de gcig gang dag te/ /kun rig rtsa ba brgya dang lnga'i bdag /gtsug tor dgu ni so bdun bdag nyid dang / /don grub dal ni nga bdun bdag nyid dang / /'gro ba 'dul ba nga bdun bdag nyid dang / /khams gsum rnam rgyal nga bdun bdag nyid do/ /tshe dpag med pa bcu gsum bdag nyid lags/ /bde ba chen po brgya dang so brgyad bdag /'phags skor gsang 'dus so gnyis bdag nyid dang / /ye shes zhabs lugs bcu dgu'i bdag nyid do/ /rdo rje hūṃ mdzad nyi shu'i bdag nyid can/ /'jam dpal nag po bcu gsum bdag nyid la/ /gdong drug khro bo nyer gcig bdag nyid do/ /gshin rje gshed dmar bcu bzhi'i bdag nyid can/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed lha dgu'i bdag nyid de/ /'jigs byed yab yum bco brgyad bdag nyid yin/ /rdo rje 'jigs chung lha dgu'i bdag nyid de/ /zhal brgyad bcu drug phyag can lha dgu'i bdag /zhal bzhi phyag drug lha dgu'i bdag nyid do//zhal gcig phyag bzhi lha dgu'i bdag nyid la/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yang lha dgu yin/ /bdag med ma ni bco lnga'i bdag nyid do/ /zhal brgyad mtshon 47—964

rnams bco brgyad bdag nyid yin/ /phyag drug pa ni bco brgyad bdag nyid do//phyag bzhi pa ni bco brgyad kho na lags/ /phyag gnyis pa yang de dang mtshungs pa'o—/ /bde mchog 'khor lo re gnyis bdag nyid dang / /ser po zhal gcig a rnyi dha na'i rjes byedangs phyag gnyis ro gnyis bdag /sngon po zhal gcig pa yang de dang mtshungs/ /bde mchog yab bka' nyer dgu'i bdag nyid can/ /bde mchog yum bka' so bdun bdag nyid do/ /sa ra ha'i bde mchog bcu gsum yin/ /lhan skyes bde mchog lha lnga'i bdag nyid dang / /te lo pa'i bde mchog lha dgu yin/ /gnyis med rdo rje lha brgyad bdag nyid can/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro lha dgu'i bdag nyid dang / /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro lha dgu'i bdag nyid la/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro lha dgu'i bdag nyid de/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro lha dgu'i bdag nyid lags/ /las kyi mkha' 'gro lha dgu'i bdag nyid yin//rdo rje sems dpa' bco brgyad bdag nyid dang / /rnam par snang mdzad bco brgyad bdag nyid la/ /rin chen 'byung ldan bco brgyad bdag nyid de/ /snang ba mtha' yas bco brgyad bdag nyid lags/ /don yod grub pa bco brgyad bdag nyid de/ /mi bskyod rdo rje bco brgyad bdag nyid do/ /saṃ bhu tri'i lha mo nyer gsum bdag /ma hā ma ya lha drug bdag nyid la/ /sgyu ma chen mo lha drug bdag nyid dang / /ku ku ri pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' gnyis/ /drang srong rgyu skar zhe lnga'i bdag nyid de/ /rgyal chen phyogs skyong nyer gsum bdag nyid la/ /klu chen brgyad ni bcu gsum bdag nyid do/ /nam mkha'i rnal 'byor nga bdun bdag nyid la/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro bcu gsum bdag nyid do//sangs rgyas thod pa nyer lnga'i bdag nyid de/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas thod pa lha 47—965

—dgu'i bdag /rdo rje sgol ma bcu gcig bdag nyid la/ /ku ru kul+le bcu gsum bdag nyid de/ /'od zer can ni nyer lnga'i bdag nyid la/ /dbyangs can dkar mo bcu gsum bdag nyid yin/ /yum chen mo ni nga dgu'i bdag nyid do/ /dus kyi 'khor lo bzhi brgya gya bzhi'i bdag /'jam dpal rdo rje bzhi bcu rtsa gsum ste/ /ngag gi dbang phyug brgya dang bcu dgu yin/ /mtshan brjod zab pa nyer gcig bdag nyid la/ /pad+ma gar dbang bco brgyad bdag nyid de/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bcu bdun bdag nyid dang / /a ra pa tsa lha lnga'i bdag nyid yin/ /gzungs chen gra lnga bcu bdun bdag nyid de/ /mi g.yo mgon po bcu gcig bdag nyid do/ /'khor lo chen po bcu bzhi'i bdag nyid de/ /bdud rtsi thigs pa lha ni gcig pa la/ /de bzhin mdor bsdus pa'ang gcig tu bzhed/ /mchod rten sngon po'i gzungs ni lha bdun la/ /gtum po khyung gsham lha ni lnga ru 'dod/ /khyung nag 'bar ba lha dgu'i bdag nyid yin/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang lha bcu'i bdag nyid la/ /seng ge sgra ni lnga'i ngo bo can/ /don yod zhags pa'i lha ni lnga yin te/ /teliphag mo zhal gsum phyag drug bcu gsum bdag /na ro'i phag mo bcu gsum bdag nyid de/ /zhal gnyis ma ni bcu gsu5 bdag nyid la/ /don grub ma ni bcu gsum bdag nyid can/ /dbu bcad ma ni bcu gsum bdag nyid do/ /phag mo nag mo lha lnga'i bdag nyid yin/ /mi tri mkha' spyod lha dgu'i bdag nyid de/ /phag mo zhal bzhi so bdun bdag nyid lags/ /nyi ma sbas pa'i sgol ma nyer gcig lags / /sku gdung bstan pa rigs brgya'i bdag nyid dang / /mi bskyod kag ni bcu gsum bdag nyid lags/ /gtso mo chen mo'i lha ni so lnga yin/ /47—966

rdo rje rnam 'joms nyer gsum bdag nyid can/ /gtsug tor rnam rgyal lha dgu'i bdag nyid do/ /gtsug tor gdugs dkar nyer dgu'i bdag nyid do/ /ser mo sha ba ri ni lha lnga la/ /gnod sbyin 'dzam lha bco brgyad bdag nyid do/ /mgon po nag po lha dgu'i bdag nyid lags/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga brgya dang rtsa brgyad kyi/ /sa'i cho gar ldan pas thig gdab la/ /tshogs bsag byin brlab dkyil 'khor gling dgur bri/ /bla ma bskyed rims ldan pas bum bsnyen bya/ /bgegs gtor btang zhing slob ma khrus byas te/ /dkyil 'khor gzhug phyir gsol gdab ye shes dbab/ /lo drang me tog dor zhing lha ngo bstan/ /rig pa'i dbang lnga brtul zhugs drug gnas dang / /rdo rje slob dpon dbang rnams rdzogs par sbyin/ /bla med rgyud kyi dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur/ /gtor chog bla ma yi dam chos skyong mchod/ /bla ma mnyes phyir yon ni ci dgyes dbul/ /bsngo ba rin po che yis rgyas gdab po/ /rkang grangs rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba tshigs su bcad pa sum bcu so bzhi pa/ jo bo spyan ras gzigs kyi dngos grub brnyes pa/rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi ṭa rnyo kis mdzad pa rdzogs sto// //de'i slob ma paṇa ṭi ta a mo gha badz+ras rang 'gyur du mdzad pa'o// //47—967
bsdur ma na/962 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉ṅkadang /bsdur 'azas re'u mig da/ (2785)47wa 968

༄ga /mngon par rtogs pa mu tig gi phreng ba zhes bya ba/①ga mngon par rtogs pa mu tig phreng ba bzhugs so// ༄ ga /rgya gar skad du—/ sa ma ti pa tra ma le/ bod skad du/ mngon par rtogs pa mu tig gi phreng ba zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir cho ga 'di'i bskyed pa'i rim pa bstan pa ni②/ thog mar skyabs su 'go ba byas la/ de nas tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ oṃ badz+ra pa ni hūṃḥzhes pas rang nyid phyag na rdo rjer bskyed la/ rang gi snying la hri a hūṃ gsum bskor bas snying dang snying tshil la sogs pa rnams pad+ma dang zla ba hūṃ du bsams la/ de nas bsrung 'khor bsgom par bya ste/ oṃ ram̐ dz+wa la ram̐ zhes pas ye shes kyi me rnam pa lnga phyogs bcur 'bar bar bsam/ oṃ badz+ra khad kha hūṃ zhes pas mtshon cha'i ra ba dang / oṃ badz+ra gro ta ra dza hūṃ zhes pas khro chung dpag tu med pa spros nas gdon bgegs skrad par bsam zhing / sum̐ bha ni brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ hūṃ pu du thi a 47—969

sa ha/ zhes pas mchod rdzas thams cad yig 'bru las phyag mtshan/ de las lha mo rang rang du gyur par bsams la dbul lo/ /oṃ a kha ro mu khang / sarba dharmā ①ar+ya nud pan nad tad tra oṃ a hūṃ/ zhes pas gtor ma'i rgyu dkar gsum mngar gsum bshos dang bdun la byas pa 'di bye ④las gtor ma'i snod bye ①las rin po che'i gzhal yas khang / khaṃ ④las gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga/de las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dpag tu med pa 'phro bar bsam la/ dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i lha la dbul lo/ /de nas bcu gsum rnam dag bya ba ni/ dang po spyan drang / gnyis pa phyag 'tshal/ gsum pa mchod pa dbul/ bzhi pa sdig pa bshags/ lnga pa skyabs su 'gro ba bya/ drug pa byang chub mchog du thugs bskyed/ bdun pa rjes su yi rang ba/ brgyad pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba/ dgu pa mya ngan las mi 'da' bar zhu ba/ bcu pa lus dbul ba/ bcu gcig pa lam brten pa/ bcu gnyis pa yongs su bsngo ba bya bske/ de nas hūṃ las 'od zer spro zhing shu rnye ta'i sngags kyis stong par bsams la—/ de'i ngang las kri ya don gyi lha drug gi sgo nas gzhal yas khang lha dang bcas pa bskyed pa ni/ dang po chos nyid stong pa nyid sgra'i lha ni/ oṃ swa bha ba sarba dharmā zhes pa ni/ chos nyid stong pa nyid sgra'i lha'o/ /gnyis pa byang chub pa ni gdan gzhal yas khang gi lha ni/ e las gru gsum mthing kha/ yi las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ kham las chu'i dal/ baṃ las gser gyi sa gzhi/ lo las rin po che'i ri rab/ ram̐ las ye shes kyi me phyogs bcur 'bar ba badz+ra las rdo rje'i ra ba g.yas su 'khor ba/ rag sha las mtshon cha'i ra ba g.yon du 'khor ba/ ka ta las gri gug gi ra ba g.yas su 'khor ba/ khad kha las ral 47—970

gri'i ra ba g.yon du 'khor ba/ tsakra las 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams g.yas su 'khor ba/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo drug po bsnol mar 'khor lo'i nang du/ bye las rin po che'i gzhal yas khang gi rtsibs brgyad par gru chad sgo bzhi rta babs ①dang bcas pa 'khor yug dkar nag gnyis kyis bskor ba la hri las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i gdan lo las nyi ma'i gdan/ phu las klu'i rgyal po chen po brgyad/khrom las mkha' lding gi rgyal po khyung / sems can rnam pa drug las grub pa'i la klu chen brgyad gnan cing zhal du gsol ba/ rtsibs brgyad la sa bdag chen po brgyad—/ sgo bzhir nyi ma/ gru chad la zla ba'i gdan/ gsum pa gsung yig 'bru'i lha ni/ gdan de'i steng du rang gi sems kyi ngo bo hūṃ mthing kha bcu bdun 'od zer kun du 'bar bar bsgom/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pa las nyi ma'i 'od kyi mun pa bcom pa bzhin/ 'gro ba drug gi nyon mongs pa kun byang nas thams cad phyag rdor gyi skur gyur pa dang / bzhi pa thugs phyag mtshan gyi lha bskyed pa ni/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang / rtse gsum pa dang / rin po che dang /rgya gram dang / dbyug to dang / tri shul dang / gri gug dang / ral gri dang / spos phor dang / me tog dang / mar me dang / dri'i dung chos dang / lcags kyu dang / zhags pa dang / lcags sgrog dang / dril bu/de rnams la yig 'brus mtshan pa'o/ /lnga pa yongs su rdzogs pa sku'i lha ni/oṃ nī lo bha ra dha ra badz+ra pā ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pas dbus su gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje sku mdog nam mkha' dngas pa ltar sngo ba/ zhal cig pa/spyan gsum pa dbu skra kham pa gyen du 'bar ba la rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i dbu brgyan/sangs rgyas mi bskyod pas mtshan pa ②phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas kyis ye shes kyi rdo 47—971

rje rtse lnga pa bsnun pa'i tshul du 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyis sdigs mdzub dril bu dang bcas pa thugs khar brten pa'i gru mo gnyis nas lha'i dbang po dang nyi ma gnyis rta dang glang po la chibs nas/ yar nam mkha' la 'dren pa'i tshul du mdzad pa la sku stod la dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs dang / seng ge'i glag pa/ sku pad+ma la nam bza' sngon po'i zab 'jol dang / stag gi sham thabs gsol ba/sbrul chen rigs lnga ni rgyal rigs dkar pos rna brgyan byas/ bram ze ser pos phyag gdub byas pa/ rje rigs dmar pos zhabs gdub byas pa rmangs rigs ljang khus do shal byas pa/ gdol rigs nag po zhal du za ba/ sku lus la bskal pa'i ①me 'bar ba'i gseb nas 'dab chags dang khro chung dang /gcan zan gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ bsgrub bya thun pur thu ba/rtsibs brgyad kyi steng gi phyag mtshan rnams las ded dpon chen po brgyad bskyed pa ni/ oṃ yag sha badz+ra pa ni tri ta na ye hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pas shar phyogs kyi rtsibs nas rdo rje mthu chen/ rdo rje rtse gsum la gdengs pa/ shar lhor rdo rje bde byed dbyug tho gdengs pa/ lhor rdo rje kun tu 'dzin rin chen gdengs pa/lho nub du rdo rje rab tu 'dul byed tri shu gdengs pa/ nub du rdo rje mi bzad 'joms pa/ pad+ma gdengs pa/ nub byang du rdo rje gdug pa 'dul byed gri gug gdengs pa/ byang du rdo rje dbyings las rgyal rgya gram gdengs pa/ byang shar du rdo rje bgegs las skyob pa ②ral gri gdengs pa/ thams cad kyang sku mdog mthing nag /g.yon pa thams cad sdigs mdzub dang dril bu skur bsten ①pa / zhabs gnyis g.yas brkyang g.yon skum pa/ sma ra dang stag gi chas dang sbrul kyis brgyan pa la/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i nang na bzhugs pa la/47—972

gru chad bzhi'i lha mo bzhi ni/ du pu hri a bzhi las shar lhor bdug pa mo dkar mo spos phor thogs pa/ lho nub du me tog ma ser mo me tog thogs pa nub byang du mar me ma dmar mo mar me thogs pa/ byang shar du dri mchog ma ljang khu dri mchog bsnams pa/ dza hūṃ baṃ ho las/ shar du lcags kyu ma dkar mo lcags kyu thogs pa/ lhor zhags pa ma ser mo zhags pa thogs pa/ nub du lcags sgrog ma ser dmaramo lcags sgrog thogs pa/ byang du dril bu ma ljang khu dril bu thogs pa/'khor yug gi 'khor lo dkar po'i steng na las las grub pa'i gnod sbyin chen po nyi shu ni oṃ yak+ṣa yak+ṣa badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa zhes pas/ seng ge'i mgo can sku mdog ser po g.yas pa kun thams cad rang rtags kyi rdo rje gsor ba la/ g.yon pa lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ khyung gi mgo can nag po 'khor lo thogs pa/ stag gi mgo can dmar po mda' gzhu thogs pa/ khra'i mgo can sngon po mdung thogs pa/gzig gi mgo can kham pa baṃ thogs pa/ bya rgod kyi mgo can ser po zhags pa thogs pa dom gyi mgo can nag po brag thogs pa/ shaṃ ka'i mgo can dri shu la thogs pa/ dred kyi mgo can sngon po ral gri thogs pa/ bzhad kyi mgo can kham pa dgra sta thogs pa/ spre'u mgo can ser po lcags sgog thogs pa/ 'ug pa'i mgo can nag po gri gug thogs pa/ ra'i mgo can dmar po gri thogs pa/rma bya'i mgo can sngon po chu zor thogs pa/ spyang khu'i mgo can kham pa phur pa thogs pa/ bya rog gi mgo can ser po dril bu thogs pa/ bye la'i mgo can nag po te'u thogs pa/ rgo tso'i mgo can dmar po dbyug to thogs pa/'phar ba'i mgo can sngon po tho ba thogs pa/ ba glang gi mgo can kham pa gri thogs pa'o/ /'khor yug 'thing kha'i steng na bsrung ba'i khro bo sum cu rtsa gnyis 47—973

sku mdog 'thing nag 'bar ba la/ phyag g.yas pa rdo rje 'bar ba thogs pa la/g.yon pa sdigs mdzub dril bur bcas pa zhal phyi nang sprad la bsgom/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa/ drug pa ting 'dzin phra mo'i lha ni/ spyi bo dang / lce rtse dang /snying kha dang / mgrin pa dang / lte ba rnams su oṃ hūṃ a hūṃ ram̐ rnams gyur pa las—/ spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bcu gnyis pa la/ yi ge bcu gsum gyis mtshan pa/ lce rtser rdo rje gsum pa las/ yi ge bcu gsum pa tshar gsum phar la 'phro ba/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad pa la yi ge bcu gsum pa dmar pos brgyan pa/ thugs khar rdo rje lnga pa la yi ge bcu gsum pa mthing khas bskor ba/ lte ba re las re dmig bcu gnyis pa/ yi ge bcu gsum pa las me 'bar bar bsams la/ rigs kyi bdag pos dbu la mtshan pa zhes pas gtso bo la ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /phyogs bzhi'i lha rnams la rigs bzhi po ye shes pa spyan drangs pa la mchod pas mnyes par byas la rigs kyi bdag po rnams dang tha mi dad du bzhugs pa dang / snying po'i yi ge bcu gsum pa gtso bo la brgya rtsa brgyad/ 'khor rnams la yak+ṣa nyi shu rtsa re re/ gzung dang bcas pa bzlas la bstod pa byas la/ dbang gi cho ga byas pa ni 'gro bzangs ma'o// //slob dpon klu grub kyi mdo gzungs kyi rjes su 'brangs nas/ lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi mngon par rtogs pa ni/ tshogs bsag pa sngon du song ba'i rjes la dkyil 'khor dngos ①bskyed pa ni/ e las nam mkha' yi las rlung /khaṃ las chu/ saṃ las gser/ lo las rin po che/ ram̐ las me/ bye las gzhal yas khang / 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa/ gru chad la sgo btod ②pa can/47—974

rta babs kyis mtshan pa/ khor yug rim pa gsum du bskor ba la gdan bskyed pa ni/ zla ba dang / nyi ma/ pad+ma'i steng du phu las sbrul chen po brgyad khyung gis za ba dang / rtsibs bzhi la nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan/ sgo bzhir zla ba'i gdan la—/ gsung yig 'bru/ hūṃ re re gyur pa las thugs phyag mtshan/ rdo rje/dri shul/ ral gri/ dbyug to/ 'khor lo dang lnga/ lcags kyu/ zhags pa/lcags sgog /dril bu'o/ /de 'phros shing 'dus pa las/ dbus su gsang ba'i bdag po zhal cig phyag gnyis pa/ rdo rje dang / sdogs mdzub/seṅge'i lpags ①pa'i stod g.yogs/ stag gi sham thabs can la/ ded dpon bzhi ni/ shar du rgyal rigs dkar po chung ma dang bcas pa'i steng du/ rdo rje gnod sbyin mthing kha/ rdo rje dang tri shul rtse gsum thogs pa/ lhor klu bram ze'i steng du rdo rje srin po rdo rje dang ral gri thogs pa/ nub tu klu rje rigs kyi steng du rdo rje gdon chen rdo rje dang dbyug to thogs pa/ byang du klu gdol rigs kyi steng du rdo rje ro langs thams cad sku mdog mthing nag rdo rje dang 'khor lo thogs pa/ dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs/ stag shaṃ dang bcas pa'o/ /dza hūṃ baṃ ho bzhi las/ shar du lcags kyu ma dkar mo lcags kyu thogs pa/ lhor zhags pa ma ser mo zhags pa thogs pa/ nub du lcags sgog ma dmar mo lcags sgog thogs pa/ byang du dril bu ma ljang khu dril bu thogs pa/khro mo bzhi po de yang stag gi sham thabs dang sbrul gyi chun pos brgyan pa'o/ /de nas lus bsrung zhing brtan par bya ba ni/ rdo rje go cha'i/ phyag rgyas gnas lngar gtugs de/ spyi bo mgrin pa/ snying kha/ gsang gnas su gtug go/ /na ma sa man ta badz+ra ka ba tsa hūṃ zhes pas/ lus kyi ba spu'i bu ga thams cad rdo 47—975

rje'i dra bar bsgom mo/ /de nas rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya byas te/ na ma sa man ta badz+ra nan/ badz+ra pa ni hūṃ/ zhes pas spyi gtsug tu rgyas btab pas/ lus thams cad rdo rje'i dra dmig rnams khro chung mtshon gang bas gtams par bsams te byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /ting 'dzin sems dpa' ni lha rang rang gi thugs khar phyag mtshan de'i lte ba la hūṃ re re bsams la/ rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan par bsam zhing ye shes pa spyan drang ba ni/ hūṃ de las 'od 'phros pas 'og min nas spyan drangs pa ①la yan lag bdun pa byas la/ rang la thim pa dang bzlas pa byas te/ tar+ya thā/ ni lo badz+ra bha ra dha ra badz+ra pa ni ra dzha pa ya ti swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad dang / yak+ṣa badz+ra pa ni hri ta ya hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes bzlas pa ni/ 'khor gyi'o/ /bstod pa byas nas dbang bskur ba ni klu grub mdo lugs kyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje bcu gsum lcags spugs ma'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ sngon du 'gro ba thams cad sngar dang 'dra ba las khyad par du/rgyu las gzhal yas khang 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa/ gru chad la sgo btod sdepa/rdo rje me ris bskor ba'i nang du/ nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan stengs su hūṃ las rdo rje de las gsang ba'i sngonapobadag po zhal gsum pa/ phyag bzhi pa/ dbu gzhan 'phrul dbang ④byed du sleb pa/ zhabs rgya mtsho'i gting du brkyang pa/ ri rab la stegs byas pa/ phyag g.yas dang po rdo rje gdengs pa/ g.yon dang po na dril bu 'phyar ba/ 'og ma gnyis kyis sbrul za ba/ stag gi sham thabs dang /yan lag sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ rtsibs bzhi la rigs bzhi las grub pa'i phyag 47—976

na rdo rje bzhi/ 'khor lo dang rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / rgya khram dang /dril bu 'phyar ba/ gru chad bzhi la rigs bzhi'i khyung bzhi sbrul za ba/ sgo bzhir sgo ba bzhi'o/ /thugs khar phyag mtshan las hūṃ gis ①mtshan pa/ dbu rnams la mi bskyod pa la sogs pa rigs lngas mtshan pa'o/ /ye shes pa spyan drang zhing rang la thim pa dang bzlas pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra tsan ṭa sarba duṣ+ṭan ata ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la/ bstod pa byas nas dbang gi cho ga bya ba ni lcags spugs ma'o/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan gyi mngon par rtogs pa ni/ tshogs bsag pa'i dkyil 'khor sngon du btang ⑦nas/ 'dir dkyil 'khor bsgom pa ni/ 'byung ba lnga'i dal sngon la bskyed la/ bye las gzhal yas khang /nang re dmig dgu pa/ phyi 'khyams rta babs sgo dang bcas pa'i nang du/ nyi zla pad+ma'i steng du dbus su sum̐ las pad+ma/ de las ye shes sems dpa' zhal drug pa| sku mdog ser po phyag gnyis na me tog pad+ma dmar po dang sngon po gnyis kyi steng du po ti re re bzhag pa dang / thugs khar zla ba'i steng du a las 'od 'phros pas hūṃ sa e ha bzhi las/ rdo rje sems ma dang / rin chen sems ma dang / pad+ma'i sems ma dang / las kyi sems ma bzhi bsgom par bya'o/ /hūṃ ā+oṃ ā haṃ las/ shar du hūṃ las rdo rje ral gri sngon po rdo rje dang ral gri thogs pa/lhor e las shes rab ye shes dkar po ral gri dang 'khor lo bsnams pa/ nub du a las a ra pa tsa na dmar po phyag gnyis na ral gri dang pu ⑦ti bsnams pa/byang du haṃ las ye shes sku can/ ljang khu ral gri dang sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pa/47—977

shar phyogs su a a i i bzhi las rdo rje sems dpa' dang / rdo rje rgyal po dang /chags pa dang legs pa bzhi baspyod par bya'o/ /u u e e bzhi las rdo rje rin chen dang / gzi brjid dang / rgyal mtshan dang / bzhad pa bzhi lho phyogs su bskyed par bya'o/ /o o saṃ a las chos rab dang / rnon po dang / 'khor lo pa dang / sgru ba bzhi nub du'o/ /a a e e baji las rdo rje las dang /bsrung ba dang / gnod sbyin dang / khu tshur bzhi byang du'o/ /'khyams la skal bzang bcu drug /sgo dang gru chad zur la yo byad ma lha mo bcu gnyis bskyed la rigs kyi bdag pos mtshan pa dang / ye shes pa spyan drang zhing mchod nas/bzlas pa bya ba ni/ thugs khar 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' mtshon gang ba re'i thugs khar zla ba'i steng du a las wa gi shwa ris bskor bar bsams la/oṃ wa gi shwa ri sum̐ zhes ci rigs par bzlas la bstod pa byas la/ dbang gi cho ga bya ba ni 'jam dpal gsang ldan kyi'o/ /tsan tra go mi'i lugs kyi mngon par rtogs pa ni tshogs stsog pa yang sngon du song nas/ 'dir dkyil 'khor bsgom pa ni/ 'byung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor sngar bzhin bskyed la/ bye las gzhal yas khang rtsa ba'i lha bcu bdun/sems dpa' dang bcas pa yan lag gi lha rigs bsdus pa shākya thub pa la sogs pa bcu drug gi khyams dang / sa lo dbang gi khyams dang / dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi khyams so/ /de ltar pho brang khyams bzhi rtseg gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa legs par bskyed la/ de'i nang du lha bskyed pa ni/ sum̐ hūṃ tram̐ hri ha rnams las/dbus su 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' zhal cig phyag bzhi pa'o/ /shar du 47—978

mi bskyod pa sa gnon gyi phyag rgya can no/ /lhor rin chen 'byung ldan/ mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya can/ nub du snang ba ①mtha' yas mnyam bzhag can/ byang du don yod grub pa skyabs sbyin can no/ /de nas gru bzhir yum bzhi'o/ /phyi'i gru bzhir bsgeg sogs bzhi po/ sgo bzhir sgo ma bzhi'o/ /de ni rtsa ba'i lha bcu bdun no/ /rigs bsdus par bzhengs na/ khyams dang po la/skal bzang bcu drug go/ /'khyams gnyis pa la rigs so so'i dkyil 'khor bcu drug /lha bcu drug ni/ shar phyogs su 'jam dpal kun tu zhal sku mdog dkar ser/ gdong lnga pa po ②ti dang ut+pa la bsnams ④pa/ lho phyogs su thub pa ser po sa gnon can/ nub phyogs su ye shes sems dpa' gser gtso ma lta bu'i mdangs dang ldan pa phyag na ral gyi dang po ti bsnams pa/ byang phyogs su gdong brgya pa zhal brgya la phyag nyis brgya yod pa ljang khu/ shar lhor rdo rje 'dzin byed nag po kha ṭaṃ dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu 'jam dpal gdong drug pa mthing kha rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ nub byang du ya ma ra tsa mthing kha rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du go'u ta ma ser po phyags shing thogs pa/ shar stod du tshangs pa ser po zhal bzhi pa pad+ma thogs pa/ shar smad du drang srong phur bu ser po bgrang phreng bsnams pa/ lho stod du dur khrod lang kha ljang nag mgo bcu lag pa nyi shu pa/ lho smad du bdud dud kha mda' gzhu thogs pa/ nub stod du lha khyab 'jug dkar po rdo rje rdzi thogs pa/ nub smad du lha'i dbang po brgya sbyin dkar po pi waṃ 'dzin pa/ byang stod du lha min rgyal po dmar po ral gri 'dzin pa/ byang smad du phyag rdor ljang khu rdo rje thogs pa'o/ /yang shar phyogs kyi khyams la sa bcu gnyis kyi lha mo rnams zhal cig pa/ phyag gnyis pa/47—979

g.yas pa thams cad rdo rje thogs pa lhag par mos pa'i lha mo dmar mo/ pad+ma 'dzin pa/ rab tu dga' ba ser mo nor bu 'dzin pa/ dri ma med pa dkar mo chu shel 'dzin pa/ 'od byed ma dmar mo nyi ma 'dzin pa/ 'od 'phro ma ljang khu ut+pa la 'dzin pa/ sbyang dka' ba ser mo ma rag ta bsnams pa/mngon du gyur pa ser mo chos bsnams pa/ ring du song ba sngon mo pad+ma rdo rje thogs pa/ mi g.yo ba dkar po pad+ma rdo rje bsnams pa/ legs pa'i blo gos ma dkar mo ral gri ud pa la①/ chos kyi sprin ser mo spo ti 'dzin pa/ kun tu 'od ma dkar ser de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku 'dzin pa'o/ /lho phyogs su pha rol tu phyin pa bcu gnyis ni/ phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pa rin po che 'dzin pa la/g.yon pa re gyi phyag mtshan 'dzin pa ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma ser mo spo ti 'dzin pa/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dkar dmar 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin pa—/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ mya ngan med pa'i yal ga me tog dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ser mo chu skyes dkar po 'dzin pa/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dmar po ud pa la 'dzin pa/bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa sngon mo pad+ma 'dzin pa/ thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ljang khu rdo rje 'dzin pa/ smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa sngon mo ral gri 'dzin pa/ stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dmar mo chos gos 'dzin pa/ ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dkar mo byang chub kyi shing 'dzin pa/ rdo rje las kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mthing kha rdo rje thogs pa/ pad+ma las kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dmar mo zla ba 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu dbang bcu'i lha mo ni/ phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pa rnams kyis pad+ma 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin 47—980

pa ni tshe la dbang ba ma ni dkar dmar gyi mdog can sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyi sku 'dzin pa/ sems la dbang ma ni dkar mo rdo rje rtse lnga 'dzin pa/ yo byad la dbang ma ser mo rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ las la dbang ma ljang khu sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pa/ skye ba la dbang ba mo sku mdog sna tshogs pa sman 'dzin pa/rdzu 'phrul dbang mo sngon mo nyi zla 'dzin pa/ mos pa la dbang ba mo dkar mo me tog gi snye ma 'dzin pa'o/ /smon lam la dbang ba ser mo ud pa la 'dzin pa/ye shes la dbang ba sngon mo ral gri 'dzin pa/ chos la dbang ma dkar mo bum pa 'dzin pa/ de bzhin nyid ma dkar mo pad+ma 'dzin pa/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems ma ser po 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du gzungs ma bcu gnyis ni/g.yas pa sna tshogs rdo rje/ g.yon pa 'gying dang bcas pa so sor 'dzin pa ni/nor rgyun ma ser mo 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin pa/ yid bzhin skar mda' dmar mo nor bu'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma dkar mo bum pa 'dzin pa/ 'od zer can dkar dmar khab skud 'dzin pa/ ri khrod ma ljang khu pad+ma 'dzin pa/ dug sel ma dkar mo dug gi snye ma 'dzin pa/ mtha' yas ma ser mo bum pa 'dzin pa/ tsun dha ma dkar mo phreng ba 'dzin pa/ dbyangs can ma dkar mo ral gri 'dzin pa/ sgrib sel ma ljang khu pad+ma 'dzin pa/ ye shes mi zad ma dmar mo za ma tog 'dzin pa/ chos kyi mdzod 'dzin ma ser mo sgom 'dzin pa'o/ /shar sgor chos yang dag par rig pa mo lcags kyu thogs pa/lho'i sgor don yang dag par rig pa mo ser mo zhags pa thogs pa/ nub sgor tshig yang dag par rig pa mo lcags sgog thogs pa/ byang du chos yang dag par rig pa mo ljang khu dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /yang 'khyams phyi ma la ①rgyu skar nyi shu 47—981

rtsa brgyad ni/ shar du byun drug dang / be rdzi/ mgo/ lag /nab so/rgyal—/ skag /bdun mdog dkar po rdo rje thogs pa/ lho phyogs su rta chen/rta chung / bya khra/ bya ma/ bya'u/ sa ri/ sa kha rnams ser po rin po che thogs pa/ nub tu lag sor/ sdu gu/ sog pa/ bye/ phul/ nam 'dongasaske/ bon po dang bdun dmar po pad+ma thogs pa/ byang du/ bu ru/sgrog /khrums stod/ khrums smad/ nam gru/ dbyug pa/ bra nye/bdun ljang khu rgya gram thogs pa'o/ /sgo bzhir rgyal po chen po bzhi bskyed la/spyan drang / mchod pa dbul/ bzlas pa ni/ oṃ ba gi shwa ri sum̐ zhes ci rigs par bzlas pa byas la/ dbang bskur ba ni 'jam dpal grags pa tsan tra go mi'i rim pa'o rdzogs sto// //khro bo'i rgyal po dpal rta mgrin kyi mngon par rtogs pa ni/ tshogs stsog pa sngon du song nas/ 'byung ba lnga'i dal bskyed pa dang / bye las gzhal yas khang / 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa sgo dang bcas pa bskyed la/ gdan ni hri las pad+ma/ a las zla ba bskyed la/ thi las be con/ de las rta mgrin dmar po phyag g.yas pa seng ldeng gi be con gdengs pa/ g.yon pa sdogs mdzub 'phyar ba/ dbu la rta mgo ljang khus brgyan pa'o/ /shar gyi rtsibs la rnam rgyal dkar po rdo rje thogs pa/ shar lhor dbyug pa sngon po me dbal thogs pa/lhor gshin rje gshed/ ser po thod dbyug thogs pa/ lho nub du mi g.yo mgon po mthing kha ral gri thogs pa/ nub tu hūṃ chen dmar po pad+ma thogs pa/ nub byang du ṭa ki rā dza ①ser po rgyal mtshan thogs pa/ byang du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa 47—982

ljang khu rgya gram thogs/ byang shar du khams gsum rnam rgyal tri shul thogs pa/gru chad bzhi la bdug ①sogs bzhi dang sgo ma bzhi spyir 'thun/ thugs ka'i hriḥl rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor la ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/oṃ hri pad+ma ta ②krid ha ya — ba hri hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes ci rigs par bzlas nas/bstod pa byas nas dbang bskur ba ni pad+ma cod pan gyi rgyud las brten snenas pad+ma badz+ra ras mdzad pa'i rta mgrin gyi'o/ /jo bo thugs rje chen po lha bcu gsum kyi bdag nyid can ni/ tshogs stsog pa dang 'byung ba lnga'i dal bskyed pa sngar ltar la/ 'dir bye las pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi sgo dang bcas pa bskyed la/ dbus su hri dang a las pad+ma dang zla ba dang /de'i steng du hri las jo bo spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug shin tu dkar ba/ phyag g.yas g.yon dang po gnyis thugs khar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og ma na shel gyi phreng ba brgya rtsa brgyad 'dren pa/ g.yon 'og ma na me tog ud pa la bsnams pa—/ g.yas dang g.yon gyi pad+ma la/ nor bu 'dzin pa dang / mu tig 'dzin pa gnyis/ sku mdog dkar po dang ser po dang / zhal cig phyag bzhi pa'o—/ /rgyab dang mdun na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang dbang gi rgyal po gnyis dkar po dang dmar po bgrang phreng dang ud pal thogs pa'o/ /gru chad bzhi la mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang / sgo bzhir sgo ma bzhi'o spyan drang zhing mchod nas yi ge drug pa'i r+shamaṇipad+me hūṃ snyen pa ci rigs par bskyal la/ bstod pa byas te dbang bskur ba ni/ jo bo spyan ras gzigs kyi cho ga bya ba'i rim pa'o /47—983

phyag na rdo rje thugs kyi dal gyi mngon par rtogs pa ni/ tshogs bsags ①pa dang 'byung ba lnga'i dal bskyed pa sngar ltar la/ 'dir bye las 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi sgo rta babs dang bcas pa bskyed la/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/dbus su hūṃ las phyag na rdo rje/ rtsibs bzhi la rnam snang la sogs pa rigs bzhi/gru chad bzhi la bdug ②sogs bzhi/ sgo bzhi dang bcu gsum bskyed la/ ye shes pa spyan drangs mchod la/ oṃ badz+ra pāṇipā ṇi hūṃ zhes bzlas la/ bstod pa byas nas dbang bskur ba ni/ phyag rdor thugs kyi dal gyi cho ga'o/ /me ltar 'bar ba phrin las kyi dal gyi mngon par rtogs pa ni/ tshogs bsags ④pa dang 'byung ba lnga'i dal bskyed pa sngar ltar la/ 'dir bye las 'khor lo rtsibs bcu gnyis pa gru chad la sgo btod rjopa can byas la/ lha bsgom pa ni/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/ khro bo me ltar 'bar ba 'thing kha/ rtsibs bzhi la khams gsum rnam rgyal/ lo ga gsum snang / ta ki ra tsa dbyug sngon can—/ g.yas kyi rtsibs bzhi la bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ rta mgrin stobs po che/mi g.yo ba/ g.yon gyi rtsibs bzhi la dus kyi srin mo/ las kyi srin mo/ don gyi srin mo/ thabs kyi srin mo bzhi bskyed/ dus kyi lcags kyu zhags pa ma la sogs pa bzhi bskyed/ thams cad sku mdog mthing nag rdo rje dang thod pa thogs pa'o/ /spyan drangs la mchod pa bya zlas pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi ⑤hri ta tiṣ+ṭa hūṃ zhes ci rigs par zlas la bstod pa byas nas dbang bskur ba ni/ me ltar 'bar ba'i'o /47—984

rdo rje dbyings kyi dal chen po babyed pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon kyis chas brgyad bzung ste/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang / rdo rje dril bu byin rmis brlab pa dang / me ltar 'bar ba skyed cing lce lag byin gyis brlab pa ni/ khro bo'i cha snga ma dang / bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa dang / dal bsrung zhing spyan drang ba dang / phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa dang / sdig pa bshag pa dang / rjes su yid rang ba dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba dang / mya ngan las mi 'da' bar zhu ba dang / lus dbul ba dang / bsngo ba bya ba dang /byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang / sdom pa bzung ba dang / gzugs brnyan gyi lhar bskyed nas snyam pa'i thal mo dang / rdo rje'i thal mo dang / rdo rje sdams pa'i thal mo dang / bsdam pa dral ba dang / ye shes dbab pa dang /dbab pa nye bar bsdu ba dang / ngan song dgug cing sdig pa dral ba dang /dal snying khar bsdu ba dang / mngon par byang chub pa lngas lhar skyed la byin gyis brlab pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyis bsgom pa dang / snying khar dbang bskur ba dang / rdo rje brtul zhugs blang ba dang / rnal 'byor chen po bskyed pa dang / rjes su rnal 'byor de bzhin gshegs pa'i khams la bzhugs pa dang /byin brlabs dang dbang bskur ba dang / mchod pa dang bstod pa byas la/bdag nyid thabs kyi 'khor lo rdzogs par byas te/ ye shes kyi sas sbyong stong pa nyid bsgoms pa dang / rdo rje'i sas sbyong 'byung ba rim rtseg gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas par babyed pa dang / 'chi ba'i srid pa lus ri rab kyi khar bzhag pa dang / srid pa bar ma dor bsam gtan dang gzugs med pa bsgom pa dang / skye ba'i rnal 'byor byang chub sems dpa' don grub du bskyed pa'i mi 47—985

g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin la slabs nas dang po sbyor ba dang dal rgyal mchog skyed pa ni—/ gling dang nye ba'i gling bran dang / ri dang mtsho las bskor ba'i ri rab kyi steng du gzhal yas khang / de'i dbus su seng ge'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad rdo rje'i skyid krungs kyis gnas pa dkar po nyi ma'i rgyab yol can/ zhal bzhi pa/ dkar po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / ljang khu'i zhal la sangs rgyas lnga dang / rin po che'i brgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa la/ a bh+ya'i bzhed kyis/ phyag brgyad pa la—/ 'dir ni phyag gnyis pa chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya can 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /phyogs bzhir rdo rje sems ma dang / pad+ma'i sems ma dang / las kyi sems ma dang bzhi/ rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / sna tshogs rdo rje thogs pa'o/ /shar du glang po che'i steng du mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje rtse lnga pa sa gnon gyi tshul du 'dzin pa/ 'khor rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje 'dzin pa/rdo rje rgyal po ser po lcags kyu thogs pa/ rdo rje chags pa dmar po mda' thogs pa—/ legs pa ljang khu rdo rje dang bcas pas thugs khar legs so sbyin pa'o/ /lho phyogs su rta'i steng du rin chen 'byung ldan ser po rdo rje skyil krungs rin po che ser po gung mos bzung ste mchod sbyin kyi tshud du byed pa'o/ /'khor lhor rdo rje rin po che ser po rin po che thogs pa/ gzi brjid dmar ser nyi ma bsnams pa/dpal 'bar sngon po rgyal mtshan bsnams pa/ bzhad pa dkar po phreng ba bsnams pa'o/ /nub du rma bya'i steng du snang ba mtha' yas dmar po mnyam bzhag gi 'thil na/ pad+ma bsnams pa la/ 'khor rdo rje chos rab dkar dmar nyi ma bsnams pa/ rnon po mdog sngo ba la ral gri 'dzin pa/ rdo rje rgyu 47—986

mdog ser po 'khor lo bsnams pa/ sgru ba dmar po rdo rje'i lce bsnams pa'o/ /byang du shang shang gi steng du don yod grub pa ljang khu skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya'i mthil na sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pa la/ 'khor rdo rje las rab 'ja'i mdog ltar bkra ba la sna tshogs rdo rje thogs pa/ bsrung ba ser po go khrab thogs pa/gnod sbyin mthing nag rdo rje mche ba thogs pa/ khu tshur ser po rdo rje'i khu tshur bcangs pa'o/ /lhor bsgyeg mo dkar mo rdo rje dang dril bu thogs pa/ lho nub tu phreng ba ma ser mo me tog gi phreng ba thogs pa/ nub byang du glu mkhan ma dmar mo pi waṃ thogs pa/ byang shar du gar ma ljang khu/ rdo rje dang dril bus gar bsgyur ba/ khyams kyi shar lhor bdug spos ma dkar mo bdug spos thogs pa/lho nub tu me tog ma ser mo me tog thogs pa/ nub byang du mar me ma dmar mo mar me thogs pa/ byang shar du dri chab ma ljang khu dri'i dung chos thogs pa'o/ /'khyams la shar du/ byams pa/ mthong ba don yod/ ngan song kun 'dren mya ngan mun 'joms rnams mi bskyod pa lta bu'o/ /lho phyogs su spos kyi glang po/dpa' bar 'gro ba/ nam mkha' mdzod/ ye shes rtog rnams rin 'byung lta bu'o—/ /nub tu 'od dpag med/ zla 'od gzhon nu bzang skyong / dra ba can gyi 'od rnams ni snang ba mtha' yas lta bu'o/ /byang du rdo rje snying po/ blo gros mi bzad pa/ spobs pa brtsegs pa dang / kun tu bzang po rnams ni/don grub ltar ro/ /yang na bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong byams pa man chod du stong du bzhis ma tshang ba bsgom par bya'o/ /sgo bzhir lcags kyu ma dang /zhags pa ma dang / lcags sgrogs ma dang / 'bebs ma rnams dkar mo dang /ser mo dang / dmar mo/ ljang khur bsgom par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bdag 47—987

pos dbu mtshan pa ni/ rnam snang la sogs pa lnga la ni rnam snang gis so/ /shar phyogs pa rnams la ni mi bskyod pas so/ /lho phyogs pa rnams la ni rin 'byung gis so/ /nub phyogs pa rnams la ni snang ba mtha' yas kyis so/ /byang phyogs pa rnams la ni don grub kyis so/ /der dal rgyal mchog bsgoms nas las rgyal mchog yang bsgoms la/ ye shes pa gzhug /rgyas gdab/dbang bskur ji lta bzhin bsgoms la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma ha yo go shwa ri hūṃ zhes pa ni snying po'o/ /oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ/ zhes pa ni las thams cad pa'i sngags so/ /de nas bstod pa byas la/ dal du bzhugs la dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje dbyings kyi cho ga'i khyad par ro/ /dpal mchog dang po'i dal kyi mngon par rtogs pa ni/ tshogs bsag pa dang 'byung ba rim rtseg bskyed nas/ bye las gzhal yas khang nang gling dgu gru chad la sgo tod pa'i phyi la khyams dang sgo rta babs dang bcas pa'i dbus dkar ba/shar dmar ba/ lho ser/ nub sngo ba/ byang lngang gu'o/ /de ltar bskyed pa'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje thugs khar 'dzin cing dril bu dkur ①brten pa/ rin po che'i brgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'o/ /de'i mdun du rdo rje yid las byung ba sku mdog dmar skya mda' gzhu thogs pa'o/ /g.yas su rdo rje ki la ya dmar skya rdo rje rtse lnga 'dzin pa/nub du rdo rje drag po sngo skya rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon du rdo rje snyems pa ser po phyag gnyis na rdo rje rtse lnga pa re re bsnams pa'o/ /de'i nang gi gra bzhir/shar lhor rab tu dga' ba dmar skya spos khang can/ lho nub tu rab tu dga' 47—988

ba dmar skya me tog gi snod①/ nub byang du rdo rje spyan sngo skya mar me'i sdong bu/byang shar du dpal chen mo ser mo dri'i dung chos so/ /de'i shar dmar po la mi bskyod ②pa dkar po rdo rje rtse lnga dang sa byuganon byas pa'i g.yas g.yon du 'jam dpal dang phyag rdor ral gri dang rdo rje 'dzin pa/ lho ser po la rin chen 'byung ldan sngon po rin po che dang mchog sbyin mdzad pa'i g.yas su nam mkha'i snying po ljang gu rang gi dbu la phreng ba gnyis dbang bskur ba'i tshul du 'ching ba dang /g.yon du nam mkha' mdzod sna tshogs mdog can rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams pa'o//nub tu sngon po la 'od dpag med pa ser po chos kyi phyag rgya'i steng na pad ma bsnams pa'o/ /g.yas su lo ga dbang phyug dmar skya g.yon gyis pad+ma'i sdong bu thugs khar bzung ba g.yas kyis kha 'byed pa lta bu byed pa/ g.yon tu rdo rje 'khor lo ser po 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /byang ljang gu la don yod grub pa sna tshogs pa'i mdog can/ g.yas pa mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgyas sna tshogs rdo rje bsnams pa/ de'i shar lhor g.yas su rdo rje khu tshur ser po rdo rje rtse lnga bsnams pa/g.yon du rdo rje gnod sbyin sngon po/ mche ba gcigs pa'i rdo rje'i gnyis zur du 'dzin pa'o/ /phyi'i gru chad bzhi la sgyeg ma dmar skya phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu rdo rje bzhad pa dmar skya/ me tog gi phreng ba 'dzin pa / nub byang du rdo rje klu chen mo sngo skya pi waṃ 'dzin pa/ byang shar du rdo rje gar ser ba rdo rje dril bus gar byed pa/ phyi nang gi sgo brgyad kyi shar sgo gnyis su—/ rdo rje gzugs dmar skya me long thogs pa/ lho'i sgo gnyis su rdo rje sgra ser skya pi wang bsdung ba/ nub sgo gnyis su rdo rje dri sngo skya dung chos thogs pa/byang sgo gnyis su rdo rje ro ro mchog gi snod thogs pa'o/ /lha de rnams kyang zhi 47—989

zhing sgyeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa bri bar bya'o/ /phyi'i lha rnams la shar du dbang phyug chen po/ tshangs pa/ lha chen po khyab 'jug /kar ti ka /brgya sbyin/gzhon nu rnams rdo rje thogs pa'o/ /lhor nyi ma/ zla ba/ spen pa/ mig dmar—/ lag pa/ phur bu/ pa ba sangs bdun rin chen thogs pa'o/ /nub tu kun tu rgyu/ stobs kyi rgyu/ spyid kyi lha rnam par rgyal ba rab tu rgyal ba/gnod sbyin/ srin po rnams pad ma thogs pa/ byang du gshin rje tshogs kyi bdag po/ chu bdag /me lha/ rigs 'dzin/ sa bdag /lha min rnams rgya gram thogs pa/ bskyed pa'i sa bon ni yi ge hūṃ ngo / /rigs kyi bdag pos dbu mtshan pa ni/ gtso bo la ni mi bskyod pas mtshan pa'o/ /phyogs bzhi'i 'khor rnams la rigs bzhi'o/ /srun drang zhing mchod pa byas pa/rtsa ba'i sngags oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ zhes ci rigs par bzlas la bstod pa byas te dbang bskur ba ni/ dpal mchog dang po'i cho ga'o/ /kun rig rtsa ba'i dal gyi lha bsgom pa'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ tshogs bsag pa sngon du song nas 'byung ba rim brtseg bskyed la/ dal bskyed pa ni bye las gzhal yas khang sgo nang ma la gling dgu/ rtsibs ①bcu drug /gru chad la sgo tod pa 'khyams phyi ma la rim pa gsum sgo sgo brgyan 'khor yug dang bcas pa bskyed la/ nang du lha bsgom pa ni/ dbus su rnam par snang mdzad dkar po chos 'chad mdzad pa/ shar du ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyal po mthing kha sa gnon mdzad pa/ lhor rgyal mchog rin chen ser po mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ nub du shākya rigs dbang ②dmar po mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ byang du me tog cher rgyas 47—990

ljang gu skyabs sbyin mdzad pa/ zur bzhi sangs rgyas spyan ma la sogs pa yum bzhi / rtsibs bcu drug la rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa sems dpa' bcu drug /gru chad bzhi la byeg mo la sogs pa bzhi sgo bzhir sgo ma bzhi'o/ khyams nang ma la byams pa la sogs pa bcu drug /khyams bar ma la nyon mongs mun sel la sogs pa dpe bral gyi sems dpa' bcu drug sku mdog dkar po dang /sngon po dang / dmar po dang / ljang gu dang / phyag mtshan rdo rje dang /rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / rgya gram 'dzin pa'o/ /'khyams phyi ma la sha ri'i bu la sogs pa nyan thos bcu drug /nyan thos kyi cha byad la po ti 'dzin pa dang / nyon mongs 'joms byed la sogs pa rang rgyal bcu gnyis lhung bzed dang bsil byed 'dzin pa'o/ /'tshams bzhi ru bdug sogs bzhi'o/ /sgo bzhi gru brgyad du/ lo ga gsum snang la sogs pa khro bo brgyad sku mdog dkar ba dang / sngo ba dang / dmar ba dang / ljang gu phyag mtshan phrin las 'dzin pa mtshon sna tshogs 'dzin par byed pa skyed la/ rigs kyi bdag po rnams kyis dbu la brgyan pa dang / spyan drang ba dang mchod pas mchod la/ oṃ sarba bid sogs dang / dur ka ti ci rigs par bzlas la bstod pa byas la dbang bskur ba ni kun rig rtsa ba'i cho ga'o/ /gtsug tor dgu'i lha tshogs kyi dal bsgom pa'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/tshogs bsag pa sngon du song nas 'byung ba rim rtseg bskyed la/ lha'i dal bsgom pa ni bye ①las gzhal yang khang / nang 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ lha rnams mu khyud dang bcas pa bskyed nas/ lha bskyed pa ni sum̐ las 'khor lo'i 47—991

dbus su bcom ldan 'das shākya seng ge ser po 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i cha byad chos 'chad byas pa/ shar du rdo rje gtsug tor dkar po sa gnon mdzad pa/ lho phyogs su rin chen gtsug tor sngon po mchod sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ nub du pad+ma'i gtsug tor dmar po ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/ byang du sna tshogs gtsug tor ljang gu skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya can/ shar lhor gtsug tor gzi brjid sku mdog dkar ba la dmar ba'i mdog yod pa/ nyi ma bsnams pa/lho nub du gtsug tor rgyal mtshan dmar nag rgyal mtshan thogs pa/ nub byang du gtsug tor rnon po sngon po ral gri thogs pa/ byang shar du gtsug tor gdugs dkar dkar po gdugs thogs pa/ byeg sogs bzhi dang / bdug sogs bzhi dang / skal bzangs bcu drug dang / sgo bzhi ni sngar ltar ro/ /ye shes pa gzhug pa dang / mchod pa dang / oṃ mu ne+e mu ne+e ma hā mu ne+e ye swā hā/zhes ci rigs par bzlas nas stod pa byas nas dbang bskur ba ni/ gtsug tor chen po dgu'i cho ga'o/ /don thams cad grub pa'i dal gyi mngon par rtogs pa ni/ tshogs bsag pa dang 'byung ba rim rtseg skyed pa sngon du song nas/ 'dir bye las rdo rje dbyings kyi pho brang 'dra ba bskyed la/ lha bskyed pa ni hri las pad+ma/ de la don grub 'od dpag med pa'i rang bzhin can dmar po la rigs bzhi'i 'khor lo sgyur ba bzhis bskor ba/ shar gyi le rtse la don grub mi bskyod pa'i rigs la rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs bzhis bskor ba/ lhor don grub rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rigs la/ rin chen sems dpa' bzhis bskor ba/ nub tu don grub snang ba 47—992

mtha' yas la pad+ma'i sems dpa' la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba/ byang du don yod grub pa la las kyi sems dpa' bzhis bskor ba/ zur bzhi la yum bzhi/lha mo bcu gnyis dang bskal bzang bcu drug bskyed pa rdo rje dbyings lta bu'o/ /spyan drang zhing mchod pa dang / oṃ pad+ma dha ma hri zhes pa'i sngags bzlas la bstod pa byas nas dbang bskur ba ni don thams cad grub pa'i cho ga'o/ /'gro ba 'dul ba'i dal gyi mngon par rtogs pa ni/ tshogs bsag pa dang dal bskyed pa rdo rje dbyings ltar la/ lha bskyed pa ni/ 'gro ba 'dul ba'i rnam snang / rin 'byung gi cha lugs yum bzhi'i rang bzhin 'khor lo bsgyur ba bzhis bskor ba/ phyogs bzhi'i de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi la phyogs phyogs kyi sems dpa' bcu drug gis bskor ba dang / gru bzhir yum bzhi dang / lha mo bcu gnyis dang / skal bzangs bcu drug gong ltar ro/ /spyan drang ba dang / mchod pa dang / oṃ rad na bha dzi ni tram̐/ zhes zlas la/ bstod nas/ dbang bsgur ba ni 'gro ba 'dul ba'i dal gyi cho ga'o/ /khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i dal gyi cho ga'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/tshogs bsag pa dang dal bskyed pa rdo rje dbyings ltar la/ 'di ltar bskyed pa ni/ dbus su hūṃ las khro bo khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba sku mdog nam mkha' ltar sngo ba zhal cig phyag gnyis pa/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'phyar ba/zhabs gnyis g.yas skum pas dbang phyug chen po kha bub ①du mnan pa/ g.yon skyang bas u ma de ba'i nu mar mnan pa'i phyogs bzhi na yum bzhi pho chas su 47—993

bsgyur ba'i 'khor lo bsgyur ba bzhi dang / gru bzhir yum bzhi dang / de'i shar phyogs su mi bskyod pa'i khro bo hūṃ mdzad la/ rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i khro bo sems dpa' bzhis bskor ba/ lho phyogs su rin chen 'byung ldan hūṃ mdzad kyi khro bo la/ rdo rje rin chen la sogs khro bor gyur pa bzhis skor ba dang / nub kyi le rtse la 'od dpag med hūṃ mdzad kyi khro bo la/ pad+ma'i sems dpa'i khro bo bzhi dang /de'i byang du don yod grub pa khro bo hūṃ mdzad la las kyi hūṃ mdzad la sogs pa'i khro bo bzhis bskor ba'o/ /mchod pa'i lha mo bcu gnyis dang / sems dpa' bcu drug gong dang mthun/ 'di rgyud kyang gi lha dgod pa yin/ 'grel pa ltar na lo ga las 'das pa'i lha brgya bcu rtsa lnga la sogs pa'i lha bzhi bcu zhe bzhi ste brgya nyi shu rtsa dgu yod/ spyan drang mchod pa dbul/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā yo gi shwa ri badz+ra pā ni hūṃ/ zhes ci rigs par zlas la/ bstod pa byas nas dbang bskur ba ni khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi cho ga bya ba'i rim pa'o/ /tshe dpag tu med pa gsung gi dkyil 'khor gyi mngon par rtogs pa ni/tshogs bsag pa dang 'byung ba rim rtseg bskyed pa sngar bstan pa bzhin la/'dir bye las 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi gru chad sgo dang bcas pa babyed la/ lha bskyed pa ni/ dbus su hri las tshe dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar po ①phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag ②byas pa'i phyag mthil du che'i bum pa 'dzin pa la/ rtsibs bzhi la rnam snang nub du byas pa'i rigs bzhis bskor ba/ mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang sgo ma bzhi ste bcu gsum mo/ /spyan drang mchod pa byas la/ oṃ pu ne+e pu ne+e oṃ pudhi pusnyu ma hā puṣ+yo a pa ra mi ta a yu pubye dzñā na saṃ bha ro bha chu swā hā/ zhes pa'i zlas pa 47—994

byas la bstod pa byas nas dbang bskur ba ni tshe dpag tu med pa'o/ /bde ba chen po'i yon tan gyi dkyil 'khor gyi mngon par rtogs pa ni/tshogs stsog pa dang 'byung ba rim rtseg skyed pa sngar ltar la/ 'di'i pho brang bskyed pa ni/ hūṃ las 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi 'khyams rim pa brgyad/ sgo dang bcas pa bskyed la/ lha bskyed pa ni dbus su hūṃ las badz+ra pā ①ṇi/ rtsibs bzhi la rigs bzhi/ gru chad bzhi la lha mo bzhi/ 'khyams dang po la sangs rgyas rabs bdun/ gnyis pa la sems dpa' bcu drug /gsum pa la bskal bzang bcu drug /bzhi pa la nyan thos bcu drug dang rang rgyal bcu gnyis/lnga pa la lha brgyad chung ma dang bcas pa/ drug pa la gza' brgyad rgyu skar dang bcas pa/ bdun pa la rgyal po bzhi/ phyogs skyong dang bcas pa/ brgyad pa la rigs drug gam bzhi/ sgo bzhir sgo ba bzhi'o/ /rigs kyi bdag po lngas dbu la mtshan pa dang / spyan drangs/ mchod pa byas la/ oṃ badz+ra tsan dha ma hā ro sha na hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes bsnyen pa bskyal la/ bstod pa byas nas dbang bskur ba ni/ bde ba chen po yon tan gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'o/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lha sum cu so gnyis 'phags pa yab sras kyi lugs kyi mngon par rtogs pa bsgom pa ni/ tshogs stsog sngon du song nas 'byung ba rim rtseg bskyed la/ bye las pho brang re dmig dgu pa las/ khyams ①sgo khyud dang bcas pa bsams la/ nyi zla pad+ma'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje de las mi bskyod pa sku mdog mthing kha nam mkha' lta bu/ zhal gsum kyi g.yas dkar ba/47—995

g.yon dmar ba/ phyag drug gi g.yas dang po na rdo rje/ bar ma na 'khor lo/tha ma na pad+ma/ g.yon gyi dang po na dril bu/ bar ma na nor bu/ tha ma na ral gri/ rang dang 'dra ba'i reg bya rdo rje ma la 'a da pa'o/ /shar phyogs su rnam par snang mdzad dkar po/ nag po dang dmar ba'i zhal/ 'khor lo rdo rje pad+ma dang / dril bu nor bu ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor rin chen 'byung ldan ser ba dang nag pa dang dkar ba'i zhal g.yas kyis rin po che rdo rje 'khor lo/g.yon pas dril bu dang pad+ma ral gri/ nub tu 'od dpag med dmar po g.yas nag pa g.yon dkar ba/ phyag g.yon pa dril bu dang bcas pa'i pad+ma dmar po thugs khar yu ba bzung ba/ g.yas pas kha 'byed pa/ g.yas g.yon gzhan bzhi pos rdo rje dang / 'khor lo dang / ral gri dang rin po che 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du don grub ljang gu g.yas nag /g.yon dmar ba/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang ral gri dang 'khor lo/ dril bu dang pad+ma nor bu'o/ /yum bzhi la shar lho mtshams kyi sangs rgyas spyan ni/ dkar mo g.yas nag cing g.yon dmar ba/phyag drug gi dang po gnyis na 'khor lo dang dril bu/ bar ma gnyis na rdo rje dang rin po che/ 'og ma gnyis na ud pal dang ral gri/ lho nub tu ma ma ki sku mdog ser mo g.yas dkar g.yon dmar phyag dang po gnyis kyis rin po che dang dril bu/ bar ma gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang rin po che tha ma gnyis ud pal dang ral gri/ nub byang gi gos dkar mo dmar mo zhal g.yas nag g.yon dkar ba'o/ /phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis ud pal dang dril bu gnyis pa na nor bu dang rdo rje/ gsum pa na 'khor lo dang ral gri'o/ /byang shar mtshadas kyi sgol ma ni ljang khu g.yas nag g.yon dkar po/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis sna 47—996

tshogs rdo rje dang dril bu/ gnyis pa na 'khor lo dang rin po che/ gsum pa na ud pal dang ral gri'o/ /shar lho'i gru chad la lha mo gzugs rdo rje ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal g.yas nag g.yon dmar/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis me long / lhag ma bzhi sangs rgyas spyan dang mtshungs so/ /lho nub tu sgra rdo rje ma ser mo g.yas nag g.yon dmar mo/ phyag dang po gnyis pi waṃ 'dzin pa/lhag ma bzhi ma ma ki dang mtshungs so/ /nub byang gi dri rdo rje ma kha dog dmar mo g.yas nag g.yon dkar/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis dung chos 'dzin pa/ lhag ma bzhi gos dkar mo dang mtshungs so/ /byang shar du ro rdo rje ma ljang khu g.yas dkar g.yon dmar/ phyag dang po gnyis ro mchog gi snod la/ phyag lhag ma bzhi / sgol ma dang mtshungs so/ /lha mo reg bya rdo rje ni gzhal yas khang gi dbus ①na gtso bo la 'khril zhing phyag mtshan sku mdog gcig pa'o/ /rim pa gsum la lha rnam la byang chub sems dpa' brgyad bsam pa ni shar du byams pa dang sa'i snying po/ lhor phyag rdor dang nam mkha'i snying po/ nub tu spyan ras gzigs dang 'jam dpal/ byang du sgrib sel dang kun bzang / brgyad po sku mdog phyag mtshan rigs bzhi dang 'thun pa'o/ /khyams kyi sgo bzhi dang zur bzhi ste/ steng 'og shar nub tu/ khro bo bcu bsgom pa ni/ shar sgor gshin rje gshed sku mdog nag po/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba phyag drug gi dang po na tho ba dang sdogs mdzub bar ma na 'khor lo dang dril bu/ tha ma rdo rje dang ral gri/ lhor gzhan gyis mi thub pa dkar po/ g.yas nag g.yon dmar po/phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rin po che dang sdigs mdzub kyis zhags pa/ bar ma gnyis dbyug pa dang dril bu/ tha ma gnyis ral gri dang dgra sta/ nub kyi rta 47—997

mgrin mdog dmar po g.yas nag g.yon dkar po/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis pad+ma dang dril bu/ bar ma gnyis ral gri dang dgra sta/ tha ma gnyis na gtun ①shing dang zhags pa'o/ /byang gi bdud rtsi 'khyil pa kha dog ljang khu/ zhal g.yas dmar g.yon dkar po/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis sna tshogs rdo rje dang sdogs mdzub—/ gnyis pa na 'khor lo dang zhags pa/ tha ma gnyis na gtun sdeshing dang dgra sta/ shar lho mtshalas kyi mi g.yo ba sngo nag g.yas dmar g.yon dkar/phyag drug gi dang po gnyis ral gri dang sdigs mdzub/ gnyis pa na rdo rje dang dgra sta/ gsum pa na 'khor lo dang zhags pa'o/ /lho nub mtshalas su 'dod pa'i rgyal po nag po g.yas dmar g.yon dkar po'o/ /phyag drug gi dang po gnyis ni the'u chung bgreng zhing mdzub mo bsgreng ba'o/ /bar ma gnyis rdo rje dang zhags pa/ 'og ma na ral gri dang lcags kyu/ nub byang gi dbyug sngon can sngon po g.yas dmar g.yon dkar po/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis na dbyug pa dang sdigs mdzub bar ma gnyis na ral gri dāng dril bu 'og ma gnyis na 'khor lo dang dgra sta/ byang shar kyi stobs po che ni/ ud pal sngon po'i mdog 'dra ba/g.yas dmar g.yon dkar ba/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis na dbyug pa dang sdigs mdzub/ gnyis pa na ral gri dang zhags pa/ gsum pa na 'khor lo dang dgra sta/ steng gi gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba sku mdog sngo nag g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis spyi bor gtsug tor 'dzin pa/bar ma rdo rje dang spyigs mdzub/ tha ma pad+ma dang ral gri/ 'og gi gnod mdzes nag po g.yas dmar g.yon dkar phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang zhags pa/ bar ma gnyis na 'khor lo dang pad+ma/ gsum pa na rin chen 47—998

dang ral gri/ zhal dbus ma thams cad mche ba bcigs pa/ g.yas pa thams cad hūṃ gi sgra sgogs g.yon pa thams cad lce 'dril zhing 'jigs su rung ba'i mtshan nyid can no/ /thod pa'i dbu rgyan ①dang / stag gi sham thabs dang / yan lag rnams sbrul gyis brgyan par bsam mo/ /zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba la/ so so'i rigs kyis dbu brgyan par bsam mo/ /de nas spyan drangs la mchod pa dang ⑧bzlas pa bya ba ni/ mi bskyod pa'i thugs khar ye shes sems dpa' phyag gnyis pa dmar po yum dang bcas pa'o/ /de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ de'i lte bar phra mo'i ting 'dzin hūṃ mthing kha/ de bzhin du rigs bzhi la oṃ swa saṃ ha'o/ /yum bzhi la mo lo lta ṭ+wāṃ bzhi'o/ /reg rdo rje ma la sum̐ dang gzhan bzhi la dza hūṃ baṃ ho bzhi'o/ /byams pa la sogs pa brgyad la mā zlo oṃ oṃ hūṃ slos ④e brgyad do/ /khro bo bcu ni hūṃ ngo de nas lha so so'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad la phog de rnams kyi sdig pa byang / de byang chub sems dpa' dang 'dra bar byas nas rjogazhal yas khang gi nang du bcug pas/ lha rnams kyi zhal mthong bas ⑤rgyud dag par bsam pa ni/ lhag par mos pa'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /snying po'i sngags oṃ badz+ra d+ma kṛ rjoswā hā/ zhes ci rigs par bzlas pa ni bsnyen ⑦pa dang bstod pa byas nas dkyil 'khor du gzhug cing dbang bskur ba ni/gsang 'dus 'phags pa yab sras kyi lugs la sogs ⑧gnyis pa'o/ /ye shes zhabs kyi lha bcu dgu'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ sngon 'gro tshogs bsag pa nas/ dngos gzhi 'byung ba rim rtseg bskyed ⑨pa sngar ltar la/47—999

'dir gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni/ bye las nang le rtse dgu la phyi rnams sgo dang bcas pa skyed la/ nang du lha babyed pa ni/ dbus su hūṃ las rdo rje/ de la rdo rje sems dpa' 'jam dbyangs kyi tshul can sku mdog gur gum lta bu dmar ser g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal nag po dang dmar po rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thogs nas rang dang 'dra ba'i shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ 'og ma bzhi mda' gzhu dang ral gri ud pal 'dzin pa'o/ /rin po che'i cod pan dang rgyan ①sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ de'i shar phyogs su rnam par snang mdzad dkar po g.yas g.yon zhal nag pa dang dmar po/ phyag g.yas g.yon 'khor lo dang rdo rje dang ral gri dang / dril bu dang / nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /lho phyogs su rin chen 'byung ldan ser po rin po che dang / rdo rje dang / ral gri dang / dril bu dang / 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu snang ba mtha' yas dmar po pad+ma dang rdo rje dang / ral gri/ dril bu/ nor bu/'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du don swod grub pa ljang khu rgya gram/ ral gri/'khor lo/ dril bu/ nor bu/ pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /rnam pa gsum po 'di dag ni zhal g.yas g.yon nag pa dang dkar po'o/ /rin po che'i rgyan ②ni sngar ltar ro/ /shar lho ru sangs rgyas spyan rnam snang dang 'dra ba/ srin por ma ma ki mi bskyod pa 'dra ba⑧/ rlung mtshalas su gos dkar mo snang ba mtha' yas lta bu'o—/ /dbang ldan du sgol ma rin 'byung lta bu'o/ /phyag dang po na rang dang 'dra ba'i ud pal dang nor bu dang / bar ma na rdo rje dril bu dang / tha ma ni nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /de ltar bsgom pa ni bsgrub thabs las de ltar bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /shar lhor gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rdo rje dang dril 47—1000

bu dang ud pal dang / ral gri dang / nor bu dang / pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /lho nub tu sgra rdo rje ma mthing kha rdo rje dang dril bu dang pi waṃ dang ral gri dang nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /nub byang du dri rdo rje ma ser mo/ rdo rje dril bu dang dung chos dang ral gri 'khor lo dang / pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /byang shar du ro rdo rje ma dmar mo rdo rje dang dril bu zhal zas ral gri nor bu 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /shar nub gnyis su reg rdo rje ma ljang khu rdo rje dril bu dang gos sna tshogs dang /ral gri dang nor bu dang / pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /chos dbyings rdo rje ma dkar mo chos 'byung dang rdo rje dril bu ral gri nor bu pad ma 'dzin pa'o/ /lha bco lnga pa'i 'di ni dkyil krung gis bzhugs pa la phyag drug gi dang po gnyis thugs khar yum la 'khyud pa'i tshul de/ de yang pho rnams mo la 'khyud pa/ mo rnams pho la 'khyud pa'i tshul lo/ /sgo bzhir gshin rje gshed dang ①shes rab mthar byed/pad+ma mthar byed/ bgegs mthar byed/ bzhi ni bzhengs nas/ g.yas bskum—/ g.yon bskyang ba'o/ /rigs kyi bdag pos dbu la mtshan pa ni/'jam pa'i rdo rje la mi bskyod pas so/ /gzhan 'khor rnams la shar nas brtsams te rigs bzhis so/ /spyan drangs la mchod pa dang bzlas pa bya ba ni/'jam pa'i rdo rje'i thugs kar rang dang 'dra ba'i sems dpa'/ de'i thugs khar ral gri'i yu ba la sa bon sum̐ḥ④bsam mo/ /rigs bzhi la thugs kar bye e dzi khaṃ las zla ba/ de'i thugs khar rang 'dra ba'i sems dpa' lha mo rnams la ni/ lo oṃ paṃ lta dza hūṃ baṃ ho khaṃ re rnams so/ /khro bo bzhi la hūṃ ngo / /snying po'i sngags ni/oṃ ā sum̐ hūṃ zhes so/ /'khor gyi snying po 'dir ma bris so/ /sngags ci rigs par bzlas la bstod ④pa byas la dbang bskur ba ni/ ye shes zhabs kyi'o/ /47—1001

rdo rje hūṃ mdzad gsang 'dus khro bo bcus skor ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/tshogs stsog pa dang 'byung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa sngar ltar la/ 'dir bye ①las 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa sgo dang bcas pa bskyed la/ de'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ②ba/ sku mdog mthing kha/ zhal g.yas dkar ba/ g.yon dmar ba/ phyag drug gis rdo rje 'khor lo/ rin po che/ dril bu pad ma ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /rang 'od kyi rig ma ④rang ci 'dra ba la 'khyud pa/ 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa'i steng du phyogs skyong chen po bcu bsgyel ba'i gdan stengs su shar du gshin rje gshed po/ lhor gzhan gyi rjomi thub pa/ nub tu rta mgrin/byang du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ shar lhor mi g.yo ba/ lho nub tu 'dod pa'i rgyal po—/ nub byang du dbyug sngon can/ byang shar du stobs po che/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba/ 'og tu gnod ⑤mdzes 'phags skor ltar ro/ /lha mo bzhi dang 'di brgyad med kyang 'gal ba med sgo ma bzhi ni khro mo'i tshugs can no/ /thugs ka'i sa bon ni hūṃ ngo / /spyan drangs la mchod pa bya ba ni/ /bzlas rjopa bya ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra be+eka ⑦badz+ra hūṃ ka ra badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes bya ba ni rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi snying po'i sngags so/ /las thams cad pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra kun dha li hūṃ phaṭa zhes so/ /bstod pa byas la dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi'o/ /'jam dpal dgra nag lha bcu gsum ma'i mngon par rtogs pa ni tshogs bsag pa dang 'byung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa sngar ltar la/ 'dir bye las 47—1002

pho brang gling dgu gru chad la sgo btod pa can byas la/ brten pa lha ①bskyed pa ni—/ nyi zla pad+ma'i steng du gshin rje khyab 'jug pho mo bsgyel ba'i steng du/ ma he de'i steng du thig le/ de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje de yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal dgra nag sku mdog dang rtsa zhal mthing kha g.yas dkar ba/ g.yon dmar ba/ g.yas dang po rdo rje/ gnyis pa na ral gri/gsum pa na gri gug go/ /g.yon dang po na 'khor lo gnyis pa na pad+ma/ gsum pa na thod pa thogs pas rang 'od la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum pas gshin rje pho mo dang ma he'i mgo gnan pa'o/ /g.yon brkyang bas ma te'i tshang stegs su ④mnan pa/ zhabs bsgrad ④pa/ mche ba gcigs pa/ spyan dgu dmar ba/ stag gi lpags pas smad dkris pa/ zhing lpags se ral khar bcings pa/ glang po'i sko zlon/ thod pa'i phreng ba dang / skam po'i dbu rgyan rjobyas pa/ sbrul rigs lngas dbu la brgyan pa'o/ /shar du e dzi na dzika⑤/zhes pas gti mug gshin rje gshed dkar po/ g.yas sngo g.yon dmar ba/phyag g.yas gsum na rdo rje 'khor lo/ ral gri/ g.yon na thod pa dang / rin po che dang pad+ma/ lho phyogs su rad na dh+rika dhices pas ser sna gshin rje gshed ⑦ser po/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dkar po'o/ /phyag g.yas na rdo rje dang rin po che dang ral gri dang / g.yon na thod pa dang 'khor lo pad+ma/ nub tu a ro lika ⑧ces/ 'dod chags gshin rje gshed sku dang rtsa zhal dmar po/ g.yas sngo ba g.yon dkar ba/ phyag g.yas na rdo rje dang pad+ma ral gri/ g.yon na thod pa 'khor lo rin po che'o/ /byang du pradzha z-ig ⑨ces pas phrag dog gshin rje gshed ljang khu/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dkar ba/ g.yas na rdo rje/ ral gri rgya 47—1003

gram—/ g.yon na thod pa 'khor lo pad+ma bsnams pa'o/ /zur bzhi la thod pa byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba bzhi'o/ /mud kar dh+rig ①ces pas shar sgor tho ba—/ gshin rje gshed sngon po/ g.yas dkar ba/ g.yon dmar ba/ rdo rje tho ba ral gri/ g.yon na thod pa 'khor lo pad+ma bsnams pa'o/ /oṃ dha dha j-ika ④ces pas lho sgor be con gshin rje gshed/ dkar po g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar ba/ rdo rje be+e con ral gri dang / thod pa 'khor lo pad+ma'o/ /oṃ pad+ma byeg ④ces pas/ nub sgor pad+ma gshin rje gshed dmar po/ g.yas dkar g.yon sngo ba/ phyag na rdo rje pad+ma ral gri dang / thod pa 'khor lo rin chen no//ā+oṃ khad kha dh+rig rjoces pas byang sgor ral gri gshin rje gshed ljang khu/ g.yas sngo/g.yon dkar ba/ rdo rje ral gri rgya gram thod pa 'khor lo pad+ma'o/ /ā+oṃ ma ha ra ti rjozhes shar lhor rdo rje tsar tsi ka dkar mo g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar ba/ gri gug 'khor lo/ ral gri thod pa/ rin chen pad+ma/ oṃ te ṣa rjor ti ces pas phag mo sngon mo dkar ba dang dmar ba/ gri gug rin chen/ ral gri thod pa 'khor lo/ pad+ma ra ga ra ti ces pas/ nub byang du dbyangs can ma/dmar mo g.yas sngo g.yon dkar ba/ gri gug pad ma ral gri/ thod pa 'khor lo rin po che/ badz+ra ra ti ces pas byang shar du mdzod ldan ma sku dang rtsa zhal ljang khu/ g.yas sngo g.yon dkar ba/ gri gug /ud pal rdo rje/ thod pa 'khor lo pad+ma/ rtsa phyag thams cad rang 'dra ba'i rig ma la 'khyud pa/ khro bo'i rgyan kyis brgyan pa'o/ /thugs khar ye shes sems dpa' rang dang 'dra ba re re/ de'i thugs khar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje/ rdo rje'i lte ba la phra mo'i ting nge 'dzin hūṃ re re/ de la skar+ṣaṣ+ṭiḥblu kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa snga hā bcu bzhi hriṣ+ṭi 47—1004

bskor bar bsam zhing / spyan drang ba dang / mchod pa dang bzlas pa dang bstod pa byas nas dbang bskur ba ni gshin rje gshed dgra nag gi rim pa'o/ /'jam dpal gdong drug gi mngon par rtogs pa ni/ tshogs stsog pa dang 'byung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa sngon du song nas/ dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni bye las 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa bskyed la/ der brten ①pa lha bskyed pa ni/nyi zla pad+ma'i steng du ya las gshin rje dang tsa mun tri ④gnyis bsnol ba'i steng du/du las ma he/ de'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje/ de las 'jam dpal gshin rje gdong drug pa/ zhabs drug pa/ sku mdog dug ha la ha la'i mdog ltar nag pa—/ rtsa zhal de dang mtshungs pa la zhal gzhan ni/ dkar ba dang ser ba dang dmar ba dang ljang khu dang steng zhal nam mkha' ltar sngo ba'o/ /phyag drug gis ①g.yas dang po na rdo rje tho ba/ bar ma na ral gri/ tha ma na rdo rje/g.yon gyi dang po na zhags pa sdigs mdzub/ gnyis pa na gtun rjoshing gsum pa na dril bu/ zhabs drug gi gnyis pa rdo rje'i dkyil dkrungs gnyis thabs dang shes rab kyi brkyang bskum ⑤gnyis gyad kyi dor thabs so/ /seng ge'i stod g.yogs dang / stag lpags kyi sham thabs gsol ba/ dbu skra gyen du 'bar zhing thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ klu rigs bzhis yan lag brgyan pa'o/ /shar gyi rtsibs la gti mug gshin rje gshed dkar po/ 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor ser sna gshin rje gshed/ ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa'o—/ /nub tu 'dod chags gshin rje gshed pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa dmar porka/ byang du phrag dog gshin rje gshed ljang khu sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram dang dril 47—1005

bu 'dzin pa/ mtshams bzhir sa rdo rje ma dkar mo/ me rdo rje ma ser mo/ chu rdo rje ma dmar mo/ rlung rdo rje ma ljang khu'o/ /'khor lo dang rin po che dang /pad+ma dang sna tshogs rdo rje thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /gru bzhir sgeg mo dkar mo dang phreng ba ma ser mo dang glu ma dmar mo dang / gar ma ljang khu'o/ /gru chad bzhir bdug spos ma dkar mo dang / me tog ma ser mo dang / dri chab ma ljang khu'o/ /sgo bzhir tho ba gshin rje gshed dkar po dang / be con gshin rje gshed ser po dang / pad+ma gshin rje gshed dmar po dang / ral gri gshin rje gshed ljang khu'o/ /thugs kha'i sa bon ni hri'o/ /snying po'i sngags ni bcubazhi pashriṣ+ṭi'o/ /spyan drangs mchod pa phul nas bzlas pa byas nas bstod cing dbang bskur ba ni 'jam dpal gdong drug gi cho ga yin no // //①'jam dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/tshogs bsag pa dang 'byung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa sngar ltar la/ de'i steng du bye las gzhal yas 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i phyogs la sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ gru chad la sgo btod pa bsgoms la/ de la lha bskyed pa ni paṃ las pad+ma'i steng du ma dmarahe glang dgod/ de'i steng du hūṃ dmar po las dbyug to hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las khro bo gshin rje gshed dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa sku mdog dmar po byi ru bcag pa 'dra ba/ phyag g.yas na khams gsum 'joms pa'i dbyug to dkar po/ phyag g.yon na bdud kyi khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa/ zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum du bzhugs pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ spyan gsum dmar ba/ mche ba gcigs pa/ sku sha rgyas pa/ stag gi sham thabs 47—1006
