can—/ glang po che'i ko rlon gsol ba/ thod pa lnga bcu'i phreng ba byas pa/yum rdo rje ro langs dmaram zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas kyis gri gug bzung nas sku la 'khyud pa/ g.yon gyis thod pa khrag gis bskang ba zhal du stobs ①pa/shar du gti mug gshin rje gshed dkar po/ 'khor lo dang dril bu bsnams pa la yum badz+ra tsar tsi kas ②naga'akhyud pa'i phyag gis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa lhor ser sna gshin rje gshed ser po rin po che dang dril bu thogs pa/ yum phag mo gri gug dang thod pa thogs pa/ nub tu 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu thogs pa la/ yum dbyangs can ma gri gug dang thod pa thogs pa/ byang du phrag dog gshin rje gshed ljang khu sna tshogs rdo rje dang dril bu thogs pa la yum gho ri ma ljang khu gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /gru chad bzhi la bum pa bzhi'i steng du thod pas mtshan pa/ sgo bzhi la shar du ya ma ra tsa dkar po g.yas na rdo rje tho ba/ lho ru ya me do tsa ser po dbyug to thogs pa/nub tu ya da ①yo ni dmar po dgra sta thogs pa/ byang du yak+ṣe ya tsa ljang khu ral gri thogs pa la g.yon thams cad sdigs mdzub gdengs pa'o/ /de dag thams cad kyi thugs khar phyag mtshan de'i lte ba la hūṃ/ de la hriḥṣ+ṭis saṃ ⑦bskor bar bsams la/ bcubazhi pa/ spyan drang ba dang mchod pa dang / bzlas pa dang bstod pa byas nas dbang bskur ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po'i mngon par rtogs pa'i cho ga'o/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi mngon par rtogs pa ni/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang / tshogs bsag pa dang 'byung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa sngon du song 47—1007

nas—/ 'dir bye las pho brang gling dgu gnyis bco brgyad sgo rta babs dur khrod rdo rje me ri dang bcas pa bskyed la/ lha bskyed pa ni nyi zla pad+ma'i steng du byol song chen po bcu drug bsnol ba'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje/ bcom ldan 'das dzhai ra ba chen po zhal dgu phyag sum cu so gnyis zhabs bcu drug pa mi mgo'i phreng ba dang / gcer bu mtshan ma gyen du 'greng ba/ zhal dgu ni rtsa zhal ma he g.yas pa gsum dkar po dang mthing kha ljang khu/ g.yon gyi gsum na dmar po nag po dud kha'o/ /rwa ①bar gyi zhal dmar ba steng zhal ser po'o/ /phyag sum cu so gnyis kyi dang po gnyis kyis glang po che'i lpags pa 'dzin pa/ de nas g.yas kyi bco lnga'i dang po ni gri gug /gnyis pa na mtshon rtse gcig pa/gsum pa na gtun ④shing / bzhi pa na chu gri/ lnga pa na cug gzang ces bya rdo rje rtse gcig pa'o/ /drug pa na sta re/ bdun pa na mdung / brgyad pa na mda'—/ dgu pa na lcags kyu/ bcu pa na dbyug to/ bcu cig pa na kha ṭaṃ kha/bcu gnyis pa na 'khor lo/ bcu gsum pa na rdo rje tho ba/ bcu bzhi pa na ral gri/ bco lnga pa na rnge chung ngo / /g.yon gyi bco lnga'i dang po na ka pā ①la/gnyis pa na tshangs mgo/ gsum pa na phub/ bzhi pa na mi rkang / lnga pa na zhags pa/ drug pa na rgyu ma/ bdun pa na dril bu/ brgyad pa na lag pa/dgu pa na dur khrod kyi ras/ bcu pa na skyes bu gsal shing la btsugs pa/bcu gcig pa na me thab/ bcu gnyis pa na thod tshal/ bcu gsum pa na sdigs mdzub/ bcu bzhi pa na 'phan rtse gsum/ bco lnga pa na rlung gis ④ras so/ /zhabs g.yas brgyad kyis mi dang ma he dang glang dang / bung bu dang / rnga mo dang / khyi dang / lug dang wa rnams brdzis pa'o/ /g.yon 47—1008

pa brgyad kyis bya rgod dang / 'ug pa dang / bya rog dang / de tsho dang /khra dang / khyung dang / ri skegs/ bzhad rnams brdzis pa'o/ /sgo bzhir shar phyogs su gshin rje lcags kyu ma mthing nag /gri dang thod pa 'dzin cing rma bya la chibs pa/ lho sgor gshin rje zhags pa ma gri dang thod pa thogs pa sbrul la chibs pa/ nub du gshin rje lcags sgrog ma gri dang thod pa 'dzin cing mthing ①ril la chibs pa/ byang phyogs su gshin rje 'be+ebs ma nag mo gri dang thod pa thogs nas kang ka mchu rings la chibs pa'o/ /shar lhor gshin rje dus mtshan ma nag mo gri dang thod pa/ chibs su bya rog chibs pa'o/ /lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo nag mo gri dang thod pa bya rgod chibs pa'o/ /nub byang du mche ba can gri dang thod pa 'ug pa la chibs pa'o/ /byang shar du gshin rje be con ma gri dang thod pa gsod byed chen mo khra la chibs pa/ de ltar bsams pa'i thugs khar a las nyi ma'i dal gyi steng du bzlas pa'i yi ge bsgoms la/ de las 'od 'phros pas ye shes pa spyan drangs la gnyis su med par bstem la char+ṣajiḥblukṛ twa na na hūṃ phaṭa/ bcu pa bzlas pa byas nas bstod pa byas pa 1la dbang bskur ba ni 'jigs byed kyi cho ga'o/ /bai skero tsa na rak+shi ta'i 'jigs byed yab yum lha bco brgyad kyi mngon par rtogs rjopa ni/ tshogs bsag pa dang 'byung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa sngar ltar la/ 'dir gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni/ bye las pho brang gru bzhi sgo bzhi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa bskyed la/ de ltar bskyed pa ni nyi zla pad+ma sems can gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje/ de las 'jigs byed badz+ra bī ra pa/ dbu dgu phyag sum cu so bzhi zhabs bcu drug /sku mdog nag po la rtsa zhal ma he'i zhal nag po/47—1009

steng gi zhal srin po'i zhal dmar po khrag 'dzag pa la/ gsum pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i zhal ser po yid tsam khro ba'o/ /rā'i ①g.yas phyogs kyi zhal gsum dang po sngon po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa ser po'o/ /g.yon gyi zhal gsum gyi dang po dkar po/ gnyis pa dud kha/ gsum pa ljang khu'o/ /zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ ral pa thams cad 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dbu'i steng na thor cog byas pa'o/ /phyag sum cu so bzhi'i dang po ni/ rtog 1pa bzhi par ①rdo rje bshad/ rtog rjopa lnga pa na bsgrub thabs sbyin sreg ⑤nas gri gug bshad de/ de mi 'gal bla ma pasgri tas bla ma chen po la dris pas de mi 'gal te/ slob dpon pad+ma'i thang sku la rdo rje yod pas rdo rje yang yin gsungs te—/ rigs pa'i dbang du byas na g.yon gyi dang po na thod pa yod pas/g.yas dang po na gri gug bsnams par rigs gsung bas/ g.yas g.yon dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa bsnams rjonas yum la 'khyud pa/ gnyis pa glang po che'i lpags pa brgyangs nas 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na mtshon rtse gcig pa/ bzhi pa na gtun ⑦shing / lnga pa na rdo rje⑧/ drug pa na rdo rje rtse gcig /bdun pa na sta re brgyad pa na mdung thung / dgu pa na mda'/bcu pa na lcags kyu/ bcu gcig pa na dbyug tho/ bcu gnyis pa na kha ṭī kha/bcu gsum pa na 'khor lo/ bcu bzhi pa na rdo rje/ bco lnga pa na tho ba/bcu drug pa na ral gri/ bcu bdun pa na cang te'u bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon kyi gsum pa na tshangs mgo /bzhi pa na phub/ lnga pa na rkang pa/ drug pa na zhags pa/ bdun pa na gzhu/ brgyad pas rgyu ma/ dgu pas dril bu/bcu pas lag pa/ bcu gcig pa dur khrod kyi ras/ bcu gnyis pa gsal 47—1010

shing la btsugs pa/ bcu gsum pas me thab/ bcu bzhi pas thod tshal/bco lnga pas shrīgs 'dzub/ bcu drug pas 'phan rtse gsum pa/ bcu bdun pas rlung gis 'phyar ba'i ras bsnams pa'o/ /zhabs bcu drug gi g.yas brgyad bskums pa'i dang pos mi/ gnyis pas ma te/ gsum pas glang / bzhi pas bung bu/ lnga pas rnga mo/ drug pas khyi/ bdun pas lug /brgyad pas wa gnan pa'o/ /g.yon brgyad brkyang ba'i dang pos bya rgod/ gnyis pas 'ug pa/ gsum pas bya rog /bzhi pas ne+e tsho/ lnga pas khra/ drug pas khyung / bdun pas shaṃ ka /brgyad pas bzhad mnan ①pa'o/ /zhabs g.yas kyi byol song brgyad kyis brgya byen dang tshangs pa gnan pa/ g.yon gyi 'dab chags brgyad kyis dbang phyug chen po dang gzhon nu khyab 'jug gnan pa'o//yum rdo rje bdag med mas gri gug dang thod pa thogs pas sku la 'khril ba/ dur khrod kyi chas dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad la shar du gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po mdog nag po dbyug tho dang rgyu zhags 'dzin pa/ mgo dgu rkang cig ma yab dang sku mdog phyag mtshan 'thun pa sku la 'khril ba/ ma he sngon po la chibs pa'o/ /shar lhor rtel ba nag po/ dbyug tho dang thod pa thogs pa/khro mo phag mo sku mdog rang dang 'dra ba sku la 'khril ba/ rnga mo nag mo la chibs pa'o—/ /lhor a ba glang mgo/ dud kha lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa/gshin rje kha rgya ma rang 'dra ba sku la 'khril ba dre rta rkang gsum chibs pa/ lho nub du ya wa ②ti nag po ral gri dang zhags pa thogs pa/ nag mo chen mo shel mig ma sku la 'khril ba chu glang sngon po la chibs pa'o/ /nub tu gshin rje mig dmar dmar po ral gri dang thod pa thogs pa la/ lag rgya chen mo sku la 'khril 47—1011

ba lug la chibs pa'o/ /nub byang du phya sangs dkar po ①la nag pa'i mdangs yod pa tri shul dang zhags pa thogs pa a sham ma sku la 'khril ba bdud sha nag mo chibs pa'o/ /byang du rmig ②pa ljang nag thod dbyug dang zhags pa/ nag mo chen mo sku la 'khril ba bra nag rting dkar la chibs pa'o/ /byang shar du ral pa tshar dgu nag po thod dbyug dang zhags pa dmar po bsnams pa'o/ /ma mo nag mo sku la 'khril ba/ ma he sngo nag la chibs pa'o/ /gru chad bzhi dang sgo bzhir sgeg sogs bzhi dang sgo ma bzhi khro mo'i cha lugs can no/ /spyan drang ba dang bzlas pa bcubazhi pabya ba ni hri tri'o/ /bstod pa byas nas dbang bskur ba ni 'jigs byed hai ra ba'i ④cho ga'o// //'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/tshogs bsag pa dang 'byung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa sngon du song nas/'dir bye las mthing nag gru gsum rtsibs brgyad pa bskyed la/ lha bskyed pa ni nyi zla pad+ma'i steng du paṃ las ro langs ma las ma he/ hūṃ las gri gug de rjolas rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa sku mdog dug ha la ha la ltar nag pa/ma he'i zhal mche ba gcigs shing gdangs pa rwa'i ⑤phrag tu 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i zhal gyis brgyan pa/ g.yas kyis gri gug /g.yon gyis thod pa khrag gis bskang ba bsnams pa/ zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum rjol dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa'o/ /snying khar nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ yig go/ /'khor babyed pa ni/shar sgor gshin rje ya ba ti dkar po lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o/ /lho'i sgor chos rgyal ser po zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /nub sgor rtel ba dmar po lcags sgog thogs 47—1012

pa'o—/ /byang sgor a ba glang mgo ljang khu dril bu thogs pa'o/ /shar lhor gshin rje rmig ①pa dkar ser zhing gi dbyug pa thogs pa'o/ /lho nub du phya ②sangs dmar po rdo rje rtse gsum thogs pa'o/ /nub byang du mig dmar dmar ljang sru gri thogs pa'o/ /byang shar du ral pa tshar dgu ljang dkar 'khor lo thogs pa'o—/ /de ltar bskyed ④nas/ spyan drang ba dang mchod pa bya ba dang r+ṣaji'o bzlas pa byas nas dbang bskur ba ni 'jigs chung gi cho ga'o/ /bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa'i mngon par rtogs pa bsgom pa ni/ tshogs bsag pa dang 'byung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa sngar rjoltar la/ 'dir bye las pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ sgo khyud dang pad ra dur khrod rdo rje/ me ri dang bcas pa bskyed la/ de'i steng du nyi zla pad+ma'i steng du tshangs pa dang khyab 'jug /dbang phyug dang lha'i dbang po ⑤ste/bdud bzhi bsgyel ba'i snying khar he ru ka zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa sku mdog mthing nag /rtsa zhal nag po'i g.yas gsum dkar po dang nag po dang nag po'o//g.yon gsum dmar po dang nag po nag po'o/ /steng zhal du ba'i mdog can no//phyag bcu drug gi g.yas brgyad na thod pa'i nang na glang po/ rta dang bong bu dang /glang dang / rnga mo dang / mi dang sha ra na dang / seng ge dang / byi la rnams 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon gyi thod pa brgyad na sa dang chu dang rlung dang me dang /zla ba nyi ma gshin rje dang nor sbyin rnams so/ /rus pa'i rgyan drug dang thod pa lnga bcu'i phreng ba byas pa/ yum rdo rje bdag med ma nag mo gcer bu gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas sku la 'khril ba/ yab yum gyi dbu thams cad spyan 47—1013

gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing dbu skra dmar ser gyen du badze+es pa/ thod pa'i dbu rgyan dang phreng bas brgyan pa'o/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi steng du shar nas go rims bzhin du tshangs pa'i steng du gho ri nag mo gri gug dang nya 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang po'i steng du tso ri dmar mo ḍa ma ru dang phag 'dzin pa'o/ /nye dbang gi steng du ro langs ma ser mo rus sbal dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o—/ /drag po'i steng du ghas ma ri ljang khu sbrul dang dgang gzar 'dzin pa'o//byang shar nas lus ngan kyi steng du pu ka si sngon mo seng ge dang dgra sta 'dzin pa'o//gshin rje'i steng du sha ba ri dkar mo/ dge slong dang bsil byed 'dzin pa'o/ /srin po'i steng du tsan dha li nam mkha' ltar sngo ba/ 'khor lo dang bshol 'dzin pa'o / /thag bzangs rigs kyi steng du ṭaṃ bhi ni khro mo rdo rje dang sdigs mdzub byas pa/ thams cad skyis krungs phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa/ rus pa'i rgyan yang bdag med ma lta bu'o/ /rigs kyi bdag po mi bskyod ①pas dbu la brgyan pa'o/ /spyan drang zhing mchod pa byas la bzlas pa bya ba ni thugs khar rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa de la aṣ+ṭa nas bskor bar bsams la bzlas pa ni/ oṃ dhe ba pi tsu badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes ci rigs par bzlas la bstod pa byas nas dbang bskur ba ni phyag bcu drug pa'i 'o// //phyag drug pa'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni sngar dang 'dra ba las/ 'dir lha bskyed pa ni hūṃ las rdo rje/ de las mi bskyod pa mthing kha/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa zhal g.yas dkar ba g.yon dmar ba/ phyag 47—1014

drug dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ bar ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu/tha ma gnyis na gri gug dang rtse gsum pa bsnams pa/ zhabs gnyis ro'i gdan la dkyil dkrungs phyed pas bzhugs pa/ yum rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma ni bdag med ma lta bu'o—/ /rgyan rnams ni phyag bcu drug pa lta bu'o/ /'khor kyi lha mo brgyad ni snga ma ltar ro/ /thugs ka'i bskyed rims ni gong bzhin no/ /bzlas pa'i sngags ni oṃ ki ṭi ki ṭi badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā zhes bzlas la dbang bskur bar bya'o// //phyag bzhi pa'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ dal sngar ltar la/ lha bskyed pa ni phyag bzhi pa mthing kha/ phyag g.yas pa rdo rje 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa khrag gi thod pa 'dzin pa/ gzhan gnyis kyis bdag nyid dang mtshungs pa'i rdo rje phag mo la 'khyud pa'o/ /'khor gyi lha mo ni sngar ltar ro/ /bzlas pa'i sngags ni oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la bh+yo hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bzlas nas dbang bskur bar bya'o// //phyag gnyis pa'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ dal snga ma ltar la/ lha skyed pa ni/ gtso bo zhal gcig gi phyag gnyis pa mthing kha/ phyag g.yas pa rdo rje gyen du 'phyar ba/ g.yon pa thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje bdag med mas 'khyud pa—/ kha ṭī ①kha mchan khung g.yon gyis 'dzin pa'o/ /'khor brgyad po ni rang ②dang 'thun no/ /bzlas pa'i sngags ni oṃ tre+e log kya k+ṣe pa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/zhes bzlas la dbang bskur bar bya'o// //bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ tshogs sog pa 47—1015

dang 'byung ba lnga'i dal bskyed pa sngar ltar la/ 'dir bye las pho brang pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa dang / brgyad pa sgo dang bcas pa bskyed la/ lha bskyed pa ni/dbus su lha mo bdag med ma/ pad ma 'dab ma bcu gnyis la/ lha mo bcu gnyis so/ /shar sgo nub sgo gnyis su mkha' spyod ma dang sa spyod ma gnyis ste bco lnga po sku mdog nag mo gri gug dang thod pa/ kha ṭī ①kha mchan khung du drangs pa'o—/ /spyan drangs ②zhing mchod la/ sngags ni/ ā+oṃ a ā i ā+o/ u spru/ ṛ dzā/ lo drwa①/ e i/ o au/ i hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bzlas la bstod pa byas nas dbang bskur ba ni/ bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i cho ga'o// //saṃ bu ṭa'i dgyes pa rdo rje lha bco brgyad kyi mngon par rtogs pa bzhi las dang po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa ni tshogs sog pa sngon du song nas/ 'byung ba lnga'i dal bskyed la/ 'dir bye las gzhal yas khang pad+ma 'dab brgyad/gru chad la sgo btod rjopa bskyed la/ de ltar lha bskyed pa ni/ dbus su nyi zla pad+ma'i steng du bdud bzhi po bsgyel ⑤ba ni/ phung po'i bdud tshangs pa dmar po/nyon mongs pa'i bdud khyab 'jug nag poci/ 'chi bdag gi bdud dbang phyug chen po dkar po/ lha'i bu'i bdud ma ha de rjob ser po/ de'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje/ de las bcom ldan 'das zhal brgyad pa phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa sku mdog 'thing nag /zhal brgyad pa rtsa zhal 'thing kha g.yas dkar ba/g.yon dmar ba/ lhag ma bzhi nag po'i steng zhal dud kha/ mche ba gcigs pa—/ g.yas kyi phyag brgyad na rdo rje dang ral gri dang mda' dang / 'khor lo dang / ka pā ⑦la dang / dbyug pa dang / rtse gsum pa dang / lcags kyu 47—1016

bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon gyi brgyad na dril bu dang / pad+ma dang / gzhu dang /kha ṭaṃ kha dang / thod pa dang / rin po che dang / sdogs mdzub dang zhags pa'o—/ /zhabs bzhi brkyang ①skum bdud bzhi brdzis pa'o/ /yum bdag med ma rdo rje dang dril bu bzung bas sku la 'khril ba'o/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ma brgyad la shar du sgo ②ri dkar mo phyag bzhi gri gug dang nya dang mda' gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor tso ri ma dmar mo phyag bzhi yis rdo rje ḍa ma ru dang lcags kyu phag 'dzin pa'o//nub tu ro langs ma sku mdog dkar ser ral gri dang rus sbal dang khrag dang /chang gis bskang ba'i thod pa gnyis 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du ghas ma ri ljang ser zhun gyis bskang ba'i thod pa dang sbrul dang / me thab dang / dgra sta 'dzin pa'o / /dbang ldan du pu ka si ser mo thod pa dang seng ge dang / shing dang /rin po che 'dzin pa'o/ /me'i mtshams su sha ba ri dkar mo/ byang chub kyi sems kyis bkang ba'i thod pa dang / dge slong dang kha ṭaṃ kha dang zhags pa'o/ /srin po'i 'tshams su tsan dha li sngon mo gri gug khrag gis bskang ba'i thod pa dang me tog dang gos so/ /rlung gi 'tshams su ḍo bhi ni khra mo chang gi thod pa dang /lce spyang dang kha ṭaṃ kha dang bshol lo/ /shar lhor gling bu ma dkar mo/ gling bu dang thod pa dang / kha ṭaṃ kha dang / zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /lho nub tu pi wang ma sngon mo pi wang dang thod pa dang / me tog dang ro ras so/ /nub byang du cha lang ma dmar mo cha lang dang thod pa dang kha ṭaṃ ngo / /byang shar du rdza rnga ma ljang ser rdza rnga dang thod pa dang rin po che'o/ /shar sgor rta gdong ma nag mo zhal g.yas dkar ba g.yon ser ba/ steng du rta'i gdong pa ljang khu'o/ /lhor phag gdong ma ser mo nag pa dang dkar ba'i zhal/ steng du phag pa'i zhal dmar 47—1017

po'o—/ /nub tu khyi gdong ma dmar mo nag pa dmar ba'i zhal/ steng du khyi'i gdong pa ser po'o/ /byang du seng gdong ma ljang khu nag pa dang dkar ba'i zhal/steng du seng gdong dmar po'o/ /phyag mtshan ni dang po na gri gug dang thod pa/'og ma na lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu ma'o/ /thams cad kyang khro bo'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa'o/ /ye shes pa spyan drang zhing mchod la/ sngags ni dhe ba'i tsu'o/ /bstod pa byas nas dbang bskur ba ni/ dgyes rdor mtshon cha ma bco brgyad lha'i cho ga'o / /①phyag drug pa'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ phyi'i dkyil 'khor sngar ltar bskyed la—/ 'di ltar lha bsgom pa ni rdo rje'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje/ de las zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ zhal gsum nag pa dang / dkar ba dang / dmar ba la spyan gsum gsum yod pa/ phyag g.yas kyis rdo rje dang mda' dang rtse gsum pa 'dzin pa g.yon pa gsum gyis dril bu dang / gzhu dang / thod pa'o/ /rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma gri gug dang thod pa thogs pas sku la 'khyud pa/ 'khor gyi lha mo bcu drug ni gong dang 'dra'o/ /spyan drangs mchod pa byas nas bzlas pa ni/ oṃ ki ṭi ki ṭi hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā zhes bzlas la bstod cing dbang bskur ba ni phyag drug pa'i'o// //phyag bzhi pa'i mngon par rtogs pa ni dal dang lha mo rnams sngar dang 'dra ba las/ gtso bo zhal cig phyag bzhi pa/ nag po phyag dang po gnyis kyi rdo rje dang thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis ni mda' gzhu'o/ /yum bdag med ma sku la 'khril ba/ sngags ni oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la bh+yo hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/47—1018

zhes dbang bskur bar bya'o// //phyag gnyis pa'i mngon par rtogs pa ni dal dang 'khor rnams sngar dang cig pa las/ 'dir gtso bo 'pho ba'o/ /ro'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje/ de las he badz+ra zhal cig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin pas yum bdag med ma la 'khyud pa/ 'khor bcu drug po sngar ltar la/ sngags oṃ tre log kya khye pa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bzlas la bstod pa byas nas dbang bskur ba ni/dgyes rdor mtshon cha can rnams bzhi'i cho ga'o// //bcom ldan 'das bde mchog 'khor lo lha drug cu rtsa gnyis ma'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ tshogs sog pa dang 'byung ba lnga'i dal bskyed pa sngar ltar la/'dir bye las gzhal yas khang 'khor lo rim pa bzhi gru chad la sgo btod pa rta babs dang pad+ma/ dur khrod rdo rje ra bas bskor ba bskyed la/ lha bskyed pa ni/pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du ①du 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan gnyis brnol ba'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje/ de las bde mchog 'khor lo sku mdog nag po zhal bzhi ni/nag po dang ljang khu dang / dmar po dang ser po las spyan gsum gsum pa'o/ /phyag bcu gnyis kyi dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams pas rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa la 'khyud pa/ phyag gnyis kyis glang po che'i lpags pa brgyangs nas 'dzin pa/ de nas g.yas bzhis ḍa ma ru dang dgra sta dang gri gug dang rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis kha ṭaṃ kha dang thod pa dang zhags pa dang tshangs pa'i mgo bsnams pa/ khro zhing 'jigs pa rus 47—1019

pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyogs bzhis ①pad+ma la mkha' 'gro ma dang lam dang dum skyes ma dang gzugs can ma rnams ni nag mo dang ljang khu dang dmar mo dang ser mo la zhal cig pa spyan gsum pa phyag bzhi'i g.yas rnams kyis ḍa ma ru dang /gri gug 'dzin pa/ g.yon rnams na kha ṭaṃ kha dang thod pa bsnams pa/ g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pa'o/ /mtshalas bzhir sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i thod pa bzhi/thugs kyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad la shar du thod pa'i dum bu dang rab gtum ma dang / byang du ne+e rus chen po dang gtum dmig ma/ nub tu keng rus dang 'od ldan ma'o/ /lhor mche ba bcigs pa dang sna ④chen ma/ shar lhor chang gra dang blo gros byang shar du rdo rje lus dang shing grib ma nub byang du rdo rje 'od dang lo ka'i dbang phyug ma/ lho nub tu 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma rnams so/ /de rnams ni mthing kha'o/ /gsung gi 'khor lo la myu gu can dang sa bsrungs ma ral pa can dang 'jigs byed ma dpa' chen dang rlung shugs ma/ hūṃ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ bzang po dang sngo bsangs ①ma/ rdo rje 'od dang shin tu bzang mo/ 'jigs byed dang rta rna ma/ mig bzangs dang bya gdong ma rnams ni dmar mo'o/ /sku'i 'khor lo stobs po che dang shugs can ma/ rin chen rdo rje dang dum skyes ma/ rta mgrin dang chang 'tshong ma/ nam snying dang go cha ma/ he ru ka dang bzang po/ gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen mo/ rnam snang dang 'khor lo bsgyur ma/ sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus ma rnams ni dkar po'o//dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni zhal cig phyag bzhi pa la dang po rdo rje dang dril bu rig ma la 'khyud pa/ tha ma na kha ṭaṃ kha dang ḍa ma ru bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba g.yon skum pa/ dpa' mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni zhal cig pa/ phyag gnyis pa 'khyud 47—1020

pa'i phyag gis thod pa 'dzin cing g.yas pa gdug pa can sdigs pa'i gri gug gdengs pa/ sgo rnams su khā gdong ma dkar mo dang 'ug gdong ma ser mo dang /khyi gdong ma dmar mo dang phag gdong ma ljang khu gri gug dang thod pa thogs pa'o//'tshams su gshin rje brtan ①ma dkar ser dang / pho nya ma dmar ser dang /mche ba dmar ljang dang / 'joms ma dkar ljang rnams ni mi'i gdong pa la/brgyad po 'di ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /rigs kyi bdag po ni gtso bo la mi bskyod pa'o/ /'khor rnams la phyogs phyogs kyi rigs bzhi'o/ /thugs khar ye shes sems dpa' rang 'dra ba'i thugs kar rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa la/ ye shes pa spyan drang zhing mchod pa dang bzlas pa ni/ oṃ shi badz+ra he te ru ru rka hūṃ snehūṃ phaṭa ḍā ki ni dzā la saṃ bha ram̐ swā hā/ snying po'i sngags so/ /bstod pa byas nas dbang bskur ba ni drug cu rtsa gnyis ma'o// //drug cu rtsa gnyis ma ser mo'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ tshogs sog pa dang 'byung ba lnga bskyed pa sngar ltar la/ 'dir bye las pho brang sngar ltar bskyed la—/ lha bskyed pa ni 'jigs byed dus mtshan kyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje/ de las bcom ldan 'das bde mchog 'khor lo sku mdog ser po zhal cig phyag gnyis pa dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa lnga po rdo rje dang dril bu thugs khar bsnol ba'o/ /dpa' mo sum cu so bdun gri gug dang thod pa thogs pa'o/ /thugs kha'i sa bon hūṃ ngo / /snying po'i sngags ni oṃ hri ha ha hūṃ ①hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas dbang bskur ba ni—/ drug cu rtsa gnyis ma ser mo'i cho ga'o // //rjo47—1021

drug cu rtsa gnyis ma sngon po'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ dal bsgom pa ni thru las sngar ltar la/ lha bskyed pa ni 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje/ de las bde mchog ljang khu zhal cig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu thogs pa nyer lnga dpa' mo so bdun kha ṭaṃ kha dang thod pa thogs pa babyed la bsgom/de nas sngags ni sngar ltar ro dbang bskur bar bya'o// //bde mchog yab ka dkar po'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ dkyil 'khor bskyed pa bye las sngar ltar la/ lha bskyed pa ni 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje de las bde mchog te ru ka rnam pa lnga dang / dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu jogs pa'o/ /thugs kha'i sa bon ni hūṃ ngo / /sngags ni yi ge bdun pa'o/ /de nas dbang bskur bar bya'o// //bde mchog yum bka' so bdun gyi bdag nyid kyi dal bskyed pa sngar ltar la—/ lha bskyed pa ni baṃ las gri gug de las dpa' mo so bdun dmar mo zhal cig phyag gnyis ma/ ḍa ma ru dang thod pa thogs pa'o/ /thugs kha'i sa bon ni baṃ mo/ /oṃ badz+ra be+e ro tsa ni ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa zhes pa ni snying po'o/ /de nas bstod pa byas la dbang bskur ba ni bde mchog yum bka'o// //bde mchog bcu gsum pa'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ tshogs sogs pa dang 'byung ba lnga'i dal bskyed pa sngon du song nas/ skad cig gis sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi steng du/ bde mchog bcu gsum ma me 47—1022

long la bris sku'i gzugs brnyan ①shar ba ltar wa le/ hri ge gsal bar bsgom pa ni bye las gzhal yas khang pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa gru chad la sgo btod pa can du bskyed la/ de'i nang du 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan gyi steng du/ dpal bde mchog 'khor lo sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi pa rtsa zhal sngon po ljang khu dang /dmar po ser po'o/ /spyan gsum gsum pa thod pa'i dbu rgyan dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol ba/ stag gi sham thabs dang mi mgo lnga bcu'i do zhal ④byas pa phyag bcu gnyis kyi dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /de 'og gnyis kyis glang po che'i lpags pa bzung ba/ g.yas gsum na cang te'u/ bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa na gri gug /drug pa na mdung rtse gsum bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon gyi gsum pa na kha ṭaṃ kha/ bzhi pa na thod pa lnga pa na zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo'o/ /yum phag mo dmar mo zhal cig pa spyan gsum pa/ phyag gnyis kyis zangs gri dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ shar gyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du ljang khu/ nub du dmar mo/ lhor ser mo/ mtshams bzhi la bum pa bzhi'i steng du thod pa/ shar sgor khā gdong ma/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma/nub sgor khyi gdong ma/ lho sgor phag gdong ma/ sku mdog nang ma dang 'thun/shar lhor gshin rje brtan ④ma/ byang shar du 'joms ma nub byang du mche ba mo/lho nub tu pho nya mo/ sku mdog byed gzugs ma/ mkha' 'gro bcu gnyis po de zhal cig pa la spyan gsum pa/ phyag bzhi pa la g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang ḍā ma ru/g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭaṃ kha/ g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs rjokyis ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /ye shes pa spyan drang zhing mchod nas/ bzlas pa ni/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru ko hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ṭā ⑤ki ni dz+wa la saṃ bha rā swā hā/ zhes bzlas la 47—1023

dbang bskur ba ni bcu gsum ma'o// //lhan skyes lha lnga'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ tshogs sog pa dang 'byung ba rim rtseg bskyed pa sngar ltar la/ 'dir bye las pho brang 'dab brgyad gru chad la sgo btod pa bskyed la der 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan gyi steng du te ru ka zhal cig phyag gnyis pa/ rdo rje dang dril bu thugs khar 'dzin pa/ yum dmar mo g.yon pa thod pa gtso bo la 'khyud pa/ g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la rdo rje ḍa ki ma dkar mo las kyi ḍa ki ma ljang khu/ pad+ma ḍa ki ma dmar mo/ rin chen ḍa ki ma ser mo/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa bzung nas ro'i gdan la phyed dkyil gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /spyan drang zhing mchod pa byas nas bzlas pa ni/ oṃ thi ha ha hūṃ ①hūṃ phaṭa zhes bzlas la dbang bskur ba ni lha lnga pa'o// //bde mchog te lo pa'i lha dgu'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ tshogs sogs 1pa las sogs pa sngar bstan nas/ 'dir bye las pad ma 'dab ma brgyad pa bskyed la/ de'i nang du 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das sku mdog dkar po zhal bzhi'i g.yas dkar po/ g.yon dmar ba steng zhal ser ba/ spyan gsum gsum pa g.yas kyi phyag brgyad rnams kyi sdigs 'dzub dang rdo rje dang dril bu dang / zhags pa dang dri'i bum pa dang / ral gri dang /mdung dang / dgra sta'o/ /g.yon kyi brgyad na thod pa dang lcags kyu dang gzhu dang kha ṭaṃ kha dang mda' dang 'khor lo dang skyab sbyin dang thod pa'o/ /nam 47—1024

bza' dkar po gsol ba zhi zhing bzhad pa'i zhal/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad la gshin rje bstan ma la swo ①pa brgyad che'i bum pa thogs pa'o/ /spyan drang zhing mchod la bzlas pa bya ba ni/ snying khar zla ba'i dal la sngags kyi 'khor lo gsal bar dmigs te/ 'chi ba la skyob par byed pa'i rigs sngags 'di bzlas te/ oṃ am+bi ta pan tsa ba ni/ ma hā adri ta bu mu khe 'dzim sdebaṃ/ spra pe sha ya spra pe sha ya sarba badz+ra pad+ma sa ma yo ge ma ya sgo dhe tsi ta pa ti si ta ④mur te hūṃ hūṃ a a saṃ a swā hā/ zhes bzlas pas 'chi ba thams cad las thar par byed do/ /de nas dbang bskur bar bya'o// //gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa'i bde mchog lha brgyad ma'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ tshogs sog pa sngon du song nas 'dir bye las gzhal yas khang rtsibs drug bskyed la/ de'i nang du 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje—/ de las te ru ka zhal gsum pa sku dang rtsa zhal nag pa/ g.yas ser g.yon ljang khu spyan gsum pa/ phyag drug pa'i dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud cing / rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ bar ma gnyis kyis mi'i lpags pa dang kha ṭaṃ kha 'dzin pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis mdung rtse gsum pa dang / thod khrag 'dzin pa/khro bo'i chas kyis brgyan pa/ yum sku mdog dang zhal phyag mtshan rang 'dra ba la khyad par du bar ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das dang snyoms zhugs byas pas mchog dang dga' bas myong bar bsam mo rtsibs drug las shar du phaṭa las byung ba'i khrag 'thung ma sngon mo/ de nas rim pas rtsibs la hūṃ las 'jigs byed ma ser mo/ ha las drag gtum ma dmar mo/ ha 47—1025

las snang byed ma ljang khu/ hri las rdo rje drag mo/ du ba'i mdog /oṃ las rdo rje mkha' 'gro dkar mo/ lha mo de dag zhal cig ma la phyag bzhi ma/ gnyis kyis ḍa ma ru dang dril bu sgra sgog cing 'dzin pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis kha ṭaṃ kha dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ khro mo'i cha lugs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /ye shes pa spyan drang zhing mchod nas yi ge bdun pa bzlas te dbang bskur ba ni yi ge bdun pa'i cho ga gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa lha brgyad ma'i mngon par rtogs pa'o// //rdo rje gur rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor lnga'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ bye las gzhal yas khang bskyed pa sngar ltar la/ 'dir rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni/ sku mdog 'thing kha zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ yum rdo rje bdag med mas 'khyud pa/ phyag gi thod pa'i nang na sems can chen po brgyad dang lha mo brgyad thogs pa'o/ /'khor brgyad ni go ①ri la sogs pa'i lha mo brgyad do/ /sngags ni ā+oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dha ra ya dha ra ya/ mar dha ra mar dha ra/ badz+ra dh+rika ②phaṭa swā hā zhes bzlas nas dbang bskur ro// //sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro dkar po g.yas g.yon dmar ba gzhan rnams sngo ba'o/ /g.yas pa'i phyag brgyad kyi thod pa na rma bya dang / ma te dang / chu srin dang / nya dang /nya khrab can dang / rgyal po dang / rus sbal dang / klu dang ngang pa rnams so—/ /g.yon gyi phyag brgyad na sbrul dang / sbal nag dang / sbrul nag po dang / sbrul dkar po dang / bra ba byi ba dang / g.yag dang / sre mo dang /47—1026

bya rgod dang / co ga rnams so/ /yum sangs rgyas spyan ma sku la 'khril ba'o/ /lha mo brgyad ni shar nas rim pa bzhin du/ skam pa ma sngon mo skam pa 'dzin pa/me tog ma dkar mo me tog 'dzin pa/ zhags pa ma ser mo zhags pa 'dzin pa/bdug spos ma nag mo spos phor 'dzin pa/ dra ba can ma dmar mo dra ba 'dzin pa/mar me ma dmar mo mar me 'dzin pa/ lcags kyu ma ljang khu lcags kyu 'dzin pa/dri chab ma ser mo dung chos 'dzin pa'o/ /sngags ni oṃ sha shwa ta pa ra ma sha shwa ta e h+ya hi dzi na dzika ①phaṭa ṭ+wā hā/ zhes bzlas la dbang bskur ro/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ rin chen mkha' 'gro ser po g.yas g.yon dkar ba dang lhag ma rnams sngo ba'o/ /phyag g.yas pa brgyad na / bya ka ran ta dang / ngur ba dang / 'ug pa dang / thi ba dang /khra dang / kyung ga dang / 'ug pa dang gzhad rnams so/ /g.yon na klu brgyad do/ /yum ma ma ki dang 'khril ba'o/ /pad+ma brgyad la nyi 'chag ma dkar mo nyi ma 'dzin pa/ sgeg mo dkar mo bsgyeg pa'i cha lugs can/ me 'chag ma sngon mo me 'dzin pa/ phreng ba ma dmar mo phreng ba 'dzin pa/ rin chen dkar mda' ma ser mo rin chen 'dzin pa/ klu ma dmar skya ting shags 'dzin pa/glog 'chag ma ljang khu glog khri 'dzin pa'o/ /gar ma ljang khu gar byed pa/sngags ni oṃ badz+ra pur+ya ha mo rnyi tra ma na sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hūṃ rad na dh+rika ②phaṭa swā hā/zhes pas dbang bskur ro// //pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar po'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ gzhal yas khang 47—1027

gi dbus su pad+ma'i mkha' 'gro dmar po ste/ zhal g.yas g.yon dkar ba lhag ma rnams nag pa'o/ /phyag g.yas brgyad na thod pa'i nang na/ dred dang /dom dang / spre'u dang / ba men dang / stag dang / spre dang / chu srin dang / lce spyang rnams so/ /g.yon rnams na khra dang / 'ug pa dang / so bya dang / chu bya/ rgod dang / thi ba dang / ne+e tsho dang / bya pho'o/ /yum gos dkar mo dang 'khril ba'o/ /lha mo rnams shar nas pad+ma can dkar mo pad+ma thogs pa'o/ /gling bu ma dmar mo gling bu 'bud pa/ chos 'byung ma ser mo chos 'byung 'dzin pa/ pi waṃ ma ser mo pi waṃ 'dzin pa/ lcags sgrog ma nag mo lcags sgog 'dzin pa/ mu gu ta dkar mo rnga bo che brdung ba/ thod pa ma ljang khu thod pa 'dzin pa/ rdza rnga ma dud kha rdza rnga brdung ba'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra dharma sa ma ya sto hu lu hu lu a ro lig phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bzlas la dbang bskur ro/ /rta mchog don yod grub pa ljang khu'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ dal gyi nang du rta mchog don yod grub pa ljang khu zhal dbus ma/ rta gdong ljang khu 'am/yang na lha'i zhal ljang khu rang ngo / /g.yas g.yon dkar ba la lhag ma nag pa'o//phyag g.yas kyi thod pa brgyad na/ gza' chen brgyad do/ /g.yon brgyad na/lha chen po brgyad do/ /yum sgrol ma sku la 'khril ba'o/ /yum lnga'i phyag mtshan ni—/ gri gug thod pa'o/ /lha mo brgyad ni sgo lcags ma dkar mo sgo lcags 'dzin pa'o/ /'khor lo ma dkar mo 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /lde ①mig ma ser mo sde mig 'dzin pa/ rdo rje ma sngon mo rdo rje 'dzin pa/ sgo 'dzin pa dmar mo sgo 'dzin pa/ pad+ma dmar mo pad+ma 'dzin pa/ yol ba ma ljang khu yol ba 'dzin 47—1028

pa—/ ud pal ma sngon mo ud pal 'dzin pa'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ phu phu ha hi pradzñā dh+rika ①phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bzlas la dbang bskur ro/ /bde mchog 'khor lo sgyur ba drug gi mngon par rtogs pa drug la/ dang po rdo rje sems dpa'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i nang du—/ hūṃ las rdo rje/ de las 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan gyi steng du/ rdo rje sems dpa' sngo skya rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum bdag med ma thod pa dang gri bzung ba la 'khyud pa'o/ /'khor lo rtsibs bzhi la shar du/ pu ri ra mar thod pa'i dum bu dang rab gtum ma/ byang du dza lan dha rar ne+e ru chen mo dang gtum mig ma/ nub u rgyan du keng rus ma dang 'od ldan ma/ lho ar bu tar mche ba rnam par brtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ brgyad ka sngo skya'o/ /sgo 'tshalas brgyad du khu gdong ma la sogs brgyad do/ /snying po'i sngags ni oṃ shri ma hā su ka badz+ra satwa baṃ/ a hūṃ ḍā ki ni dz+wa la saṃ bha ra ā hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ thugs kyi sa bon ni hūṃ ngo / /sngags bzlas la dbang bskur bar bya'o// //yang rnam par snang mdzad kyi mngon par rtogs pa ni/ bye las tshangs pa'i snying khar rnam par snang mdzad dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu thogs pas yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro la 'khyud pa/ phyogs bzhi'i shar du gho ta pa rir changs sgra dang dpa' bo'i blo gros ma/ byang tsha ma lar rdo rje lus dang shing grib ma/nub de bi ko trar ⑤rdo rje hūṃ ka ra dang lang ka'i dbang phyug ma/ lho ra me sho rar snang ba dpag med ma dang / mi thung ma/ thams cad dkar mo/ tshalas ①ma 47—1029

brgyad ni gong ltar ro/ /thugs ka'i sa bon/ bye mo/ /snying po'i sngags ni/oṃ shri byudha ḍa ki ni a pa la/ rgyu a hūṃ dha ki ni dz+wa la saṃ bha ra hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/zhes bzlas la dbang bskur ro/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ lha'i bu nyi ma'i snying khar/oṃ las rin chen 'byung ldan ser po rin chen dang dril bu bzung bas yum rin chen mkha' 'gro ma la 'khyud pa/ rtsibs bzhir shar du ka ma rur myu gu can dang sa bsrungs ma/ byang o dhar rdo rje'i ral pa can dang 'jigs byed ma/nub tri sha ku nir/ dpa' bo chen po dang rlung shugs ma/ lho ko sa lang rdo rje rā hūṃ byed dang chang 'thung ma/ thams cad sku mdog ser mo/ sgo 'tshams ma brgyad sngar ltar ro/ /thugs kyi sa bon e ngo / /sngags ni/oṃ shi rad na ta ki tram̐/ a hūṃ dha ki ni/ dza la saṃ bha ra hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/zhes bzlas la dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ dbang phyug chen po'i snying khar hri las pad ma'i mkha' 'gro dmar mo pad ma dang dril bu thogs pa'i phyag gnyis kyis pad+ma'i mkha' 'gro la 'khyud pa/ rtsibs bzhi'i shar ka ling ka ru rab tu bzang mo dang sngo bzangs ma byang nyi ma lar mig mi bzang dang mkha' 'gro'i gdong / nub kaspyo rar ①'jigs byed chen mo dang rta rna ma/ lho lam ba kar ④rdo rje bzang mo dang / shin tu bzang mo rnams dmar ba'o/ /sgo mtshams ma rnams ni sngar ltar ro/ /thugs kha'i sa bon ni hri'o/ /sngags ni 47—1030

oṃ shri pad+ma ḍā tī hriḥ.a hūṃ ḍā ki ni dz+wa la saṃ bha ra hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bzlas la dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /mi bskyod rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ khyab 'jug gi snying khar hūṃ las rdo rje mkha' 'gro nag po/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje mkha' 'go la 'khyud pa/ rtsibs bzhi/ shar spre ta pu rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shubs ①ma/ byang sgri ha dhe bar rin chen rdo rje dang dum ③skyes ma/ nub tu ra trar rta mgrin dang chang 'tshong ma/ lho rna sgri par nam mkha' snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha rnams ni mthing kha/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad ni gong ltar ro/ /thugs kyi sa bon ni hūṃ ngo / /sngags ni/ oṃ shri badz+ra ḍā ki ni ā ①hūṃ dha ki ni dz+wa la saṃ bha ra hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas dbang bskur ro/ /don grub sna tshogs mkha' 'gro'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ kham las lha'i bu zla ba'i snying khar rdo rje dkyil dkrungs kyis bzhugs pa/ ljang khu'i phyag gnyis na sna tshogs rdo rje dang / dril bu 'dzin pas yum sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma la 'khyud pa/ 'khor rnams shar du na ga rar khrag 'thung dang shin tu dpa' mo/byang ku lu tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang / brtson 'grus chen mo/ nub ma ru rtser rnam par snang byed dang / 'khor lo bsgyur ma/ lho sin dur pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma rnams ni ljang khu'o/ /sgo mtshalas kyi lha mo brgyad ni gong ltar shes par bya'o/ /thugs kyi sa bon ni khaṃ ngo / /sngags ni oṃ bha sha ta ka ho/ khaṃ a hūṃ ḍā rjoki ni dz+wa la saṃ bha ra hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod la 47—1031

bstod pa byas la dbang bskur ba ni/ bde mchog 'khor lo sgyur ba rnam pa drug las don grub pa'i he ru ka'o/ /saṃ bhu ta'i lha mo nyer gsum gyi mngon par rtogs pa ni/ tshogs bsag pa dang gzhal yas khang bskyed pa sngon bzhin byas la/ 'di ltar lha bskyed pa ni/ro'i steng du oṃ las bdag med ma mthing kha/ zhal cig pa/ phyag bzhi pa/g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje dang gri gug /g.yon gnyis kyis thod pa dang kha ṭaṃ kha 'dzin pa 'khor rnams kyang phyag bzhis de ltar bya'o/ /pad ma 'dab ma bzhi la phrin las bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ma bzhi/ steng du mkha' spyod ma dkar mo nam mkha' la gzigs pa dang / 'og na sa spyod ma mthing kha thur la gzigs pa dang /pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad la gho ri dkar mo dang / tso ri dmar ser dang / ro langs ma dkar ser dang / ghasma ri ljang khu dang / pu ka se ser mo dang /sha ba ri dkar mo dang / tsan dha li sngon mo dang / ḍo bhi ni ljang ser dang /zur la gling bu ma dkar mo dang / 'khar rnga ma ser mo dang / pi waṃ ma dmar mo dang / rdza rnga ma ljang khu dang / shar du rta gdong ma dkar mo dang / lhor phag gdong ma ser mo dang / nub tu khyi gdong ma dmar mo dang / byang du seng gdong ma ljang khu dang / thams cad zhal cig pa phyag bzhi/ gtso mo dang phyag mtshan cig pa'o—/ /mi bskyod pa la sogs pas dbu brgyan cing thugs kha'i sa bon ni oṃ mo/ /snying po ni oṃ saṃ swā hā zhes bzlas la dbang bskur ba ni bdag med pa'o// //ma hā ma ya lha drug gi mngon par rtogs pa ni/ tshogs sog pa dang 'byung 47—1032

ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa sngar ltar byas la/ 'dir rgyu las pho brang 'dab ma brgyad pa sgo dang bcas pa bskyed la/ der lha bskyed pa ni/ nyi zla pad+ma'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje/ de las ma hā ma ya zhal bzhi phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis dang ldan pa/ sku mdog mthing kha/ zhal bzhi ni rtsa zhal nag pa'o/ /g.yas ser ba—/ g.yon ljang ba/ rgyab zhal ljang ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum ①yod pa/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du 'bar ba/ thod pa'i dbu rgyan dang / rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis na thod pa dang mda'/g.yon kha ṭaṃ kha dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhabs skyil krung phyed pa'i gar kyis bzhugs pa/ yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma gtso bo dang zhal phyag kha dog 'dra ba—/ sku la 'khril ba/ shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo ser mo dang /ljang khu dang dkar ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhis rdo rje dang thod pa dang / dril bu dang kha ṭaṃ kha 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor ②rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo dang sngon mo dang dkar mo dang ljang khu'i zhal/ phyag bzhis rgyal mtshan dang tri shu la dang / lce spyang dang ka pā ①la 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu pad+ma'i mkha' 'gro ma dkar dmar zhing ser po dang sngon po dang ljang khu'i zhal lo/ /phyag bzhis pad+ma dang mda' dang ka pā dul dang gzhu'o/ /byang phyogs su sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma ljang khu dang ser po dang dkar po dang sngon po'i zhal la phyag bzhis ral gri dang ḍa ma ru dang ka pā ⑤la dang zhags pa thogs pa'o/ /spyan drangs pa dang mchod pa dang /thugs kyi sa bon ni hūṃ ngo / /oṃ ā hri hūṃ/ zhes bzlas la bstod cing dbang bskur ba ni ma te ma ya'i cho ga'o/ /47—1033

sgyu ma chen mo'i mngon par rtogs pa 'bring po dkyil 'khor bskyed pa sngar ltar la/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje/ de las sgyu ma chen mo sku mdog mthing kha zhal cig phyag gnyis pa kha ṭaṃ kha dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ rang dang 'dra ba'i shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog sngon mo zhal cig phyag gnyis pa/ kha tram̐ kha dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /sna tshogs mkha' 'go ma ljang khu zhal cig phyag gnyis pa kha ṭaṃ kha dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o—/ /pad+ma'i mkha' 'gro dmar mo kha ṭaṃ kha dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ lhor ①rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo kha tram̐ kha dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ oṃ ā hri hūṃ swā hā/zhes bzlas la dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /ma hā ma ya dpa' bo gcig pa'i bzlas pa ni/ dkyil 'khor pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dkar por bskyed la/ der hūṃ las rdo rje/ de las rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dril bu thugs khar bsnol ba yum la 'khyud pa la yum yang yab dang 'dra ba'o/ /pad+ma'i steng du thod pa bzhi sngags ni gong ②mas so de nas dbang bskur ba ni lugs chung ngo / /drang srong brgyad kyi mngon par rtogs pa ni/ rgyu las pho brang gling dgu gru chad la sgo btod pa can bskyed la/ nang du lha bskyed pa ni dbus su hūṃ las badz+ra pa ni/ sku mdog mthing nag g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten ma ①can bskyed la/ shar du so las drang srong zla ba dkar po pad+ma bsnams pa/g.yon drang srong brgyad ka thugs khar phyed phyag byed pa zhabs rgyal po chen po rol 47—1034

pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /shar lhor a dmar po las drang srong nyi ma dmar po 'bud dung bsnams pa/ lho phyogs su sa ser po las drang srong spen pa ser po be con bsnams pa/ lho nub tu ra dud kha las/ ra hu la dud kha ra'i mda' gzhu thogs pa/ nub tu a dmar po las dmag dpon dmar po me sgron 'dzin pa/ nub byang du shu lcags kha las pa sangs me tog thogs pa/ byang du nyi ljang khu 'od du zhu ba las/ phur bu ljang khu po ti bsnams pa/ byang shar du bu nag po 'od du zhu ba las/ drang srong lag pa ljang khu ud pal bsnams pa/rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad ni/ shar phyogs pa bdun dkar po la byun drug phreng ba 'dzin pa/ snar ma me tog 'dzin pa/ mgo ud pal 'dzin pa/ lag me tog 'dzin pa/ nam so phreng ba 'dzin pa/ rgyal pad+ma 'dzin pa/ skag ①ghan dha thogs pa/ lho phyogs pa bdun ser po la/ waṃ ②bum pa 'dzin pa/ rta chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ rta chung zhags pa 'dzin pa/ bya khra shing thog 'dzin pa/bya ma mar me 'dzin pa/ bya'u zhags pa 'dzin pa/ sa ri zhags pa 'dzin pa/sa ga be con 'dzin pa'o/ /nub phyogs pa bdun dmar po lag sor me tog 'dzin pa/ sdu ③gu dung phor 'dzin pa sog ༷pa ku mu ta 'dzin pa/ bye pad ma 'dzin pa/ phul rin chen 'dzin pa/ gro zhun me tog 'dzin pa/ byi zhun pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /byang gi bdun ljang khu la/ mon dre mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/mon gru dmar po nang ⑤tshang can la 'dug pa/ khrums stod ral gri 'dzin pa/khrums smad sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ rna gru pad ma 'dzin pa/ tha skar rdo rje 'dzin pa/ bra nye lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o/ /gru chad la bdug rjosogs bzhi dang sgo ba bskyed pa la gsang ba'i bdag po'i bzlas pa bya ste/ dbang bskur ba ni 47—1035

drang srong brgyad kyis ①cho ga'o/ /phyogs skyong bcu dang rgyal po bzhi'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ rgyu las pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu sgo dang bcas pa bskyed la/ lha babyed pa ni dbus su badz+ra pā ②ni sku mdog mthing nag rdo rje sdogs shing dril bu 'phyar ba sbrul rigs bzhis sku la brgyan pa bskyed la/ pad+ma 'dab bzhi la yul 'khor bsrung dkar po pi waṃ thogs pa/ 'phags skyes po sngon po ral gri thogs pa/spyan mi bzang dmar po mchod rten thogs pa/ rnam sras ser po rgyal mtshan thogs pa'o/ /rtsibs bcu la brgya byin ser po rdo rje rtse gsum thogs pa/ me lha dmar po me thab thogs pa'o/ /gshin rje nag po dbyug to thogs pa srin po mthing kha ral gri thogs pa/ chu lha dkar po zhags pa thogs pa/ rlung lha dud kha ba dan thogs pa/ gnod sbyin ljang khu dbyug to thog ①pa/ dbang ldan dkar po tri shul thogs pa/ tshangs pa dkar dmar nyi zla thogs pa/ sa bdag ser po bum pa thogs pa'o/ /lha mo bzhi dang sgo ba bzhi yang bskyed la/ sngags ci rigs par bzlas la dbang bskur ba ni rgyal chen phyogs skyong gi cho ga'o/ /klu chen po brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor gyi mngon par rtogs pa ni/ bye las pho brang 'dab brgyad sgo 'khyams dang bcas pa bskyed la/ hūṃ las badz+ra pā dze+eni/phu las klu chen po brgyad/ phyogs mtshon du thal mo sbyar ba bskyed la/ sgo bzhir rigs bzhi yang bskyed de/ yi ge 'di rnams kyi snying po/ chabadz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ drug pa dang bcu gsum pa dang / gzungs rings bzlas la/ dbang bskur bar bya 47—1036

ba ni/ klu brgyad kyi cho ga'o/ /gdan bzhi nam mkha' rnal 'byor gyi mngon par rtogs pa ni/ tshogs sog pa dang / 'byung ba lha'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa sngon du song nas/'dir bye las re ①dmig dgu pa la pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa dang / 'dab ma bcu drug pa dang khyams sgo dang bcas pa bskyed la/ der lha bskyed pa ni/dbus su seng ge'i steng du nam mkha' rnal 'byor mdog nag po zhal g.yas g.yon dkar ba dang dmar ba'i/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bu bzung nas yum ye shes mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog zhal phyag yab dang 'dra ba la 'khyud pa/ g.yas kyi bar mas yum gyi nu ma nyed cing 'og mas mda' 'dzin pa'o/ /phyag g.yon pa gnyis kyis pad sdong dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /dbu skra kham pa gyen du 'bar ba/ rus pa'i rgyan drug stag gi sham thabs gsol ba'o/ /shar gyi re dmig la glang po che'i steng du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo/ byang du rma bya'i steng du 'jigs byed ma ser mo/ nub tu sbrul gyi steng du ro langs ma dmar mo/ lhor bya'i steng du gtum mo sngon mo/ gtso mo dang lnga ni/ kha tram̐ kha dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /shar lhor nam mkha' lding gi steng du stag gi gdong can—/ dkar ba dang nag po'i mdog can lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/byang shar du seng ge'i steng du seng gdong ma dkar ser kha tram̐ kha dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub byang du lce spyang gi steng du khyi gdong ma dmar ser 'ug pa'i gdong can dbyug pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu ma te'i steng du lce spyang ma dmar nag dgra sta dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad kyi shar du 47—1037

lce 'dzin ma dkar mo lce khar bcug pa/ byang du thal mo sbyar ma ser mo spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba/ nub tu 'jigs byed ma ljang khu khrag gi phor pa gsol ba/lhor rka 'dzin ma nag mo gtun shing 'dzin pa/ byang shar sgeg mo bsgeg pa/nub byang du gar ma gar byed pa/ lho nub tu glu ma kha'i thad kar sprugs mdzub g.yob pa/ shar lhor pi waṃ ma/ pad 'dab bcu drug la shar lhor me tog ma dkar mo/ lho nub tu bdug pa ma ser mo/ nub byang du mar me ma dmar mo/byang shar du dri chab ma ljang khu shar gyi 'dab ma gsum la/ pu ka si dang ghasma ri gtum mo gsum bdud rtsi'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du 'jigs byed ma dang /'khra mo dang sha za ma gsum sha lngas bskang ba'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu drag shul ma dang 'bar ma dang / mi sdug ma gsum gtor ma'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /lho ru thod pa ma dang / rdo rje ma dang bum pa ma rnams gtung ba'i snod 'dzin pa'o—/ /shar sgor khyab 'jug nag po/ byang du tshangs pa ser po/ nub tu dbang phyug dkar po/ lhor gdong drug dmar po/ dbang ldan du dbang po ser po/ nub byang du chu lha dkar po/ lho nub tu gshin rje nag po shar lhor lus ngan ser po/ shar gyi snam bu la thod pa'i 'jigs byed dang / kha tram̐ kha'i srin po tshogs kyi dbang phyug dang dril bu'i rna ba can rnams dkar po/ byang du gtum po'i dbang phyug /myun pa'i lha/ rigs kyi dbang phyug /'jigs su rung ba rnams ser po/ nub tu drag po'i 'dod pas sa ri dbang phyug /ta ru 'du byed/ rnga sgra 'jigs byed rnams dmar po/ lhor gtum po dbang phyug /tha ra gha dro dbang phyug mche ba bcigs pa/ gzhu 'dzin rnams nag po/ khyab 'jug la sogs pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi po 'di dag ni/ zhal cig pa/ spyan gsum pa/47—1038

phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje dang kha tram̐ kha 'dzin pa/ g.yon gnyis kyis dril bu dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /rang 'od ①kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ mi bskyod pa la sogs pa rigs kyi bdag po rnams kyis mtshan pa'o/ /snying kha'i sa bon ni hūṃ ngo / /spyan drangs mchod la/ sngags ni/ oṃ hūṃ ha swā hā/ zhes bzlas la dbang bskur ba ni gdan bzhi nam mkha'i rnal 'byor yab bka'o/ /gdan bzhi ye shes mkha' 'gro'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ tshogs sog pa dang 'byung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa sngar ltar la/ 'dir rgyu las pad ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ gru chad la sgo btod pa can du bskyed la/ nyi zla pad+ma dang seng ge'i steng du/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo zhal gsum g.yas dkar ba—/ g.yon dmar ba/ spyan gsum gsum pa/ phyag drug gi g.yas gsum na kha tram̐ kha dang / dgra sta dang / rdo rje/ g.yon gsum na dril bu dang zhags pa dang khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro dkar mo/ byang du 'jigs byed mkha' 'gro ser mo/ nub tu ro langs ma dmar mo/ lhor gtum mo sngon mo seng ge'i gdan la kha ṭaṃ kha dang thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /byang shar du seng ge gdong ma dkar mdangs ser ba'i lus phyed ma glang po la bzhugs pa/ nub byang du 'ug gdong ma dmar ser klu'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ lho nub tu lce spyang gdong dmar nag ma he la bzhugs pa/shar lhor stag gdong ma dkar sngo rin po che'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ rdo rje zhags pa dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /shar sgor rgyal ba'i dbang phyug ma dkar mo phyag khar bcug pa/ byang du thal mo sbyar ba/ nub tu 'jigs byed dmar mo 47—1039

khrag 'thung ba/ lhor shaṃ 'dzin nag mo sdigs mdzub gsang gnas su btsugs pa lha mo bcu gsum po thod pa dang rus pa'i brgyan byas pa/ rigs lngas so sor dbu la mtshan pa/ thugs kha'i sa bon ni hūṃ ngo / /sngags ni/ oṃ tri swā hā zhes pa'o/ /de nas dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje gdan bzhi'i yum bka'o/ /sangs rgyas thod pa'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ tshogs sog pa sngon du song nas 'dir rgyu las gzhal yas khang / rtsibs brgyad pa gsum la sgo btod pa—/ lha bskyed pa ni mi ro'i steng du sangs rgyas thod pa/ zhal cig phyag bzhi pa—/ sku mdog mthing kha/ zhabs gnyis byas krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon na thod pa dang kha ṭaṃ kha 'dzin pa/ stag gi sham thabs dang glang po che'i stod g.yogs dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol ba/ mnga' bdag gi btsun mo ni sna tshogs rdo rje ma dmar mo zhal cig phyag gnyis ma yab kyi mgrin pa la chags pa'i phyag g.yon pas khrag gi rgyun 'dzin pa'i thod pa stob pa/ g.yas gri gug gdengs pa'o/ /rtsibs kyi shar nas nag po la legs pa'i phreng ba can ma/ byang du thod pa can ma/ nub tu 'jigs can ma/ lhor gzhan gyis mi thub ma'o/ /mtshalas bzhir 'dod yon gyis bskang ba'i thod pa bzhi'o/ /pad+ma 'dab ma dmar po la shar nas dge ba'i ske regs ma/ byang du gzugs can ma/ nub tu rnam par rgyal ma/lhor 'dod byed ma/ byang shar nag mo/ nub byang sdod ma/ lho nub tu 'phrog ma/ shar lhor rgya mtsho chen mo/ rtsibs dkar mo brgyad pa la/ shar du sgol ma/ byang du lo ga ma/ nub tu legs mthong ①ma/ lhor mi thub ma/47—1040

byang shar du dge ba mo/ nub byang du grags can ma/ lho nub tu dus mtshan ma/shar lhor grib gnon ma/ shar sgor mdzes ma/ byang sgor sa'i lha mo/ nub sgor skal bzangs ma/ lho'i sgor yid 'ong ma/ 'di rnams thams cad phyag mtshan gri gug dang thod pa/ sku mdog nag mo/ rigs lnga so sos dbu la mtshan pa'o/ /thugs ka'i sa bon ni hūṃ ngo / /snying po'i sngags ni oṃ bud ①dha ka pā ②li ni a —ཿtiḥnyi hai hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes bzlas nas dbang bskur ba ni sangs rgyas thod pa'o/ /sangs rgyas thod pa lha dgu'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ tshogs sog pa sngon du song nas/ 'dir rgyu las pad+ma 'dab brgyad sgo dang bcas pa bskyed pa'i nang du gtso bo yab yum sngar gsung pa lta bu la/ 'khor brgyad ni shar nas rim pa bzhin du sna tshogs bde ma dang / 'dod ma dang sa 'og gnas ma dang / legs bzang ma rnams ni sku mdog sngon mo/ rus pa'i rgyan dang stag gi sham thabs can la—/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis na ḍa ma ru dang thod pa/ g.yon gnyis na dril bu dang kha tram̐ kha/ zur bzhir chang 'tshong ma dang g.yung mo dang / phyag bzhi ma dang / nam mkha' gnas pa dang de rnams ni ser mo na bza' ser mo snedang stag gi sham thabs gsol ba/ phyag g.yas gnyis kyis gri gug dang ḍā ma ru/g.yon gnyis kyis kha tram̐ kha dang pad+ma bzung ba'o/ /rus pa'i rgyan drug dang mi mgo lnga bcu'i phreng bas rjobargyan pa'o/ /thugs kha'i sa bon hūṃ ngo / /sngags ni/oṃ bhud dha ka pā ⑤li ni ā nyi hai duhūṃ phaṭa zhes ci rigs par bzlas la dbang bskur ba ni lha dgu ma'o/ /47—1041

rdo rje sgrol ma lha bcu gcig gi mngon par rtogs pa ni/ tshogs sog pa sngon du song nas 'dir bye las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa sgo dang bcas pa babyed la/lha bskyed pa ni/ dbus su rdo rje sgrol ma sku mdog gser btso ①ma lta bu/ zhal bzhi ni ser ba dang / dkar ba dang / sngo ba dang / dmar ba'i zhal la/phyag brgyad na rdo rje dang / zhags pa dang / mda' dang / mdung 'dzin pa'o—/ /ud pal dang / gzhu dang / lcags kyu dang / sdigs mdzub po//shar du me tog sgol ma dkar mo me tog 'dzin pa/ lhor spos kyi sgrol ma ser mo spos 'dzin pa/ nub tu mar me'i sgol ma dmar mo mar me 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du dri mchog sgrol ma ljang khu dri'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /gru bzhi la ni rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i rdo rje dang / 'khor lo dang / pad+ma dang / ral gri'o/ /sgo bzhi la ni sgo ma bzhi'o/ /grwa bzhi la ni yum bzhi'i bum pa bzhi'o/ /steng du gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma dkar mo 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /'og tu gnod ⑤mjes ma sngon mo klu'i zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /phyag g.yon thams cad ni sdigs mdzub mdzad ⑦pa'o/ /thams cad rdo rje'i dkyil dkrungs kyis bzhugs pa'o—/ /rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa la/ gtso mo la ni rin chen 'byung ldan gyis so/ /'khor rnams la ni gzhan rigs bzhi'o/ /snying kha'i sa bon tai ngo / /oṃ tā re tud tā re tu re swā hā/ zhes bzlas la dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /lha mo ku ru kupre rjolha bcu gsum gyi mngon par rtogs pa ni/ rgyu las pad+ma 'dab bzhi sgo dang bcas pa bskyed la/ dbus su ku ru kukhre ⑤dmar mo zhal cig spyan gsum pa/ phyag bzhis mda' dang lcags kyu dang gzhu dang / ud pal 47—1042

dmar po 'dzin pa'o/ /phyogs bzhir yum bzhi'o/ /gru bzhir sgeg sogs bzhi'o/ /sgo bzhir sgo ma bzhi'o/ /thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar mo mda' gzhu 'dzin pa ro'i gdan la phyed dkyil gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /snying kha'i sa bon ni hri'o/ /oṃ ku ru kukhre tri swā hā/ zhes bzlas la dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /lha mo 'od zer can gyi mngon par rtogs pa ni/ rgyu las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa sgo dgas dang bcas pa bskyed la/ de'i dbus su nyi zla pad+ma'i steng du lha mo 'od zer can ser mo zhal gsum ser ba dang / dkar ba dang / sngo ba dang / spyan gsum pa/ dbu rgyan mchod rten dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag drug gi g.yas rnams kyis mda' dang / rdo rje dang / khab 'dzin pa/ g.yon rnams kyis gzhu dang / sgud pa dang / mya ngan med pa'i shing 'dzin pa/ stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs sngon po gsol ba/ thams cad kyang phag gi gdan la bzhugs pa/ shar du nyi ma yin ma dkar mo khab dang skud pa 'dzin pa/ lhor ma bsi ser mo khab dang skud pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu gzi brjid ma dmar mo mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ byang du mi ran yin pa ljang khu/mya ngan med pa'i shing ①sdigs mdzub byas pa/ mtshalas bzhir u tra ya ma dang /khu lu ma si dang / bha na ma si dang / rtsi ra ma si rnams snga ma bzhin du sku mdog phyag mtshan cig pa'o/ /shar du rtsi ra ma si nag mo dang / phag mo phag zhal nag mo can no/ /lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor rkang gnon ma dang tshogs 'phreng ma ser mo mya ngan med pa'i shing dang rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu pha rol gnon ma dang tshig gi phreng ma dmar mo mda' gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /47—1043

byang du slab byin ma dang mchog 'phreng ma ljang khu khab skud 'dzin pa/ shar lhor bhan dha la dmar mo khab skud 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu rma 'phreng ma ser mo khab skud 'dzin pa/ nub byang du mchog ma dkar mo shing dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/byang shar du phag zhal ma dmar mo mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /sgor a lo dang ta lo dang / ka lo dang tsha lo rnams ni dkar mo dang / ser mo dang /dmar mo dang / ljang khu rnams lcags kyu dang / zhags pa dang / lcags sgog dang dril bu rnams 'dzin pa'o/ /lha mo nyer bzhi po rnams spyan dang /rgyan dang / cha lugs gtso bo dang 'thun pa'o/ /rnam snang la sogs pa rigs kyi bdag pos dbu la mtshan pa'o/ /thugs ka'i sa bon ni me ngo / /oṃ ma ri byi swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags bzlas la dbang bskur ba ni 'od zer can gyi'o/ /lha mo dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ rgyu las pho brang rtsibs bzhi gru chad sgo dang bcas pa bskyed la/ dbus su lha mo dbyangs can ma dkar mo 'khor lo dang pi waṃ 'dzin pa/ rdo rje sems ma la sogs pa yum bzhi dang / bdug ①sogs bzhi dang / sgo ba bzhis skor ba/ thugs kha'i sa bon hri'o/ /oṃ bi ti ti wi hri a ā i khra ②u spru/ ṛ dzā/ '-i gis/e i/ o chu e aḥrjo/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la dbang bskur ba ni lha mo dbyangs can ma dkar mo'o/ /yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ hūṃ las pho brang gling bcu gcig bskyed la/ dbus su pho brang 'dab ma brgyad pa la 47—1044

yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma zhal cig phyag bzhi dang po gnyis kyis po ti dang chos 'chad mdzad pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje/ g.yon dkur ①brten pa mdog ser mo'o/ /pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad la shar du sangs rgyas spyan dkar mo/ g.yon po ti dkur brten pa/ rin chen sgol ma ser mo dang / ma ma ki sngon mo po ti thogs pa sgrol ma ljang khu po ti thogs pa'o/ /shar lhor rdo rje sems ma dkar mo/ lho nub rin chen sems ma ser mo/ nub byang pad ma'i sems ma dmar mo/ byang shar las kyi sems ma lngang khu/ shar phyogs su mya ngan med pa'i dpal dkar po mchog sbyin mdzad pa la/ 'khor chos kyi rgyal mtshan dkar po rgyal mtshan thogs pa/ dbang phyug rgyal po sngon po lcags kyu thogs pa/ bkod pa'i rgyan dmar po po ti thogs pa/ rin chen 'od 'phro ljang khu rin po che thogs pa'o/ /lho phyogs su 'khor ba rgyun gcod sngon po po ti bsnams pa la 'khor snang ba'i mchog dkar po rin po che thogs pa/ phyag rgya'i rgyal po sngon po mda' gzhu thogs pa/ spobs pa'i rgyal po dmar po za ma tog thogs pa/ spobs pa brtsegs pa ljang khu gdugs thogs pa'o/ /nub tu 'gro ba'i dpal dmar po mche ba bsnams pa/ 'khor pad+ma'i rgyal po dkar po pad+ma thogs pa/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma sngon po pad+ma'i sdong bu 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje mi g.yo ba dmar po po ti 'dzin pa/ thogs med rgyal po ljang khu lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o/ /byang phyogs su thams cad dbang bsgyur ljang khu nyi ma'i steng na pad ma 'dzin pa la/'khor rin chen dbang phyug dkar po rin po che 'dzin pa/ sems dpa' grub pa sngon po rgya gram 'dzin pa/ dga' ston dmar po me long 'dzin pa/ mi g.yo'i tshul ljang khu phyag mnyam bzhag mdzad pa'o/ /byang shar du shākya mu ne+e ser 47byed1045

po chos 'chad mdzad pa la/ 'khor phyag rdor dkar po rdo rje bsnams pa/spyan ras gzigs sngon po pad+ma bsnams pa/ nam mkha' snying po dmar po za ma tog bsnams pa/ sa'i snying po ljang khu rin po che'i myu gu bsnams pa/ shar lhor ma chags pad+ma can sngo skya po ti 'dzin pa la/ 'khor kun bzang dkar po rin po che'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ 'jam dpal sngon po ud pal 'dzin pa/sgrib pa rnam sel dmar po ral gri 'dzin pa/ byams pa ljang ser klu shing thogs pa'o—/ /lho nub tu bdag don rnam grol dmar ser chos 'chad mdzad pa la/'khor mthu ①chen thob dkar po rdo rje thogs pa/ sman gyi rgyal po sngon po a ru ra bsnams pa/ yon tan snying po dmar po rin po che'i snye ma bsnams pa/mthong na dga' ba ljang khu klu shing gun ②dhe bsnams pa'o/ /nub byang 'khor ba bdud 'joms ser po mnyam gzhag ①mdzad pa la/ 'khor sems dpa' gzhon nu dkar po me tog 'dzin pa/ skyes bu dam pa sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa/seng ge sgra dmar po rnga yab 'dzin pa/ sems dpa' ljang khu sdigs mdzub byas pa'o—/ /steng du dga' ba sgyur ba'i dpal sngon po nyi zla 'dzin pa la/ 'khor bzang skyong dkar po bum pa 'dzin pa/ 'byung gnas sngon po rin po che 'dzin pa—/ dpa' bar 'gro ba dmar po ral gri 'dzin pa/ zla 'od gzhon nu ljang khu zla ba 'dzin pa'o/ /'og tu 'dam skyes pad+ma ser po sa gnon mdzad pa la/'khor ye shes tog dkar po ud pal 'dzin pa/ mya ngan kun 'joms dkar po ral gri 'dzin pa/ blo gros mi bzad pa dmar po po ti bsnams pa/ ye shes 'od ljang khu rdo rje rtse gsum pa bsnams pa'o/ /de ltar lha bskyed nas sngags ni 'di lta ste/ tad yā thā/ oṃ pradzño prazlo prarnye a lo ka ka ni/ a dzñā na bha dha 47—1046

snya ni/ sī dha pu sī dhi si ta man bha ga ba ti bhad sa le/ pra sa ri/ dha ha te/sgra ma shā sa kā ri/ ti ha ti ta/ shaṃ pā rka pā/ tsa la tsa la/ bha ra bha ra/gha4 gha4/ a ghad dzha/ a ghad rnye bha gha ba ti/ marwa martswa/ bi la gharba swā hā—/ zhes bzlas pas dbang bskur ba ni yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis bskor ba'i cho ga'o// //dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ tshogs sog pa dang 'byung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa sngon du song nas/ 'dir rgyu las nang re dmig dgu pa'am rtsibs brgyad pa/ phyi 'khyams rim pa gsum yod pa cig du bskyed la/ nang du lha bskyed pa ni/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su nyi zla pad+ma'i steng du g.yas su drag po dmar po phyag bzhi na mda' gzhu dang / lcags kyu zhags pa thogs pa/ g.yon du bdud dga' rab dbang phyug dkar po phyag bzhi na kha tram̐ kha dang cang te'u/ phyag gnyis kyis tho ba dang rdo rje rtse gsum pa 'dzin pa/ de'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje/ de las dpal dus kyi 'khor lo sku mdog mthing kha zhal bzhi phyag nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ zhal bzhi'i dbus mthing /g.yas dmar g.yon dkar/ rgyab ser po la phyag nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni/ dang po brgyad mthing kha/ bar pa brgyad dmar po/ tha ma brgyad dkar po la/ dang po gnyis thugs khar rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ g.yas rnams ni go rims bzhin du rdo rje dang ral gri dang / kha tram̐ kha dang / gri gug dang / mda' dang /lcags kyu dang / cang te'u dang / sta ri dang / 'khor lo dang / mdung dang / dbyug pa dang / tho ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon rnams ni go rims bzhin 47—1047

du—/ dril bu phub dang / tri shul dang / thod pa dang / gzhu dang /zhags pa dang / nor bu dang / pad+ma dang / dung dang / me long dang /lcags sgog tshangs pa'i mgo bo'o/ /zhabs gnyis ni/ g.yas dmar ba/g.yon dkar po'o/ /yum ser mo zhal bzhi mdun ser ba/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba/ rgyab nag pa/ phyag brgyad kyis g.yas dang po gri gug /'og ma lcags kyu/ gsum pa cang te'u/ bzhi pa phreng ba/ g.yon pa thod pa/zhags pa/ pad ma/ nor bu'o/ /shar du 'bar ma nag mo zhal bzhi pa/phyag brgyad kyis spos dang tsan dan gur gum gla rtsi'i snod thogs pa/ g.yon dril bu pad+ma ljon shing phreng ba'o/ /lhor 'bar ma dmar mo zhal bzhi/ phyag brgyad kyis mar me dang / do shal dang / cod pan dang / lag rdub/gos dang skegs regs dang / rin po che dang / brgyan dang rkang dung 'dzin pa'o—/ /nub 'bar ma ser mo zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/ dung dang gling bu dang / nor bu dang cang te'u dang / pi waṃ dang / rnga dang 'khar rnga dang dung 'dzin pa'o/ /byang byu 'bar ma dkar mo zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma 'o ma dang chu dang sman dang chang dang / bdud rtsi dang sha dang shing thog dang zan no/ /mtshams rnams su du ba ma nag mo dang / dmig rgyu ma dmar mo dang / mar me ser mo dang / mkha' gsal ma dkar mo rnams zhal bzhi phyag brgyad kyis rang gi mdog dang mtshungs pa'i rnga yab 'dzin pa'o/ /shar gyi rtsibs la don yod grub pa zhal gsum nag po dang dmar ba dang dkar ba'i zhal lo/ /phyag drug gis ral gri dang gri gug dang rtse gsum pa/ g.yon gyis phub dang thod pa dang kha tram̐ kha 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor rin 'byung dmar po dkar ba dang nag pa'i zhal/47—1048

phyag drug gis me'i mda' dang lcags kyu dang cang te'u dang / gzhu dang /zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu rnam snang ser po dkar ba dang nag pa'i zhal la/phyag gis 'khor lo dang dbyug ①pa dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa/ dung dang lcags sgog dang dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du snang ba mtha' yas dkar po nag pa dang dmar ba'i zhal la phyag g.yas pas tho ba dang mdung dang / rtse gsum pa/pad+ma dang me long bgrang phreng 'dzin pa'o/ /mtshalas rnams su sgrol ma dang gos dkar mo dang sangs rgyas srun dang / ma ma ki rnams sku mdog dang zhal dang phyag mtshan rang rang gi yab dang 'thun pa'o/ /shar stod du kun tu bzang po sngon po zhal gsum phyag drug gis rdo rje dang gri gug dang dgra sta dang / dril bu dang thod pa dang tshangs pa'i mgo 'dzin pa'o/ /shar smad du nam mkha'i snying po don grub lta bu'o/ /lho stod du phyag na rdo rje ljang khu phyag drug gis kun tu bzang po lta bu 'dzin pa/ lho smad du sa snying rin 'byung lta bu'o/ /nub stod du rdo rje chos kun tu bzang po lta bu/ nub smad sgrib pa rnam sel rnam snang lta bu'o/ /byang stod du ye shes rdo rje kun bzang lta bu'o/ /byang smad du sprun ras gzigs snang ba mtha' yas dang mtshungs pa'o/ /zur bzhir reg rdo rje ma dang dri rdo rjeka ma dang ro rdo rjekha ma dang / gzugs rdo rje ma rnams ni yum bzhi dang mtshungs pa'o/ /shar sgor khro bo rab rtog /lhor skugs byed/ nub rengs byed byang nga rgyal can—/ bzhi ni rigs bzhi dang mtshungs pa'o/ /thugs 'khor gyi dal lha so bzhi'o / /gsung gi dal rnam pa brgyad la shar du tsar tsi ka /dmar po zhal cig pa spyan gsum pa g.yas gri gug dang tri shu la/ g.yon gyis thod pa dang kha tram̐ kha 'dzin pa/ zhabs brkyang ②skum du bzhugs pa/ 'khor lha mo brgyad ni 47byed1049

'jigs byed ma dang drag mo dang / mche ba nag mo dang / me 'bar ma dang /rlung shugs ma dang / rab gtum ma dang / drag dmig ma dang / spos mo brgyad ni sku mdog phyag mtshan gtso mo dang 'thun no/ /shar lhor khyab 'jug ma nag mo 'khor lo dang dbyug tho dang pad+ma dang mdung 'dzin pa la/ 'khor dpal mo dang sgyu mo dang / grang mo dang phun sum tshogs ma dang rnam par rgyal ma dang / rgyal byed ma dang / 'khor lo ma rnams sku mdog phyag mtshan gtso mo dang 'thun no/ /lhor phag gdong ma dmar mo dbyug pa dang ral gri dang lcags sgrog dang / phub 'dzin pa la/ 'khor keng rus ma dang / dus mtshan ma dang / khro bo ma dang / lce nag ma dang / mcher bcigs ma dang /nag mo dang 'jigs ma dang / gzugs can ma rnams so/ /lho nub tu gzhon nu ma dmar mo phyag na shag ti dang lcags kyu bsnams pa/ rin chen dang zhags pa 'khor pad+ma dang yan lag ma dang / gzhon nu ma dang / ri dwags ma dang /bur 'gro ma dang / rin chen phreng ba ma dang / spyan ma dang gdug ma dang bzang mo'o/ /nub tu dbang mo dmar mo rdo rje dang mda' dang / dril bu dang gzhu 'dzin pa la 'khor rdo rje 'od dang lugs can ma dang gser ldan ma dang las dbang ma dang / sna tshogs ma dang chu shing ma dang a ha la dang / mig 'bras ma rnams so/ /nub byang 'tshams su tshangs pa ma ser mo pad+ma dang dbyug pa dang bum pa dang chu'i snod 'dzin pa/ 'khor pad can dang chu skyes can dang gol ma dang / dbang phyug ma dang ngag dri ma dang glag 'grol ma dang / dran ma rnams so/ /byang du drag mo dkar mo rtse gsum dang cang te'u dang kha tram̐ kha dang sbrul 'dzin pa la/ 'khor go ri dang rka ka ma dang stan ma dang / myur ma 47—1050

dang / dod ma dang / mtshan can ma dmar ser dang nag mo rnams so/ /dbang ldan du seng ge'i steng du pad+ma'i ze 'bru la gnas pa phun sum tshogs ma dkar mo g.yas gnyis na pad ma bgrang phreng ba dang rdo rje me tog dang rin po che 'dzin pa la 'khor pad+mo dang zla ba'i ri mo dang ri 'ong 'dzin ma dang ngang ma'i mdog dang / dga' ma dang pad dbang dang spyan rings dang / dri med ma'o//lha mo brgyad po thams cad zhal rang rang gi gtso mo la gzigs pa/ sku mdog phyag mtshan gtso mo dang 'dra ba/ spyan gsum pa 'gying ba'i tshul gyis bzhengs nas bzhugs pa ni gsung gi dal lo/ /de nas sku'i dal bcu gnyis ni/ gtso bo la zhag sum cus gtso byas pa'i lha sum brgya bdun cu rtsa gnyis la dal bcu gnyis ston te/ zla ba dang po'i spyid zla ra ba'i lha shar stod du pad+ma dmar po bzhi brgyad cu drug gi steng du dbus der spyid zla ra ba'i lha srin po nag po ral gri dang gri gug dang phub dang thod pa thogs pa la nya stong gnyis kyi lha ni/ gtso bo'i g.yas g.yon la gzhan ni pad+ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad la'o/ /dal bcu gnyis kyi 'khor sku mdog phyag mtshan thams cad gtso bo dang 'thun pa'o/ /shar smad du spyid zla 'bring po'i lha ①khyab 'jug nag po 'khor lo dang pad+ma dang dbyug tho dang dung 'dzin pa la zhag gis ②lha sum cus bskor ba'o/ /shar lhor spyid zla tha chungs kyi lha rlung lha nag po shing dang me tog dang rin po che dang ud pal 'dzin pa la 'khor sum cus bskor ba'o/ /lho stod du gshin rje dmar po ral gri dang dbyug pa dang lcags sgrog dang zhags pa thogs pa la rang 'dra ba sum cus skor ba ni dbyar zla ra ba'i lha'o/ /lho smad du dbyar zla 'bring po'i lha me lha dmar po shag ti dang dbyug to dang pad+ma dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa la 'khor sum cus skor 47—1051

ba'oske/ /lho nub tu dbyar zla tha chungs kyi lha gdong drug dmar po shag ti dang mdung dang rin po che dang me long 'dzin pa zhag gi lha sum cus bskor ba'o/ /nub stod du ston zla ra ba'i lha lus ngan ser po nor bu dang dbyug to dang ne+e le dang pad+ma 'dzin pa la 'khor ①sum cus skor skeba'o/ /nub smad du ston zla 'bring po'i lha dbang po ser po rdo rje dang me'i mda' dril bu dang gzhu'o/ /de 'khor sum cus bskor ba'o/ /nub byang du ston zla tha chungs kyi lha tshangs pa ser po khab dang bgrang phreng dang pad+ma dang rdzas snod 'dzin pa'o/ /'khor sum cus bskor ba'o/ /byang stod du dgun zla ra ba'i lha drag po dkar po rtse gsum dang mda' dang sbrul dang gzhu 'dzin pa la 'khor sum cus bskor ba'o/ /byang smad du dgun zla 'bring po'i lha rgya mtsho'i lha dkar po/ zhags pa dang rin po che dang chu shel dang nor bu 'dzin pa la 'khor sum cus bskor ba'o/ /byang shar du dgun zla tha chungs kyi lha tshogs kyi bdag po dkar po dgra sta dang rdo rje dang zhags pa dang rin chen 'dzin pa la 'khor sum cus skor ba'o/ /shar stod du dpyid zla ra ba'i lha khyab 'jug nag po 'khor lo dang / dbyug to dang /pad ma dang / dung 'dzin pa la/ rang dang 'dra ba'i 'khor sum cus skor ba ni thams cad gcig go/ /shar sgor khro bo dbyug pa sngon po don yod grub pa lta bu'o—/ /lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po rin 'byung lta bu'o/ /nub tu stobs po che rnam par snang mdzad lta bu'o/ /byang du mi g.yo ba snang ba mtha' yas lta bu'o/ /steng du gtsug tor 'khor lo sgyur ba phyag na rdo rje lta bu'o/ /'og tu khro bo gnod ①mdzes kun tu bzang po lta bu'o/ /de ltar lha bskyed nas spyan drangs mchod pa byas thugs khar sa bon hūṃ bkod de/ ā+oṃ shri ka la tsag kra ye hūṃ swā hā/ zhes 47—1052

bzlas nas bstod de dbang bskur ba ni dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'o/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi mngon par rtogs pa ni/ tshogs bsag pa dang 'byung ba lnga'i dal gyi steng du rgyu las gzhal yas khang nang re dmig dgu la pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pas skor ba 'khyams sgo dang bcas pa bskyed la nyi zla pad ma'i steng du 'jam pa'i rdo rje sku mdog ser po rnam par snang mdzad kyi ngo bo mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba zhal g.yas sngo/ g.yon dkar ba/ phyag drug g.yas kyis ral gri dang mchog sbyin dang mda'/ g.yon gyis po ti dang ud pal dang gzhu bsnams pas chos kyi dbyengs kyi dbang phyug ma rang lta bu la 'khyud pa—/ shar du mi bskyod pa 'thing kha dkar ba dang dmar ba'i zhal/ phyag drug gis rdo rje dang lcags kyu dang mda' dang gzhu dril bu dang nu ma 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor rin 'byung ser po sngo ba dang dkar ba'i zhal/ phyag dang po gnyis rin chen dang mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ 'og ma thams cad mi bskyod ①pa lta bu'o/ /nub tu 'od dpag med dmar po zhal g.yas dkar g.yon sngo ba'o/ /phyag dang po gnyis pad+ma kha 'byed pa 'og ma bzhi 'dre'o/ /byang don yod grub pa ljang khu zhal dmar ba dang dkar ba'o/ /phyag dang po gnyis rgya gram dang ral gri 'dzin pa—/ 'og ma bzhi 'dra/ zur bzhir sangs rgyas spyan dang ma ma ki dang gos dkar mo dang sgol ma bzhi rigs bzhi dang sku mdog dang zhal dang phyag mtshan 'thun pa'o/ /pad+ma brgyad la sems ma rdo rje ma dang / rin chen rdo rje ma dang /chos kyi rdo rje ma dang / las kyi rdo rje ma dang / tsun dha ma dang / rin chen skar mda' ma dang / khro gnyer ma dang / rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma rnams sku mdog 47—1053

phyag mtshan rigs bzhi dang 'thun pa las khyad par phyag g.yon gyi 'og ma sdogs mdzub byas pa'o/ /khums la skal bzangs bcu drug /zhal cig phyag gnyis pa'o—/ /sgo bzhi dang zur bzhi steng 'og gnyis khro bo bcu 'phags skor lta bu'o//rigs kyi bdag po rnams kyis dbu la mtshan pa'o/ /spyan drangs mchod nas thugs khar sum̐ bkor nas/ oṃ bā gi shwa ri sum̐ zhes pa ni snying po'i sngags so/ /sgyegs pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i 'jam pa'i rdo rje'o/ /slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pa'i bzhed kyis chos dbyings ngag dbang mtshan brjod kyi mngon par rtogs pa bsgom pa ni/ tshogs sog pa dang 'byung ba lnga'i dal bskyed pa sngon du song nas/ 'dir bye las gzhal yas khang nang re dmig dgu pa la khyams rim pa gsum pa sgo dang bcas pa bskyed la lha bskyed pa ni nyi zla pad+ma'i steng du 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog ser po zhal bzhi pa/ser ba dang sngo ba dang dmar ba dang dkar ba'i zhal bzhi pa la phyag brgyad kyi dang po gnyis chos kyi 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ gzhan drug ni ral gri dang rdo rje darja mda' dbaṃ po ti dang / dril bu dang gzhu bsnams pa'o/ /rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa la 'khor gtsug tor brgyad sku mdog ser po g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon pas rang gi gdan gnan pa'o/ /shar gyi re dmig la mi bskyod pa mthing kha zhal sngon po dang dkar po dang ser po'i dang dmar ba'i zhal la/ lhor rin chen 'byung ldan ser po nag po dang dkar ba dang dmar ba'i zhal/ byang du don yod grub pa ljang khu ser ba dang dkar ba dang dmar ba'i zhal lo/ /nub tu 'od dpag med dmar po nag pa dang dkar ba dang ser 47—1054

ba'i zhal lo/ /zur bzhi la spyan ma dang ma ma ki dang gos dkar mo dang sgrol ma dang bzhi sku mdog zhal phyag rigs bzhi dang 'dra ba la/ yum brgyad kyi phyag na ral gri dang mda' dang lcags kyu dang 'dzin pa snyigs mdzub dang zhags pa dang dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /rigs bzhi la rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa sems dpa' bcu drug gis rdo rje 'byung ba ltar bskor/ sgo bzhi la lcags kyu ma la sogs pa sgo ma bzhi'o/ /gru chad bzhi la gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo me long 'dzin pa/ ro rdo rje ma dmar mo zhal zas 'dzin pa/ sgra rdo rje ma ljang khu pi waṃ 'dzin pa/ reg rdo rje ma sna tshogs mdog can gos 'dzin pa/ khyams bar ma la shar du sa bcu lha mo bcu ni lhag par mos pa dang / rab tu dga' ba ma dang /dri ma med pa dang / 'od byed ma dang / 'od 'phro ma dang / sbyang dka' ma dang / mngon du gyur ma dang / ring du song ma dang / mi g.yo ma dang /legs pa'i blo gros ma dang / chos kyi sprin ma'o/ /lhor pha rol phyin ma bcu'i lha mo ni/ shes rab ma dang / sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / thabs dang / smon lam dang / stobs dang / ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin ma bcu'o/ /nub tu dbang bcu'i lha mo ni/ tshe la dbang ma dang / sems la/ yo byad la/las la/ skye ba la/ rdzu 'phrul la/ mos pa la/ smon lam la/ ye shes la/chos la dbang ma'o/ /byang du gzugs ma bcu'i lha ni/ nor rgyun ma dang /rin chen skar mda' ma dang / rnam par rgyal ma dang / 'od zer can ma dang / ri khrod ma dang / dug sel ma dang / sgo mtha' yas ma dang /tsun dha ma dang / shes rab 'phel ma dang / sgrib sel ma'o/ /lha mo bzhi 47byed1055

bcu po 'di rnams ni/ shar du dkar mo rdo rje thogs pa/ lhor ser mo rin po che thogs pa/ nub tu dmar mo pad+ma thogs pa'o/ /byang ljang khu rgya gram thogs pa'o/ /sgo bzhir chos dang / don dang / nges pa dang / spobs pa rnams yang dag par rig pa'i lha mo bzhi lcags kyu la sogs pa thogs pa'o/ /khyams phyi ma la skal bzangs bcu drug dang / sgo'i g.yas g.yon du sgog ①sogs bzhi dang / bdug ④sogs bzhi bskyed par bya'o/ /sgo bzhi dang zur bzhi steng 'og gnyis su khro bo bcu gsang 'dus ltar bskyed par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bdag pos so so'i dbu la mtshan pa ni sngar ltar ro/ /thugs kha'i sa bon ni sum̐ ngo / /snying po'i sngags ni a ā sarba ta thā dze+eg ta hri ta ya ha ra ha ra oṃ hūṃ hri bha ga bā rjon rnye na mur tī bā gi shwa ra ma hā ⑤pa tsa sarba dharma ga ga rjon a ma lā ⑦su pa ri shudha dharmā dha ⑧du dzha na gar ba ⑨u zhes bzlas la dbang bskur ba ni/ngag gi dbang phyug gi'o/ /mtshan brjod zab pa gdam ngag can kyi mngon par rtogs pa ni/ tshogs sog pa dang 'byung ba lnga'i dal bskyed pa sngar ltar la/ 'dir rgyu las pad+ma 'dab bzhi rtsibs brgyad gru chad la sgo btod ⑩pa can du bskyed la nang du lha bskyed pa ni a las ye shes sems dpa' ser po zhal cig phyag bzhi pa rtsibs bzhi la lha mo bzhi/ rtsibs brgyad sgo gru chad rnams la sems dpa' bcu drug bskyed la/spyan drang ba dang phyag 'tshal ba dang / mchod pa dang / sngags ni/ oṃ bā gi shwa ri sum̐ bzlas la dbang bskur ba ni/ mtshan brjod zab pa'i cho ga'i rim pa'o/ /47—1056

pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug gi mngon par rtogs pa ni/ tshogs bsag pa dang 'byung ba lnga'i dal bskyed pa sngon du song nas/ 'dir bye las pho brang 'dab brgyad gru chad la sgo btod pa can du bskyed la/ lha bskyed pa ni nyi zla pad+ma'i steng du hri las khro bo rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal gsum g.yas sngo g.yon dkar ba spyan gsum gsum mo/ /phyag brgyad pa g.yas kyi rdo rje dang / dbyug pa sdigs mdzub dang mda' 'phyar ba'o/ /g.yon na khyung dang yum gyi nu ma 'dzin pa/pad+ma dang gzhu 'phyar ba'o/ /yum gos dkar mo dmar mo yab kyi sku la 'khril cing g.yas kyis gri gug gis yab la 'khyud cing g.yon dung dmar gtso la stobs pa dur khrod kyi chas khro bo'i brgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /'khor kyi lha mo brgyad ni shar nas brtsams nas/ rnam par gzigs dkar mo dang / rdo rje sems ma dkar ser dang / dbang phyug ma ser mo dang / rin chen sems ma ser sngo dang khro gnyer can sngon mo dang / pad+ma'i sems ma sngo ljang ①dang / sgol ma ljang khu dang / sna tshogs ma ljang dkar rnams g.yas pad+ma dang g.yon thod pa snams pa'o/ /gru chad bzhi la bdug ②sogs bzhi'o/ /sgo bzhir sgo ma bzhi'o/ /thugs kha'i sa bon hri'o/ /oṃ ha ya spru ba swā hā zhes zlas la dbang bskur ba ni rta mgrin pad+ma gar kyi dbang phyug gi yin no/ /yi ge brgya pa'i lha rdo rje sems dpa'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad gru chad la sgo btod pa can du bskyed la/ lha bskyed pa ni bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs khar/g.yon dril bu dkur perten pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang 0ba bskyed la/ rtsibs 47—1057

brgyad la rigs bzhi dang yum bzhi dang / bdug ①sogs bzhi dang / sgo ba bzhi bskyed la/ thugs kha'i sa bon ni hūṃ la yi ge brgya pas bskor la zlas pa byas nas dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa'i'o/ /shes rab 'khor lo a ra pa tsa na'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ bye las pad+ma 'dab bzhi pa'i bskyed la/ der a las 'jam dpal a pa ra tsa sku mdog dkar po phyag gis ral gri dang po ti 'dzin pa/ shar du ra las dra ba can dkar mo/ lhor pa las rdzogs pa'i zla ba ma dkar po/ nub tu tsa las rdzogs pa'i sgra can ma dkar mo/ byang du na las nye ba'i sgra can ma dkar mo/ sku mdog phyag mtshan gtso bo lta bu'o/ /ā+oṃ ā ra pa tsa na ye swā hā zhes bzlas la dbang bskur ba ni a ra pa tsa'/ /gzungs dral lnga'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ rgyu las lte ba re mig dgu pa gru chad la sgo btod par bskyed la/ dbus su so so 'brang ma ser mo zhal bzhi dkar ba dang dmar ba dang sngo ba'i mdog can/ phyag bcu na 'khor lo dang /mchod sbyin dang lcags kyu dang / mda' dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ g.yon du rdo rje dang sdigs mdzub dang / zhags pa dang / gzhu dang / dgra sta 'dzin pa/shar du stong chen mo dkar mo zhal bzhi sngon po dang ser po dang ljang khu'o/ /phyag bcu na 'khor lo dang mchog sbyin dang lcags kyu dang mda' dang ral gri'o/ /g.yon rdo rje sdigs 'dzub/ zhags pa gzhu dgra sta rnams so/ /lhor gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma nag mo dkar ba dang dmar ba dang ser ba'i zhal lo/ /47—1058
