phyag bcu gnyis ni dang po gnyis chos 'chad 'og ma gnyis mnyam bzhag /de 'og brgyad kyis rdo rje dang mda' dang / mchog ①byin dang mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang / zhags pa dang gzhu dang / pad+ma dang bum pa 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu bsil ba'i tshal dmar mo dkar ba dang nag pa dang ser ba'i zhal lo/ /phyag brgyad kyis pad+ma dang mda' dang rdo rje dang ral gri dang zhags pa dang gzhu dang rgyal mtshan dang po ti dang / byang du rma bya chen po ljang khu nag po dang dkar ba dang ser ba'i zhal/ phyag na rma bya dang mda' dang mchog sbyin dang / ral gri dang /lhung bzed dang / gzhu dang bum pa dang / sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /zur bzhir rgyal po chen po bzhi/ gru chad la bdug sdesogs bzhi/ sgo ba bzhi'o/ /lha mo lnga'i sa bon ni dre bye hūṃ rdzu me ngo / /oṃ ma ni dha ri badz+re ni ma hā pra ti swā ri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bzlas la dbang bskur ba ni gral lnga'o/ /khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo mgon gyi mngon par rtogs pa ni/ rgyu las 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa babyed la/ nyi zla pad+ma'i steng du bgegs kyi rgyal po dgyel ba'i steng du hūṃ las ral gri/ de las mi g.yo ba sku mdog mthing nag zhal cig phyag gnyis g.yas kyis shel gyi ral gri 'debs pa'i tshul/ g.yon pas sdigs 'dzub la rdo rje'i zhags pa dkris ④pa/ zhabs gnyis bskyang skum du bzhugs pa/rtsibs bcu la rang dang 'dra ba'i khro bo bcu gnas pa'o/ /thugs kha'i sa bon ni hūṃ ngo / /oṃ badz+ra tsan dha ma ha ro sha na hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes bzlas nas dbang bskur ba ni mi g.yo ba'o/ /47—1059

phyag na rdo rje dzā ba ri pa 'khor lo chen po'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/tshogs bsag pa dang sdig pa bshags pa dang 'byung ba lnga'i dal bskyed pa sngon du song nas/ 'dir rgyu las gzhal yas khang 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi gru chad la sgo btod pa can du bskyed la/ lha bskyed pa ni nyi zla pad+ma'i steng du dbus su tshangs pa dang brgya byin/ shar dri za/ lho gshin rje/ nub chu bdag /byang gnod sbyin—/ de'i steng du hūṃ las thod pa dang rdo rje dang / de las sangs rgyas gos sngon po can/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa zhal g.yas dkar ba/ g.yon dmar ma/spyan gsum 'jigs su rung ba/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis na rdo rje dang sdigs mdzub 'phyar ba/ bar ma gnyis yum la 'khyud pa/ tha ma gnyis sbrul sked pa nas bzung nas za ba/ zhabs g.yas skum pa/ g.yon rkyang ①ba/ yum lha mo mdzes ldan ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa sku la 'khril ba'o—/ /shar du khro bo bdud las rgyal dkar po zhal cig phyag bzhi dang po gnyis rdo rje dang kha tram̐ kha 'phyar ba/ 'og ma gnyis sdigs 'dzub bsnol ba yum la 'khyud parka/ yum 'od zer can dkar mo lhor rdo rje gzi brjid ser po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ 'og ma sdogs 'dzub bsnol bas yum mdangs can ma ser mo la 'khyud pa'o/ /nub tu rngam pa sgra sgogs dmar po zhal cig phyag bzhi pa dang pos rdo rje dang sbrul zhags 'dzin pa 'og ma gnyis kyis yum sgra can ma dmar mo la 'ag pa/ byang du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ljang khu zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa dang po gnyis rdo rje dang be+e con 'dzin pa/tha ma gnyis sdigs 'dzub kyis yum rlung 'byin ma la 'a da pa/ yum bzhi'i phyag mtshan gtso mo dang 'dra/ sgo bzhir sgo ma bzhi bskyed par bya'o/ /thugs 47—1060

kha'i sa bon ni hūṃ ngo / /ye shes pa spyan drangs mchod la/ oṃ ni lo bha ra dha ra badz+ra pa ni hri dha ya ma hā gro ta sa ta hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes bzlas ①la dbang bskur ba ni 'khor lo chen po'i cho ga'o/ /bdud rtsi thigs pa'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ pad+ma 'dab bzhi sgo dang bcas pa bskyed la/ lha bskyed pa ni nyi zla pad+ma dang tshangs pa brgya byen gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsams la/ de yongs su gyur pa las sangs rgyas gos sngon po can/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba/ phyag drug gi dang po rdo rje dang sdigs 'dzub/ bar ma thal mo sdebs pa/ tha ma gnyis sbrul gdug pa bzung nas zhal du za ba/ zhabs g.yas ④skyang g.yon skum nas gdug pa can gnan pa/ sbrul dang stag gis brgyan pa/ phyogs bzhi nas ye shes lnga mtshon pa'i rdo rje bzhi bskyed la/ thugs kha'i sa bon ni hūṃ ngo / /oṃ badz+ra pa ni ni lo bha ra dha ra hri ta ya ma ha tro ka ta sad ta hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bzlas la dbang bskur ba ni/ bdud rtsi thigs pa'o/ /mdor bsdus pa'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi sgo dang bcas pa bskyed la/ nyi zla pad+ma'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje/ de las gos sngon po can zhal cig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang sdigs 'dzub byas pa/ sku mdog 'thing nag can me dpung 'bar ba'i klu rigs brgyad kyis sku la brgyan pa/ pad+ma brgyad la hūṃ brgyad yod pa/ thugs khar rdo rje dang hūṃ bkod pa/ ā+oṃ ni lo bha ra dha ra badz+ra pa ni ma hā gro ta sa twa hūṃ/ zhes bzlas la dbang bskur ba ni mdor bsdus pa'i'o/ /47—1061

mchod rten sngon po'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ rgyu las pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i steng du mchod rten lnga dang bcas pa bskyed la/ der hūṃ las rdo rje/de las dpal phyag na rdo rje mdog sngon po zhabs g.yas skum g.yon brkyang ba'i mchan khung na lha'i dbang po brgya byin mdog dkar po glang po che'i steng na rdo rje thogs pa'i steng na bcom ldan 'das phyag g.yas kyis rdo rje nam mkha' la 'phyar ba—/ g.yon gyis mchan khung na lha'i bu nyi ma sku mdog dmar po rta bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta'i steng na rdo rje pad+ma'i snams pa'i steng na rje btsun gyi phyag g.yon pa dril bu dang sdigs 'dzub mdzad pa rteg pa nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /shar du rnam par snang mdzad byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/lho rin chen 'byung ldan mchog sbyin/ nub snang ba mtha' yas mnyam bzhag /byang don yod grub pa skyabs sbyin/ thugs kha'i sa bon ni mchod rten dang hūṃ ngo //sngags ni gzungs rings so/ /rjes la dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /rdo rje gtum po khyung gsham can gyi mngon par rtogs pa ni/ rgyu las 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi gru chad la sgo btod pa can bskyed la/ a las zla ba'i steng du dbang phyug chen po dang u ma dhe ba'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje gtum po sku mdog nag po zhal cig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje 'phyar zhing sdigs 'dzub gdengs pa/snyigs 'dzub steng na khyung rnam par 'phro ba/ thod pa skam po'i dbu rgyan dang brlon pa'i do shal byas pa stag gi sham thabs dang sbrul rigs bzhis sku la brgyan pa—/ shar du rnam rgyal dkar po rdo rje dang sdogs 'dzub byas pa/ lhor 47—1062

gshin rje ser po thod dbyug dang sdigs 'dzub byas pa/ nub tu rta ma grin dmar po khu shing dang sdigs 'dzub byas pa/ byang du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa lngang khu dbyug to dang sdogs 'dzub byas pa'o/ /thugs kha'i sa bon ni hūṃ ngo / /oṃ badz+ra tsan dha ma ha ro sha na hūṃ phaṭa zhes bzlas la dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje gtum po'o/ /rdo rje khyung gi mngon par rtogs pa ni/ rgyu las 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad sgo dang bcas pa bskyed la/ der nyi zla pad+ma'i steng du khrom las rdo rje/ de las 'dab chags kyi rgyal po khyung sems can rnam pa drug las grub ste/ ru 'bri/mig sbal pa/ 'tshul pa lug /lag pa mi bshog pa bya/ rkang pa gcan zan gyi sder mo/ sgrul za zhing sku mdog nag po'o/ /rtsibs brgyad la rdo rje'i khyung dang dbyug to dang / rin chen dang / tho ba dang / pad+ma dang ral gri dang /rgya gram dang / gri gug dang / khyung nag cing 'jigs pa bskyed par bya'o/ /oṃ ka ru na nan sbad lus btul/ na ga ma ra na ya re ram̐ dz+wa la shi shi tul tul/'phung sngad swā hā zhes bzlas la dbang bskur ba ni khyung gi'o/ /jo bo spyan ras gzigs yab yum kyi mngon par rtogs pa ni/ rgyu las phyogs la pad ma zur la 'khor lo'i rtsibs te 'dab ma brgyad pa bskyed la/ nyi zla pad+ma'i steng du hri la jo bo spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog shin tu dmar brka/ zhal cig pa spyan gsum pa 'dzum pa'i gseb na cung zad khro ba/ dbu skra ya la thor tshugs dang mar la sil ma yod pa/ zhabs g.yas cung zad skyang zhing g.yon skum pa/ phyag gnyis g.yas mu tig gi phreng ba 'dren pa/ g.yon ud pal 47—1063

'dzin pa yum la 'khyud pa/ yum gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo phyag g.yas gser gyi ḍa ma ru sgol ba/ g.yon thod khrag gtso la stob ①pa sku la 'khril ba'o—/ /shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo/ lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo/ nub pad+ma'i mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo/ byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro ma ljang khu'o—/ /gri gug dang thod pa thogs nas zhabs byed dkyil mdzad pa/ shar lhor rdo rje rigs kyi ging dkar po rdo rje dang thod pa thogs pa/ lho nub rin chen rigs kyi ging ser po rin po che thogs pa nub byang pad+ma rigs kyi ging dmar po pad+ma thogs pa/ byang shar du las kyi ging ljang khu rgya gram thogs pa'o/ /g.yon ud pal thogs pa'o/ /thugs kha'i sa bon ni hri'o/ /oṃ ma be+e pad me hūṃ ru ma gha ye ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya swā hā zhes bzlas la dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /'phags pa seng ge sgra sgrogs kyi mngon par rtogs pa ni/ rgyu las pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa bskyed la/ dbus su hri las seng ge'i steng du 'phags pa seng ge ⑪sgra sku mdog dkar po zhal cig phyago gnyis pa/ nang pa'i rtags su spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yon na pad+ma dkar po'i dkyil na ral gri 'bar ba dang pad+ma dkar po'i steng na thod pa dkar po me tog gis bkang ba'o/ /phyag g.yas na tri shu la rtse gsum sbrul gyis brgyan pa'i kha nas 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum skyug pa'o/ /pad+ma bzhi la snang ba mtha' yas kyi gnas su rnam par snang mdzad byas pa'i rigs bzhi'o/ /thugs kha'i sa bon ni hri'o/ /oṃ a sing ha na dha hūṃ phaṭa zhes bzlas la dbang bskur ba ni seng ge sgra'i cho ga'o/ /47—1064

don yod zhags pa'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ rgyu las 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa can cig tu babyed la/ lha bsgom pa ni dbus su jo bo khar sa pa ni sku mdog dkar po zhal cig phyag gnyis g.yas skyabs sbyin/ g.yon pa pad+ma thogs pa—/ shar du don yod zhags pa dmar po zhal cig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas zhags pa dang rdo rje/ g.yon lcags kyu dang bgrang phreng bsnams pa'o/ /lhor khro gnyer can sngo skya phyag bzhi g.yas na dbyug tho dang / pad+ma/ g.yon bum pa dang phreng ba thogs pa'o/ /nub rta mgrin dmar po be con sdigs 'dzub g.yon 'khor lo pad+ma thogs pa'o/ /byang du e ka dza ti mthing nag phyag brgyad g.yas na ral gri zhags pa pad+ma mda'o/ /g.yon 'khor lo dbyug to rtse gsum gzhu thogs pa—/ oṃ na ma sa man ta 'bu ta nan sarba ta thā gā ta a ba lo ki te ka ru na sa ma ya sa man ta mur te e hūṃ dza swā hā zhes spyan drangs bzlas pa byas mchod nas dbang bskur ba ni don yod zhags pa'o/ /rdo rje phag mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ rgyu las phag mo'i dal thams cad 'dab ma brgyad pa bskyed pa'i dbus su baṃ las gri gug de las rdo rje phag mo dmar mo zhal gsum g.yas sngo/ g.yon dkar ba/ spyan gsum pa/ skra grol zhing thod pa'i dbu brgyan dang mi mgo'i phreng ba byas pa/phyag drug gis rdo rje dang / dril bu dang / mda' gzhu dang / lcags kyu dang / thod pa dang / kha tram̐ kha bcas pa/ zhabs phyed skyis kyis bzhugs pa/phyogs kyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo la ma ljang khu/ dum skyes ma dmar moske/ gzugs can ma ser mo/ ro'i steng na nyi ma la dkyil krungs phyed pa'i 47—1065

gar gyis bzhugs pa gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /zur bzhi la thod pa bzhi'oske/ /sgo bzhir khu gdong ma dang / 'ug gdong ma dang / khyi gdong ma dang / phag gdong ma dang / zur bzhir gshin rje bsreg ma dang / pho nya ma dang / mche ba ma dang / 'joms ma rnams babyed la/ ā+oṃ shri badz+ra bha ra hi a hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa ni te lo pa'i phag mo'o/ /rje na ro pa'i phag mo'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ hūṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad kyi steng du ro'i steng du baṃ las rdo rje phag mo zhal cig phyag gnyis ma gri gug dang thod pa kha tram̐ kha 'dzin pa'o/ /sku mdog dmar mo phyed skyil gyis bzhugs pa 'khor gyi lha mo bcu gnyis sngar ltar ro/ /oṃ sarba bud dha ḍā ①ki ni ye badz+ra warna ni ye hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa ni na ro pa'i'o/ /yang rgyu las rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mo zhal gnyis g.yas na phag zhal sngon mos mtshan pa/ phyag gnyis gri gug thod pa kha tram̐ kha 'dzin pa/ 'khor lha mo bcu gnyis sngar ltar ro/ /oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bhud dha ḍā tī ni ye badz+ra warna ni ye badz+ra bai ro tsa na ye hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bzlas la dbang bskur ba ni zhal gnyis ma'o// //don thams cad grub pa'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ rgyu las pho brang phe las ro'i steng du don grub ma dmar mo zhal cig phyag bzhi ma rdo rje lcags kyu zhags pa thod pa kha tram̐ kha 'dzin pa/ 'khor ni lngar ro/ /oṃ badz+ra ba ra hi a 47—1066

ste sha ya sarba duṣ+ṭa tri swā hā/ zhes pa ni don grub ma'o/ /dbu bcad ma'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ rgyu las pho brang baṃ las gri gug/de las dbu bcad ma dmar ser la de'i g.yas su ljang khu g.yon du ser mo phyag gis gri gug dang nyid kyi thod pa 'dzin pa/ dbu skra grol zhing gcer bu spyan gsum dang ldan pa zhabs g.yas skyang ba/ g.yon skum pa/ gri gug gis rang gi ske bcad nas khrag gsol ba/ 'khor bcu gnyis ni gong ltar ro/ /oṃ sarba bhud dha ḍā ki ni ye/ oṃ badz+ra warna ni ye/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa ni ye hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā—/ zhes bzlas nas dbang bskur ba ni dbu bcad ma'i cho ga'o/ /phag mo nag mo'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ rgyu las pho brang skyed la/der hūṃ las gri gug de las rdo rje phag mo mthing nag zhal cig phyag gnyis kyis gre gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ phag zhal steng na nor bu'i srun gsum yod pa/shar ro nyi'i dkar mo 'khor lo dang tri shul 'dzin pa/ lhor kharnya ro nyi ser mo ḍa ①ma ru dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu sa spyod ma dmar mo lcags kyu zhags pa 'dzin pa/ byang du mkha' spyod ljang khu rdo rje 'khor lo thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /thugs kha'i sa bon ni/ hūṃ he dha ti a'o/ /oṃ sarba jud dha ḍā ki ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bzlas pa dbang bskur ba ni phag mo nag mo'i cho ga'o/ /mi ②tri pa'i mkha' spyod ma'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ rgyu las dal bskyed la de'i nang du lha bskyed pa ni baṃ las rdo rje de las rje btsun ma dmar mo 47—1067

mkha' spyod ma kha gyen la lta zhing rkang pa g.yas pa nam mkha' la gtad pa'i phyag g.yas pa babyud khung nas gteg nas rdo rje nam mkha' la gtad pa/ zhabs g.yon pa la rnam pa'i phyag gis thod pa 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad spangs pa'o//rtsibs brgyad la rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / gshin rje mo dang / yid bzhin mo dang / smongs byed mo dang / dbang bsdud ma dang / kun byed ma dang /kun grags ma dang gtum mo ste brgyad bskyed la/ oṃ baṃ haṃ oṃ hri mo hre hri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bzlas la dbang bskur ba ni mi ①tri mkha' spyod do/ /phag mo zhal bzhi'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ rgyu las pho brang bde mchog gi dal ltar bskyed la/ lha bskyed pa ni gri gug de las phag mo zhal bzhi dmar ba dang ser ba sngo ba dang ljang khu'o/ /phyag bcu gnyis ni dang po gri gug /g.yon pa thod khrag /de 'og gnyis kyis zhing pags bsnams pa/ cang te'u/rdo rje dgra sta sbe ha g.yas/ kha tram̐/ thod pa zhags pa tshangs pa'i mgo/zhabs gnyis phyed dkyil gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /'khor gyi lha mo sum cu rtsa drug ni gtso mo ltar phyag bzhi bzhi'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ gsum ma'o/ /de nas dbang bskur bar bya ba ni zhal bzhi ma'o/ /sgol ma nyi shu rtsa cig ma'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ rgyu las pad+ma 'dab bzhi dang 'dab brgyad gru chad la sgo btod pa can bskyed la/ der lha bskyed pa ni dbus su sgol ma dmar mo zhal gcig spyan gsum phyag brgyad ma dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu spyi bor 'dzin pa/ de 'og gnyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/47—1068

de 'og gnyis 'khor lo dang mdung 'dzin pa/ de 'og gnyis ral gri dang zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /rtsibs bzhi'i shar nas sgol ma dkar mo zhal gsum pa/g.yas sngo/ g.yon ser ba'o/ /phyag bcu gnyis kyi dang po gnyis mnyam bzhag/gnyis pa kha tram̐ kha dang ril ba/ gsum pa 'khor lo dang ud pa la/ bzhi pa na rin po che dang dril bu/ lnga pa gnyis rdo rje dang bum pa/ drug pa gnyis me tog dang po ti/ zhabs skyil mo krung / lhor sgrol ma gser kyi mdog can zhal gcig ma/ phyag bcu ma dang po gnyis phreng ba dang / dar spyangs/ gnyis pa ral gri dang zhags pa/ gsum pa gnyis mda' dang gzhu/ bzhi pa gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu/ lnga pa gnyis dbyug gu dang pad ma'o/ /nub tu sgrol ma dmar mo zhal cig phyag bzhi ma dang po gnyis mchog sbyin dang spyi blugs/gnyis pa gnyis phreng ba dang dbyug gu'o/ /byang du sgrol ma ser mo zhal cig phyag gnyis ma skyabs sbyin pad+ma ser po bsnams pa'o/ /'dab ma brgyad kyi shar nas rim pa bzhin du dmar mo zhal cig phyag bzhi rdo rje dang sdigs mdzub dang /ral gri dang zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /nag mo zhal cig phyag bzhi ma 'khor lo dang zhags pa dang ral gri dang sdigs 'dzub po/ /ser mo zhal cig phyag bzhi ma mya ngan med pa'i shing dang pad+ma dang rin po che dang bum pa bsnams pa'o/ /dmar mo zhal cig phyag bzhi ma spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba mya ngan med pa'i shing dang ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /rje btsun ma nag mo zhal cig phyag gnyis ma lcags kyu dang zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /ser mo zhal cig phyag brgyad ma'i dang po gnyis na/kha tram̐ kha dang rin po che/ gnyis pa na lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ gsum pa na rdo rje dbyug pa/ bzhi pa na ral gri dang bum pa'o/ /dmar po zhal cig phyag 47—1069

bzhi ma ral gri dang 'khor lo mda' gzhu bsnams pa'o/ /nag mo zhal gsum g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba/ phyag drug gis ral gri dang lcags kyu dang dbyug gu dang thod pa dang / zhags pa dang / mgo bo thogs pa'o/ /gru chad bzhi la sgrol ma dkar mo zhal cig phyag drug ma phreng ba dang mchog sbyin dang dbyug gu dang pad+ma dang spyi blugs dang mgo bo/ dmar mo zhal cig phyag gnyis ma kha tram̐ kha dang sdigs 'dzub mdzad pa'o/ /dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma thugs khar zla ba bsnams pa'o/ /dkar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma lcags kyu dang a du ru / gnyis mchog sbyin mdzad pa'o/ /sgo bzhir ni/ dmar mo zhal cig phyag gnyis thugs khar mar me 'dzin pa'o/ /dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma thugs khar bum pa 'dzin pa'o/ /dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma phreng ba dang mdung bsnams pa'o/ /ljang khu zhal cig phyag gnyis ma mchog sbyin dang ud pal bsnams pa'o/ /oṃ tā ①re tud tā ②re tu re swā hā zhes bzlas ①la dbang bskur ba ni sgrol ma nyi ma sbas pa'i nyer cig ma'o / /rjosku gdung bstan pa dam pa rigs brgya'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ rgyu las pho brang pad ma 'dab brgyad 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug khyams sum rtseg sgo dang bcas pa bskyed la/ lha bskyed pa ni/ dbus su rnam par snang mdzad kyis gtso byas pa'i rigs lnga yum bzhi dang bcas pa/ rtsibs bcu drug la rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i sems dpa' bcu drug dang / gru chad la sgeg sogs bzhi dang / khyams nang ma la skal bzangs bcu drug dang / bar pa la dpe bral bcu drug dang bdug /⑤sogs bzhi dang / phyi ma la nyan thos bcu drug dang 47—1070

rang rgyal bcu gnyis dang / sgo la sgo ma bzhi dang / rta babs kyi mchod rten la rgyal po chen po bzhi bskyed pa'o/ /spyan drangs mchod pa byas nas/ oṃ hūṃ tram̐ hri a/zhes rigs lnga spyi'i snying po bzlas la dbang bskur ba ni sku gabyeng 'bar ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod ka ka ni'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ rgyu las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa gru chad la sgo btod pa bskyed la/ der lha bskyed pa ni rgyu las rdo rje/ de las sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad la bkra shis kyi lha mo brgyad/ sgo ma bzhi rnams bskyed la spyan drangs mchod pa bya/ ka ka ni ci rigs par bzlas la/ stod pa byas nas dbang bskur ba ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /gtso mo chen mo'i brgyud gzungs kyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ rgyu las pad+ma 'dab brgyad rim pa gsum bskyed la/ lha bskyed lhapa ni/dbus su bcom ldan 'das thub pa/ pad+ma nang ma la byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/bar pa la nyan thos brgyad/ pad+ma phyi ma la phyogs skyong bcu/ gru chad la bdug rngusogs bzhi/ sgo bzhir rgyal po chen po bzhi bskyed la/ mu ni oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu ni ye swā hā bzlas pa byas la dbang bskur ba ni kha 'bar ma'i dal gyi cho ga'o/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ rgyu las 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi/ khyams dang bcas pa bskyed la/ der lha bskyed pa ni dbus su rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog mthing kha/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rgya gram bsnun pa—/ g.yon sdogs 'dzub dang dril bu dkur grubarten pa/ zhabs skyang skum 47—1071

du bzhugs pa'o/ /shar du rdo rje rtum po mthing kha rdo rje rtse cig pa thogs pa lhor rdo rje ki la ya 'thing kha phur pa thogs pa'o/ /nub tu rdo rje be+e con sku mdog 'thing kha be+e con thogs pa/ byang du rdo rje tho ba 'thing kha tho ba thogs pa'o/ /g.yon thams cad dril bu dkur ①rten pa/ khyams la phyogs skyong bcu dang bkra shis kyi lha mo brgyad bsgoms la/ rnam 'joms kyi sngags ci rigs par bzlas la/dbang bskur ba ni dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i cho ga'o/ /gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ rgyu las pad+ma 'dab bzhi sgo dang bcas pa bskyed la/ der lha bskyed pa ni dbus su rnam par rgyal ma dkar mo/ zhal gsum g.yas ser/ g.yon sngo/ khro mo'i cha lugs spyan gsum pa dang / phyag brgyad g.yas na rdo rje dang 'od dpag med dang mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ g.yon na sdigs 'dzub zhags pa dang mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa dang gzhu dang bum pa 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yas na spyan ras gzigs dkar po pad+ma dang rnga yab 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon na gsang bdag gos sngon po rdo rje dang rnga yab 'dzin pa/ rgyab dang mdun na lha'i bu gnyis kyis ye shes kyi bum pa 'dzin pa'o / /sgo bzhir khro bo bzhi ni/ mi g.yo sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa g.yon sdigs 'dzub can/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po sngon po lcags kyu bsnams pa/ dbyug pa sngon po dbyug pa thogs pa/ stobs po che sngo nag rdo rje thogs pa'o/ /oṃ rgyu swā hā zhes bzlas pa'am/ gzungs ci rigs par bzlas nas dbang bskur ba ni rnam rgyal ma'o// //47—1072

gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo can gyi mngon par rtogs pa ni/ rgyu las pad+ma 'dab brgyad 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug dang bcas pa gru chad la sgo btod pa can bskyed la/ lha bskyed pa ni/ dbus su pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du gtso mo gdugs dkar mo zhal gsum sngo ba dang dmar ba dang / phyag brgyad ma gdugs dang / 'khor lo dang / gzhu dang / lcags kyu bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon na rgyal mtshan dang rdo rje dang mda' dang zhags pa'o/ /shar du drag shul chen mo sngon mo dang / lhor rtum mo chen mo ser mo dang / nub tu 'bar ma chen mo dmar mo/ byang du stobs chen mo ljang khu/ g.yas bum pa 'dzin pa/g.yon dkur brten ①pa'o/ /rtsibs bcu drug gi shar ma bzhi la/ gos dkar mo/ dmar mo/ khro gnyer can ljang khu/ phreng ba ma ser mo/ pad ma'i rdo rje sngon mo/ bzhi ud pa la 'dzin pa'o/ /lho'i bzhi la gzhan gyis mi thub ma sngon mo/ sgrol ma ljang khu/ mchod ma dkar mo/ gzi brjid ma ser mo—/ bzhi rdo rje dang dbyug pa thogs pa'o/ /nub tu lu gu rgyud ma dmar mo/spos ma ser mo/ stobs chen ma dkar mo/ rdo rje rigs 'dzin ma ljang khu/bzhi po ni rdo rje dang bgrang phreng bsnams pa'o/ /byang du rdo rje rin chen ma dmar mo/ gtsug tor 'gying ma dkar mo/ gser can ma ljang khu'o/ /sgol ma ljang khya'o/ /bzhi po ni sna tshogs rdo rje dang phreng ba'o/ /gru chad la sgrol ma dkar mo/ pad+ma'i spyan dmar mo/ zla ba'i 'od ④sngon mo/ phyag rgya'i tshogs ljang khu/ bzhi po 'di skyabs sbyin byas pa'o/ /sgo ma bzhi dal gzhan dang 'thun no/ /oṃ ma ma hūṃ ni swā hā/ ces bzlas la dbang bskur ba ni gtsug tor dkar mo'i'o/ /47—1073

ri khrod lo ma can parna sha ba ri ser mo'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ rgyu las pho brang rtsibs bzhi pa skyed ①la/ lha bskyed pa ni zla ba'i dal baṃ las pad+ma/baṃ las rdo rje/ de las bcom ldan 'das ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gsum/g.yas dkar ba/ g.yon dmar ba/ spyan gsum khro mo/ shing lo'i nam bza' dang rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje dang dgra sta mda' bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon gsum na sdigs 'dzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang shing lo'i chun po dang gzhu bsnams pa'o/ /me tog gis bcings pa'i cod pan la mi bskyod pas mtshan pa'o/ /nad rigs stong phrag brgyad cu'i bdag mo bsgyel nas mnan pa/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur kyis 'og gi bgegs gzir cing sdigs pa'o/ /phyogs bzhi na rgyal po chen po bzhis bden pa'i bka' bsgo ba'o—/ /oṃ pi sha tsi par+ṇa sha ba ri sarba mā ra pra sha ma ni swā hā/ zhes bzlas nas dbang bskur ba ni/ yī par+ṇa sha ba ri'i cho ga'o/ /gnod sbyin 'dzam bha lha ser po yab yum gyi mngon par rtogs pa ni/ rgyu las pad+ma 'dab brgyad sgo dang bcas pa bskyed la/ der dza dang paṃ gyur pa las/gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po 'dzam bha lha zhal cig phyag bzhi pa sku mdog ser po gsus pa rab tu che ba g.yas na pi tsu pu ra dang / g.yon nas ne+e'u la'i kha nas nor 'dzag pa 'dzin pa/ phyag gnyis kyis rang 'dod kyis ④rig ma lha mo nor rgyun ma g.yas pi tsi pu ra dang / g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma bsnams pa/ yab yum rtse ba'i rtsed mo mdzad pa la pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad kyi steng du 'khor gnod sbyin chen po 47—1074

brgyad yum lha mo brgyad la 'khyud pa/ gtso bo yab yum ji lta bar bskyed la bzlas pa bya ba ni/ oṃ dze+e bha lha dzā len tra ye dus dus sma kudre kudre swā hā/zhes ci rigs par bzlas la dbang bskur ba ni/ gnod sbyin 'dzam bha lha'i longs spyod la mnga' mnyes pa'i cho ga'o// //dpal mgon po ma hā ka la'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ rgyu las 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad sgo dang bcas pa bskyed la/ der nyi zla pad+ma'i steng du paṃ las ro'i gdan—/ de'i steng du hūṃ las gri gug /de las ma hā kā la zhal cig phyag bzhi pa—/ thung la sbom pa sku sha rgyas pa/ spyan gsum bgrad pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba bcigs pa/ phyag g.yas gnyis na bhe tsa'i 'bru 'am/ gri gug thogs pa/ 'og ma ral gri/ g.yon dang po thod pa khrag gis bkang ba/ 'og ma na kha tram̐ kha 'dzin pa/ stag gis be+egs pas smad dkris pa/ zhabs phyed skyil gyis bzhugs pa/ rtsibs brgyad la/ 'khor bya rog ma brgyad/ gri gug dang thod pa thogs pa/ zhabs skyang skum gyis bzhugs pa skyed la/ spyan drangs mchod la/ sngags ni/ oṃ ma hā kā ①la hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes bzlas sdel dbang bskur ba ni dpal ma hā kā ①la'i cho ga'o/ /mngon par rtogs pa brgya rtsa brgyad po ni/ /de ltar ma lus bshad par gyur mod kyang / /phyi'i rgya mtsho la ni chu 'dzin gyis/ /chu blangs pas ni zad par mi 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun rnams/ /'thor ba cig du bsdus pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /grub thabs rjodapag tu med pa rgyud pa'i chos/ /mkhas pa'i dbang phyug gzhan don byed gyur cig /jo bo 47—1075

spyan ras gzigs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po mi tra 'dzo gis mdzad pa'i mngon par rtogs pa mu tig gi phreng ba zhes bya ba rdzogs sto// //pan ṭi ta chen po don yod rdo rjes rang 'gyur du mdzad pa'o// //brtsar mchan/969 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉ra/97 ①〈〈pe 〉〉—rmā/ ②④〈〈pe 〉〉bye/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sna /971 ①〈〈pe 〉rabab ④〈〈pe 〉〉la/972 ①〈〈pe 〉rdzal ba'i/ ②〈〈pe 〉7pa/ ①〈〈pe 〉mirten/974 ①〈〈pe 〉mthos/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉tod/975 ①〈〈pe 〉〉pags/976 sde〈〈pe 〉d+kung ba/ sde〈〈pe 〉〉tod/ dze+e〈〈pe 〉7dbang /977 ①〈〈pe 〉mego/ ②〈〈pe 〉sngagatang / ④〈〈pe 〉mas/97spyo sti〈〈pe 〉thar/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉skos/ ①〈〈pe 〉rams/98 ①〈〈pe 〉7༅la/ ('di'i 'og gi ud pa la zhes pa rnams 〈〈pe 〉skal ut+pal zhes 'khod kyang bsdur mchar du bkod med/)981 ①〈〈pe 〉7/982 ①〈〈pe 〉〉ta ki ra tsa/983 ①〈〈pe 〉radug sne〈〈pe 〉〉ti/ ①〈〈pe 〉snyen/984 ①〈〈pe 〉thasag ④〈〈pe 〉sngagadug ①〈〈pe 〉7sag ༷〈〈pe 〉〉stod/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉mi ni/98/ ①〈〈pe 〉7ra/9/9 ①〈〈pe 〉ranod/ ④〈〈pe 〉sa /99 ①〈〈pe 〉༅ba/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉7dbang /991 ①〈〈pe 〉tha/993 ①〈〈pe 〉d+kub/47—1076

1༷57 ①〈〈pe 〉〉 sa ②〈〈pe 〉〉gdugs/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉skur/ du〈〈pe 〉musang /1058 ①〈〈pe 〉stanadugs/1059 ①〈〈pe 〉〉pachod/ ②〈〈pe 〉sngagadugs/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉bkris/1༷6 ①90〈〈pe 〉〉skyang /1061 ①〈〈pe 〉〉blas/ ②〈〈pe 〉sngaganyis/1064 ①〈〈pe 〉〉bstob/ ②〈〈pe 〉stana'i/1༷65 ①〈〈pe 〉smosad dha/1༷67 ①〈〈pe 〉〉blo/ ②〈〈pe 〉stab/1068 ①〈〈pe 〉〉mi/107 ①②〈〈pe 〉〉ta/ ②〈〈pe 〉sku sa/ du〈〈pe 〉ska/ // ⑤〈〈pe 〉sngagadugs/1071 ①〈〈pe 〉〉skyed/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉gdugs/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉skur/1༷72 ①〈〈pe 〉〉skur/1073 ①〈〈pe 〉〉skur rten/ ②〈〈pe 〉torago/1༷74 ①〈〈pe 〉〉skyes/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉kyi/1075 ①〈〈pe 〉〉ka ②〈〈pe 〉〉zas/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉ka rjo〈〈pe 〉〉thab/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (2786)47—1079

༄ga /dkyil 'gor thams cad kyi bsgrub pa'i thabs rjegs pa'i rjal 'byor gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba/①dze+e rdzogs pa rnal 'byor gyi phreng ba bzhugs sto// ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/shri mnya dzu badz+ra ma ti kra ma a rnyi sa ma ya sa mun tsa ni sa pan na yo ga a ba li na ma—/ bod skad du/ 'jam dpal 'jam pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa'i mngon par rtogs pa kun las btus pa rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan don phun sum tshogs gang rdo rje 'chang 'di'i 'od kyis 'gro ba pha ma byed2 nang gi mun pa rnam par bcom pas rgyal spangs pa phun sum tshogs pa byed pas/ /gang zhig gnyis med yeshesarang bzhin shin tu sgeg pa'i phuladuphyin pa yon tan tshogs kyi dpal du yongs gyur pa'i rang don phun sum tshogs pa/ /gang gis rdo rje 'dzin pa'i cheba'iyon tan thugs rje'i brtse ba'i bdud rtsi'i ⑤brlan byas semasanyid snying po rab bskyed pa spangs pa rang don gzhan don/ /de dag spyod pa rmad du byung ba'i rang bzhin blo'i gzi brjid gdulabya spyod la 'byongs 47byed1080

gyur cig/ //dkyil 'khor rdo rje phreng bas rab brgyan pa/ /byedapa po rdo rje 'chang gi mdzad spyod mtshar che ba/ /sgeg pa'i sprul pa rab 'bring tshogs bcas byed pa'i sgrub thabs kyis/ /don yod mchog dpal myur du 'dzin par 'gyur// //'dir rim pa chung ngu dang 'bring po dag gi ting nge 'dzin legs par bsgoms pa las shes rab mchog dang ldan pa la rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor bstan to//bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang / spro dang bsdu ba byas pa la/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /ye shes skad cig gis rdzogs pa'i/ /rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor zhes brjod do zhes gsungs so/ /de'i rim pa ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa thob par 'dod pa'i spro ba dang ldan pas/ phung po dang khams dang skye mched la sogs pa gzugs brnyan lta bur stong pa nyid du ro gcig par nges par byas pa'i sgo nas 'od gsal ba la rab tu zhugs te/ skad cig mas yan lag dang bcas pa rdzogs par bskyed pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su/ dal gyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' ni stong pa nyid dang snying rje ro gcig pa bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin/ rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan cing thugs kha'i sa bon dang ldan pa/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa'i gzugs las dpag du med pa'i de ba dang / lha mo dang byang chub sems dpa' dang khro bo la sogs pa spros te/ de dag gis gdul bya rnams ji ltar smin du rung ba bzhin tu chos bstan pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas gzhan kyis don mdzad pas bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la gzhag cing / slar yang bsdu ba byas pa'i tshul gyis bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur 'char bar bya'o/ /de la 'di'i 47—1081

yan lag la sogs pas ni sa'i 'og gi bar du ji ltar blos phyogs pa'i rgya chen po bar mtshams med pa'i snying po gcig tu gyur pa'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi 'bar ba dang /'od zer gyi dra ba bskal pa 'jig pa'i dus kyi me ltar rab du 'bar ba'i phreng ba dang ldan pa'i mtshams bcing ba dang / steng du rab du 'khrig pas gcig par gyur pa'i sra zhing 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang / rdo rje'i dra ba'i steng du bar mtshams med par gcig du gyur pa'i steng du rdo rje'i mda'i dra ba dang / de'i 'og du rdo rje'i bla re dang / de'i 'og du rdo rje'i gur 'bar ba dang / de'i nang du gnas pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dal gyi steng du 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa ser po g.yas su 'khor ba'o/ /de'i rtsibs la khro bo dgod pa ni/de la shar kyi rtsibs la gshin rje gshed nag po/ dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal dang ldan pa/ rdo rje tho ba nag po dang / ral gri dang / nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /lho'i rtsibs la shes rab mthar byed dkar po/ nag po dang dmar po'i zhal/ rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug tho dkar po dang / ral gri dang /nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /nub kyi rtsibs la pad+ma mthar byed dmar po/sngon po dang dkar po'i zhal/ pad+ma dmar po dang / ral gri dang / nor bu dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /byang gi rtsibs la bgegs mthar byed nag po/dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal/ 'jigs su rung ba'i rdo rje dang / ral gri dang / nor bu dang / pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /me'i mtshams su 'dod pa'i rgyal po sngon po/ dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal/ lcags kyu dang / ral gri dang /nor bu dang / pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /srin po'i mtshalas su dbyug pa sngon po nag po—/ dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal/ dbyug pa sngon po dang / ral gri dang /47—1082

nor bu dang / pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung gi mtshams su stobs po che nag po/dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal/ rtse gsum dang / ral gri dang / nor bu dang / pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan kyi mtshams su mi g.yo ba can sngon po/dkar po dang nag po'i zhal/ ral gri dang / rdo rje dang / nor bu dang /pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /steng du gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba ser po/ sngon po dang dmar po'i zhal/ 'khor lo ser po dang / ral gri dang / nor bu dang /pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /'og du gnod mdzes rgyal po sngon po/ dkar po dang dmar ba'i zhal/ rdo rje dang / ral gri dang / nor bu dang / pad+ma 'dzin pa'o / /de la gtsug tor dang / 'dod pa'i rgyal po dang / mi g.yo ba dang gnod mdzes rnams ni rin po che'i cod pan can/ rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ sgeg par gyur pa/ mche ba cung zad brtsigs pa dang ldan pa/de las gzhan rnams ni mi sdug pa'i gzugs can/ smin mtshams khro gnyer dang bcas pa/ dbu skra dmar po gyen du badze+es pa/ smin ma dang sma ra dmar ba/zhal gdangs pa/ mche ba brtsigs pa/ ljags 'gyur ba/ gad mo'i sgra sgrogs pa/ klu brgyad kyis 'jigs par brgyan pa/ gzugs thung ba/gsus pa che ba/ lto ba 'phyang ba/ de ltar bcu po 'di dag kyang gdan dang bcas pa brtan pa/ g.yas bskum pa/ g.yon bskyang ba/ rtsibs kyi rtse mo la nye ba/ cung zad ma 'byar ba'i sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa/ nyi ma'i cod pan can/ shin tu khro ba dang 'bar bas 'jigs su rung bar byed pa/bskal pa 'jig pa'i dus kyi me lta bu'i 'od dang ldan pa/ rang dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa dpag tu med pa'i sprul pa'i tshogs kyis khams gsum mtha' yas pa na 47—1083

gnas pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs ma lus pa rnams yang dang yang du brlag par byed pa—/ phyag drug pa'i dang po gnyis kyis rang dang 'dra ba'i rig ma la 'khyud ①pa/zhal gsum pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sku mdog lta bu/ g.yas dang g.yon pa gong du ji ltar brjod pa'i kha dog dang ldan pa/ zhal re re yang sbyan gsum pa dmar zhing zlum pa'o/ /'khor lo shin tu drag tu 'khor bas brtan par gnas pa lta bu rgyun ma chad pa'i 'bar ④ba'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spro bar bya'o/ /'khor lo de'i nang lte ba'i 'og gi rtsibs su chos 'byung gru gsum dkar po rab tu rgyas pa/de'i 'og zur la gnas pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa rnams so/ /rdo rje de'i phyogs kyi rtsibs rnams sbyor ba ji lta bar rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa lta bu'i mdog can ste/ dbus kyi lte ba yang de bzhin no/ /der rin po che kha dog lnga las yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhal yas khang thub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer sna tshogs kyis phyogs kun gyi 'khor lo khyab par byas pa'o/ /de'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i gzugs can/ gur gum lta bur dmar ser/ g.yas dang g.yon kyi zhal nag po dang dkar po/ rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis kyis rang dang 'dra ba'i shes rab ma la mkhyud pa/ ral gri dang / mda' dang / ud pal dang / gzhu 'dzin pa/rin po che'i cod pan can/ rin po che sna tshogs pa la sogs pas brgyan pa/'od zer mtha' yas pa'o/ /de'i shar phyogs su rnam par snang mdzad dkar po/g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal nag po dang dmar po'o/ /phyag rnams na 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa dkar po dang / ral gri dang / nor bu dang / pad+ma 'dzin pa'o//lho'i phyogs su rin chen 'byung ldan ser po/ phyag rnams ni nor bu ra ga ta zur 47—1084

dgu pa dang / ral gri dang / 'khor lo dang / pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /nub du snang ba mtha' yas dmar po/ pad+ma dmar po dang / ral gri dang / nor bu dang / 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du don yod grub pa ljang khu ral gri dang 'khor lo dang nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /rnam pa gsum po 'di dag ni g.yas g.yon gyi zhal nag po dang dkar po'o/ /de ba 'di dag rin po che'i cod pan dang ldan pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'o/ /me'i mtshams su spyan ma rnam snang dang mtshungs pa'o/ /srin por ma ma ki mi bskyod pa dang mtshungs pa ni ud pa la dmar po dang / ral gri dang / nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa ste/ sgrub pa'i thabs thams cad las bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /rlung gi mtshams su gos dkar mo snang ba mtha' yas dang mtshungs so/ /dbang ldan du sgol ma rin chen 'byung ldan dang mtshungs pa ud pa la ser po dang ral gri dang /nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /nang gi rim pa las phyi rol me'i mtshams su gzugs rdo rje ma rnam par snang mdzad dang mtshungs pa/ rin po che'i me long dang ral gri dang nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /srin por sgra rdo rje mi bskyod pa dang mtshungs pa'o/ /tam bu ra sngon po dang ral gri dang nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o—/ /rlung du dri rdo rje ma rin chen 'byung ldan dang mtshungs pa/ dri chab kyi dung chos ser po dang ral gri dang 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du ro rdo rje ma snang ba mtha' yas dang mtshungs pa/ ro'i snod dmar po dang ral gri dang nor bu dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /shar sgo'i g.yon phyogs su reg rdo rje ma don yod grub pa dang mtshungs pa/ gos sna tshogs dang ral gri dang nor bu dang / pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /shar sgo'i g.yas phyogs su chos kyi dbyings kyi rdo rje 47—1085

ma rdo rje sems dpa' dang mtshungs pa/ chos 'byung dkar po dang ral gri dang nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa'i lha 'di dag ni zhal gsum pa/ phyag drug pa/ dang po'i phyag mtshan gnyis g.yas pa gnyis kyis 'dzin pa/ gzhan gnyis pa gnyis ni g.yon pa gnyis kyis 'dzin pa'o/ /thams cad rtsa ba'i zhal sku dang mtshungs pa'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo ru gshin rje mthar byed dang / shes rab mthar byed dang pad+ma mthar byed dang /bgegs mthar byed rnams so/ /'dir 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang rnam par snang mdzad dang lha mo bcu po 'di rnams ni zla ba'i dal la rdo rje'i dkyil dkrung gis bzhugs pa ste/ gzhan rnams ni nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /zla ba dang nyi ma'i 'og tu sna tshogs pad+ma'o/ /de ba rnams ni rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis kyis rang dang mtshungs pa'i shes rab ma la mkhyud pa ste/ lha mo rnams kyang rang dang mtshungs pa'i thabs la mkhyud pa'o/ /rigs kyi bdag po ni dbu la dgod do/ /de'ang 'jam pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa'i de ba rnams la/ ma ma ki dang / sgra rdo rje ma dang bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i khro bo brgyad rnams la ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /spyan ma dang gzugs rdo rje ma dang gshin rje gshed byed rnams la ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /dri rdo rje ma la ①rin chen 'byung ldan no/ /gos dkar mo dang ro rdo rje ma dang pad+ma mthar byed rnams la 'od dpag med do/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rdo rje ma la'ang rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /gzhan kyi lugs la ni mi bskyod pa'i zhes 'dod do/ /rdo rje sems dpa' ni sku mdog dkar po la yid tsam dmar ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal ni sngon po dang dmar po'o/ /phyag dang po gnyis rang dang 'dra ba'i shes rab ma la mkhyud pa/ phyag lhag ma 47—1086

rnams kyis rdo rje sngon po dang / ral gri dang nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ zla ba lta bu'i mdog can/skyil krung dang rin po che'i cod pan can/ rin po che'i rgyan kyis brgyan pa/dbu la mi bskyod rdo rjes rgyas btab pa'o/ /'dir 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i thugs kha ste—/ nu ma gnyis kyi bar du dam tshig sems dpa' lta bu'i ye shes sems dpa'o//de'i snying khar zla ba la ral gri'i yu ba la zla bas mtshan pa la sa bon rma mo/ /rnam par snang mdzad dang rin chen 'byung ldan dang 'od dpag med dang don yod grub pa dang mi bskyod pa rnams kyi thugs khar rang gi phyag mtshan zla ba dang nyi mas mtshan pa la sum̐ oṃ dz+re khaṃ hūṃ ngo / /srun ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams la mo lo tai/ dza hūṃ baṃ ho khaṃ re mo/ /khro bo rnams ni hūṃ ngo / /lha thams cad kyi snying po'i sngags ni rdo rje phreng ba las bstan to/ /'dir rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor la mig la sog sa pa byin kyis brlab pa dang / ye shes sems dpa' dgug gzhug la sogs pa ni ma gsungs so/ /de dag med kyang spyan lnga dang mngon par shes pa la sogs pa'i yon tan gyi tshogs dpag du med cing bsam gyis mi khyab pas mdzes par byas pa'i sku yi dam gyi lha gcig char du nyidadulegs par yongs su dag pa'i rnam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur te/ yang dang yang du lhag par mos pa brtan pa'i phyir ro/ /snying po'i sngags la sogs pa ni bum pa lhag par gnas pa la sogs pa nye bar sbyor ba'i ched du'o/ /gang gi tshe dbus de ba gzhan bdag por gyur pa de'i tshe dbus kyi gtso bo gang gis byed pa de gnas par 'gyur ro/ /'od dpag med kyang dkar por 'gyur ①te/ chos rnams dkar po'i rang bzhin gyis/ /'di ni ngag gi dbang phyug dkar/ /ces gsungs 47—1087

pas so/ /'dir brjod pa/ 'chad par 'gyur ba'i dal rnams la/ gang dal 'khor lo'i lha rnams kyi gnas gsungs pa rnams brjod par bya ste/ de la de nyid rtso bo yin pas dal gyi bdag po la zhal mngon par phyogs pa'o/ /des mkhyud pa'i lha mo ni de nyid la zhal mngon par phyogs pa ste/ pha rol gyi gnas su mngon du phyin pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir ni gzhal yas khang gi rdo rje'i sa gzhi la sogs pa'i yan lag can rdo rje'i gur dang / bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang /chos 'byung zhes bya ba yan lag rnam pa gsum mo/ /de la rdo rje'i gur ni 'dir 'chad par 'gyur ba'i gzhal yas khang thams cad la yin no/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang chos 'byung ni gzhung kha gcig la brjod par bya ste/ bri bar bya ba'i gzhal yas khang rnams la ni chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin chos 'byung ma/chos kyi dbyings kyi khongs su chud pa mngon par bya ba'i ched du kho bos rdo rje phreng ba las bri bar brjod do/ /ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin bdag /zhes lhag par rdzogs rims kyi dal bstan pa'i phyir dang / 'jig rten gyi khams kyi lcags ris mtshon par bya ba'i phyir rdo rje'i phreng ba bri ba ni nges pa'o gur ni bsgom pa'i skabs la bri ba la med do/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ni de ltar ma yin pas bri mi dgos te/bgegs dgag pa bstang bstabs la sogs pa ①gzhan gyis kyang byed pas so/ /de'ang khyad par du stong pa nyid kho na bcom ldan 'das yin pas/ bgegs kyi tshogs ma lus pa rtsa ba dang bcas pa rab tu brlag par byed nus par 'gyur la/ de la lhag par mos pa brtan pa nyid dad pa bskyed pa'i ched du bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dal la bri ba ma bstan to/ /bsgom pa'i 'khor lo la'ang kha gcig du de bsgom par gsungs pa las gzhung thams cad du ma bstan to/ /gal te gzhan dag na re 47—1088

bgegs bsal ba'i rjes su stong pa nyid la rab tu zhugs pas bsgom par bya ba'i dal la bsrung ba'i 'khor lo med pa'i phyir mi bri na/ de ltar na de'i tshe lcags ris mtshon par bstan pa'i rdo rje'i ra ba yang bri mi dgos par 'gyur ro/ /yang na gzhal yas khang bskyed pa'i tshe de'ang bskyed do zhe na ma yin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rdo rje ra ba lan gnyis bskyed pa ni gang la yang ma gsungs pa dang /lan gnyis bskyed pa la dgos pa med pa'i gcig char bskyed pa nyid kyis rdo rje'i sa gzhi bcings pa dang / rdo rje'i ra ba la sogs pa ma lus pa gzhag pa'i stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin sgyu ma lta bur gnas pa nyid do/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yod kyang dal gcig las mi 'bri ba'i rgyu mtshan ni gsungs pa nyid yin la/gang chos kha gcig las bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yang bri bar bya'o zhes 'dod do zhes so / /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dal rdzogs so// //sngag /mdor byas las bstan pa'i dal 'khor lo bstan pa ni gzhal yas khang gi bar ni sngar dang mtshungs so/ /lha khro bo la sogs pa rnams kyi khyad par brjod par bya ba ni/ gzhal yas khang gi dbus su mi bskyod pa nag po drag po g.yas dkar po dang g.yon dmar po dang / phyag g.yas rnams kyis 'jigs shing sdigs pa'i rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang pad+ma bsnams pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu dang yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ rang dang 'dra ba'i reg rdo rje ma la mkhyud pa'o/ /de'i shar la sogs pa'i phyogs su rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'o/ /me'i mtshams la sogs pa rnams su spyan ma la sogs pa bskyed do/ /de'ang rnam par snang mdzad ni dkar po dang nag po dang 47—1089

dmar ba'i zhal 'khor lo dang rdo rje dang pad+ma dkar po dang dril bu dang nor bu dang ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /gong du bstan pa dang phyis 'chad pa'i phyag rnams la dang po g.yas rnams kyi steng nas 'og gi bar dang / g.yon rnams ni 'og nas steng gi bar du phyag mtshan gyi rim pa khong du chud par bya'o/ /rtsa ba dang g.yas dang g.yon kyi rim pas zhal gyi kha dog go bar bya'o/ /rin chen 'byung ldan ser po dang nag po dang dkar po'i zhal/ nor bu dang rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang dril bu dang pad+ma ser po dang ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /snang ba mtha' yas ni dmar po dang nag po dang dkar po'i zhal/ phyag g.yon pa dril bu dang bcas pas pad+ma dmar po'i yu ba bzung nas g.yas pa'i phyag gis thugs khar kha 'byed pa/gzhan rnams kyis rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang rin po che dang ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /don yod grub pa ni ljang khu dang nag po dang dkar po'i zhal/ ral gri dang rdo rje rgya gram dang 'khor lo dang dril bu dang pad+ma ljang khu dang nor bu 'dzin pa'o/ /'di ltar de ba lnga nas brjod par bya ba'i sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba'i bar du ral pa'i thor cog dang rin po che'i cod pan dang / rin po che la sogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /spyan ma ni rnam par snang mdzad dang mtshungs pa la/ khyad par du pad+ma dkar po'i gnas su ud pa la dkar po'o / /ma ma ki ni mi bskyod pa dang mtshungs pa la khyad par du pad+ma'i gnas su ud pa la sngo dmar ro/ /gos dkar mo ni snang ba mtha' yas dang mtshungs so/ /sgol ma ni don yod grub pa dang mtshungs pa las sna tshogs rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang ud pa la sngon po dang dril bu dang ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /rim pa gnyis pa la me'i mtshams su gzugs rdo rje ma srun ma lta bu la khyad par du dang po'i phyag 47—1090

gnyis kyis me long dmar po 'dzin pa'o/ /srin po'i mtshalas su sgra rdo rje ma ser mo—/ ser po dang nag po dang dkar po'i zhal dang ldan pa'o/ /dang po'i phyag gnyis ni pi wang bgreng bas 'dzin pa'o/ /'og ma'i phyag rnams kyis rdo rje dang / ud pa la sngon po dang / rin po che 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung gi mtshams su dri rdo rje ma gos dkar mo lta bu dang po'i phyag gnyis kyi dung phor 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan gyi mtshams su ro rdo rje ma ljang khu ljang khu dang dkar ba'i zhal/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis ro'i snod dmar po 'dzin pa/ 'og ma rnams kyis rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /rim pa gsum pa'i shar gyi snam bu la byams pa dang sa'i snying po gnyis so/ /lho'i snam bu la phyag na rdo rje dang nam mkha'i snying po gnyis so/ /nub kyi snam bu la spyan ras gzigs dang 'jam dpal gnyis so/ /byang du sgrib pa rnam par sel ba dang kun tu bzang po gnyis so/ /brgyad po 'di dag ni rigs kyi bdag po dang mtshungs pa las/ khyad par du byams pa'i phyag g.yas na klu shing gi yal ga me tog dang bcas pa 'dzin pa'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo dang me la sogs pa'i mtshams bzhi dang / steng dang 'og tu go rims bzhin du khro bo bcu'o/ /gshin rje gshed ni nag po/ nag po dang dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal dang ldan pa/ phyag na rdo rje tho ba dang 'khor lo dang rdo rje bsnams pa'o/ /dgra sta dang dril bu dang snying khar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdogs 'dzub bsnams pa/ shes rab mthar byed dkar po/dkar po dang dmar po dang nag po'i zhal dang ldan pa/ rdo rje dang rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug tho dkar po dang ral gri dang snying khar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dang dril bu dang dgra sta 'dzin pa'o/ /pad+ma mthar byed 47—1091

dmar po dmar po dang nag po dang dkar po'i zhal dang ldan pa/ pad+ma dmar po dang ral gri dang gtun shing dang / dril bu dang dgra sta dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'o—/ /bgegs mthar byed sngon po/ sngon po dang dkar po dang dmar ba'i zhal dang ldan pa/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang gtun shing dang zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs 'dzub dang dril bu dang dgra sta 'dzin pa'o/ /mi g.yo ba sngon po sngon po dang dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal/ ral gri dang rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang sdigs 'dzub dang dgra sta dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /'dod pa'i rgyal po sngon po/ sngon po dang dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal/ phyag gong ma gnyis kyis rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya 'dzin pa/ phyag 'og ma rnams kyis rdo rje dang ral gri dang zhags pa dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o/ /dbyug pa sngon po nag po—/ nag po dang dkar po dang dmar ba'i zhal/ rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa sngon po dang ral gri dang 'khor lo dang snying khar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs 'dzub dang pad+ma dang dgra sta 'dzin pa'o/ /stobs po che nag po/ nag po dang dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal/ rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dang ral gri dang 'khor lo dang / snying khar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs 'dzub dang pad+ma dang dgra sta 'dzin pa'o/ /gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba nag po/ nag po dang dkar po dang dmar ba'i zhal/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya lag pa gnyis thal mo bskyang ba'i srin lag gi sen mos mnan te/mthe'u chung dang gung mo dang 'dzub mo rnams rtse sprad de sen mo'i rtse mo mnyam par byas pa ni kun tu snang ba zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya spyi bor 'dzin pa ste/ skabs gzhan tu rnam pa gzhan yang yin no/ /phyag 'og ma rnams kyis rdo rje dang pad+ma 47—1092

dang sdigs 'dzub dang ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /gnod mjos rgyal po nag po nag po dang dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal/ rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang rin po che dang /snying khar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdogs 'dzub dang pad+ma dang ral gri 'dzin pa'o//mi bskyod pa la sogs pa 'di dag gi steng du ni sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du rim pa bzhin du rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang / 'khor lo dang rin po che ma ra ta ga sul dgu pa dang / pad+ma dmar po dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang / 'khor lo dang /rdo rje dang / pad+ma dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang / 'khor lo dang / rdo rje dang / pad+ma dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang / klu shing gi me tog dang rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / rdo rje dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang / rdo rje tho ba dang rdo rje dang / pad+ma dmar po dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang / ral gri yu ba dang / dbyug to nag po dang / rdo rje dang / de dag gi steng na nyi ma dang zla ba la bzhugs pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug pa ste/ de dag gi ral gri'i yu ba ni rang gi lha'i kha dog gi rin po che la byas pa'o/ /de la khyad par ni rnam par snang mdzad dang lha mo rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams zla ba la gnas pa'o/ /gzhan rnams ni nyi ma la gnas pa'o/ /mi bskyod pa la sogs pa ni rdo rje skyis dkrung can no/ /khro bo rnams ni g.yas bskyang la g.yon bskum pa/ zhal re re la spyan rlum la dmar ba gsum gsum dang ldan pa'o/ /sgra sgogs shing 'bar ba ste shin tu 'jigs pa bsrung ba'i 'khor lo las bstan pa'i 'jigs pa'i gzugs can la sogs pa'i bye brag dang ldan pa'o/ /'di la dal gye bdag po ni yum dang bcas pa yin la/ lha gzhan rnams ni gnod mdzes kyi bar du yum med pa'o/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la gnas pa'i gshin rje 47—1093

gshed la sogs pa ni dal gyi rtso bo lta bu shes rab ma dang bcas pa'o/ /de dag ni go rims bzhin du rdo rje ro langs ma dang / gzhan gyis mi thub ma dang /khro gnyer can ma dang / ral gcig ma dang / sna tshogs rdo rje ma dang / sna tshogs rin chen ma dang / sna tshogs pad+ma ma dang / sna tshogs las ma dang /nam mkha'i rdo rje ma dang / sa 'dzin ma rnams so/ /de nas mi bskyod pa'i thugs khar ye shes sems dpa' phyag gnyis pa dmar po yum dang bcas pa'o/ /de'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūṃ nag po/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi ā+oṃ/rin chen 'byung ldan gyi swa/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi a/ don yod grub pa'i ha/spyan la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyi lo oṃ baṃ tai dza hūṃ baṃ ho/ reg rdo rje ma'i khaṃ rnams bsam mo/ /byams pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' brgyad po rnams kyi shā/ zlo ①ā+oṃ ā+oṃ ā+oṃ hūṃ yī saṃ ②rnams bsam mo/ /khro bo rnams ni hūṃ ngo //lha mo rnams kyi snying po'i sngags rnams ni/ rdo rje phreng bar lha rnams kyi sngags las shes par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bdag po ni mi bskyod pa dang kun tu bzang po gnyis rdo rje sems dpa' yin par gong du bstan pa'o/ /khyad par du rdo rje dang 'khor bo dang pad+ma dang dril bu dang nor bu dang / ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /bdag nyid lta bu'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug mas kun tu mkhyud pa'o/ /de ba rnams dang ma ma ki dang / phyag na rdo rje dang 'jam dpal dang gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba dang / gnod mdzes rgyal po rnams kyi mi bskyod pa'o/ /spyan ma dang gzugs rdo rje ma dang / byams pa dang / sa'i snying po dang /gshin rje gshed dang / mi g.yo ba rnams kyi rnam par snang mdzad do/ /sgra rdo rje ma dang / nam mkha'i snying po dang / shes rab mthar byed dang / 'dod 47—1094

pa'i rgyal po rnams kyi rin chen 'byung ldan no/ /gos dkar mo dang / dri rdo rje ma dang / srun ras gzigs dang / rta mgrin dang / dbyug pa sngon po can rnams kyi snang ba mtha' yas so/ /sgol ma dang / ro rdo rje ma dang / reg rdo rje ma dang / sgrib pa rnam par sel ba dang / bgegs mthar byed dang /stobs po che rnams kyi don yod grub pa'o zhes shes par bya'o// //dpal kun tu kha sbyor du gsungs pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' pa'i dal du/rdo rje gur gyi nang du bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i lte ba'i nang na/ me dang / rlung dang chu dang / sa'i dal dang / ri rab kyi steng chos 'byung gi dkyil du gzhal yas khang ngo / /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo gshin rje gshed phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis dngapordo rje gnyis pa lcags kyu dang gsumapa'akhor lo dang rdo rje rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa gsum gyis sdigs 'dzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang /dril bu dang / dgra sta 'dzin pa'o/ /shes rab mthar byed ni zhags pa dang /rdo rje dang / ral gri dang / snying khar sdigs mdzub dang / dril bu dang /dgra sta dang / zhags pa'o/ /pad+ma mthar byed lcags sgrog dang / pad+ma dang /ral gri dang / dril bu dang / dgra sta dang zhags pa'o/ /bgegs mthar byed ni rdo rje dril bu dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang / 'khor lo dang / sdigs 'dzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang gtun shing dang dgra sta 'dzin pa'o/ /mi g.yo ba ni ral gri dang 'khor lo dang / rdo rje rnams dang / sdigs 'dzub dang / dgra sta dang / zhags pa'o/ /'dod pa'i rgyal po ni g.yas pa dang /g.yon pa'i phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang / lcags kyu dang /47—1095

ral gri dang / rdo rje dang / zhags pa'o/ /dbyug pa sngon po ni rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dang ral gri dang 'khor lo rnams dang / snying khar sdigs 'dzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang / pad+ma dang / dgra sta'o/ /stobs po che ni rtse gsum dang / ral gri dang / 'khor lo dang / snying khar sdigs 'dzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang / pad+ma dang / dgra sta rnams so/ /gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i ni g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i phyag dang po gnyis kyis spyi bor gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i phyag rgya dang / 'khor lo dang /pad+ma dang / sdogs 'dzub dang / ral gri'o/ /gnod mdzes ni rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang rin po che dang / snying khar sdigs 'dzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang / pad+ma dang / ral gri'o/ /bcu po 'di dag ni dbu la thod pa lngas brgyan pa/ 'khor lo la sogs pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ mi mgo'i phreng ba ske la 'chang ba rnams go rims bzhin du steng dang phyogs su gnas pa rnams la mi bskyod pa dang / rnam snang dang / rin chen 'byung ldan dang / 'od dpag med dang / don yod grub pa dang / yang 'og dang mtshams na gnas pa rnams la ni rnam par snang mdzad dang rin chen 'byung ldan dang / 'od dpag med dang / don yod grub pa dang / mi bskyod pa'i phyag rgyas brtag pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi lto ba'i dbus su rdo rje sems dpa' ni 'dzum pa dang bcas pa'i zhal gsum pa ste/ sngon po dang dmar po ni g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal lo/ /zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ sku mdog dkar po la cung zad dmar ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ ral pa'i thor cog nag po la gnas pa'i nor bu dang sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i 'og du g.yon ngos su gnas pa'i zla ba'i 'od 47—1096

dang / sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan dang / dpral ba'i steng du thod pa lnga'o/ /gzhan yang 'khor lo dang / rna cha dang / mgul brgyan dang lag gdub dang ske regs dang thal ba rnams kyis brgyan pa'o/ /phyag drug pa/ rdo rje dril bus rnam par brgyan pa'i phyag gnyis kyis rang dang 'dra ba'i shes rab ma la mkhyud pa/shes rab ma'i chu skyes la mnyam par sbyor ba'i dga' ba dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas pa gnyis kyis ral gri dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa gnyis kyis thod pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nyi ma'i 'od kyi rgyab yol can/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang thod pa dang zla ba la skyil krung phyed pas gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pas bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i thugs khar sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la ye shes sems dpa' dkar dmar gyis ①mdog sems dpa'i skyil krung can/ sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan gyis spras pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje dang dril bu dang bcas pa'i phyag gnyis kyis rang dang 'dra ba'i shes rab ma la mkhyud pa/de'i thugs khar zla ba la ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūṃ nag po'i gzugs so/ /'dir sems dpa' gsum gyi bdag nyid can gtso bo de'i shar phyogs su rnam par snang mdzad dkar po zhi ba/ phyag bzhi pa g.yas gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang dril bu/ g.yon pa gnyis thod pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ lhor rin chen 'byung ldan dbang phyug chen po phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas pa gnyis kyis rin po che dang lcags kyu/ g.yon pa gnyis kyis thod pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu 'od dpag med ⑦dmar po phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas pa gnyis kyis mda' dang pad+ma'o—/ /g.yon pa gnyis kyis gzhu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ byang du don yod grub pa ljang khu phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas pa gnyis kyis rdo rje dang lcags kyu/47—1097

g.yon pa gnyis kyis dril bu dang / thod pa 'dzin pa/ dbang ldan du sbyan ma dkar mo phyag brgyad ma/ g.yas rnams kyis 'khor lo dang rdo rje dang ral gri dang mda' bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis thod pa dang dril bu dang zhags pa dang gzhu bsnams pa'o/ /me'i mtshams su ma ma ki sngon mo phyag bcu gnyis ma/ g.yas rnams kyis mda' dang ral gri dang rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang rin po che dang pad+ma bsnams pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis gzhu dang lcags kyu dang dril bu dang zhags pa dang thod pa dang kha ṭaṃ kha ①bsnams pa'o/ /srin po'i mtshams su gos dkar mo dmar mo phyag brgyad ma/ g.yas pa rnams kyis mda' dang pad+ma dang ral gri dang rdo rje'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis gzhu dang thod pa dang zhags pa dang dril bu bsnams pa'o/ /rlung gi mtshams su sgrol ma ljang khu phyag brgyad ma/ g.yas pa rnams kyis ud pal dmar po dang ral gri dang lcags kyu dang mda'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis 'khor lo dang zhags pa dang thod pa dang gzhu bsnams pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol rim pa gnyis pa la shar gyi phyogs su rdo rje drag mo dkar mo/ phyag na mda' dang lcags kyu dang / gzhu dang byang chub kyi sems kyis bkang ba'i thod pa'o/ /lho ru rdo rje sku ma ser mo/ phyag na rdo rje dang mdung dang / zhags pa dang thod pa khrag gis bskang ba'o/ /nub tu 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ phyag na ral gri dang rdo rje dang chus bskang ba'i thod pa dang dril bu'o/ /byang du zhi ba ma ljang khu/ phyag na lde mig dang ba dan rtse gsum dang rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha tram̐ ②ka dang thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /dbang ldan du rdo rje gnod sbyin ni dkar ①dmar gyi mdog la phyag na dbyug pa dang ud pa la dang thod pa dang ḍa ma ru'o/ /me'i mtshams su rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dmar 47—1098

ser phyag na pad+ma dang me long dang rkang mar gyis bkang ba'i thod pa dang dgra sta'o//srin po'i mtshams su sgra rdo rje ma sngon dmar phyag na shag ti dang mdung dang 'khor lo dang khrag gis bskang ba'i thod pa'o/ /rlung gi mtshams su sa'i rdo rje ma ljang dkar—/ pad+ma dang rdo rje dang bdud rtsi dang sha lngas gang ba'i thod pa mi lpags kyis dkris pa dang dril bu'o/ /brgyad po 'di dag ni phyag bzhi ma/ dang po'i phyag mtshan gnyis ni g.yas pa gnyis kyis 'dzin pa/ gzhan gnyis ni g.yon pa gnyis kyis 'dzin pa'o/ /de'i phyi rim gsum pa la/ shar du gad mo ma dmar mo phyag gnyis rdo rje dang rdo rjer bcas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa gad mo mngon par dgod pa'i tshul can ma'o/ /lho ru sgeg mo sngon mo nga rgyal dang bcas pas rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ sgeg pa'i tshul gyis gar byed pa'o/ /nub du glu ma ser mo phyag gnyis cha lang brdebs pa/ sgeg pa'i sku g.yo bar byed pa'i nyams dang ldan pa'o/ /byang du gar ma ljang khu phyag rgya'i tshul la sogs pa'i gar gyis g.yo ba'i tri shu la 'dzin pa dang / rdo rje dang dril bu bskor ba'o/ /dbang ldan du gling bu ma dmar mo gling bu 'bud pa'i tshul dang / me'i mtshams su pi wang ma ser mo phyag gnyis ma/ sgeg pa'i ros lus bag tsam g.yo zhing 'akying ba'o/ /srin po'i mabyedas su rdza rnga ma dkar mo dang / rlung gi mtshams su rnga zlum ma du ba'i mdog can no/ /rnam pa 'di dag bzhi ni phyag gnyis rang rang gi sgra'i snod la chags pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa'o/ /de nas phyi'i snam bu'i me'i mtshalas su me tog ma dkar mo g.yon me tog phreng ba dang g.yas 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /srin po'i mabyedas su bdug spos ma du ba'i mdog can/ g.yon bdug pa'i phor pa dang g.yas rin po che 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung gi mabyedas su mar me ma gser gyi 47—1099

mdog can/ g.yon du mar me'i yu ba g.yas pa pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan gyi mtshams su dri chab ma dmar mo/ g.yon dri'i dung chos dang g.yas ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /shar gyi phyogs su me long ma dkar mo phyag gnyis kyis me long 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor ro ma dmar mo phyag gnyis kyis ro'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /nub du reg bya ma ljang khu phyag gnyis kyis gos sna tshogs 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du chos ma dkar mo phyag gnyis kyis chos 'byung dkar mo 'dzin pa'o/ /'di rnams dang rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i lha rnams ni zhal gcig pa spyan gsum pa/ ral pa'i thor cog nag po la cod pan nag po btags pa/ thod pa lnga dang 'khor lo la sogs pas brgyan pa/ lha'i na bza' gon pa/ dkyil dkrung phyed pa'i gar kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu ma nam mkha' lta bur sngon mo/ zhal gsum pa g.yas nag po g.yon dkar po/ phyag drug pa'i g.yas pa rnams kyis lcags kyu dang ral gri dang 'khor lo/ g.yon pa rnams kyis zhags pa dang sdigs 'dzub dang dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /lho sgor rdo rje zhags pa ma dkar ser zhal gsum pa/ lha'i na bza' gon pa/ g.yas nag po g.yon dmar po/ phyag drug pa'i g.yas rnams kyis zhags pa dang / rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon pa rnams kyis 'khor lo dang dril bu dang sdigs 'dzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa'o/ /nub sgor rdo rje lcags sgog ma dmar mo zhal gsum pa/ g.yas nag po dang g.yon dkar po/ phyag drug pa'i g.yas pa rnams kyis lcags kyu dang rdo rje dang ral gri'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis 'khor lo dang dril bu dang lcags kyu'o/ /byang du rdo rje dril bu ljang khu zhal gsum pa/g.yas nag po dang g.yon dkar po/ phyag drug pa'i g.yas rnams kyis rdo rje 47—1100

dang dril bu dang ral gri'o/ /g.yon rnams kyis 'khor lo dang lcags kyu dang zhags pa'o/ /bzhi po 'di rnams ni zhal re re la'ang spyan gsum gsum pa/dbu skra ser po gyen la badze+es pa/ 'bar zhing thod pa lnga dang 'khor lo la sogs pas brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i gos can/ zhabs g.yas bskyang nas g.yon pas gar byed pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang thod pa dang nyi ma la bzhugs pa'o/ /rin chen 'byung ldan dang 'od dpag med dang don yod grub pa rnams kyang sna tshogs pad+ma dang thod pa dang nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /gzhan lha mo thams cad ni sna tshogs pad+ma dang thod pa dang zla ba'i gdan la gnas pa'o/ /'di dag thams cad nyi ma'i rgyab yol can no/ /'dir rdo rje sems dpa' kho na shes rab ma dang bcas pa las lha gzhan rnams ni shes rab ma dang bral ba'o zhes phyogs gcig pa'o/ /de rnams bdag nyid lta bu'i shes rab ma dang bcas pa'o zhes lugs gnyis pa'o/ /rigs kyi bdag po rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i de ba thams cad dang / ma ma ki dang sgra rdo rje ma dang / glu ma dang reg rdo rje ma dang chos kyi dbyings kyi rnams mi bskyod pa'o/ /spyan ma dang rdo rje drag mo dang sa'i rdo rje ma dang me tog ma dang gad mo ma dang gling bu ma dang rdo rje lcags kyu ma rnams kyi ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang rdo rje sku ma dang bdug spos ma dang sgeg mo ma dang pi wang ma dang rdo rje zhags pa ma rnams kyi rin chen 'byung ldan no/ /gos dkar mo dang rdo rje chags pa ma dang / mar me ma dang dri ma dang rnga chen ma dang rdo rje lcags sgrogs stim rnams kyi snang ba mtha' yas so/ /sgol ma dang rdo rje zhi ba ma dang rdo rje gnod sbyin ma dang /gar ma dang ro ma dang rdza rnga ma dang rdo rje dril bu ma rnams kyis don yod grub pa'o//47byed1101

thugs kha'i sa bon la sogs pa rnams ni rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i dal bskyed pa'i rim pas/ hūṃ bye e hri/ khaṃ rgyu ①hūṃ hri tai/ e saṃ/ i rnam/sum̐ sum̐/ saṃ saṃḥri haṃ i rī lo rī r+ghaṃ/ t+t+waṃ r+pā rgo ram̐ ā+oṃ khru ā+oṃ ā+o ā+o dza hūṃ baṃ ho/zhes pas so/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i snying po'i sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ①ta ma hā su kha hūṃ swā hā/ zhes bya'o/ /rdo rje dril bu ma'i snying po'i sngags ni/ oṃ byedabadz+ra ghan dhe hoḥhaṃ swā hā/ zhes bya ba ste las thams cad pa'i sngags so/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor la ni lha gzhan rnams kyi snying po'i sngags rnams kyi bsgrub bya rnams kyang gtso bo'i snying po'i sngags kyis 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de rnams ni gzhung mangs pas 'jigs pas ma bris so/ /de bzhin du thog ma dang tha mar rig par bya'o// //rdo rje gdan bzhi'i bsgrub thabs ni/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dal gyi 'khor lo la ni/ rdo rje'i gur gyi nang du sna tshogs pad+ma dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su gdugs dkar po'i 'og na gnasake pa'i seng ge'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i rdo rje 'di man cad gdan bzhi'i he ru ka hūṃ las sku mdog 'thing kha zhal gsum zhal re re la byed gsum gsum dang ldan pa phyag drug la g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus 'thing / dar gyi cod pan can/spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan can/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams nas yum la mkhyud pa/ g.yas g.yon bar pa gnyis kyis nu ma dang bzho dong 'dzin pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis shes rab mda' gzhu 'dzin pa can du 'di yan chad bsgomayab kyi 'di rnams sa yin kyus su shor ba yin 47—1102

no—/ /ye shermi mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo/ 'di'i cod pan dar gyis bcings pa/steng du rdo rjes mtshan pa/ sangs rgyas lnga'i 'od 'phro bas brgyan pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal khro ba/ gad rgyangs dang bcas pa/ g.yas pa dkar ba'i bzhad pa dang bcas pa/ g.yon dmar po sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa'o/ /zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum pa/ g.yas pa'i phyag gsum na steng du bstan pa'i kha ṭī ga dang dgra sta dang rdo rje'o/ /g.yon gyi gsum na dril bu dang khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa dang ral gri bsnams pa'o/ /'di'i shar phyogs su rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa'o/ /'di'i g.yon byang phyogs su 'jigs byed mkha' 'gro ma gser gyi mdog can no/ /nub du ro langs ma dmar mo'o/ /lho phyogs su tsan ḍa li sngon mo'o/ /bzhi po 'di dag kyang seng ge'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'o/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa'i phyag gnyis kyi steng du bgreng ba'i kha ṭī ga dang khrag gis bskang ba'i thod pas mchod pa byed pa'o//dbang ldan du seng ge ma ni seng ge'i gdong can zhal dang sku'i g.yon dang g.yas kyi phyed dkar ba dang ser ba/ seng ge'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /me'i mtshams su stag mo stag gdong ma zhal dang sku g.yon pa dang g.yas kyi phyed sngon po dang dkar mo/ rin chen bdun gyi phung po la gnas pa'o/ /srin po'i mtshams su spyang khu ma spyang khu'i gdong can/ zhal dang sku g.yon dang g.yas kyi phyed nag pa dang dmar po ma te la gnas pa'o/ /rlung gi mtshams su 'ug gdong ma 'ug pa'i gdong can zhal dang sku'i g.yon dang g.yas kyi phyed phyed ser po dang dmar po/ klu brgyad kyi mjug ma la gnas pa'o/ /bzhi po 'di dag ni g.yas dang g.yon pa'i phyag na rdo rje lcags kyu dang bcas pa'i rdo rje'i zhags pa'o/ /sna 47—1103

tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'o/ /de nas shar sgor rgyal po'i dbang mo dkar mo phyag gnyis kyi thal mo khar bcug pa'o/ /byang du mar me can ma ser mo mar me 'dzin pa lta bu'i thal mo spyi bor 'dzin pa'o/ /nub du 'jigs byed ma dmar mo khrag gis bskang ba'i snyim pa steng du bkab nas kha'i thad kar bzung nas khrag gi rgyun 'thung bar byed pa'o/ /lho ru kam pa 'dzin nag mo rdo rje'i snyim pa la mthe bong gnyis phan tshun sbyar ste sdigs 'dzub gnyis kyi rtse mo sprad nas rang gi gsang ba'i gnas la bzhag nas gsang ba'i gnas ston par byed pa'o/ /bzhi po 'di dag ni sna tshogs pad+ma dang ro'i snying khar nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa'o//rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa bcu gnyis ni zhal gcig pa spyan gsum pa'o/ /lha mo bcu gsum mo thams cad kyang lha'i gos dmar po bsnams pa/ dbu la thod pa lnga'i phreng ba dang ldan pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i skyil dkrungs can/ klu'i rgyal po brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/'jig pa'i dus kyi me'i 'od lta bu'i 'od zer kyi tshogs kyi dra bas 'jigs par byed pa/ go rims ji lta bas mi bskyod pa dang rnam par snang mdzad dang rin chen 'byung ldan dang snang ba mtha' yas dang don yod grub pa dang / rnam par snang mdzad dang rin chen 'byung ldan dang snang ba mtha' yas dang don yod grub pa rnams kyis rgyas btab pa'o/ /hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ a slo s+t+waṃ rī r+pā e smyo aḥ'adi dag rnams ni thugs kha'i sa bon rnams so/ /ā+oṃ hriḥswā hā zhes bya ba ni ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i snying po'i sngags so/ /ā+oṃ be+e ta li hūṃ swā hā zhes bya ba ni las thams cad pa'i ste ro langs ma'i sngags so// //47—1104

saṃ bu ta'i rgyud kyi dgyes pa rdo rje lha bcu bdun pa'i dal gyi bdag nyid can la/ rdo rje gur gyi nang du chos 'byung gi dkyil na gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru la gnas pa'i ro'i snying khar khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa'i steng du nyi ma la dgyes pa rdo rje rnam pa gsum mo/ /bzhi pa ni ro'i gdan med par ro/ /lo ka gsum 'gugs par byed pa ni nag po rdo rje rgya khram gyis mtshan ma dang / dbu skra dmar po gyen du brjes la/ thod pa lnga dang phyag rgya drug dang mi mgo'i phreng ba rlon pas brgyan pa'o/ /stag gi lpags pa'i smad dkris can/ g.yon pa'i brla la g.yas pa'i zhabs kyi rtse mo bzhag pa'i dkyil dkrungs phyed kyis gnas pa/ spyan gsum pa zlum pa rab tu dmar ba/ zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis kyi g.yon pa'i phyag gis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i thod pa khrag gis bskang nas phyis 'chad pa'i bdag med ma la 'khyud ①pa/ phyag g.yas pa rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'dzin pa'i tshul gyis bsnun pa'o/ /yang na phyag bzhi pa la'ang phyag gnyis pa lta bu gzhan ma'i phyag gnyis kyis bdag nyid dang mtshungs pa'i rdo rje phag mo la mkhyud pa'o/ /zhes bya ba ni khyad par ro/ /yang na phyag drug pa nag po zhal gsum pa nag po dang dmar po dang dkar po zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum pa/ ral pa'i thor cog gis brgyan pa/ g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang mda' dang rtse gsum pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis rdo rje dril bu dang gzhu dang thod pa'o/ /de dag gi dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang rdo rje dril bu dang ldan pa'i bdag nyid can dang mtshungs pa'i yum lu gu rgyud ma la mkhyud pa ste/gzhan yang sbyor ba ji lta bas 'di nyid kyang snga ma bzhin no/ /sngar bstan pa'i ste ru ka gsum kyi shar la sogs pa'i 'dab ma brgyad la sgo ri la sogs pa'i lha mo 47—1105

brgyad do/ /de'i phyi rol dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams su gling bu ma dang pi wang ma dang rdza rnga ma dang rnga rdung ma rnams so/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo rnams la rdo rje lcags kyu ma dang rdo rje zhags pa ma dang rdo rje lcags sgog ma dang rdo rje dril bu ma rnams so/ /lha mo bcu drug po 'di dag ni gong bzhin du thabs dang bral ba'o—/ /dgyes pa'i rdo rje gsum gyi rigs kyi bdag po mi bskyod pa'o/ /snying kha'i sa bon ni hūṃ ngo / /snying po'i sngags ni/ ā+oṃ a hūṃ hri swā hā/ gtso bo re re'i sngags ni rim pa ji lta bar ā+oṃ tre+e lokyā k+shi pa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ ā+oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la bh+yo hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ ā+oṃ ṭi ma dang pa ra ta dang ki ḍi ki ḍi badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/dgyes pa rdo rje bzhi pa ni phyag bcu drug pa mi bskyod pas rgyas btab pa/ bdag sked ma la mkhyud pa/ 'dir khyad par du bdud bzhi ni gong du bshad pa'i ro'i gnas su phung po'i bdud ni tshangs pa'i gzugs ser po/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud khyab 'jug nag po/ 'chi bdag gi bdud dbang phyug chen po dkar po/lha'i bu'i bdud lha'i dbang po ser po/ de dag gi steng du bcom ldan 'das zhabs gnyis kyis rdo rje'i skyil krung phyed pas gnas pa dang / gzhan gnyis ni g.yon bskum pa dang g.yas bskyang bas bzhugs pa'i zhabs bzhi pa/ sku mdog nag po dang sna tshogs rdo rje la sogs pa nas stag gi lpags pa'i bar du sngar bshad pa'i khyad par can/ zhal brgyad pa spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa'o/ /rtsa ba'i zhal nag po gad mo rgod pa/ g.yas pa dkar po 'dzum pa g.yon pa dmar po/steng gi mche ba rtsigs pa/ gzhan rnams ni nag po'o/ /g.yas pa'i phyag rnams na rdo rje dang ral gri dang mda' dang 'khor lo dang chang gi snod dang dbyug pa dang rtse gsum dang lcags kyu rnams so/ /g.yon pa rnams su dril bu dang pad+ma 47—1106

dang gzhu dang kha ṭī ka bgreng ba dang thod pa dang rin po che dang sprugs 'dzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa'o/ /shar gyi 'dab ma la gho ri dkar mo phyag g.yas pa gnyis na mda' bkang ba dang rdo rje dril bu/ g.yon pa gnyis na khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa dang gzhu dang nya ro hi ta dang bcas pa'o/ /lho phyogs su tso'u ri ma dmar mo rdo rje dang ḍa ma ru dang thod pa khrag gis bkang ba'i phag pa dang bcas pa'o/ /nub du ro langs ma dkar ser ral gri dang rus sbal dang bcas pa'i khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa dang / chang gis bkang ba'i thod pa dang dri chus bkang ba'i thod pa'o/ /byang du ghasma ri ljang khu cung zad ser ba rkang mar gyis gang ba'i thod pa la gnas pa'i sbrul dang mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang / rdo rjes mtshan pa'i me thab dang dgra sta'o/ /dbang ldan du pu ka si ser mo shas gang ba'i thod pa la gnas pa'i seng ge dang mchod sbyin kyi phyag rgya dang / dpag bsam kyi shing gi yal ga dang rin po che'o/ /me'i mtshams su sha ba ri dkar mo byang chub sems kyis gang ba'i thod par dge slong dang rdo rje dang / kha ṭ+wāṃ ka dang zhags pa'o/ /srin po'i mtshams su tsan dha li sngon mo g.yas su khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa la stag dang g.yon du pu ka ri ka dang /phyag gzhan gnyis na rlung bskyod kyi gos so/ /rlung mtshams su ḍo bi ni nag mo chang gi snod thod pa dang rtse gsum pa gyen du bstan pa dang / bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa la gnas pa'i spyang gi dang thong bshol lo/ /de dag rnams kyi phyi'i zur du gling bu ma la sogs pa bzhi gong bzhin du'o/ /shar gyi sgo ru stag gdong ma nag mo zhal rnams nag pa dang dkar ba dang dmar po dang ser po dang steng du stag gdong ljang khu'o/ /lhor phag gdong ma ser mo dang nag mo dang /47—1107

dkar mo rnams kyi zhal dang / steng du phag pa'i zhal dmar po'o/ /nub du khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ dmar mo dang nag po dang dkar po'i zhal rnams dang steng du khye gdong ser po'o/ /byang du seng gdong ma ljang khu rnams ni ljang khu dang nag po dang dkar mo rnam ①dang steng du seng ge'i gdong pa can dmar po'o//de lta bas na rtsa ba dang g.yas dang g.yon dang steng gi rim pas zhal bzhi pa'o/ /sgo skyong ma rnams phyag bzhi pa rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pa bzhin du phyag mtshan 'dzin pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang khrag gis bskang ba'i thod pa la gnas pa'i ro'i steng du g.yas bskum pa dang g.yon bskyang bas gnas pa/ dbu skra dmar po gyen du badze+es pa'o/ /lha gzhan rnams ni rdo rje'i dkyil dkrung phyed pa/thams cad kyang zhal re re zhing spyan gsum pa/ phyag rgya lnga la sogs pas brgyan pa yab med pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kyi sa bon hūṃ ngo / /snying po'i sngags ni/ ā+oṃ de ba pi tsu badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā zhes so/ /yī ā+o swā hā zhes pa ni ghasma ri'i las thams cad pa'i sngags so/ /dgyes pa rdo rje rnam pa bzhi'o// //lha dgu'i bdag med ma'i dal la rdo rje gur kyi nang du chos 'byung la gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar bdag med ma'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i 'dab mar rdo rje ma dang gho'u ri ma dang tso'u ri ma dang ghasma ri dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams so/ /rim pa gnyis par sna tshogs pad+ma la/shar la sogs par sgo ri dang tso'u ri dang bhe ta li dang ghasma ri rnams so/ /dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams su pu ka si dang sa ba ri dang tsan ḍa li 47—1108

dang ḍo bi ma rnams so/ /bdag med ma'i steng gi shar phyogs su pad+ma la gnas pa'i mkha' spyod ma zhal gyen du gzigs pa'o/ /'og gi nub phyogs su pad+ma la gnas pa'i sa spyod ma zhal thur du gzigs pa'o/ /phyi'i rim pa la gnas pa'i sgo ri la sogs pa brgyad ni phyag bcu drug pa'i dal lta bu ser po la sogs pa'i mdog can no/ /gzhan bdun ni sngon mo'o/ /'di dag bco lnga po thams cad dkyil dkrung phyed kyis ro'i snying khar gnas pa'i nyi ma'i dal la bzhugs pa/zhal gcig pa spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du badze+es pa/ stag gi lpags pa bsnams pa/ phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje dang gri gug /g.yon gnyis kyis thod pa dang gyen du bsgreng ba'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa'o/ /mgo la mi mgo lnga'i phreng ba can/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa'o/ /zur rnams la gling bu ma la sogs pa bzhi ni sngar bzhin no/ /shar gyi sgor stag gdong ma dkar sngo/lho ru phag gdong ser sngon/ nub du khyi gdong ma dmar ljang / byang du seng ge'i gdong can ma ma ra ga lta bu sngo ljang ma'o/ /bzhi po 'di dag kyang g.yas bskyang ba/ g.yon bskum pa nyid kyis g.yas g.yon gyi phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ nyi ma la gnas pa/ ming gi rjes su 'brang ba'i zhal gcig ma/ mdog gnyis gnyis dang ldan pa/ khyad par gzhan ni rnam pa thams cad kyis bdag med ma bzhin du'o/ /bdag med ma la rim pa ji lta bas mi bskyod pa dang / rnam par snang mdzad dang / rin chen 'byung ldan dang /snang ba mtha' yas dang / don yod grub pa dang / mi bskyod pa dang rnam par snang mdzad dang rin chen 'byung ldan dang snang ba mtha' yas dang mi bskyod pa dang rnam par snang mdzad kyis rgyas btab pa'o/ /gling bu ma la sogs pa dang 47—1109

stag gdong ma la sogs pa la rnam par snang mdzad dang rin chen 'byung ldan dang 'od dpag med ①dang don yod grub pa rnams kyis rgyas btab pa'o/ /bdag med ma'i thugs kha'i sa bon ni saṃ ngo / /yī i swā hā zhes bya ba ni snying po'i sngags so/ /ā+oṃ s+t+waṃ swā hā zhes bya ba ni ghasma ri'i las thams cad pa'i sngags so/ /yang na bdag med ma la sogs pa lha mo bco lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi dal la/de la lha mo rnams sku mdog nag mo g.yas g.yon gyi phyag gis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ mchod phyir thogs dang bcas pa'i rnal 'byor gyi kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang bcas pa'o/ /gzhan ni gong bzhin no/ /ā+oṃ byedabadz+ra ghasma ri ā+oṃ hūṃ swā hā zhes bya ba ni ghasma ri'i sngags so// //gang gi tshe ku ru kul+le dal bdag ④mor gyur na sku mdog dmar mo phyag bzhi pa—/ g.yas gnyis kyis mda' dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ g.yon gnyis kyis ud pa la dmar po dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhal gcig ma/ spyan gsum pa/rigs kyi bdag po snang ba mtha' yas kyis byas pa/ rdo rje ma la sogs pa bcu bzhi sku mdog dmar mo mda' gzhu 'dzin pa'i phyag gnyis ma'o/ /bco lnga po thams cad pad+ma dmar po dang ro'i snying khar zla ba la skyil krung phyed pas gnas pa'o—/ /ku ru kul+le'i snying po'i sa bon ni hri/ oṃ ku ru kupre tri swā hā/ zhes bya ba ni snying po'i sngags so/ /gzhan ni sa bon dang sngags sngar bzhin du ste de'i tshe ku ru kul+le'i dal du 'gyur ro// //rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud kyi dal bram ze r+ṣa po sa ra ha'i lugs dang rdo rje bdud rtsi'i dal du rdo rje 47—1110

gur gyi nang du chos 'byung gi dbus su gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru dang zla ba la dpal rdo rje bdud rtsi sems dpa'i skyil krung gis gnas pa/ sku mdog me tog pri yang ku lta bu'i ljang sngon dang dkar ba dang dmar ba ni rtsa ba dang g.yas dang g.yon kyi zhal lo/ /ri mo sna tshogs pa'i lag rdub dang dpung rgyan la sogs pa dang gos rnams kyis brgyan pa/ phyag drug pa'i rdo rje dril bur bcas pa'i phyag gnyis kyis rang nyid lta bu'i shes rab ma la mkhyud pa/ g.yas pa gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon pa gnyis kyis zhags pa dang lcags kyu 'dzin par 'od dmar po'i rgyab yol can/ zhi ba dang sgeg pa'i nyams kyi tshogs dang ldan pa'o/ /shar gyi 'dab mar zhi ba ma dkar mo zhal gsum pa/ dkar ba dang nag pa dang dmar ba/ lhor zhi ba'i zhal ser mo ni zhal gsum pa/ ser ba dang dkar ba dang / dmar ba/nub du zla ba la skyes ma dmar mo zhal gsum pa/ dmar ba dang nag pa dang dkar ba/ byang du zla ba mo ljang khu zhal gsum pa/ ljang khu dang dmar po dang dkar po/ me'i mtshams su zla ba'i snying po sngon mo zhal gsum pa/ sngon po dang dkar po dang dmar po/ srin po'i mtshams su zla ba'i ri mo ma me tog pri yang ku lta bu ljang sngon ma zhal gsum pa/ ljang sngon dang dkar po dmar po/rlung gi mtshalas su yid 'ong ma ud pal sngon po lta bu'i mdog can zhal gsum ma/sngon po dang dkar po dang dmar po/ dbang ldan gyi mtshams su yid spro ma gser lta bu'i mdog can/ zhal gsum pa/ ser mo dang dkar po dmar po/ lha mo 'di rnams ni dal gyi gtso bo lta bu'i phyag gi mtshan ma 'dzin pa'o/ /khyad par du ni 'khor lo'i dbus su zla ba'i dal 'dzin pa rnams so/ /zla ba'i ri mo ni 47—1111

tshes gnyis kyi zla ba 'dzin pa'o/ /rim pa gnyis pa dbang ldan gyi mtshalas su me tog ma dkar mo zhal gsum pa/ dkar po dang nag po dang dmar po/ me'i mtshams su bdug pa ma du ba'i mdog can zhal gsum pa/ du ba'i mdog dang dkar po dang dmar po/ srin po'i mtshams su mar me ma gser gyi mdog can zhal gsum pa/ ser po dang dkar po dang nag po/ rlung gi mtshams su dri chab ma dmar mo zhal gsum pa dmar po dang nag mo dang dkar po/ 'di rnams ni go rims bzhin du g.yas kyis ①phyag dang pos me tog gi za ma tog dang /spos phor dang mar me'i kong bu dang dri'i dung 'dzin pa'o/ /phyag lhag ma rnams kyis gtso bo'i phyag mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i snam du ②la gling bu ma dang pi wang ma dang / mu kun da dang / rang rings ma rnams ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ dmar mo dang ser mo dang dkar mo dang du ba'i mdog can rnams te/ gling bu la sogs pa'i sgra 'byin pa la brtson pa'o/ /shar gyi sgo la khro gnyer sngon po nam mkha'i mdog can zhal gsum/ nam mkha'i mdog lta bu dang dkar po dang dmar po/ lho'i sgor 'jigs pas bsdigs byed dkar po zhal gsum pa/ dkar po dang nag po dang dmar po/ nub sgor rta'i gzugs can zhal gsum pa/ dmar po dang / dkar po dang nag po/byang sgor tshogs kyis ①'dren pa zhal gsum pa/ ljang khu dang dkar po dang dmar po/ 'di rnams ni zhi ba dang khro bo'i 'gying ba'i zhabs kyis brten pas bzhugs pa/ dal gyi rtso bo'i phyag mtshan lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o/ /khyad par du ni g.yas dang pos rim pa ji lta bar lcags kyu dang zhags pa dang lcags sgog dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ mche ba cung zad brtsigs pa'o/ /'dir dal gyi rtso bo ni 47—1112
