de ba lnga'i gzugs brnyan dang ldan pa'i sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rin po che sna tshogs pa'i cod pan can no/ /de las gzhan nyi shu po rnams ni rdo rje bdud rtsi'i glegs bam gyis mtshan pa'i rin po che'i cod pan kyis brgyan pa'o/ /thams cad zla ba'i dal la gnas pa ste/ dal gyi rtso bo lta bu rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /me tog ma la sogs pa bcu gnyis po ni sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'o/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i thugs kyi sa bon ha'o/ /ā+oṃ haḥbadz+ra a spri ta swā hā zhes bya ba ni snying po'i sngags so/ /las thams cad pa'i sngags kyang de nyid yin no/ /gzhan rdo rje bdud rtsi rnam pa gsum gyi bsgom pa'i khyad par mangs pas 'jigs pas 'dir ma bshad de/ rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud nyid las shes par bya'o// //dgyes pa'i rdo rje rnam pa bzhi'i lha dgu'i bdag nyid can gyi dal du ni/rdo rje gur gyi nang du gnas pa'i chos 'byung la gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang ngo / /phyag bcu drug pa'i dal 'jam pa'i rdo rje lta bu'o/ /phyogs gnyis pa la bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa yang yod do/ /gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar gnas pa'i tshangs pa dang khyab 'jug dang dbang phyug dang lha'i dbang po ste bdud rnam pa bzhi'i rang bzhin gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i snying khar gnas pa'i nyi ma la zhabs bzhi pa/ gcer bu gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa / zhabs gnyis kyis rdo rje'i skyidzi krung dang / gzhan zhabs gnyis kyis g.yon bskum pa dang g.yas bskyang ba'i gar gyi tshul gyis gnas pa dang / spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa dang / dbu skra dmar po gyen du badze+es pa dang /47—1113

dpral ba'i steng du lpags pa bral ba'i mi mgo lngas brgyan pa/ sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan can/ sku mdog nag po phyag bcu drug pa/ zhal brgyad pa zhal re re zhing spyan gsum dmar zhing zlum pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal nag po/ g.yas pa rnams ni dkar po dang dmar po dang nag po rnams so/ /g.yon pa rnams ni dmar po dang sngon po nag po rnams so/ /steng gi zhal ni du ba'i mdog can mi sdug pa/zhal thams cad smin ma zhigs pa khro gnyer can/ mche ba brtsigs pa'i myu gus 'jigs par byed pa/ g.yas pa'i phyag brgyad kyis bsnams pa'i thod par glang po dang rta dang bong bu dang glang dang rnga mo dang mi dang sha ra ba dang byi la rnams so/ /g.yon pa'i phyag gi thod pa rnams su sa dang chu dang / rlung dang me dang zla ba dang nyi ma dang gshin rje dang nor sbyin rnams so/ /'khor lo dang rna cha dang 'gul brgyan dang lag rdub dang ska rags dang thal ba rnams dang / mi mgo lnga bcu'i phreng ba dang / dpung brgyan dang rkang rdub rnams kyis brgyan pa'o/ /'di'i yum bdag med ma nag mo gcer bu phyag gnyis kyis dril bu dang thod pas mchod par byed pa bcom ldan 'das la mkhyud pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum pa/g.yon bskyang ba'i gar gyi tshul kyis gnas pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ zhal gcig pa/ spyan gsum pa dmar la zlum pa/ mche ba brtsigs pa/ dbu skra 'bar ba gyen du badze+es pa'o/ /dpral ba la gnas pa'i thod pa dang mgrin par mi mgo skam po'i phreng ba 'chang ba dang / rkang rdub la sogs pas brgyan pa'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i 'dab mar gnas pa'i tshangs pa dang dbang po dang nye ba'i dbang po dang drag po'i snying kha'i steng du zla ba la gho'u ri la sogs pa'o/ /dbang ldan la sogs pa'i 'dab mar gshin rje dang lus ngan dang srin po dang 47—1114

thags bzangs ris kyi snying khar zla ba'i dal la gnas pa'i pu ka si la sogs pa'o//de la gho ri ma nag mo g.yas gri gug g.yon ro ti ta'i nya'o/ /tso'u ri ma dmar mo g.yas phag pa g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /ro langs ma gser gyi mdog can phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pa na rus sbal dang g.yon pa na pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /ghasma ri lngang khu phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pa na sbrul dang g.yon pa na rnal 'byor kyi snod thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /pu ka si sngon mo phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pa na seng ge g.yon pa na dgra sta 'dzin pa'i phyag go/ /sha ba ri dkar mo phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pa na dge slong g.yon pa bsil byed 'dzin pa'o/ /tsan dha li nam mkha'i mdog lta bu phyag gnyis kyi g.yas 'khor lo g.yon thong bshol 'dzin pa'o/ /ḍo bi mo khra mo phyag gnyis kyi g.yas rdo rje g.yon sdogs 'dzub 'dzin pa'o/ /brgyad po 'di dag ni skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa/ gzhan yang khyad par kyi rgyan bdag med ma lta bu'o/ /dpal te ru ka dang bdag med ma gnyis kyi rigs kyi bdag po ni mi bskyod rdo rje'o/ /gho ri ma la sogs pa bzhi'i rigs kyi bdag po ni mi bskyod pa dang / rnam par snang mdzad dang / rin chen 'byung ldan dang /snang ba mtha' yas so/ /de rnams kyis rgyas btab pa'o/ /de bzhin du pu ka si la sogs pa rnams kyang shes par bya'o// //yang na khyad par du dal gyi gtso bo phyag gnyis pa ni phyag g.yas pas rdo rje phyar ba/ g.yon pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i thod pa 'dzin pa bdag med mas mkhyud pa/ kha ṭī ga yang g.yon pa'i mchan khung la 'dzin pa'o// //47—1115

yang na dal gyi rtso bo sngon po phyag bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje 'dzin pa/g.yon pas khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ phyag gzhan gnyis kyis bdag nyid lta bu'i rdo rje phag mo la mkhyud pa'o// //yang na dal kyi gtso bo zhal gsum pa phyag drug pa rtsa ba'i zhal dang g.yas dang g.yon gnyis ni sngon po dang dkar po dang dmar po bsam mo/ /phyag g.yas pa gnyis kyis rdo rje dang gri gug /'og ma gnyis kyis rtse gsum dang dril bu/gzhan gnyis kyis lu gu rgyud ma la mkhyud pa'o/ /rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma ni sku mdog dang zhal dang phyag mtshan la sogs pa bdag med ma dang mtshungs par gsang ba 'dus pa lha bcu dgu ma'i sgo nas grub pa thob pa lus med rdo rje'i zhabs kyis gsungs so/ /'dir phyag gnyis pa la sogs pa ni sna tshogs pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru la ro'i steng du nyi ma la skyil krung phyed pas gar byed pa/ smin ma g.yo ba dang bcas pa'i khro gnyer can/mche ba brtsigs pa rnams so/ /mi bskyod pas rgyas btab pa dang sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa dang / dbu skra dmar po gyen du brjes pa dang / mi mgo lngas dbu brgyan pa'o/ /phyag bcu drug pa ltar 'khor lo la sogs pas brgyan pa'o/ /de dag kyang gho ri la sogs pa lha mo rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba ste/ lha mo 'di rnams ni thabs dang bral ba'i rdo rje phag mo dang rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma la ni mi bskyod pas rgyas btab pa'o/ /dgyes pa'i rdo rje rnam pa bzhi'i thugs kyi sa bon hūṃ ngo / /ā+oṃ de ba pi tsu badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ phyag bcu drug pa'i snying po'o/ /ā+oṃ ā+oṃ lokyā k+ṣe pa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa ni phyag gnyis pa'i'o/ /ā+oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la bh+yo hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ phyag bzhi pa'i 'o/ /ā+oṃ ki ṭi ki ṭi badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/47—1116

phyag drug pa'i'o/ /ā+oṃ a badz+ra ghasma ri ā+oṃ hūṃ swā hā zhes bya ba ni las thams cad pa'i de las thams cad pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ni byang phyogs kyi lha mo don grub yin pas gsung sngags so// //dpal sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i dal du rdo rje gur gyi nang du gnas pa'i chos 'byung gi nang du gzhal yas khang ngo / /kha gcig gi lugs kyis rdo rje gur gyi nang du chos 'byung med par gzhal yas khang ngo / /gzhal yas khang gi dbus su pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ze'u 'bru la nyi ma'i gdan la sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i ming can he ru ka nag po/ nyi ma lta bu'i 'bar ba'i phreng ba du ma 'khrigs pa—/ sgeg pa'i khro bo dbu skra 'bar zhing gyen du badze+es pa/ thod pas brgyan pa'i cod pan can/ sngon po dang ser po dang dkar po dang ljang khu'i rtsa ba'i zhal dang g.yas dang nub dang g.yon kyi zhal dang bzhi'o/ /zhal re re la'ang spyan gsum dmar la rlum pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis na thod pa dang mda'/g.yon gnyis na kha ṭī kha dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa/ mi'i lpags pa'i na bza' can/ dkyil dkrung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa/dpal sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo dang / ser po dang dkar po dang ljang khu'i zhal/ gtso bo lta bu'i phyag mtshan dang sku mdog dmar po phyag gnyis pos mgul nas mkhyud pa'o/ /shar gyi 'dab mar rdo rje mkha' 'go ma sngon mo/sngon po dang ser po dang dkar po dang ljang khu'i zhal/ rdo rje dang thod pa dang dril bu dang kha spyo ga 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo/ser po dang sngon po dang dkar po dang ljang khu'i zhal/ rin po che 'bar ba dang tri shu la dang 'grin pa brtsir ba'i spyang khu dang ba dan 'dzin pa'o/ /nub du 47—1117

pad+ma'i mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo/ dkar po dang ser po dang sngon po dang ljang khu'i zhal/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang mda' dang thod pa dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma ljang khu/ ljang khu dang dmar po dang ser po dang sngon po'i zhal/ ral gri dang ḍa ma ru dang zhags pa dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /thams cad kyang sna tshogs pa'i rgyan dang phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ zla ba'i gdan dang rgyab yol can te/ 'di rnams kyi khyad par gzhan rnams ni gtso bo lta bu'o//bcom ldan 'das kyi rigs kyi bdag po mi bskyod pa'o/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa rnams kyang go rims ji lta ba bzhin du rnam par snang mdzad dang mi bskyod pa dang rin chen 'byung ldan dang 'od dpag med dang don yod grub pa rnams so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kyi sa bon hūṃ ngo / /ā+oṃ hūṃ hūṃ snying po'i sngags so/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa rnams kyi yang /yī yī hūṃ/ ā+oṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ ā+oṃ swā hūṃ/ ā+oṃ aḥhūṃ/ ā+oṃ hā hūṃ/ zhes bya ste sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma'i sngags ni las thams cad pa'i sngags so// //bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas thod pa lha dgu'i dal la ni/ rdo rje gur gyi nang gi chos 'byung la gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'o/ /de'i ze'u 'bru la ro dang nyi ma'i gdan la shes rab ma dang bral ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das sku mdog la sogs pa phyis 'chad pa'i 'khor lo gsum la gnas pa'i bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas thod pa bzhin no/ /shar dang byang dang nub dang lho'i 'dab ma la yang rim pa ji lta bas/ sna tshogs bde ma dang / 'dod ma dang / sa 'og gnas ma dang / legs bzang po rnams ni sku mdog sngon mo/47—1118

g.yon bsgum pa g.yas bskyang ba/ stag gi lpags pa bsnams pa/ phyag g.yas gnyis kyis dril bu dang thod pa'o/ /g.yon gnyis kyis kha ṭī ga dang ḍa ma ru 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan dang me dang bden bral dang rlung gi mtshams kyi 'dab ma la/ chang 'tshong ma dang / 'byung mo dang / phyag bzhi ma dang /nam mkha' ma rnams ni ser mo na bza' ser mo bsnams pa/ 'od zer ser po'i 'phro ba/ zhabs gnyis g.yas bskyang g.yon bskums ①pa klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pa gnyis kyis rdo rje dang ḍa ma ru/ g.yon pa gnyis na kha ṭaṃ ga dang pad+ma'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /brgyad po 'di dag thams cad nyi ma'i dal la gar gyi byed gyis gnas pa/ dbu skra dmar po gyen du badze+es pa/ thod pa lnga'i phreng ba can/ phyag rgya lnga la sogs pas brgyan pa/ mi mgo don pa lnga bcus mgul du 'phyang ba/ mche ba cung zad brtsigs pa/ zhal gcig pa phyag bzhi pa/ spyan gsum pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das la mi bskyod pa la sogs pa rigs lngas rgyas btab pa'o/ /ri mo bde ba la sogs pa rnams kyi mi bskyod pa dang rnam par snang mdzad dang rin chen 'byung ldan dang snang ba mtha' yas so/ /chang 'tshong ma la sogs pa rnams kyi yang de dag rnams so/ /yang na bcom ldan 'das 'di dang phyogs kyi lha mo rnams kyang sku mdog dkar mo/ mtshalas kyi lha mo rnams dmar mo/ 'di ni yum dang bral ba'am yum dang bcas pa'o// //rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi a bi da na'i rgyud kyi dal du/ rdo rje gur gyi nang du chos 'byung gi dbus su gzhal yas khang ngo / /de'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma la g.yon bskum pa dang g.yas bskyang 47—1119

bas mnan pa'i bcom ldan 'das lo ka gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i khro bo ni/'jig pa'i dus kyi me lta bu 'od zer 'bar zhing 'gro ba ma lus pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs thams cad rab tu gsol bar mdzad pa'i sku mdog sngon po/ sngon po dang ser po dang ljang khya'i mdog can gyi rtsa ba'i zhal dang g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal kha phye ba/ mche ba brtsigs pas rab tu gtum pa/ ljags 'dril bas 'jigs su rung ba/ zhal re re'ang sbyan gsum pa/ smin ma g.yo ba'i khro gnyer dang bcas pa/ spyan gsum pa dmar zhing rlum pa'i dpral ba'i thog du zla ba'i steng na thod pa lnga'i phreng ba dang / mgul par rab tu 'phyang ba'i mi mgo lnga bcu'i phreng ba dang ldan pa yum dang bcas pa/ klu mtha' yas sngon pos dbu skra dmar zhing 'bar ba gyen du bcings pa/ klu 'jog po dmar pos rna rgyan byas pa/ klu pad+ma chen po pad+ma dkar po lta bus mgul rgyan byas pa/ klu dkar po lha ngur pa lta bus mchod phyir thogs byas pa/ nor rgyas dkar pos ske rags byas pa/ pad+ma pad+ma dkar po lta bu mdzes pas rkang rdub byas pa/ dung skyong ser pos lag rdub byas pa/ rigs ldan ngur pa lta bu khro bos dpung rgyan byas pa/rdo rje sems dpas dbu la rgyas btab pa/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'i phyag gnyis kyis lo ka gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgya dang mtshungs pa'i yum la mkhyud pa—/ g.yas pa gnyis kyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa gnyis kyis thod pa dang kha ṭī ga 'dzin pa'o/ /'di'i shar phyogs su rdo rje dbyug pa sngon po rtsa ba dang g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal sngon po dang ser po dang ljang khu'o/ /phyag g.yas pa gnyis kyis rdo rje tho ba dang sdigs 'dzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje gyen du 'phyar ba/ g.yon pa gnyis kyis thod pa dang kha ṭaṃ ga 'dzin pa'o/ /byang 47—1120

du me'i nyi ma ser po rtsa ba dang g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i zhal ser po dang sngon po dang ljang khu'o/ /phyag dang pos rdo rje dang dbyig pa 'dzin pa/ rdo rje la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan rnams rdo rje dbyug pa lta bu'o/ /'di'i 'og nas 'chad pa rnams kyang de ltar shes par bya'o/ /nub du rdo rje tsug tor dmar po zhal gsum pa dmar po dang dkar po dang ljang khu'o/ /phyag na pad+ma dmar po'o/ /lhor rdo rje bdud rtsi 'khyil pa lngang khu/ ljang khu dang ser po dang dkar po'i zhal lo / /sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshon par byas pa'i phyag go/ /me'i mtshams su rdo rje gnod sbyin du ba'i mdog /du ba'i mdog dang ser po dang ljang khu'i zhal lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o/ /srin po'i mtshams su rdo rje nag po dmar po dmar po dang ser po dang ljang khu'i zhal can dgra sta 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung gi mtshams su stobs po che sngon po/ sngon po dang ser po dang ljang khu'i zhal can tri shul 'dzin pa'o—/ /dbang ldan kyi mtshams su rdo rje 'jigs su rung ba ①nag po/ nag po dang ser po dang ljang khu'i zhal can ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje dbyug pa la sogs pa 'di brgyad ni rim pa ji lta bas/ gshin rje mthar byed dang / shes rab mthar byed dang / pad+ma mthar byed dang / bgegs mthar byed dang /'dod pa'i rgyal po dang / dbyug pa sngon po dang / stobs po che dang / mi g.yo ba rnams ni ming gi rnam grangs can no/ /steng du tsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba dkar po/ dkar po dang sngon po dang ljang khu'i zhal 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /'og tu rdo rje sa 'og gnod mjes kyi ming gi rnam grangs sngon po/ sngon po dang ser po dang ljang khu'i zhal/ gtun shing 'dzin pa'o/ /'di'i phyag g.yon du klu'i zhags pa sdigs 'dzub dang bcas pa'i kha ṭī kha'o/ /rdo rje dbyug pa la 47—1121

sogs pa khro bo 'di dag rnams ni dang po'i phyag mtshan dang thod pas mtshan pa'i phyag gnyis kyis rang dang mtshungs pa'i yum la rnam par sbyor ba/ dbu skra 'bar zhing gyen du badze+es pa/ rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos mdzes par brgyan pa/ smin ma g.yo ba dang khro gnyer dang bcas pa'i brtsigs pa'i zhal re re la spyan dmar la zlum pa gsum gsum mo/ /mi mgo'i phreng ba dang / phyag rgya lnga la sogs pa dang / klu'i rgyal po rnam pa brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad dang / steng du tshangs pa dang 'og du thag ①zangs ris rnams g.yas bskyang zhing g.yon bskum pas mnan nas bzhugs pa/ rang gi rigs bdag gis dbu brgyan pa/'jam pa'i rdo rje ji lta ba bzhin du 'khor lo'i rtsibs bcu la bsgom par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi thugs kyi sa bon ni hūṃ ngo / /ā+oṃ badz+ra dh+rig badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa ces bya ba ni rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi snying po'i sngags so/ /las thams cad pa'i sngags ni ā+oṃ badz+ra kun ḍa li badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa ces bya'o/ /yang na shar la sogs pa'i phyogs dang mtshams dang steng dang 'og du sna tshogs rdo rje dang nyi ma'i gdan rnams la gshin rje gshed la sogs pa g.yas skor gyi khro bo bcu'o/ /'di dag thams cad kyi gnas dang sku mdog la sogs pa mdor byas kyi gzhung du gsungs pa'i rim pa ltar ram/ yang na 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa bzhin no/ /yang na kun tu kha sbyor gyi rdo rje sems dpa'i dal du bshad pa bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /'dir bshad pa'i phyogs gsum la bgegs mthar byed kyi sngags/ ā+oṃ aḥbe+ebyun ta krid hūṃ zhes bya ste las thams cad pa'i sngags so// //47—1122

dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dal la/ rdo rje gur gyi nang du ri rab kyi steng du sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar gzhal yas khang gi dbus su/ bcom ldan 'das sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar gnas pa'i nyi ma'i steng du 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan mo g.yon bskum pa dang g.yas bskyang ba'i zhabs gnyis kyis gnan pa/ sku mdog nag po/ nag po dang ljang khu dang dmar po dang ser po la sogs par shar dang byang la sogs pa'i zhal bzhi'o//zhal re re'ang srun gsum pa/ stag gi lpags pa gyon pa/ phyag bcu gnyis pa/rdo rje dang dril bu dang bcas pa'i phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje phag mo la mkhyud pa/phyag gnyis kyis rgyab du khrag dang bcas pa'i glang po che dkar po'i lngags pa brgyangs nas 'dzin pa'o/ /de ma yin pa'i g.yas pa'i phyag rnams kyis ḍa ma ru dang dgra sta dang gri gug dang rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭī ga dang khrag gis bskang ba'i thod pa dang rdo rje zhags pa dang tshangs pa'i mgo bo rnams so/ /mgul la 'phyang ba'i mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i phreng ba dang ldan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa/ mi'i rgyus pas mchod phyir thogs pa bla ma.a hrū gdams pa'o/ /dpral ba'i steng du thod pa lnga dang nor bu dang g.yon ngos su gnas pa'i zla ba phyed pa dang / sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor tshugs nag po dang ldan pa/ mi sdug pa'i zhal gdangs pa dang mche ba brtsigs pa drag po'o/ /gar gyi nyams dgu'i tshogs dang ldan pa'o/ /rdo rje phag mo ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa spyan gsum pa/ sku mdog dmar ba/skra'i tshogs grol ba'i gcer bu thod pa dum bu'i ske rags bcings pas tshang ra 47—1123

brgyan pa/ mkhyud par byed pa'i phyag gis 'dzag par byed pa'i khrag gi rgyun gtso bo la stob pa/ sdigs 'dzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje steng du phyar bas gdug pa can rnams sdigs par byed pa/ chags pa dang bral ba'i brdar mi mgo skam po'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ nyi ma'i 'od kyi rgyab yol can/ cung zad bzhad pa/phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ zla mtshan 'bab pa dang / ba sru gyen du langs pa'o /de nas shar la sogs pa'i phyogs rnams la g.yon skor gyis dang / me la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams la g.yas skor kyis 'khor lo la sogs pa bskyed pa ni/ de la phyogs kyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma dang / lam dang / khaṇa ḍa ro ha dang /ru pi ni rnams ni nag mo dang / ljang khu dang / dmar mo dang / ser mo rnams so/ /zhal gcig pa spyan gsum pa dbu skra grol ba/ phyag bzhi pa'i g.yon pa gnyis kyis kha ṭī ga dang thod pa bsnams pa/ g.yas pa rnams kyis ḍa ma ru dang gri gug 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yon bskum pa/ g.yas bskyang ba/mtshams kyi 'dab mar byang chub sems dang khrag dang bdud rtsi lnga dang / mar me lngas dngul chu grub pa ltar bdud rtsir gyur pas gang ba'i pad+ma'i snod rnams so//yang na bzhi po yang bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'o/ /de nas thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar kyi rtsibs su thod pa'i dum bu dang rab gtum ma'o/ /byang du keng rus chen po dang / gtum pa'i mig can ma'o/ /nub du keng rus dang 'od ldan ma'o/ /lho ru mche ba rnam par brtsigs pa dang sna chen ma'o/ /me'i mtshams su chang sgra dang / dpa' ba'i blo gros ma'o/ /srin po'i mtshalas su 'od dpag med dang /mi'u thung ma'o/ /rlung gi mtshalas su rdo rje'i 'od dang / lang ka'i dbang phyug ma'o—/ /dbang ldan du rdo rje'i lus dang / shing grib ma'o/ /rim pa de 47—1124

bzhin du gsung gi 'khor lo la/ myu gu can dang / sa srungs ma'o/ /rdo rje ral pa can dang / 'jigs byed chen mo'o/ /dpa' bo ①chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma'o/ /rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang / chang 'thung ma'o/ /rdo rje bzang po dang ljang lha mo'o/ /rdo rje 'od dang shin du bzang mo'o/ /'jigs byed chen po dang / rta rna ma'o/ /mig mi bzang dang / mkha' 'gro'i gdong ma'o/ /de bzhin du sku'i 'khor lo la/ stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/rdo rje rin chen dang / dum skyes ma/ rta mgrin dang / chang 'tshong ma/nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ dpal te ru ka dang / shin tu bzang mo/ pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen mo/ rnam par snang mdzad dang / 'khor lo bsgyur ma/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo'o/ /keng rus thod pa la sogs pa'i dpa' bo rnams rgo zhal gcig pa spyan gsum pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can dpral bar gnas pa'i rdo rje phreng bas mtshan pa'o/ /dang po ni thod pa can phyag bzhi pa/ mkhyud par byed pa'i phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu/ g.yon ngos su kha ṭaṃ ga dang tshangs pa'i skud pa dang dpung rgyan dang ldan pa/ mche ba brtsigs pa'i zhal/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ g.yon bskum zhing g.yas bskyang bas gnas pa'o/ /rab tu gtum mo la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams ni zhal gcig pa spyan gsum pa/ 'jigs su rung ba'i gzugs can ma/ dbu skra grol ba/ gcer bu/ phyag gnyis pa/mkhyud par byed pa'i phyag gis thod pa 'dzin pa/ g.yas gdug pa can sdigs par byed pa'i gri gug 'dzin pa/ g.yon bskum zhing g.yas brkyang bas gnas pa'o—/ /sgo rnams la bya rog gdong ma dang / 'ug gdong ma dang / khyi 47—1125

gdong ma dang / phag gdong ma rnams ni mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa bzhi'o①/ /khyad par du 'di rnams kyi zhal ni ming gi rjes su 'brang ba'o/ /zur rnams su gshin rje sreg ma dang / gshin rje pho nya mo dang / gshin rje mche ba ma dang /gshin rje 'joms ma rnams ni mi'i zhal lo/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi phyogs ni lha mo gnyis ni g.yas dang g.yon kyi sku phyed phyed dang ldan pa 'di brgyad kyang gos dang ldan pa'o/ /mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa thams cad mi mgo'i phreng bas brgyan pa/rdo rje'i phreng bas dpral bar brgyan pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa can/ sgra sgrogs pa'i g.yer kha la sogs pas mtshan pa'i ske rags kyis brgyan pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi rigs kyi bdag po mi bskyod pa dang / rdo rje phag mo'i rnam par snang mdzad dang / mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa'i rin chen 'byung ldan/ thugs dang gsung dang sku'i 'khor lo rnams la mi bskyod pa dang / snang ba mtha' yas dang /rnam par snang mdzad do/ /dam tshig gi 'khor lo la gnas pa rnams kyi don yod grub pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis sdethugs kyi sa bon hūṃ/ ā+oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kai hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ḍa ki ni dz+wa la saṃ bha ra swā hā/ snying po'i sngags so/ /ā+oṃ khan+d+ra ④ro te hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes bya ba ni khaṃ rjoḍa ro te las thams cad pa'i sngags so/ /lha gzhan rnams kyi sngags ni bdag gis dpal bde mchog gi mngon par rtogs pa'i bsgrub thabs las bshad do// //yang na dal gyi dbang phyug la sogs pa nas gshin rje 'joms ma'i bar du thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'o/ /de la dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa lnga ni g.yas g.yon gyi phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la mkhyud pa'o/ /47—1126

mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa rnam pa bzhi dang khwa gdong ma la sogs pa rnams ni g.yon pas thod pa dang mchan khung na chags pa'i kha ṭī ga 'dzin pa g.yas pas ḍa ma ru 'dzin pa/ gzhan thams cad ni gong bzhin no// //yang na 'dir khyadapara'akhor lo'i dbang phyug la sogs pa phyag gnyis pa'i phyogs la/ dpal bde mchog dang rdo rje phag mo gnyis ni gser gyi mdog lta bu'am—/ yang na lugs gcig la dal gyi lha thams cad sngon po ste/ bcom ldan 'das ni phyag g.yas pa rdo rje gsor ba gyen du 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas thod pa dang kha ṭī ga 'dzin pa'am/ yang na rdo rje dang dril bu'i phyag gnyis kyis mkhyud par byed pa'i tshal gyis dal thams cad ser po gnas pa'o/ /mkha' 'go ma la sogs pa bzhi ni ser po g.yas pas ḍa ma ru 'dzin pa/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i dpa' bo rnams ni nag po/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dpa' mo rnams ni dkar mo/ phyag g.yas na rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdogs 'dzub 'dzin pa'o/ /gsung gi 'khor lo'i dpa' bo rnams ni dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams ni nag mo phyag g.yas pad+ma dang bcas pa'i sdigs 'dzub mdzad pa'o/ /sku'i 'khor lo'i dpa' bo rnams ni dkar po/ 'khor lo dang / rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /lha mo rnams rgo dmar mo g.yas pas sdigs 'dzub dang bcas pas 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /dpa' bo thams cad ni chags pa'i tshul gyis yum la mkhyud pas g.yon bskum g.yas bskyang bas gnas pa/ dpa' mo rnams ni de'i brla' gnyis la dkris pa'i tshul lo/ /khwa gdong ma la sogs pa rnams ni g.yas pas sdigs 'dzub dang bcas pa'i gri gug 'dzin pa'o/ /lha mo thams 47—1127

cad g.yon pas thod pa 'dzin pa/ gshin rje sreg ma la sogs pa ni g.yas pa ḍa ma ru/ g.yon pa sdigs 'dzub dang bcas pa'i mi mgo brlon pa 'dzin pa'o/ /mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa rnams dang khā gdong ma la sogs pa rnams kyis g.yon pa'i mchan khung na kha ṭaṃ ga 'dzin pa'o/ /bcu gnyis po 'di rnams ni skyid krung phyed pa'i gar gyi tshul gyis gnas pa/ gzhan gyi khyad par ni gong bzhin no/ /bde mchog gi dal rnam pa gsum mo// //gang gi tshe dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa lnga mi bsgom na de'i tshe rdo rje phag mo'i dal du 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe rdo rje phag mo'i dal gsum ni mngon par rtogs pa'i snye ma las shes par bya'o—/ /rdo rje phag mo'i sa bon baṃ ngo / /ā+oṃ badz+ra tre+e ro tsa na ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/zhes bya ba ni snying po'o/ /de rnams ni phyag gnyis pa'i bde mchog gi lha'o/ /phyag g.yas na gnas pa rnams kyi mtshan ma ni bri ba'i dal las shes par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas thod pa'i dal lha nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'i bdag nyid can la rdo rje gur dang chos 'byung gi nang du gnas pa'i pho brang gi dbus su 'khor lo nag po rtsibs brgyad pa dang sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad kyi ze'u 'bru la steng du ro gan rkyal gyi snying khar nyi ma'i dal la bcom ldan 'das he ru ka sku mdog nag po skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa spyan gsum dmar ba/ g.yas kyi phyag gnyis na gri gug dang ḍa ma ru/ g.yon gyi phyag gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭī ga 'dzin pa'o/ /phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa/mi mgo lnga bcu'i phreng ba'i tshogs 'gul la 'phyang ba/ stag gi lngags pa grol bas sku ①/ smad la brgyan pa'o/ /sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i 47—1128

ral pa'i thor tshugs nag po dang / dpral ba'i steng du thod pa lngas brgyan pa/sangs rgyas lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ gtso bo 'di'i yum yid 'ong ma ri mo bde ma mi mgo'i phreng ba can/ dbu skra grol zhing gyen du 'bar ba/ thod pa lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ mche ba cung zad brtsigs pa/ sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yas pa yab kyi mgrin pa la gri gug dang bcas pa'i chags pa'i phyag gis mkhyud pa/ g.yon gyis thod pa khrag gi rgyun 'dzag pa yab la stob pa/ shar gyi rtsibs la steng gi 'dab ma la legs pa'i phreng ba can ma'o/ /byang du thod pa can ma'o/ /nub du sdigs ma'o/ /lho ru gzhan gyis mi thub ma'o/ /de nas dbang ldan la sogs pa'i 'dab ma rnams la g.yas skor gyis byang sems dkar po dang dmar po dang bdud rtsi lnga dang mar me lngas gang ba'i thod pa rnams so/ /rim pa dang po ni rdo rje sngon po'i phreng bas bskor ba'o/ /de nas rim pa gnyis pa la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dmar po la gnas pa'i pad+ma dmar po brgyad kyis phyi rol rdo rje dmar po'i phreng bas bskor ba'o—/ /de'i shar gyi rtsibs la dge ba'i ske rags ma'o/ /byang du ni gzugs can ma'o/ /nub du ni rnam par rgyal ma'o/ /lho ru ni 'od byed ma'o/ /dbang ldan du ni nag mo'o/ /me'i mtshams su rgya mtsho chen mo'o/ /srin po'i mtshalas su 'phrog byed ma'o/ /rlung gi mtshams su gsod ma'o/ /de nas rim pa gsum pa la ni 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad la gnas pa'i pad+ma dkar po rdo rje dkar po'i phreng bas bskor ba'o/ /de'i shar du ni sgol ma'o/ /byang du ni 'jigs ston ma'o/ /nub du ni legs mthong ma'o/ /lho ru ni mi 'pham ma'o /dbang ldan du ni dge ma'o/ /me'i mtshams su o tar ka'o/ /srin po'i 47—1129

mtshams su dus mtshan ma'o/ /rlung gi mtshalas su gshin rje chen mo'o/ /shar sgo'i pad+ma la ni mdzes ma'o/ /byang sgo'i pad+ma la ni sa'i lha mo'o/ /nub sgo'i pad+ma la ni skal bzangs ma'o/ /lho'i sgo'i pad+ma la ni yid 'ong ma'o byams mthong ma zer rdo rje phreng ba dang mtshan bstun pa gal che/ /'di dag thams cad g.yas dang g.yon gyi phyag gis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ so cung zad phyar ba/ zhal gcig pa/spyan gsum pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /mi mgo'i phreng ba ljang khu dbu skra dmar po gyen du badze+es pa/ byang sems 'dzag pa nyi ma'i gdan la skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyi tshul gyis gnas pa'o/ /sgo skyong ma rnams ni zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon bskyang ba ste/ 'di rnams thams cad ni stag gi lpags pa bsnams pa—/ sku mdog sngon po/ yang na 'di rnams la phreng ma can ma la sogs pa bzhi nag mo'o/ /rim pa gnyis pa la gnas pa rnams ser mo'o rim pa gsum pa la gnas pa rnams ljang khu'o/ /sgo'i lha mo rnams ni nag mo'o/ /bcom ldan 'das la ni mi bskyod pa la sogs pa de ba lngas rgyas btab pa'o/ /ri mo bde ma ni rnam par snang mdzad kyis so/ /phreng ba can ma la sogs pa bzhi ni rin 'byung gis so/ /rim pa gnyis pa la gnas pa rnams ni snang ba ①mtha' yas kyis so—/ /rim pa gsum pa la gnas pa rnams ni rnam par snang mdzad kyis so/ /sgo'i lha mo rnams ni don yod grub pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kyi sa bon ni hūṃ ngo / /ā+oṃ bhud dhā ka pā li nī aḥhriḥte hūṃ phaṭa/ snying po'o/ /'di nyid kho na dal 'di'i las thams cad pa'i sngags dang snying po'i sngags gcig pas so// //dpal rnal 'byor nam mkha'i dal la rdo rje gur gyi nang du me dang chu dang 47—1130

sa'i dal gyi steng du rgya mtsho chen po la sogs pas yongs su bskor ba'i ri rab kyi steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang rdo rje rgya khaṃ gyi lte ba la gnas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang gi rim pa'i lte bar/ seṅge'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la sems dpa'i dkyil dkrung gis bzhugs pa/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rnal 'byor nam mkha' nag po rtsa ba dang g.yas g.yon gyi zhal nag po dang dkar po dang nag po'o / /zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum pa/ phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa/dpral bar gnas pa'i thod pa'i phreng ba lnga dang / nor bu dang zla ba phyed pa dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang ldan pa'i ral pa nag po'i thor cog can/ de ba lnga spro ba dang bsdu ba'i cod pan can/ sku smad la stag gi lpags pa'i gos grol zhing 'phyang ba/ phyag drug pa phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams pas shes rab kyi mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo'am nag mo la mkhyud pa/ g.yas pa gnyis kyis nu ma dang mda'/ g.yon pa gnyis kyis pad+ma'i snod dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /de nas shar gyi gnas la glang po che'i rgyal po la rol pa'i tshul gyis gnas pa'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo/ byang du rma bya'i gdan la dkyil dkrung phyed pa'i gnas pa'i 'jigs byed mkha' 'gro ma ser mo sbrul kyis brgyan pa dang / nub du sbrul gyi gdan la tsog pur gnas pa'i ro langs ma dmar mo/ lho ru las byed ma king ka ra'i gdan la skyil dkrung phyed pas gnas pa'i gtum mo sngon mo/dbu skra dmar po bkram zhing spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /'dir ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa lnga ni g.yas dang g.yon gyi phyag gis thod pa dang kha ṭī ga 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa ni glang po che la sogs pa'i steng na pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i glang po che'i lpags pa'i smad g.yogs dang mi'i 47—1131

lpags pa stod du gyon pa'o/ /dbang ldan du seng ge la rol pa'i tshul du gnas pa'i seng ge ma dkar ser/ phyag gnyis pa'i g.yas steng du phyar bas kha ṭaṃ ga 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas sdigs 'dzub dang bcas pa'i thod pa 'dzin pas bzhugs pa'o/ /me'i mtshams su gnod sbyin rdo rje gdong gi gdan la zlum po'i tshul gyis gnas pa'i stag mo dkar mo/ phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas dang g.yon pa lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /srin po'i mtshams su ma te la dkyil dkrung phyed kyis bzhugs pa'i spyang mo spyang khu'i zhal ma dmar nag phyag gnyis pa dgra sta dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung gi mtshams su 'ug pa'i gdong can ma 'ug pa ma tsog pur gnas dmar ser phyag gnyis pa dbyug pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /'di rnams ni rang rang gi chibs la pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng na gnas pa'o/ /shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i rgyab du mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo phyag gnyis kyi rtse mo khar bcug pa'o/ /byang du sdigs byed mkha' 'gro ma'i rgyab du mar me ma ser mo spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba dang bcas pa'i mar me 'dzin pa'o/ /nub du ro langs ma'i rgyab du 'dzin ma dmar mo snyim pa khrag gis bskang ba khar bcug pa'o/ /lhor gtum mo'i rgyab du ka po dzi nag mo phyag gnyis kyis thugs khar gtun shing 'phyar ba'o—/ /bzhi po 'di dag pad+ma dang nyi ma dang ro'i gdan la gnas pa'o/ /de nas rdo rje phreng ba 'od zer gyi phreng ba'i phyi rol gyi rim pa la bskor ba la pad+ma dang zla ba rnams la/ shar phyogs su pu ka se dang dra bi li dang / gtum mo rnams phyag gnyis ma bdud rtsi'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du 'jigs byed ma dang /khrag mdog mo dang / sa ga ma rnams me lngas gang ba'i pad+ma'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /nub du drag shul ma dang / 'bar ba ma dang / mi sdug pa'i gzugs can ma 47—1132

rnams gtor ma'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor thod pa ma dang / rdo rje ma dang /bum pa ma rnams btung ba'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du sgeg mo/ sgeg pa'i tshul gyis gar byed pa dang ①/ dri ma dri'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /me'i mtshalas su pi wang ma pi wang bgreng ba dang / me tog ma me tog gi phreng ba steng du 'thor ba'o/ /srin po'i mtshams su glu ma kha'i thad khar sdigs 'dzub g.yo ba dang / bdug spos ma bdug spos dang bcas pa'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung gi mtshams su gar ma dkar mo gar kyi tshul gyis steng du thal mo sbyar ba dang /mar me ma mar me'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa sum cu rtsa gsum po 'di dag thams cad kyang zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis pa/spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra grol ba/ dbu la mi mgo lnga'i phreng ba can no/ /khyad par du 'jigs byed kyi mkha' 'gro ma ni dbu skra gyen du bsdes pa/ seng ge mo la sogs pa gos dmar po gyon pa/ pu ka si la sogs pa rnams ni dkar mo sterka/ me'i mtshams kyi lha mo rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /'jigs byed kyi mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa ni ser mo ste/ dbang ldan gyi lha mo gnyis kyang de bzhin no/ /drag shul ma la sogs pa rnams ni dmar mo ste/ rlung gi mtshams kyi lha mo rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /thod pa ma la sogs pa rnams ni nag mo ste/srin po'i mtshams kyi lha mo rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /de nas rdo rje phreng ba'i phyi'i rim pa'i sgo rnams dang snam bu'i mtshams la mtsho skyes dang zla ba'i gdan rnams la ni/ shar sgor khyab 'jug nag po dang / byang du tshangs pa ser po dang / nub du dbang phyug chen po dkar po dang / lho ru gdong drug dmar po dang / dbang ldan gyi mtshalas su dbang po ser po dang / me'i mtshams su 47—1133

lus ngan po ser po dang / srin po'i mtshams su gshin rje nag po dang /rlung gi mtshams su chu lha dkar po'o/ /shar gyi snam bu la shar du ka ka ra'i 'jigs byed dang / kha ṭaṃ ga'i srin po dang / tshogs kyi dbang phyug dang /dril bu'i rnam pa can rnams dkar po'o/ /byang du gtum mo'i dbang phyug dang mdun pa'i lha dang / rigs kyi dbang phyug dang smra ba'i 'jigs byed rnams ser po'o/ /nub du 'dod pa drag po dang / gtum mo'i dbang phyug dang /ḍa ma ru'i 'dul byed dang / rnga sgras 'jigs byed rnams dmar po'o/ /lhor gtum bu ri'i dbang phyug dang / tho ra na tha dang / mche ba brtsigs pa dang /gzhu 'dzin ma rnams nag po dang / nyi shu rtsa bzhi po 'di rnams ni/ khyab 'jug la sogs pa zhal gcig pa phyag bzhi pa spyan gsum pa/ g.yas pa'i phyag gnyis kyis kha ṭaṃ kha dang tri shul 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa gnyis thod pa dang bcas pa ste lha mo la mkhyud pa/ ral pa nag po'i thor tshugs can/ thod pa lnga'i phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i na bza' dang ldan pa'o/ /'di dag gi lha mo rnams kyang g.yas pa na kha ṭī ga dang /g.yon pa na thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /'dir dpal rnal 'byor nam mkha' la ni mi bskyod pa la sogs pa de ba lngas rgyas btab pa/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ba la ni mi bskyod pa'am rnam par snang mdzad kyis rgyas btab pa'o/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa bzhi ni rnam par snang mdzad dang rin chen 'byung ldan dang snang ba mtha' yas dang don yod grub pa rnams kyis so/ /seng ge ma la sogs pa bzhi ni mi bskyod pa dang rnam par snang mdzad dang rin chen dbang phyug dang snang ba mtha' yas rnams kyis so/ /tshangs pa la rnam par snang mdzad kyis so/ /47—1134

dbang phyug chen po la snang ba mtha' yas kyis so/ /gzhan lha dkar po rnams kyi ni rnam par snang mdzad kyis so/ /ser po rnams ni rin chen 'byung ldan gyis so//dmar po rnams ni snang ba mtha' yas kyis so/ /nag po rnams ni mi bskyod pa'o//dal dbang phyug gi thugs kha'i sa bon ni hūṃ ngo / /ā+oṃ hūṃ hāḥswā hā/ zhes bya ba ni snying po'i sngags so/ /ā+oṃ ghu gha swā hā/ ro langs ma'i las thams cad byed pa'i sngags so/ /zhes rim pa gsum ldan gyi dkyil 'khor ro// //bcom kaldan kha'adas gshin rje gshed kyi dal du/ rdo rje gur gyi dbus su chos 'byung gi lte bar gnas pa'i/ yang gakha gcig la dbus kyi dal gzhal yas khang gi rim pa la/ mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa bzhi po rnams sgo rnams la bskyed pa'i tshul kyang bshad do/ /kha cig ni rim pa gnyis pa yang gzhal yas khang gi dbyibs lta bu zer ro/ /de nyid kyang zlum por byed pa'i lugs kyang shes par bya'o—/ /gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sna tshogs mtsho skyes dang nyi ma'i steng du gnas pa'i ma te nag po khros pa rus brgyan gyis brgyan pa'i rgyab du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i gshin rje'i steng du gshin rje gshed nag po g.yon bskyang g.yas bskum pa/ rma ra dmar skya/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du badze+es pa/rdo rje'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ thung zhing sbom pa gsus pa 'phyang ba/ mi mgo'i phreng ba 'gul du 'chang ba/ ljags 'dril ba/ 'bar ba'i mche ba brtsigs pa/rtsa ba dang g.yas g.yon gyi zhal nag po dang dkar po dang dmar ba'o/ /phyag drug pa'i gri gug dang thod pas mchod par byas pa'i g.yas dang gcig shos kyi phyag gnyis kyis bdag dang mtshungs pa'i shes rab ma la mkhyud pa/ gzhan 47—1135

g.yas pa gnyis na rdo rje dang ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa gnyis na 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ mtha' yas la sogs pa'i klus brgyan pa ni lo ga gsum las rnam par rgyal ba bzhin du'o/ /'di'i shar du gti mug gshin rje gshed dkar po ste/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang g.yas dang gcig shos kyi zhal dkar po dang nag po dang dmar po'o/ /phyag g.yas pa gnyis na 'khor lo dang ral gri/g.yon gyi phyag gnyis na rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /lho phyogs su phra ma gshin rje rin chen 'byung ldan gser gyi mdog lta bu zhal gsum pa/ ser po dang sngon po dang dkar po'o/ /g.yas kyi phyag gnyis na rin po che dang ral gri/ g.yon pa gnyis na 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /nub du 'dod chags gshin rje gshed snangab mtha' yas dmar po ste/ zhal gsum pa/ dmar po dang nag po dang dkar po'oske/ /g.yas kyi phyag gnyis na pad+ma dang ral gri/ g.yon gyi phyag gnyis na nor bu dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du phrag dog gshin rje gshed ljang khu ste/zhal gsum pa ljang khu dang nag po dang dkar po'o/ /g.yas kyi phyag gnyis na ral gri dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis na nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /'khro bo bzhi po 'di dag ni dal gyi bdag po'i mtshan nyid can/ phyag g.yas g.yon gyi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas bdag nyid lta bu'i yid du 'ong ba la mkhyud pa'o/ /me'i mtshams su rdo rje tsar tsi ka skem mo gzugs dang phyag mtshan rnams ni gti mug gshin rje gshed lta bu'o/ /bden bral gyi mtshalas su rdo rje phag mo/ phag mo'i zhal/ zhe sdang gshin rje gshed lta bu'o/ /rlung gi mtshams su rdo rje dbyangs can ma 'dod chags gshin rje gshed lta bu'o/ /dbang ldan gyi mtshams su gho ri ma phrag dog gshin rje gshed lta bu'o/ /'dir 47—1136

rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa ni rdo rje rgya gram gyi rtsibs kyi rtsa rnams la'o/ /rdo rje ra'i mtshams bzhi rdo rje tsar tsi ka la sogs pa bzhi ni bdag nyid lta bu'i thabs la mkhyud pa'o/ /shar sgor tho ba gshin rje gshed nag po zhal gsum pa ste/nag po dang dkar po dang dmar po'o/ /g.yas kyi phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje tho ba dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa gnyis kyis nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /lho'i sgor dbyug tho gshin rje gshed dkar po dkar po dang sngon po dang dmar po'o—/ /zhal gsum pa/ g.yas pa gnyis dbyug pa dang ral gri/ g.yon pa gnyis pad+ma dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /nub sgor pad+ma gshin rje gshed 'dod chags gshin rje gshed lta bu'o/ /byang sgor ral gri gshin rje gshed phrag dog gshin rje gshed lta bu'o/ /khyad par cung zad sngo ba shas che ba'o/ /thams cad ni klu ma rungs pas brgyan pas 'jigs par byed pa/ dgyes pa'i gad mo can—/ dbu skra dmar po gyen la badze+es shing / mche ba brtsigs pa'i zhal can/phyag gi gtso bo gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas bdag dang mtshungs pa'i shes rab la mkhyud pa'o/ /'dir ni rnam par snang mdzad dang lha mo rnams ni sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'o/ /lha gzhan rnams ni sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'o/ /dal gyi me la sogs pa'i mtshams bzhi la sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i thod pa bzhi ni byang chub kyi sems dkar po dang khrag dang bdud rtsi lnga dang mar mes bkang ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bdag po ni gshin rje gshed nyid do/ /rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa bzhi yang de bzhin no/ /de rnams ni go rims ji lta bar tsar tsi ka la sogs pa bzhi dang / tho ba gshin rje gshed la sogs pa 'di rnams la'ang shes par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi 47—1137

byed———thugs kyi sa bon ni yo ngo / /ā+oṃ hriḥspyaḥbi kri ta na na hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes bya ba ni snying po'i sngags dang las thams cad pa'i sngags so/ /dal 'di la thig bzhi btab pas le tshe dgur 'dod pa yang yod/ rdo rje'i ra'i rtsa bar 'dod pa yang yod/ gru bzhi phyogs mtshams su 'dod pa yang yod/ lha snam rkyang par 'dod pa yang yod/ thams cad yab yum du 'dod pa yang yod/ de yang yab gti mug rdo rje'i sar yum tsar mika byung na yab kyis yum la 'ag/ yum gyi sar yab byung nas yum gyi yab la 'ag pa'o/ /rdo rje sgol ma'i dal bla ma a bya ka ra'i bzhed pa yin la/ rdo rje gur gyi nang du chos 'byung gi dbus su gzhal yas khang gi lte ba la/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba la bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje sgrol ma gser btso ma lta bu/ sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan can/ zhal bzhi pa rtsa ba'i zhal dang / g.yas dang / nub dang /byang rnams gser gyi mdog dang dkar po dang sngon po dang dmar po'o/ /phyag brgyad kyi g.yas rnams kyis rdo rje dang zhags pa dang mda' dang dung 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis ut+pal ser po dang gzhu dang lcags kyu dang sdigs 'dzub mdzad pa'o/ /shar gyi 'dab mar me tog ma dkar mo phyag gnyis kyis me tog gi phreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor spos kyi sgol ma nag mo phyag gnyis kyis bdug spos 'dzin pa/ nub du mar me'i sgol ma ser mo mar me yu ba dang bcas pa phyag gnyis kyis 'dzin pa/ byang du dri'i sgrol ma ljang ser phyag gnyis kyis dri chab kyi dung 'degs pa'o/ /lha mo bzhi po 'di dag ni zla ba la gnas pa'o/ /me la sogs pa'i 'dab ma rnams la rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i mdog lta bu'i 'khor lo dang rdo rje dang pad+ma dang ral gri'o/ /rim pa gnyis pa'i shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu ma dkar mo g.yas pa na lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lhor rdo rje zhags pa 47—1138

ma ser mo phyag g.yas kyis zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /nub du rdo rje lcags sgrog ma dmar mo phyag g.yas na lcags sgrog gis mtshan pa'o/ /byang du rdo rje dril bu ma ljang khu phyag g.yas pa rdo rje dril bus mtshan pa'o/ /me la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams su ni sna tshogs pad+ma rnams la spyan ma la sogs pa'i rnam par dag pas byang chub sems kyi bum pa dang / ri rab dang / me thab dang / rgyal mtshan chen po'o/ /steng du gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma dkar mo ni phyag g.yas 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /'og tu gnod mdzes ma sngon mo ni phyag g.yas pas klu'i zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /lha mo drug po 'di rnams kyi phyag g.yon pa ni sdigs 'dzub dang bcas pa'i khu tshur snying khar bzung ba/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi mar gnas pa'o//bcu po 'di dag kyang zhal gcig ma phyag gnyis ma rdo rje'i dkyil dkrungs kyis bzhugs pa/ gser gyi rna cha la sogs pas brgyan pa/ gos sna tshogs dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ pad+ma ra ga'i 'od dang ldan pa'o/ /rdo rje sgrol ma'i rigs kyi bdag po ni rin chen 'byung ldan no/ /me tog sgrol ma la sogs pa rnams kyi rnam par snang mdzad dang / mi bskyod pa dang / snang ba mtha' yas dang / don yod grub pa rnams so/ /rdo rje lcags kyu ma la sogs pa rnams kyang de bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /gtsug tor rgyal ma'i rin chen 'byung ldan no/ /gnod mdzes ma'i ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs kha'i sa bon ni tai ngo / /ā+oṃ tā re tud tā re tu re swā hā sgrol ma sdug bsngal las r+ṣa ma bkra shis ma ga hā/ zhes bya ba ni snying po'i sngags dang las thams cad pa'i yang sngags so// //47—1139

'phags ma 'od zer can gyi dal la rdo rje gur gyi nang chos 'byung gi dkyil du gzhal yas khang ngo / /'di la chos 'byung med par ri rab kyi steng du bsgom pa'i tshul yang yod do/ /gzhal yas khang gi lte bar mchod rten gyi nang du sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i zla ba'am nyi ma la g.yas bskum g.yon bskyang bas gnas pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma 'od zer can ma ser mo rin po che sna tshogs kyi1 cod pan dang / maichod rten gyis brgyan pa dang / skra rnams lam̐ rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ zhal gsum pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal ser po/ g.yas pa'i zhal dkar po/ g.yon pa phag pa'i zhal nag po/ khros pa/ khro gnyer gyi mig zur gyis mtshan pa/ ljags 'gul ba/ 'jigs par byed pa phyag drug ma/ g.yas pa rnams kyis mda' dang rdo rje dang khab 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis gzhu dang skud pa dang mya ngan med pa'i shing me tog dang bcas pa 'dzin pa'o/ /gos sngon po gyon pa/ stod g.yogs sngon po can/gser gyi mdog lta bu phag pa'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /gser lta bu'i nag thub nag po phag pas bskor ba/ mya ngan med pa'i me tog gi phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa'o—/ /shar phyogs su nyi ma nag mo akam si zhes bya ba me tog ban du ka'i mdog lta bu/ g.yas g.yon gyi phyag gis khab dang skud pa 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor mar ka ma si ljanganag ma zhes bya ba'i lha mo gser gyi mdog can/ g.yas pas skud pa dang bcas pa'i khab dang / g.yon pas mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga 'dzin pa'o/ /nub du nagathub nag mo an dhar ta na ma si ser mo ni g.yas pa mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa sdigs 'dzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du te tso ma si gzibajid nag mo zhes bya ba sku mdog 47—1140

dmar mo phyag gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /me'i mtshalas la sogs par shar ba'i nag mo dang gul ma ma si nags ྾ nag mo dang / bha na ma si dang ྾/tsi ba ra ma se gosarnams rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du ma ra ①si la sogs pa'i mdog dang phyag mtshan bzhin no/ /rim pa gnyis pa'i snam bu la shar du gos chen nag mo dang / phag mo'i zhal ma nag mo ni mche ba brtsigs pa mi sdug pa 'jigs pa/g.yas pa rdo rje lcags kyu dang / g.yon pa rdo rje zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /lho ru rkang pas gnon pa nag mo dang mchog 'phreng ma pad+ma ka mo kra ma si ba ra li la sogs pa mya ngan med pa'i yal ga dang / g.yon pas rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /nub du pha rol gnon ma parakra ma si nag mo dang tshig gi phreng ba bhadalidamar mo ni g.yas dang gcig shos kyis mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du nyi ma nag mo sur+yam si dang/ bā rā li mchog phreng ma ljang khu ni g.yas dang g.yon gyis khab dang skud pa 'dzin pa'o/ /me'i mtshams su bha ta li zhes bya ba g.yas g.yon kyi phyag gnyis kyi khab dang skud pa 'dzin pa'o/ /bden bral gyi mtshalas su tshig phreng ma bhadaliser mo ni g.yas pa na skud pa dang bcas pa'i khab dang / g.yon pas mya ngan med pa'i yal ka me tog dang bcas pa 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung gi mtshams su mchog 'phreng ma bha ralisku mdog dkar mo g.yas dang g.yon pa gnyis kyis mya ngan med pa'i yal ga dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du phag zhal ma dmar mo phyag gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgor a lo ta lo dang / kā lo dang / pa ta tsha lo dang / saṃ bha mur dha ḍo rnams ni rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du dkar po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / ljang khu'i mdog rnams kyis phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje lcags kyu dang zhags pa dang lcags sgrog dang dril bu 47—1141

'dzin pa'o/ /arga ma si la sogs pa'i lha mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi po 'di dag ni sngon du shar ba'i tshod la bab pa/ mchod rten gyis dbu rgyan byas pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ khyad par du gyur pa'i gos sngon po dang / khyad par gyur pa'i stod g.yogs sngon po dang / zhal gcig pa dang / srun gsum pa dang / phyag gnyis pa dang / gser kyi mdog lta bu'i phag la chibs nas gser mdog lta bu'i phag gi 'khor gyis bskor ba'o/ /sgo skyong ma rnams ni sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la g.yon bskum g.yas bskyang bas gnas so/ /gzhan nyi shu ni sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la g.yas bskum g.yon bskyang bas gnas so/ /'phags ma 'od zer can ma'i rigs kyi bdag po ni brtag pa'o/ /shar phyogs las la sogs pa na gnas pa rnams ni mi bskyod pa dang rin chen 'byung ldan dang snang ba mtha' yas dang don yod grub pa rnams so/ /me la sogs pa'i phyogs bral ma rnams la yang de bzhin du'o zhes pa yang gsungs so/ /yang dkar mo rnams la rnam par snang mdzad/ nag mo rnams la mi bskyod pa/ ser mo rnams la rin 'byung / dmar po rnams la snang ba mtha' yas/ ljang khu rnams don yod grub pa'o zhes gsungs pa yang yod do/ /'od zer can ma'i thugs kha'i snying po'i sa bon ni rma mo/ /ā+oṃ mā rī tsā swā hā zhes bya ba ni snying po'i sngags so/ /ā+oṃ mā rī rtswa hūṃ sarba bighān u pa ḍā ya hūṃ phaṭa swā hā zhes pa 'di ni las thams cad pa'i sngags so// //gzungs gral lnga'i dal du rdo rje gur gyi nang du ri rab kyi steng du gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar gnas pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla 47—1142

ba la bcom ldan 'das so sor 'brang ma chen mo ser mo 'od zer dmar po'i rgyab yol can/ zhal bzhi pa/ dang po'i zhal ser po/ g.yas dkar po/ nub du ser po/ g.yon pa dmar po/ phyag bcu gnyis pa'i g.yas pa rnams kyis rin po che 'bar ba dang 'khor lo dang rdo rje dang mda' dang ral gri dang mchod sbyin gyi phyag rgya'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang zhags pa dang rtse gsum dang gzhu dang dgra sta dang dung rnams 'dzin pa/ dbu la mchod rten gyis brgyan pa/rdo rje skyil dkrungs can ma'o/ /de'i shar phyogs su stong chen mo rab tu 'joms ma sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sku mdog dkar mo zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ zhal bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar po/ de'i g.yas kyang dkar/ rgyab ser po/ g.yon ljang khu/ phyag bcu'i g.yas pa rnams kyis pad+mar gnas pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa dang / mchod sbyin dang lcags kyu dang mda' dang ral gri rnams so/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang sdigs mdzub dang zhags pa dang gzhu dang dgra sta rnams so/ /lho'i phyogs su sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi mar gnas pa'i gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma sku mdog nag mo nyi ma'i rgyab yol can/ rdo rje dkyil dkrungs su bzhugs pa/ rtsa ba dang g.yas dang g.yon pa'i zhal nag mo dang / dkar mo dang dmar mo'i zhal/phyag bcu gnyis pa/ g.yas dang g.yon pa'i phyag gi rtso bo gnyis kyis chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya 'dzin pa/ gzhan pa gnyis kyis ting nge 'dzin bsam gtan gyi phyag rgya'o/ /g.yas gzhan rnams kyis rdo rje dang mda' dang mchod sbyin dang mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs 'dzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang gzhu dang rin po che 'bar ba dang pad+mas mtshan pa'i bum pa 'dzin 47—1143

pa'o—/ /nub tu sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la bsil ba'i tshal chen mo dmar mo skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ nyi ma'i rgyab yol can/ rtsa ba dang g.yas dang g.yon pa'i zhal dmar po dang dkar po nag po'o/ /phyag brgyad pa'i g.yas pa rnams kyis pad+ma dang bcas pa'i mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang / mda' dang rdo rje dang ral gri'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs 'dzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang gzhu dang rin po che'i rgyal mtshan dang po ṭi snying khar gnas pa'i tshul du 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la rma bya chen mo ljang khu zla ba'i rgyab yol can sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rtsa ba dang g.yas g.yon gyi zhal ljang khu dang nag mo dang dkar mo'o/ /phyag brgyad ma g.yas pa rnams kyis rma bya'i mjug sgo dang mda' dang mchog sbyin dang ral gri'o// //g.yon pa rnams kyis lhung bzed la gnas pa'i dge slong dang gzhu dang /snying khar gnas pa'i rin po che 'bar ba char 'be+ebs pa'i bum pa dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang / rin po che'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /rim pa gnyis pa la me'i mtshams su dus mtshan sku mdog nag mo lag pa gnyis kyis dung 'dzin pa'o/ /bden bral du dus mtshan ma ser mo phyag gnyis kyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung gi mtshams su rna ba nag mo nag mo rna mdog zer dmar mo phyag gnyis kyis dgra sta 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan kyi mtshalas su dkar mo sku mdog dkar mo phyag gnyis kyis tri shul 'dzin pa'o/ /bzhi po 'di rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'o/ /dgu po 'di rnams ni rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyan dang gos dang rin po che'i cod pan dang / zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum pa/rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du rin chen 'byung ldan dang / rnam par snang mdzad dang /47—1144

mi bskyod pa dang / snang ba mtha' yas dang / don yod grub pa dang /mi bskyod pa dang / rin chen 'byung ldan dang / snang ba mtha' yas dang /rnam par snang mdzad kyis rgyas btab pa'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgor sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la rdo rje lcags kyu ma dang / rdo rje zhags pa ma dang / rdo rje lcags sgrog ma dang / rdo rje dril bu ma rnams gong bzhin du'o/ /so sor 'brang ma la sogs pa rnams kyi sa bon pre mo/ /ā+oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ra ṇi ma hā pra ti swa re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā zhes pa ni snying po'o/ /stong chen mo'i sa bon ni bye/ ā+oṃ aḥm hā sā hā pra mar dha ni hūṃ bye snying po'o/ /gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin pa'i sa bon ni hūṃ/ ā+oṃ ā ma hā man tra a nu pā ri ṇi hūṃ hūṃ/snying po'o/ /bsil ba'i tshal ma'i sa bon ni dzi/ ā+oṃ aḥm hā shri ta ba ti dzi hūṃ/snying po'o/ /rma bya chen mo'i sa bon ni rma/ s+t+waṃ ma hā ma yu rī bit+yā rā rnyi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ snying po'o/ /gzhan 'di rnams kyi dal gyi dbang phyug ma ni gang dang gang dgos pas bya'o/ /dal dbang phyug ma'i sngags ni las thams cad pa'i sngags so// //rdo rje dbyings kyi dal la ni rdo rje gur gyi nang du gling dang gling phran dang rgya mtsho bdun la sogs pas yongs su bskor ba'i ri rab kyi steng du gzhal yas khang ste—/ de'i dbus su seng ge'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru la bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad dkar po rdo rje'i skyil krung gis gnas pa nyi ma'i rgyab yol can/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ sangs rgyas lngas spras pa'i rin po che'i cod pan dang / nor bus brgyan pa/ khyad par du gyur pa'i rin po che'i rgyan 47—1145

sna tshogs dang / gos dang ldan pa/ zhi ba/ zhal bzhi pa/ dkar po dang ser po dang dmar po dang ljang khu'o/ /phyag brgyad pa/ g.yas pa dang g.yon pa gnyis kyis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya 'dzin pa'o/ /gzhan gnyis kyis bsam gtan gyi phyag rgya 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yas pa gnyis kyis bsgrang phreng dang mda' 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /yang na 'di ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa sku mdog dkar po/phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur las rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sdigs 'dzub langs pa la/ g.yas pa rdo rje bzung nas byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya langs pa'o/ /shar gyi 'dab mar rdo rje sems ma sngon mo ni g.yas pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa dmar po 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor rin chen rdo rje ser po g.yas pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i rtse mor mtshan pa'i rin po che 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pas sdigs par byed pa'i sdigs mdzub po/ /nub du chos kyi rdo rje dmar po g.yas pas rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan pa'i pad+ma 'dab brgyad pa dmar skya 'dzin pa'o—/ /g.yon pas kyang pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du las kyi rdo rje ma ljang khu g.yas pas sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa de ba lnga'i mdog lta bu 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pas sdigs mdzub sdigs par byed pa'o/ /de nas shar gyi phyogs su glang po che'i dbang po'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje skyil krung gis gnas pa/ phyag g.yas kyis mthe bong dang gung mo'i rtse mor rdo rje rtse lnga pa bzung nas sa gnon kyi tshul byed cing g.yon pa'i phyag mnyam bzhag dang bcas pa'o/ /shar kyi 'dab mar rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po phyag g.yas pa'i 47—1146

gung mos snying khar gyen du 'gying ba'i tshul gyis rnal 'byor gyi rdo rje dang /g.yon pas nga rgyal dang bcas pa'i dril bu dkur ①brten pa'o/ /lhor rdo rje rgyal po ser po ni g.yas par gnas pa'i rdo rje lcags kyu 'gugs pa'i tshul byed pa'i tshul can/ g.yon pas zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /yang na phyag gnyis kyis 'gugs par byed pa'i lcags kyu 'dzin pa zhes kyang kha gcig las gsungs so/ /byang du nubazer rdo rje chags pa dmar po g.yon dang gcig shos rnam pa gnyis kyis gzhu dang mda' 'dzin pa'o/ /nub du byangazer rdo rje legs pa mar gad kyi mdog lta bu rdo rje dang bcas pa'i phyag gnyis kyis snying khar legs so sbyin pa'i tshul du byed pa'o/ /lho ru rta'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba la rin chen 'byung ldan ser po rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ g.yas pa rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rin po che gung mo la bzung ste mchog sbyin gyi tshul du byed pa'o/ /g.yon pa de nyid kyi rtsar gan rkyal du bzhag pa'o/ /shar gyi 'dab mar rdo rje rin chen ser po ni g.yas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyi phyogs gnyis la rdo rje gnyis kyis mtshan pa'i rin po che'i phreng ba dbang bskur gyi gnas su 'ching bar byed cing / g.yon pa rdo rje dril bu sgeg pa dang bcas pas 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor rdo rje gzi brjid dmar po phyag gnyis kyis snying khar nyi ma gsal bar byed pa 'dzin pa'o/ /nub du byang zer rdo rje me tog ljang khu g.yon gyi phyogs na gnas pa'i phyag gnyis yid bzhin gyi nor bus mtshan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'phyar ba'o/ /byang du nubazer rdo rje bzhad pa dkar po g.yas pas ba so'i phreng ba dang ldan pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pas kyang de bzhin du so'i phreng ba gnyis dang ldan pa'i rdo rje gnyis khar bcug pa'o/ /nub du rma bya'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru la snang ba mtha' yas dmar po rdo rje 47—1147

dkyil dkrung can/ g.yon pa dang gcig shos gan rkyal du byas ste/ lte ba'i thog du bzhag pas ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya dang ldan pa'o/ /shar kyi 'dab mar rdo rje chos dmar skya/ g.yon pas 'gying ①bag dang bcas pas ud pa la'i yu ba 'dzin zhing g.yas pas kha 'byed pa'o/ /lho ru rdo rje rin po che sngon po g.yon pas snying khar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti 'dzin pa/ g.yas pas ral kyi phyar ba'o/ /nub du byangazer rdo rje rgyu gser btso ma'i mdog lta bu g.yon par gnas pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa g.yas pa'i gung mos ghal me lta bur skor zhing chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du nubazer rdo rje smra ba dmar po g.yon pa chos kyi dung g.yas pas rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rtse mo 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du khyung gi steng du sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar don yod grub pa ljang khu skyil krung gis gnas pa/ phyag g.yas pa'i gung mos sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i tshul byed cing / g.yon pa lte ba'i 'og tu gan rkyal du bzhag pa'o/ /shar gyi 'dab mar rdo rje las ljang khu g.yas pas snying khar sgreng ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dril bu skur brten pa'o/ /yang na lag pa gnyis kyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar nas sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /lho ru rdo rje bsrung ba ser mo phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje'i go cha 'dzin pa'o/ /nub du byangazer rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po phyag gnyis kyi mthe'u chung gis rdo rje mche ba'i mtshon gyi rtse mo gnyis khar bcug pas gdug pa rnams bsdigs pa'o/ /byang du nubazer rdo rje khu tshur khu tshur gnyis kyis bzung ba'i rdo rje'i rtse mnan pa'o/ /dbus kyi rim pa'i me'i mtshalas kyi pad+ma la rdo rje sgeg mo dkar mo rdo rje 'akying ba'i phyag rgyas phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje gnyis 47—1148

'dzin pa'o/ /bden bral gyi mtshams su phreng ba ma ser mo phyag gnyis kyis rin po che'i phreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung gis ①mtshams kyi pad+ma la glu ma dmar mo phyag gnyis kyis pi wang gi rgyud bgreng ba'o/ /dbang ldan byu pad+ma la gar ma ljang khu phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse gsum pa bzung nas gyen du gar byed pa'o/ /dbus kyi gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol shar gyi snam bu'i 'dab ma la/ byams pa dang /mthong ba don yod dang / ngan song kun 'dren dang / mya ngan gyi mun pa thams cad 'joms pa'i blo gros rnams ni mi bskyod pa lta bu'o/ /lho'i pad+ma rnams la spos kyi glang po dang / dpa' bar 'gro ba dang / nam mkha' mdzod dang / ye shes tog rnams rin chen 'byung ldan lta bu'o/ /nub kyi pad+ma rnams la 'od dpag med dang / zla 'od dang / bzang skyong dang / dra ba'i 'od rnams ni 'od dpag med lta bu'o/ /byang gi pad+ma rnams la rdo rje snying po dang /blo gros mi bzad pa dang / spobs pa brtsegs pa dang kun tu bzang po rnams don yod grub pa lta bu'o/ /yang na bskal pa bzang po'i byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la sogs pa ste/ stong phrag gcig la bzhis ma tshang ba bsgom par bya'o//shar la sogs pa'i snam bu la de dag gi ming ②rnams ni brjod kyis mi lang bas ma bshad do/ /me'i mtshams kyi pad+ma la rdo rje bdug spos ma dkar mo dang /bden bral gyi mtshams kyi pad+ma la rdo rje me tog ma ser mo dang / rlung gi mtshams kyi pad+ma la rdo rje mar me ma dkar dmar dang / dbang ldan gyi mtshams kyi pad+mar rdo rje dri chab ma ljang khu'o/ /bdug spos ma la sogs pa 'di rnams ni gong bzhin du phyag mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo rnams la rdo rje lcags kyu dang / rdo rje zhags pa dang / rdo rje lcags sgrog dang / rdo rje 'bebs pa 47—1149

la sogs pa'i rim pa bzhin du dkar po dang ser po dang dmar po dang ljang khu rnams kyis gong bzhin du phyag mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /'dir bcom ldan 'das rdo rje dbyings las gzhan pa'i lha rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ gos dang rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ rin po che'i cod pan can no/ /dal gyi dbang phyug gi mngon du gyur par rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa ni bzhag nas rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bcu drug ni rang rang gi bdag po de ba'i mdun du mngon du gyur pa'o/ /rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa nas rdo rje 'be+ebs pa'i bar kyi lha rnams ni ji ltar gsungs pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la zla ba la gnas shing nyi ma'i rgyab yol can/ de ba lnga las gzhan lha rnams bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad ni sems dpa'i dkyil dkrung gis bzhugs pa'o—/ /'dir bcom ldan 'das rdo rje dbyings rnam par snang mdzad ni chos dbyings yang dag par rnam par dag pa'i ye shes kyi bdag nyid bdag lta bu'i rdo rje sems dpas rgyas btab pa'o/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes la sogs pa'i bdag nyid mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i de ba bzhi'i rigs kyi bdag nyid ni rnam par snang mdzad dang / rdo rje sems dpa' dang / rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa bzhi dang / sgeg mo dang bdug spos ma dang byams pa la sogs pa bzhi dang / rdo rje lcags kyu ma la sogs pa rnams ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /rdo rje rin chen ma dang rdo rje rin chen ma la sogs pa bzhi dang / phreng ba ma dang / me tog ma dang /spos kyi glang po la sogs pa bzhi dang / rdo rje zhags pa ma rnams ni rin chen 'byung ldan no/ /chos kyi rdo rje ma dang / rdo rje chos ma la sogs pa bzhi dang /glu ma dang / mar me ma dang / 'od dpag med la sogs pa bzhi dang / rdo rje 47—1150

lcags sgrog ma la sogs pa rnams ni snang ba mtha' yas so/ /rdo rje las ma dang /las kyi rdo rje la sogs pa bzhi dang / gar ma dang / dri ma dang / rdo rje snying po la sogs pa bzhi dang / rdo rje 'beb pa bzhi dang rdo rje dril bu ma la sogs pa rnams kyi don yod grub pa'o/ /nang gi gzhal yas khang gi sgo rnams la yang rdo rje lcags kyu ma la sogs pa sgo skyong ma rnam pa bzhi bsgom par bya'o zhes zer ba yang yod do/ /rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs kha'i sa bon ni a/ ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā yo gi shwa ri hūṃ zhes pa ni snying po'o/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ zhes pa 'di ni rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi las thams cad pa'i sngags so/ /rdo rje rtse mo la sogs pa'i rgyud rnams las rnam pa gzhan gyis kyang lha rnams kyi khyad par gsung ste/ de ni brjod kyis mi lang bas 'dir ma bshad do// //'jam pa'i rdo rje'i 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i dal lha bzhi bcu rtsa gsum gyi bdag nyid la/ rdo rje gur la sogs pa nas gzhal yas khang gi bar du gong du bshad pa'i 'jam dpal rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi rang bzhin no/ /'di ni khyad par du khro bo rnams kyi ni phyis 'chad pa'i gzugs can no/ /zhes bya ba'i tshul kyang yod do/ /yang rdo rje gur gyi nang dang ri rab kyi steng du sna tshogs pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar gzhal yas khang zhes pa ni lugs gnyis pa'o/ /phyogs gnyis ka la yang mchod brten ①dkar po'i nang du gzhal yas khang / de'i lte ba la seng ge'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin 'jam pa'i rdo rje ni sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu'i yid du 'ong zhing 47—1151

blta na sdug pa dang / me tog sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i gtsug phud kyis rnam par brgyan rtsa ba dang g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal/ ser po dang dmar po dang dkar po'o—/ /phyag drug pa'i g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri dang / mchod sbyin dang /mda' 'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti dang /chu skyes sngon po dang / gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /bdag nyid lta bu'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma la sogs par 'jug pa'o/ /shar gyi le'u tshe la glang po che'i dbang ba'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la mi bskyod pa 'akying ba'i stangs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /rtsa ba dang g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal sngon po dang dkar po dang dmar po'o/ /phyag brgyad pa'i g.yas pa'i gung mos snying khar rdo rje gyen la bsgreng ba/ g.yon pas rdo rje khu tshur gyis rdo rje dril bu skur brten pa'o/ /gzhan g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri dang / lcags kyu dang / mda' 'dzin pa/g.yon pa rnams kyis bum pa dang / zhags pa dang / gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /lho'i phyogs kyi rta'i steng du chu skyes dang nyi ma la rin chen 'byung ldan sems dpa'i dkyil dkrung gis bzhugs pa/ ser po/ rtsa ba dang g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i zhal/ ser po dang sngon po dang dkar po'o/ /phyag drug pa/ dang po'i phyag gnyis kyis mnyam par bzhag pa'i phyag rgya can/ g.yas pa'i phyag gnyis kyis rin po che dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa gnyis nu ma dang rdo rje 'dzin pa'o—/ /nub du rma bya'i steng du sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma la sems dpa'i skyil krung gis gnas pa'i snang ba mtha' yas dkar po sems dpa'i skyil krung can/rtsa ba dang g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i zhal/ dkar po dang sngon po dang dmar po'o—/ /phyag drug pa g.yon pa sgeg pa dang bcas pas pad+ma'i yu ba snying khar 47—1152

bzung ste g.yas pas kha 'byed pa'o/ /g.yas pa gnyis kyis bsgrang phreng dang rdo rje 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa gnyis kyis nu ma dang phyag tshang rku ba'i spyi blugs 'dzin pa'o—/ /byang du khyung gi steng du sna tshogs chu skyes dang nyi ma la don yod grub pa dmar po sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rtsa ba dang g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal dmar po dang sngon po dang dkar po'o/ /phyag drug pa'i dang po gnyis kyis bsam gtan gyi phyag rgya bcings pa/ g.yas pa gnyis kyis ral gri dang rdo rje 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa gnyis kyis nu ma dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du spyan ma ser po sems dpa'i skyil krung can/ phyag brgyad ma/ g.yas pa rnams kyis mchog sbyin pa dang mi 'jigs pa dang rdo rje dang mda' 'dzin pa'o//g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang rin po che 'bar ba dang bsgrang phreng dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /me'i mtshams su ma ma ki sems dpa'i dkyil dkrung can sngon mo/ khros pa dang bcas pa'i gad mo rgod pa dang / phyag drug pa/ g.yas pa rnams kyis mi 'jigs pa dang rdo rje dang mda' 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyi sdigs mdzub dang zhags pa dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /bden bral gyi mtshams su gos dkar mo phyag drug pa/ g.yas pa rnams kyis mi 'jigs pa dang rdo rje dang mda'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis pad+ma dang bgrang phreng dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ rol pa'i tshul gyis gnas pa'o/ /rlung gi mtshams su sgol ma mar gad lta bu'i mdog can/ sems dpa'i skyid krung gis gnas pa/ phyag drug pa'i g.yas pa rnams kyis mi 'jigs pa dang rdo rje dang mda'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang ud pa la dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /rim pa gnyis pa la ni shar la sogs pa'i phyogs su rdo rje sems 47—1153

dpa' ma dang / rdo rje rin chen ma dang / rdo rje chos ma dang / las kyi rdo rje ma rim pa bzhin du sku mdog dang phyag mtshan mi bskyod pa la sogs pa bzhin no/ /'on kyang nu ma bzung du med pas rdo rje sems dpa' ma dang / rdo rje rin chen ma dang / las kyi rdo rje ma rnams sdigs 'dzub 'dzin pa'o/ /chos kyi rdo rje ma zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du tsuṇa ḍa dkar mo zla ba'i mdog can phyag nyi shu rtsa drug ma rtsa ba'i ①phyag gnyis kyis snying khar rtsa ba'i phyag rgya dang /g.yas pa rnams kyis mi 'jigs pa dang / ral gri dang rin po che'i phreng ba dang pi tsa pu ri dang / mda' dang / dgra sta dang / mdung thung dang / tho ba dang lcags kyu dang / rdo rje dang / ba dan gsum gyi tshul dang / bgrang phreng ngo / /g.yon pa rnams kyi yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan dang /pad+ma dang / spyi blug dang / zhags pa dang / gzhu dang / shag ti dang /'khor lo dang / ral gri dang / sdigs mdzub dang / bum pa bzang po dang /lcags zhags lta bu dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti 'dzin pa'o/ /gos bzang po gyon pa/ stod g.yogs bcings pa gar gyi nyams dgu'i rang bzhin can/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar po/ g.yas pa sngon po ljags 'gul zhing mche ba cung zad brtsigs pa/ g.yon pa ser po ma mchu mnan pa/ thal mo sbyar ste mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i tshigs pa gnyis par zlum po'i rnam par sbyar te/mthe bong gnyis 'dzub mo'i rtsar gzhag par bya ste/ 'di ni rtsa ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /me'i mtshams su rin chen sgron ma ser mo phyag drug ma/ phyag gnyis kyis snying khar rin po che kha sbyor 'dzin pa/ g.yas pa gnyis kyis mi 'jigs pa dang /mda' 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa gnyis kyis sdogs mdzub dang / gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /47—1154

bden bral gyi mtshalas su khro gnyer ma dkar mo phyag drug ma/ g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang / dbyug pa dang / mda' 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang gzhu phyagamawo med 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung gi mtshams su rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma ljang khu phyag drug ma/ g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang / rdo rje lu gu rgyud dang mda' 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs 'dzub dang zhags pa dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /bcu gnyis po 'di rnams ni rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /spyan ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams ni zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs shing zla ba'i 'od kyi rgyab yol can/ rang rang gi rigs bdag bzhin du zhal gsum pa'o/ /rim pa gsum pa'i dal gyi shar gyi snam bu la/ byams pa gser gyi mdog lta bu phyag dang po gnyis kyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya dang / g.yas pas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang / g.yon pas me tog dang bcas pa'i na ga ge sar gyi yal ga 'dzin pa'o/ /'jam dpal dmar po khyad par du shes rab ma dang bral ba'o/ /spos kyi glang po ljang khu/ g.yon par bum par gnas pa'i glang po che'i lag pa 'dzin pa/ g.yas pas mchog sbyin no/ /ye shes tog ser po g.yon pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ g.yas pas mchog sbyin no/ /lhor bzang skyong sku mdog dmar po/ g.yon pas rin po che 'dzin pa g.yas pas mchog sbyin no/ /blo gros rgya mtsho dkar po phyag gnyis kyi sor mo rnams bskyang bas sbyin pa gter ba'i tshul du byed pa'o/ /blo gros mi bzad pa gser gyi mdog can g.yon pa'i khu tshur snying khar bzhag ste/ g.yas pas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya'o/ /spobs dhipa brtsegs pa ljang khu g.yas pas khu tshur snying khar ma reg par bsgreng ba/ g.yon pas se gol tog pa'o/ /nub du mthu chen thob 47—1155

dkar po g.yon pa cung zad rgyas pa'i pad+ma 'dzin pa/ g.yas pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya 'dzin pa'o/ /ngan song thams cad spong dkar po lag pa gnyis kyis sdigs sprug pa'i tshul lo/ /mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad rnam par 'joms par byed pa'i blo gros gser gyi mdog lta bu lag pa gnyis kha sbyar bas brdeg pa'i tshul lo/ /dra ba can gyi 'od dmar po g.yon pas ud pa la dang nyi ma'i dal 'dzin pa/ g.yas pas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du zla 'od gzhon nu sku mdog zla ba lta bu ste/ g.yon pas ud pa lar gnas pa'i zla ba'i dal 'dzin pa/ g.yas pas mchog sbyin no/ /'od dpag tu med pa dmar po/phyag gnyis kyis dbang bskur ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa'o/ /nam mkha' mdzod sku mdog ser po g.yon pas khu tshur 'gying bas sku bsten pa/ g.yas pa rdo rje nam mkha' la bskor ba'o/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnam par ser ①ba sngon po'am dkar po/ g.yon pa sa la reg pa/ g.yas pa khu tshur gyis mthe bong dang sdigs 'dzub sbyar te/ dri ba'i tshul gyis gnas pa'o/ /byams pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'di rnams ni zla ba'i gdan la zla ba'i rgyab yol can/sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ spyan gsum pa/ rang phyogs kyi bdag po bzhin du zhal gsum pa phyag drug pa/ phyag gnyis kyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya byas pa/ gnyis pa gzhu dang mda' 'dzin pa/ byams pa dang 'jam dbyangs gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya'o/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa'i lha rnams thams cad ni khyad par du gyur pa'i gos dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ 'dzum bag dang ldan pa'i zhal dang sgeg pa'i ro dang ldan pa'o/ /shar gyi sgor ma te'i steng du gshin rje gshed nag po phyag drug pa/47—1156

g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri dang rdo rje dang mda' 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub gyen la bgreng bas sdigs par byed pa/g.yon pa'i gnyis pas lha mo la mkhyud nas nu ma 'dzin pa/ lha mo'ang zhi ba zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis pa sku mdog dkar mo/ phyag g.yon pas pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa/ phyag g.yas pas yab la mkhyud par byed pa'o/ /phyag g.yon pa'i gsum pas dngul gyi gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /lha mo mar gad lta bu ljang khu phyag gnyis ma—/ g.yas pas ud pa la sngon po 'dzin pa/ phyag g.yon pas yab kyi ske la mkhyud pa'i lha mo des g.yas phyogs brgyan pa/ zhabs drug pa/ gsus pa 'phyang ba/ zhal sngon po drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal gyis dgyes pa'i gad mo bzhad pa / gnyis pa 'jigs par byed pa/ gsum pa'i zhal gdangs pa/ bzhi pa 'jigs su rung ba/ lnga pa rdo rje'i mche ba can/ drug pa spyi bo'i steng du gnas pa ljags 'gul ba'o/ /yang na steng gi sngon po la rtsa ba la sogs pa'i zhal rnams ni g.yas skor gyis sngon po dang dkar po dang ser po dang dmar po dang ljang khu rnams so/ /lho'i sgor gzhan gyis mi thub pa ser po ni rtsa ba dang g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal ser po dang nag po dang dkar po'o/ /phyag drug pa/g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang mdung thung dang mda' 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang nu ma dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o//nub kyi sgor rta mgrin dmar po rtsa ba dang / g.yas pa dang g.yon pa'i zhal dmar po dang sngon po dang dkar po/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i dbyug pa dang ka na pa dang mda' rnams so/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang nu ma dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /47—1157

byang sgor bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sngon po bgegs zhabs kyis mnan pa/ phyag drug pa/g.yas pa rnams na ral gri dang dgra sta dang mda' rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs 'dzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang / nu ma dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan gyi mtshams su rin po che'i ri bo'i steng du mi g.yo ba sngon po/ mi g.yo ba dang ldan pa/ g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri dang zhags pa dang mda' 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs 'dzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang / nu ma dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon ngos su phyang ba'i gos sngon po gcig 'dzin pa/ khrag gis brlan pas g.yas g.yon gyis gnas su ljags 'dril ba/ zhal gdangs pa'o/ /me'i mtshams su 'dod pa'i rgyal po sngon po/ phyag drug pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis btsun po la mkhyud pa/g.yas pa gnyis kyis rdo rje dang mda' dang / g.yon pa gnyis kyis nu ma dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur phan tshun rgyab sbyar ste/ 'the'u chung gnyis bsnol nas sdigs 'dzub gnyis phyir bkyed nas zhags pa'i tshul du byas pa ni 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya'o/ /bden bral gyi mtshams su dbyug pa sngon po sku mdog sngon po phyag drug pa/ g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang / dbyug to dang /mda' 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs 'dzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang nu ma dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung gi mtshams su stobs po che sngon po phyag brgyad pa/ g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang dbyug tho dang ral gri dang /mda' dang / g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang nu ma dang tho ba dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /dal gyi dbang phyug gi steng du gnod mdzes sngon po/ phyag drug pa/ phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya 47—1158

bcings pa/ g.yas pa gnyis kyis ral gri dang mda' dang / g.yon pa gnyis kyis nu ma dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya de nyid kyi 'dzub mo gnyis gyen du bgreng ba ni gnod mdzes kyi phyag rgya'o/ /'og du sa 'og sngon po ni phyag drug pa/ g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang lcags kyu dang mda'/g.yon pa rnams kyis nu ma dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang tri shu la dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o—/ /bgegs mthar byed la sogs pa bdun ni rtsa ba dang g.yas g.yon kyi zhal gsum sngon po dang ser po dang dmar po'o/ /khro bo bcu yang khros pa'i stang stabs can/ khro bo'i lta bas spyan dmar ba dang / rtsa ba'i zhal cung zad che ba/smin ma khro gnyer zhigs pa dang / cung zad kyis 'dzum par byas pa dang /g.yas pa'i zhal gdangs pa dang / g.yon pas mchu mnan pa dang / mche ba brtsigs pa dang / stag gi lpags pas gos dang stod g.yogs byas pa dang /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ dbu skra dmar zhing gyen la badze+es pa cung zad 'khyil ba/ sma ra dmar skya rol pa'i stang stabs can/ phud kyi sgra sgogs pa—/ klu'i rgyal po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la g.yas bskum zhing g.yon bskyang bas gnas pa ste/ khyad par du gshin rje gshed ni g.yon bskum la g.yas bskyang ba'am/ rdo rje dkyil dkrung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /dal 'di la gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba gnod mjos kyi gzugs kyis gnas pas logs nas khyad par du ma bshad de/ dpal sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud las rnal 'byor rgyas pa nye bar bstan pa la/ 'bring por rim pa nges par bstan pa la'ang / 'jam dpal rdo rje spyi bo'i steng du rin po che'i ri la gnas pa'i pad+ma dang nyi ma la rdo rje skyil krung gis gnas pa'i gtsug tor 'khor lo 47—1159

bsgyur ba ser po rtsa ba dang g.yas g.yon gyi zhal ser po dang sngon po dang dkar po'o—/ /phyag brgyad pa'i phyag gnyis kyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'o/ /g.yas pa rnams kyis 'khor lo dang bsgrang phreng dang mda' dang / g.yon pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang nu ma dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /khyad par du gyur pa'i gos dang rgyan dang ral pa'i thor ①cog gi cod pan dang / spyan ma la sogs pa'i lha mo bzhi rnam par brgyan pa'o/ /zhes phyogs gnyis su gsungs so/ /de'i rjes su 'brangs pas rnal 'byor rgyas pa'ang gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba dang dal gyi lha dang de'i steng du gnod mdzes rgyal po'ang shes par bya'o/ /zhes pa la la dag gi lugs kyis bshad do/ /'dir lha bzhi bcu rtsa gsum po rnams kyang zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum pa'o/ /'dir ni mi bskyod pa la sogs pa bzhi ni bdag lta bu'i shes rab ma la snyoms par zhugs pa'o/ /khro bo rnams kyis kyang rang rang dang 'dra ba'i shes rab ma la g.yon ngos su gnas pa la bstan pa zhes bya'o/ /gshin rje gshed ma gtogs pa khro bo gzhan rnams shes rab ma med kyang shes rab ma de'i nu ma 'dzin pa'i tshul gyis bdag gi nu ma 'dzin par bstan pa ni gzhan gyi lugs so—/ /'dir ni rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin 'jam dpal rdo rje la chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa'i ye shes kyi bdag po bdag lta bu'i rdo rje sems dpas rgyas btab pa'o/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes la sogs pa'i rang bzhin mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i de ba bzhi dang / spyan ma dang tsun da li la 'jam pa'i rdo rjes rgyas btab pa'o/ /ma ma ki dang rdo rje sems dpa' dang byams pa la sogs pa bzhi dang khro bo bcu la mi bskyod pas rgyas btab pa'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' ma dang rin chen sgol ma dang bzang skyong la sogs pa bzhi la rin chen 'byung ldan kyis 47—1160

rgyas btab pa'o/ /sgol ma dang las kyi rdo rje ma dang rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma dang zla 'od la sogs pa bzhi la don yod grub pas rgyas btab pa'o/ /'jam dpal rdo rje'i thugs kha'i sa bon sum̐ mo/ /stse a zhes pa ni snying po'i sngags so // //①ā+oṃ a za sneta kun ḍa li bisnan ta ka hūṃ zhes las thams cad pa'i sngags so—/ / //dam pa dang po'i rgyud ra po las chos kyi dbyengs ngag gi dbang phyug gi dal la sngar bshad ma thag pa'i dal bzhin du rdo rje gur la sogs pa bsgom ①pas rnam par bzhag pa'o/ /'dir khyad par du gshin rje gshed la sogs pa'i khro bo rnams ni 'chad par 'gyur ba'i gzugs can no/ /mchod rten ni 'dir med de gzhal yas khang gi lte bar sna tshogs pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru la gnas pa'i seng ge'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la 'jam pa'i dbyangs rdo rje dkyil dkrung du gnas pa/ nyi ma 'char ka'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'od dang ldan pa'i sku mdog gser mdog can/in dra ni la'i tsug phud 'bar ba/ rdo rje dang rin po che dang pad+ma dang / sna tshogs rdo rje'i phreng ba cod pan gyi steng du sangs rgyas lnga dang rin po che'i cod pan dang ldan pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa dang / na bza' sna tshogs bsnams pa/ sgeg pa'i nyams kyis spras pa/ rtsa ba dang g.yas pa dang / g.yon pa'i zhal ser po dang sngon po dang / dmar po dang dkar po'o/ /phyag brgyad pa'i dang po gnyis kyis chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya mdzad pa'o/ /g.yas pa rnams kyi ral gri dang mda' dang rdo rje bsnams pa'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti dang gzhu dang rdo rje dril bu bsnams pa'o/ /shar la 47—1161
