sogs pa'i phyogs rnams su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa la gnas pa'i seng ge'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i dal la/ gtsug tor chen po dang / gdugs dkar po dang /gzi brjid phung po dang / gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba rnams so/ /dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams su rnam par 'gro ba dang / gyen du 'phags pa dang /gyen du cher 'phags pa dang / rgyal ba'i stobs rnams so/ /gtsug tor brgyad po 'di rnams ni rdo rje dkyil dkrung la bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i cod pan can sku mdog ser po/ phyag gnyis pa'i g.yas pas 'khor lo gyen du slong bar brtson pa/g.yon pa nas rgyab ngos nas rang gi gdan gnan pa'o/ /de nas shar gyi re'u mig gi dbus su glang po che'i rgyal po'i steng du mi bskyod pa'i rgyal po sngon po rdorje dang zhal bzhi pa rtsa ba'i zhal sngon po khro ba dang bcas pa/ g.yas pa'i zhal dkar po sgeg pa/ nub ser po drag po'i zhal gdangs pa/ g.yon pa dmar po dpa' bo mche bas ma mchu mnan pa/ phyag brgyad pa'i g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri dang mda' dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs 'dzub dang dril bu dang gzhu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /de la rdo rje sems dpa' dang /rdo rje rgyal po dang / rdo rje chags pa dang / rdo rje legs pa rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba'o/ /lho'i re'u mig gi dbus su rta mchog gi steng du rin chen 'byung ldan ser po/ ser po dang nag po dang dkar po dang dmar po'i zhal bzhi pa/ phyag brgyad pa'i g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang / ral gri dang mda' dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ g.yon rnams na yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan dang rdo rje dril bu dang zhags pa dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /de la rdo rje rin chen dang / rdo rje nyi ma dang / rdo rje me tog dang / rdo rje bzhad pa rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba'o/ /47—1162

nub kyi re'u mig gi dbus su rma bya'i steng du snang ba mtha' yas dmar po zhal bzhi pa/ dmar po dang nag po dang dkar po dang ser po'o/ /phyag brgyad kyi g.yas pa rnams kyis/ rdo rje dang mda' dang ral gri dang / lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o / /g.yon rnams kyis pad+ma dang gzhu dang zhags pa dang dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /de la rdo rje chos dang / rdo rje rnon po dang / rdo rje sgyu dang / rdo rje smra ba rnams kyis bskor ba'o/ /byang gi re'u mig gi dbus su khyung gi steng du don yod grub pa ljang khu/ rtsa ba'i zhal ljang khu mche ba brtsigs pa/ g.yas ser po zhi ba/ nub kyi dmar po sgeg pa dang bcas pa/ g.yon kyi zhal dkar po zhi ba/ phyag brgyad pa'i g.yas pa rnams na ral gri dang rdo rje dang mda' dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa—/ g.yon pa rnams kyis sdogs 'dzub dang dril bu dang gzhu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /de la rdo rje las dang / rdo rje gsung ba dang / rdo rje gnod sbyin dang / rdo rje khu tshur rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba'o/ /mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i de ba rnams la rang rang gi chibs ①kyi steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la byas krung gi bzhugs pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ mdzes pa'i na bza' bsnams pa rin po che'i cod pan can no/ /de la rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa bcu drug gi dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams la gnas pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la gnas pa/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dal chen mo las bshad pa'i rang bzhin can rnams te/ 'di dag la phyogs bzhi na gnas pa'o zhes 'dod pa'i lugs kyang yod do/ /dbang ldan la sogs pa'i re'u mig la gnas pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas spyan dang ma ma ki dang gos dkar mo dang sgol ma rnams ni sems dpa'i skyil krung can/47—1163

rim pa ji lta bas 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang / mi bskyod pa dang / rin chen 'byung ldan dang / snang ba mtha' yas dang / don yod grub pa lta bu'o/ /shar gyi sgor rdo rje lcags kyu ma dmar ser/ phyag gnyis rdo rje lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /zhabs gnyis g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang bas gnas pa'o—/ /lho sgor rdo rje zhags pa ser po phyag gnyis rdo rje dang zhags pa 'dzin pa g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas gnas pa'o/ /nub kyi sgo la rdo rje lcags sgrog dmar po phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang lcags sgog 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis sa ga'i 'dug stangs su gnas pa'o/ /byang gi sgo la rdo rje dril bu ljang khu rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis skyis krung gis gnas pa'o/ /bzhi po 'di dag ni sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i phyag gnyis pa spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra dmar po gyen du badze+es shing sma ra dmar po dang ldan pa/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa'o// //de nas nang gi dal la ltos nas dal gnyis pa la/ shar gyi phyogs kyi dbang ldan la sogs pa g.yas skor du rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug rnams ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pa thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /de la mos pa spyod pa'i sa ma ni pad+ma bzhin du dmar ba pad+ma dmar po 'dzin pa'o/ /rab tu dga' ma dmar mo dpag bsam gyi nor bu 'dzin pa'o/ /dri ma med ma dkar po chu skyes dkar po 'dzin pa'o/ /'od byed ma ni dmar mo sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i nyi ma'i dal 'dzin pa'o/ /'od 'phro ma ni rin po che mar gad lta bu'i mdog ljang khu dmar po can ud pa la sngon po 'dzin pa'o/ /sa sbyang dka' ma 47—1164

ni sor mo mdun na gnas pa'i lag pa gan rkyal gyis ma ra ga ta'i nor bu 'dzin pa'o—/ /mngon du gyur pa'i sa ma ni gser gyi mdog can pad+ma'i steng du gnas pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti 'dzin pa'o/ /ring du song ba ma ni nam mkha' ltar sngo bsangs sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pa'oske/ /mi g.yo ma ni ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog can zla ba la gnas pa'i lag pa gan rkyal gyis ma ra ga ta'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa dmar pos mtshan pa'i pad+ma dmar po'i yu ba 'gying bag dang bcas pas 'dzin pa'o/ /legs pa'i blo gros ma ni dkar mo ral gris mtshan pa'i ud pa la 'dzin pa'o/ /chos kyi sprin ma ser mo chos kyi sprin kyis yongs su bskor ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti 'dzin pa'o/ /kun tu 'od ma ni nyi ma phyed pa'i nyi ma'i mdog can pad+ma'i steng du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mtshon par ①byed pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i sku 'dzin pa'o//me'i mtshams nas brtsams nas lho'i phyogs su pha rol tu phyin pa bcu gnyis ni/phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas thams cad kyis yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'dzin pa⑤/g.yon pas rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /de la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni khyad par phyag gnyis lhag pas bzhi pa'o/ /de la rin po che pad+ma'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni dmar po pad+ma la gnas pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'o/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dkar dmar gyi mdog can 'bras so ba sna tshogs kyi snye ma 'dzin pa'o/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dkar mo yal ga dang bcas pa'i me tog gi sdong po 'dzin pa'o/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin ma ni ser mo chu skyes dkar po 'dzin pa'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin ma ma ra ga ta lta bu'i mdog can ud pa la sngon po 'dzin pa'o/ /bsam gtan gyi pha 47—1165

rol tu phyin ma ni nam mkha' ltar sngo bsangs pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma gser gyi mdog ltar yid du 'ong ba pad+ma la gnas pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti 'dzin pa'o/ /phyag lhag ma gnyis kyis chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya mdzad pa'o/ /thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin ma ni me tog pri yang ①ku'i mdog ltar ljang khu pad+ma ser po la gnas pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin ma ni sngon mo ud pa la lta bu'i mdog can ud pa la sngon bo la gnas pa'i ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dmar mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i spo ti 'dzin pa'o/ /ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dkar mo rin po che tha dad kyi 'bras bu can byang chub kyi shing gi yal ga 'dzin pa'o—/ /rdo rje las kyi pha rol tu phyin ma ni sku mdog sna tshogs ud pa la sngon po la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /②nub nas brtsams nas nub du dbang bcu'i lha mo phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pa rnams kyis pad+ma 'dzin cing g.yon pa rnams 'gying ①ba dang bcas pas rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin pa ste/ tshe la dbang ba dkar mo ni dkar dmar kyi mdog can nor bu pad+ma ra ga la gnas pa'i snang ba mtha' yas kyi sku 'dzin pa'o/ /sems la dbang ba ma ni dkar mo rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga pa 'dzin pa'o/ /yo byad la dbang ba ma ni ser mo yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'dzin pa'o/ /las la dbang ba ljang khu sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pa'o—/ /skye ba la dbang ba mo sku mdog sna tshogs kha dog sna tshogs pa'i khri shing 'dzin pa'o/ /rdzu 'phrul la dbang ba mo nam mkha' ltar sngo bsangs pad+ma la gnas pa'i nyi ma dang zla ba'i dal 'dzin pa'o/ /mos pa la dbang ba ma ni pad+ma'i rtsa ba ltar dkar ba pri yang ku'i me tog gi snye ma 'dzin pa'o/ /smon lam 47—1166

la dbang ba ser mo ud pa la sngon po 'dzin pa'o/ /ye shes la dbang ba mo ni sngon mo ud pa la gnas pa'i ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /chos la dbang ba ma ni sgu mdog dmar mo pad+ma la gnas pa'i bum pa 'dzin pa'o/ /de bzhin nyid ma dkar mo phyag g.yas pas pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas rdo rje rin po che'i snye ma 'dzin pa'o/ /sangs rgyas byang chub ma ni gser zhun ma lta bu'i mdog canaske/ phyag g.yas pas pad+ma ser mo ①la gnas pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'dzin pa/g.yon pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan gyi steng du 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du gzungs ma bcu gnyis ni/ phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pa rnams kyis sna tshogs rdo rje/ g.yon pas 'akying ba dang bcas pa'i rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin pa'o—/ /de la nor rgyun ma ser mo so ba'i snye ma 'dzin pa'o/ /rin po che'i sgon ma dmar mo yid bzhin gyi nor bu rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma ni sku mdog dkar mo nor bu chu shel gyi bum pa 'dzin pa'o/ /'od zer can ma dmar ser skud pa dang bcas pa'i khab 'dzin pa'o/ /ri khrod ma ni ljang khu rma bya'i mdongs 'dzin pa'o/ /dug sel ma ni dkar mo dug gi me tog gi snye ma 'dzin pa'o/ /mtha' yas pa'i zhal ma me tog pri yang ku ljang khu lta bu chu skyes dmar po la gnas pa'i mi zad pa'i gter chen po'i bum pa 'dzin pa'o//tsun dha ma dkar mo spyi blugs la 'phyang ba'i bzlas pa'i phreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ /shes rab ma dkar mo ud pa la sngon mo la gnas pa'i ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /las thams cad kyi sgrib pa rnam par sel ma ljang khu rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa'i pad+ma dmar skya 'dzin pa'o/ /ye shes mi bzad pa'i za ma tog dmar po rin po che'i za ma tog 'dzin pa'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos mdzod ma ni ser 47—1167

mo pad+ma la gnas pa'i rin po che sna tshogs kyi snod 'dzin pa'o/ /shar phyogs kyi sgor chos so sor yang dag par rig ma sku mdog dmar skya phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o/ /lho phyogs kyi sgor don so sor yang dag par rig ma ma ra ga ta lta bu'i mdog can phyag gnyis rin po che'i zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /nub kyi sgor nges pa'i tshig so sor yang dag par rig pa dmar mo phyag gnyis na pad+mas mtshan pa'i lcags sgrog 'dzin pa'o/ /byang gi sgor spobs pa so sor yang dag par rig ma ma ra ga ta lta bu ljang khu phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /me'i mtshams su sgeg mo ser mo sgeg pa dang bcas pa'i phyag gnyis rdo rje gnyis 'dzin pa'o/ /bden bral gyi mtshams su phreng ba ma dmar ser phyag gnyis kyis rin po che'i phreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung gi mtshams su glu ma dmar mo phyag gnyis kyis singasing gi sgra tam bu ra'i sgra bgreng ba'o/ /dbang ldan kyi mtshams su gar ma ljang khu phyag gnyis rdo rje rtse gsum pa dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i gar ro/ /mos pa spyod pa la sogs pa'i lha mo 'di rnams thams cad rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs dang / rin po che'i cod pan sna tshogs dang ldan pa—/ cung zad 'dzum bag can sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dal la sems dpa'i dkyil dkrung gis bzhugs pa ste/ khyad par du sgo skyong ma rnams ni nyi ma'i dal la bzhugs pa yin no/ /de dag la'ang gzhan dag ni zla ba'i dal la gnas pa zhes zer ro/ /dal gsum pa la dbang ldan nas brtsams ste byang chub sems dpa' rnams so/ /de'ang shar phyogs kyi snam bu la kun tu bzang po ser po phyag g.yas pas mchod sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang /g.yon pas ud pa la la gnas pa'i ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /blo gros mi bzad pa 47—1168

ser po g.yas pas ral gri dang / g.yon pas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgyas spyi blugs kyi bum pa 'dzin pa'o/ /sa'i snying po ser po g.yas pas sa gnon mdzad pa dang / g.yon pas pad+ma la gnas pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing 'dzin pa'o/ /nam mkha'i snying po ljang khya g.yas pas rin po che sna tshogs kyi char 'bebs pa dang /g.yon pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'dzin pa'o/ /lho phyogs kyi snam bu la nam mkha' mdzod ser po g.yas pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'dzin pa dang / g.yon pas bum pa bzang po 'phyang ba'i dpag bsam gyi shing 'dzin pa'o/ /phyag na rin po che ni ljang khu g.yas pas rin po che dang / g.yon pas pad+ma la gnas pa'i zla ba'i dal 'dzin pa'o/ /blo gros rgya mtsho dkar po g.yas pas dung dang /g.yon pas rdo rje ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje snying po ni ud pa la sngon po lta bu'i mdog can g.yas pas rdo rje dang / g.yon pas sa bcu'i mdo'i po ti 'dzin pa'o—/ /nub du spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dkar po g.yas pas mchod sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang / g.yon pas chu skyes dkar po 'dzin pa'o/ /mthu chen thob ser po g.yas pas ral gri dang / g.yon pas pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /zla 'od gzhon nu dkar po g.yas pas rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon pas zla bas mtshan pa'i pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /dra ba can gyi 'od dmar skya g.yas pas ral gri/ g.yon pas pad+ma nyi mas mtshan pa 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du 'od dpag med dkar po g.yas pas sna tshogs pad+ma dang / g.yon pas pad+ma la gnas pa'i bum pa 'dzin pa'o / /spobs pa brtsegs pa ser po g.yas se gol dang / g.yon pas pad+ma la gnas pa'i ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /mya ngan kyi mun pa thams cad rnam par 'joms pa'i blo gros gur gum lta bu g.yas pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ g.yon pas shag 47—1169

ti 'dzin pa'o/ /sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba sngon po g.yas pas ral gri dang / g.yon pas sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /bcu drug po 'di rnams ni sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dal la sems dpa'i dkyil dkrung gis bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i cod pan can/ rin po che sna tshogs dang /gos sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis pa'o/ /shar sgor ma te'i steng du gshin rje gshed nag po/ gsus pa 'phyang ba/ zhal drug pa—/ zhabs drug pa/ phyag drug gis g.yas pa rnams kyis lcags kyu dang ral gri dang mda' 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs 'dzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang dril bu dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /zhal dang zhabs gnyis kyi bye brag gong bzhin no/ /lho phyogs kyi sgor shes rab mthar byed ser po zhal bzhi pa'i rtsa zhal sgeg pa/ g.yas gdangs pa/ nub kyi drag po/ g.yon zhi ba'o/ /yang na 'di dag rnams ni zhal rim pa ji lta bar ser po dang / sngon po dang /dmar po dang / ljang khu rnams so/ /yang na phyag brgyad pa ste/ g.yas pa rnams ni zhags pa dang / rdo rje dang ral gri dang mda' 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis snying khar lcags kyu dang rdo rje dril bu dang shag ti dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o//nub tu pad+ma mthar byed zhal bzhi pa dmar ba rtsa ba dang g.yas dang rgyab dang g.yon pa'i zhal rnams ni sgeg pa dang drag po dang bzhad pa dang zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan pa'o/ /yang 'di rnams ni dmar po dang nag po dang ser po dang dkar po rnams so/ /phyag brgyad pa'i phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje lcags sgog dang /phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang ral gri dang mda' 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa rnams ni dril bu dang sdigs 'dzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /47—1170

'di dag gsum po ni rol pa'i stangs ①kyis gnas pa'o/ /byang du bgegs mthar byed sngon po zhal bzhi pa/ sngon po'am/ yang na zhal de dag sngon po dang ser po dang dmar po dang ljang khu rnams te/ phyag brgyad pa'i gnyis kyis rdo rje gdams pa'i tshul kyis rdo rje dang / dril bu dang / g.yas pa rnams na ral gri dang mda' dang lcags kyu dang / g.yon pa rnams na sdigs mdzub zhags pa dang bcas pa dang gzhu dang dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /tshogs kyi bdag po'i steng du g.yon bskyang ba dang g.yas bskum pas mnan nas bzhugs pa'o/ /dbang ldan gyi mtshams su lo ga gsum las rnam par rgyal ba sngon po zhal bzhi pa/rtsa ba'i zhal khros pa dang bcas pas sgeg pa/ g.yas drag po rgyab kyi zhal dpa' ba—/ g.yon 'jigs pa'o/ /yang na 'di dag kyang sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang dkar po rnams so/ /phyag brgyad pa'i phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs khar bzung nas rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yas pas ni ral gri dang lcags kyu dang mda' bsnams pa/ g.yon pa rnams rdo rje dang zhags pa dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /zhabs g.yas bskum pas dbang phyug chen po'i dbu mnan pa/ g.yon bskyang bas u ma'i nu ma mnan pa'o/ /me'i mtshams su rdo rje 'bar ba'i nyi ma nag po sgeg pa dang dpa' ba dang 'jigs pa dang snying rje'i nga ro dang ldan pa'i zhal bzhi nag po'o/ /yang na 'di dag ni sngon po dang dkar po dang ser po dang dmar po'o/ /'di'i phyag brgyad kyi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang ral gri dang mda' dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu dang zhags pa dang gzhu dang kha ṭaṃ ga dang 'brel pa'i ba dan 'dzin pa'o/ /zhabs gnyis g.yon bskum g.yas bskyang bas khyab 'jug 47—1171

chung ma dang bcas pa mnan nas bzhugs pa'o/ /bden bral gyi mtshalas su rdo rje he ru ka sngon po zhal bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal drag po/ g.yas rab tu dga' bar byed pas myos pa/ rgyab rngam pa/ g.yon sgeg pa dang bcas pa'o /yang na 'di dag ni sngon po dang dmar po dang ljang khu dang dkar po'o/ /'di'i phyag brgyad kyis g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang ral gri dang mda' dang khrag gis bskang ba'i thod pa'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis snying khar pad+ma kha 'byed pa dang gzhu dang dril bu dang ba dan dang bcas pa'i kha ṭaṃ ①ga 'dzin pa'o/ /phyag gnyis kyis 'jigs byed kyi lpags pa rlung gi gos bzhin du 'dzin pa'o/ /'di ni chung ma dang bcas pa'i tshangs pa la g.yas bskum g.yon bskyang bas gnas pa'o/ /rlung gi mtshams su rta mchog ljang khu/ zhal bzhi yang ljang khu/rtsa ba'i zhal khro ba dang bcas pas sgeg pa/ g.yas pa drag po/ g.yon pa tshangs pa'i zhal lta bu ste/ yang na 'di dag ljang khu dang / sngon po dang dkar po dang spyi bor rta'i zhal lta bu sngon po'o/ /'di'i phyag brgyad kyi g.yas dang po na sna tshogs rdo rje ba dan dang bcas pa bgreng ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin pas gnas pa—/ gnyis pa ba dan gsum gyi tshul du sor mo bgreng ba/ 'og ma gnyis kyis ral gri dang mda' 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pas gdengs ⑤pa'i phyag gis pad+ma dang /lhag ma gsum gyis shag ti dang / dbyug pa dang / gzhu rnams 'dzin pa'o/ /zhabs bzhi g.yon bskum zhing g.yas bskyang ba dang / g.yas bskum zhing g.yon bskyang ba rnams so/ /g.yas kyi dang pos brgya byin gyi chung ma dang dpa' mo/gnyis pas dga' mo dang tshim pa mo dang / g.yon pa gcig gis lha'i dbang po dang sbrang rtsir byed pa dang / gnyis pas brgyal bar byed pa dang spyid lha mnan 47—1172

pas gnas pa'o/ /dal gyi bdag po'i steng gi nam mkhar gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba ser po zhal bzhi ser ba'am/ yang na ser po dang sngon po dang dmar po dang dkar po'o/ /phyag brgyad pa'i g.yas pa rnams kyis 'khor lo dang lcags kyu dang ral gri dang mda'o/ /g.yon pa rnams na dril bu dang zhags pa dang bzlas pa'i phreng ba dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /rol pa'i stabs kyis gnas pa'o//'og tu gnod mdzes rgyal po nag po zhal bzhi pa/ drag po dang zhi ba dang bzhad pa dang sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa'o/ /yang na zhal bzhi nag po dang dkar po dang dmar po dang ser po'o/ /phyag brgyad pa'i g.yas pa rnams na rdo rje dang lcags kyu dang ral gri dang mda' rnams so/ /g.yon pa rnams na dril bu dang zhags pa dang mdung rtse gcig pa dang gzhu rnams 'dzin pa'o/ /zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon bskyang bas gnas pa'o/ /khro bo bcu po 'di dag rnams ni sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'o/ /zhal re re zhing spyan gsum gsum pa/khro gnyer dang ldan pa/ stag gi lpags pas stod g.yogs dang sku'i smad dkris pa/thod pa'i phreng bas gtsug tor byas pa/ dbu skra 'bar zhing gyen du bcings pa/rmang ra dmar po dang ldan pa/ klu'i rgyal po brgyad kyis 'jigs su rung ba'o/ /dal gsum pa la zur bzhi'i nang khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba la sogs pa khro bo bzhi'i phyi rol na re ga'i phyi rol gyi gnas rnams la me'i mtshams la sogs pa zur thig gi g.yas ngos su me tog ma la sogs pa bzhi'o/ /g.yon rnams su gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa bzhi'o/ /de la me tog ma ni ser mo phyag na me tog gi snod 'dzin pa'o/ /bdug spos ma nag mo phyag na bdug spos kyi snod 'dzin pa'o/ /mar me ma dmar mo phyag na rin po che'i mar me'i yu ba 'dzin pa'o/ /dri chab ma 47—1173

ljang khu dri'i dung phor 'dzin pa'o/ /gzugs rdo rje ma ser mo phyag na me long 'dzin pa'o/ /sgra rdo rje ma ljang khu phyag na pi wang 'dzin pa'o/ /ro rdo rje ma dmar mo phyag na ro'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /reg rdo rje ma sna tshogs pa'i kha dog phyag na gos sna tshogs 'dzin pa'o/ /brgyad po 'di dag ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ rin po che'i cod pan dang ldan pa/ gos sna tshogs dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i dal la sems dpa'i khrug krung gis bzhugs pa'o//rim pa bzhi pa rdo rje rigs kyi dal gyi shar phyogs su lha'i dbang po ser po glang po che dkar po'i steng na gnas pa'i phyag g.yas na rdo rje dang g.yon na nu ma 'dzin pa'o—/ /gshin rje'i phyogs su gshin rje nag po ma te'i steng na gnas pa phyag gnyis kyis dbyug pa dang mdung rtse gcig pa 'dzin pa'o/ /chu lha'i phyogs su chu lha dkar po chu srin gyi steng na gnas pa sbrul mgo bdun dang ldan pa/ phyag gnyis na dung dkar bo 'dzin pa/ sbrul gyi zhags pa'o/ /gnod sbyin gyi phyogs su lus ngan po ser po mi'i steng na gnas pa lcags kyu dang shag ti dang dbyug to 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan gyi mtshams su dbang ldan dkar po glang gi steng na gnas pa/ phyag gnyis tri shu la dang thod ①pa 'dzin pa/ thod pa dang ral pa'i thor cog dang zla ba phyed pas dbu brgyan pa'o/ /sbrul gyi mchod phyir thogs dang ldan pa/ mgrin pa sngon po'o/ /me'i mtshams su me lha dmar po ra'i steng na gnas pa glugs bzar gyi spyi blugs 'dzin pa'o/ /bden bral gyi mtshams su srin po'i bdag po zhes bya ba sngon po/ ro'i steng na gnas pa phyag gis ral gri gdengs pa dang / ri dwags gsod pa'i phyag rgya desabasdegs pa'i ྾ 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung gi mtshams su rlung lha sngon po ri dwags kyi steng na gnas pa rlung yol gyi ras 47—1174

yug 'dzin pa'o/ /brgyad po 'di dag ni phyag bzhi pa ste/ g.yas dang po'i phyag mtshan 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa'i dang pos phyag mtshan bzung nas rang nyid lta bu'i yum la mkhyud pa/ phyag 'og ma gnyis kyis gtso bo la 'dud pa'i tshul kyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /dbang ldan dang nye ba'i phyi rol tu dbang ldan kyis ①mtshalas nas brtsams nas tshangs pa la sogs te/ de la tshangs pa ni ngang pa la zhon pa ser po/ zhal bzhi yang ser po/ phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas g.yon gyi dang po gnyis kyis bzlas pa'i phreng ba 'dzin pa dang pad+ma 'dzin pas thal mo sbyar ba—/ 'og ma gnyis kyis dbyug pa dang spyi blugs bzung nas thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /khyab 'jug nag po khyung la zhon pa phyag bzhi pa'i dang po gnyis dung dang 'khor lo 'khor lo dang dung zer 'dzin pas spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba/ 'og ma gnyis kyis dbyug pa mdung thung dang ra'i gzhu 'dzin pa/ dbang phyug chen po dkar po glang la zhon pa—/ ral pa'i thor cog can/ zla ba byed pas mtshan pa phyag bzhi pa/ spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba dang tri shul dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /gdong drug dmar po rma bya la zhon pa/ gdong drug pa/ phyag g.yas pa gnyis rdo rje dang shag ti 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa gnyis kyis khyim bya dang dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /lhag ma gnyis kyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /'di rnams kyang gong bzhin du rang nyid lta bu'i yum dang bcas pa'o/ /de la tshangs pa ni tshangs pa dang mtshungs pa'o/ /drag mo ni drag mo dang mtshungs pa'o/ /khyab 'jug ma ni khyab 'jug dang mtshungs pa'o/ /gzhon nu ma ni gdong drug dang mtshungs pa'o/ /dbang mo ni dbang phyug dang mtshungs pa'o/ /phag mo nag mo 'ug pa la zhon pa phyag bzhi pa g.yas dang g.yon gyis nya ro hi ta dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ lhag ma gnyis spyi bor 47—1175

thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /tsa mun ta dmar po yi dwags la zhon pa/ phyag bzhi'i gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /'bring gi ri ti nag mo shin tu skem pa/ phyag gnyis kyis phreng ba dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ thal mo gnyis sbyar ba'o/ /tshogs bdag dkar po byi ba la zhon pa glang po'i gdong can/sbrul gyi mchod phyir thogs gyon pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis tri shu la dang mdung 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa gnyis kyis dgra sta dang la phug 'dzin pa'o/ /nag po chen po ni nag po tri shu la dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /dga' byed dbang phyug nag po rnga rdza ring po la zhon pa/ phyag gnyis kyis rdza rnga brdung ba'o/ /nyi ma dmar po rta bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta la zhon pa/ g.yas pa dang g.yon pa gnyis kyis pad+ma la gnas pa'i nyi ma'i dal 'dzin pa'o/ /zla ba dkar po ngang pa la zhon pa phyag g.yas pa dang g.yon pa ku mu ta la gnas pa'i zla ba'i dal 'dzin pa'o/ /mig dmar dmar po ra la zhon pa/ g.yas na ka ta ra/g.yon pas mi mgo za ba'i tshul du 'dzin pa'o/ /lag pa ser po pad+ma'i steng na mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /phur bu dkar po thod pa'am sbal ba la zhon nas gnas pa/ phreng ba dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa'o/ /spa ba sangs dkar po pad+ma la gnas pa'i phreng ba dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa'o/ /spen pa nag po rus sbal la gnas pa dbyug pa 'dzin pa'o/ /sgra gcan dmar nag phyag gnyis kyis nyi ma dang zla ba 'dzin pa'o/ /'jug rings nag po ral gri dang klu'i zhags pa 'dzin pa'oske/ /stobs bzang dkar po glang po la gnas pa ral gri dang bshol 'dzin pa'o—/ /rgyal bar byed pa ljang khu khyung la zhon pa phyag bzhi pa g.yas pa gnyis na me tog gi phreng ba dang mda' 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa gnyis na btung ba'i snod 47—1176

dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /sbrang rtsir byed pa dkar po ni tshos khur ba'i shing rta'i steng na gnas pa ①phyag bzhi pa g.yas gnyis kyis chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan dang mda'o//g.yon pa gnyis kyis btung ba'i snod dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /spyid kyi lha dkar po bya'i khri la gnas pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas pa gnyis kyis mda' dang ral gri/g.yon pa gnyis kyis gzhu dang btung ba'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /klu mtha' yas dang nor rgyas dang 'jog po dang / stobs kyi rgyu dang pad+ma dang pad+ma chen po dang dung skyong dang rigs ldan rnams sbrul mgo bdun dang ldan pa thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /yang na rang rang gi rigs bdag gi phyag mtshan kyi gtso bo bzung nas thal mo sbyar ba'o—/ /thag bzangs ris dang / stobs ldan dang / rab tu sim byed dang / rnam par snang byed la sogs pa'i lha ma yin gyi dbang po chen po rnams mdog nag po go cha sna tshogs bsgos nas ral gri la sogs pa mtshon cha sna tshogs par 'dzin pa'o/ /nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po rkang pa'i mthil nas srus mo'i bar du dkar po/ de nas lte ba'i bar du ser po/ de nas mgrin pa'i bar du dmar po/ de nas mgo bo'i bar nag po/ phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa dmar ser phyag gnyis kyis pi wang bgreng ba'o/ /dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa ser po phyag gnyis pi wang gi sgra sgrog pa'o/ /rigs 'dzin gyi rgyal po don kun grub pa dkar po me tog gi phreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ /gnod sbyin gang ba bzang po sngon po/ nor bu bzang po ser po/ nor sbyin dmar po/ rnam thos kyi bu ser po/ pi tsi rku dha li dmar po/ ke li mi li ljang khu kha'i dbang po ser po/ spyod pa'i dbang ser po ste/ gang ba bzang po la sogs gnod sbyin gyi bdag po 'di dag ni phyag g.yas pa dang / g.yon pa 47—1177

gnyis kyis shing thog pi tsa pu ra dang ne+e'u le 'dzin pa'o/ /'phrog ma ser po phyag gnyis kyis zan gyi chang bu gnyis 'dzin pa bu dang bcas pa'o/ /skar ma ni smin drug dkar mo/ snar ma ljang khu mgo ljang khu lag dmar skya/ nam so nag po—/ rgyal ser po/ skag ser po/ mchu ljang khu/ dre dkar po/ sbo ser porka/ me bzhi mdog pri yang ku lta bu sngon po/ nag pa ljang khu/ sa ri dkar po—/ sa ga ljang khu/ lha mtshams ser po/ spyon nag po/ snrubs ljang khu/chu stod ser po/ chu smad ser po/ gro zhun nag po/ byi bzhin dkar skya/mon gre dkar ser/ mon gru nag po/ khrums stod ser po/ khrums smad ljang khu/ nam gru ser po/ tha skar ser skya/ bra nye ljang khu/ smin drug la sogs pa'i lha mo 'di rnams ni stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs g.yo ba dang bcas pa rnams la phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /gzhan yang lha mo rnams ni shing rta la gnas par shes par bya'o/ /dbang po la sogs pa'i lha de rnams ni pad+ma la gnas pa ste/ re re la'ang 'khor dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ rang gi sbyor ba ji lta ba bzhin du rin po che sna tshogs dang gos kyi bye brag gis brgyan pa/dal gyi bdag po bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal zhing bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i sgra phyogs thams cad du sgrogs pa'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i phyogs rnams su lcags kyu la sogs pa'i sgo skyong bzhi ni nang gi sgo ji lta bar gnas pa'o/ /'dir bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i bdag nyid ni 'jam pa'i dbyangs te/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin ni bdag nyid lta bu'i rdo rje sems dpas rgyas btab pa'o/ /me long lta bu la sogs pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i de ba bzhi gtsug 47—1178

tor rnam pa brgyad/ spyan ma rnams ni 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rgyas btab pa'o//rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa bzhi dang / ma ma ki dang / rdo rje lcags kyu dang / sa bcu gnyis dang / chos so sor yang dag par rig pa dang /sgeg mo dang / kun tu bzang po la sogs pa bzhi dang / khro bo bcu dang /me tog ma dang / gzugs rdo rje ma dang / shar la sogs pa'i lha rnams ni mi bskyod rdo rjes so/ /rdo rje rin chen la sogs pa bzhi dang / rdo rje zhags pa dang / pha rol tu phyin ma bcu dang / don so sor yang dag par rig pa dang /phreng ba ma dang / nam mkha' mdzod la sogs pa bzhi dang / bdug spos ma dang / sgra rdo rje ma dang / lho phyogs na gnas pa'i lha rnams ni rin chen 'byung ldan gyis so/ /rdo rje chos la sogs pa bzhi dang / gos dkar mo dang /rdo rje lcags sgrog ma dang / tshe la dbang ma la sogs pa bcu gnyis dang /nges pa'i tshig so sor yang dag par rig ma dang / glu ma dang spyan ras gzigs la sogs pa bzhi dang / mar me ma dang / ro rdo rje ma dang / nub phyogs na gnas pa'i lha mo rnams kyang 'od dpag med kyis so/ /rdo rje las la sogs pa bzhi dang / rdo rje 'be+ebs pa dang / gzungs bcu gnyis dang / spobs pa so sor yang dag par rig pa dang / gar ma dang / 'od dpag med la sogs pa bzhi dang / dri chab ma dang / reg rdo rje ma dang / byang phyogs na gnas pa'i lha rnams kyang don yod grub pas rgyas btab pa'o/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sa bon ni sum̐ mo/ /a aḥsarba ta thā ga ta hri da yā/ ha ra ha ra/ā+oṃ hūṃ hriḥb ga ban dzha na mur ti/ bā gī shwa ra/ ma hā pa tsa/ sarba dharmā ga ga na a ma la/ su pa ri shud dha/ dharmā d+mā tu dzñā na gar bhe aḥ zhes bya ba ni snying 47—1179

po'i sngags so/ /ā+oṃ adz+re ta kun ḍa li bighā na ta ka hūṃ zhes bya ba ni bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ste/ las thams cad pa'i sngags so// //ngan song thams cad rnam par sbyong ba'i dal la rdo rje gur kyi nang du rlung dang me dang chu dang sa dang ri rab kyi steng du gzhal yas khang gi dbus su nang gi dal la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa ser po rdo rje'i phreng ba sngon pos bskor ba'o/ /'ga' zhig gis 'khor lo sngon por yang gsungs so/ /gzhan kha cig gi 'dod pa lte ba sngon po/ shar gyi rtsibs dkar/ lho nag po/ nub dmar po/byang ljang khu zhes kyang gsung ngo / /'khor lo'i lte ba la sna tshogs pad+ma gnas pa'i seng ge'i steng du/ ༄ bcom ldan 'das shākya seng ge rnam par snang mdzad gser gyi mdog lta bu/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya 'dzin pa'o/ /shar phyogs kyi rtsibs la rdo rje gtsug tor dkar po sa gnon kyi phyag rgya can no/ /lho phyogs kyi rtsibs la rin chen tsug tor sngon po mchod sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang ldan pa'o/ /nub kyi rtsibs la pad+ma gtsug tor dmar po ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya dang ldan pa'o//byang gi rtsibs la sna tshogs gtsug tor ljang khu skyabs sbyin kyi phyag rgya dang ldan pa'o//me'i mtshams la gtsug tor gzi brjid dkar dmar phyag g.yas pas nyi ma 'dzin pa—/ g.yon pa skur brten pa'o/ /bden bral mtshams la gtsug tor rgyal mtshan dkar nag 'dres pa/ phyag gnyis kyis yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung gi rtsibs la gtsug tor rnon po nam mkha' ltar sngo bsangs—/ phyag g.yas ral gri g.yon pas spo ti 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan gyi rtsibs la gtsug tor gdugs dkar sku mdog dkar po phyag gnyis kyis gdugs 47—1180

'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje phreng ba'i phyi rol kyi me la sogs pa'i mtshams su sgeg mo dang / phreng ba mo dang / glu ma dang / gar ma rnams sku mdog dkar mo dang ser mo dmar mo dang khra mo'o/ /phyag gnyis pa rnams so/ /sgo'i g.yon ngos kyi lha rnam ①la byang chub sems dpa' gnyis gnyis dang / g.yas su gnyis gnyis so/ /de la shar gyi snam bu la byams pa ser po g.yas pa'i phyag gis klu shing gi me tog dang / g.yon pas rdza snod 'dzin pa'o/ /mthong ba don yod ser po phyag g.yas pas mig dang bcas pa'i pad+ma/ g.yon pa dku ②la brten pa'o/ /ngan song sbyong ba dkar po phyag gnyis kyis lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o//mya ngan kyi mun pa rnam par 'joms pa'i blo gros dkar ser 'dres pa'i mdog can—/ phyag g.yas pas dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas khu tshur dku ①la brten pa'o/ /lho phyogs kyi snam bu la spos kyi glang po dkar ljang / g.yas kyis dri chab kyi dung 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas khu tshur dku rjol brten pa'o/ /dpa' bar 'gro ba dkar po g.yas pas ral gri dang / g.yon pas khu tshur dku ⑤la brten pa'o/ /nam mkha' mdzod dkar ser g.yas pas pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi spo ti 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas khu tshur skur brten pa'o/ /ye shes tog sngon po phyag g.yas pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa skur brten pa'o/ /nub kyi snam bu la bdud rtsi 'od dkar po g.yas bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa cod pan gyi steng du 'dzin pa/ g.yon sku la brten pa'o/ /zla ba can gyi 'od dkar po g.yas pas pad+ma la gnas pa'i zla ba 'dzin pa/g.yon sku la brten pa'o/ /bzang skyong dkar po g.yas pas rin po che 'bar ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa sku la brten pa'o/ /dra ba can gyi 'od dmar po g.yas 47—1181

kyis rdo rje skur 'dzin pa/ g.yon sku la brten pa'o/ /byang gi snam bu la rdo rje snying po sngo skya/ g.yas pas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i ud pa la sngon po 'dzin pa/g.yon dkur ①brten pa'o/ /blo gros mi bzad pa dkar po/ phyag gnyis kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /spobs pa brtsegs pa dmar po g.yas pas pad+ma la gnas pa'i rin po che brtsegs pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa dkur ②brten pa'o/ /kun tu bzang po gser gyi mdog can g.yas pa rin po che'i snye ma 'dzin pa/ g.yon dkur ①brten pa'o/ /dal gyi me la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams la me tog ma dang / bdug spos ma dang / mar me ma dang /dri chab ma rnams ni dkar mo dang / nag mo dang / dmar mo dang / ljang khu rnams phyag gnyis kyis me tog la sogs pa 'dzin pa'o/ /shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu dkar mo phyag gnyis kyis lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o/ /lho sgor rdo rje zhags pa sngon mo phyag gnyis kyis zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /nub du rdo rje lcags sgog dmar po phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje lcags sgog 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du rdo rje 'bebs pa ljang khu phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /lha sum cu rtsa bdun po 'di dag kyang gos sna tshogs dang / rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/rin po che'i cod pan can spyan gsum pa/ phyag gnyis pa sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la sems dpa'i dkyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /'dir rnam par snang mdzad chen po la ni nyid dang mtshungs pa'i rnam par snang mdzad kyis rgyas btab pa'o/ /rdo rje gtsug tor la sogs pa bzhi ni rnam par snang mdzad chen po'o/ /shar phyogs dang me'i mtshams la gnas pa'i lha rnams la rnam par snang mdzad kyis so/ /lho phyogs dang bden bral gyi mtshams na gnas pa rnams la rin chen gtsug tor 47—1182

—gyi'o / /nub phyogs dang rlung gi phyogs na gnas pa rnams la pad+ma gtsug tor gyis so/ /byang phyogs dang dbang ldan kyis mtshams na gnas pa rnams la sna tshogs gtsug tor gyis so/ /'dir phyi rol kyi dal kyi lha'i gnas kyi snam bu la zla ba'i dal nyi shu rtsa brgyad blta'o zhes rgyud las gsungs pa'i phyir snam bu rnams la byang chub sems dpa' bcu drug bskyed pa mi rigs ste zla ba'i dal nyid do/ /'ga' zhig ni nang gi dal zhes rgyud nas gsungs pa la brten nas phyi rol gyi gzhal yas khang gnyis pa gsungs so/ /'ga' zhig gis rnam par snang mdzad chen po la sogs pa de ba dgu gtsug tor dang bcas pa'i de ba dge sbyong gi gzugs 'dzin par gsungs so/ /pad+ma'i phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'i rdo rje'i phreng ba/ lcags ri'i nang du dbang ldan nas brtsams nas g.yas skor kyis 'grin pa sngon po la sogs pa bskyed par bya ste/ de'ang dbang ldan du glang gi steng du 'grin sngon dkar po mchod phyir thogs gyon pa/ phyag gnyis na rdo rje dang mchod sbyin gyi phyag rgya'o/ /g.yon pa gnyis na rtse gsum dang ral gri'o/ /'grin sngon ma 'grin pa sngon po lta bu'o/ /nam mkha' lding gi steng du khyab 'jug nag po g.yas gnyis na dbyug tho dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis na dung dang 'khor lo'oske/ /gser kyi rdo rje ma khyab 'jug lta bu khyad par gser gyi mdog can no/ /rma bya'i steng du rdo rje dril bu zhal drug pa dmar po/ g.yas gnyis na shag ti dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis na khyim bya dang rdo rje dril bu'o/ /rdo rje gzhon nu ma rdo rje dril bu lta bu'o/ /ngang pa'i steng na smra spyod rdo rje ser po zhal bzhi pa/g.yas pa gnyis na rdo rje dang bzlas pa'i phreng ba/ g.yon pa gnyis dbyug pa dang spyi blugs so/ /rdo rje zhi ba ma tshangs pa lta bu'o/ /glang po che mche ba drug 47—1183

pa dkar po dang zla ba la gnas pa rdo rje mtshon cha dkar po rol pa'i tshul gyis gnas pa/ phyag g.yas na rdo rje g.yon sku la brten pa'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gyi lha mo ni rdo rje mtshon cha ji lta ba'o/ /rta bdun gyi shing rta la rdo rje 'khyil pa dmar po khro bo g.yas pa na pad+ma/ g.yon pa na pad+ma la gnas pa'i nyi ma'i dal 'dzin pa'o—/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi ma rdo rje 'khyil pa bzhin no/ /ngang pa'i steng du rdo rje 'od dkar po khro bo phyag g.yas pas rdo rje/ g.yon pas pad+ma la gnas pa'i zla ba 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje mdog rdo rje 'od lta bu'o/ /ra'i steng du rdo rje dmar skya khro bo dmar po phyag g.yas na rdo rje/ g.yon pas mi bzung nas za ba'i tshul lo/ /rdo rje ske rags ma rdo rje dmar po bzhin no/ /pad+ma'i steng du rdo rje zhi ba khro bo ser po mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje zhi ba mo rdo rje zhi ba bzhin no/ /sbal pa'i steng du rdo rje bla ma khro bo ser po g.yas pas bzlas pa'i phreng ba dang /g.yon pas spyi blugs 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje bla ma ma rdo rje bla ma ji lta ba bzhin no/ /pad+ma'i steng na rdo rje pa ba sangs khro bo g.yas pa na bzlas pa'i phreng ba/ g.yon pa spyi blugs 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje spa ba sangs ma rdo rje pa ba sangs ji lta ba bzhin no—/ /rus sbal gyi steng du rdo rje dbyug pa khro bo nag po/ g.yas pa na rdo rje/g.yon pas dbyug pa 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje dbyug pa ma ni rdo rje dbyug pa dang 'dra'o—/ /rdo rje sgra gcan khro bo dmar nag phyag g.yas pas ni nyi ma/ g.yon pas zla ba 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje lha min rdo rje sgra gcan ji lta ba bzhin no/ /rdo rje rtog khro bo nag po g.yas ral gri dang / g.yon sbrul zhags 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje klu ma rdo rje rtog ji lta ba bzhin no/ /'di ltar bzhi po 'di dag kyang rdo rje zhi ba la sogs pa drug rgyud gzhan las gsungs pa bzhin du bdag gis bris pa 47—1184

yin no/ /glang po che'i steng du rdo rje sna dkar po g.yas pas rdo rje g.yon pas bshol 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje 'dul ba mo rdo rje sna ji lta ba bzhin no/ /khyad par ni g.yon pas kha ṭī ga 'dzin pa'o/ /khu yug gi steng du phreng ba can ljang khu g.yas pa rdo rje g.yon pa na me tog gi phreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje gdan ma rdo rje phreng ba can ji lta ba'am yang na g.yon pas shag ti 'dzin pa'o/ /ne+e tsho'i shing rta'i steng du rdo rje dbang can ser po/ g.yas pa rdo rje g.yon pa na chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba ste chags pa'i lha'o/ /rdo rje dbang can ma rdo rje dbang can ji lta ba bzhin no/ /khyad par du sku mdog dmar po'o/ /sbal pa'i steng du rdo rje rnam par rgyal ba dkar po rdo rje dang ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje ldan ma ni rdo rje rnam par rgyal ba lta bu'o/ /me tog gi shing rta'i steng du rdo rje gtun shing ser po phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje gtun shing 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje pho nya ma btun shing ji lta ba'am—/ yang na g.yon pas kha ṭī ga 'dzin pa'o/ /ra'i steng du rdo rje me dmar po g.yas gnyis na rdo rje dang go cha/ g.yon pa gnyis na dbyug pa dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje 'bar ba ma rdo rje me ji lta ba bzhin no/ /ma te'i steng du rdo rje nag po sku mdog nag po rdo rje dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o/ /ro langs ma rdo rje nag mo sku mdog nag mo rdo rje dang kha ṭī ga 'dzin pa'o/ /klu dkar po'i steng du rdo rje lcags kyu sngon po phag pa'i zhal rdo rje dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o/ /skyes bu'i steng du rdo rje gdong ma sngon mo/ phag gdong ma rdo rje dang ral gri 'dzin pa'o//chu srin gyi steng du klu'i rdo rje dkar po sbrul mgo dkar po brgyad dang ldan pa/g.yas pas rdo rje g.yon pas zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /chu srin gyi steng du rdo rje chu srin ma dkar mo sbrul mgo bdun dang ldan pa/ g.yas pas rdo rje g.yon pas rdo 47—1185

rjes yu ba byas pa'i chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan no/ /ri dwags kyi steng du rdo rje rlung sngon po/ g.yas pas rdo rje g.yon pas rlung bsgrib pa'i gos 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje shugs ma rdo rje rlung lta bu'o/ /ro langs kyi steng du rdo rje 'jigs byed sngon po rdo rje dang dbyug to 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje rnam par 'bigs ma rdo rje 'jigs byed lta bu'o/ /yang na g.yon pas zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /tsotsibyi ba'i steng du rdo rje rnam par 'dren ma dkar po tshogs bdag dkar po glang po che'i zhal/ phyag g.yas pa gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dgra sta 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa gnyis kyis sra shing dang dbyug pa 'dzin pa sbrul gyi mchod phyir thogs dang ldan pa'o/ /byi ba'i steng du gtsang ma sngon po/ g.yas pas rdo rje g.yon pas phyag shing 'dzin pa'o/ /sdigs ma ljang khu g.yas pas rdo rje/ g.yon pas ral gri gdengs pa'o/ /dpal mo sku mdog ser mo/ g.yas pa rdo rje/ g.yon pas pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /dbyangs can ma dkar mo g.yas pa na rdo rje g.yon pa na pi wang bsnams pa'o/ /seng ge'i steng du sgrod dka' ①ma ljang khu/ phyag g.yas pa gnyis na ral gri dang 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gnyis na lde men dang ral gri'o/ /mgrin pa sngon po la sogs pa'i lha 'di dag phyag g.yas rdo rje bsnams pa/ g.yon pa de dag gi rdo rje rtse gsum par rig par bya'o/ /nub du klu'i rdo rje dang nye bar pad+ma la gnas pa'i sa'i lha mo gser gyi mdog lta bu phyag gnyis kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 1'dzin pa'o/ /lha ma yin rnams kyi sku mdog sna tshogs pa dang gos sna tshogs bgos nas ral gri 'dzin pa/ ras bal gyi stan 'jam pa la gnas pa'o/ /klu rnams ni nor bu dang ldan pa'i ldengs ①ka can/ btsun mo dang bcas pa thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /lcags ri'i phyi rol tu me'i phyogs su mnar med pa la sogs pa'i 47—1186

dmyal ba rnams so/ /bden bral gyi mtshalas su yi dwags kyi 'gro ba rnams so//rlung gi mtshams su dud 'gro'i 'gro ba rnams so/ /dbang ldan kyi mtshams su mi'i 'gro ba rnams so/ /rim pa 'di ni rgyud gzhan kyi rim pa'i tshul kyis bris pa'o/ /gzhan rdo rje 'jigs byed dang nye ba na sa'i lha mo dang gnod sbyin rnams so/ /rdo rje nag po dang nye ba na lha ma yin rnams so zhes bya ba la sogs pa brjod par byed do/ /dal gyi bdag po'i thugs khar zla ba la ā+oṃ mu ne+e mu ne+e ma hā mu ne+e ye swā hā—/ zhes bya ba'i sngags dgod do/ /snying po'i sngags ni yī na mo bha ga wa ti sarba dur ga ti pā ri sho dha na rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/ ar had de saṃ myag saṃ bud dha ya/tar+ya thā/ ā+oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni/ sarba pā paṃ/ bi sho dha ni/ shud dha bi shud dhe/ sarba karma a pa ra na bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes bya ba ni phreng ba'i sngags so/ /rdo rje 'be+ebs pa'i sngags ni/ yī sarba bid sar+pā pā ya/ ga ti ga ha ni bi sho dha ni hūṃ hoḥphaṭa—/ ces bya ba ste las thams cad pa'i sngags so/ /yī badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ zhes pa gzhan dag gis brjod do// //'byung po 'dul byed kyi dal la rdo rje gur gyi nang du ri rab kyi steng na sna tshogs pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru la sna tshogs rdo rje'i stegs bu'i steng du gzhal yas khang gi lte ba la glang po che'i rgyal po'i steng du 'am/ yang na glang po che med kyang sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la/ 'byung po gzhan gyis mi thub pa dkar po zla ba phyed pa dang 'od zer dang ldan pa'i ral pa'i thor cog dmar po dang ldan pa/ rmang ra dmar po mnga' ba/ thod pa lngas brgyan pa/ spyan gsum pa/ mche ba brtsigs pas 'jigs pas 'jigs su rung ba/ gsus pa 'phyang ba/ mchod 47—1187

phyir thogs dang ldan pa/ stag gi lpags pas phyed dkris pa/ phyag bzhi pa/phyag g.yas pa gnyis kyis gri gug dang ḍa ma ru/ g.yon pa gnyis kyis thod pa dang rtse gsum pa 'dzin pa/ drag po'i gdan la g.yas bskyang g.yon bskum pas bzhugs pa'o/ /'byung po 'dul byed drag po chen po sku mdog sngon po thod pa lngas mtshan pa'i cod pan can de ba lngas dbu la mtshan pa/ dbu skra ser po'i sked par bcings pa/ gos sngon bsnams pa/ zhal mche ba brtsigs pa/spyan gsum dmar ba/ sgeg pa'i gad mo mdzad pa/ phyag bzhi pa'i g.yas dang pos rdo rje sngon po 'jigs pa gsor zhing / g.yon pas sdigs 'dzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin/ phyag gnyis kyis phyag rgya mdzad pa ste/ phyag rgya ni—/ srin lag gnyis ni bsnol nas su/ /mdzub mo gnyis po bskum par bya/ /mthe'u chung dang ni gung mo yang / /mthe bong gis ni mnan par bya/ /ces gsungs so/ /klu'i rgyal po brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan pa ste/ kar ko ta sngon pos dbu skra bcings pa/ 'jog po dmar pos 'gul brgyan byas pa/ dga' bo dang nye dga' bo ser pos rna rgyan byas pa ste/ ser por gcig pas grangs gcig par bya'o/ /mtha' yas dkar pos tshangs skud byas pa/ nor rgyas dkar pos ske rags/ rigs ldan phug ron mdog lta bus phyag rgya bcings pa'i phyag gnyis kyis dpung brgyan/ dung skyong dkar pos gzhan gnyis kyi dpung rgyan—/ pad+ma dang pad ma chen po dmar pos rkang rdub byas te/ de'ang cig gi grangs nges su byas pa'o/ /shar phyogs kyi re'u mig la glang dang nyi ma dbang phyug chen po mtshan ma gyen du langs pa thod pa'i phreng ba can/ thal ba'i mdog spyan gsum pa/ zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor cog can/ sbrul gyi 47—1188

mchod phyir thogs dang bcas pa/ phyag bzhi pa'i g.yas pa gnyis kyis gri gug dang ḍa ma ru/ g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang rtse gsum 'dzin pa'o/ /lho'i phyogs su nam mkha' lding gi steng du khyab 'jug nag po cod pan dmar po can/phyag g.yas gnyis kyis rnga dang dung 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang dbyug to 'dzin pa'o/ /nub phyogs su bya ngang pa dang zla ba'i stengs su tshangs pa dkar po zhal bzhi pa phyag g.yas gnyis kyis bzlas pa'i phreng ba dang gdugs kyi yu ba/ g.yon gnyis kyis pad+ma dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa'o/ /byang phyogs su rma bya dang nyi ma'i steng du gdong drug dmar po tsug phud gsum dang ldan pa—/ g.yas pas rnga yab dang g.yon pas mdung thung 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan gyi mtshams su byi ba dang zla ba la tshogs bdag dkar po glang po'i zhal/spyan gsum pa/ spyi bor zla ba phyed pas brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pa gnyis na la phug dang dgra sta/ g.yon pa gnyis na rtse gsum dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /me'i mtshams su nyi ma'i dal la nyi ma dmar po g.yas pa dang g.yon pa gnyis kyis pad+ma la gnas pa'i nyi ma ste so sor gnyis 'dzin pa'o/ /bden bral gyi mtshams su shing rta'i steng du nyi ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i sgra gcan dmar nag dbu skra ser po gyen la badze+es pa/ mig dang rma ra dmar ba/ mche ba bzhi pa/ zhal cung zad gdangs pa/ phyag gnyis na nyi ma dang zla bar bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar ba'o—/ /rlung gi mtshams su zla ba'i steng du dga' byed dbang phyug ser po/gar byed cing spyi bor zla ba phyed pa can/ sbrul gyi mchod phyir thogs dang ldan pa/phyag gnyis kyi g.yas kyi ḍa ma ru dang g.yon kyis rtse gsum 'dzin pa'o/ /rim pa gnyis pa la shar kyi phyogs su zla ba'i steng du dpal mo dkar mo thugs khar thal 47—1189

mo sbyar bas pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /lho phyogs su zla ba'i steng du thig le mchog ma dmar po gar byed cing spos kyi snod 'dzin pa'o/ /nub phyogs su zla ba'i steng du zla ba mo dmar mo mar me 'dzin pa'o/ /byang phyogs su zla ba'i steng du dka' bzlog ma ser mo gdengs ka'i ①lag pa bzlog nas spyir snebor bzhag pa'o/ /me'i mtshams su rin chen dpal mo dmar mo dri'i dung 'dzin pa'o/ /bden bral du zla ba'i steng du dbyangs can ma ljang khu pi wang gi sgra sgrog pa'o/ /rlung gi mtshams su zla ba la gnas pa'i lha mo mdzes ma nag mo rin po che'i phreng ba 'dzin pa'o—/ /dbang ldan du kun tu 'byor ma zla ba la gnas pa ser mo rdo rje rtse gsum pa 'dzin pa'i phyag gnyis kyis gar byed pa'o/ /rim pa gsum pa'i shar phyogs su glang po sa srungs dang zla ba'i steng du brgya byin ser po mig stong dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i cod pan can g.yas pa skyabs sbyin g.yon pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'o—/ /lho phyogs su ma he dang nyi ma'i steng du gshin rje nag po gsus pa 'phyang ba—/ spyan dang smin ma/ dang rma ra dang ral pa dmar po/ na bza' ser po bsnams pa/ phyag g.yas pas thod pas mtshan pa'i dbyug pa 'dzin pa/g.yon pas sdigs 'dzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /nub phyogs su sbrul dang zla ba'i steng du chu lha dkar po sbrul mgo bdun dang ldan pa/ g.yas pas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas sbrul zhags 'dzin pa'o/ /byang phyogs su lus ngan po ser po sha rgyas shing gsus pa 'phyang ba/ rin po che'i cod pan can/ g.yas pa dang g.yon pa gnyis kyis dbyug to dang ne+e'u le 'dzin pa'o/ /me'i mtshams su ra dang nyi ma'i steng du me lha dmar po ral pa gsum dang ldan pa/ skra dang rma ra ser cing 'bar ba/ gsus pa 'phyang ba/47—1190

phrag pa la phyag tshang rku ba btags pa/ mchod phyir thogs pa can/ g.yas pa gnyis kyis mchog sbyin dang bzlas pa'i phreng ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa gnyis kyis dbyug pa rtse gsum pa dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa'o/ /bden bral kyi mtshams su ro langs dang nyi ma'i steng du srin po nag po/ smin ma dang rma ra dmar po/ phyag g.yas kyis ral gri g.yon pas mi shas gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung gi mtshams su ri dwags dang zla ba'i steng du rlung lha sngon po tsug phud dang ldan pa phyag gnyis kyis rlung yol 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan gyi mtshams su ngang pa dang zla ba'i steng du zla ba dkar po/ phyag g.yon pa me tog ku mu ta la gnas pa'i zla ba dang / g.yas pas mchog sbyin no/ /dbang ldan ni dbang phyug chen po lta bu'o—/ /rim pa bzhi pa'i shar du seng ge'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin ma dkar mo seng ge'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor zla ba'i steng du rnam par rgyal sbyor ma dmar mo lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o/ /nub du zla ba'i steng du pad+ma chen mo dkar mo gzhu dang mda' 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du zla ba'i steng du chang 'phrog ma dmar mo yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du zla ba'i steng du 'phrog mchog ma ser mo me tog dang bcas pa'i ①thal mo thugs khar sbyar ba'o/ /me'i mtshams su zla ba'i steng du rin chen dbang phyug ma ser mo spos phor 'dzin pa'o—/ /bden bral gyi mtshalas su zla ba rgyal ma ser mo dri'i dung 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung gi mtshams su zla ba la 'gro skyong ma ser mo mar me'i skong bu'i sdong bu 'dzin pa'o—/ /'dir khyad par gyi tshig med pa de dag ni gdan sna tshogs pa la gnas pa'o—/ /lha thams cad sems dpa'i dkyil krung can gos dang rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'o/ /'dir dal gyi bdag po'i rigs kyi bdag po mi 47—1191

bskyod pa'o/ /thugs kha'i sa bon ni hūṃ ngo / /hūṃ badz+ra phaṭa ces pa ni snying po'o//yang na/ ā+oṃ byu ta ḍā ma bo'i ra bhu ta a dhi pa ti/ a khyo bh+ya ki ri ḍi na/ sarba bhu ta pri ta bi shā tsa na swā dha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa bya'o①/ /'dir las thams cad pa'i sngags kyang de nyid do// //mkha' 'gro ma lnga'i dal la ni/ rdo rje'i sa la sogs pa nas bzung nas gzhal yas khang gi bar du thog mar ④bstan pa'i 'jam pa'i rdo rje ltar shes par bya'o—/ /de nas dbus kyi gzhal yas khang gi nang du bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ shar la sogs pa'i sgo rnams su gho'u ri la sogs pa'o/ /dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams su puska se la sogs pa'o/ /de la sgo ri ma dkar mo g.yas pas lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ tso ri ser mo g.yas zhags pa 'dzin pa/ bhe ta li dmar mo phyag gnyis kyis lcags sgog 'dzin pa/ ghasma ri ljang khu rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'o①/ /pu ka si sngon mo phyag g.yas na byang chub sems kyi bum pa 'dzin pa/ sa ba ri dkar mo ri rab 'dzin pa/ /tsan ḍa li sngon mo me thab 'dzin pa/ ḍom bhi ni sku mdog sna tshogs ma/ rgyal mtshan chen po'i ba dan 'dzin pa'o/ /shar phyogs kyi gzhal yas khang gi dbus su zla ba'i steng du sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro dkar po ste/ 'di'i rtsa ba'i zhal dkar/ g.yon pa dmar/lhag ma rnams sngon po'o/ /g.yas pa'i thod pa brgyad na rma bya dang ma te dang chu srin kum bhe ra dang / nya dang glang po che dang rus sbal dang sbrul dkar po dang ngang pa'o/ /g.yon pa'i phyag gi thod pa na/ skyin gor rjodang dmigs bu dang sbrul ha la ha la dang / a dzña na ba dang / byi ba dang g.yag dang gos dri can 47—1192

dang tsa da ka dang rnams so/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo rnams dang dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshams rnams la rim pa bzhin du skam pa mo la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams so/ /de'ang / skam pa mo sngon mo phyag na skam dhipa 'dzin pa'o/ /zhags ldan ma ser mo zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /dra ba can dmar mo dra ba 'dzin pa'o—/ /lcags kyu ma ljang khu lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o/ /me tog ma dmar mo me tog gi za ma tog 'dzin pa'o/ /bdug spos ma nag mo spos phor 'dzin pa'o/ /mar me ma ser mo mar me'i yu ba 'dzin pa'o/ /dri chab ma ser mo dri ser pos gang ba'i dung 'dzin pa'o/ /lho'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su rin chen mkha' 'gro ser po te/ 'di'o rtsa ba'i zhal ser po dang / g.yon pa dkar po dang /gzhan rnams ni sngon po'o/ /g.yas pa'i thod pa rnams na ka ran dang / tsalnga bā ga dang / e ḍa ka dang / tsa ko ra dang / bye na dang / bā dzi dang / byube+e dang / kur ba la sogs pa brgyad do/ /g.yon pa rnams la kar ko ta dang rigs ldan dang pad ma dang pad+ma chen po dang 'jog po dang nor rgyas dang mtha' yas rnams so/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo rnams dang dbang ldan la sogs pa'i mtshalas rnams su lha mo rnams so/ /de la nyi phyag ma dkar mo nyi ma'i dal 'dzin pa'o/ /mar me ma sngon mo mar me'i yu ba 'dzin pa'o/ /rin chen sgron ma ser mo rin po che 'dzin pa'o/ /klog phyag ma sngon mo klog 'phro ba 'khril pa 'dzin pa'o/ /sgeg mo dmar mo phyag gnyis kyis ril ba dang bcas pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /phreng ba ma dmar mo phyag gnyis kyis rin po che'i phreng ba 'dzin pa'o—/ /glu ma dmar skya phyag gnyis kyis khar rnga'i sgra'i 'dren pa can 'dzin pa'o//gar ma sna tshogs pa'i mdog phyag gnyis rdo rje dang bcas pas gar byed pa'o/ /47—1193

nub kyi gzhal yas khang gi dbus su pad+ma'i mkha' 'gro ste/ rtsa ba'i zhal dmar po dang / g.yon pa dkar po la zhal lhag ma rnams nag po'o/ /phyag g.yas pa'i thod pa rnams ni/ dom dang bya rgod dang bse dang ba men dang stag dang spre'u dang chu srin ku bi ra dang spyang khu rnams so/ /g.yon pa rnams na khā dang 'ug pa dang bya gag dang seng ge dang bya sa ra sa dang ra dang ri dwags dang phag rnams so—/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo rnams dang dbang ldan la sogs pa rnams la lha mo rnams te/ de la shar phyogs su pad+ma can dkar po phyag na pad+ma'o/ /chos 'byung ma ser mo phyag na chos 'byung bsnams pa'o/ /lcags sgrog ma nag mo phyag na lcags sgog 'dzin pa'o/ /rang mkhyud ma ljang khus sangs rgyas thams cad la rjes su chags pa'i phyag na rdo rje dang thod pa bzung nas rang la mkhyud pa'o/ /gling bu ma dmar mo phyag gnyis kyis gling bu bzung nas sgra sgrogs pa'o/ /pi wang ma ser mo phyag gnyis kyis pi wang bsgreng ba la brtson pa'o/ /mu rnga ra ma zer kun ta ma dkar dmarazer mo phyag gnyis kyis rnga chen brdung ba'o/ /rdza rnga ma ljang khu du ba'i mdog can rdza rnga gdung ba'o/ /byang gi gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sna tshogs mkha' 'gro tsa dur ba ltar ljang ba ste/ 'di'i rtsa ba'i zhal ni rta'i gdong pa ljang khu'o/ /zhal g.yas pa dkar po gzhan rnams ni lha'i zhal lo/ /phyogs cig la rtsa ba'i zhal yang lha'i zhal lo/ /g.yon pa dkar po'o/ /lhag ma rnams ni sngon po'o/ /g.yas pa'i thod pa rnams na/ gza' lhag dang phur bu dang / 'jug rings dang sgra gcan dang mig dmar dang spa ba sangs dang spen pa dang khyab 'jug rnams so/ /g.yon pa rnams la dbang po dang chu lha dang tshangs pa dang drag po dang 'dod pa'i lha dang stobs bzangs dang thang bzangs 47—1194

ris dang stobs can rnams so/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo rnams dang / dbang ldan la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams te/ de la sgo lcags ma dang lha ①mo sgo lcags 'dzin pa'o/ /lde mig ma ser mo lde mig 'dzin pa'o/ /sgo 'dzin ma dmar mo re bzhi 'dzin pa'o/ /ras yol 'dzin ma nag mo ras yol 'dzin pa'o/ /spyan ma dkar mo 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ / mā ma tī ②sngon mo rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /gos dkar mo dkar mo phyag na pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /sgrol ma dmar mo ud pa la sngon po 'dzin pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang chen po'i sgo rnams su dang / dbang ldan la sogs pa la gho ri la sogs pa dang puk+ka si la sogs pa ste sngar bzhin no/ /'dir rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni gdan dang sku mdog dang / dbyibs dang zhal dang phyag la sogs pa rnams kyis te ru ka lta bu'i bdag nyid can gyi dal la ji ltar phyag bcu drug gi dgyes pa'i rdo rje yum dang bcas pa'ang de bzhin no/ /de ltar 'khor lo'i mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa bzhi ni gong du bshad pa'o/ /khyad par rnams las khyad par gzhan na rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang mtshungs so/ /de dag la mkhyud pa'i lha mo rnams ni rim pa ji lta bar spyan ma dang / mā ma gī ①dang /gos dkar mo dang / sgrol ma rnams ni dkar po dang dmar po dang ser po dang ljang khu rnams so/ /gri gug dang sdigs 'dzub dang bcas pa'i phyag gnyis pa'o//mkha' 'gro lnga ni rim pa bzhin rang rang gi de ba lnga'i cod pan no/ /gzhal yas khang thams cad la lha mo rnams ni gcer bu/ spyan gsum zlum la dmar ba/mche ba brtsigs pa/ zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis pa/ dbu skra dmar zhing gyen du badze+es pa/ dpral ba'i dbyes la thod pa dang mgo skam po'i phreng ba'i do shal dang phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa'o/ /sna tshogs pad+ma dang ro dang nyi ma la g.yas 47byed1195

bskum g.yon bskyang ba'i rdo rje'i dkyil krung phyed pa'i gar kyis gnas pa'o/ /gang khyad par ma bshad pa rnams ni g.yon pa'i phyag gis khu tshur snying khar sdigs par mdzad pa'o/ /'khyud ①pa'i lha mo ni gdan tha dad med do/ /gho ri la sogs pa brgyad la rim pa ji lta bar ro'i gdan gyi gnas su/ tshangs pa dang dbang po dang nye dbang dang drag po dang gshin rje dang lus ngan po dang srin po dang thag bzangs ris rnams so/ /zhes pa ni phyogs gzhan no/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang gho ri la sogs pa rnams ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro la mngon par phyogs pa'o/ /lha gzhan rnams ni rang rang gi bdag po nyid la mngon par phyogs pa'o/ /mi bskyod dgyes pa rdo rje'i spyi bor rdo rje 'dzin pa dang rdo rje'o/ /sgo mtshams kyi lha mo rnams la mi bskyod pa dang brtag pa dang rin chen 'byung ldan dang 'od dpag med rnams so/ /brtag pa'i spyi bor 'khor lo 'dzin pa dang 'khor lo'o/ /sgo dang mtshams kyi lha mo rnams kyi thugs rdo rje dang rin chen 'byung ldan dang 'od dpag med dang don yod grub pa'o/ /rdo rje nyi ma la phyag na rin po che dang /yid bzhin nor bu'o/ /sgo dang mtshams kyi lha mo rnams su sku rdo rje dang thugs rdo rje dang 'od dpag med dang don yod grub pa rnams so/ /pad+ma gar kyi dbang phyug la ni pad+ma 'dzin pa dang rdo rjes mtshan pa'i pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /de'i sgo mtshams kyi lha mo rnams la sku rdo rje dang rin chen 'byung ldan dang mi bskyod pa dang tshe dpag med rnams so/ /rta mchog gi ral gri dang ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /sgo dang mtshams kyi lha mo rnams ni sku rdo rje dang gsung rdo rje dang 'od dpag med dang don yod grub pa rnams so/ /phyi rol gyi gho ri la sogs pa ni sngar bzhin no//rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sogs pa'i mkha' 'gro rnams kyi thugs kha'i sa bon ni/ hūṃ 47—1196

ā+oṃ tram̐ aḥkhaṃ zhes bya ba rnams so/ /snying po'i sngags rnams ni/ ā+oṃ dha ra dha ra/d+mā ra ya dhā ra ya/ mar da ya mar da ya/ badz+ra dṛka ①phaṭa swā hā/ ā+oṃ shwa shwa ta ba ra mi shwa shwa ta/ ā+oṃ e bye hai dzñā na dzi na dzig dze+ehūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ yī badz+ra sur+ya ta mo bi dha ma na sa ma ya sto/ hang rad na d+dhāka 1hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ ā+oṃ badz+ra dha ma sa ma ya sto/ hu lu hu lu a ro lig swā hā/ ā+oṃ phu phu nyi hi prad dzñā rjaka ④phaṭa swā hā/zhes bya ba'o/ /na maḥs man ta bud dhe bh+yo/ na mo badz+ra kro dha ya/ ma ḍi jong ka ḍa be+e ra bā la/ badz+ra san to ha/ dar bā ya/ a smri ta kun ḍa li hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes bya ba ni bgegs sel bar byed pa'i sngags te las thams cad pa'i sngags so/ /mkha' 'gro ma lnga po 'di dag gang yang rung ba la rtso bor byed pa de dbus su bsgom par bya'o/ /re re yang de dang de'i dal yin par bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs te/ mgon po gang zhig sangs rgyas ni/ dbus su gyur pa'i dal ni/de nyid kyi ni dal gsungs/ snying po len phyir dal ste/ yang na bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /zhes so// //'khor lo bsgyur ba drug gi dal la/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi'i la sogs pa dang /rtsibs bcu pa'i 'khor lo bsgom pa'i bar 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dal du bstan pa ji lta ba'am/ yang na rtsibs bcu pa'i 'khor lo'i khro bo bcu ni log gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i dal las bshad pa'i rdo rje dbyug pa la sogs pa nas rdo rje sa 'og gi bar du bshad pa lta bu'o/ /'di'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa'i lte ba'i nang du chos 'byung gi nang du rlung dang me dang chu dang gser gyi rang bzhin byi sa gzhi'i dal dang / ri rab kyi steng du sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba la gnas pa'i sna 47—1197

tshogs rdo rje'i dbus su gzhal yas khang chen po'o/ /phyogs kha cig la chos 'byung med do/ /gzhal yas khang gi dbus su gnas pa'i seng ge'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i nyi ma'i dal gyi dbus su bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes rgyud bla ma las gsungs pa'i phyir—/ nyi mar gnas pa'i 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma'i steng du rdo rje dkyil dkrung du gnas pa'i ye shes kyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro ①rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po'am nag po rdo rje dril bu dang bcas pa'i g.yas dang cig shos kyi phyag gis rdo rje lha mo la mkhyud pa'o/ /lha mo ni sdigs 'dzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje'i phyag g.yas pa bskyang ba/ phyag g.yon khrag gis bskang ba'i thod pa 'bul bas yab la mkhyud pa/ sku mdog dmar mo ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma zhes bya ste/ming gzhan chos kyi dbang phyug ma zhes kyang brjod cing / phag mo zhes kyang grag go—/ /de ltar shar la sogs pa nas g.yas skor kyis sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro la sogs pa rnam pa lnga bskyed par bya ste/ de dag gi 'khor rnams kyis dal tha dad la so sor shar la sogs pa'i phyogs rnams su g.yon bskor gyis bskyed cing /me la sogs pa'i mtshams su g.yas bskor gyis bskyed par bya'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyogs bral rnams su rim pa ji lta bas mkha' 'gro ma dang lā ma dang dum skyes ma dang gzugs can ma ④rnams ni sngon po dang ser po dang dmar po dang ljang khu rnams g.yon bskum pa dang g.yas bskyang bas gnas pa'o/ /sgo rnams la thod pa'i dum bu can dang keng rus chen po dang keng rus dang mche ba rnam par brtsigs pa rnams sku mdog nag po rdo rje dril bu dang bcas pa'i phyag gnyis kyis gtum pa dang gtum pa'i mig can ma dang 'od ldan ma dang sna chen ma rnams 47—1198

thal ba dkar po'i mdog can la mkhyud pa'o/ /de nas rnam par snang mdzad kyis gzhal yas khang gi dbus su seng ge'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i tshangs pa'i snying khar sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro rdo rje dkyil dkrung gis bzhugs pa/ sku mdog dkar po 'khor lo dang 'khor los mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa'i phyag g.yas pa dang g.yon pa gnyis kyis sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma la mkhyud pa'o/ /sgo rnams la chang dgra dang / 'od dpag med dang / rdo rje 'od dang / rdo rje'i lus can rnams ni sku mdog dkar po 'khor lo dang 'khor los mtshan pa'i dril bus mtshan pa'i phyag gnyis kyis/ dpa' bo'i blo gros ma dang / mi'u thung ma dang / lang ka'i dbang phyug ma dang / shing grib ma rnams ser mo la mkhyud pa'o/ /rin chen 'byung ldan gyi gzhal yas khang gi dbus su rta'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i nyi ma'i lha dbang phyug chen po'i snying khar rin chen mkha' 'gro rdo rje skyil krungs su bzhugs pa/sku mdog ser po/ rin po che dang rin po ches mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa'i phyag g.yas dang g.yon gnyis kyis rin chen mkha' 'gro la mkhyud pa'o/ /sgo rnams la myu gu can dang / rdo rje ral pa can dang / 'od chen po dang / rdo rje hūṃ mdzad rnams sku mdog ser po 'khor lo dang 'khor los mtshan pa'i dril bu ljang khu 'dzin pa'i phyag gnyis kyis e ra ba ti dang / 'jigs byed chen mo dang /rlung gi shugs ma dang / chang 'thung ma rnams ser mo la mkhyud pa'o/ /snang ba mtha' yas kyi dal gyi dbus su rma bya'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i dbang phyug chen po'i snying khar pad ma mkha' 'gro dmar po rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ pad+ma dang pad mas mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa'i phyag g.yas 47—1199

pa dang g.yon pa gnyis kyis pad+ma mkha' 'gro la mkhyud pa'o/ /sgo rnams la legs bzangs dang rdo rje bzang po dang 'jigs chen po dang mig mi bzang rnams dmar po/ pad+ma dang pad+mas mtshan pa'i dril bur bcas pa'i phyag gnyis kyis lha sngo sangs ①mo dang legs bzangs mo dang rta rna mo dang bya gdong ma rnams dkar mo la mkhyud pa'o/ /mi bskyod pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su glang po che'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i khyab 'jug gi snying khar rdo rje mkha' 'gro nag po rdo rje skyil krungs kyis bzhugs pa/ rdo rje dang rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dril bu phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la mkhyud pa'o/ /lha mo de dag ni dmar mo'am nag mo'o/ /sgo rnams la stobs chen rdo rje dang /rin chen rdo rje dang / rta mgrin dang / nam mkha'i snying po rnams nag po rdo rje dang dril bu dang ldan pa'i phyag gnyis kyis 'khor lo'i shugs can ma dang dum skyes ma dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma rnams ser mo la mkhyud pa'o/ /don yod grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su mkha' lding gi steng du zla ba'i lte ba la rdo rje skyilta dkrung gis bzhugs pa/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro sku mdog ljang khu/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dril bu bzung ba'i phyag gnyis kyis sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma ljang khu la mkhyud pa'o/ /sgo rnams su te ru ka dang pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang rnam par snang mdzad dang rdo rje sems dpa' rnams sku mdog ljang khu/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dril bu phyag gnyis kyis bzung nas/ shin tu dpa' mo dang stobs chen mo dang 'khor lo bsgyur ma dang brtson 'grus chen mo rnams du ba lta bu'i sngo skya'i tshogs la mkhyud pa'o—/ /de ltar dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi po rnams g.yas bskyang ba dang g.yon 47—1200

bskum pas gnas pa'o/ /'dir mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa bzhi ni g.yas pa dang g.yon pa ḍa ma ru dang thod pa dang bcas pa'i kha ṭī 'dzin pa'o/ /ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dang rab tu gtum ma la sogs pa phyag g.yas pas rdo rje dang g.yon pas sdigs mdzub gdengs pa'o/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro dang dpa' mo'i blo gros ma la sogs pa ni sdogs 'dzub dang bcas pa'i 'khor lo'o/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro dang e ra bha ti la sogs pa rnams ni sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i rin po che'o/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro dang sngo bsangs ma la sogs pa rnams ni sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma rnams ni sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje'o/ /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma dang shin tu dpa' mo la sogs pa rnams ni sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'o/ /de ltar ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa ni g.yon pa'i phyogs su khrag gis bkang ba 'dzag pa dang bcas pa'i thod pa 'dzin pas mkhyud pa'o/ /dal chen po'i sgo rnams la khwa gdong ma dang 'ug gdong ma dang khyi gdong ma dang phag gdong ma rnams ming gi rjes su 'brang ba'i zhal te rim pa ji lta bas sngon po dang ser po dang dmar po dang ljang khu'i mdog can no/ /phyag g.yas pa rnams na lcags kyu dang zhags pa dang lcags sgrog dang dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /mtshams bzhi na gshin rje bsreg byed ma1 dang gshin rje 'joms ma dang gshin rje mche baṃ mo dang / gshin rje brtan ma4 rnams ni mi'i gdong pa g.yas dang g.yon pa'i mdog bye brag g.yas g.yon gyi sku phyed phyed dang ldan pa'o/ /phyag g.yas pa rnams na me long dang pi wang dang dri'i dung dang ro'i snod dang rnams 'dzin pa'o/ /lha mo brgyad po 'di dag kyang phyag g.yon pas 47—1201

thod pa dang kha ṭaṃ ga 'dzin pa'o/ /zhabs g.yon bskum pa dang g.yas bskyang bas gnas pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang drug po rnams kyi mtshams su sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba la sogs pa'i thod pa rnams so—/ /mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa nas gshin rje 'joms ma'i mthar thug pa rnams ni sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /'khor lo bsgyur ba rnams kyi khyad par ni ro la gnas pa'o zhes bya ba yang phyogs cig go/ /dpa' bo rnams ni sku smad stag gi sham thabs rnam phyed dkris pa/mchod phyir thogs can/ mi mgo rlon pa'i do shal mgrin pa la 'phyang ba/ral pa nag po'i thor tshugs can no/ /dpa' mo rnams ni gcer bu skra nag po gol zhing mi mgo skam po'i phreng ba 'phyang ba'o/ /lha bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis po thams cad kyang zhal cig pa phyag gnyis pa spyan gsum pa/ dpral ba'i steng du rdo rje'i phreng ba dang bcas pa'i thod pa lngas brgyan pa/ dbu brgyan dang g.yer ka la sogs pas brgyan pa dang phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa'o/ /yang na 'khor lo bsgyur ba rnams phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa'o/ /zla ba phyed pa nor bu dang bcas pa sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor cog can dag go/ /lha mo sum cu rtsa bzhi po de dag kyang so so rang rang gi dal gyi bdag po la mngon par phyogs pa'o/ /'khor lo bsgyur ba lnga dang / khyi gdong ma la sogs pa ni dbus kyi dal gyi bdag po la zhal mngon par phyogs pa'o/ /dpa' bo rnams ni rang rang gi shes rab ma la zhal mngon par phyogs pa'o/ /de ltar bshad pa de ni gzhung cig go/ /'khor lo bsgyur ba drug po 'di dag kyang zhabs g.yon bskum pa dang g.yas bskyang bar 'dod pa ni phyogs gnyis pa'o/ /phyogs 'di la yang ye shes kyi 47—1202

mkha' 'gro ma dang sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro dang / de dag gi 'khor rnams kyang seng ge'i steng du gnas pa dang / rin chen mkha' 'gro dang de'i 'khor rnams kyang rta'i steng du gnas pa dang / pad+ma'i mkha' 'gro dang de'i 'khor rnams rma bya'i steng du gnas pa dang / rdo rje'i mkha' 'gro dang de'i 'khor rnams kyang glang po che'i steng na gnas pa dang / sna tshogs mkha' 'gro dang de'i 'khor rnams kyang nam mkha' lding gi steng na gnas pa'o/ /ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa 'di dag kyang rdo rje dkyil dkrung dang / khyi gdong ma la sogs pa phyogs mtshams skyong ba brgyad ni g.yon bskum pa dang g.yas bskyang bas phyogs skyong ba brgyad kyi gdan la gnas pa'o zhes bya ba ni phyogs gsum pa'o/ /phyogs 'di dag dang phyogs gzhan rnams la'ang ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa rnams nyid zhal cig phyag bzhi pa la sogs pa dang zhal gsum phyag drug pa la sogs pa nyid dang / zhal lnga phyag drug ma la sogs pa dang / zhal cig phyag gnyis pa la sogs pa dang / zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa la sogs pa nyid dang /zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa la sogs pa nyid bcom ldan 'das kyis rab tu spros nas gsungs te/ gzhung mangs pas 'jigs nas 'dir ma bkod do/ /'di dag gi rigs kyi bdag po rnams ni 'khor lo bsgyur ba drug la/ so sor rang gi 'khor rnams la dal gyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa'o/ /'khor lo bsgyur ba lnga la ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro'o/ /de nyid la ni ye shes mkha' 'gro'o/ /khwa gdong la sogs pa la ni sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ste/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro dag la la 'dod do / /ye shes mkha' 'gro la sogs pa rim pa ji lta bar thugs kha'i sa bon ni/oṃ hūṃ/ i hri hūṃ khaṃ zhes so/ /snying po'i sngags ni ā+oṃ shrī ma hā su ka badz+ra swā hā/47—1203

ḍā ki ni dz+wa la saṃ bha ra hūṃ aḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ ā+oṃ shri bud dha ḍā ①ki ni/ a la la la/bye ā/ ḍā ⑤ki ni dz+wa la saṃ bha ra hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ ā+oṃ shri rad na ḍā ki ni tai aḥhūṃ ḍā ①ki ni dz+wa la saṃ bha ra hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ ā+oṃ shrī pad+ma ḍā ki hriḥ.aḥhūṃ phaṭa/ ḍā rjoki ni dz+wa la saṃ dzha ra hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ ā+oṃ shrī badz+ra ḍā ka rjo.aḥhūṃ phaṭa/ ḍā ki ni dz+wa la saṃ bha ra hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ yī shri bi shā ḍā ka hoḥkhaṃ a hūṃ/ ḍā ki ni dz+wa la saṃ bha ram̐ hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pas so/ /ā+oṃ khaṇa ḍa ro ha hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes bya ba ni dum skyes ma'i ste las thams cad pa'i sngags so// //dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dal la rdo rje gur gyi nang du bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa'o/ /de'i shar dang lho dang nub dang byang gi rtsibs rnams la/shin tu stobs dang / rmongs byed dang / rengs byed dang / nga rgyal byed pa rnams ste/ bgegs mthar byed dang / shes rab mthar byed dang / gshin rje mthar byed dang / pad+ma mthar byed ces bya ba'i ming gi rnam grangs so/ /me'i mtshams la sogs pa'i rtsibs rnams la/ dbyug pa sngon po dang 'dod pa'i rgyal po dang stobs po che dang / mi g.yo ba rnams so/ /steng du gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba'o/ /'og du gnod mdzes rgyal po'o/ /de skad du yang rtsa ba'i rgyud las gsungs pa/ 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa'i phyogs dang phyogs bral la gnas pa'i khro bo'i tshogs ni bsgom par bya zhes pa dang / dri ma med pa'i 'od las kyang / bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la khro bo la sogs pa spro bar bya ste/ dal gyi sa gzhi bsrung ba'i don du'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /khro bo 'di dag di 'og nas 'chad pa'i gzugs can no/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du chos 'byung ngo / /47—1204

de skad du 'ang dri ma med pa'i 'od las gsungs pa/ phyi rol gyi skye ba mtshan pa'i phyir nam mkha'i dbyings mtha' yas pa'o/ /lhag par nang du bdag nyid shes rab chos 'byung gru gsum mo/ /zhes so/ /nam mkha'i dbyings nyid chos 'byung du bsgom par bya'o zhes dal du nges par ro/ /chos 'byung de'i dbus suka me dngakha rlung dngag chu dngang sa'i dal la gnas pa'i ri rab dang / sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma dang thig le nag po'i gzugs sgra gcan dang bcas pa'i phyi rol tu rdo rje phreng ba'i 'od zer gyis bskor ba nam mkha' dang rlung dang me dang chu dang sa'i dal gyis bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang chen po'o/ /yang na bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bgegs nye bar zhi ba tsam gyi dgos pa'o/ /zhes 'dod pas bgegs bsrung ba'i rjes la kha cig gis chos 'byung bsgom par byed do/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i gur kyi nang du nam mkha'i dbyings dang me'i 'khor lo la sogs pa rnams phyi rol gyi dal nas bzung nas sgra gcan 'dzin gyi mthar thug pa'i steng du gnas pa phyi rol tu me la sogs pas bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang ngo / /de'i phyed kyis gsung gi 'khor lo'o/ /de'i phyed kyis thugs kyi 'khor lo'o/ /de'i phyed kyis bde chen kyi 'khor lo'o/ /de'i byed kyis gtso bo'i pad+ma ljang khu'o//pad ma'i cha gsum ze'u 'bru'o/ /de'i steng dang steng na gnas pa'i zla ba dang nyi ma dang sgra gcan dang dus kyi me'i dal kyi steng du gan rkyal du gnas pa'i yan lag med pa dang drag po'i snying khar g.yon bskum zhing g.yas bskyang bas gar byed pa'i bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo nag po/ nor bu dang zla ba phyed pa 'dzin pa/ sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan pa'i ral pa'i thor cog can/ rdo rje'i nor bu dang rdo rje'i rna cha dang / rdo rje'i phyag rdub dang / rdo rje ske rags dang /47—1205

rdo rje'i rkang rdub dang rdo rje'i thod phreng dang rdo rje'i phreng ba dang / stag gi wags pa g.yo bas gnam phyed dkris pa/ zhal bzhi pa spyan bcu gnyis pa'o/ /de la rtsa ba'i zhal nag po/ drag po mche ba brtsigs pa'o/ /g.yas pa dmar po chags pa dang bcas pa/ nub ser po ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa/ g.yon dkar po zhi ba/ mgrin pa gsum pa/ dbus sngon po/ g.yas dmar po/g.yon dkar po/ g.yas pa'i dpung ①pa sngon po/ gnyis pa dmar po/gsum pa dkar po/ de bzhin du g.yon pa'i sngon po dang dmar po dang dkar po ste dpung pa drug go/ /phyag ngar bcu gnyis la nye ba'i phyag mgo nyi shu rtsa bzhi'o//de la g.yas kyi phyag rnam pa gnyis sngon po gnyis dmar po gnyis dkar po ste/de bzhin du g.yon pa dag kyang shes par bya'o/ /de bzhin du phyag mgo rnam pa bzhi nag po/ bzhi dmar po/ bzhi dkar po ste/ g.yas g.yon gnyis so/ /phyag re re la sor mo lnga lnga las de dag gi tshigs rnam pa gsum mo/ /de la mthe bong ser po/ mdzub mo dkar po/ gung mo srin lag nag po/ mthe'u chung ljang khu'o/ /phyag gi dkyil nas sor mo thams cad kyi tshigs kyi phreng ba dang po'i bar nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po ste/ de dag gi sor rdub rnams la 'od zer 'bar ba dang ldan pa'o/ /g.yas pa'i phyag nag po rnams kyis rdo rje dang ral gri dang rtse gsum dang gri gug rnams 'dzin pa'o/ /dmar po rnams kyis me'i mda' dang rdo rje lcags kyu dang ḍa ma ru dang tho ba 'dzin pa'o/ /dkar po rnams kyis 'khor lo dang mdung dang dbyug to dang dgra sta rnams 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa'i nag po rnams na rdo rje dril bu dang phub ring mo dang kha ṭī ga dang khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa rnams so/ /dmar po 47—1206

rnams la gzhu dang zhags pa dang nor bu rin po che dang pad ma dmar po rnams so/ /dkar po rnams la dung dang me long dang rdo rje lcags sgrog dang tshangs pa'i mgo bo rnams so/ /g.yas pa'i zhabs brla man chad dmar po'i mthil gyis drag po dang dkar po zhal cig spyan gsum pa/ phyag bzhi pa/ rtse gsum dang / ḍa ma ru dang thod pa dang kha ṭī ga 'dzin pa'i snying khar mnan pa'o/ /'dod chags kyi lha phyogs su dga' ba mo dang dbang phyug chen mo'i phyogs su dkar mo ste/ lha mo 'di dag ni rnam par mnan pas nyams chung ba'i zhal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis mkhyud pa'i sna tshogs yum ni g.yas bskum zhing g.yon bskyang bas gnas pa'o/ /gser rmi mdog lta bu phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis gri gug dang lcags kyu dang ḍa ma ru dang bzlas pa'i phreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa rnams na nya phyis dang zhags pa dang pad+ma dkar po dang rin po che rnams so/ /shar kyi 'dab ma la nag mo 'bar ma ni nag mo phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis/ snod dang tsan dan gyi snod dang gur gum kyi snod dang gla rtsi dang bcas pa'i ga bur gyi snod dang / g.yon pa rnams na dril bu dang pad ma dang ljon shing gi me tog dang me tog sna tshogs kyi phreng ba 'dzin pa'o/ /lho phyogs kyi 'dab ma la dmar mo 'bar ma dmar mo/ g.yas pa rnams kyis mar me dang do shal dang cod pan dang lag rdub po/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis gos dang ske rags dang rin po che'i rna rgyan dang rkang rdub 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu ser mo 'bar ma sku mdog ser mo g.yas pa rnams kyis dung dang gling bu dang nor bu dang cang te'u'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis pi wang dang rnga dang mkhar rnga dang zangs dung ngo / /byang du skar mo 'bar ma sku mdog dkar mo/ /g.yas pa rnams kyis 'o ma'i snod dang chu'i snod dang 47—1207

sman gyi snod dang chang gi snod do/ /g.yon pa rnams su bdud rtsi'i snod dang bcud len gyi snod dang bdud rtsi shing thog gi snod dang zan kyi snod 'dzin pa'o/ /me'i mtshams la sogs pa rnams la du ba ma dang / mig rgyu ma dang / mar me ma dang / mkha' gsal ma rnams kyi lha mo ste/ rim pa ji lta bar nag po dang dmar po dang ser po dang dkar po'i mdog can/ phyag brgyad kyis rang rang gi mdog dang mtshungs pa'i rnga ma 'dzin pa'o/ /de dag gi rgyab kyi phyi rol tu yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang / chos kyi ghan dhe dang dpag bsam gyi shing dang chos kyi dung rnams/ nag po dang dmar po dang ser po dang dkar po'o/ /nag mo 'bar ma la sogs pa 'di brgyad ni zhabs gnyis mnyam par gshibs te bzhengs pas gnas pa'o/ /sna tshogs yum la sogs pa'i lha mo 'di rnams rgo phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ phyag brgyad pa/ zhal bzhi pa/ spyan bcu gnyis pa'o/ /de la shar dang lho dang nub dang byang gi rim pa'i zhal rnams so/ /sna tshogs yum gyi ser po dang dkar po dang sngon po dang dmar po rnams so/ /de las ser mo rnams kyi yang de dang mtshungs so/ /nag mo rnams kyi yang nag po dang dmar po dang ser po dang dkar po rnams so/ /dmar po rnams kyi dmar po dang ser po dang dkar po dang sngon po rnams so/ /dkar mo rnams kyi dkar po dang nag po dang dmar po dang ser po rnams so/ /rim pa gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i lha rnams ni phyag drug pa zhal gsum pa spyan dgu pa'o/ /de la shar phyogs su don yod grub pa nag po nag po dang dmar po dang dkar po'i zhal rnams so/ /phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri dang gri gug dang rtse gsum pa rnams 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis phub chung dang thod pa dang kha ṭaṃ ①ga 'dzin pa'o/ /spyan 47—1208

mas mkhyud pa'o/ /lho'i phyogs su rin chen 'byung ldan dmar po/ dmar po dang dkar po dang nag po'o/ /g.yas rnams kyis me'i mda' dang rdo rje lcags kyu dang cang te'u rnams so/ /g.yon pa rnams na gzhu dang rdo rje zhags pa dang rin po che rtse dgu pa 'dzin pa/ ma ma ki la mkhyud pa'o/ /nub tu rnam par snang mdzad ser po ser po dang dkar po dang nag po'i zhal/ g.yas pa rnams kyis 'khor lo dang dbyug pa dang mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang / rdo rje'o/ /g.yon pa rnams kyis dung dang / lcags sgrog dang rdo rje dang gri gug 'dzin pa yum sgol ma la mkhyud pa'o/ /byang du snang ba mtha' yas dkar po zhal dkar po dang nag po dang dmar ba/ g.yas pa rnams kyis tho ba dang mdung dang rtse gsum pa dang / g.yon pa rnams kyis pad+ma dkar po dang me long dang phreng ba rnams 'dzin pa gos dkar mo la mkhyud pa'o/ /bzhi po 'di dag ni pad+ma dkar po dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i ral pa'i thor cog can te/ zhal rnams ni rtsa ba dang g.yas dang g.yon pa'i go rims bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /me'i mtshams dang bden bral gyi mtshams dang rlung gi mtshams dang dbang ldan gyi mtshams su pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba la sgrol ma dang gos dkar mo dang spyan ma dang ma ma ki rnams rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du don yod grub pa dang rin chen 'byung ldan dang brtag pa dang snang ba mtha' yas dang mtshungs pa la/ rnam par snang mdzad dang snang ba mtha' yas dang don yod grub pa dang rin chen 'byung ldan rnams kyis mkhyud pa'o/ /sgrol ma'i kha ṭī ga'i gnas su ud pa la zhes kyang bshad do/ /mtshalas brgyad du bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa brgyad do/ /rim pa gsum pa'i snam bu la shar sgo'i g.yon ngos su kun tu bzang po sngon po/ g.yas pa rnams 47—1209
