'byor pa'i dbugs rnams ni/ /yang gsal g.yo'i dam rdzas te/ /byang phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs la dgod/ /hūṃji snyed 'byor pa'i tsi ta snying srog pa tsa ma bral bdang / /rtsa lag ma nyams bcu bzhi dag /ma mo bcu bzhi'i rdzas yin te/ /pad ma chen po bcu bzhi la'o/ /gnyis pa padamadangos grub gsol byang thod pa mtshan ldan dang / /zhal zas rlog pa spyan gzigs sna tshogs gzhag par bya/ /sha rus rkang dang tshil chen dang / /glo snying mkha' stim nang khrol bcas/ /sman mor grags pa'i dam rdzas te/ /bar khyams dag la dgod par bya/ /de la sogs ste dam rdzasadus rdzas lus mdor spyi la da las kun/ /gsum ga blo ldan kyis ni dgod par bya/ /dam rdzas rten rdzas brda' rdzas dang / /sgrub rdzas da la rgyan gyis rdzas/ /'di ni mkha' 'gro rtsa lngar gsungs/ /ma mo sgrub pa byed pa logs pa ming gis med du mi rung ngo / /de la cha gsum btang yang dag dang mthun sgrub pa'i'adugathabs rnal 'byor pa/ /bla ma lung ldan 'khor bcas kyang / /khrus byas las kyi gzhung la 'jug /dpal rdzas las kyi da la mchod pa'i phyir/ /de bas spags pa'i lho phyogs su/ /stegs bu khru gang gru bzhi la/ /sna tshogs khrag gis chag chag gdab/ /dbus su dpal gyi gtor ma gzhag /dpalagang byed las kyi bya ba gzhung bsnyesapabazhin no/ /de bas spags pa'i nub phyogs su/ /sgrub po'i tshe dang dpal dgug pa'i phyir/ /stegs bu de bzhin khru gangabazhi la/ /dbang gi zla gam dmar po bri/ /dbus su mdzes pa'i tshebum pa dang / /snying po lngardzas sman wī rnams bcas pa la /'gul pa tshesadar dkar ba su gdags 'bul྾/ /rgod mda' dngaleb rgan dag gis brgyan/ /man ngag ldan pas tshe dpal drang / /cho ga rgyas pa'i mchod pa'i phrin las gzhung khungalas brtag /ma mo'i lasamakhan 'phrin las byas nas bya/ /de 47—1377

nas lta spyod ting nge gdeng ldan rtogasapa'i slob dpon des/ /sgrub pa'i bcol ri sa la bab tsa na 'phrin las gzhung bsrang baspyodadrang dbul nas/ /snang ba tshigachenagyi me mar kha lnga bltam//zasachen rdzas chen po ni gnyis sposabasregs nas/ /mchog gi ser 'phreng chen po 'grang / /chas zhagathal khrag chen po ni nyid mthing nag brgyan ste/ /rag ta la ni srog snying drang / /tsi ta'i mamo'isnying po'i don dkyil nas drangs nas ni/ /ma mo rnams rang dbang med par mngon du 'ong bar dmigs pa la/ /lasabazhigang 'dod las bcol las byed par dmigs/ /srog gi snying po so sor rang re'i/ /rtsa ba'i ①rgyud dgupa las bco lnga pa ltar las gsungs pabazhin drang / /tshad ni nyin dang mtshan mo la/ /stong ngam yang na 'bum du bzlas/ /de bzhin rtags dge byung ba na/ /sgrub pa chen po brtsam par bya'o/ /sgrub pa'i rim pa'o// //bcu bzhi pa de nas 'khor dang bcas pa kun/ /bsgrub pa chen po brtsam pa'i phyir—/ /bzang ngan rtags kyi cha phye ba/ /rtags byung ba la gzugs sgra dri rnam gsum ste/ /gcig la'ang gsum du shes par bya/ /gzugs rgyas pa ni bud med dkar mo mdzes pa sitiblang rab/ /dmar mo 'bring na cho ga skyar la bya ②chags chen 'gying ma 'bring / /nag mo bskang so bya ba mi sdug ngan par gnyis sam rtags de la mdog bshad—/ /mi drag 'brug sgra dril bu rab①/ /klu ngadang sgyugs pa 'bringadu ba brtag /ru dang gson po'ibla mgoskam drud 'dra ngan par bshad/ /dmar gsal rtags khyab pa 'od rab kyi/ /til dkar me 'dra 'khyil ba 'bring / /me ribukhyer shugs zhugasa'adra ngan thamapa'o/ /mkhas pas rtags gsal degong gibazhin dushes par byas si ti blang nas// /si ) blang ba dings de la sa bkrashis rab la dngos grub blang ngo mche na ldan 47—1378

ka pa la gsolabyang/ /'dza gad bu ram sbrang rtsi ltam/ /dar dkar tshil bus kha bcad ltotshilaspyan gzugs shamar ni/ /snacho gas pa nub tha ma la cha gsum drang sngon 'gro mthun phrin las bsrang tshogs dbul sbyin sreg bya dang bzhes skrum ldan/ /bzhag nas phyirakhrus byas las gzhung mchodapa'i'aphrin las bsrang te/ /dngos grub rim pa blang bar bya/ /hūṃ tshig bskul chos kyi sku las 'bar ba'i sku bzhengs pa/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i sku mnga' bas/ /'gro 'dul thabs kyi 'phrin las cir yang ston/ /bla med khrorgyal che mchog sidha rtsal du gsol bya'o/ /khrag 'thung dngos grub sprul du gsol/ /hūṃ sku rigs las barma la 'khril ba'i yum chen mi phyed ma/ /kun la dbang bsgyur srid pa gsum gyi bdag /gang la ma chags 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i yum/ /mi bzad yon tan rgyal mo'i dngos grub gsol/ /hūṃ dbyings rangargyud las bskyed pa'i ma chen rgyal mo drug /'byung ba cha snyoms ma mo kun gyi gtso'/ /ma chen khyed la mngon shes drug mnga' bas/ /mngon shes drug gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /hūṃ bde 'gro la sogs bcu bzhi'i tshogs ces brjod la ban dha'i chang gsol byin po blang kyin snying la bdug cing sbyin srig byed hom du bya/ mi byed na dam rdzas su chags bya/ mar me snying la thig la rgya mtsho stem zhal zas rol bkra shis bya/ /'dul ba'i dbang gis ri yang sku sprul ma/ /ma chenaspyod la thun mong rdzu 'phrul tshogs mnga' bas/ /rkang mgyogs la sogs dngos grub stsal du gsol—/ /hūṃ lasabasod nams tshogs las grub pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /chags byed la sogs lnga bcu rtsa lnga'i tshogs/ /ma chenar+ṣa la mthu rtsal stobs mnga' bas//drag po sgrol ba'i dngos grub sprul ma mor byas la bza' btung du gsol/ /sgrub pa chen po'idabyibs rimapa'o/ /47—1379

de la dang po thog mar bsnyen pa bya ba bstan shesabyaganas gtsal ba ba/ /bkra shis la nyams dga' ba dbe+en pa'i gnas rtsal nas/ / la sogs ①'thabamo las rgyalaba'i sa'irang bzhin nus mthus yod las 'dzin pa la/ /stegs bu tshadakhru gang gru bzhi brtsig chag chag gdab /sha khrag khardzas rtor rag rtsi mchod pa dbus bzhag nas/ /de nas ting 'dzin rnam las rim pa lnga las gsumagazhal yas khang baspyod pa nas/ /sa bon bye las bskyed bya ba/ /bsnyen pa'i dal rtsibs bsnyen pa la don bzhi las dang po gnas btsal ba brgyad la/ /gru chad bar khyams shaldan par ①bsgom/ /de'i dbus su bdag gi dngos/ /gnyis pa lha bskyed pa la gnyis gtso bo dang 'khor las dang po gtso bo bskyed pa swa bon las chogagasum ni sku bzla/da pa/ /sngags bcom ldan che mchog he ru ka /che mchog kro ti shwa ri gnyis/ /dregs pa'i stan la bzhugs par bsams/ /de nas gnyis med 'khor bskyed pa la gsum la yum bskyed pasems sprin las/ /sa bon las ni bskyed baspyodapabya ba/ /gtso mo yum chen drug gi sku/ /bton nas go char dgod bya ste/ /cig shos mu kho la thugs kar byung bas kro'i thugs kar thim zer thugs la sbas pa yin/ /snying ka skye mched drug dngasam las dgal/ /rtsa ba'i mkha' gsang bla ma rgyud bzhin dgod par bya/ /'phra men bskyed pa'i ma mo las rgya mtsho rjemo baspyod pa man chad kyang / /bdag gi 'khor du bzhugs bya ba/ /rgya mtsho ma dang thod 'phreng gnyis/ /bdag nyid chen mo'i mdun rgyab la'o/ /'khros pa'i ma bzhi la sogs rnams/ /rtsibs brgyad rtsibs mchan bzhi la bzhugs/ /sman mo smanamo'igazhan rnams don gyis gsal rigs thigs ltar/ /de nas drang stem go rims bshad te bya/ /dgug dang stemagazhug dang phyag snyanagasan phyag btsalab/ /bdud rtsi rnam rtorakhrag gsum sbyin pa rtsidang / /'dza'abum bzlas bstod dang ga gis 'phrin las bsnyen pa'i dus su bcol ring mi bya bcol bya ste/ /bco brgyad rgungagi phyed cha phyed kyis 47—1380

bsten rim rdzogs/ /man ngag bla las shes par ma mo srog zin pa la sogs pa bya 'dzab bya ba te ru ka kro ta sha ri sto/ kerihūṃ ha te phaṭa/ yumadum mā yo gi ni/ ru lu bh+yo/bā bzhim ma yo gi ni/ ru lu bh+yo/ smanam mā yo gi ni/ ru lu bh+yo/ hūṃ bstod pa'i bcom ldan che mchog he ru ka /dbu dgu phyag kyang bco brgyad ste/ /zhabs kyang rnam pa brgyad du bgrad/ /dbus kyi dbu gsum rol pa ni/ /zhe sdang 'khor ba rtsad bcad nas/ /skye ba med pa'i thugs dang sbyor/ /dbu gsum g.yas nas zhi ba ni/ /gti mug 'khor ba rtsad bcad nas/ /'byung ba med pa'i sku dang sbyor/ /dbu gsum g.yon nas gshe ba ni/ /'dod chags dngos po rtsad bcad nas/ /chags pa med pa'i gsung dang sbyor/ /spyan mig 'bar ba nyi shu bdun/ /'khor ba'i sems can thams cad la/ /gzigs pas thams cad bde la 'god/ /spyan dgu dbus kyis gzigs pa yis/ /byams pa thugs rje 'bar ba'i spyan/ /gzigs pas thams cad bde bar byed/ /spyan dgu g.yas kyis gzigs pa yis/ /ma rig mun pa sel ba'i spyan/ /rmongs pa'i sems can sel bar mdzad/ /spyan dgu g.yon nas gzigs pa yis//rnam par mi rtog rang rig spyan/ /'khor ba'i bag chags sel bar mdzad/ /zhal dgu gdangs ste 'od zer gyis/ /skye dgu zhal du rngub par mdzad/ /phyag dgu g.yas nas rol pa ni/ /skye dgu nyon mongs gnas su 'joms/ /phyag dgu g.yon nas rol pa yis/ /sa dgu'i sdug bsngal gtan nas sbyong / /g.yas kyi dang po rdo rje bsnams pa ni/ /ye shes rnam pa lnga dang sbyor ba'i rtags//g.yas kyi 'og ma'i phyag brgyad na/ /ke ri sha za brgyad 'phyar zhing / /'khor ba'i sems can thams cad kun/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i dbyings la 'god/ /47—1381

g.yon gyi dang po ban dha rag tas bskang ba bsnams pa ni/ 'khor ba'i sha khrag zhal du gsol ba'i rtags/ /g.yon gyi 'og ma'i phyag brgyad na/ /mu ka 'phra men brgyad 'phyar zhing / /'khor ba'i sems can thams cad kun/ /bde ba chen po'i dbyings la 'god/ /sku la rgyan chas brgyad dang ldan/ /thod pa tshar gsum zhags pa ni/ /dug gsum 'khor ba rtsad nas gcod/ /sku gsung thugs kyi ngang la sbyor/ /glang chen ko rlon gsol ba ni/ /nga rgyal dbang du sdud pa'i rtags/ /zhing chen g.yang gzhi gsol ba ni/ /'dod chags dbang du sdud pa'i rtags/ /thal chen tshom bu bris pa ni/ /sa gsum bsnyes pa'i mtshan ma'o/ /zhing chen g.yang gzhi gsol ba ni/ /'dod chags dbang du sdud pa'i rtags/ /sbrul gyi chun pos brgyan pa ni/ /zhe sdang dbang du sdud pa'i rtags/ /rag ta'i thig les brgyan pa ni/ /sems can don la chags pa'i rtags/ /zhag gi zo ris bris pa ni/ /don dam thugs su chud pa'i rtags//dregs pa khyo shugs gdan stengs su/ /zhabs gnyis bskyang nas bzhugs pa ni/ /'gro don ma lus mdzad pa'i rtags/ /zhabs gnyis gyad kyi dor thabs ni/ /bdud dang mu stegs 'dul ba'i rtags/ /zhabs gnyis phyogs bzhir dgrad pa'i sa/ /bdud bzhi zil gyis gnon pa'i rtags/ /de 'dra rdzogs pa'i te ru ka /khro rgyal khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de nas gnyis med sbyor ba ni/ /yum chen kro ti shwa ri ma/ /khro mo gnam zhal dbyengs kyi yum/ /dbu dgu phyag kyang bco brgyad ste/ /rnam par thar pa'i dbu dgu 'is/ /theg pa dgu'i rtsad bcad nas/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang la sbyor/ /phyag kyang rnam pa bco brgyad te—/ /khams chen bco brgyad rtsad nas bcad/ /stong pa bco brgyad dbyings 47—1382

la 'khod/ /zhabs kyang gtso bo yab dang 'dra/ /dur khrod chas brgyad de bzhin te/ /sku la yon tan dpal 'bar ma/ /yum chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod—/ /de bzhin bdag nyid byin ldan pas/ /bsnyen pa zhes su gsungs pa yin/ /zhag gsum bsnyen pa byas nas kyang / /de nas bsgrub pa brtsam par bya'o/ /bsnyen pa'i rim pa'o// //sgrub chen rdzogs nas mdos kyis rtsa rgyud kyi le'u rtsa dgu pa la zhalastobs sirnyi zhal nas phyi ma'i phyi ma le'u brgyad pa phyi ma nyer gnyis pa las phyi ma nyer bdun nas sa bzhi yan chad bya/ /nyams pa gso' phyir tshe bsgrub chen po brtsam/ /thun dbab lha dang bral ba skabs dang sbyar/ /dbang drag 'phrin las brtsam pa rtsa rgyud bcu dgu pa las rgyud las brtag /thar pa bstab pa phyi ma le'u bzhi bcu pa rtsa rgyud rtsa gsum pa las thob phyir dbang bskur rim par nas/ /phyi mabazhi bcubasreg dang 'phang dang gtad pas ①las bzhug bsdu'/ /man ngag kha bskang gi rim pa'o// //dge rtsa bla ma'i snyan khung rim brgyud nas/ /bsgrub pa las kyi rim pa bris/ /ngal bar gyur pa'i dge rtsa gang / /phyi rabs rnal 'byor don du bsngo/ /bsgrub pa'i thabs chen bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ slob dpon shan ting gar pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //u rgyan mkhan po pad ma sam bha ba dang / bod kyi lo tsha ba bai ②ro tsa nas bsgyur ba'o// //spri/ maṅga lo/47—1383
